title: 3D Computer Vision Research Engineer, Geospatial Visual Localization
descriptionHtml:
About Niantic Spatial

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time.

That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

About the Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer to help develop our Geospatial Visual Localization technologies, which allows people and robots to accurately localize themselves anywhere on the planet.

This is an end-to-end applied research role. You will develop new approaches to open problems alongside our researchers in 3D vision and machine learning, and publish your work at leading conferences. You will help build and train large models on large-scale multi-modal datasets, including our proprietary collection of 30 billion posed images and ship them into production, to be used by people and robots from all over the world.

Our team works with heterogeneous captures from phones and other handheld devices, 360 cameras, vehicles, and drones, as well as aerial and satellite imagery, LiDAR, and external geographic data. Your focus will be to improve accuracy and robustness across urban and rural locations, cameras, seasons, weather, and capture quality. The system must remain reliable with noisy GPS, in GPS-denied environments, and with outdated reference maps. Each pose estimate comes with an uncertainty that our customers rely on, and keeping it well calibrated across these conditions is part of the work.

What You'll Do

  • Design, implement, and evaluate novel visual localization algorithms, combining 3D vision and deep learning.

  • Train large models on multi-modal data at scale, and build the benchmarks that measure their accuracy and robustness.

  • Develop robust solutions for difficult real-world conditions: noisy or denied GPS, changing appearance, varying capture quality, large geographic extents, and imperfect reference maps.

  • Work side-by-side with leading researchers in visual localization, 3D computer vision, and mapping, as well as engineering and product teams, to identify the highest-impact problems and turn research into end-to-end solutions that operate at production scale.

  • Communicate results clearly through technical writing, design reviews, internal presentations, and publications.

What You'll Bring

  • Strong grounding in 3D computer vision, deep learning, robotics, photogrammetry, or a closely related field.

  • Demonstrated experience with multi-view geometry and related problems, such as camera pose estimation, monocular depth estimation, SfM, SLAM, georeferencing, point-cloud registration, or sensor fusion.

  • Knowledge of transformer models for 3D vision, such as vision foundation models, feed-forward 3D reconstruction, or multi-view and multi-modal attention.

  • Knowledge of geospatial data and coordinate reference systems.

  • Ability to formulate ambiguous real-world problems, choose appropriate mathematical or learning-based tools, and evaluate solutions rigorously.

  • Strong Python skills and experience training deep learning models at scale, with libraries such as PyTorch, NumPy, and SciPy.

  • Strong software engineering skills, with the ability to turn research prototypes into reliable, scalable, and maintainable systems.

  • Experience taking an algorithm from research idea and experimental prototype through evaluation, benchmarking, and deployment on real-world data.

  • Clear written and verbal communication and the ability to collaborate across research and engineering disciplines.

Nice to Have

  • A PhD in computer vision, robotics, machine learning, photogrammetry, geodesy, remote sensing, or a related field, or equivalent research or industry experience. A PhD is not required.

  • A strong publication record or substantial active involvement in the research community, especially at venues such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR, SIGGRAPH, SIGGRAPH Asia, 3DV, ICRA, RSS, or related conferences and journals.

  • Experience with aerial or satellite imagery, GNSS/GPS, IMUs, LiDAR data, geodesy, mapping systems, or large-scale spatial data.

  • Evidence of technical leadership, mentorship, or successful cross-functional delivery.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: Competitive market rate. Compensation also includes an annual bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Location & Work Model

This role is based in our London office, with three days per week in office.

Inclusive Application

We know the strongest candidates don't always tick every box. If you're excited about this role and believe you could do it well, we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't match every qualification listed - you may be exactly who we're looking for.

Equal Opportunity

Niantic Spatial is an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment at Niantic Spatial are considered without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, creed, age, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or related medical conditions), marital status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected category under applicable laws. Niantic Spatial will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with applicable laws. Please contact your recruiter if you want to request an accommodation for the job application or interview process.

Candidate Privacy

title: 3D Packaging Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

As a 3D Packaging Engineer, you will collaborate closely with our engineering team to physically realize our VIO products. You will operate, adapt, and fine-tune high-precision assembly equipment to meet the precise tolerances required for optimal device performance.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Tooling Adaptation: Assist in modifying and calibrating high-precision assembly equipment (e.g., flip-chip bonders, die attach machines) to meet unique quantum 3D integration specifications.

  • Process Optimization: Help develop and refine placement and bonding processes (thermo-compression bonding, laser-assisted bonding, coldwelding) for non-standard substrates. Test adhesives, glues, and solders to determine which materials survive extreme thermal cycling and cryogenic vacuum conditions.

  • 3D Assembly Execution: Execute complex integration strategies, including multi-die stacking, interposer-based 3D architectures, and orthogonal (vertical) chip placement.

Your Profile

  • Education: BS, MS, or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Physics, Materials Science, or a related field.

  • Tooling Experience: 3–5 years of hands-on experience operating and adjusting high-accuracy semiconductor assembly platforms.

  • Precision Assembly: Demonstrated experience achieving tight placement tolerances (around 1µm) in an R&D or pilot production environment.

  • 3D Integration Knowledge: Solid foundational understanding of 3D integration (TSVs, micro-bumps, interposers) and how structural materials behave under thermal stress, high vacuum, or cryogenic conditions.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

title: 2027 Strategic Finance Analytics Graduate Programme
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The role

As part of Checkout.com’s #NextGen Strategic Finance Analytics Graduate Program you’ll work alongside experienced professionals, gaining hands-on experience and a comprehensive introduction to digital payments and technology. The program offers an extensive learning experience through technical training, professional development workshops, and direct access to industry experts. You'll be part of a global Early Careers, Graduate community, with regular networking events, mentoring opportunities, and social activities designed to build connections and accelerate your growth and leadership potential. By the end of the scheme, you’ll be equipped with the knowledge, experience, and confidence to make a lasting impact at Checkout.com and beyond.

How you’ll make an impact

During the programme, you may:

  • Analyse commercial and business performance in order to help the business assess where it is creating value.

  • Leverage AI tooling as a force multiplier to build and automate reusable analytical workflows and agents to create insights from financial data.

  • Collaborate directly with Data Engineering and Data Science to support the development and enhancement of our core financial data models, and the context layer that enables AI agents to leverage that data.

  • Craft executive-style deliverables, which may include decks, models, written documents or AI-powered apps.

  • Work with your manager to translate ambiguous requests from leadership, Finance and cross-functional stakeholders into clear, decision-ready insights.

  • Drive continuous reporting improvements, standardisation, and simplification whilst documenting definitions and limitations - leaving no room for approximation.

  • You will work with Finance and Data partners to scope requirements and support the delivery of key initiatives.

What we’re looking for

You’re a curious, analytical and innovative individual, either due to graduate in summer 2027 or having graduated within the last 12 months, who is excited to dive into the world of Finance.

You’ll bring:

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a quantitative or business discipline.

  • Strong analytical mindset - You’re comfortable working with numbers, identifying the underlying patterns and drawing sound conclusions.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills - You have the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels.

  • Commercial curiosity - You want to dive into the details to understand how merchant, product, and commercial dynamics affect financial performance.

  • Confidence with data tools - You have a clear aptitude and willingness to learn data tooling. Python and SQL experience is a plus.

  • Exceptional attention to detail - You rigorously validate data, pressure-test assumptions, and transparently communicate analytical limitations.

  • Payments or financial knowledge is a bonus, but not required.

Early Careers experience

You’ll receive:

  • Dedicated onboarding and payments-focused training.

  • Professional skills workshops and leadership sessions.

  • Mentoring from experienced colleagues.

  • Networking and community events.

  • Opportunities to work on meaningful, business-critical projects.

  • Regular feedback and transparent performance conversations.

  • Potential progression into a permanent role, subject to performance, readiness, headcount availability and business requirements.

Eligibility

  • Graduated within the last 12 months or due to graduate by the programme start date, depending on the selected pathway.

  • Available to work full-time for the duration of the programme.

  • Able to work from the stated programme location and meet applicable right-to-work requirements.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

title: ABM Operations Manager, AI & Automation
descriptionHtml:
About the role 

Our ABM team runs highly targeted programs for the accounts that matter most to RELEX. We want those programs to be even more personalized, more interactive, and faster to launch across channels, without adding manual effort for every new account. 

That's where you come in. You'll advise how the ABM team runs and develops five operational areas: paid media, landing page creation, content personalization, targeted direct mail, and analytics. You'll review how each area works today, then design and build the AI-based workflows, templates, and quality guardrails that let the team focus on account strategy, creativity and stakeholder alignment over manual work. 

What you'll do 

Across all five operational areas 

  • Map how each area works today, find where time and quality can be improved, and agree a prioritized automation roadmap with the Head of ABM
  • Build and maintain the AI workflows the ABM team uses day to day, with tools such as Claude, n8n, Folloze and HubSpot
  • Partner with Marketing Operations, who own our martech platforms, data, and integrations: build ABM workflows on top of the shared stack, follow its standards, and hand over anything that should become a cross-team capability
  • Agree brand and quality guardrails with Brand & Creative so AI-produced assets can go live with light review
  • Document every workflow and train the team so it runs without you 

Ad operations (LinkedIn, Influ2) 

  • Own the setup and execution model for ABM account and contact level campaigns
  • Build workflows and guardrails that cut the time spent on campaign setup
  • Build workflows that generate on-brand ad variants by account, segment, and buying group role
  • Run channel and tactic experiments to find the right mix of reach, engagement, and conversion activity
  • Close the data feedback loop, so account and contact level engagement flows back to the account team and into ABM planning automatically 

Landing page operations 

  • Build a template and component library the team can use to generate account and segment pages with AI
  • Set standards for personalization depth, and work with ABM designers on a tailored look and feel per account
  • Find opportunities to build deeper, more interactive experiences for prospects 

Content build operations 

  • Build and fine-tune workflows that turn existing RELEX content (research, customer stories, point of view pieces) into account-tailored assets such as one-pagers, guides, and sales follow-up material 

Direct mail operations 

  • Design a direct mail program framework that delivers personalized mailers at scale
  • Own the operating model behind them: vendor setup, address data quality, GDPR compliance, budget, and cost per account
  • Connect every send to a defined sales follow-up, and measure what it contributes 

Analytics and reporting 

  • Define how ABM programs are measured, together with the Head of ABM and Marketing Operations: account reach, engagement, buying group coverage, and pipeline contribution
  • Build and maintain reporting that shows what's working by account, channel, and tactic, so channel and budget decisions rest on evidence rather than assumption
  • Keep campaign data clean and comparable across platforms, including naming conventions, UTM standards, and campaign taxonomy
  • Measure the impact of the AI workflows themselves: time saved, cost per asset, and speed from brief to launch 

What we're looking for 

  • 4+ years in B2B ABM, demand generation, growth marketing, GTM engineering, or marketing operations
  • A working understanding of how B2B paid media runs, ideally on LinkedIn: campaign structure, account and contact list targeting, bidding and budget pacing, and which platform metrics you can and can’t trust
  • A proven track record of designing and shipping AI and automation workflows that other people use, with examples you can walk us through
  • Practical experience working with LLMs: prompt design, structured outputs, connecting models to business data and tools, and evaluating output quality
  • Hands-on experience building automations in n8n, Make, Zapier, Workato, or similar, including APIs, webhooks, JSON, and error handling
  • A process mindset: you can map a workflow, see where it breaks, and design a repeatable replacement
  • Good judgment on quality: you know when AI output is ready to be rolled out and when it isn't 

Nice to have 

  • Enough Python or JavaScript to write, read, and debug automation scripts and API calls
  • Experience with intent and engagement platforms such as 6sense, or contact-level advertising such as Influ2
  • Experience running direct mail or gifting programs in B2B
  • Working knowledge of SQL and at least one BI or reporting tool (for example Power BI, Looker, or Tableau)
  • Background in global enterprise B2B software with long, multi-stakeholder buying cycles 

About RELEX 

RELEX Solutions creates cutting-edge supply chain and retail planning software. Within our platforms, we have the power and potential to increase adaptability, efficiency, and sustainability in the consumer goods and retail value chain. Our impact is tangible; from sustainability and eliminating waste to delighting customers and delivering great tailored tech solutions, we’re curious and passionate challenge-seekers creating the future of retail today.

We’re currently a global team of 2000+ employees working from offices in the US (Atlanta), UK, Germany, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, France, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Singapore, Australia, and our headquarters in Helsinki, Finland. We work in small teams where everyone’s input is valued. We’re passionate about what we do, we like putting our skills to the test, and we make sure we have fun during the process — because life is supposed to be fun.

RELEX Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

descriptionHtml:
What we're all about.

We achieve this through online learning, instructor-led training and practical technical programmes that help Quantexa users configure, use and implement our award-winning Decision Intelligence Platform. You will act as a key interface between the Academy, learners, clients and partners, working closely with colleagues across Education Services, Cloud, Delivery, Solution Engineering, Technology Account Partners and Alliances.


What You’ll Be Doing

title: Account Development Representative - France
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. 

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our French EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach. 

We have offices in Paris and London and we offer remote working from France and the United Kingdom.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France and the United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CET. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara’s mission.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will: 

  • Drive pipeline through personalised outreach to prospects via phone, emails and LinkedIn
  • Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
  • Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
  • Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
  • Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in closing-sales roles
  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a “win as a team” environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways

Through Samsara’s ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs’ understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

  • ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.
  • The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.
  • The highest level within our organization is ADR III. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Please submit an English CV with your application.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Account Director - (F/H) - CDI
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Dans un souci de clarté et d’accessibilité, nous avons choisi de ne pas utiliser l’écriture inclusive dans nos communications. WPP Media est fermement engagé en faveur de la diversité : nous valorisons l'inclusion et l'égalité, en considérant tous les candidats sans distinction d'identité de genre, d'origine ethnique ou de religion. Tous nos postes sont également ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. 

A propos de WPP Media: 

WPP is the creative transformation company. Nous utilisons le pouvoir de la créativité pour construire un avenir meilleur pour nos collaborateurs, notre planète, nos clients et nos communautés. Pour plus d'informations, visitez wpp.com. 

WPP Media est le collectif média global de WPP. Dans un monde où les médias sont omniprésents nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour développer les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance inégalée à nos clients. Pour plus d'informations, visitez wppmedia.com. 

Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. C'est grâce à cette synergie que nous parvenons à créer des expériences véritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos équipes internes. Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media : 

  • Être Extraordinaire en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle. 
  • Créer un environnement Ouvert en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fondé sur une confiance mutuelle. 
  • Diriger avec Optimisme en stimulant activement la croissance et le développement pour mobiliser l'ensemble de notre organisation. 

A propos d’Openmind : Une marque de WPP Media A Leading WPP Media Brand

Openmind by WPP est un modèle d'agence intégrée puisant dans les talents de l'ensemble de WPP. Il a été créé pour accélérer la transformation européenne de la fonction média de Nestlé. Au cœur de cette solution se trouvent les meilleures capacités avancées de données et de technologie, alimentées par l'investissement de WPP dans l'IA, pour maximiser l'impact de l'investissement média de Nestlé. 

LE RÔLE :
Au sein de l'équipe Above-Market d’OpenMind (WPP), l'International Account Director est un expert média confirmé dédié au compte Nestlé Europe sur la catégorie Café (Nescafé, Dolce Gusto & Starbucks At Home). Véritable consultant média auprès des équipes locales et clients, vous jouez un rôle d'orchestrateur et de facilitateur stratégique sur un périmètre clé allant jusqu'à 26 marchés.

À la croisée des chemins entre la vision stratégique et l'agilité opérationnelle, vous êtes "hands-on", force de proposition, et capable de mener à bien des projets complexes avec une grande autonomie. Ce poste est pensé pour s'intégrer dans une structure d'équipe optimisée pour garantir une réactivité et une excellence de service

RESPONSABILITÉS :

• Pilotage Client & Vision Stratégique : Mener les discussions stratégiques sur les campagnes Coffee, venir en soutien des leads Coffee pour orchestrer les cycles annuels de planification (avec un temps fort d'accélération stratégique d’avril à septembre).
• Coordination Internationale : Assurer la coordination fluide des agences WPP et des équipes locales (jusqu’à 26 marchés), en garantissant la cohérence régionale, la compréhension locale des directives et le succès des lancements multi-marchés.
• Conseil & Stratégie Média : Traduire la vision de marque en stratégies de prioritisation des allocations d'investissements multi channels (« fewer, bigger, better »). Agir en consultant média en produisant des guidelines de comms planning actionnables pour les pays.
• Gestion de la Performance & Reporting : Co-concevoir et animer les QBR, assurer le suivi mensuel des investissements et performances de campagnes (spend reporting, benchmarks) avec les experts digitaux.
• Synergie d'Expertises : Fédérer les équipes spécialistes du réseau (Search, Social, Programmatique/Video & RDM, Data & Tech) pour délivrer une planification média intégrée et innovante.

COMPÉTENCES REQUISES :

• Expérience : Expérience confirmée et solide (4-5 ans minimum) en agence média en conseil & coordination internationale et/ou comms planning est requise. Une expérience préalable avec de grands clients mondiaux de coordination multi-marchés est fortement recommandée.
• Expertise Internationale : Savoir-faire éprouvé en coordination multi-marchés et gestion de parties prenantes dans des organisations matricielles complexes.
• Mindset & Posture : Esprit consultant, pragmatique et autonome. Capacité démontrée à être hands-on pour faire avancer les projets et performer dans une équipe agile.
• Connaissance Sectorielle : Forte maîtrise des enjeux FMCG / PGC et des dynamiques omnicanales (une sensibilité à la catégorie Café / Boissons est un plus).
• Data & Storytelling : Solide culture data pour transformer les métriques de performance en opportunités stratégiques, doublée d'excellentes qualités de présentation et d'organisation.
• Langues : Anglais bilingue / courant impératif (100 % des communications, réunions et livrables au quotidien).

La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages :

Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. Cette démarche s'accompagne d'une vision responsable dans nos stratégies d'investissement médiatique, reflétant ainsi notre double priorité : valoriser nos collaborateurs tout en adoptant des pratiques durables dans notre secteur. Les collaborateurs de WPP Media ont un accès privilégié aux réseaux internationaux de WPP Media et WPP, leur permettant de développer leurs passions, d'étendre leur réseau professionnel et de rester à la pointe des innovations en marketing et publicité. 

Nous disposons de ressources vastes et variées au service de nos collaborateurs, notre entreprise cultive activement l'inclusion des talents de tous horizons. Les réussites et expertises des équipes sont régulièrement mises en lumière lors d'événements fédérateurs qui ponctuent également les moments clés de l'année, renforçant ainsi notre culture d'entreprise collaborative et diversifiée. 

Nos avantages comprennent: 

  • Télétravail : jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine et 2 semaines complètes à prendre en deux fois dans l’année 
  • Deux jours de repos supplémentaires offerts, dont le lundi de Pentecôte  
  • Jours de congé additionnels par pallier de 5 ans d’ancienneté  
  • 5 jours de télétravail additionnels par mois pour les collaborateurs souffrant d’endométriose  
  • Politique handicap : 3 jours d'absence autorisés payés par an, accès à des Chèques Emploi Service Universel, et accompagnements spécifiques pour les collaborateurs ayant une RQTH  
  • Missions solidaires possibles via le programme We care and we act  

  • Un Cadre de Travail Inspirant : Chez Openmind, vous aurez l'opportunité de contribuer à des projets passionnants et de collaborer avec des marques renommées. Nous cultivons un environnement de travail inclusif où chaque talent peut s'épanouir et se développer.

Process de recrutement :

Entretien avec l’équipe recrutement : Un premier entretien téléphonique ou par vidéoconférence avec un membre de notre équipe. Cela nous permettra de mieux connaître vos compétences et votre expérience, et vous donnera l'occasion de poser des questions sur le poste et l'entreprise. 

Étude de cas : Une étude de cas vous sera proposée afin d’évaluer vos compétences techniques liées au poste. Une restitution vous sera proposée.

Entretien opérationnel : Vous échangerez ensuite avec la Business Partner et la Lead Openmind France.

Nous nous engageons à rendre ce process aussi rapide et efficace que possible, et à maintenir une communication ouverte et transparente tout au long du process. 

WPP Media garantit l'égalité des chances et considère tous les candidats sans discrimination ni considération de caractéristiques particulières. Nous nous engageons à cultiver un environnement de respect où chacun se sent à sa place et bénéficie des mêmes opportunités d'évolution professionnelle. 

Consultez notre politique de confidentialité pour tout savoir sur la protection de vos données politique de confidentialité. 

Bien que nous étudiions toutes les candidatures reçues, nous ne contactons que les personnes sélectionnées pour un entretien.

title: Account Director | Healthcare Communications | London
descriptionHtml:
About us

Hanover is an award-winning communications consultancy that advises enterprises, institutions, and individuals on building recognition and enhancing reputation.

From our offices across Europe and the Middle East, we adopt an integrated approach that connects the dots across channels, audiences and issues.

Our collective of smart, curious people think differently and live by a shared mission, purpose, vision, and values. These shape how we work, not just with our colleagues, but with clients and partners too.

Our mission is to ‘rewire communications for impact’ and harness its transformative power to advocate, trailblaze and make a difference.

We do this by igniting and empowering the potential of every individual within our company, recognising that each person is a unique spark, capable of creating extraordinary impact. We believe that by nurturing and harnessing the collective brilliance of our people, we can drive innovation, foster an uncommon work culture, and make a positive difference to society.

Embracing the complete range of skills and services across the communications spectrum without constraint, we create the best outcomes for our clients and deliver world-class work.

We're in search of a driven professional to take on the role of Account Director (or Senior Account Director for the right candidate) in our Healthcare Communications team.

You will play a pivotal role in delivering strategic guidance to our esteemed public relations clientele, overseeing account management, team leadership, and budgeting. The role involves spearheading new business initiatives, from identifying prospects to leading pitches, and nurturing the professional growth of junior team members up to the Consultant level.

Passionate about propelling innovative healthcare products, services, and organisations to new heights of success, you will engage with a varied client portfolio, ranging from leading global healthcare corporations to dynamic startups, all while making a meaningful impact on patient care and the healthcare community. Our client roster boasts prominent names like Lilly, AstraZeneca and Merck..

Joining our team means bringing your expertise to a diverse array of projects, spanning product PR, patient advocacy, corporate communications, and media relations, within stimulating therapeutic fields such as neuroscience, immunology, and cardiometabolic health.

Our team's excellence hasn't gone unnoticed—we've earned accolades from PRWeek, SABRE, and PharmaTimes, and we've been contenders for an agency award at the Communiqué Awards. Join us and be part of a team that's not just winning awards, but also making a real difference in healthcare communications.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide timely and relevant strategic advice to clients informed by broad intelligence-gathering on client, sector and competitors and policy environment
  • Project manage and supervise the delivery of all client services across multiple accounts
  • Exhibit a willingness to challenge the status quo, innovate, and embrace new ideas to drive the business forward
  • Lead regular client meetings and internal account management meetings, reviewing progress and allocating tasks
  • Manage account teams, providing direction and support to ensure high-quality client service
  • Manage client budgets and adhere to company budget setting and management processes
  • Ensure timely and accurate billing to ensure client needs are met within budget
  • Project manage activities focused on new business development, including marketing and new business pipeline management
  • Demonstrate an active and ever-expanding new business network that can provide significant opportunities for Hanover
  • Identify opportunities to cross-sell services between Hanover teams and/or offices
  • Provide personal management and mentoring of junior members of the team, up to Consultant level, providing guidance to improve quality of work, overall efficiency and foster a culture of excellence
  • Conduct performance reviews and support career progression for team members
  • Champion diversity and inclusion within the team and in client work, ensuring a range of perspectives are considered and valued.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:

  • Proven track record of experience working in a healthcare / pharmaceutical PR role, ideally within a consultancy or in-house team
  • Proven media relations expertise with network of UK or international media connections
  • Proficient in both healthcare product and corporate communications
  • A willingness to challenge the status quo, innovate, and embrace new ideas to drive the business forward
  • Ability to lead teams and drive client accounts
  • Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly and persuasively
  • Effective time, project and financial management
  • Client focused with close attention to detail
  • Familiarity with relevant media (print, broadcast and digital) and digital communication channels
  • Proactive and experienced in developing new business

BENEFITS:

In addition to a competitive salary, your core benefits package will include:

  • An annual performance-related bonus plus additional bonus potential linked to recruitment, new business and long service
  • 25 days’ annual leave (plus bank holidays)
  • Private healthcare and dental insurance
  • Travel insurance
  • A company pension plan, including 5% employer contribution

You’ll also have access to a wide range of opportunities and initiatives, including:

  • Flexible working policies, plus eligibility to apply for a sabbatical after 2 years’ service
  • Summer Fridays finish (3pm) – early Friday finish the rest of the year (4pm)
  • The Hanover Academy, which incorporates training, coaching, mentoring and reverse-mentoring opportunities to support personal development and career progression across all levels, with a generous training budget
  • International secondments as well as the opportunity to collaborate with all offices across the AVENIR GLOBAL’s network
  • A wellbeing programme, featuring (but not limited to) pre- and post-maternity leave coaching, a working parents’ group, subsidised gym membership
  • Our Culture Club, with a robust social calendar all year round and CSR activity

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Statement + 

Hanover Communications is an equal opportunities employer, committed to creating and ensuring a fair, inclusive, and diverse work environment where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. We believe that equality and diversity are essential to high performance and a thriving culture.

We maintain a strict no-tolerance stance against any form of discrimination and harassment, ensuring all individuals are treated equitably, irrespective of their race, ethnicity, religion, beliefs, age, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, marital or pregnancy status, genetic background, or any other attribute safeguarded under our company policies or federal, state or local laws and legislation.

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please send an email to

We are committed to transparency about how we collect and use your data, including ensuring we comply with legal obligations relating to data protection. You can view our data privacy policy here. 

Hanover is part of AVENIR GLOBAL’s powerhouse of specialist communications consultancies across EMEA and North America. Collectively we rank among the top 15 largest communication firms in the world.

Find out more about Hanover and working for us.

title: Account Executive – Accountant Channel
descriptionHtml:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot,based on 60,000 reviews. Our cultureputs customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here).

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 byAlexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.


Join us as an Account Executive – Accountant Channel to turn France’s accounting firms into one of Qonto’s strongest growth channels. You’ll build your own pipeline of firms and close them end to end, under the guidance of Adrien Cannet, our Lead Accountant Channel.

➡️ What you’ll do

  • Build your own pipeline: You’ll source and prospect accounting firms across France, with no inbound to lean on.

  • Own the whole sales process end to end: qualify, understand how each firm works and where its pain sits and close the deal.

  • Turn firms into referral partners: You’ll get accountants recommending Qonto to their own client base.

  • Use AI to work smarter: You’ll lean on AI tools to prep calls, personalise outreach and speed up qualification.

➡️ What we’re looking for

  • Outbound experience: At least one year of full-time sales experience (CDI), with a track record of building your own pipeline.

  • You’ve closed a full cycle yourself: You’ve owned at least one deal end to end, from first call to signature.

  • You are fluent in French and English: Both are mandatory, with a minimum of C2 in French and C1+ in English.

  • You don’t quit: You keep working quiet accounts without losing energy or tact.

  • You’re AI-fluent: You use AI tools naturally to sharpen outreach, prep and follow-up.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • A channel with real impact: The accountant channel is one of Qonto’s strategic growth priorities, and it’s still being built.

  • Room to shape it: You’ll have the autonomy to test your own angles and help set the ways of working this team runs on.

  • Growth you earn: A clear growth path if you deliver.

  • Qonto’s sales school: Hands-on coaching and transferable skills that travel well.

➡️ Your future manager

You’ll report to Adrien Cannet, who leads the Account Executive team for the accountant channel. With a strong SaaS sales background at Spendesk, Adrien joined Qonto via Regate in 2024 as an Account Executive and has since taken the lead on new business for the accountant channel. His management style is hands-on but empowering: through one-to-one coaching, he helps you get to the root of a stalled deal, sharpen your approach, and find a way forward, then trusts you to take the reins and close it yourself.


[DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.

[HIRING PROCESS DURATION] On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here

[DATA RETENTION] By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.

title: Account Executive (AE) | DACH (d/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
About the role

Luminovo builds the B2B SaaS platform that powers the electronics supply chain. DACH is our home market and one of our strongest, and we’re adding an Account Executive to the German-speaking team.

Unlike traditional transactional sales, you'll be selling complex supply chain software to technical buyers—requiring deep discovery, consultative selling, and the ability to prove measurable ROI in a trillion-dollar industry. You'll sell software that directly impacts how electronics companies—from automotive suppliers to industrial equipment manufacturers—manage their complete electronics supply chain. The impact is tangible, the industry is fascinating, and the growth trajectory is yours to shape.

Who you are

  • You’ve sold B2B software, and you can walk through your own numbers from memory: quota, attainment, average deal size, how long your ramp took

  • You’ve built something that didn’t exist before you — a segment, a first playbook, a function nobody had staffed, a company of your own. You’re more comfortable without a playbook than with an inherited one

  • You use AI as more than a better search engine. You’ve built your own automations, workflows, or tools, and you can name what you shipped and what came of it

  • You’ve been close to how electronics or physical products actually get made — manufacturing, hardware, or supply chain. A bonus rather than a must, and the strongest single signal we look for, because it’s what lets you find the pain before a customer names it

  • You’re consultative by instinct. Our buyers rarely arrive knowing they have a problem worth solving, so short cycles with demo-ready buyers aren’t the motion here

  • You work in German and English at a professional level. Discovery, demos, and negotiation happen in German; the company runs in English

Your potential growth path:

  • Months 1-6: Master the product, close your first 5-10 deals, build your DACH network

  • Months 6-18: Take on larger deals, navigate complex stakeholder environments, mentor BDRs

  • 18+ months: Transition to Enterprise AE (€100k+ deals), own strategic accounts, mentor junior AEs

Your performance objectives

📣 Generate pipeline

  • Build your network. Connect with 50+ relevant decision-makers at electronics manufacturers per quarter through industry events, LinkedIn, and targeted outreach. Establish Luminovo's presence at 2-3 key industry fairs annually.

  • Generate qualified pipeline. Create €240k-€400k in qualified pipeline ARR per quarter (depending on seniority) through outbound prospecting, events, and inbound lead qualification using SPICED discovery.

  • Qualify with precision. Run customer-centric discovery to uncover Situation, Pain, Impact, Critical event, and Decision criteria. Quantify potential value before investing in lengthy sales cycles.

💪 Close opportunities

  • Inspire with demos. Deliver product demonstrations tailored to each customer's pain points. Clearly articulate our competitive positioning.

  • Prove measurable value. Collaborate with domain experts to run workshops that demonstrate ROI through concrete impact calculations (time savings, cost reductions, efficiency gains).

  • Close strategically. Guide prospects through complex buyer journeys, map stakeholders, and turn negotiations into win-win outcomes. Close €60k-€100k in new ARR per quarter (depending on seniority) with smooth handovers to Customer Success.

💡 Build expertise

  • Become an industry insider. Develop deep knowledge of electronics supply chains and feed customer insights back to product teams.

  • Master consultative selling. Make SPICED your guiding principle and build expertise in technical SaaS sales with longer cycles and multi-stakeholder decisions.

📈 Lead by example

  • Own your metrics. Monitor pipeline health, conversion rates, and deal velocity. Use data to consistently hit quarterly targets.

  • Enable your peers. Mentor junior AEs through shadowing and deal reviews. Contribute to our sales playbook.

  • Embrace feedback. Reflect on every major customer interaction and proactively seek coaching to maximize impact.

🇪🇺 Your territory

You'll primarily cover the German-speaking market (DACH), with some English-speaking territories. Fluency in 🇩🇪 German and 🇬🇧 English is essential.

 

📍 Work location

Munich headquarters or Berlin satellite office (both in hybrid setup with home-office flexibility). Our sales team meets in the office three days per week. Occasional travel for team retreats and industry events (expenses covered).

 

Whom you'll be working with

  • Clifton Lobo, VP Global Sales — Your manager who'll coach you on deal strategy and career progression

  • Sebastian Schaal, Co-Founder — Provides strategic guidance on positioning and pricing

  • Inga Schwarz, Team Lead and Pioneer AE for OEM — Your primary partner in building the OEM sales playbook

  • Max Hungenbach and RevOps — Provide CRM support, dashboards, and sales enablement

  • Marketing, Customer Success & Product teams — Regular collaboration on campaigns, customer onboarding, and product roadmap

💡 Skills, knowledge, and expertise

Just so you know—we purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. We care much more about your motivation and ability to help us accelerate technical progress than we care about your CV.

If you're interested to find out more about why we banned requirements from our performance profiles—see here.

⚡️ About Luminovo

Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion-dollar electronics industry.

We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress.

We bring innovations to life faster and cheaper by creating a more connected and resilient electronics supply chain.

To date, over 300 active customers worldwide are working with us towards this shared goal. Supported by leading investors such as Cherry Ventures, General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have raised more than €20 million.

Our core principles: putting people first & building great things

As a remote-first company headquartered in Munich, our brilliant team is spread across cities including Munich, New York, Austin, Calgary, Berlin, London, Valencia, Nairobi, and Verona, among others. 🌍

Our team includes a mix of product enthusiasts, people advocates, business masterminds, and engineering experts. Among us are graduates from institutions like Stanford University and the University of Cambridge, as well as talented individuals with unconventional CVs. What matters most is their drive to build great things.

We provide an authentic environment based on psychological safety to empower Luminerds from various backgrounds to succeed, grow, and focus on impact. Putting people first means that we deeply care about who our employees are, what makes them unique, and what they excel at.

About the Role

Join our sales team as an Account Executive to help us drive our Benelux & Nordics market! As an integral team member, you will report to the Sales Leader and work alongside motivated individuals passionate about changing how organisations manage their business travel and expenses.

We're looking for someone fearless in rolling up their sleeves, hitting the phones, and engaging with new customers to grow our client base. You should be hungry with an outbound mentality (you are expected to source a part of your pipeline yourself), perseverant, and focused, with excellent communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills that enable you to win new clients and maintain strong relationships with existing ones.

But that's not all - we also value collaboration and teamwork, so you should be just as motivated to help your colleagues succeed as you are to meet your targets. We take pride in our fun, challenging, and inclusive culture and seek someone who shares our passion for creating a positive work environment. If you're excited about the prospect of selling a disruptive product that is changing the game for business travel management, we want to hear from you!

 

What will you be doing?

  • Prospecting your own pipeline and managing outbound and inbound leads for the Benelux & Nordics market, mainly focusing on the Belgian market;

  • Presenting demos to potential clients and owning the follow-up until closing the deal (Full sales cycle);

  • Seeking to understand the needs of your target prospects and articulating the value that Perk provides which is most aligned to the needs of that customer;

  • Conducting high-level discussions with various stakeholders, from Office Managers to CFOs;

  • Maintaining accurate information on prospects and interaction activities in Salesforce;

  • Working closely with the Marketing team to develop new ways to increase awareness of Perk and to both evolve and improve the lead qualification process;

  • Become an expert in Perk and our ever-evolving features.

 

What we're looking for

  • Native French speaker;

  • Excellent communication and video presentation skills;

  • Experience working with the Benelux or Nordics markets;

  • Solid experience working in a Sales position and a demonstrated ability to be a pure hunter - proven track record of developing your pipeline through outbound initiatives;

  • Proven track record of developing successful relationships with C-suite executives;

  • Good understanding of B2B solution selling with a short sales cycle;

  • Being hungry and ambitious, yet ethical and sound;

  • Able to work as an individual contributor, but bearing in mind you are part of a team;

  • Customer-centric mindset;

  • You must have legal authorisation to work in Spain.

 

What we offer

  • 25 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • An optional pension scheme to support your long-term financial wellbeing.

  • A tax-efficient bike leasing scheme through Lease a Bike, for your commute or personal use.

  • Reimbursed commuting costs if you live more than 10km away from the office.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

  • Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

  • Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

  • A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

  • Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

 

Interview Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins - Virtual

  • Assessment Interview - 90 mins - Virtual

  • Final Interview - 30 mins - Virtual

  • Values Interview - 30mins IRL

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

descriptionHtml:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

We offer a highly competitive compensation package with On-Target Earnings (OTE) designed to reward high performance and results. This includes a strong base salary complemented by an uncapped commission structure, meaning there is no limit to what you can earn — your success directly drives your income. Top performers have the opportunity to significantly exceed OTE, supported by a transparent, performance-driven bonus plan that truly rewards achievement.

What you will do

  • Build and develop your own client portfolio by identifying and acquiring new business opportunities within your assigned market.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients to foster long-term partnerships.

  • Proactively qualify new leads through daily outbound calls, follow-ups, and consistent pipeline management.

  • Engaging in conversations with potential and existing clients, and guiding them through the sales process.

  • Work closely with the technology team to provide feedback on platform functionality and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Collaborate with both buyers and suppliers to address any issues, inquiries, or challenges that may arise during the trading process.

  • Monitor your performance against monthly targets and KPIs, taking ownership of revenue growth within your portfolio.

  • Stay informed about market trends, product demand, and industry dynamics to make informed trading decisions.

Who you are

title: Account Executive (DACH)
descriptionHtml:
About SINGU

At SINGU, we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.

 

Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide, supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started.

 

Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

 

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a high-energy, relentlessly optimistic Account Executive with proven experience in SaaS and the real estate/proptech sector. You are a confident “hustler” who sees the glass as half full and thrives in a high-activity sales environment.

This is a pure new business role where you will own a defined territory and named-account set in the DACH region. You will control the pipeline you create and oversee the commercial outcome of every deal from the first conversation to the final signature. Singu supports complex property and facilities operations across more than 250 million square metres, with established customers spanning commercial real estate, logistics, retail, facility management, and the public sector. You will enter deals with credible enterprise references, a proven product, and senior executive support.

The deals are consequential rather than transactional: multi-stakeholder, multi-site, and typically take six to nine months to close. Initial deal values range from £25k to £100k and have clear multi-country expansion potential. Winning requires a strong business case, quantified value discovery, and the ability to align stakeholders across operations, real estate, procurement, IT, and finance.

Core Capabilities & What You Will Own

Strategic Navigator & Deal Execution

  • Deeply understand account politics and decision-making structures to “connect the dots” within complex opportunities.

  • Ensure opportunities are qualified to a MEDDICC standard, featuring a quantified business case and direct access to the economic buyer.

  • Ensure every material deal is multi-threaded so that it survives any change of internal sponsor.

  • Lead commercial negotiations that build value and protect price, rather than defaulting to discounts.

  • Apply rigorous qualification to make early decisions on opportunities that lack a credible business case, buying process, or route to decision.

Relationship Builder & “Land and Expand”

  • Cultivate strong connections and effectively influence key stakeholders across your target audience.

  • Scope first wins so they can grow, ensuring sites, countries, and use cases are sequenced from the start.

  • Execute a clean handover to Customer Success with a fully documented expansion path.

Market Educator & Alliance Builder

  • Proactively educate market participants and win strategic partners to build valuable alliances.

Driven Execution, Pipeline & Coverage

  • Maintain a high volume of sales activity with resilience, confidence, and a proactive mindset.

  • Take personal responsibility for territory coverage, hitting a new business quota mapped out by a strategic territory plan.

  • Build pipeline through business development, marketing, partner channels, and self-generated activity.

  • Lead diagnostic conversations grounded in operating cost, compliance, and risk.

Forecasting and Governance

  • Maintain a robust forecast with stage integrity, next steps, and close dates you confidently stand behind.

  • Surface risks early with an honest view of what has changed and what is needed.

  • Contribute to the sales playbook with competitive intelligence, repeatable use cases, and objection handling.

What Excellent Performance Looks Like

  • Commercial Outcomes: Hitting new-logo ARR against quota, robust pipeline creation, territory coverage, and securing strategic logos. Strong win rates against incumbents or “no decision” outcomes, driving high average deal values and total multi-year value.

  • Operating Standards: High forecast accuracy, multi-threading, MEDDICC quality, price protection, discount discipline, CRM quality, and process discipline.

Your First 12 Months

  • First 90 days: Complete onboarding, build the territory and account plan, establish pipeline coverage, and create the first qualified opportunities.

  • By six months: Achieve credible coverage against a ramped quota, progress multi-threaded opportunities through evaluation, and close (or materially advance) a first customer win.

  • By 12 months: Deliver against a ramped quota, establish a repeatable pipeline-creation motion in your territory, and land accounts with clear expansion potential.

What We’re Looking For

  • Typically five or more years in B2B software or complex technology sales, including a sustained period carrying a new business quota (quality of results matters more than years).

  • Evidence of sustained over-performance in new business sales: quota attainment, team ranking, pipeline personally created, and representative deals won (we will ask for specifics).

  • The ability to walk us through significant deals end-to-end: how the opportunity was created, how the buying group developed, what changed, and why it was won or lost.

  • A structured seller who uses MEDDICC (or a comparable methodology) in practice.

  • Strong results combined with the forecast and CRM discipline required to run a predictable business.

  • English and German at a business level is a hard requirement.

  • Experience in CAFM, IWMS, FM, PropTech, or multi-site operations is a strong advantage.


Package, Support, and Progression

  • Competitive base salary with uncapped commission and meaningful accelerators for over-performance.

  • Comprehensive support including business development coverage, Pre-Sales, marketing, and enablement to support your success.

  • Direct access to the CRO for deal strategy, coaching, and fast commercial decisions without a committee.

  • Structured onboarding, methodology training, and deal coaching, starting with a fairly ramped quota.

  • Clear progression into global accounts or sales leadership, as we back elite individual contributors as readily as future managers.

This role is for an accomplished new business seller who wants the autonomy to build a territory, the support to win complex enterprise deals, and real reward for over-performance. If you have created pipeline, won meaningful customers, and run a disciplined process, we would like to hear from you.
