title: Account Executive, native Mandarin speaker
descriptionHtml:
We pull medical technology from the future to solve human health.

 

Scarlet is authorised to assess and certify medical devices. We combine clinical, technical and regulatory expertise with AI agents and software so rigorous certification can keep pace with product development at the world’s most ambitious technology companies, without lowering the safety bar.

Our customers have cut a year or more from their certification timelines for new AI-enabled medical devices and shortened product-update cycles from months to weeks. You’ll join a team building the infrastructure that makes these outcomes repeatable at scale.

 

About the role

As an Account Executive at Scarlet you will own deals from discovery to close by building relationships with regulatory and operations leaders. You will become a regulatory expert capable of meeting the complex needs of our customers. Your work will help ambitious medical technology companies bring safe products to patients sooner and drive Scarlet’s growth.

This is a London-based role with a global reach requiring native-level Mandarin and excellent English. You will initially sell to English-speaking customers, including customers outside China, while helping us prepare for future demand from Chinese-speaking customers. As that demand grows, your focus may increasingly include Chinese-speaking accounts. You will remain based in London, including if China-related work becomes your full-time focus.

 

What you'll be working on

The companies you'll be selling to are doing some of the most interesting work in healthcare right now. A few of the customers you'll be pointing prospects towards:

  • Floy certified three AI radiology devices under EU MDR, completed an ISO transfer and a scope extension, all in 16 weeks

  • Skin Analytics brought a Class III AI dermatology device to the European market

  • Augmedit certified multiple augmented reality neurosurgery devices

  • Flok Health went from submission to EU MDR certification of an AI physiotherapy device in 14 weeks

  • Lucida Medical transferred an AI radiology device to Scarlet in seven weeks and started shipping model updates immediately

  • Feebris got an AI photoplethysmography device certified in time to support critical NHS priorities

You can read all of these at scarlet.cc/customer-stories. Your job is to find the next Floy or Skin Analytics and show them there's a faster way.

 

Responsibilities

  • Build and nurture relationships with key decision-makers at cutting-edge technology companies across the healthcare industry, in person wherever possible, including at major industry conferences (e.g. MEDICA in Düsseldorf, RSNA in Chicago) and customer sites globally

  • Sell to English-speaking customers and, as demand develops, Mandarin-speaking customers

  • Source, own, and win deals from discovery to closed won with the right customers

  • Collaborate closely with teammates to bring the relevant expertise to different parts of the sales motion and communicate Scarlet’s value proposition

  • Work with the rest of the Sales function to continuously improve our processes

  • Drive continuous iteration by sharing insights from customer interactions to help shape our go-to-market strategy and product offering

 

Required qualifications

  • You have 2-3 years of B2B closing experience

  • You’re insatiably curious about the world and what makes people tick

  • You have native-level spoken and written Mandarin, alongside excellent spoken and written English, and can confidently sell to customers in both languages

  • You are able to work in a London-based role and are comfortable initially selling to English-speaking customers outside China, with your portfolio evolving as customer demand grows.

  • You have a high EQ, which alongside your curiosity enables you to navigate complex human relationships, understand people’s drivers, communicate creatively, and close complex deals

  • You have exceptional written & verbal communication skills

  • You are a self-starter, high-agency, and take ownership of your own success

 

Preferred qualifications

  • You have experience working in healthcare and/or a regulated industry

 

Interview process

Note: we typically collapse interviews 4-7 into one in-person session at our London HQ.

  1. Intro call with Karan - 15 mins

  2. An advanced Mandarin language test (20 mins)

  3. Interview with Val or Anna - 30 mins

  4. Live case with Dan - 45 mins

  5. Interview with James A - 30 mins

  6. Culture Q&A with Yun in Mandarin (10 mins)

  7. Founder interviews: James and Jamie (2x20 mins)

  8. Offer & references

Compensation: £150K – £190K • Offers Equity

  • Orchestrate account teams and partner ecosystems, including GSIs, cloud providers, and regional partners, to drive pipeline creation and deal execution.
  • Run a rigorous, value based sales process tailored to cloud native software, with accurate forecasting and strong hygiene in Salesforce and forecasting tools.
  • Partner with Customer Experience to expand adoption post sale, identify expansion triggers, and build customer advocacy within the Telco community.
  • Stay ahead of competitive dynamics in Kubernetes data services, backup and recovery, and container storage, using insights to sharpen strategy and messaging.
  • Represent Portworx in customer meetings and relevant industry events, with a field first mindset.

What You’ll Bring

  • Proven enterprise software sales experience, with a track record of closing and expanding high value, multi stakeholder deals in large organisations.
  • Demonstrable experience selling into Telco, with an understanding of procurement, governance, risk, and security requirements.
  • Strong grasp of cloud native concepts and the Kubernetes ecosystem, plus the ability to credibly engage architects and platform teams.
  • Experience selling to both technical and executive stakeholders, translating technical capabilities into business value and risk outcomes.

  • Comfort working in a matrixed environment, influencing cross functional teams without direct authority.
  • Strong communication and programme management skills, with clear account planning and stakeholder alignment.
  • A customer first mindset and a bias for action, with resilience and curiosity.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

title: Account Executive Pro - English & Italian speaker
descriptionHtml:
At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers.
From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.
As a certified B Corp, we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.
Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries—from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches.
We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn, backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started!

We're looking for an Account Executive Pro to join our growing team, based in Paris, France.

We are looking for a highly motivated, quota-driven individual to join our Account Executive team and drive growth primarily across the Italian market, with additional opportunities across other international markets.

This is a high-volume, efficiency-focused role where you will qualify inbound leads, close deals quickly with our packaged PRO offering, and build momentum through a strong pipeline.

You will own the full conversion process for your segment, driving revenue growth while maintaining the quality of relationships that turn customers into long-term advocates. Your ability to balance volume, velocity, and sound escalation judgment will be key to your success in this role at Brevo.


Your impact at Brevo:
Client Engagement & Relationship Management
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships through effective communication, active listening, and tailored solutions. Respond to inquiries with clarity and professionalism while adapting to client feedback and evolving needs.
    • Sales Execution & Deal Management
  • Drive the full sales cycle : outreach on warm leads, qualification, demo, negotiation and closing. Deliver compelling, benefit-focused product presentations. Use persuasive communication to convey value and secure commitments.
    • Lead volume & Pipeline Management
  • Update your pipe and be an ambassador of our sales CRM. Ensure fast treatment of incoming leads and strong sales velocity. Ensure accurate sales forecasting, CRM hygiene, and timely stakeholder updates across departments.
    • Product & Client Expertise
  • Build a deep understanding of Brevo’s platform, features, and add-ons. Map product capabilities to the needs of different Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs), particularly within the mid-market segment.
    • Lead Generation & Outreach
  • Proactively look for outreach & upgrade opportunities for our free or low-paying customer base. Maintain a healthy pipeline and drive continuous business growth.
    • Qualifying Enterprise leads
  • Some inbound leads will be a better fit for our Enterprise solutions. In those cases, the Account Executive shall qualify the lead and if appropriate, pass it along to the Enterprise AE. These will be jointly compensated opportunities.

    • Who you are:
  • You have 2+ years of proven sales experience (previous BDR experience is a plus).
  • You speak Italian at a native level and have excellent written and spoken communication skills in English. Spanish is a big plus.
  • You possess a strong understanding of sales processes and methodologies, both in complex sales environments and faster sales cycles.
  • You are skilled at understanding and clearly pitching use cases, offering solutions, and finding workarounds when necessary, using the right industry vocabulary to drive adoption.
  • You are results-driven and skilled at closing deals: creating urgency, communicating impact, and reinforcing value to drive the deal across the line
  • You are agile, able to adapt to feedback, and collaborate with colleagues to build new systems and processes.
  • You are genuinely curious, always seeking to understand people and their goals.
  • You are hands-on, with a proactive mindset, eager to take on challenges and actively seek solutions in a dynamic, evolving environment.

    • Why people love working at Brevo:

    A place to grow, together: Join an international team in a bright, collaborative office located in a vibrant neighborhood.

    Practical perks for everyday balance: RTT days off, 50% public transport reimbursement, Sustainable Mobility Package (whether you ride a classic bike or go electric, we support your choice to commute greener) and daily Swile meal vouchers (€12.50/day).

    Learning, every step of the way: Access to English classes and 155,000+ courses on Udemy, plus a strong internal culture of knowledge-sharing and support.

    Flexible for life: A remote-friendly setup, budget to support your home workspace, and relocation assistance for international talents.

    Wellbeing that works: Top-notch private healthcare (70% covered), 6-week second-parent leave, extra time off if your child is sick and needs you, and several services related to prevention, health and personal and professional well-being on Welii platform.

    A culture that cares: From inter-office trips to regular team events, there are plenty of ways to connect beyond your day-to-day. You'll also find active social, green, and LGBTQIA+ communities, plus Work Council benefits via Leeto, all here to support what matters to you, inside and outside of work.

  • Introductory call with TA
  • Meeting with hiring manager
  • Case study with Team Lead Sales Pro and Sales Director Pro
  • Last interview with Business Unit General Manager
    • Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, if this role speaks to you, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Account Executive - SaaS
descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Account Executive Type: Full-time Experience: 3+ years What about us? Launched in 2023, INFINIT is a fast-growing fintech scale-up operating in multiple countries across Europe and Americas. At INFINIT we are on a mission to reshape the future of SMEs with AI at the forefront. Our all-in-one operating system has banking at its core, and empowers small business owners and their teams to seamlessly manage and optimize every aspect of their business with AI agents. By focussing on specific industries, INFINIT delivers tailored, high-value solutions, while building innovative AI products to further unlock significant growth opportunities for our customers. INFINIT operates globally, with ambitions to further expand its footprint to redefine the fintech landscape for SMEs worldwide. Join us on the INFINIT journey as we revolutionise the SME economy and drive meaningful impact through innovation 🚀 The Role

As an Account Executive at INFINIT, you will own new-business revenue from first contact to signed contract, working entirely from our office. You will source your own leads, run cold outreach by phone and email, deliver product demos, and close deals remotely, with no field visits.

This is a full sales cycle role. You will do the prospecting, the qualification, the demo, the negotiation and the close yourself, and show SME owners how INFINIT's AI-driven operating system transforms the way they run their business. We are looking for a self-starter with a hunter mentality, who is energised by a high-activity, phone-based sales environment and has a record of hitting and beating targets.


What do we want to achieve together?

  • You will own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through demo, negotiation and close, with a clear monthly and quarterly revenue target.

  • You will generate your own pipeline through cold calling, email and various outreach methods, and by researching and sourcing new leads in our target SME segments.

  • You will deliver tailored product demos by video call, uncovering each prospect's needs and showing how INFINIT's platform solves them.

  • You will build trusted relationships with business owners and decision-makers over the phone and online, and handle objections with confidence.

  • You will keep the CRM accurate and up to date, and forecast your pipeline reliably.

  • You will work closely with Product and Customer Success to hand over new customers smoothly and feed back what you hear in the market.

  • You will help refine our outbound playbook, messaging and value proposition based on what works.


    • What do you need to be successful in this role?

  • 3+ years of B2B sales experience in a full-cycle or inside sales role, with a proven record of meeting or exceeding quota.

  • Demonstrated experience prospecting your own leads through cold calling and outbound outreach, and closing deals without field visits.

  • Confidence delivering live product demos and running sales conversations by phone and video.

  • Strong communication, negotiation and objection-handling skills.

  • A hunter mentality: proactive, resourceful, resilient and driven by results.

  • Experience thriving in a fast-paced startup or scale-up with evolving processes.

  • An analytical mindset and attention to detail; comfortable using CRM and sales intelligence tools (e.g. Salesforce, HubSpot).

  • Ability to work cross-functionally with Customer Success and Operations to ensure a seamless customer handover.


    • What will you find working at INFINIT?
  • Competitive Salary and Equity: We offer highly competitive salaries and a stake in our success with share options because we're building this together.
  • Diverse and Inclusive Team: Join a dynamic and international team in excess of 8 nationalities. You'll have the chance to work with experienced professionals from around the world, fostering a rich learning environment.
  • Inspiring Mission: We are dedicated to revolutionizing business financing and making a positive impact on the European economy. Your work at INFINIT will have a lasting effect on businesses and communities.
  • Health and Well-being: Your health matters to us. You will have access to top-quality Medical & Mental Health Insurance via Alan as well as gym discount.
  • Quality Time Together: We foster a sense of community with annual gatherings and bi-weekly office team gatherings. You're more than welcome to join us for quality time.
  • Personal Time Off: Enjoy flexibility with your personal time off.
  • Flexibility and Ownership: We trust our team and we are goal-oriented. Enjoy the flexibility of hybrid working with 3 days a week at our London office and 2 days optional from home.
    • Diversity and Inclusion INFINIT promotes an inclusive culture that seeks equity and values different perspectives. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic.

  • Recruit, onboard and grow channel partners, including resellers, MSPs, VARs and integrators, and build joint business plans with measurable goals
  • Work closely with marketing on events, programmes and campaigns that create demand among partners’ customers

title: Account Executive 🇫🇷 (Small Businesses)
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Disclaimer: We're open to hire Account Executives across our Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes and Biarritz offices.

⭐️ The Account Executive (Small Businesses) job

Your mission

Join our Small Businesses team targeting companies with 10-30 employees across tech, consulting, and business services, the market segment where Alan has the strongest product-market fit and brand recognition. You'll work in a high-velocity environment with strong conversion rates, and the opportunity to make an immediate impact on hundreds of growing French companies.

What you'll own

  • Full sales cycle: From prospection to closing

  • Strategic relationships: Drive deals and manage key customer relationships

  • Education & demos: Deliver inspiring product demonstrations and guide stakeholders through the evaluation process

The Alan way of selling

We've developed the Alan Smart & Soft selling method:

  • Smart: Leverage precise messaging and materials to educate and inspire

  • Soft: Create tailored, high-touch strategies for each prospect

  • Experience: Deliver a seamless journey that reflects Alan's customer-first approach

Beyond sales

As an Alan team member, you'll:

  • Shape our product evolution

  • Contribute to improving our methods and strategy

  • Participate in growth initiatives

  • Be part of a collaborative team that thinks big

Join us in revolutionizing healthcare through technology and human connection 🌟

Meet Estelle Berdugo one of our Account Executives.


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Small Businesses Team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 3 years of experience managing the whole Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. Prospection is a key part of the role;

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English.

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills;

  • Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems;

  • Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building;

  • Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models;

  • Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team;

  • Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1;

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the B1-C0 level range.

If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France.


Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

descriptionHtml:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We are looking for an Account Executive, SMB who will play a critical role generating new business and fielding inbound prospects in their territory. You will be responsible for targeting, building and nurturing positive relationships with key decision-makers and assisting them through their Figma evaluation and buying process of all products. This is an opportunity to accelerate your career, learn from leading sellers in the industry and build an incredible network of cross functional partners at Figma.

What you'll do at Figma:

  • Create and manage a pipeline of SMB accounts from inbound and outbound activity to consistently meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales targets
  • Apply effective discovery and value-selling techniques to build and strengthen relationships with key decision-makers in both new and existing customers (500< FTEs)
  • Align with key decision makers to identify where Figma’s roadmap and innovations can solve business challenges
  • Conduct thorough analysis to tier and prioritize accounts in large volumes
  • Expertly position Figma and engage cross-functional partners where necessary to drive deals forward
  • Leverage opportunities to advance relationships through in-person meetings and networking opportunities

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • Experience closing sales for a software or SaaS business in an outbound function
  • Consistent performance meeting pipeline generation targets for net new business
  • Demonstrated experience successfully managing high volume sales cycles (1-3 months)
  • A sales methodology and process that creates value for customers
  • Fluency in German

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience selling solutions to technical audiences (i.e. Engineering, Product, Design teams)
  • Demonstrated ability to succeed in a changing environment
  • Certified in deal qualification and prospect discovery
At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish. Figma is an equal opportunity workplace - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity/expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to apply for a role, participate in the interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require accommodation, please reach out to

Examples of accommodations include but are not limited to: 

  • Holding interviews in an accessible location
  • Enabling closed captioning on video conferencing
  • Ensuring all written communication be compatible with screen readers
  • Changing the mode or format of interviews 

To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and facilitate a more personal connection, we require all candidates keep their cameras on during video interviews. Additionally, if hired you will be required to attend in person onboarding.

By applying for this job, the candidate acknowledges and agrees that any personal data contained in their application or supporting materials will be processed in accordance with Figma's Candidate Privacy Notice.

Application limits: To help candidates focus on the opportunities most relevant to their skills and experience, Figma limits the number and frequency of applications. These limits apply to all roles:

  • Candidates may submit up to 5 applications during any rolling 30-day period.
  • Candidates may not reapply to the same role while an application is active or within 90 days of receiving a rejection.

Once the applicable days has passed, candidates are welcome to apply again.

title: Account Executive - SMB Inbound (Inside Sales)
descriptionHtml:
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Mission Principale : En tant qu'Account Executive SMB, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le développement de notre portefeuille clients en traitant l'intégralité du cycle de vente, de la qualification des leads entrants jusqu’au closing. Votre focus sera les leads entrants non identifiés dans notre CRM, en dehors des sociétés déjà connues de notre base de données. Vous aurez pour objectif de transformer ces opportunités en contrats clients. Responsabilités : 1. Gestion du cycle de vente intégral : - Qualification des leads entrants : Identifier et prioriser les leads générés par le marketing ou d'autres canaux, avec un focus sur les entreprises SMB (1 à 5 juristes). - Compréhension des besoins clients : Mener des découvertes approfondies et efficaces pour comprendre les défis et besoins spécifiques des prospects afin de proposer la solution la plus adaptée. - Présentation des solutions : Démonstration de notre plateforme SaaS et de ses fonctionnalités en lien avec les enjeux des prospects. - Négociation et closing : Gérer la proposition de valeur, négocier les termes du contrat et finaliser les ventes jusqu'à la signature. 2. Suivi des opportunités commerciales : - Utilisation proactive du CRM pour tenir à jour les opportunités, le pipeline de vente, et assurer un suivi rigoureux des prospects. - Priorisation des opportunités les plus chaudes - Participer aux réunions hebdomadaires de revue du pipeline 3. Collaboration interservices : - Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Marketing, Produit et Customer Success pour assurer une excellente expérience client. - Remonter les feedbacks des prospects et clients pour améliorer le produit et les processus commerciaux. 4. Développement de la connaissance marché : - Maintenir une veille active sur les évolutions du secteur juridique et des besoins spécifiques des entreprises juridiques SMB. - Proposer des initiatives pour améliorer la qualification des leads et les stratégies de vente sur ce segment de marché. Objectifs et KPIs : - Honorer un nombre de volume rdvs journaliers issus de la qualification de leads entrants. - Taux de conversion des leads entrants en opportunités qualifiées. - Allier qualité et opportunisme dans traitement des salescycle pour convertir avec le meilleur Sales Cycle. - Atteinte des quotas de vente mensuels et trimestriels.
Compétences requises :
  • Expérience commerciale : Expérience significative en tant qu’Account Executive, Business Developer ou poste similaire, idéalement dans un environnement SaaS ou dans la vente de solutions B2B.
  • Cycle de vente complet : Capacité prouvée à gérer un cycle de vente de bout en bout (qualification, négociation, closing).
  • Orienté résultats : Forte capacité à atteindre et dépasser les objectifs de vente, avec un excellent sens des priorités.
  • Communication : Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale, capacité à établir des relations de confiance avec des interlocuteurs variés.

    • Qualités personnelles :
  • Autonomie et proactivité : Capacité à travailler de manière autonome dans un environnement startup en forte croissance.
  • Écoute active : Vous êtes à l’écoute des besoins de vos interlocuteurs et savez adapter votre discours en conséquence.
  • Esprit d'équipe : Vous aimez collaborer avec les autres départements pour atteindre des objectifs communs.
  • Adaptabilité : Vous êtes flexible et capable de vous adapter rapidement aux changements dans un environnement en constante évolution.
  • Résilience : Vous avez une forte capacité à surmonter les obstacles et à persévérer pour atteindre vos objectifs.

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.

    Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

    🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

    🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

    🌱 Des opportunités concrètes de mobilité interne

    🏄‍♂️ Des évènements collectifs réguliers

    📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise

    🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être

    🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an

    👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan

    🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois)

    💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal

    🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple

    Notre processus de recrutement 🚀

    • Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine
    • Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager, pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.
    • Un ou deux tests techniques pour évaluer concrètement tes compétences
    • Une venue dans nos bureaux pour : un déjeuner avec 3 personnes de différents départements chez Doctrine, pour te donner un aperçu de tes futur.e.s collègues ; un échange sur les valeurs de l’entreprise pour te partager notre vision, et une rencontre avec notre CEO, Guillaume.
    (si nécessaire le processus pourra être adapté pour répondre à tes contraintes personnelles et professionnelles) Mesdames, autorisez-vous à candidater ! Certaines études scientifiques montrent qu'en particulier les femmes ont moins tendance à postuler à une offre d'emploi quand elles n'ont pas toutes les qualifications. Si cela peut vous rassurer, sachez que cette fiche de poste est indicative donc prenez la comme telle : c'est un guide, ni plus ni moins. Si Doctrine vous intéresse, sachez que nous aurons plaisir à recevoir votre candidature ! Diversité & inclusion Toutes nos offres sont ouvertes aux personnes en situation de handicap, n'hésitez pas a nous en parler lors du process de recrutement. descriptionHtml:
Über Cosuno

Die Baubranche ist eine 14-Billionen-Euro-Industrie, die noch immer auf E-Mails, Excel-Tabellen und eingescannten PDFs läuft. Cosuno ersetzt das durch KI. Generalunternehmer schreiben ihre Projekte auf unserer Plattform an mehr als 250.000 Nachunternehmer aus, und unsere agentische KI findet die passenden Firmen, erkennt Auffälligkeiten in Angeboten und vergleicht jeden Preis mit 6,5 Millionen Datenpunkten aus über 136 Milliarden Euro verarbeitetem Angebotsvolumen. Jede Ausschreibung macht die KI klüger. Die Ergebnisse sind messbar: Generalunternehmer senken ihre Kosten um rund 6 %, Nachunternehmer gewinnen 22 % mehr Volumen, und jeder neue Generalunternehmer-Kunde hat sich in diesem Jahr für unser KI-Produkt entschieden. 2019 in Berlin gegründet und von Cherry Ventures und Spark Capital mit über 40 Millionen Euro finanziert, skalieren wir mit diesem Kapital jetzt Sales, Customer Success und Marketing. Und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Die Rolle

Du ownst jeden Kunden nach erfolgreichem Onboarding Abschluss: Performance Tracking, Erstkontakt nach Kündigungseingang innerhalb von fünf Werktagen, Pain-Analyse, Angebot, Abschluss oder sauberer Abschied. Du verhandelst Paketwechsel, Laufzeiten und Incentives selbstständig innerhalb des Playbooks und hältst den Preis, wo er zu halten ist.

Dein Erfolg bemisst sich am Wert deines Kundenpools: Winbacks, Downgrades, Upsells – was am Ende an ARR bleibt. Dafür forecastest du deine Cases wöchentlich mit Commit und Best Case und hältst Salesforce so sauber, dass dein Forecast ohne Nachfrage lesbar ist.

Rund 30 % deiner Zeit onboardest du Neukunden, die ohne Hilfe nicht in die Nutzung kommen: Onboarding-Call, Profil, erste Angebote.

Du berichtest an den Head of Customer Success.

Woran wir dich nach 12 Monaten messen

  • Mindestens 50 % der Kündigungen, die du bearbeitest, hast du (zu einem Upsell) gedreht.

  • Du bearbeitest alle Winback Cases im Monat, jeder Kunde hat innerhalb von fünf Werktagen von dir gehört und ein konkretes Angebot bekommen.

  • Dein Forecast steht jede Woche, Commit und Best Case, ohne dass jemand nachfragen muss.

  • Salesforce ist bei dir vollständig: Status, Kündigungsgrund, Angebot, Ergebnis – bei jedem Case.

Wer bei Cosuno erfolgreich ist

  • Ownership. Du sprichst über eigene Fehler, bevor jemand fragt, und darüber, was du daraus geändert hast.

  • Speed. Du löst Probleme pragmatisch und heute, nicht perfekt und nächstes Quartal.

  • Drive. Wenn du zur Monatsmitte unter Ziel liegst, telefonierst du mehr, nicht weniger.

  • Low Ego. Du teilst, was bei dir funktioniert hat, damit das Team besser wird.

Diese Rolle ist für dich, wenn

title: Account Manager - DACH
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

This is a builder's role, where you'll own both the technical depth and commercial outcomes for some of ElevenLabs' most exciting customers across the DACH region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland), sitting at the intersection of product, engineering, and revenue.

You'll get ahead of the problem. You'll dig into how customers deploy ElevenLabs across web, mobile, and their systems, spot the problems before they do, inspire new use-cases and own the solution end to end. You'll own the number too: renewals, expansion and cross-sell. Success here means driving real revenue retention and growth for your book of business.

 

What this looks like day to day

You'll run onboarding, enablement, and growth across ElevenLabs' full platform, core speech models, creative tools, and Agents. You'll advise customers on production deployment, not just theory, digging into usage and performance data to catch friction early and keep adoption moving.

You'll also own commercial outcomes for a defined book of business against clear targets: Gross Revenue Retention, Net Revenue Retention, cross-sell, and net expansion. You'll spot expansion opportunities early, own renewals and upsells end to end, and work closely with Sales, Engineering, and CS leadership to turn technical wins into revenue.

 

Requirements

  • 5+ years of Customer Success, Account Management or Technical Account Management experience supporting complex B2B SaaS, Developer Tools, or AI/ML products in the DACH region

  • Proven experience of owning and managing a defined Book of Business

  • Fluent in German and English

  • Proven experience working across the DACH market. Knowledge of the landscape and cultural nuances

  • Familiarity and experience with building and deploying AI agents

  • Strong builder mindset - you thrive in ambiguity and being a pioneer, finding ways to innovate across a full region or market to drive revenue outcomes

  • Familiarity and experience with API Integrations, and comfort and knowledge of navigating SDKs

  • Proven experience working cross functionally with Sales, Engineering, Product, and Marketing teams

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Germany.

title: Account Manager - EMEA
descriptionHtml:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Benchling believes in putting our customers at the center of everything we do. We strive to provide an exceptional experience for our customers and our users from the first touchpoint, through our implementations, and once they are live. We take pride in our world-class renewal rates, and Account Management is an essential part of this equation. To keep up with our rapidly expanding growth, we have a team of seasoned Account Managers with experience in Life Sciences, who can help grow the organization, develop our processes, and drive execution.

Our Account Manager team works alongside our Professional Services, Product, Sales and technical teams to help our most strategic customers enhance the value of their Benchling investments. Account Managers will engage regularly and strategize directly with our customers to ensure long term value. Alongside the client, they will develop strategies and tactics to understand the health of the client, own renewal negotiations and execution and drive expansion of success packages. Through regular engagements with the clients, Account Managers will identify clients who can benefit from a product or technical subject matter expert related to areas of improvement, and direct them to the approapriate team to drive progress on customer initiatives.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build and maintain productive relationships with key stakeholders across Scientific and IT functional areas including customer champions and economic buyers

  • Experience managing complex customers with highly technical implementations

  • Utilize customer engagement models throughout the lifetime customer journey to ensure customer satisfaction, governance, expansion opportunity in order to maximize value.

  • Use strong processes and systems are in place so that trends in customer contraction and churn are identified early, communicated with the appropriate audience, and appropriate follow-up action is taken

  • Manage the renewal experience,identify and define client challenges or new scientific business case opportunities aligned with the customers’ objectives and vision with support from the extended Benchling team to client success and avoid contraction/churn.

  • Experience negotiating upwards of $100,000 in ARR for renewals and expansions in collaboration with sales to drive accurate forecasting around adoption, expansion and retention.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • BS or M.Sc. in Biology, Molecular Biology, Genetics, Biotechnology, Bioengineering or experience working in the Life Sciences field.

  • 2+ years of Account management, Customer Success, Renewal Management, Sales, Professional Services, or Consulting experience in a SaaS software environment with the ability to forge relationships with users, decision makers, and influential stakeholders

  • 2+ years commercial experience in negotiations utilizing skills to handle contract discussions and ensure favorable outcomes for both the customer and the company

  • An understanding of Life Sciences R&D processes and scientific concepts is preferred. Demonstrated ability to immediately interface and build trust with Scientists, as well as Director & VP Level Business and IT leaders in top Biotech and Pharma companies

  • Excellent communication skills, able to communicate confidently and concisely in verbal, written and presentation formats to all types of audiences

  • Self-motivated, independent, adaptable, and can thrive in a fast-paced startup environment

  • Ability to travel 10-20% based on customer needs

#LI-Remote

#BI-Remote

Benchling welcomes everyone.

We believe diversity enriches our team so we hire people with a wide range of identities, backgrounds, and experiences.

We are an equal opportunity employer. That means we don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

title: Account Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Werde Account Manager (m/w/d) mit Fokus Digital Media bei Carwow in München.

Du verkaufst unsere digitalen Mediaprodukte YouTube, Meta und Data an Automobilhersteller, Partner und Mediaagenturen und begleitest die Kampagnen von der Buchung bis zur Aussteuerung.

Du bist dir nicht ganz sicher, ob die Position zu dir passt? Bewirb dich und lass es uns gemeinsam herausfinden.



Unsere Mission

Carwow ist Europas führende Plattform für den Autowechsel. Wir verändern, wie Menschen Autos kaufen, verkaufen und leasen. Mit Technologie, Medien und Automotive Expertise haben wir uns von einer reinen Bewertungsplattform zu einem der größten Online-Marktplätze entwickelt.

Unsere Reichweite geht weit über die eigene Plattform hinaus: 10 Mio. YouTube Abonnenten und mehr als 350 Mio. Online Leser pro Jahr in der Gruppe. Genau diese Reichweite und unsere Daten machen wir jetzt für Werbekunden auch außerhalb von Carwow nutzbar.

Dein Impact @ Carwow

Du baust die Säule Digital Media, Audiences und Data im deutschen OEM & Media Team aus. Unsere Brand Partnerships Manager:innen verkaufen Retail Media auf der Plattform. Du sorgst dafür, dass Carwow auch in den Mediaplänen der Agenturen fest gesetzt ist.

Dafür hast du drei Produkte im Gepäck. Du schnürst daraus Pakete, die zu den Zielen der Partner passen und verbindest sie mit unserem Retail Media Angebot zu einer durchgängigen Media Story bis zum Kauf. So wächst ein noch junger Umsatzstrom zu einem festen Standbein, und du prägst ihn von Anfang an mit.

YouTube: Bewegtbildkampagnen im Carwow Umfeld und mit Carwow Zielgruppen, von Awareness bis Klick

Meta: Kampagnen auf Facebook und Instagram, ausgesteuert auf Menschen, die gerade nachweislich ein Auto suchen

Data: Datenberatung auf Basis der Carwow Daten, verbunden mit unserem Verständnis des deutschen Automarkts

Und neue Produkte: Weitere Formate und Ideen, die wir gerade entwickeln. Du bringst ein, was Kunden und Agenturen brauchen, und führst neue Produkte in den Markt ein


Deine Aufgaben als Account Manager mit Fokus Digital Media

  • Du verantwortest den Umsatz mit YouTube, Meta und Data im deutschen Markt und baust ihn gezielt aus (genau hier brauchst du eine "Hunter Mentalität" im Vertrieb)

  • Du bist erste Ansprechperson für die Mediaagenturen der Automobilhersteller, von den großen Networks bis zu den spezialisierten Häusern, und kennst dort Planung, Einkauf und Strategie

  • Du gewinnst gemeinsam mit unseren Brand Partnerships Manager:innen die Marketing und Mediaverantwortlichen der OEMs für unsere Digitalprodukte

  • Du beantwortest Briefings mit Mediaplänen und Angebote, die sich an den KPIs der Kunden messen lassen, und überzeugst mit starken Pitches

  • Du bringst gewonnene Kampagnen sauber in die Buchung: Angebot, Auftrag, Übergabe an Media Operations und Abstimmung von Assets, Laufzeiten und Tracking

  • Du steuerst laufende Kampagnen gemeinsam mit Media Operations aus, optimierst auf die vereinbarten KPIs, ordnest Reportings für Kunden ein und machst aus guten Ergebnissen Folgebuchungen und Jahresvereinbarungen

  • Du entwickelst mit Produkt, Analytics und Media Operations unsere Angebote weiter und bringst zurück, was Agenturen wirklich brauchen

    ... und du pflegst deine Pipeline und deinen Forecast so, dass wir uns darauf gemeinsam verlassen können

Dein Profil


Hinweis: Niemand erfüllt alle Anforderungen zu 100 %. Wenn du dich stark mit der Rolle identifiziert und Lust auf richtig guten Mediavertrieb hast, freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung. Denn wir wollen gemeinsam mit dir wachsen.

  • Du bringst mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im digitalen Mediavertrieb mit, zum Beispiel bei einem Vermarkter, Publisher, einer Plattform oder auf Agenturseite

  • Du kennst die deutsche Agenturlandschaft und hast idealerweise ein belastbares Netzwerk in den Agenturen

  • Du hast digitale Kampagnen selbst aufgesetzt und ausgesteuert, idealerweise in DV360 (YouTube) und im Meta Ads Manager, und sprichst über CPM, Reichweite und Conversion so sicher wie über Markenziele

  • Du arbeitest gern mit Daten und kannst aus Zahlen eine Geschichte machen, die ein Kunde versteht und kauft

  • Du präsentierst komplexe Sachverhalte zielgruppengerecht und überzeugend, vor der Planer:in genauso wie vor der Marketingleitung

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig, auch wenn mehrere Angebote und Buchungen gleichzeitig laufen

  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie verhandlungssicheres Englisch

    Benzin im Blut ist kein Muss, Neugier auf die Automobilbranche schon.



Unser Interview Prozess

  • Talent Screen (telefonisch) mit unserem Recruiting Team - ca. 30 Minuten

  • Video Interview (online) mit dem Fachbereich - ca. 30 Minuten

  • Case Study (vor Ort) mit dem Fachbereich - ca. 60 Minuten

  • Final Values & Team Fit (vor Ort oder online) nach Möglichkeit im Anschluss an deine Case Study - ca. 30 Minuten


Und was springt für dich dabei raus?

Bei uns findest du ein innovatives, vielfältiges und lockeres Arbeitsumfeld im Herzen Münchens. Dazu kommen:

  • Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehaltspaket mit variablem Anteil

  • 28 Urlaubstage, die mit der Betriebszugehörigkeit auf bis zu 35 Tage steigen, plus Sonderurlaub für Umzüge, Hochzeiten und mehr

  • Hybrides Arbeiten (3 Tage Office, 2 Tage Home Office, für dessen Ausstattung du ein Budget von 500 Euro on top bekommst)

  • Eine Bezuschussung der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge

  • Eine vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft im Urban Sports Club

  • ... sowie eine ehrliche Work Life Balance

Vielfalt und Inklusion sind fest in unserer Unternehmenskultur verankert. Wir freuen uns über jede Bewerbung und treffen unsere Entscheidungen fair, transparent und ausschließlich auf Basis von Fähigkeiten, Erfahrung und Potenzial.

title: Account Manager, native Mandarin speaker
descriptionHtml:
We pull medical technology from the future to solve human health.

 

Scarlet is authorised to assess and certify medical devices. We combine clinical, technical and regulatory expertise with AI agents and software so rigorous certification can keep pace with product development at the world’s most ambitious technology companies, without lowering the safety bar.

Our customers have cut a year or more from their certification timelines for new AI-enabled medical devices and shortened product-update cycles from months to weeks. You’ll join a team building the infrastructure that makes these outcomes repeatable at scale.

About the role

As an Account Manager (Customer Outcomes Specialist) at Scarlet, you will own customer relationships from onboarding through expansion. You will keep complex projects on track, remove friction, and ensure customers achieve their goals. You will work day-to-day with ambitious medical technology companies and help them deliver safe devices to patients sooner.

This is a London-based role requiring native-level Mandarin and excellent English. You will initially manage existing English-speaking customers, including accounts outside China, while helping us prepare for future demand from Chinese-speaking customers. As that demand grows, your portfolio may increasingly include Chinese-speaking accounts. You will remain based in London, including if China-related work becomes your full-time focus.

 

Responsibilities

  • Build long-term, trust-based relationships with forward-thinking companies in health tech

  • Act as the central point of accountability for customers, ensuring the right outcomes, at the right time, with clear communication throughout.

  • Listen closely, capture what matters, and surface it, so internal teams stay aligned with what customers value (and what they don’t) throughout the journey.

  • Spot friction early and eliminate it - whether it is process confusion, scope drift, or quiet frustrations.

  • Own every key moment - from onboarding to expansion - keeping customers focused and confident, even when the path is complex.

  • Support customers in English and, as demand develops, Mandarin, with an initial portfolio that includes English-speaking accounts outside China.

 

Required qualifications

  • You’ve owned complex customer relationships in B2B environments for 3+ years, preferably within the health tech industry and/or a regulated industry.

  • You operate with a bias for action. Customers turn to you in critical moments, and internal teams count on your signal to make smart bets.

  • You have strong project management skills. You connect dots, see risks early and keep multiple workstreams on track without breaking a sweat.

  • You have an insatiable curiosity and thrive in a fast-paced and innovative environment, eager to think creatively and iterate quickly.

  • Your verbal and written communication skills are exemplary, aligned with MECE principles and adapted to an asynchronous work environment.

 

The Interview Process

Note: we typically collapse interviews 4-5 into one in-person session at our London HQ.

  1. Intro call with Aarzoo (30 mins)

  2. An advanced Mandarin language test (20 mins)

  3. CX team interviews: Rachel (60 mins), Steven (30 mins)

  4. Culture Q&A with Yun in Mandarin (10 mins)

  5. Founder interviews: James and Jamie (2x20 mins)

  6. Offer & references

Compensation: £60K – £70K • Offers Equity

title: Account Manager — New Business & Closing (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Manager — New Business & Closing (m/f/d) based in France.

As an Account Manager specializing in new business and closing, you will turn qualified sales opportunities into signed partnerships, helping businesses unlock the commercial potential of loyalty programmes. You will manage the full sales cycle, from discovery and solution development to presentations, negotiations, and contract closure. Working with small and medium-sized businesses, you will identify customer acquisition and retention challenges and demonstrate how loyalty solutions can drive repeat purchases and sustainable growth. You will collaborate closely with Sales Development Representatives and Customer Success to ensure a seamless customer journey, from the first qualified conversation through successful onboarding. By combining consultative selling, disciplined pipeline management, and AI-powered sales tools, you will help accelerate revenue growth in an expanding B2B loyalty market. This is an opportunity to join an international, remote-first team where commercial ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement are central to success.


Accountabilities:
  • Own the full sales cycle: Manage qualified opportunities from initial discovery through solution development, proposal preparation, commercial negotiations, and signed agreements, taking personal responsibility for converting prospects into customers.
  • Conduct consultative discovery: Understand each prospect's business model, target audience, commercial priorities, customer acquisition challenges, and buying process to identify meaningful opportunities for loyalty partnerships.
  • Develop tailored loyalty propositions: Demonstrate how loyalty currencies, including airline miles and reward points, can help businesses attract new customers, increase spending, strengthen retention, and encourage repeat purchases.
  • Lead presentations and negotiations: Deliver compelling sales presentations, prepare customized proposals, address objections, negotiate commercial terms, and guide decision-makers toward confident purchasing decisions.
  • Maintain deal momentum: Establish clear next steps, engage relevant stakeholders, follow up consistently, and proactively address obstacles throughout the sales process to improve conversion rates and shorten sales cycles.
  • Manage pipeline and forecasting: Maintain accurate records in HubSpot, qualify opportunities objectively, track deal progression, and produce realistic forecasts based on customer engagement and demonstrated buying intent.
  • Leverage AI and sales technology: Use AI-powered tools to improve prospect research, meeting preparation, follow-up communications, and pipeline analysis while applying sound judgment to customer interactions and sales decisions.
  • Coordinate with internal teams: Work closely with Sales Development Representatives on qualified leads and provide Customer Success with structured handovers covering customer objectives, agreed deliverables, commercial commitments, and implementation expectations.
  • Contribute to sales strategy: Share insights on successful deals, common objections, customer needs, and conversion challenges to help refine sales messaging, improve the proposition, and strengthen the overall sales process.
  • Collaborate with sales leadership: Work directly with the Head of Partnerships on live opportunities, commercial strategies, performance improvement, and initiatives that support the growth of the sales team.

    • Requirements:

  • B2B sales experience: At least three years of relevant B2B sales experience, with a demonstrated track record of acquiring new customers and successfully closing commercial agreements.
  • Relevant industry background: Experience selling on the provider side of the loyalty, CRM, or marketing industry, such as within a loyalty technology company, software platform, agency, or specialist services provider.
  • Full-cycle sales ownership: Proven ability to manage opportunities independently from discovery and qualification through presentations, proposals, negotiations, and contract signature.
  • SME sales expertise: Experience selling to small and medium-sized businesses, managing multiple opportunities simultaneously, and adapting sales approaches to different customer needs and buying processes.
  • Commercial understanding of loyalty: Ability to explain loyalty programmes in straightforward business terms and connect proposed solutions to customer acquisition, retention, spending, and overall business economics.
  • Strong communication skills: Excellent presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building abilities, with the confidence to engage business stakeholders and communicate complex propositions clearly.
  • Language proficiency: Fluency in both German and English, with the ability to conduct sales conversations, deliver presentations, and negotiate effectively in both languages.
  • CRM and pipeline discipline: Practical experience using CRM platforms, ideally HubSpot, with strong habits around opportunity qualification, record keeping, follow-up, and forecasting.
  • AI tool proficiency: Confidence using AI tools in daily sales activities, including research, preparation, communication, and pipeline analysis, while maintaining accuracy and a personal approach.
  • Ownership and resilience: A proactive, persistent, and commercially motivated mindset, with the ability to maintain deal momentum, navigate objections, and take responsibility for results.
  • Learning and collaboration: Openness to coaching, a willingness to share knowledge, and a team-oriented approach to improving sales performance and contributing to shared goals.
  • Remote working readiness: Ability to work independently in an international remote environment and maintain reliable availability during shared Central European Time (CET) business hours.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation: A monthly compensation range of €5,000–€10,000, with a base salary and performance-based variable compensation.
  • Remote-first flexibility: Work remotely from anywhere in the world, subject to the role's working-hour requirements and applicable employment arrangements.
  • Work-life balance: A standard 40-hour working week and 24 days of annual leave.
  • Direct leadership access: Collaborate closely with sales leadership on active opportunities, commercial strategy, and professional development.
  • Clear role ownership: Benefit from qualified leads generated by Sales Development Representatives, with dedicated responsibility for closing deals and a structured handover to Customer Success.
  • Professional growth: Help shape sales processes, test new approaches, and contribute ideas as the partnership business expands.
  • International team environment: Work with a collaborative, ambitious team that values initiative, knowledge sharing, mutual support, and celebrating commercial wins.
  • AI-enabled sales environment: Use modern tools to streamline workflows, improve productivity, and strengthen sales execution.
  • Meaningful commercial impact: Help businesses unlock new customer acquisition and retention opportunities through innovative loyalty partnerships.

Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? title: Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.
Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.
Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.
How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.
About the Role: As an Account Manager at Aircall, you are the owner of customer success and revenue growth across your portfolio. You drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by uncovering opportunities to expand, renew, and strengthen customer relationships. Acting as both the voice of Aircall for the customer and the voice of the customer within Aircall, you ensure our customers realize the full value of their investment while fueling sustainable growth for Aircall. By deeply understanding the needs of our customers across a variety of industries and use cases, you become the trusted expert who identifies growth potential and helps improve the customer experience. This means translating customer goals into solutions that unlock adoption, value realization, and expansion — ensuring each account grows in both impact and partnership over time. This is a highly strategic and commercial role — blending consultative relationship management with the rigor and energy of a quota-carrying seller. You’ll partner cross-functionally with Customer Engineering, Product, and Support to accelerate adoption, drive usage of add-on SKUs, and build deep, long-term relationships with customers at all levels of their organizations. Aircall is undergoing an exciting transformation — building on our market-leading communications platform and introducing AI functionality that helps customers operate more intelligently, efficiently, and competitively. Join us and be part of shaping that journey. This is a hybrid role, in office 3 days a week in Paris.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Own NRR: Manage the full post-sale lifecycle — driving renewals, expansions, and churn mitigation to deliver predictable and profitable growth.
  • Drive Growth: Identify and activate growth opportunities within your portfolio, prospecting into new subsidiaries, use cases, and additional SKUs to unlock untapped potential.
  • Target Strategically: Prioritize high-potential accounts that may have low spend today but represent strong expansion opportunities, developing long-term growth plans.
  • Prospect and Outbound: Run proactive outreach within your base to expand relationships and identify new value creation opportunities.
  • Develop Stakeholder Maps: Build and maintain multi-layer relationships — from daily users to senior decision-makers — ensuring alignment, sponsorship, and retention.
  • Sell Competitively: Position Aircall’s value head-to-head against competitors, with a clear understanding of how our solutions address each customer’s unique business needs.
  • Negotiate and Close: Lead complex renewal and upsell negotiations, balancing commercial outcomes with customer success to close revenue and foster loyalty.
  • Manage Pipeline & Forecast: Maintain an accurate pipeline of renewal and expansion opportunities and deliver consistent, data-driven NRR forecasting.
  • Partner for Adoption: Collaborate closely with your Customer Engineering counterpart to ensure customers achieve adoption milestones and measurable outcomes.
  • Champion the Customer Voice: Surface insights, pain points, and product feedback that inform Aircall’s product roadmap and go-to-market strategies.
  • Shape Local Strategy: Share learnings across teams to enhance customer experience and strengthen regional growth initiatives.

    • Qualifications:
  • Experienced in SaaS Account Management, Commercial Customer Success, or Renewal Management, with a track record of achieving revenue targets.
  • Skilled in consultative sales, prospecting, and negotiation, with the ability to balance commercial focus and customer advocacy.
  • Customer-obsessed — curious about how different industries and use cases leverage Aircall, and proactive in identifying ways to add value.
  • Capable of developing and executing account expansion strategies, including stakeholder mapping and whitespace analysis.
  • Confident in competitive sales cycles, able to articulate differentiation and handle objections effectively.
  • Analytical, detail-oriented, and accountable for forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene.

title: Account Manager - SMB
descriptionHtml:
About Hiya

At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective.

Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve.

Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed.

About the Role

Hiya is growing its SMB customer base across the UK and Europe, and this role exists to ensure those customers stay, grow, and succeed.

This role sits within Hiya Connect - our branded calling product. Hiya Connect Branded Call enables businesses to display their verified brand name, logo, and call reason on outbound calls, helping customers recognize trusted calls, increase answer rates, and improve engagement.

As an Account Manager, SMB, you’ll own a high-volume portfolio of 300+ customers. You’ll make commercial decisions every day about how to prioritise your time, engage customers, and create growth across your book of business. The pace is fast and the portfolio is broad.

Our European base is growing quickly, and this role is for someone who can work with customers in German, French or Spanish as well as English. Holding a renewal or pricing conversation in a customer’s own language builds trust faster, and at this end of the market that speed matters.

This role is perfect for someone who enjoys autonomy, thrives in a high-velocity environment and wants genuine ownership of customer outcomes, with a clear path into more strategic account management as Hiya continues to scale across Europe.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own a portfolio of 300+ SMB accounts across the UK and Europe, with full accountability for renewals and expansion

  • Manage your European accounts in German, French or Spanish as well as English

  • Triage your book daily - identify which accounts need intervention and which are healthy enough to run digitally

  • Run proactive outreach to at-risk accounts before they become churn conversations

  • Identify natural expansion signals - usage growth, new teams, new use cases and convert them into upsell opportunities

  • Forecast portfolio performance and maintain accurate CRM records

  • Surface patterns from your book of business that help Sales, Product, and Support improve how Hiya serves SMB customers

  • Balance short-term renewal pressure with longer-term account health, making clear tradeoffs under volume

What We Are Looking For

  • 2+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a commercial SaaS role

  • Must have - Business-level German, French or Spanish - confident holding renewal, pricing, and expansion conversations in that language

  • Demonstrated ownership of renewals, expansions, or quota

  • Commercial instinct - able to spot a growth opportunity, build a case for it, and close it without heavy support

  • Clear, direct communication with customers and internal stakeholders

  • Comfortable working independently in an environment where not every process is fully defined

You’ll Likely Stand Out If You Have

  • Experience managing SMB or Mid-Market customers

  • Experience working across UK and European markets

  • More than one of German, French or Spanish, or an additional European language

  • Experience balancing personalised customer engagement with scale

  • Exposure to conversation intelligence, caller ID, or communications technology

Role details

  • Status: Full-time

  • Type: Hybrid

  • Location: London, United Kingdom

  • Travel: Up to 25%

  • Department: Sales – Customer Success

  • Reports to: Sr. Manager: Customer Success, UK & EU

 

Come Work With Us!

We're building a team with diverse perspectives, identities, and professional experiences. We evaluate candidates through a business lens and believe that diversity and unique viewpoints make our company stronger, more dynamic, and a great place to build a career.

We've been recognized by Built In, GeekWire, Comparably, G2, Forbes, and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 for our culture, innovation, leadership, compensation, and more. At Hiya, we're a people-centric company focused on helping each employee grow both personally and professionally. We create a culture of support and empowerment that challenges the status quo, resulting in an energized team that's passionate about their work. You'll love working here if you're looking for an innovative challenge that's disrupting an industry. Come join us!
