title: AI Engineer (LLM Products) - Remote
descriptionHtml:
Welcome to dexter health!!

At dexter health, we build AI-powered software for care teams. Our mission is to reduce administrative workload in healthcare so caregivers can spend more time with patients.

We are looking for a high-agency AI Engineer to help us build new AI features faster and improve the quality, reliability, and speed of existing AI workflows.

This is a hands-on engineering role. Not research. Not prompt-only. You will turn ambiguous product ideas into working, production-ready AI features.

The role is mostly focused on shipping AI product features, with some AI systems and infrastructure work where needed.

You will work closely with product and engineering, but we expect you to take real ownership. You should be comfortable moving fast, making technical decisions under ambiguity, and using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar every day.

Tasks

As our AI Engineer, you will:

  • Build new AI-powered product features from idea to production

  • Improve existing AI workflows for quality, reliability, latency, and user value

  • Design and implement LLM-based workflows, structured outputs, validation logic, and fallback behavior

  • Build evaluation loops, tests, and quality checks for AI-generated outputs

  • Integrate AI capabilities into existing product and backend systems

  • Work with commercial and open-source LLMs without being tied to one specific provider

  • Support self-hosted model workflows where they make sense for quality, speed, cost, or control

  • Debug AI feature failures across inputs, outputs, data, backend logic, and user flows

  • Use AI development tools as a core part of your daily workflow

  • Ship quickly while keeping production quality high

Requirements

We care less about formal seniority and more about speed, intelligence, ownership, and product impact. We like people who operate with founder-like urgency: they figure things out, make progress under ambiguity, and care about outcomes more than titles.

Must-have

  • Strong software engineering skills, especially in Python or a comparable backend language

  • Experience building AI-powered product features or LLM-based workflows

  • Ability to turn ambiguous product ideas into working software quickly

  • Strong understanding of how to design, test, validate, and improve AI outputs

  • Experience integrating AI workflows into production systems

  • Strong debugging instincts across application logic, data, model outputs, and user-facing behavior

  • Experience with evaluation, testing, validation, or quality checks for AI-generated outputs

  • Serious experience using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar as part of your daily workflow

  • High intelligence, fast learning speed, bias to action, and ownership mindset

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, fast decisions, and a high-trust startup environment

  • Clear written and spoken English

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with frontend or fullstack product development

  • Experience with self-hosted LLMs, model serving, inference optimization, or similar systems

  • Experience with open-source LLMs and related deployment workflows

  • Experience improving latency, cost, quality, or reliability of AI systems

  • Experience with healthcare software, healthcare data, or regulated environments

  • Experience working with structured data extraction, documentation automation, voice workflows, or workflow automation

  • German language skills

  • Knowledge of nursing homes or elderly care workflows

This role is probably not for you if

  • You are mainly looking for an ML research role

  • You are a prompt engineer without strong coding skills

  • You need detailed specifications before making progress

  • You prefer slow, highly structured corporate environments

  • You are mainly looking for management, not hands-on building

  • You want to use AI tools only occasionally instead of as part of your daily workflow

  • You optimize for perfect process over fast, reliable execution

Benefits

  • Remote work

  • Fair compensation based on skills, experience, and location

  • Ownership of important backend systems

  • Work on software used in real healthcare workflows

  • Modern AI-native development workflow

  • Room to grow with the company

Why?

Caregivers spend too much time on documentation, coordination, and administrative work. We build technology that reduces this burden.

AI is core to our product. But useful AI features do not come from demos alone. They need strong engineering, fast iteration, evaluation, production thinking, and deep ownership of the user outcome.

If you want to build AI product features that ship, improve real workflows, use AI tools every day, and take ownership in a fast-moving team, we would like to hear from you.

title: AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Opportunity

The Data Science team is growing at 9fin! We are doing world-class work with groundbreaking technologies to build data-driven products using machine learning, computer vision, natural language processing, speech and audio, and knowledge/data mining. We are looking for a AI Engineer to accelerate our application of AI across teams and products. Come and join us, you will get to build large-scale AI powered systems, learn and apply the latest techniques, and work alongside other great researchers and engineers!

Every day is different, but here's an example of the kind of things you'll work on:

  • Design and build generative AI applications tailored to complex financial and legal workflows, leveraging state-of-the-art models to deliver innovative, practical solutions that streamline decision-making and unlock new efficiencies.

  • Drive end to end model development lifecycle, leading the team in best practices, ensuring reproducible research and well managed model delivery/deployment.

  • Collaborate cross functionally to share diverse ideas, understand business problems, and elevate/mentor your teammates.

  • Translate complex problems into well-defined scoped bets in an internal startup style environment, dynamic and fast-paced.

  • Learn and apply ground-breaking research and approaches in advanced topics, iterating improvements with a fail fast mentality.

  • Be a proactive sharer of compelling ideas/work to the rest of the team and organisation. We want you to help lead/push the adoption of AI throughout 9fin.

About You

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • Strong proficiency in Python for production ready delivery.

  • You’re an expert in any of the following areas - deep expertise in one and familiarity with others is ideal:

    • Information Retrieval: chunking strategies, (finetuning) embedding models, training re-rankers.

    • Entity/relationship extraction/resolution

    • Knowledge Graphs; building and inference, graphRAG

    • Recommendation systems and ranking: personalisation, learning-to-rank, feed ranking, user modelling, etc.

    • Tabular ML: feature engineering, structured data modelling (GBDTs, etc.)

    • Statistical & Predictive Modelling: supervised ML, anomaly detection, temporal modelling, etc.

    • Deep understanding of the GenAI landscape and agentic frameworks.

  • Experience working in the full model lifecycle (including experimentation, training, testing, monitoring, and deployment). We are data centric and love our evals!

  • You have a strong product focus with a desire to understand the end-to-end impact of your solutions for our end users.

  • Good knowledge of AWS’s AI infrastructure.

Benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance 

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off 

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Hybrid working model, to allow you the flexibility to decide how, where and when you do your best work

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Training & Culture 

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • AI experimentation budget of £800 (UK) per employee to trial AI tools

  • Quarterly team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

This role combines applied AI engineering, process design and hands-on Python development. You will work on loosely defined problems, test ideas quickly and turn the strongest ones into reliable services.

In under a year, we built a chatbot across Loans, Credit Cards and Motor Finance that now handles more than 1 million customer chats a year at around a 70% resolution rate. It completes complex account actions autonomously, end to end, and we hold it to the same standard as our best operations agents.

We have also built AI document parsers that process around 500,000 documents a year, and are trialling voice AI on our phone lines. You will help take these systems further and find the next high-impact processes to automate.

What you will do

  • Improve the chatbot's quality and expand the account actions it can complete autonomously.

  • Expand our in-house document extraction pipelines to make parsing faster and more accurate.

  • Design LLM-driven workflows that simplify case management.

  • Find new opportunities to replace manual work with effective AI systems.

  • Own solutions from discovery and prototyping through deployment, evaluation and monitoring.

What we are looking for

  • Strong engineering skills and experience building production systems.

  • Hands-on experience using LLMs in real workflows.

  • Experience designing and improving prompts, retrieval pipelines, agent workflows and evaluations.

  • An understanding of business processes and good judgement about where AI can simplify or automate them.

  • The ability to structure ambiguous problems, test hypotheses and make progress with partial information.

  • Clear communication and the ability to explain trade-offs and influence stakeholders.

Why join us

  • Work with LLMs, retrieval systems, agents and automation pipelines every day.

  • Join a small, autonomous team with meaningful ownership and decision-making power.

Interview process

  1. Introductory call

  2. Take-home exercise

  3. Take home debrief

  4. Case study

  5. Onsite final interview

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • More info: The FAQ below, juro.com/careers, our handbook or ask ----- anything.

HELP US HELP THE WORLD AGREE FASTER

Juro has big ambitions: to make it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts. And we'll need help doing it.

Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity.

Our Agentic team was the first team at Juro to go fully AI-native, and it's been the role model for our other product teams as Juro evolved into an AI company.

As the Agentic team, we build the AI foundations the rest of engineering ships on — starting with Operator, the agent that works across contracts inside Juro.

We want Operator to do a lot more. That takes more and better tools, solid evals, and a harness that keeps up with a stack that’s still rapidly evolving. And more great people to do it.

What you're here to do

Give Operator the tools it needs to act across Juro and make sure what it does is measurably good. In your first months, success looks like this:

  • You've shipped new tools that connect Operator to the Juro app, from first idea to production.

  • What you ship has evals around it, supported by the Quality Assurance team, so we can tell whether a new model, prompt or library version makes things better or worse.

  • You own parts of the agent harness (planning, tool use, context) without the team becoming a. bottleneck.

  • You review a lot of agent-written code and decide quickly what's safe to merge and what will break three cycles later.

We care about building a diverse team where everyone feels they belong. That’s why our perks & benefits and choice-first work approach are designed with inclusivity in mind. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub.

WHO WE LOOK FOR

Research shows that while men apply to jobs if they meet ~60% of criteria, women and those in traditionally under-represented groups tend to apply only if they check all boxes. So if you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

To succeed here:

Every Juror finds their balance across our four core Principles — we hire, develop and celebrate people who live them every day.

Curious how you’d fit? Try our personality quiz to see how you map against our principles.

On top of that, you have been part of a journey where:

  • You’re a programmer first, and you now build with AI and LLMs. You’ve written production TypeScript/Node.js and MongoDB for users. Agents write most of the code today, but you can still tell when an agent’s output shouldn’t go through.

  • You’ve built agentic systems yourself, including the tools that let agents act on APIs and integrations. You can explain the parts of an agent (planning, tools, context, the loop around them) because you’ve built them.

  • You’ve written and run evals and think about quality in probabilities.

  • You’ve shipped something people can use: a product, an open-source project or a tool. (We’ll ask you for a link or description in our application form.)

  • Bonus: you’ve used our AI stack before. It changes often, so understanding why things break matters more than knowing the tools already.

Day to day, you’ll work with Node.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, Redis and pgvector on AWS, plus Bedrock, LiteLLM and Mastra for the AI layer.

These requirements can come from a job, a side project or open source. The field is about two years old, so we care about what you've built, not how many years you've been doing it.

This job likely isn’t for you if:

  • You need a polished setup before you can ship. We'd rather ship a small, good version this week than a perfect one in two weeks, by which time the stack has moved on.

  • You want a stable roadmap. Priorities here can change week to week.

  • You want to rebuild things whenever you'd have done them differently. We disagree a lot and openly, but once a call is made, we commit and move.

  • You've only ever worked inside one opinionated framework and never looked under the hood.

  • You'd rather build product UI. Most of this work is foundations other engineers build on.

OUR MISSION

Juro exists to help the world agree faster by making it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts.

The load on legal teams is increasing as business teams move faster with the help of AI. The only way out is to deploy AI within the legal team so that (a) routine contract work can be executed autonomously and (b) lawyers’ time is reserved for problem solving.

It’s like having an extra team member that is always on and takes on heavy lifting. Just like an in-house lawyer, Juro:

  • is present for, and trusted by, business teams

  • owns contracts from first draft to signature and beyond

  • builds judgement from every contract it works on

…all within guardrails controlled by the legal team.

  • Our careers page: https://juro.notion.site

title: AI-for-Hardware Engineer, Frontier Tech
descriptionHtml:
About Hexa

Hexa (formerly eFounders) gives entrepreneurs the best chances to build outstanding companies.

We are a pioneering, world-leading startup studio born in Europe that designs, builds and launches category-defining startups. We are today recognized as one of the best venture studios in the world, with a track record comparable to tier-1 VC funds.

We have created 60+ companies (including 3 unicorns) with a combined valuation of over $5 billion, among them Aircall, Spendesk, Front, Swan and Yousign.

Hexa is in full growth mode, with three early-stage activities: our Ventures programs Hexa Start and Hexa Sprint which help entrepreneurs go from zero to one, and a PE program, Hexa Scale, which takes majority stakes in existing startups and pushes them to new thresholds.

The hardware vertical at Hexa: Frontier Tech

Frontier Tech is Hexa’s studio focused on physical tech, led by Guerric de Crombrugghe.

We build companies that move atoms: real machines, deployed in the field, often for defense, energy, space and critical infrastructure. A few examples of what is on the bench today include containerized atmospheric water generators, expendable turbojets, and ship-borne satellite ground stations.

Our edge is velocity. We go from idea to working hardware with small teams and lean budgets, against legacy players with hundreds of engineers and decade-long programs. AI is now the biggest lever we have to widen that gap, today by speeding up how we build, and tomorrow by shaping what kind of companies we build.

Why this role, why now

AI for hardware is moving faster than any team can track. Our internal map now tracks close to 200 tools, from text-to-CAD, AI-native electronics and physics surrogates to manufacturing, test data, procurement and the MCP connectors that let agents drive CAD and EDA tools directly.

Most of these tools will not matter. A handful will cut weeks off our programs. We need someone whose job is to find those, prove them on our real parts, and put them in the hands of our founders before our competitors do.

The mission

We’re looking for an industrial hardware engineer who is 100% AI-pilled, with a dual objective:

  • Adopt AI inside our startups. Make every Frontier Tech venture the fastest-moving hardware team in its category, using the best AI tools available today.

  • Build companies that grow with AI. Design products and business models that are both AI-enabled (they get better with every new generation of models) and AI-enablers (they feed AI with the data, compute, energy or infrastructure it needs), and run the companies themselves on AI from day one. The goal is a positive feedback loop: the more AI grows, the more our companies grow.

Adoption is the immediate focus. The role splits into two:

80%: deploy AI inside our ventures

Hands-on, embedded in the teams, measured by weeks saved.

  • Map the bottlenecks. Sit with each venture and map its engineering workflow, from requirements to design, simulation, electronics, firmware, test, manufacturing and documentation. Find the steps that cost the most weeks.

  • Do the engineering. You are part of the team, not an advisor. You will run the CAD, set up the simulations, push the PCB, write the firmware agent, build the digital twin, produce the documentation, build the tools that automate technical pre-sales material that wins a contract. You ship parts and files, not slides.

  • Run the shared AI infrastructure. Set up and maintain the agents, repos and connectors between tools (CAD, EDA, simulation, data), with a common setup across ventures, so founders spend their time engineering rather than configuring.

  • Make it stick. Start with hands-on workshops on each team’s real problems, then train founders and engineers, write the playbooks, and track real adoption so tools are used every day rather than demoed once.

20%: studio radar and partnerships

  • Keep the map alive. Track the AI-for-hardware landscape and what frontier labs ship, and maintain our living map of tools, maturity and pricing.

  • See beyond the hype. Our founders want evidence, not promises. Benchmark tools on our own parts and problems, not on vendor demos, and tell the studio plainly where the value is and where it is not.

  • Close partnerships. Negotiate studio-wide deals with key players (early access, design-partner status, credits, preferential pricing) so every Hexa hardware venture starts with better conditions than it could get alone.

  • Build the default stack. Turn what works into a reusable AI toolkit that every new Frontier Tech venture gets on day one.

  • Design AI-native companies. Work with founders from day one on where AI sits in the product, how the business model captures value as models improve, which data to capture and own, and which workflows run on agents so the team scales without headcount growing in step with revenue.

Who we’re looking for

  • An industrial hardware engineer. 3 to 7 years designing, building and testing physical products in aerospace, defense, energy, automotive, industrial equipment or a hardware startup. You have taken parts from CAD to the shop floor and know tolerancing, DFM, test campaigns and suppliers.

  • 100% AI-pilled. You use AI agents every day, you have built your own automations, and you have already tried text-to-CAD, AI simulation or AI electronics tools on real work. You switch setups as soon as something better ships, and you have opinions on how a hardware company should be built when much of its engineering is done by agents.

  • A skeptical builder. You judge tools by measured time saved, not by launch videos. You are as happy killing a tool as adopting one.

  • High agency and fast. You figure it out and ship without waiting to be told how. You are comfortable jumping between projects in the same week.

  • Commercial sense and pedagogy. Comfortable in front of founders, engineers and vendors, able to run a workshop that turns skeptics into users, and to negotiate a partnership that actually benefits our ventures.

  • Languages and location. Working in English, based in Paris or Brussels, with regular days physically with the founding teams.

Recruitment process

  • First call with Laure, Talent Partner at Hexa

  • Interview with Guerric: mutual introduction, deep dive into the role and how we work.

  • Case study: a real engineering problem from one of our ventures with Tanguy, Hexa's CTO. Propose an AI-augmented workflow and run it as a short hands-on workshop with the founders, with at least one tool working live

  • Cultural fit interview with Matthieu (CEO)

  • Coffee with team members & Reference checks

We are looking for a talented Forward Deployed Engineer to be embedded with one of our strategic customers running our software in production.   • Guide the customer through software upgrades, cluster expansion, and new feature rollouts.

  • 5+ years in a hands-on infrastructure engineering role (forward deployed engineer, SRE, platform engineer, solutions architect, or similar) with direct customer or internal-customer exposure.

title: AI / Machine Learning Engineer II
descriptionHtml:
About the team

Within the Global Operations organisation, our mission is to build the best customer experience in the fintech industry by delivering an effortless customer experience to all our merchants. We are seeking a skilled and passionate Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our talented AI team and lead the development of AI models and algorithms that will drive our customer support service to new heights.

As an AI / Machine Learning Engineer at SumUp, you will be responsible for building and optimising state-of-the-art AI models and algorithms. Your expertise with machine learning, deep learning, and LLMs will be crucial in driving the success of our AI-driven initiatives. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including backend engineers, data scientists and product managers, to translate business requirements into innovative AI solutions. Your contributions will shape the future of our support products and help us stay at the forefront of technological advancements in the field of AI.

What you’ll do

  • Design, develop and deploy our AI solutions and systems in production environments, ensuring reliability, high performance and scalability.
  • Collaborate and communicate closely with data scientists, product managers, developers and other business stakeholders to bring state-of-the-art AI solutions to Customer Support, enhancing customer experience and improving operational efficiency.
  • Develop and maintain ML infrastructure and pipelines to support efficient data processing, model training and serving.
  • Optimize and fine-tune machine learning models to improve accuracy, efficiency and scalability.
  • Collect, preprocess and clean large text datasets to ensure high-quality input for model training and evaluation.
  • Embrace software development principles, best practices and industry standards, including version control, CI/CD processes and unit testing frameworks as your day-to-day work.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of machine learning solutions into software applications and platforms. 

You’ll be great for this position if you have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Machine Learning, Computer Science or an engineering-related field.
  • 4+ years of proven experience working as a Machine Learning Engineer, focusing on building and deploying scalable machine learning or AI solutions and data-driven systems.
  • Relevant experience building AI products, such as Chatbot Assistant, RAG system, etc.
  • Solid Software development engineering skills to design computationally effective solutions and maintain them in large-scale production environments (data version control, model serving, continuous monitoring & alerting)
  • Experience building and deploying ML models using cloud services (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Expert in Python and familiarity with MLOps tools (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, Langfuse).
  • Experience with machine learning workflow orchestration and algorithm optimisation, feature engineering pipelines, data ingestion and transformation. 

Why you should join SumUp:

🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup.

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: Be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2,000 for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education.

🚀 Enrolment onto our VSOP program: You will own a stake in SumUp’s future success

💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions

🔄 30 Days Sabbatical: Enjoy the unique opportunity to take a well-deserved break with our 30 days sabbatical benefit after completing 3 years of employment with SumUp.

🔗 Referral Bonus: Earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team.

🚵🏾‍♂️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, relocation assistance, subsidised office lunches.

About us:

SumUp is a leading financial technology company, founded in 2012 with the goal of empowering small businesses around the globe. We’re the financial partner of choice for more than 4 million merchants in over 35 markets. We collectively build, plan and fine-tune the technology that drives SumUp and empowers small businesses around the world.

We believe in the everyday hero. Those who have the courage to follow their passion and who have the strength and determination to realise their dreams. Small business owners are at the heart of all we do, so we're creating powerful, easy-to-use financial solutions to help them run their business. With a founders mentality and a 'team-first attitude' our diverse teams across Europe, South America, and the United States work together to ensure that small business owners can be successful doing what they love.

SumUp is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. SumUp does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by Company policy. title: AI Marketing Artist - Yuzu
descriptionHtml:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

Yuzu is building a portfolio of real money gaming apps, combining accessible mobile gameplay with competition and real cash prizes. We’re currently developing our first games, with the ambition to launch and grow several apps.
We’re a small team working across product, creative production and growth, using AI to prototype ideas, create content and test quickly. Joining Yuzu means getting involved before launch, taking ownership of projects and helping shape both the games we build and the way we work.

Role

You will work closely with the team building the product and launching the business. You will contribute across creative production, AI workflows and early growth, with room to suggest ideas and take them through to execution.
Your role is to turn ideas into things we can use and test: creative assets, playable prototypes, useful workflows and experiments that help us move towards launch.

  • Produce creative content. Develop concepts and create videos, visuals, animations and gameplay content for our marketing. Take an idea from a first draft to an asset we can put in front of users.

  • Build systems with AI. Turn repetitive work into practical workflows for research, content production and testing. Create reusable templates and lightweight automations, and check the quality of the outputs.

  • Benchmark widely. Explore competing games and relevant consumer apps. Study their creatives, onboarding, gameplay and reward systems, then turn your observations into ideas we can try.

  • Prototype interactive experiences. Use AI, no-code or coding tools to build demos, small game concepts and playable ads. Learn the tools needed to get a first version working.

  • Run frequent experiments. Quickly test different creative angles, formats and interactions. Be clear about what you want to learn, review the results and recommend what to try next.

  • Help get the business ready to launch. Produce and organise launch assets and materials, spot gaps and pick up practical tasks with the team. Follow through until they are done.

 

Profile

  • You are a final-year student or recent graduate, ideally from an engineering school or a leading business school. You learn quickly, enjoy unfamiliar problems and want to help launch a new business in real money gaming.

  • You build things on your own. You have side projects to show: a small product, a website, a content project, a game prototype or an automation. You can explain what you made and how you approached it.

  • You are comfortable working with AI. You already use AI to research, create and solve practical problems. You enjoy combining tools into repeatable workflows and improving how work gets done.

  • You have a knack for content. Experience with image and video generation, editing tools, AI coding assistants, no-code workflows or simple scripting will be useful. A good visual eye and an interest in consumer products will also help.

  • You are curious and analytical. You like exploring products, comparing approaches and testing ideas. You can break down a problem, identify a useful first experiment and explain what you learned.

  • You take initiative and follow through. You are comfortable switching between creative, technical and business tasks. You can make progress independently, ask for feedback and flag blockers early.

  • You work well in French and English. You speak fluent French and have strong written and spoken English. You can communicate your ideas clearly and research unfamiliar topics independently.

Nice to have: You have a feel for games. You explore new games and notice what makes a mechanic satisfying or an experience engaging. Card games, tournament formats and risk-and-reward mechanics are familiar territory.

We will value your ability to learn, choose the right tools and deliver work that we can use.

 

Benefits

  • Competitive salary upon experience, plus bonus

  • Swile Lunch voucher

  • Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)

  • Premium healthcare coverage SideCare, for your family, 100% covered by Voodoo

  • Wellness activities in our Paris office

title: AI-Native PHP/Laravel Developer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du bist ein erfahrener PHP/Laravel Fullstack-Entwickler mit mindestens 5 Jahren Berufserfahrung, beherrschst Laravel und MySQL und hast bereits mit AWS gearbeitet?

Und vor allem: AI gehört für dich inzwischen selbstverständlich zur Softwareentwicklung?

Dann suchen wir dich!

Wir entwickeln eine SaaS-Plattform für die Daten- und AI-gestützte Optimierung von Digitalmarketing-Kampagnen, die bereits seit über fünf Jahren erfolgreich im Einsatz ist. Wie auch in unserem Produkt, verfolgen wir in unserer Softwareentwicklung konsequent eine AI-First-Strategie.

Dabei verstehen wir AI nicht als gelegentliche Unterstützung beim Schreiben einzelner Funktionen. Coding Agents sind ein fester Bestandteil unseres Software Development Lifecycles. Von der Analyse eines Tickets über Implementierung und Tests bis hin zu Code Reviews und Dokumentation setzen wir AI gezielt dort ein, wo Aufgaben sinnvoll unterstützt oder übernommen werden können.

Wir suchen Entwickler, die AI effektiv einsetzen und dadurch mehr Zeit für die Aufgaben haben, bei denen menschliche Erfahrung entscheidend ist: Architektur, technische Entscheidungen, Qualität und Verantwortung für das Ergebnis.

Deshalb solltest du Claude Code oder OpenAI Codex bereits kennen und aktiv für deine tägliche Entwicklungsarbeit nutzen.

Das sind deine Aufgaben:

  • Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung unserer SaaS-Plattform mit Laravel und MySQL.

  • Konzeption und Implementierung neuer Features und technischer Lösungen.

  • Entwicklung, Anbindung und Integration von APIs.

  • Nutzung von Coding Agents wie Claude Code oder Codex als festen Bestandteil deiner täglichen Entwicklungsarbeit.

  • Eigenständige Umsetzung von Tickets mithilfe von AI-gestützten Entwicklungsworkflows.

  • Verantwortung für den von dir und deinen Agents erzeugten Code – von der fachlichen Anforderung bis zur produktionsreifen Lösung.

  • Weiterentwicklung unserer gemeinsamen Agents, Skills, Coding Rules und AI-Workflows.

  • Sicherstellung der Softwarequalität durch automatisierte Tests, statische Analysen und Quality Gates.

  • Analyse und eigenständige Lösung technischer Herausforderungen.

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team bei Architekturentscheidungen, Code Reviews und der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unseres SDLC.

Das erwarten wir von dir:

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung als PHP-Entwickler, idealerweise im Fullstack-Bereich.

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in PHP, Laravel und MySQL.

  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung, Anbindung und Nutzung von REST APIs.

  • Erfahrung mit AWS Services wie CloudFormation, ECS, IAM oder API Gateway.

  • Du nutzt Claude Code oder OpenAI Codex bereits regelmäßig in deiner Entwicklungsarbeit.

  • Du kannst AI-generierten Code verstehen, bewerten und verantworten.

  • Du hast Interesse daran, klassische Entwicklungsprozesse zu hinterfragen und gemeinsam mit uns einen Agentic-SDLC weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse.

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.

  • Teamfähigkeit, Kommunikationsstärke und die Motivation, dich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Ein spannendes Produkt an der Schnittstelle von SaaS, AI und Digitalmarketing.

  • Ein Entwicklungsumfeld, in dem AI First tatsächlich gelebt wird und nicht nur ein Punkt auf der Unternehmensagenda ist.

  • Die Möglichkeit, moderne Agentic-Development-Workflows aktiv mitzugestalten und auszuprobieren.

  • Hybrides Arbeiten: Remote und vor Ort in Köln.

  • Attraktive Vergütung und flexible Arbeitszeiten.

  • Keine klassische Projekt-Hektik: voller Fokus auf die Weiterentwicklung unserer eigenen Optimierungsplattform.

  • Raum für technische Entscheidungen, Experimente und kontinuierliche Verbesserung unserer Toolchain.

  • Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und die Möglichkeit, neue AI-Tools und Entwicklungsansätze frühzeitig einzusetzen.

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege, direkte Kommunikation und echte Verantwortung.

Klingt spannend? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Bitte sende uns deinen Lebenslauf und – falls vorhanden – Beispiele deiner bisherigen Projekte.

Erzähl uns in deiner Bewerbung kurz: Wie nutzt du Claude Code oder Codex heute in deinem Entwicklungsalltag? Welche Aufgaben überlässt du bereits einem Coding Agent und wo greifst du bewusst selbst ein?

Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns, wie Softwareentwicklung in einer AI-First-Organisation funktioniert.

The product works, the first customer deployments are beginning, and a great deal is still undecided — so the people who join us now will shape what it becomes.
It's an AI-native operating system for small businesses: a system of agents that helps a solopreneur, a hair salon or a building contractor run their whole business — clients, contracts and signature, invoicing, their website, their inbox. Modules get added the way an ERP grows, except the whole thing is built around agents from the ground up.


Your Impact at Brevo:
  • Turn a very high level business need into something real : understand the function, define the users, the smallest useful version, the entities and their lifecycles, the permissions and constraints that matter, and what to build versus integrate
  • Decide which of our platform primitives to extend rather than reinvent, then build it, ship it, watch it in production, and improve it
  • Work across product management, frontend, backend, data modelling, infrastructure, and AI. Everyone arrived with a specialism and nobody is confined to theirs; product thinking and business analysis is part of everyone’s job
  • Build almost entirely through coding agents: Claude Code is the workflow, not a pilot running alongside it, for implementation, codebase exploration, documentation, debugging, and operations
  • Decompose problems into work an agent can actually execute, give it context without over-constraining it, and tell the difference between correct and merely plausible
  • Verify with tests and instrumentation, not vibes, and keep a large generated codebase coherent
  • Work day to day in TypeScript, Kubernetes, and agentic frameworks

    • Who you are:
  • Around 2-5 years of professional engineering experience. We care more about your slope than your years.
  • Real depth in something, and no attachment to staying there. Bring what you're genuinely strong at — the team compounds those — and expect to spend a good part of your time well outside it.
  • Coding agents already central to how you work. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, something equivalent. Not "I've generated the Unit Tests" — real delegation of substantial work, and real review of what comes back. Scepticism about generated output is a feature of this job, not a problem.

title: AI-Native Software Engineer - CDI Paris - Theodo
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Aujourd’hui, l’ambition du groupe est de se positionner comme le leader de l’IA appliquée au développement logiciel, c’est pourquoi nous avons lancé la practice AI Modernisation. Au sein de cette practice, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la modernisation de leurs systèmes legacy. Grâce à une IA maîtrisée et une méthode éprouvée, nous allons 3 fois plus vite sur le delivery de ces projets critiques.
La practice accompagne principalement des scale-ups comme Qonto ou Doctolib et des grands groupes comme Carrefour, Pernod Ricard, Les Mousquetaires, Urgo, Cdiscount ou Edenred. Si tu veux rejoindre le futur de la tech, tu es au bon endroit !
Ton équipe : Tu rejoindras une communauté tech de plus de 120 Theodoers : software engineers, tech leads, engineering managers et architectes, avec lesquels tu pourras échanger, apprendre et progresser au quotidien. Chez Theodo, les techs travaillent en équipes projet, constituées en fonction des besoins de chaque client. Tu feras partie d’une équipe de Theodoers à taille humaine (4 à 5 personnes), réunissant Software Engineers, Tech Lead et Product Manager. Ensemble, vous collaborerez étroitement avec le client, avec des échanges réguliers pour partager vos avancées, approfondir la compréhension de son problème et faire évoluer le produit au plus près des besoins de ses utilisateurs. Tes futures missions : En tant que Software Engineer Fullstack chez Theodo, ta mission sera de concevoir et développer des produits digitaux utiles, performants et durables pour répondre aux problématiques de nos clients et de leurs utilisateurs. Tout au long de tes projets, tu seras accompagné pour monter en compétences et apprendre à écrire du code de qualité, à comprendre les enjeux produit et à intervenir sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie d’une application, de la conception au déploiement. Ce que tu vas apprendre en tant que Software Engineer chez Theodo :
  • Comprendre le problème de ton client et y répondre avec un produit performant, maintenable et orienté valeur, en intervenant sur tout le cycle de production, de la conception au déploiement.
  • Produire du code de qualité dans les délais, en intégrant tests, refactoring et standards techniques de l’équipe, quelle que soit la technologie utilisée.
  • Mener des investigations techniques, débugger efficacement et corriger les défauts de manière pérenne, dans tout type d’environnement.
  • Analyser en profondeur des problèmes dans le code pour développer son esprit de résolution de problèmes
  • Travailler avec un LLM pour accélérer les développements
Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples :
  • HealthHero : leader européen de la télémédecine, ils souhaitent moderniser leur plateforme française, Qare, en vue d’une fusion avec la plateforme UK. L’objectif est de passer de Loopback2 à Nest pour pouvoir upgrade de Node 10 vers Node 20. Grâce à notre méthode de modernisation accélérée par l’IA, nous passons d’une estimation à 70 semaines sans IA à une migration terminée en 21 semaines et accélérons la vitesse de delivery par 5.
  • Pernod Ricard : souhaitait moderniser une application interne utilisée pour gérer leur campagnes marketing, des millions d’euros en jeu. L’impact de Theodo : 23 semaines pour moderniser complètement l’application de Vue Express vers React Nest avec une réécriture plus pragmatique. Nous avons également effectué la connection à leur nouvel ERP, auparavant impossible sans la migration.
Tes perspectives d'évolution : Notre ambition est de former les leaders de la tech de demain. Grâce au coaching et formations que l’on propose, tu pourras :
  • Devenir un expert en développement en étant formé aux meilleurs standards de qualité
  • Développer des compétences transverses : coaching, recrutement, commercial, management et marketing technique
  • Participer à des groupes d’expertises avec d’autres passionnés (Cybersécurité, Serverless, Performance, GreenIT…)
  • Construire ton parcours sur-mesure pour atteindre tes objectifs : tech lead, senior architecte, évangéliste (spécialiste d’un sujet), CTO ou fondateur d’une entité etc
Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu : Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits. Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. Profil recherché : Nous recherchons avant tout des potentiels plus que des compétences déjà acquises. Si tu n’es pas encore un·e développeur·se chevronné·e, ce n’est pas un frein : ne te retiens pas pour postuler.
  • Tu es diplômé·e d’une top école d’ingénieur
  • Tu as entre 0 et 2 ans d'expérience
  • Tu aimes travailler en équipe et intéragir avec des profils et des métiers variés, en faisant preuve de pédagogie et d’esprit constructif (revues de code, pair programming)
  • Tu es orienté·e création de valeur : tu t’intéresses à l’activité du client et tu ne fais pas de la tech pour la tech
  • Tu es promoteur de l’IA, notamment sur les sujets de GenAI, et tu cherches à progresser en continu grâce à la veille technique
  • Tu fais preuve d’exigence sur la qualité du travail produit et sais questionner, voire interrompre, la chaîne de production lorsque nécessaire (#jidoka)
  • Tu aimes travailler de manière structurée et appliques naturellement des principes d’organisation et d’amélioration continue (inspirés du 5S)
  • Tu souhaites évoluer dans un environnement qui encourage au quotidien l’envie de progresser, l’esprit d’équipe et la prise d’initiative
Le processus de recrutement :
  • Un premier call de 30 minutes avec un recruteur
  • Un échange d’une heure avec le même recruteur
  • Un exercice de refactoring à effectuer chez toi, suivi d’un échange avec un tech lead pour revenir sur tes erreurs
  • Un exercice en direct de debuging
  • Un entretien dirigeant de 30 minutes pour revenir sur tes motivations à rejoindre Theodo et répondre à tes derniers questions
Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo ? L’environnement: 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 De l’épargne salariale avec un mécanisme d’intéressement en partenariat avec Epsor 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile 🧒 Aides et places en crèche réservées Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

Ce que tu vas apprendre en tant que Software Engineer chez Theodo :
  • Comprendre le problème de ton client et y répondre avec un produit performant, maintenable et orienté valeur, en intervenant sur tout le cycle de production, de la conception au déploiement.
  • Produire du code de qualité dans les délais, en intégrant tests, refactoring et standards techniques de l’équipe, quelle que soit la technologie utilisée.
  • Mener des investigations techniques, débugger efficacement et corriger les défauts de manière pérenne, dans tout type d’environnement.
  • Analyser en profondeur des problèmes dans le code pour développer son esprit de résolution de problèmes
  • Travailler avec un LLM pour accélérer les développements
Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples :
  • HealthHero : leader européen de la télémédecine, ils souhaitent moderniser leur plateforme française, Qare, en vue d’une fusion avec la plateforme UK. L’objectif est de passer de Loopback2 à Nest pour pouvoir upgrade de Node 10 vers Node 20. Grâce à notre méthode de modernisation accélérée par l’IA, nous passons d’une estimation à 70 semaines sans IA à une migration terminée en 21 semaines et accélérons la vitesse de delivery par 5.
  • Pernod Ricard : souhaitait moderniser une application interne utilisée pour gérer leur campagnes marketing, des millions d’euros en jeu. L’impact de Theodo : 23 semaines pour moderniser complètement l’application de Vue Express vers React Nest avec une réécriture plus pragmatique. Nous avons également effectué la connection à leur nouvel ERP, auparavant impossible sans la migration.
Tes perspectives d'évolution : Notre ambition est de former les leaders de la tech de demain. Grâce au coaching et formations que l’on propose, tu pourras :
  • Devenir un expert en développement en étant formé aux meilleurs standards de qualité
  • Développer des compétences transverses : coaching, recrutement, commercial, management et marketing technique
  • Participer à des groupes d’expertises avec d’autres passionnés (Cybersécurité, Serverless, Performance, GreenIT…)
  • Construire ton parcours sur-mesure pour atteindre tes objectifs : tech lead, senior architecte, évangéliste (spécialiste d’un sujet), CTO ou fondateur d’une entité etc
Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu : Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits. Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. Profil recherché : Nous recherchons avant tout des potentiels plus que des compétences déjà acquises. Si tu n’es pas encore un·e développeur·se chevronné·e, ce n’est pas un frein : ne te retiens pas pour postuler.
  • Tu es diplômé·e d’une top école d’ingénieur
  • Tu as entre 0 et 2 ans d'expérience
  • Tu aimes travailler en équipe et intéragir avec des profils et des métiers variés, en faisant preuve de pédagogie et d’esprit constructif (revues de code, pair programming)
  • Tu es orienté·e création de valeur : tu t’intéresses à l’activité du client et tu ne fais pas de la tech pour la tech
  • Tu es promoteur de l’IA, notamment sur les sujets de GenAI, et tu cherches à progresser en continu grâce à la veille technique
  • Tu fais preuve d’exigence sur la qualité du travail produit et sais questionner, voire interrompre, la chaîne de production lorsque nécessaire (#jidoka)
  • Tu aimes travailler de manière structurée et appliques naturellement des principes d’organisation et d’amélioration continue (inspirés du 5S)
  • Tu souhaites évoluer dans un environnement qui encourage au quotidien l’envie de progresser, l’esprit d’équipe et la prise d’initiative
Le processus de recrutement :
  • Un premier call de 30 minutes avec un recruteur
  • Un échange d’une heure avec le même recruteur
  • Un exercice de refactoring à effectuer chez toi, suivi d’un échange avec un tech lead pour revenir sur tes erreurs
  • Un exercice en direct de debuging
  • Un entretien dirigeant de 30 minutes pour revenir sur tes motivations à rejoindre Theodo et répondre à tes derniers questions
Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo ? L’environnement: 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 De l’épargne salariale avec un mécanisme d’intéressement en partenariat avec Epsor 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile 🧒 Aides et places en crèche réservées Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

title: AI Operations Associate
descriptionHtml:
About Nevoya:


Nevoya is North America's leading next-generation electric trucking carrier, transforming logistics through AI-native operations and relentless customer focus. The company builds and uses proprietary technology to deliver zero-emissions carrier services to Fortune 500 shippers with superior economics and service to legacy diesel operators. The company has operations in California and Texas, and is backed by globally-renowned investors including Lowercarbon Capital.

About the Role:

This is a foundational hire. You will do different aspects of dispatching in trucking — without needing any trucking experience. You’ll keep real freight moving for real customers: assigning loads, communicating with drivers, handling exceptions, and solving the problems of the day.

The reason this works is you. You are AI-native — AI is your default way of researching, troubleshooting, and getting work done — and you have the critical thinking to notice when the playbook is wrong and the initiative to propose the fix. You’ll work directly with engineering and product to automate the repetitive parts of the job, so the role keeps getting smarter.

You’ll get a lot of direction, coaching, and ownership early. Do this well and the role is a launchpad: people who build the operational foundation here will grow into bigger roles across the company.

What You’ll Do:

  • Run daily dispatch execution from our playbook: load assignment, driver communication, check-calls, and exception handling

  • Keep loads covered and customers informed, escalating with judgment when something can’t wait

  • Use AI tools daily to research, troubleshoot, draft, analyze, and automate your own work

  • Improve the playbook as you go — document what works, flag what doesn’t, and ship a better process every week

  • Call out problems early and come with proposed solutions, not just escalations

  • Partner with engineering and product to turn recurring manual work into automated workflows

  • Track the KPIs of your operation — load coverage, on-time performance, driver utilization — and use them to improve

What You’ll Bring:

  • A recent degree or 1–2 years of work experience — high-performing new grads encouraged to apply

  • AI-native habits: you already use AI as your default tool for learning, research, and producing work

  • Sharp critical thinking — you spot what’s broken, ask why, and bring a proposed answer

  • Hungry and coachable: you want direction, feedback, and a steep learning curve

  • Strong written and verbal communication — you’ll be talking to drivers, customers, and engineers in the same hour

  • Organized and calm under pressure; comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities

  • No trucking, logistics, or dispatch experience required

Nice to Have:

  • Internship or early experience in operations, logistics, supply chain, or a fast-moving startup

  • Comfort with data — spreadsheets, SQL, or light scripting

  • Spanish language proficiency, a meaningful asset in our operating markets

At Nevoya, we believe diverse teams build better solutions.


We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive and welcoming environment for all employees. We consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

If you're excited about our mission but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be the right candidate for this or another role.

title: AI Platform Engineer (m/w/d) | AI Hub für 10+ Unternehmen
descriptionHtml:
Über CHAPTERS Group

CHAPTERS Group ist eine börsennotierte deutsche Holding, die vertikale Softwareunternehmen erwirbt und hält. In den letzten fünf Jahren sind wir um das Zehnfache gewachsen und besitzen heute mehr als 60 Unternehmen. Jedes führt sein eigenes Geschäft, nah an seinen Kunden. Wir machen sie stärker, ohne ihnen das Steuer aus der Hand zu nehmen. KI ist eine der größten Chancen, die wir für sie sehen. Sie wirkt aber nur, wenn die Menschen in diesen Unternehmen sie auch nutzen.

Die Rolle

Du bist Teil des AI Core Teams im Office des CTO und arbeitest als Forward Deployed Engineer nah an den Unternehmen unserer Gruppe. Du betreibst unseren AI Hub, eine Open WebUI-basierte KI-Plattform, für mehr als 10 Unternehmen. Du bringst mit, was du im Feld siehst, testest neue Fähigkeiten und gestaltest die Plattform für alle 60+ Unternehmen mit.

Deutsch (C1+) und Englisch sind Pflicht.

Was du machst

  • Den AI Hub für 10+ Unternehmen betreiben: Deployments, Updates, Konfiguration, SSO mit Entra ID, Monitoring, Backups und Incident Handling

  • Unternehmen und Teams onboarden: Skills, Knowledge Bases und Tools einrichten, damit jedes Unternehmen produktiv mit dem Hub arbeitet

  • Technische Ansprechperson sein: Wenn etwas ausfällt oder ein Champion nicht weiterkommt, analysierst und behebst du das. Wiederkehrende Probleme dokumentierst du, damit sie nur einmal gelöst werden müssen.

  • Den Hub anbinden, wo ein Use Case es braucht: Microsoft 365 / Graph, CRM, Ticketing und ERP-Systeme über Tools, MCP-Server und REST-APIs

  • Wiederkehrende Fragen in wiederverwendbare Bausteine verwandeln: Dokumentation, Vorlagen und kurze Hands-on-Sessions

  • Im AI Core Team arbeiten: Muster über Unternehmen hinweg teilen, neue Features testen und Erkenntnisse in die Plattform-Roadmap einspeisen

  • Gelegentlich das M&A-Team unterstützen (etwa 10 bis 20 % deiner Zeit) bei technischen Fragen, zum Beispiel bei der Bewertung des Tech- und AI-Stacks von Übernahmekandidaten

Das bringst du mit

Pflicht

  • Deutsch (C1 oder höher) und fließend Englisch. Du arbeitest täglich auf Deutsch mit Geschäftsführern und nicht-technischen Teams. Hier machen wir keine Ausnahmen.

  • Erfahrung im Produktivbetrieb. Du hast containerisierte Anwendungen produktiv deployt und betrieben (Docker, CI/CD, Linux, eine große Cloud, Azure bevorzugt) und warst verantwortlich, wenn sie ausgefallen sind. Das heißt meist mindestens 2 Jahre in einer DevOps-, Platform-, SRE- oder Backend-Rolle.

  • Python, das du sicher lesen, debuggen und erweitern kannst

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit LLMs. Du nutzt sie im eigenen Arbeitsalltag ernsthaft, hast beruflich oder privat etwas damit gebaut und weißt, wo sie scheitern.

  • Du erklärst Technik so, dass Nicht-Techniker sie verstehen und danach handeln können. Du bist gern die technische Ansprechperson für Teams ohne technischen Hintergrund.

Starke Signale

  • Enterprise Identity: Entra ID, OAuth, SSO

  • Selbst gehostete LLM-Plattformen wie Open WebUI oder LibreChat

  • MCP, Tool Calling, Agent-Frameworks

  • Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform)

  • Erfahrung in einer Support-, Solutions- oder kundennahen technischen Rolle

  • Erfahrung in der Arbeit über mehrere Unternehmen, Tenants oder eine Gruppenstruktur hinweg

Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn du

  • den Großteil deiner Zeit damit verbringen willst, neue AI-Produkte von Grund auf zu bauen

  • ML-Forschung oder Modelltraining suchst

  • nur mit Engineers arbeiten und direkten Kontakt mit Fachbereichen vermeiden willst

Das bekommst du

  • Echte Verantwortung: 10+ Unternehmen, eine Plattform, und du sorgst dafür, dass KI dort funktioniert

  • Ein kleines AI Core Team mit direktem Draht zum C-Level. Entscheidungen fallen schnell.

  • Wirkung über deine Plattform hinaus: Was in deinen Unternehmen funktioniert, wird Standard für 55+

  • Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle, Remote-first mit gelegentlichen Präsenzterminen

  • Entwicklung: Talent Reviews, Events und Konferenzen. Wir stellen Leute ein, die mit uns wachsen wollen.

So bewirbst du dich

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte diese eine Frage auf Deutsch, maximal 200 Wörter. Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht.

  1. Erzähl uns von einem System, das du produktiv betrieben hast und das ausgefallen ist. Was ist passiert, was hast du getan, und was hat sich danach geändert?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

title: AI Platform engineer
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij de engineer die organisaties naar het volgende niveau tilt met de kracht van Microsoft Power Platform én AI? 

Join the journey!

Wat ga je doen?

Als AI Platform Engineer speel je een sleutelrol binnen het Microsoft Power Platform team van HSO: een snelgroeiende afdeling met een ondernemende mindset waarin jouw expertise noodzakelijk is om verder te kunnen groeien. Jij ontwerpt de fundamenten waarop klanten hun digitale transformatie bouwen — van datamodel tot beveiliging tot ALM — en zorgt dat AI-gedreven oplossingen betrouwbaar, schaalbaar en beheersbaar zijn. 

Jij bent vanaf de salesfase betrokken om samen met het beoogde klantteam de klant op weg te helpen met onze aanpak en propositie. Jij kunt in alle vrijheid platform- en AI-implementatietrajecten uitdenken en begeleiden. In sommige gevallen opereer je alleen, in andere gevallen gesteund door een ervaren en gemotiveerd team — waaronder de AI Platform Consultant, die het business probleem, het functional design en de user journeys aanlevert als basis voor jouw technisch ontwerp. 

Kerntaken: 

  • Je ontwerpt Dataverse-modellen en de bijbehorende security-architectuur (tabellen, relaties, business rules, rollen en rechten), inclusief de datagrondslag (grounding) waarop AI-agents veilig kunnen redeneren. 
  • Je kiest en onderbouwt het juiste patroon per vraagstuk: app, portal, workflow of AI-agent, en ontwerpt de technische architectuur van Copilot Studio-agents (topics, plugins, connectoren, Azure OpenAI-integratie). 
  • Je bepaalt de ALM- en omgevingsstrategie (dev/test/acceptatie/productie, pipelines, release management), inclusief versiebeheer en promotie van AI-agents en hun kennisbronnen. 
  • Je richt governance en beveiliging voor AI in: Data Loss Prevention-policies, tenant- en environment-instellingen voor Copilot Studio, en monitoring/observability van agentgedrag. 
  • Je beoordeelt en valideert AI-gegenereerde oplossingsontwerpen en -code op kwaliteit, security, kosten en schaalbaarheid, en stuurt bij waar nodig. 

Wat breng jij mee?

  • HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau. 
  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie bij een IT-dienstverlener, consultancy of aan klantzijde. 
  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwerpen van Dataverse-datamodellen en security-architectuur (rollen, teams, business units, field-level security). 
  • Ervaring met het afwegen en kiezen tussen app-, portal-, workflow- en agent-patronen (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages, Copilot Studio). 
  • Kennis van en ervaring met het definiëren van ALM- en omgevingsstrategieën (pipelines, solution management, environment strategy). 
  • Ervaring met het reviewen en valideren van (AI-gegenereerde) solution designs en code. 
  • Kennis van het technisch ontwerpen van AI-agents in Copilot Studio: topics, plugins, connectoren, grounding op Dataverse en integratie met Azure OpenAI/Azure AI Foundry. 
  • Kennis van AI-governance en beveiliging: Data Loss Prevention-policies, tenant-instellingen, monitoring en responsible AI-principes. 
  • Goede kennis van Power Platform-onderdelen (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages, Dataverse, Copilot Studio). 
  • Kennis van of ervaring met Microsoft Dynamics 365 (ERP & CRM) en Azure is een pre. 
  • Ervaring met multidisciplinaire teams (Solution Architecten, Project Managers). 
  • Ervaring als Lead Architect of Solution Architect met grote, complexe systemen, bij voorkeur met meerdere (Microsoft) platforms. 
  • Ervaring met Prince II & Agile/Scrum projectmethodieken 

Wat bieden we jou?    

Werken bij HSO is uitdagend, we willen je daar graag een goede beloning voor teruggeven. Naast goede primaire voordelen bieden wij:  

  • Een competitief salaris en jaarlijkse bonus op basis van bedrijfs-, team- en individuele prestaties; 
  • Mobiliteitsvergoeding waarbij je of een auto kunt leasen of het bedrag toe kunt  
    voegen aan je salaris. Daar bovenop krijg 100% betaald van de ov-kosten;  
  • Hybride werken, vanuit huis, op kantoor (Rotterdam, Veenendaal) of zelfs tijdens  
    je Workation;  
  • EUR 65,- netto vitaliteitsbudget – we vinden het belangrijk dat we gezond blijven en een veilige werkplek hebben, zowel op kantoor als remote;  
  • Reiskostenvergoeding, 23 cent per kilometer; 
  • Je kunt deelnemen aan het leasefietsplan;  
  • Telefoonabonnement & standaard telefoon of CYOD met bijbetaling of EUR 10,- netto per maand voor eigen telefoon;  
  • 25 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er 35 van te maken;  
  • Pensioen van BeFrank;  
  • En vooral een leven lang leren. Op dag één start jouw onboardingprogramma en daarna heeft onze HSO-Academy een leerreis voor je gedefinieerd;  
  • Je ontvangt ook een GoodHabitz account, een online trainingstool voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling.  


Over HSO     

HSO is de eerste full-service Microsoft Partner in Nederland. Samen met ruim 2500 getalenteerde medewerkers in Europa, Azië en Noord-Amerika verlenen we ondersteuning op lokaal en internationaal niveau aan industriële bedrijven, retailers, financiële en zakelijke dienstverleners en overheidsinstellingen.  
  

HSO is voortdurend op zoek naar nieuw talent. We blijven onze wereldwijde community uitbreiden en scheppen er plezier in om samen te werken met prestatiegerichte mensen met een ondernemersgeest. Professionals die voortdurend willen leren en innoveren.  
  

Vrijheid, flexibiliteit en fun  

Je werkt in een internationale omgeving met professionals met verschillende nationaliteiten. Een flexibele werkweek van 40, 36 of 32 uur behoort tot de mogelijkheden omdat wij van mening zijn dat jouw manier van werken bij jouw levensstijl moet passen. HSO heeft professionals in dienst die plezier hebben in hun werk en klaar staan voor elkaar. Om het plezier in ons werk nog groter te maken, organiseren we uiteraard teamuitjes en bedrijfsfeesten, maar ook wekelijkse zomerborrels op ons dakterras, allerlei sportactiviteiten en is er de mogelijkheid bij te dragen aan onze Maatschappelijk Verantwoord Ondernemen-werkzaamheden.

title: AI Powered Tech Lead - CDI Paris - Theodo
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.

Ton équipe :
Tu rejoindras une communauté tech de plus de 120 Theodoers : software engineers, tech leads, engineering managers et architectes, avec lesquels tu pourras échanger, apprendre et progresser au quotidien.

Chez Theodo, les techs travaillent en équipes projet, constituées en fonction des besoins de chaque client. Tu feras partie d’une équipe de Theodoers à taille humaine (4 à 5 personnes), réunissant Software Engineers, Tech Lead et Product Manager. Ensemble, vous collaborerez étroitement avec le client, avec des échanges réguliers pour partager vos avancées, approfondir la compréhension de son problème et faire évoluer le produit au plus près des besoins de ses utilisateurs.

Les métiers du Software Engineering évoluent avec l’IA : viens apprendre à devenir un Tech Lead AI Native.

Tes futures missions :
Nous recrutons un·e Tech Lead pour concevoir et développer des produits digitaux utiles, performants et durables pour répondre aux problématiques de nos clients et de leurs utilisateurs.

En tant que Tech Lead, tu es garant du rythme et de la qualité de delivery de ton projet. Tu mobilises ton équipe, fais les choix techniques adaptés au contexte et accompagnes les Software Engineers dans leur progression, avec l’objectif de faire grandir à la fois le produit et les personnes qui le construisent.

  • Garantir le delivery et la qualité du projet
Tu vises un niveau de qualité radicalement supérieur, en structurant le delivery autour de standards :
    • Concevoir des architectures évolutives et résilientes (diagrammes d’architecture clairs et partagés)
    • Rédiger des spécifications précises pour permettre le développement sans bugs de fonctionnalités
    • Mettre en place une stratégie de qualité basée sur : le Clean Code, les tests automatisés, les code reviews
    • Assurer un environnement de travail structuré avec les principes 5S (organisation, clarté, efficacité)
    • Accélérer la vitesse de développement grâce au déploiement des agents IA
  • Être le partenaire technique du client
    • Participer aux routines projet (backlog refinement, daily, cérémonies) et veiller à la satisfaction continue du client
    • Expliquer et défendre les choix techniques pour créer de la confiance et aligner toutes les parties prenantes
  • Créer les conditions de performance de l’équipe
    • Mettre en place un environnement de travail efficace et structuré pour l’équipe projet
    • Mettre en place des boucles de résolution des problèmes via le Daily Problem Solving
    • Créer les conditions pour que l’équipe exploite les LLM et gagne en productivité dans son quotidien
