title: AI Product Concept Designer & Interior Stylist – Home Décor (Part-/Full-time)
descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Product Concept Designer & Interior Stylist – Home Décor (Part-/Full-time) based in France.

In this fully remote role, you will combine creative vision, interior design expertise, and advanced AI image-generation skills to develop distinctive, commercially promising home décor products. You will transform emerging design trends and customer preferences into original product concepts and compelling visual experiences. A key part of your work will involve creating photorealistic interior scenes that showcase products with accurate materials, textures, colors, and proportions. You will collaborate with designers to refine concepts and prepare product visuals for e-commerce launches. By balancing aesthetics with commercial potential, you will help shape an attractive product portfolio for a premium home décor brand serving online customers. This long-term freelance opportunity offers the flexibility to work part-time or full-time while contributing directly to product innovation and digital merchandising. It is ideal for a visually driven creative professional who understands how to turn inspiring design ideas into products customers want to buy.


Accountabilities
  • Product concept development: Research interior design trends, competitor offerings, and customer preferences to identify new home décor opportunities and develop original, commercially viable product concepts.
  • AI-powered concept visualization: Use advanced generative AI tools to explore, visualize, and refine new physical product ideas, translating creative concepts into compelling visual representations.
  • Interior styling and scene creation: Place existing and proposed products into realistic, aesthetically cohesive AI-generated interiors that reflect different design styles, including Japandi, organic modern, and coastal interiors.
  • Photorealistic product imagery: Produce high-quality lifestyle and product visuals for e-commerce websites, ensuring generated images accurately represent the original products' shapes, proportions, materials, colors, and textures.
  • Visual quality and consistency: Maintain high standards of realism, composition, lighting, and styling across all creative outputs, ensuring that product details remain faithful to the intended designs.
  • Trend research and opportunity identification: Monitor emerging interior styles, materials, product categories, and customer preferences to uncover opportunities for new product development and commercial growth.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with designers and relevant team members to refine concepts, incorporate feedback, and prepare product designs and visual assets for launch.
  • Commercial evaluation: Assess the market appeal and potential sales value of proposed products, balancing aesthetic originality with customer demand and commercial objectives.
  • E-commerce content development: Create visually engaging product and lifestyle imagery that strengthens online merchandising, communicates product value, and supports customer purchasing decisions.
  • Creative workflow management: Organize multiple projects, manage deadlines, maintain clear communication, and deliver consistent, high-quality outputs in a fully remote working environment.
  • Product feasibility awareness: Consider practical manufacturing requirements, material limitations, production constraints, and shipping considerations when developing physical product concepts.

    • Requirements

  • Visual design and aesthetic expertise: Excellent visual taste and a strong understanding of interior design, styling, color theory, materials, textures, proportions, and composition.
  • Advanced AI image-generation skills: Demonstrated proficiency with generative AI tools such as Nano Banana, Flux, Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, or comparable platforms.
  • Photorealistic image creation: Proven ability to generate convincing interior scenes and product imagery while preserving accurate product characteristics, including shape, material, color, texture, and proportions.
  • Creative concept development: Strong imagination and the ability to translate market insights, design inspiration, and customer preferences into original, visually appealing, and commercially promising physical products.
  • Relevant portfolio: A portfolio demonstrating high-quality interior visuals, AI-generated imagery, product concepts, home décor projects, or other closely related creative work.
  • Project management and organization: Strong organizational skills, reliability, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple creative assignments while meeting deadlines.
  • English proficiency: Fluent English communication skills for collaborating with the team, discussing concepts, understanding feedback, and documenting creative decisions.
  • Commercial awareness: An understanding of how visual design, product differentiation, and customer preferences influence purchasing decisions in e-commerce.

    • Strongly preferred:

  • Professional experience in home décor, interior styling, furniture, or lifestyle products.
  • Experience developing concepts for physical products from initial inspiration through visual refinement.
  • Familiarity with US interior design trends, home décor preferences, and target customer expectations.
  • Experience producing product photography alternatives, lifestyle visuals, or marketing imagery for e-commerce websites.
  • Knowledge of wood, natural finishes, and other materials commonly used in premium home décor.

    • Nice to have:

  • Experience collaborating with manufacturers, product designers, or suppliers.
  • Understanding of product feasibility, manufacturing processes, production constraints, and shipping considerations.
  • Experience using Pinterest, Instagram, or similar platforms to research interior design inspiration, consumer trends, and emerging product opportunities.
  • Familiarity with iterative creative workflows that combine AI-generated concepts with product development and commercial evaluation.

    • Important role clarification: This position focuses on AI-assisted product concept development, interior styling, and photorealistic visual creation. It is not a traditional CAD design or UX/UI design role. The ideal candidate combines outstanding visual judgment with the ability to create attractive, realistic, and commercially viable home décor concepts using generative AI.

    Benefits

  • Competitive compensation: US$25–$45 per hour, depending on experience, skills, and portfolio quality.
  • Flexible engagement: Choose between part-time and full-time collaboration, with an expected workload of approximately 25 hours per week.
  • 100% remote work: Work remotely from Anywhere.
  • Long-term opportunity: Initial 12-month contract with an emphasis on sustained collaboration and continued product development.
  • Freelance flexibility: Independent contractor engagement, offering flexibility in organizing your work and managing creative projects.
  • Creative ownership: Contribute directly to product concepts, interior styling, and visual assets that support commercial launches.
  • AI-driven innovation: Work with modern generative AI tools to explore new creative workflows and develop innovative product imagery.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with designers and other team members to refine concepts and bring new home décor products to market.
  • Portfolio development: Build experience creating AI-powered product concepts and high-quality lifestyle visuals for a premium direct-to-consumer e-commerce business.

    • Application requirements:

    Please include the following when applying:

  • Your portfolio featuring relevant interior visuals, product concepts, AI-generated images, or home décor projects.
  • A list of the AI image-generation tools you regularly use.
  • Your expected hourly rate.
  • Your availability and preferred working arrangement (part-time or full-time).

Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? title: AI Research Engineer (London)
descriptionHtml:
About Edra

Edra is solving one of the hardest problems in enterprise AI: AI models are generic but company processes are specific. We build AI agents that learn how processes actually run, and then run their operations.

We're a Series A startup, backed by Sequoia and other leading VC firms, led by Co-Founders who created and led Forward Deployed AI Engineering at Palantir, and we're growing our team in New York and London. We're a deeply technical team of engineers, AI researchers, and strategists with a high bar for talent and a shared belief that exceptional people are the foundation of everything great we'll build.


The Role

We're building a learning system that teaches AI agents how enterprises actually work. Our system starts from what a customer already has: knowledge base articles, support conversations, tickets, system logs, and agent traces. From that evidence it reverse-engineers how the business actually runs and writes the process down as instructions a person can inspect and an agent can execute, with confidence scoring to know when to automate and when to seek human input.

We're looking for AI Research Engineers who have built complex, production LLM-based systems. Whether you've scaled LLM workflows handling millions of requests, built multi-agent systems in production, or designed evaluation frameworks for enterprise deployments, we want people who bring intensity and self-direction to their craft. You'll work on our agentic learning environment: the loops that turn human corrections and agent outcomes into better knowledge and instructions over time. The job combines applied research with ownership of production systems. You find a failure, form a hypothesis, run the experiment, and ship the fix into real customer workflows.

You'll spend most of your time advancing our core context-learning library and the harness that powers our agents across every customer. The work spans continuous learning, context engineering, agent orchestration, and evaluation. You'll contribute to our knowledge benchmarks and to the self-improving capabilities of the harness.


What You'll Do

  • Build and extend our core context-learning library, turning customer-informed problems into reusable platform capabilities.

  • Design and implement LLM-powered systems and agentic workflows from concept to production.

  • Build agentic features for knowledge management: agents that can edit, update, and maintain large knowledge bases autonomously.

  • Build continuous learning loops that use human corrections and production outcomes to find knowledge gaps, detect changed procedures, and improve prompts and instructions.

  • Build reliability and confidence systems: evaluation frameworks, confidence scoring, and logic for when to automate and when to escalate to a human.

  • Architect async, scalable systems that handle complex AI orchestration.

  • Contribute to the direction of our AI strategy and product capabilities.


What We’re Looking For

  • You've built a complex, production LLM system with real depth: multiple layers of engineering decisions you can walk through, including what changed after real users arrived.

  • You have practical depth in one or more of context engineering, retrieval, agent orchestration, memory, evaluation, or learning from feedback.

  • You have experimental judgment. You can turn an ambiguous problem into a testable hypothesis, set a baseline, and tell a real improvement from noise.

  • You're excited by open-ended problems where the solution might not exist yet.

  • You can navigate between research papers and production code with equal comfort.

  • You're a strong communicator who can explain your work to teammates and customers.

  • You have 3+ years of professional experience.

 

Don’t meet all of the above traits? We’d still love to hear from you. We’re looking for exceptional people with unique skills and interests, and we know that great people have different backgrounds and skillsets.

title: AI Researcher - Pre-training (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission
Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model. Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.

We are hiring an AI Researcher (f/m/d) to join our Pre-training team and help advance the architecture and training of our next generation of foundation models. If you are excited about how large models learn, want to run experiments that feed directly into production training runs, and want hands-on time on large-scale clusters (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs), we would love to hear from you.

Team Culture
We foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We collaborate closely on complex technical problems, working in pairs or using mob programming to resolve challenging issues. New team members learn through real work: from your first weeks you will pair with experienced researchers on live problems, and take on more ownership as you grow into it.

About the Role
As an AI Researcher in Pre-training (f/m/d), you will work on the technical levers that determine the success of our next-generation models: architecture, optimization, stability, and scaling.

Working at the intersection of research and engineering, you will learn to translate mathematical reasoning and empirical observations into principled training decisions, from small-scale proxy experiments to multi-thousand-GPU runs. You will start with well-scoped problems alongside senior researchers and progressively take ownership of larger parts of the training recipe.

We are looking for someone with strong fundamentals, sharp experimental instincts, exceptional skills, and the drive to go deep fast. You learn as much from a failed run as from a paper, you write code others can build on, and you want to become an expert in large-scale pre-training.

Your Responsibilities

  • Recipe & Architecture Experiments: Design and run ablations on core elements of the training recipe (optimizers, schedules, initialization), and implement PyTorch-based architectural changes. Evaluate their effect on convergence, stability, and training efficiency.

  • Scaling Experiments: Run and analyze small-scale proxy experiments, and contribute to the hyperparameter scaling laws and scale-up methods we use to predict behavior at multi-thousand-GPU scale.

  • Run Monitoring & Debugging: Help monitor large-scale training runs and investigate convergence issues such as loss spikes and divergence. Work with the team to track down distributed training failures.

  • Research to Practice: Follow the literature, reproduce promising results at small scale, and bring ideas worth testing to the team.

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work with the Compute Performance, Data, Evaluation, and Post-Training teams to understand how hardware constraints and the rest of the model lifecycle shape pre-training decisions.

Core Qualifications

  • You are proficient in Python and have hands-on experience with PyTorch.

  • You have a strong foundation in machine learning, shown through research (e.g., a PhD, a strong MS'c thesis, or publications), open-source contributions, or substantial professional or substantial personal projects.

  • You have a solid mathematical background (linear algebra, probability, optimization) and enjoy reasoning formally about why models train the way they do.

  • You understand how transformers work and have pre-trained LLMs from scratch yourself, even at small scale.

  • You design experiments carefully, report noisy and negative results honestly, and can explain clearly what your evidence does and does not show.

  • You have a track record of picking up unfamiliar technical areas quickly and going deep, for example by reimplementing papers, ramping up on a large new codebase, or debugging a problem well outside your comfort zone.

  • You write clean, maintainable code and care about reproducible experiments.

  • You communicate clearly, raise problems early, and actively seek out and act on feedback.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Distributed Training: Experience training models on multi-GPU or multi-node setups, or familiarity with distributed frameworks (e.g., Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, torchtitan) and parallelism strategies (data, tensor, pipeline, expert).

  • Training Dynamics: Familiarity with scaling laws, hyperparameter transfer (e.g., µP), or recent work on optimizers and training stability.

  • Efficient Architectures: Exposure to Mixture-of-Experts, efficient attention variants, or other inference-efficient designs.

  • Research Output: Publications at top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) or contributions to open-source ML training libraries.

  • Systems Curiosity: Low-level kernel optimization is not required, but we highly value a strong curiosity about the hardware and systems constraints that shape scale.

title: AI Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors.

We are looking for a Data & AI / ML Evaluation Engineer to own the data collection, mining, curation and continuous evaluation foundation for our various AI security products. High-quality models require high-quality datasets and ongoing enrichment and retraining. In this role, you will build automated data ingestion pipelines from surrogate web traffic and open sources, manage dataset curation, labeling workflows, model training and operate our benchmark and evaluation harnesses. This is a data and AI / ML software engineering role focused on building the data infrastructure that trains our proprietary Prompt Injection SLMs, Shadow-AI detection models, Malicious Macro classifiers, PII, Content Classification engines and more.

Outcomes & KPIs Key Outcome(s) Owned:

  • Automated, continuous generation and curation of training, evaluation, and false-positive (FP) datasets across web, file, and macro threat surfaces.

  • Standardized, reproducible evaluation benchmarks that guide model improvements before deployment.

  • Automated data pipeline uptime and ingestion throughput from web/file sources.

  • Size, diversity, and labeling accuracy of threat dataset repositories (PI, Shadow-AI, PII, Macros).

  • Mean time to ingest live false-positive/false-negative feedback into training evaluation loops.

  • Accuracy and benchmark coverage across historical vs. newly trained SLMs.

What You'll Do

  • Design and operate automated data collection, mining, and web-scraping pipelines to gather threat samples from surrogate traffic and web sources.

  • Build data processing, annotation, and dataset curation workflows, training and re-training various models, e.g. Prompt Injection (PI) SLMs, Shadow-AI detection models, Malicious Macro classifiers, and PII detection.

  • Build mechanisms to capture false-positive (FP) samples from live user/DDR flows and represent / integrate them into model retraining pipelines.

  • Develop automated benchmarking and evaluation harnesses to continuously test model detection quality, runtime performance, and accuracy against baseline models (e.g., Vertex AI).

  • Build automated pipelines for model training for various models.

  • Work closely with research and software engineering teams to turn raw detection telemetry into ongoing actionable model improvements.

Required:

  • 2–4 years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or automated QA/evaluation roles.

  • Strong programming proficiency in Python. Adv: C++, SQL.

  • Experience in model training and various ML, AI algorithms.

  • Experience building data pipelines, web scrapers, or automated data processing systems.

  • Familiarity with data structures, storage formats, and database configurations.

  • Methodical approach to dataset labeling, validation, bug logging, and metric tracking.

Preferred / Nice to Have:

  • Hands-on experience with ML evaluation frameworks, dataset curation, or annotation tools.

  • Familiarity with text extraction, NLP preprocessing, or document parsing techniques.

  • Understanding of cybersecurity concepts (Prompt Injection, Malicious Macros, DLP/PII).

  • Basic experience with cloud storage, object stores, and basic containerization (Docker).

  • Experience with AWS, GCP, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Linux.

Our culture is defined by five core mindsets: Proactive Leadership, Straight Talk, United Impact, Elevated Talent, and Customer-Compelled. We take ownership and drive outcomes without waiting to be told. We communicate directly and seek hard truths. We break down silos and win together. title: AI Software Builder (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
AI Software Builder (m/w/d)

Code schreiben. KI zähmen. Eine Branche aufs nächste Level bringen.

📍 Remote First – deutschlandweit | 2–3 Tage im Monat in Sinsheim

💰 36.000–42.000 € brutto/Jahr

💻 Vollzeit | Unbefristet

Die Immobilienbranche ist digital noch nicht da, wo sie sein könnte. Das ändern wir gerade mit unserem eigenen ERP, gebaut mit KI. In unserer Party ist nur noch der Slot „Entwickler“ frei.


Das ist deine Stelle, wenn …

– du an einem Bug dranbleibst, bis er wirklich gelöst ist,

– du mit Claude, Cursor & Co. nicht nur chattest, sondern damit baust,

– du Strategiespiele magst, weil man da erst denkt und dann klickt,

– dein GitHub mehr über dich verrät als dein Lebenslauf,

– du ein Problem lieber selbst knackst, als auf ein Ticket zu warten.

Studium abgeschlossen, abgebrochen oder nie angefangen? Ausbildung, Quereinstieg, Autodidakt? Ist uns egal. Wir schauen darauf, was du baust.

Wer wir sind

Wir sind die Zapf Unternehmensgruppe, ein Mittelständler mit Schwerpunkt Immobilien, Projektentwicklung und digitale Geschäftsmodelle.

Unter der ImmoSandbox GmbH entwickeln wir LeaseFox, ein ERP für die Verwaltung und Bewirtschaftung von Gewerbeimmobilien. Ideen für KI-Anwendungen, Automatisierungen und digitale Werkzeuge haben wir reichlich, sie entstehen bei uns schneller, als man „Feature-Request“ sagen kann. Was uns fehlt, ist jemand, der daraus saubere, stabile Software macht und dabei mitdenkt, wohin die Reise geht.

Deine Quests

– LeaseFox weiterbauen: neue Features, Bugs jagen, Architektur aufräumen.

– Mit KI entwickeln: Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Copilot sind für dich Werkzeuge und keine Spielerei. Du weißt, wann du der KI trauen kannst und wann nicht.

– Automatisieren: Muss etwas zum dritten Mal von Hand erledigt werden, schreibst du ein Skript dafür.

– Prototypen bauen: Du testest neue Ideen schnell und zeigst, was technisch geht.

– Ordnung ins kreative Chaos bringen: Du machst aus schnellen Ideen wartbaren Code, mit Struktur, Tests und Doku.

– Mitdenken: Du bringst eigene Ideen mit, statt nur Aufgaben abzuarbeiten.

– Auch Grinding gehört dazu: Support-Anfragen unserer LeaseFox-Nutzer, Bugfixes, Pflege. Ohne das kein Level-up.

Dein Skilltree

– erste echte Projekte in Python, JavaScript oder TypeScript

– Grundverständnis davon, wie Anwendungen, Datenbanken und APIs zusammenspielen

– KI-Tools, mit denen du selbst schon etwas gebaut hast

– logisches Denken und Durchhaltevermögen, wenn etwas nicht läuft

– eigenständiges und zuverlässiges Arbeiten, auch wenn dir niemand über die Schulter schaut

Ohne Marketing-Filter

Einen Senior Developer, der dich an die Hand nimmt, gibt es bei uns nicht. Ein Tutorial-Level auch nicht, das hier ist Open World.

Du musst nicht alles wissen. Du solltest aber herausfinden können, wie du eine Aufgabe löst, und merken, wann du Hilfe brauchst.

Dein Loot

– fast komplett remote, von überall in Deutschland

– einmal im Monat 2–3 Tage gemeinsam in Sinsheim, quasi der Raid vor Ort

– direkter Draht zum Unternehmer statt Hierarchie-Dungeon

– echte Softwareprojekte mit viel Spielraum

– moderne KI-Tools und die Freiheit, Neues auszuprobieren

– viel Verantwortung und eine langfristige Perspektive in der Unternehmensgruppe

Roadmap

Nach ein paar Monaten kennst du unsere Anwendungen, hast eigene Lösungen live gebracht und setzt kleinere Projekte allein um.

Langfristig wirst du unser technischer Mitdenker, der Ideen aufgreift und daraus funktionierende Software macht.

Du musst heute nicht alles können. Du solltest aber Lust haben, morgen mehr zu können als heute.

Bewerbung: kein Anschreiben, nur drei Fragen

1. Was hast du schon selbst gebaut, gern mit Link?

2. Welche Tools nutzt du am liebsten und warum?

  • Strong communication skills in English—both written and verbal.
  • Passion for innovation and using technology to create business value.
  • Commitment to ethical AI development and continuous professional growth.

Benefits

At Zone, we provide the platform; you provide the grit. We operate as a high-velocity, fully remote, global team where autonomy isn't just a perk, it’s the standard. We ditch micro-management for high-trust flexibility, ensuring you have the space to innovate and scale. Our benefits are built to fuel this lifestyle, supporting your life beyond the screen so you can focus on making a global impact. Explore our offerings at https://www.zoneandco.com/careers

title: AI Software Engineer (F/H/NB)
descriptionHtml:
SFEIR est un cabinet d'expertise technologique spécialisé dans la conception, l'architecture et l'industrialisation de solutions numériques sur-mesure. Nous accompagnons les organisations dans leurs transformations les plus complexes en combinant la rigueur du Software Craftsmanship avec la maîtrise des technologies d'avenir. Convaincus que la souveraineté numérique est un enjeu stratégique majeur, nous concevons des architectures sécurisées, performantes et indépendantes, portées par des partenariats solides avec des acteurs clés comme SENS et Scaleway. Acteur de référence sur l'intelligence artificielle, nous faisons évoluer les standards d'ingénierie modernes. À travers notre plateforme GenAI RAISE et notre statut de partenaire Anthropic Preferred (au sein du Claude Partner Network), nous plaçons le Context Engineering et l'IA générative au cœur de nos pratiques.

Nos chiffres clés :

  • 950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l’IA.

  • 8 agences en France, au Luxembourg et en Belgique.

  • Partenaire Anthropic Select au sein du Claude Partner Network.

  • 15 ans de partenariat avec Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks, Confluent...

  • +5000 personnes formées par an via le SFEIR Institute.

Rejoindre SFEIR, c'est intégrer un collectif où la culture technique prévaut. Nous offrons des trajectoires de carrière dédiées aux experts (Individual Contributor / IC), te permettant de progresser en haute maîtrise technique sans devoir basculer vers du management organisationnel. Nous intégrons l'IA à nos propres pratiques d'ingénierie (utilisation quotidienne de RAISE et Claude Code) pour automatiser les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée et concentrer nos efforts sur la conception d'architectures résilientes.

▪️ À propos du poste

Tu conçois et déploies des agents IA et systèmes agentiques complets exécutant des processus métier de bout en bout : support client avancé, recherche multi-sources, opérations IT, ainsi que des cas d'usage avancés liés à l'industrie du futur et à la continuité digitale (ex. traçabilité des exigences, maintenance prédictive, continuité de l'ingénierie et jumeaux numériques). Tu sais aussi bien développer des agents sur-mesure en code que configurer des agents via des plateformes low-code/no-code avec des plateformes type Gemini Enterprise.

Ton terrain d'action combine maîtrise technique du cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) et compréhension fonctionnelle fine des enjeux métiers. Tu orchestres l'autonomie des agents, la planification, le choix des outils et la mémoire, tout en garantissant la fiabilité, la gouvernance et le respect des garde-fous.

Les missions :

  • Analyser et appréhender les besoins et processus métiers avec une vision fonctionnelle claire pour définir les cas d'usage d'automatisation et la répartition des tâches (autonomie agentique vs validation humaine).

  • Concevoir et développer des systèmes agentiques complets (mono ou multi-agents), en choisissant l'approche adaptée : développement sur-mesure ou programmation/configuration d'agents low-code/no-code (Gemini Enterprise, Vertex AI Agent Builder, AWS).

  • Construire les outils des agents : function calling, intégration d’API et de systèmes d’information, création et consommation de serveurs MCP, workflows asynchrones et longue durée.

  • Maîtriser la fiabilité : gestion des erreurs et des reprises, boucles de contrôle, limites de budget et de pas, comportement face à l’imprévu.

  • Évaluer les agents : jeux de scénarios, analyse des trajectoires, taux de réussite des tâches, LLM-as-judge, tests de non-régression à chaque changement de prompt, d’outil ou de modèle.

  • Observer en production : traces détaillées, coûts par tâche, détection des dérives et des boucles, tableaux de bord.

  • Sécuriser l’autonomie : permissions minimales sur les outils, protection contre la prompt injection, isolation des actions sensibles, validation humaine, traçabilité, conformité (RGPD, AI Act).

  • S'intégrer dans le cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) complet et déployer sur le cloud (Google Cloud / Vertex AI) avec intégration CI/CD et gestion des coûts.

  • Partager : documenter les patterns, former les équipes clientes, contribuer aux publications et événements SFEIR.

▪️ Le profil idéal

  • 5 ans d’expérience en développement logiciel (hors stage et alternance) avec une vision transverse du SDLC et une première expérience solide sur des projets LLM / IA
  • Pratique démontrée de la création d'agents IA : développement custom (frameworks/code) ou création via des environnements low-code/no-code (Gemini Enterprise, AWS,...)
  • Connaissance de MCP et des protocoles d’interopérabilité entre agents (A2A)
  • Compréhension fine des modes d’échec des agents : dérive, boucles, mauvais choix d’outil, perte de contexte
  • Solide maîtrise des API, de l’asynchrone et des architectures événementielles
  • Rigueur d’ingénierie : tests, observabilité, code relu
  • Aisance relationnelle et bon niveau fonctionnel pour échanger avec les équipes métiers, comprendre leurs enjeux et leur expliquer les possibilités et limites des agents IA

Un plus

  • Expérience d’évaluation d’agents et d’observabilité (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse…)
  • Connaissance de la méthodologie BMAD
  • Google Cloud (Vertex AI, Cloud Run, Gemini),
  • Sensibilité sécurité : modèles de menaces sur les agents, gestion des identités et des permissions
  • Notions de RAG, vues comme un outil de l’agent
  • Contributions open source, side projects agentiques, talks

▪️ L'ancrage Bordelais

L'agence SFEIR Bordeaux regroupe une quinzaine d'ingénieurs et d'architectes seniors. Tu y trouveras la proximité et l'agilité d'une structure à taille humaine, adossée à la solidité d'un grand groupe. Tu participes activement à l'écosystème tech local (meetups, conférences BDX/IO, SFEIR Talks) et tu peux intégrer le programme AI Champions pour piloter la R&D de l'agence.

▪️ Tes conditions de travail

  • Organisation : 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine.
  • Équipement : Laptop haut de gamme au choix (MacBook Pro ou Dell Precision dernière génération).
  • Package : Rémunération fixe attractive, prime de vacances, accord d'intéressement, forfait mobilités durables, mutuelle et titres-restaurant.

▪️ Le processus de recrutement

  1. Échange RH : Alignement sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les opportunités SFEIR.
  2. Session Technique ("PlayOffs") : Évaluation pratique en pair-programming (Algo et GenAI) avec deux Sfeirians.
  3. Échange Métier & Projection : Discussion approfondie sur les cas d'usage, les missions cibles et le contexte client à Bordeaux
  4. Entretien Final : Échange stratégique avec le Directeur d'Agence.

title: AI Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

TrustFlight is the Aerospace Safety Intelligence Platform - the only company in aviation that integrates safety and security technology, world-class training and consulting, and emergency preparedness and response into a single, connected platform. We serve 1,600+ organisations across 120 countries through four capability pillars: TrustFlight (technology), Baines Simmons (training and expertise), Redline Assured Security (security), and Kenyon International (emergency response).

We’re entering a new phase of growth. Smart Suite, our AI-powered agentic platform, is redefining how aerospace organisations manage safety, compliance, and operational risk. Our go-to-market needs to keep pace.

Why Choose TrustFlight?

✈️ Our Mission: To revolutionize aviation by delivering digital workflow solutions that enhance safety, streamline operations, and inspire confidence across the industry.

✈️ Impact: Over 200,000 users rely on our systems daily, making aviation safer and more efficient.

✈️ Core Values: Guided by integrity, responsibility, innovation, and excellence, we are committed to empowering our partners to operate with confidence.

Join us in shaping the future of aviation and making an impact through technology.

The Role

You will join TrustFlight as an AI Software Engineer and serve as a core member of the AI Team. In this role, you will work closely within the team and cross-functionally across the organization to design, build, and deliver high-impact AI-powered software solutions.

This is an opportunity for a self-motivated, creative engineer who enjoys taking ideas from early exploration through technical planning, implementation, deployment, and iteration in production. The role is software engineering first, with a strong emphasis on applying AI thoughtfully and effectively to real business problems.

You will help build full-stack AI applications, backend services that provide AI capabilities to other products and users, and integrations that embed AI directly into existing applications and workflows. You will also help strengthen the AI Team’s engineering approaches, contribute to sound architectural and implementation decisions, and support AI understanding across the organization by sharing practical use cases, guidance, and best practices.

What you’ll be doing

  • Drive the full lifecycle of AI/ML solutions, from research and prototyping through production deployment, evaluation, and monitoring.

  • Design and implement scalable, maintainable systems with strong software engineering fundamentals, using sound architecture, infrastructure, and design patterns.

  • Help shape the AI team's software engineering practices by contributing to technical direction, improving implementation approaches, and ensuring solutions are built in a reliable, maintainable, and scalable way.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to develop and optimize AI-powered product features and internal tools.

    • Build, orchestrate, and integrate LLM-based systems into production applications.

    • Apply AI patterns and frameworks such as RAG, skills, document extraction, and workflow orchestration where they are the right fit.

    • Refine AI use cases through prompt engineering, evaluation, guardrails, and orchestration strategies.

  • Assess where AI can streamline or improve existing processes, and identify cases where conventional software solutions are a better choice.

  • Support AI adoption across the organization by helping teams understand, use, and implement AI effectively in their day-to-day work.


What you’ll bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 2–3+ years of professional experience shipping production software, with strong engineering fundamentals.

  • Strong proficiency in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to deliver full-stack changes across backend services, web applications, and Python-based systems.

  • Experience building and shipping production-quality software with attention to reliability, maintainability, testing, and performance.

  • Experience delivering AI features into production, including working with LLM APIs and building reliable AI workflows with considerations such as latency, streaming, retries, fallbacks, and error handling.

  • Strong understanding of the capabilities, trade-offs, and limitations of modern AI systems.

  • Clear communication, strong ownership, and the ability to operate effectively in a small team.

  • A growth mindset, with a willingness to learn, adapt, and continuously improve technical and product skills.

What makes you stand out

  • Strong background in software development, with experience contributing across the product and engineering lifecycle.

  • Experience integrating and implementing AI features, automations, or products in a professional environment.

  • Comfort working with LLM provider SDKs, APIs, and common abstractions such as PydanticAI, LangChain, or LiteLLM.

  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to gather requirements and develop practical solutions.

  • Experience leading projects, mentoring teammates, or helping raise engineering standards.

Location

This role is based in our Vancouver office. This is an on-site role with room for flexibility, because we know life doesn't always fit a 9-to-5 mould.

Why join us

  • See Your Impact: Your contributions directly enhance the safety and efficiency of aviation operations, affecting hundreds of thousands of passengers and crew every month.

  • Build and Create: Be part of an environment where you'll have the freedom to innovate, build, and create solutions that define the future of digital aviation.

  • Growth Opportunity: Join us at an inflection point as we scale our revenue growth using cutting-edge AI tools and SaaS best practices.

Also, we offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive benefits package including health and dental benefits. Paid time off plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday.

  • Invest in your future: Take advantage of our company contribution to pension/RRSP matching program to grow your savings while you work.

  • Professional Growth: As a fast-growing company, we offer incredible opportunities for career advancement and skill development.

  • Competitive salary range: We place huge importance on the contribution and experience you bring to the team. The base pay offered is based on location and may vary depending on skills, job related knowledge, experience and internal equity.

    The expected base salary range for this role is $110,000 to $160,000 CAD, depending on skills and experience.

    $110K–$120K: Solid software engineering experience with some hands-on experience building or integrating AI/LLM-powered features. Candidates can contribute effectively to production software and have practical familiarity with AI-enabled workflows, though they may not yet have deep experience delivering complex AI systems.

    $120K–$130K: Strong software engineering experience with solid applied AI experience, or stronger AI experience paired with solid software engineering fundamentals. Candidates can design, build, and ship production software that includes AI-powered features, applying sound judgment across reliability, maintainability, and user impact.

    $130K–$145K: Proven ability to design, build, and deliver production-grade systems that combine strong software engineering fundamentals with applied AI expertise. Candidates demonstrate end-to-end ownership, sound architectural judgment, and practical depth across backend/application engineering and AI systems.

    $145K–$160K: Senior-level ability to lead the design and delivery of production-grade AI-enabled systems. Candidates bring deeper expertise across both software engineering and AI, with the flexibility for one area to be especially strong while the other remains credible and production-ready. They can make robust technical decisions in regulated or safety-critical environments and mentor others.

    Final compensation will reflect your experience, technical depth, and overall impact.

How to Apply

Click Apply and send us your resume along with a cover letter. We’d love to learn how your experience and perspective can contribute to creating best-in-class tools and services across the aviation industry.

While we sincerely appreciate all applications, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. No phone calls please.

title: AI Solutions Architect (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

BeNeering was founded in 2007 by experienced SAP solution architects who had spent years working inside global corporations. We know from first-hand experience where procurement gets slowed down and how to fix it. As a German software company and certified SAP partner, we started out in consulting and became a solutions provider in 2013. Our core development team from that time is still with us today.

Our main product is the BeNeering Digital Procurement Platform. It uses AI-powered guidance and automation to make indirect procurement easy. The platform connects to SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA in real time, so SAP remains the system of record while employees shop in a modern, intuitive interface that feels like a web shop. Many of our customers use it as the modern replacement for SAP SRM.

BeNeering is privately owned and has no outside investors. We don’t chase short-term targets. We build long-term partnerships and develop our product together with our customers

About the Job

Do you design AI solutions that hold up in production, write solid Python, and enjoy being the person customers trust to deliver? At BeNeering you will architect and build AI features for procurement used by global companies, and run customer projects end to end.

Responsibilities

  • Design the architecture of AI solutions for our procurement platform, including LLM-based assistants, AI agents, retrieval (RAG) and machine learning models

  • Develop production-grade Python services and APIs, from prototype to deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement

  • Run customer projects independently: scope requirements, plan and estimate, deliver, and report progress to customer stakeholders

  • Lead workshops and explain technical concepts clearly to both business users and IT teams

  • Integrate AI services with SAP systems (S/4HANA, SAP BTP) and with our cloud platform, working closely with our SAP developers and consultants

  • Ensure AI solutions are secure, reliable and compliant with data protection rules, including GDPR and the EU AI Act

title: AI Systems Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors.

We are seeking an AI Systems Infrastructure Engineer (IC4) to lead the platform and backend architecture powering our real-time security detection services. In this role, you will build and scale low-latency serving infrastructure for Small Language Models (SLM), Prompt Injection (PI) engines, and Content / Intent Classification platforms running across GPU and cloud clusters. We are looking for a strong systems engineer who understands production backend services, microservices, container management, and high-throughput inference optimization. While you will work closely with ML researchers, your primary focus will be engineering robust backend services, GPU replica scaling, guardrails, and automated evaluation infrastructure.

Outcomes & KPIs Key Outcome(s) Owned:

  • Sub-hundred-millisecond SLM and detection service execution speeds across high-volume tenant workloads.

  • Highly resilient, auto-scaling GPU inference cluster infrastructure with automated CI/CD and regression gating.

Success Metrics / KPIs:

  • P95 and P99 detection latency for prompt injection (PI) and classification services.

  • GPU pod readiness time and cluster auto-scaling efficiency under burst traffic.

  • Service availability and rate-limiting guardrail enforcement per tenant.

  • Automated MLOps/LLMops pipeline throughput and deployment turnaround time.

What You'll Do

  • Architect, build, and optimize production serving pipelines for Small Language Models (SLMs) and traditional ML models using model quantization, batching, and GPU acceleration.

  • Own and scale backend microservices (e.g., sds-service-prompt-injection, sds-service-ddr) delivering real-time threat detection.

  • Build consumption-based monitoring, tenant rate-limiting, and runtime guardrail infrastructure.

  • Manage and optimize GPU cluster replicas (Kubernetes / Pod infrastructure) to minimize cold-start times and manage infrastructure costs.

  • Build continuous evaluation, automated retraining pipelines, model CI/CD, and automated regression gates to test model detection quality against live benchmarks.

  • Refactor legacy service boundaries, service-to-service auth flows, and backend database configurations.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience building distributed backend systems or high-throughput microservices.

  • Proven track record in model serving and inference optimization (e.g., TensorRT, vLLM, ONNX Runtime, Triton Inference Server).

  • Strong programming experience in Python, Go, or C++.

  • Hands-on expertise with Kubernetes, container orchestration, GPU scheduling, and infrastructure auto-scaling.

  • Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines, MLOps/LLMops principles, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP).

Preferred / Nice to Have:

  • Experience building consumption-based rate limiting or multi-tenant guardrail architectures.

  • Familiarity with database refactoring, auth protocols, and backend technical debt remediation.

  • Background in cybersecurity, threat detection engines, or DLP/PII filtering platforms.

  • Experience benchmarking runtime vs. accuracy trade-offs between local SLMs and cloud LLMs (e.g., Vertex AI).

  • Experience with AWS, GCP, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Linux.

Follow us on LinkedIn!

Why Menlo?

At Menlo, we don't settle for the status quo — in our technology or our culture. How we think and act is just as important as what we build. Our culture is defined by five core mindsets: Proactive Leadership, Straight Talk, United Impact, Elevated Talent, and Customer-Compelled. We take ownership and drive outcomes without waiting to be told. We communicate directly and seek hard truths. We break down silos and win together. We hold a high bar for ourselves and the people around us. And we treat every customer interaction as mission-critical. If you're someone who sees it, owns it, solves it, and does it — you'll thrive here.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

TO ALL AGENCIES: Please, no phone calls or emails to any employee of Menlo Security outside of the Talent organization. Menlo Security’s policy is to only accept resumes from agencies via Ashby (ATS). Agencies must have a valid services agreement executed and must have been assigned by the Talent team to a specific requisition. Any resume submitted outside of this process will be deemed the sole property of Menlo Security. In the event a candidate submitted outside of this policy is hired, no fee or payment will be paid.

title: AI Systems - Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.

We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our $22m Series B round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.

We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.

About the Role

As a Software Engineer on our AI Systems team, you'll build the AI foundations and product experiences of Ledgy: the Ledgy Agent, the tools and skills it runs on, our MCP server, and the platform capabilities that let other teams embed AI safely in their domains. You'll collaborate with fellow engineers, product managers, and designers in a new and fast-moving product area where correctness matters as much as speed - our customers need equity data they can trust.

Location: We hire remotely across the UK, Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania. For candidates based in London, we use a hybrid model with 2 days in the office per week.

The team you'll join:
AI Systems - Develops Ledgy's AI foundations and product experiences, from AI agents and AI-assisted workflows to the platform capabilities that help other teams embed AI safely in their domains. The team works in a new and evolving product area, balancing rapid iteration with reliable execution, evaluation tooling, and responsible automation.

What You'll Work On

Help build the future of how companies manage equity.

  • Ledgy Agent. You'll design and build the system behind our in-app agent, so equity administrators can do through AI what they do manually in the app today. Ledgy Agent takes real actions and runs real analysis on live equity data, like onboarding a stakeholder end to end, and administrators depend on its accuracy and observability. You'll design the tools, skills, context, and orchestration behind it, and how it decides to handle each request.
  • Ledgy MCP. Not everyone wants to open Ledgy to get things done. Our MCP server lets customers bring equity into the AI agents and tools they already use. You'll shape it alongside the in-app agent, so a capability built once works in both places, and you'll decide what we expose and how we keep it safe.
  • Measuring and improving the agent. You'll design and build the system we use to measure the agent's quality and learn from how customers use it: evaluations, tracing, and feedback from real conversations. You decide what "good" means for customers, how we measure it, and how what we learn changes what we build next.
  • Scaling. The Ledgy web application, the agent, MCP, and surfaces we haven't built yet all need the same capabilities. You'll design the foundations that let us build AI features once and reuse them everywhere, and that let other teams add AI to their domains without compromising correctness. You'll also design how it runs as usage grows: the backend infrastructure, cost, and latency behind the agent and MCP, and how we keep them reliable and observable.

You'll own real parts of this and have a say in where we invest. You'll also spend time with customers to see how administrators actually use the agent, and use that to decide what to build next.

You'll Thrive in This Role If You

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. These are the things that would make you an especially good fit.

  • You have 5+ years of experience working as a Software Engineer, with strong TypeScript/Node fundamentals across back end and front end
  • You've built and shipped agentic or LLM-based software to production, such as an agent, an assistant, or a chat product, and you've been the one running it. You've debugged failures in real conversations and kept cost and latency in check as usage and models changed.
  • You've designed the agent itself: tools and skills, context and prompt engineering, state, streaming, and the agent loop. You know at least one agent framework or runtime well and can say where it works and where it doesn't.
  • You improve these systems with evidence. Evals, regression sets, tracing, and feedback from real usage tell you whether a change helped, and you use them to decide what to do next.
  • You keep up with what the foundation labs and the wider community are learning about building agents. You try new techniques early and judge which ones make our product better and are worth adopting now, and which should wait.
  • You take part in deciding what we build. You read the data, talk to customers, and push for what you think matters most.

Our Tech Stack

We work in a TypeScript monorepo: React and Tailwind on the front end, tRPC, Node.js, MongoDB, and Temporal on the back end. It runs on GCP with Kubernetes, managed through Terraform. The agent is currently built on the Vercel AI SDK, and we run an MCP server alongside it.

You don't need to know all of it, but hands-on experience building with LLMs is strongly preferred.

What Your Journey Could Look Like

First day: Get the app running locally and make your first commit. Your onboarding buddy helps you get there.

First week:

  • Meet the engineers, product managers, and designers you'll work with.
  • Learn the agent end to end: its tools, skills, MCP surface, and how we evaluate it.
  • Ship a few smaller features.

First month:

  • Meet the wider engineering team and learn how Ledgy works and how customers use it today. This is the background you'll use for decisions later.
  • Make larger contributions and take a bigger part in code reviews.

First 3 months:

  • Drive part of a larger piece of work, such as process, tooling, a new product, or new functionality.
  • Work with Product and Design to prove and deepen the value AI adds to the product.
  • Take part in architecture and long-term decisions.

After the first 3 months:

  • Take a bigger role in shaping where the team is heading. Own key parts of our AI platform and decide where we can add the most value for customers.
  • Mentor other engineers and raise the bar. Help teams across Ledgy add AI to what they build, whether that means advising, reviewing, or working alongside them.
  • Help shape Ledgy's technical direction, for AI and for everything else we build.

The interview process:

  • Getting to know you (45 min): Meet with someone from our people team to talk about your experience and to ask questions about the role
  • Live Coding (60 min): An equity domain problem to solve collaboratively using your preferred language and IDE. We want to see how you think, so this step does not allow AI. But you can freely look up syntax questions if you need to.
  • System Design (60 min): A system design session where you will design an architecture for a problem from the Ledgy domain using a visual tool of your choice
  • Behavioural (45 min): Answer behavioural style questions about your experience, using the STAR method - with a PM and EM.
  • Culture Interview: A chance to meet one of our founders and your hiring manager for a 30-minute chat about Ledgy's mission and values
  • Offer 🎉

Being part of Ledgy means:

  • Recharge and re-energize with flexible working hours, 25 days of vacation, and up to 40 days of remote work from outside your home country.
  • We make space for your own professional development, with a generous yearly learning & development budget.
  • This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. All salaries are aligned with competitively benchmarked ranges based on work location and levelling.
  • For candidates based in London we use a hybrid work model of 2 days in the office per week.

title: AI Technical Product Manager (QVAC) (100% remote)
descriptionHtml:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices, it gives users greater control over their data and how they use artificial intelligence. Our focus is on local, on-device, and privacy-preserving AI, with opportunities to connect these experiences across Tether’s peer-to-peer ecosystem.

We’re looking for a Product Manager with a strong interest in AI and a practical understanding of how to turn emerging capabilities into useful products.

You will work closely with the Product Lead to help advance the QV.AC vision: identifying valuable use cases, defining AI features, exploring product concepts, and working with engineering and design to bring them to users. You’ll contribute to product direction and take responsibility for moving assigned features from discovery through delivery and iteration.

This role suits someone who knows how to leverage AI to the maximum and enjoys experimenting with new AI technologies, understands its possibilities and limitations, and cares about making complex technology easy to use.

Responsibilities

  • Help shape AI features: Work with the Product Lead to translate the QV.AC vision into concrete use cases, feature proposals, and product requirements. Bring ideas grounded in user needs, research, and hands-on experimentation.

  • Understand users and their problems: Gather feedback, conduct research, and explore how people use AI in their everyday workflows. Identify where AI can solve a meaningful problem and where a simpler solution may work better.

  • Turn ideas into clear specifications: Write product briefs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and user flows that help engineering and design understand the intended experience, constraints, and measures of success.

  • Prototype and explore: Create wireframes, mockups, and working prototypes to test ideas and communicate product behavior. Use AI-assisted tools to explore concepts quickly and refine them with the team.

  • Collaborate on technical trade-offs: Work with engineers to understand what is feasible across devices and models. Help assess the impact of response quality, latency, memory usage, battery consumption, and privacy on the user experience.

  • Support prioritization and planning: Help the Product Lead evaluate opportunities, clarify scope, identify dependencies, and maintain a focused backlog aligned with product priorities.

  • Drive feature delivery: Follow assigned features through development, resolve product questions, review the experience, and coordinate feedback and release readiness with relevant teams.

  • Stay close to AI developments: Explore new AI products, models, tools, and interaction patterns, and explain their practical relevance to QV.AC. Share clear recommendations about what is worth testing or adopting and why.


Mandatory:

  • 7+ years of product management experience, ideally working on AI software products with technical engineering teams.

  • Practical experience building, shipping, or prototyping AI-powered features, with the ability to explain your contribution and what you learned.

  • A working understanding of AI concepts such as inference, harnesses, model capabilities and limitations, context, and evaluation, alongside an interest in local and on-device AI.

  • The ability to translate an ambiguous idea into a clear user problem, proposed solution, and actionable requirements.

  • Strong product judgment, with attention to usability, scope, and measurable user value.

  • Confidence creating prototypes using design or coding tools

  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to discuss technical trade-offs with engineers and explain them to non-technical colleagues.

  • A proactive, collaborative approach: comfortable taking responsibility for your work, asking questions early, and incorporating feedback.

  • Familiarity with product analytics, user research, and iterative software development.

Preferred:

  • Experience with local AI, on-device inference, or open-source models.

  • Experience building AI assistants, conversational interfaces, or multimodal features.

  • Familiarity with desktop or mobile product development.

  • An understanding of peer-to-peer technologies and decentralized applications.

  • Experience evaluating AI output quality and designing user experiences that account for uncertainty and errors.

  • Experience working in a distributed team.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

descriptionHtml:
TLDR: We’re looking for top 1%, high agency, AI-forward transformation leads to be part of our early team at Resonance in Berlin. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital, to deploy AI into the economy and rebuild businesses for the AI era. You’ll work at the frontier and solve real problems in an environment that champions ownership, autonomy and innovation at pace.

Who we are

Resonance is an applied AI company. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital. Our mission is to close the AI diffusion gap and rebuild businesses for the AI era. We're looking to hire Europe’s elite AI talent, and we're building our Berlin hub to serve clients across Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

Why now

We believe the economic diffusion of AI is the major challenge of the next decade. Foundation models are advancing far faster than organisations can absorb them; the bottleneck is embedding AI deeply into the core processes of a company to drive an inflection in pace and create organisational advantage. Europe is falling behind on AI, and we exist to help its businesses build real, defensible advantage from it rather than simply adopting it.

The role

As an AI Transformation Lead in Berlin, you’ll work on our most ambitious client engagements across DACH, helping leading businesses redefine themselves through AI. You’ll own major workstreams alongside a Senior AI Transformation Lead and the AI engineers who build with you. You’ll map how a business runs its key processes, find where AI fundamentally changes the economics, and redesign them agentic-first rather than bolting AI onto today’s process. You’ll prototype the new workflows yourself with Claude Code or similar, build the analysis behind the business case, and track the productivity or revenue each build delivers once it’s live. You’ll lead the change on the ground by training users, running workshops and helping people work in entirely new ways. What you learn shapes our products, platform and playbooks, so every engagement is faster and more ambitious than the last, and as one of our first 100 you’ll help shape how Resonance hires, operates and grows in DACH.

What we’re looking for: You have extreme agency, operate with urgency, and have consistently been among the top performers wherever you’ve been, at university or at work. You typically have up to four years in consulting, PE, banking, strategy, operations or a high-growth startup. You structure complex problems quickly and back your arguments with data. You’re a builder with a deep understanding of technology. You don’t need to write production code, but you use AI every day, build with it yourself (prototype workflows, agents, internal tools), know what models can and can’t do, and hold your own with engineers. You’re as comfortable with a client’s managers as with the operators doing the work. PE portfolio or value creation experience, exposure to software or services businesses, and German for client work in DACH are a plus. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway.

What we offer: Competitive total compensation plus equity. Frontier AI work with real stakes, driving tangible outcomes for consequential companies. Learning from people who have embedded AI into 50+ businesses, with scope that grows as fast as your impact. A team built to be one of the most talent-dense in Europe, and the chance to shape how the firm delivers and grows in Berlin as an early joiner. A chance to help close Europe’s AI gap, moving European businesses to the right side of the productivity chasm.

Logistics: Berlin, 3+ days a week in the office or at client sites, mostly in DACH and Europe. English is our working language; German is a plus. We can sponsor visas for eligible candidates, and start dates are flexible.

Apply

Send your CV and a short note on a problem you're proudest of solving and the impact it had.

We hire people from every background and judge them on what they've built. If you don't tick every box, apply anyway.

Resonance is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. If you need adjustments at any stage, tell us and we'll make them.

descriptionHtml:
AI Tutor/Lehrkraft (all genders)

Du brennst für GenAI und Large Language Models und möchtest Dein Wissen nicht nur anwenden, sondern auch weitergeben? Als KI Tutor/Lehrkraft begleitest Du unsere Teilnehmenden fachlich und didaktisch auf ihrem Weg zu praxisnahen KI-Kompetenzen: Du beantwortest ihre Fragen rund um GenAI, LLMs und verantwortungsvollen KI-Einsatz, unterstützt sie in Übungen und Projekten und sorgst dafür, dass sie KI-Tools am Ende nicht nur verstehen, sondern sicher und reflektiert in ihrem Arbeitsalltag einsetzen können.

Du bewertest Lernfortschritte, führst Abschlussprüfungen durch und gibst strukturiertes, konstruktives Feedback. Durch den engen Kontakt zu den Lernenden trägst Du außerdem aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Trainingsprogramme bei – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Coaching Team Lead, dem Learning Team und weiteren Schnittstellen.

Schwerpunkte Deiner Rolle

  • Fachliche Beantwortung von Fragen der Lernenden (schriftlich und mündlich)

  • Vermittlung und Vertiefung von Trainingsinhalten in Live-Sessions, Webinaren, Classrooms und individueller Lernbegleitung

  • Begleitung bei Unsicherheiten im Lernprozess sowie in Übungen und Projekten

  • Durchführung und Bewertung von Abschlussprüfungen sowie Entscheidung über den Trainingserfolg

  • Erstellung, Aufbereitung und Weiterentwicklung von Lernmaterialien rund um praktische GenAI/LLM-Fähigkeiten, grundlegende KI/ML-Kompetenz und verantwortungsvollen, ethischen KI-Einsatz

  • Qualitätssicherung bestehender Trainings inkl. Feedback ans Learning-Team

  • Durchführung individueller Coaching-Sessions und Unterstützung neuer Teammitglieder

Das bringst Du mit

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation in einem quantitativen, analytischen oder technischen Fachbereich

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse moderner KI-Konzepte – insbesondere GenAI mit Fokus auf LLMs, inkl. Grundverständnis von Trainingsdaten, Modellen, Evaluierung und typischen KI-Limitierungen (Machine Learning und Deep Learning sind ein Plus)

  • Praktische Erfahrung in der Nutzung von LLMs (z. B. Prompt-Engineering, Workflow-Integration, Agenten) sowie mit No-/Low-Code-KI-Tools

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit (einfachen) API-Clients (z. B. Postman, curl); gute Python-Kenntnisse sowie Erfahrung mit SQL, Power BI oder Excel sind von Vorteil

  • Bewusstsein für ethische, rechtliche und organisatorische Aspekte von KI-Anwendungen sowie Interesse an aktuellen Entwicklungen im KI-Sektor

  • Didaktische Erfahrung in der Vermittlung technischer oder fachlicher Inhalte an nicht-technische Zielgruppen sowie Verständnis für Konzepte der Erwachsenenbildung und Online-Weiterbildung

  • Hohe Kunden- und Serviceorientierung, Empathie, klare Kommunikation und konstruktive Feedbackkultur

  • Hands-on-Mentalität, Teamgeist, Belastbarkeit und Flexibilität

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1)

Das bieten wir Dir

Arbeitskultur
Dich erwartet eine lösungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, eine offene Feedbackkultur sowie ein starker Teamspirit. Zwei vom gesamten StackFuel-Team gewählte Trustees unterstützen Dich bei Fragen und Anliegen als neutrale, vertrauliche Anlaufstelle.


Ownership
Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit.

Workation
Bis zu 10 Tage pro Jahr kannst Du von überall aus der EU, dem EWR und der Türkei arbeiten.

Raum für Austausch
Regelmäßiger Austausch im Team, saisonale Feiern und eine immer gut gefüllte Küche sorgen für ein lebendiges Miteinander.

title: AIT Electrical/Harness Technician
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


We are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.

We want you as a hands-on AIT Electrical/Harness Technician to help us in our mission by building, integrating, maintaining and documenting Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE) and electrical harnesses used for FM1 integration and on-site ground testing, to ensure that our mission will succeed and our system will work in space!

Key Responsibilities

In your role as an AIT Electrical/Harness Technician, your role will include the following responsibilities:

  • Build, wire, assemble and inspect EGSE assemblies and associated electrical harnesses in accordance with released drawings, bills of materials and work instructions

  • Where drawings or complete work instructions are unavailable, use available information and agreed engineering direction to support practical build decisions, capture the as-built configuration and any assumptions or open points, and seek review and approval before the equipment is used

  • Manufacture, terminate, label, route, inspect and maintain electrical harnesses and test cables used during FM1 integration and ground testing

  • Perform prescribed electrical checks, such as continuity, pinout and polarity checks, using approved procedures, equipment and acceptance limits

  • Support installation, setup, connection, disconnection and removal of EGSE and harnesses in integration areas and at on-site ground-test locations

  • Maintain and troubleshoot EGSE, harnesses and test cables; identify faults and report discrepancies for engineering or quality disposition before making changes outside approved instructions

  • Support engineers and test teams during integration and ground-test activities by preparing equipment, maintaining tidy cable routing and assisting with approved checks

  • Maintain accurate build, inspection, test, maintenance and as-built records, including equipment identification and configuration status

  • Keep track of tools and measuring equipment used for the work, including their serviceability and calibration status where applicable

  • Follow applicable electrical-safety, ESD, clean-work-area and hardware-handling requirements

  • Support the packing, transport, deployment and return of EGSE and harnesses for ground-test campaigns

  • Help maintain an orderly workshop, equipment inventory and stock of consumables.


What we would love to see from you

In the role of AIT Electrical/Harness Technician, ideally you will bring the following skillset, mentality and experience:

  • Vocational training or apprenticeship in electrical/electronic engineering, electronics, mechatronics or a comparable qualification; equivalent practical experience will also be considered

  • Hands-on experience assembling electrical wiring, cable harnesses, electrical panels or rack-based equipment; experience in aerospace AIT or with EGSE is an asset

  • Practical skills in wire preparation, crimping, connector termination, cable routing and labelling; soldering experience is an asset where required by the work instructions

  • Ability to read and follow electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, connector pinouts, assembly drawings and work instructions

  • Experience using hand tools and basic electrical measurement equipment, such as a multimeter or continuity tester

  • Careful approach to workmanship, inspection, configuration control and recording completed work

  • Willingness to stop and raise a discrepancy when a drawing, label, measurement or instruction does not agree, rather than making an unauthorised change

  • Basic fault-finding skills and the ability to communicate findings clearly to engineers and test teams

  • Willingness to work hands-on in workshops, integration areas and on-site test locations, including supporting time-critical campaign activities

  • Sense of responsibility and a clean, organized and safety-conscious way of working

  • Fluent in written and spoken English

  • Willingness to travel for ground-test and launch campaigns.

 

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for.
