title: Associate Director, Financial Advisory
descriptionHtml:
The Role

This is an excellent opportunity to work alongside our established team who will support you to utilise and enhance your advisory skills and experience. You will work alongside some of the most experienced practitioners in the field advising the boards, management teams, lenders and shareholders of companies which are underperforming and/or facing any financial stress. 

As an Associate Director in the team, you will have the opportunity to work and lead on a diverse range of engagements across all sectors, with plenty of responsibility for leading workstreams, managing junior staff and supporting Directors and Managing Directors in client-facing delivery. 

Key Responsibilities

Client Service

  • Preparation of engagement letter(s) and ensuring adherence to all compliance requirements.
  • Manage parts of the engagement, providing support to the Managing Director/ Director (or often directly to Senior Managing Director) in managing external stakeholders.
  • Support management teams in preparing and challenging business plans, short term cash flow forecasts and Financial Advisory plans.
  • Providing comprehensive financial restructuring and cash management services to identify working capital and other cash flow improvements.
  • Reviewing and stress-testing integrated business plans, budgeting and forecasting models using a fact-based, data driven approach, including KPI definition, data visualization, reporting automation and touchless forecasting.
  • Establishment or enhancement of company finance functions and processes.
  • Develop, analyse and present Financial Advisory options using input from other teams, e.g. insolvency or tax analysis, sector and financial modelling. Liaise with the Company’s legal advisors to understand key aspects of legal documentation and also drive any documentation processes (term sheets, waivers, loan documentation etc.)
  • Management of complex insolvency cases reporting to the appointees.
  • Manage forensic accounting, complex and lengthy litigation issues, and multi-jurisdictional asset recovery actions.
  • Apply an understanding of engagement economics.
  • Apply an understanding of financial and risk management.

Knowledge Acquisition

  • Build client relationship skills, sector knowledge and continue to develop leadership skills.
  • Continue to build technical expertise, broader business advisory and people management skills.
  • Understand the market, topical issues and our Financial Advisory propositions.

People and Leadership

  • Support practice and talent development.
  • Provide on-job coaching and development to staff.
  • Develop junior staff outside of jobs through appraising and mentoring.
  • Support wider Financial Advisory training initiatives.
  • Manage diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.

Business Development

  • Start to own elements of business development including actively supporting business development activities, building and expending your own contact network and supporting Director/ Managing Director-led marketing and sales activities.
  • Participate in existing business development programmes and key client accounts.
  • Identify opportunities to expand jobs as well as opportunities to provide wider Teneo services to existing clients.
  • Take responsibility for leading marketing initiatives aimed at specific channels to market, or events.

Key Skills & Experience

  • Qualified accountant (ACA/ACCA or equivalent), both time and exam qualified.
  • Financial Advisory experience gained either as an advisor within a professional services company, consultancy or investment bank; as an analyst in a debt or special situations funds. An understanding of debt markets, banking, loan agreements and other relevant financial and legal documentation.
  • Understanding of financial statements and related data to assess historical financial performance and future outlook for client companies and prospects.
  • Good understanding of the Financial Advisory marketplace, its trends, and key players (principals and advisers).
  • Very strong analytical skills, including: business analytics, business planning, short term cash flows, financing options. A basic understanding of Crown Dependencies’ insolvency legislation and practice is not a prerequisite but helpful.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Strong project management skills, with ability to lead mid-large teams and develop people.
  • Ability to conduct business in fluent oral and written English is a pre-requisite.

What can we offer you?

New joiners are supported by an induction programme. As well as this we offer a whole host of benefits and reward including;

  • Market-leading Salary
  • 28 days holiday
  • Discretionary Bonus Scheme

  • Extensive investment in personal development & learning

About Teneo

Teneo is the global CEO advisory firm. We partner with our clients globally to do great things for a better future.

Drawing upon our global team and expansive network of senior advisors, we provide advisory services across our five business segments on a stand-alone or fully integrated basis to help our clients solve complex business challenges. Our clients include a significant number of the Fortune 100 and FTSE 100, as well as other corporations, financial institutions, and organizations.

Our full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial transactions and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organizational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs, corporate governance, ESG and DE&I.

When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on

Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. What You’ll Do

Reporting to the Executive Director of International Patient Advocacy, this role drives engagement across the skeletal dysplasia community in Latin America, Europe and supports other relevant international and local markets as needed, ensuring community insights inform company strategy and decision-making. title: Associate Director, Payments/Scheme Economics
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

Who you are

We are looking for an Associate Director, Payments/Scheme Economics to own the integrity, visibility and management of Airwallex’s payment costs, starting with card scheme fees and interchange fees across Visa and Mastercard.

Reporting to the Head of Strategic Finance, you will be the subject matter expert on scheme economics, translating complex and rapidly changing network rules into accurate system configurations, financial outcomes and business decisions. You will ensure we understand what every payment should cost, that those costs are accurately reflected across our systems and financials, and that we systematically identify opportunities to improve payment economics as we scale.

Over time, the remit will expand across other card schemes, local payment methods and the broader payments cost base.

What you’ll do

  • Own scheme economics and rule interpretation: Maintain deep expertise across scheme fees, interchange and network rules. Interpret scheme bulletins, operating regulations and fee schedules, translating changes into clear financial, product and operational requirements.

  • Ensure accurate payment cost configuration: Translate complex scheme rules into fee tables, eligibility criteria and transaction-level logic. Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure cost calculation, allocation and customer billing accurately reflect current network rules across markets and payment flows.

  • Protect payment cost integrity: Establish robust governance, testing and controls across scheme configurations. Reconcile expected costs against actual network charges, identify anomalies and leakage, and drive root-cause resolution.

  • Build granular visibility into payment economics: Develop robust models and analytics across markets, products, payment methods and transaction types, creating a clear view of unit economics, margin drivers and cost movements.

  • Drive structural cost and margin optimization: Identify, quantify and execute opportunities to improve economics through transaction qualification, BIN routing, cost configuration, and other levers. Partner with Product, Finance and Commercial teams to prioritize the highest-value opportunities.

  • Shape pricing and commercial decisions: Translate underlying payment economics into recommendations for customer pricing, product design, new market launches and commercial strategy, ensuring growth is supported by sustainable unit economics.

  • Build scalable infrastructure and automation: Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to strengthen cost engines, fee allocation logic, dashboards and automated controls. Apply AI and advanced analytics to accelerate rule interpretation, detect anomalies and surface optimization opportunities.

  • Own complex scheme economics issues: Serve as the escalation point for scheme pricing, interchange and rule-related questions, working directly with Visa, Mastercard and other payment partners where required.

What you’ll bring

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in payments, acquiring, issuing, card networks, payment infrastructure or related roles, ideally within a global PSP, acquirer, scheme, issuer or fintech.

  • Deep knowledge of card payment economics, particularly Visa and Mastercard interchange, scheme fees, transaction qualification and network rules.

  • Strong ability to operationalize complex payment rules, translating fee schedules and network requirements into system logic, configurations and controls.

  • Experience with payment cost systems and controls, including interchange tables, scheme fee logic, BIN-based rules, transaction attributes or similar payment configurations.

  • Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities, including experience working with transaction-level data, economic modeling and reconciliation of expected versus actual payment costs.

  • Strong commercial judgment, with the ability to connect detailed payment mechanics to pricing, product decisions and margin optimization.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and ownership, with the discipline required to manage complex rules where small errors can create meaningful financial impact at scale.

  • Strong cross-functional execution, with the ability to work effectively across Product, Engineering, Finance, Data, Operations and external payment partners.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Das zeichnet dich aus:

  • Media Expertise: Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Performance-, Digital- oder Media-Umfeld mit und hast bereits anspruchsvolle Kunden oder Projekte eigenständig betreut.
  • Strategieverständnis: Du verstehst das Zusammenspiel verschiedener Performance-Kanäle, kannst Daten und KPIs einordnen und daraus fundierte Empfehlungen ableiten.
  • Führungskompetenz: Du hast Kolleg:innen bereits fachlich oder disziplinarisch begleitet, Verantwortung im Team übernommen oder möchtest den nächsten Schritt in Richtung Teamführung gehen.
  • Kundenorientierung: Du fühlst dich in der Beratung wohl, kannst komplexe Themen verständlich vermitteln und trittst auch in Präsentationen souverän auf.
  • Organisationstalent: Du behältst auch bei mehreren Projekten und Stakeholdern den Überblick, setzt Prioritäten und arbeitest strukturiert sowie lösungsorientiert.
  • Teamgeist: Du arbeitest gerne mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen und Experten Teams zusammen und verstehst dich als verbindende Schnittstelle.

Darüber hinaus bist du: #strategisch #kommunikationsstark #teamorientiert #eigenverantwortlich

title: Associate Director, Planning, UK
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

4011 - Associate Director, Planning, UK

Role Summary and Impact

About WPP 650                     

Join an award-winning team at the heart of UK government, where your work will genuinely shape lives. As part of WPP 650 you’ll be part of a supportive, collaborative environment that values curiosity, kindness, and growth. Together, we use behaviour change principles to design smarter services, influence better decisions, and help millions of people across the country.

Named WPP 650, after the 650 UK constituencies, the name is a reminder that our work must reflect the full breadth of the country, every community, every audience. No two days are the same. The challenges are complex, the problems worth solving, and the learning constant. You’ll tackle issues that matter, alongside talented colleagues who care deeply about what they do. It’s demanding – but always rewarding.

WPP 650 is a bespoke agency unit within WPP, dedicated to serving the evolving communications needs of government clients. We bring together the best of WPP's talent, technology, and insights to deliver impactful, modern, and effective public communications. We are at the forefront of reimagining how government engages with its citizens.

This is meaningful work with real-world impact – the kind you can point to with pride.

About the role:

The planning team are the guardians of creating industry leading, unrivalled work at WPP 650. We are central conduits to all specialists, striving to push boundaries and have a positive impact on consumers and brand.

WPP 650 is looking for a Associate Director, Planning to join our growing planning team, to drive planning across specific clients and be a media planning expert.

In this role, you will:

Media planning craft:

  • Develop an advanced understanding of media channels, channel ecosystems and planning best practices.
  • Start to translate strategic approach into planning practices for specific client briefs and pitches.
  • Have an advanced understanding of WPP 650’s Consumer Journey thinking and planning philosophy across all client work. Including being an expert in a broad set of internal tools, as well as external tools to build a deep understanding of the consumer, the client’s business and its specific opportunities.
  • Have an expert overview of the media market landscape, trends and start to build media owner relationships.

Campaign management & effective communication:

  • Oversee campaign management, ensuring quality control and output is of the highest standard.
  • Develop a skilled understand of commercial practises and of the wider agency.
  • Build and maintain client and agency relationships at a mid-senior level, to ensure a comprehensive understanding of stakeholders and client business.

Comms planning and storytelling:

  • Own planning presentations including defining the inputs needed and working with the wider teams to compile work and meet deadlines.
  • Lead brainstorm and idea creation for campaigns
  • Start to independently problem solve, including integrating and questioning data and insights and find solutions based on knowledge and experience.

Skills and Experience

Practice Area Knowledge -Skilled- Develops breadth and depth of industry understanding. Becomes confident using tools, technology, techniques and systems and is able to train others. Comfortable presenting both direct from platform (Open) and developing a story from data but delivered outside of platform (Telmar etc). Can confidently answer client questions and liaise with internal teams on best solutions to use.

Problem Solving – Skilled - Uses critical questioning and maintains a broad perspective when analyzing information to gain a deeper understanding of the problem and wider impact. Quickly generates appropriate solutions informed by previous experience. Understands how to resolve escalated issues and supports others to problem solve. Supports or leads troubleshooting communication for issues.

Stakeholder Relationships – Skilled - Has an expert knowledge of client and agency structures. Can identify key decision makers and understands their perspectives which is used to build relationships. Has strong knowledge of the client sector/industry which is shared to build strategies and plans. Identifies strategic issues and raises questions to help stakeholders explore and understand their wider business challenges. ​​​​​​​ Can easily suggest business solutions to match client/stakeholder needs and achieve objectives.

Effective Communication -Advanced- Leads the delivery of relevant and accurate information to drive maximum impact. Consistently delivers communications to influence and educate all levels of seniority, appropriately judging the demands of the situation. Creatively develops presentations and comms to help with the understanding/education of complex information. Guides others on the best practices and approaches for creating clear, concise and organized communication materials to convey plans in a user-friendly way.

Campaign Management – Advanced - Reviews the work of others to ensure accuracy and thoroughness objectives have been met; provides coaching on ways to improve work outputs.  Applies best practice to campaign management and acts as the escalation point for issues.  Provide actionable insights during mid and post campaign reports to improve in-flight optimizations and future campaign brief recommendations.  Oversees team members to discuss current projects, workload and activities prioritises resources accordingly.  Improves workload management by supporting other in setting priorities and by postponing less relevant work.

Compelling Storytelling – Skilled - Applies big picture thinking in work and proactively leverages an understanding of the organization and key industry trends.  Understand the different elements of responses.  Designs differentiated communications (content focus, style, presentation etc) for various internal and external audiences.

Ideas Creation – Advanced - Lead new projects/activities that can create ideas to deliver effective solutions to clients’ business objectives.  Ability to proactively generate ideas to provoke and deliver against broader business strategies.  Coaches others to gain new insights and view opportunities from different perspectives.  Championing an environment that fosters innovation by encouraging others to openly share and build on other’s new ideas, products and solutions

Comms Planning – Skilled - Applies knowledge of client, audience, channel, market and category to effectively deliver compelling multi-media plans.  Translates learnings and trends to create marketing communication strategies that are effective with clear measurement.   Application of purchase journey thinking and visualization of how the media plan works channels.  Translation of strategic direction/platform/provocation into directional role for media, channel role and behaviour in channel.  Identifies and recommends budget shifts as campaign is in-flight where appropriate.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location

title: Associate (Education)
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team

Our Public Services Business Unit is committed to leveraging AI for the benefit of individual citizens and the public good.

From our work informing strategic government decisions, to optimising our NHS, through to reducing bureaucratic backlogs - we know that AI offers opportunities to drive improvements at every level of Government and we are proud to lead on some of the most impactful work happening in the sector.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work on site with these clients from time to time.


About the role

As an Associate at Faculty, you will join a collaborative team scoping, building, and delivering impactful AI projects across education and public services. You will support work streams alongside assessment bodies, educational platforms, and government partners to ensure bespoke AI solutions are safe, evidence-backed, and practical.

We will look to you to nurture trusted client relationships, translate operational needs into clear delivery plans, and partner with technical teams to deploy tools that genuinely improve learning outcomes. This is an exciting opportunity to build your career at the forefront of safe, purposeful AI innovation.

What you'll be doing:

  • Managing individual work streams to support the smooth delivery and deployment of bespoke AI tools across education and public service organisations.

  • Working side-by-side with education leaders, publishers, and assessment partners to understand user needs and core learning challenges.

  • Translating operational requirements and pedagogical goals into clear, actionable user stories for data science and engineering squads.

  • Partnering with AI safety and evaluation specialists to test workflows and ensure solutions uphold rigorous standards of fairness, validity, and evidence.

  • Collaborating closely with multidisciplinary project teams to keep delivery on track and maintain exceptional delivery quality.

  • Contributing to problem-led proposals, client workshops, and internal thought leadership on the positive impact of technology in learning.

Who we're looking for:

  • You bring strong analytical thinking and curiosity, with a talent for synthesising complex information and communicating ideas with clarity.

  • You have foundational experience working on data, software, or AI-oriented projects, ideally with exposure to public services or educational platforms.

  • You demonstrate client-facing experience and take pride in building empathetic, collaborative partnerships that help projects succeed.

  • You understand Agile ways of working and appreciate how iterative delivery helps multidisciplinary squads achieve meaningful results.

  • You show a thoughtful awareness of why validity, fairness, and safety are critical when applying AI to education and public services.

  • You thrive in entrepreneurial settings, bringing initiative, adaptability, and enthusiasm for finding creative solutions in fast-moving environments.

Our interview process

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 mins)

  2. Introduction Interview (60 mins)

  3. Case Study Interview (60 mins)

  4. Interview with Business Unit Director (30 mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

descriptionHtml:
Du bist Arzt/Ärztin, kreativ, kommunikationsstark und behältst gerne den Überblick? Du bringst gerne Projekte pragmatisch voran und hast ein Talent für Organisation? Du willst tausenden Ärzt:innen ermöglichen, sich neben dem Klinik- und Praxisalltag mit AMBOSS-Fortbildungen online weiterbilden zu können?

Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab sofort eine/einen Associate Medical Project Manager für den deutschsprachigen ärztlichen Markt. In dieser Rolle leitest du eigenverantwortlich die Erstellung von medizinischen Online-CME-Fortbildungen. Dabei vernetzt du die Teams aus Redaktion, Videoproduktion, Design, Marketing und externe Kooperationspartner:innen miteinander. Dank deiner ärztlichen Perspektive ist AMBOSS auch weiterhin von Mediziner:innen für Mediziner:innen!

Was deine Aufgabe sein wird

  • Schwerpunkt ist das Projektmanagement für die Erstellung von Online-Fortbildungen und -Kursen aller Fachrichtungen für Ärzt:innen im deutschsprachigen Raum

  • Mitwirkung bei der Auswahl von geeigneten Fortbildungsthemen und Formaten

  • Konzeption und didaktische Aufbereitung der zu schulenden Fachinhalte

  • Du wirst Hauptansprechpartner:in für deinen zu betreuenden Kurs sein – vom Start des Projekts bis zur Veröffentlichung

  • Intensive Kommunikation und Austausch mit zusammenarbeitenden Teams innerhalb von AMBOSS, sowie mit externen Kooperationspartner:innen

Was du mitbringst

  • Organisierte, gut strukturierte und pragmatische Arbeitsweise

  • Abgeschlossenes Humanmedizinstudium

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, sehr gute Englischkenntnisse

  • Hervorragende Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten

  • Pluspunkt: Erfahrungen im Projektmanagement, Arbeitserfahrung in einem betriebswirtschaftlichen Umfeld, Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder der BWL

Pluspunkt: Klinische Erfahrung von mind. 1–3 Jahren

Warum AMBOSS?

AMBOSS ist ein starkes und effizientes Lerntool für das Medizinstudium und Hilfsmittel für ärztliche Entscheidungen im Klinikalltag, das Ärzt:innen weltweit zur bestmöglichen Patientenversorgung befähigen will. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2012 nutzen wir die neueste Technologie, um das umfangreichste Lern- und Nachschlagewerk auf dem Markt zu entwickeln und die Wissensaneignung von Medizinstudierenden und Ärzt:innen zu revolutionieren.

Bereits 2017 haben wir die Lernerfahrung für 95% des deutschen Marktes verbessert. Im selben Jahr führten wir zusätzlich unsere internationale Plattform ein. Im Jahr 2019 wurde unsere harte Arbeit in der Serie-B-Finanzierung mit 30 Mio. € belohnt, durch die wir unser Produkt und die Reichweite beständig ausbauen können. Heute suchen wir weiterhin nach Wegen der Innovation und Etablierung, um weltweit etwas zu verändern. Nachdem wir 2021 vom Business Punk zu einem der Top 10 Health & Science Unternehmen ernannt wurden, ist klar, dass nicht nur wir begeistert und gespannt auf die Zukunft von AMBOSS sind.

Benefits:

AMBOSSSians erzählen uns, dass eine innovative Arbeit ihnen Antrieb gibt und sie sich durch Mitarbeiter-Benefits wertgeschätzt und in ihrer Arbeit bestärkt fühlen. Wir investieren in jeden AMBOSSian mit unseren Mitarbeiter-Benefits, die extra zugeschnitten wurden, um die finanzielle, physische und mentale Gesundheit zu unterstützen und zu einer positiven Work-Life-Balance beizutragen.

title: Associate Partner - Financial Services / Data & AI (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Advise. Invest. Build. Meet ALAIKA — a new kind of Financial Services firm — globally scaling, headquartered in Munich. The work is hard. The bar is high. Partner promotion possible, for the ones who can keep up and actually build a business themselves on our platform. 

About ALAIKA 

At ALAIKA, our vision is to build the future of Financial Services with three brands under one roof — Advisory (Strategy Consulting), Capital (Private Equity), Building (Company Builder). Right now, we are in the midst of building our trojan horse ALAIKA Advisory. 

The ambition: building the leading Financial-Services-specific entrepreneurial holding — Fortune 500 access, PE discipline, Silicon Valley technology-depth and thinking. Three networks that compound and multiply. 

  • One industry. Financial Services. Nothing else. 
  • One focus. The intersection of business and technology — across Strategic Transformations, AI & Data Intelligence, and Cybersecurity. 
  • One goal. Being the go-to partner for the world's leading Fortune 500 financial services companies — and the ones we might help build into that. 

Founded in October 2022 by Johanna von Geyr (build-up and led Financial Services Practice for a NASDAQ-listed strategy consultancy) and Harald Braunstein (serial entrepreneur with exits incl. IPO), we bring together deep functional domain expertise and networks in global Financial Services, with a proven track record in building, scaling, and investing in leading software product companies.  

Curious what ALAIKA is all about? Explore our website and introduction deck. 

Join the movement — apply now.
 

The role and what you will work on 

  • Advise. Take on the most pressing strategic and technology challenges of the world’s leading financial services companies — across Strategy, Data & AI, and Cyber, with deep Financial Servicesdomain expertise as your anchor. You are the guiding thought leader for your clients’ topics before the problem is fully defined. 
  • Own. Own client holding groups end-to-end — the relationships, the revenue, the team, the outcomes. You do not own pieces or projects; you own accounts. 
  • Lead. Run project teams and large key initiatives. Set the standard for your team — challenge them, develop them, raise their game. Multiply the output of everyone around you — not just your own. 
  • Sell. Own the full sales process end-to-end, independent of deal size. Open new buying centers. Originate mandates. Turn one client into three. Your pipeline is your business — and you run it like one. 
  • Connect. Industry-shaping relationships. C-suite at the leading Financial Services firms. Your network walks in with you, extends with the role, and becomes the platform for everything the practice does next. 
  • Grow. Sharpen the rare profile the market is short on — analytical mastermind, data & AI expert, entrepreneurial dealmaker. The partner promotion for you is not a question of IF. It is a question of WHEN. 
  • Build. We are scaling, with real building left to do — IP, processes, go-to-market, strategy. You are a strategic partner in shaping what ALAIKA becomes. That is not a slogan — it is your Tuesday. 

When you are a fit 

“Show me an athlete who did well academically. An athlete because they know what it takes to win and they have had to experience loss.” 

— Kenneth C. Griffin, Founder of Citadel 

You will work alongside intrinsically driven people chasing an uncapped career — people who do "what it takes". You fear "being one more number stuck in middle management".  

  • Book-smart. Strong academic foundation. Think in structures, not gut feel. 
  • Street-smart. Read the room fast. Prioritise ruthlessly. Grasp commercial reality. 
  • People-smart. Communicate with precision — clear, direct, persuasive. Build trust across functions and seniority. 
  • Athlete performance mindset. High aspirations. Grit. Learn faster than the environment changes. 
  • Entrepreneurial guts. You have built something, owned something, or bet on yourself at some point — and it shows in how you operate. P&L is not an abstraction. Ambiguity is not a problem. Youmove. 

What you bring 

  • Background. Outstanding degree in an analytical field from a top-tier university, or a track record that speaks for itself. 
  • Track Record. A track record of building a leading practice at a strategic consultancy or  major Financial Services firm.   
  • Senior Network. Established C-Level and Tier 1-3 relationships across financial services. Your network walks in with you. 
  • Sales Track Record. Proven ability to originate and close mandates at €2m+ scale. You have built a book before.

title: Associate, Power & Compute Hardware
descriptionHtml:
About Marble

Marble creates hard tech companies for the New Climate Era, across energy, industry and resilience. Since 2021, we have launched 15 companies backed by some of the best investors across Europe and North America.

About The Role

We are hiring an Associate to drive venture creation across multiple opportunity areas: grid hardware, power electronics, energy storage, semiconductors, photonics and compute infrastructure.

Reporting to Partners, this role gives exposure to every aspect of venture creation: opportunity research, founder recruitment, tech and product development, economic analysis, go-to-market, fundraising, investment decisions, portfolio management.

Because we work at pre-company stage, the job requires to identify what will be relevant and fundable in 2-3 years, not just what is hype today.

Location: Paris, France

Language: English fluency required. French or German is a plus.

Responsibilities

As part of the Venture Lead team, you will be responsible for driving our venture creation process on the opportunity areas that you own:

  • Opportunity research: build conviction on priority areas where Marble should create new companies, based on deep technical and market analysis.

  • Talent sourcing: identify talent with high founder potential and relevant domain expertise and hire them as Founders in Residence to build with Marble.

  • Building: work with Founders to develop venture ideas, systematically de-risk them, and turn them into new companies with team, funding and a roadmap to seed. You'll ensure robust diligence to support progress / stop decisions.

Alongside these, you will take on supporting work and special projects based on priorities and your profile, such as: external content creation, events, founder resources development, portfolio support, ecosystem relations, etc.

Requirements

This role is ideal for an engineer or physicist who can build, reason from first principles, with enough technical foundations to navigate various hardware domains where electrons handle power, information, or both:

  • Technical expertise in one of two fields: device/compute or power/grid. You hold a PhD in either Applied Physics, Engineering Physics, Electrical Engineering or related, ideally with applied experience in startups or industry.

  • Experience building hardware that had to work. It can be a device you made, a product you had to test in a real-world environment, etc.

  • Commercial orientation. Beyond tech alone, you enjoy thinking about product, customers, economics, deployment, manufacturing or supply chains.

  • First principles reasoning. You can break down a problem into its core constituents to understand what needs to be true for things to work.

  • Clear communicator. You can articulate complex ideas and defend a conviction with sharp memos and engaging presentations.

  • Talent intuition. You know a great founder when you meet them, and if you want to work with them, you know how to persuade them.

  • Makes things happen. Team player who moves fast, with high standards for excellence, and high ownership on projects from start to finish.

We would love to hear from you if this sounds like you:

  • You have prior experience working with early-stage startups, deep tech commercialisation, applied R&D, or industrial tech development.

  • You are AI native. You can combine frontier tools and human judgment to maximise productivity and leverage in your work.

  • You are relentlessly curious. You stay current in your own field, you enjoy learning about new domains, and you learn very fast.

  • You have a superpower. For example: technical mastery in a field, the ability to see patterns where others cannot, truly original ideas, high EQ and energy level, strong network in a relevant domain, extraordinary writing skills, etc.

  • You are playing to win. You know that venture is competitive and follows a power law, and the challenge motivates you.

  • You are a pragmatic optimist with a driving motivation to solve the hardest problems in electrification, clean energy and intelligence.

Your ability to learn on the job matters more than ticking every box.

What We Offer

  • Full-time (CDI) contract, Associate level*

  • €60-70k gross annual base salary + 10% target bonus + stock options

  • Office in Paris. Occasional remote days are possible

  • Health insurance (Alan), meal and mobility vouchers (Swile)

  • Exposure to our network of top founders, investors, and advisors

  • Working with the brightest, most driven individuals you'll meet

  • Rapid learning curve and personal development

  • Enhanced parental support

What is hard to capture just with the above is the unique opportunity this role offers to join Marble in the early days of our journey, and shape the future of what we hope will become a top institution in climate and hard tech in Europe and beyond.

(*) We're opportunistically open to more experienced candidates who could potentially join at the Senior Associate level.

We believe that a diverse group of minds creates an unfair team advantage when building high impact companies. Hence, we actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds, genders and perspective to apply.

Studies have shown that under-represented candidates are less likely to apply unless they feel they meet every single qualification. If you are excited about the opportunity but your experience does not align perfectly - please apply anyway!

title: Associate Product Manager (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. AI is becoming the engine of that communication. Integrations are what give that engine teeth: the data, the tools, the systems that turn a clever agent into one that actually closes loops.

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

We're looking for a Product Manager to join our Integrations team.

In this role, you'll own the surface that decides whether our AI agents are clever demos or systems that actually do work. CRM sync, appointment bookings, call transfers, custom workflows: every action our agents take in the real world runs through your team. Plus our public API, webhooks, and the developer experience that lets partners build on top of us. If you're excited to design APIs, ship agent tooling, and own a surface that gets more strategic every quarter, this might be a great fit.

We're reshaping our product function around three pillars, AI, Integrations, and Core, with a PM in each, operating directly with our founder and CPO Mika. This role is for Integrations.

Learn how product is built from the inside, working side by side with our CPO.

As our Associate Product Manager, you'll work directly with our CPO as a force multiplier for the product team. You'll take on high-impact work across customer research, product data, product marketing and adoption - topics that span the whole product org rather than a single product area. 

Who We Want 

Hungry learner
You're eager to learn fast, actively seek feedback and turn it into visible progress within weeks, not months.

Structured self-starter
You're highly organized, bring order to messy situations and get things done without step-by-step guidance.

Analytical thinker
You're comfortable with data and can pull numbers from spreadsheets or analytics tools and turn them into clear insights.

Customer-curious
You enjoy talking to users, ask good follow-up questions and turn interviews into actionable takeaways.

Clear communicator
You write crisply, build clean slides and feel comfortable presenting to customers, e.g. in webinars.

Scrappy generalist
You're happy to switch between product marketing, data, research and ops, and no task is "beneath you".

AI-native
You use AI tools daily to work faster and better - from research and data analysis to drafting content and slides - and you're always experimenting with new ones.

Has taste
You have a strong sense for what good looks like in product, design and writing, and you notice when something feels off, even if it's "technically fine".

Language
You're fluent in English, written and spoken.

Who We Don't Want 

  • You only want "pure PM" work like roadmaps and specs and aren't interested in marketing or customer-facing tasks
  • You need a lot of structure and clear processes to be productive
  • You struggle to communicate clearly in English, in writing or in front of an audience
  • You get defensive when receiving feedback
  • You see this mainly as a title step rather than a chance to learn and get hands-on

Your Day to Day 

Strategic Projects (~25%)

  • Work directly with our CPO on the topics that matter most right now
  • Prepare leadership meetings, drive decisions forward and make sure priorities turn into results

Product Marketing & Launches (~35%)

  • Plan and run initiatives that bring our product to customers: webinars, product updates, customer events, newsletters and educational content
  • Prepare and launch new features end-to-end together with Product, Engineering and Marketing
  • Build sharp slides and reports for customers and leadership 

Customer Research (~20%)

  • Run customer interviews and turn what you hear into clear insights for the product team
  • Feed those insights into roadmap decisions together with our PMs

Product Analytics & Adoption (~20%)

  • Own dashboards on activation and adoption and turn the numbers into actions
  • Drive initiatives that improve activation and adoption of key features

Stakeholders

Product Managers: Feed customer insights and data into roadmap decisions and support with research, specs and launch prep
Engineering & Design: Clarify requirements, gather product feedback and coordinate release timing for launches
Customer Success: Identify customers for interviews and work together on onboarding, activation and adoption initiatives
Sales: Build enablement material and slides, and align on positioning and messaging for new features
Marketing: Co-own product launches, webinars, release content and campaigns
Customers: Run interviews and webinars, collect feedback and turn it into insights for the team

Why People Choose Us

  • We believe in the power of in-person collaboration: We're an in-office culture at heart - we genuinely love being together in the Berlin office. That's where the best ideas happen, decisions move faster, and we learn from and grow with each other every day. We do offer some flexibility for remote work, but our default and our energy is being in the room together.
  • We're an international team with diverse cultural backgrounds and languages. Openness, mutual respect, and the exchange of different perspectives shape the way we work together.
  • We value ambition and drive. We're looking for people who take ownership, show initiative, and are excited to grow quickly.
  • We work with a high degree of ownership and a strong learning mindset. Asking questions, staying curious, and continuously improving are part of our everyday culture.
  • We care deeply about humility and teamwork. No egos, open feedback, and a willingness to learn from one another matter more to us than titles.

Benefits & Culture

  • Choose between an Urban Sports Club or John Reed membership, or a public transport pass/Dance subscription.
  • Regular company-wide and team events.
  • An annual €500 learning and development budget that you can use for conferences, courses, books, career coaching, and more.
  • An inclusive and exciting startup culture that supports rapid professional and personal growth.
  • A beautiful office in the heart of Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) with free snacks, drinks, and top-notch equipment.

We want to build a community, not just a company.

Creating an environment where people genuinely enjoy spending time together is important to us - whether that's through HYROX training, golf, beer pong tournaments, running clubs, Warhammer, weekend activities, or any other community you'd like to build here.

We believe that diversity makes companies stronger. We welcome applications from everyone, regardless of gender, background, nationality, or religion. Feel free to apply - we'd love to hear from you!

title: Audit Methodology Lead
descriptionHtml:
We build AI agents that perform audit procedures for audit firms. We need an experienced auditor to decide what correct output from those agents looks like, and whether our agents meet that bar.

You'll join one of our product groups as its audit expert. You'll write the criteria and reference cases our agents are tested against, review agent output the way you'd review a file, and tell the team plainly when something isn't ready for a live engagement. You'll use AI to create realistic test material, and you'll review all of it yourself.

About DataSnipper

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

 

What you'll own

  • Define the correct answer, and the reasoning behind it, for the procedures our agents perform

  • Interpret ISAs and NV COS (IFRS for reporting matters; US GAAS and PCAOB where relevant) into requirements engineers can build against

  • Create realistic audit cases with AI tools, including documents, workpapers, exceptions and judgement calls, and review every one

  • Review agent output against those cases, and find misapplied standards, weak reasoning and conclusions that wouldn't pass partner review

  • Turn recurring errors into findings product and engineering can fix

  • Give a clear, evidenced view on whether a capability is ready for live engagements

  • Review methodology content from partners and our own teams, with versioning, approval and documented changes

  • Track changes in standards and inspection findings, and explain what they mean for the product

  • Teach product and engineering how audit work is actually done, including how firms differ

  • Work with customers and content partners when the work requires it

What you'll bring

  • A professional qualification: RA, AA, CPA, CA, ACA, ACCA or equivalent

  • Experience as an Audit Manager: setting the approach, reviewing others' work, clearing review notes and defending conclusions

  • Recent experience across several clients and industries

  • Working knowledge of ISQM 1 and how firms document and review audit work

  • Regular use of AI tools, and a clear sense of how they fail

  • Precise writing: people without your training will build from what you write

  • Patience for detail: line-by-line review, and real time spent on a single conclusion

Nice to have:

  • You want to use your audit expertise on hard problems in AI: judgement, evidence and review

  • You'd rather change how audit work is done than automate how it's done today

  • You've built something yourself, such as a tool, prototype or workflow, to fix a slow process

  • You stay with open-ended problems until the answer holds up

What this role is not

  • Not product management. You shape what ships, but you don't own the roadmap

  • Not implementation or customer success

  • Not volume work. AI produces the volume; you decide what's right

Recruitment steps

  • Recruiter screen

  • Interview with an Audit Expert

  • Assessment interview

  • Final conversations with the people you would work alongside

 

At DataSnipper, we believe great ideas come from different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and providing every candidate with a fair and equitable hiring experience.

Our hiring decisions are merit-based and grounded in the skills, experience, potential, and capabilities relevant to the role.

We welcome applicants regardless of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you, you.

What matters to us is what you can bring to the role, the team, and DataSnipper. 🚀

title: Automation Engineer (All genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Operations Excellence team sits within the COO organization and serves as a strategic partner to managers, team leads, and colleagues across Stark. By delivering data-driven insights, leading critical projects, and driving continuous process improvement, we help the organization operate more efficiently, scale effectively, and achieve its goals faster. As an individual contributor, you will take end-to-end ownership of complex initiatives with significant business impact. Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you will have the opportunity to influence key decisions, shape core operating processes, and contribute directly to the success of one of Europe’s fastest-growing unicorns.

YOUR MISSION

As Automation Engineer, you build and deploy automations that eliminate manual effort across operations and the back-office. You work across RPA, LLM-based tooling, and API integrations — and you are as likely to be automating an invoice approval chain as a production line data feed. You measure success in hours saved and errors eliminated.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Design and build RPA workflows for operational and back-office processes — UiPath, Power Automate, or equivalent
  • Develop LLM-based automation tools for document-heavy workflows: invoice extraction, quality certificates, order processing, email triage
  • Integrate automation solutions with ERP, MES, and business applications via APIs
  • Build agent-based workflows where multi-step reasoning or decision-making is required
  • Test, deploy, and maintain automations in production — including monitoring, alerting, and incident response
  • Document automation logic, dependencies, and maintenance procedures thoroughly
  • Work with operational and back-office teams to identify, scope, and prioritise new automation opportunities

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • 3–6 years building automations in an operational or business process context
  • Has shipped working automations into production — not just proof-of-concept or demo environments
  • RPA tools — UiPath, Power Automate, or equivalent (hands-on production experience)
  • Python scripting — for custom automation logic, API integration, and LLM tool use
  • API integration — REST APIs, webhooks, data exchange across ERP and business systems
  • Process analysis and QA mindset — automations must be reliable, not just functional
  • BSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or similar

NICE TO HAVE

  • LLM-based tooling — prompt engineering, agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
  • ERP system familiarity (SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar)
  • Manufacturing or back-office finance/ops experience

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

Reporting into the Deputy Head Of AV, you will be the Senior AV representative for EMN, from our Team to all clients, Media Owners to senior internal stakeholders across our UK business. As an AV Director you will be expected to see the Bigger Picture and overarching AV and Video strategies for all of our clients.

You will work closely with your senior counterparts in the planning, strategy, digital, PRO and Creative Future departments to understand our client’s business needs, with a view to our team delivering knowledgeable, accurate and innovative AV approaches across the board that can really drive our client’s business forward.

In collaboration with our senior digital, social and creative future colleagues, review then improve our wider agency video investment capabilities today – benchmarking them and identifying where we can get better.

You will lead on all AV senior media partner relationships, driving efficiencies in our approach across the market. Ensure all senior contact strategies are relevant throughout EMN and that we are always front of mind for all market opportunities.

Play a leading role in our AV thinking in new business pitching and organic business development, leveraging media partner relationships to bolster our thinking and ideas.

From a Bigger Picture perspective, you will support the marketing of the agency. This will include but not limited to, creating and leading internal/external media insight events (Thinkbox Tevevisionaries, AV week etc) the writing of market leading case studies and contribute to award entries where required.

Responsibilities of the role:

People:

  • Ensure the AV team deliver our new essencemediacom breakthrough thinking and culture principles in everything we do from learning everyday to building better together, always inclusive and celebrate every success.

Proactively shape, clearly communicate, and proactively implement new ways of working across all levels of our team (1 – 5.5), manage all learning and growth opportunities as well develop our culture with input from the wider AV team, making EMN the place to work.

  • Continue and grow the already existing trust and confidence you have of senior internal UK stakeholders, senior clients, industry leads (such as Thinkbox) and senior Media Owners across the video media marketplace.
  • Ensure your profile is always raised across the senior management team in EM UK.
  • The senior EMN AV representative. For all clients, media partners and internal stake holders across our UK business.

Product / Output: AV Operations

  • In support of the Deputy Head Of AV, help lead our overall AV offering to clients and market.
  • Be responsible for the overall strategic planning output across the AV team.
  • Ensure, in collaboration with our senior Planning colleagues that the AV briefing, planning, implementation and reporting outputs are as efficient, relevant and at all points fit for purpose.
  • High level of presentation skills required, with the ability to present at short notice to a range of audiences both internally and externally.
  • Ensure our AV team maintains zero errors across everything we do, with recommendations being supported with rationale and clear understanding.
  • Think Digital First: Be digitally literate in the field of AV and ensure our team are putting data at the heart of plans.
  • Push the boundaries. Ensure our team are confident in challenging briefs and deliver innovation/new thinking wherever possible across everything we do as AV.
  • Show a genuine, proactive interest in industry research with a view to producing award-winning work across our team.
  • Be adaptable, pro-active, demonstrate an ability to change approach or tweak work based on feedback and changing circumstances to meet the needs of our team, clients and colleagues.
  • You will be ultimately responsible for the buying output of our team, ensure best practice approach to buying is followed by all of you reports.

Commercial:

  • Lead our AV thinking in new business pitching and organic business development, leveraging media partner relationships to bolster our thinking and ideas.

You will have an extensive knowledge of the AV market, market mechanics (including audits) and all AV tools used, ensuring specialism excellence in the overall Teams output.   

The role requires long term proof of strong leadership, proactive strategic thinking, great communication skills with an ability to flex your style dependent on personality type, numeracy acumen, strong presentation skills, history of being a team player, individual and team development, resilience, and the ability to remain calm under pressure.

title: Avionics Electronics Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

 

Role & Mission

Avionics Architecture & Hardware Design

  • Design, develop, and integrate avionics and electronic subsystems for high-performance unmanned aerial systems

  • Own schematic capture, PCB layout reviews, and component selection for flight-critical electronics, with a strong focus on size, weight, power, and cost

  • Define the electrical architecture, power distribution, and harnessing for compact, high-dynamic airframes

  • Select and integrate flight controllers, navigation sensors (IMU, GNSS, magnetometer, air data), data links, and onboard compute

  • Design for manufacturability and reliability, from early prototypes through to series production

Integration, Test & Validation

  • Lead bench, hardware-in-the-loop, and environmental testing of avionics subsystems

  • Integrate electronics into the airframe and support full system integration with the software and guidance teams

  • Diagnose and resolve hardware, power, signal integrity, and EMI/EMC issues

  • Support ground and flight test campaigns, analyse test data, and feed results back into rapid design iterations

Suppliers & Industrialisation

  • Work with component suppliers to secure quality, cost, and lead times

  • Manage component obsolescence, second-sourcing, and supply chain resilience for critical parts

  • Produce and maintain design documentation, BOMs, interface control documents, and test procedures

  • Support qualification activities against relevant aerospace and military standards

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Software, Guidance & Navigation, Mechanical, Product and Flight Test teams in short iteration loops

  • Contribute to design reviews, trade studies, and product roadmap decisions

  • Support field deployments and live demonstrations with customers when required

 

Requirements

Candidate profile

  • MSc or equivalent in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field

  • 3-8 years of experience in avionics, embedded hardware, or electronics design, ideally on UAS, aircraft, missiles, or other airborne systems

  • Hands-on experience taking boards from schematic to tested flight hardware

  • Solid understanding of power electronics, motor control, RF and data links, and sensor interfaces

  • Familiarity with autopilot ecosystems (PX4, ArduPilot, or proprietary) is a strong plus

Skills & Qualities

  • Hands-on, lab-oriented mindset: at ease with an oscilloscope, a soldering iron, and a test bench

  • Rigorous, structured problem solver able to deliver under tight timelines

  • Able to make pragmatic trade-offs between performance, cost, and schedule

  • Clear technical communicator in documentation and design reviews

  • High integrity, discretion, and understanding of security culture

  • Fluent English; French is a plus

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a defense startup, neoprime, or fast-moving hardware environment

  • Knowledge of MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-810, DO-160, or equivalent standards

  • Embedded firmware experience (C/C++) on STM32 or similar microcontrollers

  • Experience integrating edge compute modules (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson) and high-bandwidth data links

  • Exposure to counter-UAS or air defense systems

  • Willingness to travel to test ranges and field sites

title: B2B Marketing Manager, DACH
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes directly to our mission of responsible and widespread AI adoption.

The EMEA B2B Marketing team translates global priorities into regionally relevant programs that drive awareness, consideration, pipeline, adoption, and long-term customer trust. We partner closely with Sales and GTM, Product Marketing, Field and Executive Marketing, Content, Customer Marketing, Partner Marketing, Comms, Events, Marketing Operations, and regional leadership.

DACH is one of OpenAI’s most important markets in EMEA. Our opportunity spans major enterprises and digital natives, ambitious startups, developers, partners, and a highly influential business community navigating the adoption of AI.

About the Role

As the B2B Marketing Manager for DACH, you will own the integrated B2B marketing strategy and execution for Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.

You will be a close commercial partner to local Sales and GTM leadership, translating market insight, revenue priorities, target-account needs, and global launches into locally relevant programs that create pipeline, accelerate complex opportunities, deepen customer relationships, and grow adoption.

You will carry clear pipeline goals and be accountable for Marketing’s measurable contribution to commercial outcomes in DACH. These goals will be established through the regional planning process and will evolve with the priorities and maturity of the market. You will be expected to understand the pipeline, make informed investment decisions, and demonstrate how marketing activity creates, influences, or accelerates revenue opportunities.

This is a generalist role spanning field and executive marketing, demand generation, account-based programs, content, customer marketing, partnerships, events, and product launches. You will bring these channels together into a focused DACH B2B plan, drawing on specialist capabilities within the EMEA B2B Marketing team in London and global Marketing teams. A particularly important partnership will be with the DACH Consumer Marketing Lead: together, you will align market strategy, narratives, launches, audience priorities, channels, and major moments so B2B and B2C activity is coordinated, complementary, and mutually reinforcing.

Close partnership with Marketing Operations will be crucial. Together, you will establish campaign infrastructure, audience and account segmentation, attribution, reporting, and operating rhythms that give Sales and Marketing a reliable view of performance and inform where the team should invest next.

The role requires someone who can move comfortably between strategy and execution: shaping the market plan, participating in pipeline reviews, developing a priority-account program, adapting a global campaign, briefing an agency, supporting an executive event, and personally unblocking delivery when needed.

This role is preferably based in Munich. Berlin may be considered for an exceptional candidate. Regular travel within DACH and to London will be required.

In this role, you will:

  • Own and execute the integrated DACH B2B marketing plan, aligned with regional priorities, local revenue goals, market opportunities, and customer needs. Partner closely with the DACH Consumer Marketing Lead to ensure B2B and B2C strategies and activities are coordinated and complementary, while retaining clear accountability for B2B pipeline and revenue outcomes.

  • Carry pipeline goals for DACH B2B marketing and be accountable for demonstrating measurable contribution to pipeline creation, influence, opportunity progression, and revenue outcomes.

  • Partner closely with DACH Sales and GTM leadership on territory planning, target-account prioritisation, pipeline goals, strategic opportunities, and quarterly business reviews.

  • Build full-funnel programs across field and executive marketing, demand generation, account-based marketing, content, customer advocacy, partnerships, events, and digital channels.

  • Design programs around priority accounts and buying groups, tailoring narratives and engagement for senior decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—and connecting customer proof, partner participation, content, and seller follow-up to create or advance opportunities.

  • Work in close partnership with Marketing Operations to define target audiences, establish campaigns, maintain data and process quality, track performance, improve attribution, and turn results into clear recommendations.

  • Build a regular Sales, Marketing, and Marketing Operations pacing rhythm covering pipeline performance, account engagement, campaign conversion, opportunity follow-up, risks, and investment decisions.

  • Translate global campaigns, product launches, narratives, and assets into locally relevant programs that reflect DACH market dynamics, language, industry priorities, and customer expectations.

  • Work with EMEA specialist teams in London to bring the strongest regional capabilities into the market, while serving as the voice of DACH in regional planning and prioritisation.

  • Develop locally relevant customer stories and advocacy opportunities in partnership with Sales, Customer Success, Customer Marketing, Comms, and senior customer stakeholders.

  • Build joint programs with strategic technology, consulting, and implementation partners where they can extend reach, strengthen customer value, or contribute to pipeline.

  • Own the operating rhythm for DACH B2B marketing, including planning, budget management, agency coordination, campaign pacing, performance reporting, and prioritisation.

  • Build repeatable playbooks and share market learning across EMEA, helping the wider organisation understand what resonates with DACH customers and decision-makers.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 12+ years of experience in integrated B2B, regional, field, demand generation, or account-based marketing, ideally in enterprise technology, cloud, AI, or SaaS.

  • Have a proven track record of driving measurable pipeline and revenue impact through integrated B2B marketing programs, ideally within large, complex enterprise sales cycles.

  • Have supported high-value products with long sales cycles, multiple decision-makers, and significant commercial scrutiny, and are familiar with engaging senior decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—throughout complex buying journeys.

  • Have held pipeline goals or comparable commercial targets and can clearly demonstrate how your marketing decisions created, influenced, or accelerated revenue opportunities.

  • Have partnered closely with enterprise sellers and Sales leadership on account prioritisation, pipeline reviews, opportunity acceleration, executive engagement, and follow-up.

  • Have worked closely with Marketing Operations on campaign architecture, segmentation, lead and account processes, measurement, attribution, and performance reporting.

  • Are comfortable using pipeline and campaign data to diagnose performance, make trade-offs, and redirect investment—not simply report activity.

  • Are a marketing generalist with experience connecting multiple channels into one coherent market plan, rather than operating within a single specialist discipline, and have a strong track record of partnering with consumer marketing leaders to integrate B2B and B2C strategy and activity without blurring ownership.

  • Understand DACH enterprise buying dynamics and can translate local customer, industry, cultural, and regulatory context into stronger marketing decisions.

  • Can balance local market needs with regional and global priorities, influencing effectively within a matrixed international organisation.

  • Are both strategic and hands-on: able to establish direction and operating structure while personally driving high-priority work to completion.

  • Bring strong commercial judgement, operational discipline, and the ability to make clear prioritisation decisions when opportunities exceed available capacity.

  • Communicate credibly with senior customer decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—as well as Sales, Marketing, and partner stakeholders.

  • Are energised by AI and motivated to help organisations across DACH adopt transformative technology responsibly.

  • Are fluent in German and English.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
