title: Backend Engineer (Golang) - Transfers Europe
descriptionHtml:
At SumUp, we empower small businesses with simple, affordable tools to start, run, and grow. Our Global Bank teams build the financial services that help merchants manage their money and keep their businesses moving.

For merchants, a transfer should feel simple. Behind that experience is a complex network of payment schemes, banks, providers, messages, certificates, reconciliations, and edge cases—all of which need to work together reliably.

Transfers Europe squad is the integration layer connecting SumUp’s internal systems with the financial networks that move money across Europe and the UK. We build and run the backend services behind SEPA and UK transfer flows, helping move money accurately and reliably across external networks.

As a Backend Engineer, you’ll take ownership of services that process real money. You’ll work on complex systems problems to ensure seamless integrations as we scale, while seeing a direct connection between your engineering decisions and merchant trust.

If you enjoy understanding how systems behave under real-world conditions while improving them over time, we’d love to hear from you.

Our tech stack includes Golang, AWS, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis and Kubernetes, supported by a strong observability toolchain with Prometheus, Grafana, and Honeycomb. We also actively use AI‑assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and others.

What you’ll do 

  • Build and maintain production money movement backend services, contributing to their delivery, observability, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Own and deliver well‑defined tasks and features, and contribute to larger projects within the team’s domain.
  • Contribute to technical design and implementation, following established architectural patterns and best practices.
  • Improve service reliability and quality by writing tests, enhancing monitoring, and following established delivery pipelines.
  • Support the operation of the systems you work on by participating in on‑call rotations, incident response, and learning from post‑incident reviews.
  • Apply a backend and systems perspective during refinement, raising questions about risks, dependencies, and edge cases.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, QA, and other engineers to deliver end‑to‑end transfer and banking capabilities.

You’ll be great for this role if you

  • Have experience building backend services in a modern environment and supporting them in production.
  • You are proficient in Golang and and comfortable learning and working with other languages as needed
  • Are comfortable working with cloud‑based systems, containerized workloads, and automated delivery pipelines.
  • Raise well-scoped pull requests, conduct thorough code reviews, and help maintain high standards of code quality and test coverage across the team
  • Understand the fundamentals of system architecture, data modelling, and API design, and are eager to deepen this knowledge.
  • Are curious about how your work fits into the broader system and product experience.
  • Communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders.

Any of the following would be considered a plus

  • Exposure to banking, payments, or financial systems, especially in regulated environments.
  • Experience supporting systems with production traffic, including participating in incident response.
  • Use of AI‑assisted tools to improve development speed, learning, or code quality.

Why you should join SumUp

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

🩺 Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches

Today, over 4 million businesses in 36 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

title: Backend Engineer (Node.js / TypeScript)
descriptionHtml:
About Nexoya

We help marketing teams unlock their growth potential with AI. Our attribution shows how advertising investments perform across channels, and our optimizations shift budgets to where they drive the bottom line. Leading European brands in e-commerce, telco, banking, insurance, energy and more rely on us.

The role

You build and run the Node.js/TypeScript services behind the Nexoya app: the GraphQL API, ad channel integrations and data ingestion, and new LLM- and agent-based features. You join a team of about 10 engineers across backend, ML, frontend and platform, and you own your features from design to production.

How we build software

AI coding agents change how software gets built, but not who is responsible for it.

  • Decisions are made together. Important technical decisions start as an Architecture Decision Record reviewed by the team. Good arguments win, not seniority.

  • Engineers design, agents implement. Your design is the input for our coding agents, guided by a shared rule set in our agent harness that the team evolves together.

  • Working is not done. Code is ready when it is maintainable: readable, tested, robust on unhappy paths. Larger changes are reviewed, so at least two engineers know every change.

  • You build it, you run it. A rotating internal support duty shows us which decisions worked.

What you will do

  • Ship backend features end to end on our Kubernetes-based Azure cloud.

  • Evolve our GraphQL API with clear schemas and stable contracts.

  • Build reliable ad channel integrations and data ingestion with MySQL and RabbitMQ.

  • Build AI features such as our in-app assistant (tool calling, retrieval, structured outputs), with evaluation, monitoring and guardrails.

  • Help evolve our agent harness and raise the bar for tests, reviews and documentation.

What you bring

  • [3+] years as a Backend Engineer with Node.js and TypeScript.

  • Solid API design (GraphQL or REST) and MySQL experience.

  • Experience with message brokers and running services on Docker, Kubernetes and a major cloud (Azure preferred).

  • You enjoy discussing design trade-offs in writing and care about code others can maintain.

  • Fluent English.

Bonus: ad platform APIs (Google Ads, Meta) or attribution; AI or agent features in production (Anthropic/OpenAI APIs, MCP, RAG); LLM evaluation or observability; team use of Claude Code or similar; data pipelines; German.

What we offer

  • Direct impact on how enterprise marketers allocate their budgets.

  • Real ownership in a team that takes engineering quality seriously.

  • A genuine AI-first culture: experiment, automate, share.

  • A transparent culture at eye level, with regular team events.

  • Strategy Days twice a year where the whole team shapes company strategy (past: Helsinki, Berlin, Belgrade, Swiss Alps, Zurich).

Application process

  1. Profile review and phone screen

  2. Take-home assignment: a backend feature

  3. Technical discussion with the engineering team

  4. [On-site] interview and team evaluation

title: Backend Engineer – Real-Time Video
descriptionHtml:
About Stream

Stream powers real-time Chat, Video, Activity Feeds, and AI Moderation for more than 1 billion end users across 4,000+ apps, from Strava and Bumble to eBay and Patreon. Our platform processes billions of API requests per month and supports applications with millions of concurrent users, while delivering highly reliable, low-latency services and a great developer experience.

The role

We're looking for a Staff Backend Engineer to join Stream on our mission of elevating the quality of apps for billions of users globally. You'll own the technical direction of Stream Video's media plane and the infrastructure it runs on.

This is a full-time role, hybrid with 3 days a week in our Amsterdam office, or remote from anywhere in the EU.

What you'll work on

Stream Video runs on an SFU we built in Go on top of Pion, plus ingest and recording fleets, all on a global edge network we own across more than one cloud. Nobody at Stream has owned this media plane end to end before. Our central infrastructure team is tuned for request-based services, and video breaks in different ways: live sessions can't be dropped, bandwidth is the biggest cost, and placement is the main lever. That's why this is a Staff role. You'll set the direction for the video backend and its infrastructure with your own roadmap, reporting to our Director of Engineering with a direct line to our CTO. The Video SDK teams own the client side, and you'll work closely with them and with infrastructure. Part of the fleet is mid-move to Kubernetes.

Job responsibilities:

  • Architecture: write the architecture and roadmap for Stream Video's backend and media infrastructure, and decide what ships.

  • Scale livestreaming: architect the SFU and media pipeline (WHIP, WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, SVC), including the path from WebRTC to CDN-backed HLS for very large audiences.

  • Own the fleet: reliability, autoscaling, placement, rollouts, observability and cost for long-lived sessions across clouds, with cost per gigabyte as a first-class metric.

  • Gate production changes: define the validation that decides which changes, including AI-generated ones, reach live media, using behaviour tests on realistic networks, nightly telemetry scans and a public quality benchmark.

  • Take the final escalation: handle the hardest quality, latency and production incidents, and work with enterprise customers on advanced integrations.

  • Raise the bar: mentor senior engineers through design review, code review and hiring.

About you

You've owned systems where a dropped session or a bad rollout is visible to users within seconds, and you think about cost and reliability as much as features. You'd rather write the hard design doc than wait for one. A founder background is an asset here. The team is small, so you'll still write and review plenty of code. If you're looking for a large organisation with a platform team to hand problems to, or a management track, this role won't suit you.

You have:

  • Extensive backend engineering experience, including significant time owning architecture for high-scale production systems

  • Expert proficiency in Go or an equivalent systems language (Rust, C++, Java)

  • A track record owning real-time, stateful or latency-sensitive systems at very high scale

  • Deep knowledge of distributed systems and networking: failure modes, placement, capacity planning and cost

  • Strong experience with real-time media or streaming: WebRTC, SFU/MCU concepts, RTP/RTCP, DTLS, or RTMP, SRT and HLS

  • Clear written communication: design docs and RFCs that others can act on

  • Hands-on experience adopting AI coding and agent tools, and judgement on how to make them safe in production

Bonus points:

  • Built or operated an SFU, or contributed to Pion or another WebRTC stack

  • Moved a stateful fleet to Kubernetes, or ran media workloads across more than one cloud

  • Knowledge of bandwidth estimation, congestion control, simulcast, SVC and codecs (Opus, VP8/VP9, AV1)

  • CockroachDB/PostgreSQL, RocksDB, Raft and Redis at scale

  • Experience at developer tooling, API or SDK companies

  • Founder or early-stage startup experience building real-time products

  • Python or Rust alongside Go

  • Conference talks, technical writing or notable open-source work in real-time media

What makes this role exciting

  • Scope: the infrastructure direction for video is yours to run as a product, with the authority to decide what ships.

  • Impact: Video is Stream's most complex product, and many customers run it alongside Chat, Feeds and Moderation, so this work matters across the company.

  • Stack: Go, Pion, WebRTC, WHIP/WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, Protobuf, CockroachDB/Postgres, RocksDB, Raft and Redis, with Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT Codex in daily use.

  • Starting point: a concrete first 90 days. Ship a validation gate on every infrastructure change that reaches production media, and move part of the fleet to Kubernetes with a cost-per-gigabyte number attached.

Why join Stream?

We're a Series B company with offices in Boulder, Amsterdam, Skopje and Toronto, and a team of 140+ people from 37 nationalities. We're backed by Felicis Ventures, GGV Capital, 01 Advisors, Techstars, and Arthur Ventures, with angels including Dick Costolo (ex-CEO of Twitter), Olivier Pomel (CEO of Datadog), Tom Preston-Werner (co-founder of GitHub), and Nicolas Dessaigne (co-founder of Algolia).

We'll be straight with you: a startup is more demanding than a large company. There's no fixed playbook, you'll own things end to end, and you'll sometimes pick up work outside your title. That's also what makes it a fast place to grow. If you want real ownership and high scale more than structure and a set career ladder, you'll feel at home here.

What we offer

  • Company equity

  • 28 days paid time off plus Dutch public holidays

  • Pension plan with a company contribution

  • NS Business Card or a company bike, covered

  • Personal development budget of EUR 500 per year

  • Catered lunches in the office

  • MacBook Pro

  • Up to EUR 60 a month toward a gym or sports club membership of your choice

  • Highly skilled migrant (kennismigrant) visa sponsorship and relocation support if you're moving to Amsterdam

This list applies to Netherlands-based employees and is adjusted to your location of residence. If you work remotely from another EU country, you'll be employed through our Employer of Record partner and get company equity plus local benefits depending on your country of employment.

Our culture

Stream is a casual, transparent team that aims high and supports each other. In engineering, we care about ownership and quality, and our goal is to ship stable software. Management stays hands-on, with less middle management and more time spent doing the work. If that sounds like the environment you want next, apply now.

Stream is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on skills and experience, and we don't discriminate based on age, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, nationality, religion or belief, political opinion, disability or chronic illness, marital status, working hours, type of contract, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need an adjustment at any point in our hiring process, let us know.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

descriptionHtml:

Netcraft is the global leader in cybercrime detection and disruption. We’re a trusted partner for three of the four largest companies in the world and many large governments. We've blocked over 225 million cyber-attacks to date, and we take down around 33% of the world's phishing attacks.

Our purpose and passion are focused on just one thing: protecting the world from cybercrime.

  • NSI, which supports engagement with criminals conducting conversational scams at scale

These products are a mixture of legacy platforms that produce key data supporting Netcraft systems and new products that support our customer base. You will build a new team to manage and improve these products, contributing code, demonstrating best practice, and managing an exciting delivery roadmap.

What You’ll Need to Be Successful

  • A strong engineering background spanning a range of technologies, including Go, OpenSearch, and MongoDB, with Perl experience considered an advantage

  • Experience interviewing and hiring engineers, building effective teams, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Strong Go development skills, particularly in technology modernisation or uplift projects
  • Experience with generative AI technologies and where and how to apply them to improve customer experiences
  • Practical experience managing engineers at different career stages, from recent graduates to seasoned professionals

The Rewards Package

  • 33 days annual leave - includes public holidays which can be worked if you prefer 
  • Generous enhanced family leave and pay 
  • Enhanced company sick pay from day one of employment, with additional support after your first six months’ service
  • Salary sacrifice pension with matched employer contributions up to 5% + NI savings 
  • Private health cover, including access to a private GP service 
  • Life Assurance at 4 x salary 
  • Equity tracking scheme (eligibility criteria apply) - allowing you share in Netcraft's long term success 
  • Hybrid and flexible working options 
  • Meals, snacks, and drinks provided in the office 
  • Comprehensive health, safety, and wellness service available 24/7 for you and your family 
  • Two paid Learning & Development days per year plus access to learning resources such as Udemy and Coursera to support your career 
  • Two Volunteering Days per year, to allow you to contribute to your wider community or charity 
  • Employee Referral Bonus scheme 
  • Spot reward bonus scheme to reward truly outstanding contributions 

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion 

This is deeply important to us. Through our ally network, we support under-represented groups and maintain a working environment free from bias, harassment, or discrimination. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

À propos de Lexroom

Chez Lexroom, nous développons l'état de l'art de la recherche juridique agentique. Quand un utilisateur pose une question, le système la décompose en sous-questions précises, puis déploie des agents spécialisés qui explorent en parallèle codes, jurisprudence, doctrine et textes européens. Chaque document est analysé en profondeur, les liens implicites entre principes juridiques sont identifiés, et le tout est synthétisé dans un rapport structuré où chaque affirmation est sourcée. Ce qui prenait une semaine à une équipe entière se fait pendant une pause café.

Notre mission : rendre le droit plus rapide, plus clair et plus fiable, et redonner aux avocats et aux directions juridiques le temps de se concentrer sur ce qui compte.

Nous construisons l'équipe commerciale, et vous en serez l'un des tout premiers membres.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Un produit qui tient ses promesses : la démo fait le travail. Vos prospects voient la différence en une session, pas après six mois de POC.

Le profil que nous cherchons

  • 6 à 12 mois d'expérience en vente outbound B2B SaaS, ou un vrai track record de SDR top performer. Le poste reste ouvert aux profils en début de carrière qui ont l'énergie, la discipline et la "faim" commerciale.

title: Beleidsadviseur Cultuur en Participatie | Publieke Sector
descriptionHtml:
Omschrijving

Wij zijn voor een onafhankelijke publieke organisatie in de culturele sector op zoek naar een Beleidsadviseur Cultuur en Participatie.

Deze organisatie ondersteunt een onafhankelijke adviesraad die bestuurders en volksvertegenwoordigers adviseert over vraagstukken rondom cultuurbeleid, cultuurparticipatie en de ontwikkeling van de culturele sector. Vanuit een zelfstandige en objectieve positie levert het bureau onderzoek, analyses en beleidsadviezen waarmee ontwikkelingen, knelpunten en kansen binnen het culturele landschap inzichtelijk worden gemaakt.

Als beleidsadviseur vervul je een centrale rol in het ophalen, analyseren en vertalen van signalen uit de culturele praktijk. Je richt je op de positie van makers, culturele instellingen en informele initiatieven en zorgt ervoor dat inzichten uit het veld op een methodische en objectieve manier worden verwerkt in beleidsadviezen. Daarmee draag je bij aan toekomstbestendig cultuurbeleid en een sterke verbinding tussen beleid, praktijk en samenleving.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je verricht beleidsgericht onderzoek naar vraagstukken binnen kunst, cultuur, cultuurparticipatie en de creatieve sector.

  • Je bouwt inhoudelijke dossiers op voor zowel gevraagde als ongevraagde beleidsadviezen.

  • Je vertaalt onderzoeksresultaten, bijeenkomsten en consultaties naar heldere, feitelijk juiste en goed onderbouwde conceptadviezen.

  • Je faciliteert en ondersteunt werkgroepen, thematafels, expertmeetings en andere participatievormen inhoudelijk.

  • Je ontwerpt en begeleidt consultatie- en participatietrajecten met makers, culturele instellingen en andere stakeholders.

  • Je volgt ontwikkelingen, behoeften, innovaties en knelpunten binnen de culturele sector en de makerspraktijk.

  • Je structureert en analyseert kwalitatieve input uit gesprekken, bijeenkomsten en stadsbrede consultaties.

  • Je zorgt voor een objectieve en zorgvuldige vertaling van signalen uit het culturele veld naar beleidsmatige aanbevelingen.


Wat vragen wij?

  • Je beschikt over een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in Cultuurwetenschappen, Kunstbeleid, Communicatiewetenschappen of een vergelijkbare richting.

  • Je hebt ervaring met beleidsontwikkeling, beleidsadvisering of onderzoek binnen een politiek-bestuurlijke, maatschappelijke of culturele context.

  • Je hebt kennis van de culturele sector, verschillende artistieke disciplines en de positie van zelfstandige makers, collectieven en culturele instellingen.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het begeleiden van participatieprocessen, dialoogsessies, expertbijeenkomsten of stakeholderconsultaties.

  • Je bent een sterke gespreksleider en weet uiteenlopende belangen en perspectieven met elkaar te verbinden.

  • Je analyseert complexe informatie op een objectieve wijze en vertaalt deze naar heldere beleidsadviezen en beleidsnotities.

  • Je schrijft zorgvuldig, gestructureerd en in heldere ambtelijk-bestuurlijke taal.

  • Je bent omgevingssensitief, onafhankelijk in je oordeelsvorming en in staat verschillende belangen zorgvuldig af te wegen.

  • Je voelt je prettig in een omgeving waarin onderzoek, participatie, cultuurbeleid en bestuurlijke advisering samenkomen.

title: BLP Academy Facilitator
descriptionHtml:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based at our HQ in central Zurich. The BLP Academy happens in person, and so does this role: you are in the room with our clients for every cohort.

Your Mission

You run the room. Two to three days in Zurich that set the tone for every implementation that follows.

Before a project kicks off, our clients send the people who will carry it, their BLP Champions, to the BLP Academy. They learn hands-on on our platform, work through real project scenarios, and meet peers from other enterprises facing the same challenges. Across 1,300+ projects, the customer team has made the difference between a smooth and a slow implementation, so these days matter.

You make them count. You welcome every participant, run and own the sessions, and set the energy in the room from the first coffee to the last evening. You bring in our BLP experts for deep dives and make sure their expertise lands. Our clients go home certified, connected and ready for their implementation, after an unforgettable few days in Zurich. And as BLP expands across Europe and North America, the Academy will grow with it, with you shaping what that looks like.

That takes an unusual mix: part entertainer, part teacher, part professor, with a real curiosity for processes and AI. We care less about where you come from than about what happens when you walk into a room. You will join a fast-growing, global AI company and a team that brings real energy to everything it does. If you light up a room and make complex things simple at the same time, read on.

Key Responsibilities

In the room

  • Host every Academy cohort in Zurich: welcome our clients, set the tone, and be their main point of contact from arrival to departure.

  • Lead the sessions: present, explain, and guide participants through hands-on exercises on the BLP platform.

  • Pace every hands-on block to the room, giving fast learners space to go deeper while making sure nobody gets left behind.

  • Moderate the deep-dive sessions with BLP experts and connect their content to each participant's situation.

  • Keep the energy high across two to three intense days, and host the evenings and everything around the program.

Around each cohort

  • Get every participant ready before they arrive, so the Academy starts with momentum on day one.

  • Make sure every participant completes the BLP Champion Certification and goes home ready for their implementation.

  • Collect feedback and participant NPS, and make every cohort better than the last.

Beyond the classroom

  • Bring the Academy experience to new formats as they launch, from online learning programs for our clients and certification for our implementation partners to onboarding for new BLP colleagues.

What We're Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Energy – You bring the room to life on day one and still have it on day three, evenings included.

  • Owning a Room – You lead groups with confidence, from senior client audiences to hands-on sessions, and know when to push, when to pause and when to make people laugh.

  • Patience and Empathy – You notice who is struggling before they say so, and you adapt the pace of a hands-on session to each participant.

  • Communication – You make complex topics simple and convincing, and you can tell whether a participant has really understood or is just nodding.

  • Credibility – You hold your own with senior experts and executives, because you think in structures and understand what you are talking about.

  • Curiosity for Processes and AI – You want to understand how enterprise processes run and what AI changes about them, and you learn fast.

  • Host Mindset – You care that every participant has a great experience, keep a multi-day program running smoothly, and notice the details that make it work.

What You Bring

  • You know how to lead a room, whether that’s a workshop, a training, an event or a client meeting, ideally with senior audiences. We care more about how you got that experience than where: consulting, teaching, events, tech or team leadership all count.

  • You’ve gained several years of professional and relevant experience, in any industry or along any path.

  • You’re excited about AI and how it changes the way businesses work, and you can’t wait to get to know the BLP platform inside out.

  • You’re fluent in German and English, both spoken and written. This is a must, because you’ll run Academy sessions in both languages, often for senior client audiences.

  • Proven experience designing and delivering trainings, workshops, or customer onboarding sessions yourself, ideally to business or technical audiences.

  • Experience with ERP systems or finance processes, workshop or event formats, or AI-driven SaaS is a plus.

How You Grow

As BLP grows, the Academy grows with it, and so does this role. You will be close to our clients, our experts and our leadership, which opens doors across the company as we expand.

Benefits

  • High ownership environment – you own the Academy experience and shape how our clients start their BLP journey.

  • Impact at scale – every cohort you run shapes implementations at enterprises across Europe.

  • Cross-functional exposure – work with project managers, consultants, engineers, product teams and our clients daily.

  • Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program.

  • Energized team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators who bring energy to everything they do.

  • Technology exposure – be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Offsites – including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about BLP and our values at https://blp.digital/company/careers.

title: Brand Designer
descriptionHtml:
This role can be office-based in Freiburg (Germany) / San Francisco (USA) or hybrid with a requirement to be in one of the offices one full week per month.

About Black Forest Labs

We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world.

Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use.

Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next.

Why this role

Black Forest Labs builds visual intelligence: models that create and understand images and video, and increasingly act in the physical world. For a company whose work is visual, the brand is part of the work. It's often the first thing people see of us, before they've tried a single model. It has to hold the same bar as our models and grow as they do.

We're hiring our first Brand Designer to define that brand and own it wherever people meet BFL. You'll bring the taste that sets the standard for how BFL looks, and build what keeps it consistent across launches, the website, events and everything in between.

This is a hands-on lead role. You'll ship much of the work yourself while setting up the tools and processes that let others ship at your level. Over time, you'll also shape how brand and marketing design grows at BFL, including who we hire next.

What you'll work on

  • Lead how our visual identity grows, including logo, type, color, imagery and motion, and turn it into guidelines and design systems others can work from.

  • Create the concept and creative direction for each model launch, campaign and event, working with research to show what every new model can do.

  • Make the work people see every day, online and offline: social posts, editorial, decks, docs, sales material, event spaces, merchandise and print.

  • Own the direction of bfl.ai and our growth pages, and help make the website one of the clearest and strongest expressions of the brand.

  • Build templates, internal tools and an agent-readable design system so marketing, sales and engineering can create on-brand work themselves. We'd rather you build the generator than draw the hundredth asset.

  • Work with product design on shared foundations like type, color and components, so bfl.ai, the Playground, the dashboard, and other product surfaces feel like one company.

Your team

Design at BFL is young, and much of how it works is still open, including how we review work, what we call finished and how design informs decisions across teams. You'll help define these and represent design across the company.

You'll work closely with Devran, who leads design at BFL, and with teams across the company, including marketing, growth, developer relations, research and product design. Among the people you'll work with most are Owais and Aitana in marketing and Jay in growth engineering.

What we're looking for

  • At least six years designing brands, and one or two projects you'd still stand behind today, where you played a key role from concept through rollout and others now build on the work. We're looking for an original idea, clear taste and execution that holds up in every detail.

  • Deep craft in identity and visual design, from typography and color to layout, art direction and motion. You notice the crop, the spacing and the timing of a transition, and you fix them before anyone asks.

  • A quality bar that raises the work around you. You've made a team better before, through the work you shipped and the feedback you gave.

  • You're ready to ship from day one. You've started work no one asked for, seen it through, and sorted out disagreements directly with the people involved.

  • A systems thinker. You've built guidelines, templates or design systems that others used well without you in the room, and you can tell when work should scale and when it should stay one of a kind.

  • You move easily between the big picture and the details. You can make the case for a design decision to a founder, an engineer and a marketer, and you change how you make it for each of them.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. One week might take you from a model launch to merch to a new page on bfl.ai. Much here isn't figured out yet, and you see that as an opportunity.

  • Curiosity about new tools, new problems and getting better at your craft. You can point to something you taught yourself recently and how it changed your work.

Nice to have:

  • Shipping web pages or prototypes yourself with AI coding tools such as Claude Code.

  • Building your own tools for brand work, such as template generators or small internal apps.

  • Using generative image or video models in your creative process.

  • Motion, 3D or creative coding.

  • Experience at an AI lab.

How we work together

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. You’ll be based in Europe or the US and work from your home location, with one week each month spent with us in Freiburg or San Francisco to stay connected with the team.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

  • Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

Please apply even if you don't match every line above. What matters most to us is curiosity and a love of making things. You don't need to know every tool we use. We'd rather hire a great, curious designer than someone who ticks every box.

If this sounds like work you'd enjoy, we'd love to hear from you.

Compensation

EU : €148K - €175K + equity
SF : $219K - $265K + equity

title: Brand Director
descriptionHtml:
We're a group of friends building apps for friends, and we think friendship deserves a better place online. Our brand is how the world first meets that idea, usually in a three-second scroll, in a language that isn't ours, on a phone in a city we've never been to.


We're looking for a Brand Lead who writes like a dream and ships like a machine. Someone who's run global campaigns at a top agency, knows what a great brief feels like, and is ready to trade the client side of the table for owning the whole thing.


You'll shape how amo sounds, looks and shows up everywhere, from a two-word push notification to a launch film watched in fifteen countries.

What you'll do:

  • Own the amo voice. Write it, guard it, and make it better every week. App copy, launch posts, store listings, social, scripts, the little lines that make people smile.

  • Run global campaigns end to end. From the first idea on a napkin to the last cut in market, across Europe, the US and beyond.

  • Brief and push creative partners. Agencies, directors, creators and our in-house design team. You know how to get their best work because you've been on their side of the table.

  • Make the brand local without making it boring. Adapt ideas so they land in Paris, London, LA and Seoul, not just translate them.

  • Measure what the brand is really doing. Set up and run brand tracking across our markets, following awareness, consideration and perception over time, and turn what you learn into the next brief.

  • Work in days, not weeks. Spot a moment on Tuesday, have a campaign live on Thursday, learn from it on Friday.

  • Sweat the details. Easter eggs, onboarding screens, the name of a feature. Small words do big work here.

What that may look like:

Kicking off a campaign with an agency for our next market launch, and setting up the tracker that tells us a month later whether people there know who we are and like what they see.

Who you are:

  • A writer first. You can make a headline sing and kill your darlings without blinking. Your portfolio proves it.

  • Agency-trained. You've spent real time at a creative agency and worked on brands people actually know. You've sat in the pitch, survived the feedback round and shipped anyway.

  • Global from day one. You've led or played a key role in campaigns that ran across several markets at once, and you know what changes (and what never should) from one country to the next.

  • Fast and opinionated. Conviction over consensus. You'd rather put out something great today than something perfect next month.

  • Fluent in internet. You know what's trending before it trends, and you can tell the difference between a moment worth joining and one worth skipping.

  • Bilingual or better is a plus. English is our working language. French, Spanish, Portuguese, Korean or Japanese would make us very happy.

Bonus points if:

You've worked on a consumer app, built a brand from scratch, or have a group chat that's funnier than most ad campaigns.

Why amo:

  • You'll own it. No account director, no client sign-off chain. Your ideas go from your head to millions of phones.

  • You'll move fast. We make decisions quickly and learn from mistakes even quicker. Intense, but healthy.

  • You'll be in good company. Over half the team is international, with 25 nationalities and counting. One in four of us moved cities or countries to be here.

  • You'll grow x10. Colleagues across product, design, engineering and growth will challenge your work every day, and you'll do the same to theirs.

  • You'll have backing. We're supported by some of the best tier-1 investors in the world and growing at a pace our space hasn't seen in years.

Life at amo:

To ensure that everyone is set up for success within our way of working, we work together onsite 5 days a week. We wanted to make sure coming to the office is as comfortable as possible for you:

  • We chose a location in central Paris, near Opera (Metro lines 3,8,9 and RER A).

  • We have a beautiful Parisian-style office with high ceilings, balconies, and huge windows. So a lot of natural light!

  • We reimburse your commuting expenses 50%.

Because life outside of work should also be stress-free, we cover:

  • Health care (100% coverage).

  • Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Second Parent Leave (salary maintained at 100%).

  • Vacation days: 8-9 weeks (total) per year - (European summer? 🥹😎).

    • 5 weeks of paid time off (by the state);

    • 1-2 additional weeks (RTT, based on our company contract);

    • ~11 bank holidays.

We shut down entirely twice a year, two weeks in the summer and one week in the winter to allow everyone to truly recharge and to avoid prolonged slowdowns (especially in the summer). This enables everyone to actually disconnect and enjoy their vacation. No Slack, no email, no FOMO. Per French standard, we also offer another 4 weeks to allow team members to choose when they want to take time off.

How to apply:

Send us your CV and a portfolio, plus one thing you'd rewrite on our website or in our app, and why. Keep it short. We'll know.

title: Brand Management Stage (vanaf januari 2027)
descriptionHtml:
Misschien wel het leukste bedrijf van Nederland is op zoek naar versterking! Dit prachtige familiebedrijf groeit als kool en daarom zijn wij hard op zoek naar marketing talent. Word jij enthousiast van grote brands? Ben je benieuwd hoe deze internationaal worden gepositioneerd en houd jij van design? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Op de Global Marketingafdeling houden we ons o.a. bezig met Brand Management, Product Management, Social Media en Influencer Marketing.

Binnen het brand management team zijn wij op zoek naar een Brand Management stagiair(e). Als Brand Management stagiair(e) draai je gewoon mee met het team. Dit betekent dat je een lekker veelzijdige baan hebt met veel verantwoordelijkheden. Je helpt ons met het ontwikkelen van diverse brand campagnes, van idee tot shoot en van lancering tot evaluatie. Daarnaast bewaak en versterk je de merk identiteit (in meer dan 85 landen!), dit doe je door veel te schakelen met andere afdelingen binnen KEUNE.

Btw, koffie halen en printen kunnen we zelf, daar ben jij niet voor. We vinden het veel belangrijker dat je je stem laat horen en ons omver blaast met je kennis van de beauty-industrie, je goede ideeën en je slimme vragen.

We staan open voor zowel meewerkstagiairs als afstudeerders. In overleg formuleren we een passende onderzoeksvraag waarmee jij kunt afstuderen, mits je minimaal 4 dagen in de week meewerkt.

YOU

  • Je volgt een relevante opleiding op HBO/WO niveau;

  • Spreekt en schrijft flawless Nederlands en Engels;

  • Begrijpt wat het inhoudt om onderdeel van een team te zijn;

  • Gaat niet zitten wachten tot er dingen gebeuren of iemand iets van je vraagt, maar toont initiatief;

  • Bent flexibel en kunt goed omgaan met last minute veranderingen;

  • Bent grappig (het is ook ok als je dat alleen zelf vindt).


OUR OFFER

  • Collega’s die elkaar behandelen als familie;

  • Een B Corp gecertificeerde werkgever;

  • Een inspirerende werkomgeving;

  • Collega’s die investeren in jouw talent;

  • De mogelijkheid om een scriptie te schrijven of onderzoek te doen;

  • De kans om samen te werken met top notch marketeers;

  • Regelmatig (eerlijke!) feedback;

  • Stagevergoeding van €650,- per maand;

  • Personeelskorting op de volledige KEUNE-collectie.

KEUNE

We zijn een familiebedrijf met een langetermijnvisie, waar wetenschap centraal staat in alles wat we doen. Ons verhaal begint in 1922, in Amsterdam. Vandaag, 104 jaar later en een koninklijk predicaat rijker, hoort KEUNE bij één van de hardst groeiende merken in professionele haarverzorgingsproducten. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Soest worden KEUNE-producten ontwikkeld, geproduceerd en wereldwijd gedistribueerd naar meer dan 85 landen. En we zijn niet van plan om gas terug te nemen! Ieder jaar openen we een nieuwe eigen vestiging. We produceren op een duurzame en diervriendelijke manier en zijn B Corp-gecertificeerd. Maar bij KEUNE gaat het niet alleen om het creëren van mooie producten - het gaat om ons verhaal en onze visie. KEUNE staat onder leiding van Philip Berlijn, die zich richt op het bouwen van een sterk merk en het creëren van een bedrijfscultuur die draait om samenwerken, duurzaamheid en het tonen van karakter.

KEUNE
HOME OF THE HAIR PRO

Neem contact met ons op via de button. Wie weet tot snel!

title: Brand & Marketing Manager (m/w/d) in Teilzeit - Fokus Markenstrategie & Bekanntheit
descriptionHtml:
Du liebst Sport, gesunde Ernährung und nachhaltige Snacks? Du weißt, wie man aus einer guten Geschäftsidee eine Marke macht, die im Gedächtnis bleibt und im Regal auffällt?

Bei TZAMPAS stehen wir vor dem nächsten großen Schritt: Wir haben ein starkes, im Handel etabliertes Produkt, aber unsere Markenbotschaft muss noch schärfer, konsistenter und bekannter werden. Wenn du Lust hast, unser Markenprofil auf den Punkt zu bringen und mit kreativen Kampagnen für echte Reichweite zu sorgen, bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Wir suchen eine Teilzeitkraft für 20-25 Std./Woche mit der Option auf Vollzeit in der Zukunft.

Aufgaben

Als Brand & Marketing Manager:in bist du das Sprachrohr und das strategische Gewissen unserer Marke. Deine Hauptaufgabe ist es, TZAMPAS eine glasklare Identität zu verleihen und die Markenbekanntheit spürbar zu steigern.

  • Markengeschichte & Botschaft schärfen: Du entwickelst unsere Core Message und ein klares Brand Playbook (Tone of Voice, Wording, Design-Leitplanken), damit TZAMPAS auf allen Kanälen - von der Verpackung über Social Media bis zum POS - wie aus einem Guss kommuniziert.

  • Bekanntheit aufbauen: Du konzipierst und steuerst kreative Kampagnen (z. B. Influencer-Kooperationen, Event-Sponsoring im Outdoor-/Sportbereich, PR und Social-Media-Aktionen) mit Fokus auf Reichweite und Markenaufbau.

  • Kanalübergreifende Konsistenz: Du achtest darauf, dass sowohl D2C (Onlineshop) als auch der B2B-Auftritt (Supermärkte/Handel) dieselbe starke Markensprache sprechen.

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung in Branding und Strategie: Mindestens 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung in Brand Strategie und - Management oder einer relevanten Marketing-Position (bevorzugt FMCG, Food oder Lifestyle).

  • Strategie & Trend-Gespür: Du bringst eine ausgeprägte „Brand Ownership“-Mentalität mit: Du denkst strategisch weit voraus, hast ein feines Gespür für gesellschaftliche sowie digitale Trends und verstehst es, diese gezielt zu nutzen, um die Marke kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln und am Puls der Zeit zu halten.

  • Fokus auf klare Kommunikation: Du kannst komplexe oder vielschichtige Themen (z. B. Nachhaltigkeit, pflanzliche Ernährung) auf einfache, prägnante und mitreißende Botschaften herunterbrechen.

  • Macher-Mentalität: Du denkst strategisch, hast aber genauso Freude daran, Ideen eigenständig und pragmatisch umzusetzen.

  • Leidenschaft für das Thema: Du lebst gesunde Ernährung, Nachhaltigkeit oder Sport und verstehst die Sprache unserer Zielgruppe intuitiv.

  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du behältst auch bei einer Vielzahl unterschiedlicher Aufgaben die Übersicht.

  • Deutschkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C2) in Wort und Schrift sind unabdingbar für deine Aufgaben.

Benefits

Darum TZAMPAS

  • Echter Einfluss: Du übernimmst direkt die Verantwortung für das Gesicht und die Stimme einer aufstrebenden Food-Marke.

  • Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice nach Absprache

  • Sinnstiftendes Produkt: Ein Produkt, hinter dem man zu 100 % stehen kann, faire Arbeitsbedingungen und ein motiviertes, unkompliziertes Team.

Schicke uns deinen Lebenslauf, deine Gehaltsvorstellungen bezogen auf eine 20 - Stundenwoche sowie 2-3 Beispiele von Marken oder Projekten, deren Botschaft du geschärft oder deren Bekanntheit du gesteigert hast (z. B. als kurzes PDF oder Link).

title: Brand & Web Designer
descriptionHtml:
Hi, I'm Rosa, Head of Brand at FeedbackFruits. 👋

As FeedbackFruits evolves, so does the role design plays in how we build and communicate our brand. Campaigns and marketing materials will always be part of the picture, but we're putting a much bigger focus on our website, our digital experiences and the brand systems that help us do better work, more consistently.

I'm looking for a brand designer with a strong B2B marketing background, someone who combines excellent visual craft with real, hands-on website experience. You'll help evolve our visual identity, develop creative concepts for campaigns and launches, and bring that work to life on our website and landing pages, from the first layout to the moment a page goes live.

The first project you'd pick up with me is one I'm particularly excited about: evolving our brand so it sits closer to the new visual language of our product. After that, you'll take ownership of our website and landing pages, shaping the direction together with me while owning the design and execution, and you'll make sure our brand shows up consistently wherever people come across us, from a launch campaign to an ebook.

Beyond the design itself, I'm looking for someone who takes real ownership: someone who asks the right questions before jumping into a brief, spots what could be better and isn't afraid to challenge the obvious solution. We also use AI a lot at FeedbackFruits, and I'd love you to bring that same mindset to design, building templates and systems that help the whole team create on-brand work without starting from scratch every time. You'll have a real say in our creative direction, and as the team grows, there's room for you to grow with it.

What you'll do:

  • Evolve our brand identity and translate it into a distinctive, coherent visual language across our website, campaigns and marketing materials

  • Design and improve our marketing website and landing pages, from early concepts and layouts to responsive designs, and build and maintain pages yourself

  • Develop creative concepts for campaigns and product launches, and carry them through to ads, social, ebooks, brochures, presentations and event materials

  • Create hero and product visuals that make a complex product clear and compelling

  • Make our website clearer, more engaging and easier to navigate, with an eye on accessibility and conversion

  • Build reusable components, templates and guidelines so colleagues can create on-brand materials themselves

  • Bring structure to how design work gets requested, briefed, reviewed and delivered, and find ways for AI and automation to take repetitive work off the team's plate

  • Brief and work with external specialists in development, motion, video or illustration when a project needs extra expertise

What you bring:

  • You have around 3–5 years of experience as a brand or marketing designer, ideally at a B2B tech or SaaS company, or at an agency working with B2B clients

  • Your portfolio shows real breadth in B2B marketing design: landing pages, ads, brochures, ebooks, hero visuals and product visuals. You know how to make a complex product easy to understand and good to look at

  • Website work is a regular part of your job, not an occasional task. You've designed and built marketing pages yourself and can explain what you owned. You work in Webflow, our platform, or in something comparable like Framer and are happy to switch

  • You think in concepts, not just layouts, and you have a strong eye for typography, composition and hierarchy

  • You can take a project from a fuzzy brief to delivery without someone managing it for you, and you keep a clear head about priorities when several people need something from you at once

  • You understand what design needs to do for marketing, and you can explain your choices to non-designers in a way that brings them along

  • You look for ways to work smarter, whether that's a template, a component or an AI workflow that saves the team hours

  • You're confident in Figma and communicate well in English

  • You live within commuting distance of Amsterdam and are available 38 hours per week, with at least 2 days a week from our Amsterdam office

What you get:

  • 25 paid holidays per year

  • Hybrid work schedule (2 days onsite)

  • A day off for your birthday

  • Advantageous pension scheme

  • 3 days of volunteering leave per year

  • €550 Learning & Development budget per year + 3 days paid leave for learning

  • Travel allowance and Swapfiets subscription

  • Free access to our office gym

  • Unlimited access to mental health support via OpenUp

Compensation: €65K – €70K

  • • Estimaded gross yearly salary, including 8% holiday allowance €65K – €70K

title: Broker Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Wayflyer

Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.

Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan.

You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney.

 

The challenge

The Broker Channel is Wayflyer's fastest-growing route to market, and growth like that doesn't manage itself. We need someone who can scale a panel of brokers into a genuine growth engine, turning relationships and referral volume into closed deals. This isn't a maintenance role. It's a build role.

What you'll actually do

  • Grow and manage our broker panel, bringing on new brokers and training them to properly understand and sell our products

  • Build real relationships with existing brokers, the kind that make them think of you first when a deal comes up

  • Review referrals and provide sense checks and indicative offers, reading business financials well enough to spot what matters

  • Own your portfolio end to end, converting referral volume into funded deals, not just noise in the pipeline

  • Represent Wayflyer at industry events and in broker networks, building our name as much as your own

What this role could turn into

Brokers are a key focus area for the business, so whoever takes this on gets a real say in shaping it, not just executing someone else's plan. From here, that can mean leading a regional broker team as we expand into new regions, or stepping into a wider commercial partnerships role across the business.

Who thrives here

Someone who treats brokers as partners, not leads, and understands that a broker's reputation is on the line every time they refer you a deal. You're commercially sharp, comfortable with numbers, and genuinely curious about the businesses behind the applications, not just the credit markers. You don't wait for a case to be handed to you in a tidy format. You chase it down, sense-check it, and move.

We hire for range

We're looking for someone who's spent at least 2 years in business lending, ideally in fintech, and at least 2 years working directly with commercial finance brokers, with a real network to show for it. You'll have at least a year analysing business financials at a working level, and Hubspot experience is a bonus. More important than the years is the trajectory: have you built something, grown a book, or turned relationships into revenue? We'll also consider exceptional candidates from adjacent areas of business finance who don't tick every box.

Location and working policy

📍London, hybrid (3-4 days)

 

The good stuff

25 days off, plus public holidays. Private healthcare, life insurance, and a pension. Equity - because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want.

 

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Wayflyer Limited will process your personal data for the purpose of evaluating your suitability for the role. Such processing is based on the need to take steps prior to entering into a potential employment agreement. To learn more about how we handle your personal data, you can contact our privacy team at https://wayflyer.com/privacy-notice.

title: Broker Development Manager
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT FLOCK

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

THE ROLE 

Our brokers play a crucial role in making this a reality. We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger. You’ll use AI day to day, from researching brokers to preparing for meetings, so more of your time goes on the conversations that win business. We’re looking for an ambitious and passionate Broker Development Manager to accelerate our distribution through brokers. In this role, you’ll maximise existing broker relationships and build strong, strategic, growth partnerships as part of our fast-paced distribution team right at the heart of Flock’s mission.

WHAT WE THINK IS MOST EXCITING ABOUT THE ROLE:

Be a part of building something truly game changing in the fleet market. You’ll manage a panel of key strategic brokers with significant growth opportunities. You’ll engage them on the market-leading benefits of Flock’s connected fleet proposition, and how together, we can reduce risk, improve costs and save lives. You’ll also have real freedom in how you use AI to work, whether that’s getting under the skin of a broker’s book before a meeting or spotting growth opportunities across your panel.

A LITTLE MORE ON WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

  • Act as a primary face of Flock for a panel of key broker partners, driving mutual growth and long-term success.

  • Deliver high volumes of broker submissions, directly supporting Flock’s ambitious growth targets.

  • Build, grow and develop our broker panel, onboarding new partners at pace and maximising their commercial potential.

  • Proactively engage brokers, finding new and creative ways to promote Flock’s appetite and proposition as we expand into new sectors.

  • Develop and execute clear, data-driven account growth strategies to drive sustained performance.

  • Achieve strong conversion and retention by supporting day-to-day trading activity and helping brokers (and Flock) win and retain business.

  • Work closely with internal teams, collaborating with brilliant Flockers across the business to deliver shared growth objectives.

  • Maintain strong broker advocacy by being visible, responsive and passionate about Flock’s product, proposition and mission.

  • Use AI in your day-to-day work, from broker research and meeting prep to analysing your pipeline, so your time goes on relationships rather than admin.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO FLOCK:

ESSENTIAL

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in managing broker relationships within the insurance sector, possessing a reputable standing in the industry.

  • Energy and innovation in abundance - the ability to work fast, spot opportunity and solve problems. 

  • A proven track record of exceeding revenue targets, driving business growth, and closely collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve collective objectives.

  • An existing network of broker contacts that will enable a rapid integration and immediate impact within Flock’s business development realm.

  • Exceptional understanding of the commercial broker marketplace, competitor carriers, broker business models, and processes.

  • Ability to deliver a consultative sales process, aligning Flock’s value proposition with brokers’ current and future business needs.

  • Comfortable using AI in your daily work, from research and meeting prep to account analysis, and curious about where else it could help you win business.

PREFERABLE

  • Experience building networks of brokers in a Commercial Motor Fleet setting. 

  • Have a broker distribution background with an active panel of brokers in the commercial insurance market. 

  • Can embrace new technologies and products, with experience of successfully distributing these to brokers.

WHAT WE OFFER (in addition to a competitive salary)

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖 

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

ONE LAST THING..

Authenticity is important to us. We value the unique qualities and experiences you bring. So if you apply, just be your genuine self. It’s who we want!

title: Business Analyst (gn)
descriptionHtml:
Festanstellung bei New Monday · Vollzeit · überwiegend remote innerhalb Deutschlands · gelegentliche Teamtreffen in Essen · Start zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt

Du verstehst komplexe Prozesse, bringst Struktur in Anforderungen und entwickelst daraus konkrete Lösungen? Bei New Monday suchen wir zwei Business Analyst für ein Kundenprojekt, das eine zentrale Herausforderung der Energiewende adressiert: den Netzausbau und die Integration von Erzeugungsanlagen.

Im Projekt entsteht ein Netzanschlusssystem mit drei miteinander verbundenen Anwendungen: einem Kundenfrontend, einem Installateursfrontend und einer Sachbearbeiterlösung. Gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Fachbereichen und Entwicklungsteams gestaltest du die fachlichen Grundlagen dafür, die durchgängigen Prozesse effizienter zu machen.

Über New Monday

Wir sind New Monday und begleiten Unternehmen bei der Entwicklung digitaler Produkte – von der ersten Idee über die Analyse und Konzeption bis hin zu Design und technischer Umsetzung. Dafür bringen wir Kompetenzen aus Business Analyse, UX/UI Design und Softwareentwicklung zusammen.

Als Teil von New Monday bringst du deine Expertise direkt in die Projekte unserer Kunden ein. Dort arbeitest du in der Regel als Mitglied des Kundenteams eng mit den jeweiligen Fachbereichen, Product Ownern und Entwicklungsteams zusammen. Du machst komplexe Anforderungen verständlich, hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse und gestaltest Lösungen, die Nutzer und Unternehmen weiterhelfen.

Dein berufliches Zuhause bleibt New Monday: Wir begleiten dich während deines Projekteinsatzes, unterstützen deine Weiterentwicklung und schaffen Raum für fachlichen Austausch und persönliche Begegnungen im Team.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du analysierst und strukturierst prozessuale Anforderungen und entwickelst fachliche sowie technische Umsetzungskonzepte.

  • Du übersetzt fachliche Bedarfe in klare, umsetzungsreife Spezifikationen als Grundlage für die technische Realisierung.

  • Du arbeitest dich in komplexe Systemlandschaften und ihre Prozesse ein, identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und dokumentierst konkrete Handlungsbedarfe.

  • Du bearbeitest definierte Testpakete, führst Reviews durch und analysierst auftretende Fehler. Dabei dokumentierst und bewertest du Fehlerbilder aus fachlicher Sicht.

  • Du erarbeitest Lösungsoptionen und Handlungsempfehlungen und stimmst diese mit angrenzenden Rollen und Fachbereichen ab.

  • Du behältst den gesamten Prozess über die drei Anwendungen hinweg im Blick und hilfst dabei, den Nutzen der Lösung kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

Was du mitbringst

  • Erfahrung in der Business Analyse oder im Requirements Engineering für komplexe IT-Projekte.

  • Die Fähigkeit, fachliche und prozessuale Anforderungen systematisch aufzunehmen, zu hinterfragen und verständlich zu dokumentieren.

  • Technisches Verständnis, um Zusammenhänge, Abhängigkeiten und Schnittstellen innerhalb einer Systemlandschaft zu analysieren.

  • Erfahrung mit der Erstellung von Spezifikationen und Umsetzungskonzepten sowie in der Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen und Entwicklungsteams.

  • Erfahrung mit fachlichen Tests, Reviews und der Analyse und Bewertung von Fehlern.

  • Eine strukturierte, eigenständige Arbeitsweise und Freude daran, gemeinsam tragfähige Lösungen zu entwickeln.

  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

  • Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Teamtreffen in Essen.

Das erwartet dich bei New Monday

  • Flexibles Arbeiten passend zum Projekt: In diesem Projekt arbeitest du überwiegend remote innerhalb Deutschlands. Gelegentliche Teamtreffen finden vor Ort in Essen statt.

  • Flexibilität und Vertrauen: Du organisierst deine Arbeit eigenständig und stimmst dich dabei mit deinem Kundenteam ab. Bei New Monday setzen wir auf kurze Abstimmungswege und Vertrauen.

  • Aufgaben mit Wirkung und Gestaltungsspielraum: Du bringst deine Erfahrung direkt im Kundenprojekt ein und gestaltest digitale Prozesse mit, die den Netzausbau und die Integration von Erzeugungsanlagen unterstützen.

  • Persönliche Begleitung im Projekteinsatz: Auch wenn dein Arbeitsalltag überwiegend im Kundenteam stattfindet, bleiben wir mit dir im Austausch und begleiten dich bei Fragen, Herausforderungen und deiner Entwicklung.

  • Ein Team, das sich auch persönlich trifft: Neben dem digitalen Austausch schaffen wir bewusst Raum für regionale Treffen und gemeinsames Coworking. Ein- bis zweimal im Jahr kommt das gesamte New-Monday-Team zusammen.

  • Zeit und Budget für deine Entwicklung: Wir fördern fachliche Weiterbildung und den Austausch im Team. Nach der Probezeit steht dir dafür ein Weiterbildungsbudget von 1.000 € zur Verfügung.

  • Entwicklung mit Perspektive: Wir arbeiten aktuell an einem Karriereentwicklungsplan, der Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und nächste Schritte bei New Monday transparenter machen soll. Deine eigenen Ziele und Interessen besprechen wir regelmäßig mit dir.

  • 30 Tage Urlaub und zusätzlich zwei Tage für unsere Team-Events.

So geht es weiter

  • Erstes Kennenlernen: Wir erzählen dir mehr über New Monday, die Rolle und das Kundenprojekt. Du berichtest uns von deiner Erfahrung und kannst alle Fragen stellen, die dir wichtig sind.

  • Vertiefender Austausch: Wir sprechen ausführlicher über deine bisherigen Projekte, deine Arbeitsweise und deine Erfahrung in der Business Analyse und im Requirements Engineering.

  • Kennenlernen im Kundenprojekt: Wenn es für beide Seiten passt, stellen wir dich beim Kunden vor. Dort lernst du das Projektumfeld und die beteiligten Ansprechpartner kennen. Die weiteren Schritte stimmen wir transparent mit dir ab.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf – auch wenn du nicht jede Anforderung vollständig erfüllst!

New Monday fördert die Gleichstellung aller Beschäftigten. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität. Menschen mit Schwerbehinderung werden bei gleicher Eignung unter Berücksichtigung der Umstände des Einzelfalls bevorzugt.

title: Business Development Associate
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

Proxima will sell fusion electricity in the late 2030s. Proxima's Business Development team finds and executes business opportunities on the way there: inorganic (acquisitions, minority stakes and joint ventures in businesses synergetic with Proxima) and organic (new product lines built from Proxima assets). You will own opportunities along our Business Development playbook, from market scan to a clear go/no-go from leadership, with an initial focus on inorganic deals. You will work directly with the Business Development Lead and the Head of Business Operations, within the CFO organization, and alongside engineering, finance, legal, and supply chain teams.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own the front of the deal funnel: Build market reports, competitive landscapes, and company mappings that shape where Proxima invests.

descriptionHtml:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced outbound sales professional to join our direct sales team to qualify and convert leads in a fast paced and fun environment. You'll benefit from an uncapped commission structure, giving you full control over your earnings. OTE of £78k-£83k, with even higher earning potential available through promotion.

As a Business Development Executive you’ll build a high quality pipeline of prospects and generate revenue by making outbound calls, booking meetings, following up with customers, using Social Selling tools, and much more. Each interaction with a potential new customer is unique, and requires focus as well as solo thinking. How you manage your pipeline will make a significant difference in hitting your KPIs. If you are successful, the opportunity to grow and develop as a sales professional is unbounded.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Building and nurturing a high quality lead pipeline by making a high volume of outbound calls, and occasionally dealing with inbound queries, at all times representing the company in a highly professional manner

  • Identifying and qualifying prospects that might have a need for business finance

  • Communicating the iwoca value proposition in a precise and compelling way to engage and convert prospects

  • Going above and beyond in your efforts to hit and exceed your KPIs; this will enable us to beat sales growth targets

  • Working as a team player, and helping improve the overall success of this exciting part of the business.

The requirements

We look for people who are smart, humble, motivated and who are always looking to improve.

Ideally you'll:

  • Have past experience in sales, ideally within financial services

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

descriptionHtml:
Big changes start with people who want to achieve more.

How do employees get to work? Why do company cars sit idle while parking spaces are scarce? And how can we make sustainable mobility the most attractive choice?

At Urban Connect, we turn these challenges into practical solutions. We bring shared e-bikes and company cars, public transport, mobility budgets and digital parking management together on one platform. We help companies reduce costs, make better use of resources and give their employees greater freedom.

Companies such as Roche, Google, SWISS and Lonza already rely on us. Our ambition goes further: we want to transform how companies manage mobility.

To make that happen, we are looking for curious minds who take ownership and want to make a difference together.

Want to understand how a technology company grows—and help make it happen?

During this six-month internship, you will work closely with our Sales and Account Management team, as well as Product and Operations. You will learn to understand customer needs, develop compelling solutions and turn data into tangible business opportunities.

Your initiative matters. You will contribute your own ideas, take on increasing responsibility and see the impact of your work.

How you will make a difference

  • Turn data into opportunities: analyse usage and market data, including vehicle and parking utilisation, and translate your findings into recommendations for better corporate mobility solutions.

  • Drive your own projects: Work with the team lead to take ownership of clearly defined projects, such as analysing products, assessing sales opportunities and developing corporate mobility concepts.

  • Understand the product: learn how customers are set up on our platform, how bookings and billing work, and how vehicles and parking barriers are connected.

  • Work smarter with AI: use AI tools thoughtfully, test new applications and help us improve research, analysis and everyday processes.

  • Help drive growth: identify prospective customers, research their challenges and support the team in winning new business and expanding existing partnerships.

  • Make a compelling case: create clear presentations, well-founded proposals and insightful quarterly reviews that demonstrate the value of our solutions.

  • Keep things moving: maintain accurate customer data and activities in HubSpot, ensuring good conversations lead to clear next steps.

  • Connect teams: resolve technical questions with the Product, Operations and Technology teams and communicate the answers clearly to customers and the Commercial team.

What you bring

  • An excellent degree, for example in business, economics, data science, engineering or industrial engineering. We are looking for excellence, curiosity, creativity and courage - not to have studied a perfect subject.

  • Some practical experience through an internship, part-time job, personal project or entrepreneurial initiative.

  • An analytical mindset, confidence with Excel and the ability to understand and communicate complex ideas and interdependencies clearly and simply.

  • Ability to think outside of the box and to question conventional ways of doing things.

  • Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot - and the excellent judgement to critically assess their output. In fact, good judgment is a key criterion for success with us.

  • An interest in technological progress, the curiosity to truly understand how things work, and the confidence to contribute your questions and ideas to a highly motivated team.

Above all, we value your mindset: you learn quickly, ask thoughtful questions and think ahead. You take initiative, develop suggestions and seek support when you need it. You care about the details, strive to make good work even better and are willing to take a risk sometimes to try something new - even when that means making a mistake and learning from it.

What you can expect

High standards - and an environment of smart, kind people to challenge you to grow.
We are ambitious, give direct, constructive feedback and support one another. Excellence shows up in our everyday work: in thoughtful solutions, careful execution and the drive to keep improving.

A view of the whole business.
You will work at the intersection of sales, customer success, technology and operations, learning how an idea becomes a solution that customers value.

Direct access and room to take initiative.
Good ideas get heard quickly here. Your responsibility grows with your capabilities and commitment.

The opportunity to build a future with us.

You will also benefit from:

Ready to make a difference?

We look forward to meeting you.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

  • Early-Stage Engagement & Demos: Initiate and lead early-stage conversations with prospects and partners. Confidently deliver compelling product demos that showcase our value proposition.

  • Marketplace & Tech Partner Lead Gen: Drive proactive lead generation and demand-gen activities through AWS and Google Cloud marketplaces.

  • Cloud Ecosystem Awareness: A solid working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, and/or Microsoft Azure) and how cloud marketplaces operate.

Our Values
