We want someone pragmatic and front-footed: comfortable rolling up their sleeves, able to explain the big picture and the detail at the same time, opinionated about where value is created, and excited to use AI to make finance faster, sharper and more strategic.

What you'll own

  • Being the CEO's right hand on all things financial, commercial and strategic

  • Bringing rigour and a fresh lens to growth decisions

  • Commercial deal-making support: pricing, contract economics, and the numbers behind new site and client decisions

  • Building and owning budgeting, forecasting and FP&A

  • The forward-looking board pack and investor reporting that leadership and shareholders use to make decisions

  • The KPIs and financial dashboards that connect day-to-day operations to financial outcomes

  • Cash flow, capex, working capital and scenario planning as the business scales

  • Building, leading and developing the finance team, including growing existing talent toward more senior roles

  • The processes, controls and systems a scaling business needs, without bureaucracy that slows it down

  • Partnering with the CEO and investors on fundraising, refinancing and M&A / corporate development

  • Banking, treasury and key financial partner relationships

  • A front-footed approach to AI and automation across reporting, forecasting, reconciliation and analysis

Who we're looking for

  • You've led finance before, or you're ready for your first shot and can prove it. A strong FD/Head of Finance ready to step up, or an early second-time CFO who wants to build rather than inherit. Either way, you can walk us through a function you built, not just one you worked inside.

  • You're commercial, not just technical. You read the business, not just the ledger, and have a view on where value is created and where it leaks.

  • You can build FP&A from scratch. Modelling, forecasting, scenario planning: the forward view is your craft, not something you outsource.

  • You're hands-on. You'll build it yourself before you delegate it, and you're not above the detail.

  • You're front-footed on tech and AI in finance. You already use modern tooling to make a lean function punch above its weight.

  • You make numbers land with people who don't live in them. A founder, an ops lead and an investor in the same room, each hearing what the numbers mean for them.

  • You're comfortable stepping outside the finance lane and getting involved directly with clients and suppliers.

  • Experience in a marketplace, proptech, paytech, or subscription/usage-based B2B business

  • Direct experience leading or closely supporting a fundraise, refinancing or M&A process

  • Presenting to a board and/or investor syndicate, not just internal stakeholders

What we offer

  • Real ownership. You own the function, the plan and the numbers, and you're in the room for every growth decision.

  • Real mission. Our tech is quietly reshaping how the physical world of parking and mobility works.

  • Meaningful upside. A competitive package with a meaningful bonus and equity tied to what you build.

Why Hozah?

At Hozah, you'll play a pivotal role in a purpose-driven company at the forefront of urban mobility innovation. We foster a culture of collaboration, creativity and positive impact, where your contributions help shape the future of smarter cities. If you're looking to make a real difference in the future of mobility (and enjoy our friendly office dogs), we'd love to hear from you.

title: Chief Information Security Officer
descriptionHtml:
Make security the reason people trust Ockto

Own security at the platform people use to share their most personal data

Every day, people use Ockto to share their identity, income, assets and bank data: when they apply for a mortgage, rent a home or take out a lease. Banks and other large organisations choose Ockto partly because of the level of assurance we offer around that data. At Ockto, security is not a support function. It is part of the product and organisational culture.

As our CISO, you make sure it stays that way as we grow. Part of that growth is adopting an AI driven operating model with strong guardrails. You own Ockto's security programme, from risk and controls to incidents, suppliers and audits. You set the standard, check that it is met, and make security measurable in a way that the whole organisation (and specifically our engineers and spec leads), clients, auditors and regulators all recognise. You do this with a real mandate and short lines to the people who decide.

What you'll do

You own the information security programme of a supervised financial company and make it work in daily practice, not just on paper. As CISO, you:

  • Own Ockto's ISMS and security policy framework, and keep our ISO 27001 certification (held since 2017) and our SOC 2 assurance current and credible.

  • Translate the risk appetite set by management into a security strategy, an annual plan and clear standards that teams can build to.

  • Keep Ockto ahead of what's coming. You track developments such as eIDAS2 and the EU Digital Identity Wallet, NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and the AI Act, assess what they mean for Ockto and our clients, and translate them into our security strategy and standards in time.

  • Verify and challenge. Our engineering teams operate the technical controls; you check that they work and that findings get fixed. You approve risk acceptance for serious vulnerabilities and commission penetration tests. All control owners are challenged and prepared to show evidence and reproduce controls.

  • Lead the response to security and privacy incidents, approve notifications to regulators, and make sure root causes lead to structural fixes.

  • Manage security risk in our supply chain, from onboarding new suppliers to the annual review of critical ones, in line with DORA.

  • Make sure our continuity and recovery arrangements are tested and hold up, together with Engineering.

  • Make security measurable. We judge it by how quickly and how structurally we resolve what we find, not by counting incidents.

  • Represent Ockto's security towards clients, auditors and supervisors: from a bank's due diligence questionnaire to our external audits and contact with DNB and AFM.

  • Build a security-aware culture with an awareness programme people actually remember.

Who you work with

You report to our Product & Trust Director, who sets Ockto's trust framework and risk appetite. Within that framework, the security strategy and its execution are yours. On security matters you also have a direct line to our CEO, and you are involved early in the product and architecture decisions that shape our risk. Our Information Security Officer is part of your team and runs day-to-day control monitoring with you.

You also work closely with our Engineering Director and the value stream teams that build and run the Ockto platform. They operate the technical controls as the first line; you set the requirements, verify and challenge as the second.

Outside Ockto, you work with the security, risk and procurement teams of our clients and with our external auditors. For audits you are the first line of planning, execution and communication with the auditor(s). Together with the Product & Trust Director, you are Ockto's security contact for DNB and AFM.


What you bring

You combine depth in security with the judgement to apply it pragmatically in a scale-up. We're looking for someone who:

• Has 8+ years of experience in information security, including at least 3 years leading a security function as CISO, Head of Security or similar.

• Has run an ISMS end to end and taken an organisation through ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II audits.

• Knows regulated financial services and works comfortably with DORA, PSD2, GDPR and supervision by DNB or AFM.

• Has solid grounding in cloud security, preferably AWS, and enough technical understanding to challenge engineers and judge designs.

• Thinks in risk: turns threats into priorities, and weighs security against cost and delivery speed.

• Communicates clearly at every level, from the management team and auditors to developers and a client's security officer.

• Is independent and principled: comfortable saying no, and good at finding the route to yes.

• Speaks and writes English fluently; Dutch is a strong advantage.

Will be a plus:

• CISSP, CISM, CCSP or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer certification.

• Experience with privacy governance and DPIAs.

• Experience leading incident response, including notification to regulators.

• Experience with third-party risk management and assurance reporting such as ISAE 3402 or ISAE 3000.

• Familiarity with digital identity, eIDAS2 and EU digital identity wallets.

• Experience governing the safe use of AI tooling in a data-sensitive environment.

What you get

You get a role with real influence on how far clients, supervisors and consumers can trust Ockto.

• Ownership of security at a company where assurance is one of the reasons clients choose us.

• A real mandate: a direct line to the CEO on security matters, a voice early in product and architecture decisions, and the final word on accepting serious security risk.

• Influence on what we build next, as Ockto grows into new markets and propositions.

• Short lines and room to shape the security function the way it should work.

• Experienced colleagues across product, engineering and compliance.

Ockto also offers:

• A good salary: between €5500,- and €6800,- per month, depending on experience

• Room and budget for personal and professional development

• A MacBook Pro and smartphone of choice

• Phone and travel allowance

• Great home and remote working facilities

• Lunch fee

• Plenty of activities, including our annual ski trip, a 1.5-day team offsite, drinks and team outings

You'll join a team that values diversity and collaboration, in a friendly, ambitious and innovative atmosphere.

About Ockto

Ockto is the leading platform for future-proof wallet services. For more than ten years we have been taking the friction out of sharing, verifying and enriching personal data, so that organisations and people can trust each other faster, based on the right information. From our office in Naarden, a team of specialists builds data-driven customer journeys that are right the first time.

Ockto. Built for trust.

Ready to join?

Do you see yourself as our new CISO? Then apply directly. After you apply, we'll contact you within five working days to discuss the role and answer your questions.

Want to know more first? Contact us at company culture, core values and recruitment process, or our other vacancies? Take a look at ockto.recruitee.com.

Your data is safe

At Ockto, we only use your CV and motivation letter during the application process to assess your application. If we don't proceed, we keep your application data for four weeks.

Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities. With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte's Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we're one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

Key Responsibilities

title: Chief of Staff or Founders Associate
descriptionHtml:
About Grubel

Grubel is a research lab that builds AI for high-stakes knowledge work, starting with law. Legal matters require specialized expertise, and each one involves its own facts, practices, parties, and institutions. General-purpose AI applies the same system to every legal matter, varying only what goes into a limited context window.

To meet the depth and diversity of legal work, we let every matter build its own AI: engineer the right data for the matter, adapt the model and agent to it, and track what improves. We combine the three into a matter-specific improvement loop that runs until the system delivers what the matter demands.

Grubel was founded in 2026 by Moritz Hardt, director at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems and formerly a UC Berkeley professor and Google Brain researcher; and Reinhard Heckel, professor of machine learning at the Technical University of Munich, on leave to build Grubel. The founding team includes engineers with PhDs in computer science and experience in foundation-model pretraining at Mistral and legal AI research at Thomson Reuters. The lab has offices in Munich and Tübingen.

Point Nine led an oversubscribed pre-seed funding round with backing from leading AI researchers and founders, including Jeff Dean, Chris Ré, Ion Stoica, and Harvey co-founders Gabe Pereyra and Winston Weinberg.

About the role

We are looking for a Founders Associate or Chief of Staff to help build and run the operations of a young company and to automate them as we go. We will hire one person for this role. The title and scope depend on your experience: as a Founders Associate you will work alongside the founders on the operations; as Chief of Staff you will own key operational areas.

We want to build Grubel the way we build our products: with AI agents doing significant work. Your job is to help make the company run and to ask which parts of it should be run by software instead.

You will work directly with the founders on everything it takes to build the company: hiring, finance, legal and corporate housekeeping across our German and US entities, funding programs, investor communication, and the tools and processes that hold it all together. This is a broad, hands-on role for someone who wants to learn how a company is built from the inside, or who has done it before and wants to do it again with better tools.

What you'll work on

  • Running our hiring process, from job postings and candidate communication to contracts and onboarding

  • Keeping our German and US entities in order: accounting, payroll, and corporate paperwork

  • Managing public funding programs and preparing investor updates

  • Setting up the tools our team runs on, and building AI agents that take over routine operations

  • Supporting the founders on projects that do not fit anywhere else, from offsites to partnership contracts

You may be a good fit if

  • You have a degree in business, economics, law, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience

  • You have worked in a startup, consulting firm, or another fast-moving environment. You may be early in your career with exceptional evidence of ownership, or more experienced and ready to help build a company’s operations from scratch

  • You are organized, reliable, and happy to own tasks nobody has done before

  • You already use AI tools heavily in your own work and want to push that much further

  • You communicate well in English and German

Logistics

  • Location: Munich. This role is primarily on-site, with flexibility for individual days at home.

  • Full time employment

  • Competitive salary plus participation in our employee stock option program in Grubel, Inc., our US parent company.

In 2024, we implemented an organizational structure built around business 'tracks'. This approach integrates key stakeholders across marketing, sales, product, and customer care into unified teams focused on specific product lines or client segments. Each track operates as a mini-business, empowered with dedicated resources (e.g., product marketing, data analytics, and operational support) and direct accountability for performance.

 

Why this role exists

Pennylane is one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs, building the financial operating system for SMBs and their accountants. As the company grows, the quality of its execution depends increasingly on how well its leadership team sets priorities, makes decisions, and follows through across the organization.
This role makes that system work. You’ll work directly with the VP Strategic Initiatives and closely with the executive committee to bring structure and momentum to Pennylane’s most important company-wide rhythms, from OKRs and leadership meetings to cross-functional steering and Board preparation.

This is not a traditional strategy role or a position observing executives from the sidelines. It is a high-leverage operating role for someone who enjoys creating clarity, improving how teams work together, and making sure important decisions turn into action.

 

What you'll own

You’ll help the executive team operate with greater focus, clarity, and consistency. That means:

  • Running our leadership rhythms. Structure the agendas, preparation, and follow-through for key executive and leadership forums. Make sure the right topics are discussed at the right time and that decisions, owners, and next steps are clear

  • Turning priorities into an operating cadence. Help coordinate the definition, cascade, and tracking of company OKRs. Maintain a clear view of progress and surface misalignment or execution risks early

  • Strengthening cross-functional follow-through. Bring consistency to how major company initiatives are reviewed through steering committees and executive reporting—without replacing the leaders accountable for delivering them

  • Preparing high-stakes moments. Coordinate the materials and inputs required for Board meetings, executive offsites, annual planning, and company-wide communications

  • Improving the system. Identify where information gets lost, decisions stall, or responsibilities are unclear, and design lightweight processes that help the organization move faster

Who we're looking for

  • Outstanding organizational judgment—you can distinguish what requires executive attention from what should be resolved elsewhere

  • A structured, concise communicator who can turn complex and fragmented inputs into a clear agenda, decision, or executive-level document

  • Strong interpersonal skills and low ego. You are comfortable coordinating senior stakeholders, challenging constructively, and creating accountability without relying on formal authority

  • High attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger picture. You anticipate what is needed, close loops, and reliably follow through

  • Comfortable operating behind the scenes and measuring success through the effectiveness of the broader team

  • Fluent in French and English

This role is designed as a launchpad into a broader operating position at Pennylane. It is a strong fit for someone early in an ambitious career who wants unusual exposure to how a scale-up operates and is motivated to turn that exposure into tangible organizational impact.

As Chief of Staff to the CTO, you will act as the CTO's deputy in the internal programme and product forums, sitting in the rooms where technical decisions are made on their behalf. You will understand how our programmes actually run, spot bottlenecks before they materialise, and drive the teams that hit them back onto a credible path.

  • Take ownership of programmes that have drifted, define the corrective path and get them back on track
  • Provide the CTO with a technically grounded, unfiltered view of programme health and the risks that are not yet visible in the plans

  • Technically credible enough to follow a design review, a production-readiness argument and an AIT non-conformance, without pretending to be the deepest expert in the room

title: Client Delivery Lead (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Was wir tun: Wir entwickeln die innovativste, zukunftsorientierteste und am stärksten KI-gestützte Plattform für Energiemanagement. Von der Ressourcenoptimierung bis hin zu herausragenden, kosteneffizienten Kundenerlebnissen: Mit modernen Kundeninformationssystemen (CIS), Abrechnung, Messdatenmanagement, CRM und KI-gestützter Kommunikation treibt Kraken die nächste Innovationswelle in der Energiebranche voran.

Warum wir das tun: Die Energieversorgung der Zukunft wird anders aussehen als die, die wir heute kennen. Wir müssen über unsere Zukunft nicht nur nachdenken, sondern sie aktiv gestalten. Jetzt.

Seit über vier Jahren lizenzieren wir Kraken und unterstützen Unternehmen bei ihrer Transformation. Dabei übertragen wir nicht nur ihren Kundenstamm auf unsere Kraken-Plattform, sondern verändern auch ihre Betriebsmodelle und Arbeitsweisen. In dieser Zeit hat unser Team wegweisende Migrationen in der Branche vorangetrieben und neue Maßstäbe dafür gesetzt, wie Unternehmenstransformation aussehen kann.

🏠 Deine Rolle bei uns:

Du wirst Teil des Client-Delivery-Teams bei Kraken und begleitest europäische Kunden auf ihrem Weg durch die technologische Transformation. Dabei unterstützt du langfristige Migrationsprojekte.

Als Client Delivery Lead verantwortest du einen technologischen Fachbereich, beispielsweise Abrechnung, Finanzen oder Kommunikation, innerhalb unserer Kundenprojekte. Dabei geht es entweder um die Migration auf unsere Kraken-Plattform oder um die Betreuung langfristiger technologischer Anforderungen. Du arbeitest eng mit den technischen und operativen Teams von Kraken sowie mit dem Kunden zusammen, um die jeweiligen Projekt- und Geschäftsziele zu erreichen.

Als Client Delivery Lead musst du genau verstehen, wie Kraken funktioniert. Du analysierst die vom Kunden gemeldeten Probleme und Anforderungen und konkretisierst passende Lösungen, um bestehende und neue Funktionen optimal zu nutzen. Du bringst Technologie, Menschen und Prozesse zusammen, um innovative Verbesserungen für unsere Kunden zu ermöglichen. Außerdem unterstützt du den Kunden dabei, Arbeitsweisen einzuführen, die zum Entwicklungsansatz von Kraken passen. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Produktmanagern und Entwicklern zusammen, bringst Entwicklungsanforderungen ein und bildest die Schnittstelle zum Kunden.

🚀 Dafür übernimmst du Verantwortung:

  • Du betreust die Beziehungen zu deinen Ansprechpartnern auf Kundenseite, häufig Product Owner und fachlich Verantwortliche.

  • Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für technische Weiterentwicklungen sowie für die Eskalation und Lösung von Problemen in deinem jeweiligen Fach- oder Produktbereich.

  • Du bist die zentrale Wissensquelle dafür, wie Kraken funktioniert und wie wir die Kraken-Plattform bereitstellen.

  • Du sichtest und priorisierst eingehende Anfragen und kommunizierst die Prioritäten der Kunden intern.

  • Du fasst Kundenanforderungen, relevante Rahmenbedingungen und Zeitpläne zusammen und vermittelst sie intern, um die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Kraken-Plattform zu ermöglichen.

  • Du unterstützt das Entwicklungsteam bei der Umsetzung von Produktfunktionen.

  • Du regst Kunden dazu an, technische Entwicklung neu zu denken, und vertrittst unseren Ansatz der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung und Bereitstellung mit Überzeugung.

Dies ist eine praxisorientierte Fachrolle ohne Personalverantwortung. Dein Arbeitsstandort liegt in Europa; deine Projekte können in unterschiedlichen Ländern angesiedelt sein. Reisebereitschaft wird vorausgesetzt.

Wir sind eine agile Organisation mit flachen Hierarchien und möchten das auch bleiben. Wir suchen aufgeschlossene Menschen, die mit Unklarheiten und einem sich ständig verändernden Umfeld gut umgehen können. Um bei uns erfolgreich zu sein, solltest du eigeninitiativ handeln und bereit sein, selbst mit anzupacken, um Probleme zu lösen. Dabei gehst du regelmäßig über deinen üblichen Aufgabenbereich hinaus, um unsere Kunden und unsere Organisation voranzubringen.

Du stehst hinter dem Kraken-Ansatz zur Technologieentwicklung, der auf Einfachheit, Kundennutzen und Effizienz beruht, und begleitest die beteiligten Interessengruppen durch den Veränderungsprozess.

Du bist bereit, bestehende Überzeugungen zu hinterfragen, unterschiedliche Perspektiven einzunehmen und bei Bedarf auch über deinen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich hinauszugehen, um den Kunden zu unterstützen.

Wir entwickeln Kraken für alle: eine universelle Plattform, bei der gemeinsam genutzte Weiterentwicklungen einen größeren Nutzen schaffen und die grüne Energiewende ermöglichen. Als Pioniere auf diesem Gebiet begeistert uns, wie Kraken das Leben unserer Kunden verändern kann. Wir sind überzeugt, dass Kraken die beste Lösung ist – sowohl für mehr Effizienz als auch als Werkzeug im Kampf gegen die Klimakrise. Wenn du diese Überzeugung teilst, bist du bei Kraken Tech genau richtig.

🧠 Das bringst du mit:

  • In dieser Position steht die Erfüllung der Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden für dich im Mittelpunkt. Wir suchen Menschen mit ausgeprägter Problemlösungskompetenz und einer durchweg positiven, lösungsorientierten Einstellung. Wenn du Herausforderungen gerne annimmst und den Ehrgeiz hast, erfolgreich zu sein, passt diese Position zu dir! Deine Haltung: „Jedes Problem hat eine Lösung. Neue Herausforderungen sind spannend, weil wir durch sie jeden Tag besser werden. Und je größer die Herausforderung, desto größer das Erfolgserlebnis.“

  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Kundenprojekten und/oder als Product Owner.

  • Erfahrung mit agilen Umsetzungsmethoden.

  • Erfahrung im Produktmanagement und mit Customer Journeys.

  • Ein solides Verständnis von Technologie und den damit verbundenen Trends.

  • Hervorragende Kommunikations-, Team- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten.

  • Überzeugungskraft und die Fähigkeit, traditionelle Denkweisen zu hinterfragen.

  • Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit umfangreichen, komplexen Projekt- und Umsetzungspipelines für Kunden.

  • Geduld und Eigeninitiative: Unsere Kunden durchlaufen tiefgreifende Veränderungen, die Zeit brauchen und unser Verständnis erfordern.

  • Gutes Zeitmanagement und eine tatkräftige, ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise.

  • Beratungserfahrung ist von Vorteil.

  • Fließende Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse.

  • Vorerfahrung in Buchhaltung und Abrechnung oder im Zahlungsverkehr sowie Kenntnisse in FI/CO sind von Vorteil.

Da wir ein internationales Unternehmen sind, bitten wir dich, deinen Lebenslauf auf Englisch einzureichen und die Fragen in deiner Bewerbung auf Englisch zu beantworten.

Wenn du dich darin wiedererkennst, freuen wir uns darauf, von dir zu hören.

title: Client Service Director
descriptionHtml:
Wat gebeurt er als je strategisch klantpartnerschap, technologie, dienstverlening en ontwikkeling samenbrengt in één rol? Dan krijg je een functie waarin je écht het verschil kunt maken voor de grootste retailklanten van Centric.

Als Client Service Director ben jij de drijvende kracht achter het succes van onze belangrijkste klantrelaties. Je begrijpt de business van de klant, denkt strategisch mee en zorgt dat ambities worden vertaald naar concrete resultaten. Je verbindt mensen, stuurt op kwaliteit en voortgang en houdt grip op zowel de dienstverlening als de financiële prestaties.

Wat jij doet

Als Client Service Director ben je verantwoordelijk voor het totale succes van jouw klantrelaties. Je bent de strategische gesprekspartner voor grote retailklanten en zorgt ervoor dat klantbehoeften, dienstverlening, projecten en commerciële doelstellingen samenkomen. Je overziet het geheel, verbindt de juiste mensen en neemt de regie wanneer dat nodig is. Van strategisch advies en klanttevredenheid tot operationele voortgang en financiële resultaten: jij zorgt voor samenhang, grip en resultaat.

  • Strategisch klantpartnerschap: je bouwt aan duurzame relaties met grote retailklanten en bent hun gesprekspartner op directie- en managementniveau. Je begrijpt hun strategie, uitdagingen en ambities en vertaalt deze naar concrete oplossingen en kansen.

  • Regie op dienstverlening: je bewaakt de kwaliteit, continuïteit en prestaties van de dienstverlening op het gebied van hardware en services. Je zorgt dat afspraken worden nagekomen en dat de dienstverlening aansluit op de verwachtingen van de klant.

  • Programmamanagement en projectregie: je houdt overzicht over meerdere projecten, programma’s en verbeterinitiatieven. Je bewaakt de samenhang, planning, voortgang, risico’s en resultaten en zorgt dat betrokken teams gezamenlijk naar hetzelfde doel werken.

  • Klanttevredenheid en escalatiemanagement: je signaleert knelpunten voordat ze escaleren, neemt de regie wanneer zaken vastlopen en zorgt voor duidelijke afspraken en opvolging. Je vertaalt klantfeedback naar structurele verbeteringen.

  • Samenwerking en stakeholdermanagement: je verbindt de klant met de verschillende teams binnen Centric, waaronder delivery, projectmanagement, techniek, commercie en finance. Je creëert duidelijkheid over prioriteiten, verantwoordelijkheden en resultaten en spreekt betrokkenen aan waar nodig.

  • Financiële verantwoordelijkheid en forecasting: je bewaakt de financiële performance van jouw accounts, waaronder omzet, marges, kosten en contractuele afspraken. Je borgt een actuele en betrouwbare forecast, analyseert afwijkingen en stuurt bij op basis van ontwikkelingen in de dienstverlening, projecten en klantbehoeften.

  • Commerciële ontwikkeling en groei: je signaleert kansen om de samenwerking uit te breiden met aanvullende hardware, services en oplossingen. Je vertaalt klantbehoeften naar concrete proposities en businesscases en werkt samen met commerciële collega's aan duurzame groei en rendement.

  • Continu verbeteren en vooruitkijken: je kijkt kritisch naar de samenwerking, processen en dienstverlening. Je initieert verbeteringen, adviseert over toekomstige behoeften en zorgt dat Centric zich blijft ontwikkelen als strategische partner van de klant.

Dit krijg je

Bij Centric kun je als Client Service Director rekenen op:

  • Een brutosalaris tussen de €6.500,- en €8.000,- per maand afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring

  • Mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken en een goede werk-privébalans doordat je de ruimte krijgt om te bepalen hoe jij jouw werkweek indeelt

  • Uitgebreide opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden

  • 26 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantietoeslag (uitbetaling in mei) en loyaliteitsdagen: hoe langer je in dienst bent, hoe meer vrije tijd

  • Een bijdrage aan je pensioen en korting op je collectieve zorgverzekering

  • Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak

  • Een thuiswerkplekvergoeding van € 15,- per maand plus € 2,45 netto per thuiswerkdag en een reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer van € 0,25 netto per kilometer óf een NS Businesscard

  • Personeelsaanbiedingen bij toonaangevende merken

  • Een bonus tot € 1.500,- als jij een nieuwe collega aan ons voorstelt

  • Een personeelsvereniging die écht leuke dingen organiseert. Ga je mee naar Praag, de Efteling of skiën?

Dit breng je mee

Je bent een ervaren professional die klantgerichtheid, strategisch inzicht en resultaatgerichtheid combineert. Je begrijpt dat grote retailklanten vragen om meer dan goed accountmanagement. Je moet hun business kennen, complexe dienstverlening kunnen overzien en in staat zijn om mensen, processen, projecten en financiële doelstellingen met elkaar te verbinden.

Je neemt eigenaarschap, houdt overzicht wanneer belangen uiteenlopen en durft beslissingen te nemen wanneer bijsturing nodig is. Je beweegt je gemakkelijk op directieniveau, maar hebt ook oog voor de dagelijkse praktijk en weet hoe je plannen vertaalt naar concrete resultaten.

Daarnaast breng je mee:

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met grote retailklanten. Dit is een harde eis. Je kent de dynamiek van grotere retailorganisaties en begrijpt hoe technologie, hardware en IT-dienstverlening bijdragen aan de continuïteit van hun bedrijfsvoering.

  • Ervaring met strategisch accountmanagement, service delivery, programmamanagement of een vergelijkbare integrale klantverantwoordelijkheid.

  • Ervaring met het coördineren van complexe dienstverlening, projecten en verschillende stakeholders.

  • Financieel inzicht en ervaring met budgetbewaking, omzet- en margeontwikkeling en forecasting.

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om te schakelen tussen directie, management en operationele teams.

  • Een proactieve en resultaatgerichte instelling: je signaleert risico’s, ziet kansen en zorgt dat afspraken worden nagekomen.

Het maken van een assessment kan onderdeel uitmaken van deze sollicitatieprocedure.

Omring jezelf met mogelijkheden bij Centric

Voor meer informatie over de functie kun je contact opnemen met onze Recruiter Kimberley Vermeulen via +31 6 1072 4584 of via
Hier starten jouw kansen
Zonder dat je het misschien weet, ben je al eens met Centric in aanraking geweest. Als je betaalt in de winkel. Als je een glas kraanwater drinkt. Als je een paspoort aanvraagt. Duizenden organisaties en hun miljoenen klanten rekenen elke dag weer op onze 200+ technologische oplossingen, hoogwaardige IT-diensten en 3.700 gekwalificeerde professionals. Samen zorgen we dat belangrijke processen in onze samenleving altijd doordraaien.

Zodra je Centric komt versterken, omring jij jezelf met mogelijkheden. Zo kun je jouw kennis vergroten door samen te werken met de ongeveer 300 collega’s van Centric Retail & Logistiek. Als partner van bedrijven binnen Retail, Logistiek, Transport, Bouw en Financiële instellingen zorgen wij er dagelijks voor dat magazijnen goed gevuld blijven, supermarkten en winkels bevoorraad worden en honderdduizenden klanten hun dagelijkse boodschappen en andere aankopen naadloos kunnen afrekenen. Maar ook dat vrachtwagens zo optimaal mogelijk beladen en geoptimaliseerde routes rijden, bouwbedrijven inzicht hebben in hun projectplanning en resources en dat financiële instellingen snel kredietrisico’s kunnen inschatten met onze risk solutions. Kortom, een rol binnen Centric Retail & Logistiek geeft je de mogelijkheid om een concrete bijdrage te leveren aan sectoren die impact hebben en maken op de maatschappij!

title: Clinical AI Research Lead
descriptionHtml:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

Heidi is building AI that works at the frontier of clinical practice. As we pursue medical device registration and expand our clinical trial portfolio and product portfolio, we need someone who can hold the full arc from regulatory strategy to research protocol to working prototypes and translate across all of them.

This role is designed for a rare profile: clinically trained, technically capable, and research-rigorous. You will own the innovation pipeline from problem identification through validated prototype, coordinate the company's clinical research programme, and serve as the internal bridge between product, regulation, and evidence. You will operate as a senior individual contributor with a small specialist team and broad cross-functional mandate.

 

What you’ll do

Research & Evidence Programme

  • Lead and support clinical trials and pilots adjacent to product development and regulation from protocol through analysis and dissemination

  • Design evaluations with research/publication-grade rigour: statistical power, confounder control, reproducible methodology

  • Provide analytical support company-wide - elevating ad hoc analysis to defensible evidence

Regulatory & Compliance Intelligence

  • Translate evolving UK and international medical device regulation into actionable product and development constraints

  • Generate and maintain technical documentation, clinical evaluation reports, and post-market surveillance artefacts - directly analytically supporting the regulatory team.

  • Partner with compliance to ensure regulatory soundness is built in, not bolted on, a strategic moat, not a checklist

  • Serve as the accessible regulatory resource for product, engineering, models and commercial teams: making regulation legible, usable and deeply embedded into all engineering practices.

  • This role is strategic support, and ownership of all product and regulatory adjacent research activities with a strong supporting team to drive progress and delivery.

Cross-functional AI & Research Support

  • Act as a senior research partner to product squads, commercial teams, and leadership, providing evidence, framing decisions, and raising analytical standards

  • Supporting commercial requests with tender applications etc…

 

What you'll need

Clinical

  • Qualified clinician with active understanding of clinical workflow, risk, and patient safety

  • Experience in medical device or clinical AI evaluation, including familiarity with MHRA, UKCA, and/or EU MDR frameworks

Research

  • Postgraduate research training in a relevant field (clinical informatics, AI/ML, health data science, or similar)

  • Demonstrated ability to design, execute, and disseminate clinical or applied research independently

  • Fluency in quantitative methods: statistical modelling, NLP evaluation, speech analytics, and performance benchmarking

  • Skills in implementation science and translational projects involving new technologies

Leadership & Communication

  • Strong written communication, capable of producing high-quality documentation for clinical, regulatory, and commercial audiences

  • Collaborative operator in a fast-moving environment; able to work across seniority levels and functions

  • Experience managing small teams or contractors; structured, outcome-oriented

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

 

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

We take care of you.

We offer 25 days of paid time off per year, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a €100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a €500 home office budget, a €700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to €7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year, Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

Heidi’s commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Heidi is dedicated to creating an equitable, inclusive, and supportive work environment that brings people together from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Our strength is in our differences. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are proud to welcome all applicants as we're committed to promoting a culture of opportunity for all.

title: Clinical Solutions Consultant
descriptionHtml:
About Rivia

Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.

Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated.

Over the past two years, European- and US-based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital.

Rivia's ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end.

The Role

As our Clinical Solutions Consultant, you'll be the bridge between science, technology, and sales, helping biotech and pharma companies understand how Rivia can transform the way they work with clinical trial data.

You'll partner closely with our Account Executives throughout the technical stages of the sales cycle, turning complex scientific and technical challenges into compelling product demonstrations, tailored sandboxes, and solutions that address real customer needs.

This isn't a role where you simply present slides or follow a demo script. You'll need to understand clinical trial workflows, get hands-on with data, challenge assumptions, and translate complex customer requirements into solutions we can actually deliver.

You'll also play an important role in shaping how we approach technical pre-sales at Rivia, building repeatable processes, improving our demo environments, and helping us scale without losing the scientific depth and customer understanding that make us different.

What Excites You

  • Bringing science and technology together: You love understanding complex scientific challenges and translating them into practical, impactful solutions.

  • Being hands-on: You don't just talk about what a product can do. You enjoy building demos, configuring sandboxes, working with data, and showing customers what's possible.

  • Making an impact on revenue: You enjoy being part of the sales process, influencing strategic deals, and helping customers confidently make decisions.

  • Solving real customer problems: You're curious about how biotech and pharma companies operate and enjoy finding creative ways to address their challenges.

  • Building from the ground up: You get excited about joining a growing company where you can shape processes, improve tools, and help establish how technical pre-sales should work.

  • Working across teams: You enjoy collaborating with Sales, Product, and Engineering, balancing commercial opportunities with technical feasibility.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with Account Executives as the scientific and technical expert throughout the sales process, helping prospects understand how Rivia can address their specific challenges.

  • Lead in-depth product demonstrations tailored to customers' clinical trial workflows, data structures, and scientific requirements.

  • Build and configure customized sandboxes, demo environments, and prototype integrations to demonstrate Rivia's value using realistic customer scenarios.

  • Understand customers' clinical trial pipelines, protocols, endpoints, and data challenges, translating their needs into practical technical solutions.

  • Scope prospective customer implementations, identifying technical requirements, dependencies, risks, and feasibility before commercial commitments are made.

  • Collaborate closely with Solutions Engineers and Customer Engagement to ensure smooth handovers from pre-sales to implementation.

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to both customers and internal teams, confidently addressing complex scientific questions while being transparent about product capabilities and limitations.

  • Adapt demonstrations and technical conversations to customers' familiarity with and readiness to adopt AI-driven solutions.

  • Identify recurring customer needs, technical objections, and product gaps, sharing insights with Product and Engineering to continuously improve our offering.

  • Help develop scalable pre-sales processes, reusable demo environments, and technical documentation as Rivia grows.

What Excites Us

  • Scientific background: You have a degree in life sciences, bioinformatics, biomedical engineering, or a related scientific discipline, and you're comfortable navigating complex scientific discussions.

  • Relevant experience: You bring at least 4 years of client-facing experience in solutions consulting, technical pre-sales, field application science, technical account management, or similar roles.

  • Scientific and technical fluency: You understand scientific data and experimental logic, and can quickly grasp complex clinical trial workflows and technical requirements.

  • Hands-on technical skills: You've personally built and configured product demos, sandboxes, or technical proof-of-concepts, rather than only presenting solutions developed by others.

  • Commercial mindset: You understand how technical expertise contributes to winning deals and enjoy working closely with sales teams to move opportunities forward.

  • Customer-facing confidence: You can communicate complex technical concepts clearly and credibly, whether you're speaking with scientists, clinical operations leaders, or technical stakeholders.

  • Strong ownership: You're proactive, independent, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where processes are still being built.

  • Collaborative approach: You know when to challenge assumptions, push back on unrealistic commitments, and work across teams to deliver the best outcomes for customers.

Bonus / Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in scientific software, clinical trial technology, biotech platforms, or laboratory informatics.

  • Familiarity with clinical trial protocols, endpoints, regulatory considerations, and clinical data integration.

  • Experience working with AI-driven products or communicating the value of AI to scientific and technical stakeholders.

Our Values

  • In It to Win It: Approach every challenge with determination, resilience, and a drive to achieve the best possible outcomes.

  • Embrace Change: We see change as an opportunity for growth, innovation, and improvement, continuously evolving to stay one step ahead.

  • Why Not?: We challenge assumptions, stay curious, and explore new possibilities rather than accepting things as they are.

  • Find the Gap: We proactively identify opportunities, anticipate challenges, and solve problems before they arise.

  • Collective Accountability: We're one team, on one mission, committed to shared responsibility, mutual support, and trust.

  • Value Add Solutions: Know better. Act better. We're dedicated to delivering meaningful solutions that create real impact.

title: Clinical Trial Manager - Contract 12 months
descriptionHtml:
🏨 The Company

Resilience Care, a leading player in remote medical monitoring and a partner in clinical research, is a French company founded in 2021 with a single mission: to provide better care.

Our company offers remote monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology, and psychiatry, based on the collection of ePROs combined with AI technologies. These solutions rely on a monitoring platform for healthcare professionals—enabling the early detection of side effects for continuous and proactive care—and a mobile app for patients, empowering them to measure and manage their symptoms using tailored resources.

Our solutions optimize patient care, continuously enrich our understanding of patients throughout their healthcare journey, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring, and in-depth analysis of real-world data. Today, our solutions are deployed in routine care for 35,000 patients across more than 200 healthcare facilities, as well as within the framework of around twenty academic and industrial clinical trials.

Through this, we put data at the service of healthcare and therapeutic innovation, driven by the ambition to enable every patient to benefit from personalized medicine.

📝 Your Role

In a few words

You will coordinate the operations of Resilience-sponsored and investigator-initiated studies across several therapeutic areas. Reporting to a Clinical Operations Lead (COPL), you will combine hands-on site oversight with regulatory and contractual coordination and improvements to clinical operations processes.

Your impact

Help sites deliver studies effectively: follow protocols, maintain up-to-date documentation and ensure data quality. You will connect the teams involved so that operational, regulatory and contractual activities progress together.

Your day to day

  • Coordinate day-to-day study operations and logistics, and support the planning and follow-up of site selection, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits.

  • Track site progress, study indicators and data quality, and share issues requiring attention during study meetings and governance committees.

  • Follow up on site agreements, amendments and budget annexes, and contribute to site budget tracking and payment follow-up with Legal and Finance.

  • Maintain regulatory documentation and the eTMF, support audit readiness and ensure compliance with GCP, applicable ICH guidelines, the French Jardé Law and GDPR.

  • Work with Clinical Scientists, Biostatistics and Product teams, and improve clinical operations trackers, standard operating procedures and templates.

✨ Your team

title: Cloud Engineer - Quantum Computing (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future.

We are looking for a Cloud Engineer (m/f/d) to join us in Hamburg or Siegen and build and operate the scalable, secure cloud platform that connects users with our trapped-ion quantum computers.

Responsibilities:

You will join our Quantum firmware Team as a Cloud Engineer. You will build the layer through which the world reaches our quantum computers. Users submit quantum programs; your services compile, schedule, and dispatch them to our machines and return the results:

  • Build and operate the cloud services that let users submit quantum programs to our systems and retrieve their results.

  • Develop and deploy our compilation pipeline as a scalable cloud service , from circuit input through transpilation down to hardware-level instructions

  • Design and maintain the public API and SDK entry points to our platform

  • Implement job queuing, scheduling, and dispatch towards the hardware backends, including quota, prioritisation, and result handling

  • Own authentication and authorisation across the platform: user and tenant identity, API keys and tokens, and role-based access to machines, jobs, and results, built on an established identity provider rather than from scratch

  • Guarantee tenant isolation, so that quantum programs and results are never visible across customer boundaries, and manage secrets and credentials across the stack

  • Work with the quantum firmware and hardware teams on the interfaces between cloud services and the machine itself

  • Instrument the platform for observability and keep an eye on latency, throughput, and cost


Required Skills:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying backend or platform services in production

  • Strong Python; additional systems-level language experience (Go, Rust, C++) is welcome

  • Solid API design skills (REST and/or gRPC) for services other developers have to use

  • Practical experience implementing authentication and authorisation in production systems: OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, token handling, and role-based access control

  • Secure engineering habits: least privilege by default, proper secrets management, and awareness of dependency and container supply-chain risks

  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar) and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or similar)

  • Working understanding of GDPR and data residency requirements, and a genuine interest in digital sovereignty

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with experimental physicists and engineers

  • Strong adaptability and a quick learning mindset

Nice to have (Bonus)

  • Multi-tenant isolation patterns in SaaS platforms

  • Familiarity with quantum SDKs and toolchains (Qiskit, Cirq, PennyLane, QIR) or hardware abstraction interfaces such as QDMI

  • Batch scheduling or HPC environments (Slurm or similar)

title: Cloud Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
A little about us

incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Netflix, Etsy, and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

Being a Cloud Security Engineer at incident means being the person who keeps the one thing customers rely on when their systems are on fire both up and safe, turning “is this secure?” into “yes, and here’s the proof.”

What that looks like day to day

As a Cloud Security Engineer at incident, you own the security of the cloud infrastructure that runs our platform: how it’s built, hardened, monitored and defended. It’s a genuinely varied role. One day you’re tightening IAM across our Google Cloud projects, the next you’re building a Terraform guardrail so engineers get a safe path instead of a ticket, the next you’re leading an investigation into something odd in the audit logs.

You’ll own cloud posture and hardening across GCP and GKE, identity and access, security as code in our Terraform and CI/CD pipelines, detection and response, isolation of customer data in our multi-tenant platform, and the cloud-side controls around our AI features.

We formed our security team this year and there are three of us. We’re hiring a Cloud Security Engineer to give the team real depth in cloud, which means little process, no approval chains, and your fingerprints on everything. We say yes wherever we genuinely can, and you’ll have the authority to block a release when it matters.

We run on Google Cloud and AWS, with Kubernetes, Terraform, Go, Postgres and TypeScript/React. We lean on Claude and other LLMs to move faster.

Who you are

  • You’ve got deep, hands-on cloud security experience, ideally on Google Cloud. Strong AWS or Azure depth that transfers is fine.

  • You design least-privilege IAM properly, and you’ve secured Kubernetes or container platforms in production.

  • You write code to fix problems, not just report them. Terraform is second nature.

  • You’ve built cloud detection or investigated cloud incidents, and you enjoy following the thread until you find the answer.

  • You can give hard feedback to an engineer and have them thank you for it.

  • You’re comfortable with high autonomy. Nobody’s going to hand you a detailed spec, you’re trusted to figure out what needs doing and just do it.

  • Bonus: Go or Postgres security, policy-as-code, supply chain security, or securing AI/LLM-powered products.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

  • Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover - we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

  • Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

  • First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

  • Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

  • Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

  • Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

  • Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

  • Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

Compensation: £110K – £200K • Offers Equity

title: Cloud Solution Architect
descriptionHtml:
Cloud Solution Architect - Data & AI

Location: UK (Hybrid)
Practice: Data & AI

About HSO

HSO is a Business Transformation Partner with deep industry expertise and global reach. As one of Microsoft's leading partners, we help organisations unlock the full potential of Microsoft Dynamics 365, Azure, Data and AI technologies to deliver meaningful business outcomes.

With operations across Europe, North America and Asia, HSO combines industry knowledge, technical excellence and a people-first culture to help customers modernise their businesses, transform operations and embrace innovation with confidence.

As demand for Data & AI solutions continues to accelerate, we're expanding our Data & AI practice and looking for experienced Cloud Solution Architects to help shape the next generation of customer transformation programmes.

The Role

As a Cloud Solution Architect - Data & AI, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping and qualifying customer opportunities across the Microsoft cloud ecosystem.

This is a highly visible role that sits at the intersection of sales, enterprise architecture and delivery, combining technical leadership with commercial thinking. You'll work closely with customers, Microsoft and internal stakeholders to understand business challenges, identify opportunities, design compelling solutions and create clear pathways from initial discovery through to successful delivery.

You'll help organisations transform the way they use data, analytics and artificial intelligence, translating business ambition into practical, costed and deliverable solutions.

Success in this role requires more than technical expertise. You'll need strong consulting and stakeholder management skills, the confidence to challenge assumptions, and the commercial awareness to ensure opportunities are both valuable for clients and aligned with HSO's delivery capability.

What You'll Be Doing

Opportunity Qualification & Solution Shaping

  • Lead Data & AI opportunity qualification alongside Account Managers, Business Development teams and Enterprise Architects.
  • Facilitate customer discovery workshops, architecture assessments and strategic discussions.
  • Understand customer business drivers, challenges and desired outcomes.
  • Help customers define realistic transformation roadmaps aligned to business priorities.
  • Qualify opportunities using structured sales and consulting methodologies, including MEDDIC/MEDDICC approaches.

Solution Architecture & Advisory

  • Design end-to-end Data & AI solutions using Microsoft technologies and best practices.
  • Shape modern analytics, AI and data platform architectures that are commercially viable and technically deliverable.
  • Provide architectural leadership across data platform modernisation, analytics, AI and automation initiatives.
  • Ensure alignment with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and Azure Well-Architected principles.
  • Communicate architectural trade-offs and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Commercial Leadership

  • Translate customer requirements into proposals, statements of work, delivery plans and business cases.
  • Produce solution estimates, cost models and phased implementation approaches.
  • Support customers in understanding ROI, value realisation and investment considerations.
  • Challenge unclear scope and identify delivery, cost and commercial risks early in the sales cycle.
  • Work closely with delivery teams to validate assumptions before commitments are made.

Growth & Go-to-Market

  • Develop demonstrations, accelerators, sales collateral and industry-specific solution narratives.
  • Support RFPs, bid responses, executive presentations and proof-of-concept engagements.
  • Collaborate with Microsoft stakeholders to drive pipeline growth and co-sell opportunities.
  • Keep up to date with emerging Microsoft technologies and industry trends across Data & AI.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate combines strong technical capability with exceptional commercial awareness.

You'll be equally comfortable discussing board-level business outcomes with executive stakeholders as you are diving into architecture decisions with technical teams.

Commercial & Consulting Experience

You'll have:

  • Proven experience in a Solution Architecture, Pre-Sales, Consulting or Technical Advisory role.
  • Experience working within a Microsoft partner, consultancy or enterprise technology environment.

  • The ability to qualify opportunities and challenge assumptions constructively.

  • Experience presenting to senior business and technical audiences.
  • The ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value.

Experience across industries such as manufacturing, retail, financial services, healthcare, public sector, not-for-profit, utilities or professional services would be advantageous.

Technical Experience

We recognise that few candidates will have expertise across every area listed below. We're primarily looking for strong Data & AI architecture experience across the Microsoft ecosystem.

Essential

Data & Analytics

  • Microsoft Fabric
  • Lakehouse architecture patterns
  • Power BI and self-service analytics
  • Semantic modelling and reporting solutions
  • Data platform modernisation and analytics strategy

Azure Data Platform

AI & Automation

  • Copilot Studio
  • Agentic AI patterns and intelligent automation solutions

Data Engineering & Platform Delivery

  • Data pipelines and transformation frameworks
  • CI/CD concepts and deployment automation
  • Azure DevOps and/or GitHub
  • Infrastructure as Code awareness

Advantageous

Data Governance & Security

Integration & Application Connectivity

As a leading Microsoft partner, HSO actively invests in certification, specialisation and continuous learning, helping our consultants stay at the forefront of Microsoft's rapidly evolving technology landscape.

This is an exciting opportunity to join one of Microsoft's most respected global partners during a period of significant growth in Data & AI.

title: CMM Programmer
descriptionHtml:
About Isembard

Isembard is building a network of high-performance factories for critical industries. We combine advanced machine tools, robotics and our own software, MasonOS, to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and frontier technology companies, with factories across the UK, US, Germany and France. Our mission is to forge industrial acceleration.

The role

Inspection is the last point where a mistake is cheap to fix, and at our London factory it decides how quickly finished parts reach customers.

As a CMM Programmer you will programme, set and run coordinate measuring machines to verify high-precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and robotics customers. You will work alongside machinists, CAM programmers and quality engineers so that what leaves the factory conforms.

What you'll do

  • Write, simulate and optimise CMM programmes for complex geometry and tight tolerances.

  • Choose probing, fixturing and datum strategies, and build inspection fixtures where needed.

  • Carry out first article inspection (AS9102 / EN 9102), in-process checks and final inspection.

  • Find non-conformances before they reach a customer, and feed corrective actions back into production with machining and CAM.

  • Look after calibration and maintenance of CMMs, gauges and hand tools.

What we're looking for

  • Several years of hands-on CMM programming in precision manufacturing, aerospace or a machine shop.

  • Strong PC-DMIS, Zeiss Calypso, Renishaw Modus or comparable software skills.

  • Practical knowledge of GD&T (ASME Y14.5) and ISO GPS, and confidence with complex drawings and 3D CAD.

  • Proven ability to inspect tolerances of ±0.01 mm and below.

  • Experience with aerospace inspection documentation, including FAI.

Nice to have

  • SPC, capability analysis or measurement system analysis.

  • AS9100 / EN 9100 experience.

  • In-process probing on 5-axis machines.

  • High-mix, low-to-medium volume production.

Why Isembard

  • Work at the centre of the factory's quality, on advanced machines and metrology equipment.

  • Help set inspection standards other sites reuse.

  • Competitive salary and equity.

Location: On-site at our Southwark factory in London.

Parmi tes clients, une variété de dossiers comme des professions libérales, consultants, développeurs, RH indépendants, entreprises d’e-commerce, agents immobiliers ou encore des holdings.

➡️ Ce qu'on recherche

  • Formation comptable : DSCG, Master CCA, ou EC mémorialiste, à n'importe quelle étape de ton parcours.

  • Une première expérience en cabinet : 6 mois minimum avec du front-client, en alternance ou en poste. Tu connais le rythme des échéances et sais interagir en direct avec tes clients.

  • Appétence pour le digital et l'IA : Tu t'intéresses à ce que la technologie change dans le métier et tu veux travailler dans un cabinet qui en fait un avantage, pas un sujet de peur.

  • Organisation et écoute : Tu jongleras avec plusieurs dossiers et plusieurs clients. L'écoute et la rigueur ne sont pas négociables.

  • Envie de construire quelque chose : Acasi n'est pas un cabinet figé. Tu veux participer à ce qui se construit — pas juste occuper un poste.

  • Langues : français courant indispensable pour la relation client. Anglais B1 minimum — nos équipes et nos outils sont en partie en anglais.

➡️ Ce qu'on t'offre

  • Être au cœur du réacteur : L'IA va transformer la comptabilité plus vite que n'importe quel autre secteur. Chez Acasi, tu n'observes pas cette transformation depuis les gradins — tu en es l'un des acteurs.

  • Un rôle produit rare : Tu as une voix directe sur l'évolution d'un logiciel comptable utilisé par des milliers de clients. Peu de cabinets offrent ça.

  • Autonomie réelle dès l'arrivée : Ton portefeuille est à toi. La taille et la complexité s'adaptent à ton niveau — mais la responsabilité, elle, est immédiate.

  • Une rémunération compétitive : un salaire fixe à 40 000€ brut/an, associé à une prime à la performance pendant la période fiscale — parce qu'on sait que les bons profils ont le choix.

Our customers range from small start-ups to global enterprises. From designing, deploying and managing infrastructure stacks within low-latency financial trading environments, to relocating the headquarters of a global fintech firm, our operations span multiple markets, industries and geographies.

The Role

We are seeking a high-performing Commercial Account Executive (Hunter) to drive net-new logo acquisition within the Commercial and SMB sector.

This role is focused on originating, qualifying, and closing new opportunities, owning the full sales lifecycle from initial engagement through to contract signature. You will be highly commercially driven, comfortable operating in complex enterprise environments, and motivated by building pipeline and winning new business.

Success in this role will come from proactive outbound prospecting, relationship-led selling, and effectively leveraging partner ecosystems and vendor alliances. You will work closely with internal pre-sales, delivery, and vendor specialists to position Techary as the trusted partner for large-scale, transformational IT initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Close outbound opportunities generated by SDRs, from discovery through to proposal and signature
  • Run a full-cycle sales process including qualification, stakeholder mapping, demos, commercial proposals, negotiation, and close

  • Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline hygiene in CRM (Salesforce)
  • Consistently hit monthly/quarterly targets for new business revenue and gross profit
  • Identify and drive upsell/cross-sell opportunities into existing accounts where relevant
  • Represent the company professionally across calls, meetings, events, and vendor engagements

 

Essential Skills:

  • Proven experience as an Account Executive / Sales Executive / New Business Sales professional
  • Strong track record of closing outbound leads, particularly those generated by SDRs
  • Experience selling within an MSP and/or VAR environment (or closely related IT services business)
  • Comfortable selling into commercial customers in the 50–1,000 user segment
  • Confident running discovery and positioning value around outcomes, not just products
  • Strong negotiation skills and ability to manage multi-stakeholder deals
  • Organised, self-motivated, and able to manage multiple opportunities at once
  • Familiarity with common sales tools (CRM, email sequencing, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, etc.)

What Success Looks Like:

  • Consistently converting SDR-qualified meetings into qualified pipeline and closed revenue
  • Strong pipeline creation, forecasting accuracy, and deal progression

title: Commercial & Analytics Projects - Mid-Level (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Only about 1% of our applicants end up in the offer stage. To increase your chances, give yourself a competitive edge and come fully prepared!

In a nutshell

As we are building the best milkman on earth, we are looking for sharp minds that can help us further shape Picnic as we expand across Europe. We are looking for experienced hires with a background in top strategy consulting, private equity, investment banking, e-commerce or commercial roles, that can tackle challenges and growth opportunities at Picnic.

Tricks of the trade

  • Lead with ambition: Bring your relentless determination, creativity, and grit. Take the driver’s seat and redefine the grocery shopping experience for millions. You will be expected to think independently, move fast, and deliver results.
  • Steep learning curve: Your growth comes from owning real problems, testing your ideas, learning from your mistakes and starting again. You'll move at a pace that accelerates your growth like nowhere else.
  • Solve real-life puzzles: Spot opportunities, use tools at the forefront of technology, and own the outcome end to end. Not just making slides, but building the solution yourself.
  • Innovate across borders: You’ll collaborate with teams across the Netherlands, Germany, and France, tackling challenges that redefine how Picnic operates at a European scale.
  • High-performance environment: You’ll work alongside some of the best teams in analytics and tech, people who set a high bar and expect you to do the same.

Your superpowers

  • Master’s degree in Econometrics, Engineering, Finance, Math or an equivalent quantitative study
  • 2-5 years of work experience in top tier management consulting, PE, investment banking, retail topics and hands-on deal experience
  • Out-of-the-box thinking and initiative: hands-on, nothing-is-impossible mindset
  • Strong communication skills in German and English, allowing you to explain complex analytical concepts in a simple and practical way
  • Proficient with SQL and Python or excited to learn 

Picnic Perks 

🏆 Rewarding Impact from Day One

You’ll receive an attractive compensation package, designed to reward your ambition, drive, and the direct impact you’ll make from your very first project.

🍎Learning & development 

You'll always have something to learn with us! You’ll benefit from opportunities like Lepaya training for polishing soft skills or Picnic Tech Academy training in case you want to learn new skills other than what you already know. We also offer free access to trained psychologists via our OpenUp partner, and German language classes if you’d like to get your experience in Germany to the next level. 

🗺️Relocation

If you’re moving from another country to join Picnic we make it as smooth as possible for you. We’ll cover your flight costs and a first month's accommodation. 

 🥗Fresh Lunch, coffee, and snacks 

Our offices are equipped with fully-fledged coffee bars and a kitchen. We get delicious fresh and warm lunches every day so you can keep your energy up.

⛳All the rest 

At Picnic you get 30 holidays, we cover your travel expenses and offer a pension plan. And your phone and laptop are on us, of course.

FAQ

Which team will I join?

At Picnic, we build almost everything in-house. This means that we have plenty of opportunities for you in terms of project topics. Your interest lies in consumer topics like pricing, assortment, customer life time value? Or rather in logistics, supply chain, automated warehousing areas? Or you'd love going adventurous into new areas as long as you're solving real world problems? Let's talk and figure it out where there's the best match.  

What are the long term opportunities for this role? What happens after I'm done with a project?

You get full accountability from the start: from shaping the strategy and driving step-change improvements, to collaborating with multiple teams to achieve tangible business results.

At Picnic, the long-term opportunity isn't just a role—it’s a platform to shape your own career trajectory with real ownership, business impact, and fast growth. Hence the career paths are as diverse as your ambitions. Depending on your interests and strengths, these are most common career paths we’ve seen so far:

  • Given our scale-up environment, many projects tend to grow in scope and complexity under your responsibility and you naturally grow a team around you in order to take your project to a next level.
  • As you grow, you’ll deepen your understanding of the business, build a strong internal network, and prove your ability to lead impactful projects. Once you feel you’ve learned everything in your scope and your projects have been successfully implemented, you can switch to complete different areas of Picnic. We have numerous colleagues that have switched from Commercial to Fulfillment, or from Distribution to Customer and many other examples.

In what language should I apply?

Please send your application in English.
