title: Commercial Contracts Associate (NDA)
descriptionHtml:
About Norm Ai
Norm Ai, the agentic law company, has a client base with a combined $30 trillion in assets under management.


Norm Ai pioneered Legal Engineering, the process that empowers lawyers to build and supervise domain-specific AI agents with Norm’s proprietary suite of no-code software tools. Norm Ai technology is deployed inside many of the largest and most consequential institutions in the world.


Norm Ai is also the technology behind Norm Law, LLP, a separate but affiliated AI-native law firm built for the era of agentic AI. Norm Law’s attorneys advise leading institutions across private funds, private equity, venture capital, real estate, registered funds, and financial regulation, using the same legal intelligence platform that powers Norm Ai’s products.

AI Fluency:
Norm Ai prefers all team members to be fluent in AI. Successful candidates actively use AI in their day-to-day work to support thinking, creation, and problem-solving. They use it to improve the quality and speed of their work and to continuously refine how work gets done end-to-end.

Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate and discuss their AI usage throughout the interview process, including concrete examples of tools, workflows, and outcomes. We look for practical, hands-on experience, not theoretical familiarity.

This Role

As a Commercial Contracts Associate (NDA), you will work on a high impact team that provides important services to Norm Law’s clients, while using AI agents to streamline the drafting, review, and execution process in providing non-disclosure agreement review for clients. You’ll collaborate closely with partners, clients, and technology teams to deliver efficient, precise, and data-driven legal services for in-house legal teams of leading asset managers.

Our practice embraces the use of AI to reduce burden and increase your ability to focus on strategic legal judgment and client engagement.

What You'll Do

  • Document Drafting, Review, and Negotiation: Leverage AI agents to generate, compare, negotiate, and redline NDAs tailored to client guidelines

  • Incorporating Legal Context: Advise clients on their NDA playbooks and market standards, including ensuring AI agents understand each client's specific context and comparing client’s actual practices with playbook positions in order to guide updates.

  • NDA Execution: Integrate AI agents into workflow management, execution, negotiation, and coordination with counterparties for any NDAs.

  • Client Advisory: Partner with clients to demonstrate how AI-assisted workflows improve accuracy, transparency, and velocity.

  • Collaboration with Tech: Work closely with the technology teams to continue to make the NDA review process even more efficient using AI.

  • Managing high volumes of requests: Maintain a tracker, manage multiple high priority requests simultaneously and communicate timing expectations to clients and consistently and proactively follow up and move negotiations forward.

What We're Looking For

Core Qualifications

  • Qualified solicitor admitted in England and Wales, with a current Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) practising certificate.

  • 2-3+ years of experience reviewing NDAs or similar agreements.

  • Strong drafting and communication skills; meticulous attention to detail.

  • Interest in applying technology to enhance traditional deal workflows.

What Success Looks Like

  • 30 Days: Learn firm AI platforms; begin supporting the commercial contracts team using AI-enabled review and drafting.

  • 60 Days: Independently manage discrete components of NDA review with AI support.

  • 90 Days: Lead AI-augmented workstreams in live NDA reviews, improving efficiency and accuracy in document management and execution processes.

Benefits

Benefits: pension plan with an employer contribution, medical and dental insurance coverage, employee referral bonus program, initial 2 week onboarding in the US.

Work Location

Location: Central London

Work model: Hybrid

In-office expectation: 4-5 days per week

Why Join Norm Law

You’ll be part of the founding UK team bringing a proven US category leader to a receptive UK market. You’ll have autonomy, visibility, and the opportunity to build meaningful relationships — backed by a world-class product, an experienced executive team, and a growing global reputation.

To learn more about Norm Ai, visit our website.

title: Commercial Counsel
descriptionHtml:
This role can be office-based in Freiburg, Germany or remote-first, with a requirement to be in the office one full week per month.

About Black Forest Labs

We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world.

Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use.

Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next.

Why This Role

We are looking for a sharp, motivated, commercially minded Commercial Counsel to join BFL’s legal team. You will support a broad range of commercial transactions across our EU and US go-to-market deals. This is a high-ownership role in which you will draft, review, and negotiate agreements, and help structure and maintain operations across the legal and go-to-market teams.

This is an exciting opportunity for a lawyer who wants to work at the cutting edge of AI: advising on novel agreement structures for foundational generative AI models, negotiating complex licensing and API deals, and helping build the legal and commercial infrastructure of a high-growth company.

What You’ll Work On

  • Partner closely with the GTM, Marketing, FDE, Infrastructure, and Finance teams to negotiate contracts and provide practical, deal-enabling legal advice

  • Support EU (and, as needed, US and UK) commercial transactions, focusing primarily on EU-centric deals across a variety of industry verticals, and advise on German corporate law

  • Contribute to company-wide compliance and legal operations initiatives as the legal team scales

  • Help develop and maintain scalable legal frameworks, contract templates, playbooks, and approval workflows

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of legal experience, including commercial transactions in the technology sector, ideally spanning both in-house roles and private practice. Start-up or high-growth company experience would be an advantage.

  • Demonstrated experience negotiating and closing complex technology agreements, including software licensing, API and platform deals, data and content agreements, and partnership contracts.

  • Prior experience supporting EU commercial deals, with comfort navigating cross-border transactions and a strong awareness of key jurisdictional differences.

  • Excellent drafting and negotiation skills, with the ability to identify material issues quickly and communicate them clearly to non-lawyers.

  • Low ego and high accountability: as comfortable rolling up your sleeves on routine agreements as you are handling high-stakes or novel deal structures.

While not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience negotiating robotics, technical manufacturing, and hardware contracts

  • Experience with products subject to export regulation in the EU

  • Experience with AI/ML, developer platforms, or foundational model licensing

  • Exposure to generative AI in prior roles; familiarity with how AI products are built, licensed, and deployed will meaningfully accelerate your effectiveness in this role

  • A JD from an accredited law school and qualification in Germany or the UK

  • Familiarity with German corporate law, the EU AI Act, GDPR, or other international regulatory frameworks relevant to AI and data

  • A background advising on IP, copyright, or data licensing matters in the context of AI training or model development

How We Work Together

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. You’ll be based in Europe and work from your home location, with one week each month spent with us in Freiburg to stay connected with the team.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

  • Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.

Compensation

EU: €150,000 - €200,000 + equity

Note: We may use AI-assisted tools to help organize applications. All hiring decisions are always made by our team.

title: Commercial Director
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

The Opportunity

This is one of the highest-leverage commercial roles in the business. As Commercial Director, you'll own the entire sales system at Relay — strategy, structure, process, and performance across all four of our segments: Pitstop/Field Sales, Enterprise, Large Parcel, and SME Parcel. You'll set the standards that let each segment lead build well, and you'll be personally accountable for the sum of the results.

Beyond the day-to-day, this role has a genuine builder's brief: creating the infrastructure and team capabilities that take Relay international over the next few years. If you want to shape how a fast-growing carrier goes to market at scale — and leave a lasting mark on how that machine works — this is the role.

What You'll Own

Sales strategy and structure

  • Design the shape of Relay's sales organisation across all four segments — how they relate, where they overlap, how resource is prioritised

  • Define the sales motion for each segment: who it sells to, how, and through which channel

  • Keep strategy current as the business and market evolve

Data and performance management

  • Set the metrics that matter across pipeline, conversion, quota attainment, and productivity

  • Build or oversee the dashboards that surface them

  • Use data to make decisions on resourcing, territory design, and where to invest or pull back — instinct complements data here, it doesn't replace it

Process, structure, and scalability

  • Own the sales playbook, forecasting cadence, deal review process, CRM hygiene standards, and comp and quota-setting principles

  • Upskill and coach the existing team on pitch, process, and performance

  • Build infrastructure that scales for the next three years, not just today's headcount

Team leadership and org design

  • Lead the four segment sales leads (Pitstop/Field, Enterprise, Large Parcel, SME Parcel) and any central sales ops or enablement partners

  • Decide what's centralised across functions versus what each segment lead owns locally

  • Hire, develop, and coach those leads so each can build out their patch well

Global and remote team leadership

  • Lead teams remotely across time zones and geographies as Relay expands into the Americas and Europe

  • Proven capability to do this is a requirement — it can't be learned on the job here

Exec partnership and GTM planning

  • Partner with the CCO and other function leads on revenue planning, headcount decisions, and commercial trade-offs

  • Translate company strategy into a sequenced sales roadmap and GTM direction

  • Push back clearly when targets or timelines aren't realistic

Who Will Thrive in This Role

  • Multi-motion sales leader. You've led more than one kind of sales motion — for example, high-volume SMB or transactional sales alongside enterprise or mid-market relationship-led sales. You're comfortable setting standards and managing performance across both. You've carried a number yourself and led others doing the same. This isn't a role for a single-lane specialist.

  • Data-driven and structured operator. You define the metrics that matter, build or oversee the dashboards, and use data to make resourcing and process calls — not gut feel alone. You have a track record of introducing or significantly upgrading forecasting discipline, CRM hygiene, territory design, and comp structures in ways that improved consistency and scalability. You think in systems across a multi-year horizon, not just the next quarter.

  • Global and remote team builder. You've led sales teams across multiple geographies or time zones, ideally including the US and Europe. You're comfortable setting standards, culture, and expectations remotely. Having helped take a company into a new country is a bonus; the core requirement is proven capability.

title: Commercial Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Griffin

Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.

We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.

We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.

Learn more about what we do

Our culture

We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.

We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life.

We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.

Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.

Learn more about our culture.

The team

We’re the Connect team, what most companies call Sales. We strive to bring the best in technology, user experience and banking to the embedded finance space and be the bank for fintechs and corporates to build on.

We’re 10 people across Commercial, Customers Success and Marketing, led by Phoebe, our Chief Revenue Officer and we’re currently focused on winning new businesses and selecting the right customers to partner with for long term mutual success.

The opportunity

You’ll take Griffin’s licensed bank and banking-as-a-service proposition to mid-market and enterprise companies in payments, lending, proptech, vertical SaaS, insurtech and digital assets. You’ll own each deal from first lead to signed commercial terms. You’ll show their engineering, product, risk and compliance teams how it all works, from API architecture and safeguarding to ledger flows, and talk with confidence to their CFO, COO or CTO. You’ll build your own pipeline, shape pricing for complex accounts with RevOps and Finance, and work with Legal, Compliance and Product on bespoke client needs. Think solutions architect who closes.

What success looks like

Within 12 months, you’ll have built a pipeline you sourced yourself, with deals that are bigger and more structured as you go. Prospects’ CFOs and CTOs will trust you to explain how it all works, and Legal, Compliance and Product will bring you in early on every non-standard deal.

To do this you’ll own

  • Your pipeline, from first lead to signed commercial terms, including sourcing your own leads alongside whatever SDRs and marketing bring in

  • Whiteboard sessions on account structures, and the technical proposal content, which you’ll write yourself

  • Pricing and commercial structures for complex accounts, such as consumption-based or bundled models, tiered volume and transfer pricing, built with RevOps and Finance

  • Regulatory and compliance questions, answered before they turn into objections

  • Commercial and technical arrangements for non-standard client requirements, shaped with Legal, Compliance and Product

Your background

To ensure this, we’re looking for people who have:

  • Built and closed their own pipeline, and get their energy from chasing and winning new business

  • A strong grasp of payments and banking infrastructure (settlement, safeguarding, ledgers, APIs, card and account issuing) and enough regulatory knowledge (EMI versus bank licence, Consumer Duty, safeguarding rules) to hold a credible conversation with a compliance team

  • Sold complex deals with long cycles and several buying committees, and negotiated beyond simple discounting, including pricing models, volume commitments and contractual carve-outs

  • A low ego and high curiosity, with a real appetite for understanding how the plumbing works

  • The resilience for long, technical sales cycles, and the confidence to work without a fixed script while our products and structures evolve

  • A love of writing - we have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write)


Nice to haves

Ideally, you would also:

  • Have worked at a BaaS provider, EMI or challenger bank, including in an SMCR-regulated environment

  • Have a structuring background, such as transaction structuring, treasury or Big 4 financial services advisory

What can we offer you?

We are an early stage startup and we're working hard to expand our benefits package. We're planning to add to this list in the future.

  • Salary: Up to £100,000 + commission

  • Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere in the UK. However, for this role you will need to be comfortable with regular travel to London, often at short notice.

  • Work from abroad: Up to 20 days a year

  • Time off: 25 days’ holiday, bank holidays and a winter break (we shut down between Christmas and New Year)

  • Share options: Own a part of what we’re building together

  • Pension: Auto-enrolment into our Penfold scheme

  • Insurance: Private medical with Bupa (including family cover) and life insurance with AIG

  • Wellbeing: 1:1 coaching and therapy session available through Oliva

  • Family leave: Enhanced parental leave with up to 6 months on full pay after two years’ service

  • AI tools: Everyone has a Claude subscription on us and access to other premium tools

  • Your setup: We’ll support you in creating a comfortable and effective WFH environment.

How long will the process take?

We move as fast as possible, but it normally takes us about 2-3 weeks to get to know to each other.

  • Step 1: An initial phone call with our Talent Team for us to tell you more about Griffin and learn about your recent experience.

  • Step 2: Meet your manager to talk through your experience and how that relates to the requirements.

  • Step 3: A task based on what you’ll be doing on a day to day at Griffin.

  • Step 4: Meet with peers in your team for a more in-depth technical interview.

  • Step 5: Pitch the Founder and CRevO

  • Step 6: Culture interview: Learn more about this here.

As a bank, we’re committed to maintaining the highest standards of security. This means that the successful candidate will need to complete background screening, and our offer will be conditional upon satisfactory review of these checks. This would include verification of right to work, criminal record, credit history, social media and professional reference checks

How do I apply?

Are we your next move? Apply via the link below, if there's a match our Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial conversation and talk you through what happens next.

Under representation

At Griffin, we’re looking for people who instinctively vibe with our values, behaviours and mission. You’re encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn’t tick every box. Careers, like life, can take many twists and turns. Your technical expertise and path to where you are today will stand out. We're committed to creating a place where everyone belongs and we welcome diverse perspectives, backgrounds and people who are ready to build a global platform for programmable finance

title: Commercial Lead
descriptionHtml:
Company

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Your Role

We are seeking an experienced Commercial Lead to build and lead a high-performing commercial function that drives strategic customer relationships and secures high-value contracts with both government customers and large enterprises (primarily satellite primes and OEMs).

You'll own the path from shaping opportunities before tenders open, through leading competitive proposals, to securing multi-year contracts and driving sustained account growth. Your ability to navigate complex, high-stakes deals, foster a results-driven culture, and partner with our engineering and business teams will directly influence NewOrbit's market leadership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Dual-market ownership (Gov & Enterprise): Build and execute account strategies for agencies and large companies; map stakeholders, budgets, and decision paths; shape requirements before tenders open.

  • Tender intelligence & capture: Track pipelines across government portals and enterprise sourcing calendars; run capture plans, win themes, and competitor/price-to-win analyses; lead bid/no-bid decisions.

  • Proposal leadership: Orchestrate compliant submissions; coordinate clarifications, BAFO, and oral presentations.

  • Complex deal negotiation: Close supply, licensing, and co-development agreements; negotiate IP, warranties/liability, service levels, and milestone payments aligned to TRL gates.

  • Partnerships & consortia: Structure teaming with primes, SMEs, universities, and test partners to strengthen bids and delivery confidence.

  • Forecasting & governance: Maintain a transparent pipeline with stage gating, ACV/TCV, probability, and cycle metrics; report risks/mitigations and drive executive decision forums.

  • Voice of customer: Feed market and procurement insights into roadmaps, qualification timelines, pricing, and make/buy decisions.

  • Compliance & controls: Work with Legal/Compliance on export control (UK/EU/US regimes), information security, and public-sector procurement rules.

  • Market presence & pitching: Represent NewOrbit at industry events, tender briefings, space conferences, and executive reviews; deliver compelling pitches and presentations that clearly communicate our vision and value proposition.

  • Team leadership: Build, mentor, and inspire a high-performing commercial team, fostering persistence, creativity, and a results-driven culture.

Fundamental Requirements

  • Space industry experience (required): Must have direct experience selling satellites or space hardware - payloads, cameras, antennas, subsystems. Candidates without space industry sales experience will not be considered.

  • Experience: Minimum 5 years in business development or key accounts, with wins across government procurement and large-enterprise buying centres.

  • Customer knowledge: Up to date on where satellite/space hardware customers are coming from today, across government, primes, and OEMs - not relying on outdated relationships.

  • Full sales cycle ownership: Demonstrated experience across all stages - pre-tender shaping, capture planning, proposal/bid leadership, negotiation, and contract close.

  • Tender mastery: Demonstrated success leading competitive bids (capture planning, scoring criteria, compliance, pricing) and handling long, multi-stakeholder cycles.

  • Deal craft: Strong negotiation track record on MSAs/SOWs, licensing, co-development, and milestone-based contracts; fluent in IP and risk allocation.

  • Domain fluency: Able to translate complex engineering (propulsion, LEO satellite platforms, qualification, test/readiness reviews) into customer value and business cases.

  • Leadership & mentoring: Proven ability to recruit, develop, and manage high-performing commercial or sales teams.

  • Process & tools: Disciplined CRM usage, forecasting, and KPI ownership (win rate, cycle time, stage conversion, ACV/TCV).

  • Governance & compliance: Familiarity with public-sector procurement practices and export-control considerations; knows when to engage specialists.

  • Marketing savvy: Skilled in shaping and delivering impactful presentations, narratives, and proposals that resonate with diverse audiences.

  • Soft skills: Executive presence, exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, stakeholder influence, and resilience in long negotiations.

  • Ways of working: High ownership in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment; willing to travel for customer meetings, briefings, and negotiations.

Preferred (Nice to Have)

  • Experience at a small satellite company that scaled into a large business - candidates who've operated through that growth curve are especially well suited to this role.

 

Why NewOrbit Space?

  • Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO.

  • Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology.

  • Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success.

  • Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups.

  • Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week.

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us.

Your job is to set the strategic direction: brand voice, messaging frameworks, content strategy, and open doors for media.

Advise. Invest. Build. Meet ALAIKA — a new kind of Financial Services firm — globally scaling, headquartered in Munich. The work is hard. The bar is high. Partner in 6-7 years possible, for the ones who can keep up and actually build a business themselves on our platform. 

Stop reading if any of these describe you: 

  • Drive. You need someone to fire the starting gun → We only hire people who can prove they are intrinsically driven and execute. 
  • Ownership. You spot the problem and walk it to your boss → We fall in love with problems. Own them. Solve them. Ship solutions. 
  • Speed. Slow is your default → Speed compounds. Be smart and brave enough to select 80/20 in the right way. 
  • Mindset. "Not possible" is part of your vocabulary → We hire people who always find a way. 

Still there? Then ALAIKA might be for you. 

At ALAIKA, our vision is to build the future of Financial Services with three brands under one roof — Advisory (Strategy Consulting), Capital (Private Equity), Building (Company Builder). Right now, we are in the midst of building our trojan horse ALAIKA Advisory. 

The ambition: building the leading Financial-Services-specific entrepreneurial holding — Fortune 500 access, PE discipline, Silicon Valley technology-depth and thinking. Three networks that compound and multiply. 

  • One industry. Financial Services. Nothing else. 
  • One focus. The intersection of business and technology — across Strategic Transformations, AI & Data Intelligence, and Cybersecurity. 
  • One goal. Being the go-to partner for the world's leading Fortune 500 financial services companies — and the ones we might help build into that. 

Founded in October 2022 by Johanna von Geyr (build-up and led Financial Services Practice for a NASDAQ-listed strategy consultancy) and Harald Braunstein (serial entrepreneur with exits incl. IPO), we bring together deep functional domain expertise and networks in global Financial Services, with a proven track record in building, scaling, and investing in leading software product companies.  

Curious what ALAIKA is all about? Explore our website and introduction deck.  

Join the movement — apply now. 

The role and what you will work on 

  • Advise. Take on the most pressing strategic and technology challenges of the world’s leading financial services companies — across Strategy, Data & AI, and Cyber. In the room with decision-makers from day one. 
  • Own. Own your deliverables and your client relationships end-to-end. You are not support staff for the partnership. 
  • Lead. Run workstreams and projects independently. Multiply the output of everyone around you — not just your own. 
  • Sell. Drive business development that other strategic consultancies reserve for managers and partners. At ALAIKA, building the business is not a privilege reserved for managers and partners. It is an expectation. 
  • Grow. Become the rare profile the market is short on — analytical mastermind, financial services expert, entrepreneurial dealmaker. Partner-track from day one. 
  • Build. We are scaling, with real building left to do — IP, processes, go-to-market, strategy. You do not just deliver client work; you co-build the firm. That is not a slogan — it is your Tuesday. 

When you are a fit 

“Show me an athlete who did well academically. An athlete because they know what it takes to win and they have had to experience loss.” 

— Kenneth C. Griffin, Founder of Citadel 


You will work alongside intrinsically driven people chasing an uncapped career — people who do "what it takes". You fear "being one more number stuck in middle management". 

Your goal is to make it to the top: at ALAIKA itself, at a leading investment or financial services firm, or in a company you build yourself — ALAIKA can help with that too. 

  • Book-smart. Strong academic foundation. Think in structures, not gut feel. 
  • Street-smart. Read the room fast. Prioritise ruthlessly. Grasp commercial reality. 
  • People-smart. Communicate with precision — clear, direct, persuasive. Build trust across functions and seniority. 
  • Athlete performance mindset. High aspirations. Grit. Learn faster than the environment changes. 
  • Entrepreneurial guts. Self-confident achiever. Act first, apologise later — speed is everything. Take full ownership of work normally reserved for far more senior profiles. 

What you bring 

  • Background. Top 10–20% of your class at a top-tier university. Analytical field — CS, Math, Physics, Finance, or equivalent rigour. 
  • Experience. 1–2+ years in a high-pressure, results-driven environment — top strategy consultancy, PE/VC-backed company, fast-growing tech, or demanding corporate financial services role. Hands-on Data and / or AI experience required. Financial services experience preferred. 
  • Leadership. You have led — a team, a club, a project, a cause. We hire people who make things happen. 
  • Analytical edge. Data-driven by default. Leverage data to drive decisions, not just decorate slides. 
  • Languages. Fluent in English and German. Additional languages are a plus. 

Why join ALAIKA 

  • Partner track from day one. Six years from early careers to partner possible. 
  • Compensation. Above market with very entrepreneurial-driven bonus structures. 
  • Stellar Network. Shoulder-to-shoulder with financial services executives running today’s giants and the founders building tomorrow’s. 
  • Offices. Munich and Barcelona. More coming. 

Plus: the essentials done right — EGYM Wellpass, bike leasing, a kitchen stocked with healthy food and team events worth showing up for: Oktoberfest, team dinners, and more. 

Advise the leaders. Build what comes next.
Invest in the future of Financial Services. 

Apply with CV, transcripts, and references. Let’s see if you are the one. 

Equal Opportunities for all (f/m/d)

ALAIKA is an equal-opportunity employer. We hire on merit and welcome applications from people of all genders, backgrounds, ages, and identities. Our team spirit celebrates diversity. We want you to be your true “you” and offer everyone an open culture and safe space

title: Consultant Informationssicherheit / IT-Risikomanagement – ISO 27001 (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wer wir sind

Rockstardevelopers, gegründet 2015 in Mannheim, weitere Büros in Stuttgart und München. Wir sind ein Software- und IT-Dienstleister mit Erfahrung aus hunderten von Projekten für Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden.

Kurze Wege, ehrliches Feedback, keine politischen Spielchen. Keine Hierarchie-Ebenen zwischen dir und den Leuten, die Entscheidungen treffen.

Deine Aufgaben

Du arbeitest in Kundenprojekten bei großen Unternehmen und unterstützt dort das Informationssicherheits- und IT-Risikomanagement im laufenden Betrieb.

  • IT-Risikoanalysen und Risk Assessments für Anwendungen und Infrastruktur durchführen
  • Bedrohungsanalysen erstellen und daraus Maßnahmen ableiten
  • Risiken bewerten, dokumentieren und mit den Verantwortlichen nachverfolgen
  • Den ISMS-Prozess nach ISO 27001 und ISO 27005 unterstützen
  • Abstimmung mit Fachbereichen, IT-Betrieb und Security-Verantwortlichen

Die Einsätze laufen überwiegend remote. Kundentermine sind meist in Frankfurt, an einzelnen Präsenztagen.

Wo du landest

Je nach Projekt bei Großkonzernen, im öffentlichen Sektor oder bei Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden. Unsere Kunden besetzen diese Projekte fast nur mit Festangestellten. Deshalb suchen wir dich in Festanstellung.

Was du mitbringst

Das erwarten wir:

  • Mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung in der Informationssicherheit
  • Mindestens drei Jahre praktische Erfahrung im IT-Risikomanagement
  • Sicherer Umgang mit den Anforderungen der ISO 27001 und ISO 27005
  • Erfahrung mit Bedrohungsanalysen

Von Vorteil (kein Muss):

  • Audit- oder Assessment-Erfahrung
  • Werkzeuge für Risikomanagement, zum Beispiel risk2value
  • Zertifizierung wie ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, BSI-Grundschutz-Praktiker oder -Auditor, CISSP oder T.I.S.P.
  • Erfahrung im Umfeld von Eisenbahn- oder Verkehrsunternehmen

Projektsprache ist Deutsch

Du arbeitest im Team des Kunden, auf Deutsch, in Meetings und in der Dokumentation. Wir erwarten Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder besser.

Was wir bieten

  • Überwiegend remote, dazu Büro, wenn du magst
  • MacBook (außer der Kunde stellt eigene Hardware)
  • Verschiedene Kunden, verschiedene Projekte
  • Die Gründer sind deine direkten Ansprechpartner

Bewerbung

Lebenslauf reicht. Kein Anschreiben nötig. Wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Tage.

title: Consultant IT Strategy / CIO Office (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
Description de l'entreprise

Tech Riders est un cabinet de conseil qui accompagne ses clients dans leurs enjeux SI en proposant des services d’excellence sur deux domaines essentiellement :

  • Conseil à la DSI (Gouvernance, Optimisation des Processus, Gestion des risques et Audit informatique etc.),

  • Accompagnement Projet (Chefferie de projet, Product Management, Business Analyse, Développement, etc.).

Nous croyons fermement que l'épanouissement professionnel est intimement lié à un équilibre sain entre la vie professionnelle et personnelle, une évolution de carrière fluide grâce à l'acquisition de nouvelles expertises, ainsi qu'une rémunération équitable.

Conscients des priorités et attentes de nos collaborateurs, nous nous engageons à construire une entreprise à taille humaine, fondée sur des valeurs et des principes solides tels que la cohésion d'équipe, la transparence, l'équilibre de vie, et le partage de connaissances et de prospérité.

Vos missions

IT Strategy / Définition et déclinaison de la stratégie IT

Au sein d'un environnement CIO Office, vous accompagnerez le management IT dans la définition, la structuration et la formalisation de sa stratégie IT.

Vous serez notamment en charge de :

  • Contribuer à la définition de la stratégie IT, en assurant son alignement avec les enjeux métiers, technologiques et les orientations du Groupe ;

  • Analyser l'existant (As-Is) et définir une vision cible (To-Be), en identifiant les axes de transformation et les opportunités d'optimisation ;

  • Structurer les piliers stratégiques IT et les décliner en initiatives, trajectoires de transformation et roadmaps ;

  • Conduire des analyses stratégiques transverses : architecture, Data & IA, cybersécurité, infrastructure, operating model, sourcing et delivery ;

  • Challenger les orientations techniques, fonctionnelles et organisationnelles des différentes parties prenantes ;

  • Préparer et animer des workshops stratégiques avec les responsables IT, les métiers et les experts ;

  • Identifier les risques, dépendances et arbitrages, et formuler des recommandations argumentées à destination du management.


CIO Office / Communication exécutive & Gouvernance

Vous interviendrez également directement auprès du Top Management afin de :

  • Concevoir des présentations PowerPoint de très haut niveau, destinées aux CIO, Heads of IT et instances de direction ;

  • Transformer des sujets complexes en messages stratégiques clairs, synthétiques et impactants ;

  • Préparer les instances de gouvernance : Steering Committees, Executive Reviews et workshops de direction ;

  • Contribuer aux échanges avec le Top Management, en présentant, argumentant et défendant les orientations proposées ;

  • Assurer la revue critique des livrables stratégiques, aussi bien sur le fond (analyses, cohérence, recommandations) que sur la forme (storytelling, qualité visuelle) ;

  • Produire des synthèses exécutives et supports d'aide à la décision, facilitant les arbitrages du management ;

  • Contribuer au suivi de la déclinaison opérationnelle de la stratégie IT.

Vos compétences

Outils et environnement

  • PowerPoint — maîtrise avancée indispensable : présentations exécutives, storytelling stratégique, visualisation de données et qualité graphique ;

  • Excel et Word : analyses, business cases et notes stratégiques ;

  • Outils collaboratifs : Teams, SharePoint, Confluence, Jira ;

  • Bonne connaissance des frameworks IT Strategy, IT Governance, Target Operating Model (TOM) et IT Roadmap ;

  • Culture IT transverse : Cloud, Data & IA, cybersécurité, architecture SI, infrastructure et IT Operations.

Description du profil

Le profil recherché dispose idéalement des compétences suivantes :

  • Expérience confirmée en IT Strategy, CIO Advisory, CIO Office ou conseil en transformation IT ;

  • Excellente capacité d'analyse, de structuration et de synthèse, avec une véritable hauteur de vue stratégique ;

  • Esprit critique et capacité à challenger des sujets techniques, fonctionnels et organisationnels ;

  • Excellente maîtrise de PowerPoint, avec la capacité à produire des supports exécutifs dignes d'un cabinet de conseil en stratégie ;

  • Communication orale et écrite irréprochable, avec une réelle aisance face au Top Management ;

  • Très bonne compréhension des enjeux IT et métiers, permettant de dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs variés ;

  • Capacité à structurer une réflexion, défendre des recommandations et faciliter les prises de décision ;

  • Autonomie, proactivité, rigueur et exigence élevée sur la qualité des livrables ;

  • Excellent niveau de français et d'anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.

Une expérience en cabinet de conseil en stratégie ou transformation IT constitue un véritable atout.

Rejoignez la famille Tech Riders et devenez les Leaders de demain ! Découvrez un environnement où l'excellence, la qualité et l'humanité sont au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons.

title: Consultant senior / Manager - Conseil en transformation, organisation et gestion de projet
descriptionHtml:
Pourquoi ce poste existe maintenant

Ad Valoris change de modèle. Depuis vingt ans, nous aidons des directions générales de Suisse romande, publiques et privées, à voir clair, à décider et à embarquer leurs équipes. Depuis 2025, nous pratiquons le conseil augmenté : l'IA nous sert à comprendre mieux, à aller plus loin, pas seulement à produire plus vite.

Le cabinet est en pleine croissance : de nouvelles directions nous confient leurs enjeux et un deuxième bureau ouvre à Lausanne. Nous cherchons deux personnalités prêtes à rejoindre cette aventure humaine : une équipe dynamique et engagée, au sein de laquelle vous pourrez contribuer au développement du cabinet et tracer votre propre parcours.

Ce que vous ferez

Vous rejoignez le cabinet comme consultant-e senior ou manager, selon votre expérience. Sur un mandat, vous pouvez assumer plusieurs responsabilités ; en particulier, vous concevez la démarche de chaque mandat, vous vous assurez qu'elle répond au vrai problème du client et vous gérez la relation avec lui tout au long de la mission.

  • Comprendre avant de proposer. Lire la situation du client, ses acteurs et ses non-dits, avant d'arriver en séance.

  • Résoudre le bon problème. Remettre en cause la commande quand elle ne vise pas le vrai sujet, et défendre une recommandation engagée.

  • Co-construire et faire avancer. Apporter tôt une première version, la faire travailler par le client jusqu'à ce qu'il en soit co-auteur, et animer seul-e des séances, y compris sur des sujets complexes, dans des environnements exigeants et avec des parties prenantes aux sensibilités diverses.

  • Créer de la valeur pour le client. Mieux comprendre, aller plus loin dans l'analyse et concrétiser : ce qui compte, ce sont les progrès durables que le client constate dans son organisation.

  • Faire grandir le cabinet. Transmettre, challenger et accepter de l'être.

Deux points d'entrée, selon votre expérience :

  • Manager (dès 10 ans d'expérience). Architecte de mission dès votre arrivée : vous cadrez et pilotez des mandats de bout en bout, et vous encadrez un ou deux consultants en continuant à produire. Vous prenez part à la conduite du cabinet : méthodes, recrutement, capitalisation. Trajectoire explicite vers un rôle où vous portez le résultat et la croissance de plusieurs comptes.

  • Consultant-e senior (dès 5 ans d'expérience). Autonome sur un périmètre cadré, vous menez vos entretiens et ateliers seul-e ou en équipe, et vous êtes une référence en conseil augmenté. Trajectoire explicite vers le rôle d'architecte de mission.

Le conseil augmenté, tel que nous le pratiquons

Le conseil augmenté, ce n'est pas utiliser l'IA pour produire plus vite. C'est l'utiliser pour comprendre mieux, sans jamais laisser la production avancer plus vite que la compréhension. Le test est simple : qu'avez-vous fait du temps que l'IA a libéré ? Plus de livrables, c'est de la sous-traitance à une machine. Plus de présence chez le client et plus de profondeur d'analyse, c'est du conseil augmenté.

Ce que nous cherchons

  • Un master ou un diplôme d'ingénieur, et cinq à quinze ans d'expérience en conseil en organisation, stratégie, conduite du changement ou pilotage de programmes.

  • Une pratique réelle du conseil augmenté : vous savez dire ce que vous avez écarté dans une réponse de l'IA et pourquoi, et vous refusez de produire ce que vous n’assumez pas.

  • La capacité à trancher avec une information incomplète, et à ajuster ce choix en avançant, à mesure que la situation se précise.

  • De la fiabilité et de la droiture : vous parlez franchement et vous tenez parole.

  • Pour le point d'entrée Manager : des mandats menés de bout en bout, des consultants que vous avez fait grandir, et des relations de confiance avec vos clients.

  • Maîtrise parfaite du français ou équivalent, excellente plume, anglais courant, allemand un atout. Le tissu romand vous est familier.

Ce que nous ne cherchons pas, pour vous éviter de perdre du temps

  • Un-e senior qui veut encadrer sans plus produire. Ici, tout le monde est en séance, les associés compris.

  • Un-e consultant-e qui vit l'IA comme un outil de productivité, ou qui s'en méfie par principe.

  • Un-e spécialiste d'une seule méthode qui veut la plaquer sur chaque client.

Ce que vous trouverez chez nous

  • Des terrains variés : État et collectivités publiques, santé et services à la personne, assurances sociales, formation et recherche, organisations internationales et ONG, énergie et mobilité, services financiers et bancaires, horlogerie et luxe, arômes et parfums, grande distribution, et le tissu industriel romand, des grands groupes aux PME.

  • Une trajectoire lisible : un référentiel de compétences partagé, un parcours collaborateur suivi, et un budget de formation continue renouvelé chaque année.

  • Un environnement augmenté réellement outillé : centre d'excellence IA interne, outils maison, base de connaissances du cabinet.

  • Deux bureaux, Genève et Lausanne, et une vraie souplesse : télétravail et horaires flexibles, présence au bureau pour le travail en commun, équilibre entre vie privée et vie professionnelle pris au sérieux.

Comment nous recrutons

Trois rencontres, une réponse motivée à chaque étape.

  • 1. Trente minutes en visio pour comprendre pourquoi Ad Valoris, et répondre à vos questions.

  • 2. Une heure avec deux de nos collaborateurs : un échange ouvert sur vos motivations et votre projet professionnel, et sur ce que le cabinet peut vous apporter.

  • 3. Une étude de cas avec la direction, tirée d'une situation réelle : avec l'IA, en temps limité, puis en restitution devant les associés.

Nous nous engageons à vous répondre sous dix jours ouvrés après chaque étape.


Candidature

Envoyez votre CV et, à la place de la lettre de motivation, une note d'une page qui répond à cette question : que devient le métier de consultant quand le client a accès à la même IA que nous ? Dites-nous sur quoi vous êtes d'accord avec notre approche, sur quoi vous ne l'êtes pas, et ce que vous apporteriez au cabinet. Appuyez-vous sur au moins une situation que vous avez vécue. Avec ou sans IA, peu importe : ce qui compte, c'est votre avis.

TRICAD MS ist eine 3D CAD-Software für TGA und Anlagenplanung auf Basis von Bentley Systems. Wir bei Tricad sind Ingenieure und kreative Enthusiasten. Für noch bessere Software gehen wir immer wieder neue Wege. Das schaffen wir mit Flexibilität, Weitblick und kundenorientiertem Denken.

Mit TRICAD MS haben wir die führende 3D CAD-Softwarelösung für die Gebäudetechnik und Anlagenplanung etabliert. Über 500 Kunden rund um den Globus sind mit TRICAD MS und unserem Know-how erfolgreich.

Bei TRICAD GmbH arbeiten wir daran, moderne und effiziente Lösungen für die Gebäudetechnik zu ermöglichen. Damit unsere Kund:innen optimal mit TRICAD MS arbeiten können, suchen wir dich als Consultant & Trainer (m/w/d) – jemanden, der technische Prozesse versteht und Menschen gern begleitet.

Aufgaben

In dieser Rolle unterstützt du Unternehmen dabei, ihre Planungsprozesse zu standardisieren und effizient zu gestalten.

Du übernimmst dabei vor allem:

  • Die Implementierung und Konfiguration von TRICAD MS in Kundenumgebungen
  • Die Erstellung und Anpassung standardisierter Planungsstrukturen
  • Die Durchführung von Trainings für Anwender:innen
  • Die Beratung zu sinnvollen Workflows und funktionalen MöglichkeitenDie Begleitung der Kund:innen beim erfolgreichen Einsatz unserer Lösung

Qualifikation

Du arbeitest strukturiert, kommunizierst klar und kannst dich gut auf unterschiedliche Gegenüber einstellen.

Dazu passt du zu uns, wenn du:

  • Ein Studium in Informatik, alternativ eine Ausbildung als Techniker mit Kenntnisse im Bereich Technische Gebäudeausrüstung oder einen handwerklichen Ausbildungshintergrund mit Sachkenntnisse zu den Anforderungen einer Baustelle
  • Idealerweise Erfahrung mit MicroStation, Revit oder Tricad hast
  • Freude daran hast, Wissen zu vermitteln und Lösungen zu gestalten
  • Offen, zuverlässig und kundenorientiert arbeitest
  • Reisebereitschaft

Benefits

Wir möchten, dass du dich bei uns gut entwickeln kannst – fachlich und persönlich.

Dich erwarten:

  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Jobrad für deine Mobilität
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten & ein unbefristeter Vertrag
  • Gehaltsrange: 65.000€ bis 75.000€
  • Flache Hierarchien und ein wertschätzendes Miteinander
  • Ein abwechslungsreiches, dynamisches Aufgabenumfeld
  • Raum für eigene Ideen und Gestaltung

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.
Bewirb dich gern bei TRICAD MS – wir melden uns zeitnah bei dir zurück.

Falls Du Fragen hast, kontaktiere mich gerne via XING, LinkedIn, klassisch per Mail oder Telefon +49173 452 9770.

Noch mehr zu uns erfährst Du über unsere Karriereseite.

Vielen Dank für Deine Zeit und Dein Interesse.

Kathrin Conradsen

title: Consultant.e Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
Conviction 🌟 Chez Thiga, nous sommes convaincus que le Design est un accélérateur de croissance responsable pour les entreprises.
Mais pour avoir un réel impact, le rôle du designer doit évoluer.
Nous défendons une approche de Product Designers “Product Builders”, capables de maîtriser l’ensemble du cycle produit : de la discovery à la delivery, en collaboration étroite avec le Produit, la Tech et le Business.

Des designers augmentés par la data et l’IA, qui leur permettent d’explorer plus vite, décider avec justesse et délivrer avec impact.
En plaçant les besoins réels des utilisateurs au cœur des produits, tout en intégrant les enjeux économiques, sociaux et environnementaux, le design devient un levier puissant pour une innovation à la fois performante et durable.

Le Product Design doit donc être porté à un niveau stratégique pour transformer réellement les organisations.

Nous recherchons des expert.e.s qui incarnent cette vision.
Être Consultant.e Product Designer chez Thiga 🖇
  • Soit tu es en immersion chez le client : tu renforces ses équipes pour créer des produits numériques responsables et performants.
  • Soit tu accompagnes le client dans la conception de la stratégie Design afin de garantir la cohérence, la qualité et l’impact des expériences utilisateurs sur l’ensemble des produits et services de l’entreprise

    • Ton quoditien chez le client 🎯
  • Tu collabores étroitement avec les équipes Produit, Tech et Marketing pour établir une vision claire du Design, en alignement avec les objectifs utilisateurs et business.
  • Tu formes les équipes internes aux meilleures pratiques de Design
  • Tu contribues à la définition de la roadmap produit en apportant une perspective centrée utilisateur.
  • Tu définis les user flows et tu crées les interfaces
  • Tu supervises la cohérence des parcours utilisateurs et des interfaces sur l’ensemble des plateformes
  • Tu promeus la valeur stratégique du Design auprès des parties prenantes
  • Tu mets en place et fais évoluer les processus, outils et rituels de Design. Tu participes notamment à l’amélioration du Design System, contribues à la Research, l’usage de la data et au déploiement de l’Intelligence Artificielle dans ton équipe
  • Tu mets en place des indicateurs de performance (KPIs) pour mesurer l’impact du Design sur les objectifs Business.

    • Expériences et qualités requises 📇
  • Tu as au moins 8 ans d’expérience avec un impact mesurable dans les environnements e-commerce et, idéalement avec un parcours varié (Scale-ups, grands groupes, Conseil)
  • Communication : tu as d'excellentes compétences en communication (aussi bien écrite que verbale) et en relations interpersonnelles. Tu as la capacité à développer une relation de confiance avec les clients.
  • Diplomatie : tu sais présenter tes idées et tes convictions et gérer les relations entre différentes parties prenantes. Tu sais faire preuve d’assertivité.
  • Curiosité : tu t’informes des nouveautés et des meilleures pratiques en Product Design, Product Management et IA. Figma Make, Claude, Lovable n'ont plus aucun secret pour toi :) Ce sont des alliés te permettant d'accélérer, d'améliorer la qualité et d'explorer de nouvelles façons de concevoir et de livrer.
  • Humilité : tu sais te remettre en question et apprendre de tes erreurs pour mieux évoluer
  • Anglais courant : tu peux travailler en autonomie dans un contexte international

    • Ce que nous offrons 🎊
  • Un on-boarding pour rencontrer tes collègues
  • De l’apprentissage avec minimum 5 jours de formations à l’année, des sessions de partage hebdomadaires et du contenu pour te faire monter en compétences
  • Du mentoring sur ta mission par un pair plus confirmé
  • Du confort avec deux jours de télétravail par semaine (selon ton client) complétés par un accès à un catalogue de matériels, ainsi qu’un Macbook Air ou un PC selon ta préférence.
  • Du fun avec des Thigapéros, des Team building et un séminaire (en prêtant attention à notre empreinte carbone).
  • Et pleins d’autres avantages comme une carte Swile, le remboursement de ton abonnement de transport à 50%/forfait mobilité durable, etc.

    • Les étapes du process 🎢
  • Un pré-entretien téléphonique avec une membre de l’équipe Recrutement
  • L'évaluation de ton portfolio par nos Product Designers
  • Une rencontre avec Fanny, Directrice de la tribe, un Principal, ou un.e Manager
  • Une étude de cas avec deux Product Designers de l’équipe pour tester ton savoir-faire
  • Un dernier échange pour apprécier l’entente mutuelle 🤝
    • Thiga accueille toutes les personnes compétentes et passionnées et s'engage en faveur de la diversité culturelle, l'égalité de genre et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés — au contraire nous considérons la diversité comme une grande richesse !

title: Consulting director
descriptionHtml:
E-commerce is booming — but independent brands still struggle to match the seamless logistics of giants like Amazon. At Bigblue, we’re on a mission to change that. We help brands turn fulfillment into a competitive advantage: scaling faster while delivering a five-star customer experience. Since 2018, we’ve built a tech-driven logistics platform powering 500+ brands — from fast-growing DTC players to global names like MUJI, Aigle, and Cabaïa. With 110+ employees across Paris, Madrid, and London, our proprietary WMS (Warehouse Management System) Atlas, and a network of 8 warehouses across Europe, we’re solving logistics challenges that others haven’t dared to tackle — making fulfillment faster, smarter, greener — and more cost-efficient. Backed by $20M+ in funding, we’re scaling rapidly — from 10 million orders in 2024 toward bold enterprise expansion. To deliver on this ambition, we are looking for a leader who will drive operational excellence and innovation at scale. The role: Consulting director Merchants often need more guidance than our product alone can provide. They struggle with optimizing delivery options, managing customer support or demand planning and streamlining other operational processes. While our product addresses part of this need, merchants require structured, expert advice to grow and optimize their business. That’s why we’re launching a new Professional Services program — to help brands unlock the full potential of Bigblue Operations. As Fulfillment Strategy & Operations Lead, you will build and lead this new function from the ground up: designing offers, structuring delivery, and ensuring execution at scale. Your mission is to sell (and sometimes offer) operational consulting, providing tailored support across logistics, transport, and commerce operations — while capturing and distributing the knowledge that will shape internal training, product development, and merchant strategy. This is a cross-functional leadership role, reporting directly to the co-CEOs, with strong exposure to sales, merchants, product and ops teams, and the executive leadership. What you’ll do 📦 Design and launch Bigblue’s Professional Services program: define the service offering, pricing models, and delivery frameworks for operational consulting. 🧠 Deliver structured, high-impact advice to merchants: help brands streamline their operations, unlock growth, and make the most of Bigblue’s operational capabilities. 📊 Create and track performance metrics: define success KPIs — including merchant satisfaction, project ROI, and delivery timelines — and build the tools and processes to monitor and improve them. 📚 Generate and structure company knowledge: turn field experience into scalable insights that fuel internal training, merchant enablement, and product roadmap decisions. 🤝 Work hand-in-hand with Sales, Product, Ops, and Customer teams: scope merchant needs, influence product direction, and ensure Professional Services are tightly integrated into the overall customer journey. 🧩 Handle both repeatable and bespoke projects: from standardized onboarding packages to tailored merchant migrations, flex between industrialized delivery and custom-built solutions. 💸 Make Professional Services a profitable growth engine: design revenue models, forecast team utilization, and ensure strong project economics while delivering value to merchants.
Who you are
  • You have 5+ years of experience in consulting, professional services, or implementation at a high-growth scale-up, logistics player, eCom or SaaS company.
  • You’re customer-obsessed, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to turn complex needs into actionable plans.
  • You know how to balance execution, people management, and financial performance.
  • You are a builder — ready to design and scale processes from scratch, not just operate what exists.
  • You thrive in cross-functional environments, collaborating across product, ops, tech, and commercial teams.
  • You are both strategic and hands-on — comfortable driving the roadmap while jumping into project firefighting when needed.
  • Fluent in English and ideally French or Spanish.
    • Why join Bigblue? 💼 High-impact leadership role at the heart of Bigblue’s growth and customer success. 🚀 Fast-growing scale-up with a well-funded roadmap and bold ambitions. ⚙️ Room to build and innovate: create a PS function from the ground up. 🌍 Pan-European scope: support leading omnichannel brands across multiple markets. 🍱 10€ meal voucher per worked day (55% paid by Bigblue) 🧘‍♀️ ClassPass membership for fitness & wellness. 🖥️ MacBook or your preferred setup to do your best work. 🩺 100% health insurance coverage with Benefiz. 💙 Founders-led company where operations are truly core to the mission. Regardless of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, origin, disability, age… At Bigblue, we create equal opportunities for all and make our culture as inclusive as possible. Because we believe that challenging assumptions and embracing diversity in experiences and backgrounds is what makes us stronger. Because what we value first and foremost are curiosity and growth-driven minds. So, regardless of who you are and how many “boxes” you tick on the job description, if you have the energy and passion to help shape Bigblue’s entrepreneurial adventure, APPLY.

title: Consulting Manager (m/f/d) Data & AI Strategy
descriptionHtml:
Who/What is Artefact?

Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organizations through data and AI. We combine the rigor of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital, and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact. With 2,000+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 26 countries, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange, and Sanofi. At our German offices, we are on a rapid growth trajectory, advising leading national and international clients cross-industry on how to unlock the full potential of their data, build scalable data architectures, and implement cutting-edge AI solutions.

As a Consulting Manager (m/f/d) Data & AI Strategy, you will act as a trusted sparring partner to executives, steer complex transformation programs across functions, and drive organizational change at scale.

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead AI Transformation Programs: Steer end-to-end execution of enterprise-level AI transformations. Identify internal champions, navigate corporate politics, manage structural blockers, and drive measurable user adoption and organizational change. 
  • Strategy & AI Use Case Scoping: Work closely with C-level stakeholders to answer high-stakes questions: How can AI reshape their business models? How should they govern data? You don't just advise; you help evaluate model choices, discuss data privacy trade-offs, and conceptualize technical feasibility.
  • Drive Business Growth: Actively drive the growth of our German practice. Take ownership in lead generation and pipeline conversion by engaging prospective clients, shaping proposals, and leading pre-sales and key-account expansion initiatives.
  • Thought Leadership & Advocacy: Represent Artefact's AI Transformation perspective externally. Advance our voice in enterprise AI through expert discussions, content creation (e.g. LinkedIn, whitepapers), and opinionated, hands-on perspectives on applied AI trends and real-world adoption pathways.
  • Advance the Practice: Evolve our methodologies, tools, and frameworks to keep our offering state-of-the-art. Develop reusable transformation playbooks and bring your strategic consulting or technology expertise into the team.
  • Team Leadership & Mentoring: Act as a senior advisor and role model - leading, coaching, and mentoring agile, hybrid project teams (consultants, data scientists, and engineers), fostering a fast-paced, “can-do” culture.

Candidate Profile

At our heart, we define ourselves by a culture of ownership, intellectual curiosity, and cooperation. We are looking for driven, capable talents who bring strong motivation and curiosity for new challenges. You are a true team player, eager to support others while scaling both the company and your own career.

  • Work Experience: You have approximately 5–8 years of full-time working experience in top-tier management consulting, technology consulting, or strategic corporate in-house roles. A proven track record of successfully leading and delivering data, analytics, or AI-driven transformation projects is essential.
  • Transformation & Change Management: Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional transformation programs, with the ability to manage executive stakeholders, navigate corporate politics, and embed AI capabilities within client organizations.
  • AI Fluency & "Builder Mindset": Strong fluency in modern and applied AI (e.g., GenAI, LLMs, agentic systems, automated workflows). While you don't need to be a full-time programmer, you have a hands-on understanding and can credibly demo working AI concepts and discuss data privacy and technical constraints.
  • Analytical & Technical Acumen: Knowledge about common machine learning techniques, cloud architectures, and data management principles. Excellent quantitative skills to draw strategic insights from complex data sets.
  • Communication & Presence: Outstanding communication, presentation, and moderation skills. You have a strong presence and can translate complex technical topics into compelling arguments for non-technical senior executives, as well as bridge the gap to technical execution teams.
  • Education: Excellent academic track record with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Computer Science, Business Informatics, Physics, Mathematics, or a comparable quantitative field.
  • Languages: Business-fluency in both German and English (written and spoken) is mandatory to successfully advise our German clients and lead workshops. Additional languages are a plus.
  • Work Eligibility: A valid work permit for Germany.

Why Join Us?

  • Strategy with a Data Edge: Artefact sits uniquely at the crossroads of top-tier business strategy and deep tech. You will build boardroom-level strategy expertise while staying at the absolute forefront of AI, data management, and digital value creation.
  • Impact & Entrepreneurial Freedom: As part of a fast-growing team in Germany, you will have high visibility from day one. You will directly help shape Artefact's footprint in the region, bringing in your own ideas and driving business growth.
  • Continuous Learning: Constant exposure to new AI solutions at the intersection of technology and business. Access to regular training in both strategy consulting methodologies and the latest AI/data capabilities through our global network.
  • Culture of Doers: We combine a high degree of self-assurance with a supportive, collaborative environment. We are entrepreneurial, fast-moving, and committed to delivering real impact - while strongly supporting each other's personal growth.

This position is based in Berlin or Munich.

Don't worry if you don't meet all the criteria! At Artefact, we value motivation, pragmatic problem-solving, and potential above all else.If you are excited about shaping the future of AI and ready to make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Diversity & Inclusion at Artefact > We believe that unique perspectives fuel innovation. At Artefact, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome and consider all applications purely based on merit, skills, and potential - regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, religion, age, background, or disability. Come as you are! 

Ready to take the next step? Please submit your CV showcasing your experience and passion for this role as a Consulting Manager (m/f/d) Data & AI Strategy. We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Consulting Manager - Financial Services / Data & AI (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Advise. Invest. Build. Meet ALAIKA — a new kind of Financial Services firm — globally scaling, headquartered in Munich. The work is hard. The bar is high. Partner in 4-5 years possible, for the ones who can keep up and actually build a business themselves on our platform. 

Stop reading if any of these describe you: 

  • Specialisation. You are a generalist with shallow expertise and a thin network → AI will eat your lunch. We bet on depth. 
  • Ownership. You spot the problem and walk it to your boss → We fall in love with problems. Own them. Solve them. Ship solutions. 
  • Speed. Slow is your default → Speed compounds. Be smart and brave enough to select 80/20 in the right way. 
  • Mindset. "Not possible" is part of your vocabulary → We hire people who always find a way. 

Still there? Then ALAIKA might be for you. 

At ALAIKA, our vision is to build the future of Financial Services with three brands under one roof — Advisory (Strategy Consulting), Capital (Private Equity), Building (Company Builder). Right now, we are in the midst of building our trojan horse ALAIKA Advisory. 

The ambition: building the leading Financial-Services-specific entrepreneurial holding — Fortune 500 access, PE discipline, Silicon Valley technology-depth and thinking. Three networks that compound and multiply. 

  • One industry. Financial Services. Nothing else. 
  • One focus. The intersection of business and technology — across Strategic Transformations, AI & Data Intelligence, and Cybersecurity. 
  • One goal. Being the go-to partner for the world's leading Fortune 500 financial services companies — and the ones we might help build into that. 

Founded in October 2022 by Johanna von Geyr (build-up and led Financial Services Practice for a NASDAQ-listed strategy consultancy) and Harald Braunstein (serial entrepreneur with exits incl. IPO), we bring together deep functional domain expertise and networks in global Financial Services, with a proven track record in building, scaling, and investing in leading software product companies.  

Curious what ALAIKA is all about? Explore our website and introduction deck. 

Join the movement — apply now.
 

The role and what you will work on 

  • Advise. Take on the most pressing strategic and technology challenges of the world’s leading financial services companies — across Strategy, Data & AI, and Cyber. In the room with decision-makers from day one. 
  • Own. Take full ownership of significant client groups and stakeholder relationships. The work, the team, the relationships, the numbers. You do not own pieces; you own outcomes. 
  • Lead. Run workstreams and project teams. Set the bar for consultants and senior consultants — challenge them, develop them, raise their game. Multiply the output of everyone around you — not just your own. 
  • Sell. Run and source proposals independently. Open new buying centers. Grow existing ones. Turn one engagement into three. At ALAIKA, business development is not a partner privilege — it is an expectation. 
  • Connect. Bring a network. Extend it. Lead peer and senior client discussions in your area of responsibility. Build trust deep enough that clients call youfirst. 
  • Grow. Become the rare profile the market is short on — analytical mastermind, financial services expert, entrepreneurial dealmaker. Partner-track within reach. 
  • Build. We are scaling, with real building left to do — IP, processes, go-to-market, strategy. You do not just deliver client work; you co-build the firm. That is not a slogan — it is your Tuesday. 

When you are a fit 

“Show me an athlete who did well academically. An athlete because they know what it takes to win and they have had to experience loss.” 

— Kenneth C. Griffin, Founder of Citadel 

You will work alongside intrinsically driven people chasing an uncapped career — people who do "what it takes". You fear "being one more number stuck in middle management". 

Your goal is to make it to the top: at ALAIKA itself, at a leading investment or financial services firm, or in a company you build yourself — ALAIKA can help with that too. 

  • Book-smart. Strong academic foundation. Think in structures, not gut feel. 
  • Street-smart. Read the room fast. Prioritise ruthlessly. Grasp commercial reality. 
  • People-smart. Communicate with precision — clear, direct, persuasive. Build trust across functions and seniority. 
  • Athlete performance mindset. High aspirations. Grit. Learn faster than the environment changes. 
  • Entrepreneurial guts. Self-confident achiever. Act first, apologise later — speed is everything. You move. 

What you bring 

  • Background. Top 10–20% of your class at a top-tier university. Analytical field — CS, Math, Physics, Finance, or equivalent rigour. 
  • Experience. Minimum 4 years in a high-pressure, results-driven environment — top strategy consultancy, fast-growing tech, or demanding corporate financial services role. Hands-on Data & AI experience required. An established network in Financial Services is expected at this level.  
  • Industry Focus. You have worked inside or deeply alongside financial services institutions. Sub-sector expertise in insurance preferred, but we would consider experience in banking, asset management, or payments as well.    
  • Leadership. You have led teams that delivered. We hire managers who build careers, not just project plans. 
  • Analytical edge. Data-driven by default. Leverage data to drive decisions, not just decorate slides. 
  • Languages. Fluent in English and German. Additional languages are a plus. 

Why join ALAIKA 

  • Partner track from day one. Four years from manager to partner possible. 
  • Compensation. Above market with very entrepreneurial-driven bonus structures. 
  • Stellar Network. Shoulder-to-shoulder with financial services executives running today’s giants and the founders + investors building tomorrow’s. 
  • Offices. Munich and Barcelona. More coming. 

Plus: the essentials done right — EGYM Wellpass, bike leasing, a kitchen stocked with healthy food and team events worth showing up for: Oktoberfest, team dinners, and more. 

Advise the leaders. Build what comes next.
Invest in the future of Financial Services. 

Apply with CV, transcripts, and references. Let’s see if you are the one. 

Equal Opportunities for all (f/m/d)

ALAIKA is an equal-opportunity employer. We hire on merit and welcome applications from people of all genders, backgrounds, ages, and identities. Our team spirit celebrates diversity. We want you to be your true “you” and offer everyone an open culture and safe space
