title: Content Lead (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Remote-first · Teilzeit (30 Std./Woche) oder Vollzeit

Über snipKI

Unsere Mission: Wir befähigen Unternehmen, KI strategisch richtig anzugehen, Teams mit den nötigen Skills und dem richtigen Mindset auszustatten und Projekte erfolgreich in die Praxis umzusetzen.

snipKI sorgt dafür, dass KI bei den Menschen ankommt – dass sie positiv angenommen und produktiv und sicher in den Arbeitsalltag integriert wird. Dafür setzen wir auf KI-Enablement und befähigen Mitarbeitende in Mittelstand und Enterprise, KI wirklich zu nutzen. Was uns unterscheidet: Unsere Formate sind brandaktuell und maßgeschneidert – nicht nur auf Unternehmens-, sondern auf Personenebene.

Unser Ziel: Wir wollen DIE KI-Marke im DACH-Raum werden – wenn Menschen an KI denken, sollen sie an snipKI denken. Das braucht Vertrauen und starken Content. Genau deshalb wollen wir zu einer echten Content- und Medienmarke im KI-Bereich werden. Wir wachsen schnell und arbeiten remote-first.

Wie wir arbeiten

KI ist bei uns kein Werkzeug, das wir für einzelne Aufgaben aufrufen, sondern die Ebene, auf der wir arbeiten. Postfach, Kalender, Ablage und unsere Projekt- und Wissenssysteme hängen über Konnektoren an unseren KI-Systemen, Wiederkehrendes läuft als Automation, und jede:r im Team baut sich die eigenen Skills und Agenten dafür selbst.

Dazu kommt das Tempo unseres Themas. Was in der KI-Welt heute passiert, ist in zwei Wochen kalt. Unser Content entsteht in Tagen, nicht in Quartalsplänen.

Deine Mission

Als Content Lead verantwortest du unseren gesamten Content, strategisch und vor allem hands-on. Strategisch heißt: Du entscheidest, welche Kanäle wir aufbauen und welche nicht, und baust sie dann auch. Hands-on heißt: Du produzierst selbst.

Das ist bewusst keine Rolle mit einem Menschen-Team unter dir: Du führst ein Team aus Agenten und Automationen, das du selbst aufbaust. Die Ideen kommen aus dem ganzen Team, du entscheidest, welcher Inhalt auf welchen Kanal gehört, produzierst ihn und sorgst dafür, dass alles aus einem Guss ist. Du hast den vollen Überblick über unseren Content und machst snipKI als Marke sichtbar.

Aufgaben

Diese Kanäle baust du aus, und die nächsten baust du auf

  • Newsletter

  • Die LinkedIn-Profile unserer Gründer und unseres Teams

  • Den LinkedIn-Unternehmensaccount

  • Unseren neuen Podcast (im Aufbau)

  • Unseren YouTube-Kanal

  • Unsere Website (Testimonials, Case Studies) und weitere Social-Kanäle

  • Und weitere Experimente mit neuen Kanälen

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entscheidest, auf welchen Kanälen wir wachsen: Du übersetzt Themen in einen kanalübergreifenden Plan, gibst jedem Kanal eine eigene Rolle statt überall dasselbe zu posten, und du sagst uns auch, welchen Kanal wir sein lassen sollten.

  • Du produzierst hands-on: Du schreibst stark, erstellst Bilder und schneidest Videos. Den Großteil davon erstellst du KI-gestützt, aber du bist immer der human-in-the-loop und prüfst alles selbst.

  • Du veröffentlichst und steuerst den Redaktionsplan: was wann wo erscheint.

  • Du baust dir die Produktionsstrecke selbst: Agenten, Skills und Automationen, die Recherche, Rohentwürfe, Varianten pro Kanal und Wiederverwertung übernehmen.

  • Du baust unseren LinkedIn-Unternehmensaccount aus und entwickelst die persönlichen Profile von Gründern und Team weiter – und dein eigenes natürlich.

  • Du sorgst für Markenkonsistenz und Premium-Qualität über alle Kanäle hinweg.

  • Du recycelst Inhalte und spinnst sie weiter (z. B. einzelne Content-Pieces aus unseren Studien-Daten) und holst Kunden-Testimonials & Case Studies ein – für Website und Social.

  • Du baust unsere neuen Formate mit auf: Podcast, YouTube & Co.

  • Du hältst unseren Content-Stack auf Stand: Du probierst neue Modelle und Systeme aus, wirfst raus, was nicht mehr das Beste ist, und gibst dein Wissen ins Team zurück.

Qualifikation

So arbeitest du mit KI

  • KI ist dein Haupt-Arbeitsmodus, nicht dein Hilfsmittel: Du arbeitest den Großteil deines Tages in KI-Systemen, nicht daneben.

  • Du hast deine Arbeitsumgebung selbst angebunden: Mail, Kalender, Ablage, Projekt- oder Wissenstool hängen über Konnektoren an deinem KI-System.

  • Du baust dir eigene Bausteine statt jedes Mal neu zu prompten: Projekte und Skills. Und du automatisierst Wiederkehrendes.

  • Du hast schon mal etwas gebaut, das du eigentlich nicht bauen kannst: ein kleines Tool, eine Seite, per Vibe Coding zusammengesetzt.

Kein Muss sind n8n, Make oder Programmieren. Wenn du das mitbringst, umso besser. Wenn nicht, reicht die Bereitschaft, dir Automationen selbst zusammenzubauen.

So machst du Content

  • Du hast mindestens einen Kanal selbst von null aufgebaut, ein LinkedIn-Profil, einen Newsletter, einen Podcast oder einen YouTube-Kanal, und kannst sagen, was der Hebel war.

  • Du denkst in Kanal-Logiken statt in Content-Stücken: Dasselbe Thema braucht auf LinkedIn, im Podcast und auf YouTube eine andere Form.

  • Du wählst Themen nach Relevanz und Positionierung, nicht nach Suchvolumen. Vieles, was wir spielen, ist so neu, dass noch niemand danach sucht.

  • Du arbeitest im Takt des Themas: Ein KI-Thema ist nach zwei Wochen kalt.

Und das bringst du außerdem mit

  • Du hast ein hervorragendes Gespür für Sprache und Kommunikation und schreibst exzellent auf Deutsch.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, greifst Ideen auf und spinnst sie eigenständig weiter.

  • Du bist schnell, pragmatisch und lieferst – auch ohne dass alles bis ins Detail vorgegeben ist.

Nice to have

  • Automatisierung mit n8n, Make oder Zapier, oder eigene kleine Tools.

  • Visuelles und redaktionelles Storytelling, Fotografie, Adobe Creative Suite.

  • Ein Gründer- bzw. Macher-Mindset.

Was dich erwartet

  • Volle Ownership: Du entscheidest über Kanäle, Themen und Produktion, nicht über eine Freigabekette hinweg.

  • Die Chance, snipKI von Grund auf als Content- und Medienmarke mitaufzubauen.

  • Arbeiten an der vordersten Front der KI: Budget für die Systeme, die du brauchst, und keine Freigabeschleife, um ein neues Modell auszuprobieren.

  • Ein ambitioniertes, nahbares Team, das genauso arbeitet wie du, und kurze Wege.

  • Remote-first mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten; Teilzeit (20–30 Std.) oder Vollzeit möglich.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung – zeig uns am besten direkt ein paar Beispiele deiner Arbeit (Content, Profile, Videos, Bilder).

Und beschreib uns deinen KI-Setup. Ein paar Sätze, ein Screenshot oder ein kurzes Video reichen: Mit welchen KI-Systemen arbeitest du, was hast du angebunden, welche eigenen Skills, Projekte oder Automationen hast du gebaut, und was davon hat dir letzte Woche konkret Arbeit abgenommen.

title: Contract manager
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

The Exploration Company builds complex space systems under contracts with government and institutional customers. Programs of this kind evolve: requirements change, design maturity improves, schedules shift, and suppliers and customers request adjustments. Each change must be formally proposed, assessed, negotiated, and recorded in the contract before it can be executed and paid for.

As Contract Manager, you will own the change lifecycle for your assigned contracts. You will drive Contract Change Notices (CCNs) from initial request to signature, protect the company's position on scope, cost, and schedule, and keep the contract baseline accurate for the program team.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the CCN lifecycle from receipt or initiation through impact assessment, negotiation, approval, and formal issue, with clear ownership and deadlines for every open item.

  • Chase and track open CCNs with customer contracting officers, program managers, and internal stakeholders, and escalate delays that threaten schedule or cash flow.

  • Coordinate impact assessments with engineering, quality, supply chain, and finance, covering technical scope, cost, schedule, risk, and compliance effects.

  • Prepare and negotiate change proposals, including pricing justification, supporting documentation, and changes to terms and conditions.

  • Maintain the contract baseline by recording each approved CCN in the contract register and ensuring the scope, price, milestones, and deliverables reflect the current agreed position.

  • Monitor entitlement and notice obligations, including time limits for submitting change requests and claims under the contract and applicable procurement rules.

  • Manage the CCN register and reporting, providing regular status updates on open, pending, and approved changes, value at stake, and aging to program leadership.

  • Support invoicing and revenue recognition by ensuring approved changes are reflected in billing milestones and Odoo or ERP records.

  • Ensure compliance with the contract's terms, applicable public procurement and export-control rules, and internal approval and delegation-of-authority policies.

  • Prepare for audits and reviews by maintaining a complete, traceable record of change decisions and correspondence.

title: Contract Senior Data Analyst (SQL,Telemetry,Browser Engine)
descriptionHtml:
The Gecko platform is the core engine of our product experience. To maintain competitiveness and user satisfaction, we must move beyond surface-level metrics to understand the deep correlations between engine performance and real-world user behavior. We currently face challenges with data quality, such as bot contamination in nightly telemetry, which obscures our understanding of true performance trends. A dedicated analyst is required to bridge the gap between engineering telemetry and actionable product strategy, ensuring that leadership has high-fidelity data to prioritize performance guardrails and technical budgets.

Engineering Deliverables

  • Automated Dashboards: Create and maintain high-level overview dashboards that translate complex performance data into consumable formats for Product Managers and leadership.
  • Telemetry Gap Analysis: Audit the Gecko codebase to identify missing collection points or "probes" necessary for a complete understanding of the product experience.
  • Data Sanitization Frameworks: Develop methodologies and tools to identify and filter data inconsistencies, specifically focusing on isolating bot traffic and hardware-specific noise from telemetry streams.
  • Behavioral Inference Reports: Deliver deep-dive analyses correlating technical performance shifts (e.g., LCP, eTLD+1) with user-facing pain points and engagement trends.

Scope, Skills, and Effort Estimate

Scope

The analyst will focus exclusively on Gecko engine telemetry across multiple platforms (Desktop and Android), collaborating with the Performance Team, Data Team, and Product Leadership.

Required Skills

  • Technical: Advanced SQL (BigQuery/Redash), proficiency in data visualization using AI tooling, and experience with statistical analysis (e.g., Pearson’s correlation, multivariate analysis). Knowledge of Rust/C++ is a strong plus. Strong proficiency with AI tools like Claude Code, Codex, or similar is highly desirable. 
  • Domain Knowledge: Ability to understand browser component interactions and their impact on user experience.
  • Soft Skills: Proven ability to work independently, translating technical requirements into business insights.
  • Independent problem solving: Comfortable working in unfamiliar technical problem spaces and figuring out a path forward with minimal guidance, using documentation, experimentation, source code, data, and other available resources.

Hiring Ranges:

Remote UK£58,500—£78,000 GBP

title: Controls Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

 

🛠️ About our Robotics Team

The Robotics team is responsible for bridging the gap from our model to our vehicle platforms, in order to let the model focus on making driving decisions. We aim to provide high quality data to the model for making such decisions, whilst abstracting away platform-specific aspects. We combine specialisms across the robotics domain, blending strong theoretical foundations with solid engineering practice to span the spectrum from research to production.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Develop, integrate, tune, and validate control, trajectory-generation, and action-processing algorithms across different vehicle platforms, operating modes, and challenging driving conditions, ensuring robust real-world performance

  • Maintain and evolve our controls software architecture that connects AI Driver outputs to real-time vehicle actuation and feedback

  • Own requirements, release readiness, and in-field performance and issue triage

  • Implement and maintain production-quality, latency-sensitive control software in C++ for deployment to prototype, reference and production vehicles

  • Use simulation, closed-loop evaluation and on-road testing to characterize controller behaviour, diagnose performance issues and validate improvements

  • Work with teams across Wayve to define controller interfaces, integrate with adjacent systems and enable new vehicle platforms and product features (Ownership through the full lifecycle)

  • Define and track quality metrics (e.g., comfort, tracking error, and safety margin KPIs, and regressions against them)

  • Contribute to safety artefacts: provide evidence for safety cases, work with the safety team to ensure compliance with required standards

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

In this role you will develop and improve the vehicle trajectory and motion controllers that translate the Wayve AI Driver outputs into safe, smooth and robust vehicle motion across different vehicle platforms and applications (both ADAS and AV). You’ll tackle cutting-edge challenges: developing principled controls approaches, implementing real time systems, testing in complex scenarios and refining our evaluation pipelines. This is a great chance to make an impact on the AV industry and grow alongside a focused team of passionate experts at the forefront of autonomous driving technology.

🙌 You should apply if you have:

Required Skills/Experience

  • Strong fundamentals in control theory, with applied experience in one or more of optimization, model-predictive control, numerical methods or dynamical systems

  • Practical experience developing, tuning and validating motion control on complex real world physical systems (e.g., direct experience with mobile robotics and/or autonomous vehicles)

  • Experience with test and validation discipline: unit and integration tests, simulation regression suites, closed-loop metrics.

  • Strong software engineering skills, with experience building reliable production-quality systems in C++

  • Experience with latency-sensitive or real-time software

  • Ability to reason about and debug system-level behaviour in complex robotic systems across software and hardware

Desired Skills/Experience

  • Applied machine learning experience, or experience developing systems that integrate with ML components

  • Vehicle dynamics and actuation. Steering, braking and powertrain interfaces, actuator delay models, and CAN or similar vehicle bus experience

  • Experience in the automotive industry, including ADAS or vehicle controls

  • Experience with safety-critical systems, validation, and relevant industry standards (e.g. ISO 26262)

  • Experience with monitoring and diagnostics: Logging, fault detection, and on-platform debugging tools, ideally with experience investigating field issues

  • Experience across multiple platforms or vehicles. The team supports vehicle-to-vehicle variation, such as accounting for parameter identification, calibration, and keeping one software stack across hardware variants

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen: general background, current situation, interests and Wayve company information & hiring context.

  • Competency Interviews: programming and code review.

  • Deep-dive technical interviews: domain knowledge & system design.

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment.

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

 

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

title: Conversion Manager - Financial Services
descriptionHtml:
Why This Role Exists

At Pennylane, our website plays a pivotal role in acquiring and converting customers, transforming traffic from paid acquisition, SEO, partnerships, and other channels into sign-ups, demo bookings, and product adoption.

 

As we accelerate our Financial Services offering, including pro account, and the monetization of our existing customer base, we are seeking a Conversion Manager to own conversion across these strategic areas.

 

You will lead the production and optimization of website pages and paid landing pages, from identifying friction to measuring business impact.

 

You will join the Website team within Growth and collaborate closely with Growth Engineers and Data in a multidisciplinary squad.

 

🌍 About Pennylane

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

 

Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising their clients.

 

Key Figures and Ambition

  • 💻 Over 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane

  • 🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Over 1,100 Pennylaners from more than 25 nationalities

  • 💰 More than €400 million raised since launch

  • 🌍 Remote-friendly, international culture expanding across Europe

 

What You’ll Do

You will own conversion across the Financial Services and Monetization scope, working across website pages, paid landing pages, product journeys, experimentation, and measurement.

 

Own CRO and Experimentation

  • Define and execute the conversion strategy for key journeys, including pro account landing pages, pricing and product pages, demo-booking journeys, self-sign-up, and upsell flows

  • Build and run a continuous A/B testing program, from ideation and scoping to sizing, analysis, and ship-or-kill decisions

  • Identify conversion friction and opportunities through analytics and behavioral insights

  • Develop clear hypotheses based on user behavior, business priorities, and funnel performance

  • Ensure experiments are measured against meaningful business outcomes

 

Manage the Website Conversion Roadmap

  • Own and prioritize the conversion roadmap for your scope based on expected impact and feasibility

  • Turn opportunities into actionable briefs, specifications, and delivery plans

  • Work closely with Growth Engineers, Data, Design, and other stakeholders to ship improvements

  • Coordinate QA, launch, and post-launch analysis

  • Own key Financial Services journeys, including pro account activation and the accountant portal

  • Contribute to monetization journeys such as upsell and self-sign-up

 

Build and Optimize Paid Landing Pages

  • Produce and optimize landing pages for Financial Services and Monetization campaigns

  • Partner with Demand Generation and Paid/SEA teams to translate campaign objectives into high-performing pages

  • Develop a strong understanding of target audiences, market context, and local messaging

  • Use these insights to improve both paid landing pages and the wider website experience

 

Own Measurement and Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Define instrumentation and tracking plans with Data

  • Build and maintain dashboards to monitor conversion performance

  • Report on results, learnings, and next steps to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Work closely with Demand Gen, Product, Sales and Customer Success Operations, Brand, Design, and Engineering

  • Create alignment across teams and move projects forward without relying on formal authority

 

What You Bring

  • 3–5 years of experience in CRO, Conversion, Website Product Management, Growth, or a related field

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, digital products, or another data-driven environment

  • A track record of shipping initiatives end-to-end and demonstrating their impact on business metrics

  • Strong hands-on experience with analytics and CRO tools, such as Amplitude and Contentsquare

  • Ability to independently analyse data, identify patterns, and formulate relevant hypotheses

  • Solid understanding of A/B testing methodology, including experiment sizing, success metrics, statistical pitfalls, and decision-making

  • Experience managing a roadmap and prioritizing initiatives based on impact and feasibility

  • Strong project management skills, from writing a clear brief to coordinating delivery and measuring results

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to:

    • Write clear briefs for designers and engineers

    • Explain prioritization decisions to stakeholders

    • Present results and recommendations to non-technical audiences

  • Ability to build relationships and secure alignment across multiple teams

  • Fluent French and professional English

 

🛠️ Tools and Environment

You will work with tools and processes dedicated to experimentation, analytics, behavioral analysis, tracking, and landing-page production.

 

Our Tools Include

  • Amplitude

  • Contentsquare

  • A/B testing and experimentation platforms

  • Analytics and reporting dashboards

  • Website content and landing-page production tools

 

You will collaborate closely with Growth Engineers, Data, Demand Generation, Product, Sales and Customer Success Operations, Brand, and Design.

 

What You Can Expect

  • Direct and measurable impact on sign-ups, demo bookings, product activation, and upsell performance

Success in This Role

Your success will be measured by:

  • The speed and volume of website and landing-page delivery

  • Conversion-rate improvement across the Financial Services and Monetization funnels

  • Growth in relevant outcomes, including sign-ups and demo bookings

Permanent position based in Paris on a hybrid basis or fully remote anywhere in France.

title: Copy of Clinical Implementation Manager  (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Company overview

Mindpeak is building cutting-edge AI technology to transform cancer diagnostics for the better. Our AI-powered software is already in clinical use across more than 25 countries, helping pathologists assess tumour tissue faster, more accurately, and more consistently. Every year, tens of thousands of cancer patients already benefit from quicker and more accurate diagnoses enabled by our technology.

Our mission is to scale this impact worldwide and help make personalised, effective cancer treatment accessible to every patient no matter where they are. By combining state-of-the-art AI with real-world clinical impact, we're working toward a future where every cancer patient gets the best possible diagnosis and, ultimately, the best possible care.

The role

Laboratories are digitising fast, and demand for our diagnostic AI has outgrown the way we deliver it. Every new lab is a project with many moving parts: our software is connected to the lab's image management and information systems, our AI is calibrated and validated on their cases, pathologists are trained, and the requirements of their market and accreditors are met. Each project brings together lab directors, pathologists and IT on the customer side, scanner and software partners, and our product, ML, engineering and quality teams internally. Usually several of these projects run at the same time and compete for the same people.

As Clinical Implementation Manager you own the delivery of these projects, from signed contract to routine clinical use. You set the plan, direct the specialists who do the technical work, make the trade-offs when projects compete, and carry the go-live date. From day one you own around 10 lab customers in parallel, from smaller labs to important accounts, without needing someone to tell you what to do next.

This is a senior delivery role. We are looking for someone who has done this before and can take ownership quickly, not someone who will learn project execution on the job. It is not a sales role and carries no sales target.

What you'll own

Delivery of our lab implementations

  • Own each implementation end to end: plan, milestones, dependencies, risks and the committed go-live date.

  • Run several implementations in parallel. Sequence them, decide what moves first when they compete for ML, engineering or customer time, and escalate only what you cannot resolve.

  • Drive technical integration with the lab and its partners (IMS, LIS, scanners, network and security reviews), working directly with our engineers and the customer's IT.

  • Direct the work of our product, ML, engineering and quality teams and of the customer's staff. Get firm commitments, follow them up, and don't accept "not possible right now" without a plan.

  • Accompany the validation each lab runs before go-live. The lab's medical director designs the study; you make sure the setup works, our teams deliver what the validation depends on, and the lab has everything it needs to finish.

  • Raise risks early, with options and a recommendation, rather than after a date slips.

The customer relationship through go-live and beyond

  • Be the lab's main operational contact: run the regular project calls, send the recaps, keep every open item owned and dated on both sides.

  • After go-live, own support for your labs: monitor usage, resolve what you can, coordinate product and engineering on the rest, and close the loop.

  • Bring structured customer feedback into product planning, and flag expansion opportunities to Sales.

How we deliver

  • Use and improve our delivery playbook, tracking and tooling so each implementation is faster and more predictable than the last.

What success looks like after six months

  • You run our small and mid-size lab implementations independently, with the Head of Diagnostic Products informed but no longer in the day-to-day.

  • Several onboardings run in parallel to plan, with fewer surprises close to deadlines.

  • Customers have one competent contact; our internal teams get clear, prioritised requests instead of ad-hoc escalations.

  • You are taking over parts of our larger, more product-heavy accounts.

Your profile

  • At least 2–3 years delivering projects to external customers, with several clients in parallel and at least one project owned from kickoff to go-live: clinical or diagnostic software, digital pathology, laboratory or medical device rollout, health IT, or comparable B2B delivery.

  • A track record of hitting committed dates in projects with dependencies you did not control. You can describe a project that went wrong and what you did about it.

  • A degree in a life or natural science such as biology, medicine, chemistry or physics, or several years of work in a comparable scientific field. You speak credibly with pathologists and can judge whether a pragmatic shortcut still makes scientific sense.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication. You lead conversations with lab directors, pathologists and IT teams, get commitments from people you don't manage, and raise blockers early. You work credibly with developers: you understand how they work and can challenge their estimates. You don't need to code.

  • Organised and self-driven: you keep many commitments on track without reminders, work in our delivery tools and help improve them, need no hand-holding, and know when "good enough" is the right call.

  • Full professional proficiency in English.

  • Based in Hamburg or willing to relocate, and working on-site with the team.

  • Willing to travel up to 10% of your time: 3–4 trips a year of about a week each, mostly to US customers and scientific conferences.

  • Comfortable with regular late-afternoon or early-evening calls to overlap with US customers.

Nice to have

  • German language skills; experience in pathology, diagnostics or laboratory environments.

  • Experience delivering software into a regulated clinical setting or working within a quality management system.

  • Experience setting up or improving delivery processes and tooling in a growing team.

What Mindpeak offers

  • A role with real ownership in a team that is building out its diagnostics delivery right now.

  • The opportunity to build AI systems that power both clinical cancer diagnostics and data-driven drug development.

  • An open, creative work environment with flat hierarchies and quick decision-making.

  • An excellent leadership team that invests in continuous development.

  • A centrally located Hamburg office with a beautiful view over the harbour.

Application details

Please apply via our website with your CV, references, salary expectations and earliest start date.

Contact: ----- or Christine Stamer at ----- · Website: mindpeak.ai

Note: Direct applicants only; agencies are not considered.

title: Core platform growth engineering
descriptionHtml:
Making preventive health the default for every human in Europe

 

The mission

At Lucis, we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the OS for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives. You can read more about who we are and how we work here.

 

The role

We've processed 200,000+ clinical tests across 4 countries with a team of 20. We're growing 10% week over week. And we're still early.

We need engineers who build systems, not features, people who own outcomes end-to-end, orchestrate AI to execute, and raise the bar for everyone around them.

You won't spend your days writing boilerplate. You'll write specs that agents execute, review AI-generated code with a critical eye, and make decisions that compound over time. This is what engineering looks like now. If that excites you, keep reading.

We'll shape the exact scope together, mobile, infra, platform, AI, full-stack, based on where you're strongest and where we need it most.

  

What we are looking for:

  • Backend: Membership & payments. A confirmed backend engineer (5+ years) who thrives on designing really reliable data models and services, without over-engineering them. You reach for the simplest model that holds. You'll own the systems membership growth runs on: subscriptions and their lifecycle, checkout and payments, promotions and partner offers.

    We're scaling across the EU, with the complexity that comes with it: new countries, currencies, payment methods, and regulations. This is code where a subtle bug costs real money and real trust. You care that the model is right before the endpoint exists, and that every edge case fails safely.

  • Frontend: Engagement & world-class experience. A confirmed frontend engineer (5+ years) with very good craft and a real sensibility for design. You like things crystal clear for the user, you build neat interfaces, and you don't wait for designs to be ready to propose something delightful.

    You'll own what a first-time visitor meets and what keeps members coming back: the acquisition funnel, onboarding, checkout, the everyday surfaces of the product. Your work has to be delightful and reliable for people who have never heard of us and decide in minutes whether to trust us with their health.

 

About you

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

title: Corporate Paralegal
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the Role

Mistral AI's corporate legal team is looking for a Corporate Paralegal to join our growing legal function in Paris. This is a newly created role designed to centralize and streamline the administrative backbone of our corporate legal operations as we scale internationally.

This is a high-autonomy role. You will own several critical workstreams end-to-end — from KYC and entity housekeeping to cap table management and contract administration — and you will be expected to exercise sound judgment, escalate when needed, and drive automation wherever possible.

What you'll do

1. Cap Table & Share Register

Own the cap table across different systems with rigor and precision. Record all share movements — issuances, transfers, ESOP/BSPCE, funding rounds. Maintain the legal share register and reconcile against articles, shareholders' agreements, and board minutes. Produce cap table extracts, shareholder lists, and ownership reports for KYC, audit, board packs, and investors — always under NDA and with judgment on what can be disclosed. Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, reconciliation) are essential.

2. Entity Management, Corporate Formalities & Notarisation

Handle entity creation from incorporation to corporate maintenance across jurisdictions (SAS, Inc, Ltd, Pte, GmbH, etc.) with confidentiality and attention to detail. Manage the annual formalities calendar, board/shareholder minutes, resolutions, powers of attorney, and the entity housekeeping file for each group company. Coordinate notarial formalities — share transfers, capital changes, statutory modifications, pledges. Handle apostilles, legalisation, and certified translations for documents used abroad via the Legal Vision Platform. Maintain up-to-date KYC packs for each entity: Kbis, articles, directors, beneficial ownership, administrative certificates. Respond to inbound KYC requests from banks, clients, and investors. Log every formalité for a complete and auditable record.

3. Insurance & Document Management

Manage insurance policies, certificates (COIs), and the renewal calendar. Handle COI requests by checking them against contractual requirements and following up with brokers. Keep a register of policies and claims. File and archive documents with naming conventions and versioning in our document management tools. Manage e-signatures (DocuSign). Maintain the contract register with expiry dates and notice periods. Provide up-to-date insurance certificates and policy summaries as part of KYC documentation for each entity.

4. Procurement Contracts

First-level review of NDAs, order forms, and simple SOWs against Mistral templates, flagging deviations for escalation. Version comparison and clean redlines. Understand the procurement policy to know when legal review is mandatory. Coordinate with Procurement, business teams, and Finance to move deals to signature. Complete supplier onboarding questionnaires (anti-bribery, sanctions, ESG, security) and supplier portals (Ariba, Coupa) as part of the vendor KYC process. Comfortable with tools like Ironclad, Notion, and Slack; keen to automate and reduce manual work.

What you bring

  • 10+ years of experience in a legal field, with a strong preference for corporate law (M&A, banking, funds, or large corporate groups).

  • Experience in a law firm (corporate/M&A/banking), investment fund, bank, or a large multinational group (e.g., CAC 40).

  • Proven experience with KYC processes, questionnaires, and administrative certificates.

  • Strong understanding of confidentiality, data protection (GDPR), and the judgment to know what can and cannot be shared externally.

  • Hands-on experience with cap table management tools (Ledgy, Axiocap) or share register administration.

  • Familiarity with French corporate law (SAS) and international entity structures (Delaware Inc, UK Ltd, Singapore Pte, German GmbH).

  • Experience with contract lifecycle management (CLM) tools and e-signature platforms.

  • Exposure to procurement contract review and vendor onboarding.

  • Fluent in English and French (both written and spoken). Additional languages are a plus.

What We Offer

Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

  • Schnitterfahrung: Du beherrschst Videoschnitt sicher – Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve oder vergleichbar – und lieferst aus Rohmaterial eigenständig fertige, plattformgerechte Video-Creatives inklusive Schnittrhythmus, Text-Overlays, Untertiteln und Sound.
  • Bildbearbeitung & Grafik: Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma oder vergleichbare Tools sind dein Handwerkszeug. Freisteller, Retusche, Composings, Layouts und saubere Exportformate für Web, Social und Amazon gehen dir leicht von der Hand.
  • Ein Portfolio, das beides zeigt – Video und Static.

Das ist uns außerdem wichtig

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Grafik-, Motion- oder Creative Designer:in, idealerweise im E-Commerce, D2C oder in einer Performance-Agentur.
  • Ein Verständnis dafür, was Performance Creatives von schönen Grafiken unterscheidet: Hook, Klarheit, Tempo, Lesbarkeit auf dem Handy.
  • Gespür für Social-Plattformen: Du weißt, wie Content auf TikTok, Instagram und Pinterest aussehen muss, um nicht weggewischt zu werden.
  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du jonglierst mehrere Aufträge parallel, hältst Deadlines und behältst den Überblick über Formate, Versionen und Assets.

Das zählt für uns am meisten

  • Lust darauf, wirklich das ganze visuelle Spektrum zu bespielen, Neugier auf neue Tools und die Motivation, mit der Rolle und dem Team zu wachsen. Das Handwerk setzen wir voraus – für alles darüber hinaus ist uns Drive wichtiger als das perfekte Profil.

Nice to have

  • Erfahrung mit KI-Tools in der Bild- oder Videoproduktion (z. B. Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, ElevenLabs).
  • Fotografie- oder Kamera-Erfahrung für Shootings.
  • Kenntnisse in Shopify (Bildformate, Theme-Assets) oder Amazon-Bildrichtlinien.
  • Erfahrung im Fitness- oder Sport-Umfeld.

Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt unter „außerdem wichtig“? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Uns interessiert dein Portfolio und wie du denkst – nicht, ob du jede Zeile abhaken kannst.

Benefits

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Du arbeitest überwiegend remote und profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, die dir eine eigenverantwortliche Gestaltung deines Arbeitsalltags ermöglichen. Zu Shootings triffst du das Team vor Ort – der Rest läuft von dort, wo du am besten arbeitest.
  • Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: Neben moderner Hardware und den Tools, die du brauchst, erhältst du eine Spenditcard mit monatlich 50 € steuerfreiem Sachbezug sowie ein persönliches Educational Budget für deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung.

  • Dynamisches Startup-Umfeld: Freue dich auf kurze Entscheidungswege, regelmäßige Team-Events und ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld in einer schnell wachsenden E-Commerce-Marke.

Wir glauben, dass Vielfalt uns stärker macht. Deshalb heißen wir alle Bewerbenden willkommen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion, Alter, sexueller Identität oder Behinderung. title: Creative Director (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Jobbeschreibung

Über Teaching Socials

Teaching Socials ist die führende Unternehmensberatung für Personal Brands im Finanz- & Immobilienbereich im DACH-Raum. Unser Team aus 25 High-Performern hat innerhalb von 2 Jahren ein konstantes Monatswachstum von über 750.000 € aufgebaut. Wir verbinden Sichtbarkeit, Kundenakquise und Unternehmenswachstum in einem System – und du sorgst mit deinen Videos dafür, dass aus Ideen Reichweite, aus Zuschauern qualifizierte Leads und aus Personal Brands messbare Ergebnisse werden.

Deine Aufgaben

Content-Strategie: Du entwickelst für jeden Kunden einen Content-Plan für die nächsten Wochen und leitest daraus einen klaren Produktionsplan für die Cutter ab.

  • Ideen und Skripte: Du findest die Themen, Hooks und Titel für alle Hauptvideos auf YouTube und schreibst die Skripte selbst.
  • Dreh: Du begleitest Drehs, verstehst Kamera, Licht und Ton und greifst selbst zur Kamera, wenn es nötig ist.
  • Schnitt und Qualität: Du gibst jedes Video frei, bevor es zum Kunden geht. Was nicht gut genug ist, geht zurück.
  • Cutter-Führung: Du führst das Cutter-Team, gibst regelmäßig konkretes Feedback und machst jeden Editor messbar besser.
  • Shortform und Ads: Du sorgst dafür, dass aus jedem Longform-Video verwertbare Clips und Ad-Creatives entstehen.
  • Kundenkommunikation: Du führst die Weeklys mit unseren Kunden, erklärst, was produziert wird und warum, und vertrittst deine Entscheidungen auch dann, wenn der Kunde anders denkt.

Was für dich drin ist:

  • Starkes Team: Familiäres Umfeld, gemeinsame Erfolge und Geburtstage
  • Schnelle Wege: Deine Ideen werden intern umgesetzt, statt in endlosen Entscheidungsschleifen zu versanden
  • Direkter Impact: Deine Videos beeinflussen unmittelbar Reichweite, Leads und Umsätze unserer Kunden
  • Führung: Du führst ein eigenes Cutter-Team und prägst, wie bei uns Content entsteht
  • Wachstum: Du arbeitest mit unterschiedlichen Personal Brands, Formaten und Zielgruppen und entwickelst dich als Creator und Führungskraft kontinuierlich weiter

Das bringst du mit:

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung als Content Creator, Video Producer oder Head of Content, idealerweise mit Fokus auf YouTube-Longform, Shortform und Video-Ads
  • Ein Portfolio mit Videos, die du verantwortet hast, idealerweise mit messbaren Ergebnissen wie Views, Klickrate und Zuschauerbindung
  • Fundiertes Verständnis dafür, was ein Video viral macht: Hook, Titel, Thumbnail, Storytelling und Retention
  • Starkes Gespür für Ideen und Skripte: Du schreibst YouTube-Skripte selbst, die Zuschauer bis zum Ende halten
  • Editing auf hohem Niveau: Longform, Shortform und cinematic – idealerweise bist du selbst Creator
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Kamera, Licht und Ton: Du kannst selbst drehen
  • Verständnis für Video-Ads und ihre Rolle im Funnel und in der Customer Journey
  • Sicherer Umgang mit relevanten Kennzahlen wie CTR, Zuschauerbindung, Views und CPL
  • Führungserfahrung: Du steuerst mehrere Cutter gleichzeitig, planst Produktion und gibst Feedback, das dein Team besser macht
  • Souveräne Kundenkommunikation: Du führst Weeklys und vertrittst deine Content-Entscheidungen auch gegenüber anspruchsvollen Unternehmern
  • Hohe Standards: Kein Video verlässt dein Team, hinter dem du nicht selbst stehst
  • Eigenverantwortung: Du wartest nicht auf Ansagen, sondern bringst eigene Ideen und Trends ein
  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau
  • Ein Plus: Erfahrung mit Podcast- und Event-Drehs sowie tiefes Technik-Verständnis (Kamera-Setups, Equipment, Workflows)

Du passt eher nicht zu uns, wenn …

  • du lieber schöne Bilder produzierst, statt Videos, die Reichweite und Nachfrage erzeugen
  • du nur schneiden willst und Ideen, Skripte und Strategie anderen überlässt
  • du dich auf Bauchgefühl verlässt und Klickrate, Retention und Views ignorierst
  • du Videos rausgibst, hinter denen du selbst nicht stehst
  • du Trends anderer kopierst, statt eigene Ideen und Formate zu entwickeln
  • du Feedback persönlich nimmst oder deinem Team kein klares Feedback geben willst
  • du lange an einem einzelnen Video feilst, aber Schwierigkeiten hast, im Volumen zu liefern
  • du Deadlines eher als Empfehlung siehst
  • du Kunden nicht klar sagen magst, wenn etwas nicht funktioniert
  • dich klare Ziele, Zahlen und ein performanceorientiertes Umfeld eher abschrecken
  • du einfach nur einen Job suchst und nicht bereit bist, dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln

Stellenanforderungen

title: Creative Director, Tidal
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Tidal was founded for artists by artists as the next innovative streaming platform to bring value back to the music industry. We empower artists with the products, resources, services, and content required to take control of their careers and connect more deeply with fans. Available in over 60+ countries, Tidal continues to help artists break down economic barriers to continue creating what's next in culture. Tidal is part of Block, Inc. (NYSE: SQ), a global technology company with a focus on financial services.

The Role

Tidal is a small, nimble design team building at the intersection of music, technology, and culture—shipping across uploads, streaming, AI-powered creative tools, and financial services that connect artists directly with their audiences in 60+ countries. We're looking for a Creative Director to help set the vision and quality bar across Tidal's product and brand ecosystem. This is a rare opportunity to be a foundational creative voice on a small team where your work will have outsized impact—shaping not just pixels but the future of how artists build careers. You'll drive complex initiatives from concept to ship, influence cross-functional strategy, and directly elevate the craft of everyone around you.

This is an individual contributor role. You'll lead project teams and set the creative standard.

You Will

  • Originate brand platforms and campaign-level ideas, and own them from concept through 360 activation
  • Reposition, reshape the brand and bring a tapped in culture and keep the platform coherent across brand and product surfaces
  • Hold the idea intact from first cut to final placement
  • Shape the brief alongside an embedded creative-strategy team
  • Design and when needed direct designers, writers, and production partners on the work
  • Work with marketing, product, and partnerships leadership to get campaigns made

You Have

  • A portfolio of work you led as a creative director: brand platforms, repositionings, campaigns, activations
  • An art direction background and the visual judgment to lead the idea in any medium
  • A track record setting creative vision and quality standards for a brand, while staying hands-on with the work
  • Credibility with cross-functional leadership as a peer
  • A history of catching cultural shifts early and putting them in the work
  • Experience carrying brand thinking across multiple products or business lines
  • Experience working in agencies, in-house, or both

How to Apply

Please submit your application along with a link to your portfolio. If your portfolio is password-protected, include the password in your application.

EEOC

We’re working to build a more inclusive economy where our customers have equal access to opportunity, and we strive to live by these same values in building our workplace. Block is a proud equal opportunity employer. We work hard to evaluate all employees and job applicants consistently, based solely on the core competencies required of the role at hand, and without regard to any legally protected class.

We believe in being fair, and are committed to an inclusive interview experience, including providing reasonable accommodations to disabled applicants throughout the recruitment process. We encourage applicants to share any needed accommodations with their recruiter, who will treat these requests as confidentially as possible. Want to learn more about what we’re doing to build an inclusive workplace? Check out our Inclusion & Diversity page

Application Guidelines

Candidates may submit up to 9 active applications within a 60-day period. Reapplications to the same role are accepted 90 days after a previous application has been reviewed.

Use of AI in Our Hiring Process

We may use automated AI tools to evaluate job applications for efficiency and consistency. These tools comply with local regulations, including bias audits, and we handle all personal data in accordance with state and local privacy laws. 

Contact us here with hiring practice or data usage questions.

Every benefit we offer is designed with one goal: empowering you to do the best work of your career while building the life you want. Remote work, medical insurance, flexible time off, retirement savings plans, and modern family planning are just some of our offering. Check out our other benefits at Block.

Block, Inc. (NYSE: XYZ) builds technology to increase access to the global economy. Each of our brands unlocks different aspects of the economy for more people. Square makes commerce and financial services accessible to sellers. Cash App is the easy way to spend, send, and store money. Afterpay is transforming the way customers manage their spending over time. TIDAL is a music platform that empowers artists to thrive as entrepreneurs. Bitkey is a simple self-custody wallet built for bitcoin. Proto is a suite of bitcoin mining products and services. Together, we’re helping build a financial system that is open to everyone.

title: Creative Lead
descriptionHtml:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

The Role

We're hiring a Creative Lead to help shape how tem shows up in the world. This is a senior, hands-on creative role sitting within our Brand & Credibility team, working closely with Product and Growth to turn strategy into work that's bold, sharp, and unmistakably tem. You'll report into the Senior Brand Lead and work closely together to build strong brand foundations and multi-channel campaigns that compound on each other for outsized impact. You won't just be setting direction from the sidelines. You'll be in the work daily, building alongside our existing creative team, low ego, high craft, always moving fast without dropping the bar.

In your first 12 months, you might:

  • Establish a clear creative system for tem's brand, from visual identity to campaign storytelling, that makes our work instantly recognisable.

  • Ship standout creative across a major launch or campaign that builds real emotional connection with a specific audience.

  • Take ownership of our tem self-serve creative AI tool, driving adoption across the larger organisation to reduce rote work without sacrificing quality.

  • Set up metric tracking and reporting for the studio, establishing a baseline for speed of execution and reporting progress against it.

  • Define what "fast and high quality" looks like for the studio, and put the systems in place to make it repeatable.

  • Identify and close a skills gap on the team through collaboration, hands-on coaching or targeted training.

Responsibilities

  • Shape the creative system: Translate our strategy and positioning into a distinctive visual identity, storytelling, and campaigns that make tem culturally relevant and instantly recognisable.

  • Build with impact: Deliver standout creative across launches, campaigns, web, and product moments that captures attention and builds emotional connection with specific audiences.

  • Lead an AI-first practice: Use modern AI tools and workflows to accelerate concepting, iteration, and production, and take ownership of our internal self-serve creative AI tool.

  • Lead without dictating: Put the systems and standards in place that everyone works to, and remove the blockers that get in the way of great work. You won't be across every project or act as gatekeeper - leadership here means levelling people up, not creative dictatorship.

  • Maintain high standards: Establish strong creative standards and help everyone produce work that feels bold, coherent, and world-class.

  • Balance pace and quality: Move fast without sacrificing craft, and bring the same energy to a scrappy project as to a major activation.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with Brand, Product, and Growth to make sure creative work drives real business outcomes, from brand awareness to product adoption.

Requirements

Must-Haves

  • In-house experience shaping or evolving a strong brand, having played a key role in building a brand identity, campaign platform, or creative system that meaningfully changed how a company was perceived.

  • Practical, proactive experience bringing AI-driven tools into a business, with a track record of accelerating concepting, design, storytelling, or production.

  • A portfolio demonstrating exceptional creative craft, with bold, memorable work across brand, campaigns, and digital experiences.

  • Startup or scale-up experience, shipping quickly in a fast-moving environment while holding a high bar for quality.

  • Experience working across channels and with a range of budgets, from scrappy to significant, with equal commitment to both.

  • Leadership experience, paired with a genuine willingness to stay hands-on and do the work rather than only direct it.

Desirable

  • Experience in energy, fintech, or another highly regulated industry.

  • Experience working in a remote-first organisation.

  • Motion design experience.

Benefits & Perks

  • Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off.

  • Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

  • Up to GBP1,200 or EUR1,200 per year for your remote setup.

  • Up to GBP150 or EUR150 per month for wellbeing.

Interview Process

  • First call with our Talent Team (30 mins).

  • Behaviour Interview with the Hiring Manager (30 mins).

  • Practical Interview with the Team (45 mins).

  • Bar Raiser Interview with a Business Leader (45 mins).

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

title: Creative Strategist
descriptionHtml:
Leads Power, c’est quoi ?

Une agence dont le cœur de métier est la lead gen, avec un pôle e-commerce en plein développement. On gère de gros budgets d’investissement publicitaire, et l’entreprise est portée par des équipes talentueuses.

Sur les Social Ads, la créa fait énormément. On cherche la personne qui va alimenter notre pipeline de concepts et qui ne sera jamais à court d’idées.

Ton rôle

Tu es la machine à idées de l’équipe. Tu trouves les concepts et les angles qui font scaler les comptes, tu les fais produire, puis tu analyses ce que ça donne.

Ce poste est stratégique, pas opérationnel : tu imagines et tu pilotes, le studio exécute.

Ce que tu fais au quotidien

  • Tu épluches les ads des concurrents et des top spenders pour dénicher les concepts forts : ce qui tourne, depuis combien de temps, pourquoi ça marche

  • Tu suis les tendances organiques (TikTok, Reels, formats, codes, sons) et tu les transformes en pubs qui convertissent

  • Tu es force de proposition en continu : chaque semaine, de nouveaux concepts et de nouveaux angles à tester

  • Tu alimentes le pipeline pour que les comptes ne tombent jamais en fatigue créative

  • Tu analyses les résultats des créas que tu as fait pousser : ce qui marche, ce qui flop, et pourquoi

  • Tu réinjectes ces learnings dans la prochaine vague de concepts

Avec qui tu bosses

  • Les Performance Managers : ils pilotent les comptes, te donnent les chiffres et les contraintes, tu leur apportes les idées. Vous construisez ensemble la roadmap de tests et vous vous challengez.

  • Le studio créa (designers, monteurs, motion designers) : tu les briefes et tu les supervises pour que ce que tu as dans la tête sorte exactement comme tu l’avais imaginé. Tu valides avant lancement et tu leur fais un retour sur la performance.

Ton profil

  • Tu es hyper curieux : tu regardes de la pub par réflexe, tu scrolles avec un œil de stratège

  • Tu as 1000 idées à la minute et tu sais les transformer en brief clair

  • Tu as de l’expérience sur les créas Social Ads (Meta en priorité, TikTok et Snap en plus)

  • Tu lis les chiffres (CPL, CPA, ROAS, hook rate, hold rate, CTR) et tu en tires des idées

  • Tu as le sens du copywriting et de la réponse directe

  • Tu sais briefer, challenger et donner du feedback

  • Tu as des exemples concrets de créas que tu as conçues et de leurs résultats

Ce poste n’est pas pour toi si

  • Tu veux faire du design ou du montage toi-même

  • Tu attends qu’on te dise quoi chercher

  • Tu n’as aucune réalisation concrète à montrer

Ce qu’on te propose

  • 100 % télétravail : tu bosses d’où ça te chante

  • Un vrai impact : tes concepts font scaler des comptes avec de gros budgets

  • Du terrain de jeu : plusieurs verticales, beaucoup de choses à tester

  • Une équipe derrière toi : performance managers, studio, automatisation

  • De l’autonomie pour proposer, tester et structurer le pôle créatif

  • Une évolution liée à tes résultats

title: Creative Technologist
descriptionHtml:
TL;DR - We're seeking an exceptional Design Engineer to build the tooling that makes AI-native brand production actually work at scale. You might call yourself a design engineer, creative technologist or even a full-stack product engineer who cares about craft. Here you’ll be someone who builds real infrastructure specifically in service of brand and creative output, working alongside brand designers who owns taste and direction.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What you'll do

In one sentence: build the front-end surfaces and the AI-generation systems that let Lovable’s brand team produce at scale without losing its taste.

  • Build pipelines connecting image/video generation APIs, internal tooling, and the systems brand and marketing already use (Lovable, Design tools, CMS, the marketing site, Slack)

  • Build internal apps for the brand team - plausibly on Lovable itself, which is both a good dogfooding story and just the fastest way to do it

title: Credit Model Validation Manager (Machine Learning & NPV Models)
descriptionHtml:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London or Remote (UK)  | 💰 £79,000 - £93,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits

🌟 About the team:

Our Borrowing (lending) business is growing rapidly across both existing products and with the planned launch of new initiatives. As our lending portfolio grows, our second line of defence Credit Model Validation team is growing with it - and we’re looking for a Credit Model Validation Manager to join us!

Our Credit Model Validation team is crucial in providing independent oversight and challenge to our model development teams in the first line of defence to help Monzo grow safely and ensure that the models we use deliver good outcomes for our customers. We’re looking for someone (maybe you?!) to join our validation squad and provide expert independent validation and oversight across our suite of credit models, covering critical business disciplines such as credit strategy and impairment.

You’ll have a particular focus on models used for customer-level decisioning and defining our credit strategies - such as underwriting scorecards, origination PD models and Net Present Value (NPV) / unit economics models - across all our lending products.

Strong data and analytical skills are a must, as is deep expertise in credit risk modelling. You’ll have hands-on experience in either model validation or model development within a financial services environment, including practical experience using Python to develop, validate or analyse machine learning and statistical models. . In-depth knowledge of credit decisioning models would be a strong plus. 

🔑 You’ll play a key role by…

  • Leading hands-on independent validation of models used for credit decisioning within our Borrowing strategies - covering a range of machine learning, decision science and NPV models. You will be ensuring that models are fit for purpose, appropriately governed, explainable and performing as expected
  • Supporting oversight and validation of broader credit risk models, including IFRS9, stress testing and economic response models
  • Developing deep understanding of Monzo’s credit models, and using this to provide impactful input and challenge to model developers to improve our modelling capabilities
  • Reviewing ongoing model performance monitoring to ensure our lending models perform within our risk thresholds, and providing support to our first line of defence teams when action is required
  • Performing statistical analyses to independently assess model performance, including developing challenger models where appropriate to test model assumptions and strengthen validation conclusions
  • Improving our Model Risk Framework, including overseeing our policies, standards and procedures to help embed best practice across the business. This means making sure we follow up-to-date regulatory guidelines, and adapt our processes to make sure they remain relevant as modelling techniques evolve
  • Writing clear and impactful model validation reports, and presenting the findings and actions in relevant committees
  • Partnering with colleagues in the first line of defence credit strategy and modelling teams - and wider risk teams across Monzo - to support the embedding of our model risk framework and establishing consistent validation standards across the organisation
  • Embracing new and innovative technology, including leading the adoption of AI tools to enhance our model validation approach

 🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • Have a strong background and practical experience in credit model development and/or validation - in particular with exposure to machine learning or statistical models used in credit decisioning, such as decision science scorecards, origination / underwriting PD models, and NPV / unit economics modelling
  • Are data driven, with strong analytical skills and deep understanding of statistical techniques for credit and model risk. Being able to get hands on with data is critical - so strong SQL and Python skills are essential, and experience with data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Looker or similar is a plus!
  • Understand how models are used in real-time decisioning and lending strategies, and how to balance commercial and risk outcomes
  • Have strong written and verbal communication skills, and are able to articulate problems and solutions using clear and simple language. This is particularly important for breaking down complex issues and priorities to non-experts
  • Have a track record of building and maintaining trusting relationships with stakeholders at all levels, and can provide effective and respectful challenge
  • Are impact-driven, and proactive in identifying issues and opportunities to improve outcomes for both our customers and our business
  • Are passionate about technology, and what we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!

Our technology stack

We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies (note we do not expect applicants to have prior experience of all them):

  • Google Cloud Platform for all of our analytics infrastructure
  • dbt and BigQuery SQL for our data modelling and warehousing
  • Python for data science and machine learning
  • Go to write our application code
  • AWS for most of our backend infrastructure

The interview process: 

Our interview process usually involves up to four main stages via Google Hangouts: 

  • An initial call with our recruiter
  • A call with our Senior Model Validation Manager, the hiring manager for the role 
  • A role-specific call with colleagues from our credit modelling teams. We’ll share a short case study in advance, but you won’t need to submit a written response; we’ll use it to guide the discussion during the interview.
  • A behavioural interview 

    🙌 What’s in it for you

    • 💰 £79,000 - £93,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance benefits.

    • 📍 This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

    • ⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

    • 📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

    • 🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given MacBooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

    • ➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

We’ll close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage, so please apply as soon as you can - we don’t want you to miss out!

LinkedIn Tags: #LI-TK1

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. title: CRM & Lifecycle Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

This position is remote-friendly.

🧚 Our Marketing team

No one is more creative and data-driven than this team; they truly combine the best of both worlds. The Marketing team’s mission is to put our product into the hearts and hands of millions of users around the world.

  • The Growth Team builds and scales innovative growth engines to conquer markets, attract, and retain users.

  • The Brand & Communications Team shapes Joko's long-term vision and builds a lasting emotional connection with users.

  • The Campaign & Merchandising Team drives our B2C campaign calendar and elevates the shopping experience.

  • The B2B Marketing Team positions Joko as the top partner in our space and builds a standout employer brand.

Led by Isa, our CMO, the team is constantly innovating to take the business to new heights.

🎯 What you will do

As CRM & Lifecycle Manager, your mission is to design and run lifecycle programs that turn new signups into engaged, loyal, high-LTV Joko users. You will own the end-to-end CRM strategy across in-app, push, and email from the first onboarding message to the campaign that reactivates dormant users. You will join the Growth team, report to the VP Growth, and partner daily with Product, Data, and Brand teams.

Your main missions will be:

  • Guide new users to their first Joko “wow” moment: The first days shape everything that follows. You’ll design the onboarding journey: messaging, timing, and triggers so every new user feels understood and reaches activation quickly. At our scale, getting those first touches right compounds into millions of engaged users.

  • Turn engaged users into power users, and power users into advocates: You’ll build retention and referral programs that deepen usage among our best users, drive word of mouth, and lift long-term retention.

  • Maximize LTV across the full lifecycle: You’ll design cross-channel journeys that deliver the right benefit to the right user at the right moment. You’ll partner closely with Data to turn behavioral signals into segmentation and triggers, and with Product to keep lifecycle nudges tightly aligned with the in-app experience.

  • Raise the bar on experimentation: You’ll run a continuous A/B testing program (hypotheses, tests, learnings, iterations) to improve existing flows and challenge our current lifecycle map. Every decision should be grounded in evidence, not intuition.

  • Take CRM to the next level with AI: You’ll use AI to automate the operational grind (segmentation, copy iteration, QA, reporting) and unlock what we couldn’t run manually: sharper personalization, faster experimentation cycles, and richer lifecycle logic. You’ll decide where AI genuinely moves the needle (and where it doesn’t), then ship production solutions.

  • Drive growth across the company: You’ll work hand-in-hand with Product, Data, User Acquisition, and Brand so CRM compounds alongside everything else we’re building.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have 5+ years of experience in B2C CRM or lifecycle marketing, ideally in a high-growth mobile or consumer app. You’ve owned lifecycle programs end-to-end, not just executed individual components.

  • CRM craft: You’re hands-on with modern CRM platforms (Braze, Iterable, Customer.io, or similar) and you know what “good” looks like across in-app, push, and email. Deliverability, segmentation logic, template design, and orchestration are second nature.

  • Data-driven to the core: You read cohort curves, funnel data, and A/B test results fluently. You use data to form opinions and drive decisions, not just to build reports.

  • Experimentation mindset: You’ve run structured A/B testing programs and know how to design experiments that actually teach you something, not just optimize a subject line.

  • Curious and hands-on with AI: You’re genuinely excited by what AI can do for CRM. You’ve already built solutions from scratch using AI to improve workflows or drive impact, and you have real opinions formed from real attempts on where it works and where it doesn’t.

  • User-centric: You’re relentlessly curious about how users think, what they need, and how they respond. Every message you ship starts from a real user insight, not a template.

  • Ownership and drive: You take initiative, hold yourself accountable to outcomes (not activities), and move fast without dropping the ball.

  • Attention to detail: You know a broken merge tag, a mistimed push, or a poorly segmented email can undo weeks of work. You have a talent for spotting flaws before they ship.

  • Languages: You’re a native-level French speaker and fluent in English, our internal working language.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation
