title: CTO - CDI Paris - Theodo Data & IA
descriptionHtml:
Theodo est une entreprise de conseil et de réalisation en technologie digitale. Ces dernières années, nous avons construit une expertise forte sur deux axes qui convergent : la donnée (plateformes data, gouvernance, qualité) et l'intelligence artificielle (IA générative, agents, ML, vision par ordinateur). Ces deux expertises sont portées par notre entité Theodo Data & AI, qui accompagne les organisations à toutes les étapes de leur trajectoire data et IA.

Le marché est à un point d'inflexion. Les entreprises disposent de volumes considérables de données internes mais peinent à les exploiter, tandis que l'IA générative ouvre des possibilités inédites d'automatisation, d'aide à la décision et de transformation des processus métiers. Nos clients attendent un partenaire capable de couvrir toute la chaîne de valeur, de la stratégie data à l'industrialisation des cas d'usage IA. Nous avons une opportunité unique de devenir un leader reconnu sur ce marché à très forte valeur, en nous appuyant sur notre approche Lean Tech® et nos partenariats stratégiques (Google Cloud Partner of the Year France 2025, AWS, Snowflake).

C'est cette practice que nous vous proposons de piloter.

Votre rôle

En tant que CTO Data & IA, vous êtes le leader qui fait le pont entre le business et la tech sur l'ensemble du périmètre Data & Intelligence Artificielle. Concrètement, vous portez quatre responsabilités.

  • Offre & expertise technique : vous positionnez Theodo à la pointe du marché. Vous benchmarkez les architectures data modernes (data platforms, data mesh, lakehouse) et les architectures IA (RAG, agents, semantic layer, fine-tuning, MLOps). Vous développez des accélérateurs et des enablers internes réutilisables, vous animez la communauté des leaders tech et data scientists, et vous formalisez les apprentissages pour capitaliser sur les retours de mission.
  • Vente & Solution Architecture : vous êtes le référent technique du cycle de vente. Vous intervenez en avant-vente comme solution architect de référence sur nos offres Data & IA, vous co-construisez les propositions techniques avec les équipes commerciales, et vous challengez et crédibilisez les réponses techniques face aux CTO, DSI et CDO de nos clients. Vous travaillez main dans la main avec notre Head of Sales sur le closing des deals stratégiques et sur nos partenariats.
  • Delivery : vous garantissez l'excellence et faites grandir les équipes. Vous communiquez en interne autour de nos offres pour attirer les meilleurs profils, et vous recrutez et formez nos ingénieurs data, data scientists et AI engineers.
  • Marketing technique : vous construisez notre visibilité et notre crédibilité sur le marché. Vous bâtissez et maintenez notre showroom (démos, cas d'usage de référence), vous produisez du contenu à fort impact (articles, livres blancs, tech radars), vous intervenez en conférences et événements (Nuit de la Data, Google Cloud Next, AWS Summit…), et vous alimentez nos partenariats technologiques avec du contenu technique.

Les défis qui vous attendent

  • Vous couvrirez un périmètre large qui va de la data platform à l'IA générative, en passant par la data science classique et le MLOps sans vous disperser.
  • Vous rejoindrez une équipe déjà expérimentée, avec une culture Theodo forte.
  • Vous articulerez une vision unifiée Data & IA là où le marché tend à séparer ces deux mondes, tout en conservant une équipe pluridisciplinaire (data engineers, data scientists, AI engineers, MLOps) pour scaler la delivery.
  • Vous naviguerez dans un écosystème de partenaires technologiques variés (Google Cloud, AWS) en maintenant une posture agnostique crédible.
  • Et surtout, vous transformerez la vague GenAI en offres industrialisables et vendables, avec un ROI démontrable pour nos clients.

Votre environnement

  • Vous travaillerez avec les fondateurs du groupe pour définir la stratégie go-to-market et les priorités de la practice, avec les leaders de la practice et notre Head of Sales pour le closing des ventes et la structuration du pipeline, et avec les leaders tech Data et IA pour renforcer l'expertise collective.
  • Vous vous appuierez sur notre Head of Delivery pour garantir le respect de nos engagements clients, et sur nos partenaires technologiques (Google Cloud, AWS) pour co-construire des offres et maintenir nos certifications.
  • Vous managerez les équipes techniques de la practice Data & IA : data engineers, data scientists, AI engineers et MLOps engineers.

Ce que nous recherchons

Nous cherchons quelqu'un de passionné par la Data et l'IA, animé par un drive fort dans la durée et une curiosité insatiable pour les avancées technologiques (LLM, agents, data platforms, MLOps).

  • Vous êtes très fort en tech sur un spectre large : architectures data modernes (data mesh, lakehouse, governance frameworks) et architectures IA (RAG, agents, fine-tuning, évaluation de modèles, MLOps).
  • Vous avez un sens business affirmé : vous comprenez les job-to-be-done métier des clients, vous savez articuler la valeur délivrée et le ROI, et vous parlez le langage des CTO, DSI et CDO.
  • Vous êtes un très bon leader, capable d'aligner des profils data et IA variés autour d'une vision commune et de fédérer une communauté technique.
  • Vous êtes à l'aise en marketing technique : vous savez valoriser l'expertise créée, vous avez envie d'être visible, et vous êtes autant à votre aise en conférence qu'en rédaction de contenu.
  • Vous avez une grosse capacité d'exécution - focus, intensité, orientation delivery - et vous savez passer de la stratégie à l'opérationnel.
  • Enfin, vous avez la posture d'un solution architect : vous challengez et proposez des architectures techniques en avant-vente face à des interlocuteurs seniors.

Les expériences qui vous permettront de réussir

  • 10+ ans d'expérience dans des rôles de leadership technique, avec une composante data et IA significative.
  • Vous avez conçu ou piloté des plateformes data à l'échelle (data warehouses, data lakes, pipelines temps réel) dans des environnements cloud (AWS, GCP, Snowflake).
  • Vous avez travaillé sur des projets d'IA en production : agents intelligents, systèmes de recommandation, automatisation opérationnelle, vision par ordinateur ou NLP.
  • Vous avez joué un rôle business clé dans un contexte de service ou de conseil, avec un esprit entrepreneurial.
  • Vous avez été speaker en conférence et avez produit du contenu structurant (articles, livres blancs, talks) sur la data ou l'IA appliquée.
  • Idéalement, vous avez évolué dans un environnement à forte croissance et participé au scaling d'une équipe technique.

title: CTO & Co-Founder @ Pre-Seed AI Infrastructure Venture, Berlin
descriptionHtml:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

We are building AI infrastructure, with pre-seed funding secured, early customer demand and a product already in production.

We are now looking for a CTO & Co-Founder to shape the company and its technology, scale the product and build the engineering organisation.

About the Role

As CTO & Co-Founder, you will own the technical direction of the company and the team that delivers it. You will lead an existing team of 3 engineers, grow it and set the standards for how it works.

We are building an AI-native engineering team from day one, with agentic engineering at the centre of how we write, review and ship code. Coding agents are not an add-on, but the default way we build software.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will stay close to the code while making the technical and organisational decisions that shape the company as it grows.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and develop our existing team of 3 engineers, set high engineering standards and take ownership of what the team ships

  • Own technical hiring and build the engineering organisation as the company grows

  • Set the technical direction, from architecture and roadmap to build-vs-buy decisions

  • Scale and operate reliable AI infrastructure, including APIs, cloud infrastructure, security, GDPR and European data residency

  • Stay hands-on, writing code and contributing directly to our core systems

  • Build an AI-native engineering culture where coding agents such as Claude Code are central to how the team develops, reviews and ships software

  • Design and continuously improve our agentic engineering setup, from harnesses and workflows to orchestrating multiple agents in parallel, evaluating their output and benchmarking what works

  • Represent the company technically with customers, in security reviews and in investor conversations

About You

You are an experienced technical leader who still loves to build. You have hired and led engineers, shipped complex systems into production and know how to make good technical decisions under real-world constraints.

You already work extensively with coding agents and have strong convictions about how AI is changing software engineering. You want to build a team around that approach, and you're excited by the ownership, ambition and uncertainty of becoming a co-founder.

  • Proven experience leading, hiring and managing engineering teams, ideally in a startup, whether as a CTO, VP Engineering, Engineering Manager or Tech Lead

  • Strong backend and platform foundations, including distributed systems, API design, cloud infrastructure and production systems

  • Hands-on experience building and operating AI infrastructure and LLM-powered systems in production

  • Extensive daily use of coding agents such as Claude Code, with strong coding fundamentals and the judgement to review and own the quality of their output

  • Experience designing and improving agentic engineering workflows for yourself or a team, including harnesses, multi-agent orchestration and benchmarking, with a clear understanding of their capabilities and limitations

Nice to Have

  • Experience optimising LLM cost and performance

  • Experience serving and operating open-weight models, including GPU and capacity decisions

Why Join

Funding is secured, an engineering team is in place and the product is already in production. But many of the most important decisions are still ahead.

You will have the opportunity to scale the technology, build the team and influence the direction of the company from an early stage, with co-founder equity in the business you help build.

This is a full-time role, based in our Berlin office 5 days a week, starting as soon as possible.

title: Customer Director
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the role

As a Customer Director at Faculty, you will spearhead ambitious growth across our Public Services portfolio. Blending strategic consulting with AI delivery, you will unlock potential for UK Government departments and international partners.

You will lead multi-disciplinary teams to design AI solutions, navigate multi-million-pound programmes, and build trusting relationships with senior government stakeholders across key areas like the Home Office, Department for Education, DWP, HMRC, DEFRA, and MHCLG.

This is an entrepreneurial opportunity to shape the future of public services by turning cutting-edge AI into operational impact.

What you'll be doing:

  • Driving sales growth and executing strategic account plans to hit ambitious multi-million-pound revenue targets across central government accounts.

  • Leading complex commercial negotiations, bidding opportunities, and pricing proposals for new and existing public sector portfolios.

  • Nurturing long-term relationships with senior government budget holders and C-suite stakeholders to ensure high client satisfaction.

  • Overseeing cross-functional delivery teams to guarantee high-quality execution of large-scale AI transformation programmes and GDS-style digital products and the associated digital service and technology infrastructure required

  • Mentoring team members to accelerate their professional development while supporting scalable business unit growth.

  • Proactively identifying innovative, data-oriented AI use cases that solve complex public sector challenges.

  • Advising client directors on AI strategy, engineering concepts, and technical implementation to demonstrate continuous value.

  • Serving as a key member of the Public Services leadership group, shaping strategic direction, driving commercial growth, and embedding customer excellence across the sector.

Who we're looking for:

  • You bring a comprehensive background in consulting or public sector strategy, with proven experience leading large-scale transformation programmes across government and public accounts.

  • You possess a natural business development mindset, combining an appetite for commercial hunting with deep relationship-building skills to manage multi-million-pound deal processes.

  • You bring demonstrable experience in digital government transformation alongside strong commercial fluency in cutting-edge AI capabilities.

  • You excel at managing complex stakeholder relationships, guiding senior civil servants through fast-paced, high-stakes programmes with structured problem-solving.

  • You bring technical curiosity and acumen to engage confidently with technical teams and advise client directors on AI and advise client directors on the creative and safe applications of AI within their most important areas of business.

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Introduction to Hiring Manager (60 minutes)

  3. Discovery Role Play Interview (60 minutes)

  4. Commercial & Leadership Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. descriptionHtml:
What we’re all about.

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our clients to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here – and it’s what will make our future. At Quantexa, you’ll experience autonomy and support in equal measures allowing you to form a career that matches your ambitions. 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We speak over 20 languages across our 47 nationalities, creating a sense of belonging for all.

We're heading in one direction, the future. We’d love you to join us.

The opportunity.

Want to transform customer engagement and growth at some of the world's largest institutions? We're looking for an EMEA lead for our Customer Intelligence solution. You'll own the solution across banking, insurance and the public sector, set the direction for the whole region, and take it to market – with real autonomy over how. You'll be the name the market knows on this subject, and the person Quantexa turns to for it.

Every large organisation is investing in data, analytics and AI to serve customers better. Most hit the same wall. The same person appears multiple times across systems that don't talk to each other. Relationships stay hidden – from families and social groups to corporate hierarchies and supply chains. The data is there, but it's fragmented, inconsistent and stripped of context, so nobody quite trusts what it says. The cost shows up everywhere: disjointed customer experiences, frustrated customer-facing teams, wasted marketing spend, and revenue left on the table.

That's the problem we solve, at scale. We connect data to build a real-world view of people, businesses, places and events, and the relationships between them – unlocking insight that accelerates revenue growth and makes customer experience genuinely better. Context is the part most approaches miss, and it's the part that makes everything downstream work: better decisions, trusted outputs, and AI that delivers on its promise across sales, marketing and customer service.

You'd lead this from our Product team, which sits where the market meets the product. We listen to what banks, insurers and public sector organisations really need. We shape the proposition around it. Then we make sure clients, partners and colleagues can see the value. The reach is unusual: our product roadmap, our go-to-market strategy and the conversations we have in the market all start here. Complex problems, senior audiences, commercial consequence. Ready?

What you’ll be doing.

  • Own the Customer Intelligence proposition across EMEA – shape the positioning, the messaging and the segments we go after, and turn what you hear in the market into requirements that influence our global roadmap.

  • Be the region’s senior expert – guide sales opportunities and client programmes as a trusted advisor to some of the largest financial institutions and government agencies in EMEA.

  • Build our voice in the market – publish thought leadership, speak at industry events, brief analysts, and host the client roundtables that shape their thinking and ours.

  • Team up with Marketing and Sales – on campaigns, market and competitor analysis, and the collateral and enablement that help our teams sell with confidence.

  • Grow the ecosystem with Alliances – develop the technology, data and delivery partnerships that give us scale, differentiation and pipeline across the region.

  • Feed the region back into global strategy – work with Product, R&D and Solution Engineering to keep the solution ahead of a market that never sits still.

What you’ll bring.

You have deep expertise in customer intelligence, customer analytics or data-led marketing, ideally in banking or financial services. Don’t tick every box below? If you recognise yourself in most of it, we’d still like to hear from you.

  • Real depth in customer intelligence. You know the data, the analytics, and how both turn into commercial outcomes. Credible with practitioners. Credible with their executives.

  • A voice the market listens to. You can present, write, and hold a room of experienced stakeholders. Whether or not you enjoy the spotlight, you make complex ideas land.

  • Strategy, and sleeves rolled up. You’ll set the direction – then happily build the business case, the demo or the deck yourself.

  • Curiosity about the tech. You’ll learn our platform properly, so you can say what it does and where it’s genuinely different. Never settling for the surface-level answer.

  • Judgement, and generosity with it. There’ll always be more opportunity than time, so you’ll choose well and bring colleagues, partners and clients with you. Experience across several EMEA markets, or extra languages, is welcome rather than required.

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

  • Volunteer Day off

  • Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

title: Customer Marketing Associate
descriptionHtml:
Customer Marketing Manager

Hi, I'm Chris. I'm a Lead Product Marketing Manager at hx - I joined over four years ago as a Product Marketing Manager. Outside of work you'll find me playing sport (badly), watching reality TV, or taking my dog Lucky to the park (or the pub!).

Product Marketing at hx is a strategic function. We shape the company's positioning and messaging, decide where and when products launch, and build the process that gets them to market. We're growing the team because customer case studies are critical to our success: insurance is a tight-knit industry that trusts practitioner voices far more than it trusts vendors.

This role is a chance to help shape the narrative we take to market and have a global impact on our success. You'll need to be comfortable managing senior stakeholders and have great taste - but what matters most is drive, and a willingness to solve problems as you find them. In return, you'll join a team that's kind, supportive, and full of very smart people who want to go fast and far. If that sounds like you, read on!

About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Product Marketing team

Product Marketing sits at the centre of hx's go-to-market engine, translating what we build into stories the market believes. Nothing earns that belief faster than a customer saying it themselves: insurance is an industry where reputation travels through a small number of trusted voices, and our customers include some of the most respected names in specialty and commercial insurance.

As our Customer Marketing Manager, you'll own that voice. Your mission is to increase the frequency, quality, and number of published customer case studies, build relationships with customer accounts so that every testimonial is genuinely mutually beneficial, find new ways to celebrate our customers, and manage award submissions that earn industry recognition for hx and the customers we serve.

This is a role with real ownership from day one. You'll work directly with senior stakeholders at hx and at some of the world's largest insurers, and the content you produce will be used across sales, marketing, and events globally.

What you'll be doing

  • Own case study production end to end - from identifying the story and recruiting the customer through to publication - delivering two published case studies (written, video, or otherwise) per quarter.

  • Publish two additional pieces of customer-contributed content per quarter, from quotes and social content to event appearances, driving hx's key messages to market through customer voices.

  • Build and continually improve our case study recruitment and production process so that participating is low-lift for both our customers and our team, and each cycle runs smoother than the last.

  • Grow engagement across the underwriting community, measured through event attendance, email open rates, and social engagement, particularly on LinkedIn.

  • Identify and manage award submissions throughout the year, coordinating internal and customer stakeholders to produce a targeted number of high-quality entries that increase industry recognition for hx and its customers.

  • Edit and assemble short-form written, video, and social content for promotion and lead generation, keeping every asset aligned with hx's positioning and brand narrative.

What you'll need to have done

  • Taken customer stories or content projects from initial idea through to publication, coordinating multiple senior, time-limited stakeholders inside and outside your organisation.

  • Built content programmes or campaigns where the relationship mattered as much as the output - securing participation, managing approvals and consent, and leaving customers glad they took part.

  • Produced short-form written and video content yourself, with the functional writing and editing skills to create new assets and make light edits without waiting on others.

  • Grown an audience or generated leads through social content, particularly by editing and assembling content for LinkedIn.

  • Demonstrated strong instincts for positioning and messaging - shaping stories that align with a brand narrative rather than just documenting what happened.

  • Improved a process so it lasted: found the friction, fixed it, and made the next cycle measurably easier for everyone involved.

You're unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer being handed a finished brief over hunting down a story, winning people over, and solving problems as you find them.

  • You see customers primarily as a source of quotes rather than partners whose goals, reputation, and time deserve as much care as our own.

  • You're uncomfortable coordinating multiple senior stakeholders with competing priorities and limited availability.

  • If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

  • £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

  • 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

  • Company pension scheme via Penfold.

  • Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

  • Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

  • Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

  • Income protection and Life Insurance.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme

Additional perks

  • Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

  • Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

  • Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

  • Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview Process

  1. Talent Partner Screen (30-45 minutes)

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (45-60 minutes)

  3. Skills Assessment (60 minutes)

  4. Values Interview (60-90 minutes)

  5. Meet the CEO/CMO/CRO (approximately 40 minutes)

  6. We offer!

Our commitment to Diversity

hxer's are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

title: Customer Onboarding Manager I (Dutch Speaking)
descriptionHtml:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

Step into the world of Customer Onboarding, a place where seamless onboarding experiences are crafted to bring delight to customers and businesses alike. As a Pleo Customer Onboarding Manager, you hold the key to unlocking the full potential of our cutting-edge solutions for businesses across Europe & the UK. Your mission is to oversee and execute the onboarding process with precision and finesse, collaborating seamlessly with both customers and internal teams to ensure a smooth and memorable journey from start to finish.


Picture yourself as the bridge between technology and human connection, understanding each customer's unique requirements, and configuring Pleo to match their needs perfectly. You'll be the go-to expert for technical queries, providing consultation, sharing best practices, and conducting training to drive user adoption that allows our customers to take their business to new levels. Your role goes beyond just technical prowess – it's about building strong relationships and ensuring customer success becomes a powerful reference point for the world to see. You will thrive in this role if you have

title: Customer Operations Manager B2B SaaS (w/m/d) – Technical Customer Success
descriptionHtml:
Wer wir sind

Die ParkEfficient GmbH ist ein wachsendes B2B-Softwareunternehmen, das sich auf die Digitalisierung des Parkraum- und Arbeitsplatzmanagements spezialisiert hat.

Mit unseren SaaS-Lösungen ParkEfficient und OfficeEfficient unterstützen wir Unternehmen dabei, ihre Büro- und Parkflächen effizienter zu nutzen, Prozesse zu automatisieren und moderne Arbeitsumgebungen zu gestalten.

Zu unseren Kunden gehören führende Banken, Versicherungen und eine Vielzahl von Unternehmen, vom deutschen Mittelstand bis hin zu DAX-Unternehmen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit im Projektmanagement, die unsere Kunden bei der Einführung unserer Softwarelösungen begleitet und Implementierungsprojekte eigenverantwortlich zum Erfolg führt.

Deine Mission

Als Senior Customer Operations Manager bist du eine zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden, dem Customer Success, Projektmanagement und unserer Softwareentwicklung.

Du übernimmst anspruchsvolle technische Kundenanfragen, analysierst komplexe Problemstellungen und sorgst für nachhaltige Lösungen. Gleichzeitig optimierst du unsere operativen Abläufe und gestaltest den weiteren Aufbau unseres Customer-Operations-Bereichs.

Die Position verbindet technischen 2nd-Level-Support und operatives SaaS-Kundenmanagement.

Deine Aufgaben

2nd-Level-Support & Technical Troubleshooting

  • Du übernimmst komplexe technische und funktionale Kundenanfragen, die über unseren First-Level-Support hinausgehen.

  • Du analysierst Softwarefehler, unerwartetes Systemverhalten und technische Probleme und gehst deren Ursachen systematisch auf den Grund.

  • Du stellst Fehler nach, grenzt Problemursachen ein und entwickelst eigenständig Lösungen oder geeignete Workarounds.

  • Du unterscheidest zwischen Anwendungsfehlern, Konfigurationsproblemen und tatsächlichen Softwarebugs.

  • Du koordinierst technische Eskalationen mit unserem Entwicklungsteam, bereitest Fehlerbeschreibungen strukturiert auf und begleitest die Umsetzung bis zur erfolgreichen Lösung.

  • Du unterstützt unser Support-Team bei besonders anspruchsvollen Fällen und gibst dein technisches Wissen aktiv weiter.

Customer Operations & Technische Bestandskundenbetreuung

  • Du unterstützt unsere Bestandskunden bei komplexeren Konfigurationen, individuellen Anforderungen und der optimalen Nutzung unserer SaaS-Plattformen.

  • Du übernimmst anspruchsvolle Anfragen von Administratoren und Kundenverantwortlichen.

  • Du sorgst gemeinsam mit unserem Projektmanagement für eine strukturierte Übergabe neuer Kunden in die laufende Betreuung.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Customer-Success-Team zusammen und schaffst die operativen Voraussetzungen für eine proaktive Kundenbetreuung.

Prozessoptimierung & Wissensmanagement

  • Du entwickelst unseren 2nd-Level-Support und unsere Customer-Operations-Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Du etablierst klare Zuständigkeiten, effiziente Ticket- und Eskalationsprozesse sowie ein systematisches Problemmanagement.

  • Du analysierst wiederkehrende Supportfälle, identifizierst deren Ursachen und leitest gemeinsam mit unserem Produkt- und Entwicklungsteam nachhaltige Verbesserungen ab.

  • Du optimierst unsere Workflows und internen Tools, insbesondere HubSpot, Jira und Confluence.

Team- und Bereichsentwicklung

  • Du bringst deine Erfahrung beim Aufbau einer professionellen und skalierbaren Customer-Operations-Struktur ein.

  • Du unterstützt die fachliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Support- und Customer-Success-Mitarbeitenden.

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung Standards für Servicequalität, Kundenzufriedenheit und effiziente Abläufe.

  • Perspektivisch besteht die Möglichkeit, zusätzliche Verantwortung für die fachliche Koordination oder Leitung des Bereichs zu übernehmen.

Qualifikation

Wen wir suchen

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einem technisch anspruchsvollen B2B-SaaS-Umfeld, idealerweise im 2nd-Level-Support, Technical Customer Success, Application Support oder Customer Operations.

  • Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt und die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Sachverhalte verständlich zu erklären.

  • Eigeninitiative, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und den Anspruch, Probleme nachhaltig zu lösen und Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse.

Benefits

Was wir bieten

  • Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum: Du übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle in unserer technischen Kundenbetreuung und kannst den Aufbau unserer Customer-Operations-Strukturen aktiv mitgestalten.

Das klingt nach dir?

title: Customer Operations Specialist - Europe
descriptionHtml:
About Plasma

Plasma is building the primary account for global money.

Money used to belong to a country. Increasingly, it belongs to a person or business moving through many countries. People and businesses now earn, spend, save, hire and invest across borders. Traditional banks cannot serve this new world.

Our first product, Plasma One, is a global money account: a place to receive, hold, send funds in seconds, earn yield and spend with a card in the local economy.

Underneath is the Plasma network, built from first principles for stablecoin payments. Stablecoins make dollars faster, cheaper and more reliable to move.

The opportunity is to become where all global money lands first: where income arrives, balances grow, payments move, businesses operate, and new financial products are built.


The Team & Our Story

We are a global team of founders, operators and engineers, obsessed with building the best products. We work at the cutting edge of financial innovation, using stablecoins to create tools for consumers and businesses.

We operate with trust, clarity, and ambition: own your craft, move with urgency, contribute beyond your lane, back your teammates, debate rigorously, and keep raising the bar for what great means.

Customer Experience

Plasma is scaling its customer-facing operations across international markets, and we’re growing the Customer Experience Team to match. You’ll join an established team and take ownership of coverage for the CET time zone, making sure our customers get great support when they need it most.

You’ll work across the full customer journey, from first contact through to resolution. Because we’re still building out our playbook, your input will directly shape the processes, standards, and team culture as we grow. You won’t just follow the process; you’ll help refine it.

Some flexibility in working hours & weekend shifts will be needed to support coverage and the occasional busy period. We’re looking for a hard-working self-starter who thrives in a fast-moving startup environment and is committed to the mission alongside the rest of the team.

The role

  • Own the customer experience day-to-day: Be the first person our customers reach when something goes wrong or they need help. You will handle inbound queries across chat, email, and support tooling, and take accountability for the quality and speed of every response.

  • Be the right hand of the Ops lead: Work directly alongside the Head of Operations to build out processes, identify gaps, and support decisions as we scale the team internationally. This is not a back-office support role. You will be involved in how we think about operations.

  • Build the foundations: We are early. Many of the processes, templates, and escalation paths do not exist yet. You will create them. From response frameworks to internal guides, you will help lay the groundwork the team will rely on as we grow.

  • Support international team scaling: As we hire Ops team members in new markets, you will help onboard them, share knowledge, and maintain consistency in how we deliver for customers across regions.

  • Spot problems before they become patterns: Track issues across the customer base, flag recurring themes to Product and Engineering, and help prioritise fixes that actually move the needle for customers.

  • Work across teams: Collaborate with Compliance, KYC, and Product to make sure the customer experience is joined up, especially during onboarding and verification flows where things can go wrong quickly.

  • Represent the customer internally: Your proximity to customer feedback is valuable. Use it. Bring customer insight into internal conversations and push for improvements that matter.

  • Be Flexible with Shift Rotation: Most weeks you’ll work the normal Mon-Fri, however team members currently rotate weekend shifts which means that you may be required to work a weekend shift once every 6 weeks. You’ll then be able to take those days worked off the following week.

The Bar

  • 1 to 3 years of experience in customer operations, customer success, or a support role, ideally within fintech, payments, or crypto. We will consider strong candidates from outside these sectors if the fit is right.

  • Someone who takes ownership. You do not wait to be told. When something is broken or missing, you fix it or flag it. You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching.

  • Clear and direct in how you communicate. You can write a helpful, professional response under pressure and explain a complex situation simply. You know the difference between being thorough and overcomplicating things.

  • Competent English Language - our team communicates in english so being competent with the language is a requirement.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. This is an early-stage company. Processes will change, priorities will shift, and some days you will be figuring things out as you go. You see that as interesting rather than frustrating. Preferably, you have worked at a fast-paced tech company.

  • Genuinely curious about crypto. You do not need deep technical knowledge, but you need to understand the basics of how stablecoins and digital assets work and be motivated to learn more. Our customers live in this space.

  • Organised under pressure. You can manage a queue, prioritise effectively, and keep quality high when things are busy.

  • Collaborative by default. You work well with people in different functions, different time zones, and different levels of seniority. Building the team abroad means working with people you may never meet in person, and you are good at that.

Nice to have

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up where you had to build or rebuild processes, not just follow them.

  • Exposure to Intercom, Zendesk, Freshdesk, or similar support tooling in a live production environment.

  • Any familiarity with KYC or compliance workflows as they relate to customer onboarding.

  • Experience supporting or managing a small team, even informally, or helping onboard new colleagues.

  • An interest in how stablecoin and DeFi products work and the customer challenges they create.

  • Multilingual skills that could support customer communication across our international markets.

What's in it for you

  • Above-market salary for the level of the role, with token compensation.

  • A beautiful London HQ with gym access and daily food, for those who thrive in an office environment. Visa sponsorship and relocation support if you're joining from abroad.

  • Premium health insurance for you and your family, fully covered by Plasma.

  • Monthly wellness budget, whether that's the gym, therapy, sauna, or massage.

  • All the tools and tech you need to operate at your best.

  • Real ownership and responsibility from day one, with your work shipping to hundreds of thousands of people, moving millions of dollars every day.

Data Protection & Privacy
We are committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal data. Any personal information you provide during the recruitment process will be processed in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable local data protection laws.

Compensation: £35K – £40K • + Tokens

  • Previous experience in office administration, customer service or a similar role.

Desirable Experience

Industry experience is an advantage but is not essential. We believe that the right attitude, personality and communication skills are just as important as previous technical knowledge.

What We Offer

If you're organised, enjoy speaking with people and would like a role that offers both variety and the opportunity to develop your career, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Customer Success Lead - Enterprise
descriptionHtml:
We are Vitesse – the treasury and payment partner of choice for insurance.

Your next adventure awaits!

Join the team who are redefining the payments space.

About Us

At Vitesse, we're more than just a payments platform – we're the trusted financial infrastructure connecting the global insurance ecosystem. Tailor-made for insurers, brokers, MGAs, and TPAs, our unified platform optimises claims funds, enables real-time global payments, and delivers full financial control. Our impact is real: over $20 billion in payments across 200+ countries, hundreds of millions returned to insurers’ balance sheets, and counting. We’re licensed in the UK (FCA), Europe (DNB), and New York (NYDFS), with over 260 amazing colleagues worldwide. With $93 million recently raised in Series C funding from KKR, our journey is just beginning, and our ambitions are sky-high.

Headquartered in the heart of London and expanding across Europe and the US, Vitesse is where your ideas power tomorrow’s insurance solutions. Are you ready to make a difference? You're in the right place.

Customer Success at Vitesse is still taking shape, which means if you join us you’ll have a genuine opportunity to shape how the function works – from engagement models and playbooks, to the way we measure customer value and growth. You’ll be responsible for our enterprise customer sucesss team that owns a portfolio of our Vitesse’s largest and most complex customers across the carrier, TPA and MGA market. These matrixed organisations often have multiple stakeholder groups, complex operating models and legacy systems. You’ll help the team navigate that complexity, build trusted executive relationships and grow the value customers realise from Vitesse. Your ideas will matter, and your impact will be visible.

The Role

Reporting into the VP of Customer Success, you’ll lead a team of CSMs and personally own one or two strategic accounts. Together, you’ll drive material growth across our Enterprise customer base by helping customers realise measurable value and increase their use of Vitesse

You’ll guide the team to build strong relationships, from operational users to senior executives, and mobilise the right people across Vitesse to deliver on customer priorities. Strong adoption and customer health will underpin that growth. You’ll work closely with Sales, Pre-Sales, Product, Onboarding, Operations, Support and Data to make it happen.

Core Responsibilities

  • Coach and develop Enterprise CSMs to act as trusted advisers and build effective relationships with senior customer stakeholders.

  • Guide the team in creating and delivering Customer Success Plans that connect customer goals to Vitesse’s value, with clear success measures, regular check-ins and strategic reviews.

  • Hold the team accountable for customer outcomes, portfolio health and growth in balances, payment accounts, participant connections and Vitesse’s share of payment activity.

  • Help CSMs map stakeholder groups, identify risks early and coordinate action across customer and internal teams.

  • Guide the team through complex customer initiatives by clarifying ownership, aligning stakeholders and keeping activity focused on agreed outcomes.

  • Support customers in enabling third parties in their payment networks, coordinating across CSMs and other internal teams where needed.

  • Partner with Sales to identify and qualify expansion opportunities.

  • Bring customer feedback to Product and operational teams, and shape the Enterprise Customer Success model and practices.

Why Join Us?

Vitesse is a high-growth business with a strong, open and positive culture. We combine the innovative energy of a scale-up with proven product-market fit and a significant market opportunity.

As Customer Success Lead, Enterprise, you’ll shape how we work with some of our largest customers, lead a talented team and help build an approach suited to complex organisations and meaningful growth.

Skills and Experience

  • Experience leading and developing a Customer Success or Account Management team in insurance or a complex B2B technology environment.

  • Experience managing strategic accounts with matrixed organisations and multiple operational, technical and executive stakeholders.

  • A record of helping customers realise measurable value and growing adoption or usage within existing relationships.

  • Confidence coaching teams to engage senior executives and communicate business value.

  • Strong commercial judgement and the ability to turn customer insight into credible account and growth plans.

  • The ability to guide teams through complex customer initiatives, keeping outcomes, ownership and risks clear.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership and knowledge of carriers, TPAs, MGAs or the wider insurance ecosystem, or the ability to build that expertise quickly.

  • An adaptable leadership style and interest in shaping an evolving Enterprise Customer Success model.

We understand that everyone has their own work rhythm and believe in a flexible working schedule - at Vitesse you’re expected to work 35 hours a week.

Our Values – or what we call “Vitesse at Our Best”

The Vitesse values are a true reflection of what it takes to thrive in our business, so it’s important to us that any employee who joins our business is aligned with these 3 attributes

Confident Humility
We believe the best ideas come from listening and learning. We leave ego at the door, ask for help when we need it, and celebrate collective success. When one of us wins, we all do.

Driven to Succeed
We’re ambitious about the opportunity ahead and committed to achieving it together. We hold ourselves to high standards, take pride in what we deliver, and push for meaningful outcomes for our customers, our partners, and each other.

Tenacious Responsibility
We take ownership of our work, our decisions, and our results. We face challenges with resilience, learn from setbacks, and see things through to completion. Because doing the right thing matters.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer

We commit to creating an inclusive environment that enables everyone to perform at their best, where we recognise the rights of all individuals to mutual respect and where there is an unbiased acceptance of others. descriptionHtml:
Über BringLiesel

BringLiesel ist die Plattform für individuelle Bewohnerversorgung in der stationären Pfege. Über 1.200 Produkte des täglichen Bedarfs werden online bestellt, einzeln je Bewohner:in verpackt und revisionssicher abgerechnet. Unsere Prozesse sind dabei tief in den Alltag der Pfege und Betreuung integriert. Über 2.300 Einrichtungen und mehr als 80.000 Pfegebedürftige vertrauen uns bereits. Unser Anspruch: Selbstbestimmung für Bewohner:innen. Entlastung für Pfege und Verwaltung. Efzienz für den Träger.

Deine Rolle

Wir befnden uns in einer Wachstumsphase – und diese Rolle ist ihr Motor im Bestand: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für den gesamten Customer-Success-Prozess von BringLiesel, von der erfolgreichen Anbindung neuer Einrichtungen bis zu ihrem nachhaltigen Ausbau. Du brauchst dafür beides – eine ausgeprägte Hands-on- und Macher-Mentalität für das operative Tagesgeschäft und den strategischen Weitblick, um die Rolle neu zu defnieren und BringLiesel für die Zukunft aufzustellen. Du holst dein Team operativ ab, führst es strategisch und setzt die richtigen Initiativen. Dabei führst du drei Account Manager, die die Einrichtungen onboarden und begleiten.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Vom Onboarding bis zum Ausbau: Verantwortung für den gesamten Lebenszyklus der Einrichtungen – von der Anbindung über die Etablierung im Pfegealltag bis zum kontinuierlichen Ausbau.

  • Wachstum im Bestand: Du stärkst die Durchdringung in den Einrichtungen (mehr Bewohnende pro Einrichtung), baust die Warenkörbe aus und etablierst BringLiesel fest im Alltag der Einrichtung.

  • Führung & Entwicklung: Fachliche und persönliche Führung von drei Account Managern, die die Einrichtungen onboarden und begleiten.

  • Zusammenspiel mit Marketing: Enge, gestaltende Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing und Digital Customer Experience als zentraler Wachstumshebel.

  • Strategische Weiterentwicklung: Du defnierst die Rolle neu, setzt die richtigen Initiativen und Prozesse und stellst den Bereich zukunftsfest auf.

  • Steuerung über Kennzahlen: Du machst Durchdringung, Warenkorb und Kundenbindung messbar und sorgst dafür, dass die Kennzahlen auch wirken.

Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Customer Success, Account- oder Bestandskundenmanagement, idealerweise mit Führungsverantwortung.

  • Du denkst und handelst strategisch UND operativ – mit klarer Hands-on- und Macher-Mentalität.

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge im Ausbau von Bestandskunden (Durchdringung, Upsell, Warenkorb) –gerne datengetrieben.

  • Erfahrung in der engen Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing.

  • Führungskompetenz: Du entwickelst ein kleines Team und gehst als Vorbild voran.

  • Kommunikationsstark und empathisch – gerade im sensiblen Pfegeumfeld wichtig.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Was wir bieten

  • Die Chance, den Customer Success bei BringLiesel neu zu defnieren und für die Zukunftaufzustellen – eine Rolle, die du von Anfang an prägst.

  • Führungsverantwortung für ein dreiköpfges Account-Management-Team.

  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum in einer Wachstumsphase: BringLiesel wächst, und diese Rolle wächst mit.

  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit: Du trägst direkt dazu bei, dass Pfegebedürftige selbstbestimmt einkaufen können.

  • Standort wahlweise Lübeck oder Hamburg – mit kurzen Wegen und direktem Kontakt zu allen Teams.

Kontakt

Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung an den Chief Commercial Officer.

title: Customer Success Manager - Agriculture
descriptionHtml:
🌎 What we do

Root is Europe’s #1 primary data collection platform for F&B companies. We help our customers to measure and reduce farm-level emissions.

~31% of global GHG emissions originate from food-related activities. For the first time in history, climate performance has become an overall business performance indicator. Enterprises are mandated by regulatory bodies to disclose their climate performance, which leads to increasing pressure from investors, competitors, retailers, and consumers to prevent and reduce their CO2e emissions. Over the next 10 years, companies have set ambitious reduction targets that need to be met. Unlike other industries, the vast majority of F&B emissions originate from farms (known as Scope 3.1 emissions) and are highly complex to address. Root exists to help overcome this challenge.

We raised >€10m in funding in the first 2 years of our existence, we launched our enterprise product, signed and onboarded some of the largest F&B players in Europe, and put together what we believe is the best-suited early-stage tech team in Europe. Will you be the next to join us? 🚀

🔭 What you will work on

Your mission

Drive customer success by supporting a customer portfolio, ensuring smooth project execution and tool adoption, and helping build strong, trust-based relationships that maximize long-term value and advocacy.

📅 Over the next months, you will…

Drive Customer Success and Long-Term Value for Root's Customers

  • Own the success of a defined customer portfolio, acting as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor, guiding customers through key success milestones (onboarding, data collection, verification, reporting, reduction readiness) and ensuring they clearly understand and realize the value of the Root Platform

  • Plan, manage, and execute customer projects end-to-end, driving primary data coverage at scale through increased user engagement and data completion, serving as the first point of contact for agricultural users when needed, and ensuring high data quality, clear milestones, and on-time delivery

  • Design and run farmer-facing enablement, including digital webinars to drive participation, improve data quality, and build trust at the farm level

  • Collaborate with Account Management to relay customer feedback while building trust-based customer relationships that drive long-term satisfaction, retention, and advocacy

  • Collaborate with Product to bring agricultural and agronomic expertise into our products, translating practical farming knowledge and farmer needs into actionable product feedback and clear, farmer-facing recommendations.

🧺 What you bring along

  • Agricultural background (practical farm experience, agricultural studies, or prior work with agricultural users such as advisors, cooperatives)

  • Hands-on and detail-oriented, you thrive in fast-changing, early-stage environments, can juggle multiple tasks, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks

  • First experience in Customer Success, Operations or other fast-paced environments, where you supported or executed customer-facing processes end-to-end

  • People-centric and proactive, empathetic, approachable, and able to communicate clearly while keeping customer outcomes and business priorities in mind

  • Comfortable working with data in Excel and digital platforms, with an eye for completeness and consistency

  • Fluent in German and English; additional languages (Polish, French, Portuguese, Spanish) are a plus

  • Work from our Berlin office 5 days a week

🤗 You don't feel like you fulfill all the criteria? We get it: confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But guess what?! There is no such thing as a “perfect” candidate. The only thing you need to ensure along the recruiting process and beyond is that the problem that we are solving with Root is one you cannot wait to get out of bed for on Monday morning!

Root Global is an equal opportunity employer, which means we do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Diese Rolle passt perfekt zu Dir, wenn Du:

  • du Energie von Gesprächen bekommst und gerne im Austausch bist
  • selbst anpackst: egal ob Anruf, Follow-up oder spontane Rückfrage
  • Lust hast, Teil eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens zu sein
  • 1-2 Jahre Erfahrung im Account Management oder Kundenkontakt mitbringst
  • erste Erfahrung mit CRM Systemen und digitalen Abläufen hast

Diese Rolle passt gar nicht, wenn Du:

  • auf detaillierte Anweisungen wartest, bevor du einen Schritt machst
  • Kundengespräche als lästige Pflicht siehst
  • du dich an wiederkehrenden Aufgaben und optimierten Prozessen störst

Was wir machen

Fired Up bietet Weiterbildungen und Coaching für Menschen in der Karriereorientierung – gefördert über Bildungsgutschein und AVGS, kostenlos für unsere Teilnehmenden. Wir sind AZAV-zertifiziert und begleiten jährlich über 1.300 Menschen durch unsere Programme. Unser kleines, engagiertes Team in Berlin wächst und du kannst ein Teil davon sein. Die Arbeitswelt verändert sich gerade stark durch KI und wir haben einen Impact, Menschen Zugänge zur neuen Arbeitswelt zu schaffen.

Dein Job (konkret, nicht in Buzzwords)

Intro Calls mit unseren Clients führen

Dein Kernstück: Du führst täglich zehn bis zwölf kurze Erstgespräche (je 15 Minuten) mit Menschen, die gerade in einer beruflichen Umbruchphase sind. Du informierst sie über unsere Angebote, nimmst dir kurz Zeit für sie – und schickst danach eine knappe Follow-up-Mail. Klingt simpel, hat aber echten Einfluss auf Menschen in einer verletzlichen Phase.

Was du brauchst: Kommunikationsstärke, Empathie, aktives Zuhören, gutes Zeitgefühl, fließendes Deutsch und Englisch

Matching mit unseren Programmen

Du informierst welche Programme wir anbieten und schaust welche am besten passt.

Was du brauchst: Sorgfalt, Systemverständnis (Hubspot), Kollaborationsbereitschaft

Follow Up Aufgaben

Du bleibst an den Menschen dran, rufst an um zu sehen ob das Programm beantragt wurde.

Was du brauchst: Grid, Drive, Energie

Was du mitbringst

Must-haves:

  • Freundliche, empathische Kommunikation – du machst Menschen das Ankommen leicht
  • 1-2 Jahre Erfahrung im Kundenservice
  • Fließend Deutsch und Englisch, mündlich und schriftlich
  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise – du weißt, was als nächstes zu tun ist

Nice-to-haves:

  • Kontakt mit Weiterbildung, EdTech und/oder Coaching
  • Vertrautheit mit CRM-Systemen, idealerweise Hubspot

Dealbreaker:

  • Für dich steht Strategie im Vordergrund
  • Empathie ist nicht deine Stärke
  • Schnelligkeit in Arbeitsprozessen schreckt dich ab

Was wir bieten

Kultur:

  • Kein BS: Wir reden miteinander, nicht übereinander
  • Impact: Deine Arbeit verändert das Leben von Menschen, die einen Neustart brauchen
  • Team Support: Großer Support mit deinen Team Mitgliedern

Strukturell:

  • 28 Urlaubstage
  • Strukturiertes Onboarding in den ersten drei Monaten – du wirst nicht ins kalte Wasser geschmissen

Es ist eine Rolle für jemanden, der wirklich zuhören kann, der Struktur liebt und der Lust hat, in einem wachsenden Berliner Startup echten Impact zu haben.

Wenn das nach dir klingt: Wir freuen uns auf dich.

title: Customer Success Manager (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Weltweit arbeiten 80 % aller Beschäftigten nicht am Schreibtisch.

Mit Ordio 💙 bieten wir eine All-in-One-Softwarelösung, die speziell für diese Mitarbeitenden entwickelt wurde und Unternehmen dabei hilft, ihren Arbeitsalltag zu organisieren und Abläufe für alle Beteiligten effizienter zu gestalten.

Als Customer Success Manager bei Ordio 💙 übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die Betreuung, Bindung und Weiterentwicklung deines Kundenportfolios.

Dein Fokus liegt auf der Steigerung der Net Revenue Retention (NRR) durch erfolgreiche Produktnutzung, Vertragsverlängerungen, Upselling und Expansion. Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf, erkennst Wachstumspotenziale und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden den größtmöglichen Mehrwert aus Ordio ziehen.

Aufgaben

🚤 Onboarding & Aktivierung: Du begleitest neue Kunden vom Setup über den Datenimport bis zur Schulung und sorgst dafür, dass sie Ordio innerhalb der ersten zwei Monate erfolgreich nutzen.

📈 Net Revenue Retention: Du verantwortest die Kundenbindung und das Wachstum deines Portfolios durch Vertragsverlängerungen, Upselling und Expansion.

🚀 Upsell & Cross-Sell: Du erkennst Wachstumspotenziale und gewinnst Kunden für Payroll Plus, zusätzliche Module, Nutzerlizenzen und weitere Services.

🔎 Renewals & Churn-Prävention: Du steuerst Vertragsverlängerungen, identifizierst Abwanderungsrisiken frühzeitig und entwickelst gezielte Maßnahmen zur Kundenbindung.

🗺️ Account Development: Du verstehst die Bedürfnisse und Wachstumspläne deiner Kunden, entwickelst Account-Strategien und identifizierst neue Potenziale.

title: Customer Success Manager - Landwirtschaft
descriptionHtml:
🌎 What we do

Root is Europe’s #1 primary data collection platform for F&B companies. We help our customers to measure and reduce farm-level emissions.

~31% of global GHG emissions originate from food-related activities. For the first time in history, climate performance has become an overall business performance indicator. Enterprises are mandated by regulatory bodies to disclose their climate performance, which leads to increasing pressure from investors, competitors, retailers, and consumers to prevent and reduce their CO2e emissions. Over the next 10 years, companies have set ambitious reduction targets that need to be met. Unlike other industries, the vast majority of F&B emissions originate from farms (known as Scope 3.1 emissions) and are highly complex to address. Root exists to help overcome this challenge.

We raised >€10m in funding in the first 2 years of our existence, we launched our enterprise product, signed and onboarded some of the largest F&B players in Europe, and put together what we believe is the best-suited early-stage tech team in Europe. Will you be the next to join us? 🚀

🔭 What you will work on

Your mission

Drive customer success by supporting a customer portfolio, ensuring smooth project execution and tool adoption, and helping build strong, trust-based relationships that maximize long-term value and advocacy.

📅 Over the next months, you will…

Drive Customer Success and Long-Term Value for Root's Customers

  • Own the success of a defined customer portfolio, acting as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor, guiding customers through key success milestones (onboarding, data collection, verification, reporting, reduction readiness) and ensuring they clearly understand and realize the value of the Root Platform

  • Plan, manage, and execute customer projects end-to-end, driving primary data coverage at scale through increased user engagement and data completion, serving as the first point of contact for agricultural users when needed, and ensuring high data quality, clear milestones, and on-time delivery

  • Design and run farmer-facing enablement, including digital webinars to drive participation, improve data quality, and build trust at the farm level

  • Collaborate with Account Management to relay customer feedback while building trust-based customer relationships that drive long-term satisfaction, retention, and advocacy

  • Collaborate with Product to bring agricultural and agronomic expertise into our products, translating practical farming knowledge and farmer needs into actionable product feedback and clear, farmer-facing recommendations.

🧺 What you bring along

  • Agricultural background (practical farm experience, agricultural studies, or prior work with agricultural users such as advisors, cooperatives)

  • Hands-on and detail-oriented, you thrive in fast-changing, early-stage environments, can juggle multiple tasks, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks

  • First experience in Customer Success, Operations or other fast-paced environments, where you supported or executed customer-facing processes end-to-end

  • People-centric and proactive, empathetic, approachable, and able to communicate clearly while keeping customer outcomes and business priorities in mind

  • Comfortable working with data in Excel and digital platforms, with an eye for completeness and consistency

  • Fluent in German and English; additional languages (Polish, French, Portuguese, Spanish) are a plus

  • Work from our Berlin office 5 days a week

🤗 You don't feel like you fulfill all the criteria? We get it: confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But guess what?! There is no such thing as a “perfect” candidate. title: Customer Success Manager
descriptionHtml:
Running a frontline business is an operational puzzle most software has never touched. Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment.

We think AI is what makes the problem solvable; better software alone wasn't enough. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. That's what we're building at Sona, and it's early enough that the systems you build now will still be foundational in three years.

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

About the Role

Sona's Customer Success function is being built from the ground up. $Millions of ARR is moving from Implementation to Customer Success, we're heading into our first year of renewals at scale, and there's meaningful seat expansion across the base. We need CSMs who can shape what good looks like, not operate inside a playbook someone else wrote.

You'll own a book of around 20-25 enterprise accounts across social care, hospitality and retail, partnering with Support, Product and Sales to own the post-live customer experience end to end. Some of the accounts you'll inherit are in difficult places, so you'll be rebuilding trust, holding rooms independently and driving outcomes in ambiguity.

We're a high-performance team. Everyone holds an important seat and is expected to perform at an elite level. We have each other's backs, we assume good intent, and we have zero space for internal politics. If that's your default, you'll thrive here.

This is an on-site role. Four days a week you'll be in our London office or out with customers, with one day working from home. Regular travel to customers across the UK is part of the job.

Responsibilities

  • Own senior customer relationships at Director level and above (Operations, Finance, HR), in person as well as over video, and act as the escalation point for your accounts

  • Run the QBR cadence and own renewals end to end, so the value case is made long before the renewal conversation

  • Drive proactive value work: account audits, surfacing unused functionality, and translating product usage into business outcomes

  • Progress seat upsells as customers grow, and flag wider expansion opportunities to AEs

title: Customer Success Manager, New Accounts (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Wunder Mobility

Wunder Mobility builds the software that powers shared mobility worldwide. Our platform runs 20M+ successful trips yearly, processing 50M+ daily API calls, across 500 cities in Europe, the US, and Asia. Operators like Forest (London), Green Mobility (Copenhagen), and Flexar (Singapore) rely on us every day to move cities forward.

What you will do

  • Demos and pilots. Run demos and pilots for the deals our leadership leads, and set up each prospect's demo or pilot environment.

  • Onboarding and launch. Own the plan, the timeline and the customer relationship from signature to go-live, with a technical lead from our team.

  • Your accounts. Own adoption, health, NPS, renewals, upselling and cross-selling, starting with an existing customer and adding the new accounts you help win.

Along the way, you refine our demo and sales playbooks with the team and help build the AI workflows behind our customer work.

The AI you'll work with

  • From week one, you prepare customer calls, account health checks, and ticket replies with Claude and our own shared skills, connected to our tickets, CRM, meeting notes, and product data.

  • Our company knowledge base is written for people and AI alike, so answers start from how we actually work.

  • Our product has AI built in. With Wunder AI, operators ask questions about their own fleet and rental data. You show it in demos and help customers use it.

  • We have a company standard for how we use AI at work, and the whole team works to it.

  • We are a founding partner of House of AI Hamburg. It shares the room with our team and hosts several evening events a week for Hamburg's AI community.

What you bring

  • 4+ years in customer-facing B2B software roles where you owned accounts: customer success, account management, implementation or solutions consulting.

  • You have run demos and pilots, and you can explain a complex platform in the language of the customer's business.

  • You have taken customers from signature to go-live, with a plan, deadlines and several parties involved.

  • AI is part of your recurring work and runs on real data. In our first call, you show us one workflow (anonymised or on sample data is fine) and tell us what you check.

  • Fluent German and English.

  • You enjoy taking existing processes and playbooks and making them better.

Nice to have

  • Experience in shared mobility, at an operator or a platform provider.

  • Go-to-market or marketing experience.

  • Something you built with AI that other people now use.

What you can expect

  • A fixed salary of €65,000 to €80,000 per year, reviewed every 12 months.

  • The new accounts you help win, from demo to launch and beyond.

  • Direct work with our CEO and leadership on deals and customers.

  • The AI tools you need. Within six months, you own at least one AI workflow that the team or company uses, with time set aside to build it.

  • Written reviews of your scope and pay with our CEO and your manager: after your first launch, when your book reaches four accounts, and after 12 months at the latest.

  • Hybrid working: in our Hamburg office on Monday, Wednesday and Thursday.

  • A 2-year fixed-term contract with 6 months' probation

How we hire

  1. Apply with your CV and short answers (a few sentences each, or a Loom recording) to two questions: Which customer did you take from pilot or signature to launch, and what would you do differently next time? What is the most useful AI workflow you set up in the last 90 days, and when did you catch it being wrong?

  2. Intro call, 30 minutes, with our Head of Customer Success. You show us one AI workflow you use.

  3. Case, at most 3 hours of preparation: a demo and a launch plan for a fictional operator, based on a short brief we send you. Ideally not slides but an interactive page or prototype you build with an AI tool. You present it live in a 60-minute conversation with our CEO and our Head of Customer Success.

  4. If needed, a short final conversation with another member of our leadership team.

  5. Offer. We ask for references at this stage.

We reply within five working days after each step. You get feedback after the case and after the final conversation. Our Head of Customer Success is your contact from start to finish.

We won't make a decision before the end of December 2026.
