title: Customer Success Manager
descriptionHtml:
Customer Success Manager

Location: Remote (European/UK time zones) - French and English required

About FullEnrich:

Every go-to-market motion runs on data, but no single provider has ever had complete coverage. We solve that problem: instead of relying on a single data source, we orchestrate 20+ premium providers around the world, automatically querying them and verifying data in real-time until we find the best available contact information. The result is industry-leading coverage and data quality, helping sales and GTM teams connect with the right people faster.

What started as a better way to find emails and phone numbers has grown into a broader vision: becoming the trusted GTM data infrastructure layer powering modern revenue teams and AI agents. Today, more than 6,000 customers, including companies like AWS, Deel, HubSpot, Clay, Intercom, Unify,and Artisan, trust us to power their prospecting and enrichment.

Founded in Paris and now headquartered in San Francisco, we're a team of 50+ people across the US, Europe, LATAM, and Israel, growing quickly and building with speed, ownership, and ambition. That's where you come in.

The Role:

You’ll be joining as a Customer Success Manager in our Customer Success team, reporting to Jemima, our Founding CSM.

FullEnrich has grown to 5,000+ customers, and our CS function has been a team of one until now. We're bringing in our next CSM to own all of our French-speaking customers, across every segment, plus our Scale/SMB book ($10k to $25k ARR). Day to day, you'll onboard new customers, drive adoption, run renewals end to end, and spot the accounts that are ready to grow. Ownership here means your book is yours: you know every account, you close every renewal, and you catch risk before it turns into churn. You'll work closely with Sales, Product and Support, and because the team is still small, you'll help shape the playbooks the rest of CS is built on.

What You'll Do:

Own your book

  • Own the post-sale relationship for all of our French-speaking customers who range from Enterprise to SMB, plus our Scale/SMB book

  • Run onboarding and kick-off calls so new customers reach first value quickly

  • Be the voice of your customers internally, feeding product feedback into the roadmap

Renewals & retention

  • Own renewals end to end: forecasting, commercial conversations and closing

  • Monitor usage, credit consumption and health signals, and act early on risk

  • Run save plays on at-risk accounts before renewal is on the line

Adoption & expansion

  • Drive adoption across our API, CSV/bulk upload and CRM integrations

  • Identify and qualify expansion opportunities, then hand them to Sales with full context

Scaled CS

  • Contribute to one-to-many programs: French-language webinars, office hours and enablement content

  • Help improve our playbooks and keep HubSpot data clean and reliable

What Success Looks like:

By 3 months

  • Confident across the product (API, CSV, integrations) and our CS playbooks

  • Owning your full book, with every account health-scored and a main point of contact in HubSpot

  • Running renewals independently, and you have hosted your first French-language webinar or office hours

By 6 months

  • Book on track for 90%+ gross revenue retention

  • [X]% of the book active and healthy (target to confirm once the health score is defined)

  • A steady flow of qualified expansion handoffs to Sales

By 12 months

  • 90%+ GRR delivered across the book

  • Measurable improvement in adoption and health across the book

  • The trusted internal voice on our French-speaking customers, shaping how we scale CS

What We're Looking For:

  • Native-level French and fluent English, written and spoken

  • 2 to 4 years in a SaaS Customer Success role, owning a book of business

  • A track record of owning and closing renewals, not just managing relationships

  • Comfortable running a high-volume book and prioritising with data

  • At home in a CRM (HubSpot ideally) and using usage data to make decisions

  • Warm, clear communicator who's confident in commercial conversations

  • Builder mindset: you like a fast-growing team where the playbook is still being written

Nice to Haves

  • Background in B2B data, sales tech or GTM tooling

  • Comfortable talking APIs and integrations with technical buyers

  • Confident using Claude to speed up your day-to-day work

The Hiring Process:

  • Intro to FullEnrich with our Talent Team (30 min) – A chance to learn more about you, introduce FullEnrich and the role, and explore whether there's a mutual fit.

  • Meet with our Founding CSM (45 mins) –A chance to dive deeper into your experience and role specific fit

  • Task stage (90 mins)

  • Final with the CEO (45 min) – A chance for you to meet our CEO, Ben, and have a conversation around FullEnrich's values, ambitions, how we work, and what we're building together.

  • Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen und weiterentwickeln: Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für unsere bestehenden KMU-Kunden. Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf, erkennst Potenziale für zusätzliche Funktionen und eine erweiterte Nutzung und hilfst deinen Kunden, ihre unternehmerischen und finanziellen Ziele mit Pennylane zu erreichen.
  • Proaktiv beraten: In regelmäßigen Gesprächen prüfst du, wie erfolgreich deine Kunden mit Pennylane arbeiten und wo sie Unterstützung brauchen. Du steigerst ihre Zufriedenheit, optimierst die Nutzung der Plattform und erkennst frühzeitig, wenn eine Abwanderung droht.
  • Gemeinsam den deutschen Markt gestalten: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem deutschen Sales-Team und dem lokalen Leadership-Team zusammen. Gemeinsam entwickelt ihr Abläufe weiter, bündelt Produktfeedback und treibt das Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland voran.
  • Expertise aufbauen und teilen: Du entwickelst dich zur gefragten Ansprechperson für unsere Plattform und die deutsche Finanz- und Buchhaltungslandschaft. Dein Wissen und bewährte Vorgehensweisen gibst du direkt an unsere KMU-Kunden weiter.

Das bringst du mit

  • Relevante Erfahrung: Du hast 2–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung, im Finanzmanagement, in Corporate Finance oder in einer vergleichbaren unternehmensinternen Rolle. Idealerweise hast du selbst mit Finanzprozessen, Rechnungsstellung oder Buchhaltungsabläufen gearbeitet. Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Umfeld, bei einem Fintech oder in einer Steuerkanzlei ist ein Plus.
  • Fachliche Grundlage: Du hast ein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen, Rechnungswesen oder Betriebswirtschaft abgeschlossen. Alternativ bringst du eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellter, eine Weiterbildung als Steuerfachwirt oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation im Rechnungswesen mit.
  • Verständnis für den deutschen Markt: Du kennst die Anforderungen von KMU an ihr Finanzmanagement und verstehst die zentralen Abläufe rund um Rechnungswesen, Rechnungsstellung und das finanzielle Tagesgeschäft in Deutschland.
  • Kommunikationsstärke und Empathie: Du hörst aufmerksam zu, versetzt dich in deine Kunden hinein und erklärst komplexe finanzielle oder technische Themen einfach und verständlich.
  • Lust, selbst anzupacken: Du möchtest Teil eines Teams sein, das in Deutschland noch am Anfang steht und wächst. Du ergreifst die Initiative, denkst in Lösungen und hast Freude daran, Prozesse von Grund auf mitzugestalten.
  • Reisebereitschaft: Du freust dich darauf, unser Team beim Onboarding im Pariser Headquarter kennenzulernen, und bist bereit, gelegentlich Kunden in Deutschland zu besuchen – etwa einmal im Monat.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder verhandlungssicherem Niveau (C2) und fließend Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren internationalen Teams.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

  • Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.

Wen wir suchen

title: Customer Success Team Leader
descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Role Description

As Customer Success Team Lead, you’ll lead a team of approximately five Customer Success Executives. Together, you’ll help qualified SME prospects move through their onboarding journey, converting leads into open, funded and actively used Allica business current accounts.

You’ll coach your team to have confident, consultative conversations with business owners and decision-makers—understanding their existing banking challenges, explaining Allica’s value proposition and supporting them as they switch to Allica.

You’ll be accountable for team performance across the full onboarding journey, while ensuring every prospective customer receives a consistently excellent experience and a strong first impression of Allica Bank.

This is a highly collaborative role. You’ll work closely with Relationship Management, Product, Marketing, Growth, Data, Customer Due Diligence and Operations to improve the onboarding experience, remove friction and create better outcomes for customers.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Working closely with the Sales Managers of Customer Success, The Customer Success Team Leader will provide line management, capacity planning, pipeline management, coaching and development to support a team of Customer Success Executives.

  • Coach team members to engage SME decision-makers confidently by telephone and email, using a consultative approach to understand their needs and banking pain points.

  • Through close collaboration with our Customer Due Diligence, operations leaders and product teams, the Customer Success Team Leader will work to support reducing friction and improving the experience in the customer onboarding journey.

  • Understanding our onboarding process and requirements and supporting customers and prospects through this process to open current accounts and deliver a great customer experience.

  • Gaining feedback from customers and prospects on potential future features they need and want from their bank and bank account and feeding these into the Product teams.

  • Working with our Growth, Marketing and Data teams to feedback your learnings from customer interactions, helping us to drive ever better customer outcomes, targeting, segmentation and messaging.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • You will have managed and led a team either in person or remotely to successfully achieve KPIs relating to customer and colleague experience.

  • You should have a general understanding of SME financial products (eg payments, lending, accounting, CRM), and ideally specific expertise in business current accounts.

  • You will have a proven track record in telephone-based lead generation with established SMEs (typically 5-250 employee firms), including business development from cold prospects.

  • You will have excellent interpersonal and communication skills, together with evidence of outperformance in similar roles through earning customer and colleague trust.

  • You will demonstrate the ability to work collaboratively with specialist colleagues such as Relationship Managers, Operations, KYCB and underwriters, to deliver a positive outcome for our customers.

  • You’ll have a proven track record of exceeding targets, providing excellent customer service generating new income opportunities and always considering risk and reputation.

  • Experience working collaboratively with specialist teams such as Relationship Managers, Operations, KYC/CDD teams and underwriters.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

title: Customer Value Architect III
descriptionHtml:
About Mixpanel

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com.

About the Role

Not a technical role, despite 'architect' in the title, this is relationship and strategy work, not engineering. Customer success, account management, or consulting backgrounds are a better fit than technical ones.

The right candidate is a relationship-first advisor who thrives on connecting customers' Mixpanel investment to real business outcomes. You'll be the consultative owner of adoption, value, and AI maturity across a named portfolio of high-value accounts, engaged from onboarding through the full contract lifecycle. You are accountable for the outcome, not the commercial relationship owning the value case and the adoption plan behind it. You will build the executive relationships and strategic plans that make Mixpanel indispensable to how your customers build products.

Responsibilities

  • Connect mixpanel to customer value
    • Own our value workstream with customers - understanding the business challenges that led them to buy Mixpanel, how they measure the ROI of their investment, and ensuring that they achieve that ROI by working across the customers’ teams and collaborating internally with other Mixpanel teams.
    • Build and own relationships across business and technical stakeholders, including executive sponsors, aligning Mixpanel's capabilities to customers' highest-priority goals.
    • Develop and execute success plans that map customer business objectives to adoption milestones and measurable outcomes.
    • Perform ongoing discovery of the customer’s business priorities, internal toolset, and ongoing business pain – synthesize this information into actions that feed your success plans and share information with internal partners as needed.
    • Operate in lockstep with the AE and renewal team, with clear lanes: you partner with the AE on expansion and growth motions and with the renewal team on renewal execution, bringing the value case and adoption evidence that underpins both. You own the value case; they own the commercial outcome.
  • Own value delivery and product relationship 
    • Lead customer enablement sessions—covering topics like dashboard design, funnel analysis, and retention modeling—to grow Mixpanel usage depth and breadth across the customer organization.
    • Proactively monitor product usage and health signals; lead regular business reviews to surface insights, deepen adoption, and surface risk early.
    • Drive customer adoption - both identifying new pockets for Mixpanel usage within an organization and strategies for re-engagement where adoption is low.
    • Identify underutilized features and contracted capabilities, translating them into concrete recommendations that expand customer value.
    • Triage customer product requests and issues - solving their use case questions, basic troubleshooting and escalating as appropriate
  • Own the AI Conversation
    • Assess a customer's AI maturity and advise on their agent and context strategy, this is now a first-class part of the job, not a bonus skill.
    • Fluently use Mixpanel's own AI surface (Mixpanel AI, Mixpanel Agent, Headless, and MCP) to help customers building AI-native workflows on their product data.
    • Use AI as a personal operating habit: a rehearsal partner for executive conversations, a discovery-prep engine and stakeholder sentiment analysis.
  • Be the voice of the customer to cross-functional partners
    • Coordinate across GTM, Product, and Engineering to manage escalations, advocate for customer needs, and bring the right resources to bear.
    • Contribute to team playbooks and best practices that scale impact across the broader CS organization.

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

  • Experience in Customer Success, management consulting, or a related field supporting complex B2B SaaS accounts.
  • A track record of managing relationships at every level across different functions (from business executives to technical ICs) and influencing decisions at the C-suite level.
  • The ability to translate technical concepts—data models, analytics instrumentation, product metrics—into business terms that resonate with non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive platform adoption and connect product usage to customer business outcomes.
  • Experience building and executing strategic value and adoption plans – tying day-to-day activities to strategic outcomes and being able to communicate wins in terms of ROI.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic or AI-native tooling. MCP-based workflows, LLM copilots, or similar (beyond casual ChatGPT use.)

Bonus Points For

  • Background in product analytics, growth, or data-driven product development.
  • Experience in a technical advisory or solutions capacity (e.g., implementation, professional services).
  • Familiarity with analytics instrumentation, event tracking, or data tooling.

#LI-Hybrid

Benefits and Perks

  • Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care
  • Mental Wellness Benefit
  • Generous Vacation Policy & Additional Company Holidays
  • Enhanced Parental Leave
  • Volunteer Time Off
  • Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break

*please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary*

Culture Values

  • Make Bold Bets: We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.
  • Innovate with Insight: We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes.
  • One Team: We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone.
  • Candor with Connection: We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations.
  • Champion the Customer: We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star.
  • Powerful Simplicity: We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible.

Why choose Mixpanel?

We’re a leader in analytics with over 29,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.

We’ve immersed ourselves in our Culture and Values as our guiding principles for the impact we want to have and the future we are building.

title: CX Manager (d/w/m)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Mission

Deine Insights und Projekte sorgen dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen dauerhaft bei SpotmyEnergy bleiben. Als CX Manager erkennst Du früh, wo Kund:innen unzufrieden werden, und sorgst dafür, dass unsere KI, unser Team und unsere Kund:innen immer auf dem aktuellen Stand sind. Du verbindest Wissensdatenbank, Kundendaten und Kundenkommunikation zu einem Kreislauf. Dein Maßstab: weniger Tickets je Kunde, mehr Fälle im First Level gelöst und noch bessere Bewertungen.
Unser KI-Assistent Lumi ist in Tickets, Chat und Hotline bereits vorgeschaltet. Du sorgst dafür, dass es die richtigen Antworten gibt. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit unserer VP Customer Experience zusammen und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt eigene Themen, bis Du sie vollständig verantwortest.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Du verantwortest unsere Wissensdatenbank: Du hältst sie aktuell, vollständig und widerspruchsfrei, für Lumi, unsere internen KI-Tools und unser Team.
  • Du machst unseren KI-Assistenten Lumi besser: Du prüfst seine Antworten, vergleichst sie mit anderen KI-Tools und schärfst über die Wissensdatenbank nach.
  • Du arbeitest jede Produktänderung zeitnah in Wissensdatenbank und Kundenkommunikation ein und gibst neue Informationen an unsere Teams und unsere KI weiter.
  • Du verantwortest unsere Auswertungen: Tickets, Anrufe, CSAT, NPS und Bewertungen. Daraus leitest Du konkrete Verbesserungen für Wissen, Prozesse und Kommunikation ab.
  • Du entwickelst Frühwarnsysteme, die abwanderungsgefährdete Kund:innen erkennen, bevor sie kündigen, und stößt passende Maßnahmen an.
  • Du zeigst unseren Fachabteilungen, was unsere Kund:innen brauchen und wo Probleme entstehen.
  • Du findest gemeinsam mit Customer Service und Technical Support heraus, welche Anliegen künftig direkt im ersten Kontakt gelöst werden können.
  • Du beantwortest Bewertungen auf Trustpilot, in den App Stores und bei Google.
  • Du entwickelst unsere Standardkommunikation weiter, prüfst Zustellbarkeit und Wirkung und testest Varianten.
  • Du lieferst unserem Produktteam auf Basis der Daten Inhalte und Anlässe, damit wir Kund:innen in allen Kanälen, auch in unserer App, im richtigen Moment informieren.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Customer Experience, Customer Insights, CRM oder einem verwandten Bereich und hast dort schon eigene Themen verantwortet.
  • Du arbeitest täglich mit KI: Du schreibst gute Prompts und prüfst Ergebnisse kritisch.
  • Idealerweise hast Du schon einen KI-Assistenten oder Chatbot konfiguriert, trainiert oder getestet.
  • Du hast Kundendaten selbst ausgewertet und daraus konkrete Verbesserungen abgeleitet.
  • Du behältst bei vielen parallelen Themen den Überblick, priorisierst selbst und lieferst Ergebnisse, die nicht nachgeschärft werden müssen.
  • Du denkst in Prozessen und gibst Dich nicht mit Symptomen zufrieden.
  • Du schreibst klar und kannst auch Themen wie Smart Meter oder dynamische Tarife verständlich erklären. Auch bei einer wütenden Bewertung triffst Du den richtigen Ton.
  • Du sprichst und schreibst sehr gutes Deutsch (C2).
  • Erfahrung mit Wissensdatenbanken, HubSpot oder Bewertungsplattformen ist ein Plus.

Unser Offer

  • Wirkung, die bleibt: Deine Insights und Projekte entscheiden mit, ob Kund:innen dauerhaft bei SpotmyEnergy bleiben. Das zahlt direkt auf unser Wachstum ein.
  • Echte Gestaltung: Du entscheidest, was Lumi, unsere internen KI-Tools und alle Mitarbeitenden über unsere Produkte wissen.
  • KI im Alltag statt auf Folien: Du arbeitest mit den Tools, die wir täglich einsetzen, und baust auf Analysen auf, die schon vorbereitet sind.
  • Nah an den Entscheidungen: Du berichtest direkt an unsere VP Customer Experience und arbeitest eng mit Customer Service, Technical Support und Produkt zusammen.
  • Energiewende mitgestalten: ein Scale-up, das gerade stark wächst, mit Büro in Köln und einem starken Teamspirit.

title: Cyber Threat Intelligence Lead
descriptionHtml:
About CyberCube:

CyberCube delivers the world's leading analytics to quantify digital risk, helping the largest global carriers, reinsurers and brokers understand, price and manage cyber risk in financial terms.

  • AI at our foundation, cyber risk at our core. We don't just use AI, we shape it.

  • Built on AI from day one. Artificial intelligence has been part of our strategy since the beginning, blended with deep cybersecurity and insurance expertise and backed by rigorous testing.

  • Trusted by more than 100 clients, including 75% of the top 40 European and US cyber insurance carriers and 70% of the top ten reinsurance brokers.

  • Backed for global growth. In 2025 Spectrum Equity joined some of CyberCube’s financial partners as a new cornerstone investor, accelerating our global growth and fueling innovation across our end-to-end cyber risk analytics for the insurance industry.

  • A truly global team across San Francisco, New York, London, and Tallinn.

  • A culture of collaboration, openness, intellectual rigor, and ownership for excellence.

  • People at the forefront. We encourage CyberCubers to challenge themselves, push boundaries, and do the best work of their careers.

The Impact You Will Make

  • Work in a team of cyber threat analysts, economists, data scientists, actuaries and risk modelers to develop insights, scores, and features for a suite of products delivering cyber risk analytics to the (re)insurance industry

  • Own CyberCube's point of view on technology risk including factors such as:

    • Offensive capabilities and trends among threat actor classes, and validating CyberCube models against observed real-world events,

    • Security hygiene standards (e.g. NIST CSF, CIS) and mitigations for companies to lower their potential likelihood and/or impact of events, and

    • Technology adoption and trends including the adoption, reliance on and governance of artificial intelligence

… translating these factors into the assumptions and scenarios that drive risk models – especially where historical data is limited

  • Own the scenario and "event family" library for cyber catastrophe modeling, including emerging AI-driven scenarios

  • Own the assumptions register and expert-judgment governance: the documented, client-defensible rationale for modeling choices that are not purely data-driven

  • Present CyberCube methodology, threat landscape and emerging risk trends to clients and prospects and engage in strategic dialogue with key stakeholders as one of CyberCube's key voices and thought leaders on technology risk. Be able to differentiate when speaking with varying technical backgrounds and seniority (e.g. analyst to C-Suite)

  • Engage in cross functional collaboration with stakeholders from engineering, product management, analytics personnel, and client facing teams to deliver on projects and product goals

  • Deliver various cyber threat intelligence reports – e.g. threat landscape, scenario libraries, changes to mitigation and exploitation assumptions, etc. – on a quarterly cadence

The Skills and Experience You Will Bring

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in cyber security, computer science, statistics, economics, mathematics, or related field

  • 3-5 years experience in offensive and/or defensive cyber security (CISSP, CEH, CISM, CompTIA Security+, or other certification preferred)

  • Working fluency in Python / R, SQL, flat files and complex data types (JSON, XML), APIs, and Excel – enough to specify and interpret analysis with Data/Analytics teams

  • Ability to translate real-world cyber threat behavior into modeling assumptions and scenarios – e.g. scenario likelihoods, severity, and mitigation impacts

  • Intellectual curiosity, willingness to learn new skills, and push ideas forward

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills

  • Strong communication and consulting presence with key stakeholders

  • Experience working in and leading project teams

  • Ability to work in an agile, fast-paced startup environment

  • Ability to maintain relationships, collaborate effectively, and meet deadlines with a distributed, remote-first workforce

  • Ability to think creatively and respond to emerging threats (cyber, AI, other) and their modeling implications in a timely manner

The Extra Credit, or The Focus Areas You Will Develop

  • Experience with analytics and risk modeling

  • Experience in a SaaS product development environment

  • Familiarity with ML techniques and statistical data analysis

  • Familiarity with AI / LLM risk and its implications for cyber risk, social engineering, product safety, errors/omissions, and critical infrastructure

  • Familiarity with a wide variety of Internet technologies such as BGP, TCP/IP, DNS, etc.

Why You'll Love it Here

  • Play an instrumental role in reshaping one of the key industries in the world

  • Flexible working hours and the option to work remotely

  • Opportunity to participate in a secondment program

  • Company-supported mentorship program

  • Grow in a collaborative, respectful, and empathetic culture

US specific

  • Competitive salary and unlimited PTO

  • Generous healthcare benefits with medical, dental and vision coverage

  • Monthly catered lunches and happy hours

  • Company-paid learning and development assistance

  • Dependant care assistance plan

UK specific

  • Competitive salary, pension and benefits

  • Generous private medical healthcare insurance with dental and vision coverage

  • Extra vacation days during winter holidays

AI Fluency at CyberCube

AI is reshaping how work gets done across every function. We value people who are curious about AI, eager to learn, and thoughtful about applying AI tools to work more effectively. AI fluency is part of how we assess every role in our hiring process.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway.

title: Cybersecurity Manager
descriptionHtml:
Cybersecurity Manager

Location: Remote - Europe (European time zones)

About FullEnrich:

Every go-to-market motion runs on data, but no single provider has ever had complete coverage. We solve that problem: instead of relying on a single data source, we orchestrate 20+ premium providers around the world, automatically querying them and verifying data in real-time until we find the best available contact information. The result is industry-leading coverage and data quality, helping sales and GTM teams connect with the right people faster.

What started as a better way to find emails and phone numbers has grown into a broader vision: becoming the trusted GTM data infrastructure layer powering modern revenue teams and AI agents. Today, more than 6,000 customers, including companies like AWS, Deel, HubSpot, Clay, Intercom, Unify,and Artisan, trust us to power their prospecting and enrichment.

Founded in Paris and now headquartered in San Francisco, we're a team of 50+ people across the US, Europe, LATAM, and Israel, growing quickly and building with speed, ownership, and ambition. That's where you come in.

The Role:

You'll be joining as our Cybersecurity Manager, reporting directly to our VP of Engineering.

At FullEnrich, security and privacy aren't just compliance requirements; they're fundamental to our product and the trust our customers place in us. As we scale, we're looking for someone to take ownership of our security, compliance, and corporate IT programs, ensuring we continue to protect our customers, strengthen our infrastructure, and meet the expectations of increasingly sophisticated enterprise clients.

As our first dedicated security and IT hire, you'll have the opportunity to build and shape this function from the ground up. You'll own our security strategy and compliance roadmap, working closely with Engineering, leadership, and teams across the business to implement practical, scalable controls. Our engineers build and operate the platform, while you'll define, oversee, and continuously improve the security measures that protect it.

We're already SOC 2 compliant, with ISO 27001 and additional certifications on the horizon. Operating across multiple regions and working with 20+ data providers also brings interesting challenges around data privacy, vendor security, and international regulations.

This is a hands-on role with significant autonomy, direct exposure to leadership, and the opportunity to build a security function that grows alongside the business.

What You'll Do:

Security & Infrastructure

  • Own and continuously improve our application and infrastructure security posture, partnering with Engineering to implement and maintain effective security controls.

  • Lead our vulnerability management program, including external penetration testing, vulnerability disclosure, and remediation tracking.

  • Identify, assess, and prioritize security risks, ensuring vulnerabilities are addressed based on their potential business impact.

Compliance & Certifications

  • Own our security compliance program end to end, maintaining SOC 2 and leading future certifications such as ISO 27001.

  • Manage ongoing evidence collection, auditor relationships, control assessments, and remediation activities.

  • Develop and maintain a scalable compliance roadmap aligned with business growth and customer requirements.

Security Governance & Risk Management

  • Develop and maintain security policies, risk assessments, and our company-wide risk register.

  • Lead regular access reviews, security awareness initiatives, and incident response preparedness.

  • Coordinate security incidents and drive continuous improvements to our security processes and controls.

Corporate IT & Identity Management

  • Own our corporate IT security framework, including device management (MDM), identity providers, SSO, and SaaS access controls.

  • Oversee secure employee onboarding and offboarding, account provisioning, and hardware inventory management, working with our operational IT team on execution.

  • Improve and automate IT security processes to ensure they remain reliable and scalable as the company grows.

Data Privacy & Vendor Security

  • Oversee privacy operations, including data subject requests, vendor data processing agreements, and cross-border data transfers.

  • Ensure our practices align with applicable privacy regulations, including GDPR and US state privacy laws, coordinating with our DPO and relevant stakeholders.

  • Build and maintain a risk-based vendor security assessment process across our data providers and wider SaaS ecosystem.

Customer Trust & Enterprise Security

  • Own the security due diligence process for enterprise customers, including questionnaires, audits, and security reviews.

  • Maintain our customer-facing security documentation, trust page, and audit report distribution.

  • Partner with Sales and leadership to turn security and compliance into a competitive advantage, helping customers move through procurement and security reviews with confidence.

What Success Looks Like:

By 3 months

  • You've taken full ownership of our existing SOC 2 compliance program, with evidence collection, control monitoring, and auditor coordination running smoothly.

  • You've assessed our current security posture, completed an initial risk assessment, and identified the highest-priority improvements across infrastructure, corporate IT, and identity management.

  • You've established an effective process for handling enterprise security questionnaires and customer due diligence, with turnaround times measured in days rather than weeks.

  • You've developed an initial 12-month security roadmap covering remediation priorities, penetration testing, incident response, and future certifications.

By 6 months

  • You've implemented improvements to our highest-priority security and IT controls, including identity management, endpoint security, and access governance.

  • You've established a repeatable vulnerability management process, with penetration testing completed or underway and remediation tracked through to resolution.

  • You've strengthened our incident response readiness through documented procedures and a tabletop exercise.

  • You've implemented consistent processes for vendor security reviews and privacy operations, ensuring risks are assessed and regulatory obligations are managed effectively.

By 12 months

  • Our SOC 2 compliance program is operating as a continuous, audit-ready process, with renewals running smoothly and minimal disruption to the wider business.

  • You've made measurable progress against our security roadmap, including advancing ISO 27001 or other certifications agreed with leadership.

  • Our corporate IT and security processes are reliable, scalable, and embedded into everyday operations.

  • Security is actively supporting business growth, with faster enterprise due diligence, stronger customer confidence, and fewer security-related obstacles in the sales process.

What We're Looking For:

  • Proven experience owning a security and compliance program end to end, including SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification, auditor management, evidence collection, and control remediation.

  • Strong understanding of application and cloud infrastructure security, with the ability to partner effectively with Engineering teams to identify risks and implement practical controls.

  • Hands-on experience with corporate IT security, including MDM, identity providers, SSO/SCIM, SaaS access management, and employee lifecycle processes.

  • Solid knowledge of data privacy regulations, particularly GDPR, and experience navigating international data protection requirements and cross-border transfers.

  • Experience managing security governance processes, including risk assessments, vulnerability management, incident response, and security policies.

  • A proactive, hands-on approach, with the ability to balance strategic thinking with practical execution in a fast-moving environment.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, with the confidence to work across technical and non-technical teams, engage with auditors, and represent security in enterprise customer discussions.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience working in a data-heavy or API-first SaaS business, particularly data enrichment, data brokerage, or similar industries.

  • Security management certifications such as CISM (Certified Information Security Manager) or equivalent.

  • Experience working as, or closely alongside, a Data Protection Officer (DPO).

  • Experience supporting enterprise sales processes through security due diligence and customer-facing security reviews.

  • French language skills or proficiency in another European language.

The Hiring Process:

  • Intro to FullEnrich with our Talent Team (30 min) – A chance to learn more about you, introduce FullEnrich and the role, and explore whether there's a mutual fit.

  • Practical case on a real security & compliance scenario from our world (1 hr) – A chance for you to showcase how you think and work.

  • Deep dive with the VP of Engineering (1 hr) – A chance to talk through your approach, strategy, and how you'd operate in this role.

  • Final with the CEO (45 min) – A chance for you to meet our CEO, Ben, and have a conversation around FullEnrich's values, ambitions, how we work, and what we're building together.

title: Data & AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Waarom jij hier JA op zegt!

✔ Werken aan data-oplossingen én AI-initiatieven met directe impact op de business

✔ Veel vrijheid, autonomie en ruimte voor eigen ideeën

✔ Salaris van maximaal €5.000 bruto per maand o.b.v. 40 uur en afhankelijk van ervaring

✔ Werken in een klein, wendbaar team zonder corporate bureaucratie

✔ 28 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband + mogelijkheid om 5 dagen bij te kopen

In deze rol ben je in de eerste plaats verantwoordelijk voor het bouwen en verbeteren van data-oplossingen. Je zorgt ervoor dat data beschikbaar, betrouwbaar en bruikbaar is voor de organisatie door data pipelines, dashboards en integraties te ontwikkelen.

Tegelijkertijd krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van AI binnen Rail Innovators Group. AI vormt daarbij een waardevolle aanvulling op de rol, maar de basis ligt in data engineering en business intelligence.

Je werkt aan uiteenlopende vraagstukken, van stuurinformatie voor de business tot innovatieve AI-toepassingen die processen slimmer en efficiënter maken.

Rail Innovators Group

Rail Innovators Group, opgericht in 2005 en gevestigd in Rotterdam, is een internationale specialist in goederenvervoer per spoor. Met meer dan 250 railprofessionals zijn wij actief in 23 landen en vervoeren wij jaarlijks meer dan 6 miljoen ton aan vracht.

Onze moderne vloot bestaat uit hoogwaardige locomotieven, een breed scala aan wagons en intermodale units. Daarmee bieden wij flexibele, betrouwbare en duurzame transportoplossingen in heel Europa en daarbuiten.

Via onze vier bedrijven Raillogix, Rail Force One, Railrelease en CWS verzorgen wij de volledige railketen: van planning en tractie tot leasing en onderhoud.

Wat ga je doen?

Je werkt aan uiteenlopende data- en AI-vraagstukken die bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming, efficiëntere processen en verdere digitalisering van de organisatie. Je werkt vanuit een backlog en roadmap, waarbij je samen met de business bepaalt welke oplossingen de meeste waarde toevoegen. Daarbij schakel je met verschillende stakeholders, van finance en operations tot directie.

Concreet betekent dit dat je:

  • Data pipelines bouwt en onderhoudt

  • Verschillende databronnen integreert en ontsluit

  • Dashboards en rapportages ontwikkelt waarmee de business kan sturen

  • De data-architectuur verder professionaliseert en verbetert

  • Businessvragen vertaalt naar concrete data-oplossingen

  • Prioriteiten stelt op basis van impact en business value

  • Werkt binnen een Agile omgeving met tweewekelijkse sprints

  • Actief meebouwt aan de verdere AI-volwassenheid van de organisatie


Wie ben jij?

Iemand die analytisch sterk is, zelfstandig werkt en energie krijgt van complexe vraagstukken. Je vindt het leuk om techniek en business met elkaar te verbinden en durft kritisch mee te denken wanneer een antwoord niet de juiste oplossing lijkt.

Dit past bij iemand die:

  • Beschikt over HBO werk- en denkniveau

  • Een opleiding heeft afgerond richting IT, Informatica, Bedrijfskundige Informatica, Econometrie of vergelijkbaar

  • Communicatief sterk is en gemakkelijk schakelt met verschillende stakeholders

  • Analytisch en probleemoplossend ingesteld is

  • Zelfstandig werkt, verantwoordelijkheid neemt en prioriteiten weet te stellen

  • Affiniteit met IT heeft

  • De Nederlandse taal goed beheerst, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk

Daarnaast is het mooi meegenomen als je ervaring hebt met:

  • Data Engineering, SQL en ETL

  • Business Intelligence

  • AI-oplossingen en tooling zoals ChatGPT of Claude

  • Agile of Scrum werkwijzen

Heb je nog niet overal ervaring mee, maar beschik je over een sterk analytisch vermogen en een hoge leercurve? Dan nodigen we je ook van harte uit om te reageren

Wat bieden wij?

  • Het salaris voor deze functie bedraagt maximaal €5.000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van jouw kennis, niveau en werkervaring

  • Je krijgt 28 vakantiedagen op fulltime basis, met daarnaast de mogelijkheid om 5 extra dagen bij te kopen

  • Daarnaast ontvang je een winstafhankelijke bonusregeling en profiteer je van een uitstekende pensioenregeling

  • We bieden flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om hybride te werken. Je werkt gemiddeld twee dagen per week op kantoor en de overige dagen flexibel vanuit huis

  • Reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23 per kilometer

  • Je beschikt over een laptop en mobiele telefoon om je werk optimaal uit te voeren

  • Korting op fitness, zodat je ook buiten werktijd fit en vitaal blijft

  • Werken vanuit een modern kantoor in de Rotterdamse Waalhaven, met goede faciliteiten en uitstekende koffie

title: Data Analyst (Mensch) mit dem Schwerpunkt Go-to-Market & Insights
descriptionHtml:
Worum gehts?

Bei Event Inc wollen wir Entscheidungen konsequent auf Basis von Daten treffen. Das gilt von der Go-to-Market-Strategie bis zur Conversion-Optimierung, in Marketing, Sales und Product. Mit Dir bündeln wir die Analysekompetenz an einer Stelle und schaffen eine gemeinsame Datenbasis, auf die sich alle verlassen können.

Deine Rolle

Als Data Analyst (Mensch) mit dem Schwerpunkt Go-to-Market & Insights bist Du die zentrale Anlaufstelle für Datenanalysen entlang unserer gesamten Wertschöpfungskette. Du bist Teil unseres Product Teams und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit unseren Data Engineers. Du begleitest Maßnahmen von der ersten Exploration über die Empfehlung bis zur Wirkungsmessung.

  • Performance im Blick: Du überwachst laufend unsere GTM-Performance über Marketing, Sales und Product hinweg, von Funnel-Analysen über Kanal-Performance bis zu Conversion-Raten.
  • Zahlen, die etwas bewegen: Du lieferst Ad-hoc-Analysen für unsere Teams, immer mit konkreten Handlungsempfehlungen statt reinen Reports.
  • Von der Idee bis zur Wirkung: Gemeinsam mit den Teams entwickelst Du Hypothesen und übersetzt sie in Experimente und A/B-Tests. Mit Vorher-/Nachher-Vergleichen misst Du, ob Maßnahmen wirklich wirken.
  • Muster erkennen: Du machst Cohort- und Funnel-Analysen über Kundensegmente und Marketplace-Bereiche hinweg (z. B. Pharma vs. Automotive). Mit Win/Loss-Analysen bei Enterprise-Deals lieferst Du wertvollen Input für unser Sales Enablement.
  • Traffic-Kanäle optimieren: In enger Abstimmung mit Marketing, Sales und Product optimierst Du unsere Traffic-Kanäle, z. B. mit Blick auf SEO/GEO-Performance und Content-Wirkung.
  • Reporting smart automatisieren: Zusammen mit einem Data Engineer baust Du eine KI- und automatisierungsgestützte Reporting-Infrastruktur auf. So fließt Deine Zeit in Analyse und Empfehlung statt in manuelle Datenaufbereitung.
  • Schnittstelle mit Gewicht: Du bist die zentrale Datenquelle für GTM-Entscheidungen und arbeitest direkt mit unserem CPO zusammen.

Was uns gefällt

  • Fundierte Basis: Du hast ein Studium oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung in Data Science, Statistik, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Mathematik, BWL oder einem ähnlichen Bereich erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
  • Erfahrung, die zählt: Du bringst 2–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Data, Business oder Product Analytics mit. Mit Marketing-, Sales- oder Marketplace-Funnel-Metriken und Tracking kennst Du Dich aus.
  • Analytisches Handwerkszeug: Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse in Datenanalyse und Statistik und weißt, wie man aussagekräftige KPIs entwickelt.
  • Daten in Klartext: Du leitest aus Zahlen konkrete, verständliche Empfehlungen ab und vermittelst sie so, dass jedes Team etwas damit anfangen kann.
  • Struktur, auch wenn's voll wird: Du arbeitest eigenständig und behältst den Überblick, auch wenn mehrere Teams gleichzeitig etwas von Dir brauchen.
  • Tech-Neugier: Du verstehst Code und schreibst ihn auch selbst (z. B. Python). Idealerweise hast Du schon mit Coding Agents Analysen erstellt oder automatisierte, KI-gestützte Reportings aufgebaut. Das ist kein Muss, aber ein großes Plus.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch

Was Dir gefällt

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements? Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

title: Data Center Architect
descriptionHtml:
Role Profile

Job Title: Data Centre Architect

Reports to: Head of Data Centre Development

Location: UK hybrid

Company Overview:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we’re building this organisation from the ground up. We’re looking for people who’d rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of team you’ve previously managed.

This is a senior individual contributor role with authority to sign off technical schedules, working with cluster and network architects, NVIDIA and other OEM engineers, colocation provider engineering and sales teams, and the internal Procurement, Legal, Finance and Site Operations teams.

What You’ll Do

You will be the single technical authority between our GPU-as-a-service business and the colocation providers that host our NVIDIA clusters. You turn cluster architecture and OEM requirements into a precise, contractable statement of work (SOW) for the data centre white space, then hold the provider to it through design, installation and acceptance.

We are growing from tens of megawatts to hundreds, on rack-scale liquid-cooled platforms at 130 kW per rack and rising to 200 kW and beyond. Mistakes in power, cooling or fibre specification show up as stranded capacity, delayed cluster delivery and disputes, so the role carries real commercial weight.

Key Responsibilities

Technical negotiation with colocation providers

  • Lead technical due diligence on candidate sites: power availability and energisation dates, redundancy topology, liquid-cooling capability, floor loading, rack logistics, fibre and meet-me access.

  • Negotiate the technical schedules of the colocation agreement with commercial and legal: capacity and density commitments, power and cooling SLAs, temperature and flow envelopes, metering, expansion rights, change control and remedies.

  • Challenge provider claims with evidence: single-line diagrams, P&IDs, load-bank and commissioning records, reference customers.

Specification & SOW

  • Work with cluster architects and OEMs (NVIDIA first) to capture rack, power, cooling, network and layout requirements, and keep them current across product generations.

  • Write and own the technical SOW for white-space fitout: containment and cooling interfaces, power distribution to rack, structured cabling and pathways, rack and POD layout, security zoning, labelling and records.

  • Define clear scope boundaries and responsibilities between us, the colocation provider, OEMs and installation contractors, with no gaps and no overlaps.

  • Maintain a requirements baseline with traceability from OEM document, to SOW clause, to acceptance test.

Design, installation & acceptance

  • Review provider and contractor designs, shop drawings and method statements against the SOW; run design reviews and close findings.

  • Define acceptance: factory and site tests, liquid flush and cleanliness, power quality, thermal performance at full load, fibre loss, burn-in, and the evidence pack needed for each gate.

  • Attend key witness tests and sign off, or reject, completion of each phase before hardware is energised.

  • Manage technical change requests and variations, and advise on cost and schedule impact.

Knowledge & standards

  • Build reusable reference designs, SOW templates and a site-scoring framework so each new deployment starts from a proven baseline.

  • Track the roadmap: higher rack densities, 800 VDC distribution, new cooling classes and optics, and tell the business early what it means for sites already contracted.

Deliverables You Own:

  • Site technical assessment: Scored, evidence-based report per candidate site, comparable across providers, with risks and mitigations.

  • Technical schedules to the colocation agreement: Measurable commitments, tested in acceptance, with remedies agreed by legal.

  • Cluster white-space SOW: Complete enough that a contractor can price and build without asking us questions; traceable to OEM requirements.

  • Reference designs and layouts: Rack, row and POD layouts, power and cooling single-line and P&ID level interfaces, fibre pathways and densities.

  • Acceptance test plan and evidence pack: Pass and fail criteria set before work starts; signed results per gate.

  • Requirements baseline and change log: One current version of the truth, with every variation recorded and costed.

  • Risk and issues register: Technical risks to schedule and capacity, with owners and dates.

Working Relationships:

  • Cluster and network architects: You translate their cluster design into facility requirements, and they rely on you to say what a site can and cannot carry.

  • OEMs, mainly NVIDIA: You are the facility-side counterpart; you obtain, interpret and challenge site-requirement documents.

  • Colocation providers: Day-to-day technical counterpart through negotiation, build and acceptance.

  • Procurement, legal and finance: You provide the technical substance of commercial terms and the impact of variations.

  • Site operations and deployment teams: You hand over a clean specification and acceptance evidence, and take back lessons learned.

What You Bring:

  • 8 or more years in data centre design, delivery or technical consulting, including at least 3 years on high-density (50 kW per rack or more) or liquid-cooled deployments.

  • Direct experience writing or reviewing technical specifications and SOWs for white-space fitout, and managing contractors against them to acceptance.

  • Strong working knowledge of data centre power: MV and LV distribution, UPS and generator topologies, redundancy models (N+1, 2N, distributed), busway and rack power, metering and power quality.

  • Strong working knowledge of cooling: direct-to-chip liquid cooling, CDUs, facility and technology loops, warm-water and dry-cooler designs, fluid quality and flushing, leak detection and containment.

  • Working knowledge of structured cabling and pathways for large GPU fabrics (single-mode optics, high fibre counts, InfiniBand and Ethernet physical layers), and of rack and POD layouts.

  • Familiarity with NVIDIA rack-scale platforms (GB200 or GB300 class, or later) and their facility requirements, and the ability to read OEM site-requirement documents critically.

  • Proven ability to run technical negotiations with colocation or construction counterparties, and to explain trade-offs to commercial, legal and executive audiences.

  • Command of standards such as EN 50600 and the Uptime Tier framework, ASHRAE TC 9.9 liquid-cooling guidance, and commissioning practice (levels 1 to 5).

  • Excellent written communication: you produce clear, unambiguous contract-grade documents.

Preferred Skills (Nice to Have):

  • Experience at a hyperscaler, neocloud or colocation provider on the operator or customer side.

  • Experience with 800 VDC or other DC distribution, large battery storage, or power smoothing for AI load swings.

  • Chartered engineer status or equivalent; recognised data centre credentials (for example CDCP, CDFOM, Uptime ATD or AOS).

  • Familiarity with BIM, digital-twin tools and requirements-management tools.

  • Willingness to travel up to 30% to sites in the UK, Europe and the US.

Success Measures:

  • First 90 days: Audit current colocation contracts and SOWs and list technical gaps; publish a requirements baseline for the current NVIDIA platform; take over technical lead on one live negotiation; agree the site-scoring framework with the cluster architects.

  • 6 months: One complete SOW issued and priced with no material scope disputes; acceptance plan agreed with the provider before build starts; reusable SOW template adopted by the team.

  • 12 months: Every new site contracted on the template with traceable requirements; clusters accepted on schedule with no facility-caused performance issues; fewer late variations and a measurable cut in time from site shortlist to signed technical schedule.

Qualities we look for:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up.

  • Inspire the change: There’s no blueprint for the future. You’ll embrace challenges and change.

  • You’re real and you’re true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you’ll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you’re talking to, you treat everyone the same.

  • Get stuck in: You’d rather be building than overseeing. Our strategy will keep evolving, and so will you — attitude and adaptability matter more to us than a fixed playbook or a big team behind you.

Package & Process:

  • Employment type: Full-time, permanent.

  • Travel: Up to 30%.

  • Interview process:

    Talent Screening >Hiring Manager Screen > Technical Interview > Final with the Head of Data Centre Development.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all backgrounds.

title: Data Center Operations Implementation Manager
descriptionHtml:
Role Overview

We are seeking a Data Center Operations Implementation Manager to own the end-to-end Day 0 to Day 2 transition of Nscale's data centres — spanning construction, fit-out, and live, steady-state local operations — across an assigned region and set of sites. Rather than owning construction execution itself, you'll be the connective tissue between Construction, Network Engineering, Compute/Infrastructure Deployment, and local Operations teams — driving a structured, well-documented transition so every site goes live on schedule and ready to support production workloads. This is an individual-contributor role built on strong stakeholder management, cross-functional influence, and travel to sites during critical transition windows.

What You'll Do

Day 0 to Day 2 Transition Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end Day 0 to Day 2 transition process for each data centre site within your assigned region — spanning construction, fit-out, and steady-state operations.
  • Define and maintain a standardized transition framework and readiness checklist applied consistently across your assigned sites.
  • Track and drive closure of cross-team action items, dependencies, and blockers standing between construction handover and operational go-live.
  • Identify and escalate risks to go-live timelines, and drive resolution across the relevant stakeholder groups.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Track progress and status across Construction, Network Engineering, Compute/Infrastructure Deployment, Facility Engineering, SDM, and local site Operations teams throughout the transition window.
  • Partner with Construction teams to track handover status, outstanding items, and site readiness milestones.
  • Track Network Engineering's buildout, testing, and cutover activities required for a site to go live.
  • Track hardware intake, rack-and-stack, and deployment scheduling with Compute/Infrastructure Deployment teams to stay aligned with the transition timeline.
  • Coordinate with Facility Engineering on site systems and infrastructure readiness ahead of transition.
  • Engage with the Service Delivery Management (SDM) team to ensure alignment with customer needs, SLAs, security, and facility performance.
  • Take part in regular cross-functional syncs and stakeholder reviews to stay current on transition status.
  • Contribute to a shared sense of ownership and accountability across stakeholder teams, even without formal authority over them.

Local Day Two Operations Readiness

  • Partner with local Operations leads to confirm staffing, training, tooling, and support processes are in place before a site transitions to Day 2 ownership.
  • Create and validate standard operating procedures (SOPs) and operational processes required for local Operations teams to run the site post-handover.
  • Create the operational site tool bill of materials (BOM) required for local Operations teams to maintain the site post-handover.
  • Verify the spare parts bill of materials (BOM) is complete and in place ahead of Day 2 handover.
  • Facilitate structured knowledge transfer and handover documentation from Construction, Network, and Compute teams to local Operations teams.
  • Confirm monitoring, ticketing, and ITSM processes are validated and operating before a site is handed to local Operations.
  • Act as an escalation point for local Operations teams during the early post-handover period to smooth the transition.

Reliability, Safety & Compliance

  • Define and enforce Day 2 readiness criteria that a site must meet before transitioning to local Operations ownership.
  • Facilitate root-cause analysis for transition delays or gaps surfaced during handover, and drive remediation across teams.
  • Ensure health, safety, and environmental requirements are validated and documented as part of readiness sign-off.
  • Support certification and audit readiness (ISO 27001, ISO 22237, SOC 2, Cyber Essentials Plus, ISO 22301) ahead of go-live.

Vendor & Supplier Coordination

  • Coordinate with construction contractors and colocation providers as needed to close out remaining items affecting the transition timeline.
  • Track vendor commitments and SLAs relevant to the transition window, and escalate delays that put go-live at risk.
  • Coordinate with the Supply Chain team to align hardware intake and staging with the transition schedule.

Monitoring, Reporting & Analytics

  • Track KPIs and KRIs for the Day 0 to Day 2 transition process (time to transition, readiness checklist completion rate, post-handover incident rate, etc.).
  • Build and maintain dashboards that track transition status across your assigned site pipeline for all stakeholder teams.
  • Produce regular reports for senior leadership on transition status, risks, and blockers.
  • Use data-driven insights to identify systemic bottlenecks in the Day 0 to Day 2 process and drive continuous improvement.

About You

Experience & Background

  • 3-8 years of experience in data centre operations, program/project management, or infrastructure deployment at scale.
  • Proven track record coordinating the transition of new sites into live operations across construction, network, compute, and operations functions.
  • Experience operating in a matrixed environment, influencing outcomes without direct authority over every stakeholder team.
  • Demonstrated success managing multiple concurrent site transitions in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Background in hyperscale, cloud, or HPC data centre environments (preferred).

Technical Knowledge & Expertise

  • Working knowledge of data centre power, cooling, networking, and compute infrastructure, sufficient to coordinate effectively across specialist teams.
  • Familiarity with network deployment and cutover processes, and compute/hardware deployment lifecycles.
  • Knowledge of Layer 1 network infrastructure, including fiber, copper, optics, and transceivers.
  • Familiarity with ITSM tooling, ticketing systems, and monitoring platforms used by local Operations teams.

Influence & Communication

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align Construction, Network, Compute, and Operations teams without direct authority.
  • Excellent cross-functional communication skills, able to translate technical detail between teams with different priorities and vocabularies.
  • Program management discipline, with the ability to track and drive multiple concurrent workstreams to closure.

We’re looking for a Director, Marketing Analytics & Intelligence to lead analytics and marketing intelligence across a major European automotive account.

This isn’t a traditional technical Data Director position. We’re looking for someone who understands how data, analytics and measurement can help senior marketing leaders make better decisions  and who can turn complex information into a clear strategic and commercial point of view.

You’ll work closely with senior stakeholders across European markets, helping them understand marketing and customer performance, identify opportunities for growth and make more informed decisions through data and insight.

title: Data Engineer (Detect & Track Distillation)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our ML teams train models on datasets derived from large volumes of raw, unstructured data. Model quality depends directly on data quality, and today that data is handled largely by hand.

As a Data Engineer, operating out of Paris, Lausanne, or Zurich, you will own the data layer that feeds the team's models, from raw field logs or public datasets through curated, versioned, training-ready datasets. You will manage terabytes of raw, unstructured data and turn it into clean, documented, versioned datasets, so that the modelers spend their time designing and training models, not waiting on data loaders or wrangling corrupted files. You join at an early stage with real influence over how field and public data gets processed for deep-learning pipelines.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ingestion Pipeline: Ingest, decode, and store raw, unstructured field data (video and other sensor streams) from field logs into efficient, controlled formats.

  • Multimodal Alignment: Align multiple data streams temporally and spatially so paired data is usable for training.

  • Curation: Transfer both ingested data and public datasets into high-value data, including parsing, filtering, de-duplication and revision.

  • Data & Labeling Requirements: Define which data to gather and what and how to label it, and own the dataset-construction workflow and labeling tooling. Coordinate with the teams responsible for data gathering and labeling.

  • Dataset Construction: Build task-specific datasets for the team’s training and evaluation needs, in collaboration with acquisition, annotation and product teams.

  • Versioning & Lineage: Version datasets and maintain lineage so training runs stay reproducible.

  • Storage & Formats: Store data in efficient, training-ready formats (such as columnar or sharded formats) and manage storage tiering to balance cost and latency as datasets grow.

  • Efficient Delivery: Deliver clean, documented datasets and the corresponding tools for loading to keep training from being I/O-bound, shaping their structure with the modelers.

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

  • Educational Background: A degree in a STEM field, or equivalent practical experience. Practical data engineering experience matters more than the specific degree.

  • Data Pipelines at Scale: Built and maintained pipelines for unstructured data at scale (video, images, or sensor data), covering ingestion, decode, storage, curation, and versioning.

  • Engineering: Strong in Python and data engineering, and comfortable optimizing data loaders for common training frameworks (for example PyTorch).

  • Bonus: Multimodal sensor data, labeling or dataset construction for ML, dataset versioning tooling, and distributed data processing tooling.

  • Attributes: Systematic, quality-minded, pragmatic, and service-oriented so the modelers are enabled, with a knack for taming messy data via automation.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

  • Lead and be responsible for the consolidation of additional data sources — including support tickets, audit logs, CRM, and other customer-facing systems — while defining the feasibility, effort, cost, and implementation approach required to support a future unified data platform.

  • Act as a credible point of contact for CoreView's Databricks estate
  • Bring automation and AI-assisted tooling into the day-to-day work — for example automated monitoring and anomaly detection on metric movements — as the platform matures.

Job Requirements

  • 3 to 5 years' professional experience building and operating production data pipelines (ETL/ELT) in a commercial setting.

Preferred skills:

title: Data Engineering & Analytics Manager
descriptionHtml:
Insurance is a numbers business, and most of those numbers are harder to trust than they look. You would lead the team that defines the numbers Insify runs on, from the event a customer fires on our website to the report a risk carrier audits months later.


About the Role

You would lead our Data & Analytics team of 3-4 engineers end to end: ingestion, the warehouse and its models, the metric layer, and the analysis and reporting built on top of it. It is a small team with a big surface, so there is nowhere to hide and nothing you can't reach.

We are deliberately not splitting data engineering from analytics. At our size the hard problems sit in the handover between the two, and we want one person who enjoys that whole puzzle.

The team serves four groups with genuinely different needs. Growth wants hourly to daily signals and can live with approximately right. Carrier reporting and corporate finance are calendar-locked and need numbers that reconcile and survive an audit months later. Actuarial needs depth and lineage over speed. Prioritising here is arbitration between things that fail in different ways, and the arbitration is yours.

It's a hands-on role. You can open the warehouse and read the models, you review a new data model before it ships, and your team trusts your technical judgement because you still use it. The job is still the team: its own game, its communication, and each person in it. When something slips, hands-on work is the first thing that yields.


What you'll be doing
  • Leading a team of 3-4 data engineers and analysts end to end: what it builds, how it runs in production, and who you hire and grow to get there
  • Running discovery with the teams we serve: understanding what they need from data, and bringing the platform and datasets that enable them
  • Owning the trade-offs between Growth, carrier reporting, finance and actuarial: deciding what the team works on, driving alignment with key partners across other teams, and saying no when the answer is no
  • Making the platform scale: a new country, carrier or product should mean configuration and reused models, and recurring manual work, like carrier reporting and cash reconciliation, should turn into automation
  • Bringing engineering excellence to how the team works: data contracts with product teams, testing in CI, alerts that get resolved, a way to try changes before they hit production
  • Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. We encourage each other to act this way, so you can expect the same from others

    • What you'll need
  • You've managed or led a data team before, including hiring, feedback and growing people. It doesn't have to be for long, but it has to be real and you have to want more of it
  • Depth on one side of the data stack and working fluency on the other. You still love shipping, you review your team's work, and they trust your judgement on it
  • A track record of shaping what gets built, not only how: you've turned business problems into data priorities, cut scope, and can show the decisions that followed
  • Ownership & impact instinct - when needed you go beyond your team's boundaries to get to results
  • You get real leverage out of AI in your daily work, and you can say where it helped, and where it hurt. Your team gets that from you: you try new tools and ways of working first, and bring the ones that stick

    • Nice to have
  • Experience with reporting that has to reconcile: bordereaux, revenue, cash, ledger
  • Experience building B2B products, especially in insurance & fintech
  • Experience working on a product distributed across different country markets
  • Experience with Databricks, dbt and event tracking (Snowplow or similar)

    • Our stack

    Databricks with Unity Catalog, dbt with SQL-based transformation, running on AWS.

    None of this is a hard requirement, and you don't need to know all of our stack. We care more about how you reason about data, systems and teams than which tools you have used. Strong on most of it? Apply.


    How we hire
    Five conversations, each with a clear purpose, and you hear where you stand after every one:
    1. Leadership. We look at your experience with performance management, personal development and building teams.
    2. Data Model Review. You review a change to our warehouse models with two of our engineers.
    3. Data Platform Design. A modelling and platform problem close to what we deal with.
    4. Values Interview. We look at your approach to work, and how it adds to our Values.
    5. Meet the Founder.
    You get the outcome within three days of your last round, with specific feedback either way.
    We offer
  • Competitive compensation. We offer a salary in the range of 85k-110k EUR plus performance-based equity grants
  • Hybrid. 3 days in the office, 2 from home, up to 4 weeks a year from abroad, 25 holiday days
  • Pension. 6% employer contribution
  • Wellbeing budget. €50 net a month via Epassi, from the gym to takeaway, rolls over
  • Learning and coaching. Internal leadership programs and coaching
  • Central Amsterdam office. Shared lunches, dogs, Friday drinks, high-spec MacBook Pro

    • About Insify

    Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

    We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader.

    Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve.
