title: Digitale Lohnbuchhaltung (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
SKALAR – Wir bauen die Steuerkanzlei der Zukunft

Radikal einfach. Voll digital. 100% mandantenfokussiert.

Wir denken Steuerberatung komplett neu: einfacher, schneller und transparenter für Mandanten und Kanzleiteam zugleich.

Wo andere Kanzleien mit manuellen Prozessen, langen Wartezeiten und intransparenter Kommunikation kämpfen, bauen wir ein völlig neues Erlebnis - digital, proaktiv, KI-gestützt. Mit automatisierten Prozessen im Hintergrund und digitalen Schnittstellen zum Mandanten laufen repetitive Aufgaben weitgehend von selbst - damit du Zeit hast für das, was wirklich zählt: anspruchsvolle Beratung, Sonderfälle und strategische Mandantenfragen.

Der Unterschied zu anderen "Digitalkanzleien": Über die Hälfte unseres Teams sind Softwareentwickler. Du gestaltest direkt mit, was sie bauen - und damit, wie KI-gestützte Steuerberatung in dieser Branche überhaupt aussehen wird. Dein Steuerwissen prägt das Produkt, nicht nur dessen Anwendung.

Wir sind ein erfahrenes Gründerteam aus Steuerberatern, Digital-Unternehmern und Softwareentwicklern mit einem Exit-Track-Record von 140 Mio. €. Mit dir gemeinsam möchten wir eine der führenden Kanzleien Deutschlands aufbauen.

Aufgaben

  • Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung: Du verantwortest die monatliche Entgeltabrechnung deiner Mandanten in DATEV Lohn und Gehalt – unterstützt durch KI- und Automatisierungstools, die Routine minimieren und Tiefe ermöglichen.

  • Meldewesen & Compliance: SV-Meldungen, Lohnsteueranmeldungen, Beitragsnachweise, Bescheinigungswesen sowie die Kommunikation mit Finanzämtern, Krankenkassen und Behörden – termingerecht und prüfungssicher.

  • Mandantenbetreuung: Du richtest neue Mandanten ein, begleitest sie langfristig und bist erste/r Ansprechpartner/in für lohnsteuer- und sozialversicherungsrechtliche Fragen.

  • Sonderfälle & Beratung: Bearbeitung komplexer Sachverhalte – von betrieblicher Altersvorsorge über Sachbezüge und Pfändungen bis zu Kurzarbeit und neuen regulatorischen Anforderungen (z. B. Mindestlohn, korrekte Lohnsteuerberechnung).

  • Entwicklung neuer Beratungsleistungen: Du bestimmst mit, welche KI-gestützten Leistungen wir rund um Lohn und Personal entwickeln. Dein Lohn-Wissen + die Unterstützung durch unsere Softwareentwickler = Services, die klassische Kanzleien nicht anbieten können.

  • Prozess- & Qualitätssicherung: Du gestaltest unsere Lohnprozesse aktiv mit – von der Mandanten-Schnittstelle über die Datenübernahme bis zur Lohnauswertung – und sorgst für gleichbleibend hohe Qualität.

Qualifikationen

  • Fachliche Basis: Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellte/r, Lohnbuchhalter/in, Fachassistent/in Lohn und Gehalt oder vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • Lohn-Praxis: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Entgeltabrechnung, sicher in Lohnsteuer- und Sozialversicherungsrecht. Sicherer Umgang mit DATEV LODAS oder Lohn und Gehalt.

  • Mandantenkompetenz: Empathische und klare Kommunikation mit Mandanten und deren Mitarbeitenden – auch bei komplexeren Themen.

  • Sorgfalt & Termintreue: Der Lohn muss stimmen. Du arbeitest präzise, strukturiert und zuverlässig – auch unter Druck.

  • Unternehmerisches Mindset: Du willst direkt mitgestalten, wie KI-gestützte Lohnbuchhaltung aussieht – und mit Softwareentwicklern bauen, was es so noch nicht gibt.

  • Tech-Begeisterung: Du probierst neue Lösungen aktiv aus und siehst Technologie als Hebel – nicht als Bedrohung.

Benefits

  • 🧠 Du baust mit, was Steuerberatung morgen ist - KI-gestützte Beratungsformate, die es so noch nicht gibt. Du entscheidest mit, wie Top-Beratung in der Zukunft aussieht

  • 🤝 Steile Lernkurve mit Gründern und Tech-Team - Direkte Zusammenarbeit im Alltag, gegenseitiges Sparring auf Augenhöhe

  • 🚀 Volle Verantwortung ab Tag 1 - Eigene Mandate, Leistungsportfolio, Wachstumsstrategie - du gestaltest mit

  • 🛠️ Modernes Tech-Setup — Digitale Prozesse, KI-gestützte Tools, klare Strukturen

  • 💰 Kompetitives Gehaltspaket

  • 🏠 Hybrides Arbeiten - Homeoffice und Büro flexibel kombinieren

  • 📍 Büro im Herzen Münchens, top angebunden

  • 🎁 3.000 € p.a. Benefitsprogramm + Firmenhandy

 

Bereit, Steuerberatung neu zu definieren?

Werde Teil von Skalar — und gestalte mit uns das modernste Mandantenerlebnis Deutschlands.

title: Direct Asset Finance Specialist
descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Allica exists for the half a million or so established SMEs with typically 5 to 100 employees. These SMEs are a crucial pillar of the UK’s prosperity - representing more than a quarter of all turnover and jobs - yet are increasingly neglected by traditional high street banks.

Our Distribution team at Allica have grown rapidly over the last 4 years since the acquisition of the AIB GB UK SME customer portfolio, expanding to give a Relationship Manager presence for established SMEs all across the UK. They are responsible for the development and execution of the commercial strategy for the bank, generating profitable opportunities from supporting our customers.

Our vision is to reimagine Relationship Banking for established SMEs, through the very best people and digital tools. We don’t pretend to have all the answers yet, and you will play a role in shaping our new offering. The direct asset finance team are early in their journey but are growing all the time, the successful candidate will be as excited as we are to continue building and expanding this offering for established SMEs.

Role Description

Reporting to the Senior Manager, this role will support the delivery of Allica’s Asset Finance product direct to customers. You will deliver a professional relationship management service to customers by providing an exemplary level of customer service to assist in maximising value to Allica, and customers.

You will be the first point of contact for all inbound Asset Finance enquiries and will work closely with a team of locally based Relationship Managers to ensure that all customers receive exemplary service. You will be an expert on all things Allica Bank Asset Finance, feeding back to product teams on how we can improve from customer insights, and making sure that the Relationship Teams are fully up to speed on the latest offerings.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Building and relationship managing a portfolio of Asset Finance customers, driving income in line with monthly, quarterly and annual targets.

  • Handling inbound calls and resolve issues for existing customers.

  • Building and developing your own network of customers, there is an expectation for you to also originate business for the bank yourself through cold out reach and regular networking in your patch.

  • Provide cover and support on Asset Finance to Relationship Managers via telephone and email

  • Roll out targeted marketing campaigns and management of new to bank prospects via telephone and email.

  • Owning the customer service provided to ensure an excellent customer service at all times for all customers, potential customers and professional counterparties.

  • Reporting of Key Business Indicators

  • Identifying Early Warning Indicators and following the correct internal process to manage these.

  • Managing conversations with Credit and appropriate management of customer relationship.

  • Work closely with and collaboratively with all areas of Allica to drive the effective delivery of the Bank’s annual lending budget and ensure a seamless and professional service is always provided.

  • Establishing and actively managing objectives and a personal development plan.

  • Ensuring your personal conduct and Treating Customers Fairly (TCF) is front and centre in everything that you do.

  • Through a marketing plan, develop and maintain effective relationships with key business Introducers and professional networks

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills together with evidence of proven career progression gained in business development within the Asset Finance market

  • Proven Introducer (non-broker) relationships and relationship management skills

  • Knowledge of Asset Finance products and SME businesses

  • Ability to structure new Asset Finance lending proposals and write credit applications

  • Ability to analyse and review financial accounts and associated information

  • Knowledge and understanding of CRM

  • Excellent time management and organisation skills to manage multiple workstreams at once.

  • A curious mind, we want colleagues who are keen to find ways to improve and develop our offering through their own experience and regular customer feedback.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

title: Directeur de projets - CDI
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un poste stimulant dans une entreprise à impact en plein développement ? Nous sommes l’entreprise qu’il vous faut ! Vestack est une Proptech qui conçoit et construit des bâtiments hors-site bas-carbone, à ossature bois. Dans le cadre de son développement rapide, nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) Directeur de projets en CDI.

Vos missions

  • Vous pilotez la relation avec le client ainsi que le suivi financier et juridique des projets,

  • En vous appuyant sur les chargés d’études, vous supervisez la conception des projets, de la phase Esquisse à la phase PRO/DCE, en animant les parties prenantes internes (notamment bureau d’études, approvisionnements et industrialisation), et externes (maîtrise d’ouvrage privées et publiques, architectes, bureaux d’études externes, sous-traitants).

  • Vous suivez et réceptionnez la production des modules en usine conformément à la conception élaborée en amont.

  • En vous appuyant sur les ingénieurs travaux, vous supervisez la logistique des modules (transport et levage) ainsi que la bonne réalisation des travaux de préparation (fondations) et de finitions par les sous-traitants en phase chantier.

  • Par ailleurs, vous contribuez à l’amélioration continue de nos processus, ainsi qu’au développement et à l’animation des relations de Vestack avec ses partenaires (entreprises générales de construction notamment).

Les projets à l’étude vont du logement aux bureaux, en passant par de la résidence étudiante, où vous représentez Vestack en tant que contractant général, entreprise générale ou co-traitant, en fonction des projets.

  • 5 années d'expérience minimum acquises en entreprise de construction, bureau d’études ou en promotion immobilière (composante conception / travaux).

  • Avoir été confronté à des environnements dynamiques, demandant prise d’initiative et autonomie, notamment sur des chantiers de construction tous corps d’état.

  • La curiosité, la rigueur et l’autonomie sont nécessaires pour réussir les nombreux challenges et vous permettre de trouver des solutions structurantes.

  • Excellentes capacités organisationnelles dans la conduite des processus et le suivi de projet.

  • Excellent relationnel et adaptabilité à différents types de parties prenantes (équipes terrains, architectes, équipe de direction).

Avantages

  • Rémunération dans l'annonce + variable (prime sur objectif à définir)

  • Télétravail : 1 journée par semaine ou 1 semaine par mois

  • Tickets restaurant 10 € (60% pris en charge par l'employeur)

  • Mutuelle 50 % prise en charge par l'employeur

  • Locaux confortables

  • Une équipe soudée, solidaire et disponible

  • Un point mensuel qui offre un moment de convivialité à l’ensemble des équipes

Rejoignez Vestack en tant que Directeur de projets CDI et transformez l'avenir du bâtiment avec nos solutions innovantes, rapides et écologiques. Participez à des projets qui changent la donne.

title: Directeur des opérations Datacenter (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
Head of DC Operations (H/F)

Région parisienne

Votre mission

Dans un environnement où la disponibilité et la fiabilité des infrastructures sont essentielles, Isatalent recherche un(e) Head of DC Operations pour piloter les opérations de ses data centers en région parisienne.

Rattaché(e) à la direction, vous êtes garant(e) de la performance opérationnelle, de la continuité de service et de la fiabilité des infrastructures. Vous encadrez les responsables de site et travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'expertise centrales, les clients et les partenaires de maintenance.

Dans un contexte de croissance de l'entreprise et d'exigences opérationnelles, vous jouez un rôle clé dans l'harmonisation des pratiques, la structuration du pilotage des activités et l'accompagnement du changement auprès des équipes.

Votre objectif : construire une vision opérationnelle consolidée, maîtriser les risques et fédérer les équipes autour d'exigences communes de performance, de sécurité et de qualité de service.

Vos responsabilités

Piloter la stratégie et la performance des opérations multisites

  • Élaborer une feuille de route opérationnelle à court et moyen terme, en définissant les priorités, les plans d'action et les ressources humaines et financières nécessaires.

  • Définir et harmoniser les méthodes de pilotage des activités opérationnelles sur l'ensemble des sites.

  • Consolider et faire évoluer les KPI et tableaux de bord portant notamment sur la disponibilité des infrastructures, la maintenance, la communication client et le respect des procédures.

  • Analyser les résultats, identifier les écarts de performance et piloter les actions correctives.

  • Produire un reporting structuré à destination de la direction et éclairer les décisions stratégiques.

Manager les responsables de site et accompagner la transformation

  • Encadrer et accompagner les responsables de site dans le pilotage de leurs activités et le développement de leurs compétences.

  • Apporter une expertise opérationnelle et technique permettant de challenger les choix, les priorités et les plans d'action.

  • Favoriser l'autonomie, la responsabilisation et la coopération des équipes.

  • Organiser l'allocation des ressources et le suivi des plans de charge.

  • Accompagner la réorganisation du périmètre, harmoniser les pratiques et contribuer à l'intégration de nouveaux sites.

  • Travailler en transversalité avec le responsable du pôle Expertise et les autres fonctions de l'entreprise.

Garantir la fiabilité des infrastructures et maîtriser les risques

  • Garantir la disponibilité, la résilience et la continuité d'exploitation des infrastructures critiques.

  • Superviser la maintenance préventive, corrective et réglementaire, ainsi que les travaux, extensions, rétrofits et changements réalisés en environnement exploité.

  • Reprendre et consolider la cartographie des risques opérationnels et techniques, notamment les points uniques de défaillance (SPOF) et les obsolescences critiques.

  • Hiérarchiser les risques, définir les plans de traitement, en évaluer les impacts financiers et humains et identifier les investissements nécessaires.

  • Piloter les incidents majeurs, les escalades, les analyses de causes et le suivi des actions correctives et préventives.

  • Garantir le respect des exigences de sécurité, de conformité et de continuité de service.

Développer la relation client et le partenariat avec les mainteneurs

  • Garantir le respect des engagements contractuels, des SLA et des standards de qualité attendus par les clients.

  • Renforcer la qualité de la communication opérationnelle et la confiance avec les interlocuteurs clients.

  • Développer une relation constructive et partenariale avec les mainteneurs et les prestataires.

  • Améliorer la coordination des interventions, le suivi des engagements et la qualité des prestations.

  • Identifier les axes de progrès et piloter les actions d'amélioration de la performance des partenaires.

Piloter les budgets et l'amélioration continue

  • Élaborer et suivre les budgets OPEX et CAPEX du périmètre.

  • Arbitrer les priorités de maintenance, de renouvellement et d'investissement en fonction des risques, des capacités et des engagements clients.

  • Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires, environnementales, HSE, ICPE et des référentiels ISO applicables.

  • Déployer des standards, procédures et méthodes de travail homogènes.

  • Contribuer à l'amélioration de la performance énergétique des installations, notamment du PUE, et à la maîtrise des coûts d'exploitation.

Votre profil

Formation et expérience

  • Formation supérieure, idéalement Bac +5, de type ingénieur ou master spécialisé en génie électrique, énergétique, climatique, maintenance industrielle ou management des opérations. Un Bac +3 technique pourra être étudié au regard d'une expérience particulièrement solide.

  • Expérience significative dans l'exploitation, la maintenance ou la direction technique d'infrastructures critiques.

  • Expérience significative en management de managers, en pilotage multisite ou dans une fonction de responsabilité opérationnelle comparable.

  • Expérience confirmée dans un environnement critique fonctionnant 24h/24 et 7j/7, avec de fortes exigences de disponibilité, de sécurité et de conformité.

  • Expérience en gestion d'incidents majeurs, pilotage de budgets, gestion des risques et conduite de transformations opérationnelles.

Compétences techniques

  • Bonne maîtrise des enjeux d'exploitation des data centers et compréhension des architectures électriques, mécaniques, CVC, de protection incendie, de GTB/BMS et des systèmes de contrôle.

  • Maîtrise du pilotage de la maintenance préventive, corrective et réglementaire.

  • Connaissance des SLA, KPI de disponibilité, capacité, qualité de service et performance énergétique.

  • Capacité à analyser et challenger les risques techniques, les plans de maintenance et les investissements.

  • Maîtrise des enjeux budgétaires OPEX/CAPEX et des exigences réglementaires applicables.

Qualités personnelles

  • Leadership et capacité à manager des responsables expérimentés.

  • Crédibilité technique et sens des responsabilités.

  • Capacité à structurer une organisation, harmoniser les pratiques et conduire le changement.

  • Aptitude à fédérer les équipes et à développer la coopération transverse.

  • Capacité de décision, d'arbitrage et de priorisation.

  • Sang-froid en situation de crise, rigueur et orientation résultats.

  • Sens du client et capacité à construire des relations de partenariat durables.

Langues : français courant et anglais professionnel, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.

Les enjeux de réussite

Au cours des premiers mois, vous aurez notamment pour objectifs de construire une feuille de route opérationnelle claire, de consolider le pilotage par les indicateurs, de hiérarchiser les risques et de définir les moyens nécessaires à leur traitement.

Vous contribuerez également à renforcer la cohésion managériale, à harmoniser les pratiques entre les sites et à accompagner l'évolution de l'organisation dans une logique durable de performance et d'amélioration continue.

Vous souhaitez mettre votre expertise des infrastructures critiques au service d'un environnement exigeant, avec une forte dimension managériale, stratégique et transverse ?

title: Director Account Management (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Aufgaben

Als Director Account Management (all genders) übernimmst Du die Gesamtverantwortung für unseren Bereich der Bestandspartner. Dieser Bereich erwirtschaftet mehr als die Hälfte des Unternehmensumsatzes. Du berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung und führst ein Team von bis zu acht Mitarbeitenden. Neben der Steuerung und Entwicklung des Teams treibst Du diesen Bereich erfolgreich in Richtung eines skalierbaren Plattformgeschäfts weiter.

  • Dein Kerngeschäft – Partnerbeziehungen: Du verantwortest mit Deinem Team die Beziehung zu unseren bestehenden Fachpartnern (SEM). Dazu gehören Bindung, Zufriedenheit, Umsatzentwicklung und der Ausbau der Partnerschaften. Der Bereich gliedert sich in zwei Segmente:
    • Kleinstpartner: Entwicklung automatisierter Prozesse, die eine effiziente Zusammenarbeit ohne großen individuellen Betreuungsaufwand ermöglichen.
    • Mittlere Partner: Automatisierung und Skalierung in Kombination mit persönlicher Betreuung.
  • Du bist Sparringspartner für andere Abteilungen und unterstützt crossfunktionale Projekte zu neuen Produkten oder Prozessen. Auf Basis Deiner Kundenerfahrung gibst Du Impulse dazu, wie sich unsere Plattform für Fachfirmen weiterentwickeln kann.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Geschäftsführung zusammen und nimmst dadurch Einfluss auf unser Kerngeschäft sowie auf Innovationsthemen bei Aroundhome.
  • Du erstellst aussagekräftige Reportings, analysierst Erfolgskennzahlen von Partner:innen und Mitarbeiter:innen und leitest daraus eigenständig zielgerichtete Maßnahmen ab.
  • Du führst ein achtköpfiges Team fachlich sowie disziplinarisch auf Basis klarer KPIs und entwickelst das Team zu Top-Performern weiter.
  • Du lebst unsere Werte aktiv vor und vertrittst Aroundhome überzeugend – sowohl intern gegenüber dem Team als auch extern im Markt.

Anforderungen

  • Du bringst ein abgeschlossenes Studium sowie mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Betreuung von Kunden und in der strategischen und operativen Führung eines Account-Management-Teams mit, idealerweise im digitalen Umfeld / Plattform-Business.
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Vertriebsstrategien, KPIs, CRM, Pipeline-Management und Reportings.
  • Du weißt, wie man Mitarbeiter:innen durch gezielte Coachings und Workshops effizient ausbildet und weiterentwickelt.

title: Director, Account Management & Sales Development – Mirakl Connect
descriptionHtml:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success
  • Connect | Paris | Full-time  

    1. The Team You'll Join

    You'll be part of our Mirakl Connect EMEA team, led by Jane Barge, VP Mirakl Connect EMEA. The team consists of up to 5 Account Managers and Business Developers covering the EMEA region. Together, you'll be scaling AI-driven revenue growth for Mirakl Connect across retention, expansion, and pipeline generation.  

    2. Your Impact

    • Lead, coach, and develop the Account Management team to drive upsell, renewals, and churn reduction targets, while personally acting as executive sponsor for a select portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts.
    • Define and execute the growth strategy across the customer base, covering upsell, cross-sell, renewals, and churn prevention from highly automated mid-market motions to high-touch enterprise relationships.
    • Own top-of-funnel pipeline generation by leading the BDR team, with targets aligned across the Sales Director, enterprise Account Executives, and Marketing.
    • Drive the adoption of AI and automation across customer touchpoints, renewals, expansion triggers, and prospecting, working closely with Product, Ops, and agent builders to test, measure, and scale what works.
    • Champion the voice of the customer by translating insights into product feedback that shapes the Mirakl Connect roadmap, while building a team culture grounded in ownership, experimentation, and results.
     

    3. What You'll Bring to the Role

    Experience:
    • 8+ years in B2B SaaS, including at least 4 years leading Account Management, Customer Success, or Sales Development teams in a fast-growing environment
    • Proven track record of driving MRR/ARR growth through renewals, upsell, and churn reduction across mid-market and enterprise customer segments
    • Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with C-level stakeholders at large brands or retailers
    • Experience managing BDR/SDR teams is a plus, as is a background in e-commerce, marketplaces, or retail tech
    Skills:
    • Revenue growth and retention strategy
    • Team leadership, hiring, and development
    • Executive stakeholder management
    • AI and automation application in customer-facing teams
    • Data-driven performance management (Salesforce and revenue metrics)
     

    4. Tools Used

    • Salesforce
    • Outreach
    • Gong
    • Google Workspace
    • Dust
    • N8N and other AI automation tools
     

    5. Languages

    • English: Fluent
    • French: Fluent
     

    6. Compensation, Perks & Benefits

    • Pay Range: Competitive; details will be discussed during the recruiter interview
     

    7. Our Hiring Process

    We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match. Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application. This helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.
    1. 30-minute Talent Acquisition screening
    2. 30-minute hiring manager interview with Jane Barge, focused on Succeed Through Expertise
    3. Two 45-minute values-based interviews with carefully selected members of our Connect team
    4. 30 to 45-minute case study in the form of a 90-day plan

#LI-Hybrid

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you’re ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world’s most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

title: Director, Advisory and Risk Consulting
descriptionHtml:
We are now seeking an experienced, commercially minded resilience management expert who can help clients anticipate, withstand and recover from complex disruptions while also building trusted, long-term client relationships. As the Director you will combine deep expertise in resilience, crisis, business continuity and risk management with the ability to manage existing accounts, and identify new opportunities to sell, originate and grow work in the German market. This role requires an individual with strong social skills, executive presence, a “refuse to lose” attitude, and the confidence to advise boards and senior executives, present ideas in a compelling way and translate complex thinking into clear, persuasive and structured client communications.

Business Development

  • Proactively manage accounts, identify prospects, build senior client relationships and generate new business opportunities for Control Risks, with a primary focus on corporate and government accounts throughout Germany.
  • Work closely with your advisory & risk consulting team, account managers, Service Line leaders and the Managing Director in a consultative sales capacity, entering client conversations as a subject matter expert, shaping opportunities and helping to close new work.
  • Own and deepen relationships with new and existing clients, demonstrating commercial persistence, high social intelligence and a “refuse to lose” approach to winning and retaining work.
  • Own and manage a qualified sales pipeline from prospecting and qualification through scoping, proposal development, negotiation and close, with clear accountability for converting opportunities into profitable work.
  • Develop targeted account plans by identifying the right accounts for Control Risks, prioritising growth accounts of relevant size and potential, mapping decision-makers and buyer groups, and pursuing cross-selling opportunities across service lines.
  • Author thought leadership on relevant topics, present at industry and network events, and help build both the Control Risks and personal brands.

Client Delivery

  • Advise clients on complex resilience management, security, crisis, business continuity and enterprise risk challenges, developing practical, sustainable approaches that can be understood and acted on by senior decision-makers.
  • Act as a senior project manager and trusted client adviser for Control Risks’ resilience and risk consulting projects, including assessing, designing, implementing and improving corporate security, resilience and risk management programmes, acting as the primary client contact and managing multidisciplinary delivery teams.
  • Provide clients with expert support and insights on risk strategy, organizational structures, Enterprise Risk, Business Continuity, Crisis, Security, Cyber Risk, Digital Risk or Intelligence Management.
  • Engage credibly with boards, executive committees and senior leadership teams, ensuring that business priorities are reflected in resilience and risk solutions and that recommendations are presented clearly, confidently and persuasively.
  • Collaboratively scope complex and multidimensional resilience projects with clients, using strong relationship-building and social skills to bring in diverse Control Risks teams and position the firm effectively for follow-on work
  • Own the full client delivery lifecycle from diagnostic assessment and solution design through implementation, stakeholder management, quality assurance and executive-level presentation of outcomes.
  • Use delivery work to identify client priorities, unmet needs and follow-on opportunities.
  • Manage engagement resourcing, budgets, margins and invoicing.

Requirements

Essential

  • Significant work experience in a consulting firm.
  • Direct, hands-on experience in selling and scoping consulting projects, including personally leading sales conversations, shaping client needs into project opportunities and converting those opportunities into won work
  • Established network in the relevant industry and market, with a degree of external recognition or profile that enables credible senior-level client engagement and supports business development.
  • Knowledge of best practices in resilience management, risk and security strategy, crisis preparedness, business continuity, organisational structures and executive decision-making under pressure.
  • Demonstrated expertise in resilience management, including risk and resilience programme development, security and crisis management, business continuity and organisational resilience optimisation.
  • Strong understanding of cyber and digital risks and how they intersect with resilience management, crisis preparedness, business continuity and senior-level risk decision-making.
  • Knowledge of data-driven approaches and understanding the impact of AI on resilience
  • Experience advising boards, executive committees and senior executives, including presenting complex recommendations in a compelling and commercially relevant way.
  • Strong presentation skills, with the ability to structure, visualise and communicate strategic thinking clearly and persuasively.
  • Business-level proficiency in German and English language.

Preferred

  • Experience in multiple industries and client operating environments
  • Ability to travel 50+% of the time and on short notice
  • Exceptional written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills, including strong social skills and the ability to build trust quickly with senior clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Ownership, accountability and commercial resilience to drive success both within the team and across Control Risks.
  • The ability to multi-task and balance competing requirements, including client-facing, business development related, and internal matters
  • Committed, enthusiastic and commercially driven, with a “refuse to lose” attitude and a proactive approach to winning client confidence and new work.
  • A high level of integrity, loyalty and discretion
  • Willingness to learn and develop new skills
  • Executive presence, board-level confidence and the ability to present ideas and recommendations in a compelling, visually clear and persuasive way.

Benefits

  • Control Risks offers a competitively positioned compensation and benefits package that is transparent and summarised in the full job offer.
  • We operate a discretionary global bonus scheme that incentivises, and rewards individuals based on company and individual performance.
  • Control Risks supports hybrid working arrangements, wherever possible, that emphasise the value of in-person time together - in the office and with our clients - while continuing to support flexible and remote working.
  • As an equal opportunities employer, we encourage suitably qualified applicants from a wide range of backgrounds to apply and join us and are fully committed to equal treatment, free from discrimination, of all candidates throughout our recruitment process.

If you require any reasonable adjustments to be made in order to participate fully in the interview process, please let us know and we will be happy to accommodate your needs.

  • We provide an excellent range of benefits like private medical cover, a generous pension scheme, life assurance, income protection, plus loads of music industry perks. There’s also time off over winter break

title: Director B2B2C Growth Partnerships
descriptionHtml:
Meet Urban Sports Club

We are among the leading platforms for sports and wellness in Europe, dedicated to inspiring people to live active, healthy lives. With just one membership we offer access to thousands of fitness and wellness experiences across the continent.

But what truly sets us apart? We believe our people are at the heart of everything we do. If you're curious about how we work, what we value and how you might grow with us, explore our Culture Hub & Career Opportunities.

*Big news: Wellhub and Urban Sports Club unite!*Urban Sports Club is now a proud part of Wellhub, creating a global wellbeing ecosystem. Together, we connect 39,000 corporate clients and 97,000 wellness partners across 18 countries, offering millions of people even more ways to stay active and take care of their health.

The opportunity

Urban Sports Club is looking for an experienced and commercially driven Director, B2B2C Growth Partnerships to establish and scale one of our most strategic growth channels across Europe.

In this role, you will define the commercial strategy and operating model for our B2B2C business, enabling Urban Sports Club's membership offering to be seamlessly integrated into partner ecosystems including banks, insurers, retailers, telcos, travel companies, loyalty programmes, marketplaces, and digital platforms.

You will own the end-to-end commercial lifecycle from identifying market opportunities and designing scalable partnership models to sourcing, negotiating, launching, and growing high-impact partnerships that generate sustainable revenue, expand our member base, and strengthen our market presence.

As the leader of this function, you will build and lead a high-performing team while working cross-functionally with Product, Growth, CRM, Brand, Finance, Legal, and Operations to launch and scale strategic partnerships. Together, you will create seamless partner experiences and establish this channel as a core driver of Urban Sports Club's long-term growth.

What you will do

  • You will define and execute the long-term European B2B2C strategy and commercial roadmap to drive sustainable business growth
  • You will build and scale strategic partnerships with leading European brands across sectors like banking, insurance, retail, travel, telecom, and digital platforms
  • You will own overall commercial performance, partnership revenue, profitability, and contributions to New Paying Members (NPM)
  • You will lead complex commercial negotiations, design scalable business models, and foster long-term executive-level partner relationships
  • You will drive the complete partner lifecycle, overseeing onboarding, activation, retention, renewals, and account expansion
  • You will partner cross-functionally with Product, Growth, CRM, Brand, Finance, Legal, and Operations to deliver seamless, scalable partner experiences
  • You will recruit, coach, and develop a high-performing partnerships team, cultivating a culture of ownership, innovation, and commercial excellence

What you will need to succeed

  • You bring 7+ years of leadership experience in strategic partnerships, enterprise sales, commercial strategy, or business development
  • You have a proven track record of sourcing, negotiating, and closing complex, high-value deals with C-level executives and senior decision-makers
  • You possess strong commercial acumen and experience owning revenue targets, deal structuring, pricing strategy, and partnership economics
  • You have successfully scaled partnership businesses, digital ecosystems, marketplaces, or embedded distribution channels
  • You are a strategic, data-driven thinker with a hands-on mindset who can convert analytical insights into new growth opportunities
  • You demonstrate exceptional cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management, with a history of building and coaching high-performing teams
  • You are fluent in English and possess native or near-native German language skills

What's in it for you

  • Free Urban Sports Club L Pro Membership + Friends and Family Discount: Stay active with free membership, plus discounts for friends and family.
  • Flexible Work Model: Enjoy a hybrid work setup, balancing on-site and remote work options to fit your lifestyle.
  • Extended Remote Work Options: Work up to 120 days remotely within the EU, the UK, and Switzerland, including 30 days outside the EU. You'll also have the option to desk-swap at our other European offices.
  • WorkOUT Life Balance: Take advantage of 30 days of paid vacation annually, plus two additional days for volunteering, flexible working hours, and complimentary access to our mental health provider Open Up.
  • Personal Development: Receive an annual budget of €1,000 for professional growth, with regular internal training sessions and weekly German and English language classes.
  • Engaging Team Culture: Participate in regular team and company events along with wellness initiatives that help you stay productive, healthy, and engaged in a hybrid work environment.

Urban Sports Club is committed to providing a friendly, safe, and welcoming environment for everyone who applies for a position or already works with us, regardless of their sports preferences, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, disability, physical appearance, body size, race, age, or religion (or lack thereof).

title: Director Brand Marketing & Community (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Meet Urban Sports Club

We are among the leading platforms for sports and wellness in Europe, dedicated to inspiring people to live active, healthy lives. With just one membership we offer access to thousands of fitness and wellness experiences across the continent.

But what truly sets us apart? We believe our people are at the heart of everything we do. If you're curious about how we work, what we value and how you might grow with us, explore our Culture Hub & Career Opportunities.

*Big news: Wellhub and Urban Sports Club unite!*
Urban Sports Club is now a proud part of Wellhub, creating a global wellbeing ecosystem. Together, we connect 39,000 corporate clients and 97,000 wellness partners across 18 countries, offering millions of people even more ways to stay active and take care of their health.

The opportunity

We look for a visionary Director of Brand & Community to report directly to our CEO. This is an extraordinary opportunity to shape the next chapter of an already immensely strong brand. As we enjoy incredible brand equity and awareness – particularly in our home market of Germany – you won't be starting from zero. Instead, you will inherit a premium, high-performing base to steer our consumer brand into its next major iteration: moving toward a broader, lifestyle and community-driven positioning.

A core focus of this role will be emphasizing the "Club" in Urban Sports Club. We are a community-driven concept, not just a utility app for solo check-ins. In this hybrid role, you will sit firmly on both the strategic/conceptual side and the operational frontlines. You will champion the evolution of the brand to maximize consumer appeal, while simultaneously developing and executing the concrete marketing strategies that bring our community vision to life. Your most exciting challenge? Internationalization – translating our proven local formula into scalable, culturally resonant consumer strategies for diverse international markets.

What you will do

  • Drive Brand Evolution: Architect the long-term conceptual development and narrative of Urban Sports Club, pivoting the brand toward a holistic, community-centric consumer lifestyle identity. You'll define the brand positioning, value propositions, messaging frameworks and audience strategies in collaboration with our Strategy team.
  • Strengthen the "Club": Ensure campaigns and activations reinforce the community aspect of our brand, creating emotional connections that highlight shared experiences and lifestyle rather than just functional access. We see community as driving both new member acquisition as well as member engagement.
  • Balance Strategy & Execution: Own the brand marketing strategy end-to-end, steering its execution across multi-channel campaigns, PR, Content, and Social Media.
  • Lead Internationalization: Translate, adapt, and scale the core brand strategy across international B2C markets, balancing global consistency with deep local cultural relevance.
  • Steer the Creative Studio & Teams: Oversee and mentor our multi-disciplinary brand teams and internal creative studio, fostering innovation, efficiency, and high-impact creative excellence.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the primary strategic brand stakeholder across the organization, collaborating closely with all marketing leaders to align brand priorities with business objectives.
  • Insights & Budget Management: Efficiently manage the global brand budget while monitoring key health metrics (awareness, sentiment, share of voice) to turn consumer insights into optimized campaign performance.

What you will need to succeed

  • 10+ years of experience leading brand management, marketing, or integrated communications, ideally within lifestyle, community or fast-paced B2C consumer industries.
  • Proven track record of developing scalable international brand strategies and managing large-scale, multi-channel campaigns.
  • Strategic & Execution Hybrid Mindset: Ability to alternate seamlessly between high-level conceptual brand building and concrete, hands-on campaign delivery.
  • Community-First Approach: A strong understanding of consumer brand positioning, audience engagement, and culturally relevant storytelling that builds community.
  • Exceptional Leadership: Strong experience leading cross-functional creative teams, PR specialists, and content creators, alongside managing external agencies.
  • Analytical & Financial Rigor: A data-driven approach to tracking brand performance metrics, translating market research into action, and managing complex global budgets.
  • Language Proficiency: Full fluency in English is required; German language skills are a significant plus.

What's in it for you

  • Free Urban Sports Club L Pro Membership + Friends and Family Discount: Stay active with free membership, plus discounts for friends and family.
  • Flexible Work Model: Enjoy a hybrid work setup, balancing on-site and remote work options to fit your lifestyle.
  • Extended Remote Work Options: Work up to 120 days remotely within the EU, the UK, and Switzerland, including 30 days outside the EU. You'll also have the option to desk-swap at our other European offices.
  • WorkOUT Life Balance: Take advantage of 30 days of paid vacation annually, plus two additional days for volunteering, flexible working hours, and complimentary access to our mental health provider Open Up.
  • Personal Development: Receive an annual budget of €1,000 for professional growth, with regular internal training sessions and weekly German and English language classes.
  • Engaging Team Culture: Participate in regular team and company events along with wellness initiatives that help you stay productive, healthy, and engaged in a hybrid work environment.

Urban Sports Club is committed to providing a friendly, safe, and welcoming environment for everyone who applies for a position or already works with us, regardless of their sports preferences, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, disability, physical appearance, body size, race, age, or religion (or lack thereof).

Anduril's Growth organization identifies, shapes, captures, and grows new opportunities for the company.

title: Director, Customer Compensation & Policy
descriptionHtml:
About the Role 

Within Global Customer Experience (GCX), our mission is to advance the HelloFresh customer relationship from reactive resolution to proactive, trust-building service. The compensation function sits at the heart of that mission: it is the mechanism through which the business acknowledges failures, restores customer confidence, and, when done well, turns a bad experience into a reason to stay.

The Associate Director, Customer Compensation & Policy is responsible for the global strategy, architecture, and governance of how HelloFresh compensates customers across all markets and brands. This is not a policy maintenance role. It is a strategic function that sits at the intersection of customer economics, operational data, behavioral experimentation, and cross-functional influence.

You will own one of the most financially material and customer-sensitive levers in the business. You will shape a multi-year roadmap and hold peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market Leadership accountable for the quality of inputs that determine how well and how efficiently we recover customer trust.

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination: analytical rigor sharp enough to architect a global compensation engine from first principles, and the executive presence to drive adoption across a complex, multi-market organization without formal authority over most of the people they need to move.

What You'll Own 

 Global Compensation Strategy & Engine Architecture

  • Own the end-to-end strategic vision for how HelloFresh categorizes customer errors and determines compensation across all markets, brands, and contact channels.
  • Lead the design and continuous evolution of the compensation engine: along with Tech, you’ll define the the rules, thresholds, segmentation logic, and automation frameworks that govern recovery decisions at scale.
  • Define the principles that govern trade-offs between customer generosity and cost discipline and translate those principles into operational rules that hold across market complexity and brand variation.
  • Partner with Technology to ensure the compensation engine is scalable, auditable, and capable of supporting dynamic, AI-assisted decisioning as the product evolves.

Experimentation & Behavioral Economics

  • Set the global roadmap for compensation experimentation: A/B testing across offer types, value levels, channel timing, and segmentation variables.
  • Apply behavioral economics frameworks to compensation design understanding how recovery offers shape long-term retention, repurchase behavior, and brand perception, not just immediate satisfaction.
  • Define the measurement framework for experimentation: what constitutes a successful test, what confidence warrants global rollout, and how results are synthesized into durable policy change.
  • Partner with Analytics & Insights to ensure test design, sample integrity, and rollout analysis meet a rigorous standard of evidence.

Financial Stewardship & Cost Governance

  • Own the global compensation P&L line: tracking spend by market, error category, customer segment, and channel — and holding yourself accountable to defined cost-per-incident and avoidable-contact targets.
  • Identify and close financial leakage: cases where compensation is being issued without policy justification, at incorrect values, or at the wrong frequency.
  • Build the reporting infrastructure that makes compensation economics visible to GCX leadership, market GMs, and Finance — with the granularity and context needed to drive decisions.
  • Define the right balance between cost optimization and customer lifetime value investment: not just 'spend less' but 'spend where it earns back.

Fraud Policy & Global Governance

  • Own the global fraud and abuse prevention framework: the policies, detection logic, thresholds, and escalation paths that protect the business without creating friction for genuine customers.
  • Lead the governance rhythm for policy: quarterly reviews, market exception management, escalation adjudication, and framework versioning across a multi-brand, multi-market environment.
  • Act as the final authority on complex, cross-market policy gaps — resolving ambiguity with speed, consistency, and strategic clarity rather than routing decisions upward by default.
  • Maintain global standards while creating principled space for market-level adaptation where local context genuinely requires it.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Accountability

  • Represent the compensation function in senior forums translating customer economics into requirements that peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market GMs must respond to.
  • Hold cross-functional partners accountable for the upstream data quality, operational accuracy, and system reliability that the compensation engine depends on.
  • Drive adoption of policy changes across markets and brands, building communication and change management plans that make new frameworks land — not just launch.
  • Influence at VP and Director level across multiple functions; escalate only strategic blockers, not routine alignment.

What You'll Bring 

Education

  • MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification required.
  • Undergraduate degree in Economics, Business, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline.

Experience

  • 8–12 years of progressive experience in customer strategy, pricing, operations, or a directly adjacent domain with meaningful exposure to global, multi-market environments.
  • Demonstrated track record of owning a financially significant operational lever and managing it with both analytical precision and strategic judgment.
  • Prior experience leading and developing teams; comfort operating as a senior individual contributor and a people leader simultaneously.
  • Background in subscription commerce, logistics, or consumer-facing operations strongly preferred. Familiarity with the economics of customer recovery in high-volume, low-margin environments is a distinct advantage.

Technical & Analytical

  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and data analysis; able to build and pressure-test the analytical models that underpin policy decisions without delegating the logic to others.
  • Fluency with experimentation methodology: test design, statistical significance, holdout analysis, and the translation of results into policy not just reporting.
  • Experience working with or alongside engineering teams to define product and system requirements for rules-based or AI-assisted decisioning tools.
  • Comfort with financial modeling: building the business case for compensation investment, forecasting spend impact, and tracking actuals against plan.

Leadership & Influence

  • Senior executive presence: able to walk into a GM, COO, or CFO conversation with a clear point of view, defend it under pressure, and leave with alignment.
  • A credible voice with peers and upward stakeholders not because of title, but because of the quality of analysis and clarity of communication.
  • Structured and decisive under ambiguity: able to make a defensible call with incomplete information and adjust as evidence develops.
  • Genuinely collaborative across markets and functions able to hold people to standards without damaging the relationships needed to sustain them.

What we offer

  • Modern and comfortable working space with great co-workers in Berlin-Kreuzberg
  • Discount for HelloFresh boxes and Convini products
  • Development possibilities along with internal trainings and a yearly Learning & Development budget
  • Flexible working hours including Work From Home/Work from Abroad/Sabbatical Policy, as well as a home office set up budget 
  • Extensive Onboarding and Buddy Program
  • Social events including team events, Friday beers, company runs, book club, etc.
  • Discounted fitness offers with our Urban Sports Club and John Reed partners and yoga classes
  • Well-being initiatives in cooperation with Headspace and Spill
  • Childcare and company pension scheme benefit
  • Monthly transportation budget via NAVIT

title: Director Customer Experience and Engagement
descriptionHtml:
About Nscale

Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud supports strategic business outcomes including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you’ll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work.

About The Role

We are looking for a Director of Customer Experience and Engagement to build and lead the organization responsible for helping Nscale customers realize meaningful value from our platform.

You will own the strategy, operating model, and execution of our customer experience function. This role will be pivotal in working with our customers across the AI lifecycle—from initial requirements gathering to contractual acceptance, onboarding and workload migration through production adoption, optimization, and expansion.

This role sits at the intersection of customers, engineering, product, sales, and infrastructure. You will be accountable for ensuring customers can successfully build and operate AI workloads on Nscale while receiving clear, proactive, and technically credible guidance throughout the relationship.

The right leader will combine strong customer judgment with technical depth and operational rigor. You should be comfortable getting into the technical details enough so that you understand where customers are blocked, influencing product priorities, and advising executives on retention, risk, adoption, and account health.

This is a highly visible leadership role with the opportunity to define what world-class customer experience looks like for the fastest growing Neocloud platform in the world.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and Develop Nscale’s initial customer engagement strategy from requirements to PoC execution and signoff
  • Define and own Nscale’s customer experience strategy across onboarding, implementation, adoption, technical success, support coordination, retention, and expansion.
  • Collaborate with a world class set of Solution Engineers across the segments to determine best path for each customer and increase deal velocity and efficiency
  • Establish account-health frameworks that combine product usage, platform reliability, workload performance, customer sentiment, support activity, and commercial risk.
  • Proactively identify at-risk enterprise accounts based on utilization patterns, support tickets, or competitive pressures and orchestrate recovery strategies
  • Create clear escalation and incident-management processes that provide customers with fast response times, strong ownership, seamless internal coordination, and proactive communication.
  • Define and track the metrics that matter, including time to value, activation, platform adoption, workload growth, retention, expansion, customer health, resolution time, and customer satisfaction.
  • Turn customer conversations and usage patterns into actionable insights for sales, product and engineering.
  • Scale the function thoughtfully, balancing high-touch customer engagement with automation, self-service resources, and repeatable programs.

What You’ll Need

  • 10+ years of experience across customer experience, customer success, solution consulting, solutions architecture, professional services, or a related customer-facing function.
  • Growth-stage, enterprise SaaS, developer platform, cloud infrastructure, or AI infrastructure environment preferred, but not required
  • A proven track record of building or scaling customer experience organizations supporting technically complex products.
  • Strong technical fluency and the ability to engage credibly with engineering leaders, ML engineers, AI researchers, infrastructure teams, and enterprise platform organizations.
  • A record of improving customer adoption, retention, account health, and operational execution through clear systems and measurable goals.
  • Strong judgment during high-pressure customer escalations, including the ability to create clarity, align internal teams, and communicate directly with senior stakeholders.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. You can move comfortably between a technical incident review, an executive customer conversation, an internal product discussion, and a team operating review.
  • Strong cross-functional influence, particularly with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, Sales, and Finance.
  • A high bias for action and comfort operating in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment with limited process and significant ownership.
  • The ability to think strategically while remaining close to customers, team execution, and operational details.

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with Ray, distributed training, model serving, inference, Kubernetes, Slurm, GPU clusters, or modern AI workloads.
  • Experience supporting both product-led and enterprise sales motions.
  • Experience building global or follow-the-sun customer coverage models.
  • Experience developing AI-powered customer operations, automation, self-service tooling, or customer intelligence systems.

The range below reflects the base salary for the position. Actual compensation may vary based on job-related factors such as skill set, experience, education, and location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus, equity, and/or commission programs. Nscale may offer a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, flexible paid time off, parental leave, and retirement plan participation.

This is a unique opportunity to join Nscale’s journey, play a key role in delivering transformative AI infrastructure, and help shape a company scaling globally with a key focus in the EMEA region.

The Role

The Director, Development Cost & Capital Planning is accountable for establishing cost certainty, capital planning, development risk and commercial viability across Nscale's EMEA Development portfolio from site identification (Gate 0) through due diligence (Gate 1) to development sanction and ‘shovel-ready’ transition into Delivery (Gate 2).

The role owns L0 Indicative Estimates, L1 Estimated Budgets and L2 Schematic Design Budget for every EMEA opportunity, consolidating the development, energy, design, construction, procurement and AI infrastructure workstream budgets into a single Total Development Cost (TDC) providing the commercial and financial foundation for site selection, land and lease acquisitions, Colocation leases, underwriting business cases, investment committee approvals and project approvals.

Operating as an individual contributor at first, the role will personally prepare estimates, cost models, risk registers, benchmarking and investment-grade business cases while establishing the systems, governance and processes required for future growth. The role will develop to manage a high performing team supporting the Development function as it expands across the EMEA region.

Key Responsibilities

  • Development Cost Planning & Estimating - Own L0, L1 and L2 estimates across the EMEA portfolio, maintaining the Total Development Cost (TDC), proforma and development cost baseline through Gate 2. Where early stage budgets have missing elements, propose and agree estimates and placeholders with the project team.
  • Investment Underwriting & Business Case Development - Provide CAPEX, contingency, cash flow and cost-risk inputs to support acquisitions, business cases and Investment Committee approvals.
  • Development Risk Management and Contingency Planning - Maintain project risk registers and govern contingency in accordance with Nscale policy.
  • Site Selection & Land Acquisition Support - Support site screening, due diligence and acquisition decisions through cost, risk and abnormality assessments.
  • Power, Utilities & Infrastructure Assessment - Integrate power, utility and enabling infrastructure costs and schedules into the overall development budget.
  • Procurement & Strategic Supply Chain Integration - Work with Procurement and Strategic Sourcing to incorporate market capacity, procurement strategy, long-lead items and supply chain risks into estimates.
  • Cost Benchmarking - Maintain EMEA cost benchmarks, escalation assumptions and market intelligence across key jurisdictions.
  • Contract / Lease Support - Support the Development team in all areas of land / power acquisition and Colocation leasing and contracting, providing cost annexes in the agreed contract form.
  • Market Intelligence - Retain current market benchmark costs and reintegrate as-built costs of developments into pre-development modelling and estimates.
  • Portfolio Capital Planning & Forecasting - Lead portfolio CAPEX forecasting, cashflow planning and variance reporting for all pre-sanction opportunities.
  • Development Governance & Gateway Approvals - Own cost deliverables, assurance and reporting for Gate 0-2 approvals.
  • Global WBS Alignment and Handover into Delivery - Structure all estimates to the Global WBS and lead commercial transition to Delivery at Gate 2.
  • Lessons Learned and Estimating Accuracy Improvement - Improve estimate accuracy, benchmarking and contingency calibration through estimate-to-outturn analysis.
  • Functional Leadership and Future Team Development - Act as EMEA lead for development cost planning, establishing standards, tools and governance with responsibility for building and leading the team as the portfolio scales.

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of experience in quantity surveying, cost management, estimating, commercial management or capital planning.
  • Proven experience within hyperscale data centres, mission critical facilities, major infrastructure, energy or industrial developments. 
  • The ability to build experienced based cost plans and budgets when limited information exists.
  • Strong understanding of the full data centre development lifecycle from site origination, early stage development, planning, permitting through construction mobilisation.
  • Experience preparing the cost basis for investment-grade business cases and underwriting budgets.
  • Experience developing risk registers, contingency models and portfolio capital plans.
  • Strong understanding of contractor markets, procurement strategies and supply chain dynamics.
  • Experience working with developers, investors, lenders, consultants and contractors.
  • Demonstrated ability to present to Executive Committees, Investment Committees and Board stakeholders.
  • Fluency in data centre cost benchmarking (€/MW, €/m², cost per IT load) and the development cost drivers of power, cooling and AI-ready infrastructure.
  • Working knowledge of EMEA contract forms and procurement routes (e.g. FIDIC, NEC and local equivalents) and their cost and risk implications.
  • Proficiency with estimating and cost management tools and advanced Excel-based cost and cash flow modelling.
  • Right to work [UK / EU] and willingness to travel across EMEA.

Preferred:

  • Degree in Quantity Surveying, Construction Economics, Commercial Management, Engineering or related discipline.
  • MRICS, CICES, ACostE or equivalent professional accreditation preferred but not essential.
  • Experience across multiple EMEA jurisdictions.
  • Experience supporting large-scale AI, cloud, hyperscale or mission-critical developments.

title: Director, EMEA Professional Services
descriptionHtml:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

About the Role

We are looking for a Director, EMEA Professional Services to build and lead our services and customer engineering motion across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

This is a player-coach leadership role at the center of the EMEA go-to-market. You will shape how we engage EMEA customers after the sale and alongside it. You will help Sales position and sell both the subscription and, when it fits, services. You will own staffing and delivery for EMEA engagements. You will also coordinate the wider Customer Engineering team in region, including Enablement Engineers, Activation Specialists, and Account Managers.

You will work closely with EMEA GTM leadership and stay aligned with global Professional Services leadership. EMEA should feel like one team with the rest of PS, with the local context it needs to win.

Location: London preferred. Open to other EMEA locations with strong overlap with UK and European business hours. Some travel to customers and to our San Francisco and New York offices is expected.

What You'll Do

  • Define EMEA Customer Engineering programs: Partner with EMEA GTM leadership to design and run programs for the region. This includes onboarding, activation, enablement, and services offerings. Adapt global programs to regional needs such as data residency, regulated industries, language, and partner ecosystems.

  • Support positioning and selling: Support the creation and evolution of standard pre sales assets to support the AEs with positioning Professional Services. Work with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers on deal strategy. Help position the subscription and the right post-sale path for each customer. Join executive conversations when needed. Scope and sell Professional Services when it is the right fit. Review SOWs, estimates, and pricing for EMEA deals.

  • Own resource management and delivery: Own staffing, capacity planning, and utilization for the EMEA PS team. Match engagements to the right people and practices. Make sure delivery follows PS methodology, including scoping, technical review, documentation, and customer handoff. Review key deliverables, surface risk early, and handle escalations.

  • Lead and grow the EMEA team: Hire, onboard, coach, and develop Architects, AI Engineers, and Engagement Managers in region. Set clear expectations and give direct feedback. Build a team culture with a high bar for quality and craft.

  • Coordinate across global Customer Engineering in a matrix model: Provide day-to-day coordination and supervision for EMEA Enablement Engineers, Activation Specialists, and Account Managers. Set shared priorities and make sure customers get a connected journey from activation to enablement to services to expansion. Work with their functional leaders on performance, growth, and standards.

  • Align with global PS leadership: Keep delivery standards, tooling, pricing, and reporting consistent across regions. Share what works in EMEA. Bring back playbooks, reusable assets, and process improvements from the global team. Contribute to the PS operating rhythm and roadmap.

  • Run the business: Own EMEA PS bookings, utilization, delivery margin, and customer outcomes. Report on pipeline, capacity, and risk to Customer Engineering and GTM leadership.

  • Stay close to customers: Remain active in key accounts. Act as the senior escalation point for strategic EMEA customers. Be a credible voice with technical and executive stakeholders.

What You'll Bring

  • You have 10+ years of experience in professional services, solutions engineering, customer engineering, or consulting. At least 4 of those years were in leadership roles.

  • You have led a services or post-sales team in EMEA. You know the regional market and its regulatory landscape.

  • You have helped sell technical services alongside a software subscription. You can scope work, price it, and defend it with customers.

  • You have owned resource management and delivery. You understand utilization, capacity planning, and delivery quality.

  • You have led through influence in a matrix organization. You can set direction for people who do not report to you.

  • You are credible with engineers and executives. You can discuss agent architectures, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise AI adoption.

  • You have built programs from scratch in a fast-moving environment. You do not wait to be told what to do.

  • You communicate clearly and directly. You work well across time zones with a global team.

You exemplify our operating principles

  • You are motivated to build something great. You hold a high bar for quality, craft, and impact.

  • You embrace hot takes. You share informed opinions, challenge the status quo, and engage in constructive debate.

  • You operate with maximum agency. You take ownership, move work forward independently, and help others unblock.

  • You run to the roar. You lean into hard problems, ambiguity, and fast-moving challenges.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with AI/ML, LLM applications, or agent frameworks

  • Experience with SaaS subscriptions, usage-based pricing, and services attach

  • Experience working with SIs and cloud marketplaces in EMEA

  • Experience in a high-growth startup or open-source company

  • Fluency in one or more European languages in addition to English

How Success Will Be Measured

  • EMEA customers have clear programs and a connected post-sale journey.

  • Services attach rate and bookings grow in the region, with healthy margins.

  • EMEA PS meets its utilization target over time, with exceptions understood and managed.

  • Delivery consistently follows PS standards, and material risks surface early.

  • Matrix partners in Enablement, Activation, and Account Management are aligned on EMEA priorities.

  • EMEA practices stay consistent with global PS and feed improvements back to it.

Compensation and Benefits

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks. descriptionHtml:

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

You'll work from our Paris, France office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 12+ years of experience in B2B enterprise sales within high-growth fintech, payments or enterprise software/SaaS environments.

  • 5+ years of direct people management experience, including experience managing managers and Director-level sales leaders.

  • A track record of leading a sizable enterprise sales organisation of 30+ people.

This team helps large, often multinational organizations solve complex financial challenges that go well beyond a single product decision — moving money globally, managing treasury operations, embedding financial services across borders, and replacing fragmented financial workflows with one global system built to scale. You’ll be helping customers understand what is possible when their financial operations work as one global system.

It's a team for strategic sellers with a builder mindset, who combine strategic thinking with deep product knowledge: comfortable with long deal cycles, multiple stakeholders, and the kind of autonomy that comes from being trusted to create value, shape the deal, and move complex opportunities forward rather than follow a rigid playbook. DIRECTOR – EUROPEAN GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS

As the Director – European Government Operations, based in Munich/ Berlin, Germany, you will lead Rocket Lab's government affairs strategy across Germany and the broader European region. You will play a critical role in advancing Rocket Lab's business objectives by shaping policy environments, building strategic government relationships, and ensuring alignment between Government Affairs and Business Development. In this role, you will work at the intersection of aerospace innovation, national security, and European public-sector engagement. Join a driven team of pioneers relentlessly tackling challenging projects, delivering on the impossible, and making an impact on the future of space.

title: Director, Fan Services
descriptionHtml:

With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.

At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Director, Fan Services leads the Fan Services customer service organization across first and second line teams, owning the departmental budget, headcount planning, and vendor/BPO relationships in partnership with global teams. HOW WILL YOU DRIVE IMPACT

Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)
