  • Proficient in EDA/CAD flow development while balancing stakeholder needs (quality, schedule, and compute efficiency).

  • Ability to quickly learn, understand, maintain, and enhance complex software design tools.

Experience

  • Bachelor or Master of Science Degree, in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science.

  • 10+ years in an EDA/CAD engineering supporting both analog and digital IC design teams.

  • Proven experience at advanced technology nodes and associated PDKs. Practical knowledge of industry-standard methodologies, tool licensing, revision control, and release management.

title: Electronics Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

The Role

We are looking for an Electronics Engineering Manager to lead the electronics function within our Systems team at IonQ. You will lead a team of three electronics engineers and grow it as our programmes scale. The team designs, builds and tests the electronics subsystems behind our mission to build the most performant quantum computers.

This is a player-coach role, with roughly 60% of your time spent leading the team and 40% on hands-on design work. You will set the technical direction for our electronics deliverables and build a team that can deliver them reliably, from experimental prototypes to rack-ready production systems.

Responsibilities 

You will own the electronics roadmap for current and next-generation quantum systems. That covers schematic capture and PCB layout through to board and system-level test, and the drive architecture for QPU designs.

You will balance hands-on technical leadership with people management, planning and coordination across teams. As the main electronics contact for the physics, firmware, mechanical and systems teams, you will turn complex physical requirements into clear, achievable engineering plans, and you will keep improving the tooling, workflow and capability of the team.Key responsibilities include: 

  • Team leadership: Lead and develop a team of three electronics engineers and play a key role in growing it through hiring. Set clear goals, run regular 1:1s and performance reviews, and build a culture of technical excellence and accountability.
  • Technical direction: Own the architecture of the electronics subsystems, including mixed-signal design, high-speed digital and signal integrity. Approve key design decisions and lead design reviews.
  • Delivery and planning: Plan, prioritise and track electronics workstreams against programme milestones, managing resourcing, schedules, risks and dependencies, and report progress to stakeholders.
  • Quality and process: Set and improve design standards, review processes, verification and test strategy (simulation, bench test, system integration) and documentation practices.
  • Productisation: Lead the move from experimental prototypes to robust, manufacturable, rack-ready production systems, working with suppliers and contract manufacturers as needed.

Requirements 

To succeed, you will need around ten years of experience in electronics design, with a strong background in high-speed and mixed-signal electronics, proven experience leading engineers and a track record of taking hardware from concept through prototype to production on schedule. You should be able to give credible technical guidance while growing the team around you, and bring a high level of attention to detail to your own work and to the designs you review.

You will be comfortable in a fast-moving, highly technical environment and know when to use waterfall or agile delivery in a hardware setting. Experience with Jira and Smartsheet, exposure to cryogenic environments, RF/microwave engineering (up to 500 MHz) or Python-based test automation, and familiarity with the Sinara/ARTIQ ecosystem in a quantum or physics research setting would all be an advantage.


You’d be a great fit with:

  • Engineering leadership experience: A track record of managing or technically leading electronics engineers, including hiring, mentoring and performance management.
  • Strong hardware design background: Hands-on experience with mixed-signal and high-speed digital design, SPICE modelling and lab verification (oscilloscopes, spectrum analysers).
  • Altium expertise: Experience with complex schematics, rigid-flex designs and advanced signal-integrity constraints, and the ability to review and guide others' designs.
  • FPGA and high-performance hardware: Familiarity with Xilinx/Intel toolchains (Vivado/Quartus) and carriers such as the BittWare XUP series or Sinara/ARTIQ hardware.
  • High-speed interfaces: Knowledge of SFP+/QSFP-DD interfaces, 10/100G Ethernet and high-speed differential pair routing.

title: Embedded Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Location: Eindhoven, the Netherlands (on-site, High Tech Campus) | Type: Full-time | Level: Medior–Senior, ~5 years of relevant experience

About us

AIM Solutions is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Eindhoven building inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. We are in an active build phase: a small, growing team turning lab setups into a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet.

The role

As Embedded Engineer you own everything between the instrument hardware and our acquisition software. You integrate cameras, frame grabbers, motion controllers, piezo stages, lasers and FPGA timing hardware, and you make them run as one synchronized, reliable scan. The work is hands-on: vendor SDKs, trigger wiring, PCIe cards and lab networks one day, clean driver code and a live data stream to the user interface the next. You work closely with the System, Mechatronics, Application and Algorithm engineers.

What you will do

  • Design the trigger and acquisition architecture that synchronizes camera exposure, stage motion and laser pulses.

  • Integrate industrial cameras and frame grabbers through industry-standard interfaces and vendor SDKs, from driver set-up to stable high-rate acquisition.

  • Integrate motion controllers and positioning stages through vendor APIs and controller scripting, including commissioning and tuning with the Mechatronics Engineer.

  • Develop and extend FPGA-based timing and I/O for triggering and position-synchronized acquisition.

  • Write driver and control layers in C/C++ and Python that the scan and reconstruction software builds on, and expose live status and data streams to the user interface.

  • Own the instrument PC and lab network set-up: PCIe hardware, high-speed Ethernet links between devices, IP planning and device discovery.

  • Bring up and debug hardware in the lab with oscilloscope, logic analyzer and network captures, and document interfaces and timing budgets with the System Engineer.

  • Take part in code review and help move the set-up from prototype to a reproducible, maintainable tool.

Your profile

  • MSc in Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Applied Physics or a related field.

  • ~5 years of hands-on experience integrating and controlling hardware, preferably in high-tech equipment, scientific instruments or industrial automation.

  • Strong C/C++ and Python, including working with vendor SDKs and drivers on Windows and Linux.

  • Proven experience with hardware triggering and synchronization of multiple devices (cameras, motion, lasers, DAQ).

  • Experience with FPGA development or working closely with FPGA-based timing hardware.

  • Solid grasp of hardware interfaces and networking: Ethernet, USB, serial, PCIe, and multi-device lab networks.

  • Comfortable in the lab: reading schematics, using an oscilloscope and logic analyzer, and debugging where hardware and software meet.

  • Experience with Git and collaborative code review.

  • Full professional proficiency in English.

We value judgment and ownership over a perfect match. If you recognize yourself in most of this, we would like to hear from you.

Bonus

  • Experience with machine-vision cameras, frame grabbers or high-throughput image acquisition.

  • Experience with precision motion controllers and encoder-based position triggering.

  • High-speed data paths to a host PC, SoC FPGAs or Linux driver development.

  • Experience building lightweight web or API layers for instrument control and live data.

  • Background in optics, lasers, coherent imaging, semiconductor metrology or lithography equipment.

  • Experience with CI, hardware-in-the-loop testing, or working in a Scrum team.

What we offer

  • Ownership of the embedded and timing backbone of a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet.

  • A small team with short feedback loops and real impact on the product.

  • Hands-on work at the meeting point of hardware, optics and software, on the High Tech Campus Eindhoven.

  • A competitive salary for the Dutch market.

title: Embedded Software Engineer - SoM
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Embedded Software Engineer at Harmattan AI, you will join the R&D team to own the embedded software stack on the compute modules used across our platforms. You will take a new module from bare board to a maintained, securely booting Linux platform, covering the boot chain, kernel, drivers, and the verification around them. This is a high impact role that combines deep Linux and kernel work with hands on bring up on new hardware, taking a board from first power up through to flight.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • BSP and Reference Images: Build and maintain the BSP layer, device trees, and the reference images for each board, including custom layers and SDK generation, and carry them forward across kernel upgrades and silicon revisions.

  • Boot Chain and Secure Boot: Own the boot chain, including bootloader porting, signed boot, verified rootfs, and A/B system update.

  • Drivers and Low Level Interfaces: Develop and validate Linux device drivers across I2C, SPI, UART, GPIO, PCIe, and MIPI, including camera and sensor interfaces.

  • Board Support on MCU Targets: Provide startup, clock, and peripheral support on the microcontrollers of boards the team designs.

  • Board Bring Up and Hardware Validation: Lead software bring up on new hardware, take part in design reviews, and debug system level issues across the hardware and software boundary.

  • Verification and Documentation: Define verification test plans and acceptance criteria, automate boot and peripheral test on real targets, and document each milestone.

  • Cross Functional Collaboration: Work with the hardware team on new boards, and with Systems and Embedded Software Platform on interfaces and integration.

  • Mentorship: Depending on seniority, mentor junior embedded engineers.

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

  • Educational Background: MSc in engineering (electrical, computer, or a related field). PhD a plus. A hands on bring up record matters more than the specific degree.

  • Experience: 5 years minimum in embedded software, with BSPs owned through their lifecycle and kept reproducible as the hardware evolved.

  • Build Systems: Strong command of an embedded Linux build system such as Yocto or OpenEmbedded, across custom layers or packages, BSP integration, image build, and SDK generation. Experience with in house or non standard build systems is an advantage.

  • Technical Expertise: Kernel space driver development on ARM targets, validated against real peripherals across I2C, SPI, UART, GPIO, PCIe, and MIPI. Device tree work on new boards and hardware revisions. Board bring up from first power up to a booting Linux image.

  • Boot and Update: Bootloader porting, kernel configuration, signed boot, and firmware update mechanisms on production hardware, with security conscious and deterministic engineering practice throughout.

  • Programming: Strong C and C++, including kernel space coding, and strong Python scripting skills, with solid version control practice (Git).

  • Debugging Expertise: Able to isolate whether a fault sits in the driver, the kernel configuration, or the board, using GDB, JTAG, OpenOCD, kernel tracing, ftrace, and perf.

  • Professional Attributes: Rigorous, structured, and systematic, able to work autonomously, unfazed by a board that will not boot. Excellent communication and documentation skills, able to present platform and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders.

  • Additional Skills: Bare metal or RTOS firmware on microcontroller targets, experience enabling hardware accelerators on embedded SoCs including VPU and NPU drivers and runtimes, familiarity with the perception or control workloads that run on the module, and UAS, drone, or defense experience are strong advantages.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence. Thrives in a fast paced environment where priorities shift and no task is too small.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Called SpaceMobile, this ultra-powerful network is being designed to provide connectivity at 4G/5G speeds everywhere on the planet – on land, at sea and in flight.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced and results driven Embedded Software Tech Leader for BSP ASIC FW/SW. This leadership role combines hands-on technical expertise with mentoring, and leading technical solutions as part of development of cutting-edge real-time software for satellite systems.

You will own SW architecture and delivery for AST’s ASIC embedded SW stack as used in the space communication platforms and play a key role in bridging between platforms hardware R&D, System, communication payload and integration teams.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and provide guidance to implementation of AST’s FW ASIC stack as required for ASIC bring up, verification, drivers and diagnostics.
  • Foster collaboration, accountability, and technical excellence across different SW groups and HW groups.
  • Technical Leadership:
    - Oversee architecture, implementation, and integration of BSP embedded software and diagnostics+test features to enable tests automation.
    - Guide development of drivers, RTOS services and applications, and system-level diagnostics for satellite communication systems.
  • Collaboration:
    - Cross collaboration with multidisciplinary teams: Systems Engineering, HW – RF and digital, ASIC VLSI, Validation and ATE, Payload applications SW
    - Act as a technical point of contact for internal stakeholders and external partners with ASIC BSP firmware.

Qualifications

Experience:
 8+ years of embedded software development experience.

  • Technical Skills:
    Expert level in C and real-time programming with “thin” infrastructure (Free RTOS, Zephyr, bare metal).
    Strong knowledge of embedded system interfaces: I2C, SPI, UART, RS-485, Ethernet, SerDes, memory device management, boot loaders and embedded HW resources (memory technologies, watch-dogs, fail-safe mechanism) - bring up and debugging
    Hands-on experience with lab equipment: oscilloscopes, analysers, signal generators.
    Proven experience in defining architecture, SW workflows and interfaces.

Experienced with SW release workflows and integration of large SW stacks..

  • Leadership Skills:
    Proven ability to guide and inspire engineers across software and test domains, preferably – across multiple site and geographies.
    Strong sense of ownership and execution.

Education: B.Sc in Computer Science or Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field., M.Sc is preferred.

Soft Skills:

  • Leadership Skills:
  • Proven ability to guide, mentor and inspire engineers across software and test domains. Strong sense of ownership and execution.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Fluent in English, written and spoken.

Technology Stack:

  • Expert in C and real-time programming (thin RTOS – Free RTOS, Zephyr, bare metal).
    Some Experience with CI/CD Buildkite/Jenkins based methodologies and tools such as Git/GitLab CI/CD, or similar
  • Experience with container technologies, including Docker

Physical Requirements

  • Working from office at least 3-4 days a week + 1-2 remote

This job description may not be inclusive to the duties and responsibilities listed. Additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time or the scope of the job may change as needed by business demands.

title: Embedded Staff Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Embedded Staff Engineer - Help us build the Control System that the world can rely on. 

About Priva  

Your Future Ecosystem  

Located between Rotterdam and The Hague, in the heart of the world’s leading greenhouse region, lies Westland, home to Priva’s modern campus in De Lier. This innovative region has been the foundation of our family-owned company since the 1950s.  

What started as a hardware business has grown into a global leader in horticulture and building automation. Today, Priva develops advanced hardware, software, and digital services for climate control, energy efficiency, and water optimization. Our solutions support horticulture, indoor and city farming, as well as offices, hotels, hospitals, and retail environments worldwide.  

Our next ambition? Becoming a leading digital service provider with “Climate as a Service” solutions that help customers operate more sustainably.  

With over 600 colleagues, 16 international offices, and more than 400 installation partners, we deliver smart, sustainable solutions in over 100 countries. 

If you want your work to have impact on sustainability, food security, and the way cities grow, then this is where you belong.  
 

Why this role matters

At Priva, we are building the next generation of IoT-enabled building automation systems: cloud-connected, security-first, and designed for long-term reliability.

As a Staff Embedded Software Engineer (C++ / Linux), you will play a key role in shaping a scalable platform that combines embedded controllers, edge gateways, and cloud services. Your work ensures that buildings operate safely, efficiently, and reliably for 10-15 years with minimal maintenance.

This role goes beyond implementation. You will drive technical direction, influence software architecture, and support complex system design decisions across our platform.

Your role as Staff Engineer

You act as the bridge between software architecture and implementation, guiding teams in building a service-oriented, event-driven IoT platform consisting of 15+ services running on embedded devices.

You bring deep expertise in modern C++ (20+) and embedded Linux, and you help ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability across the system.

Your team

You will join our Alpha team, a group of highly experienced embedded software engineers and test engineers, working on cutting-edge building automation technology.

What you’ll do

  • Design and develop embedded software in modern C++ (C++17 or later) on Linux

  • Build scalable, modular, and configurable control components

  • Implement deterministic and real-time control strategies

  • Develop robust 24/7 runtime systems for real-world environments

  • Create simulation environments and automated test frameworks

  • Contribute to software architecture and design decisions

  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and quality gates

  • Support application lifecycle management (ALM)

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (hardware, cloud, QA)


What you bring

  • 10+ years of experience in Embedded Software Engineering (C++ / Linux)

  • Strong expertise in modern C++ (C++17 or later)

  • Solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and SOLID principles

  • Experience with multithreading, concurrency, and performance optimization

  • Experience with distributed or service-oriented systems

  • Knowledge of communication protocols such as MQTT, CAN, Serial

  • Experience working in resource-constrained environments (real-time systems)

  • Ability to review, challenge, and improve architectural decisions

  • Strong debugging and system-level problem-solving skills

  • Experience working in cross-functional and international teams

Nice to have

  • Experience in IoT, building automation, or industrial systems

  • Familiarity with Node-RED or control systems

  • Experience with Yocto, Docker, or containerized environments

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices

  • Experience with test strategies, automated testing, and system validation

What you get 
In numbers 

  • A competitive salary based on your experience; 

  • We find a healthy work-life balance important: working flexible hours combined with 30 vacation days a year and the option to buy more; 

  • 8% holiday allowance; 

  • Travel allowance of € 0,23/km with a daily maximum of 150 kilometers. 

For your own sustainability 

  • Be secured with our pension plan; 

  • Feel engaged and join our participation plan; 

  • Keep on learning with your personal education possibilities and budget; 

  • Be happy and fit by using our healthy cafeteria, our free on-premises fitness where you can participate in CrossFit, Pilates and Spinning classes or play table tennis or table football.

Our values
Priva's mission is to create an optimal environment where people can work, grow and develop. We offer worldwide solutions for horticulture and building automation. Our ambition is to be known as the leading technology and service provider for sustainable urban deltas. We are proud that our solutions result in lower consumption of natural resources and contribute to some of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

Our culture is built around our core values; sustainable, innovation, make it happen and human. In our latest employment survey, our colleagues mainly described our culture as: open, ambitious, innovative, friendly, committed, informal, flexible and down to earth. We aim to be a dynamic, fast-paced, flat and informal organization, where our colleagues have the space to grow and develop.

We believe that to be successful, it is important to include people with different perspectives, backgrounds and cultures. Every day, we continue to build our open culture with people who are driven to turn our vision into reality, regardless of who they love, where they are from, or what they believe in. We encourage and celebrate people to voice their opinions and be their authentic selves.

Apply
Does this make you smile, and do you see yourself as our new Embedded Staff Engineer? Apply below or contact us for more information. We’ll get back to you within two weeks, we are keen to get to know you!

title: EMEA Sales Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Firstwork

Labour markets are broken. Millions of people are ready to work and can't start. Screening, right-to-work checks, contracts, onboarding and scheduling still run across disconnected systems, with hundreds of manual decisions in between. Firstwork builds AI agents that run frontline workforce operations end to end. We activate hundreds of thousands of workers a month globally for some of the world's largest employers and staffing firms, working forward-deployed inside the customer's operation. Backed by Y Combinator and Gradient (Google’s AI fund), with offices in New York, with London and Dubai opening later this year.

Why this role

European customers are not evaluating us out of curiosity. Workforce compliance has turned into a board-level risk and there are deadlines attached to it. The demand is already here. What we don't have is coverage, or an enterprise motion that repeats.

You are the first commercial hire in Europe and you build the team around you. It is a player-coach role and it stays that way, because we are not going to put someone in charge of coaching a European motion; they have never run against European buyers themselves. You carry a quota while you hire. A Solutions Consultant joins alongside you, SDRs come after that, and how the pod fits together is your call.

None of this starts from zero. The North American playbook holds up on qualification, pricing, security review and technical validation. Your job is to work out which parts of it survive European procurement, works councils and regulators, rebuild the rest, and turn the result into the thing every rep in the region runs.

What you'll do

  • Own enterprise revenue across EMEA, and carry your own deals from first meeting through to signature

  • Build and qualify pipeline in staffing, healthcare, logistics, manufacturing and retail

  • Turn the North American motion into a European playbook other people can run

  • Hire the pod. SDRs, account executives, and with the CEO, the first five people on the team

  • Forecast well enough that the exec team can plan the company against it

  • Get what you hear in the field back to product while it still matters

What we're looking for

  • Seven or more years selling complex enterprise software, with six and seven figure closes you can talk us through in detail

  • Time selling into staffing, healthcare, logistics, manufacturing and/or retail

  • Deals across more than one European market, so you know how procurement, works councils and regulators change the shape of a cycle

  • Experience hiring and managing reps while still carrying your own number

  • The ability to hold a room with a Head of Compliance and a CTO in it at the same time

  • A territory run on tooling rather than headcount. AI for account mapping, call prep, proposals and pipeline hygiene, and we will ask to see the stack

  • No difficulty being wrong in front of the CEO

If you have built a commercial team once and think the second one would be better, we should talk.

Firstwork is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status.

title: EMEA Statutory Reporting Senior Manager
descriptionHtml:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About the role

Applied Intuition is scaling quickly across entities and geographies, and statutory reporting, clean audits, and compliant local filings are essential. In this London-based role, you will be the accountable owner of statutory reporting, audit, and compliance for our EMEA entities, including the UK, Germany, Sweden, and Saudi Arabia, with more to come.

Reporting to the Director of Accounting, you will lead the EMEA local close and statutory audits, own the filing calendar, oversee the US GAAP to local GAAP conversion work produced by our India-based outsourced accounting team, and partner with Tax, Legal, and Business Technology to automate statutory and compliance processes in NetSuite. This is a hands-on opportunity to build a best-in-class statutory and compliance function across EMEA for a high-growth company.

At Applied Intuition, you will:

  • Own the preparation, review, and sign-off of statutory financial statements for our EMEA entities under local GAAP (UK GAAP/FRS 102, German HGB, Swedish K2/K3, and IFRS as endorsed in Saudi Arabia), including the US GAAP to local GAAP conversion and bridge work papers.

  • Lead each statutory audit end to end with our external auditors, from planning and PBC lists through audit queries, adjustments, and management representation letters, closing audits on schedule.

  • Run the EMEA month-end on the US close calendar: review and sign off statutory balance sheet reconciliations, drive aged reconciling items to zero, and maintain local GAAP schedules such as leases and accrued vacation.

  • Own the EMEA statutory and compliance filing calendar, covering VAT, corporate income tax and zakat (with Tax and external advisers), company registry filings, and annual accounts, so every filing goes in on time with no notices from authorities.

  • Manage the quality and performance of our India-based outsourced accounting team and of in-country auditors, tax advisers, and accounting providers, and turn statutory and conversion workpapers into standard templates the team can run with minimal rework.

  • Partner with Business Technology to automate statutory reporting, VAT, and e-invoicing in NetSuite, design and document the related controls, and bring new entities and regulatory changes (for example, FRS 102 amendments and German and Saudi e-invoicing mandates) into the process ahead of effective dates.

We’re looking for someone who has:

  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, or CPA) with 14+ years of relevant accounting experience

  • Proven ownership of multi-entity UK statutory reporting under UK GAAP (FRS 102) and the Companies Act 2006, including leading statutory audits end to end

  • Experience converting US GAAP to local GAAP and reviewing GAAP bridge workpapers (for example, leases and accrued vacation)

  • Experience managing outsourced or offshore accounting teams, including setting quality standards and reviewing output across time zones

  • Proficiency with NetSuite, ideally in a multi-subsidiary environment

  • Sound judgment on materiality and filing risk, and clear communication with auditors, advisers, and partners across EMEA, the US, and India

Nice to have:

  • Big 4 or top-tier public accounting background, and in-house experience at a software/technology multinational

  • Hands-on German GAAP (HGB) and GmbH statutory experience

  • Exposure to Swedish (K2/K3) or Saudi (IFRS, zakat, ZATCA e-invoicing) statutory reporting, or other EMEA local GAAPs and languages

  • Working knowledge of VAT, Making Tax Digital, and e-invoicing requirements across EMEA

  • Experience designing internal controls (SOX or audit readiness) and testing finance system automation, including applying AI tools to accounting workflows

Compensation at Applied Intuition for eligible roles includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Base salary is a single component of the total compensation package, which may also include equity in the form of options and/or restricted stock units, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance coverage, 401k retirement benefits with employer match, learning and wellness stipends, and paid time off. Note that benefits are subject to change and may vary based on jurisdiction of employment.

Applied Intuition pay ranges reflect the minimum and maximum intended target base salary for new hire salaries for the position. The actual base salary offered to a successful candidate will additionally be influenced by a variety of factors including experience, credentials & certifications, educational attainment, skill level requirements, interview performance, and the level and scope of the position.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

descriptionHtml:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

Job Description:

We are looking for a highly strategic and execution-focused EMEA Talent Acquisition Partner to help scale some of the most critical engineering hiring within the company. This person will own full-cycle recruiting for complex software engineering functions with a particular emphasis on Autonomy, Robotics, Embedded Software, Perception, Planning, Controls, Distributed Systems, and other highly specialized technical domains supporting next-generation aerospace and autonomous systems development. This is not a traditional recruiting role. We are looking for someone who can operate as a true talent partner to engineering leadership — helping shape hiring strategy, influence workforce planning, drive prioritization discipline, and build scalable pipelines for some of the hardest-to-hire technical talent in the industry.

The ideal candidate thrives in high-growth, high-ambiguity environments and brings a strong track record of closing senior and niche software engineering talent while balancing speed, quality, and stakeholder partnership.

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for highly specialized software engineering roles across Autonomy, Robotics, Perception, Planning, Embedded Software, Distributed Systems, Simulation, Machine Learning, Infrastructure, and related technical domains
  • Build and execute proactive sourcing strategies for difficult-to-find technical talent across aerospace, defense, robotics, autonomous systems, automotive, AI/ML, and adjacent industries
  • Act as a strategic advisor to leadership on market trends, talent availability, compensation competitiveness, and hiring risks
  • Drive strong operational rigor across pipeline management, funnel health, data accuracy, and stakeholder communication
  • Help influence workforce planning and ensure hiring activity remains aligned to approved business priorities
  • Improve recruiting scalability through process improvements, documentation, interview calibration, and tooling optimization
  • Deliver an exceptional candidate experience while maintaining urgency and high hiring quality standards


    • Required qualifications:
  • 8+ years of full-cycle technical recruiting experience, including significant ownership of complex software engineering searches across the EMEA region
  • Proven success recruiting Software Engineers, Autonomy Engineers, Robotics Engineers, Embedded Software Engineers, Perception Engineers, Infrastructure Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, or similar technical talent
  • Strong understanding of software engineering concepts, technical architectures, and engineering organizational structures
  • Experience partnering with senior engineering leadership in fast-paced or high-growth environments
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex searches simultaneously while maintaining strong hiring outcomes
  • Strong sourcing and market-mapping capabilities across highly competitive technical domains
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and operational execution skills
  • Experience using ATS systems, sourcing platforms, and recruiting analytics to drive decisions and pipeline visibility
  • Ability to operate strategically while remaining highly execution-oriented

    • Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience recruiting within aerospace, defense, robotics, autonomous systems, AI/ML, automotive, or other highly technical industries
  • Familiarity with autonomy stacks, robotics systems, embedded software development, distributed systems, simulation environments, or machine learning workflows
  • Experience supporting hiring at scale during periods of rapid organizational growth

title: EMI, HIRF, Lightning Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

We are looking for an EMI/EMC, HIRF & Lightning Engineer (all genders) to join our Central Engineering team and support electromagnetic compatibility and electromagnetic environmental effects activities for the Microliner aircraft.

You will be responsible for the day-to-day engineering activities related to EMI/EMC, High-Intensity Radiated Fields (HIRF), and lightning protection throughout the aircraft development lifecycle, from requirements and architecture support through analysis, design integration, testing, verification, and certification. Working closely with colleagues from Systems, Propulsion, Airframe, Safety, Verification and Validation, and Certification, you will ensure that electromagnetic environmental effects are appropriately addressed at aircraft, system, equipment, and installation level.

As part of Central Engineering, you will act as an internal focal point for EMI/EMC, HIRF, and lightning engineering. Working within the established technical approach and with guidance from senior subject-matter expertise, you will independently drive engineering activities within your area, coordinate across disciplines and suppliers, resolve technical issues, and develop substantiated recommendations for higher-level technical decisions.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Develop and maintain aircraft-level EMI/EMC, HIRF, and lightning requirements within the established technical framework, supporting their decomposition, allocation, and verification across aircraft systems, equipment, installations, and structures.

  • Perform and coordinate EMI/EMC, HIRF, and lightning assessments, including interference sources, coupling paths, equipment susceptibility, installation effects, and direct and indirect lightning effects.

  • Develop, assess, and support the implementation of protection and mitigation measures, including shielding, grounding and bonding, filtering, cable routing and separation, equipment installation, and structural protection provisions.

  • Support the maturation of the aircraft EMI/EMC, HIRF, and lightning protection approach, evaluating technical solutions, identifying risks and trade-offs, and developing substantiated recommendations for higher-level technical decisions.

  • Define and coordinate verification and qualification activities within the assigned scope, including analysis, inspection, equipment qualification, ground and aircraft testing, and testing performed by external laboratories.

  • Independently investigate and resolve electromagnetic interference and compatibility issues during equipment development, system integration, and testing, involving senior technical expertise where significant architectural or programme-level decisions are required.

  • Support safety, certification, and compliance activities, including preparation and review of assessments, qualification evidence, verification results, and compliance documentation in accordance with applicable standards.

  • Act as an internal technical focal point for EMI/EMC, HIRF, and lightning topics, coordinating with engineering teams, suppliers, test laboratories, and technical specialists, while contributing to the continuous improvement of related engineering methods and processes.

 

Your Profile:

  • Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, or a comparable technical discipline, with a minimum of 4 years of professional experience in EMI/EMC, HIRF, lightning protection, or related electromagnetic environmental effects.

  • Practical experience in EMI/EMC engineering, including emissions and susceptibility/immunity, grounding and bonding, shielding, filtering, cable installation, and electromagnetic coupling, combined with experience in HIRF and/or lightning protection.

  • Working knowledge of relevant aerospace standards and guidance, such as RTCA DO-160 / EUROCAE ED-14 and the SAE ARP541x series, with experience supporting related analysis, testing, or equipment qualification.

  • Good understanding of aircraft electrical and electronic systems and their integration; experience with high-voltage architectures, electric propulsion, power electronics, or composite aircraft structures is a strong plus.

  • Experience with civil aircraft development and certification under EASA CS-23/CS-25, FAA Part 23/25, or comparable frameworks is desirable; experience within an EASA Part 21J Design Organisation is a plus.

  • Understanding of systems and safety engineering principles for safety-critical aircraft systems, preferably with exposure to SAE ARP4754 and ARP4761.

  • Ability to work with a high degree of autonomy within an established technical framework, while recognizing when technical issues require broader coordination, specialist input, or escalation.

  • Structured, analytical, and solution-oriented professional with strong technical ownership and the ability to investigate complex electromagnetic interactions and translate findings into practical design recommendations.

  • Strong communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering disciplines, suppliers, test laboratories, and technical specialists.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Strong motivation for aviation and the advancement of electric aircraft technologies.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

title: Employer Brand Strategist
descriptionHtml:
In short: one of Conduct's first marketing hires, owning employer brand and our talent community. You will make the case, to exceptional people in every function, for why Conduct is where they should do their life's work.

Why Conduct

The world's largest companies compete by being different, and most of that difference lives in software they built for themselves. It decides how parcels reach your door and how food reaches the supermarket. That software is their advantage. It is also the hardest thing in the business to change safely, so good ideas wait months, sometimes years, for the systems to catch up.

Every large enterprise has a software company hiding inside it. Conduct is building its operating system. It reads a company's code and processes, works out what has to change, and helps the business and its systems move together. We start with SAP, and go wherever custom software has grown too complex to change safely.

Rio Tinto, Daimler Truck, and DHL already trust us with their most critical systems. We have signed partnerships with major systems integrators, just raised a $60M Series A, and demand is ahead of what we can serve.

We are a talent-dense team doing our life's work in London and New York. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here shapes the company, and how the world's largest companies operate.

About the role

We're looking for someone to own employer brand and talent community as part of the founding marketing team. Hiring exceptional people fast enough is the biggest challenge Conduct faces. We're scaling from about 70 people to 500, across engineering, deployment strategy, go-to-market and operations, and every one of those candidates needs to understand why Conduct matters.

You will articulate why Conduct matters to talent: who we are, what we care about, why the product matters and where it is going. You will take the case the founders make for the company's ambition and turn it into something every candidate hears, from the careers page to the final interview. You will work closely with the talent team on candidate experience, and with our Social & Community Lead, who owns our social channels and developer community, to bring the employer brand to life online.

You will also build Conduct's talent community: the people who aren't ready to join yet but should be one day. You will design recruiting and talent events across every function, and relationships that keep great people close.

What you'll do

  • Tell the talent story. Write the talent narrative: why work at Conduct, the opportunity areas and the vision, with a clear story for each function we hire into.

  • Own the careers experience. The careers page, job descriptions, candidate materials and everything we say to candidates.

  • Shape candidate experience. Work with the talent team on a consistent, high-touch process, from candidate prep packs to how the founders' case for Conduct shows up in every interview.

  • Create employer brand content. Produce films, stories and assets that show what it is really like to work here, for the Social & Community Lead to amplify on our channels.

  • Build our talent community. Design recruiting events, talent dinners and programmes that keep great people close until the timing is right.

  • Shape partner events. Combine thought leadership with recruiting at events with partners like Anthropic, OpenAI and Legora, with Owned Events leading production.

  • Welcome new joiners. Create a values document and welcome pack for new Conductors, in partnership with internal comms.

What we're looking for

  • A generalist with sharp taste and a relentless drive to ship. You have built things before (brands, communities, events, side projects) and you have strong opinions on what great looks like. You see a gap and fill it.

  • Exceptional writing and editing. This is the most important skill for the role.

  • A clear spike in employer brand, and the range to contribute across the wider marketing team.

  • A track record of building an employer brand or talent community that helped a company hire, ideally across technical and commercial roles.

  • Experience at a fast-moving tech company, and comfort with a broad mandate and the pace that comes with it.

  • The ability to make things yourself, in words, video and visuals, rather than only brief them.

  • Genuine conviction about the problem Conduct solves. Experience in enterprise software or AI is a strong plus.

  • A bias to action. You are hands-on whatever your seniority.

  • An appetite for being in the office every day, close to the team and the work.

Your seniority does not matter. Ambition, craft and the ability to turn ideas into high-quality work quickly do. We sponsor visas from everywhere. We're convinced diverse teams build better products, and we especially encourage people from groups underrepresented in tech to reach out.

title: Engineering Leader
descriptionHtml:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

title: Engineering Manager - Accounting
descriptionHtml:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot,based on 60,000 reviews. Our cultureputs customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here).

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 byAlexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.


Join us as Team Lead – Accounting and help build the last missing piece of Qonto's all-in-one offer for businesses. You'll lead a cross-functional team of Backend and Frontend engineers making accounting effortless for business owners, under the guidance of Yanis, our Head of Engineering for the Accounting domain.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Lead your team: You'll manage a team of Backend and Frontend engineers and help each of them grow.

  • Put accounting on autopilot: You'll build features that generate bookkeeping automatically and show customers, in real time, the VAT they owe.

  • Make accounting simple: You'll turn complex accounting and tax steps into a clear experience that business owners can complete with confidence.

  • Bring AI into accounting: You'll ship AI-first experiences, like a chat that answers customers from their own accounting file.

  • Co-own the product & keep the technical bar high: You'll shape the roadmap with your Product Manager and Designer, and guide technical design with your engineers while staying close to the code.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • People leadership: You've led engineers as a manager or Tech Lead, and you're driven by helping people grow.

  • Technical depth: You've built production systems in backend (Go) or frontend (React), and you've coded recently or bring strong system design skills.

  • AI-driven development: You use AI in your own engineering work and push your team to raise the bar with it.

  • Languages: You're fluent in French and English.

  • Bonus: You're familiar with the French accounting world, its services and how accountants work with businesses.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • A product at launch: You'll join right after the first launch of Qonto Accounting and shape what it becomes.

  • Visible business impact: Accounting keeps customers with Qonto for the long run, so your team’s work shows up directly in loyalty.

  • A domain on the move: Qonto Accounting is growing fast in France and starting to expand to other European markets.

➡️ Your future manager

You'll report to Yanis, Head of Engineering, but don't expect micro-management. Yanis grew from Lead Engineer to Head of Engineering over 4 years at Qonto.

He's a pragmatic generalist who has built payment integrations from scratch and is as comfortable on the frontend as on the backend. He gives engineers real ownership, values sharing failures as much as wins, and gets out of the way so the team can ship.

➡️ Our stack & practices

  • Our primary languages are Go and Ruby, ReactJS for frontend, and Kotlin and Swift for our mobile apps.

title: Engineering Manager AI-Modernisation - CDI Paris - Theodo
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Aujourd’hui, l’ambition du groupe est de se positionner comme le leader de l’IA appliquée au développement logiciel, c’est pourquoi nous avons lancé la practice AI Modernisation. Au sein de cette practice, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la modernisation de leurs systèmes legacy. Grâce à une IA maîtrisée et une méthode éprouvée, nous allons 3 fois plus vite sur le delivery de ces projets critiques.
La practice accompagne principalement des scale-ups comme Qonto ou Doctolib et des grands groupes comme Carrefour, Pernod Ricard, Les Mousquetaires, Urgo, Cdiscount ou Edenred. Si tu veux rejoindre le futur de la tech, tu es au bon endroit !

Ton équipe :

Tu rejoindras une communauté tech de Theodoers en plein essor : software engineers, tech leads, engineering managers et architectes, avec lesquels tu pourras échanger, apprendre et progresser au quotidien.

Chez Theodo, les techs travaillent en équipes projet, constituées en fonction des besoins de chaque client, réunissant Software Engineers, Tech Lead et Product Manager. Ensemble, ils collaborent étroitement avec le client, avec des échanges réguliers pour partager vos avancées, approfondir la compréhension de son problème et faire évoluer le produit au plus près des besoins de ses utilisateurs.

En tant qu’Engineering Manager, ton rôle est de manager jusqu’à 4 tech leads, soit de chapeauter la réussite de 4 projets, en binôme avec un(e) Group Project Manager.

Tes futures missions :

Le besoin actuel porte sur des missions “grands-comptes” avec des produits et architectures complexes, développées par plusieurs squads de Theodo :

  • Manager les profils lead sur les projets complexes sur lesquels ils sont staffés
  • Porter la qualité des projets à travers le geste du Weak point management (stratégie 0 défauts)
  • Améliorer les conditions de travail des équipes, qui inclut aussi le setup des conditions de travail agentique.

Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples :

  • HealthHero : leader européen de la télémédecine, ils souhaitent moderniser leur plateforme française, Qare, en vue d’une fusion avec la plateforme UK. L’objectif est de passer de Loopback2 à Nest pour pouvoir upgrade de Node 10 vers Node 20. Grâce à notre méthode de modernisation accélérée par l’IA, nous passons d’une estimation à 70 semaines sans IA à une migration terminée en 21 semaines et accélérons la vitesse de delivery par 5.
  • Pernod Ricard : souhaitait moderniser une application interne utilisée pour gérer leur campagnes marketing, des millions d’euros en jeu. L’impact de Theodo : 23 semaines pour moderniser complètement l’application de Vue Express vers React Nest avec une réécriture plus pragmatique. Nous avons également effectué la connection à leur nouvel ERP, auparavant impossible sans la migration.

Tes perspectives d’évolutions :

Perspectives d’évolution moyen terme (1 - 2 ans) :

  • Manageriale : VP Tech ou Group Manager
  • Technique : Architecte senior
  • Business/Influence : Thought Leader (animer une communauté tech) ou Intrapreneur (porter une nouvelle offre)

Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu :

Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits.

Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients.

Profil recherché :

  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience professionnelle, avec une expérience confirmée en management d’équipes tech et en environnement ESN / conseil.
  • Basé(e) en région parisienne, avec une préférence pour une présence majoritaire au bureau, attendue pour un rôle stratégique et managérial.

Hard skills

  • Solide expertise technologique permettant d’être crédible et légitime auprès des équipes, sans être attendu·e sur le code au quotidien.
  • Capacité à concevoir des architectures évolutives et à arbitrer des choix techniques dans des contextes grands comptes complexes.
  • Expérience significative en management d’équipes techniques, avec la capacité à débloquer des Tech Leads sur des problématiques techniques complexes.
  • Capacité d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes complexes, avec un impact transverse dans l’organisation.
  • Appétence forte pour l’IA générative et son usage dans la conception et le développement de produits digitaux.

Soft skills

  • Leadership affirmé et posture pédagogique pour embarquer, inspirer et faire progresser des équipes exigeantes.
  • Orientation marquée business et création de valeur : chez Theodo, nous ne faisons pas de la tech pour la tech.
  • Aisance relationnelle et communicationnelle, avec la capacité d’adresser tous niveaux d’interlocuteurs, y compris C-level, et de mener des conversations exigeantes.

Le process de recrutement :

  • Call de qualification (30 min) avec un membre de l’équipe recrutement
  • Cultural fit (1h) avec le même recruteur
  • Entretien modélisation (1h)
  • Test technique de refactoring (à la maison + débrief 1h)
  • Final avec un dirigeant

title: Engineering Manager, Alwin Agent Runtime
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a skilled and passionate Engineering Manager to join our Alwin Agents Runtime Team in the Amsterdam office. Working in a bootstrapped and profitable scaleup, you'll have the unique opportunity to lead a team building the intelligence layer that automates the assurance lifecycle and brings AI directly into the workflows of auditors worldwide.


Why DataSnipper?

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.


What You Will Do:

  • Lead an engineering team through outcomes, not tasks; set clear goals with the team and trust them to figure out how.

  • Make the team measurably better; raise the engineering bar, grow engineers into bigger problems, and address performance issues directly when they arise.

  • Drive a step change in what the team can do with AI; not just shipping faster, but tackling harder problems, raising quality, and expanding what the team can credibly own.

  • Lead the team responsible for building AI-powered agents that automate assurance workflows, from risk assessment and evidence gathering to control testing and documentation generation.

  • Own the technical direction and architecture of the Alwin Agent Runtime, ensuring agents are reliable, observable, secure, and effective in real customer workflows.

  • Guide the team in designing and scaling agentic systems that combine LLMs, document intelligence, business workflows, and human oversight.

  • Partner closely with Product, Infrastructure and other Engineering teams to shape the roadmap and translate customer needs into impactful AI experiences.

  • Make the architectural and technical calls that shape the team's systems, and stay close enough to the code to do so credibly.

  • Lead the adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices and contribute to how DataSnipper leverages AI across the broader engineering organization.

  • Help shape the team's scope as it evolves, including expanding ownership areas and standing up new teams when needed.

  • Foster a culture of experimentation, learning, documentation, and operational excellence.

What You Bring:

  • At least 3 years of leading and managing engineering teams, driving performance, growth, and professional development through hands-on mentorship, feedback, and goal setting.

  • Minimum 5 years as a software engineer with a passion for building scalable, reliable, and high-quality software systems.

  • Track record of leading engineering teams that build with AI day to day, and making those teams measurably more effective as a result.

  • Experience building AI-powered products or platforms, ideally involving LLMs, agentic workflows, document processing, or automation systems.

  • An empowerment style of management; you lead through outcomes and trust, not by assigning tasks.

  • Strong product aptitude; can challenge product framing, translate customer needs into technical solutions, and make effective roadmap tradeoffs.

  • Strong understanding of software architecture, distributed systems, APIs, and cloud native development.

  • Experience operating systems in production with a focus on reliability, observability, and maintainability.

  • A track record of growing engineers and creating high-performing teams.

  • Strategic thinker; able to shape product direction, technical direction, and team scope, not just execute on what's handed down.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-moving scale-up environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building and deploying GenAI applications in production.

  • Experience with agentic systems, orchestration frameworks, or AI-powered workflow automation.

  • Experience with Python and modern backend development practices.

  • Familiarity with Azure AI services, document intelligence, and cloud infrastructure.

  • Experience with observability and monitoring tools.

  • Experience working in startups or scaleups.

  • Experience in fintech, audit technology, or document-intensive workflows.

  • Strong understanding of testing strategies and engineering quality practices.

What We Offer:

  • Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact

  • Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share the company's success and growth

  • Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary

  • 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance

  • Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office

  • Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energized

  • NS business card for easy commuting to the office if applicable

  • Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills

  • Engage with a vibrant international team spread across five global offices

  • Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together

  • Access to a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing


Recruitment Process

  • Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes, online)

  • Product Insight Discussion (60 minutes, on-site)

title: Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
Hi, I'm Killian, VP Engineering at FeedbackFruits. 👋

We're moving to one Engineering Manager per squad, and we’re looking for an Engineering Manager for our System Squad. It's our most product-heavy squad: five engineers, three senior and two medior, building the learning tools that teachers and students around the world use every day. Because so much of the squad's work is shaped by what those users need, whoever leads it works closely with the Product Manager on what we build as well as on how we build it.

We're looking for an Engineering Manager with engineering depth, someone senior engineers respect on code and architecture, who has chosen to focus on growing people and still cares a lot about the product. You'd own how the squad works, set its technical standards and lead the way in how it uses AI, and you'd help raise the bar across the wider engineering department too. Our stack is Ruby on Rails and Ember.js, and experience with either is welcome but not required.

What you'll do:

  • Co-own the backlog and roadmap with the Product Manager: challenge scope on user value, propose smaller first versions and turn product goals into technical plans

  • Lead the squad's day-to-day delivery, from planning to unblocking, so engineers keep shipping

  • Grow every engineer through regular 1:1s, direct feedback and a personal growth path in our Career Progression Framework, with a development plan for each of them every year

  • Set the squad's technical direction and quality standards, and review code and architecture with enough depth to be genuinely useful while the team does the coding

  • Use AI in your own work with good judgement, set the example for the squad and help everyone adopt it while keeping quality and security high

  • Explain technical trade-offs clearly to Product, Design and stakeholders, including what the option you didn't pick would cost

  • Review delivery and reliability with the squad every week (DORA metrics, PR cycle time, uptime, incidents), balance roadmap work against tech debt, and take your turn in the on-call rotation

  • Help hire the people who join the squad, and help shape how the engineering department works beyond it

What you bring:

  • You have 6+ years in software engineering, with at least 2 of them managing engineers with direct reports

  • Your engineering background is senior-level, so you hold your own on code and architecture in a web stack

  • You're curious about users and why the squad builds what it builds. You've shaped a roadmap together with a PM and changed what got built because of something you learned from users or data

  • You've grown engineers to the next level and can point to the conversations, including the hard ones, that got them there

  • You balance empathy with directness: you build strong relationships and still say the hard thing. You stay steady under pressure and can hold an unpopular position when it matters

  • AI is already part of how you work, and you have a clear view on how to bring it into a team

  • You see skill gaps as teachable, in yourself and in every engineer, and you ask for feedback as readily as you give it

  • You get energy from a scale-up, even when it feels like building the plane while flying it, and you're comfortable with uncertainty and change

  • Experience with Ruby on Rails or Ember.js, EdTech or B2B SaaS used at scale, a tech-lead or product-engineer background, or setting up DORA/DX metrics and CI/CD all help, as does an affinity with education

  • Excellent written and spoken English, available full-time

What you get:

  • 25 paid holidays per year

  • A day off for your birthday

  • Advantageous pension scheme

  • 3 days of volunteering leave per year

  • €550 Learning & Development budget per year + 3 days paid leave for learning

  • Travel allowance and Swapfiets subscription

  • Free access to our office gym

  • Unlimited access to mental health support via OpenUp (EU, US, and AUS)

Compensation: €90K – €105K

  • • Annual base salary incl. 8% holiday allowance. Your offer within this range depends on your experience and interview performance: €90K – €105K

title: Engineering Manager (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Following our $35 million Series B in May 2026, we are entering our next stage of growth. We are hiring an Engineering Manager to help scale our product development team, strengthen our technical foundations, and turn complex private-markets problems into reliable, intuitive solutions.

Your primary responsibilities will be ensuring our engineering output delivers tangible customer value, setting technical and architectural direction, and developing the people and team capacity needed to deliver sustainably. You will help shape the next stage of our engineering organisation, with a focus on Product Excellence, clear ownership, and sustainable engineering processes.

Your Role

  • You will be at the core of building the technology that powers bunch: secure, reliable infrastructure that makes private-market operations simpler and more efficient.

  • You will lead a team and have full accountability for delivering solutions that truly solve customer problems, connecting engineering decisions to product outcomes.

  • You will help us scale beyond our Series B by strengthening our architecture, growing our engineers, and building delivery practices that support long-term quality rather than short-term output alone.

You will:

  • Collaborate with Product Management: Actively participate in problem discovery and solution creation, using your technical expertise to shape pragmatic solutions alongside Product and Design.

  • Own capacity management and delivery: Take a proactive role in planning, make priorities and trade-offs explicit, and own your team's output from discovery through release and follow-up. Balance customer impact, delivery predictability, and engineering quality.

  • Drive collaboration across teams: Work closely with other engineering teams and cross-functional partners to manage dependencies and ensure smooth delivery of new features and improvements.

  • Manage our architecture and technical debt: Guide system design, scalability, performance, and maintainability within your team's domain and across shared systems. Make deliberate investment decisions that keep our platform ready for growth.

  • Develop sustainable engineering practices: Establish clear quality standards and practical ways of working that help the team deliver reliably without adding unnecessary process.

  • Support team growth: Coach engineers through regular feedback and development conversations. Ensure they understand the core problems we are solving and how their day-to-day work contributes to customer outcomes and their own growth plans.

About you

To excel as a member of the Product Development team, you should combine a passion for technology with an entrepreneurial mindset and strong problem-solving skills.

  • 3+ years' experience leading engineering teams, with a track record of developing engineers and taking accountability for delivery.

  • A collaborative approach, strong work ethic, and excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • A product-focused mindset: you care about understanding customer problems and can partner with Product and Design to turn them into effective technical solutions.

  • Strong backend development experience with TypeScript or another strongly typed language.

  • Experience with SQL databases and Nest.js or similar web/dependency management frameworks, such as Spring Boot or ASP.NET core

  • A strong understanding of system design principles, scalability, and performance tuning, with sound judgment about architectural trade-offs and technical debt.

  • The ability to create structure in a growing organisation while keeping processes pragmatic and focused on outcomes.

  • Experience with private markets, fintech, highly regulated industries, or document processing is a plus.

Our tech stack

  • Frontend & Backend: TypeScript on both the frontend (Svelte but moving to React) and the backend (Node.js with Nest.js)

  • Database: MySQL

  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (K8S) on top of AWS

Workplace & Benefits

  • Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more)

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Hybrid setup for Berlin-based teammates (3 days/week in office)

  • Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 120+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring process

  • First interview with the People team (30 min): get acquainted with the bunch and to understand if what we’re offering is what you’re searching for

  • Hiring Manager Interview (60 min): this conversation will cover product-focused culture and values, including collaboration, ownership, self-awareness, and quality standards.

  • Technical Interview (60 min): System Design technical conversation with two engineers, we will focus on collaborative problem-solving, starting with open-ended questions and progressing to more specific challenges

  • Leadership Case Interview (60 min): this interview with Product and Design focuses on leadership style, cross-functional collaboration, and delivering strategic impact in a scaling environment.

  • Final Round: Meet our VP of Engineering and VP of Product (60 min) to learn about ways of working, vision for bunch, and team culture.

  • Meet-and-Greet (Optional - 30 min) to meet a few members of your future cross-functional team.

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

At bunch, we're committed to an inclusive environment where diversity is valued and celebrated. We provide equal opportunities to all qualified applicants.

We process personal data in line with applicable laws (including GDPR). See our Privacy Policy for details on your rights and how to reach us.
