Tes futures missions : Le besoin actuel porte sur des missions “grands-comptes” avec des produits et architectures complexes, développées par plusieurs squads de Theodo : - Manager & faire progresser les Tech Leads : tu accompagnes 1 à 4 Tech Leads dans leur montée en compétence et leur épanouissement. - Assurer le delivery technique : tu garantis la qualité du code (3S : stabilité, sécurité, vitesse), la tenue des jalons et la robustesse de l’architecture. - Contribuer au développement business : tu participes aux discussions stratégiques avec nos clients (DSI, sponsors…), tu aides à identifier des opportunités et tu es acteur de l’avant-vente avec nos sales. Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples : - Hub Santé : lancé par l’Agence du Numérique en Santé en 2024, vise à connecter en temps réel les 83 SAMU, SMUR, SDIS et autres acteurs de l’urgence, dans un écosystème historiquement fragmenté. Accompagnée par une équipe de 3 experts Theodo, l’ANS a déployé une plateforme nationale d’interopérabilité permettant une coordination critique plus fluide et sécurisée. Résultats : +10 SAMU connectés dès la phase pilote, interopérabilité effective sur plusieurs périmètres et conformité HDS maintenue. - Vidal : référence centenaire de l’information médicale, a développé avec Theodo un assistant médical basé sur l’IA générative pour fournir aux professionnels de santé des réponses fiables en un temps record et sécuriser la prescription. En 8 semaines, une équipe de 4 experts Theodo a conçu un POC de chatbot RAG connecté à la base Vidal, capable de réduire le temps de recherche tout en garantissant traçabilité et fiabilité des sources. Objectif : renforcer la confiance des praticiens et faire entrer Vidal dans l’ère du service médical “fonctionnel”. Tes perspectives d’évolutions : Perspectives d’évolution moyen terme (1 - 2 ans) : - Manageriale : VP Tech ou Group Manager - Technique : Architecte senior - Business/Influence : Thought Leader (animer une communauté tech) ou Intrapreneur (porter une nouvelle offre) Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu : Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits. Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. Profil recherché : - 7 à 14 ans d’expérience professionnelle, avec une expérience confirmée en management d’équipes tech et en environnement ESN / conseil. - Basé(e) en région parisienne, avec une préférence pour une présence majoritaire au bureau, attendue pour un rôle stratégique et managérial. Hard skills - Solide expertise technologique (Java / Spring Boot et/ou Angular) permettant d’être crédible et légitime auprès des équipes, sans être attendu·e sur le code au quotidien. - Capacité à concevoir des architectures évolutives et à arbitrer des choix techniques dans des contextes grands comptes complexes. - Expérience significative en management d’équipes techniques, avec la capacité à débloquer des Tech - Leads sur des problématiques techniques complexes. - Capacité d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes complexes, avec un impact transverse dans l’organisation. - Intérêt pour l’IA générative et son usage dans la conception et le développement de produits digitaux. Soft skills - Leadership affirmé et posture pédagogique pour embarquer, inspirer et faire progresser des équipes exigeantes. - Orientation marquée business et création de valeur : chez Theodo, nous ne faisons pas de la tech pour la tech. - Aisance relationnelle et communicationnelle, avec la capacité d’adresser tous niveaux d’interlocuteurs, y compris C-level, et de mener des conversations exigeantes. Le process de recrutement : - Call de qualification (30 min) avec un membre de l’équipe recrutement - Cultural fit (1h) avec le même recruteur - Test technique de refactoring (à la maison + débrief 1h) - Entretien modélisation (1h) - Simulation vente d’architecture à un DSI (1h) - Final avec un dirigeant - Prise de référencePourquoi rejoindre Theodo HealthTech ? L’environnement: 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 Prime d’intéressement indexée sur la croissance de Theodo 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile 🧒 Aides et places en crèche réservées Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

title: Engineering Manager - Chat Platform
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Team

World-class customer service is one of the cornerstones. We're about delivering exceptional customer experiences and are looking for someone who understands the power of outstanding support. Someone who thrives on leading an engineering team to excellence and who believes in the importance of effective communication.

Imagine being at the helm of a team dedicated to ensuring every customer interaction is a delight. As an Engineering Manager in this team, you'll have the opportunity to lead a diverse team of engineers who are passionate about building top-notch support products and tools. With your guidance, they'll be empowered to tackle challenges head-on and build a high-load real-time system, crucial to continue supporting the growth of our business.
Location: London, UK. This is a hybrid role, with 3 days a week in the office.

About the Role

You'll be the driving force behind our support operations, leading a cross-functional team across backend, web, and mobile development. Fostering their growth, and ensuring they have the support they need to thrive. Your days will be filled with collaboration, mentorship, and strategic planning as you lead your team through the weekly cycle, create personal development plans, and conduct regular one-on-ones.

But it's not just about leading a team; it's about making an impact. You'll be instrumental in shaping the future of our customer support, working closely with our Product Lead to develop new innovative solutions. And with over 25+ million monthly users counting on us, your contributions will directly impact the experiences of millions around the world.
Get to know our Engineering team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • To thrive in our team, you'll need solid leadership experience collaborating strongly with product teams and business stakeholders.
  • Being flexible and comfortable working with various languages and technologies depending on the task is a big plus.
  • Previous hands-on software development experience in backend is definitely needed.
  • You happen to be a big adept of modern AI tools and stay close to the code.
  • We appreciate candidates who have worked closely with product teams and senior team members, and who can handle stakeholder relationships on the business side.
  • Experience with rollouts and fast-paced production environments is essential.
  • Additionally, having expertise in Kubernetes and AWS would be valuable, as we rely on these technologies for our projects.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Engineering Manager - Compilers
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

The role

Fractile is building a full-stack AI accelerator from the ground up, and the compiler team sits at the heart of how we deliver performance. As the Engineering Manager for Compilers, you will build and lead a team of 10+ engineers developing the compiler stack for our novel AI acceleration hardware, with direct responsibility for enabling industry-leading LLM inference performance on Fractile's accelerators. This is a hands-on technical leadership role in a fast-moving, collaborative environment where the compiler team works closely with hardware, driver, runtime and ML engineers across the stack. If you want to shape the architecture of a compiler from first principles, build a world-class team around it, and have your work directly determine the performance of next-generation AI hardware, this is the role.

What we’re looking for:

  • Proven track record of leadership experience managing a high-performance development team and delivering consistently outstanding outcomes.

  • Proven experience in compiler development, with experience of machine learning compilers and industry standard technologies such as MLIR or TVM being a significant advantage.

  • Up-to-date knowledge of machine learning techniques and technologies

  • A good understanding of computer architecture and performance optimisation techniques.

  • Excellent C/C++ skills and solid experience of industry standard development tools and technologies.

  • A creative and innovative mindset, and a willingness to take ownership and drive results in a fast-paced environment.

What you’re signing up for:

This is a young company doing hard things, at the intersection of novel silicon and the software stack that makes it useful. You'll be building and leading a compiler team as the hardware it targets is still taking shape, which means making architectural decisions against a specification first, then a simulator, then early silicon. The IR design, the lowering strategy, the execution model: you'll help define all of it before you can run it on real hardware. That takes comfort with ambiguity and the ability to make good calls with incomplete information. If that sounds frustrating, this probably isn't the role. If that sounds like the interesting part, we should talk.

The boundaries here are soft by design. The compiler team works closely with hardware architects, kernel engineers, runtime teams and ML researchers. You'll need to understand enough of what sits above and below your layer to make good decisions at the boundary, and to build a team that can do the same. That breadth is a feature of the job, not a distraction from it.

You'll be there when the first model runs end to end on Fractile silicon. When the lowering strategy you helped design produces a result the hardware team didn't think was possible yet. When the team you hired and grew ships something that goes into every rack we sell.

We want a team that reflects the world it's building for, and we welcome applicants from every background, including those whose path here hasn't been straight. We care that you're energised by this kind of work, that you build and develop great engineers, and that you make the people around you better.

Come build it with us.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

 

Export controls

Our work involves technologies subject to UK, US and other international export control regulations. Certain roles may require additional eligibility checks to ensure compliance with applicable law. We'll be transparent about this throughout the hiring process.

title: Engineering Manager - Cx App Foundations
descriptionHtml:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Team

Cx App Foundations is a platform organisation within our global Cx organisation. It provides shared consumer foundations and platform capabilities used by engineering teams across Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo. Within this organisation, the Velocity team owns the paved road for consumer app development across mobile and web: shared SDKs and client foundations, integration patterns and multi-brand customisation, migration playbooks and reference implementations, and developer tooling that makes building on shared foundations fast and safe. Our mission is to reduce the cost, time, and risk of building consumer experiences across platforms and brands. Product teams own customer-facing experiences; our job is to make sure they can spend their time on delivering delightful experiences. The team is AI-native: AI is a default part of how we design, build, and ship software.

About the Role

As the Engineering Manager, you will lead a team of experienced engineers across mobile and web, collaborating closely with product teams, design, and adjacent platform organisations across three brands. Your primary responsibility will be owning the team's roadmap and delivery of shared client foundations, and driving their adoption across the organisation, so that product teams ship delightful customer experiences without rebuilding the foundations under them. You will be a key player in keeping the team's operating model healthy: clear intake from stakeholders, predictable delivery, and support expectations that keep the platform from drifting into a general escalation queue. You will also guide architectural and system design decisions with your tech leads. You will stay hands-on: contributing code, reviews, and prototypes alongside the team is part of the job. This role is ideal for a leader who has run platforms, SDKs, or shared services for other engineering teams, communicates clearly across brands and time zones, and wants their impact measured through what other teams achieve with the foundations you ship.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Own the platform roadmap - the shared SDKs, client foundations, and developer tooling the team ships - and sequence it against the migration and adoption goals of the three brands
  • Drive adoption of the shared foundations by partnering with product teams, running onboarding and rollout support, and making the supported path the easiest path
  • Lead, coach, and grow experienced mobile and web engineers, keeping growth conversations, calibration, and feedback loops running
  • Keep the team's operating model healthy: clear intake (stakeholder management, shared-platform, product-specific, or exception work), supported capabilities with entry criteria and support expectations, and predictable delivery
  • Guide architectural and system design decisions for client foundations that three brands and multiple app platforms depend on
  • Stay hands-on by contributing code and reviews alongside the team, and champion AI-native development practices
  • Grow the team through hiring

Our humble expectations

  • You have 3+ years of experience managing engineers, including a team with senior engineers
  • You have a solid background (5+ years) in mobile or web engineering, with enough technical depth to hold your own in architecture discussions about client foundations
  • You use AI tooling fluently in your day-to-day work and stay close to the code
  • You have run a platform, SDK, or shared service that other teams depend on, and know how to treat internal customers as customers
  • You work across boundaries naturally: product teams, design, other platform organisations, data/analytics and stakeholders in other locations and time zones
  • You hold a high bar for engineering quality and can navigate production incidents and release tradeoffs with calm structure

What we offer

A platform leadership role with real leverage: the foundations the team owns shape how consumer experiences get built across Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo, and your roadmap decisions multiply across every product team that builds on them.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

The compensation will be a combination of monthly pay and DoorDash RSUs. The latter makes it exceptionally easy to be excited about our company growing and doing well, as you'll own a piece of the pie.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: Engineering Manager - Data Platform (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
At AutoScout24, our Data Platform Engineering team builds and operates the AWS-based platform that enables teams across the company to work with data independently. Built around Data Mesh principles, it provides the infrastructure, self-service tooling, and governance that allow domain teams to own and manage their data products. 

 
As Engineering Manager, you'll lead the team responsible for developing and operating this platform. The role combines people leadership with strong technical involvement, from architecture and complex engineering problems to reliability, performance, and cost optimization. 
We're also making AI a native part of how our Data Engineering organization works and how people use our platform. This includes bringing AI directly into the daily workflows of Data Engineers and Analytics Engineers, as well as making the platform more intelligent, easier to use, and more accessible to business users. 
 

What you'll do

  • Build a team that takes ownership, makes sound technical decisions, and delivers independently.
  • Evolve our AWS-based data platform, making decisions around architecture, reliability, performance, security, and cost.
  • Work alongside engineers on complex technical problems, including hands-on implementation when needed.
  • Develop and improve self-service capabilities for data pipelines, dataset discovery, access management, and data quality monitoring.
  • Strengthen our Data Mesh implementation, including domain ownership, data contracts, access controls, and federated governance.
  • Improve data quality, lineage, and observability through automation and platform-level controls.
  • Work closely with Product, Analytics Engineering, Data Governance, and business stakeholders to understand problems and develop solutions.
  • Integrate AI into existing engineering tools and workflows across Data Engineering and Analytics Engineering, improving how teams develop pipelines, build data models, test changes, review code, and troubleshoot failures.
  • Build AI capabilities directly into the data platform, helping users discover and understand datasets, work with data using natural language, investigate issues, and complete tasks that previously required technical knowledge or manual steps. 

What we're looking for 
 

  • 5+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager, with a strong track record of hiring, coaching, and developing engineering teams.
  • Strong software or data engineering background, with recent hands-on technical experience and the ability to contribute to complex engineering decisions.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar. You use these tools extensively in your own engineering work and understand how to use them effectively beyond basic code generation.

title: Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
Engineering Manager

Location: Remote - Europe (CET ±2 hours)

About FullEnrich:

Every go-to-market motion runs on data, but no single provider has ever had complete coverage. We solve that problem: instead of relying on a single data source, we orchestrate 20+ premium providers around the world, automatically querying them and verifying data in real-time until we find the best available contact information. The result is industry-leading coverage and data quality, helping sales and GTM teams connect with the right people faster.

What started as a better way to find emails and phone numbers has grown into a broader vision: becoming the trusted GTM data infrastructure layer powering modern revenue teams and AI agents. Today, more than 6,000 customers, including companies like AWS, Deel, HubSpot, Clay, Intercom, Unify,and Artisan, trust us to power their prospecting and enrichment.

Founded in Paris and now headquartered in San Francisco, we're a team of 50+ people across the US, Europe, LATAM, and Israel, growing quickly and building with speed, ownership, and ambition. That's where you come in.

The Role:

You'll be joining as an Engineering Manager, reporting directly to our VP of Engineering.

As FullEnrich continues to grow, we're investing in the engineering leadership and structure needed to support our next stage of growth. We're looking for someone who combines strong people leadership with technical depth, and who enjoys building high-performing teams, improving how engineers work, and creating the foundations for sustainable growth.

You'll initially lead a multidisciplinary team of up to ten engineers across backend, frontend, and data, taking ownership of their development, performance, and delivery. Working closely with Product Managers and engineering leadership, you'll help translate business priorities into achievable engineering objectives, ensuring teams have the clarity, support, and processes they need to deliver great work.

This is an opportunity to have a real impact on how our engineering organization evolves. As we scale toward 25 engineers, you'll help shape our squad structure, establish effective ways of working, and build an environment where engineers can grow and do their best work. You'll work closely with the VP of Engineering, CTO, and other Engineering Managers, with the autonomy to influence decisions and drive meaningful improvements across the organization.

What You'll Do:

People Leadership & Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop engineers through regular 1:1s, performance management, feedback, and career development.

  • Build a supportive, high-performing team environment where engineers have clear expectations, opportunities to grow, and the autonomy to do their best work.

  • Take ownership of team health, engagement, and retention, proactively identifying and addressing challenges.

Hiring & Team Growth

  • Own the engineering side of hiring for your squads, including defining requirements, setting assessment criteria, interviewing, and making hiring decisions.

  • Develop effective onboarding processes that help new engineers become productive and autonomous quickly.

  • Partner with engineering leadership to shape team structure, squad ownership, and hiring priorities as the organization scales.

Engineering Delivery & Execution

  • Partner with Product Managers to translate product and business priorities into clear engineering objectives, realistic roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.

  • Own engineering delivery across your squads, ensuring work is appropriately scoped, estimated, and delivered with clear accountability.

  • Identify and manage delivery risks, technical dependencies, and competing priorities, keeping stakeholders informed and addressing blockers early.

Engineering Processes & Continuous Improvement

  • Own and continuously improve how your squads operate, using our Discovery → Run lifecycle, inspired by Shape Up, and DORA metrics to measure delivery effectiveness.

  • Establish practical, scalable ways of working that improve predictability, collaboration, and engineering quality without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy.

  • Collaborate with other Engineering Managers and the VP of Engineering to evaluate and improve engineering processes across the wider organization.

Technical Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Provide technical guidance on architectural decisions, engineering trade-offs, and complex delivery challenges, ensuring teams make well-informed decisions.

  • Work closely with Product, Design, Support, Sales, and leadership to align engineering priorities with business needs.

  • Communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly, creating transparency and trust across teams and stakeholders.

Our Tech Stack

Our backend is built in Go (Golang), with Svelte on the frontend, PostgreSQL and OpenSearch for data, and DigitalOcean for cloud infrastructure. We use Docker, GitHub Actions, and Grafana to support deployment, automation, and observability, with a modular hexagonal monolith architecture.

You won't need to be hands-on with every technology, but you'll bring the technical understanding to challenge architectural decisions, navigate trade-offs, and support your engineers in solving complex problems.

What Success Looks Like:

By 3 months

  • You've built a strong understanding of our product, technology, engineering processes, and business objectives, establishing trusted relationships with your engineers and key stakeholders.

  • You've taken ownership of people management across your squads, with regular 1:1s, clear expectations, and an understanding of each engineer's strengths and development needs.

  • You've assessed current delivery practices, team structure, and performance, identifying opportunities to improve collaboration, predictability, and team effectiveness.

By 6 months

  • Your squads are operating with clear objectives, defined ownership, and measurable KPIs aligned with product and business priorities.

  • You've established effective delivery practices, with more predictable planning, proactive risk management, and improved visibility for stakeholders.

  • You've identified team capability gaps and are actively contributing to hiring, onboarding, and the development of engineers across your squads.

  • You're contributing meaningful improvements to engineering processes and organizational structure alongside the wider engineering management team.

By 12 months

  • Your squads consistently deliver against realistic, well-defined roadmaps, with clear accountability, effective collaboration, and measurable improvements in delivery performance.

  • Engineers have clear development paths, receive regular feedback, and feel supported in their growth, contributing to strong engagement and retention.

  • New engineers are onboarding efficiently and becoming productive quickly, supported by established processes and a clear engineering hiring bar.

  • You've helped shape a scalable engineering organization with well-defined squad ownership, effective ways of working, and stronger alignment between Engineering, Product, and the wider business.

  • Stakeholders have confidence in engineering delivery, with transparent communication, reliable planning, and fewer unexpected blockers.

What We're Looking For:

  • Proven experience directly managing and developing software engineers, ideally eight or more across multiple teams, within a growing engineering organization.

  • Demonstrated experience building or scaling engineering teams, including hiring, onboarding, performance management, and supporting engineers' career development.

  • A strong software engineering background with solid architectural fundamentals, enabling you to challenge technical decisions, understand trade-offs, and provide credible guidance.

  • Experience owning engineering delivery, translating product and business objectives into actionable plans, managing dependencies, and driving measurable outcomes.

  • A data-driven approach to engineering management, with experience using delivery metrics and team performance insights to identify and implement improvements.

  • The ability to establish effective engineering processes and ways of working that improve team performance without introducing unnecessary complexity.

  • Strong leadership and organizational skills, with the confidence to create structure, navigate ambiguity, and influence decisions in a scaling environment.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with experience collaborating effectively across distributed teams and cross-functional stakeholders.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience working with Go (Golang) or managing teams building Go-based applications.

  • Familiarity with Shape Up or similar appetite-driven development methodologies.

  • Experience using DORA metrics to measure and improve engineering delivery.

  • Knowledge of Team Topologies and experience shaping squad structures as engineering teams scale.

  • Experience scaling an engineering organization from approximately 10 to 25 engineers.

  • Background in B2B SaaS, data-intensive products, or API-first platforms.

The Hiring Process:

  • Introduction to FullEnrich with our Talent Team (30 mins) - A chance to learn more about you, introduce FullEnrich and the role, and explore whether there's a mutual fit.

  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (45 mins) - A chance for you to meet our VP of Engineering and walk through your background, the teams you've led, what you've built and broken along the way.

  • Engineering management case study (60 mins) - A practical session grounded in a real situation: a hiring decision, a delivery slipping, a process that isn't being followed, a performance conversation.

  • Final Interview with our CEO (45 min) – A chance for you to meet our CEO, Ben and have a conversation around FullEnrich's ambitions, how we work and what we're building together.

Benefits:

Your benefits package will reflect the requirements and market practices of the country in which you're employed, including applicable leave, healthcare, retirement and wellbeing benefits.

Full details will be shared during the hiring process.

FullEnrich is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

title: Engineering Manager, Guardian
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

The Guardian team builds practical safety and oversight systems for increasingly capable AI agents. Our goal is to make it possible for agents to take on longer-running, higher-autonomy work while preserving meaningful safeguards, respecting user intent, and intervening when actions could cause serious or difficult-to-reverse harm.

Auto-review is an early example of this work. When an agent reaches a permission boundary, a separate model evaluates the proposed action in context and determines whether it should proceed. The team is now extending this foundation into more capable oversight systems that account for richer user context, support a broader range of agent experiences, and integrate across OpenAI products.

Guardian sits at the intersection of engineering, alignment research, product, infrastructure, and security. The team already has a strong engineering foundation in London and will continue to grow there as a concentrated, highly collaborative group.

About the Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead and grow the Guardian team in London. You will own the engineering strategy and execution for production systems that evaluate agent behavior, identify risk, and take appropriate action without creating unnecessary friction for users.

This is a builder-manager role with substantial technical depth. You will set direction, develop engineers, and create the operating cadence for a high-performing team, while remaining close enough to the work to shape architecture, review designs, debug difficult problems, and write code when it is the highest-leverage way to help the team move forward.

The role is highly visible and cross-functional. You will work closely with alignment researchers to translate emerging research into dependable systems, and with product teams to make agent safety a foundational capability across OpenAI.

This role is based in our London office.

In this role, you will

  • Lead, hire, and develop a London-based team of engineers working across agent safety, backend systems, applied AI, and product infrastructure.

  • Set the technical roadmap for Auto-review and the broader Guardian platform, balancing safety, product utility, latency, and operational reliability.

  • Build production systems that evaluate agent actions in real time, detect potentially harmful behavior, and support safe recovery or escalation paths.

  • Improve how oversight systems understand user intent, environmental context, permissions, and relevant personalization signals while protecting privacy and avoiding unnecessary friction.

  • Partner closely with alignment researchers to turn prototypes, evaluations, and new monitoring techniques into scalable product capabilities.

  • Work across Product, Security, Infrastructure, and other engineering teams to integrate Guardian capabilities into agent experiences throughout OpenAI.

  • Establish rigorous evaluation and operational practices, including adversarial testing, failure analysis, monitoring, and metrics for safety performance, false positives, latency, and user impact.


You might thrive in this role if you

  • Have significant experience leading engineering teams that shipped complex, high-stakes production systems end to end.

  • Have built with AI agents or large language models in a core product, startup, or technically serious independent project, and understand the unique challenges of agentic systems.

  • Bring strong product-engineering judgment and can navigate tradeoffs across safety, usability, speed, and reliability.

  • Can partner effectively with research teams, translate open-ended findings into engineering plans, and communicate clearly across technical disciplines.

  • Have a thoughtful management system for hiring, coaching, performance, and execution.

  • Care deeply about building AI systems that are useful, trustworthy, and safe.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

descriptionHtml:

The Role: Platform Engineering Manager (Cloud Foundations)

Location: London / Hybrid (2 days per week in office) 

Reporting to: Head of Technology Operations


The Role 

 Rightmove’s Cloud Foundations team delivers the secure, reliable, scalable and cost‑optimised platform foundations used by hundreds of engineers and dozens of mission‑critical services. As we ensure safe, low friction delivery of core services and operate at scale, the Engineering Manager will lead a team providing cloud platforms and infrastructure, cloud security, governance, automation, and operational excellence.  

This position blends people leadership, cloud operations, platform engineering, security governance, and FinOps. The successful candidate brings deep operational experience in product‑led technology companies and understands how to run cloud foundations as a modern internal platform. 

Key Outcomes for This Role 

Strategy, Delivery and Execution 

  • Through working with your team, key stakeholders, and the platform product manager, we provide a cloud platform strategy and roadmap that aligns to Rightmove business goals and our internal customer’s needs.  
  • The team provides accurate estimates and realistic plans. 
  • The platform roadmap, initiatives/projects, and OKRs are well managed and delivered in line with expectations. 

People Leadership & Team Development 

  • Through coaching and mentoring engineers, setting clear, achievable development goals and provides actionable feedback, they improve skills, confidence, and impact. 
  • Individual growth plans align with team objectives and organisational priorities. 
  • Engineers are supported to designing and delivering scalable, secure, resilient platform services without micromanagement. 
  • Achievements are recognised and rewarded, performance issues are addressed early and fairly.  
  • There is an inclusive, psychologically safe environment; with leadership tailored to individual strengths and motivations. 

Platform Engineering, Operations & Reliability 

  • Cloud platform and key services are reliable, incident detection and resolution are smooth due to proactive monitoring, well‑maintained alerts/logs, and complete observability coverage. 
  • Platform resilience and DR planning/testing strategy is defined and operational, working across the business with validated requirements and outcomes. 
  • Backup, restore and resilience mechanisms are regularly tested, ensuring the platform can recover predictably. 
  • Incident management processes are consistently followed, including timely post‑incident reviews (PIRs) and completion of follow‑up actions. 
  • On‑call is well staffed, sustainably operated, and fosters a healthy on‑call culture. 
  • Automation (AI‑driven or traditional) delivers increased speed, reduced toil, and enhanced reliability. 
  • Support requests are triaged and responded to promptly, with prioritisation based on upstream impact. 
  • Capacity and cloud spend are effectively managed—no incidents caused by under‑provisioning, and costs are controlled by avoiding unnecessary over‑provisioning. 
  • Finops culture is embedded with tooling and process across product development teams 
  • Vendor relationships are managed, supplier due diligence is completed on time, contract costs and SLAs are negotiated as needed. 
  • Continuous improvement culture is embedded: teams regularly evaluate performance, reliability and cost efficiency, feeding learnings back into the platform. 

Governance, Guardrails & Security 

  • Infrastructure‑as‑Code, Policy‑as‑Code and automated guardrails accelerate delivery while strengthening governance and consistency across the platform. 
  • Secure software delivery practices and policies are followed, vulnerabilities are managed within SLAs, Platform configuration standards are maintained (CIS Benchmarks). 
  • Cloud security policies, governance standards and privacy controls consistent with predefined roles, least‑privilege IAM patterns and role-based access practices are implemented and followed 
  • The organisation meets regulatory, contractual and audit obligations, maintaining documentation, policies and process evidence for compliance reviews 
  • Secure cloud configurations, WAF policies, bot protection, and cloud‑native security tooling are maintained. 
  • Architecture diagrams for network and key components are maintained for audit, security, knowledge sharing purposes. 

What you’ll bring  

  • Proven experience in cloud operations and platform engineering management, overseeing cloud infrastructure and platforms, monitoring, reliability, and service delivery in production environments. 
  • Previous hands‑on experience running large cloud-based website environments with GKE, service mesh, load balancers, CDN/WAF, Kafka, Elasticsearch. 
  • Strong understanding of cloud services including networking, compute, storage, containerisation, security and IAM. 
  • Experience with IAC, python, Go, CI/CD, Terraform, Kubernetes, modern ops tooling and DevOps workflows. 
  • Demonstrated experience implementing security controls, IAM policies, and cloud governance frameworks.  
  • Familiarity with platform engineering concepts including developer platforms, reusable platform components and enabling internal product teams. 
  • Experience improving operational processes and developing documented procedures (monitoring, DR, incident response, upgrade processes). 
  • Strong leadership, team management, collaboration and communication skills, aligned with expectations for managing technical cloud teams.  
  • Experience designing scalable, reliable cloud platform architectures, consistent with Cloud  

A note from your future manager - "You'll shape the cloud foundations that empower hundreds of engineers to build, deploy and innovate at scale."

descriptionHtml:
Hybrid, based in our London, Bath or Edinburgh office. We are flexible but would like you to be in the office at least once per week.

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

The role

We’re looking for an engineering manager to lead one of our product engineering squads, reporting to an engineering director. As Seccl grows and our platform supports more customer firms and investors, you’ll help your squad deliver the scalable platform capability we need for what comes next.

You’ll build a strong, psychologically safe engineering team where people feel trusted, supported and able to do their best work. You’ll coach and develop engineers, create clarity and help the team maintain high standards while delivering valuable outcomes.

Working closely with your product manager, engineering leaders and teams across Seccl, you’ll help define priorities and keep the squad focused on the right outcomes. You’ll balance delivery pace with engineering quality, security, operational resilience and long-term maintainability.

This role brings together people leadership, delivery and engineering accountability. You’ll stay close enough to the technology to guide and challenge decisions, while giving engineers the ownership and support they need to develop effective solutions.

What you’ll own

  • Building, leading and developing an inclusive, high-performing engineering squad

  • Creating an environment of trust, psychological safety, continual learning and constructive challenge

  • Owning the delivery health of your squad, from priorities and planning through to production readiness, reliability and ongoing maintainability

  • Partnering with product managers to align the squad’s work with customer, commercial, regulatory and platform priorities

  • Guiding technical decisions and helping the team build solutions that are scalable, secure, resilient and well integrated with the wider platform

  • Using metrics, feedback and team insight to improve delivery predictability, system reliability and team effectiveness

  • Recruiting and onboarding engineers while contributing to shared engineering practices and collaboration across Seccl

This role’s for you if...

  • You’re an experienced engineering manager who has led teams working within complex product or technology domains

  • You have a strong track record of hiring, onboarding, coaching and developing engineers

  • You can balance people leadership with delivery accountability and remain close enough to the technology to offer meaningful guidance

  • You have experience with a modern JavaScript and cloud-based technology stack. Our stack includes Node.js, JavaScript and TypeScript, MongoDB, AWS, Lambda and Serverless Framework

  • You communicate clearly and can work effectively with product managers, engineering leaders and senior stakeholders

  • You have recent, practical experience with AI-assisted engineering tools and can help teams use them responsibly to improve delivery, quality and developer effectiveness

  • You care about building secure, scalable and resilient systems. Experience in financial services, fintech, investment platforms or another regulated environment would be valuable

This role isn’t for you if...

  • You’re looking for a purely people-management role. You’ll need enough technical credibility to guide decisions and challenge constructively

  • You want to be the primary technical decision-maker. You’ll create the environment for engineers to own solutions and grow their capability

  • You need priorities to remain fixed. You’ll be leading delivery in a fast-moving environment where plans and business needs can change

  • You prioritise speed at the expense of quality. Delivery pace matters, alongside security, resilience and long-term maintainability

What’s in it for you

We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

  • 💰 £95,000 to £110,000 depending on experience, reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance

  • 🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, your birthday off and paid dependant leave

  • 💙 Two volunteering days each year

  • 🌎 The option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

  • 🌟 Secclbrate, our recognition programme offering flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

  • 🏅 One-month paid sabbatical after eight years

  • 🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

  • 👪 Enhanced parental leave

  • 💻 MacBook and up to £500 towards your home office set-up

  • 📖 £750 annual learning budget

  • 🌻 Health and wellbeing support, including free therapy through Wellness Cloud and mental health support through Headspace

  • 🌱 Financial wellbeing benefits, including Octopus Money, the Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing through Octopus Legacy

  • 🎁 Perkbox, with flexible points and a range of discounts and perks

  • 🚲 Access to Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

Our culture

We put people first and try hard to create an environment where people feel trusted, heard and able to do their best work.

We value openness, curiosity and different perspectives. You’ll have the freedom to challenge how things are done, experiment with better ways of working and take real ownership of your impact.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way process. Our interviews are conversational, with plenty of time for you to get to know us and ask questions too.

  • Initial conversation: a chat with someone from our Talent team about your experience, what you’re looking for and the role

  • System design interview: a 60-minute technical conversation exploring how you approach architecture, trade-offs and complex engineering decisions

  • Leadership interview: a 45-minute conversation focused on people leadership, delivery and cross-functional collaboration

  • Bar raiser: a 45-minute conversation with colleagues from outside the immediate team, focused on our operating principles and how you approach your work

We review applications as they come in and may close the role once we have enough candidates to move forward. We’ll keep you updated throughout.

Everyone’s welcome

We want to build a diverse and inclusive company full of brilliant people with different skills, experiences and perspectives. All applicants will be considered without regard to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran status, neurodiversity or disability.

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you.

title: Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Parallel, we build AI agents to help healthcare facilities automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding.


Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work. Legacy software hasn’t helped, it’s made things slower, more complex, and more frustrating for care teams.

We believe AI agents can change that. Our technology combines Large Language Models with system-level automation to handle real work inside existing hospital tools. No integrations, no disruption.

Our first agent automates coding workflows and frees up time for medical staff to focus on patients.

We launched in 2024, are backed by top investors (Index, Frst, Y Combinator, Hexa, Kima Ventures, Better Angle), and we’re just getting started.

 

The future of healthcare isn’t just digital — it’s automated. Come help us build it !

Context

Parallel closed a $20M Series A with Index Ventures, is deployed in 40+ hospitals, and is scaling fast. Founders Paul Lafforgue (Polytechnique, ex-Meta, ex-McKinsey) and Chris Rydahl (who previously built Hublo, Europe's largest healthcare staffing platform) are based in Paris with the team.

Our tech team is 10 people today, all reporting directly to the CTO — and it will double by 2027. A flat structure got us here, now we need managers who stay close to the code to get us there.

The team is organized in streams, each run by a PM and a Stream Owner: Coding, Extraction, and Activity (activity steering, dashboarding, and our assistant products).

Your mission

  • Directly manage the engineers of your stream (AI Engineers, Software Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers): 1:1s, feedback, growth, performance.

  • Own a stream end to end as its Stream Owner: drive its technical direction and delivery with your PM.

  • Be a hands-on leader. Expect roughly 50% hands-on / 50% management — a bit more hands-on in your first months.

  • Be responsible for your squad's tech culture: code quality, rituals, standards, knowledge sharing.

  • Onboard new engineers and be the relay when the team changes hands.

  • Work daily with PMs, Ops and the other Stream Owners to keep priorities aligned.

Outcomes

  • In your first months, you are a trusted Stream Owner: you know your stream's code, clients and roadmap inside out.

  • Your team ships reliably and at pace, and every engineer knows what's expected of them and how they're growing.

  • New hires are productive fast, thanks to the onboarding and culture you put in place.

  • Over time, your role grows beyond one stream: you help shape how the whole tech org scales.

This job is for you if

  • You have 5+ years of experience, including at least 2 years managing an engineering team.

  • You've managed 4–5+ people and owned both their performance and the people side (feedback, growth, tough conversations).

  • Your background is strong full-stack software engineering or data — and you still love building.

  • You've worked in startups or scale-ups and thrive in a fast, high-ownership environment.

  • You see management as a way to have more impact, not as a title: you're happy to own a stream and write code.

  • You are autonomous and pragmatic: done beats perfect at this stage.

  • You are French-speaking.

Hiring process

  1. A quick call with our recruiter (30 min)

  2. A conversation with Chris, our CTO (30 min)

  3. A case study at our Paris office, covering both management and technical judgment. combined with a meeting with Paul, our CEO. (2h in total + preperation)

  4. Reference checks

Why should you join us?

  • Real traction: Seed and Series A closed in under a year, with Index Ventures on the cap table.

  • A problem worth solving: cutting hospital admin gives time back to care teams.

  • A different technical approach: agents that work on existing systems without heavy integration.

  • A team that has done it before: the founders built and scaled Hublo, and worked at Meta and McKinsey. High standards, low ego.

  • Real ownership: you'll be our first Engineering Manager and shape how the tech team scales from 10 to 20+.

  • Competitive salary and equity, premium health insurance (Alan), Swile meal vouchers, latest Apple equipment, and an office in Paris (Strasbourg Saint-Denis).

   

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

About the role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Codeless, our internal Server-Driven UI (SDUI) platform team. In this role, you will lead a cross-functional team bridging mobile/web frontend engineering and core platform backend systems.

While this role is deeply rooted in modern UI architecture, its mission goes beyond standard UI development: Codeless empowers product teams across the organization to ship dynamic, native UI experiences dynamically from the backend—eliminating app store release bottlenecks, dramatically accelerating feature iteration, and establishing a unified UI schema across iOS, Android, and Web.

  • Team Leadership & Strategy: Build, mentor, and scale an engineering team responsible for our core Server-Driven UI platform ("Codeless"). Foster an inclusive, high-ownership engineering culture.

Engineering Management: 3+ years of experience managing software engineering teams, with a track record of coaching engineers, delivering complex platform initiatives, and driving technical strategy.

descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

Engineering Managers at Lendable are a unique group of amazing humans that combine strategic insight, hands-on technical leadership, and strong people management to shape and evolve our engineering teams. They operate at the convergence of business goals, technical execution, and team coaching, ensuring that every project and process aligns seamlessly with our mission and values. They build a resilient foundation for sustained success by focusing on team growth and technical innovation.

We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead one of the teams delivering our Zable App, used by over 1 million customers on iOS and Android. In this role, you’ll act as both a visionary and a hands-on leader, driving the team’s delivery efficiency, technical excellence, and cross-functional collaboration. You’ll own and refine the delivery process, balancing feature development with technical investments and maintaining high team development standards. With a proactive approach, you’ll guide the team to meet our business goals while nurturing a collaborative and growth-oriented culture.

There’s much to accomplish as an Engineering Manager at Lendable. You’ll help create a high-performing, resilient team that achieves today’s objectives while building a foundation for long-term success. From enhancing delivery quality to developing a robust, valuable platform, your work will ensure we deliver impactful solutions that meet the needs of our customers and stakeholders alike.

Our Tech Stack

The backend of our Zable app is Kotlin, AWS & GraphQL and the frontend is React Native with TypeScript, and NextJS. Across the rest of Lendable we also use PHP 8, Symfony, MySQL, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes, React, ArgoCD, Behat, PHPUnit, Jest, and Maestro.

How you'll have an impact

  • Own and optimise the delivery process to ensure features reach customers efficiently, contributing directly to quarterly and yearly OKRs focused on customer satisfaction and delivery timelines.

  • Collaborate with Product Managers to balance feature development with technical improvements, achieving a sustainable pace for the team that aligns with business outcomes.

  • Build and develop a high-performing team by conducting regular assessments, cross-training, and implementing clear career progression pathways, supporting team resilience and adaptability.

  • Drive technical strategy in alignment with business goals, using insights from Tech Leads and senior engineers to make strategic trade-offs between short-term deliverables and long-term technical investments.

  • Ensure high-quality output by establishing best practices in quality assurance and incident management, tracking metrics such as uptime and incident reduction in the team’s area.

  • Facilitate cross-team collaboration to align on shared objectives and integrated roadmaps, ensuring seamless workflows and supporting key OKRs across dependent teams.

  • Embed continuous feedback within the team culture, fostering an environment of continuous improvement and aligning the team’s performance with organisational goals.

What we're looking for

  • A degree in Computer Science or relevant experience in software engineering and technical management.

  • 5+ years of experience in engineering leadership, with a strong track record in driving delivery processes, team development, technical strategy, and cross-team collaboration.

  • Strong understanding of the mobile app development process and experience managing cross functional backend and frontend teams in an environment with dependencies on other business areas.

  • Demonstrated ability to balance feature delivery with technical improvements, ensuring a sustainable and high-quality pace for the team.

  • Strong business acumen and a proactive approach to gaining deep business context, enabling alignment of technical decisions with broader business goals.

  • Proven experience in owning delivery timelines and quality outcomes, with the ability to identify and resolve bottlenecks quickly and efficiently.

  • Skilled in building high-performing teams, with experience in skills assessment, cross-training, and fostering a continuous learning and improvement culture.

  • Ability to strategically guide technical decisions without being a blocker, with familiarity in technical debt management, architectural planning, and quality assurance best practices.

  • Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with experience facilitating joint planning and maintaining alignment across multiple teams and stakeholders.

  • Proficiency in managing incidents and on-call processes, ensuring platform robustness and reliability.

Interview process

  • A quick phone call with someone from the People Team

  • An Introductory call to the role with either one of our Senior EM's or one of our VP's of Engineering

  • Three onsite interviews:

    • Delivery Management and Team Collaboration

    • Technical Interview (don’t worry, we won't ask you to code)

    • People and Team management

  • One last interview with someone from the senior leadership team.

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

title: Engineering Manager - Unified Platform
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Team

The Unified Privacy Platform team's mission is to earn the trust of every DoorDash user by upholding their right to privacy, consent, and transparency. We are building a common privacy foundation across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo so Consumers, Dashers, and Merchants can understand how their data is used, control their choices, and exercise their privacy rights through simple, consistent experiences.

Our work is organized around three connected pillars: the Privacy Center, a unified user-facing destination for privacy controls and rights; the Unified Privacy Platform, which captures and enforces consent, policy, jurisdictional requirements, and privacy actions; and Privacy Operations and Intelligence, which gives Legal, Support, Privacy, and engineering operators the workflows, diagnostics, audit history, and automation needed to resolve privacy work safely and efficiently.

Together, these capabilities turn fragmented, one-off compliance work into reusable platform primitives that can support new products, brands, and emerging regulations.

Location: London, UK. This is a hybrid role, with 3 days a week in the office.

About the Role

DoorDash is looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the Unified Privacy Platform team. You will lead a team of backend and platform engineers responsible for the next generation of privacy and consent infrastructure, including the Privacy Center, the User Consent Platform, privacy-policy decisioning, self-service data-rights experiences, and the operational tooling required to manage privacy cases at global scale.

As the Engineering Manager, you will own and execute a multi-year vision for privacy at DoorDash. You will balance legal and regulatory correctness, user trust, security, reliability, and developer velocity while building systems that work consistently across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. You will be a strategic partner to Product, Legal, Security, Data Governance, Marketing and Communications, and engineering leadership, establishing clear ownership boundaries and turning complex privacy requirements into scalable, self-service capabilities.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Lead and mentor a high-performing team of backend and platform engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, privacy by design, operational excellence, and thoughtful cross-functional partnership
  • Drive the technical strategy across the Privacy Center, the Unified Privacy Platform, and Privacy Operations and Intelligence
  • Build the cross-brand User Consent Platform, including canonical consent state, policy and configuration management, consent SDKs, audit history, and consistent enforcement across products and jurisdictions
  • Deliver simple, self-service experiences for consent and communication preferences, Right to be Forgotten (RTF), Right to Information (RTI), and Data Subject Access Requests (DSARs)
  • Turn emerging privacy and regulatory requirements into standardized platform capabilities instead of one-off product implementations
  • Lead the migration from fragmented legacy consent systems to a single source of truth across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo, while managing compatibility and safe deprecation
  • Define clear contracts with data-governance fulfillment systems and downstream product and storage teams so privacy actions are traceable, retryable, auditable, and correctly reflected back to users and operators
  • Provide architectural guidance for distributed systems that manage sensitive user choices, policy evaluation, orchestration, secure data delivery, reporting, and immutable audit trails
  • Partner with recruiting to build a diverse and inclusive team, attracting and retaining exceptional engineering talent

We're excited about you because you have…

  • A bachelor's, master's, or doctoral degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 3+ years of experience in people management leading backend or platform teams
  • 8+ years of industry experience
  • Extensive experience as an engineer or engineering leader in a fast-paced, platform-focused development environment
  • Proven experience designing large-scale distributed systems, service application programming interfaces (APIs), policy or rules engines, workflow orchestration, state machines, data-lifecycle systems, or audit architectures
  • Preferred experience with privacy, consent, data governance, or regulatory systems, including concepts such as the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA), data-subject rights, retention, deletion, and legal holds
  • The ability to translate ambiguous legal, policy, and product requirements into clear platform boundaries, reusable abstractions, and executable roadmaps
  • Strong product sense and the ability to partner effectively with Legal, Product, Design, Security, Data, Marketing, Support, and engineering teams across multiple brands and geographies
  • A growth mindset—you are eager to expand your skills, raise the quality bar, and build enduring systems in a rapidly changing environment

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!
