Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We are looking for Fullstack Engineer to help QVAC application teams develop, review, test, and deliver reliable software with less friction. Your focus will be our desktop and mobile applications and their shared runtime, AI harness, and skills packages. You will build and maintain developer tools, integrate AI agents into engineering workflows, and improve code quality and delivery automation.

This is a hands-on engineering role with room to shape the tooling roadmap. You will work with engineers to identify useful improvements and own them from implementation through adoption and ongoing support. Success means shorter feedback loops, dependable automation, and tools that developers trust and use.

Responsibilities

  • Evaluate, integrate, and maintain developer tools and AI agents, including the repository guidance and integrations they need to work effectively.

  • Build and operate agents in CI and scheduled workflows that investigate failures, propose fixes, and give engineers evidence they can act on.

  • Improve automated pull request reviews, evaluating finding accuracy and reducing noise for reviewers.

  • Develop code quality scripts and checks for complexity, function and file size, dependency cycles, and performance regressions. Work with package owners on practical thresholds and targeted refactoring.

  • Improve development environments, testing, and build and release workflows so engineers and agents can verify changes reliably.

  • Prioritize improvements with engineering teams, support adoption through documentation and onboarding, and measure effectiveness, reliability, and operating costs.

Example projects include agents that investigate CI failures, diagnose compatibility and performance regressions, and flag changes that affect package interfaces or architecture. You will choose and refine these workflows with the engineers who use them.


  • Experience building and maintaining developer tools or engineering automation used by others, with strong JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js skills.

  • Hands-on experience using and integrating AI coding tools or agents, with sound judgment about their limitations, output validation, and human review.

  • Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, and systematic debugging of build, test, or integration failures.

  • A strong approach to code quality: maintainable code, useful automated checks, and refactoring that preserves behavior.

  • Ability to work independently, collaborate with engineers, and communicate clearly in English within a remote, globally distributed team.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: Functional Safety Engineer - Fuel Cell Systems
descriptionHtml:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To help achieve our vision of a decarbonised future we are seeking a Functional Safety Engineer to embed safety into our fuel cell systems, leading hazard analysis and safety engineering across hardware, software and controls to ensure our products are safe, compliant and certifiable.

This role requires full-time, on-site presence at our Nyon, Switzerland office. We're not able to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be prepared to relocate.

 

Key Responsibilities:

• Own the functional safety lifecycle for fuel cell systems from concept to release

• Lead hazard and risk analyses (HARA, HAZOP, FMEA/FMEDA, FTA) and define safety goals

• Derive safety requirements and concepts and allocate them across hardware, software and controls

• Define/verify safety mechanisms, diagnostics and safe states with the controls and embedded teams

• Perform safety analyses and calculations (SIL/PL/ASIL determination, metrics, PFH/PFD)

• Compile safety cases, safety plans and supporting documentation for certification

• Interface with notified bodies, certification authorities and customers on safety topics

• Promote a strong safety culture and coach teams on functional safety practices

 

Skills and Experience Required:

• BSc/MSc in electrical, electronic, mechatronic, control or safety engineering is mandatory

• Minimum 3-5 years of functional safety experience in industrial, energy or hydrogen systems

• Working knowledge of safety standards (ex. IEC 61508, ISO 13849, ISO 26262 and/or IEC 62061)

• Hands-on experience with HARA, FMEA/FMEDA, FTA and safety requirements engineering

• Understanding of safety-related hardware, embedded software and control architectures

• Familiarity with hydrogen, high-voltage or pressure system safety is a strong plus

• Team player able to work autonomously with internal and external experts

• Excellent spoken and written English is mandatory; French/German is a plus

• Functional safety certification (e.g. TÜV FSEng) is a plus

 

Start date: Immediately

title: Functioneel applicatiebeheerder Backend Platform
descriptionHtml:
Bouw jij mee aan betrouwbaar functioneel beheer voor applicaties die onze collega’s dagelijks nodig hebben?

Wie ben jij

Je vindt het leuk om je vast te bijten in applicaties en processen en neemt technische kennis mee. Wanneer een gebruiker met een vraag of probleem komt, wil jij niet alleen weten hoe je het oplost, maar ook begrijpen waar het vandaan komt.

Je beweegt gemakkelijk tussen business en IT. Je kunt met een gebruiker praten over een bedrijfsproces en vervolgens met technische collega's of een leverancier bepalen wat er nodig is om een probleem op te lossen of een verbetering te realiseren.

Daarnaast kijk je verder dan je eigen applicatie. Je begrijpt dat systemen steeds meer met elkaar verbonden zijn en houdt daarom rekening met afhankelijkheden binnen de gehele keten.

We vinden het belangrijk dat je:

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau hebt, bij voorkeur met een relevante opleiding;

  • ervaring hebt met applicatiebeheer of een vergelijkbare functie;

  • affiniteit hebt met bedrijfsprocessen en informatiesystemen;

  • gebruikersvragen en problemen kunt analyseren en vertalen naar effectieve oplossingen;

  • ervaring hebt met het testen en implementeren van wijzigingen;

  • oog hebt voor de samenhang tussen applicaties, processen en IT-ketens;

  • ervaring hebt met Agile werken;

  • initiatief neemt, verantwoordelijkheid pakt en proactief handelt;

  • helder communiceert en gemakkelijk samenwerkt met gebruikers, IT-collega's en leveranciers.

Ervaring met applicaties of processen binnen Finance, Verzekeringen of HR is een pré. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan CODA, Crescendo, QIS of AFAS. Je hoeft ze zeker niet allemaal te kennen. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je ervaring hebt met applicatiebeheer en je nieuwe applicaties en bedrijfsprocessen snel eigen kunt maken.

Wat ga je doen

Als Functioneel Applicatiebeheerder ben jij een belangrijke schakel tussen gebruikers, de business, IT-teams en leveranciers. Je zorgt ervoor dat applicaties en IT-diensten betrouwbaar functioneren en dat gebruikers goed worden ondersteund. Je werkt aan zowel de dagelijkse operatie als aan de verdere professionalisering van het beheer. Afhankelijk van jouw kennis, ervaring en de behoefte binnen Backend Platform kun je bijvoorbeeld werken aan applicaties binnen Finance, Verzekeringen of HR.


Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • functioneel beheren en ondersteunen van één of meerdere bedrijfskritische applicaties;

  • behandelen en analyseren van functionele vragen, incidenten en verstoringen;

  • bewaken van de goede werking en continuïteit van applicaties;

  • analyseren van gewenste wijzigingen en bepalen wat deze betekenen voor de applicatie en de omliggende keten;

  • afstemmen met gebruikers, leveranciers en IT-collega's over problemen, oplossingen en verbeteringen;

  • ondersteunen bij het realiseren en implementeren van wijzigingen;

  • voorbereiden, coördineren en uitvoeren van functionele en ketentesten;

  • bewaken dat wijzigingen correct en beheerst in gebruik worden genomen;

  • signaleren van mogelijkheden om processen, applicaties en het gebruik daarvan verder te verbeteren;

  • vastleggen en delen van kennis over applicaties, processen en werkwijzen.

Wat bieden wij

Bij Univé IT bieden we je een uitdagende functie binnen een dynamische organisatie, waarin je veel ruimte krijgt om mee te bouwen aan professioneel en toekomstgericht applicatiebeheer.

  • Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, eigenaarschap en vakinhoudelijke ontwikkeling.

  • Nauwe samenwerking met ervaren collega’s binnen IT, architectuur, security en waardestromen.

  • De mogelijkheid om actief bij te dragen aan de verdere professionalisering van IT Kern.

  • Ruimte om mee te denken over marktontwikkelingen, automatisering en de inzet van AI binnen Unive en IT.

Arbeidsvoorwaarden

  • Jaarsalaris van € 51.777 tot € 71.907 bruto per jaar op basis van 38 uur, inclusief vakantiegeld en dertiende maand en exclusief variabele beloning;

  • Dienstverband van 32 tot 38 uur per week;

  • Standplaats Zwolle of Assen, met hybride werken in overleg met het team;

  • Een contract voor bepaalde tijd met uitzicht op een vast contract;

  • 13e maand en 8% vakantiegeld;

  • Variabele collectieve prestatiebeloning van maximaal 9% van het jaarsalaris;

  • 26 vakantiedagen bij een 38-urige werkweek;

  • Goede pensioen- en studiekostenregeling;

  • Thuiswerk- en reiskostenvergoeding;

  • Korting op schade- en zorgverzekeringen bij Univé.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die dicht bij haar leden staat. Als IT-organisatie werken we aan een wendbaar, betrouwbaar, veilig en toekomstgericht IT-landschap. Schaalbare technologie, goede processen, standaardisatie en continu verbeteren zijn daarbij belangrijk. Binnen IT Kern werken verschillende teams aan het beheren, ondersteunen en doorontwikkelen van applicaties, platformen, infrastructuur, netwerkdiensten en securityoplossingen. Deze IT-diensten zijn essentieel voor onze dagelijkse dienstverlening aan leden en voor de ondersteuning van onze collega’s. Samen bouwen we aan een moderne IT-organisatie waarin we betrouwbaar functioneren, waardestromen goed worden ondersteund en vernieuwing gecontroleerd en toekomstbestendig kan plaatsvinden. Je komt terecht in een team waarin samenwerking, eigenaarschap en plezier in het werk belangrijk zijn. We werken met collega’s die graag verbeteren, verantwoordelijkheid nemen en elkaar helpen om het applicatie- en IT-landschap iedere dag een stukje beter te maken.

title: Genesis-World: Core Physics Engineer
descriptionHtml:
What we're building

Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future.

Genesis-World is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI. One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Nyx, our in-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real-time photo-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state-of-the-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available (paper). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact (paper) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise.

Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright.

This is at the core of Genesis AI's strategy. Evaluation is the bottleneck of scalable robotics: real hardware caps iteration at wall-clock time, but simulation turns it into a compute problem. Ours already runs two orders of magnitude faster than hardware (tens of thousands of episodes in half an hour instead of 200+ hours), while correlating with on-hardware rollouts at 89%. The north star: physical AI that improves at the speed of compute.

The role

You push the physics of Genesis-World forward. The mandate is clear: ship production-ready simulation capabilities that matter for the company's internal needs. Research applied end-to-end, from algorithm to merged, tested, documented code that real robot-learning pipelines depend on. Occasional groundbreaking research happens, notably through academic collaborations. But the core of the job is making the engine measurably better along five axes:

  • Speed. Algorithms that are not only faster but also smart enough to spend compute only where it matters across both time and space: larger stable timesteps, selective fidelity (adaptive across scales or simply hand-set), structure-aware solvers.

  • Completeness. No physics off limits: water, human animation, air flow, gravel, tendons, even body organs. Whatever the next use-case needs, the engine grows to cover it.

  • Fidelity. More realistic models: contact, friction, deformation, energy, actuation, materials…

  • Versatility. Extensible multi-physics without compromise on realism: all solvers in the scene coupled together at once, two-way and constraint-based. Write your own solver and it joins the scene like a native one, growing into an open solver ecosystem.

  • Scalability. From workstation to factory scale, and one day, city scale: thousands of interacting entities, batched across environments, without losing physical soundness.

Our ambition is to establish Genesis-World as the go-to simulator for physical AI, from companies and research labs to individuals.

The problems waiting for you

  • Every fidelity for every physics. The same physics at every point of the speed-accuracy spectrum, from heavily batched training with XPBD or VBD to final validation with IPC. Same scene, same API, pick your tradeoff.

  • Invent physics level-of-detail (LOD). Rendering has had LOD for decades, physics is still waiting. Simulate at full fidelity what agents interact with and see, coarsely what they do not.

  • Heterogeneous environments. Every parallel world can hold a completely different model: different bodies, joints, and collision geometries.

  • Adaptive timesteps per island. Error-based control with Runge-Kutta Dopri5, and Time-of-Impact stepping during collision detection, as done in Jiminy.

  • Couple everything, exactly. Efficient and accurate two-way constraint-based coupling between heterogeneous grey-box solvers, using state-of-the-art methods like ADMM. Owning every solver in the stack is what makes it possible.

  • More scalable constraint solvers. Push rigid constraint solving beyond its current scalability ceiling (reference).

  • Unify contact resolution. Hydro-elastic compliance, unilateral constraints, and sequential impulses in the same framework, ideally under one generic formulation.

  • Closed kinematic loops without constraints. Handle loops intrinsically for numerical stability and speed, in the spirit of Kamino.

Day to day: you write your physics in plain Python and Quadrants makes it fast on every backend. And you validate it the hard way: analytical closed forms, other engines, real-world data.

Who you are

You are a physicist and an engineer at once. You judge a method by whether it holds up in production at real scale, and you do not stop until it does. No blind spots: you relentlessly hunt down even the defect that looks insignificant, because it never is.

  • A strong background in physics-based simulation, preferably related to robotics: RBD, FEM, MPM, SPH, IPC, XPBD, VBD, ABD, plus constrained optimization and numerical integration of stiff systems.

  • A track record of shipping simulation code that others rely on, in an engine, in industry, or in a research codebase used beyond its authors.

  • Solid HPC programming (CPU and/or GPU), and an instinct for what makes a numerical method fast in practice, beyond complexity classes.

  • Rigor in validation: analytical closed forms, cross-engine consistency, real-world data.

Bonus points: publications in simulation, graphics, or robotics venues (SIGGRAPH, ICRA, IROS, CoRL, RSS). Contributions to an open-source physics engine.

title: Genesis-World: Core Simulation Engine Engineer
descriptionHtml:
What we’re building

Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future.

Genesis-World is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI. One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Nyx, our in-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real-time photo-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state-of-the-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available (paper). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact (paper) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise.

Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright.

This is at the core of Genesis AI’s strategy. Evaluation is the bottleneck of scalable robotics: real hardware caps iteration at wall-clock time, but simulation turns it into a compute problem. Ours already runs two orders of magnitude faster than hardware (tens of thousands of episodes in half an hour instead of 200+ hours), while correlating with on-hardware rollouts at 89%. The north star: physical AI that improves at the speed of compute.

The role

Simulation is still a hard sell in robotics. Outside a few success stories, like reinforcement learning for locomotion, most teams skip it, and friction is a big part of why: painful to use, painful to debug. We live that pain ourselves: debugging a failing experiment during policy evaluation takes 30 minutes, and there is no way to automatically generate a standalone reproduction script. That blocks adoption, even internally.

Your job is to kill that friction. You build the software engineering backbone of Genesis-World: everything that makes a large, fast-moving simulation codebase reliable, maintainable, frictionless. And it all ships in the open. Every hour of pain you remove, you remove for every roboticist who comes after you.

You join as core maintainer of Genesis-World, with shared stewardship of the whole platform from day one. Our physics team develops the algorithms, but just as importantly, you work to make everything around them excellent: infrastructure, tooling, APIs, architecture.

The problems waiting for you

  • Make testing of a JIT-compiled engine scalable. Running our full suite is already taking hours because the ratio between compile time and runtime can be as bad as x10. Getting rid of this bottleneck is a serious challenge that will require a joint effort from the Genesis-World and the compiler teams.

  • Make any bug reproducible. Dump and reload simulations bit-exactly, across machines, across backends, even when a single timestep of a batched simulation can already max out VRAM. Turn any failing run into a standalone reproduction script, automatically.

  • Make autodiff first-class. Genesis-World is differentiable today, but partially: memory-hungry, slower than it could be, and hard to maintain due to manual operation recording. The project spans the engine and the compiler: you drive the requirements on Quadrants and iterate in a tight loop with the compiler team until the integration is solid.

  • Edit scenes at frozen time. See the scene, move entities and robots around, iterate on layout, all without building the scene or compiling the engine. Authoring today means a full build cycle. Make it instant.

  • Make the simulator extensible. First-class plugins for physics solvers and interactive viewer backends, including Nyx. Sensors already work this way. Generalize it, and Genesis-World becomes a platform others build on.

  • Give robots real actuation. Motors and MIMO transmissions, cleanly abstracted at the interface between users and the physics engine.

  • Make time a local variable. Today the clock and the timestep are global to the engine, which forbids whole classes of speedups: environments cannot step independently, the timestep cannot adapt to the state, and individual solvers cannot advance at their own rate. Free the clock down to the sub-scene level and let the simulation fly.

  • Make scenes come alive. Events triggered by physics: press the button and the microwave door pops open, squeeze the trigger and the drill spins.

  • Keep the core sharp. Refactoring legacy subsystems, stronger typing, consistent coding style, less Python overhead on hot paths, full scene serialization, telemetry and replay.

Beyond the code: you review issues and pull requests with the core team, answer questions from users and contributors, and can join the push on adoption.

Who you are

You care about the engineer using what you build as much as the thing itself. A slow test, a cryptic error, a manual step: you see it, you go after the root cause, and you remove it for everyone. You have opinions about API design.

You are comfortable with physics and robotics: the right design choices take a working picture of what a simulator like Genesis-World does, how it works, and how it is used, a picture you can partly build on the job.

  • Strong Python engineering on large codebases: architecture, refactoring, typing, packaging, performance profiling (py-spy, Nsight, Xcode Instruments, RenderDoc).

  • Developer tooling, test infrastructure, or CI at scale.

  • Enough fluency with JIT compilation, code generation, or GPU computing stacks to reason about compilation caching, kernel dispatch, and startup cost. You will work closely with Quadrants.

  • At ease debugging across the full platform matrix: Windows, Linux, and macOS, on x86 and arm64, over CUDA, AMD, and Apple Metal (and possibly Intel XPU via Vulkan soon)

  • Open-source reflexes: triaging issues, reviewing external pull requests, communicating with a community.

Bonus points: experience with other robotics simulators (Drake, MuJoCo, Newton, Isaac, RaiSim, Jiminy, Brax). PyTorch, our user-facing interface. Other JIT compilers such as Triton, JAX, or Numba. 3D tooling and interactive editors (Maya, Blender, Houdini). Serialization formats (USD, glTF, MJCF/URDF). C++, CUDA, or Metal. Developer relations or community work.

Plus de 400 marketplaces nous font confiance. Nous gérons 1,4 million de portefeuilles utilisateurs et avons levé 50 M€ auprès de Breega, SpeedInvest et Toscafund.

Rentable depuis quatre ans et en croissance de +25 % en 2025, Lemonway vise à rester parmi les leaders du paiement en Europe grâce à une croissance saine et durable.

  • Secteur : FinTech / Paiements en ligne

  • Localisation : Paris, France (Quartier du Sentier, 2e arrondissement)

  • Télétravail : Jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine (au choix)

Le poste

Lemonway est à la recherche de son prochain Gestionnaire Cash Management en stage pour renforcer son équipe actuelle et accompagner sa croissance.

Il s'agit d'une opportunité unique de rejoindre une fintech ambitieuse dans le secteur du paiement en constante évolution.

Les principales responsabilités

Au sein de l’équipe Cash Management et sous la supervision d’un Senior, tu interviendras sur plusieurs aspects du flux des paiements.

Tes missions incluront notamment :

  • Participer à la gestion quotidienne de la trésorerie : suivi des soldes bancaires, cash pooling et prévisions de trésorerie.

  • Contribuer aux rapprochements bancaires et à la réconciliation des flux de paiement.

  • Assurer le suivi des retours de fonds et des rejets de virements, identifier les anomalies et participer aux actions correctives.

  • Apporter un support opérationnel dans la gestion des incidents liés aux flux de paiement.

  • Être en relation avec les partenaires bancaires et les équipes internes pour le suivi des flux de paiement sortants.

  • Participer aux contrôles mensuels, au reporting opérationnel et aux analyses ponctuelles.

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus et à la mise à jour de la documentation.


  • Tu es étudiant(e) en fin de cycle ou en année de césure (Bac+4/5) en Master Finance, Banque ou équivalent

  • Tu portes un intérêt pour l’univers du paiement, des fintechs et/ou de la gestion de trésorerie

  • Tu as une première connaissance des systèmes de paiement (SEPA, SWIFT, Instant Payments, Visa, Mastercard)

  • Tu maîtrises le Pack Office

  • Tu t’exprimes couramment en Français et tu es capables d’échanger en Anglais

  • Tu es reconnu pour ta rigueur, ton organisation, ton sens du détail et ta proactivité

  • Tu es doté d’un fort esprit d’analyse et tu as une forte capacité à résoudre des problèmes

  1. Entretien RH avec Sabina

  2. Test de personnalité – Assessfirst

  3. Entretien avec Gaëtan, Head of Payment Operations et un membre de l’équipe

Ce qu’on te propose

  • Accès à Gymlib

title: GIS Systemarchitekt (m/w/x) – ArcGIS Enterprise
descriptionHtml:
Die VertiGIS Unternehmensgruppe entwickelt Softwarelösungen für Geografische Informationssysteme (GIS). Wir sind führender Lösungsanbieter in den Bereichen Energieversorgung, Wasserwirtschaft, Landmanagement, Behörden, Infrastruktur, Facility Management und Telekommunikation. Unsere Produkte helfen Unternehmen, Netze, Anlagen und Prozesse effizient zu planen, zu verwalten und zu optimieren – weltweit im täglichen Einsatz.

Als GIS Systemarchitekt konzipieren, dimensionieren, installieren und konfigurieren Sie ArcGIS-Enterprise-Umgebungen für Utility-Kunden. Sie beraten Kunden zu On-Premises-, Cloud- und hybriden Szenarien und übernehmen im laufenden Betrieb HealthChecks, Wartungen und Aktualisierungen.

Die Aufgaben

Konzeption und Kundenberatung

  • Dimensionierung von ArcGIS-Enterprise-Umgebungen anhand der erwarteten Systemlast bei Utility-Kunden

  • Vergleich von On-Premises-, Cloud- und hybriden Betriebsszenarien

  • Beratung der Kunden in Präsentationen und Workshops sowie Erstellung technischer Entscheidungsvorlagen

Installation und Konfiguration

  • Installation und Konfiguration von ArcGIS Enterprise und VertiGIS-Komponenten in Kunden- und Managed-Services-Umgebungen

  • Systemhärtung und Beratung zu erforderlichen Netzwerkfreischaltungen

  • Erstellung von Systemskizzen und Installationsdokumentationen für die Übergabe in den Betrieb

Betrieb und technische Abstimmung

  • HealthChecks und Fehleranalysen an laufenden ArcGIS-Enterprise-Umgebungen

  • Planung und Umsetzung von Wartungen und Aktualisierungen

  • Technische Abstimmung der ArcGIS-Enterprise-Umgebung im Projekt sowie Aufbereitung technischer Inhalte für Kundenangebote und Ausschreibungen


  • Erfahrung mit ArcGIS Server und ArcGIS Portal im Umfeld von ArcGIS Enterprise

  • Erfahrung mit der Installation und Konfiguration von ArcGIS Enterprise

  • Grundlegende Kenntnisse in Netzwerk- und Security-Anforderungen für ArcGIS-Enterprise-Umgebungen

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch C1, Englisch B2

Wünschenswert

  • Erfahrung in der Dimensionierung von ArcGIS-Enterprise-Umgebungen

  • Grundkenntnisse in relationalen Datenbanken, insbesondere SQL Server und Oracle, sowie in Python, PowerShell und SQL für wiederkehrende Installations-, Analyse- und Wartungsaufgaben

  • Kenntnisse in Docker, Kubernetes und Container-Orchestrierung

Unsere Rahmenbedingungen

✔️ Regelung zum mobilen Arbeiten (hybrides Arbeiten möglich)

✔️ Flexible Arbeitszeit durch Gleitzeit

✔️ Internationales Arbeitsumfeld

✔️ Attraktive Benefits (Zusätzlich zu Ihrem Gehalt erhalten Sie monatlich bis zu 80 € für persönliche Extras – je nach Standort können Sie diese z. B. für Mahlzeiten, ÖPNV oder weitere Angebote nutzen.)

title: Global Account Executive at CFO Insights
descriptionHtml:
Are you someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, where you are given the autonomy and support to handle large amounts of responsibility?

Are you looking for the opportunity to accelerate your sales career whilst also being surrounded by an exceptional entrepreneurial team with motivated and extremely driven people?

The role

You’ll be responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of sponsors across our international conferences, building long-term relationships with senior decision-makers and driving sponsorship revenue.

This is a high-performance B2B sales role with a strong focus on sponsor retention, renewals and account growth, alongside identifying and closing new sponsorship opportunities.

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for a commercially driven salesperson who enjoys building strong client relationships, growing accounts and consistently delivering against revenue targets.

You should have:

  • At least 2 years of B2B sales experience.

  • A proven track record of achieving or exceeding individual revenue targets.

  • Experience managing client relationships, retaining customers and identifying opportunities to grow existing accounts.

  • Confidence engaging, pitching and negotiating with senior decision-makers.

  • Strong commercial instincts and the ability to identify new revenue opportunities.

  • Ambition, resilience and ownership – you take responsibility for your portfolio, performance and results.

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

This role might not be the right fit if...

  • You prefer a role focused purely on relationship management, without responsibility for sales and revenue.

  • You don't enjoy negotiating, closing deals and working towards commercial targets.

  • You're not comfortable taking ownership of client relationships and proactively identifying opportunities to grow accounts.

  • You're looking for a hybrid or remote position – our London team works together from the office five days a week.

What you’ll do

  • Manage and retain sponsors: Build strong, long-term relationships with an existing portfolio of sponsors, driving renewals and repeat business.

  • Grow existing accounts: Identify opportunities to upsell, cross-sell and increase sponsorship revenue within your portfolio.

  • Drive new business: Identify, pitch and close new sponsorship opportunities to expand our client base.

  • Own your revenue targets: Take responsibility for achieving ambitious individual sales and retention targets.

  • Deliver exceptional partnerships: Work closely with our content and delivery teams to ensure sponsors receive a high-quality experience and see value in their partnerships.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and market-leading OTE.

  • Significant ownership and responsibility from day one.

  • The opportunity to work closely with our senior leadership team.

  • International travel to our conferences.

  • Training, coaching and ongoing development.

  • Strong opportunities for internal progression as we continue to grow.

About us

CFO Insights is a leading Northern European community for CFOs, finance executives and future finance leaders. Through our conferences and events, we bring together senior finance professionals to exchange insights, explore the evolving role of finance and build valuable business relationships.

CFO Insights is part of United Media, a global B2B media and conferences group.

Start date: As soon as possible.

Monday–Friday, we work from our WeWork office in Victoria, London. Due to the collaborative nature of our work, we do not offer remote work.

You must have the right to work in the UK.

title: Global Account Manager - Automotive
descriptionHtml:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About the role

You’ll grow a portfolio of our most important automotive OEM and supplier accounts in EMEA, working hand in hand with our Business Development leaders. Our deals are large, technical and multi-year. These deals are built on a foundation of understanding multiple technical and business stakeholders, from individual engineers, to leadership and C-suite. You will need to spend time understanding what an engineering team is battling, what the program manager is worried about, how to gain support and buy in from procurement and purchasing teams, and what the CTO is trying to achieve at a strategic level, then pull these threads together to build a successful deal. You'll work hand in hand with solution engineering and business development teams to shape, build and close deals. Internally, you’ll coordinate engineering, product, legal and finance to deliver on what we commit.

At Applied Intuition, you will:

  • Own critical client relationships and expand reach into key accounts including major OEM and Tier 1 relationships.

  • Drive strategic alignment and executive engagement across R&D, procurement and other relevant teams

  • Grow current footprint across Applied Intuition's solutions and land multi year commercial deals, including securing renewal risks

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Bachelor's degree

  • 5-10 years of experience automotive software / platform / semiconductor sales into Automotive OEMs

  • Track record of securing large scale, multi year software deals

  • Strong knowledge of a complex software sales process, including ability to map stakeholders, leverage key contacts and drive progress through legal, following up and maintaining CRM hygiene

Nice to have:

  • Technical fluency around Software Defined Vehicle technical topics, ADAS/AD, ADAS validation, SIL/HIL toolchains

  • Ability to have a technical conversation without the presence of a solution engineer

  • Strong network inside at least one or more major European Automotive OEMs

  • Masters in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or comparable Engineering subject

  • MBA

Compensation at Applied Intuition for eligible roles includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Base salary is a single component of the total compensation package, which may also include equity in the form of options and/or restricted stock units, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance coverage, 401k retirement benefits with employer match, learning and wellness stipends, and paid time off. Note that benefits are subject to change and may vary based on jurisdiction of employment.

Applied Intuition pay ranges reflect the minimum and maximum intended target base salary for new hire salaries for the position. The actual base salary offered to a successful candidate will additionally be influenced by a variety of factors including experience, credentials & certifications, educational attainment, skill level requirements, interview performance, and the level and scope of the position.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Applied Intuition is an equal opportunity employer and federal contractor or subcontractor. Consequently, the parties agree that, as applicable, they will abide by the requirements of 41 CFR 60-1.4(a), 41 CFR 60-300.5(a) and 41 CFR 60-741.5(a) and that these laws are incorporated herein by reference. These regulations prohibit discrimination against qualified individuals based on their status as protected veterans or individuals with disabilities, and prohibit discrimination against all individuals based on their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin. These regulations require that covered prime contractors and subcontractors take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status or disability. The parties also agree that, as applicable, they will abide by the requirements of Executive Order 13496 (29 CFR Part 471, Appendix A to Subpart A), relating to the notice of employee rights under federal labor laws.

title: Global Investigator (EMEA)
descriptionHtml:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

As a Global Investigator on the triage team, you will be the first line of operational defense in a fast-moving crypto disruption pipeline. You will process inbound complaint data, validate outputs from our artificial-intelligence (AI) investigation platform, and route cases into the investigative pipelines that result in frozen scam proceeds and seized assets. You will hold the disposition pen: your call is what turns a complaint into a freeze, a takedown, a recovery handoff, a legal-process draft, a victim notification, or a close.

The impact you will have:

  • Validate and route hundreds of complaint dispositions per week, feeding a live asset-recovery pipeline.

  • Catch the AI errors that matter, such as false positives, merged syndicates, and misclassified scam patterns, before they propagate downstream.

  • Enrich complaint selectors using a stack of more than forty commercial data-source integrations.

  • Take the highest-priority complaints beyond disposition: trace funds through consolidation wallets to regulated exchanges or other actionable endpoints

  • Own clean shift handoffs so the around-the-clock operation never drops a lead, providing EMEA-hours coverage that keeps the queue moving while colleagues in other regions are offline.

What we’re looking for:

  • 4 or more years of investigative or analytical experience in the public or private sector, including hands-on blockchain analysis.

  • Demonstrated experience tracing funds across chains and attributing addresses to real-world actors, including the judgment to tell an unattributed service from a privately controlled (unhosted) wallet

  • Experience building or contributing to cases that led to a freeze, seizure, arrest, or takedown.

  • Strong AI fluency, meaning comfort using AI tools as a daily co-pilot, plus the judgment to know when they are wrong.

  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, fluid environment where the project's scope and emphasis may shift quarter to quarter.

  • Strong written and verbal communication.

About the Team:

  • The team is built around a mix of seasoned investigators and rising talent. Triage investigators sit alongside experienced crypto tracers and intelligence-trained individual contributors.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Daily schedule: standard business hours in your local time zone.

  • Collaboration: coordinate with global teammates for handoffs on time-sensitive items, giving the wider operation near follow-the-sun coverage.

On-Call Responsibilities:

  • Formal on-call rotation for high-priority events, such as hacks, law-enforcement support, and other time-sensitive matters.

  • Weekly rotation, with occasional weekend coverage as needed.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • React quickly to incoming complaint surges and live takedown events.

  • Continuously learn new patterns in crypto-enabled crime.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

title: Global Service Specialist - Semiconductor Equipment (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Description

Our quantum sensing technology is already operating in customer environments across United States, Asia and Europe. As our installed base grows and we move from first deployments to repeat orders, ensuring the reliability and performance of every system becomes increasingly important.

As our Global Service Specialist, based at our Munich HQ, you’ll be part of a rapid-deployment team that resolves complex and escalated technical issues across our worldwide installed base. You’ll step in where regional service teams and partners need deeper expertise, and support installations, commissioning, and repairs when situations require it.

You’ll work directly with leading semiconductor foundries, IDMs, and OSATs, ensuring our systems operate reliably and consistently meet their specifications. You’ll collaborate closely with our Engineering and Applications teams, combining technical problem-solving with a strong customer focus.

This is also an opportunity to help shape our global service function from an early stage, introducing the processes, tools, and standards that will support our growing international installed base.

 

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

 

Why join QuantumDiamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

  

What will you do

  • Act as the technical escalation point for regional service teams and distribution partners, resolving issues that require deeper system expertise.

  • Deploy rapidly to customer sites across Europe, the US, and Asia to resolve critical system issues and minimize downtime.

  • Support installation, commissioning, and qualification of our quantum sensing systems when required, working closely with our Munich-based engineering teams.

  • Perform advanced troubleshooting, calibration, and repairs across optical, laser, mechanical, electronic, and software subsystems.

  • Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues systematically, collaborating with Engineering and R&D when root causes go beyond service-level expertise.

  • Work closely with Field Application Engineers, who focus on measurement execution and customer applications, to ensure a seamless customer experience.

  • Support spare-parts planning and service logistics across the global installed base, ensuring critical parts are available for rapid response.

  • Document service activities, technical findings, and root causes, feeding recurring issues and improvement opportunities back into Product Development.

  • Build trusted relationships with customers and partners through clear technical communication and professional service in demanding semiconductor environments.

  • Help establish and continuously improve our global service processes, including escalation workflows, maintenance procedures, troubleshooting guides, and technical documentation.

 

What is expected of you

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in field service, service support, or equipment engineering roles, ideally with semiconductor, optical, laser, inspection, or metrology equipment.

  • A proven track record of resolving escalated or complex system issues that first-line service could not solve.

  • Strong practical troubleshooting skills across complex electromechanical systems, ideally combining optics, lasers, precision mechanics, electronics, and control software.

  • Experience working in semiconductor fabs, cleanrooms, or similarly demanding technical environments, with an understanding of relevant safety and operating procedures.

  • Familiarity with laser safety and interlocked systems, or willingness to complete the necessary technical and safety qualifications.

  • Experience with spare-parts management, service documentation, and ERP or service ticketing systems is an advantage.

  • A structured, independent, and solution-oriented approach to technical challenges, especially under time pressure.

  • Strong communication skills and a customer-focused mindset, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly and build trust with customers, partners, and internal teams.

  • Willingness to travel internationally on a frequent basis, often at short notice, to support customers and partners across the US, Europe, and Asia.

  • Fluency in English. Other languages (e.g. German, Mandarin, Korean) are a plus.

  • A degree in Engineering, Physics, Mechatronics, or a related field, or equivalent technical training and relevant practical experience.

 

Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

  • Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills.

  • Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together.

 

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

descriptionHtml:
Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One+, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.

Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen.

 

Deine Aufgaben

Als Go-to-Market Manager:in – Commercial Energy Solutions (w/m/d) bei der Enpal Business Solutions GmbH treibst du die Energiewende aktiv voran und verantwortest komplexe Vertriebsprojekte im Bereich Commercial Energy Solutions. Du begleitest Industrie- und Gewerbekunden von der ersten Opportunity bis zum Vertragsabschluss und leistest einen direkten Beitrag zum Ausbau von Großbatteriespeicher-, PV- und weiteren Energielösungen.

  • Identifiziere und entwickle neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten im Bereich Commercial Energy Solutions

  • Verantworte komplexe Sales-Prozesse mit Industrie- und Gewerbekunden eigenständig von der Qualifizierung bis zum Vertragsabschluss

  • Übernimm die End-to-End-Verantwortung für Opportunities und stelle einen erfolgreichen Dealabschluss sicher

  • Entwickle überzeugende Lösungskonzepte gemeinsam mit internen Fachbereichen

  • Führe kommerzielle Verhandlungen auf verschiedenen Entscheidungsebenen bis hin zur Geschäftsführung

  • Steuere mehrere Stakeholder gleichzeitig und behalte auch bei längeren Verkaufszyklen den Überblick

  • Bringe deine Erfahrung ein, um Vertriebsprozesse und Go-to-Market-Strukturen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln

  • Trage aktiv dazu bei, den Ausbau von Batteriespeichern und weiteren Energielösungen im Markt zu beschleunigen

     

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung in Business Development, Sales, Commercial Management oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld

  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung komplexer B2B-Verkaufsprozesse mit mehreren Stakeholdern

  • Starkes Interesse an Energielösungen und der Energiewende

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️

 

Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen

  • Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit.

  • Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten.

  • Das ideale Setup für deinen Fokus - Wir sind überzeugt, dass exzellente Ergebnisse dort entstehen, wo die Bedingungen stimmen. Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt. Du brauchst neue Impulse auf internationalem Niveau? Mit Workflex bieten wir, abhängig von deiner Verantwortung, die Möglichkeit, deine Tätigkeit bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr ins Ausland zu verlegen.

  • Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt.

  • Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt.

  • Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit -Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt.

  • Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents.

  • Dein Extra-Boost -29 Urlaubstage + je ein freier Tag an Heilig Abend & Silvester, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden.

  • Vorsorge für deine Zukunft – Wir denken nicht nur nachhaltig, wenn es um Energie geht, sondern auch, wenn es um dich geht. Nutze unsere betriebliche Altersvorsorge und baue dir Schritt für Schritt ein solides Fundament für deine Zukunft auf.

  • Mache dein Zuhause smart – Nachhaltigkeit fängt in den eigenen vier Wänden an. Als Teil des Teams profitierst du von dauerhaften 25% Rabatt auf das gesamte Bosch Smart Home Sortiment – für ein noch effizienteres und vernetzteres Zuhause.

 

Wir bei Enpal sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlechteridentität, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. Enpal steht für einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und geht gegen Diskriminierung und Belästigung jeglicher Art vor.

title: Golang Backend Engineer, Financial Product Fraud
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person.

We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform.

This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch.

We are now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one.

This role will be based in London, UK as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin.

What you'll do:

  • Build and maintain high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go that score financial events in real time, including payout enrollments, bank account links, credit applications, and account-to-account transfers.
  • Design fraud detection and automated enforcement for our financial products end to end: from signal collection through to the decision that blocks a fraudulent payout.
  • Build on and extend our shared fraud decisioning platform, so signals, rules, and models work across all three of our brands instead of being rebuilt three times.
  • Partner closely with risk analysts, data scientists, and product managers to turn observed fraud patterns into shipped detection, and to know when a rule, a model, or a product change is the right answer.
  • Work across team boundaries with our account security, payments fraud, and financial product teams. We build on their signals rather than rebuild them, so clean interfaces matter.
  • Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decisions as we establish the fraud infrastructure baseline for financial products, with support from senior engineers on the team.
  • Write well-tested, observable code and help the team hold a high quality bar. In fraud, a silent failure is a loss event.

Our expectations:

  • 3 to 6 years of professional software engineering experience, including backend services you have shipped and owned in production.
  • 1+ years of production experience in Golang, or strong experience in another backend language and real enthusiasm for picking Go up quickly.
  • A working understanding of low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems. Real-time decisioning comes with a latency budget, and you are keen to learn to build inside one.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, and some exposure to event-driven architectures (Kafka or similar).
  • Willingness to operate what you build, including a share of on-call, with a pragmatic approach to reliability.
  • Uses AI tooling in day-to-day development and can critically evaluate its output for correctness and quality.

Nice to have

  • Experience in fraud, risk, payments, lending, or financial crime, especially money movement fraud, bank account linking fraud, payout abuse, or lending fraud.
  • Experience with rules engines, real-time feature stores, or ML model serving in a decisioning path.
  • Background in Kotlin, Java, Python, or Node.js alongside Go.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP).
  • Experience working across multiple brands, regions, or regulatory regimes.

What we value

  • A product-oriented mindset. You think beyond the ticket, understand the "why" behind the work, and take a high level of responsibility for outcomes rather than output.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. This is a new team on a new surface; parts of the charter are still being drawn, and you will help draw them.
  • A track record of owning a project or feature end to end, especially in fast-paced environments.
  • Clear and proactive communication, with a collaborative spirit. We work across three companies and several time zones, so we move fast, but we succeed together.
  • An adversarial instinct. The best fraud engineers enjoy thinking like the attacker.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. title: Graduate AI Transformation Lead
descriptionHtml:
TLDR: We’re looking for top 1%, high agency, AI-forward graduates to join the first graduate cohort at Resonance in Berlin as AI Transformation Leads. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital, to deploy AI into the economy and rebuild businesses for the AI era. You’ll work at the frontier and solve real problems in an environment that champions ownership, autonomy and innovation at pace.

Who we are

Resonance is an applied AI company. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital. Our mission is to close the AI diffusion gap and rebuild businesses for the AI era. We're looking to hire Europe’s elite AI talent, and we're building our Berlin hub to serve clients across Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

Why now

We believe the economic diffusion of AI is the major challenge of the next decade. Foundation models are advancing far faster than organisations can absorb them; the bottleneck is embedding AI deeply into the core processes of a company to drive an inflection in pace and create organisational advantage. Europe is falling behind on AI, and we exist to help its businesses build real, defensible advantage from it rather than simply adopting it.

The role

As a Graduate AI Transformation Lead in Berlin, you’ll work on client teams across DACH from your first month, alongside experienced AI Transformation Leads and AI engineers, with real responsibility from day one. You’ll analyse how a business works, where time and money go, and where AI fundamentally changes the economics. You’ll build the models, business cases and story a leadership team will act on, and prototype new workflows yourself with Claude Code or similar. You’ll work side by side with engineers to define what gets built, test it with the people who will use it, and help the client’s teams adopt it. As one of our first graduate cohort, you’ll also help shape our graduate programme and how Resonance trains and grows.

Your first year: Structured training in AI, consulting and the industries we work in, with coaching from Senior AI Transformation Leads and the founding team. You’ll be on a client team from your first month, in a small team where you know everyone by name and work closely with colleagues in London. Nobody expects you to know it all when you start: asking for help early is part of the job. You’ll start as a Junior Transformation Lead and typically move up a level within 18–24 months.

What we’re looking for: You have extreme agency, operate with urgency, and have consistently been among the very top performers of your peers. You’re finishing an undergraduate or master’s degree in a technical subject, such as engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics or another natural science, or a quantitative subject such as economics, or you graduated in one in the last two years, with top results from a top university. You structure problems clearly and are comfortable with numbers. You use AI every day and have built something with it, whether a project, a tool or an automation, and you’re curious about how businesses actually work. You can show you make things happen through internships, a society you led, a company you started or something you built. An internship in consulting, banking, private equity or a startup is a plus, and so is German for client work in DACH. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway.

What we offer: Competitive total compensation plus equity. Real client work from your first month, learning from people who have shipped 30+ AI products and embedded AI into 50+ businesses. Every engagement ends with AI running in production and results you can measure. A team built to be one of the most talent-dense in Europe, and a chance to help close Europe’s AI gap, moving European businesses to the right side of the productivity chasm.

Logistics: Berlin, 3+ days a week in the office or at client sites, mostly in DACH and Europe. English is our working language; German is a plus. We can sponsor visas for eligible candidates. Start date Summer 2027 (dates to be confirmed). We also offer Summer 2027 internships for students in the penultimate year of their degree.

Apply

Send your CV with your grades and a short note on something you've analysed or built with AI.

We hire people from every background and judge them on what they've built. If you don't tick every box, apply anyway.

Resonance is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. If you need adjustments at any stage, tell us and we'll make them.

Launch your engineering career with Zeeco

title: Graduate / Junior Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
About THG Ingenuity 

THG Ingenuity is a proprietary Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) technology, robotics, and operations platform built for global ecommerce. Developed through more than two decades of operating ecommerce and retail services at scale, its software and automation capabilities have been engineered, tested, and refined through the real-world demands of managing complex commerce operations. Today, THG Ingenuity provides an integrating operating environment that enables brands to intelligently optimise the entire commerce lifecycle from browsing and checkout to AI inventory management and forecasting, automated fulfilment, carrier control, and customer experience. The platform comprises: 

  • THG Fulfil: The fulfilment operating system for global ecommerce. Delivered via a proprietary SaaS and Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model, THG Fulfil orchestrates every stage of checkout, fulfilment, delivery, and customer experience through an integrated system. 
  • THG Studios: The UK's most innovative creative hub, helping brands create content that connects, experiences that engage, and IP that scales, all from its end-to-end, in-house facilities.  
  • THG Commerce: A cloud-native technology stack enabling retailers and brands to create intelligent, AI-powered, digital shopping experiences, while integrated marketplace and social commerce functionality allows brands to reach customers across every sales channel 

With its expertise in building and scaling brands, THG Ingenuity is uniquely positioned to bring pertinent, pragmatic, and global know-how across all aspects of commerce. 

The Role

We are seeking a talented and commercially astute Data Scientist to join our dynamic team tackling Fraud, Payments and Finance. In this multi-focus role, you will be responsible for protecting our global e-commerce operations from fraud, optimising our payments performance and driving profitability and automation initiatives within Finance.

Working with vast, complex datasets, the work will involve combatting online fraud using our award-winning THG Detect platform and driving payments optimisation by increasing authorisation rates, while also using the latest AI software and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure to build complex data solutions and applications.

This role requires a blend of strong technical skills, commercial acumen, and effective communication to translate complex data insights into tangible business value.

Responsibilities:

  • Optimise Fraud Detection: Continuously improve automated decision-making in our in-house THG Detect platform using machine learning and decision rules.
