title: Graduate Mechanical Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Company

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Hiring now

We are hiring as soon as possible. This role is for someone who has already graduated, or who will complete their degree in time to start with us very soon. We are not able to consider final-year students who graduate in summer 2027 or later, and this is not a graduate scheme with a fixed annual intake.

Role Overview

This is a first full-time engineering role on the NEO-1 satellite. You will design satellite hardware and help keep the satellite's full CAD assembly organised as the design matures, learning from our lead designer and working in a small, multidisciplinary team. You will take ownership of real parts early, translate requirements into manufacturable designs and support their validation through prototyping and environmental testing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop mechanical hardware for the satellite, such as brackets, panels, component mounts, thermal-control hardware and cable and harness routing, with guidance from the lead designer.

  • Work in the satellite's large 3D CAD assembly alongside the wider design team, learning how to keep interfaces, configurations and revisions in step as several designers work in the same model.

  • Support assembly configuration, PLM data (3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX') or similar), bills of materials and engineering change control (ECO/ECR/ECN), so that models, drawings and interfaces stay consistent as changes are released.

  • Run interference and clash checks and help maintain the digital mock-up, working with each subsystem owner to allocate space and resolve conflicts.

  • Produce dimensioned, manufacturing-ready drawings using GD&T, with review from senior engineers.

  • Support design reviews (PDR and CDR) and qualification, working with structural and thermal engineers.

  • Work with manufacturers and suppliers to make designs easier to build, and to balance cost, mass and reliability.

  • Support prototype builds, integration and environmental test campaigns, iterating designs based on results.

  • Collaborate with electrical, software, systems and thermal engineers to integrate mechanical components into the satellite platform.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in mechanical, aerospace or a related engineering discipline, completed or completing very soon.

  • Hands-on 3D CAD skills from university projects, a placement or an internship (SolidWorks preferred; CATIA, NX or Creo also considered).

  • Working knowledge of GD&T and experience producing engineering drawings, including from coursework or a team project.

  • Solid grounding in mechanical design principles, materials and thermal management, with a working understanding of structural mechanics.

  • Evidence of designing, building and testing something real, such as a placement project, Formula Student, a UAV, or a rocketry or satellite team, including troubleshooting and iteration.

  • Clear communicator who is comfortable explaining and defending design decisions, and open to feedback and challenge in a fast-moving team.

Preferred Experience

  • A placement, internship or year in industry in aerospace, space, motorsport or another high-reliability field.

  • Experience of several people working in one CAD assembly, for example in a Formula Student or university team, including how files and revisions were controlled.

  • Exposure to PLM or PDM systems (for example 3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX'), Windchill, Teamcenter, ENOVIA or SolidWorks PDM) or to formal engineering change processes (ECO/ECR/ECN).

  • Experience of design reviews, documented requirements and standards.

  • Satellite, CubeSat or rocketry project experience, including hardware that has launched.

  • Basic FEA familiarity and exposure to manufacturing processes.

Why NewOrbit Space?

  • Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO.

  • Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology.

  • Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success.

  • Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups.

  • Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week.

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us.

One day you’re building an AI workflow that drafts questionnaire answers, the next you’re pushing our ISO 27001 work forward, the next you’re telling the product team what makes GRC painful.

Our GRC programme is young, and Slack is our system of record. You’ll make it scale, using AI-powered tooling and workflows to take the toil out of audits, evidence collection and customer questions.

Right now, that means:

  • ISO 27001. It’s in progress, and you’ll help raise the bar and get us over the line.

  • ISO 42001. We build AI products, so we want to manage AI responsibly. In your first two quarters or so, you’ll run a gap assessment against the standard.

  • Dogfooding. We use incident.io for our own security work, and you’ll drive product improvements that make GRC less painful for our customers too.

You’ll work closely with the wider security team, engineering, legal and product.

Who you are

  • You’ve run or contributed to a real compliance programme, ideally ISO 27001, and you know what it takes to get through an audit.

  • You’d rather automate evidence collection than chase people for screenshots.

  • You write code (Python, Go or similar) or build workflows, and you’re excited about using AI and agents to remove toil.

  • You can answer customer security questionnaires quickly, accurately and in plain English.

  • You can explain a control to an engineer and a risk to an executive, and both come away knowing what to do next.

  • You care about the product, and you’ll tell us what’s missing from our own GRC tooling.

  • You’re comfortable with high autonomy. Nobody’s going to hand you a detailed spec, you’re trusted to figure out what needs doing and just do it.

  • Bonus points for ISO 42001 or AI governance experience, SOC 2, GDPR, or time in a fast-growing SaaS company.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

  • Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover - we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

  • Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

  • First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

  • Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

  • Meaningful equity. We’re rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

  • Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We’re all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

  • Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we’re doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

  • Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

title: Ground Software Engineer - Core
descriptionHtml:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft Orbital is looking for a Software Engineer to join our Core team within Ground Platform. The team develops the core capabilities that support Loft's ground platform, improve development workflows, and ensure platform reliability. You'll help build shared services and tools that benefit software teams across Loft.

You'll work on backend services, workflow automation, AI tooling, and platform infrastructure, with a focus on observability and reliability. You'll also have the opportunity to take part in spacecraft operations through SatDevOps rotations, helping investigate anomalies and supporting real-time incident response when needed.

If you're excited about improving how software is developed across Loft, contributing to key technical decisions, and building more reliable platform systems, we'd love to hear from you.


About this role:
  • Evaluate and implement new technologies and software patterns that propagate to the entire Loft's software stack
  • Lead the creation and evolution of Loft's AI tooling for development, review, and spacecraft anomaly investigation
  • Develop central ground platform functionalities such as workflow automation, microservice inter-communication, and metrics
  • Take responsibility for the reliability and performance of Loft's ground platform infrastructure, including message queues, CI/CD, and observability
  • Have the opportunity to take part in spacecraft operations through SatDevOps rotations, occasionally helping investigate anomalies and supporting real‑time incident response when needed
  • Collaborate with software engineers and satellite operators from all over the company to support and foster consistent, maintainable, and performant software solutions

Must Haves:
  • Solid backend software development experience
  • Hands-on knowledge of deployment and Infrastructure as Code
  • Ability to define and maintain CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience working with Kubernetes

Nice to Haves:
  • Python development, particularly with Django
  • Knowledge of GraphQL and Graphene
  • Experience with message queues and streaming technologies (NATS)
  • Knowledge of DevOps and observability tools (Helm, Terraform, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Loki, etc)
  • Familiarity with AI tooling
  • Frontend development with Vue and Web Components

Some of Our Awesome Benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)

At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.

Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.
    With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.
    As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.

title: Group Creative Director Automotive (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wir suchen am Standort München eine:n Group Creative Director Automotive (w/m/d) zur kreativen Führung und Weiterentwicklung eines unserer größten internationalen Automotive-Accounts. Die Rolle ist zunächst auf 18 Monate befristet.

Wir sind eine globale, socially-led Creative Agency mit über 1.300 Mitarbeitenden in 17 Büros weltweit. In einer Welt, in der Social Media Kultur prägt, helfen wir Marken dabei, Ideen zu entwickeln, über die Menschen sprechen.

Wir verstehen Online-Communities, Kulturen und Subkulturen über die gesamte Social Landscape hinweg. Zu unseren Kund:innen in Deutschland zählen unter anderem AUDI AG, Mercedes-Benz Trucks und Müller. We Are Social ist Teil der Plus Company.

Als Group Creative Director übernimmst du die übergeordnete kreative Verantwortung für einen unserer größten internationalen Accounts. Du entwickelst eine klare kreative Vision, setzt Standards und stellst sicher, dass unsere Arbeit über unterschiedliche Kampagnen und Workstreams hinweg überzeugt.

Dabei leitest du kreative Führungskräfte und Teams, gibst Orientierung und förderst Eigenständigkeit und Ownership. Du behältst das kreative Gesamtbild im Blick, setzt entscheidende Impulse und steigst dort tiefer ein, wo deine Erfahrung den größten Unterschied macht. Außerdem vertrittst du den kreativen Output der Teams gegenüber der Kund:innen und stehst ihnen als Sparringspartner zur Seite.

Requirements

Was beinhaltet die Rolle?

  • Übergeordnete kreative Verantwortung für einen internationalen Automotive-Account sowie Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer klaren kreativen Vision
  • Führung und Weiterentwicklung kreativer Führungskräfte und Teams mit dem Ziel, Eigenständigkeit, Ownership und kreative Exzellenz nachhaltig zu stärken
  • Sicherstellung einer hohen kreativen Qualität über unterschiedliche Kampagnen und Workstreams hinweg
  • Konzeptionelle Führung bei großen Kampagnen, Pitches und kreativen Schlüsselprojekten – mit einem klaren Fokus auf innovative, kulturell relevante Social-First-Ideen
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Client Service, Strategy, Media und Production, um kreative und strategische Potenziale bestmöglich auszuschöpfen
  • Aufbau und Pflege vertrauensvoller Beziehungen zu Senior Stakeholder auf Kund:innenseite sowie überzeugende Präsentation und Vertretung kreativer Ideen
  • Proaktive Identifikation kreativer Wachstumschancen und Weiterentwicklung des Kunden durch neue Ideen, Formate und innovative Ansätze
  • Aktive Mitgestaltung der kreativen Standards und Weiterentwicklung von We Are Social über den eigenen Account hinaus

Wonach suchen wir?

  • Langjährige Erfahrung in einer seniorigen kreativen Führungsrolle auf Agenturseite sowie in der Entwicklung großer, integrierter und Social-First-Kampagnen
  • Automotive-Erfahrung und ein gutes Verständnis für die Markenführung und Strukturen großer internationaler Automobilmarken
  • Herausragende Konzeptstärke, strategisches Denken und ein tiefes Verständnis für Social Media, Plattform-Mechaniken und kulturelle Trends
  • Nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Führung und Weiterentwicklung kreativer Teams sowie die Fähigkeit, Verantwortung zu delegieren und Eigenständigkeit zu fördern
  • Souveränität und Überzeugungskraft im Umgang mit Senior Stakeholder sowie exzellente Präsentations- und Pitch-Fähigkeiten
  • Entscheidungsstärke, ein ausgeprägtes Ownership-Mindset und die Fähigkeit, auch bei hoher Komplexität Prioritäten zu setzen und kreative Orientierung zu geben
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Benefits

Warum du Teil unseres Teams werden solltest?

Lebendiger Teamgeist: Wir tragen das Adjektiv social sehr bewusst im Namen und leben einen starken Teamgeist und eine offene Unternehmenskultur mit flachen Hierarchien, in denen deine Stimme zählt!

Spannende Projekte mit internationaler Reichweite: Wir arbeiten an digitalen Projekten, die Maßstäbe setzen! Unsere Kund:innen kommen aus dem B2C- und B2B-Umfeld und sind sowohl lokale als auch internationale Player.

Global verbunden und lokal verwurzelt: Unsere Teams an den Standorten München und Kreuzberg profitieren von einem nachhaltigen Wissensaustausch mit den WAS Standorten weltweit und sind im Glockenbachviertel und Kreuzberg zu Hause.

Flexibilität - Yes please!: Hybrides Arbeiten vereint für uns die Vorteile des Home Offices mit denen des Arbeitens im Büro. Genau deswegen haben wir uns für einen 2/3 Split entschieden, der bedeutet, dass wir bei 40h mindestens 2 Tage vor Ort mit unseren Kolleg:innen und 3 Tage im Home Office arbeiten. But that’s not all! Darüber hinaus sind wir große Fans von Remote Arbeit. Deswegen hast du bei uns die Möglichkeit 20 Tage innerhalb Deutschlands und weitere 20 Tage innerhalb Europas remote zu arbeiten. Wenn du also kein großer Fan des Deutschen Winters bist, join us und du kannst diese Zeit in Portugal oder Griechenland genießen.

Mehr Benefits für dich: Weil wir wissen, wie wichtig Well-being ist und wir Benefits einfach lieben, bieten wir dir mehr als nur den Standard. Genieße 2 zusätzliche Health Days, Menstrual Leave, einen freien Tag an deinem Geburtstag, eine Kooperation mit Wellpass, das Deutschlandticket, eine Mitgliedschaft bei OpenUp und vieles mehr.

title: Group Director of Supply Chain
descriptionHtml:
Why A‑Gas?

At A‑Gas, what we do matters — every single day. We are a global leader in Lifecycle Refrigerant Management. We help industries reduce emissions, protect the environment, and transition to a more sustainable future.

Our goal is clear: to protect and improve the environment by effectively managing refrigerants throughout their entire lifecycle.

Role Description

The Group Director, Supply Chain is accountable for designing and leading A-Gas's global supply chain, strategic sourcing and Sales, Inventory and Operations Planning (SIOP) capability. The role will create an integrated view of demand, supply, inventory and third-party spend to secure critical supply, improve service, optimise inventory and working capital, reduce total cost and enable better commercial and operational decisions. Key spend categories include gases, valves, cylinders and containers, logistics, maintenance, repair and operations (MRO), and selected indirect categories. Working through a global matrix of regional Operations, Purchasing, Commercial and Finance teams, the role will establish common governance, data standards, category strategies and performance measures while enabling effective regional execution. The role operates through a global matrix structure. While accountable for Group strategy, governance, performance and capability, day-to-day execution remains with regional procurement, Commercial, Operations and supply chain teams.

Reports to

Group Operations Director

Principal Place of Work

United Kingdom or United States - home-based or hybrid by agreement, with regular travel to A-Gas sites, suppliers and international meetings.

Experience, Knowledge and Qualifications

Essential

  • Significant senior leadership experience across strategic sourcing, procurement and supply chain planning in a complex, multi-region organisation.

  • Demonstrable experience designing or materially improving S&OP/SIOP processes

  • Proven delivery of measurable value across direct and indirect categories.

  • Strong commercial, negotiation and financial analysis capability.

  • Experience leading enterprise change through a matrix.

  • Strong understanding of supplier risk, logistics, inventory and supply continuity.

  • Experience using ERP, CRM, planning and spend analytics data.

Desirable

  • Industrial gases, chemicals, refrigerants, hazardous materials or regulated-sector experience.

  • Dangerous goods logistics, international sourcing and trade compliance experience.

  • Experience in a private equity-backed, acquisitive or high-growth organisation.

  • APICS/ASCM, CIPS, CPSM or another relevant qualification.

What do you get in return?

Why choose A‑Gas?
Because your work contributes to something bigger:

  • An organization with a clear mission, innovative strength, and long-term vision

Together, we are building a sustainable future.

title: Growth Account Executive, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About Telnyx

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network, to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.

We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.

The Role

Most sales roles chase new logos. This one unlocks the revenue already inside Telnyx's customer base — and there's a lot of it.

As a Growth Account Executive (Expansion), you'll take commercial ownership of established Telnyx customers after their first 12 months, identifying and closing new revenue opportunities across our product portfolio, from Voice AI and programmable communications to messaging, connectivity, and AI infrastructure.

You'll own an assigned portfolio of existing customers, identify untapped opportunities, build relationships with new stakeholders, and drive expansion from prospecting through close.

This isn't traditional account management. You're not here to simply maintain relationships or renew contracts. You're here to grow accounts by introducing new products, expanding into new business units and geographies, and helping customers build more with Telnyx.

You're not farming. You're hunting inside the base.

What You'll Do

  • Own and grow your accounts. Take commercial ownership of an assigned portfolio of established customers, developing strategies to drive incremental recurring revenue.
  • Find untapped opportunities. Analyze customer usage, product adoption, business models, and growth plans to identify opportunities for cross-selling, upselling, and geographic expansion.
  • Hunt within existing accounts. Run targeted, personalized outbound campaigns to engage new stakeholders, departments, and decision-makers within your customer portfolio.
  • Own the expansion sales cycle. Lead discovery, qualify opportunities, develop commercial proposals, negotiate terms, and close expansion deals.
  • Sell across the Telnyx product portfolio. Identify opportunities spanning Voice AI, SIP trunking, programmable voice, messaging, WhatsApp Business, global numbers, wireless, and AI infrastructure.
  • Build strategic relationships. Develop connections with technical buyers, business leaders, and economic decision-makers to uncover new use cases and accelerate adoption.
  • Drive measurable revenue growth. Own an incremental MRR target, focusing on commercially attributable, profitable expansion rather than organic usage growth alone.
  • Collaborate across teams. Work closely with Hunter AEs during account transitions and partner with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Product teams to execute expansion strategies.
  • Own your forecast. Maintain accurate opportunities, account plans, and forecasts in Salesforce, ensuring clear visibility into pipeline health and commercial progress.
  • Bring customer intelligence back to Telnyx. Share market insights, product feedback, and emerging customer requirements to help shape our roadmap and go-to-market strategy.

What You Bring

  • Experience in B2B technology sales, ideally as an Account Executive, Growth AE, or in a commercially focused business development role.
  • A demonstrated ability to generate pipeline through proactive outbound prospecting rather than relying exclusively on inbound demand.
  • A hunter mentality and the commercial curiosity to identify opportunities that aren't immediately obvious.
  • Strong discovery and consultative selling skills, with the ability to connect technical capabilities to measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience navigating multiple stakeholders and building relationships with both technical and commercial decision-makers.
  • The ability to independently manage opportunities, develop business cases, and move deals through a structured sales process.
  • Strong account research and strategic thinking skills, including identifying whitespace and opportunities for cross-selling.

title: Growth Engineer (all genders) B2B SaaS für KMU
descriptionHtml:
Deutschland lebt von seinen kleinen und mittleren Unternehmen, und viel zu viel von deren Geld und Aufmerksamkeit geht in die Pflicht: Buchhaltung, Umsatzsteuervoranmeldung, Jahresabschluss. Unvermeidbare Arbeit, die niemand will und für die alle zu viel bezahlen.

mika nimmt sie ihnen ab. Weil nichts davon optional ist, verstehen wir das, was wir bauen, als Infrastruktur und nicht als Software, und der Zweck ist einfach: Es soll billiger werden, in Deutschland ein Unternehmen zu führen.

Von 100 auf über 900 Kund:innen in acht Monaten, und immer noch ein kleines Team. Intern arbeiten wir auf Englisch, weil das Team international ist. Der Markt ist deutsch.

Worum es geht

Unser Growth-Team hat mehr Ideen als Hände. Es gibt eine Website, die mehr könnte, Landingpages, die gebaut werden wollen, Tracking, dem man noch nicht trauen kann, und eine Menge Handarbeit in Marketing und Vertrieb, die niemand machen müsste. Diese Rolle ist die technische Hand im Growth-Team – die Person, die das baut, live stellt und am Laufen hält.

Du bekommst Probleme, keine Tickets. Wenn etwas an dich übergeben wird, dann in der Form „hier klemmt es" und nicht „bau bitte genau das" – den Weg dahin entwirfst du. Und du bringst eigene Ideen mit: Was dir auffällt und was du für richtig hältst, landet auf derselben Liste wie alles andere.

Was du machst

  • Website und Landingpages: entwickeln, bauen, live stellen – inklusive der interaktiven Elemente, die eine Seite von einer Broschüre unterscheiden

  • Tracking, SEO und Hosting: dass die Seite schnell ist, gefunden wird und dass man den Zahlen dahinter trauen kann

  • Prototypen und Automationen: Die schnellste Version, die eine Frage beantwortet – ein Prototyp ist bei uns meistens auch ein Experiment, und du liest das Ergebnis mit

  • Tooling für Growth und Sales: z.B. Clay, Lemlist und was sonst gerade das Richtige ist. Leitfrage: Welche Handarbeit in diesem Team müsste es eigentlich nicht mehr geben?

  • Die Brücke zum Produkt: Du sitzt in Growth, gehst aber auch in die Dailys der Entwickler – vieles, was Marketing braucht, hängt am Produkt und umgekehrt

Wie es hier wirklich aussieht

Vieles ist unfertig. Unserem Tracking kann man an Stellen nicht trauen, und ein Teil der ersten Monate ist Aufräumen, bevor es Bauen wird. Dafür gilt das Gegenteil von dem, was du vielleicht kennst: kein Freigabeprozess, kein Ticketstapel, kein Warten auf eine andere Abteilung. Was du für richtig hältst, kannst du heute live stellen.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast schon etwas selbst live gestellt – nicht nur lokal gebaut. Du weißt, wie ein Server von innen aussieht, was Hosting bedeutet und worin der Unterschied zwischen Herumprobieren und Ausliefern liegt.

  • Du willst nicht nur Entwickler:in sein. Marketing interessiert dich wirklich: Du verfolgst, was im Markt passiert, hast eine Meinung zu Kampagnen, die dir begegnen, und willst verstehen, warum Leute kaufen – nicht nur, wie man es technisch umsetzt.

  • Neugier auf Werkzeuge. Du probierst Neues aus, bevor dich jemand darum bittet, und hast Spaß daran, anderen im Team die Arbeit leichter zu machen.

  • Auge für Gestaltung. Du erkennst, ob eine Seite absichtsvoll aussieht, und kannst sagen, warum eine schwache Version schwach ist.

  • KI ist dein Normalzustand, nicht dein Nebenprojekt. Ohne würde dir das Arbeiten langsam vorkommen.

  • Eigene Ideen. Du wartest nicht, bis dir jemand sagt, was zu tun ist – aber du kannst auch mit einer fremden Priorität arbeiten, ohne dass es dich stört.

hilfreich, aber nicht nötig

  • Erfahrung mit HubSpot, GA4, GTM oder vergleichbaren Stacks

  • Eigene Projekte, ein Nebenprodukt, ein Shop, eine Seite, die Leute wirklich benutzen

  • SEO über die Grundlagen hinaus

kein Fit

  • Du willst reine Entwicklungsarbeit und Marketing ist dir egal

  • Du brauchst fertige Tickets, Reviews und einen Prozess, bevor du anfängst

  • Du hast noch nie etwas außerhalb deines eigenen Rechners live gestellt

  • Du arbeitest lieber monatelang an einer sauberen Lösung, als nächste Woche eine zu haben, die funktioniert

Das Level, auf dem wir einstellen

Das ist eine Einstiegs- bis Mid-Level-Rolle, und wir meinen das ernst: Uns zählt, was du schon gebaut und live gestellt hast, nicht wie viele Jahre dahinterstehen. Du berichtest an den Head of Growth.

Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder höher sowie Englisch auf C1-Niveau oder höher setzen wir voraus – unser Markt ist deutsch, unsere Teamsprache englisch.

Gehalt
65.000 bis 100.000 € je nach Erfahrung, dazu Stock Options.

Drei Runden: ein erstes Kennenlernen, eine Arbeitssession mit einer kleinen Aufgabe und eine letzte Runde mit den Gründer:innen. Ein Termin findet in Berlin persönlich statt, und du hörst in jeder Stufe innerhalb einer Woche von uns, auch wenn die Antwort nein ist.

Warum mika

  • Du stellst selbst live. Kein Freigabeprozess, keine fremde Abteilung dazwischen – was du für richtig hältst, ist heute online.

  • Viel ungetestete Fläche. Fast alles, was man anfassen kann, ist noch nie angefasst worden, und es gibt ein Budget dahinter.

  • Zwei Welten statt einer. Du sitzt in Growth und arbeitest mit den Entwicklern – wer beides lernen will, findet hier wenige vergleichbare Stellen.

  • Alle KI-Lizenzen sind da, und ihre Nutzung ist Erwartung, nicht Duldung.

  • Die Arbeit zählt auch außerhalb des Büros. Jedes Stück Automatisierung heißt, dass kleine Unternehmen weniger Zeit und Geld für Papierkram ausgeben, den sie sich nie ausgesucht haben.

  • Berlin, hybrid, vollkommen flexible Arbeitszeiten bis auf das tägliche Standup.

Klingt nach dir?

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und zwei Dinge, mehr nicht:

  1. Etwas, das du gebaut und live gestellt hast – ein Link reicht. Sag kurz dazu, was daran von dir ist und womit du es gebaut hast.

  2. Eine Sache, die du an unserer Website ändern würdest, nachdem du zwanzig Minuten daraufgeschaut hast.

Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.

Bei mika schätzen wir Vielfalt und arbeiten an einem Umfeld, in dem alle im Team ihr Bestes geben können. Bau mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen für kleine Unternehmen.

title: Growth Engineer (Intern)
descriptionHtml:
👷🏻‍♀️ What we do 👷🏻‍♀️

At Emidat, we are building the first climate-native product management system for building material manufacturers.

Emidat aims to decarbonise building materials, making up 11% of global GHG emissions. We collect data from physical production processes, generate a digital product passport with verified environmental data and make it usable along the value chain. In short: One solution to assess, design, buy, sell and manage products - with environmental impact at the core.

Embodied carbon is emitted on day zero and can never be reduced later, while global floor area is set to double by 2060. From January 2026, EU regulation (CPR) requires verified environmental data. 430,000 manufacturers will need it, and only about 2,500 have it today. That gap is our market.

Find out more about us, the team and our values here.

What you will work on

Your mission

Drive initiatives that grow Emidat. In Growth we prioritise by one question: does this bring in new customers? As a Growth Engineer Intern you work across our four growth functions that sits closest to that answer; 1. Growth Engineering, 2. Growth Marketing, 3. Sales Development and 4. Partnerships

Topics you might work on: our automated campaign planning and lead development process, and the automations behind it. Our mapping of the total addressable market (TAM) and the GTM analysis sheet we use to decide which segments and countries to go after. Our industry get-togethers, for example expert exchanges and C-level breakfasts, from the invite list to the follow-up. LinkedIn posts and customer case studies, which means talking to manufacturers who use Emidat and turning what they tell you into material our sales team can send.

This internship is ideal for someone who has future aspirations to ‘found’ a company. Building a revenue function is one of the most difficult parts of founding, and during your internship, you’ll get insights into how demand is created, how a pipeline is built, and how AI actually optimises a go-to-market team. You will work on initiatives with the leads of each growth function, including our Head of Growth. We expect you to work independently, form your own view on what to prioritise, and challenge us when you think we have it wrong.

  • Own our Campaign Process: Run and sharpen the automated workflow that qualifies and enriches our target accounts, and take responsibility for the pipeline our SDR team works from.

  • Map our Market: Extend our TAM mapping into every new geography we enter, and keep our view of the relevant manufacturers, associations and registries current - so the commercial team always plans against a reliable picture of who is worth targeting.

  • Turn Data into Decisions: Build and maintain the reporting our team steers by, from campaign performance to pipeline health. Translate data into clear, actionable insights and own the data quality that makes those numbers trustworthy.

  • Organise our industry get-togethers: Organise formats like the BAU Dinner, our C-level AI Breakfasts and the Climate Native Summit end-to-end - guest list, invitations, on-site logistics and follow-up - turning each one into a reliable source of senior conversations.

What you will bring to this role

Minimum Requirements

Genesis brings together AI research, simulation, and robotics to build general-purpose robots that can work in the real world. Our mission is to unlock unlimited physical labor.

Our ability to grow depends on how well we find exceptional people, hire them, and help them become effective. There are engineering problems throughout that journey: fragmented data, repetitive workflows, disconnected tools, and processes that become slower as the company gets bigger.

You’ll build the software and automations that solve those problems.

Your users will be recruiters, hiring managers, the People team, and employees. You’ll work directly with them, identify the highest-impact opportunities, ship useful tools, and measure what changes. Your work should help us reach stronger candidates, move faster, and give people more time for the decisions and conversations that need them.

What you’ll own

  • Building recruiting tools that improve reach and relevance. Create workflows for talent mapping, research, enrichment, and rediscovery of candidates already in our network. Help recruiters turn scattered information into useful context.

  • Running measurable growth experiments. Partner with Recruiting to test sourcing channels, outreach workflows, referrals, and candidate nurture. Measure qualified conversations and downstream conversion.

Plasma is building the primary account for global money.

Money used to belong to a country. Increasingly, it belongs to a person or business moving through many countries. People and businesses now earn, spend, save, hire and invest across borders. Traditional banks cannot serve this new world.

Our first product, Plasma One, is a global money account: a place to receive, hold, send funds in seconds, earn yield and spend with a card in the local economy.

Underneath is the Plasma network, built from first principles for stablecoin payments. Stablecoins make dollars faster, cheaper and more reliable to move.

The opportunity is to become where all global money lands first: where income arrives, balances grow, payments move, businesses operate, and new financial products are built.

We are a global team of founders, operators and engineers, obsessed with building the best products. We work at the cutting edge of financial innovation, using stablecoins to create tools for consumers and businesses.

descriptionHtml:
Über Buena

Buena (backed by GV) macht alles rund um Immobilien so einfach und transparent wie den Kauf eines ETFs. Ob Suchen, Kaufen oder Finanzieren einer Wohnung. Wir tun das, indem wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland übernehmen und in Technologieunternehmen verwandeln. In den vergangenen drei Jahren sind wir mit weniger als 25 Vollzeitmitarbeitern im HQ zur drittgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands geworden.

Über die Rolle

Wir verwalten über 70.000 Einheiten in ganz Deutschland. Das ist nicht das Geschäft, das ist die Plattform. Darauf bauen wir neue Verticals auf: Versicherung, Energie, Finanzierung und Brokerage. Für Brokerage suchen wir jetzt die Person, die daraus ein echtes Geschäft macht. Viele unserer Eigentümer wollen irgendwann verkaufen. Wir sitzen direkt an der Quelle und kennen Objekte, Eigentümer und Timing.

Deine Aufgabe ist, daraus eine planbare Akquise-Maschine zu bauen: Du identifizierst die richtigen Eigentümer aus unserem Bestand, sprichst sie gezielt an und wandelst erstes Interesse in hochqualifizierte Leads für unsere Makler um. Das ist keine Strategie-Rolle mit Folien und Roadmaps. Du baust selbst: Kampagnen, Outbound-Workflows, Automatisierungen, Funnels. Du weißt jede Woche, welche Zahl du bewegt hast. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Leadership-Team, ohne Hierarchie-Ebenen dazwischen.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Akquise-Engine aufbauen: Du analysierst unseren Bestand, findest Eigentümer mit Verkaufsbedarf und baust Workflows für Datenanreicherung, Lead-Scoring und automatisierte Ansprache.

Du passt, wenn du

  • 3+ Jahre operative Erfahrung in Growth oder Performance Marketing, mit eigener Verantwortung für Leads, Conversion oder Umsatz.

  • Du hast Dinge von null aufgebaut, etwa als Gründer:in, als Geschäftsführer:in eines kleinen Unternehmens oder in einer frühen Startup-Phase. Das ist für uns ein starkes Signal.

  • Hands-on-Erfahrung mit datengetriebener Akquise: Outbound, Datenanreicherung, CRM und Automatisierung.

  • Marketing-Erfahrung mit Performance-Kanälen und Kampagnen ist ein klares Plus.

Deine Benefits

  • Ein Vertical, das du von Anfang an prägst, mit 70.000 Einheiten als Basis und voller Rückendeckung vom Leadership-Team.

  • Ein Inside-Sales-Team, auf das du zugreifen kannst: Es übernimmt Anrufe und die Bearbeitung deiner Kampagnen, damit du dich auf den Aufbau der Akquise-Engine konzentrieren kannst.

Warum jetzt einsteigen

descriptionHtml:
This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 95 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

At Almedia, you’ll:

  • Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

  • Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity.

  • Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

  • Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

Growth Manager (Berlin)

Salary Range: €55K – €75k

At a Glance

You'll own a real book of business in Russian speaker markets. There is a sales and account-management motion. The size of the responsibility comes from top-line ownership. Quota chasing is not the job. You shape the work and execute it.

What You’ll Do 🎯

  • Own a book of 5–15 advertiser accounts end-to-end. You'll be the person behind the growth and expansion efforts in Russian speaker markets. The one advertisers ask when something breaks. The one our Director checks in with when an account spikes.

  • Grow the revenue line. You are measured on the top-line you grow, not on activity. You communicate clearly, you drive yourself without being managed, and you stay open-minded when the data proves you wrong.

  • Run the ROAS dial. With guidance from senior team members, tune Almedia's internal ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) targets per offer, geo, and OS, often hourly. Use Hex (or comparable SQL-notebook tool), Amplitude, Looker Studio, and Almedia's internal Freecash AI every working day.

  • Develop a proactive account instinct. You'll work toward spotting issues before they become problems, push budget increases, geo expansions, and format tests on a rhythm. You'll learn to intervene before a metric becomes a complaint.

  • Bridge commercial and technical teams. When partners flag issues, you'll debug, coordinate with engineering, and communicate back clearly to the partner.

  • Contribute to the playbook. Help document process improvements as you learn. Your fresh perspective is an asset.

What your first 90 days look like

  • Days 1–30: Shadow our Senior Growth Managers on their account calls. Take over 2 small accounts (sub-€10K daily spend) and learn the backbone of our growth engine hands-on.

  • Days 31–60: Take over a full book of 5–10 accounts. Own your first KPI review with our a senior team member. Contribute with your first written process improvement.

  • Days 61–90: Operating with increasing independence. You've caught at least one issue before it escalated and proposed a test or lever on your book.

  • Beyond 90 days: A clear path from Growth Manager to Senior Growth Manager to Strategic Growth Lead and beyond.

What You’ll Bring 💡

  • You're hungry and looking for a challenge. You want to build and own real outcomes, not collect a title. You have some professional experience, have had to figure things out independently and you liked it.

  • You tell stories with data. You read the numbers, then you tell their story. You don't need to be a data scientist, but you should be able to open a dashboard, spot something off, and ask the right questions.

  • You're bilingual in the best sense, equally fluent and comfortable talking commercial with advertisers and technical with algorithm teams in the same day.

  • You speak Russian on a native level, have ideally worked in this market before and understand the market specifics.

Bonus points if you:

  • Have some exposure to performance marketing metrics like ROAS, LTV, retention, or ARPU. If not, we'll get you there by week 2.

  • Have managed a book of advertiser or partner accounts in performance marketing, mobile gaming UA, or rewarded UA. If not, we're more than willing to develop you into that role.

  • Have used tools like AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Singular, or want to learn.

  • Have built and grown a book of business in a measurable way.

  • Top-tier consulting (MBB) or scale-up background. We hire the for right thoughts. Rewarded-UA depth comes in your first 60 days.

  • Have actually used Hex, worked inside the admin of a rewarded UA platform, or been on the advertiser side of one.

What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟

  1. Own Everything: Get It Done. When an advertiser drops 28 action items into your channel on Monday, you don't escalate. You triage, batch, and ship the 10 that matter by Friday. You don't ask for permission to fix obvious things.

  2. Take Initiative: Be Proactive. You spot the geo where the cap consistently under-fills. You ask the algo team why. You propose the test. You don't wait for someone to assign it.

  3. Move Fast: Start Simple, Iterate Quickly. You'd rather change the ROAS target today on incomplete data, watch for 7–14 days, and learn. Not wait two weeks for a perfect read. You know the stabilisation window. You don't tune at hour 3. You also don't drift past day 14 without a verdict.

  4. Focus on Impact: Deliver What's Most Important. You'd rather move €500K of monthly spend on the top account than €50K across five small ones. You know which accounts are load-bearing.

  5. Raise the Bar: Have High Standards. When something is sub-optimal, you fix it AND document it, so the next person inherits a better one. You hold the line on quality even when it would be easier not to.

Why Almedia? 🎁

  • Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.

  • Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.

  • Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

Du machst Lovebetters Marketing vielseitiger, effizienter und wachstumsstärker.

Du entwickelst Marketingideen, setzt Kampagnen um, betreust bestehende und neue Wachstumskanäle und erkennst anhand von Daten, was funktioniert und wo wir besser werden können.

  • Marketingperformance analysieren und optimieren: Du behältst relevante KPIs im Blick, analysierst Kampagnen, Content und Funnels, erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und leitest konkrete Maßnahmen daraus ab.
  • Websites und Landingpages weiterentwickeln: Du übernimmst kleinere Anpassungen an unseren digitalen Angeboten und unterstützt bei Tests und Optimierungen. Wenn du dafür ein neues Tool wie WordPress lernen musst, arbeitest du dich eigenständig ein.
  • Marketingprojekte und Partner koordinieren: Du hältst laufende Projekte zusammen, koordinierst interne und externe Beteiligte und sorgst dafür, dass Aufgaben zuverlässig und termingerecht umgesetzt werden.
  • KI und Automatisierung sinnvoll einsetzen: Du nutzt moderne KI-Tools für Recherche, Content, Analysen und operative Aufgaben und entwickelst Ideen, wie wir unsere Marketingprozesse kontinuierlich verbessern können.

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

  • Abwechslung statt Silodenken: Du arbeitest nicht ausschließlich an Content, Performance oder Analytics, sondern lernst unterschiedliche Marketingdisziplinen kennen und verbindest sie miteinander.
  • Eigenverantwortung statt langer Abstimmungswege: Du bekommst Raum, eigene Ideen einzubringen, Entscheidungen vorzubereiten und Projekte selbstständig voranzutreiben.
  • Kreativität trifft Zahlen: Du kannst neue Kampagnenideen entwickeln und anschließend anhand konkreter Ergebnisse nachvollziehen, ob sie erfolgreich waren.
  • Lernen gehört zum Job: Du musst nicht jedes Tool und jeden Marketingkanal bereits kennen. Wir schätzen Menschen, die sich Herausforderungen stellen und neue Fähigkeiten selbstständig aufbauen.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem CMO: Du erhältst Einblicke in strategische Marketingentscheidungen und bist eng an der Weiterentwicklung unseres Marketings beteiligt.
  • Persönliche Entwicklung und Perspektive: Du wächst mit deinen Aufgaben und hast die Möglichkeit, mit der Weiterentwicklung von Lovebetter zunehmend Verantwortung für größere Projekte, Prozesse und perspektivisch auch Menschen zu übernehmen.

Dein Impact

Wenn du deinen Job exzellent machst, entsteht:

  • ein Marketing, in dem gute Ideen schneller in konkrete Maßnahmen umgesetzt werden
  • ein Ambassador- und Kooperationsprogramm, das kontinuierlich wächst und messbare Ergebnisse liefert
  • neue Marketingkanäle, die strukturiert getestet, bewertet und weiterentwickelt werden
  • bessere Kampagnen und Inhalte durch die Verbindung von Kreativität und datenbasierten Erkenntnissen
  • optimierte Funnels, CRM-Kampagnen und digitale Kontaktpunkte, die mehr qualifizierte Leads erzeugen
  • effizientere Prozesse durch Eigeninitiative, Automatisierung und den sinnvollen Einsatz von KI
  • ein Marketing-Team, das schneller, selbstständiger und wirkungsvoller arbeitet

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns, dich kennenzulernen.

Schick uns keine Standardbewerbung.

Erzähl uns lieber:

  • welche Marketingprojekte oder Kampagnen du bereits eigenständig umgesetzt hast
  • wann du dich zuletzt in ein völlig neues Thema oder Tool eingearbeitet hast und was daraus entstanden ist
  • wie du kreative Ideen entwickelst und herausfindest, ob sie tatsächlich funktionieren
  • welche Aufgaben du schon übernommen hast, obwohl du sie vorher noch nie gemacht hattest
  • und warum du glaubst, dass genau du Lovebetters Marketing mit Kreativität, Eigeninitiative und Umsetzungskraft auf das nächste Level bringen kannst

Stellenanforderungen

Wen wir suchen (und wen nicht)

Diese Rolle passt zu dir, wenn …

  • du bereits praktische Erfahrung im digitalen Marketing gesammelt und idealerweise Kampagnen oder Projekte eigenständig umgesetzt hast
  • du sowohl kreativ als auch analytisch denkst und Spaß daran hast, zwischen unterschiedlichen Aufgaben zu wechseln
  • du eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität mitbringst und lieber ins Machen kommst, als lange über Möglichkeiten zu diskutieren
  • du neugierig bist, schnell lernst und dir neue Tools, Plattformen oder Fähigkeiten eigenständig aneignen kannst
  • du auch vor unbekannten Herausforderungen nicht zurückschreckst und den Mut hast, Neues auszuprobieren
  • du Marketingkennzahlen verstehst und aus Ergebnissen sinnvolle Schlussfolgerungen ziehen kannst
  • du strukturiert und zuverlässig arbeitest, Prioritäten setzen kannst und auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick behältst
  • du KI bereits aktiv nutzt oder motiviert bist, sie schnell und sinnvoll in deinen Arbeitsalltag zu integrieren
  • du sehr gut auf Deutsch kommunizierst und ein Gespür für überzeugende Texte und zielgruppengerechte Ansprache hast
  • du Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest und Lust hast, gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen

Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn …

  • du ausschließlich in einer einzelnen Marketingdisziplin arbeiten möchtest und wenig Interesse an anderen Bereichen hast
  • du für neue Aufgaben immer eine detaillierte Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitung brauchst
  • du lieber Konzepte entwickelst, als sie selbst umzusetzen
  • du bei unbekannten Tools oder Herausforderungen schnell aufgibst, statt nach Lösungen zu suchen
  • du Zahlen ignorierst und Marketingentscheidungen ausschließlich nach Bauchgefühl triffst
  • du Verantwortung lieber abgibst, statt Themen eigenständig voranzutreiben
  • du mit sensiblen Themen wie Sexualität, Männlichkeit, Beziehungen und persönlicher Entwicklung nicht offen und reflektiert umgehen kannst

title: Growth Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
Growth Marketing Manager

Retire the ERP

Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our Smart Financial Platform gives modern, global companies superpowers - automated accounting, real-time reporting, and financial flows that move at the speed of the business.

We build with our customers, ship fast, and obsess over craft. In a short time, Light has gone from idea to the operating core for leading companies like Lovable, Legora, and Fuse Energy.

We're an early team defining a new software category. Think engineers who love debits and credits, designers who care about reconciliation states, and operators who treat finance as a product. If you're excited to modernise how companies run money, you're in the right place.

Backed by world-class investors including Balderton and Atomico and advised by industry titans, we're building category-defining products with the freedom to ship ambitiously and own outcomes. Come help us make Light the global default for next-gen finance.

Finance deserves better

Finance teams at fast-growing companies run global, real-time businesses on a patchwork of legacy ERPs and point solutions. Every new entity, market or tool adds another system to stitch together and another hire to keep the numbers reconciled.

Light gives them a way out.

We build the finance solution that lets finance teams have it all, through three parts that work as one:

  • Our ledger records every transaction across every entity in real time, so the numbers hold up from day one.

  • Our apps adapt Light to how each business runs, from procurement to billing to reporting.

  • Our agents operate the repetitive work that used to need another hire, so finance teams spend their time on the decisions that matter.

We take on the ERP and the legacy point solution world with something fast to implement, AI-native from the ground up, and better the more you use it.

Today we run the finance function for companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot, with backing from Atomico, Balderton, Seedcamp, Cherry and Entrée, and teams across Copenhagen, London and Stockholm, with remotes world over.

The Role

We're looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to join our growth team and open up the channels we haven't really touched yet.

We've built a lean, efficient demand generation engine on the core paid channels you'd expect at a Series A B2B company, with Google Ads and LinkedIn doing the heavy lifting. It works, and it fills our pipeline every month. Now we want to find the next sources of pipeline, and we need someone who knows how to build them from scratch.

You'll work alongside our Senior Growth Marketing Manager, VP Marketing and the wider marketing team, with the freedom to test, learn and scale the channels that move the number. You'll sit close to sales, product and design, and you'll own the results of everything you launch.

We may hire more than one person through this process, so if you go deep on some of these channels rather than all of them, we still want to hear from you.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Building a referral programme that turns happy customers, partners and finance leaders into a steady source of pipeline.

  • Running G2 and Capterra campaigns that put Light in front of buyers at the moment they compare options, and turning our reviews into proof across every channel.

  • Launching and scaling Meta Ads for B2B, testing creative and audiences until you find what drives qualified pipeline.

  • Finding the creators and influencers finance teams follow, writing briefs that land and scaling their content into campaigns that drive pipeline.

  • Growing our presence across search and AI answer engines, so that when a finance leader asks Google or ChatGPT about ERP alternatives, Light shows up.

  • Setting up measurement for each new channel with RevOps, so we know what every dollar returns.

  • Sharing what you learn with the team, doubling down on what works and cutting what doesn't.

What We Think* You'll Need

  • Enough years in growth to know how to take a channel from zero to pipeline at a fast-growing B2B SaaS company.

  • Hands-on experience across referrals, review sites, Meta Ads, influencer marketing or SEO and GEO. We don't expect you to master all five, so show us where you go deep.

  • A test-and-learn mindset, with the discipline to measure every experiment against pipeline and revenue.

  • Comfort with numbers and tools, from ad platforms to HubSpot to spreadsheets.

  • An eye for creative and a feel for what makes finance people stop scrolling.

  • Deep curiosity about how AI is reshaping marketing, finance and the companies we serve.

  • A can-do, empathetic and collaborative spirit. No brilliant assholes here, please.

*If the core of the role sounds compelling but you don't tick every box, we'd still love for you to reach out and convince us you're the right person.

The Good Stuff

  • A five-day, in-office culture with a high-density team in Copenhagen.

  • A competitive salary and potential stock options.

  • 25 days of annual leave plus public holidays in the country where you're based.

  • Regular socials and two company offsites a year.

  • The chance to build new growth channels from the ground up at a company defining a new category.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

The Famous Last Words

We've proven the core of our growth engine works. Now we want to see how far it can go, and we want you to build the parts we haven't tried yet. If you love starting channels from scratch and watching them turn into pipeline, let's talk.

title: Growth Partnerships Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

Zable is about to become the face of Lendable. We’re rebranding the company and product, significantly increasing our D2C marketing investment, and building out a marketing function under our newly appointed CMO. It’s one of the most exciting marketing builds in UK fintech right now, backed by real financial strength, a large customer base and a product people love.

Partnerships and sponsorships will be central to how we grow, and we’re building the team to make that happen. As our Growth Partnerships Manager, you’ll shape the strategy and the budget, not just manage the day-to-day. Reporting to the Head of Growth Partnerships, you’ll define our commercial approach, decide where partnership spend goes, and take every deal from first conversation to live activation: agreeing terms, making sure campaigns land well, and keeping partners engaged. You’ll also make the case for each investment, with the data to back it, to senior leadership.

This is a senior seat for someone who enjoys both the creative and the analytical sides of partnerships. You’ll have real budget responsibility, model payback economics, and bring colleagues with you on the big calls. If you think about CPA, rev share and LTV:CAC as naturally as you think about relationships, you’ll feel at home here.

What we're looking for:

Essential:

  • 5+ years in partnerships, affiliate marketing, sponsorships, BD or growth roles for a consumer brand, including time spent shaping commercial strategy, not just executing it

  • Fluent in core acquisition performance metrics, CPA, Revenue share, LTV, ROI and blended CAC, and comfortable moving between them when structuring a deal

  • Working knowledge of channel economics: payback period, cohort behaviour, and how partnership spend compares against other acquisition channels

  • Direct experience running affiliate and/or influencer partnership end to end, including commercial negotiation (not just relationship management)

  • Track record of running activations end-to-end and delivering measurable results

  • Strong account / relationship management skills

  • Comfortable with the data, channel economics, attribution and ROI

  • Highly organised and detail-oriented, you can run multiple activations in parallel

  • Strong commercial communicator, you can hold your own with senior partners and senior internal stakeholders alike

  • Experience setting and owning a partnerships budget or channel P&L, with the judgement to reprioritise spend as performance data comes in

  • Comfortable presenting strategy and performance to senior leadership, and defending investment decisions with data

  • Demonstrable use of AI in your workflow

Desirable:

  • Experience in fintech or financial services

  • Experience with sport, entertainment, media or large brand sponsorships

  • Experience with an affiliate network or tracking platform (e.g. Impact, Awin, CJ, Partnerize) and reading platform-level reporting unassisted

  • Experience with affiliate, influencer or embedded finance partnerships

  • Some deal structuring experience

  • Experience line-managing or mentoring a more junior partnerships or affiliate executive

You’re a good fit if you’re:

  • A natural relationship-builder, partners trust you, and so does your team

  • A strategic thinker as much as a doer, you can zoom out to set the plan, then zoom back in to execute it yourself

  • Commercially literate first, relationship-led second, you measure success in growth, not vanity

  • A strong project manager, you keep things moving and on-budget

  • Data-fluent , you build your own view on what’s working from raw performance data, not just a dashboard summary

  • Hands-on and resourceful, you make things happen

  • Curious about AI and how it changes the partnerships discipline

What you'll be doing

Leadership & Strategy:

  • Set the partnerships strategy and roadmap, and own the case for investment with senior leadership

title: GTM Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Notion already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 12x YoY.

The Role

We're looking for a GTM Engineer to build the systems that take Kernel to $100m+ ARR. You'll own the infrastructure behind how we find, sell to and grow customers, from Salesforce and outbound to forecasting, renewals and expansion.

This is a hands-on builder role, not a traditional RevOps support function. You'll work like a product engineer for GTM: find the biggest constraint on growth, turn a messy commercial problem into a working system, ship it quickly and improve it using real results. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you do need to be able to build with Salesforce, Clay, APIs, automation platforms and AI tools rather than waiting for someone else to do it.

You'll also be Kernel's own internal customer, using Kernel to build an AI-native revenue engine, pressure-test the product in real workflows and turn what you learn into useful feedback for Product and Engineering.

You'll report to Arvin Ashrafi, Head of Finance & Operations, and work closely with Sales leadership and the wider GTM team.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build a better outbound engine: improve account targeting, signals, enrichment, prioritization, personalization, sequencing and measurement so the team consistently reaches the right companies at the right time

  • Make the GTM team more productive: automate repetitive work across account research, meeting preparation, follow-ups, CRM hygiene and handoffs so BDRs, AEs and Account Managers spend more time with customers

  • Run the revenue operating infrastructure: own the systems behind pipeline management, forecasting, funnel reporting, quota planning, GTM incentive compensation, renewals and expansion

  • Set the rules of engagement: own account assignment and routing, settle ownership disputes, and make sure every meeting booked and held is captured and credited to the right person

  • Improve how revenue work moves through Kernel: build reliable routing, attribution, account assignment and cross-functional handoffs, resolve edge cases and make performance visible

  • Be Kernel's own internal customer: deploy Kernel on our CRM, use it to improve our GTM data and workflows, and turn what you learn into useful feedback for Product and Engineering

What You Bring

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience: you have worked in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM Engineering at a high-growth Series B-E SaaS company and owned meaningful parts of the revenue engine end to end

  • Deep Salesforce fluency: you understand objects, record types, fields, formulas, flows, validation rules, permissions, reports and data migration. You can reason about architecture and debug production behavior

  • Strong GTM building ability: you have built useful systems with Clay, APIs, automation platforms and AI tools, and you know how to move from a rough idea to a reliable workflow that people adopt

  • Commercial judgment: you understand how accounts become meetings, meetings become pipeline, pipeline is qualified and forecast, and won revenue flows into implementation, expansion, renewal and retention

  • Strong data instincts: you can turn fragmented information into trustworthy workflows, measure what is working and create feedback loops that improve performance over time

  • Clear, low-ego communication: you can turn a messy request into a crisp decision, explain trade-offs to non-technical teams, push back constructively and drive adoption through influence rather than authority

It is a plus if you also have:

  • Experience supporting an enterprise sales motion with multi-stakeholder deals and MEDDPICC

  • Experience with renewals, expansion, compensation, quota setting or planning

  • Familiarity with Gong, sales engagement platforms and modern enrichment or intent tooling

  • Experience building operational controls around LLM- or agent-powered workflows

⚠️ This role may not be for you if you:

  • Prefer strategy and recommendations over configuring systems, cleaning data, investigating edge cases and debugging workflows yourself

  • Need outlined requirements or stable priorities before you can make progress

❌ This role is definitely not for you if you:

  • Are not comfortable taking broad ownership of a function

What We Offer

We will do our best to offer you a ride of a lifetime. It will not be easy, but it will be thrilling.

title: GTM Lead Germany
descriptionHtml:
At Parallel, we build AI agents to help healthcare facilities automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding.


Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work. Legacy software hasn’t helped, it’s made things slower, more complex, and more frustrating for care teams.

We believe AI agents can change that. Our technology combines Large Language Models with system-level automation to handle real work inside existing hospital tools. No integrations, no disruption.

Our first agent automates coding workflows and frees up time for medical staff to focus on patients.

We launched in 2024, are backed by top investors (Index, Frst, Y Combinator, Hexa, Kima Ventures, Better Angle), and we’re just getting started.

 

The future of healthcare isn’t just digital — it’s automated. Come help us build it !

Context

Germany is one of Europe's largest healthcare markets, and its hospitals face the same pressure we solve in France: rising administrative load, staff shortages and revenue lost to incomplete coding.

As Germany GTM Lead, you are our first hire in the country. You will report directly to Paul Lafforgue, CEO and co-founder, and work closely with Chris, our CTO, and the product team in Paris. You will own everything from the first prospecting call to the first signed contracts, shape the local product and build the German team from zero.

  • Location: 2 to 3 months of onboarding in Paris, then based in Germany with regular trips to Paris. Office in Munich or Berlin.

  • Team: none at first. Around 5 people in H1 2027, around 12 by the end of 2027.

Your mission

Take Parallel from zero to a validated, repeatable market in Germany by the end of 2027: 2 to 3 flagship hospitals as paying customers, 2M€ ARR and a local team of around 15.

Outcomes

  • First customers: build the pipeline with Paul, book your own first meetings (your calendar starts empty), sign the first pilots and turn them into paying contracts.

  • German go-to-market: pick the segment to win first (private groups, public or university hospitals), adapt the pitch to the German healthcare context, test our success-based pricing, including in public tenders, and build visibility through networks, trade shows and customer references.

  • Local product: run the feedback loop between German hospitals and the product & tech team, and bring in local medical expert(s) to validate usage

  • German team: hire a team growing from 0 to around 12 across sales, ops, engineers and set up the office.

  • Growth story: report on Germany's progress to the leadership team and investors, and, if we acquire a local company, contribute to due diligence and lead the integration of the acquired team.

Who you are

A builder who wants to open a market, not run one. This job is for you if:

  • You are a native German speaker, with your schooling and career in Germany, and fluent in English, our working language with headquarters.

  • You have 5 to 10 years of experience, including at least 2 years in a quota-carrying B2B sales role.

  • You have lived at least one 0-to-1 experience: you founded a company, joined a startup of fewer than 50 people or launched a new market.

  • You enjoy being on the ground: meeting customers, travelling and opening doors yourself.

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and an empty playbook.

  • You are credible with hospital leadership (CEO, CFO, chief medical officer) as well as with physicians.

  • You can convince first hires to join a company that nobody in Germany knows yet.

  • You are open to about 3 months of regular trips to Paris, with a long-term base in Germany.

  • Bonus: you know the German healthcare system, or you have already launched a business.

  • Bonus: you have hired and managed a team, or worked on M&A or the integration of an acquired team.

Our values

  • Play to Win: we are not here just to participate, ship something “good enough”, or enjoy the startup ride. We want to win. That means caring deeply about outcomes, moving fast and being willing to put in the intensity required when it matters.

  • High Trust, High Standards: trust is our default. If you joined us, it's because we believe you can own your scope and make good decisions. We don't want a company built on approvals, control and micromanagement. But trust comes with responsibility. The more freedom we give, the higher the standard we expect.

  • Low Ego, Hands-On: no one at Parallel is above doing the work. Titles, seniority and past achievements don't exempt anyone from getting their hands dirty. Everyone should be willing to step into the arena when needed. Leadership means taking responsibility, not creating distance from execution.

  • Don't Take Yourself Too Seriously: we are extremely serious about our mission. We don't need to be extremely serious about ourselves. Building a company is intense. We want Parallel to remain a place where people enjoy spending time together, laugh, celebrate and bring energy to the people around them. High standards and good vibes are not opposites. We want both.

Hiring process

  1. Screening call (40 min)

  2. Practical case + Q&A with Paul, CEO (video call, 45 min)

  3. Presentation of your written practical case (video call, 1h30)

  4. Business case in Paris (half a day)

Why should you join us?

  • A rare opportunity: open Parallel's first international market as employee #1 in the country, with a direct line to the CEO and the room to build the team, the playbook and the office your way.

  • A product that already works: you start with a live product, around 800 customer references in France and local CTO in Germany ready to adapt it with you.

  • Real-world impact: every hospital you sign gives clinical staff time back from paperwork to improve patient care.

  • Package & perks: competitive salary and meaningful equity, health insurance, top-quality equipment and a public-transport contribution.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.
