title: Head of Corporate Communications (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
FASTR Energy gehört zu den führenden Energiedienstleistern und Stromversorgern in
Deutschland. Das Unternehmen wurde 1989 in Aachen gegründet und hat
heute seinen Hauptsitz in Düsseldorf sowie Niederlassungen in Berlin,
Hamburg, München und Leizpig. Aus einem ursprünglich familiengeführten
Unternehmen ist ein dynamischer Energiepartner geworden, der sich im Mai
2025 durch die Partnerschaft mit KKR auf einen klaren Wachstumskurs
begeben hat. In einer spannenden Transformationsphase gestalten wir
aktiv die Zukunft der Energieversorgung – mit einer klaren Vision: Als
Dekarbonisierungspartner der Immobilienwirtschaft leisten wir einen
entscheidenden Beitrag zur Energiewende in Deutschland.

Die Rolle

Als Head of Corporate Communications (mögliche Standorte Düsseldorf, Berlin, München oder Hamburg) verantwortest du die Kommunikation eines Unternehmens in einer prägenden Phase: FASTR ist als bundesweiter, integrierter Energiedienstleister für die Immobilienwirtschaft, Kommunen und Stadtwerke neu aufgestellt und wächst. Du baust die Kommunikationsfunktion strategisch auf und aus, gibst ihr Struktur und Handschrift und machst die Positionierung des Unternehmens nach innen und außen erlebbar.

Das ist ausdrücklich keine ausführende Kommunikationsrolle. Du gestaltest von Grund auf – mit direktem Zugang zur Geschäftsführung, unternehmensweiter Sichtbarkeit und dem Mandat, Themen zu setzen statt sie nur zu begleiten.

Deine Verantwortung

  • Du entwickelst die Kommunikationsstrategie des Unternehmens und führst interne wie externe Kommunikation zu einem konsistenten Auftritt zusammen.

  • Du verantwortest die Kommunikation gegenüber Kunden ebenso wie gegenüber Bewerbenden und Mitarbeitenden und sorgst dafür, dass alle Zielgruppen dieselbe Marke erleben.

  • Du berätst die Geschäftsführung als Sparringspartner in Kommunikationsfragen, übersetzt Strategie und Positionierung in klare Botschaften und bringst Themen aktiv ein.

  • Du machst technisch und regulatorisch geprägte Themen der Energie- und Immobilienwirtschaft für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen verständlich und positionierst das Unternehmen als verlässlichen Partner gegenüber Wohnungswirtschaft, Kommunen, Stadtwerken und institutionellen Investoren.

  • Du entwickelst in enger Abstimmung mit HR das Employer Branding von FASTR und machst uns als Arbeitgeber sichtbar – von den Karrierekanälen bis zur internen Kommunikation.

  • Du verantwortest die Presse- und Medienarbeit, baust Beziehungen zu relevanten Medien und Multiplikatoren auf und positionierst das Unternehmen zu den Themen der Energie- und Immobilienwirtschaft.

  • Du steuerst und erweiterst die Kommunikationskanäle – von LinkedIn bis zur Fachpresse – und entwickelst Formate, die zur Positionierung des Unternehmens passen.

  • Du steuerst die Zusammenarbeit von Corporate Communications und Sales Marketing und verantwortest die digitalen Marketingkampagnen – von Content über Social Media bis Performance Marketing – zur Unterstützung von Markenbekanntheit und Leadgenerierung.

  • Du schaffst die Grundlagen einer skalierbaren Kommunikationsfunktion: Prozesse, Guidelines, Standards und Strukturen, die mit dem Unternehmen mitwachsen.

  • Du führst ein kleines Team an der Schnittstelle von Kommunikation und Marketing, entwickelst es weiter und verzahnst beide Bereiche eng.

Das bringst du mit

Erforderlich

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Unternehmenskommunikation, davon nachweislich in einer gestaltenden oder aufbauenden Funktion.

  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit, komplexe, erklärungsbedürftige Sachverhalte klar, präzise und zielgruppengerecht zu vermitteln.

  • Erfahrung in der B2B- und Stakeholder-Kommunikation, idealerweise in einem technisch, industriell oder infrastrukturnah geprägten Umfeld.

  • Strategisches Denkvermögen kombiniert mit der Fähigkeit und Bereitschaft, Themen selbst operativ umzusetzen.

  • Sicheres, souveränes Auftreten gegenüber der Geschäftsführungsebene – du schaffst Klarheit und vertrittst deine fachliche Haltung überzeugend.

  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Presse- und Medienarbeit.

  • Erfahrung in der Führung von Mitarbeitenden sowie die Bereitschaft, ein Team aufzubauen und weiterzuentwickeln.

Von Vorteil

  • Ein belastbares Netzwerk zu Medien und Fachöffentlichkeit.

  • Erfahrung in Marken- oder Integrationsphasen, etwa bei der Zusammenführung mehrerer Organisationen unter einer gemeinsamen Marke.

  • Erfahrung darin, eine neue oder sich entwickelnde Markenidentität kommunikativ zu tragen.

  • Nähe zu erklärungsbedürftigen Branchen wie Energie, Infrastruktur oder Immobilienwirtschaft.

  • Erfahrung im Employer Branding und Personalmarketing, idealerweise in enger Zusammenarbeit mit HR.

  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung digitaler Marketingkampagnen (z. B. Content-, Social-Media- und Performance-Marketing) sowie im Zusammenspiel mit Sales Marketing.

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Eine Aufbau- und Gestaltungsrolle mit echtem Mandat statt vorgegebener Routinen.

  • Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung und Einfluss auf die Außen- und Innenwahrnehmung des Unternehmens.

  • Ein Unternehmen in einer aktiven Wachstums- und Integrationsphase, in der Kommunikation strategisch gebraucht wird.

  • Die Möglichkeit, eine Kommunikationsfunktion nach eigenen Vorstellungen zu prägen und mit dem Unternehmen wachsen zu lassen.

  • Eine Aufgabe mit Sinn: Hinter deinen Botschaften stehen echte Anlagen, echte Kunden und ein Thema, das gesellschaftlich zählt.

  • Eine solide Basis: über 25 Jahre operative Erfahrung, rund 1.100 betriebene Heizzentralen und ein Investor im Rücken, der unser Wachstum trägt.

  • Ein Team im Zusammenwachsen: Aus drei Unternehmen wird eine Marke – und du prägst mit, wie sich das nach innen und außen anfühlt.

Warum diese Rolle?

Solche Ausgangslagen sind selten: eine etablierte operative Basis von über 25 Jahren, eine frisch geschärfte Marke und ein finanziell solide getragenes Wachstum. Wenn du Unternehmenskommunikation nicht verwalten, sondern gestalten und sichtbar Wirkung erzielen möchtest, findest du hier den Rahmen dafür – mit Verantwortung ab dem ersten Tag und dem Gestaltungsspielraum, eine Funktion von Grund auf zu prägen.

title: Head of Creative
descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Role Description

Own creative direction for Allica Bank across brand, design, motion, video, copy and web, leading a multi-disciplinary studio team that serves both brand & marketing work and the high-volume production needs of Growth & Digital Acquisition. Balance hands-on craft leadership with production efficiency at scale, and drive AI adoption across the studio to meet growth's velocity requirements without compromising brand or compliance standards.

Principal Accountabilities

Creative direction & craft

  • Set and maintain creative direction across all brand & growth touchpoints including digital, video, motion, print/OOH, email, sales collateral and internal comms.

  • Provide hands-on creative direction and craft feedback across brand, copy, design, motion and video.

  • Direct and prioritise in-house studio output; own the AI tooling roadmap for extending capacity and make the resourcing case if/when AI-assisted tools no longer cover demand.

Team & production management

  • Lead, develop and manage a team of 7 across copy, design, motion/video and web.

  • Own production process end-to-end: briefing, resourcing, review cycles, delivery timelines, quality control.

  • Manage external agency/freelance relationships where in-house capacity is stretched.

Production capacity & growth support

  • Own the studio's operating model for serving two distinct demand types: considered brand/campaign work, and high-volume, fast-turnaround performance/growth creative (landing pages, ad variants, paid social, CRO test assets).

  • Build a production process (templating, design systems, copy/creative frameworks, AI-assisted variant generation) that can meet Growth & Digital Acquisition's volume and speed requirements without pulling the whole studio into reactive, always-on production.

  • Partner directly with Growth/Digital Acquisition leadership to support in-housing of all Allica’s creative assets, agree SLAs, prioritisation rules, and what can be templated/self-served vs. what needs bespoke creative input.

  • Decide what volume of production can be safely delegated to AI-assisted workflows versus what requires human craft and compliance review.

  • Track studio capacity against demand from both brand and growth, and use that data to make resourcing/tooling cases.

AI adoption

  • Own the studio's broader AI adoption roadmap across design, copy, motion and web production, balancing speed against brand quality and IP/copyright risk.

  • Periodically reassess whether AI tooling is sufficient to cover demand or whether the team has outgrown that setup, and make a resourcing case if so.

Brand

  • Champion brand consistency and evolution as Allica scale.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Proven creative leadership role (Creative Lead/Director level) in a high-growth in-house or prestigious agency environment, managing a multi-discipline team of similar size.

  • Genuine hands on craft experience across brand, copy, design and motion/video, not delegated oversight.

  • Practical, current experience embedding AI tools into creative production workflows (design, copy, motion, and ideally web/no-code tooling).

  • Experience running a creative studio that serves both brand and performance/growth marketing demand, understands the difference in process, pace and quality bar between the two.

  • Experience building templated/systemised creative production (design systems, modular copy frameworks, creative testing pipelines) to support high-volume output.

  • • Comfortable partnering with Growth, Digital Acquisition and Product stakeholders, not just Brand and Marketing.

  • Strong commercial acumen and able to work with senior commercial, product and growth leads and advocate for the importance of quality creative execution.

  • Financial promotions or regulated marketing experience: a plus, not a requirement. Comfortable learning and operating within a regulated approval process even without prior direct experience.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

descriptionHtml:
Über Cosuno

Die Baubranche ist eine 14-Billionen-Euro-Industrie, die noch immer auf E-Mails, Excel-Tabellen und eingescannten PDFs läuft. Cosuno ersetzt das durch KI. Generalunternehmer schreiben ihre Projekte auf unserer Plattform an mehr als 250.000 Nachunternehmer aus, und unsere agentische KI findet die passenden Firmen, erkennt Auffälligkeiten in Angeboten und vergleicht jeden Preis mit 6,5 Millionen Datenpunkten aus über 136 Milliarden Euro verarbeitetem Angebotsvolumen. Jede Ausschreibung macht die KI klüger. Die Ergebnisse sind messbar: Generalunternehmer senken ihre Kosten um rund 6 %, Nachunternehmer gewinnen 22 % mehr Volumen, und jeder neue Generalunternehmer-Kunde hat sich in diesem Jahr für unser KI-Produkt entschieden. 2019 in Berlin gegründet und von Cherry Ventures und Spark Capital mit über 40 Millionen Euro finanziert, skalieren wir mit diesem Kapital jetzt Sales, Customer Success und Marketing. Und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Die Rolle

Du übernimmst das SC-Customer-Success-Team und verantwortest den Churn im Nachunternehmer-Segment vollständig. Nicht als Sponsor, sondern als Owner: Aktivierungslogik, Winback-Playbook, Durchsatz je Person, Forecast. Du entscheidest, was gemessen wird, was im Playbook steht und wann es sich ändert.

Wir führen Customer Success wie Vertrieb. Du bist dafür verantwortlich, dass dieses System läuft, und du bist selbst Teil davon: Die härtesten Kündigungen und Eskalationen fährst du persönlich.

Woran wir dich nach 12 Monaten messen

  • Churn im Nachunternehmer-Segment liegt unter 20 %. Heute sind es 28 %. Das ist die eine Zahl, an der sich alles andere ausrichtet.

  • Die Winback-Quote deines Teams liegt bei mindestens 50 % der bearbeiteten Kündigungen.

  • 90 % der onboardeten Kunden sind nach 30 Tagen aktiv – und das bleibt so, während du gemeinsam mit Product die Selbstaktivierung im Produkt ausbaust.

  • Winback- und Onboarding-Playbook gehören dir: Sie laufen, werden wöchentlich gemessen und du änderst sie, wenn die Zahlen es sagen. Der wöchentliche Forecast läuft ab deinem ersten Monat.

  • Die harten Cases und Eskalationen hast du selbst geführt – und wenn das Team unter Wasser ist, mehr.

  • Product und Sales bekommen von dir strukturiert, was Kunden sagen: Kündigungsgründe, Aktivierungshürden, falsche Erwartungen aus dem Closing.

Wer bei Cosuno erfolgreich ist

  • Ownership. Du sprichst über eigene Fehler, bevor jemand fragt, und darüber, was du daraus geändert hast.

  • Speed. Du löst Probleme pragmatisch und heute, nicht perfekt und nächstes Quartal.

  • Drive. Du hast Beispiele parat, wo du Prozesse gebaut oder Probleme gelöst hast, ohne dass dich jemand darum gebeten hat.

  • Low Ego. Du redest über Team-Erfolge und gibst Credit weiter – und hast trotzdem eigene Zahlen, die du nennen kannst.

Diese Rolle ist für dich, wenn

  • du ein Team mit eigener Zahl geführt hast und weißt, wie es sich anfühlt, wenn eine Person drei Wochen unter Ziel liegt – und was du dann tust.

  • du selbst Kündigungen gedreht hast, ohne den Preis zu verschenken, und das auch noch einmal tun willst.

  • du in Cases pro Woche denkst, nicht in zwanzig Accounts, die du betreust.

  • du am Vormittag ein Playbook schreibst und am Nachmittag den Kundencall führst

Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn

  • du Customer Success als Beziehungspflege verstehst und Verkaufen jemand anderem überlässt.

  • du als Head keine Kundencalls mehr machen willst.

  • du Prozesse baust, aber nie selbst gegen eine Quote gearbeitet hast.

  • du aus der Strategieberatung kommst und noch nie ein operatives SaaS-Team geführt hast.


Harte Anforderungen

  • 3–5 Jahre B2B SaaS in Customer Success, Retention, Renewals oder Account Management, davon mindestens 2 Jahre Führung eines quotentragenden Teams.

Was wir bieten

title: Head of Data Platform (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Since its creation in 2007 in the financial city of Frankfurt am Main, Solactive AG has grown to one of the key players in the indexing space. The German multi-asset index provider focusses on tailor-made indices, offering to its clients a faster service, with greater flexibility and at a reasonable cost. Solactive AG and its subsidiaries have become one of the fastest growing index providers over the past few years and support the leading investment banks and asset managers across the globe. We have gained global recognition for our role in the Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) industry, where we rank among the top providers worldwide for underlying indices. We also excel in diverse areas such as Structured Products and investment mandates, showcasing the wide range of our capabilities. The impact and value we bring to the market is palpable, but also in the reputation we have proudly built by being close to our customers, solidifying Solactive AG as a trusted and reliable ally in the ever-evolving global financial landscape.

Job Overview

At Solactive, data powers everything we do. We are looking for a Director, Data Platform to lead the architecture and operation of our internal data hub, ensuring clean, reliable, and timely market data reaches our teams. If you thrive on building scalable, high-impact data platforms, we'd love to hear from you.

Your Tasks

  • Translate market data and client requirements into platform capabilities, aligning technical solutions with business and product objectives.
  • Define and deliver the data platform vision by building and operating a scalable, reliable, and cost-effective infrastructure that underpins index construction, analytics, and client delivery.
  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of ~30 data engineers and operations professionals, fostering a culture of trust, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Oversee end-to-end data operations from ingestion and normalization of hundreds of external market data sources to reliable internal distribution.
  • Shape data architecture and governance frameworks to ensure data quality, lineage, compliance, and operational excellence.
  • Drive strategic alignment and execution across engineering, product, and operations teams to deliver on shared business outcomes.
  • Promote innovation and systems thinking by evaluating internal and external solutions or services to ensure the platform evolves with new technologies, data sources, and business needs.
  • Communicate vision and progress effectively to stakeholders across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Partner with HR and senior leadership to attract, develop, and retain top talent, building sustainable leadership and technical depth within the team.

Your Profile

  • Experience: 10+ years in data engineering, platform management, or infrastructure leadership, including 5+ years leading large teams.
  • Domain Knowledge: Understanding of financial market data (e.g., pricing, reference, corporate actions, ESG, and alternative data).
  • Technical Expertise:
    • Deep experience with modern data architectures and tools (e.g., Kafka, Airflow, Flink, Iceberg, Databricks, Snowflake, AWS/GCP/Azure).
    • Proven ability to operate large-scale data ingestion and processing systems handling financial or reference data.
  • Leadership: Track record of leading multidisciplinary teams to deliver business-critical systems in complex environments.
  • Soft Skills: Excellent communicator with strong strategic thinking, stakeholder management, and problem-solving abilities.

Our Offer

  • Global Team: Join our motivated international team at Solactive
  • FinTech Excellence: Experience FinTech excellence at Solactive
  • Modern Culture: Enjoy our modern, flat hierarchy and startup-like culture
  • Responsibility & Connections: Take over responsibility from day one and build relationships in- and outside of the company.
  • Vacation: Enjoy 30 annual vacation days, plus extra time off for Christmas Eve and New Year
  • Competitive Compensation: Receive a competitive compensation package
  • Special Benefits: Job ticket, access to Corporate Benefits, modern office space with ergonomic set-up, employee lounge, and free beverages and fruits
  • Community & Networking: Engage in our various networking events
  • Professional Development: Grow both personally and professionally through our diverse training offers
  • Flexibility: Embrace a flexible work culture with the freedom to choose your work hours, all within a diverse and dynamic environment

title: Head Of Data Protection & DPO
descriptionHtml:
💬 Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS.

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book,which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.


The Opportunity:

We're on a journey to steward AI into the NHS safely and responsibly. We've already deployed ambient voice technology to write up consultations, released our first AI triage products to help practices read and route hundreds of patient requests a day, and we're now working on deploying agents in healthcare settings.

The next few years will define how AI is used with patient data in the NHS. As Head of Data Protection and our in-house DPO, you'll help set that standard nationally: building the frameworks that let us move quickly and safely, and earning the trust of the patients, clinicians and organisations who rely on us.

This role is about building and shaping, not just running. You'll own data protection at Accurx end to end: the strategy, the statutory role, the team and the calls. You'll be a key leader in our Technology division, working as a trusted partner to our Chief Product Officer and Head of Legal.

Challenges you'll solve...

  • Steward AI into the NHS: set Accurx's positions on how we build, deploy and monitor AI products at scale, from controllership and assistive vs automated, to retention of AI inputs and outputs, sub-processors and model hosting, without ever undermining the trust we've built with our users

  • Set guardrails, not gates: define clear guardrails so product teams can move fast inside them without asking permission each time, and make our positions public and credible so NHS DPOs can rely on them rather than starting from scratch

  • Bring privacy into product design: work with product, design and engineering to embed privacy by design. Much of what we're building hasn't been seen in the health system before, so you'll need to be unapologetically forward-looking and comfortable taking informed, calculated risks

  • Turn decisions into reusable patterns: with our in-house privacy team, build governance templates, pre-approved data flows and plain-English privacy notice wording that healthcare organisations can pick up and use, and shape how we responsibly use our data to improve products and patient outcomes

  • Hold the statutory DPO role with independence: inform, advise and monitor compliance under UK GDPR, including our record of processing, DPIAs, training and audits. You'll be our named contact for the ICO, NHS customers and data subjects, and lead testing, breach assessment and reporting

  • Run corporate privacy: own our core privacy obligations and registrations, keep the evidence current for regulators, customers and bids, lead privacy due diligence on suppliers, partners and corporate transactions, and oversee how we handle employee and corporate data as well as patient data

  • Build a function that moves at product speed: lead and grow a small, bar-raising privacy and data function, and make it easy for 200+ colleagues to get fast, consistent answers to privacy questions

You should apply if...

  • You're product-minded about privacy: you've worked inside a product company and helped ship things, finding an approach that's both more private and better for the user. You've guided technology organisations through responsible innovation, especially where AI/ML meets sensitive data

  • You're AI-fluent with deep UK data protection expertise: you apply UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018, the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 and the common law duty of confidentiality in practice, understand how modern AI systems actually handle data, and have a view on ICO AI guidance and where regulation is heading

  • You've built and led privacy teams: you grow capability, bring your team into decisions, delegate real ownership and build trust across functions

  • You're confident externally: you can represent the business to regulators, NHS organisations and partners, and communicate complex positions clearly

  • You know health and the NHS, or have a fast route to it: controller and processor roles in primary care, DSPT, DTAC, the Caldicott Principles and the national data opt-out. You learn the NHS by going to see it

  • You challenge the status quo: you stay ahead of changes in digital health, AI and data ethics, and see privacy as something that enables the business to move at pace

What’s in it for you?

You’ll join a high-performing team on a mission to solve healthcare productivity, building a platform used by around 300k NHS staff every week, supporting the care of over 50 million NHS patients every year. We set a high bar, move fast, and give people the ownership and support to do the best work of their careers

  • £110,000 - £140,000 salary, plus a discretionary recognition bonus for exceptional performance and impact, nominated by managers and awarded by our leadership team

  • Equity: £100,000 in equal share options, so you share in the value you help create

  • Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life

  • Built for collaboration: We are an office-first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office for a minimum of 3 days a week

  • Close to our users: Regular hackathons, plus dedicated time to visit GP practices and other healthcare settings to see first-hand how our products are used

  • Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year

  • Support at home: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support

  • We have our very own chefs: Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches, plus a weekly sweet treat

Compensation: £110K – £140K • Offers Equity

title: Head of Data Science and Analytics (JetBrains Air)
descriptionHtml:
You’ve built data teams from the ground up and know how to turn raw information into better product decisions. You care deeply about how AI is changing software development, and you want to shape the data foundations that make it happen.

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 organizations, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 companies rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

JetBrains Air is an AI-native software development platform that connects developer workflows, collaboration, and control into a single system. Because this is a major strategic focus for us, we need a strong data function to help guide it. As Head of Data Science and Analytics for JetBrains Air, you’ll lead our data science, analytics, and data engineering capabilities for both the product and go-to-market domains. 

By building a high-performing team, you’ll help us use data to navigate product direction, optimize product and go-to-market decisions, and accelerate growth. You’ll own the data strategy for JetBrains AI, partnering closely with product, engineering, and leadership teams to ensure our data infrastructure scales smoothly alongside our ambitions.

Day to day, you will:

  • Build and lead a cohesive team of data scientists, analysts, and data engineers.
  • Help teams adopt a rigorous experimentation culture, improving how we test and measure product changes.
  • Uncover insights across the customer journey to improve acquisition, retention, and monetization.
  • Establish scalable analytics foundations, including clear metric frameworks, data models, and self-service reporting.
  • Partner with engineering teams to design robust, compliant data infrastructure and pipelines.
  • Guide the development of machine learning capabilities that enhance marketing acquisition, product personalization, and operational efficiency.
  • Translate complex data signals into clear, actionable recommendations for leadership.
  • Define the business unit's data strategy to support product and engineering priorities.

What you’ll bring

  • A strategic mindset paired with a willingness to dive hands-on into the details when necessary.
  • A strong belief in building experimentation cultures and helping others make data-informed decisions.
  • The ability to navigate ambiguity and build new capabilities in a fast-moving space.
  • Clear, candid communication skills to align both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A deep appreciation for developer products and a distinct point of view on how AI will shape the future of software creation.
  • A commitment to maintaining high standards for privacy, security, and responsible data use.

What you’ll need

  • Proven experience leading and scaling a data function within a product-led, B2B SaaS, AI, or developer tools environment.
  • A deep understanding of modern data science and analytics practices, including cohort analysis, A/B testing, segmentation, and machine learning applications to product and marketing problems.
  • A solid grasp of data engineering fundamentals, such as data modeling, and orchestration.
  • A track record of hiring, mentoring, and developing multidisciplinary data teams.
  • Willingness to learn fast and find practical solutions to hard problems.

What success looks like

You will have transformed JetBrains Air into a truly data-informed, experimentation-driven product offering. By establishing strong data foundations, you’ll empower teams to deeply understand our customers, accurately measure product impact, and confidently make strategic decisions. Rather than just reporting on what has already happened, your work will actively shape what we build next.


Why join JetBrains? 

  • Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
  • Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
  • Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad.
  • Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
  • Medical insurance allowance. Enjoy peace of mind for you and your family
  • Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
  • Relocation support. We help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible.
  • Language classes. Pick up the local language or sharpen your English skills.
  • Fuel your day. Enjoy a hot meal or receive a lunch allowance on workdays.
  • Mental health support. To help you feel your best, we provide easy access to professional mental health services.
  • Sports benefit. Enjoy an on-site gym or sports club stipend.
  • Internal events. Join company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.

*Some benefits may vary depending on location.

title: Head of Design
descriptionHtml:
Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work.

Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual.

Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate.

A bit about us:

🚀 We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on.

🏢 Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision.

💰 We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date.

🤝 We're trusted by 5,000+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster.

💡 Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one.

The role

You will report directly to the CTO and work alongside engineering, product, legal engineering and AI from the start. Your direct team is small today, three designers, and you will shape how it grows from here.

Your starting point is not a design backlog handed to you in advance. It is the product strategy, growth ambition, and AI-first operating model, and you will use that context to set the design agenda.

Orbital is at an inflection point. The product is live and trusted by some of the most demanding real estate legal professionals in the world. The challenge now is not building something from scratch but making it significantly better: cleaner, faster, and genuinely easier to trust. As the product scales across the UK and US, the design function needs to grow with it, and you will be the person who builds it.

What you'll do

Lead from the product.

Your first team is the product engineering leadership team. You will be part of product, commercial, and strategic conversations, bringing a strategic design perspective to business challenges rather than representing the design function in isolation. From there, you will form your own view on where the product experience is constraining growth, where the interface is creating friction for users, and what needs to change. You will help the leadership team pressure-test product decisions against user reality, spot where information architecture, interaction patterns, or visual clarity are becoming bottlenecks, and ensure that how we design is aligned with where the business is heading.

Set the design agenda from product context.

You will not be given a predefined project list. You will assess what you learn from the product, the users, and the business and set the design priorities from there. That means making sure areas like information architecture, interaction design, design systems, user research, and AI interface patterns are pointed at the right problems and prioritised accordingly. A major part of the brief is translating current product realities into a sharper design mandate and challenging existing assumptions when the evidence demands it.

Define what AI-native design looks like here.

The hardest design problems at Orbital are not aesthetic. They are epistemic. How do you help a real estate lawyer trust an AI output enough to put their name to it? How do you present the reasoning behind a 50-document analysis in a way that a partner can review in 20 minutes? How do you make agentic behaviour feel controllable to a professional who is accountable for the outcome? You will set the standard for how Orbital answers those questions, shape the interaction patterns that distinguish our product from everything else in the market, and hold the wider team accountable for the quality of the experience we ship.

Build the design function.

You will be the consistent presence the design team anchors around. You will invest in their growth, develop clear ownership within the function, and be accountable for the team's development over time, not just its immediate output. Over time you will shape a high-leverage design function that combines strong craft, deep user understanding, and a genuine instinct for where AI changes the rules.

Requirements

The must-haves

  • Significant experience leading product design at a senior level at a scaling B2B tech company. You bring real depth across the design discipline. That foundation is essential, but what sets you apart is the ability to operate beyond it.

  • A track record of sitting at the product leadership table and influencing business decisions, not just delivering a design agenda within one.

  • Experience scaling a design function through a high-growth phase, with the judgment to know what process and structure matters at each stage and what slows you down.

  • You have designed AI-native products. Not tools with AI bolted on. You have worked through the real problems: explainability, trust, agentic UX, confidence signals. You have opinions formed from real experience.

  • You have designed for expert professional users, people who know their domain better than any designer ever will, and you understand how to design for that dynamic without condescending or oversimplifying.

  • Strong commercial instincts. You understand how product design affects adoption, retention, and revenue, and you can connect design decisions to business outcomes.

  • The ability to translate product context into a design strategy and challenge existing priorities when the evidence demands it.

  • Experience leading through a design team, setting direction and standards without owning every deliverable.

And a few nice-to-haves

  • Direct experience of a Series B to Series C growth journey.

  • Built a design function from an early-stage base rather than inherited one.

  • Familiarity with legal tech, fintech, compliance tech or another domain where precision and professional accountability shape every design decision.

  • Experience building or significantly evolving a design system that improved team velocity at scale.

Why you'll love it here

  • You will join a company at a genuine inflection point, with real influence at the product engineering leadership table from day one.

  • You will shape the design function rather than inherit one, with room to build it around craft, research, and AI-first thinking.

  • The design problems here are some of the most interesting and challenging in the market.

  • You will be part of a collaborative, highly ambitious team where the standard is high and the ownership is real.

Benefits 🌟

🧑 💻 We believe in flexibility, but we're also big on in-person collaboration. This role is based in our London office with an expectation of multiple days in the office per week. It's about being present when it matters, and balancing autonomy with commitment.

🏢 Equity options in a fast-growing startup

🌴 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

📚 Personal development budget and learning opportunities

🍔 Free lunch on Wednesdays and Deliveroo budget for late nights

🚲 Cycle-to-work scheme

📚 A bias toward experimentation, rapid learning, and iterating quickly based on real feedback

We're in the process of building an inclusive, welcoming culture where everyone feels seen and valued. Expect regular team off-sites, shared lunches, and social events, with something for everyone.

🔒 Security is everyone’s responsibility at Orbital. We ask all team members to follow our security policies, complete regular awareness training, and handle sensitive data with care in line with ISO 27001 standards. Spot something unusual? Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on.

💡 At Orbital, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially welcome applications from people who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, or if the right role isn’t listed yet, we’d still love to hear from you.

💰 This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on several factors, which may include job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and business requirements.

Everyone who works with Orbital goes through background screening before they start. It's part of how we keep Orbital secure, for the people who work here and for the client information we're trusted with.

title: Head of Engineering (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

We're hiring a Head of Engineering to lead engineering for one of our product tribes. You'll manage 15 to 20 engineers directly, with tech leads in each squad owning technical direction but no management layer between you and the team. You report to the CTO and sit in a tribe leadership trio with the Product Tribe Lead and Design Lead. Which tribe you'd lead is something we'll work out with you during the process.

This is a people leadership role with a hard technical requirement. The engineers report to you, so hiring, development, performance and pace are yours. At the same time you have to hold your own on system architecture: challenge estimates from your engineers, spar with the Product Tribe Lead on solutions, and know when a design is wrong before it ships. This role needs both.

How we're set up

Tribes are the organisational body: people management, capacity, planning and reporting live there. Squads are assigned to problem spaces and run discovery and delivery, each led by a trio of Tech Lead, Product Manager and Product Designer. Tech Leads own the technical decisions in their squad, including estimates, and write code alongside their engineers. They don't manage people. You do.

We keep the structure deliberately flat. Management is anchored at tribe level, squad composition flexes to serve the most important work, and structure changes as we learn (roughly every six months in practice, not on a schedule). Discovery and delivery run in parallel: the next mission is scoped before engineers finish the current one, so engineers weigh in on architecture early and have the context to unblock themselves.

What you'll own

  • Feasibility and delivery for the tribe. You're accountable for tribe-wide delivery outcomes and velocity: the right problems, solved at the right quality, as fast as possible.

  • The people. 15 to 20 direct reports. Hiring, onboarding, expectations, feedback, development, compensation and promotion recommendations, and the tough calls that keep talent density high. Tech Leads feed you performance signals; the decisions and the conversations are yours.

  • Technical judgement across squads. Broad understanding of the tribe's systems and how they fit into the wider Moss architecture. You challenge estimates and technical proposals from your engineers; you don't produce the estimates yourself.

  • A seat in the tribe trio. Roadmap and planning input through a feasibility lens. You argue solutions and trade-offs with the Product Tribe Lead as a technical peer, and push back on scope and timelines when the engineering picture says so.

  • Operating rhythm. How the tribe plans, estimates, tracks and reports on delivery, with proactive, timely transparency to the tribe and to leadership, the good and the bad.

  • Capacity. Putting your best people on the most impactful work, moving engineers between squads (and, where it serves Moss, between tribes) while still letting people build real domain depth.

  • Alignment across tribes. Tribe leads aren't isolated trios. You align proactively with your peer Heads of Engineering and with platform and architecture owners, and you resolve shared-architecture questions through alignment, not around it.

How we expect leaders to operate

  • Velocity first, with high agency. Working smart and hard on the right problems.

  • Lead by example, stay close to the work. You know the details of what your team is building and course-correct in real time. You get hands-on when speed or quality is on the line.

  • End-to-end ownership of outcomes. Responsibility doesn't stop at your team's boundary. Make changes elsewhere when that's what it takes, communicating first, not unilaterally.

  • No waterfall, no blame. Product, Design and Engineering work together from the start. If there's a gap in the trio, fill it or name it.

  • Disagree and commit. Challenge when it matters. Once a call is made, own the message and explain the why, including for calls you argued against.

  • Proactive expertise. We build expert products for finance teams. Decisions rest on real expertise, internal and external, not assumptions.

Moss has one manager framework for every people leader, and this role is held to it in full: build a high-performing team, define success clearly, deliver results with your team, and operate with speed and ownership. You can hold us to it too.

What you bring

  • 4 to 6+ years in engineering management, with a track record of managing engineers directly at a meaningful span. You've run hiring, performance management and difficult conversations yourself, not through a layer of managers.

  • A senior engineering career before that. You've operated at senior or staff level as an engineer and your judgement on system design is current, not historical.

  • Strong systems design. You can read an architecture, spot where it will break, and argue an alternative with the people who built it. You can tell a 2-week estimate from a 6-week one and explain why.

  • Comfort as a technical peer to product leadership. You've shaped roadmaps and scope through feasibility arguments, and you've won and lost those arguments gracefully.

  • Structure at scale without a middle layer. You build the practices that make 15 to 20 direct reports work: clear expectations, regular feedback, visible delivery.

  • Fast in unfamiliar domains. You can reason about a new technical domain quickly and contribute before you have deep prior expertise in it.

  • Experience from an environment with mature engineering practices: code review, testing, incident handling, planning and estimation that actually work. You know what good looks like and can build it where it's missing.

Strong pluses

  • Background at an AI product company or in ERP / financial systems. Both are directly relevant to what we build.

  • Experience leading in a flat or tribe/squad-style organisation.

  • Experience with a Tech Lead / Engineering Manager split, as either side of it.

What this role is, and isn't

It's worth being clear about the shape of the job. Your technical contribution is judgement, challenge and architecture-level input; Tech Leads own the how and write the code alongside their squads, so this isn't a role with an IC workload attached. And it's a role where you manage engineers, not managers: every engineer in the tribe reports to you directly, there is no management layer beneath you, and we don't plan to add one. If that combination of deep people leadership and real technical engagement is what you're looking for, you'll find a lot to like here.

About Moss

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star.

We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA: playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect:

  • Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. 

  • Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.

  • Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.

Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).

By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our Data Privacy Policy.

title: Head of Engineering (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Unsere Opportunity

Predium hat in den letzten drei Jahren die führende Immoblien-Intelligence-Plattform für ESG und Wert-Management in der DACH-Region gebaut - mit den stärksten Namen der Branche als Kunden: Asset Manager, Wohnungsbaugesellschaften, Banken. Unsere Kundenbasis, die Daten, unsere Glaubwürdigkeit sind wertvolles Kapital für den nächsten Schritt. Investment-, Kredit- und Asset-Management-Entscheidung werden in der Real Estate Branche noch immer in Excel getroffen, Fall für Fall. Wir bauen jetzt den AI-Analysten, der diese Arbeit übernimmt. Direkt auf den Daten des Kunden, skalierbar ohne zusätzliche Köpfe. Wir sind stark finanziert und bringen KI in die Real Estate Branche.

Deine Mission

Als Head of Engineering übernimmst du die Führung unseres aktuell rund 10-köpfigen Engineering-Teams und baust es weiter aus. Du hilfst deinem Team, ambitioniert zu liefern: kontinuierliche Verbesserungen für unsere bestehenden Kunden, aber auch neue Prototypen und Innovationen, die unser Geschäftsmodell erweitern. Gleichzeitig sorgst du für Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit im Team, damit alle jeden Tag ein Stück besser werden.

Du bist ein starker Sparringspartner und denkst in Systemen: Gemeinsam mit unserem C-Level, dem Product- und Data-Team sowie unseren Kunden entwickelst du unsere Produktstrategie weiter und findest technisch tragfähige, smarte Lösungen. Bei uns gewinnt die beste Idee - egal von wem sie kommt. Mit 40 Leuten gibt's einfach keinen Raum für Politik.

Technisch baust du unsere Architektur so, dass sie mit uns skaliert und Raum für Innovation lässt - etwa bei der Integration von AI-Komponenten und Datenpipelines. Dabei hast du bei uns freie Hand: Neues ausprobieren, den Tech-Stack weiterentwickeln und auch Kapazität für technisches Fundament und Tech Debt einplanen.

So hilfst du auch unseren Sales- und Customer-Success-Teams, neue Kunden zu gewinnen - und baust dir damit deine eigene User- und Fan-Base auf. Und: Jede Zeile Code trägt dazu bei, den CO2-Fußabdruck von Immobilien zu verbessern.

Tech-Stack: TypeScript (Full Stack, React im Frontend, NestJS im Backend), Hasura/GraphQL, PostgreSQL RDS, AWS ECS / Elastic Beanstalk, Claude

Woran wir Erfolg messen

  • Du holst das Beste aus agentic engineering raus und erweiterst zusammen mit deinem Team die Plattform um eine 360°-Sicht auf die Immobilie.
  • Du hast das Team schneller liefern lassen - indem du es unterstützt, die Can-do-Mentalität stärkst und den Fokus auf die wirklich wichtigen Dinge setzt - bei Produkten und Architektur-Projekten.
  • Du hast das Team um starke Talente erweitert.
  • Du weißt, was jede Person in deinem Team antreibt - und hast ihr geholfen, die eigene Performance aufs nächste Level zu heben.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Software-Engineering-Führung und -Architektur, mit einer Erfolgsbilanz beim Skalieren von Engineering-Teams bei gleichzeitig hoher Shipping-Geschwindigkeit - idealerweise in einem Nicht-Konzernumfeld.
  • Du liebst es, Teams wachsen zu lassen, sie in ihrer Entwicklung zu unterstützen und ihnen gleichzeitig ambitionierte Ziele zu setzen.
  • Du hast fundierte Erfahrung mit den genannten Frontend- und Backend-Technologien sowie modernen Tech-Stacks - nicht, indem du alles selbst codest, sondern indem du dein Team befähigst.
  • Du denkst in Systemen und löst Probleme konsequent aus einer First-Principles-Perspektive.
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau bzw. C1 und fließend Englisch.

Warum Predium?

  • Stage: ~40 Leute, stark finanziert, auf dem Weg die Kategorie zu definieren. Früh genug, dass vieles noch gebaut werden muss. Ja, es ist manchmal messy - aber genau das ist der Punkt. Wenn du einen fertigen Playbook-Job suchst, ist das hier nicht der richtige Fit.
  • Impact: Du bist nicht Rädchen #100 in einer Company. Was du hier aufbaust - Team, Architektur, ein Produkt, das Kunden wirklich nutzen - bleibt. Dein Beitrag ist direkt sichtbar: im Revenue, im Produkt und darin, wie das Engineering-Team in einem Jahr arbeitet.
  • Ownership: Wir managen nicht deine Zeit, wir messen deine Ergebnisse. Du bekommst Verantwortung und Freiraum - und die Erwartung, beides zu nutzen.
  • Compensation: Competitive Salary, Bonus und Equity-Beteiligung. Wir wollen, dass du am Erfolg partizipierst, den du mitaufbaust.
  • Team: Office-first im Werksviertel München, 3,5 Tage/Woche.

title: Head of Finance Automation/ AI Agentification
descriptionHtml:
Finance at Rohlik is being rebuilt to run on AI. We already have agents in production that chase overdue payments, process invoices, allocate cash and clear the team's inbox. The pieces work. What we need now is one person to own the whole thing and make it deliver at scale.

 

Role Overview

This is a new role that owns how AI and automation reshape the finance operating model across the Group. You will take a programme that is already live across procure to pay, order to cash and our shared services centre, and turn it from a set of promising experiments into the way finance actually runs.

You report to the Group CFO. You inherit a small team and a live roadmap, and you own the result. You decide what gets automated first, you build and ship with AI tools when that is the fastest way, and you hold every workstream to a number.

The role is deliberately hands on. You should be close enough to the work to build an agent or connect two systems through an API with AI assistance, even though you are not a software developer. You should also be senior enough to redesign how finance works and bring the rest of the business with you.

 

Why this role is exciting

  • You’ll inherit a live AI programme with real agents, real data and real impact from day one — not a greenfield slide deck.

  • You’ll shape how Finance actually runs across the Group as we move toward the next stage of growth — including the journey toward IPO readiness.

  • You’ll have access to a top-notch AI-first tech stack and the freedom to use it pragmatically.

  • You’ll work directly with the Group CFO, with fast decisions and no corporate red tape.

  • Your good ideas will be implemented almost immediately — not parked in a roadmap waiting for HQ approval.

  • You’ll lead a small team, but this is not a “manager from a distance” role. It’s highly hands-on, high-impact, and built for someone who wants to make things move fast.

 

What we expect from you

  • Own the AI and automation agenda across finance, from strategy through delivery to measured impact.

  • Lead process redesign the right way: map and understand the as-is, then design an agentic-first to-be rather than automating the old steps.

  • Lead complex cross-functional programmes across Finance, Tech and Operations, driving delivery through stakeholders and teams beyond your direct reporting line.

  • Bring the live programme to its targets, with a clear owner, baseline and deadline behind every workstream.

  • Redesign core finance processes around AI and agents, starting with close, reporting and forecasting.

  • Build and ship yourself when it is faster, using AI assisted tools to create agents and connect systems such as NetSuite, Rossum and n8n.

  • Lead and grow the team (three today) and raise AI fluency across finance and the SSC so the business can use what you build.

  • Track what matters and report it straight: automation rate, close time, cash allocation speed, cost and effort taken out.

  • Roll out across our five markets, balancing local reality against one Group standard.

 

What we look for

You have probably spent time in strategy consulting or in a transformation role, and you are now genuinely excited by what AI can do. You are a sharp generalist who can walk into a messy process, find the real problem, and fix it. You are as comfortable in a CFO pre-read as you are in the AI first tool building the thing.

  • A track record of leading transformation or automation programmes that actually delivered. A consulting, operations or generalist operator background all fit.

  • Strong understanding of finance processes, ideally gained through finance transformation, operating model redesign or automation programmes.

  • Hands on with AI. You can build agents and integrate APIs with AI assistance. You are not a software engineer and you do not need to be, but the tooling does not scare you.

  • You set baselines, name owners, hit deadlines, and say so early when something slips.

  • You can lead a small team and still do the work yourself.

  • You prioritise by impact and move fast. Better done than perfect.

  • You bring finance, tech and operations along with you.

  • Fluent in English. Czech is not required, but is an advantage.

 

What’s in it for you

  • Fair reward - You’ll get a strong fixed salary — no bonus games, no politics. Great work is rewarded clearly and fairly.

  • Good food every day - You’ll enjoy a free lunch every day and fresh fruit & veggies in the office. Because good food fuels great work.

  • Life, not just work - You’ll have real flexibility – three days in the office, 2 days Home Office where it suits you. And unlimited paid vacation based on trust.

  • Personal growth - You’ll grow as fast as Rohlik does. Every challenge is a chance to learn and make an impact.

  • Real impact - What you do here matters. You’ll see your work changing how people eat and live — from day one.

  • Recognition among colleagues - Your effort won’t go unnoticed. You can recognise others (and be recognised) through peer credits to use in our internal cafeteria.

  • Xtra membership - You’ll get free Xtra membership and 10% cashback on everything you buy on Rohlik.cz.

  • Sport & wellbeing - You’ll stay active with company sports challenges or a subsidised Multisport card.

  • A team that sticks together - You’ll work with people who move fast, support each other and celebrate wins together.

  • If this sounds like you…You’re someone who takes ownership, acts fast and gets things done. Ready to bake something great with us?

Your mission

You will combine strategic foresight with strong execution skills: you will develop financial models and scenarios, evaluate business models, investments, partnerships and growth options, and make opportunities, risks and economic implications transparent to management.

In this role, you will work closely with the CFO, the executive team, functional departments and internal and external finance partners. A particular focus will be on international legal entity and intercompany structures, licensing and revenue-share models, as well as the further development of KPI, forecasting and reporting processes.

Why us?

title: Head of Finance
descriptionHtml:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

💰 Our Finance team

The Finance team ensures Joko's financial health and long-term success. We manage everything from financial planning and accounting to financing and cash management.

We make sure every euro is put to its best use, working closely with all teams, we provide the insights and structure needed to scale efficiently.

As we scale, we're splitting Finance into three specialized poles: FP&A, Finance Operations, and Procurement, each with its own ressources. Today, the team consists of 2 people but are actively recruiting toward a target organization of 7. Most of it is still to be hired and built — by you. You will report to Quentin, our COO.

✨ Why this role is special

  • You build the function instead of inheriting it. The target organization — FP&A, Finance Operations, Procurement — exists on paper and almost nothing of it is built. You recruit the team, set the standards, and decide how Finance operates for the next stage of the company. The role is designed to grow into VP Finance once the function is in place.

  • You get a genuinely 360 scope. Planning, accounting close, cash, financing, multi-entity structuring, procurement, and investor relations all sit with you — across multiple business lines, in France, Spain, and the US, with more markets coming. Very few finance leaders get that full surface at this stage.

  • You join a profitable company that is moving fast. Joko is already profitable and keeps growing quickly, with new business lines and countries opening. You build a finance function for a company on the offensive, not one managing a slowdown.

  • You sit at the table where the decisions are made. You partner directly with the COO and the co-founders on market expansion, investment allocation, and business line priorities, with the numbers you built as the basis of the discussion.

🎯 What you will do

This is a builder role. We are looking for a finance leader who runs the core of Finance hands-on today and builds the team that will run it tomorrow. Over the next two years, your mandate is to recruit the people the function is missing, set up the three poles, and put in place the processes that let you step back from the day-to-day.

We prefer to say it upfront: if what excites you is leading a team that already exists, this is not the role. If you want to build one on solid foundations and grow with it, it is a great one.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Build and lead the Finance team: manage and develop the current 2 team, recruit the next hires across FP&A, Finance Operations, and Procurement, and set how the team works;

  • Own planning and reporting: budget, forecast, and actuals vs. budget across all business lines (Online, Card-Linked, Gift Cards) and geographies. Our modeling combines elasticity-based CAC projections, cohort-based revenue models, and granular bottom-up cost budgets — you will own it, keep improving it.

  • Run the accounting close and controls: monthly and annual closing with our external accountants across France, Spain, and the US, the audit of our financial statements, and robust controls to prevent fraud and errors. Build toward group consolidation under international standards (IFRS) as entities are added;

  • Manage cash and financing: day-to-day cash visibility, Gift Cards working capital, multi-currency flows, and our relationships with banks and financing partners. Cash is king — make sure the whole company knows it;

  • Structure a multi-entity group: how our entities are organized, intercompany flows, transfer pricing, cost allocation, and local compliance as we open new countries;

  • Be the financial voice at the leadership table: partner with the COO and co-founders on market expansion, investment allocation, pricing, and business line priorities;

  • Support investor relations: investor model, financial reporting, and fundraising preparation;

  • Drive cost efficiency: work with budget owners on their targets and negotiate key supplier contracts;

  • Do the work, with AI: you will be a high-level individual contributor as much as a manager. We expect you to use AI to automate repetitive work (reporting, reconciliation, data extraction) and augment analysis, so a lean team operates like a much larger one;

  • Coordinate with external partners: accountants, auditors, and financial advisors.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have 10+ years of experience combining traditional finance (audit, transaction services, corporate finance, investment banking, or private equity) and finance in a high-growth tech company or scale-up. Ideally, you have done several cycles in companies at a stage close to ours.

  • Breadth: You have worked hands-on on at least two of the three pillars of a finance function: FP&A and business projection, accounting / financial control / cash, and financing / structuring / procurement. You are a 360 finance profile, not a specialist of one area.

  • Ownership: You have run a finance function, or a large part of one, end to end, and you have led or coordinated a team. You are ready to build a bigger one.

  • Team builder: You have hired and developed finance people yourself, and you know what good looks like when you interview for FP&A, accounting, or procurement profiles.

  • Hands-on builder: You are eager to build things yourself — models, closing processes, reporting packs — not only review them, and you have the drive to put in the work during the build phase.

  • Learning speed: You understand a new business fast, and you can explain its key mechanics clearly to demanding stakeholders, including co-founders and investors.

  • Strategic mindset: You think like a business partner, not just a finance controller, and you are comfortable challenging leadership with data-backed recommendations.

  • Operational rigor: You are structured, data-driven, and detail-oriented, with a talent for spotting flaws and building processes that prevent them.

  • AI-native mindset: You use AI tools in your work today and have a practical point of view on how they change the finance function.

  • Languages: You are fluent in English (the main language we use internally). French is a plus but not mandatory

🤝 Our hiring process

  • 20-min call with the Hiring Manager

  • 45-min personality interview with two team members

  • A case study followed by a 45-min debrief

  • 45-min Founders interview

  • Reference calls

You might also be invited to meet other team members at the office for a coffee or a drink!

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Compensation: €90K – €130K • Offers Equity

Yet an estimated 1.8 million people in the UK already use cannabis to manage a health condition, mostly outside the legal system. That is more than 10x today’s market, in a category that is still largely uncharted.

We are building a clinic and platform that makes care simpler, faster and more personal. Our UK team is at an early stage, which means real ownership, real impact and the chance to shape how we work from day one.

The role

  • Location: London, 4 days a week in the office

  • Reporting to: MD and Co-Founder UK

  • Employment type: Full-time, permanent

As Head of Growth, you will lead growth for enua UK: building our patient acquisition engine and shaping how the UK talks about medical cannabis as a legitimate treatment. This is a highly commercial, founding leadership role in the UK.

You will own our growth strategy and budget, with the mandate to build the team and infrastructure to deliver it. You will sit on a small management team with our MD and Co-Founder, jointly responsible for the success of the business, and have a real say in product, pricing and go-to-market decisions.

Tasks

  • Leadership: Be a core member of our management team, jointly responsible for setting and delivering the strategy for the business. Build a high-performing, AI-first marketing team and get the best from our agencies and freelancers.

  • Growth strategy and execution: Own the growth plan and budget. With the MD, set and deliver our patient acquisition strategy, including which channels we use and how much we invest in each. Partner with product and tech to improve conversion across our website and sign-up flow, and evolve our brand positioning as we learn from patients.

  • Long-term value: Drive total net long-term value from every patient we acquire, optimising CAC, average revenue per patient and retention together. Focus on acquiring the right patients, not just more of them. Set targets and budgets with finance based on unit economics.

  • Performance marketing: Own performance across all channels, including search and SEO, paid social, affiliates, partnerships, referral, offline and print.

  • Tracking and reporting: Set up attribution, tracking and reporting from scratch, so every pound of spend is accountable, and report weekly on performance.

  • Category awareness and PR: Build awareness and trust in medical cannabis and help reduce stigma. Set our PR strategy with our agency partners.

  • CRM and retention: Shape the patient CRM journey to drive engagement and retention, working closely with our clinical team.

Requirements

  • A strategic, AI-first leader: 7+ years in marketing, with at least 3 in a senior or Head of role. You have led a team of 3 or more, been part of a leadership team and embedded AI in how a team works.

  • Experienced performance marketer: Strong hands-on experience across search, SEO, paid social and funnel optimisation, with a track record of scaling spend at a healthy CAC and LTV:CAC. Partnerships experience is a real bonus.

  • A builder: You have been an early hire in a founding team and helped take a consumer business from launch through rapid scale, building the growth engine rather than inheriting it.

  • Sector-savvy: Background in D2C subscription, consumer health or another regulated category (healthcare, pharma, telehealth or similar), with a good grasp of repeat-purchase economics, CRM and advertising within the rules.

  • Commercially sharp: You think in unit economics and long-term value, can explain the numbers to non-marketers and make every pound work.

  • A proactive driver of growth: You test, learn and adapt quickly without waiting to be asked.

Benefits

  • Define a new category: Medical cannabis is still young in the UK. You will shape how patients, clinicians and the public see it, and set the standard for what great looks like.

  • Build it with the founding team: A seat on our small management team from day one, working side by side with our MD and Co-Founder.

  • Real ownership: Your own budget, your own plan and the mandate to build the team and partners to deliver it.

  • A fast-growing market: Patient numbers are growing by around 40% a year, with more than 10x headroom still to come.

  • Serious backing: The support of a profitable European healthcare group with real credentials in products, pharmacy and telemedicine.

We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. Excited but not sure you tick every box? We would still love to hear from you. If you need any reasonable adjustments during the process, just let us know.
