title: Head of Investor Relations
descriptionHtml:
This isn't investor relations at a listed company or LP reporting at a fund: we're hiring the leader of a team of six who build and grow relationships with family offices, VCs and strategic investors every day, and report directly to both co-founders.


Pairs is a vetted private capital network. We put breakout founders in front of the family offices, VCs and strategic investors who fit them, and those investors join our network as members. Founders pay for the access to those relationships and for the investor relations work our team does around every introduction, and that work is ultimately the product we sell.

The two co-founders have led this team themselves until now. It has grown to around six associates, which is past the point where two founders can coach it hands on while running the rest of the company, so we are hiring the person who takes it over.

The role
You lead the investor relations team and report to both co-founders. Each associate holds a book of investor members and runs several things at once, new investor relationships, the nurturing of existing ones, and the introductions we make for our clients, plus the follow-up work from there. Your job is to make that team excellent and keep it at full leverage, which means every associate knows what is expected, gets coached every week, can measure their own progress, and hears it the same day when something is off.

What you will do

  • Run the weekly rhythm, a pipeline and network review (CRM), a review of every win and loss, KPIs, and a one to one with every associate.

  • Coach every associate on their calls and their introductions.

  • Hire, onboard and, when needed, let people go, against a written bar for what good looks like.

  • Own the health of the entire Pairs network, more active members every month, and every member getting founders that fit at the pace they asked for.

  • Work with our client success team on each client's plan, so what your team works on matches what the client expects, and with our founder relations team, who build relationships with top founders long before they become clients.

  • Spot the constraint that holds the team back and fix it, with a process or together with our engineers, which takes someone who knows which problem is worth solving.

  • Bring the two co-founders the weekly numbers, investor calls, newly active members, introductions sent, founder calls and referrals, and what you are changing because of them.


What you bring

  • You have run a sales, business development or investment team of five or more for at least two years, the number you carried was the team's, and you can name what the team achieved under you and who you promoted.

  • People respected you and still wanted to work for you, without you needing to be liked. You give straight feedback and you hold the standard when it is uncomfortable.

  • Ego and politics are not part of how you work. You talk about the team's results before your own, and your last team would say the same about you.

  • Systems are how you think. You have built the CRM discipline, the reporting or the playbook that others then ran on, and you can find the one constraint in a team and remove it.

  • Incentives and retention make sense to you. You know what makes the right behavior pay and what makes a team stick together, and you have the retention to show for it.

  • You play the long game. You would not squeeze one month at the cost of the next three, and you go for quality over quantity with investors and founders alike.

  • The investor world is one you know well enough to coach. You have sold high ticket to senior buyers, raised capital, or built an investor or executive network yourself, and years in venture capital or at a fund are a plus on top of the team you led.


Backgrounds we expect to see are high ticket competitive sales, consulting, banking and investment teams. This is not the seat for a great dealmaker who has never led a team, our associate role is the right application for that, and investor relations at a listed company or LP reporting at a fund is a different job from this one.

What good looks like

  • By day 30 you have familiarized yourself closely with the associate work and what we expect from it.

  • Ninety days in, the weekly rhythm runs on your numbers and every associate has a written plan they measure themselves against.

  • Every month the network has more active members and every client's introductions went out on fit and on time.

  • Every quarter one constraint is gone from the team's way, through a process or through engineering.

  • After a year the associates have grown, and the relationships with investors and founders are stronger than they were, since everything here is built to compound over years.


Compensation and how we work
US$200K to US$300K+ total compensation, base plus a bonus on the team's results. Fully remote, your day overlaps with US Eastern time for a few hours. The best AI tooling is paid for, so the admin runs itself and your hours go to people. You work next to our client success lead, our founder relations team and our engineers, each of them running their own lane.

How to apply
Hit apply, which takes you to a short form with four questions. The two co-founders read every application. The process from there is a first call, final conversations with both co-founders, and three references.

No ego is the first rule here, the team's result comes before anyone's name, the co-founders included. And everything is built to compound, so every relationship and every number should be stronger next year than it is now.

Compensation: $200K – $300K

title: Head of Operations (GPU Fleet)
descriptionHtml:
Your mission

Demand for sovereign European compute is not our constraint. Capacity is. As Head of Operations you own Lyceum's GPU fleet end to end: every GPU we own, lease or operate for partners, from the first conversation with a data center to the day a node goes live and every day it runs after that.

The job has two halves. Grow the fleet: turn new financing into live GPUs, fast. Run the fleet: keep everything we operate available, efficient and under contract. Your north star is GPUs under management. You report directly to the CEO and work closely with the CFO, CTO and engineering. Depending on experience, we hire this role at Head or VP level.

What You'll Do

  • Secure data center capacity across Europe: power, liquid cooling, space, connectivity and colocation leases

  • Own relationships with OEMs and suppliers for servers, networking and storage, and manage lead times so hardware arrives when we need it

  • Run every deployment as a programme, from logistics and installation to burn-in, acceptance and handover to engineering

  • Keep the financing side of deployments clean: schedules, drawdown milestones, asset records, insurance and lender reporting

  • Run the live fleet together with engineering: availability, incidents, RMAs, warranty, spares and remote hands

  • Own supply-side contracts, renewals and SLAs, and drive down cost per GPU-hour

  • Build the operations team and the operating rhythm that lets us scale deployments without scaling chaos

 

Your profile

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of bringing physical infrastructure online at scale, ideally data centers, GPU or HPC clusters, or comparable hardware-heavy environments

  • You have owned the whole picture, from capacity and suppliers to deployment and live operations, not one slice of it

  • Exceptional analytical and strategic thinking. You see the whole board, from site selection to unit economics

  • Enough technical depth to hold your own with engineers and vendors on power, cooling, networking and hardware

  • Strong programme management: you run complex projects with many parties against hard deadlines

  • Confidence negotiating and managing contracts with data centers, OEMs and suppliers

  • You have built and led teams from scratch and still go deep into the details yourself

  • Very high sense of urgency and ownership

  • You make good decisions fast with incomplete information and prefer momentum over perfection

  • Strong written and verbal communication in English, German is a plus. Willingness to travel across Europe

Why us?

Genau diese Entwicklung treiben wir mit MY HEALTH & BEAUTY aktiv voran.

Leadership & People

Du analysierst die operativen Prozesse des Unternehmens und stellst sie kontinuierlich infrage.

Was funktioniert, wird standardisiert.

Was nicht funktioniert, wird verändert.

Was unnötig kompliziert ist, wird vereinfacht.

Aus 10 erfolgreichen Standorten eine skalierbare, professionelle Operations-Struktur zu bauen, die auch mit weiteren 20, 30 oder 100 Standorten funktioniert.

title: Head of Operations
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is that we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region, including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

The Head of Operations Lead – UK owns the operational backbone of BJAK's UK business. You'll make sure daily operations, internal systems, and customer-facing execution run smoothly, efficiently, and at a standard that supports scale.

This is not a P&L role, and it's not a "manage from a distance" role either. You'll partner closely with the CEO to turn business objectives into strong execution on the ground, building systems, leading teams, and stepping in directly when execution breaks.

 

What You'll Own

  • Define and execute operational strategies that support growth and align with BJAK's objectives in the UK market.

  • Run day-to-day operations across customer service, administrative operations, and internal workflows so execution stays frictionless.

  • Hire, lead, and develop a high-performing operations and admin team with a strong culture of ownership and accountability.

  • Own process improvement, finding bottlenecks, automating where possible, and implementing systems that cut cost and increase speed.

  • Lead the customer support function and step in hands-on during high-stakes or escalated cases.

  • Oversee company administration and internal operations, including office management, documentation, vendor coordination, and adherence to internal policies.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong background in operations, execution, or internal business operations in tech, fintech, or fast-scaling environments.

  • Proven experience leading operations and admin teams in high-expectation environments.

  • Hands-on mindset with the ability to solve problems directly, not just delegate them.

  • Strong organisational, execution, and problem-solving skills.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and bringing structure to fast-moving situations.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally and drive execution without formal authority.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who want to direct operations from a distance instead of stepping in when things break.

  • Candidates who need fully-built systems and processes handed to them.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid escalations, messy cases, or hard conversations with vendors and staff.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

  • This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week.

Language

  • English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1-2 weeks from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

The Role

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

We are looking for a Head of People Operations to build and run a distributed hub model that delivers an excellent people experience — in every location, every day.

Your job is not to design the system from scratch. It's to own the execution of it across six hubs: hold the standard, make local teams genuinely strong, and build the kind of autonomy where hub partners decide and act without waiting.

This is not a classic HR Operations leadership role. What distinguishes it:

  • You lead distributed hub teams that own the full employee lifecycle on the ground — not a central function serving locations from a distance

  • You build autonomy, not dependency — hub teams should know what winning looks like and act on it

  • You partner directly with the individual domain leads across the function — Workplace & Experience, Payroll, Compliance, People Tech, Rewards. Not their manager, but a peer who depends on their expertise to run the hubs well

  • AI is core infrastructure, not a pilot — you default to automation for everything repeatable in the function

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀

  • Own People Operations across all hubs: Netherlands, Spain, Armenia, US (Austin, Bay Area, New York), Brazil, Remote

  • Set the standard for what excellent hub execution looks like, and hold it across all locations

  • Run the weekly sync rhythm with each hub — align priorities, surface blockers, keep quality consistent

  • Build the hub community: connect People Ops partners across locations to share practice and raise the floor

Own Outcomes, Not Process

  • Hub teams should decide and act — your job is to remove blockers, not add approval layers

  • Compliance — support policy adoption, manager training, and exit case handling in every location

  • Rewards — run compensation reviews and benefits implementation per country

Challenge feasibility, propose alternatives, execute agreed decisions.

Build the Team

  • Manage People Operations Partners across locations: NL, ES, AM, BR, US, Remote

  • You're standing up the hub model while running it — build the team while it's operating

  • Drive team development: upgrade skills, address underperformance, enable people with AI tools

Manage the Operational Realities

  • Visa and relocation support coordination across locations

TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥

Experience & Background

  • Direct experience managing distributed teams across multiple countries and employment frameworks

  • Proven record building distributed operating models — not just inheriting and running existing ones

  • Experience standing up new processes and functions in fast-changing environments

title: Head of People Operations
descriptionHtml:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

🔎 The People Operations team

At Joko, credibility starts with reliability. The People Operations team owns and runs the core people processes — contracts, payroll, benefits, compliance, HR systems and data — across France, Spain, and the US. Today, the team consists of two experienced People Operations Managers — and because the whole Joko team is growing rapidly, from 100+ people today to 200+ within 18 months, we are doubling it: alongside this role, we are hiring two additional People Operations Managers. People Operations sits within the broader People function, which also covers Talent Acquisition, People Business Partnering, and Workplace Management.

✨ Why this role is special

  • You will build a department, not inherit one. You will be Joko's first Head of People Operations. The foundations exist — experienced team members owning our core people processes across three countries, a strong compliance track record — but the department structure, the operating model, and the roadmap are yours to design.

  • You will do it at a real scale moment. Joko is a profitable scale-up entering its international chapter, set to grow from 100+ people today to 200+ within 18 months, across France, Spain, the US, and soon more. The processes you design now are the ones that much larger company will run on.

  • You will operate at the frontier on tooling and AI. AI is used daily across Joko, and People Operations is one of the highest-leverage places to apply it. You will have the tools, the budget, and dedicated BizOps support to automate aggressively and build one of the most modern People Ops setups out there.

🎯 What you will do

As Head of People Operations, your mission is to build the operational backbone that lets Joko double in headcount without losing an ounce of reliability. You will report to the VP People and manage the People Operations team: two People Operations Managers today, four soon.

  • Build and lead the People Ops team: Hire, coach, and grow your People Operations Managers. Organize ownership across countries and specialties so the team scales smoothly, with no single point of failure — every critical task has a named backup.

  • Own our core people processes end-to-end: Payroll, contracts, benefits, time off, and onboarding/offboarding administration across France, Spain, and the US — accurate, compliant, and on time, every time.

  • Anticipate scale: Project the company 18 months ahead and build for it today: country playbooks (our Spain entity is ramping up now, and more markets will follow), clean org data, and reliable workforce reporting for planning and reviews.

  • Own systems and data: Take full ownership of our HRIS and people data. Make People data a single source of truth, automate everything that should be automated — with AI and with dedicated support from our BizOps team — and keep improving the employee-facing experience of every process.

  • Own compliance: Ensure compliance with French and Spanish labor law hand-in-hand with our Head of Legal and external counsel, anticipate regulatory changes, and keep our documentation ready for audits, fundraising, and due diligence at any moment.

  • Deliver a human employee experience: Make sure every employee interaction with People Ops is fast, accurate, and discreet, with clear and accessible policies — reliability people can feel.

  • Partner across the company: Work closely with Finance (payroll reconciliation, headcount and budget actuals), Legal (labor law), Talent Acquisition (fast, flawless contracts and pre-onboarding), and Workplace Management.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: 8+ years in People Operations or HR, including several years managing a team, in high-growth tech startups or scale-ups — you've lived through a similar headcount inflection.

  • A builder: You've stood up or rebuilt a People Ops function, not just run one that was already in place. You know what to build now versus what can wait.

  • Expertise: Deep command of French payroll and labor law; exposure to Spanish or US employment matters is a strong plus.

  • Systems thinker: You've owned an HRIS, you design processes that hold up at 3x the headcount, and you are rigorous about data quality.

  • Analytical skills: You reason with data — headcount, payroll, budget actuals — and build reporting that people trust.

  • Attention to detail: You thrive on precision, organization, and reliability — in People Ops, the details are the job.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset: You thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments. You take ownership without being asked, you welcome feedback, and you go the extra mile by default.

  • AI fluency: You already use AI tools daily in your own work and have a point of view on which parts of People Ops should be automated — the People team is expected to lead by example on this front.

  • Discretion: You handle sensitive matters — disciplinary cases, offboarding, personal data — with absolute integrity.

  • Manager-coach: You grow the people you manage, and you see developing your team as core to the job.

  • High standards, hands-on: You set the bar high and you are never afraid to roll up your sleeves — you can run a payroll cycle yourself if needed.

  • Languages: Fluent in French, fluent in English (our working language). Spanish is a plus.

  • Location: Based in France or Spain.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

title: Head of Product
descriptionHtml:
Head of Product

Our mission for you

European energy costs are 2x compared to US and China. Electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. Market price volatility & complexity are here to stay. The backbone of Europe's industrial economy is at risk — and companies need to act now.

trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that orchestrates procurement, energy management, and flexibility steering in one product. Supply, Manage, Flex — combined. That integration unlocks up to 30% in recurring electricity cost savings — all while helping companies switch to renewable energy.

We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast — the market window is open and we intend to own it.

trawa is a scale-up based in Berlin with ~100 FTE, ~30 of whom work in Product & Tech. We've raised over €35M to date, including a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic, and Tiny VC. All three founders are on board and 100% committed to build the utility of the future.

We're looking for a Head of Product to own vision, strategy, and execution across the entire customer journey. You'll report directly to the CEO, with close collaboration with the CTO and COO. You will join the leadership team alongside other department leaders. You'll shape the product that makes European industry competitive again — and you'll do it at pace. This role is based in Berlin. trawa is an "office first" company, which means you will work from the headquarters in Berlin with our international, dynamic team.

Your team

You will lead a well-established team of 6 Product Managers and Designers embedded in 6 interdisciplinary teams in Product & Engineering. You will be the key decision-maker for what the teams work on. Our main customer segment is the German Mittelstand, therefore fluent German is required for this position.

You'll drive the evolution of three key areas:

Product Vision & Strategy: Own the product vision for the customer-facing products and roadmap across Supply, Manage, and Flex. Turn market dynamics and customer pain into a clear, prioritized strategy that compounds value across products. Internal products such as Trading platform as well as Energy Utility Platform are out of scope for this role.

Value Delivery at Scale: Drive execution across teams, products, and geographies. Own the metrics that matter. Turn data into decisions and trade-offs into momentum.

Team & Organisation: Build and lead high-performing product teams. Partner with Engineering, Design, GTM, and Operations. Create an environment where exceptional people do their best work.

Who we are looking for

Product Vision Leader: You deeply understand customer problems and translate them into a compelling product vision that aligns the entire company. You communicate strategy with clarity and conviction. You rally cross-functional teams around shared goals.

Product Excellence: You have excelled as a Product Leader (Staff, Head of, VP) at a fast-paced scale-up. Proven track record of shipping products customers love that drive measurable business results.

Value Delivery at Scale: You lead teams that deliver value at scale — shipping regularly, holding themselves accountable to outcomes, not just output. You set the bar for execution quality and speed across products, teams, and markets.

Software Builder: Expert in building B2B software products, ideally experienced with working with customers in the Commercial & Industrial segment. You understand and master software product dynamics — activation, retention, pricing and upsell along the full customer lifecycle.

Seasoned Executor: You deliver in high-paced environments with clear target achievement. You thrive in uncertainty — creating structure, driving momentum, and turning ambiguity into action. You prioritize with clarity and ship relentlessly.

AI-Native Builder: At trawa, we embrace new technology and use it to our competitive advantage. Core decision processes in trading and energy operations run on AI-based predictions. Customer success, sales enablement as well as Operations are fueled by agentic workflows. We are reinventing what a modern utility looks like — driving cost-to-serve toward €0 and increasing trading profits through AI-based signal processing. You will have the mandate and the environment to reinvent product development, tooling, and ways of working with AI across the organization.

Energy Expert (Strong Plus): Deep energy market expertise is beneficial — but not a prerequisite.

At trawa, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly, we encourage you to apply — you may be the right fit for this or another opportunity.


90 Day Goals

After 6 Weeks (Onboarding):

  • You deeply understand trawa's business and product

  • You have established your philosophy of running Product & Tech teams’ delivery

  • You shape new quarterly roadmap and OKR plans for your teams

Month 3 (Ramp-Up):

  • You have assembled the company around your product vision for the entire customer journey

  • Your vision for the customer journey comes to live - first key metrics are moved

  • Your teams follow your rhythm of value delivery in fast measurable iterations

Why us?

Impact: European SMEs spend between €150k and €10M per year on electricity — most are overpaying and locked into outdated procurement. Your product will directly change how thousands of companies buy, manage, and use energy. The impact is measurable, the market is massive, and the timing is now.

The Role: This is a rare opportunity to own product end-to-end at a company where product is the business. You won't be managing a feature backlog — you'll be shaping a platform that spans energy trading, real-time asset steering, and enterprise software. Few product roles in Europe offer this combination of complexity, commercial impact, and speed.

Responsibility & Support: You'll join the leadership team with direct impact on company strategy. We support you through regular leadership sessions, cross-department leadership initiatives, and experienced mentors who want to see you succeed.

Ownership: We empower our team members to take ownership of their work and drive results, regardless of background or experience level.

Learning & Growth: We provide an annual budget and dedicated time for professional development. You'll have opportunities for mentorship, learning, and career progression.

Diversity and Inclusion: We're an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects that. Our organisation brings together over 15 nationalities, contributing a variety of languages, experiences, and perspectives. At trawa, we're family-friendly with parents across all levels, and our diversity is represented throughout the company, including leadership. We're committed to an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

Package & Benefits: We offer a competitive compensation package including salary and stock options, 30 days of vacation, and a range of benefits including subsidies for home internet and lunches, a Sports Club membership, dedicated learning days with an annual learning budget, plus a weekly team lunch and regular team events.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

As Head of Product for Flex, you own the vision, strategy and commercial success of our residential VPP platform globally. title: Head of Product & Technology (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About enua

enua is an integrated medical cannabis company with a mission to give patients safe and reliable access to treatment. We are the second-largest supplier in the German market and a fast-growing international group, on track for around €100m in group revenue in 2026 with a double-digit EBITDA margin. Founded in Cologne in 2018, we have built a profitable business across our own products and more than 700 partner pharmacies.

Now we are bringing that to the UK. Medical cannabis is one of the fastest-growing areas of UK healthcare: around 140,000 people will be prescribed it in 2026, up from around 100,000 a year earlier. Yet an estimated 1.8 million people in the UK already use cannabis to manage a health condition, mostly outside the legal system. That is more than 10x today’s market, in a category that is still largely uncharted.

We are building a clinic and platform that makes care simpler, faster and more personal. Our UK team is at an early stage, which means real ownership, real impact and the chance to shape how we work from day one.

The role

  • Location: London, 4 days a week in the office
  • Reporting to: MD and Co-Founder UK
  • Employment type: Full-time, permanent

As Head of Product & Technology, you will own the platform at the heart of enua UK: the patient-facing product and the systems behind it, from first visit through consultation, prescription and repeat order. We want patients to genuinely love using us, and this role is central to making that happen. It is a founding leadership role and one of the most important hires we will make.

You will not start from a blank page: we have already built a modern, AI-native platform. You will take it forward: setting the strategy for how it evolves, making the big build, buy and partner calls, and shipping the features that make us the easiest and most trusted way for UK patients to access care. You will be hands-on from day one, sit on our management team alongside our MD and Co-Founder, and work closely with our group technology team.

Tasks

  • Platform strategy: Set the strategy for our UK platform so it gives us a lasting advantage through convenience, quality and cost. Build on the foundations we have and decide where we build, buy or partner across EHR, telehealth, pharmacy, payments and CRM.
  • Leadership: Be a core member of our management team, jointly responsible for the strategy and execution of the business. Build and lead a high-performing product and engineering function as we scale, working closely with group colleagues.
  • Patient experience: Own the end-to-end patient product, from first visit to repeat order, and drive exceptional patient satisfaction. Set the roadmap with the MD and management team, balancing the needs of patients, clinicians and operations.
  • Hands-on build: Build and ship yourself. Balance pace with reliability, keep technical debt in check, and set high standards for architecture, security and AI-assisted code.
  • Testing, data and analytics: Own end-to-end testing and optimisation, from UX to back end, and the tracking, analytics and reporting the business runs on.
  • AI agenda: Set the AI agenda for the organisation, finding where it can improve the patient experience and how we work, and making sure it is used safely.
  • Compliance and clinical safety: Make sure our platform meets the standards of a regulated healthcare provider, including CQC, UK GDPR and clinical safety (DCB0129/DCB0160), working with our group quality and regulatory teams.

Requirements

  • A product leader: 7+ years in product and technology, with at least 3 leading a product or engineering function. Obsessed with patient experience, with strong UX instincts and the ability to turn patient and commercial needs into a clear roadmap. You have hired and led teams and been part of a management team.
  • Technically deep: Strong architectural judgement, able to set technical direction, review code (including AI-generated code) and build data and analytics the business can rely on.
  • A builder: You have taken a digital product from 0 to 1 and on through rapid scale, ideally in D2C subscription, telehealth or digital health.
  • Regulation-ready: Experience delivering in a regulated environment (healthcare, pharma, fintech or similar), and comfortable with data protection, security and clinical safety.
  • Commercially sharp: You make smart build, buy and partner decisions with an eye on total cost and speed.
  • Hands-on and AI-first: You still enjoy building and shipping yourself, and use AI to move faster and do more.

Benefits

  • Define a new category: Medical cannabis is still young in the UK. You will build the platform that sets the standard for how patients access care.
  • Build it with the founding team: A seat on our small management team from day one, working side by side with our MD and Co-Founder.
  • Real ownership: Own the platform, the roadmap and the technology choices, with the mandate to build the team and partner ecosystem to deliver them.
  • A fast-growing market: Patient numbers are growing by around 40% a year, with more than 10x headroom still to come.
  • Work that matters: What you build will make it easier for people with long-term conditions to get treatment that works for them.
  • Serious backing: The support of a profitable European healthcare group with real credentials in products, pharmacy and telemedicine.

We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. Excited but not sure you tick every box? We would still love to hear from you. If you need any reasonable adjustments during the process, just let us know.

Mission

En tant que Head of Product Transformation, tu accompagnes nos clients grands comptes dans leur transition vers une organisation Produit : la bonne structuration des équipes, les bonnes expertises, les bons processus, le bon mode de financement, la bonne gouvernance, les bonnes trajectoires d'évolution.


Tu pourra être amené·e à :

  • Piloter l'audit de maturité de l'organisation en stratégie produit et tech, en incluant l'intégration et l'impact de l'IA sur la chaîne de valeur

  • Définir l’organisation cible au travers du Product Operating Model (organisation des équipes produit, gouvernance, processus, financement, etc.) pour garantir l'efficacité et la scalabilité de la fonction Produit

  • Piloter le déploiement de la transformation produit et adresser les chantiers transversaux qui permettent cette transition en étant hands-on

  • Collaborer avec les parties prenantes seniors du client et être leur sparring partner tout au long de la transformation

  • Coacher et accompagner les équipes produit pour les faire gagner en maturité, en diffusant de bonnes pratiques qui tiennent dans la durée

  • Assurer une veille sectorielle et méthodologique selon tes appétences, notamment sur l'évolution des Operating Models à l'ère de l'IA, et partager tes découvertes pour enrichir nos pratiques


    • En interne chez Thiga, Selon ton niveau de séniorité et tes envies, tu peux prendre des responsabilités qui vont au-delà de la mission client 💡

  • Manager une équipe, chez Thiga et/ou en mission, en accompagnant des Thiguys·girls dans leur développement et en assurant les conditions de leur épanouissement professionnel

  • Contribuer au développement commercial de Thiga en menant des avant-ventes

  • Contribuer au rayonnement de Thiga en prenant la parole sur nos convictions et nos retours d'expérience en externe

  • Former au sein de la Thiga Academy


    • Compétences métier 🖇

  • Tu maîtrises les techniques de diagnostic (interviews, shadowing, analyse de livrables) et tu sais en superviser la synthèse de manière claire et pertinente

  • Tu sais élaborer des stratégies de changement d'Operating Model complexes (organisation, processus, outils : mise en place de squads, déploiement d'OKR, structuration des équipes IA/Data) et piloter l'accompagnement des équipes tout au long de leur adoption

  • Tu animes des ateliers avec des interlocuteurs de tous niveaux, des opérationnels jusqu'au Codir

  • Tu transmets tes connaissances, tu formes et tu encadres des consultants en tenant compte du niveau de maturité de chacun·e

  • Tu rédiges des livrables impactants, en version synthétique comme en version détaillée, et tu sais faire passer tes messages clés en présentation client

  • Tu as une compréhension approfondie des enjeux liés à l'IA et tu sais intégrer ces dimensions dans les stratégies produit et les Operating Models que tu construis


    • Compétences relationnelles 🎙

  • Communication : tu rends visible et compréhensible ce que tu fais, avec synthèse, clarté et écoute active, et tu sais développer une relation de confiance avec tes clients

  • Assertivité : tu défends tes convictions, tu embarques les parties prenantes même les plus résistantes, et tu gères les dynamiques politiques complexes chez le client

  • Curiosité : tu te tiens informé·e des meilleures pratiques en organisation Produit, stratégie, change management et transformation digitale, avec un intérêt particulier pour les impacts de l'IA sur ces domaines

  • Humilité : tu te remets en question et tu apprends de tes erreurs pour progresser

  • Pragmatisme : tu t'adaptes à différents contextes et tu sais faire avancer les sujets qui comptent

  • Anglais courant : tu travailles en autonomie dans un contexte international


    • Expériences 📇
    Tu as au moins 7 ans d'expérience en transformation digitale et en product management dans des grands comptes.
    Ce qu'on t'offre 🎊

  • Un onboarding avec 2 jours de formation, pour bien démarrer et rencontrer tes collègues

  • Des formation, du contenus pour progresser, et un programme dédié aux Product Leaders couvrant coaching, OKR, organisation et stratégie produit

  • Des crédits Claude (ou autre) pour accélérer tes pratiques AI-augmented

  • Un accès à un catalogue de matériels, et un MacBook Air ou PC selon ta préférence

  • Jusqu’à deux jours de télétravail par semaine selon le client

  • Des Thigapéros, des squad-buildings et de belles soirées pour se retrouver 🎉

  • Carte Swile, remboursement de ton abonnement transport ou forfait mobilité durable


    • Les étapes 🎢

    1. Un pré-entretien téléphonique avec un membre de l'équipe recrutement

    2. Une rencontre avec un des Directeurs.rices

    3. Une étude de cas avec deux consultant·e·s pour confirmer ce que tu mets en pratique

    4. Un dernier échange pour apprécier l'entente mutuelle 🤝

    Thiga accueille toutes les personnes compétentes et passionnées, et s'engage en faveur de la diversité culturelle, de l'égalité femmes-hommes et de l'inclusion des travailleurs handicapés. On considère la diversité comme une richesse réelle.

title: Head of Project Management (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Rotzinger Transver

Rotzinger Transver mit Standorten in Kaiseraugst und Altendorf in der Schweiz ist ein führender Anbieter von Lösungen für Produktflusssteuerung, Pufferung, Verteilung und Fördertechnik für die Lebensmittel-, Süsswaren- und Verpackungsindustrie.

Unser Portfolio umfasst eine breite Palette innovativer Systeme, die eine zuverlässige Produkthandhabung, eine stabile Linienleistung sowie eine effiziente Verbindung zwischen Verarbeitungs- und Verpackungsprozessen gewährleisten. Mit modularen, skalierbaren und hygienischen Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, Produktverluste zu reduzieren, Stillstandszeiten zu minimieren und die Gesamtanlageneffektivität (OEE) zu steigern. Wir sind bestrebt, unser Angebot und unsere Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, um den sich wandelnden Anforderungen unserer Kunden gerecht zu werden.

Weitere Informationen über Rotzinger Transver und unser umfassendes Leistungsspektrum finden Sie auf der Website: www.rotzingertransver.com.

Rotzinger Transver ist Teil von Coesia, einer weltweit tätigen Unternehmensgruppe für innovative Industrie- und Verpackungslösungen mit Hauptsitz in Bologna. Coesia ist in 34 Ländern vertreten, vereint 21 Unternehmen und beschäftigt per 2026 mehr als 8'000 Mitarbeitende weltweit.

Über die Rolle

Als Head of Project Management (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für das Projektportfolio an unseren Produktionsstandorten in Kaiseraugst und Altendorf. Sie führen ein Team von Project Managern und sorgen für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung unserer internationalen Kundenprojekte. Dabei treiben Sie die Weiterentwicklung des Projektmanagements aktiv voran und tragen dazu bei, Projekte effizienter, transparenter und profitabler umzusetzen.

Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortungen

  • Führung und Weiterentwicklung des PMO-Teams über beide Standorte hinweg

  • Steuerung und Priorisierung des Projektportfolios in Abstimmung mit den Unternehmenszielen

  • Sicherstellung der erfolgreichen Umsetzung komplexer Kundenprojekte hinsichtlich Qualität, Kosten und Termine

  • Aktives Management von Risiken, Änderungen und Projektprofitabilität

  • Überwachung relevanter KPIs und Förderung kontinuierlicher Verbesserungen

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Sales und Service

  • Weiterentwicklung von Projektmanagement-Standards, Prozessen und Methoden

  • Professionelles Stakeholder- und Kundenmanagement über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus


Was Sie mitbringen

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektmanagement sowie Führungserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Rolle

  • Erfahrung in der erfolgreichen Leitung komplexer Kundenprojekte

  • Erfahrung im Maschinen- und Anlagenbau oder einem vergleichbaren industriellen Umfeld

  • Technischer Hochschulabschluss oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Unternehmerisches Denken und ein gutes Verständnis für Kosten, Margen und Projektprofitabilität

  • Projektmanagement-Zertifizierungen wie PMP oder IPMA von Vorteil

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations-, Führungs- und Veränderungskompetenzen

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

  • Reisebereitschaft zwischen den Standorten sowie zu internationalen Kunden (ca. 20–30 %)

Was wir bieten

  • Ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld

  • Attraktive Sozialleistungen und ein modernes Altersvorsorgemodell

  • Vergünstigungen beim Fahrzeugkauf

  • Dienstjubiläums- und Treueprämien

  • Unterstützung bei Aus- und Weiterbildungen

  • 25 Ferientage bis zum Alter von 49 Jahren, 28 Tage ab 50 Jahren und 30 Tage ab 60 Jahren

  • Kostenlose Parkplätze

  • Gute Anbindung an den öffentlichen Verkehr

  • Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg (Profit Sharing)

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, wenden Sie sich bitte an unsere Talent Acquisition Spezialistin, Dajana Smyrek ----- bewerben Sie sich direkt über folgenden Link:

https://www.coesia.com/modules/custom/coesia_talentlink/vendor/apply/apply.html?jobId=Q4GFK026203F3VBQB7VV4F6SL-12300&langCode=en_GB

Personalvermittlungsagenturen werden höflich gebeten, von Anfragen oder einer Kontaktaufnahme im Zusammenhang mit dieser Stellenausschreibung abzusehen.

Coesia ist ein Unternehmen, das die Chancengleichheit fördert und sich für Vielfalt und Integration einsetzt.

title: Head of Regulatory Affairs - AI and P2P (100% remote)
descriptionHtml:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Tether is seeking an experienced and visionary Head of Regulatory Affairs to design and execute global regulatory affairs strategies for our Tether Data business vertical. At Tether Data, we are committed to pioneering advancements in AI and peer-to-peer (P2P) technologies. Our mission is to innovate and lead in the creation of technological solutions that empower people, communities, cities and countries to become more independent and sovereign. In a world constantly changing and becoming more unpredictable, technology should be used to ensure freedom and respect of human rights, rather than capturing people’s private digital lives.

Responsibilities

  • Policy Advocacy, Monitoring, Analysis and Guidance: Monitor, analyse and communicate changes in global regulatory policies, and advise executive leadership on potential regulatory risks and opportunities, while driving initiatives to influence regulatory frameworks as well as monitoring for change across regulations to ensure proactive compliance where required.

  • Regulatory Advocacy and Thought Leadership: Leading or participating in regulatory agency interactions and advocacy work regarding legislation relevant to this field. Engaging with relevant regulatory authorities, industry bodies, collaborative communities, and policymakers to shape the regulatory landscape for AI and P2P.

  • Regulatory Strategy Development: As appropriate, leading the development and execution of regulatory strategies, identifying preferable market/s from which to operate, and to ensure the company’s readiness for compliance with relevant national and international regulations.

  • Cross-functional Leadership and Product Development: Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., R&D, legal, compliance) in both Tether and with our partners to to integrate regulatory considerations into the design and deployment of AI models and technologies, as applicable.

  • Thought Leadership: Act as a thought leader both externally and within the organization, educating internal teams on regulatory issues, trends, and best practices in the AI and P2P space.


  • Proven experience in a senior regulatory role, ideally within the technology, AI, or digital industries.

  • Strong knowledge of global AI regulations, data privacy laws (e.g., GDPR), and emerging trends in AI and P2P governance. Legal, compliance, or policy background with a deep understanding of ethical AI principles is a plus.

  • Demonstrated understanding of decentralised, self-sovereign and locally executed AI/P2P architectures—and the regulatory implications of these models—distinct from traditional centralised platform approaches.

  • Demonstrated experience working with regulators and government bodies advocating and advising in a regulatory capacity, with demonstrated achievements securing favourable policy positions on behalf of another organisation.

  • Expertise in preparing complex regulatory documents and other major regulatory submissions, including the preparation and execution of interactions with regulatory authorities.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law, Policy, Computer Science, or related fields.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesise complex regulatory topics for non-technical audiences.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders across borders and time zones.

  • Communication: Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with experience in public speaking and representing companies in regulatory discussions.

  • Must be a strong team player, and willing to be fully engaged with key stakeholders both in our company but also with our partners. Must be a hands-on professional capable of working collaboratively and independently.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: Head of Research & Editorial
descriptionHtml:
About Firstwork

Labour markets are broken. Millions of people are ready to work and can't start. Screening, right-to-work checks, contracts, onboarding and scheduling still run across disconnected systems, with hundreds of manual decisions in between. Firstwork builds AI agents that run frontline workforce operations end to end. We activate hundreds of thousands of workers a month globally for some of the world's largest employers and staffing firms, working forward-deployed inside the customer's operation. Backed by Y Combinator and Gradient (Google’s AI fund), with offices in New York, and London and Dubai opening this year.

Why this role

Frontline labour markets are badly measured. Governments publish unemployment and vacancy statistics. Nobody publishes a credible number for how long it takes to get a qualified person from application to first shift, what that delay costs, or how much of it is regulatory rather than operational.

We see activation at scale, across sectors and jurisdictions, so we can measure what nobody else can. Publishing it sets the terms of the debate, gives policymakers something real to work with, and gives our commercial teams something better than a pitch deck. The standard we are aiming at is work a member of government or tier one investor forwards along to their colleagues.

What you'll do

  • Set the research agenda

  • Write and publish flagship reports and white papers

  • Own editorial standards across everything Firstwork publishes

  • Build data stories with our data and engineering teams

  • Lead policy engagement on European labour and employment regulation

  • Produce the CEO's long-form writing and speaking material

  • Build partnerships with academics, institutions and industry bodies

  • Manage a Content Producer who turns the research into video, graphics, podcasts and report design

What we're looking for

  • Seven or more years in research, journalism, think tanks, policy, or a strategy function producing original published work

  • A portfolio with at least one piece that changed how someone thought about a subject

  • Quantitative comfort. You can interrogate a dataset and recognise when it won't support the claim you want to make

  • Real interest in labour markets, migration, regulation or the economics of work

  • The spine to hold a line on accuracy when there is commercial pressure not to

  • Editorial judgement. You can commission, edit and improve other people's work

  • Use of AI across the research process, on the understanding that it raises the verification bar rather than lowering it

This is a rare opportunity for a serious writer and content creator to help shape the future of work at a high-growth, well-funded company with strong opinions about what the world should look like in the age of AI. If the idea of running a research desk on a dataset nobody else has access to excites you, send us your best work.

Firstwork is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status.

title: Head of Revenue Enablement
descriptionHtml:
Hi, I'm Romain - SVP Global Sales at hx.

I joined hx six months ago because I saw a rare mix of things: a deeply talented team, a product that is genuinely changing how insurers make decisions, and the ambition to build something category-defining in one of the world's most important industries.

The commercial opportunity in front of us is huge, but it is also complex. We sell into a market where credibility matters, where our customers are actuaries, underwriters and senior insurance leaders, and where AI needs to create real business value, not just a better story.

That is why we are hiring our first Head of Revenue Enablement. This person will help us build the operating rhythm, onboarding, materials and enablement programmes that make our global Revenue team sharper, more consistent and more credible in the field.

A note on level: we're open on seniority for this hire. What matters most is finding the right person to build this function from scratch, not matching a specific title. If your experience sits closer to a senior enablement lead than a Head, we still want to hear from you, see the companion Revenue Enablement Lead posting for a version calibrated closer to that level.

This is not a role where you inherit a finished playbook, and it is not a role that comes with a team or budget to build one out immediately. It is a role for someone who wants to build the first version properly, hands-on, working closely with Revenue leadership, and help shape how hx sells as we continue to scale.

About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurers have been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision, helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally, already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do, from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure, it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the team

hx's commercial engine is scaling rapidly, and Revenue Enablement sits at the heart of making that scale sustainable. Today, enablement happens across pockets of the organisation, Revenue leadership, RevOps, Sales Ops, Product Marketing, and Marketing, but there's no single owner, no operating cadence, and no clear system for turning commercial strategy into repeatable field execution.

This is where you come in. You'll be building hx's first dedicated Revenue Enablement function from scratch, working in close partnership with Romain and the wider commercial leadership team. Your mission is to close the gap between intent and execution: improving how our sellers are trained, equipped, motivated, and held to a consistent operating rhythm that drives revenue.

You'll take an AI-first approach to how enablement gets built at hx. That means using AI tools to accelerate content creation, calibrate messaging against live deal data, and build feedback loops faster than a traditional enablement function could, not just producing more content, but producing a smarter, faster system.

In this role, you'll treat enablement as a system, not a content library. You'll bring structure and pace to a high-performing sales organisation, staying close to the customer, the field, and the behaviours that actually move deals forward. This is a builder role for someone who thrives in ambiguity and sees the opportunity to shape how a world-class commercial team operates, hands-on, not from a distance.

Check out our Sales and Partnerships Candidate Hub for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining!

What you'll be doing

  • Build hx's first Revenue enablement operating model, defining clear scope, ownership, intake processes, prioritisation frameworks, and success metrics that make enablement predictable and aligned to commercial priorities.

  • Create and execute the 2026 Revenue enablement roadmap, translating commercial OKRs into a focused programme of training, content, and rhythms that improve seller effectiveness and execution discipline.

  • Drive measurable improvements in seller behaviour, designing enablement programmes that strengthen qualification, discovery, deal progression, sales process adherence, Salesforce hygiene, and forecasting accuracy.

  • Strengthen customer-centric selling by equipping the sales team with better customer insight, references, case studies, proof points, and value messaging that make sellers more credible and commercially sharp in every conversation.

  • Partner closely with Marketing, Product Marketing, and ABM to ensure sellers can confidently use targeted messaging, launch materials, competitive positioning, and customer stories in the field.

  • Design scalable onboarding and continuous learning programmes with clear curriculum, measurable ramp indicators, manager reinforcement, and defined productivity milestones for commercial hires.

  • Use AI tools directly and hands-on to build, iterate, and scale enablement assets and programmes rather than relying solely on manual content production.

What you'll need to have done

  • Built or significantly scaled Revenue enablement in a B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or complex commercial environment, demonstrating that enablement is about changing seller behaviour, not just producing training content.

  • Designed and implemented enablement operating models that include intake, governance, stakeholder alignment, measurement, and repeatable cadences across Revenue, Marketing, Product Marketing, and Operations teams.

  • Delivered programmes that measurably improved seller effectiveness, such as better discovery execution, increased win rates, faster ramp times, improved Salesforce adoption, or stronger commercial discipline in live deals.

  • Partnered cross-functionally with senior commercial leaders, earning trust through pragmatic judgement, clear prioritisation, and demonstrable revenue impact rather than relying on formal authority.

  • Created structured onboarding and ongoing learning programmes that shortened time-to-productivity for new hires, with clear curriculum, reinforcement mechanisms, and measurable outcomes.

  • Used customer insight, market context, references, and proof points to improve how sellers engage with prospects, demonstrating commercial credibility and customer-centricity in enablement design.

  • Been comfortable building alone, without a team, at least in the first phase of the role.

You're unlikely to thrive here if

  • Your experience is mainly in content production, LMS administration, or training delivery without building the operating system and structure around enablement.

  • You need an existing playbook to follow, or see enablement as separate from sales execution, commercial strategy, customer insight, and cross-functional operating cadence.

  • You're a strategist who struggles with hands-on delivery, or someone who prefers working in isolation rather than collaborating closely with Revenue leadership, Marketing, RevOps, and frontline sellers.

  • You're looking for a role with a team and budget to build out from day one.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energized, hx may not be the place where you will do your best work. We are building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process, our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations, and we're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  1. Initial call with our Talent team to kick things off.

  2. Manager interview with our SVP of Sales.

  3. Skills assessment: 60-minute working session where you'll present your diagnosis of the enablement opportunity at hx, a proposed 6-month enablement plan, your operating model for intake and prioritisation, and one example enablement programme designed to improve seller behaviour in practice.

  4. Values interview + Meet the CEO

  5. We offer!

Our commitment to Diversity

hxer's are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

title: Head of Sales (m/w/d) AI-Startup
descriptionHtml:
Du kannst gut verkaufen? Dann könnten wir gut Matchen.

Wir suchen einen Head of Sales auf selbstständiger Basis, zunächst ideal als Nebenjob. Du hast die Chance, früh in ein internationales AI-Startup einzusteigen, ein Vertriebsteam aufzubauen und dies für den gesamten deutschen Markt zu leiten. Zu einem späteren Zeitpunkt ist auf Wunsch ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag + Fixgehalt vorgesehen.

Über uns

Wir sind ein Startup und arbeiten überwiegend remote. Optional kannst du auch vor Ort aus Hamburg, London oder Prag mit uns arbeiten.

Aktuell bauen wir Fenie auf, eine innovative KI-Assistentin speziell für Kosmetikstudios und Unternehmen aus der Beauty-Branche. Fenie hilft die Beauty Branche dabei, ihre Kundenkommunikation zu automatisieren.

Wir suchen einen Head of Sale (m/w/d), der Vertrieb im Blut hat und gemeinsam mit uns wachsen möchte.

Vergütung & Perspektive

Aktuell bieten wir kein fixes Grundgehalt, da wir uns noch in der Growth-Phase befinden. Die Zusammenarbeit erfolgt daher auf selbstständiger Basis, (siehe unten unter „Vergütung“).

title: Head of Sales – France & International
descriptionHtml:
À propos de Galénic

Fondée en 1978 par Pierre Fabre, Galénic est une Maison française de skincare scientifique qui associe excellence de la recherche, innovation et savoir-faire du luxe français.

Portée par son centre d'innovation scientifique à Toulouse et par l'ouverture de la Maison Galénic Paris, à quelques pas de la Place Vendôme, la marque entre dans une nouvelle phase de développement.

Notre ambition est de construire un modèle de distribution sélectif, international et omnicanal, conjuguant e-commerce, retail expérientiel, distributeurs premium et partenariats stratégiques.

Rattaché(e) directement à la Direction Générale, vous aurez la responsabilité de construire, piloter et accélérer le développement commercial de Galénic en Europe et sur ses marchés internationaux prioritaires.

Vous serez responsable de la performance commerciale, de la croissance du chiffre d'affaires et de la rentabilité de nos différents canaux de distribution.

Vous interviendrez à la fois sur la définition des stratégies commerciales, leur exécution opérationnelle et la structuration progressive des équipes.

  1. Piloter la stratégie et la performance commerciale

  • Optimiser les réservations, le taux d'occupation des cabines, la conversion post-soin et la productivité commerciale.

  • Accompagner les équipes opérationnelles dans l'atteinte de leurs objectifs, tout en préservant l'excellence de l'expérience client.

4. Construire et développer notre réseau de distribution international

  • Définir et déployer les plans de développement commercial sur les marchés prioritaires

  • Piloter la contribution de ces partenariats au développement commercial et à la visibilité de Galénic.

  • Structurer progressivement les équipes commerciales, en fonction du développement de l'activité.

Challenge the team to think differently about how we execute ideas, finding unexpected, culturally relevant and creatively disruptive ways to make TALA stand out and content travel.
  • Trend & Culture: Stay ahead of social, cultural and platform trends, identifying opportunities for TALA to participate in the conversation in a way that feels authentic to the brand and has the potential to drive meaningful reach and growth.
  • Campaign Strategy: Partner with the Marketing team and Creative Director on campaign strategy, ensuring social plays a clear role in building awareness, excitement and cultural relevance. Develop channel strategies and rollout plans for key campaigns and launches.
  • Insights & Analytics: Own the analysis of social performance, customer behaviour and competitor activity. Turn data into clear insights and recommendations, using performance to continuously improve our strategy.
  • Test & Learn: Develop a test-and-learn approach across social, identifying new formats, platforms, creators and ways of working. Test, learn and scale what works.
  • Team Leadership: Lead, develop and inspire the social and content creation team, setting clear objectives, ways of working and standards. Ensure the team understands not just what they are creating, but why and what it needs to achieve.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Brand, Creative, Performance, PR, Influencer, Product and Ecommerce to ensure social is fully integrated into the wider marketing and commercial strategy.
  • Channel Health: Oversee the overall health and performance of TALA’s social channels, ensuring content is consistent, on-brand and delivering against agreed objectives. You will provide strategic direction while empowering the team to own day-to-day execution.
  • Reporting: Own weekly, monthly and quarterly reporting against social KPIs, going beyond performance reporting to provide clear insights, recommendations and actions for the wider business.
  • Key collaboration: Partner with the Head of Performance Marketing to create a boosting strategy
  • Social Innovation: Keep TALA ahead of how social is evolving, from new platforms and formats to creators, communities and emerging behaviours, ensuring we continue to find new ways to grow our audience.
  • Governance: Partner and align with the Creative Director on the visual representation of BAU, drops and campaign assets.

Requirements

You should:

  • Have significant professional social media experience, ideally within a fast-moving fashion, beauty, lifestyle or consumer brand.
  • Proven track record of working closely with a Creative team.
  • Be highly collaborative with key stakeholders including Brand, Creative, Performance, PR, Influencer, Product and Ecommerce.
  • Be able to demonstrate how you have grown a social presence, not just through content volume, but through a clear strategic approach.
  • Have a proven track record of developing and delivering social strategies that have driven audience and brand growth.
  • Have a deep understanding of Instagram and TikTok, with knowledge of Pinterest and LinkedIn.
  • Be highly analytical and commercially minded, able to interpret data and turn it into clear strategic recommendations.
  • Have a strong understanding of social culture, trends, formats and what makes content travel.
  • Have experience developing social strategies, content frameworks, channel plans and campaign rollouts.
  • Have experience managing and fostering development across a team, with the ability to set direction, inspire creativity and create a high-performing team culture.
  • Be an excellent cross-functional collaborator and communicator, comfortable working with senior stakeholders and multiple teams.
  • Be highly organised and an excellent project manager, able to bring clarity and structure to a fast-moving environment.
  • Be comfortable working in a start-up environment: working lean, moving quickly and finding solutions with available resources.
  • Be equally comfortable operating at a strategic level and getting into the detail when required.
  • Be driven, ambitious and solution-oriented, with a genuine passion for finding new opportunities for growth.
  • Have a strong understanding of the TALA brand and customer, and be excited about the opportunity to help shape the next stage of TALA’s growth.

Benefits

What we can offer:

  • 25 days holiday a year plus bank holidays
  • Very generous employee discount after probation period
  • Nominated Friends & Family Discount
  • Clothing allowance spending gift
  • Class Pass or Gym Flex membership
  • Health Shield
  • Enhanced maternity/paternity pay
  • Charity fundraising match of up to £1,000

About us:

TALA is an activewear brand built to actively solve problems without creating new ones for people, the planet, or anyone else. Every collection prioritises functionality and thoughtful design, combining premium fabrics with multi-way versatility and flattering fits that deliver maximum impact with minimal effort. Each piece is crafted with attention to detail, ensuring women can look and feel their best with ease.

When founder Grace Beverley shifted from fast fashion to more sustainable options in her everyday clothing, she found a host of responsibly made options in every category other than activewear. Founding TALA in 2019, the proud female-led brand is on a mission to make consciously made active and off-duty styles accessible and inclusive without sacrificing performance or fit.

Read about TALA's people, purpose and product work here.
