title: Head of Solution Consulting R&D / Field CSO
descriptionHtml:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

WHY THIS ROLE, WHY NOW

R&D leaders trust people who have done the science. More than half of the world's top 50 biopharma companies already use Benchling, and many of the most important are in Europe. Our ambition is 10x faster science, from idea to first dose. With Science Foundries, launched at Benchtalk 2026, agents and scientists run entire R&D workflows together, so a three-person team can have the productive capacity of thirty.

In a senior R&D role, you can change how one organisation does science. As our Field CSO, you'll take one question to R&D organisations across EMEA: how do we get from idea to first dose 10x faster?

ROLE OVERVIEW

You'll lead our EMEA R&D Solution Consulting organisation: a team of 12, with two first-line leaders covering our Enterprise and Strategic segments, plus occasional support for APAC deals. You'll be the scientific counterpart to our General Manager, EMEA, and work alongside our Field CTO. They lead on IT, data science and architecture; you lead on the scientists and how their work changes.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Be the scientific voice in the room. Brief the GM and account teams before key meetings, then join them as a peer to the CSOs and Heads of R&D across the table. Act as senior sponsor on our largest EMEA opportunities, and use account-team introductions to open new R&D relationships.

  • Lead the 10x conversation. Turn Benchling's vision, from AI agents to Science Foundries, into a credible plan R&D leaders can act on, including how their scientists move onto Benchling and what changes in the lab.

  • Lead and develop two first-line leaders and their team of 10. Provide in-region leadership continuity, set the scientific bar for every customer engagement, and build a succession plan as the team grows.

  • Shape EMEA strategy and the roadmap. Decide with sales leadership where to focus the team's expertise, and bring patterns from the field back to Product, Marketing and global Solution Consulting.

HOW WE'LL MEASURE SUCCESS

This is a commercial role with a scientific core. We'll look at EMEA revenue growth and influenced pipeline, technical win rate, forecast accuracy on the technical side of deals, regional ownership of our largest R&D relationships, and the strength of your leadership bench.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Substantial hands-on R&D experience in biotech or pharma, with a PhD or equivalent scientific depth. You've run experiments, led programmes and know how large R&D organisations make decisions and adopt change.

  • A record of driving change, from adopting new technologies to rethinking how your teams work, and clear views on how AI will change R&D.

  • Experience leading through other managers, and executive presence with VPs, Heads of R&D and C-level leaders.

  • Commercial ambition and a growth mindset. We'll teach you how software is sold. We can't teach how a large R&D organisation works from the inside, and that's what you bring.

  • Readiness for a field role: frequent on-site time with the largest pharma and biotech companies across EMEA, plus US travel three to four times a year for team offsites and our global sales kickoff.

  • Fluency in English; German or French is a plus.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with Benchling or a comparable R&D platform (ELN, LIMS or R&D data platform), including leading its evaluation or rollout

  • Customer-facing scientific, internal consulting, or CRO/CDMO programme leadership roles

  • Presales or solution consulting experience

HOW WE WORK

We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).

#LI-Hybrid

#BI-Hybrid

Benchling welcomes everyone.

We believe diversity enriches our team so we hire people with a wide range of identities, backgrounds, and experiences.

We are an equal opportunity employer. That means we don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

title: Head of Strategic Accounts
descriptionHtml:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Head of Strategic Accounts, EMEA to lead the top tier of our commercial organisation — the largest, most complex accounts driving 9fin’s next phase of growth. Strategics is our top segment: a targeted book of our largest ARR accounts across the global banks, top-tier law firms, multi-strategy hedge funds, asset managers, and private equity firms who set the standard for how credit intelligence is bought and used.

You’ll build and lead a team of ~5–6 senior relationship managers in London, each owning a small portfolio of strategic accounts in a hybrid Account Management and Enterprise Sales role. You’ll partner closely with our Head of Strategic Accounts, EMEA to run a globally coordinated segment and work with senior Customer Success partners at the account level.

This is a builder role for a leader who has personally carried a large number, sold enterprise-scale deals into financial services, and knows how to raise the bar on rigour, presence, and multi-year deal execution.

This role requires 3 days in our London office.

What you’ll work on

Every day is different, but here’s an example of the kind of things you’ll work on:

  • Lead the EMEA Strategics team to consistent, forecastable delivery quarter over quarter across a book of $13M+ ARR accounts.

  • Coach and manage a team of ~5–6 Strategic Account Managers covering our most important banks, asset managers, hedge funds, private equity firms, and law firms in EMEA.

  • Drive multi-year deal execution, lock in early renewals, and structure enterprise agreements that grow durably over time.

  • Coach the team through complex commercial motions — MSAs, procurement, legal review, and executive alignment at the MD, Partner, PM, Head of Desk, and C-suite level.

  • Run weekly segment reviews focused on deals moved, deals at risk, pipeline health, and account-level path-to-close plans.

  • Set the operating cadence for the segment. Enforce our 3-day office minimum, and drive territory planning, account mapping, and a shared deal methodology across the team.

  • Partner with the EMEA Head of Strategic Accounts to build geographic reciprocity, with EMEA AMs backing up EMEA coverage on global accounts, and vice versa.

  • Work in a “two-in-the-box” model with senior CSMs (product and usage) and Sales Engineering (pre-sales), and partner across Enablement, Rev Ops, Marketing, and Product to remove barriers to growth.

  • Be the senior voice of our strategic clients into Product and Engineering — translating segment-level themes across credit, leveraged finance, restructuring, distressed, and private credit into a clear point of view on the roadmap.

  • Represent 9fin externally with the C-suite — at client offsites, executive briefings, industry conferences, and roundtables — and become a recognised name in EMEA debt markets.

  • Build the operating system for the Strategics segment — deal reviews, path-to-close proposals, territory planning, and account planning frameworks that scale.

About You

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • Have 12+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience, including 4+ years leading strategic or enterprise sales teams selling into financial services (banks, asset managers, hedge funds, PE firms), law firms, or a mix.

  • Have personally carried and consistently exceeded a large individual quota on multi-million-dollar strategic accounts, and can point to specific accounts you’ve grown from $X to $Y and explain exactly how.

  • Bring a consultative approach to selling and want to become a strategic partner to our clients

  • Have deep familiarity with capital markets, credit, or the debt markets ecosystem across credit, leveraged finance, restructuring, distressed, and private credit — you can hold your own with a restructuring lawyer, a leveraged finance banker, or a credit PM.

  • Have led teams through multi-year deal execution and understand what it takes to secure meaningful year-over-year uplifts, early renewals, and complex enterprise agreements.

  • Can coach reps through complex procurement, MSA negotiation, legal review, and executive alignment at the MD, Partner, PM, Head of Desk, and C-suite level.

  • Bring C-suite presence and cross-organisational credibility. You show up sharp, prepared, and trusted by both your team and your customers.

  • Are a proactive coach, not a reactive manager. You share process, mentor your reps, and help them plan deals in advance rather than reacting to slipped forecasts.

  • Have run a disciplined operating cadence — weekly deal reviews, forecast rigour, territory and account planning, and a shared deal methodology across the team.

  • Are commercially sharp and operationally rigorous, and can be a credible senior voice of your team’s clients into Product and Engineering.

  • Build trust across a matrixed commercial organisation and can partner effectively with Customer Success, Sales Engineering, Enablement, Rev Ops, Marketing, and Product.

  • Set a high bar and lead through presence and standards rather than fear. You drive accountability without burning your team out.

  • Thrive in ambitious, fast-moving environments where expectations are high, opportunities are abundant, and no two days look the same.

Our benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

 

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Equity options

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Growth & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • Quarterly team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

title: Head of Strategy & Operations
descriptionHtml:
About remove

remove is a non-profit organisation with a mission to enable innovators globally to realize the "net" in net zero. remove has established premier global startup accelerator programs focused solely on Carbon Dioxide Removal (CDR) across Europe, India, Sub-Saharan Africa and Latin America. To date, we have supported over 200 startups and cultivated a global CDR community. We also develop CDR ecosystems and engage in strategic projects to close systemic gaps in carbon removal globally. We are a small, remote team that works like a startup: high standards, an agile approach and a lot of ownership per person. Our work is funded by leading climate foundations and philanthropic partners such as The Grantham Foundation for the Protection of the Environment and Postcode Loterij Fonds.

About the role

We are looking for a senior professional to lead strategy and operations at remove, managing our talent and running the engine that keeps us moving. You will work very closely with our two co-founders, manage our program managers, and be the person who makes sure the right things get done, well and on time, as we grow our impact in new ways and into new regions at a pivotal stage of our organization.

What you will own

Strategy

  • Lead strategic thinking, be a sounding board to the co-founders, and the person who "writes the strategy down" and plans for its execution.

  • Prepare and run strategy days, offsites and team meetups.

  • Own key strategic documents and shape important external documents.

Planning and Operations

  • Develop and own our roadmap and workplans. Keep everyone accountable to shared goals and spot early and proactively when plans need to change.

  • Own our operating rhythm: recurring meetings, brainstorms, 1:1s, team updates, retros and milestone planning.

  • Develop and improve the processes and documentation the team relies on, including program SOPs and team policies.

People and team

  • Line-manage our program managers: debottleneck daily operations, set priorities, manage workload, coach the team, manage development plans, etc.

  • Lead hiring and onboarding for new team members and external support, and plan team capacity as we grow. We are not expecting to grow team members in large numbers; we intend to remain a lean and mighty team.

  • Look after team health and ways of working in a fully remote, multicultural team.

Fundraising operations

  • Run the process behind the co-founders’ fundraising efforts.

  • Maintain and develop core materials such as our decks, concept notes and one-pagers, and draft or coordinate grant applications.

  • Own impact reporting content and contribute to funder reports.

Strategic projects & programs

  • Scope & lead strategic initiatives from idea to delivery, alongside recurring work.

  • Oversee our programs and systems as we expand.

  • Oversee our entity’s brand and communications.

Who you are

You must have

  • 12+ years of experience, including roles where you ran strategy, operations and/or a PMO for a leadership team. You have done this job before with a laser focus on high standards and timely execution. You don’t let things fall through the cracks.

  • Experience supporting fundraising or business development, e.g. pipelines, proposals and reporting.

  • A track record of managing people well, ideally in small remote teams.

  • Comfort with ambiguity. You can build structure where there is none and adjust it as things change.

  • Resourcefulness and agency. You see what needs doing and do it without waiting to be asked, including the unglamorous parts. You have an entrepreneurial spirit and drive in conceptualising and executing initiatives, with strong organisational and documentation skills.

  • Excellent communication, writing and synthesis. You can turn a messy conversation into a clear plan, deck or proposal.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to inspire and persuade diverse groups, in a cross-cultural remote setting.

  • Ability to work autonomously in a remote workspace, meeting deadlines and managing several work streams simultaneously.

  • Adaptability, curiosity and eagerness to keep learning in a dynamic environment.

  • Ability to speak and write in English fluently.

  • Willingness to travel locally or occasionally regionally/globally, if necessary.

It is a plus if you have

  • A university degree (MSc. preferred) in a relevant field (e.g. environmental science, engineering, sustainability, business administration)

  • Experience in and a strong passion for climate action, carbon removal or the wider sustainability field.

  • Experience with accelerators, startups or entrepreneurship programs.

  • Experience with foundations or philanthropic funding.

  • Experience working in or with partners in the Global South.

  • A coaching or facilitation background.

Practicalities

  • This role reports to the two co-founders.

  • Location: remote, in Europe. Preference will be given to those based in Northwestern Europe due to proximity to the co-founders. Occasional travel for team meetups and selected events.

  • Contract: full time, with start date April 1, 2027. Depending on your location, you may be employed through an employer-of-record provider. You must be able to work in your country of residence. We will not sponsor visas or work permits.

  • Salary: competitive for non-profit salary bands for small teams in your location.

What we offer

  • A flexible and remote-first workplace.

  • An impact-driven role as part of a mission-driven team and organisation working with entrepreneurs globally.

Our products are available across Europe and the US, since March 2025, in Sephora Europe & since August 2026 in Sephora US – online and in over 1200 stores. As a certified B Corp™, we are committed to building a business with purpose. With a team of over 120 brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda’s story every day.

About this opportunity

As our Head of Supply Chain, you will play a critical role in ensuring the efficiency, scalability, and reliability of our supply chain from Asia into our EU, UK and US warehouse network, driving operational excellence to support our ambitious growth plans.

You'll lead our entire supply chain operations from sourcing of raw materials and our cosmetic products to final delivery of orders at our customers’ door step. You ensure smooth procurement, manufacturing, and logistics processes via air and sea shipments (incl. import) to our warehouses and efficient delivery to our B2C and B2B customers. If you're a strong Operations leader, passionate about building efficient and scalable processes and enjoy solving complex supply chain challenges in a fast-paced environment, we’d love to have you on board.

Your tasks

  • Lead the end-to-end supply chain function, including demand planning, procurement/manufacturing, logistics and import, fulfilment, last mile, and inter-warehouse transfers.

  • Build strong relationships with suppliers, manufacturers, and logistics providers; negotiate contracts and favourable terms, and ensure adherence to quality standards and delivery timelines.

title: Head of Talent Acquisition
descriptionHtml:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

🧲 Our Talent Team

At Joko, hiring has been a founding obsession since day one. Our founders have always been convinced that markets aren't cracked with headcount — they're cracked with talent density. That bet has worked: we've grown to 6 million users and become one of France's most recognized shopping apps with just 30 people in the early years, and we've kept the same bar as we've scaled past 100.

The Talent team exists because we believe talent is the single biggest asset of a company, and that identifying, attracting, and closing the best profiles is a craft worth investing in seriously. We are constantly experimenting with state-of-the-art techniques, tools, and processes to find the people who will build the future of shopping with us.

Today, the Talent team sits within the broader People function, which also covers People Ops, People Business Partnering, and Workplace across France, Spain, and our growing international footprint into the US. We are a team with a big scope and rare ownership per person, and we move fast.

✨ Why this role is special

Recruiting is Joko's #1 company objective — because talent unlocks everything else — which makes this one of the most strategic seats in the company. Three things make it genuinely rare:

  • The team is exceptionally involved in hiring. From ICs to managers to founders, recruiting is treated as a first-class responsibility, not something delegated to TA. You will work with hiring partners who actually show up, give sharp feedback, and care about the bar as much as you do.

  • You will have the tools, and the budget, to be on the frontier. We already work with a modern stack (Ashby, Claude, Claap, and more), and we keep investing to stay among the most performant and modern TA setups out there. You will not be fighting for basic tooling, you will be deciding what comes next.

  • You will live a genuinely unique scale moment. Growing from 100+ people today to 200+ within 18 months, with a real international component (France, Spain, US, and more to come) is the kind of stretch many TA leaders don’t often get to experience. You get to do it here, with a company that has already proven it can build a recognized product with a fraction of the usual headcount.

To be concrete about what this looks like in practice: in year one, the job is to build the team — sourcing, hiring, and coaching the TAMs who will power Joko's growth. The AI strategy, international employer brand, and long-term function design are the horizon you are building toward. They are real, and you will own them fully. But the foundation comes first, and the foundation is the team.

🎯 What you will do

As Head of Talent Acquisition, your mission is to build and lead the TA function that will take Joko from 100+ people today to 200+ within 18 months, and beyond, with the bar, craft, and intentionality that have defined Joko's talent density since day one. You will report to the VP People and be part of the People leadership team, alongside the Head of People Operations and our Lead People Business Partner. You will partner closely with founders, hiring managers, and the broader People team.

  • Build and own the TA team: The most important thing you will do, especially early on, is hire the recruiters who will hire everyone else. Two Talent Acquisition Managers are already in the team, and four more TAM positions are open today. You will make the case for what else the function needs over time, from sourcing specialization onward, and recruit, coach, and grow the team around you.

  • Define how Joko recruits: Inbound, outbound, RPO management, agency relationships, tooling (Ashby), and process are all yours. You will set the standards, not just execute against them — including upskilling hiring managers so the bar is applied consistently across every panel.

  • Recruit senior and critical roles yourself: You will stay close to the hardest hires. You know when to delegate and when to own the desk.

  • Build a global AI strategy for recruiting: The way recruiting is done is changing drastically with AI. You will define and roll out Joko's AI strategy for TA: which parts of the funnel to automate, which tools to deploy, how to keep human judgment where it matters most, and how to turn AI into a real competitive advantage in how we source, screen, and close. You will own this end to end.

  • Drive an international employer brand: We are not well known enough yet, and that is costing us. You will build an employer brand strategy that reflects who we actually are, starting in France, scaling very soon to Spain, and preparing for the US and other markets.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have stood up a TA function before, or rebuilt one, and you have also worked somewhere with best-in-class standards. You can operate in both 0-to-1 mode and best-in-class mode, and you know when to switch. The strongest candidate may not have done "just" Talent — a track record that spans ops, sales, consulting, or building things beyond recruiting is a real asset here.

  • Coaching mindset: You know how to develop the resourcefulness and drive of the people you manage. You see growing recruiters as part of the job, not a tax on it.

  • High-bar mindset: Joko's culture is built on talent density. Our hiring managers are involved, exacting, and not afraid to pass on a 90% candidate. You find that energizing, not frustrating.

  • Ops-oriented and performance-driven: You think in systems, not one-offs. You instrument the funnel, care about the numbers, and build process that holds up as the team scales.

  • Strong sense of craft in TA: You know the difference between a recruiter who has relied on inbound for years and one who genuinely knows how to source. You’ve done both, and you know which approach each situation calls for.

  • Analytical skills: You reason with data — funnel metrics, conversion rates, capacity plans — and you use it to drive decisions, not to decorate slides.

  • Attention to detail: You know candidates judge us on every touchpoint — an outreach message, a scorecard, an offer letter — and you hold the bar on all of them.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset: You thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments. You take ownership without being asked, you welcome feedback, and you go the extra mile by default.

  • Curious and experimental about AI: You don't claim to have it all figured out, the field moves too fast for that. But you have hands-on experience deploying AI tools into a TA function, you have strong opinions formed from real attempts (and real failures), and you genuinely enjoy figuring out what works.

  • International scope: Paris, Barcelona, New York, our footprint is growing. You are comfortable recruiting across geographies and building an Employee Value Proposition that resonates in more than one market.

  • Location: Based in Paris.

  • Education: No specific requirement. Track record matters more than credentials.

  • Languages: You are fluent in French and English (our working language). Spanish is a plus.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Compensation: €79K – €114K • Offers Equity

title: Head of Technical Program Management, Applied AI
descriptionHtml:
About LILT

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.

We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone, regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality.

At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues—Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Dance in the customer's shoes; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1—guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation, Canva, the United States Department of Defense, the United States Air Force, ASICS, and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI.

About the Role

As Head of Technical Program Management for Applied AI, you will drive and own all project execution, customer outcomes, and delivery excellence across LILT’s Applied AI practice

for the world's leading AI labs. Serving as builder and coach, you will lead the people, operations, and systems behind every Applied AI engagement — multilingual and multimodal training data, evaluations, and benchmark programs — and make sure each one ships on time, on budget, and to the highest quality bar. You are responsible for constructing LILT’s technical program management capabilities from the ground up while actively developing, mentoring, and elevating a high-performing team. Operating at the intersection of cutting-edge AI research and industrial-scale execution, you hold total accountability for every customer engagement —ensuring every deliverable across your entire team meets the highest standards of precision, speed, and technical rigour.

This is an operator's role: you will balance high-stakes operational ownership with a builder and coach mindset. You will manage and run a high-volume, high-velocity delivery organization: Technical Program Managers, project managers, and the expert and vendor workforces behind them. You bring equal passion to building the operational systems and cadence, capacity models, quality systems, and execution frameworks that power our AI lab deliverables, and coaching your team to operate as high-agency "CEOs" of their respective customer portfolios, , all while staying close enough to the work to step into a critical program or a customer escalation when it matters. You are technically fluent enough to partner with researchers and engineers, but your edge is turning complex, ambiguous customer requirements into reliable, repeatable delivery. While you empower your team to drive day-to-day execution, the buck stops with you for overall portfolio health, customer retention, program SLAs, and delivery outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • End-to-end Practice Ownership: Serve as the single point of accountability for customer outcomes across all Applied AI programs — technical delivery, project work and timelines, quality SLAs, margin, and customer satisfaction. You own top-line program success metrics, quality SLAs, delivery timelines, and customer satisfaction across all Applied AI projects.

  • Lead and scale the delivery team: Recruit, mentor, and scale a world-class team of TPMs and project managers. Set clear goals, coach for ownership, unblock across complex technical and operational challenges, and build a team that runs complex programs independently.

  • Run delivery operations and capacity planning at volume: Own capacity planning, staffing, and resource allocation across programs. Turn shifting customer demand into reliable production plans and delivery forecasts that protect speed and margin.

  • Build the delivery operating system: Standardize intake, scoping, kickoff, quality control, reporting, and close-out. Turn individual program learnings into repeatable playbooks, systems, processes, and dashboards.

  • Strategic Customer Partnership & Escalations: Act as executive partner and delivery sponsor for key frontier AI lab relationships. Proactively co-develop benchmark transcreations with customer research leads. Lead escalations, run business reviews, and help shape scope, pricing, and timelines with Sales.

  • Own quality: Partner with Research to standardize quality control across delivery, including embedded calibration, gold sets, inter-annotator agreement, LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, model eval pipelines and root-cause analysis into every customer program, ensuring that quality issues are proactively controlled and mitigated.

  • Manage the expert and vendor workforce: Work with Expert Supply and Operations to qualify, manage, and engage multilingual contributors and vendors, with clear performance and cost metrics.

  • Cross-functional Workflow Design and Execution: Design, build, and optimize scalable program frameworks for text, image, video, and audio modalities. Turn complex technical requirements into seamless operational realities, bridging Sales, Engineering, Research, Product, Production, and Engineering to scope and build project workflows that are designed optimally, launched quickly, and executed smoothly

Qualifications

  • Accountable Mindset & Ownership: Proven track record as the final owner of large-scale, mission-critical technical portfolios, with direct accountability for project delivery, customer outcomes, and SLA adherence. Demonstrated experience architecting mitigations for AI-specific operational risks (e.g., dataset contamination, domain drift, quality decay, and SLA vulnerabilities).

  • Experience: 10+ years in delivery, operations, or program leadership, including 5+ years managing managers or multi-team delivery organizations.Proven ownership of a large, customer-facing delivery portfolio with accountability for SLAs, quality, and margin.

  • Builder & Coach Mindset: Proven track record of building technical program functions, processes, and systems from scratch, coupled with a deep dedication to coaching, mentoring, and growing talent.

  • People Management & Leadership: 5+ years of direct people management experience building and scaling TPM, Product, or Engineering teams within high-growth AI or enterprise tech environments.

  • Frontier AI Expertise: Deep, hands-on understanding of the modern AI landscape—including LLMs, multimodal models, training/inference pipelines, and complex dataset diversity (multilingual and multi-domain). Hands-on experience delivering AI training data, human data, LLM evaluation, annotation, or localization programs at scale, with distributed contributor or vendor workforces.

  • 0-to-1 & Scale Experience: Demonstrated ability to build operating systems in high-velocity startup environments and scale them to support high-throughput, mission-critical operations where quality control is paramount.

  • Strong Data Fluency: comfortable using SQL, spreadsheets, or BI tools to run the business on metrics such as throughput, quality, cost per task, and utilization.

  • Contemporary Industry Acumen: Working knowledge of the modern AI landscape (LLMs, multimodal models, training and evaluation pipelines) to partner credibly with researchers and engineers.

  • Executive Stakeholder Management: Excellent business acumen, executive presence, and communication style with experience building high-trust partnerships with top-tier AI labs, customers, and enterprise executive teams

  • Education: B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, AI, or a related technical field with 12+ years of industry experience (or Ph.D. with 8+ years).

Preferred Skills

  • Experience at an AI data, human data, or language services company, or delivering for frontier AI labs.

  • Experience leading globally distributed teams across time zones.

  • Familiarity with Python and modern program tooling (e.g., Linear, Jira, custom analytics) to automate reporting and workflows.

  • Fluency in multiple human languages.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary, equity, and benefits package.

  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technology in a rapidly growing industry.

  • A dynamic and collaborative work environment.

  • Significant opportunities for professional growth and development.

  • The chance to make a real impact on global communication and business.

Our Story

Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.

LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.

With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.

Our Tech

What sets our platform apart:

  • Brand-aware AI that learns your voice, tone, and terminology to ensure every translation is accurate and consistent

  • Agentic AI workflows that automate the entire translation process from content ingestion to quality review to publishing

  • 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation

  • Human-in-the-loop reviews via our global network of professional linguists, for high-impact content that requires expert review


LILT in the News

  • Featured in The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies!

  • LILT makes it onto the Inc. 5000 List.

  • LILT’s continues to be an intellectual powerhouse, holding numerous patents that help power the most efficient and sophisticated AI and language models in the industry.

Fünf Praxen, ein Auftrag: Du verantwortest die Technik und baust Software, die unseren Teams Zeit zurückgibt. KU64 ist inhabergeführt, ohne Investoren und ohne Kette. Über 40 Zahnärztinnen und Zahnärzte arbeiten in fünf Praxen in Berlin und Potsdam, jeden Monat kommen über 1.000 neue Patientinnen und Patienten dazu.

Du verbindest IT-Betrieb und eigene Softwareentwicklung für alle fünf Standorte und berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung. Dabei arbeitest du mit den Praxisteams und unseren IT-Partnern zusammen, klärst Zuständigkeiten und entscheidest, was zuerst besser werden muss.

Das verantwortest du

  • Betrieb an fünf Standorten: Netz, Server, Arbeitsplätze, Telefonie und Telematikinfrastruktur. Du sorgst für einen Betrieb, auf den sich jedes Team verlassen kann, und dafür, dass Wissen nicht nur in Köpfen steckt.
  • Praxissoftware und Geräte: CGM Z1 Pro ist das Herz des Praxistags. Dazu digitales Röntgen, DVT, Intraoralscanner und CAD/CAM. Du koordinierst ihre Anbindung mit Teams, Herstellern und Partnern.
  • Sicherheit und Datenschutz: Gesundheitsdaten verdienen Sorgfalt: Rechte, Verschlüsselung, Zwei-Faktor, Auftragsverarbeitung, Schulung. Und eine Wiederherstellung, die du geprobt hast.
  • Partner und Budget: Du steuerst Dienstleister für Hardware, Telefonie und Gerätewartung, prüfst Verträge und machst Kosten und Prioritäten nachvollziehbar.
  • Eigene Software und Agenten: Wir entwickeln unsere interne Software selbst, und sie wächst unter dir weiter. Du prüfst, wo KI-Agenten im Praxisalltag wirklich helfen, erprobst sie mit dem Team und bringst in den Betrieb, was sich bewährt.

Womit du arbeitest

  • In der Praxis: CGM Z1 Pro, Doctolib, Personio, Telematikinfrastruktur
  • Bildgebung und Geräte: DVT und digitales Röntgen, Intraoralscanner, CAD/CAM
  • Infrastruktur: Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Windows Server, UniFi, Azure geplant
  • Eigene Entwicklung: TypeScript, Cloud-Dienste, APIs und Schnittstellen, Sprachmodelle

Du musst nicht alles davon kennen.

Deine ersten 90 Tage

  • 30 Tage, Verstehen: Du lernst Teams, Systeme und Verträge kennen und hältst fest, wo der Betrieb zuerst Aufmerksamkeit braucht.
  • 60 Tage, Ordnen: Zuständigkeiten sind geklärt, die wichtigsten Verbesserungen laufen. Mit einem Team wählst du den ersten Anwendungsfall für einen Agenten.
  • 90 Tage, Erproben: Deine Roadmap für die nächsten zwölf Monate liegt auf dem Tisch. Eine erste Lösung läuft im Praxisalltag, mit einem Menschen an ihrer Seite.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast IT-Betrieb verantwortet: Für Systeme, Dienstleister und die Menschen, die damit arbeiten. Nicht nur für Code.
  • Du entwickelst selbst: TypeScript, APIs und Cloud-Dienste. Du bringst Software zuverlässig in den Betrieb und hältst sie dort.
  • Du nimmst Menschen mit: Du setzt Prioritäten und erklärst Technik so, dass ein Praxisteam sie gern benutzt. Deutsch fließend.

Ein Plus

  • KI-Agenten oder Sprachmodelle im echten Einsatz
  • CGM Z1 oder andere Praxis- und Kliniksoftware
  • Telematikinfrastruktur, Röntgen und Medizingeräte im Netz
  • Entra ID, Intune, Azure und UniFi

Das bieten wir

  • Eine Rolle, die es noch nicht gab: Du baust sie auf und berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung.
  • Wirkung, die man sieht: Was du baust, benutzen fünf Praxisteams am nächsten Morgen.
  • Mittagessen im Haus: Unser Mitarbeiterrestaurant am Ku'damm.
  • Büro am Kurfürstendamm 64: Mitten in der City West, mit dem Team im selben Haus.

So läuft die Bewerbung

  1. Bewerben: Ohne Anschreiben. Lebenslauf hochladen, fünf kurze Fragen beantworten und ein Beispiel aus deiner Arbeit beschreiben.
  2. Gespräch mit der Geschäftsführung: Am Ku'damm oder per Video. Wir reden über Systeme, die du verantwortet hast, und über das, was dich an der Rolle reizt.
  3. Ein Nachmittag im Haus: Du siehst Empfang, Behandlungszimmer und Technik und sprichst mit dem Team.
  4. Angebot: Wenn es passt, besprechen wir Gehalt und Starttermin.

title: Head of Technology (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
We find your position.

ISA Telematics baut Systeme, die Menschen, Fahrzeuge und Güter im Blick behalten, wenn es darauf ankommt: Notruf, Ortung, Alarmierung.

Das Besondere daran ist der Umfang. Die ganze Kette läuft durch eine Hand, von der Firmware auf dem Gerät über Funkprotokoll und Server bis zur Leitstelle. Kein Modul, kein Ausschnitt: das komplette System.

Und die Probleme sind echt. GPS, das im Stahlbau aussteigt. Mobilfunk, der abbricht, wenn er gebraucht wird. Geräte, die jahrelang im Feld stehen und trotzdem aktualisierbar bleiben müssen. Ein Alarm, der nicht meistens ankommt, sondern immer.

Unsere Kunden: Industrie, Energieversorger, Bahn und Logistik, Kliniken, Polizei- und Sicherheitsorganisationen im DACH-Raum. Das Produkt ist eingeführt, zertifiziert und profitabel, du baust also mit echten Nutzern und laufenden Umsätzen im Rücken.

Nach vorn ist viel Platz: weitere Branchen, neue Produkte auf der bestehenden Plattform, internationale Märkte, ein stärkeres App-Geschäft. Was zuerst gebaut wird, entscheidest du mit, gemeinsam mit einem erfahrenen Entwickler, der das System seit Jahren betreut.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

  • Volle Verantwortung für Produkt und Technik: Architektur, Roadmap, Code

  • Rund zwölf Monate übergibt dir der Entwickler das System persönlich, anschließend leitest du den Bereich Product & Technology

  • Du entscheidest, was bleibt, was modernisiert wird und was neu entsteht

  • Neue Produkte und Anwendungsfälle auf der bestehenden Plattform mitgestalten

  • Kundenprojekte von der Aufwandsschätzung bis zum Go-live, inklusive Geräte- und Ortungsanbindung (TCP/UDP, XML)

  • Normkonforme Weiterentwicklung (DGUV, DIN VDE V 0825, CE) und Störungsanalyse im laufenden Betrieb

Qualifikation

Das bringst Du mit

  • Java: drei Jahre professionelle Entwicklung

  • SQL und relationale Datenbanken, Git im Alltag

  • Kommunikationsschnittstellen entwickeln und debuggen (TCP/UDP, XML)

  • Aufwände abschätzen und mit technischen Ansprechpartnern auf Kundenseite verhandeln

  • Führungskompetenz und unternehmerisches Denken

  • Deutsch & Englisch verhandlungssicher

Von Vorteil:

Android, JavaScript, Linux, Windows Server, Tomcat, Netzwerktechnik, GPS, Mobilfunk/M2M, Firmware, Informix, Erfahrung mit Produktnormen.

Benefits

Was wir bieten

  • Viel Gestaltungs- und Entscheidungsspielraum in einem kleinen Team mit kurzen Wegen

  • Gehaltsspanne 70.000–90.000 € p. a. je nach Erfahrung

  • Du berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung und leitest zukünftig den Bereich Product & Technology

  • 28 Tage Urlaub

  • Aufbauphase selbst gestalten: Produkt, Kunden und Cashflow sind da, die nächste Ausbaustufe baust du

title: Head of Transformation
descriptionHtml:
Deducta

Head of Transformation

Location: London, UK, near London Bridge. Hybrid, 3-4 in-person days a week.

Compensation: £130k base salary plus equity

Visa Sponsorship: Available for the right candidate

Start Date: As soon as possible

Why we exist

Every decision a business makes, from the suppliers it trusts to the risks it accepts, eventually shows up as spend. This makes spend data the most honest record of how a company operates. Not the strategy deck or the org chart: spend describes what really happened.

This record exists, but it's scattered across dozens of systems and decades of legacy technology. Companies spending billions a year still can't easily answer: Who are our suppliers? Where are we exposed? What are we paying for twice?

We believe a business that can't see itself clearly can't make great decisions. Deducta exists to give the world's most complex organisations a true picture of how they operate, and the intelligence to act on it. Our ambition is to become the category-defining platform for enterprise data intelligence.

We're well funded, growing fast, and have already processed more than £1 trillion of spend for some of the world's largest and most recognisable companies. Our partners use Deducta to deliver major business transformations orders of magnitude faster.

Why this role matters

Our customers are some of the world's largest companies, and every partnership depends on Deducta delivering the measurable outcomes we've committed to. This role owns that delivery, from sales handover through implementation, adoption and ongoing value. You'll report to the leadership team.

You'll work directly with senior leaders at our customers, own our most important relationships, and build and lead the customer team as we scale. You'll have the autonomy to shape how Deducta delivers, and to make that model repeatable without losing quality.

What you'll do

  • Customer delivery: Own delivery end to end, from sales handover through implementation, adoption, value realisation and ongoing partnership.

  • Enterprise programmes: Translate customer objectives into clear workstreams, milestones, owners and dependencies, and keep complex programmes moving.

  • Senior relationships: Build trusted relationships with stakeholders from day-to-day programme leads through CPOs, CFOs and other executives.

  • Data and platform: Work directly with customer data and the Deducta platform, understanding each customer's business so our work produces meaningful insights and outcomes.

  • Implementation and adoption: Identify blockers early, coordinate the right resources across product and engineering, and make sure customer learnings shape how we improve the product.

  • Team and operating model: Build, manage and grow the customer team and delivery model as the company scales.

Success in this role means:

  • Trusted partner: Customers see Deducta as a partner that consistently delivers against its commitments.

  • Predictable implementations: Implementations move quickly, with risks and blockers surfaced early rather than through firefighting.

  • Visible value: Customers adopt the platform, can articulate the value Deducta creates, and keep deepening how they use it.

  • Scalable delivery: Our delivery model becomes more repeatable and scalable without sacrificing the quality of the customer experience.

Who you are

We're looking for a high-agency operator with roughly three to four years in MBB or top-tier management consulting, experience managing complex workstreams and confidence in front of senior clients. You should be as comfortable in the data as you are presenting to an executive. A background in procurement or enterprise software isn't required.

You might be the right fit if you have:

  • Client leadership: You build credibility quickly, manage demanding stakeholders and become a trusted partner to senior executives.

  • Programme leadership: You turn an ambitious objective into a structured plan and create accountability across stakeholders you don't control.

  • Analytical depth: You get into the data yourself, identify what matters and synthesise complex information into clear conclusions.

  • Problem solving: You diagnose why something isn't working, separate symptoms from underlying problems, and drive the team to a practical solution.

  • Executive communication: You take complex, messy work and communicate the answer clearly and confidently to senior stakeholders.

  • People leadership: You have managed others, or can build and lead a high-performing customer team.

  • Nice to have: Experience in enterprise software, data, analytics, AI, procurement, complex technology implementations, or a high-growth environment.

We care most about how you think, the quality of your work and how you approach unfamiliar problems. Previous startup experience isn't essential, but the pace, initiative and judgement to thrive in one are.

How we work

We believe in freedom and responsibility. We set clear priorities, share the context and trust people to decide how to deliver. You'll thrive here if you value:

  • Ownership: You own the outcome, not just the task. You deliver what you commit to, follow through when things get difficult, and own your mistakes.

  • Unreasonable hospitality: You treat prospects, clients and teammates with exceptional care as a default. You anticipate needs, communicate with clarity, and help others succeed.

  • Bias for action: We don’t have every answer upfront. You move things forward without waiting to be asked, take calculated risks, and adapt as you learn.

  • Craft: Moving quickly matters, but so does doing work that stays clear, reliable and useful as we grow.

  • System building: You create leverage beyond your own output, building processes, tools and documentation that others reuse and that keep working without you.

  • Candor: You tell the hard truth early, give and receive feedback thoughtfully, ask for help when you need it, and push back when priorities need to change.

  • Curiosity about AI: You’re excited by what applied AI makes possible, and you look for ways to use it in your own work.

As an early team member, you'll help shape our culture, our processes and where Deducta goes next. We're growing quickly, and this role will grow with us.

Hiring process

  1. Intro call

  2. Background interview

  3. Technical exercise

  4. Final interview

  5. Offer, referencing and start

Help the world's biggest businesses finally see themselves clearly.

Compensation: £130K • Offers Equity

title: Health and Safety Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Health & Safety Engineer to support safe operations across our facilities, construction activities, manufacturing, testing, and launch operations.

This is a technical role focused on identifying hazards, developing effective controls, and helping teams work safely in a fast-moving engineering environment. You will work closely with operations, engineering, construction, manufacturing, test, and external contractors to ensure that safety is built into the way we work.

Fluent German and experience working with German authorities would be a substantial advantage

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, have just crossed €10m in revenue for our first operating year and are applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Conduct risk assessments, hazard reviews, workplace inspections, and safety assessments across company operations.

  • Develop practical safety procedures, engineering controls, permits, emergency plans, and supporting documentation.

  • Support safe working practices across construction, manufacturing, testing, hazardous-materials handling, and launch activities.

  • Work with engineers, operations teams, contractors, and subject-matter experts to identify and control operational risks.

  • Liaise with German authorities, regulators, inspectors, and external safety bodies on approvals, inspections, and compliance matters.

  • Investigate incidents, near misses, unsafe conditions, and non-conformances, driving corrective actions and improvements.

What we are looking for

  • Proven experience in health and safety engineering, HSE, operational safety, or a similar role in a technical or industrial environment.

  • A degree or equivalent professional experience in safety engineering, engineering, occupational safety, environmental health and safety, or a related discipline.

  • Strong understanding of workplace risk assessment, hazard controls, incident investigation, and safety documentation.

  • Experience working with contractors, technical teams, construction activities, manufacturing, testing, or other high-risk operations.

  • Fluent German and proven experience working directly with German authorities and regulatory bodies.

  • A practical, structured, and confident approach, with the ability to challenge unsafe decisions and influence teams at all levels.

Desirable experience

  • Aerospace, space, defence, rocketry, propulsion, chemical processing, construction, or high-energy testing.

  • Hazardous chemicals, explosives, energetic materials, pressure systems, or high-consequence test operations.

  • German permitting, inspection, environmental, occupational-safety, construction, or hazardous-materials processes.

  • Emergency response, contractor safety, operational-readiness reviews, audits, or safety training.

  • Formal health and safety, process-safety, environmental, or occupational-safety qualifications.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

  • Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

Please submit applications in English

 

Compensation: €70K – €90K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

title: Health Solution Architect - CDI Paris - Theodo
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire de Theodo et son succès

Depuis 2009, Theodo conçoit, développe et déploie des produits digitaux ingénieux. Notre approche : le meilleur de la technologie, au service de la création de valeur, porté par l'approche Lean.

Notre approche unique est fondée sur 3 principes :

  • nous avons développé des expertises reconnues dans les technologies clés de la conception et du développement produit;
  • quelle que soit l’étape du projet, notre priorité à chaque décision est la création de valeur pour nos clients;
  • nous recrutons les meilleurs talents digitaux et cultivons leur ingéniosité grâce à l’approche lean.

En 15 ans, nous sommes devenus un groupe de plus de 700 Theodoers, organisé en entités spécialisées par technologie (Apps, Cloud, Data & AI) et par industrie (Fintech, Govtech, Healthtech, Consumer Products Goods). En 2025, le groupe génère 100M€ de CA.



Tes missions

La santé se digitalise. Les données de vie réelle explosent. Elles facilitent le soin et accélèrent la recherche, notamment via les entrepôts de données de santé.

Ces données sont extrêmement sensibles et réglementées. Nos clients ont donc besoin de notre expertise pour bâtir des applications sur des architectures Cloud conformes à la réglementation HDS. L'arrivée des LLM ajoute un défi : exposer ces données à des agents pour aider les soignants et les patients, sans jamais transiger sur la sécurité.

Dans notre équipe, tu travailleras sur des sujets concrets, au service du soin et de la recherche. Des projets utiles, pour des produits qui comptent.

Ton rôle : concevoir, convaincre et déployer

Ta mission est avant tout opérationnelle. Tu conçois, tu présentes et tu mets en place des architectures Cloud qui répondent aux besoins fonctionnels, de sécurité et de conformité de nos clients.

Concrètement :

  • Avant-vente : traduire un besoin en architecture adaptée, et convaincre le client que c’est la plus ingénieuse pour le projet.
  • Déploiement : infrastructure as code, de bout en bout.
  • Audit : conformité HDS et bonnes pratiques des standards Cloud.
  • Développement d’assets : agents, boilerplates, projets open source.

    • À plus long terme, nous voulons t’impliquer dans la structuration des offres et des équipes Theodo.

    Autonome sur ton expertise, fort en équipe

    Sur l'architecture Cloud, tu dois pouvoir être autonome. C'est ton domaine, tu le pilotes.

    Mais tu ne travailles jamais seul. En avant-vente, tu fais équipe avec l'Account Manager et le Solution Architect. En projet, tu collabores avec l'Engineering Manager et les autres DevOps. La collaboration est au centre de chaque mission.

    L'équipe que tu rejoins

    Theodo est certifié infogéreur HDS. Nous avons développé notre propre framework de mise en conformité, et assurons la maintenance HDS d'une vingtaine d'applications en production.

  • Ton manager : Ludovic Descateaux, Group Manager de Theodo Healthtech.
  • En avant-vente : un binôme Account Manager (ex. Marine Accolas) et Solution Architect.
  • En projet : un Engineering Manager (ex. Thomas Walter).
  • L'équipe Run HDS, riche de plus de 50 projets, t'épaule sur les architectures.
  • Tu participes aux guildes Sécu, DevOps, Agentique, et aux rituels hebdomadaires de formation.

    • Tes perspectives d'évolution (moyen / long terme)

  • Business : Partnership, avec la responsabilité d'une plateforme business et/ou d'une practice du groupe.
  • Managériale : Group Manager.

    • Profil recherché

    Expériences

  • 6 à 14 ans d'expérience.
  • Une expertise en infrastructure Cloud.
  • Une expérience en service (ESN ou conseil).
  • Nice to have : Une expérience dans la santé et des notions de réglementation HDS.

    • Compétences clés

  • Concevoir des architectures qui accélèrent le développement tout en respectant la réglementation.
  • Traduire un besoin en architecture adaptée aux contraintes du client.
  • Utiliser les agents LLM de façon structurée pour améliorer la qualité du code.
  • Présenter et convaincre sur la pertinence d'une solution.
  • Maîtriser Terraform, Ansible, Helm, Kubernetes, ArgoCD et un cloud public (AWS / GCP / Azure / Scaleway).

    • Le process de recrutement

  • Call de qualification (30 min) avec un·e Talent Acquisition Manager.
  • Entretien fit (1h).
  • Test technique infra (1h).
  • Entretien avant-vente (1h).
  • Entretien dirigeant (1h).
  • Prises de référence, notamment avec des managers précédents.

    • Mots clés :

    Medtech, ISO 13485, IEC 62304, ISO 27001, MDR, Dispositif Medical, Health Data Hub,

    DevOps, Cloud, Terraform, AWS, GCP, Azure, OVH, Scaleway

    Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

    L'environnement :

    💼 Un groupe de 700 personnes, avec de vraies possibilités d'évolution cross-entités. 🤝 Un coach interne dédié, avec des séances hebdomadaires sur ton quotidien et ta carrière. 🎯 Des projets associatifs via la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…). 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d'entreprise annuel.

    Le package :

    📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe. 💸 Épargne salariale et intéressement (Epsor). 🖥 Budget matériel pour t'équiper. 🧒 Avantages CSE (Gymlib, Kiosk, Happypal). 🏖 5 semaines de congés + 8 à 12 RTT/an. 🩺 Mutuelle SideCare prise en charge à 50%. 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurant Swile. 🍼 Aides et places en crèche réservées.

    Prêt·e à nous rejoindre ?

    Chez Theodo, la diversité est une richesse et l'égalité des chances une conviction. Notre processus de recrutement est équitable, bienveillant et fondé sur les compétences. Nous accueillons toutes les candidatures, sans distinction de genre, d'origine, d'orientation sexuelle, d'âge, de situation de handicap ou de croyances.

title: Homologation & Certification Engineer, Energy Systems
descriptionHtml:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

     

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

     

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

     

Start date: Immediately

Dein Arbeitsalltag ist wesentlich durch die telefonische Beratung unserer Fachkundschaft geprägt. Über den Tag hinweg stehst du kontinuierlich im direkten Austausch mit Fachkräften aus der Hörakustik und bist für sie eine kompetente fachliche Ansprechperson.

Bei audiologischen und technischen Fragestellungen berätst du unsere Kundschaft und unterstützt dabei, konkrete Herausforderungen direkt im Gespräch zu analysieren und zu lösen.

Bei Fragen zur Hörgeräteanpassung, zu unseren Produkten und zur Anpasssoftware sowie bei technischen Problemen und der Fehlerdiagnose unterstützt du kompetent und lösungsorientiert.

Fachliche Themen rund um Reparaturen, Reklamationen, ITE-/Im-Ohr-Lösungen und Remakes begleitest du und hilfst dabei, die passende Lösung zu finden.

Ergänzend zur telefonischen Beratung gehören die Bearbeitung schriftlicher Kundenanfragen sowie die Dokumentation relevanter Informationen und Lösungen zu deinen Aufgaben.

Produktschulungen und interne Trainings führst du eigenständig durch und vermittelst dabei dein Wissen verständlich und praxisnah.

Feedback und Anforderungen aus dem Markt nimmst du auf und bringst die Perspektive unserer Fachkundschaft in die Organisation ein.

Mehr über dich

Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Hörakustik oder eine Ausbildung bzw. ein Studium im Bereich Audiologie oder eine vergleichbare fachliche Qualifikation bilden die Grundlage für diese Position.

Fundiertes audiologisches Fachwissen sowie praktische Kenntnisse rund um Hörgeräte, deren Anpassung und typische technische Fragestellungen zeichnen dich aus.

Telefonieren gehört für dich gerne und selbstverständlich zum Arbeitsalltag: Der intensive telefonische Austausch mit unserer Fachkundschaft macht einen wesentlichen Teil deines Arbeitstages aus. Auch über längere Zeit am Telefon zu beraten und unterschiedliche Anfragen nacheinander zu bearbeiten, liegt dir.

Freude daran, dein Fachwissen weiterzugeben, zeichnet dich ebenso aus wie die Fähigkeit, auch komplexe audiologische oder technische Zusammenhänge am Telefon verständlich und lösungsorientiert zu erklären.

Eine ausgeprägte Kunden- und Serviceorientierung sowie Geduld und Kommunikationsstärke gehören zu deinen Stärken.

Im Umgang mit digitalen Anwendungen bist du sicher und bringst eine gute Software- und Technikaffinität mit.

Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind für die Beratung unserer Kundschaft erforderlich; Grundkenntnisse in Englisch sind von Vorteil.

Mehr über das, was wir bieten

Bei uns kannst du deine Erfahrung aus der Hörakustik in einem neuen Umfeld einsetzen: Du bleibst nah an audiologischen Themen und der täglichen Praxis unserer Fachkundschaft. Gleichzeitig gibst du dein Fachwissen an andere Fachkräfte aus der Hörakustik weiter und unterstützt sie kompetent bei audiologischen und technischen Fragestellungen.

Als Teil eines großen und erfahrenen Teams profitierst du vom regelmäßigen fachlichen Austausch und erhältst gleichzeitig Einblicke in die Arbeit eines der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Hörlösungen. Dabei arbeitest du mit bekannten Marken wie Phonak, Unitron und Hansaton und entwickelst dein Wissen über Produkte, Technologien und moderne Hörlösungen kontinuierlich weiter.

Als einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter im Bereich Hörversorgung mit Hauptsitz in der Schweiz setzen wir uns für eine inklusive Unternehmenskultur ein. Wir möchten ein Umfeld schaffen, in dem du eine erfolgreiche Karriere mit deinen persönlichen Verpflichtungen und Interessen vereinbaren kannst. Darüber hinaus bieten wir dir vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterbildung sowie individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

title: HR Director
descriptionHtml:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

The HR Director will serve as a strategic partner to Axon’s Chief Revenue Officer and provide leadership within the Global Sales organization across a broad spectrum of HR disciplines including Talent Development, Org Effectiveness, Executive Coaching, Compensation, and Employee Relations. In addition, this role will be responsible for overseeing the development of Axon’s international People Operations function and local HR leadership support for all Axon operations across EMEA, APAC, and META. 

To be successful in this role you must understand organizational priorities and translate those into a talent strategy that enables the business to scale. You must leverage your global expertise and continuous improvement mindset, in order to build the foundational infrastructure required for our international People Operations function to scale. You will leverage data, critical thinking, and problem solving skills to influence business leaders and deliver solutions which drive higher performance, retention and motivation across teams at all levels of the organization.

What You’ll Do

Location: This role is based out of our London office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.

Reports to: Vice President, HR Business Partners

  • Lead a team of HR Business Partners and international People Ops support in providing best-in-class support to Axon employees and business leaders.
  • Partner with key business stakeholders and other HRBP Leaders, to provide localized support to international teams across Axon.
