title: Inhouse Consultant SAP S/4HANA FI (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Im Auftrag unseres Mandanten, eines international erfolgreichen und technologisch führenden Unternehmens im Bereich der Vakuumtechnologie, suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit als Inhouse Consultant SAP S/4HANA FI (m/w/d). In dieser verantwortungsvollen Position übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle bei der Weiterentwicklung der globalen SAP-Finance-Prozesse und fungierst als wichtige Schnittstelle zwischen IT und Fachbereichen. Dabei bringst du deine Expertise in SAP S/4HANA FI, End-to-End-Prozessen, Customizing und der Umsetzung internationaler IT-Projekte ein.

Aufgaben

  • Du unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung und Umsetzung globaler Geschäftsprozesse innerhalb der SAP-Landschaft.
  • Dabei stellst du einen reibungslosen und durchgängigen Prozessablauf im Bereich SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) sicher – insbesondere entlang der Prozesse Record-to-Report und Cash-to-Invest.
  • Du übernimmst das Customizing sowie die Pflege relevanter Stammdaten und Systemeinstellungen im SAP-FI-Umfeld.
  • Als Ansprechpartner berätst du die Fachbereiche bei der Optimierung ihrer Finance-Prozesse und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihnen passende SAP-Lösungen.
  • Du verantwortest eigene (Teil-)Projekte und begleitest unter anderem die Planung und Durchführung von IT-Integrationstests.
  • Für Key User, Anwender und den 1st-Level-Support erstellst du technische Dokumentationen, Prozessbeschreibungen und Schulungsunterlagen.
  • Darüber hinaus unterstützt du den laufenden SAP-Betrieb im Rahmen des 2nd- und 3rd-Level-Supports.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit den relevanten Fachbereichen sowie weiteren internen IT-Stakeholdern zusammen.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung in der SAP-Beratung und bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in SAP S/4HANA FI mit.
  • Ein gutes Verständnis der zugrunde liegenden End-to-End-Prozesse, insbesondere Record-to-Report und Cash-to-Invest, ist für dich selbstverständlich.
  • Kenntnisse in weiteren SAP-Modulen wie CO, SD, MM oder PP sind von Vorteil.
  • Erfahrung mit SAP ABAP sowie dem SAP Solution Manager ist ein Pluspunkt.
  • Idealerweise hast du bereits Erfahrung in der technischen bzw. IT-seitigen Projektsteuerung gesammelt.
  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch; Französischkenntnisse sind ein zusätzlicher Vorteil.
  • Eine selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise zeichnet dich aus.
  • Du verfügst über ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen und kannst dich schnell in komplexe Prozesse und Systemlandschaften einarbeiten.

Benefits

  • Eine vielseitige Inhouse-Position mit Gestaltungsspielraum und internationalen Projekten.
  • Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten sowie interne Karriereperspektiven.
  • Eine attraktive Vergütung nach IG-Metall-Tarif inklusive Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld sowie weiteren Zusatzleistungen.
  • Weitere Benefits wie AVWL, bezuschusste Kantine und Fahrradleasing.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten durch Gleitzeit und 30 Tage Urlaub.
  • Die Möglichkeit, flexibel mobil zu arbeiten und Beruf und Privatleben miteinander zu verbinden.
  • Eine offene und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur mit einem internationalen Arbeitsumfeld.
  • Einen langfristig sicheren Arbeitsplatz bei einem international aufgestellten und zukunftsorientierten Arbeitgeber.

Bei offenen Fragen kannst du dich gerne an mich wenden.

Max Löwe

title: Initiativbewerbung Büro Düsseldorf
descriptionHtml:
Gestalte mit uns die Buchhaltung von morgen: cloudbasiert, KI-unterstützt, papierlos

Du brennst für Zahlen und möchtest die Finanzbuchhaltung nicht nur verwalten, sondern aktiv in die digitale Zukunft führen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig, unabhängig davon, wo du in deiner Karriere gerade stehst.

Wir suchen engagierte Persönlichkeiten aus dem Bereich Finanz- und Buchhaltung und freuen uns über Initiativbewerbungen von:

  • Junior-Finanzbuchhaltern (m/w/d), die nach ihrer Ausbildung oder ihrem Studium durchstarten und wachsen möchten,
  • Finanzbuchhaltern (m/w/d) mit solider Praxiserfahrung, die den nächsten Schritt suchen,
  • Senior-Finanzbuchhaltern (m/w/d), die eigenverantwortlich Mandate und Projekte steuern wollen,
  • Bilanzbuchhaltern (m/w/d), die ihre Expertise in HGB-Abschlüssen und Bilanzierung voll einbringen möchten.

Ob erste Berufserfahrung oder langjährige Expertise, bei uns findest du den passenden Platz und den Raum, dich weiterzuentwickeln.

Deine möglichen Aufgabenfelder

Je nach Erfahrung und Spezialisierung:

  • Betreuung unserer Mandantinnen und Mandanten mit modernsten Technologien
  • Mitwirkung an bis hin zur eigenverantwortlichen Führung der digitalen Finanzbuchhaltung
  • Vorbereitung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB und Finanzbuchhaltungsvorgaben
  • Kontenpflege, Kontenabstimmungen, Vorbereitung des Zahlungsverkehrs sowie Umsatzsteuervoranmeldungen
  • Kontinuierliche Analyse und Optimierung der Buchhaltungsprozesse durch den Einsatz digitaler Tools
  • Gestaltung und Nutzung digitaler Workflows (z. B. Belegflüsse, Freigabeprozesse, Dokumentenmanagement)
  • Bei entsprechender Erfahrung: eigenverantwortliche Projektsteuerung end-to-end sowie, wenn vorhanden, das Einbringen deines eigenen Mandanten-Netzwerks zum Ausbau unseres Kundenportfolios

Was du mitbringen solltest

Wir wissen: Nicht jede/jeder erfüllt alles und das ist völlig in Ordnung. Bewirb dich, wenn ein Großteil auf dich zutrifft:

  • Eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder ein vergleichbares Studium
  • Berufserfahrung passend zu deiner Karrierestufe, von ersten praktischen Erfahrungen (Junior) über mehrjährige Buchhaltungspraxis bis hin zu 3 bis 5+ Jahren und fundierter Bilanzbuchhaltungserfahrung (Senior/Bilanzbuchhalter)
  • Idealerweise (für erfahrene Profile) Praxis aus einer Steuerkanzlei/einem Steuerbüro sowie Beteiligung an oder eigenständige Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen
  • Kenntnisse in HGB und Finanzbuchhaltung, je nach Level Grundkenntnisse oder umfassende Expertise
  • Begeisterung für digitale Innovationen und Erfahrung bzw. Offenheit im Umgang mit digitalen Workflows
  • Kenntnisse in Microsoft M365 und DATEV (Grundkenntnisse wünschenswert bis sicherer Umgang); Erfahrung mit Business Central, Oracle oder branchenspezifischen ERP-Systemen von Vorteil
  • Ausgeprägtes Zahlenverständnis, Sorgfalt und Genauigkeit
  • Eine selbstständige, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie Kommunikationsstärke und Teamfähigkeit, digital wie persönlich
  • Von Vorteil (kein Muss): ein eigenes Mandanten-Netzwerk, das du mit einbringen möchtest

Was wir dir bieten

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Bring deine Ideen ein und gestalte aktiv die Zukunft der Buchhaltung mit
  • Verantwortung & Entwicklung: Baue unser Team in Düsseldorf mit auf, mit echtem Raum für deine persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung
  • Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung: Bleib am Puls der digitalen Entwicklung, insbesondere bei Workflows und Automatisierung
  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Remote oder im modernen Büro mit höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen in der Düsseldorfer Altstadt, du hast die Wahl
  • Work-Life-Balance: 30 Urlaubstage, zusätzlich frei an Heiligabend und Silvester sowie flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Mitarbeiter-Benefits: spendit-Karte, kostenlose Getränke, regelmäßige Teamevents (in Planung)
  • Mobilität: Fahrtkostenzuschuss für das Deutschlandticket und JobRad-Leasing

Über uns

Die advacc advanced accounting GmbH ist der Partner für moderne, vollständig digitale Buchhaltung mit Standorten in Düsseldorf und Greifswald. Als externe Buchhaltung übernehmen wir für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden zentrale Aufgaben der Finanzbuchhaltung, von der Bearbeitung von Ein- und Ausgangsrechnungen über die Buchung aller Geschäftsvorfälle bis zur Lohnabrechnung und stellen fristgerechte, transparente und rechtssichere Abläufe sicher.
Darüber hinaus beraten wir betriebswirtschaftlich, steuern das Forderungsmanagement und treiben die Digitalisierung sowie Optimierung von Buchhaltungsprozessen voran. Unser erfahrenes Team arbeitet softwareunabhängig, schnell und proaktiv, mit dem Anspruch, Abläufe zu vereinfachen, Liquidität zu sichern und Freiräume für das Kerngeschäft unserer Kundinnen und Kunden zu schaffen. Wir stehen für innovative Lösungen, hohe Serviceorientierung und echte Hands-on-Mentalität.

title: Initiativbewerbung, Deutschland (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Isembard

Isembard baut ein Netzwerk hochleistungsfähiger Fabriken für kritische Industrien auf. Wir verbinden moderne Werkzeugmaschinen, Robotik und unsere eigene Software MasonOS, um Präzisionsteile für Unternehmen aus Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung, Energie und Zukunftstechnologien zu fertigen, mit Fabriken in Großbritannien, den USA, Deutschland und Frankreich. Unsere Mission: industrielle Beschleunigung schmieden.

Keine passende Stelle dabei?

Wir lernen oft großartige Leute kennen, bevor wir die passende Stelle für sie haben. Wenn du Isembard in Deutschland mit aufbauen willst und keine unserer offenen Stellen passt, bewirb dich hier und erzähl uns, woran du arbeiten möchtest.

Wir lesen jede Bewerbung. Sobald eine Stelle frei wird, die zu deiner Erfahrung passt, melden wir uns.

Von wem wir gern hören

  • Zerspaner, Programmierer, Prüfer und Ingenieure, die schon Präzisionsteile gefertigt haben.

  • Software-, Robotik- und Datenleute, deren Arbeit in einer echten Fertigung laufen soll.

  • Leute aus Operations, Supply Chain, Vertrieb und Finanzen, die einem schnell wachsenden Fertiger beim Skalieren helfen.

So bewirbst du dich

  • Lade deinen Lebenslauf hoch und füge dein LinkedIn-Profil hinzu, falls du eins hast.

  • Sag uns, welcher Bereich dich interessiert.

  • Ein paar Zeilen dazu, warum Isembard, reichen völlig. Kein Anschreiben nötig.

Standort: Vor Ort in unserer Fabrik in Hamburg.

Isembard steht für Chancengleichheit. Bewerbungen auf Deutsch oder Englisch sind willkommen.

  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit 3D-Druck / additiver Fertigung (LPBF, SLS) von Vorteil, aber kein Muss

  • Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise

  • Sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen und MS Office

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und fließendes Englisch

Was wir bieten

  • Ein attraktives Fixgehalt plus leistungsabhängige variable Vergütung

  • Hybrides Arbeiten / Remote + an Standorten wie z.B.: Essen - Zur Einarbeitung intensiv

  • Die Chance, einen neuen Geschäftsbereich von der ersten Stunde an mitzugestalten

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege eines Startups, abgesichert durch die Hoffmann Group / SFS Group

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Business Development Manager und viel Raum für eigene Ideen

title: Inside Sales Manager
descriptionHtml:
Wer wir sind

docu-fix digitalisiert den sozialwirtschaftlichen Mittelstand. Wir automatisieren Prozesse rund um Dokumente: Scan-Dienstleistungen, Dokumentenmanagement (u. a. DocuWare), Workflows und E-Signatur. Unsere Kunden sind unter anderem Träger der Sozialwirtschaft, Rechenzentren und öffentliche Verkehrsbetriebe.

Unsere Kunden sparen mit uns bis zu 80% ihrer Prozesskosten – mit einer Lösung, die EU-konform ist. Wir wachsen stark und bauen unseren Vertrieb jetzt richtig auf. Dafür suchen wir dich.

title: Instructional Designer
descriptionHtml:
What we're all about.

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our clients to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here – and it’s what will make our future. At Quantexa, you’ll experience autonomy and support in equal measures allowing you to form a career that matches your ambitions. 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We speak over 20 languages across our 47 nationalities, creating a sense of belonging for all.

We're heading in one direction, the future. We’d love you to join us.

The opportunity.

The Quantexa Academy helps our customers, partners and colleagues become self-sufficient with the Quantexa Platform. We do that through online learning, instructor-led sessions and bespoke digital resources that let every user harness the power of our award-winning Decision Intelligence Platform.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for an Instructional Designer to join our Design & Publish Team within Education Services. You'll turn complex technical topics – data, analytics, software and FinTech – into clear, engaging and accessible learning experiences, taking projects from first conversation with a subject matter expert through to a polished, published solution.

This is a role for an independent problem solver. You'll own your design projects end to end, decide how best to approach each one, and organize your own time across several priorities at once, spotting risks early and keeping stakeholders informed without needing to be chased. You'll work alongside Product, R&D and Delivery experts, and have the room to bring your own ideas on tools, approaches and how we use AI to design better learning.

If you love making hard things easy to learn, and do your best work with autonomy and trust, we'd like to hear from you.

This is a hybrid role, with the expectation of attending the company office in central London twice a week.

What you'll be doing

  • Design and update technical learning solutions for customers, partners and employees, covering storyboards, articles, documentation, presentations, and eLearning.

  • Apply best practice in learning design methodologies, accessibility, and user experience, so every learner has a great experience.

  • Build assessments and use learner feedback and data to shape your design decisions.

  • Use AI-assisted tools to speed up research, authoring and quality checks, with human review to keep content accurate and aligned to learning objectives.

  • Work with subject matter experts, and with Product, Delivery and R&D teams, to understand the Platform and turn that knowledge into effective training.

  • Take ownership of your programs, keeping them current and aligned as the Platform evolves.

  • Research technical documentation, demos, recordings, and learner feedback to make sure our content is accurate and high quality.

  • Plan and track your own content projects, flagging risks and blockers early and keeping stakeholders in the loop.

  • Use tools such as Confluence, Jira, SharePoint and Asana to manage tasks, document your work and collaborate across teams.

  • Identify, propose and lead the introduction of new tools, processes or AI approaches that improve our learning design and the learner experience.

  • Support teammates through feedback and knowledge sharing, and take the lead on projects where it's useful.

What you'll bring.

Essential

  • Experience designing technical or complex training content – for example in FinTech, analytics, data science, data engineering or software development.

  • Solid knowledge of designing, delivering, and evaluating training programs grounded in adult learning principles and instructional design theories.

  • Good understanding of at least one programming language (Java, Scala, Python or any other OOP)

  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex information clearly and concisely.

  • Confident use of Microsoft Office 365 (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint)

  • Experience, or real curiosity, in using GenAI for content creation, automation and productivity.

  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing needs.

  • A collaborative, proactive and solution-focused approach, and the ability to build positive relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.

Desirable

  • Experience with an LMS and using learner data or feedback to improve content.

  • Experience coordinating projects that involve several stakeholders.

  • Experience mentoring or sharing knowledge with colleagues, or an interest in doing so.

  • Familiarity with Confluence, Jira or Asana.

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Company bonus

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

  • Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover

  • Life Insurance and Income Protection

  • Regularly bench-marked salary rates

  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave

  • Well-being days

  • Volunteer Day off

  • Work from Home Equipment

  • Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes

  • Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app

  • Continuous Training and Development

  • Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy

  • Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

 

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

title: Instrumentation Development Embedded Engineer
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

As the Instrumentation Development Embedded Engineer, you will own the development of high-speed control and protection systems for the Alpha fusion demonstrator, focusing on FPGA-based solutions for plasma heating hardware protection.

You will work across the full development lifecycle, from writing and verifying HDL code to developing software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop testing, integrating embedded software and electronics, and establishing robust development and deployment pipelines.

You will also help establish Proxima’s FPGA development capability beyond plasma heating, defining reusable architectures, development workflows, testing methodologies, and HDL best practices that can be adopted across other systems.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Design, implement, and maintain HDL-based control and protection systems, starting with plasma heating system protection.

  • Establish end-to-end FPGA development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and SIL/HIL test environments integrated with plant design frameworks.

  • Develop embedded software, firmware, and low-level drivers to interface FPGAs with sensors, actuators, and other control systems.

  • Collaborate across RF, controls, electronics, and systems teams to define system interfaces, ICDs, and verification plans.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Degree in Electronics, Embedded Systems, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Strong proficiency in HDL (VHDL, Verilog, SystemVerilog) and software scripting (Python, C/C++).

  • Proven experience integrating FPGAs with hardware peripherals, board-level electronics, and communication interfaces.

  • Familiarity with modern software development practices (Git, CI, code review, automated testing).

  • Systems-thinking approach with strong debugging skills spanning HDL, embedded firmware, and physical hardware.

Nice to have:

  • High-speed digital interfaces (multi-gigabit serial links, LVDS, SerDes, RF/instrumentation links) and PCB-level signal integrity.

  • FPGA+processor platforms and MPSoCs (e.g., AMD/Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+).

  • Precision timing and synchronization (IEEE 1588 PTP, White Rabbit)

  • Network protocols (Ethernet).

  • Real-time signal processing, fast protection systems, and high-speed data acquisition in fusion or industrial environments.

  • HDL design methodologies and techniques for reliable radiation-hardened systems.

  • Schematic comprehension and custom PCB development.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)


*This role sits at "L2" of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: Insurance Compliance Counsel
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

The Role

Alan’s Insurance Compliance Counsel, you will be Alan's expert on insurance compliance and consumer protection regulation. You will define how regulatory obligations translate into Alan's tools, processes, and products. You will own the compliance posture on your perimeter, proactively manage our exposure, and be the primary interface with regulators on the topics you cover.

You will also be a key connector between the compliance function, internal control, and the audit processes Alan conducts - ensuring audit findings are properly digested, remediated, and embedded into how we operate.

As Alan expands into new markets, you will play a central role in ensuring our compliance standards travel with us: adapting Group frameworks to local requirements and helping stand up the right compliance foundations in new geographies.

The role sits within the Legal Area in the Corporate Unit, and involves close daily collaboration with the Legal, Insurance, Operations, Sales, Care, and Product teams across all of Alan's markets.

 

What You Will Do

Own Alan's Insurance Compliance Posture

  • Define how regulatory obligations relating to Alan’s core product (IDD including duty of advice, product governance, AML/CFT, etc.) translate into Alan's operational processes, product design, and tooling

  • Suggest optimal ways to meet regulatory requirements within Alan's products while improving members' experience - from pricing components and options design to UX choices and complaint handling

  • Proactively identify compliance risks, assess their exposure, and develop mitigating action plans in coordination with internal stakeholders

  • Lead the structuring and continuous improvement of Alan's complaints management framework across France, Belgium, and Spain, ensuring compliance with ACPR recommendations and local equivalents

Reporting & Audits

  • Serve as the compliance function's key contributor to Alan's internal control system: document compliance-related risks and controls in the Group's centralised mapping, and co-deploy the internal control approach across teams (Insurance, Operations, Sales, Care)

  • Prepare and support internal and external audits: assess Alan's standing against planned operational improvements, define remediation plans, and drive and monitor their effective implementation

  • Report on compliance obligations and risk exposure to Alan's Board and governance committees, with clarity and foresight; Manage regulatory reporting obligations including the ACPR Questionnaire Protection de la Clientèle (QPC)

  • Respond to regulatory inspections (ACPR, FSMA, or equivalent in Alan’s operating countries), coordinating internally and ensuring Alan is always audit-ready

AML/CFT & KYC

  • Support the AML framework: conduct second-level analysis on suspicious cases, manage relationships with regulatory bodies and financial intelligence units, approve high-risk client relationships (including PEPs), and maintain the AML/CFT risk assessment framework

  • Oversee KYC Ops referents' training and upskilling, including Belgium-specific AML requirements

  • Coordinate with the AMLO on annual priorities, documentation, monitoring tools, and regulatory reporting to the ACPR and equivalent supervisors

Compliance Roadmap & Stakeholder Coordination

  • Maintain Alan's compliance roadmap: prioritise, track progress, update the risk mapping, and re-prioritise as the regulatory environment evolves

  • Lead compliance projects with internal stakeholders across Insurance, Product, Sales, Care, and Operations, translating regulatory requirements into concrete deliverables and timelines

  • Contribute to pragmatic compliance positions on regulatory requirements that affect our products and contracts - turning complex constraints into well-reasoned, pragmatic solutions that support the business.

Regulatory Training & Internal Capability

  • Design and maintain mandatory regulatory training programmes for Sales and Care roles (IDD competency requirements including duty of advice and product governance, Loi Evin, AML/CFT)

  • Build internal compliance frameworks, guidelines, and decision-making tools that increase team autonomy and reduce reliance on external resources

  • Contribute to Alan's written culture by producing high-quality documentation that teams can rely on independently

International Compliance & Localisation

  • Ensure Alan's compliance standards travel consistently across all Group markets, whether existing (France, Belgium, Spain, Canada) or newly opened, adapting Group frameworks to local regulatory requirements and deploying them locally in coordination with local counsel.

 

Profile

Experience & Skills

  • 4+ years of experience in compliance in an insurance or fintech company; solid coverage of at least two of the following: AML/CFT, insurance distribution (IDD), complaints handling, regulatory reporting

  • Solid understanding of the French insurance regulatory framework and ability to work across EU/local requirements

  • Proven ability to lead compliance projects cross-functionally: you translate regulatory requirements into clear priorities, align internal stakeholders, and deliver without creating bottlenecks or increased friction

  • Bilingual French/English (both required, written and spoken)

  • International exposure is a strong plus

You Will Thrive Here If You Are

  • A pragmatic problem-solver: you find the right answer within regulatory constraints rather than defaulting to the most conservative one

  • Rigorous and well-organised: you maintain high documentation standards, track your commitments, and keep stakeholders informed

  • Business-minded: you understand what matters for the company's growth and your members' protection, and you calibrate your compliance work accordingly

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

You want to know more about Alan?

About Zego 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

The role

Zego Insurance Limited (ZIL) is a Gibraltar-based motor insurer regulated by the GFSC. We're growing, and as we do, we need to keep maturing how we operate as an insurer - proportionate to our size, with strong governance and a firm regulatory focus. This is a pivotal role to help us do that in a scalable and sustainable way.

Reporting into the Executive Director, Insurance Operations, you'll own ZIL's operations and lead insurer-focused projects across the business. You'll make sure we operate effectively as an insurer, bring more of our regulatory and project delivery in-house, and help us get ready for the bigger initiatives and partnerships ahead.

You'll also be involved in the management and oversight of our insurance partners and outsourced service providers, helping make sure the right operating rhythms are in place and contractual and regulatory requirements are met.

Here's what you'll be doing

  • Lead insurer-focused projects and regulatory workstreams, such as onboarding new insurance partners, operational resilience and GFSC deliverables.

  • Be hands-on in delivery. The expectation is to get things done and see them through to completion, not just oversee or track progress.

  • Take ownership of ZIL's operational resilience framework, as well as business continuity and disaster recovery, keeping them embedded and aligned to regulatory expectations.

  • Support ZIL's internal audit programme, coordinating reviews, working with the business on findings and making sure actions are closed out.

  • Further enhance ZIL's governance, strengthening our frameworks and controls, proactively documenting procedures and keeping policies up to date, clearly owned and on their review cycle.

  • Support the oversight of our outsourced service providers, including Zego MGA. This includes maintaining our outsourcing register, due diligence and exit plans for critical providers, keeping intragroup agreements and service schedules up to date, and producing SLA and KPI reporting for committees.

  • Support the management of our insurance partners, ensuring effective operating rhythms, strong relationships and that contractual requirements are met.

  • Continually improve how we operate, simplifying processes and making the most of AI and the right tools to drive us forward.

What you'll need to be successful in the role

  • Experience in an operations, project or governance role within a regulated insurer. Knowledge of Gibraltar, UK or EU insurance regulation is a plus.

  • A solid understanding of how an insurer works, such as co-insurance, reinsurance or MGA oversight.

  • A track record of delivering complex projects across multiple teams.

  • Experience with governance, policies or audit. Operational resilience experience is a bonus.

  • Strong stakeholder management, both internally and with external partners.

  • Detail-oriented, proactive and good at solving problems.

  • Able to prioritise and manage multiple workstreams in a structured way.

  • A hands-on go-getter who balances commercial, operational and regulatory needs.

The Zego ways of working 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

Here is what the last one looked like.

Benefits 🎁

💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year.

🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution.

📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

🩺 Private medical insurance.

🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new.

💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? We want to hear from you.

Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance.

title: Integration Architect
descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

The Integration Architect is an individual contributor within Metrea's Platform Development Capability Area, owning the architecture, development, and support of system interfaces across the organisation's core ERP, Supply Chain, and Maintenance business applications. Drawing on strong .NET, API/SFTP integration, conversion scripting, and SQL development experience, the postholder will design and deliver the interfaces and custom system features that connect Metrea's business-critical platforms. 

The role calls for a strong technical background coupled with a solid understanding of business process, and the ability to interact effectively with personnel at all levels of the business. In an entrepreneurial and fast-paced environment, there will be a need to adapt and rapidly prioritise to changing business needs in support of the company's commercial and operational objectives. 

This is a hands-on architecture and development role. The successful candidate will be expected to design solutions, build integrations, develop custom code and scripts, troubleshoot issues, and engage directly with business stakeholders.

What You'll Do

  • Development of conversion scripts, when required

  • Experience with integration and ETL frameworks  
  • Experienced in SQL, including creation for SQL views, stored procedures, and functions  
  • Experienced in architecting and developing custom solutions  
  • Ability to create technical specifications and documentation  
  • Expertise in ERP development; 2-3+ years of hands-on D365 FO development and integration experience is a must, including designing and supporting integrations with enterprise business systems.
  • Experience in Power Platform development is a plus  
  • Microsoft Synapse expertise is a plus   
  • Strong analytical skills  
  • Strong experience in implementing packaged and/or custom systems  
  • Experience in supply chain, maintenance, and project accounting systems, would be a plus  
  • Strong grasp of systems from “big picture” integration perspective  
  • Expertise in MS Office suite.  Visio experience would be a plus  
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail and accuracy  
  • Must be organized, focused and able to deliver under tight timelines  
  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communications skills, with the ability to interact with various levels of personnel, including end users, management, and developers  
  • Microsoft Architecture certification or other architecture certification would be a plus

Benefits

Work Authorization / Security Clearance

The employee will have the legal right to work in the UK and will be able to produce right to work documentation.  You may be required to obtain security clearance for this role. Details of this can be discussed in the interview process. 

AAP/EEO Statement

Metrea Management Limited (MAM)  is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or other characteristics protected by law.

This is a full-time position with typical working hours of Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.  

Work Environment

Hybrid role, London 3 days per week

Our Firmware

At Metrea, our single core value is Rooted in Humility, and our four cornerstone attributes are Entrepreneurial, Systematic, Discerning, and Over-Deliver. These form what we call our Teammate Firmware. Just like technical firmware connects software and hardware, our Firmware is the constant interface between our mission and our people. It defines how we show up, how we work together, and how we solve complex problems.

Our team Firmware creates a web-like, hyper-collaborative, dynamically hierarchical way of working that helps us adapt quickly, communicate openly, and distribute decision-making to where expertise actually lives. This foundation allows us to deliver elegant, effective solutions and uphold our purpose: protecting our precious inheritance.

title: Interim Chief Privacy Officer | RVO
descriptionHtml:
Omschrijving

title: Interim QA Specialist
descriptionHtml:
About us

Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 100+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role

As an interim Senior QA Specialist at Rentman, you make sure every release reaches customers without regressions. You own the test strategy across our 3 product teams and finish moving regression testing from a manual release-day cycle to an automated, shift-left E2E suite. Without this role, quality depends on manual testing on release day, bugs show up in staging or production, and the move to automated testing stalls. This is an interim position: the duration is still to be confirmed, and the role ends once the assignment is complete.

What you'll do

  • Join refinement with the product teams and write Gherkin (Given/When/Then) acceptance specs that developers turn into tests

  • Test new features on staging, going beyond the acceptance criteria to find edge cases, and file clear, reproducible bug reports in Jira

  • Write and review Playwright tests (TypeScript) in the frontend repo, and review developer-written tests in pull requests

  • Monitor the daily automated regression run in GitHub Actions, triage failures the same day, and fix flaky tests at the root cause

  • Run release-day regression and the OWASP ZAP security scan for each release, and give a clear go / no-go call

  • Migrate the remaining legacy tests and decide what is worth automating and what stays manual

  • Organise cross-team QA days and coach developers so they own their tests

     

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years in QA on web applications

  • At least 2 years writing and maintaining UI test automation in code (Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, ideally TypeScript/JavaScript), not only record-and-play tools

  • Strong manual and exploratory testing, with bug reports developers can act on without follow-up questions

  • You have defined a test strategy (what to automate, what to test manually, coverage), not only executed test cases

  • Experience running automated tests in CI (GitHub Actions or similar)

  • You get developers to adopt new habits through pairing, good examples and clear specs, not by policing

     

Nice to haves

  • Experience with complex B2B SaaS

  • Playwright specifically, and Gherkin / BDD

  • Experience leading a shift-left change or coaching developers to own their tests

  • API testing (REST, Postman or similar)

  • Basic security testing (e.g. OWASP ZAP)

  • Mobile app testing (iOS / Android)

What you’ll get

  • Competitive salary based on experience, plus 8% holiday allowance

  • A results-based bonus based on company performance (up to a full 13th month's salary)

  • 25 vacation days to recharge

  • Earn an extra day of PTO for each year at Rentman, from your second anniversary up to five years.

  • A 4-week paid sabbatical after 5 years to go on an adventure

  • Flexible WFH policy & work from anywhere for 4 weeks a year

  • Pension plan through BrightPensioen

  • An annual training budget to grow your skills

  • Access to OpenUp for mental well-being and personal growth

  • Your choice of a shiny new Windows, Linux, or Mac

  • Stay active with the team: join the Rentman football team, squash and padel, plus a discounted Urban Sports membership

  • An OV Business card if you live more than 10km from the office

  • An ambitious, inclusive, and diverse international team

  • A flexible, energizing workplace with free lunches, office perks (PS5, ping pong, D&D), legendary karaoke nights, and regular team activities

  • An amazing office in the heart of Utrecht, in the historic Drift 17

Our process

Here's a breakdown of our recruitment process to give you a clear idea:

  • Introduction Call with the recruiter about the job & Rentman, online (30 mins)

  • Past Experience & Culture Interview with the team, online or on-site (60 mins)

  • Final Skills Interview, on-site (60 mins)

title: Intern - AI Financial Advisory (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Finton

Finton ist eine AI-Native Finance-Beratung, die AI-gestützte Lösungen für den CFO-Bereich konzipiert und implementiert. Unsere Services erbringen wir mit unserer eigenen Software, die den Berater von Projektmanagement über Datenverarbeitung bis zu Datenanalyse und Dashboard-Erstellung durchgängig mit AI unterstützt.

Konkret heißt das: Wir setzen auf dem bestehenden ERP, der Buchhaltung und den operativen Systemen des Kunden auf, bringen die Daten zusammen und liefern in kürzester Zeit ein produktives Ergebnis, etwa ein monatliches Management Reporting mit Kommentierung, einen rollierenden 13-Wochen-Cash-Forecast, eine Deckungsbeitrags- und Umsatzanalyse nach Kunden, Produkten oder Projekten oder einen Datenraum und ein Financial Fact Book für eine anstehende Transaktion.

Daneben arbeiten wir klassisch beratend: als Sparringspartner des CFO bei Budget, Forecast und Investorenkommunikation, als Interim-Kapazität in der Finanzabteilung und als Unterstützung bei M&A, Fundraising und Due-Diligence-Vorbereitung.

Unsere Kunden sind mittelständische und investorenfinanzierte Unternehmen mit typischerweise 10 bis 250 Mio. Euro Umsatz, bei denen das Finance-Team für die Anforderungen von Gesellschaftern und Banken zu klein oder zu manuell aufgestellt ist.

Finton wurde 2023 von Jan, Julian und Neil gegründet und betreut Kunden in der gesamten DACH-Region von Hamburg, Köln und München aus. Mehr als 150 abgeschlossene Projekte sprechen für sich.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Projektunterstützung: Du arbeitest im Hintergrund in laufenden Kundenprojekten mit: Du bereitest Finanzdaten aus ERP und Buchhaltung auf, baust Auswertungen und Dashboards auf unserer AI-Plattform und lieferst dem Projektteam die Grundlage für das Gespräch mit dem CFO.

  • Finanzmodelle und Analysen: Du wirkst an Finanzmodellen, Cash Forecasts, Deckungsbeitragsanalysen und Unternehmensbewertungen mit und prüfst Daten und Ergebnisse auf Plausibilität.

  • Business Development: Du recherchierst Zielkunden, Investoren und Multiplikatoren, pflegst unsere Lead-Listen und erstellst Angebots- und Pitch-Unterlagen sowie Case Studies.

  • Strategie: Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern an strategischen Fragen wie Positionierung, Pricing, neuen Service-Linien und Partnerschaften, von der Analyse bis zur Entscheidungsvorlage.

  • Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalyse: Du beobachtest Markt, Wettbewerber und AI-Entwicklungen im Finance-Bereich und leitest daraus Empfehlungen für unser Angebot ab.

  • Produktentwicklung: Mit deinem Feedback aus Projektarbeit und Markt hilfst du unserem Technologie-Team, die AI-Plattform weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Eigeninitiative: Du gestaltest mit, statt nur abzuarbeiten, auch bei internen Themen wie Recruiting, Wissensaufbau oder Prozessverbesserung.

Das bringst Du mit

  • Studium: Laufendes oder abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens oder eine vergleichbare Fachrichtung mit sehr guten Leistungen, mindestens drei abgeschlossene Semester.

  • Erfahrung: Erste relevante Praxiserfahrung, etwa durch Praktika in Consulting, Investment Banking, Transaction Advisory, Private Equity oder in der Finanzabteilung eines Unternehmens.

  • Handwerk: Sicherer Umgang mit Excel und PowerPoint, Grundverständnis von Bilanz, GuV und Cashflow; erste Berührung mit Finanzmodellen oder Bewertung ist ein Plus.

  • Technologie: Interesse an AI und Prozessautomatisierung im Finanzwesen. Programmierkenntnisse sind kein Muss, aber du willst verstehen, wie unsere Lösungen funktionieren.

  • Analytik: Starke analytische Fähigkeiten, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und ein gutes betriebswirtschaftliches Verständnis.

  • Haltung: Eigeninitiative, Zuverlässigkeit und Freude daran, in einem kleinen Team Dinge selbst voranzutreiben.

  • Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Deine ersten Monate bei Finton

In den ersten Tagen lernst du unsere Plattform, unsere Projektmethodik und unsere laufenden Mandate kennen und bekommst einen festen Ansprechpartner im Team. Schon in der ersten Woche unterstützt du ein Kundenprojekt aus dem Hintergrund: Du bereitest Daten auf, baust erste Auswertungen und siehst, wie aus Rohdaten ein Reporting für den CFO wird.

Nach den ersten Wochen übernimmst du eigene Arbeitspakete, etwa einen Teil eines Finanzmodells, eine Wettbewerbsanalyse oder den Aufbau einer neuen Lead-Liste, und präsentierst deine Ergebnisse direkt den Gründern.

Benefits

  • Echte Aufgaben statt Zuschauen: Du arbeitest an realen Projekten, Modellen und Strategiethemen mit und siehst, was mit deiner Arbeit beim Kunden passiert. Kein Kaffeekochen, kein Folienschubsen ohne Kontext.

  • Direkter Draht zu den Gründern: Du bekommst einen festen Mentor aus dem Gründerteam, regelmäßiges Feedback und Einblick, wie eine Beratung aufgebaut und geführt wird.

  • Perspektive: Wer überzeugt, hat die Option, nach dem Praktikum in Vollzeit bei uns einzusteigen.

  • Vergütung: Eine faire Praktikumsvergütung, die deine Erfahrung berücksichtigt.

  • Technologie: Du arbeitest mit unserer eigenen AI-Plattform statt mit Excel-Handarbeit und lernst, wie Finance- und Beratungsarbeit in den nächsten Jahren aussehen wird.

  • Standort Köln: Unser Büro liegt am Friesenplatz, mitten in der Stadt. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam vor Ort, weil du so am schnellsten lernst und wir als kleines Team schnell entscheiden wollen. Flexible Arbeitszeiten gehören dazu.

  • Ausstattung und Extras: Firmenlaptop, Zuschuss zum ÖPNV-Ticket, Fitnessabo, kostenlose Getränke im Büro, lockere Kleiderordnung sowie regelmäßige Teamevents und Firmenfeiern in einem kleinen Team mit flachen Hierarchien.

Bewerbung

Wenn du diesen Weg mitgestalten willst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung über die Plattform. Ein Lebenslauf reicht uns für den Anfang; ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Du hörst innerhalb von einer Woche von uns, und dein erstes Gespräch führst du direkt mit einem der Gründer.

title: Intern - Chief of Staff to the Group CMO - Paris
descriptionHtml:

Fluency in English is essential, as you will lead international workshops, align stakeholders, and scale best practices across all Artefact entities.

What you will do

  • Analytics & strategy: Derive actionable insights from the marketing data platform to guide executive decision-making.
  • Agentic content workflows: Automate content operations by building and deploying an AI skill/agent library using tools such as Gemini Enterprise, Claude, and Lovable.
  • Global enablement: Scale adoption across international hubs by designing learning modules, documenting playbooks, and running hands-on training sessions in English.
  1. Go-to-market & revenue operations: Leverage AI tools and skills to optimize inbound and outbound funnels, drive pipeline velocity, and enhance Marketing-Sales alignment for sustained lead generation.

title: Internal Communications Lead
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

The Internal Communications Lead will build the machine and communications culture that keep Faculty's leadership and teams genuinely connected as we scale - carrying vision, strategy and our worldview on AI to every team undiluted, and surfacing the stories from across the business worth telling

This role has two core mandates:

1. Building the internal communications machine - you will design and own how leadership and our teams stay connected day to day - whether live or written, scheduled or ad hoc, and whatever formats a genuinely global, always-on business needs. You will build the architecture - cadence, ownership, structure - so the right message reaches the right people at the right moment, and noise becomes context rather than clutter.

2. Culture, Voice & Connection at Scale - you will be the person who makes sure leadership's vision, strategy and worldview on AI actually reach our teams everywhere, honest and crisp, without being diluted, delayed, or lost in translation as we grow. Leadership owns their voice and their point of view - that stays theirs. Your job is building the stage it's delivered from: sharp, timely, and sensitive to how a message lands differently across cultures and geographies.

What you own

  • The voice going down - The communications framework and rhythm that allow the Faculty Leadership to effectively communicate their vision, strategy and worldview on AI to every team, wherever they are in the world, undiluted and on time.

  • The voice from Accenture to Faculty - Point person for relevant Accenture news, updates and requirements that the Faculty teams need to know.

  • The detective work - Some of the best things happening at Faculty aren’t visible from the top. A team quietly solved a hard client problem. Someone's work never got the credit it deserved. A pattern of small wins nobody's connected into a story yet. You go looking for this, building the instincts and the relationships across the business to find the stories worth telling.

  • How we organise ourselves to communicate effectively - The architecture and judgment behind all of it so our people get a clear read of what matters without being buried under what doesn't.

What you will be doing

Forums & Formats

  • Design the company-wide forums that carry leadership's message, choosing the right format for the right moment rather than defaulting to habit

  • Build for global and cultural nuance from the start, so a message crafted in one office lands with the same weight and clarity in every other

  • Establish a working cadence that respects people's time and attention, so more communication is never mistaken for better communication

Channel Architecture & Cadence

  • Own the internal channel architecture, so messages reach the right people without adding to the volume everyone already wades through

  • Set clear ownership of who can broadcast to the whole company, on what, and how often

  • Bring judgement to every leadership message: which forum, format, tone and timing will make it land, and the confidence to say when something needs live delivery, a short note, or nothing broad at all

Storytelling & Culture

  • Play detective for the stories that don't naturally surface and give them the visibility they deserve

  • Treat culture preservation as a first-order responsibility of scale, not a side effect of good comms: building formats that carry how Faculty's leaders and teams work together, not just what the business is doing

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Where needed, partner closely with leadership as a trusted advisor, protecting their voice while making sure it travels well

  • Establish strong cross-functional relationships across regions and teams to understand what's really happening in the business and shape the internal communications programme around it

  • Support the international expansion of Faculty's internal communications, working with regional colleagues to ensure forums and formats travel well and adapt where they need to

What we are looking for

  • Designing the Machine - A track record of designing and building the machine from scratch - cadences, channels, and company-wide forums - rather than simply running an existing playbook.

  • Judgement - A sharp instinct for signal versus noise: what deserves broad visibility, what doesn't, and the confidence to say so to senior stakeholders.

  • Storytelling - A detective's instinct for finding the story in a large, fast-moving organisation, and the ability to tell it with clarity and a genuine point of view.

  • Global & Cultural Fluency - Proven experience communicating across geographies and time zones, with real sensitivity to how messages land differently across cultures and offices.

  • Stakeholder Management - Skilled at working alongside senior leaders and founders, earning trust quickly through sound judgement and discretion.

  • Communication - Exceptional written and verbal skills, able to convey a complex or nuanced leadership message clearly and briefly without losing what made it worth saying.

  • Change & Scale Experience - Experience communicating through a period of fast growth, acquisition, or significant organisational change, ideally in a technical or fast-moving industry.

  • Autonomy & Resilience - Highly self-sufficient, with the flexibility and tenacity to thrive in a fast-paced, complex scale-up environment now operating at global scale.

  2. Introduction with the Hiring Manager (60 mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. title: Internship: Explainable AI for the qualification of aerospace algorithms
descriptionHtml:
Background

Machine learning is increasingly used in aerospace for tasks that have traditionally relied on human experts or on fixed rule-based procedures. For such tasks, data-driven algorithms promise gains in speed, consistency and sensitivity. Before they can be used in practice however, they must be qualified, which means it has to be demonstrated with sufficient substantiation that the algorithm performs its intended function reliably within a defined set of conditions. The qualification approaches used in the sector today were developed for human operators and for conventional systems whose behaviour can be traced back to explicit requirements. They do not translate directly to algorithms whose behaviour is learned from data, and emerging guidance from aviation authorities names explainability as a key ingredient of trustworthy AI, while leaving open how it should be demonstrated in practice.

Performance figures on a test set do not show why an algorithm reaches a decision, whether it relies on physically meaningful information, or how it behaves outside the data it was trained on. Explainable machine learning offers a wide range of methods to address this, from feature attribution and saliency methods, to example-based and concept-based explanations, but it is still an open question which of these can provide evidence that is strong enough to support qualification. This project therefore investigates how explainability methods can contribute to the qualification of machine learning algorithms for aerospace, starting from an use case, and provides a comparative assessment of several methods.

Assignment

The assignment will include the following tasks:

  • A literature study on the qualification of machine learning algorithms in safety-critical sectors and on explainability methods for machine learning (e.g., attribution and saliency methods, example-based and concept-based explanations, interpretable models, uncertainty quantification), including the ways in which explanations themselves are evaluated.

  • A use case provided by NLR, for instance automated defect detection, and identification of the substantiation needed to qualify the algorithm, translated into criteria that explanations should meet.

  • Implementing several explainability methods for the use case and analysing them against these criteria, for example their faithfulness to the model, their robustness and their usefulness to domain experts.

  • Assessing how the resulting explanations can serve as evidence in the qualification of the algorithm, and formulating recommendations for the use of explainability in qualification.

Results

The final outcomes of this assignment will be:

§ A structured assessment, as part of a literature study, of explainability methods for machine learning and their suitability for qualification in aerospace, together with a justified selection of the use case.

§ An implementation and comparative evaluation of several explainability methods on the selected use case, with recommendations on how explainability can support the qualification of the algorithm.

§ A technical report, either an MSc thesis following the guidelines of your faculty or an internship report, describing the approach, results, and conclusions of the work.

Duration

For an MSc thesis, the standard duration of a thesis at your faculty applies (typically 9 months). For an internship, the duration is 6 months.

Profile

  • You are an MSc student in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics or a similar master.

  • You have a strong background in machine learning, preferably deep learning. Knowledge of explainable AI is a plus.

  • You have experience with programming in Python and with machine learning libraries, for instance PyTorch or scikit-learn.

  • You have an affinity with aerospace, inspection or certification, and are motivated to bring machine learning closer to qualified use in practice.

What we offer

  • A challenging graduation project/internship in a high-tech result orientated work environment

  • Weekly supervision and availability of the technical staff for support

  • An internship allowance

  • Working in an actual R&D project as part of the team

  • Internship results to be used in the current and future projects

About NLR

Royal NLR has been the ambitious research organisation with the will to keep innovating for over 100 years. With that drive, we make the world of transportation safer, more sustainable, more efficient and more effective. We are on the threshold of breakthrough innovations. Plans and ideas start to move when these are fed with the right energy. Over 800 driven professionals work on research and innovation, from aircraft engineers to psychologists and from mathematicians to application experts. Our colleagues are happy to tell you what it's like to work at NLR. This assignment will be managed by the Avionics Systems and Maintenance Engineering (ASAM) department.

Interested?

We empower organizations across diverse industries, including Consumer Packaged Goods, Retail, and Technology, to seamlessly integrate data, people, and processes, enabling them to plan and adapt rapidly. With a vibrant team of over 700 professionals across North America and Europe, and offices in Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, Pigment has successfully secured nearly $400 million in funding from leading global venture capitalists. Our recognition as a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software underscores our commitment to excellence, as we proudly partner with industry leaders like Unilever, Vinci, Kayak, Siemens, and Coca-Cola. At Pigment, we champion smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all as a united team. Every team member has the opportunity to make a significant impact and tackle ambitious challenges. Together, we pursue excellence with a collaborative spirit, continuously raising the bar to ensure strong performance and a proactive approach while fostering an environment of humility. If you are passionate about innovation and wish to collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry, we would love to hear from you!

Our Engineering team

Our Engineering team is responsible for developing our SaaS platform and building a comprehensive and user-friendly product. Pigment engineers participate in the entire application development lifecycle, focusing on design, coding, and keeping the production platform up and running. They can be specialized, but there is no strict separation between the infrastructure, backend, and the frontend.

We value user-centricity and pragmatism: we choose the most relevant tools for the problem we have to solve, understanding the strengths and constraints of each technology. Our engineering culture also values curiosity, humility, trust, ownership and team spirit.

👉 Curious to see what we’re building? Check out our Tech Blog!

As a Software Engineer Intern, you will work on meaningful projects that directly impact our product, collaborating with experienced engineers and contributing to challenges at scale. During your internship, you will have the opportunity to work on one of the following projects:

Project overview in the Data Ingestion team:

The Data Ingestion team is in charge of how customer data gets into Pigment, notably through our library of connectors to external systems.

Upgrade, migrate and improve our connector library

  • Upgrade and migrate existing connectors to newer versions and approaches.
  • Improve the reliability, performance, and consistency of the connector library.
  • Contribute to shared tooling and documentation to make new connectors faster to build.

Project overview in the Modeler team:

The Modeler team builds the AI-powered tools that help customers create and evolve planning models in Pigment.

Importing a model from another planning tool with the Modeler Agent

  • Explore whether recent progress in LLMs and the Modeler Agent makes it possible to recreate a model from another planning tool in Pigment.
  • Design an automated approach to translate its structure, dimensions, and formulas into Pigment blocks and valid formulas.
  • Define tests to validate that the imported model behaves as expected.

Technical Stack

Our stack includes:

  • Languages & Frameworks: C# (.NET Core Linux), React, TypeScript
  • Databases: PostgreSQL
  • Infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, RabbitMQ
  • CI/CD: CircleCI

We don’t expect you to know them all. What matters most is strong software engineering skills: the ability to translate requirements into simple and elegant designs and deliver robust code.

Work Environment

  • Hybrid: possibility to work partially remotely
  • Office in the heart of Paris
  • Choose your working environment (hardware / OS)
  • A competitive remuneration package
  • Opportunity to continue your journey with us after your internship
We conduct background checks as part of our hiring process, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations in the countries where we operate. This may include verification of employment history, education, and, where legally permitted, criminal records. Any checks will be conducted lawfully, with candidate consent, and information will be treated confidentially. Pigment is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity is a strength and fosters innovation. We are committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, social origin, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We may process your personal data in accordance with our HR Data Protection Notice.

title: Internship Talent Acquisition
descriptionHtml:
Internship: Talent Acquisition (HR Recruitment)

Sunweb Group is looking for an enthusiastic Talent Acquisition intern to join our People, Culture & Organization team. This is a work-along internship for a student who is currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s degree programme and is looking to complete an internship as part of their studies. You will become part of the team and gain hands-on experience; this is not a full-time thesis assignment.

Location: Rotterdam (Hybrid – 50% in office)
Start Date: January/ February 2027

Availability: 32-40 hours

Duration: 5 months
Team: POC Talent Acquisition

Your impact

At Sunweb Group, we’re looking for an enthusiastic Talent Acquisition intern to strengthen our People, Organization & Culture (POC) team. Our goal is to deliver exceptional employee experiences through a service-oriented Employee Experience approach.

In this internship, you will gain hands-on experience in Recruitment, working closely with specialists focused on Processes, People Analytics, Business Partnering and broader HR topics such as Compensation & Benefits and Onboarding.

This is a unique opportunity to learn how HR and Recruitment works from A to Z while contributing your own ideas to help us attract, support, and engage our talented people.

  • Assist the Talent Acquisition Specialist with recruitment activities such as drafting job postings, screening CVs, scheduling interviews, and supporting the candidate journey.

  • Support the full employee life cycle by handling operational tasks related to contracts, employee data, and day-to-day HR queries.

  • Maintain and update employee files with accuracy and attention to detail.

  • Collaborate closely with colleagues across the People team and other departments on both daily tasks and project-based initiatives.

  • Stay informed about the latest HR trends and best practices to help us continuously improve our processes.

What you bring

  • You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s degree programme in Human Resources, Business Administration, Marketing & Communication, or a related field, and this internship forms part of your studies.

  • You have a strong interest in HR and are curious to learn more about Recruitment.

  • You are detail-oriented, organized, and capable of handling multiple priorities.

  • You are proactive, eager to learn, and not afraid to share your own ideas.

  • You enjoy working with people and can build relationships across departments as well as with candidates.

  • You are tech-savvy and comfortable working with HR systems and digital tools.

  • You have good verbal and written communication skills in English (Dutch is a big plus).

Let us introduce Sunweb Group

Sunweb Group is one of Europe’s largest online travel agencies, sending over 1.3 million holidaymakers annually to unforgettable destinations. Operating in eight international markets, we cater to all travelers through our brands, Sunweb and ‘Eliza Was Here.’ With a team of 600 colleagues and operational hubs in Rotterdam, Girona, Paris, Copenhagen, Stockholm, Antwerp, Chambéry, and Zurich, we deliver seamless, high-quality holiday experiences at competitive prices. Our Fast Forward culture fosters focus and trust, enabling us to shape the future of holidays while helping our customers press pause and create lasting memories.

Why join our journey?

  • Working for an international, ambitious, and dynamic organization

  • Internship remuneration of €500 per month on full-time basis (5 days)

  • We work hybrid; we’d like to see you in our Rotterdam office 3 days per week

  • Attractive discount when booking with our brands (Sunweb, Eliza was Here)

There is room to work on a study-related internship assignment for approximately one day per week, depending on the requirements of your study programme and in consultation with the team.

Ready for departure?

Do you want to become part of our team as our Talent Acquisition intern? Click on “Apply”. Do you have any questions? Please feel free to reach out to our Talent Acquisition team via . We are looking forward to hearing from you!

Closing date for applications: 15 November

Sunweb Group is an equal opportunity employer, which means we do not discriminate in any way. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and safe environment for all employees.
