title: Investment Associate/Manager Private Markets (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Rolle

Als Investment Associate oder Investment Manager (m/w/d) übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in unserer mehrfach ausgezeichneten Vermögensverwaltung. Als Teil des Investmentteams gestaltest du aktiv die Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Anlagelösungen mit besonderem Fokus auf unsere Private-Markets-Angebote. Hierzu gehören sowohl unsere geschlossenen Dachfonds für erfahrene Anleger als auch unsere ELTIFs für Privatanleger. Dein Beitrag hat direkten Einfluss auf unseren Unternehmenserfolg und eröffnet dir die Möglichkeit, Innovationen gezielt voranzutreiben.

Was machst du dabei konkret

Investmentexpertise und Stakeholder-Beziehungen:

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit strategischen Partnern und Dienstleistern bei Konstruktion, Steuerung und Reporting unserer Fonds

  • Überwachung der Portfoliokonstruktion, Durchführung von Portfolioanalysen sowie Markt-Screenings und Benchmarking

  • Zentrale Ansprechperson für investmentbezogene Anfragen interner und externer Stakeholder im Bereich Private Markets

Produktentwicklung und Projektmanagement:

  • Aktive Mitwirkung am Ausbau unseres Produktportfolios im Bereich Private Markets

  • Mitgestaltung und Umsetzung unserer KI-Strategie, insbesondere durch die Identifikation und Automatisierung relevanter Prozesse

  • Steuerung von und Mitarbeit in vielseitigen (Teil-)Projekten mit Fokus auf Innovation und Skalierung

Operations, Reporting und Kommunikation:

  • Umfassende Verantwortung für deine Produkte inklusive aktiver Mitgestaltung und Überwachung operativer Prozesse

  • Verantwortung für das regelmäßige Produkt- und Portfolioreporting gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern

  • Enge, funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit mit Tech, Product, Compliance, Operations und Marketing

  • Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung von Kommunikationskonzepten für Endkunden und externe Medien

Das bringst du mit

Background:

  • Mindestens zwei Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung für die Position als Associate / mindestens vier Jahre für die Stelle als Manager. Idealerweise in der Unternehmensberatung mit Fokus auf Finanzdienstleister, im Investmentteam eines Investmentmanagers oder -beraters (z. B. Family Office, Vermögensverwalter, PE-/VC-Spezialist) oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im Finanzsektor

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Masterstudium an einer führenden Universität, idealerweise in Wirtschaftswissenschaften mit Schwerpunkt Finance, Management oder einer quantitativen Fachrichtung

Skills und Qualifikationen:

  • Fundiertes Verständnis volkswirtschaftlicher Zusammenhänge sowie der Funktionsweise der Finanzmärkte

  • Kenntnisse der Merkmale unterschiedlicher Anlageklassen, insbesondere im Bereich Private Markets

  • Erfahrung in der Analyse von Zielfonds und Investmentmanagern sowie erste Erfahrungen mit ELTIFs sind von Vorteil

  • Strukturierte, analytische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise und Erfahrung in der Steuerung und Umsetzung von Projekten

  • Erste praktische Erfahrung mit KI-gestützten Prozessen und ausgeprägtes Interesse daran, diese weiterzuentwickeln

Mindset:

  • Hands-on-Mentalität, ausgeprägtes Auge fürs Detail sowie sorgfältige und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise

  • Proaktive Identifikation und Optimierung ineffizienter Prozesse

  • Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeit

Das bieten wir dir

  • Vielfalt: Flache Hierarchien und kulturelle Offenheit machen dich ab Tag 1 zum integralen Bestandteil unseres bunten Teams aus internationalen Talenten.

  • Flexibilität: Wir machen dein Leben nicht kompliziert. In flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, Arbeitszeiten und Mobile-Working-Regelungen findest du die richtige Balance. 28 Tage Urlaub und 2 zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. und 31.12. verschaffen dir zudem entspannte Auszeiten.

  • Wertschätzung: Du gestaltest mit uns die Zukunft des digitalen Wealth Managements in einem innovativen, mehrfach ausgezeichneten Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs, mit hoher Marktrelevanz und viel Raum für deine Ideen.

  • Entwicklung: Wir unterstützen deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung mit einem jährlichen Development-Budget von 1.500€. Außerdem erhältst du zu Beginn deiner Tätigkeit bei LIQID ein hochwertiges Equipment, bestehend aus MacBook, Kopfhörern und Display.

  • Smart Money: Als LIQIDian erhältst du attraktive Konditionen für unsere Anlagestrategien, einen monatlichen Lunch-Zuschuss und exklusive Discounts bei verschiedenen Anbietern.

  • Wohlbefinden: Regionale Bio-Produkte halten dich vor Ort im Office fit – und unsere Gesundheitsinitiativen oder unser Health Assistance Programm auch weit darüber hinaus.

So geht es für dich weiter

Eine ausgezeichnete Candidate Experience und Transparenz haben für uns im Interviewprozess die höchste Priorität. Die verschiedenen Bewerbungsphasen helfen uns zu verstehen,​ wie eine Zusammenarbeit aussehen könnte.

  • Erstes virtuelles Kennenlernen dem Recruiting Team: Wir tauschen uns aus, ob deine Erfahrungen und Erwartungen an die Position mit unseren Anforderungen übereinstimmen.

  • Videointerview mit dem Leiter des Investmentteams: Im zweiten Videocall triffst du den Leiter des Investmentteams. Gemeinsam prüfen wir, ob deine bisherigen Erfahrungen und Erwartungen mit den Anforderungen der Position übereinstimmen, und vertiefen wichtige fachliche Aspekte.

  • Case Study: Es wird eine typische Situation eingegangen, die dir in dieser Rolle begegnen könnte.

  • Persönliches Kennenlernen: Du triffst das restliche Team, Peers und interne Stakeholder und besprichst deine Case Study Ergebnisse.

Über uns

Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit.

Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. Mit einem betreuten Vermögen von über 4 Milliarden Euro gehören wir schon jetzt zu den führenden Vermögensverwaltern in Deutschland. In unserer weiteren Entwicklung arbeiten wir mit starken und erfahrenen Partnern wie LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust und Project A zusammen.

LIQID ist ein Arbeitgeber, der für Chancengleichheit steht. Alle qualifizierten Bewerbungen werden ohne Rücksicht auf Hautfarbe, Alter, Religion, Geschlecht, ethnische und nationale Herkunft, Behinderung oder aufgrund von anderen durch Gleichbehandlungsgesetze geschützte Eigenschaften berücksichtigt.

title: Investment Director - Property Sales
descriptionHtml:
We are building the operating system and wealth management platform for buy-to-let investing. Our mission is to make professional, institutional-grade property investing open to everyone.

GetGround is the all-in-one UK property investment platform. Investors use it to set up and run limited companies, arrange mortgages, manage lettings, handle accounting and tax, and track performance in one place.

  • Over £2.5bn of property administered on the platform

  • 30,000+ active customers and a database of 120,000+ property investors

  • A network of 1,700+ partners, including lenders, mortgage brokers, financial advisers, accountants and tax specialists

  • Offices in the UK, Hong Kong, Singapore and Dubai

  • Backed by leading FinTech and WealthTech investors and angels

BuyAssociation brings 20 years of direct-to-developer relationships. That gives our investors access to some of the best investment property in the market, often before it reaches the open market.

Together, we cover the full investor journey: find the right asset, buy it in the right structure, then let the platform manage and grow it.

Why join us

If you've built a career in property sales and want to move into AI-first fintech and proptech, this is your chance. You keep doing what you're great at – selling property – but with a far stronger proposition behind you.

  • Sell more than a property. Every deal comes with a full ownership solution: company structure, finance, lettings, management and reporting, all run by GetGround.

  • Better stock, warmer leads. BuyAssociation's developer relationships give you access to quality stock. Our 120,000+ investor database, partner network and marketing engine keep your pipeline full.

  • AI-first tooling. We build with AI at the core, so you spend less time on admin and more time with clients.

  • Long-term relationships, not one-off sales. Investors stay on the platform, so you can grow with them from their first property to a full portfolio.

  • Enterprise exposure. In 2026 we expanded into enterprise B2B partnerships. You'll sell to institutional clients alongside private investors – experience that is rare in property sales.

  • Startup pace, real scale. A fast-moving team disrupting a traditional industry, with £2.5bn+ of property already on the platform.

  • Uncapped earnings. A very competitive base for the property industry, with unlimited commission potential.

What you'll do

You'll help investors acquire new assets for their portfolios, which GetGround then structures, manages and runs. You'll work across private investors and enterprise partners.

Investor sales

  • Own the full sales cycle, from first conversation to completion, for UK and international buy-to-let investors

  • Understand each investor's goals, budget and strategy, and match them with suitable stock from our developer network

  • Present the full GetGround proposition: ownership structure, mortgage, lettings and ongoing management

  • Manage a pipeline of inbound leads, database opportunities and partner referrals, and generate your own

  • Guide investors through reservation, legal, finance and completion, working with developers, solicitors and our in-house mortgage team

  • Build long-term relationships and grow investors from first purchase to multi-property portfolios

Enterprise and B2B sales

We are expanding into enterprise B2B partnerships. This opens up opportunities to sell to institutional clients, giving you exposure to B2B sales alongside our core B2C investor business.

Ways of working

  • Hit and exceed monthly and quarterly revenue targets

  • Keep HubSpot up to date and use data to manage your pipeline and forecast

  • Share market insight with the Head of Investment Sales to shape stock, pricing and proposition

  • Stay current on the UK property market, developer launches and buy-to-let trends

What we're looking for

  • A proven track record in property sales – ideally new-build, off-plan or investment property

  • Experience closing high-value deals with investors, and comfort managing a full sales cycle

  • The determination and appetite to sell to institutional and enterprise customers; B2B experience is a strong plus

  • Strong knowledge of the UK buy-to-let market, including limited company ownership, finance and lettings

  • A consultative, client-first approach that builds trust and long-term relationships

  • Self-motivated and target-driven, with the resilience to thrive in a fast-paced startup

  • Curiosity about technology and AI, and willingness to adopt new tools

  • Confident with a CRM (HubSpot preferred) and with data

Nice to have: experience with international investors (USA, Africa, India, Turkey, Hong Kong, Singapore, Middle East), an existing investor network, or a background in wealth management or financial services.

What we offer

  • Highly competitive base salary for the property industry

  • Uncapped commission – no ceiling on what you can earn

  • Equity options – share in the company's success

  • Hybrid working from our London Waterloo office

  • International exposure, with teams in Hong Kong, Singapore and Dubai and opportunities to travel

  • Career growth in a scaling business, with a clear route into senior and enterprise sales roles

  • A fast-paced, mission-driven team that is changing how people invest in property

What we are building: The first end-to-end real estate investment offering - making the dream of owning real estate more accessible to everyone globally.

Diversity & inclusion at GetGround: We encourage applications from all sections of society and we believe in the criticality of an inclusive culture. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other basis as protected by law.

  • 42% of our employees identify as female or non-specified, 58% as male

  • 22 nationalities represented across offices in 5 countries

  • Our work on Design Accessibility

  • Inclusion is at the heart of our culture - we celebrate and reflect on key D&I and cultural events such as: Black History Month, International Women's Day and Pride

title: Investor in Residence
descriptionHtml:
About the role

You've built a company, run a team or invested for a few years, and you're between chapters. Maybe you've exited, left a role, or wound something down. You want time to work out what comes next without stepping out of the venture world while you do.

We're offering a seat in our Berlin office for six to nine months. You'll work as part of the investment team on real deals and real portfolio problems, and you'll have room to explore your own next move, whether that's founding again, joining a startup or going deeper into investing.

About PT1

PT1 is an independent early-stage VC with offices in Berlin and London. We invest in companies that electrify energy and buildings, automate construction and industry, and make infrastructure more resilient.

Our portfolio includes Voltfang, ecoworks, PlanRadar, Wunderflats, Terra One, Gendo, Beagle, Climate X and AUAR. We've invested alongside Visionaries, ForwardOne, Daphni, Insight Partners, Google Ventures, Zacua Ventures and Aenu.

How we work

We're a small team, and PT1 feels more like a well-funded startup than a classic fund. Everyone here has shaped the firm, from how we run diligence to which theses we chase to the tools we've built. We run on our own stack for sourcing, diligence and portfolio work, and people who've seen it call it the most advanced VC stack they know.

  • Use the time and the network to work out your own next step. If that turns out to be a company we'd back, even better.

About you

  • Ex-founder, operator or investor with real years behind you (VC, PE, M&A, or building and running a company)

  • Technical background or technical depth: engineering, CS, maths, natural sciences, or years of building technical products

  • Strong opinions on at least one of energy, infrastructure, construction or automation

  • Comfortable with financial models and term sheets

  • Fluent in English. German helps.

  • Available full-time for six to nine months, based in Berlin

  • Right to work in Germany

What we offer

  • A defined window to explore your next chapter while staying close to the founders, investors and deals in the ecosystem

  • A real seat on the investment team, not an advisory title

  • Access to our dealflow, portfolio and co-investor network across Europe's energy, infrastructure and automation scene

  • Our Berlin office with links to the London team

  • A network that stays with you after you leave

title: Investor Relations Associate
descriptionHtml:
About Pairs
Pairs is a vetted private capital network. We put breakout US founders, from seed to Series B, in front of the family offices, VCs and strategic investors who know their market and can open the doors they need. We work only with the top 1% of deals, vet every founder and investor before they join, and invest our own money alongside our investors in a few of the companies we believe in most.

The role
We're hiring an Investor Relations Associate to grow the investor side of Pairs: the family offices, VCs and strategic investors our founders raise from. You'll support our senior investor team on live mandates and, from day one, build relationships of your own. You don't need a decade of experience or an investing background. You need proof that you can build a network, a clear method for growing it, and a real drive to learn. The role isn't technical: software and AI run under the hood, so your time goes to investors, not admin.

What you'll own
• Your book: the investor relationships you bring and open here, qualified and kept warm
• Mandate support: investor qualification, briefing notes and follow-up on live deals
• New relationships: regular first conversations with investors new to Pairs
• Your growth: every call you shadow and every brief you write builds toward a senior role

What success looks like after 3 months
• 70–150 investor relationships in your book (150 is the cap)
• At least 10 meetings a week booked between our clients and your investors; 20–30 is strong

You're a fit if you
• Have built your own investor network, through a family office, placement, an accelerator, a fund, wealth management or your own initiative
• Know investors who back US-based startups (required: our mandates are US-only)
• Have made 100+ introductions between companies and investors
• Can explain how you find the right investors, start conversations and keep relationships warm
• Are eager to grow and learn from a senior team
• Communicate clearly and confidently, on calls and in writing
• Build trust by listening first and respecting investors' time
• Handle confidential information with care
• Use Claude confidently, including connectors and MCP servers

Compensation
OTE of $120,000–$160,000 USD, with a base of at least half of OTE.

Location and working style
Fully remote and async, open to candidates in any country where you already have the right to work (we can't offer visa sponsorship). Your day overlaps with US Eastern time for a few hours. You'll get the best AI tools, paid for, a senior team to learn from, live deal flow from week one, and a path to managing your own side of the network.

How to apply
Apply through our short form. Tell us about the network you've built, how you built it, and roughly how many company-investor introductions you've made.

title: iOS Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Looking for a new adventure? You’ve come to the right place.

We're an Amsterdam-based team of 90+ (and counting) with 25+ nationalities amongst us! A varied bunch of “Citizens of The World” with a wide range of skills and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our travel belts. And we have something important in common (other than our very well-worn passports): We want to change the way people travel.

And that's exactly what we're doing, with the travel app to plan, track, and relive trips in a smart and beautiful way.

Polarsteps has over 20 million users already, but, for us, this is just the beginning. We have big plans for the future, and so we need even more talented and enthusiastic people to help us on our journey.

Want to know more about us? Here you go.

Your expedition: iOS development at Polarsteps

We’re a small team, doing big things.

If you haven't seen our app yet, go ahead and check it out, you'll see that we care (a lot) about providing a seamless, top-quality user experience for every one of our travellers. And it is this that has got us ratings of 4.8* and 4.7* on the app stores (where we’ve been featured multiple times). But it doesn’t stop there, not only did Google create this awesome video about us but we’ve been mentioned in two of Apple’s WWDC keynote speeches. And we're one of the top 26 apps for 2026 according to Apple!

We’ve got an impressive past but we’re even more excited for the future, and the impact you can make from day one is huge, with everything you ship affecting millions of users.

Even with that in mind, we believe in truly giving our team members the freedom they need to craft to perfection while encouraging a practical mindset to avoid under or over-engineering mishaps.

We are seeing an enthusiastic and accelerated growth of the travel industry, and with that comes both opportunities and growing pains (especially in the complex, multi-layered travel domain). So, if on top of the challenges inherent to feature development, you enjoy thinking about the performance and scalability aspects of a platform, you're in for a lot of fun with us.

Your itinerary

What your journey at Polarsteps will look like day-to-day.

You will:

  • Working closely with Jimmy (our Lead iOS Engineer), and the iOS team on all things related to our app.

  • Be responsible for implementing new features, improving existing features and maintaining the day-to-day operations of our iOS App.

  • We're product-first; meaning you won't just work within the iOS team, you'll be embedded in a dedicated Product Pillar team, each owning a distinct part of the user journey. Day-to-day you'll work closely with PMs, designers, and engineers across disciplines. It's a genuinely cross-functional setup: PMs, designers, and engineers working together from problem to solution, because the best product decisions happen when technical perspective is in the room early.

  • Proactively improving the maintainability, resiliency and extensibility of our app, addressing technical debt when needed or even better, preventing it when it makes sense.

The equipment in your backpack

What we’re hoping you’ll bring with you.

  • At least 3-5 years of hands-on experience with iOS development

  • Experience working in an agile team environment.

  • A pragmatic approach to problem-solving, and an absence of fear when it comes to tackling big challenges in UI, architecture, or refactoring that 5-year-old piece of legacy code.

  • A strong iOS development background, we work with Swift, but we still have some legacy Objective-C code, so we would love it if you are also familiar with that.

  • Extensive experience with large apps published in the App Store.

  • In-depth knowledge of UIKit, SwiftUI and experience building complex user interfaces.

  • Experience with writing and debugging multithreading code. We use GCD, Combine, and the latest Swift Concurrency.

  • Realm knowledge.

  • Experience with Swift Package Manager is a bonus.

  • Experience using Xcode instruments to optimize app performance and memory consumption.

  • Experience with setting up and maintaining CI/CD pipelines. We use Fastlane and Github actions.

  • Experience leveraging AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex) to improve development speed, code quality, and debugging efficiency.

  • You are already based in the Netherlands

1st class extras

Some cool things to make the journey extra sweet.

  • Salary range: Between EUR 69.000 - 82.000 (medior level) gross per year incl. 8% holiday allowance (based on 40 hours/week). Where you land in the range depends on your experience and skills, assessed during the interview process.

  • Equity: You'll be able to participate in our Polarsteps SAR Plan.

  • A yearly free flight or train ride to a random location! Give our Teleporter a spin here.

  • A shiny new MacBook to work your magic on.

  • Hybrid working, our way. Work from home and the office, we ask everyone to be in the office 2 days a week. It’s how we stay flexible, focused, and meaningfully connected in person.

  • An extensive home office set-up — everything from noise-canceling headphones to a standing desk.

  • 30 days of vacation (for adventures or sitting on the couch, it's up to you)

  • Two paid Culture Days for days that are important to you but not recognized by the official Dutch calendar.-

  • The option to switch up your zoom background by working from another country for up to 8 weeks a year.

  • A personal development budget for that curious mind of yours!

  • A pension plan to help you save for those around-the-world retirement trips.

  • Delicious daily team lunches.

  • Awesome monthly parties, as well as team trips away.

  • A lively office in downtown Amsterdam, with travel costs reimbursed.

  • Free Polarsteps Travel Books to contain all your far-flung adventures.

At Polarsteps, we believe the best products are built by people as diverse as the travelers using our apps! That's why we specifically encourage people underrepresented in the tech industry to apply for a role with us. Because we believe that diversity, be it age, race, sexual orientation, physical ability, ethnicity, or gender identity, makes both the world and the workplace better.

Think this is the path for you? Find out more about how we hire.

title: IT Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find, fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZero™ platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by IT Ops/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers & operators, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools and false positives, resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, “checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 

What You’ll Do

We are seeking an IT Support Analyst to provide hands-on technical support with a focus on coverage for our EMEA wide employees - both onsite and remotely. This is a front-line role for someone who enjoys solving technical problems directly with end users and wants to build depth across endpoint, identity, and collaboration tooling.

This role will resolve day-to-day technical issues remotely for the broader distributed workforce — covering hardware, software, account access, and collaboration tools. The ideal candidate brings solid troubleshooting fundamentals, reliable follow-through, and a customer-service mindset, and is comfortable escalating complex or ambiguous issues to senior support staff or the Global Help Desk Manager.

 

This role will be responsible for.....

  • Provide onsite technical support including hardware setup, network connectivity, conference room/AV equipment, and printer/peripheral troubleshooting.

  • Resolve incoming help desk tickets and requests for the broader distributed workforce, covering hardware, software, account access, and [ticketing system] queue management

  • Support onboarding and offboarding logistics for employees, including equipment provisioning, account setup, and device retrieval

  • Administer routine identity and access tasks (password resets, MFA support, access requests) within [identity/access platform], escalating complex or policy-sensitive requests

  • Support endpoint management tasks such as imaging, patch verification, and asset tracking within tools like Jamf or Iru

  • Maintain accurate records of tickets, assets, and resolutions to support reporting and audit needs

  • Follow documented runbooks and knowledge base articles for common issues, and flag gaps or outdated content to the Global Help Desk Manager

  • Escalate unresolved or high-impact issues to the appropriate lead or manager in a timely manner, providing clear context and troubleshooting steps already attempted

  • Partner with Security and IT Engineering on device compliance and access control practices as directed

  • Demonstrate a commitment to integrity, process improvement, and customer satisfaction

 

What You’ll Bring

  • Must have foundational experience in IT support, help desk, or end-user services

  • Must have working knowledge of common endpoint operating systems (MacOS and/or Windows) and standard enterprise collaboration software

  • Must be able to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical employees

  • Must be able to prioritize and manage a queue of concurrent requests with minimal direction

  • Must demonstrate sound judgment in knowing when to resolve an issue independently versus escalate it

  • Must demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to question the norm in pursuit of an exceptional user experience.

 

Minimum Education and Experience

  • 2–4 years of experience in IT support, help desk, or IT operations

  • Experience supporting both in-office and remote/distributed employees preferred

 

Required Tech Stack Experience

  • Familiarity with Jira or Jira Service Management

  • Comfortable managing identity in Okta, Entra, or similar

  • Experience using Jamf, Iru, or Intune

  • Expert in Google Workspace, Slack, and Zoom

 

What Sets You Apart?

  • You've supported a hybrid or distributed workforce and are comfortable switching between in-person and remote troubleshooting

  • You've contributed to onboarding/offboarding or endpoint management processes that improved speed or consistency

  • You're proactive about documenting fixes and updating knowledge base content for the next person

  • Relevant certifications such as CompTIA A+, ITIL Foundation, or similar

  • Experience in high-growth SaaS or cybersecurity companies

 

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

  • Base salary range: The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. 

Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

  • Bring acquired entities onto that same platform

  • Acquire technical knowledge on Alan's platform: Alan Home, Google Workspace/SSO, Kandji, Cloudflare WARP

What we're looking for

title: IT Manager
descriptionHtml:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payments infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payments fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

The role

Paddle's IT team is looking for an IT Manager to lead and develop the team that keeps every Paddler equipped, connected, and secure. This is a role for someone who can operate at two altitudes at once: setting IT strategy, managing budget and vendor relationships, and leading people, while also being willing to get hands-on. You'll lead a lean team of IT engineers, own the systems that underpin how the business works day to day (identity, devices, service delivery), and be the person who pushes the function forward - using data and automation, including AI, to change how IT operates rather than just keeping the lights on.

What you'll do

  • Lead, coach, and develop a lean team of IT engineers - setting priorities, unblocking their hardest problems, and stepping in hands-on for complex or escalated issues.

  • Own Okta identity and access management for the business: the lifecycle, integrations, and day-to-day administration that keep joiners, movers, and leavers secure and frictionless.

  • Own macOS and Apple device management and endpoint tooling across the business, in a way that's secure by default and low-friction for Paddlers.

  • Drive the adoption of data, automation, and AI across IT operations - identifying where tooling and agents can remove manual toil, speed up support, and evolve how the team operates.

  • Set and own IT's operating rhythm: support tooling, SLAs, and the metrics that show whether the function is improving.

  • Manage the IT budget and vendor portfolio - evaluating spend, negotiating commercial terms, ensuring that we’re operating efficiently and running a SaaS estate that spans across multiple departments.

  • Implement and maintain baseline security and resilience practices for IT-owned systems (CIS Benchmarks, patching, disaster recovery), partnering closely with the wider Security team on anything that crosses into security engineering.

  • Act as the conduit between IT and the rest of the business - translating department needs into IT capabilities.

Skills & Experience

At Paddle we value a growth mindset and a willingness to learn, so if you're confident in most of these skills (not necessarily all) and you're excited to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We'd love to hear from you if you:

  • Have led or managed a technical IT team before, with a track record of developing people as well as delivering outcomes.

  • Are technically credible: strong systems administration and infrastructure fundamentals, and comfortable being the escalation point when something's genuinely hard.

  • Have hands-on experience running an IAM platform in production, ideally Okta, including lifecycle automation and integrations.

  • Have in-depth knowledge of macOS and Apple hardware, ideally managing it in a corporate/enterprise environment (Iru or equivalent).

  • Are excited about AI and automation as tools for operational leverage, with examples of using them - or data and workflows more broadly - to change how a team works.

  • Can manage a budget and vendor relationships commercially: evaluating cost, negotiating terms, and knowing how to get the most out of a tool or platform.

  • Have experience running IT projects end-to-end, from scoping through delivery and stakeholder reporting.

  • Understand core security and compliance fundamentals well enough to implement and maintain them.

  • Communicate clearly and adapt your message for technical peers and non-technical senior stakeholders alike.

  • Are a strong leader who can hold a calm, clear line under pressure (incidents, competing priorities, escalations).

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.


Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We are a diverse, growing group of Paddlers across the globe who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We live and breathe our values, which are:

Paddle for others

Paddle together

Paddle simply

We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, retirement plans, private healthcare and wellbeing initiatives.

We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

Connecting at Paddle

We’re a ‘digital-first’ company, which means our Paddlers always have the freedom to choose where, when and how they work within our hub locations.

We recognize that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration.

Our Paddle hubs:

  • In Europe: UK (London headquarters), Portugal (Lisbon hub), Netherlands and Ireland (Dublin hub)

  • In North America: Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada)

Our hub philosophy creates an engaging experience for all Paddlers, wherever, whenever and however we choose to work.

To support this, we focus hiring within our hubs and will always openly share the available locations for each open position on our job description.

title: IT Ops
descriptionHtml:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

As Dust's first full time IT Ops hire in Paris, you'll own the infrastructure that keeps a fast-growing team running: from devices and access management to the systems and security practices that scale with us. This is a foundational role at a company where AI is woven into every workflow, giving you a front-row seat to how the future of work is actually being built. You'll work directly with the team and have real impact from day one.

What you'll do

Own Device & Endpoint Management

  • Provision, configure, and manage all employee hardware (Mac and Linux) across the Paris team

  • Maintain MDM tooling and ensure all devices meet security and compliance standards

  • Build and document onboarding/offboarding hardware workflows

Manage Identity & Access

  • Own IAM across SSO, Google Workspace, and third-party SaaS tools

  • Ensure access controls are current, auditable, and correctly scoped

  • Partner with the team to implement least-privilege access policies

Keep the Office Running

  • Manage AV, networking, and physical infrastructure at the Paris office

  • Be the first point of contact for IT issues — resolving quickly and building self-serve resources to reduce recurring requests

  • Coordinate with vendors and manage hardware inventory

Drive Security & Compliance

  • Support internal security reviews, audits, and compliance initiatives

  • Identify risks proactively and propose practical mitigations

  • Maintain IT documentation that stays accurate and useful

Build IT Systems That Scale

  • Automate repetitive processes and reduce manual IT overhead

  • Evaluate and implement new tools as the team grows

  • Contribute to IT roadmap planning alongside the Ops and Engineering teams

Requirements

Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same 3 dimensions. Aptitude, Attitude and Agency.

Aptitude

  • Hands-on experience managing macOS and Linux endpoints in a SaaS or tech environment

  • Strong working knowledge of MDM solutions (Jamf, Kandji, or equivalent), SSO, and identity management platforms

  • Solid understanding of network fundamentals: routing, VPNs, DNS, and office connectivity

  • Comfortable working in security-conscious environments with an understanding of access control best practices

  • Able to document systems and processes clearly enough that others can operate them independently

Attitude

  • Shows up as a team multiplier — resolves issues without drama and leaves things better than they found them

  • Communicates proactively: flags problems early and follows through without needing to be chased

  • Takes user experience seriously — treats every colleague as a customer of IT

  • Gives and receives direct feedback without friction

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where the priorities can shift

Agency

  • Proactively identifies IT risks and improvements before they become problems

  • Owns issues end-to-end: from diagnosis through resolution, without dropping the thread

  • Builds processes and automation that reduce recurring manual work for the team

  • Makes reasonable calls under ambiguity rather than escalating everything upward

  • Continuously looks for ways to use AI tools to improve how IT operations run at Dust

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

Samenwerking en verbetering

  • Bijdragen aan standaardisatie, automatisering en verdere professionalisering van het platform.

Wat bieden wij

Een inhoudelijk sterke rol binnen een cruciaal Backend Platform van Univé. Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en vakinhoudelijke ontwikkeling. title: IT Support Administrator W/M
descriptionHtml:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France

(and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and

Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and

finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the

best decisions for their business.

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small

businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon

Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and

much more...

‍‍‍ Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of

the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong

remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of

Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding

ratings

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000

accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

Your impact

Every great employee experience starts with great IT.

At Pennylane, our mission is to make technology simple, seamless and secure, so our

teams can focus on building the future of finance.

As an IT Support Administrator, you'll be one of the main points of contact for our

employees. You'll help them stay productive, improve the way we work and contribute to

building an IT environment that scales with our growth.

What you'll do

Deliver an outstanding IT experience

Whether it's resolving technical issues, answering questions or helping employees get the

most out of our tools, you'll make sure every Pennylaner has a smooth IT experience.

Employee onboarding & offboarding

You'll make sure every employee has everything they need before day one.

From day one to the last day, you'll make sure every employee has everything they

need to work successfully.

You'll prepare laptops, provision accounts, manage permissions and introduce new joiners to

our IT environment and security best practices.

You'll also handle offboarding and manage IT operations for freelancers and external

partners.

Keep our IT environment secure

Security is everyone's responsibility. You'll play an important role in making security part of

everyone's daily habits.

You'll help monitor compliance with our internal IT policies, manage software access, review

permissions and contribute to maintaining a secure environment for the whole company.

Manage our internal tools

You'll administer our SaaS ecosystem by creating accounts, managing permissions and

ensuring employees have the right access at the right time.

You'll also help improve how we manage and document our internal tools.

Share knowledge

You'll contribute to building a strong IT culture across the company.

That means writing clear documentation, improving our knowledge base, delivering

onboarding sessions and helping employees adopt best practices around IT and security.

Who are you?

We're looking for someone who combines excellent customer service with strong IT

fundamentals.

Someone who enjoys solving problems, communicating with people and continuously

improving the employee experience.

You won't know every tool we use on day one, and that's perfectly fine.

What matters most is your curiosity, your willingness to learn and your ability to take

ownership.

Why you'll love this role

● You'll work with every team across the company.

● You'll have real ownership from day one.

● You'll continuously improve our internal IT experience.

● You'll play a key role in scaling the internal IT environment of one of Europe's

fastest-growing fintechs.

We'd love to meet you if...

● You enjoy helping people and delivering a great employee experience.

● You have previous experience in IT Support, Workplace IT or IT Administration.

● You're proactive and enjoy taking ownership.

● You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical people.

● You're curious and enjoy learning new tools.

● You're comfortable administering modern workplace tools. Experience with Google

Workspace, Microsoft 365, Jamf, Intune, Okta or similar platforms is a plus.

● You care about security and access management (experience with ISO 27001 or

SOC 2 is a plus).

● You're fluent in English and French.

What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a

monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and

more than 300 activities related to wellness

You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work

remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum

time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days

(which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar,

fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on

top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue

healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon,

Bordeaux, Nantes...)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as

well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

● To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department

you’re applying to)

● To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

● To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

● Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they

meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a

meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your

exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings

published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional

email addresses with the domains @pennylane.com or @pennylane-partners.com

We will never ask you for payment or financial information

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the

recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not

respond and to report it to us immediately.

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that

we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.

We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender,

sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If

anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Notre data policy

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. title: IT Support Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Clay

AI is unleashing the biggest wave of company creation in history. Clay's mission is to be the engine those companies use to grow to their full potential.

Clay predicts the next best action for your business and then helps you take it. We started by aggregating the best data for B2B companies. Then, we built the infrastructure to run any personalized campaign on top of it, including emails, ads, landing pages, and workflows that make reps more productive. Now, we're building agents that can help grow your company for you. We're already helping thousands of customers — including Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and Visa — go to market with unique data, signals, and AI research.

In 2026, we raised a $115M Series D at $7.1B Valuation led by Wellington — and are on track to cross $200M in revenue this quarter. We also launched a $1M Scholarship fund for GTME Education.

Some things to know about us:

  • Our community includes 17,000+ customers, 200+ integration partners, 125+ agencies, 50+ Clay clubs, and 30k members on Slack.

  • Our cultureis unique inside and outside of work. Our team members are also DJs, activists, writers, clowns, marathoners, skydivers, psychedelic therapists, social workers, and more.

  • All employees can work with world-class coaches who specialize in creativity, management, and more.

  • Our operating principles — including negative maintenance and non-attached action — guide our work. Read more about them here.

  • Read about us in the NYT, Forbes, First Round Review, and more.

Hear from our employees directly on our Glassdoor page!

 

About the Role

Clay is scaling fast and the IT function is new. The IT Support Team will be the first point of contact for requests, the team that keeps the queue moving, and a key partner to the Head of IT in building out how the helpdesk operates.

The core of the support engineer role is service delivery: triaging incoming requests, resolving issues quickly, and making sure employees get reliable, responsive support. Alongside that, you'll work closely with the Head of IT to configure workflows and build process in our AI-powered ITSM platform, so the function gets more efficient as Clay grows.

This is a good fit if you take pride in running a clean queue, communicate clearly with employees, and are genuinely interested in building better process, not just executing it.

What You’ll Do (Job Responsibilities)

  • Be the face of IT at Clay. Triage and resolve incoming requests across access, software provisioning, onboarding and offboarding, hardware support, and general helpdesk needs. Employees should feel like IT is fast, reliable, and easy to work with.

  • Own onboarding and offboarding execution. Provision and deprovision accounts, coordinate hardware, and make sure new hires are set up from day one and departing employees are fully off-boarded without gaps.

  • Help build the helpdesk function. Partner with the Head of IT to configure and improve our ITSM platform — define request categories, build intake workflows, and manage queues as the function takes shape and scales.

  • Keep the office running. Support conference room AV, networking equipment, peripherals, and general office tech so employees can do their best work without technology getting in the way.

  • Administer the SaaS stack. Manage day-to-day administration across Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Notion, and other core tools — provisioning users, managing settings, and keeping things clean.

  • Handle hardware logistics. Coordinate device provisioning, shipping, receiving, and basic asset tracking so employees have what they need when they need it.

  • Build process, not just runbooks. Document what you own, identify patterns in incoming requests, and flag opportunities to improve or automate recurring work. The goal is a helpdesk that gets smarter over time.

What You’ll Bring

  • 3 to 5 years in IT support, helpdesk, or a closely related role

  • Strong service delivery instincts; you prioritize well, keep queues clean, and close requests with clear communication

  • Hands-on experience with ITSM platforms; you understand how to configure and manage one, not just work inside it

  • Broad SaaS admin experience: Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Notion, and similar platforms; you've provisioned users, managed settings, and handled admin tasks across a modern SaaS stack

  • Familiarity with office technology: conference room AV setup and troubleshooting, Meraki or similar networking equipment, common peripherals

  • Experience supporting onboarding and offboarding workflows end to end

  • Technical fluency: comfortable in SaaS platforms, macOS, and basic identity and access management tasks (provisioning, deprovisioning, group management)

  • AI-forward mindset: you use AI tools to work faster, handle volume more intelligently, and improve the support experience

  • Process-oriented: you notice what's inefficient and want to fix it

  • Clear communicator: employees trust you and know their issues are being handled

Bonus Points If You

  • Experience with Serval ITSM, either launching it or working within it day to day

  • Experience at a fast-scaling startup where IT processes were being built out

  • Familiarity with Okta or similar identity platforms at a user/admin level

  • Experience building workflows or automations in an ITSM or similar platform

  • Exposure to broader automation tooling

Why This Role

title: IT Support Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

About the Role

We are hiring an IT Support Engineer to own the employee technology experience end to end — from day-one device readiness through the full asset lifecycle. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who is equally comfortable resolving a Tier 3 macOS escalation, standing up device management infrastructure from scratch, and turning repetitive support work into documented, self-service processes.

You will be the technical escalation point for our Windows and macOS fleet, administer our identity and endpoint management platforms, and partner with security to keep the fleet patched and compliant. You will also mentor junior support staff and set the standard for white-glove service across the company.

Key Responsibilities

Endpoint & Device Management

  • Be the front line supporting MDM platforms across the fleet in collaboration with our Technical Engineer — Supporting Windows & macOS — including enrollment, configuration profiles, group policies, and software distribution.

  • Serve as the Tier 1/2 escalation point for macOS and Windows device management issues, including configuration drift, update failures, and security policy conflicts.

  • Work with Technical Engineers to standardized OS images and deployment workflows on a quarterly cadence.

  • Monitor endpoint performance and digital employee experience to identify emerging issues before they scale, and drive proactive remediation across the fleet.

  • Execute workstation imaging, setup, and deployment for new hires and internal transfers, scaling to 100+ builds per month during peak hiring.

Identity & Access Management

  • Tier 1 /2 — provisioning, deprovisioning, group management, and application access requests.

  • Tier 1 /2 supporting authentication methods including FIDO2 security keys, passkeys, and biometric authentication.

  • Troubleshoot via remote sessions with Slack Huddle, Zoom, or Google Meet.

Security & Compliance

  • Partner with the IT Engineering team on patch management, vulnerability remediation, and endpoint compliance using tools such as BigFix, SentinelOne, or Automox.

  • Exposure in supporting security-driven remediation tickets within SLA and maintaining fleet compliance against internal and regulatory standards.

Service Delivery & Support

  • Own a high-volume ticket queue in ServiceNow or Jira, consistently meeting or beating SLA targets while maintaining high customer satisfaction.

  • Provide in-person and remote support to a globally distributed workforce across North America and EMEA time zones.

  • Troubleshoot Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace issues including sync failures, authentication errors, mail flow, and collaboration tooling (Teams, Zoom, SharePoint).

  • Support conferencing and telephony systems for internal and executive-level meetings.

Asset Lifecycle & Vendor Management

  • Provide asset management support to help track and manage our computer hardware and software.

  • Asset shipping and recovery for our new joiners and leavers.

Enablement

  • Lead new-hire IT onboarding sessions covering workstation setup, security protocols, and support procedures.

  • Author and maintain runbooks and self-service documentation in Confluence or SharePoint to reduce repeat ticket volume.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in IT support, end user services, or systems administration.

  • Strong hands-on expertise troubleshooting both Windows and macOS in an enterprise environment.

  • Production experience administering at least one major MDM platform (JAMF Pro, Microsoft Intune, Addigy, or equivalent), including building configuration profiles and policies from scratch.

  • Working knowledge of identity platforms — Okta, Active Directory, or Entra ID — including SSO and MFA administration.

  • Experience with endpoint security and patch management tooling (BigFix, SentinelOne, Automox, Zscaler, or similar).

  • Proficiency with an ITSM platform (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management) and a track record of meeting SLA commitments at volume.

  • Strong administration skills in Microsoft 365 and/or Google Workspace.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate with minimal process and high ambiguity, and to build structure where none exists.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with a white-glove approach to customer service across all levels of the organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • JAMF Certified Tech (JAMF 200) or higher; Microsoft, Okta, or CompTIA certifications.

  • Linux fundamentals and experience administering virtual machines (VMware vSphere, Hyper-V).

  • Experience supporting file share, print, or application servers on Windows Server.

  • Scripting for automation (PowerShell, Bash, or Python).

  • Reporting and dashboarding experience with Power BI or equivalent.

  • Experience supporting users across multiple international regions.

Success in the First 6 Months

  • Fully ramped on the fleet and operating independently as the Tier 3 escalation point for Windows and macOS.

  • Measurable reduction in average time-to-resolution and repeat ticket volume through documentation and automation.

  • Onboarding and imaging workflows standardized, documented, and consistently delivering day-one readiness.

  • Endpoint compliance sustained at or above target across the fleet.

Physical & Work Requirements

  • Ability to lift and move IT equipment up to 40 lbs.

  • Onsite presence required for imaging, deployments, hardware repair, and in-person support.

  • Occasional after-hours or weekend work for maintenance windows, migrations, and escalations.

Why Fireworks?

  • Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

  • Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

  • Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

  • Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

title: IT System Engineer (w/m/d), 80–100 %
descriptionHtml:
Kunden begleiten. Lösungen umsetzen. Verantwortung übernehmen.

Du willst die IT deiner Kunden nicht nur am Laufen halten, sondern verstehen, weiterentwickeln und verantworten? Bei Dukers betreust du eigene Kundenumgebungen von A bis Z – mit einem Team im Rücken, das sein Wissen teilt und bei kniffligen Fragen zusammensteht.

Über Dukers

Dukers ist ein Spin-off der Swisscom mit Sitz in St. Gallen. Wir planen, implementieren und betreiben die IT von Organisationen, die ihre Informatik in verlässliche Hände geben wollen.

Unsere Kunden erhalten eine Lösung aus einer Hand: Arbeitsplätze, Netzwerk, Server, Cloud-Dienste und Kommunikation werden von uns aufgebaut, laufend überwacht, aktuell gehalten und abgesichert. Die Verantwortung für den Betrieb liegt bei uns – mit festen Ansprechpersonen, die die Umgebung ihrer Kunden kennen.

Besondere Tiefe haben wir in Cloud-Infrastrukturen und UCC, gestützt auf starke Partnerschaften mit Swisscom und Microsoft. Unser Team besteht aus Spezialisten mit langjähriger Erfahrung – mit den Standards eines grossen Anbieters und der Verbindlichkeit eines Partners, der seine Kunden persönlich kennt.

Deine Rolle

Du bist die technische Ansprechperson für deine Kunden. Du kennst ihre Umgebungen, betreibst sie zuverlässig und setzt Anpassungen, Installationen und Rollouts selbstständig um – von der Konfiguration über die Inbetriebnahme bis zur Dokumentation. Bei Migrationen und grösseren Projekten arbeitest du mit unseren Spezialisten für Netzwerk, Security und Cloud zusammen.

Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben und entscheidest im Alltag selbst. Bei anspruchsvollen Fragen steht das Team hinter dir.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du betreust die IT-Umgebungen deiner Kunden, kennst ihre Anforderungen und bist ihre verlässliche technische Ansprechperson.

  • Du administrierst Microsoft-365-Tenants: Entra ID, Intune, Microsoft Defender, Exchange Online.

  • Du betreibst Clients, Netzwerke und Serversysteme, analysierst Störungen und behebst ihre Ursachen nachhaltig.

  • Du setzt Anpassungen, Installationen und Rollouts selbstständig um und arbeitest bei Migrationen und Projekten mit.

  • Du erkennst, wo eine Umgebung sicherer oder stabiler werden kann, und bringst konkrete Vorschläge ein.

  • Du dokumentierst deine Arbeit sauber, damit jede Umgebung für das ganze Team nachvollziehbar bleibt.

Womit du arbeitest

  • Microsoft 365 und Cloud: Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Exchange Online, Azure

  • Virtualisierung: VMware Cloud Director, Hyper-V, Proxmox

  • Netzwerk: Ubiquiti UniFi, Cisco, HPE Aruba

  • Security: Fortinet, Versa, Cisco

  • Rechenzentrum: Eigene Infrastruktur in einem der sichersten und nachhaltigsten Rechenzentren der Schweiz, auf der wir unsere Lösungen und die unserer Kunden betreiben

  • Betrieb: Backup, Monitoring und Ticketing mit Tools, die wir selbst entwickeln und weiterentwickeln

Netzwerk und Security betreiben wir als Managed Services – als Value Added Reseller der Swisscom für unsere gemeinsamen Kunden. Wer hier Tiefe aufbauen will, findet bei uns das Umfeld dafür.

Das bringst du mit

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im IT-Bereich, beispielsweise als Informatiker/in EFZ, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung in der Administration von Microsoft-365-Umgebungen – idealerweise mit Entra ID, Intune und Defender

  • Solide Netzwerkkenntnisse: IP-Adressierung, VLANs, DNS und DHCP sind dir vertraut, Routing und Firewall-Regelwerke kein Fremdwort

  • Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt und die Fähigkeit, technische Themen verständlich zu erklären

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

  • Lernbereitschaft und Interesse, dein Wissen im Team einzubringen

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Führerausweis Kategorie B

Idealerweise hast du bereits Kundenumgebungen eigenständig betreut. Stehst du noch am Anfang deiner Laufbahn, bringst aber die fachlichen Grundlagen und den Willen mit, dich einzuarbeiten, möchten wir dich ebenfalls kennenlernen. Deine Aufgaben und deine Verantwortung wachsen mit deinem Können – das Onboarding ist darauf ausgelegt.

Dein Arbeitsort und deine Einsätze

Dein Arbeitsalltag verbindet Einsätze bei Kunden in der Ostschweiz und im Raum Zürich mit Arbeit und Austausch in unserem Büro in der Stadt St. Gallen. Wir suchen dich in St. Gallen und Umgebung.

Das Büro liegt verkehrsgünstig: Die Autobahnein- und -ausfahrt Kreuzbleiche ist drei Minuten entfernt, Winkeln fünf. Die Bushaltestelle Schönenwegen liegt eine Minute vor der Tür. Parkplätze sind kostenlos. Dazu kommen ein eigener kleiner Park, ein Balkon direkt am Büro mit Grill – und der Blick auf die Geissli nebenan.

Was dich bei Dukers erwartet

  • Einarbeitung, die den Namen verdient: Du startest mit einem intensiven Training und arbeitest in den ersten Wochen im Tandem mit einer erfahrenen Kollegin oder einem erfahrenen Kollegen, bis du deine Umgebungen selbst verantwortest.

  • Fünf Weiterbildungstage pro Jahr: Bezahlt und für Zertifizierungen, Kurse oder Herstellertrainings nutzbar – wir fördern deine fachliche Entwicklung aktiv.

  • Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg: Dukers wächst, und wer diesen Erfolg mit erarbeitet, soll daran teilhaben. Deshalb beteiligen wir unser Team jedes Jahr am Unternehmenserfolg – zusätzlich zum Lohn.

  • Fünf Wochen Ferien, bei Bedarf mehr: Bis zu zwei zusätzliche Ferienwochen pro Jahr kannst du unkompliziert dazukaufen.

  • Arbeit, die zu deinem Leben passt: Familie, Weiterbildung, Sport oder ein Projekt, das Zeit braucht: Wir richten die Anstellung nach deiner Lebenssituation aus – mit einem Pensum von 80 % oder 100 %, Gleitzeit und Remote Work nach Absprache. Und wenn sich dein Leben verändert, verändern wir das Modell mit.

  • E-Firmenfahrzeug mit Privatnutzung: Ohne Zusatzkosten für dich, inklusive Ladepauschale. Und wenn du zu Hause laden willst, beteiligen wir uns an deiner eigenen Ladestation.

  • Geschäftshandy mit Mobilabo: Gehört zur Ausstattung.

Bei uns entscheidest du mit. Wer eine Umgebung betreut, kennt sie am besten – also liegt die Entscheidung dort, wo das Wissen ist. Siehst du eine bessere Lösung, bringst du sie ein, und wir setzen sie gemeinsam um.

Lernen wir uns kennen

Stellenantritt: per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung. Und wenn du vor deiner Entscheidung einen Tag mit dem Team verbringen möchtest – gerne.

Deine Ansprechpersonen:

  • Livia Julia Tanner, Leitung Personal, nimmt deine Bewerbung entgegen und beantwortet Fragen zur Stelle und zu den Anstellungsbedingungen.

  • Aaron Herceg, Gründer und Governance Manager, leitet das Engineering-Team, mit dem du arbeitest, und beantwortet deine technischen Fragen.

Schreib uns an ----- mit Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätzen dazu, warum diese Stelle zu dir passt.
