title: IT System Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey. We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further. Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other. Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or ----- domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.

About the job

You will join the IT System Engineering team within the IT Department, alongside the IT Support and IT Project Management teams. Based in Paris, you will report to the IT System Engineering Manager and contribute to the design, deployment, maintenance, and continuous improvement of Contentsquare’s core IT platforms. This is a full-time, permanent position with no direct reports.

You will work across identity and access management, endpoint and mobile device management, SaaS applications, automation, and AI-enabled IT initiatives. The role is primarily on-site in Paris, with some remote work permitted according to company policy.

What you’ll do

  • Design, build, deploy, maintain, and continuously improve the core IT platform across identity and access management, endpoint management, enterprise mobility, and cross-functional SaaS applications.

  • Manage and improve Okta, Jamf, Google Workspace, Slack, Microsoft Intune, macOS, and Windows environments, ensuring secure, reliable, and effective services for employees.

  • Build and maintain automated workflows using Okta Workflows, Zapier, Workato, or similar platforms to simplify IT processes and improve the employee experience.

  • Develop, maintain, and improve Bash scripts and other scripts used to automate IT operations, system administration tasks, monitoring, configuration, and user or device lifecycle processes.

  • Collaborate with the IT Support team on escalated cases and cross-team projects, providing technical expertise across identity, endpoints, access, SaaS applications, and device management.

  • Lead assigned initiatives autonomously, contribute to project management, provide clear progress updates, and use tools such as Jira to track projects and deliverables.

  • Use AI tools and set up MCP servers to support automation, IT operations, and the AI at Work initiative.

Outcomes you will work toward

  • Maintain secure, reliable, and well-managed identity, endpoint, and SaaS environments for Contentsquare employees.

  • Improve the efficiency, scalability, and consistency of IT operations through automation and scripting.

  • Resolve escalated cases effectively in collaboration with the IT Support team.

  • Deliver owned projects and initiatives with clear planning, documentation, stakeholder communication, and follow-through.

  • Identify and implement practical opportunities to improve security, performance, reliability, and employee experience across the IT platform.

Operational responsibilities

  • Manage the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of identity, endpoint, MDM, SaaS, and automation platforms.

  • Develop and maintain Bash scripts and other scripts that reduce manual work and improve consistency across IT operations.

  • Monitor configurations, deployments, software updates, access, and security controls across managed environments.

  • Investigate complex technical issues, identify root causes, and implement scalable solutions.

  • Document systems, workflows, processes, and technical decisions clearly.

  • Collaborate with IT Support, IT Project Management, and other teams on escalated cases and cross-team projects.

What you’ll need to succeed

  • Experience in IT systems engineering, endpoint management, identity and access management, or a closely related field.

  • Proficiency in Okta and a solid understanding of identity and access management concepts.

  • Hands-on experience with Jamf, Google Workspace, and Slack.

  • Experience building and maintaining automated workflows with tools such as Okta Workflows, Zapier, Workato, or similar platforms.

  • Practical knowledge of macOS and Windows environments.

  • Proficiency in Bash and scripting, with the ability to automate repetitive administration tasks, integrate systems, troubleshoot issues, and maintain clear and reusable scripts.

  • Proficiency in AI tools for IT operations, automation, or productivity.

  • Experience setting up MCP servers.

  • The ability to contribute to project management and take ownership of initiatives.

  • The ability to work autonomously while collaborating effectively with others.

  • The ability to provide clear and regular progress updates on owned projects and initiatives.

  • A proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement.

  • The ability to understand and follow clear guidelines and directions.

  • Professional fluency in English.

Nice-to-have

  • Some knowledge of Jira.

  • Experience with Microsoft Intune.

  • French language skills.

  • Experience contributing to internal AI, automation, or digital workplace initiatives.

If you are interested in this role, please send your CV in English.Why you should join Contentsquare We invest in our people through career development, mentorship, social events, philanthropic activities, and competitive benefits. We are always assessing the perks we offer to ensure we’re aligned with the employees' needs. Here are a few we want to highlight: - Virtual onboarding, Hackathon, and various opportunities to interact with your team and global colleagues both on and offsite each year - Work flexibility: hybrid and remote work policies - Generous paid time-off policy (every location is different) - Lifestyle allowance - A Culture Crew in every country we’re based in to coordinate regular activities for employees to get to know each other and bond outside of work - Every full-time employee receives stock options, allowing them to share in the company’s success - We have multiple Employee Resource Groups, that offer a safe space for individuals who share common identities, life experiences, or allyship to connect, support one another, and passionately advocate for the issues close to their hearts - And more benefits tailored to each country Contentsquare is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. Your personal data is used by Contentsquare for recruitment purposes only. Read our Job Candidate Privacy Notice to find out more about data protection at Contentsquare and your rights. You can exercise your rights by using our dedicated Data Subject Rights Portal here. Your personal data will be securely stored in our hosting provider’s data center in Oregon (US west). We have implemented appropriate transfer mechanisms under applicable data protection laws. Contentsquare may use AI-assisted tools to help review and screen applications. All decisions involving hiring are made by human reviewers, and your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

title: Junior Account Executive, Enterprise - German speaker
descriptionHtml:
About Us

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider helping enterprises and consumer brands deliver seamless connectivity worldwide. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform, proprietary eSIM technology, and its own mobile core network across 15 countries, 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider in 43 countries.


Founded in 2022, 1GLOBAL has rapidly become one of Europe's fastest-growing telecom technology companies, connecting more than 80 million people and devices globally. Our customers include leading banks, multinational enterprises, global retailers, travel companies, payment service providers, and digital-first businesses.


Headquartered in the Netherlands, with R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 550 professionals across 16 countries. With annual revenues exceeding US$200 million and a strong track record of profitability, we continue to invest in innovation, infrastructure, and international expansion as we redefine the future of global mobile connectivity.

About the Team

Our enterprise team serves internationally operating companies that want to simplify mobile connectivity across borders. Instead of many contracts with different network operators, they get one provider, one platform and consistent processes from 1GLOBAL, including eSIM, IoT connectivity and API integration. We work directly with customers and indirectly through resellers and distributors, in the DACH region and across our other markets.

We are growing with our existing customers, through our partners and from new inbound requests. Many of these opportunities don't need a long enterprise sales cycle; they need fast and reliable closing. That is where you come in: you own this business independently, with your own targets and short paths into the team. You will be the first person in this role and shape it from day one.

About the Role

You win revenue with our existing customers, partners and new inbound requests: from identifying needs through quoting and negotiation to signature and activation. With your own sales targets, you own a clearly defined segment and work closely with our enterprise and partner teams in the DACH region and internationally.

Grow existing customers

  • You manage a portfolio of existing customers, spot additional needs (more countries, users, plans or IoT use cases) and turn them into upsell and cross-sell deals.
  • You own contract renewals and expansions, from timely outreach through to signature.
  • You are your customers' first point of contact in sales and resolve requests quickly, together with Customer Success or Support where needed.

Qualify and close new opportunities

  • You handle inbound requests, qualify them in a first call and close small and mid-sized deals yourself.
  • You hand larger opportunities over to our enterprise sales team, well prepared, and support them through to closing.
  • You use campaigns, events and referrals to start new conversations with companies in our focus segments.

Activate partner revenue

  • You support our resellers and distributors day to day: with quotes for their end customers, pricing questions and orders.
  • You make sure new partners are up and running quickly and close their first deals.
  • You identify which partners have more potential and agree next steps with Partner Management.

From quote to activation

  • You prepare quotes, negotiate terms within our pricing guidelines and take deals through to signature.
  • You manage the path from order to activation, because revenue only starts once connections go live.
  • You keep your pipeline and forecast up to date in our CRM so we always know where we stand.

Requirements

About You

Must Have

  • Fluent German and English, spoken and written: you negotiate and write in both languages every day
  • Completed commercial apprenticeship or a degree, plus 1 to 4 years of B2B sales experience, for example in inside sales, account management, as an SDR/BDR or in sales support with direct customer contact
  • Drive to close: you enjoy working towards targets and follow up until the deal is signed
  • Fluent German and English, spoken and written: you negotiate and write in both languages every day
  • Structure and reliability: you keep many deals and orders moving in parallel and see each one through
  • Confident on the phone, by email and on video calls, with a friendly and solution-oriented tone
  • Experience with CRM systems and confident with MS Office, especially Excel


Nice to Have

  • Experience in telecommunications or IT, for example with a network operator, service provider, system integrator or distributor
  • Experience in indirect sales with resellers and distributors
  • Experience with quoting and contract processes in an enterprise environment
  • Additional languages, for example Dutch, Spanish, French, Polish or Portuguese

Benefits

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 50% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

title: Junior Accountmanager Software
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij jouw commerciële carrière een vliegende start geven en energie halen uit het binnenhalen van nieuwe klanten? Bij ITIS Products in Barendrecht krijg je alle ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen tot succesvol softwareaccountmanager. Je richt je voornamelijk op new business, leert alles over onze innovatieve softwareoplossingen en bouwt stap voor stap aan jouw eigen klantenportefeuille. Ervaring met softwareverkoop is mooi meegenomen, maar jouw commerciële drive en enthousiasme zijn voor ons veel belangrijker.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Junior Accountmanager Software ligt jouw focus op het creëren van nieuwe commerciële kansen. Je gaat actief op zoek naar potentiële klanten, legt de eerste contacten en laat organisaties kennismaken met de softwareoplossingen van ITIS Products. Je krijgt hierbij de begeleiding van ervaren collega's, zodat je jezelf kunt ontwikkelen tot een zelfstandig accountmanager.

Je adviseert organisaties over SOFOS 360, onze software voor het registreren en beheren van gevaarlijke stoffen. Daarnaast werk je met Chemwatch, een internationaal toonaangevende softwareoplossing waarvoor ITIS Products exclusief partner is binnen de Benelux.

Jouw werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Actief benaderen van nieuwe klanten en genereren van new business.

  • Opbouwen van jouw eigen klantenportefeuille.

  • Plannen van commerciële afspraken bij potentiële klanten.

  • Inventariseren van klantbehoeften en commerciële kansen.

  • Verzorgen van softwaredemonstraties, zelfstandig of samen met een productspecialist.

  • Opstellen, uitwerken en opvolgen van offertes.

  • Begeleiden van het verkoopproces van eerste kennismaking tot opdracht.

  • Onderhouden en verder uitbouwen van klantrelaties.

  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en nieuwe commerciële kansen.

  • Intensief samenwerken met consultants, productspecialisten en softwareontwikkelaars.

  • Stap voor stap doorgroeien naar een zelfstandig Accountmanager Software.

Wat wij je bieden

  • Je ontvangt een passend salaris, afhankelijk van jouw kennis, werkervaring en opleiding.

  • Een aantrekkelijke bonusregeling op basis van behaalde resultaten.

  • Een leaseauto, laptop en telefoon van de zaak.

  • 26 vakantiedagen (op basis van een fulltime dienstverband), met de mogelijkheid om vakantiedagen te kopen of te verkopen.

  • Een goede pensioenregeling.

  • Een opleidingsbudget en volop mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding en coaching door ervaren collega's.

  • Mogelijkheden om, in overleg, deels vanuit huis te werken.

  • Een informele werksfeer met korte lijnen en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

  • Kennissessies, vrijdagmiddagborrels, teamuitjes en familiedagen.

  • Daarnaast profiteer je van diverse extra voordelen, zoals personeelskortingen, leuke evenementen en andere aantrekkelijke extra's.

Wat neem je mee?

Je hoeft geen ervaren softwareverkoper te zijn om succesvol te worden in deze functie. Misschien werk je nu als commercieel medewerker binnendienst, accountmanager, sales consultant of in een andere commerciële B2B-omgeving en ben je toe aan de volgende stap. Ook wanneer je net aan het begin van jouw commerciële carrière staat en graag wilt leren, nodigen wij je van harte uit om te reageren.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau.

  • Interesse in software, IT of digitale oplossingen.

ITIS Products en de VDK Groep

ITIS Products is een innovatieve softwareontwikkelaar uit Barendrecht. Met SOFOS 360 helpen wij organisaties om gevaarlijke stoffen veilig te registreren, beheren en te voldoen aan wet- en regelgeving. Daarnaast zijn wij exclusief partner van Chemwatch binnen de Benelux en ondersteunen wij organisaties met internationale softwareoplossingen en actuele chemische informatie.

  • Ontwikkelaar van de gespecialiseerde softwareoplossing SOFOS 360.

VDK Groep, de razendsnel groeiende Topwerkgever van Nederland!

ITIS Products is onderdeel van de VDK Groep: een familie van meer dan 115 zelfstandige bedrijven binnen de installatietechniek. Zo krijg je volop kansen om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen en mee te groeien met een organisatie die blijft investeren in mensen, technologie en innovatie.

title: (Junior) Marketing Manager*in Ad Operations (m/w/d) - Programmatic Display & Video
descriptionHtml:
Wir sind Interactive Performance Deutschland (IPD) - kein Netzwerk, keine klassische Agentur. Wir sind ein Performance Marketing Spezialist, der Display Prospecting und Retargeting im Full Funnel-Modell betreibt: von CPM und CPV für Reichweite und Awareness bis CPO, CPL und CPC für messbaren Abschluss-Erfolg. Vollständige Ergebnisverantwortung über den gesamten Funnel. Unser Inventar buchen wir programmatisch mit exklusiven Private SSP-Deals, unsere Ads sind feed-basierte HTML5-Formate direkt aus dem Advertiser-Produktfeed und IAS Pre-Bid schützt jeden Cent vor Invalid Traffic.

Kurz: Wir kombinieren die Reichweite eines Media-Players mit der Vergütungslogik eines Affiliate-Kanals über den gesamten Funnel. Das gibt es so in DACH kein zweites Mal. Bei IPD hast du einen direkten Draht zur Geschäftsführung: kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen und eine Wachstumsstory, zu der du beitragen kannst.

Aufgaben

• Du setzt digitale Kampagnen in unserem Inhouse-Adserver und DSPs wie Active Agent, DV360 und weiteren Plattformen auf.

• Du steuerst und optimierst die Kampagnen im Tagesgeschäft auf die jeweils relevante KPI

• Du analysierst Performance-Daten und leitest Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung ab

• Du arbeitest eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus dem Vertrieb, Business Intelligence und Account Management zusammen.

• Du lieferst Input bei der Konzeption & Planung von Kampagnen an das Account Management und nimmst bei Bedarf an Kundengesprächen teil.

Qualifikation

• Für Junior: Erste Erfahrung im Online Marketing – z. B. durch ein Praktikum, Studium oder eigene Projekte.

• Für Mid-Level: 1-2 Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung im Ad Management, Paid Social, o. ä.

• Du hast Lust auf Technik, Tools & Daten – und willst verstehen, was wirklich funktioniert.

• Du arbeitest zuverlässig, eigenverantwortlich und strukturiert

• Du hast ein gutes Zahlenverständnis und willst dich stetig weiterentwickeln

• Deine Arbeitsweise zeichnet sich durch den Blick über den Tellerrand aus. Du gibst dich nicht mit dem Status Quo zufrieden, sondern versuchst stets Produkte, Prozesse & deine eigene Arbeit zu hinterfragen und weiterzuentwickeln.

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse

Benefits

  • Einzigartiges Produkt: Full-Funnel Display & Video mit vollständiger Ergebnisverantwortung.

  • Direkter GF-Draht: Entscheidungen in kurzer Zeit. Open Door Policy.

  • Hybrides Arbeiten: Hamburg (Jungfernstieg) als Basis, flexibles Remote-Modell.

  • Deutschlandticket: Wir übernehmen dein Deutschlandticket, damit du klimafreundlich und stressfrei zur Arbeit kommst.

  • Wellpass: Zugang zu tausenden Fitnessstudios, Schwimmbädern und Yogastudios deutschlandweit – für deinen Ausgleich neben dem Job.

  • Edenred Gutschein: Monatlicher steuerfreier Sachbezug auf deine Edenred-Karte, den du flexibel bei zahlreichen Partnern einlösen kannst.

WARUM IPD

Wir sind kein Konzern und keine Holding, kein Politik-Theater, kein Quartals-Reporting, das niemand liest. Wir haben ein Produkt, das funktioniert.

In den kommenden fünf Jahren wollen wir zu einer der führenden Adressen für programmatische Display & Video Kampagnen, Retargeting und Lead-Generierung im deutschsprachigen Markt werden. Wer jetzt einsteigt, gestaltet mit und wird Teil unserer Wachstumsstory.

BEWERBUNG

Bitte schicke uns dein Anschreiben & Lebenslauf inkl. deiner Gehaltsvorstellung zu.

title: Junior AI Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team - from Finance to HR - to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time. Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake or Siemens, use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario. With a team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software. At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.
What you'll do
  • Your mission is to ensure the Pigment Frame Methodology is applied consistently across all integration partners. You’ll work closely with them and with our Senior Architects/ Partners to deliver the highest-quality models. You’ll also be expected to develop your project-management and technical skills to provide an initial level of analysis.
  • Communicate with partners and customers to gather all documents required by the Pigment Framework.
  • Use the analysis framework to deliver a first layer of automated qualification with AI.
  • Understand, review, and validate business requirements translated from the customer by the partner.
  • Understand, review, and validate design architecture.
  • Assess the robustness, quality, and accuracy of the models configured for the customer.
  • Determine when to escalate issues to a Senior Architect and/or the partner to address identified gaps.
  • Collaborate with Senior Architects and Pigment’s Product Team to design and build GenAI-based QA tools that support and accelerate all QA activities.
  • Provide level-1 support to partners on modeling activities.
  • Provide level-1 support to partners on integrating source software and migration solutions (connectors and APIs).
  • Onboard onto the Pigment platform, complete full certification, and begin your path toward Pigment modeling mastery.
  • Apply learnings from each experience to improve your performance and contribute to the growth of the wider Pigment ecosystem.

    • Who you are
  • Structured and well-organized, with strong project management skills.
  • Skilled at understanding and building complex systems (EPM, ERP, Data Warehouse) while maintaining clarity on the underlying business purpose.
  • 1–2 years of experience in a technical role, ideally within software implementation; experience with EPM technologies such as Pigment, Anaplan, or Adaptive is especially relevant.
  • Strong communicator, able to clearly explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Skilled at translating detailed data analysis and technical insights into clear, concise, and actionable recommendations.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative mindset when working cross-functionally with other departments and partners.
  • Exercises sound judgment in identifying when topics require escalation to senior team members, ensuring the right level of information is communicated.
  • A strong learner, especially in new domains; our customers’ use cases and businesses are highly diverse—understanding what you are building is essential.
  • Able to adapt to a rapidly evolving product; this is not standard B2B software—we are only 1% finished.
  • Fluent in English; French or additional European languages are a plus.
  • Master’s degree or other relevant advanced degree preferred.

    • What we offer
  • Competitive package
  • Stock options to ensure you have a stake in Pigment's growth
  • The best health insurance with Alan Blue entirely free for you and your family
  • Weekly Lunch and Lunch vouchers (Swile card) to cover your lunch breaks with total flexibility
  • Subscription to Egym Wellpass (ex-Gymlib) for full access to gyms, studios, and wellness spaces across France
  • Trust and flexible working hours
  • Along with one company offsite every year, we have brand new offices at the heart of major cities including New York, San Francisco, Toronto, Paris, and London
  • High-end equipment (based on stock/availability) to do your work in the best conditions
  • Remote-friendly environment
  • We are hiring to fill an immediate opening for this position.

    • How we work
  • Thrive Together: We can only win as a team. We are all founders and do the right thing for our peers, Pigment customers, partners, and the planet
  • Never Settle: We aim to become the best at what we do by delivering with rigor and ambition every day. Delivering means building a passionate Pigment community
  • Go for it: We are biased towards action. Every action leads to learning and these learnings get us one step closer to our mission
  • Be real, be humble: We are generous with our feedback, open to change our views and we approach it with empathy knowing everyone is trying to do the best for Pigment

Any checks will be conducted lawfully prior to formal employment contracts being signed, with candidate consent, and information will be treated confidentially. Pigment is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity is a strength and fosters innovation. We are committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at the workplace. title: Junior Automatisierungsingenieur (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wir bei Modulist helfen Logistikunternehmen und mittelständischen Betrieben dabei, ihre Prozesse durch maßgeschneiderte Softwarelösungen, Vibe-Coding-Anwendungen und digitale Automatisierungen effizienter zu gestalten. Wir arbeiten zu 100 % remote, mit flachen Hierarchien, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einem starken Fokus auf eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten und praktische Ergebnisse.

Aufgaben

  • Workflow- & Automations-Engineering: Du baust und erweiterst komplexe Automatisierungen und Schnittstellen (z. B. via Make, n8n oder API-Integrationen) für unsere Kunden in der Logistik und im Mittelstand.
  • Vibe Coding & Anwendungsintegration: Du nutzt moderne AI- & Vibe-Coding-Tools, um schnell Prototypen, interne Tools oder maßgeschneiderte Micro-Services zu entwickeln und umzusetzen.
  • Websites & Hosting: Du erstellst und betreust gelegentlich Unternehmens-Websites auf WordPress-Basis, kümmerst dich um das Hosting, Deployments und technische Anpassungen.
  • Zusammenarbeit im Team: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Senior Automationsingenieur zusammen, der dich anleitet, architektonische Leitplanken vorgibt und dir bei komplexen Aufgaben sparrend zur Seite steht.

Qualifikation

  • Ausbildung & Studium: Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik (oder vergleichbar) oder eine fundierte Weiterbildung / Fachausbildung im IT-Bereich.
  • Praktische Erfahrung: Du hast bereits erste berufliche Erfahrung im Bereich Automatisierung, API-Anbindungen und Systemintegrationen gesammelt.
  • Hands-on Mentalität im Coding: Du hast Freude daran, mithilfe moderner Entwicklungsansätze und AI-Assistenz (Vibe Coding) zügig lauffähigen Code und funktionsfähige Workflows zu bauen.
  • WordPress & Web-Know-how: Grundkenntnisse im Umgang mit WordPress, HTML/CSS/JS sowie Server- & Hosting-Themen sind vorhanden.
  • Kein Senior nötig, aber Macher-Gen: Du musst kein Senior mit jahrzehntelanger Erfahrung sein – eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe, Lernbereitschaft und Freude an pragmatischen Lösungen sind uns wichtiger.
  • Selbstständigkeit im Homeoffice: Du arbeitest strukturiert, ziehst dir Aufgaben eigenverantwortlich und kommunizierst transparent im Remote-Alltag.

Benefits

  • Strukturierter Einstieg & Coaching: Unser Senior Automationsingenieur arbeitet dich intensiv ein und unterstützt dich kontinuierlich bei deiner fachlichen Weiterentwicklung.

title: Junior Compute Architect
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

About the Hardware organisation at Fractile
Processor Architecture sits within Fractile’s hardware organisation, which owns everything from compute engine definition and ISA design through memory hierarchies, on-chip interconnects, and the path from early architectural exploration through to tapeout and post-silicon validation. Architecture at Fractile isn’t a paper exercise — it’s built in constant collaboration with logical design, physical design, and verification teams, so that every architectural decision is grounded in what will actually perform in working silicon.

About the team and role
As an Early Career Processor Architect, you’ll join our architecture team to learn how to define the compute engines, ISA definitions and programming models that sit at the heart of our silicon. Working closely with senior architects and our logical design, physical design, and verification teams, you’ll get real exposure to performance modelling, specification writing, bottleneck analysis, and pre- and post-silicon validation — with experienced architects mentoring you as you build toward owning more of this yourself.

About you
We’re looking for someone with a strong foundational understanding of computer or processor architecture — built through coursework, personal projects, internships, placements, or research — who’s genuinely curious about performance and power trade-offs and eager to learn how to navigate them. You don’t need prior industry experience as a Processor Architect; what matters is real hands-on exposure to processor or accelerator design, through a final-year project, FPGA build, RISC-V implementation, internship, or research, plus a comfort working across disciplines and a track record of thriving in ambiguity and fast iteration.

Key Requirements

  • A degree (BEng, MEng, MSc or equivalent) in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.

  • A solid foundational understanding of computer/processor architecture, including matrix- and vector-centric floating-point arithmetic and memory hierarchies, gained through study, projects, internships, or research.

  • Some exposure to RTL design concepts and how physical design constraints feed back into architectural choices — academic or internship-level experience is fine.

  • Any hands-on exposure to architectural performance modelling tools (gem5, SystemC, or custom cycle-accurate simulators), compiler/toolchain interactions, or AI acceleration/vector-matrix compute, through study or projects, is highly valued.

  • A clear communicator, comfortable working across architecture, modelling, implementation, verification, and software teams, who thrives in ambiguity and fast iteration.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

 

Export controls

Our work involves technologies subject to UK, US and other international export control regulations. Certain roles may require additional eligibility checks to ensure compliance with applicable law. We'll be transparent about this throughout the hiring process.

About Yepoda

Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.

Our mission is to bring Clean K-Beauty Innovations,from Korea straight to Europe, UK, and the US – without ever compromising on our values, quality, and sustainability. Our clean, mindfully produced skincare products are made with love in Korea, vegan, cruelty-free, and packed with the best natural and active ingredients.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a fast-growing beauty start-up based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available across Europe and the US, since March 2025, in Sephora Europe & since August 2026 in Sephora US – online and in over 1200 stores. As a certified B Corp™, we are committed to building a business with purpose. With a team of over 120 brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda’s story every day.

We are looking for a highly motivated Junior Financial Controller to own the integrity of our numbers and help deeply understand and steer the business. You will be responsible for a fast, accurate month-end close, robust reporting and internal controls, and you will support budgeting, forecasting, and performance management. This role falls within the FP&A department and will partner closely with Accounting, our Operational Teams and our Leadership Team to track spend, improve visibility, and provide insights into business mechanics that drive efficient growth.

This is an ideal role for someone with a solid accounting and controlling foundation who enjoys business partnering and wants to understand and discover the deeper mechanics of a D2C business and operations in a fast-growing environment.

Your Tasks:

  • Own the monthly, quarterly, and year-end closing process from a controlling perspective, including thorough review of accruals, provisions, and reconciliations

  • Prepare monthly management reporting (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) and reporting for different stakeholders, including leadership and investors

  • Support budgeting vs. actuals, forecasting, and long-range planning for SG&A functions including Brand, HR, Product Development and Customer Care

  • Track budget vs. actuals and forecast, and prepare variance analysis with clear explanations of underlying drivers

  • Maintain and update models and drivers behind operating expenses

  • Oversee inventory valuation, cost of goods sold, and product margin analysis across sales channels

  • Monitor G&A spend and identify cost optimization opportunities

  • Design, implement, and maintain internal controls, guidelines, and finance processes (e.g. approval flows, cost center structure, chart of accounts)

  • Act as a finance partner to functional leaders, helping them understand spend trends and trade-offs

  • Help setting up KPI & trend analysis to support data driven decision making

Your Profile:

  • Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a comparable field

  • 2-3 years of experience in Controlling, Accounting or FP&A, ideally in e-commerce or D2C, consumer goods. Audit firm experience is a plus

  • Solid knowledge of German GAAP (HGB), IFRS and month-end/year-end closing

  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and hands-on mentality

  • Process driven and excited about setting up new projects and flows from scratch

  • Strong collaboration & communication skills

  • Experience working at a growing scale-up or consulting with strong collaboration and communication

  • Experience with G-Suite or Excel, ERP and FP&A systems. NetSuite is a plus

  • Fluent in English

What We Offer:

  • Dynamic Environment: The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team.

  • Accelerate Your Career: Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand.

  • Inspiring Workspace: Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks.

  • Hybrid Working: We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery.

  • We Value Diversity: We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default.

  • Employee Discounts: You’ll get to enjoy the Yepoda products at a discount and share it with friends and family to keep your glow going!

  • Unique Add Ons: A monthly benefits budget that's yours to spend. Through the Probonio app you pick what actually fits your lifestyle.

Would you like to be part of the team? Then we'd love to hear from you! 🫰✨

title: Junior Legal Counsel
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

You'll join a small but ambitious Legal team with a broad remit, working with every part of the business — from Product and Engineering to Credit Risk, Marketing and People. Lendable is an FCA-regulated lender operating in the UK, US and Mexico, so you'll get early exposure to regulated products and new markets. As Lendable grows, this role is focused on commercial contracts, product and corporate work. You'll own matters end to end, explain legal issues clearly to non-lawyers, and weigh the legal position against what the business is trying to achieve.

What you'll be doing

  • Draft, review and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements. You'll lead on supplier and customer contracts, engagement letters and NDAs, and support on partnership and other strategic contracts as you build towards leading them

  • Manage our contract review process, including triaging incoming requests, providing templates and reviews, and managing the e-signature process (for example DocuSign) through to completion

  • Respond to day-to-day legal queries from the business and our counterparties

  • Drive process and knowledge management by building and maintaining document repositories, administering our contract management and AI tooling and helping us develop processes to support contract review and negotiation

  • Support on intellectual property matters and litigious matters as they arise

  • Take on company secretarial and governance work

  • Support corporate and transactional work, including KYC / due diligence requests and diligence reviews on corporate projects

  • Work closely with the rest of the Legal team to deliver timely, first-class legal support

How you’ll make an impact

  • You'll help drive the business forward by taking the initiative and embracing work beyond your comfort zone

  • You'll get to grips with new markets and financial products, bringing energy and curiosity to each new challenge


What we're looking for

  • NQ - 2PQE, qualified in England & Wales, or in another common law jurisdiction with relevant UK experience

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, including explaining legal issues to non-lawyers

  • Strong organisation: you can run multiple matters at once and prioritise them independently

  • Comfortable with pace and change, and keen to take ownership of a broad remit rather than a narrow specialism

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

title: Junior Pricing Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

London (hybrid, 3 days in office)

We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this position.

 

About the team

Marshmallow's pricing team applies quantitative methods to real insurance problems. In this role, you'll learn how pricing decisions work in practice and turn data into meaningful outcomes. You'll work closely with a senior pricing team member, bringing your quantitative background into an industry setting. The aim is for you to develop the practical judgement and independence to take on – and eventually lead – increasingly substantial work.

What you'll be doing

  • Working closely with pricing colleagues on scoped analytical and data-driven projects, taking on more responsibility as your experience develops.

  • Applying mathematical, statistical and machine learning techniques to practical pricing questions, connecting your analysis to the decision it needs to inform.

  • Explaining your findings clearly, keeping colleagues from different areas of the business updated on progress and following up on agreed actions.

  • Using feedback to improve your work and build your understanding of data science methods, coding best practice and the commercial context of insurance pricing.

Who you are

  • You want to learn, seek feedback and build towards working independently.

  • You communicate your rationale and findings clearly, and keep colleagues informed about your progress.

  • You follow through on agreed actions and take ownership of your work.

What you’ll bring

  • A strong academic record and a research master's or PhD in a quantitative field, such as mathematics, physics or econometrics.

  • Experience applying quantitative methods or machine learning to a practical problem through your studies, research, a personal project or work.

  • Industry experience is preferred - a placement, internship or experience whilst studying, or in between research masters / PhD.

  • The ability to explain how your approach fits the problem, rather than relying on theory alone.

 

Perks of the job

  • Bonus scheme designed to reward high performance

  • Private medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with Oliva

  • Personal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a year

  • Monthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose

  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

  • 4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year

Our process

  • Initial call with a member from our Talent Team (30 mins)

  • Combined Past Experience & Technical interview (90 mins)

  • Onsite Culture interviews (90 mins)

Diversity of thought

We know the best ideas come from having different perspectives in the room - and we're committed to hiring fairly, regardless of background, identity or experience. If you see yourself in this role, we'd encourage you to apply.

title: Junior Public Sector Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role
Elastic, the Search Analytics company, is seeking a Jnr Public Sector Account Exec. You’ll own a greenfield Dutch public sector territory: municipalities, healthcare, education and research. This is a hunter seat with loads of potential, Elastic has the momentum in this segment. You’ll open doors, build champions, and turn Search, Observability and Security use cases into new projects, with a main focus on applying AI.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Build and run a territory plan that prioritizes where to hunt first, using account tiering and contact coverage.
  • Generate your own pipeline through outbound, events, partners and public sector networks. Many accounts have no contacts yet, so you’ll build coverage from scratch.

title: Junior Quantitative Trader | Crypto Options
descriptionHtml:
BlockTech is hiring a Junior Quantitative Trader to join its options trading team in Amsterdam. In this role, you'll help run and improve the systems that trade our capital.

We trade crypto derivatives and spot markets across global venues, 24/7. Our traders don't just watch the systems. They own them end-to-end.

About BlockTech

BlockTech is an algorithmic trading firm headquartered in Amsterdam, with a second office in Singapore. We specialize in market making and trade cryptocurrency derivatives and spot markets globally, using our own capital. We're growing fast and expanding into new markets.

Our traders work side by side with quantitative researchers and engineers. Research, engineering, and trading happen a few meters apart, so the path from a market read to live PnL is short.

What will you do?

You'll be responsible for our day-to-day trading operations, from running the automated systems to managing positions to shaping the strategies that come next.

You will:

  • Run the systems. Monitor and operate our automated trading systems and dashboards in live markets.

  • Tune the pricing. Adjust pricing and parameters as market behavior shifts.

  • Own the risk. Manage positions and the risk that comes with them.

  • Build new strategies. Develop and deploy new strategies together with quantitative researchers and engineers.

  • Spot what’s next. Research new business opportunities and stay on top of market news and changes.

What we're looking for

You'll need:

  • A strong academic background in a quantitative field such as mathematics, physics, statistics, or computer science.

  • Proficiency in Python.

  • Focus and composure behind the screen when markets get busy.

  • A strong sense of ownership and excellent collaboration skills.

Bonus points for:

  • Professional trading experience at a high-frequency trading firm

Pay, location, and relocation

  • Compensation: a competitive base salary plus a very attractive performance bonus based on individual and company results.

  • Trading fund: strong performers get the opportunity to buy into the trading fund.

  • Location: On-site on our trading floor in Amsterdam

  • Visa: BlockTech sponsors the Dutch highly skilled migrant visa.

  • Relocation: All-in relocation package and Dutch classes for international hires. Eligible hires may qualify for the 30% ruling.

What else is in it for you

  • Pension plan, company laptop, and home internet reimbursement

  • An extensive in-house training program and an annual learning and development budget

  • An environment that embraces AI, both to speed up your work and to advance our systems

  • Gym reimbursement and sports during working hours: kickboxing, CrossFit, fitness, and soccer

  • Weekly Friday drinks, monthly outings, quarterly sports competitions, and two trips abroad a year

  • Daily breakfast and warm lunch, plus snacks and drinks all day

How we work

We're a team of trading and tech enthusiasts with a flat hierarchy. Have an idea today, and it can ship tomorrow. The best idea wins, whoever it comes from.

This role comes with a high degree of autonomy. You'll own hard problems from concept to production and solve them your way. We promote reverse leadership, give everyone an equal playing field, and invest in personal and professional development.

Our culture

At our core, we are a team of passionate trading and tech enthusiasts committed to revolutionizing trading through automation. Our collaborative approach ensures that everyone contributes to achieving our ambitious goals.

In this role, you will be both challenged and stretched, with ample opportunities for growth and development, both within and beyond your main responsibilities.

We invest in our people by offering competitive compensation and benefits, fostering innovation, and celebrating success. Our commitment to personal development transcends traditional norms; we provide an equal playing field, promote reverse leadership, and offer boundless growth opportunities for all our employees.

Join us to unlock your potential and drive innovation in the exciting world of algorithmic trading.

title: (Junior-) Sales Development Representative (all genders) Outbound & Messen, B2B SaaS für KMU
descriptionHtml:
Buchhaltung ist für die meisten Gründerinnen und Gründer ein Blackbox-Posten: teuer, langsam, und am Ende weiß niemand genau, wofür er zahlt.
mika ändert das. Wir bauen KI-gestützte Buchhaltung, die Unternehmen selbst in die Hand nehmen können, ohne Steuerberater dazwischen. Belegerfassung, Klassifizierung, E-Rechnung, Validierung und Meldungen laufen automatisiert, statt im Monatsrhythmus über einen externen Schreibtisch zu wandern.
Wir sind 30 Leute, betreuen rund 900 Kunden und haben unsere Seed-Runde frisch abgeschlossen.

Aufgaben
Unser Inbound funktioniert. Leute, die uns finden, überzeugen wir. Was wir jetzt aufbauen, ist die andere Richtung: Gespräche mit Unternehmen, die noch gar nicht wissen, dass ihre Buchhaltung ein lösbares Problem ist.
Genau da sitzt du. Du baust deine Pipeline selbst auf, statt eine fertige zu übernehmen.

Outbound (ca. 50 %)

  • Zielkunden identifizieren und priorisieren: Agenturen, Beratungen, SaaS-Unternehmen und E-Commerce im deutschen Mittelstand

  • Eigene Multichannel-Sequenzen aufsetzen (E-Mail, LinkedIn, Telefon) und laufend gegen Antwortraten optimieren

  • Kaltakquise am Telefon, ohne dass es dir die Woche verdirbt

  • Erste Gespräche führen, in denen du Bedarf überhaupt erst sichtbar machst


Qualifizieren und Abschließen (ca. 40 %)

  • Demo-Anfragen und Trials aus Content, Website und Partnern schnell qualifizieren

  • Kurze Qualifizierungs-Calls führen und die tatsächliche Buchhaltungssituation verstehen: aktuelle Kanzlei, Volumen, Systeme, Schmerzpunkte

  • Produktdemos halten, die auf den konkreten Fall zugeschnitten sind statt auf die Feature-Liste

  • Einwände zu Steuerberater-Wechsel, Haftung und Migration sauber auflösen

  • Abschluss und strukturierte Übergabe an Customer Success


Messen und Events (ca. 10 %)

  • Du bist auf Messen und Startup-Events vor Ort, am Stand und davor

  • Du sprichst Leute an, die nicht vorhaben, mit dir zu sprechen, und machst daraus ein Gespräch

  • Gute Gespräche bringst du direkt zum Abschluss, der Rest geht sauber in die Nachverfolgung


Systeme und Zahlen

  • Pipeline sauber in HubSpot führen

  • Deine Conversion-Raten je Stage kennen und wissen, woran es hakt

  • Einwände, Gewinn- und Verlustgründe dokumentieren, damit das ganze Team daraus lernt


Qualifikation
Wir schauen hier mehr auf Persönlichkeit und Richtung als auf Jahre im Lebenslauf.

  • Erste Vertriebserfahrung: Praktikum, Werkstudium oder ein bis zwei Jahre in einer Sales-Rolle, gerne SaaS, gerne auch aus einer ganz anderen Ecke

  • Wirtschaftlicher Hintergrund aus Studium oder Ausbildung. Du musst kein Steuerexperte sein, aber Begriffe wie Gewerbesteuer, Körperschaftsteuer oder Jahresabschluss sind für dich keine Fremdwörter

  • Du gehst von dir aus auf fremde Menschen zu, am Telefon wie am Messestand, und ein Nein bringt dich nicht aus dem Takt

  • Du willst verkaufen und zwar das hier. Unser Produkt verstehst du in Tagen, nicht in Monaten

  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: du weißt zu jedem Zeitpunkt, wo deine Gespräche stehen und warum

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, weil du mit Geschäftsführern über ihre Finanzen sprichst

  • Berlin oder Umzugsbereitschaft



Nice to have

  • Erste eigene Outbound-Erfahrung, Sequenzen von null aufgebaut

  • Erfahrung auf Messen oder im Eventvertrieb

  • Verständnis für Buchhaltung, Steuerberatung oder Fintech-Produkte

  • Erfahrung mit HubSpot oder Sales-Engagement-Tools



Benefits

  • Bis zu 55.000 € Fixgehalt, rund 100.000 € OTE bei guter Zielerreichung, Provision ungedeckelt

  • Ein Produkt mit klarem Kostenvorteil gegenüber dem Status quo

  • Vertriebs- und Kommunikationstraining von Anfang an, du wirst nicht ins kalte Wasser geworfen

  • Direkter Draht zu den Gründern, kurze Entscheidungswege, keine Reporting-Schichten

Hiring-Prozess

title: Junior Sales Manager (m/w/d) – 100 % Inbound, SaaS | Berlin (Hybrid)
descriptionHtml:
Junior Sales Manager (m/w/d) – 100 % Inbound, SaaS | Berlin (Hybrid)

Unbefristet · Vollzeit · Start ab sofort · Berlin, 2 Tage pro Woche im Office

Starte deine Sales-Karriere bei Pennylane in Berlin. Als Junior Sales Manager (intern: Sales Development Representative) arbeitest du 100 % Inbound: Du sprichst mit Unternehmen, die bereits Interesse an unserer Software gezeigt haben, klärst ihren Bedarf und vereinbarst passende Demo-Termine für unsere Account Executives – ohne Kaltakquise. Mit Sales Academy, Buddy und Shadowing lernst du den SaaS-Vertrieb von Grund auf.

Du willst Arbeit, die etwas bewirkt – an einem Produkt, das bald Millionen von Unternehmer:innen in Europa helfen könnte?

Du arbeitest am besten in einer Kultur, die auf Vertrauen und Eigenverantwortung setzt?

Dann könnte Pennylane genau der richtige Ort für dich sein.

Unsere Vision

Unser Ziel ist es, die beliebteste Finanzmanagement-Software für KMU in Europa zu werden.

Wir befreien Unternehmer:innen von zeitraubenden Aufgaben in Buchhaltung und Finanzen und geben ihnen die Finanzkennzahlen an die Hand, die sie für die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen brauchen.

Gleichzeitig helfen wir Steuerkanzleien, weniger Zeit mit repetitiven Aufgaben und mehr Zeit mit der Beratung ihrer Mandant:innen zu verbringen.

Kontext

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich – und wir sind im zweiten Jahr unserer Expansion nach Deutschland, mit unserem deutschen Team in Berlin.

In 6 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

  • 💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Steuerberater:innen bekannt gemacht.

  • 💰 Wir haben insgesamt 400 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, PayPal und viele mehr investiert hat.

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf mehr als 1.100 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

  • 🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeitenden bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

  • 🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen tausender Kund:innen und Steuerkanzleien gewonnen – mit herausragenden Bewertungen.

  • 🚀 Bereits mehr als 1.300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 6.500 Steuerkanzleien nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

Warum ist diese Rolle so wichtig für uns?

Das SDR-Team ist entscheidend dafür, wie wir neue Kund:innen gewinnen.

Als erstes Glied in unserer Sales-Kette prüfen SDRs, welche Anfragen gut zu Pennylane passen, und machen daraus Gesprächstermine – und legen damit die Basis für den Erfolg des gesamten Teams.

Das deutsche SDR-Team besteht aktuell aus 2 Personen, und du gestaltest es mit, während es wächst. Du brauchst keine jahrelange Sales-Erfahrung, um bei uns einzusteigen: Diese Rolle ist als Berufseinstieg im Vertrieb gedacht – wir investieren in dich mit unserer Sales Academy, einem Buddy aus dem Sales-Team und einem klaren Entwicklungsplan.

Wie trägst du zum Projekt bei?

Wir erhalten täglich viele Inbound-Anfragen von Unternehmen, die Pennylane kennenlernen möchten. Genau mit diesen arbeitest du – 100 % Inbound-Vertrieb, Kaltakquise (Outbound) gibt es in dieser Rolle nicht.

Als erste Ansprechperson für unsere zukünftigen Kund:innen verstehst du ihren Bedarf, begeisterst sie für unsere Lösung und vereinbarst eine Demo mit einem Account Executive – der den Deal dann zum Abschluss bringt.

Konkret heißt das:

  • Du reagierst während deiner Arbeitszeit schnell auf neue Anfragen – in der Regel innerhalb weniger Minuten, denn Tempo entscheidet bei Inbound über den Erfolg

  • Du führst strukturierte Erstgespräche (Discovery-Calls) – Unternehmensgröße, aktuelle Buchhaltung, Bedarf, Timing, Entscheider:innen – und erkennst, ob eine Anfrage zum KMU- oder zum Steuerkanzlei-Team gehört

  • Du fasst per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn nach und reaktivierst Leads, die abgetaucht sind oder einen Termin verpasst haben

  • Du übergibst qualifizierte Leads mit einem klaren Briefing an den Account Executive und hältst Salesforce sauber – Lead-Status, Notizen, nächste Schritte

  • Du teilst Erkenntnisse zu Lead-Qualität und -Quellen mit dem Marketing

Dein Erfolg zeigt sich daran, wie viele passende Gesprächstermine du vereinbarst, wie viele davon stattfinden und aus wie vielen konkrete Verkaufschancen entstehen.

Wie sehen deine Aufgaben im Alltag aus?

Deine Verantwortung wächst mit dir – so sieht dein Weg bei uns aus:

Die ersten 3 Monate

  • Onboarding mit Sales Academy, Buddy und Shadowing: Du lernst Pennylane, unser Produkt, die Lead-Typen und unsere Pitches kennen

  • Du führst deine ersten Calls mit Leads aus kleineren Unternehmen

Monat 4 bis 8

  • Du managst deine eigene Inbound-Pipeline in Salesforce und übernimmst zunehmend komplexere Leads

  • Du bringst dich in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Prozesse ein und gibst Kundenfeedback an Produkt, Customer Care und Marketing weiter

Und danach …

  • Mit wachsender Erfahrung übernimmst du zusätzliche Verantwortung: eigene Projekte, die Pflege unserer Wissensdatenbank (Notion) und die Unterstützung neuer Kolleg:innen

  • Abhängig von deiner Leistung und offenen Positionen kannst du dich perspektivisch in Richtung Account Executive entwickeln

Wen wir suchen

title: Junior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.


And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.


Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

About the role

We're looking for a Junior Software Engineer to join our engineering team in London. This is a hybrid role, with a minimum of three days a week in our London office. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who wants to grow quickly, work on real production systems, and learn how a high-growth fintech operates from the inside.

You'll work alongside experienced engineers who will support you through code reviews, pairing and mentorship. We maintain a culture of ownership, and we value engineers who are curious about the business and keen to work with stakeholders to improve processes and the customer experience.

There are opportunities across platform engineering, B2B customer integration, conversion optimisation and business process automation. You'll work on a best-in class Open Banking decision-making platform and learn how to build systems that operate with low latency, at scale.

Our technology stack:

Python (including FastAPI, OpenTelemetry, procrastinate, SQLAlchemy, Uvicorn), Java,

React, Postgres, MySQL, Liquibase, Retool, Docker, AWS

What you’ll be doing

  • Build and maintain features in our backend services, which can span any part of the lending lifecycle – from finding and onboarding new customers, to helping underwriters assess affordability, through to paying out and collecting loans

  • Take part in the full software development lifecycle: contributing to designs, writing tests, reviewing code and helping with deployments

  • Write clean, well-tested code in Python and Java, with guidance and feedback from senior engineers

  • Work with colleagues in Product and Design, as well as internal users, to understand requirements and turn them into working software

  • Help troubleshoot and resolve system issues that affect our customers, as part of a supported team rota during business hours

  • Write and improve SQL queries against our Postgres databases

  • Gradually take ownership of parts of the platform as your experience grows

  • Build and improve frontend features in React, and grow your skills across the full stack

Who you are

  • 0–2 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent experience from a degree, bootcamp, internships or personal projects

  • Working knowledge of Java and Python – you don't need to be an expert, but you're comfortable writing and debugging code in both

  • Hands-on experience building frontend interfaces with React

  • An understanding of core programming concepts such as data structures, object-oriented design and writing unit tests

  • Familiarity with SQL and relational databases

  • Comfortable using Git for version control

  • A genuine interest in fintech and how financial products work

  • A sharp eye for detail – in lending, small mistakes can have a real impact on customers

  • You learn fast, pick up new tools and concepts quickly, and enjoy doing so

  • You thrive in a fast-moving environment, are comfortable finding your way around a large, evolving codebase, and take initiative to work things out

  • Good problem-solving skills and a methodical approach to debugging

  • Clear communicator who asks questions, takes on feedback and works well in a team

  • Keen to work across the full stack, from backend services and databases through to the frontend

  • Able to work from our London office at least three days a week

title: Junior TechOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Hozah

Hozah makes parking automatic. Our cameras recognise your car when you arrive and payment happens by itself when you leave. No apps, no machines, no tickets. We were named PayTech Company of the Year, we sit in Deloitte's list of the 50 fastest growing tech companies in the UK, and we are expanding our estate of automated car parks across the country.

Every site runs on ANPR cameras, payment kiosks, edge devices and 4G connectivity, and all of it has to work around the clock. The TechOps team keeps that estate healthy, and we are looking for a junior engineer to join it.

The role

You will be hands-on from day one, helping to monitor, maintain and fix the technology running in car parks across the country. When a camera drops offline, a kiosk misbehaves or a site stops reporting data, you will be part of the team that works out why and puts it right, usually remotely.

You will learn a genuinely broad set of skills in one role: networking, IoT devices, monitoring, APIs, databases and cloud systems, all on a live estate where your work has visible impact the same day. You will be coached and supported as you grow, with clear standards, documented processes and experienced engineers around you.

What you'll be doing

  • Monitoring the health of cameras, kiosks and network equipment across 150+ car parks, and acting when something looks wrong.

  • Diagnosing and fixing faults across devices, networks and our backend platform, working through problems methodically.

  • Preparing, configuring and shipping hardware for new sites, and supporting site launches.

  • Keeping inventory, configuration records and documentation accurate and up to date.

  • Managing your tickets in Jira with clear notes, sensible prioritisation and proper follow-through.

  • Learning constantly: from the TechOps team, from our developers, and from the estate itself.

What we're looking for

This is a junior role. We care more about fundamentals, honesty and appetite to learn than years of experience.

  • Around 1–2 years of hands-on experience in IT support, infrastructure or technical operations, or strong fundamentals you can demonstrate from projects, a home lab or study.

  • Networking basics you can explain in plain English: what a switch and a router do, what an IP address is, what a VPN is for.

  • A structured instinct when something goes offline: check power, check the network, check the device, in that order.

  • Some awareness of APIs and SQL. You do not need to be fluent; knowing what they are and wanting to use them is enough.

  • Solid Windows knowledge: event logs, command line, system configuration.

  • Organised, reliable and calm when something breaks on a live site.

What this role isn't

  • Corporate IT support. The users of our systems are cameras and cars, and the work is looking after a distributed technology estate.

  • A narrow role. You will touch hardware, networking, software and data in the same week.

  • A dead end. The team is growing, the estate is growing, and there is a clear path to more senior TechOps work as you develop.

Salary, location and working pattern

  • 4 days a week in our Croydon office, 1 day from home, with occasional site visits.

  • Free breakfast, lunch, drinks and snacks in the office, excellent transport links, and two friendly office dogs.

  • You will need the right to work in the UK. A full UK driving licence is handy for site visits.

title: Key Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Hozah

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities. With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte's Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we're one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

And we're only getting started. We currently hold a small share of a large market, which means the opportunity ahead, for the business and for the people who join it now, is huge.

The Role

We're hiring a Key Account Manager to win new logos and then grow them. You'll find and open the door at landowners, managing agents, hotel groups and multi-site operators that have never worked with us, win their first site, and then earn the rest of their estate by delivering and building the relationship from the inside.

This is a target-carrying sales role for someone who loves the hunt. Rather than inheriting a book of accounts to farm, you'll build your own: the accounts you develop will be the ones you win, and the commission you earn on them is uncapped. Cold calling and outbound prospecting are a core part of the job, so it suits someone who enjoys both landing the first deal and then multiplying it.

You won't be running site go-lives, resolving driver appeals or chasing operational issues. Our Client Success Managers own the day-to-day running of each account, so your time goes on the commercial relationship, the next site and the next logo.

Key responsibilities

  • Own a named list of target organisations and be accountable for converting them into Hozah clients — from first cold call to signed contract.

  • Own the growth of every account you win: map the estate, build relationships beyond the original buyer, and secure the next sites and additional services.

  • Hit your sales targets. You will carry a new-logo target and an account-expansion target, with commission on both.

  • Run a disciplined outbound engine: daily cold calling, email and LinkedIn sequences, event follow-up and referral asks, with the activity, pipeline and forecast recorded accurately in the CRM.

  • Run the full sales cycle yourself: discovery, site visits, proposals, commercial negotiation and close, with support from the wider team where a deal needs it.

  • Hand each new site to the Client Success Manager cleanly, with the commitments made in the sale written down, and stay the commercial owner of the relationship after go-live.

  • Hold regular commercial reviews with the accounts you own — performance, value delivered, and what else we can do for them.

  • Feed what you learn from prospects and clients back to the CEO, product and operations, so the proposition keeps improving.

Who we're looking for

We'll explore each of these during the interview process, so come ready with specific examples.

  • A track record of winning new logos in B2B sales, with the numbers to show for it: targets carried, attainment over multiple periods, and deals you personally sourced from cold.

  • A track record of then growing those accounts — not a career spent only developing accounts somebody else won. We want to see both halves: the first win and what you turned it into.

  • Genuine comfort with cold calling and outbound prospecting as a daily discipline, and the resilience to keep going through a run of rejections.

  • The ability to run a consultative sale: ask the questions that uncover the real problem, write a proposal that leads with it, and handle price and timing objections without caving or bulldozing.

  • Commercial judgement on deal structure — knowing when to hold price, what to trade, and when a deal is not worth doing.

  • Pipeline and CRM discipline: a real, repeatable routine for managing, prioritising and forecasting a pipeline.

  • Comfort working alongside an operations and customer success team, handing over cleanly and resisting the temptation to become the client's help desk.

  • Willingness to travel to meet prospects and clients in person across the UK.

title: Key Account Manager Immobilienwirtschaft (m/w/d) – Wohnungsunternehmen & Bestandshalter
descriptionHtml:
Die besser zuhause GmbH unterstützt Menschen dabei, möglichst lange sicher und selbstständig zuhause leben zu können.
Wir planen und koordinieren altersgerechte Badumbauten und Wohnraumanpassungen – von der ersten Beratung über die Fördermittel bis zur handwerklichen Umsetzung.
Dabei verbinden wir schnelle Prozesse, moderne Planung und echtes handwerkliches Verständnis.

Viele unserer Kunden wohnen zur Miete, oft bei Wohnungsunternehmen, Genossenschaften oder großen Bestandshaltern. Für diese Vermieter sind wir ein verlässlicher Partner: Ihre Mieter können länger selbstständig in ihrer Wohnung leben. Die Umbauten werden fachgerecht ausgeführt und dokumentiert, und die Vermieter haben dabei kaum Aufwand.
Als Key Account Manager verantwortest du diese Partnerschaften von Anfang bis Ende. Du gewinnst neue Partner, pflegst die Beziehung und sorgst dafür, dass Genehmigungen für die Umbauten ihrer Mieter schnell und zuverlässig erteilt werden.
Du bist das Gesicht von besser zuhause in der Immobilienwirtschaft und machst aus Kontakten Kooperationen, die für beide Seiten einfach funktionieren.

Aufgaben

Qualifikation

Benefits

Your role goes beyond managing existing business: you will build strong relationships with key stakeholders, understand their business and people development priorities, and identify opportunities to expand the value Speexx brings to their organization. What You'll Bring
