title: Key Account Manager*in - Job mit Purpose
descriptionHtml:
Du willst nicht nur arbeiten – sondern mitgestalten? Dann komm zu uns und werde Teil eines kleinen Purpose getriebenen Teams für eine faire und nachhaltige Arbeitswelt.

Wir sind INES Analytics – ein leidenschaftliches Software-Startup im Herzen Berlins. Unsere Mission: soziale Nachhaltigkeit messbar machen und Unternehmen dabei unterstützen, faire Arbeitsbedingungen zu schaffen.

Um unsere Mission weiter voranzutreiben, suchen wir dich:

eine engagierte Persönlichkeit, die unser Team in Vollzeit (35–40 Std.) verstärkt.

💼 Was dich erwartet

Ein wachsendes Team, eine klare Mission und die Chance, mit deiner Arbeit echten gesellschaftlichen Wandel mitzugestalten – datenbasiert, praxisnah und zukunftsorientiert.

Aufgaben

  • Du betreust Midmarket und Enterprise Kund*innen von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zum erfolgreichen Projektabschluss.

  • Du berätst Unternehmen zu unseren Softwarelösungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihnen die Einführung der Tools.

  • Du koordinierst alle Schritte der Zusammenarbeit – von Angebot und Umsetzung bis zur langfristigen Kundenbetreuung

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Entwickler*innen, und dem Management-Team zusammen

  • Du erkennst neue Potenziale und baust langfristige, vertrauensvolle Kundenbeziehungen auf

  • Du vertrittst INES Analytics auf Messen und Events und erweiterst eigenständig und kontinuierlich dein Netzwerk im HR-Kosmos.

Qualifikation

  • mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Key Account Management und Vertrieb

  • Freude am Kundenkontakt und echtes Interesse an sozialer Nachhaltigkeit

  • im besten Fall bringst du bereits ein Netzwerk aus Personalern mit

  • Kommunikationsstärke, Empathie und Organisationstalent

  • Kundenorientierte Denkweise und sicheres Auftreten

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, gute Englischkenntnisse

  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office und ggf. CRM-Systemen

Benefits

  • Ein großartiger Job mit Purpose: Gemeinsam mit unserem Team schaffst du die Grundlage für eine diskriminierungsfreie Zukunft für alle Beschäftigten in Unternehmen

  • Für jeden Deal, den du mit Neukunden abschließt bekommst du zusätzlich zu deinem Fixgehalt eine Umsatzbeteiligung

  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege

  • Freiraum für eigene Ideen und viele Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Hauptsächliches Arbeiten aus dem Office in Berlin Mitte mit Möglichkeit auf Home Office

  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

  • Apple Arbeitsgeräte

  • Deutschlandticket

  • Tischtennisplatte im Office

Bei uns gibt es keinen endlosen Bewerbungsprozess. Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf und ein kurzes Anschreiben, damit wir ein bisschen mehr über dich erfahren. Wenn's passt, laden wir dich zu einem lockeren Online-Austausch ein. Und wenn wir uns gegenseitig sympathisch finden, geht’s weiter: Willkommen bei uns im Berliner Büro – inklusive Kaffee, Team-Vibe und vielleicht sogar einem kleinen Tischtennismatch zum Abschluss.

Auch intern leben wir Vielfalt und setzen uns aktiv für Chancengleichheit ein. Daher freuen wir uns besonders über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Perspektiven – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Behinderung oder religiöser Zugehörigkeit.

title: Key Account Sales Executive
descriptionHtml:
Key Account Sales Executive – Paris (Office-first)

Team description

Our Paris sales team helps small and growing merchants across France get set up with SumUp's payment tools, often as their very first introduction to the brand. We're a close-knit, target-driven group that thrives on outbound conversations, quick thinking and celebrating wins together. This role gives you a real seat at the table from day one: you'll own conversations end to end, learn the fundamentals of a fast-paced sales cycle and see the direct impact of your work every time a merchant signs up.

What you'll do

  • 💼 Reach out to small business prospects by phone, email and social media, starting the conversation and building the pipeline

  • 🤝 Get to know each business's needs and show how SumUp can genuinely help them

  • 🎤 Run product pitches and demos that turn curiosity into commitment

  • 🔥 Manage the full sales cycle, from first contact through to closing the deal

  • 📊 Track performance against targets and use feedback and data to keep improving

  • 🧠 Share ideas with the team and help build an energised, collaborative office culture

What we're looking for…

  • Experience in outbound sales or business development, with a genuine drive to learn and grow quickly.

  • Comfort working with high volumes of phone-based outreach.

  • Curiosity and confidence when speaking with new people and solving their problems.

  • A results-driven mindset with a track record of working towards targets.

  • Fluency in French and English, given daily contact with local merchants and a global team.

Why you should join SumUp

  • 🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our Paris location. This involves an office-first setup

  • 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

  • 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education

  • 💼 Financial security: corporate pension contributions that support your long-term future

  • 🏥 Healthcare support: we cover 50% of the monthly cost of your health insurance for your Mutuelle and Prévoyance

  • 🚌 Extra allowances: we offer restaurant tickets (Swile) and cover transportation costs

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok.

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

  • Durchführung von Untersuchungen der periodischen Fahrzeugüberwachung (HU/SP)

Sie haben noch keine Führungserfahrung oder sehen bei sich selbst noch Entwicklungsbedarf? Kein Problem – genau dafür planen wir die lange Einarbeitung ein. Wir schauen gemeinsam, where Sie stehen, und entwickeln Sie gezielt weiter:

Du erhältst einen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich, betreust Kunden eigenständig und hast die Möglichkeit, deine Ergebnisse und damit auch deine finanzielle Entwicklung aktiv zu beeinflussen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Eigenständige Kundenbetreuung: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für einen definierten Kundenbereich und bist Ansprechpartner für Kundenanliegen, Rückfragen und Beschwerden.

  • Professionelles Beschwerdemanagement: Du kümmerst dich um anspruchsvolle Kundenanliegen, findest passende Lösungen und führst auch schwierige Gespräche souverän und zielorientiert.

  • Schriftliche Kommunikation: Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Kommunikation per E-Mail. Je nach Situation führst du ergänzend Telefonate oder Videogespräche.

  • Strukturierte Fallbearbeitung: Du analysierst Sachverhalte, priorisierst Anliegen, dokumentierst Vereinbarungen und sorgst dafür, dass offene Vorgänge konsequent bearbeitet werden.

  • Wirtschaftliches Kundenmanagement: Du behältst neben der Kundenzufriedenheit auch die wirtschaftlichen Rahmenbedingungen im Blick und triffst Entscheidungen mit Augenmaß.

  • Zielorientiertes Arbeiten: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich auf gemeinsam vereinbarte Ziele hin und kannst dir durch deine Leistung attraktive zusätzliche Vergütungen sichern.

Das bringst du mit

Wir suchen keinen bestimmten Lebenslauf, sondern die richtige Persönlichkeit.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du kannst dich schriftlich hervorragend ausdrücken und findest auch in schwierigen Situationen die richtigen Worte.

  • Durchsetzungsvermögen: Du kannst freundlich, aber bestimmt kommunizieren, Grenzen setzen und deinen Standpunkt souverän vertreten.

  • Belastbarkeit: Beschwerden, Kritik oder Ablehnung bringen dich nicht aus dem Konzept. Du nimmst Dinge nicht persönlich und behältst einen kühlen Kopf.

  • Struktur und Organisation: Du kannst mehrere Vorgänge parallel bearbeiten, behältst den Überblick und arbeitest zuverlässig.

  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe: Du verstehst komplexere Sachverhalte schnell, erkennst Zusammenhänge und findest eigenständig praktikable Lösungen.

  • Wirtschaftliches Denken: Du hast ein Gespür für sinnvolle Entscheidungen und arbeitest gerne ergebnisorientiert.

  • Eigeninitiative: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand jeden Schritt vorgibt, sondern übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst Dinge selbstständig zum Abschluss.

Erfahrungen im Kundenservice, Beschwerdemanagement, Vertrieb, Account Management oder in der kaufmännischen Sachbearbeitung sind von Vorteil. Auch motivierte Quereinsteiger mit der passenden Persönlichkeit sind ausdrücklich willkommen.

Das bieten wir dir

Deine Leistung soll sich lohnen.

  • Attraktives Vergütungsmodell: Du erhältst eine Kombination aus fixer Vergütung und leistungsabhängigen zusätzlichen Verdienstmöglichkeiten.

  • Überdurchschnittliches Einkommenspotenzial: Bei entsprechender Zielerreichung und überdurchschnittlicher Performance sind attraktive zusätzliche Einkünfte möglich. Deine Entwicklung ist dabei nicht ausschließlich an klassische Gehaltserhöhungen gebunden.

  • Transparente Zielvereinbarungen: Deine Leistung wird anhand gemeinsam definierter Ziele bewertet. Gute Ergebnisse werden finanziell honoriert.

  • Eigenverantwortung: Du erhältst einen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich und kannst deine Arbeit selbstständig gestalten.

  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Wenn du Verantwortung übernehmen und dich weiterentwickeln möchtest, stehen dir bei uns entsprechende Perspektiven offen.

  • Wiese Dental-Benefits: Zusätzlich profitierst du von unseren weiteren Mitarbeiterangeboten und Arbeitgeberleistungen.

Wen wir besonders suchen

Wir suchen jemanden, der nicht bei jeder kritischen E-Mail nervös wird, sondern sich denkt: „Das bekomme ich gelöst.“

Jemanden, der freundlich bleiben kann, ohne sich alles gefallen zu lassen. Der gerne kommuniziert, aber auch weiß, wann eine klare Ansage notwendig ist. Aufgaben

So arbeiten wir

  • Wir sprechen die Sprache unserer Kunden. Unsere Kunden sind 17, 18 oder 19 Jahre alt. Sie melden sich nach der Schule, in der Pause oder kurz vor der Deadline. Sie brauchen jemanden, der geduldig erklärt, verlässlich zurückmeldet und ehrlich sagt, wenn es eng wird.

  • Hybrid, ehrlich gemeint. Unser neues Office liegt im Mindspace in der Uhlandstraße 32, direkt am Kudamm und bestens angebunden, mit allen Annehmlichkeiten eines Coworking Space. Alle weiteren Mindspace Standorte kannst du temporär mitnutzen. Homeoffice und mobiles Arbeiten sind selbstverständlich möglich, solange das Ergebnis stimmt.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Kundenservice oder Support, idealerweise mit Endkunden. Quereinstieg ist ausdrücklich willkommen, etwa aus Hospitality, Hotellerie, Gastronomie, Einzelhandel oder Jugendarbeit.

title: Laboratory technician
descriptionHtml:
About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them - and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

The company is growing fast, and we are now seeking the best talents to come and join our exciting and ambitious team in the fight against cancer - join us!

Position overview

Orakl Oncology works on a large cohort of patient-derived organoids (PDO) to predict clinical outcomes of patients and derisk clinical trials. We are looking for a dynamic and motivated Lab Technician to help us execute large-scale drug screening assays on our semi-automated platform, either for internal or external projects. In this position, you will:

  • Actively participate in our commercial contracts: you will take care of numerous PDOs of interest and perform drug screening assays to generate high-quality, robust datasets. These results will be leveraged by our data science and computational biology teams to deliver actionable insights and decision-support data to our partners.

  • Work on the expansion of the Orakl biobank: you will work on patient specimens and organoid cell lines to increase the amount of data collected, thus improving our understanding of cancer.

  • Contribute to the optimisation procedures at Orakl: you will bring new ideas and approaches to improve automation and accelerate workflows in both 3D cell culture and drug screening experiments.

  • Ensure smooth laboratory operations: you will play a key role in laboratory maintenance, documentation, and traceability of activities, while proactively anticipating the needs for consumables and reagents.

Required qualifications

  • BSc (or equivalent degree such as BTS, BUT, Licence) in cellular biology, biotechnology or any related discipline.

  • Hands-on experience in mammalian cell culture, 3D cell culture and preferably organoid culture.

  • Hands-on experience in drug screening assays or viability assessment assay.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and organisational rigour.

  • Flexibility, and a taste for overcoming operational challenges.

  • A genuine enthusiasm and passion for teamwork and learning.

  • As part of an international team, ability to communicate clearly in English

  • Genuine curiosity for cancer biology.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills to interact in an interdisciplinary setting with biologists, ML engineers and researchers.

  • Previous experience working in cancer biology

  • Fluent in English

Recruitment process

  • HR Call (15 minutes call) – An initial discussion to better understand your background, experiences, and motivations.

  • Technical Interview (45 minutes call) – A deep dive into your technical skills and expertise relevant to the role.

  • Lab Case (Around 90 minutes) - You will be directly manipulating in our labs to demonstrate your ability to follow a specific protocol and to work under aseptic conditions.

  • Founder Interview: As final step of our recruitment process, you will meet the CTO of Orakl Oncology in person at our office. This meeting is an opportunity for the founders to assess cultural fit and ensure alignment with our company values.

title: Langfuse - Senior Cloud Infra Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Why Cloud Infrastructure at Langfuse

Your work will keep Langfuse running — everywhere.

Langfuse processes over a billion trace events per month. When a Fortune 50 company relies on Langfuse in production, they're relying on the infrastructure you operate. You'll own uptime, performance, and cost efficiency across our entire cloud footprint — and you'll make sure every self-hosted deployment runs just as smoothly.

You'll operate Langfuse Cloud on AWS ECS Fargate and ClickHouse Cloud, with Datadog as the observability backbone. You'll also own our public self-hosted infrastructure — including our Helm chart, Docker Compose setup, and everything in between — so that teams from startups to enterprises can run Langfuse on their own terms.

This isn't a "maintain what exists" role. We're scaling fast, and you'll be the person who makes sure the infrastructure grows ahead of demand — not behind it.

Langfuse is now part of ClickHouse, which means the team behind the database at the core of our stack is one channel away. Few infrastructure roles give you that kind of direct access to the people who build your most critical dependency.

 

You will grow at Langfuse by

Own Langfuse Cloud operations: You'll run our production environments on AWS ECS Fargate and ClickHouse Cloud. You'll manage deployments, autoscaling, capacity planning, and cost optimization — making sure we stay fast and affordable as traffic scales.

Build world-class observability: You'll own our Datadog setup end to end — dashboards, alerts, and SLOs. When something degrades, you'll ensure we know before our customers do. You'll build the monitoring culture that lets the whole team ship with confidence.

Make self-hosting effortless: Thousands of teams run Langfuse on their own infrastructure. You'll own and evolve our Helm chart, Docker Compose configuration, and deployment documentation. You'll turn "works on my machine" into "works on every machine" — from a single-node setup to a multi-region enterprise deployment.

Automate everything: CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, automated scaling, zero-downtime deployments. You'll replace manual processes with automation that makes the team faster and the platform more reliable.

Scale for what's next: We're growing fast and new product directions — like complex long-running agent observability and real-time evaluation — push the infrastructure in new ways. You'll be thinking ahead about what breaks at 10x scale and building the foundation before we get there. 10x is always just one quarter away here at Langfuse.

Harden security and compliance: As more enterprises adopt Langfuse, you'll help ensure our cloud and self-hosted deployments meet the security and compliance bar that large organizations require.

 

What we're looking for

  • Strong infrastructure or SRE engineer who gets excited about running systems at scale and making them better every day

  • Experience operating production workloads on AWS (ECS/Fargate, networking, IAM, S3, etc.) or on comparable hyperscale vendors.

  • Comfortable with container orchestration — Kubernetes and/or ECS, Helm charts, Docker

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, or similar)

  • Strong monitoring and observability instincts — you've built dashboards and alerts that actually caught problems (Datadog experience is a plus)

  • You organize yourself. You have strong opinions about reliability, automation, and how to ship infrastructure changes safely

  • Interest in open source software and genuine enjoyment helping users debug their self-hosted deployments

  • Thrives in a small, accountable team where your output is visible and matters

  • CS or quantitative degree preferred

Bonus points:

  • Experience with ClickHouse Cloud or other managed analytical databases

  • Background in operating high-throughput event processing or observability infrastructure

  • Contributions to open source infrastructure tooling (Helm charts, Terraform modules, etc.)

  • Former founder

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

title: LCA Working Student
descriptionHtml:
👷🏻‍♀️ What we do 👷🏻‍♀️

At Emidat, we are building the first climate-native product management system for building material manufacturers. We aim to decarbonise building materials, making up 11% of global GHG emissions. We collect data from physical production processes, generate a digital product passport with verified environmental data and make it usable along the value chain. In short: One solution to assess, design, buy, sell and manage products - with environmental impact at the core.

With this, we are building the digital infrastructure to make it faster, easier, and more sustainable to build the world around us.

Find out more about us, the team and our values here.

What you will work on

Your mission

Join our LCA team as a Working Student (10-20 h/week) and support the work that sits underneath every Environmental Product Declaration (EPD) we produce. Your focus will be raw material matching, the backbone of every EPD and LCA. You will work with the ecoinvent database and our Emidat Ecomapping tool, and research LCA topics such as product category rule (PCR) requirements. You'll gain hands-on experience supporting the day-to-day LCA team, who are responsible for the correct calculation of LCA results in the Emidat App.
At the same time, you'll dive into the building materials industry itself — getting to know manufacturers of cement, steel, windows, construction chemicals, asphalt, electronic building equipment, and many more, and understanding how differently each of them approaches EPDs and LCAs. This gives you insight into a diverse product spectrum with different peculiarities from an LCA perspective, which is valuable for building broader experience in LCA.
There is also the long-term opportunity to support and supervise a practical master's thesis within the Emidat environment. Our LCA team has experience supervising academic theses.

In the first 6 months, you will

  • Match raw materials: Carry out raw material matchings, mapping the product's input materials to the ecoinvent database. Ecoinvent is the most widely used environmental database for LCA worldwide, so in-depth knowledge of it is a core advantage for working with LCAs. In the material mapping, you'll be supported by our Emidat Ecomapping tool.

  • Research LCA topics: Look into LCA questions as they come up, such as PCR requirements. Experience the process of translating LCA calculation rules into software logic that delivers both correct results and usability for customers.

  • Support the LCA team: Back up the LCA team in its day-to-day business. Gain first insights into customer requests with varying levels of LCA experience — a crucial skill for working as, e.g., an LCA consultant.

What you will bring to this role

Minimum requirements

  • Studies: You are enrolled in a degree programme in LCA, sustainability, chemistry or materials science.

  • First LCA experience: Experience working with Life Cycle Assessments, whether through coursework, a thesis, an internship or preferably, a previous intern/working student role.

  • Database: Hands on experience using the Ecoinvent database to make assessments, or run matchings

  • AI native: Hands-on experience using AI tools to automate a workflow, analyse data, or accelerate a deliverable — comfortable experimenting with new AI features as they emerge.

  • Project Management: Demonstrated previous experience taking projects from start to finish - owning, structuring and driving the measurable outcomes.

  • Languages: Business fluent in English (C1/C2).

Nice to have’s

  • Language: Fluency in German.

  • Experience: Working with Emidat or another common LCA software

  • Industry Interest: Relevant work experience, education or interest in the sector. Demonstrated through engagement with climate topics, the building materials / construction industry, or how software can capture complex technical processes.

How we support you

Your manager / team lead will be

  • Benedikt Dellawalle - Team Lead, LCA

You will work closely with

  • Anna Sander-Titgemeyer, LCA Expert

  • Jonas van der Ham, LCA Expert

  • Areeba Qureshi, LCA Expert

  • Elahe Shirkhan, LCA Expert

title: Lead AI Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Worum es geht

MAIA ist eine KI-Plattform für Unternehmen. Mit MAIA durchsuchen Teams ihre internen Daten und verankern Agenten tief in ihren Prozessen. Wir begleiten Unternehmen dabei, KI nicht nur in einzelnen Abteilungen, sondern im ganzen Unternehmen einzusetzen.

Technisch heißt das: Wir bauen eine GenAI-Anwendung mit eigenen Agentensystemen, RAG-Pipelines und agentenbasierten Workflows, binden externe Systeme unserer Kunden an und analysieren ihre Daten. Wir nutzen die besten verfügbaren Modelle, betrieben in der EU, und machen sie verlässlich für anspruchsvolle Arbeit mit großen, komplexen Datenmengen.

Zahlreiche Industrieunternehmen arbeiten seit Jahren intensiv mit MAIA. Nach unserer erfolgreichen Finanzierungsrunde 2026 bringen wir MAIA jetzt in die Breite. Entwickelt wird MAIA seit 2021 in Leipzig.

Was du bei uns machst

Als Lead AI Engineer führst du unser Engineering-Team in Leipzig, entwickelst rund drei Viertel deiner Zeit selbst mit und arbeitest eng mit unserem CTO zusammen.

Deine Schwerpunkte:

  • Selbst entwickeln. Du übernimmst anspruchsvolle Features und Architekturthemen in unseren Agenten-, RAG- und Workflow-Systemen und schreibst Pläne, an denen sich andere orientieren.

  • Technische Richtung. Du triffst wichtige Designentscheidungen mit, priorisierst gemeinsam mit dem CTO die technische Roadmap und treibst die technische Vision von MAIA voran.

  • Das Team anführen. Du koordinierst die Arbeit im Team und bist Sparringspartner für alle Engineers, in Designdiskussionen, Reviews und Feedback. Du führst technische Interviews und entscheidest mit, wen wir einstellen.

  • Besser werden, gemeinsam. Mit dem Team verbesserst du laufend, wie wir entwickeln, gerade im agentischen Arbeiten: von Plänen und Reviews über Evals bis zu Releases.

  • Am Puls der Technik. Du verfolgst neue Entwicklungen bei LLMs, Retrieval, Agenten und darüber hinaus, bewertest sie nüchtern und bringst ins Produkt, was trägt.

Was wir suchen

  • Ein herausragender AI Engineer. Du hast LLM-Systeme gebaut und in Produktion betrieben. RAG, Embeddings, Vektorsuche, Tool Calling und Agenten kennst du aus der Praxis, auch die Stellen, an denen sie scheitern. Neue Modelle und Techniken probierst du aus eigenem Antrieb aus und trennst dabei Substanz von Hype.

  • Starke Architektur. Du hast Backend-Systeme gebaut, ausgeliefert und über längere Zeit in Produktion betrieben. Du triffst Designentscheidungen, die auch in einem Jahr noch tragen, und erkennst schwache Architektur auch dann, wenn ein Coding Agent sie geschrieben hat.

  • Sehr gut in mindestens einer unserer Sprachen. TypeScript, Python oder Go, am besten eine der statisch typisierten. Alle drei musst du nicht mitbringen. In die anderen arbeitest du dich ein.

  • Technische Führung. Du hast ein Team als Tech Lead, Lead Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle fachlich geführt. Wie die Rolle hieß, ist zweitrangig. Du gibst Verantwortung ab und freust dich, wenn das Team ohne dich gute Entscheidungen trifft. Gleichzeitig entwickelst du gern selbst weiter, denn diese Rolle ist keine reine Managementrolle.

  • Messen statt vermuten. Du weißt, wie man Systeme testet und evaluiert, die auf dieselbe Frage nicht immer gleich antworten. Du baust die einfachste Lösung, die das Problem löst. Weitere Retrieval-Stufen, Prompt-Ketten oder Abstraktionen kommen erst dazu, wenn Messungen sie rechtfertigen.

  • Agentisch arbeiten. Coding Agents gehören für dich zum Alltag. Du hast eine klare Meinung dazu, wie ein Team mit ihnen schnell bleibt, ohne an Qualität zu verlieren.

  • Sicherheit mitdenken. Unsere Kunden vertrauen uns ihr internes Wissen an. Mandantentrennung, Zugriffsrechte und sichere Entwicklung sind für dich selbstverständlich.

  • Klar kommunizieren. Du sprichst Probleme früh an, argumentierst mit Belegen und erklärst technische Entscheidungen verständlich, im Team ebenso wie gegenüber Produktmanagement, Customer Success und Vertrieb. Du sprichst sehr sicher Deutsch und ebenso Englisch.

Arbeiten bei MAIA

Uns verbindet ein gemeinsames Ziel: ein richtig gutes Produkt zu bauen. Jede und jeder übernimmt Verantwortung für das eigene Thema. Wir haben Spaß an der Arbeit und sind stolz auf das, was unsere Kunden mit MAIA erreichen. Die Wege sind kurz, und Entscheidungen fallen schnell. Im Engineering-Team hinterfragen wir kritisch, wie wir entwickeln, und verbessern unsere Prozesse laufend, gerade in der agentischen Entwicklung.

Wir arbeiten gern zusammen in unserem Büro, zentral zwischen Innenstadt und Zoo, und kochen fast jeden Tag gemeinsam. An mindestens drei Tagen pro Woche sind wir vor Ort, an den übrigen arbeitest du, wo du möchtest. Wann dein Tag beginnt, legst du selbst fest.

  • Zugang zu aktuellen Frontier-Modellen und Coding Agents

  • Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungen, auch zu Führungsthemen

  • Zugang zu einer Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft

Vergütung

Das Jahresbruttogehalt liegt bei 90.000 bis 100.000 €. Wo du in dieser Spanne liegst, besprechen wir spätestens nach dem Interview zu Technik und Führung. Dazu kommt eine virtuelle Beteiligung über unser VSOP.

Bewerbung und nächste Schritte

Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte uns in ein paar eigenen Sätzen eine Frage: Warum willst du MAIA mitgestalten?

Wir arbeiten jeden Tag mit KI. Für diese Antwort zählt aber deine eigene Perspektive. Schreib sie deshalb bitte selbst, gern kurz und ohne Feinschliff.

Passt es, folgen ein 30-minütiges Kennenlernen, ein 90-minütiges Interview zu Technik und Führung und ein Abschlussgespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Nach jedem Schritt hörst du in der Regel innerhalb von zwei Werktagen von uns. Unser Ziel ist eine Entscheidung in rund drei Wochen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Lead AI Engineer - ML/LLM Ops & Agentic AI
descriptionHtml:
Shift delivers AI agents that transform insurers' most critical work. By combining deep industry expertise and unmatched data resources, Shift provides proven results that have earned the trust of hundreds of the world's leading insurers. Our insurance-grade AI is accurate, explainable, and secure—empowering human experts to move with unmatched speed, total confidence, and a renewed focus on the people they serve.

Our culture is built on innovation, trust, and a drive to transform the insurance industry through our SaaS platform. We come from more than 50 different countries and cultures and together we are creating the future of insurance.

Learn more at www.shift-technology.com

ABOUT THE ROLE

At Shift, we are building the next generation of AI-driven platform capabilities. We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Lead AI Engineer in our Data & AI Platform Engineering team to drive our LLMOps roadmap and our most business-critical agentic use cases; someone who is deeply passionate about building, prototyping, and scaling modern AI/LLM systems, while leading a small team.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role for a senior builder who excels at the intersection of cutting-edge AI technologies (Agentic frameworks, LLM orchestration, MCP, GenAI, MLOps) and production-grade software engineering. You will lead a focused team of engineers and work directly with software engineers and product leaders to design, prototype, and ship state-of-the-art AI systems into production, while acting as the link with our Data Science team to align priorities with their needs and spread best practices.

If you are a senior AI engineer looking for the next step in your career, where you can lead people and shape a roadmap without giving up hands-on coding and building, this role is for you.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build agentic systems (hands-on): design and ship production-grade agentic workflows (LLM orchestration, tool calling, MCP, RAG, structured outputs), and define reference architectures that decide what a model handles and what deterministic code handles.
  • Own LLMOps standards: evaluation harnesses, prompt and agent versioning, tracing (OpenTelemetry), cost and token governance, and release gates, with tenant-aware patterns that respect client data isolation.
  • Evolve our ML platform: be the technical owner of our Databricks-based ML platform (Unity Catalog, MLflow, CI/CD to serving on AKS, monitoring), and extend it toward the agent and prompt lifecycle.
  • Run & Serve Open-Weight Models: Partner closely with our Cloud Ops team to design and deploy the architecture required to self-host open-weight foundation models internally. You will own the inference layer and model optimizations (latency, throughput), while collaborating seamlessly with Cloud Ops on GPU resource provisioning and cluster management.  
  • Push the frontier: run time-boxed POCs on emerging techniques, such as relational foundation models for claims fraud detection or agentic ingestion of medical billing sources to generate claim edits, with clear success criteria and a path to production.
  • Lead and grow the team: coach and develop 2 to 5 people, raise the technical bar through design and code reviews, and partner with product, SMEs, architecture, security and SRE.

 

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Agentic AI expertise: proven experience building production agentic systems (Microsoft Agent Framework, OpenAI Agents SDK, PydanticAI, LangGraph or custom), and strong command of tool calling, MCP, RAG and evaluation.
  • MLOps and engineering: high proficiency in Python; hands-on experience with experiment tracking, model registry, serving and monitoring (ideally Databricks and MLflow); backend services on Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform and event-driven patterns.
  • Applied ML curiosity: solid ML foundations, ability to judge new approaches critically; exposure to graph ML, fraud or claims data is a plus.
  • Software design: high proficiency in Python and strong experience with OOP; proven ability to design robust, maintainable software systems and write clean code, applying the right design patterns and software engineering best practices.
  • Leadership: experience leading technical initiatives across stakeholders, and coaching or managing technical contributors (or a clear motivation to do so).
  • English fluency required; French is a plus.

 

HOW YOU WORK (Shift High-Impact Behaviors)

  • Jump in and get things done: You are a proactive builder who loves turning ambitious ideas into working code. You don't wait for permission to solve hard problems.
  • Make things simpler: You can break down complex AI concepts and architectures into clear, executable steps for engineers, data scientists, and non-technical partners alike.
  • Test & learn new things: You are genuinely obsessed with the fast-moving AI landscape. You constantly experiment with new models, libraries, and papers, and know how to extract real product value from the hype.
  • Communicate with impact & help others grow: You lead by example and collaboration, upskilling team members through pair programming, code reviews, and pragmatic design discussions.

RECRUITMENT PROCESS

  • A first fit call with our Talent Acquisition Specialist
  • A couple of interviews to test your leadership & technical skills
  • A final round at our office with multiple interviews inc. with some of our co-founders

#LI-RH1 #LI-HYBRID 

To support our permanent, full time employees at every stage of their careers and lives, we provide a competitive total rewards and benefits package. Here are the global benefits we’d like to highlight:

  • Flexible remote and hybrid working options
  • Competitive Salary and a variable component tied to personal and company performance
  • Multiple Learning and Development opportunities, including Focus Fridays, a half-day each month to focus on learning and personal growth
  • Generous PTO and paid holidays
  • Mental health benefits

  • Review designs and mentor engineers
  • Raise the quality bar across initiatives

5. Grow AI Capability

  • Mentor AI Engineers and Agent Builders
  • Share knowledge and reusable components
  • Build AI expertise within your organization

Success Metrics

  • Adoption within the domain

  • Team capability growth

  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models
  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases
  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

You'll Love This Job If you have

  • 7+ years in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, or Applied AI
  • Strong experience with LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, evaluation, and production systems
  • Ability to influence Product and Business decisions
  • Proven leadership on complex cross-functional initiatives

title: Lead AI Engineer (m/w/d) – Remote
descriptionHtml:
Worum es geht

MAIA ist eine KI-Plattform für Unternehmen. Mit MAIA durchsuchen Teams ihre internen Daten und verankern Agenten tief in ihren Prozessen. Wir begleiten Unternehmen dabei, KI nicht nur in einzelnen Abteilungen, sondern im ganzen Unternehmen einzusetzen.

Technisch heißt das: Wir bauen eine GenAI-Anwendung mit eigenen Agentensystemen, RAG-Pipelines und agentenbasierten Workflows, binden externe Systeme unserer Kunden an und analysieren ihre Daten. Wir nutzen die besten verfügbaren Modelle, betrieben in der EU, und machen sie verlässlich für anspruchsvolle Arbeit mit großen, komplexen Datenmengen.

Zahlreiche Industrieunternehmen arbeiten seit Jahren intensiv mit MAIA. Nach unserer erfolgreichen Finanzierungsrunde 2026 bringen wir MAIA jetzt in die Breite. Entwickelt wird MAIA seit 2021 in Leipzig.

Was du bei uns machst

Als Lead AI Engineer führst du unser Engineering-Team, entwickelst rund drei Viertel deiner Zeit selbst mit und arbeitest eng mit unserem CTO zusammen.

Deine Schwerpunkte:

  • Selbst entwickeln. Du übernimmst anspruchsvolle Features und Architekturthemen in unseren Agenten-, RAG- und Workflow-Systemen und schreibst Pläne, an denen sich andere orientieren.

  • Technische Richtung. Du triffst wichtige Designentscheidungen mit, priorisierst gemeinsam mit dem CTO die technische Roadmap und treibst die technische Vision von MAIA voran.

  • Das Team anführen. Du koordinierst die Arbeit im Team und bist Sparringspartner für alle Engineers, in Designdiskussionen, Reviews und Feedback. Du führst technische Interviews und entscheidest mit, wen wir einstellen.

  • Besser werden, gemeinsam. Mit dem Team verbesserst du laufend, wie wir entwickeln, gerade im agentischen Arbeiten: von Plänen und Reviews über Evals bis zu Releases.

  • Am Puls der Technik. Du verfolgst neue Entwicklungen bei LLMs, Retrieval, Agenten und darüber hinaus, bewertest sie nüchtern und bringst ins Produkt, was trägt.

Was wir suchen

  • Ein herausragender AI Engineer. Du hast LLM-Systeme gebaut und in Produktion betrieben. RAG, Embeddings, Vektorsuche, Tool Calling und Agenten kennst du aus der Praxis, auch die Stellen, an denen sie scheitern. Neue Modelle und Techniken probierst du aus eigenem Antrieb aus und trennst dabei Substanz von Hype.

  • Starke Architektur. Du hast Backend-Systeme gebaut, ausgeliefert und über längere Zeit in Produktion betrieben. Du triffst Designentscheidungen, die auch in einem Jahr noch tragen, und erkennst schwache Architektur auch dann, wenn ein Coding Agent sie geschrieben hat.

  • Sehr gut in mindestens einer unserer Sprachen. TypeScript, Python oder Go, am besten eine der statisch typisierten. Alle drei musst du nicht mitbringen. In die anderen arbeitest du dich ein.

  • Technische Führung. Du hast ein Team als Tech Lead, Lead Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle fachlich geführt. Wie die Rolle hieß, ist zweitrangig. Du gibst Verantwortung ab und freust dich, wenn das Team ohne dich gute Entscheidungen trifft. Gleichzeitig entwickelst du gern selbst weiter, denn diese Rolle ist keine reine Managementrolle.

  • Messen statt vermuten. Du weißt, wie man Systeme testet und evaluiert, die auf dieselbe Frage nicht immer gleich antworten. Du baust die einfachste Lösung, die das Problem löst. Weitere Retrieval-Stufen, Prompt-Ketten oder Abstraktionen kommen erst dazu, wenn Messungen sie rechtfertigen.

  • Agentisch arbeiten. Coding Agents gehören für dich zum Alltag. Du hast eine klare Meinung dazu, wie ein Team mit ihnen schnell bleibt, ohne an Qualität zu verlieren.

  • Remote führen. Du führst auch aus der Ferne wirksam. Du kommunizierst proaktiv, machst Entscheidungen schriftlich nachvollziehbar und bist für das Team gut erreichbar.

  • Sicherheit mitdenken. Unsere Kunden vertrauen uns ihr internes Wissen an. Mandantentrennung, Zugriffsrechte und sichere Entwicklung sind für dich selbstverständlich.

  • Klar kommunizieren. Du sprichst Probleme früh an, argumentierst mit Belegen und erklärst technische Entscheidungen verständlich, im Team ebenso wie gegenüber Produktmanagement, Customer Success und Vertrieb. Du sprichst sehr sicher Deutsch und ebenso Englisch.

Arbeiten bei MAIA

Uns verbindet ein gemeinsames Ziel: ein richtig gutes Produkt zu bauen. Jede und jeder übernimmt Verantwortung für das eigene Thema. Wir haben Spaß an der Arbeit und sind stolz auf das, was unsere Kunden mit MAIA erreichen. Die Wege sind kurz, und Entscheidungen fallen schnell. Im Engineering-Team hinterfragen wir kritisch, wie wir entwickeln, und verbessern unsere Prozesse laufend, gerade in der agentischen Entwicklung.

Ein großer Teil des Teams arbeitet gemeinsam in unserem Büro in Leipzig, zentral zwischen Innenstadt und Zoo, und kocht fast jeden Tag zusammen. Du arbeitest remote von überall in Deutschland, dein Wohnsitz muss in Deutschland liegen. Zweimal im Jahr treffen wir uns zu Team-Events, und ab und zu gibt es Teamtage in Leipzig. Wann dein Tag beginnt, legst du selbst fest.

  • Zugang zu aktuellen Frontier-Modellen und Coding Agents

  • Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungen, auch zu Führungsthemen

  • Zugang zu einer Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft

Vergütung

Das Jahresbruttogehalt liegt bei 90.000 bis 100.000 €. Wo du in dieser Spanne liegst, besprechen wir spätestens nach dem Interview zu Technik und Führung. Dazu kommt eine virtuelle Beteiligung über unser VSOP.

Bewerbung und nächste Schritte

Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte uns in ein paar eigenen Sätzen eine Frage: Warum willst du MAIA mitgestalten?

Wir arbeiten jeden Tag mit KI. Für diese Antwort zählt aber deine eigene Perspektive. Schreib sie deshalb bitte selbst, gern kurz und ohne Feinschliff.

Passt es, folgen ein 30-minütiges Kennenlernen, ein 90-minütiges Interview zu Technik und Führung und ein Abschlussgespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Nach jedem Schritt hörst du in der Regel innerhalb von zwei Werktagen von uns. Unser Ziel ist eine Entscheidung in rund drei Wochen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Lead Analytics Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We’re on a mission to back the UK’s small businesses like no one else 🚀

Small businesses are the backbone of the economy, and we’re here to help them win. We’ve built a platform that uses clever data to get them the funding they need in minutes, not weeks.

At Funding Circle, we have the restless energy of a fintech start-up with the stability of a public company. It’s a unique mix that gives Circlers the autonomy to take ownership and the scale to make an impact that truly counts.

We’re a high-performing team that chooses to lift each other up. We challenge, we champion, and we have each other’s backs - because we know that when we stand together, we move faster and build better.

The impact is real: Last year alone, the businesses on our platform generated £7.2bn for the UK economy 📈 Come and join a mission that matters!

[Read our Impact Report] | [See our Trustpilot]

The role ⚡

📍 London (Hybrid) | 🤝 2 days in the office | 💰 Competitive Salary + Benefits

 

You’ll make a real difference for our customers and your team from day one. We believe the fastest way to grow is by doing, so we give you the ownership to run with things and see real-time results.

  • Owns the data modelling strategy, sets standards for data modelling, transformations, and governance.

  • Leads the design and implementation of new features,, such as the creation of a new star schema and other best practices to optimise data usability.

  • Sets best practices and standards on how we use SQL & dbt / Python / Pyspark and/or other languages to solve business problems.

  • Becomes an expert in the business subject area the team are working on, holding expertise on both the business requirements as well as the technical implementation.

  • Delivers high quality code, provides technical mentorship and ensures the team is building scalable, maintainable data models.

  • Co-owns the backlog with the Engineering Manager and helps to break down technical requirements.

 

What we’re looking for 🌱

We value deep expertise, but a growth mindset and good energy are what really make our team click. We’re a group that chooses to lift each other up and think smart every day.

 

  • Extensive experience in SQL / Python / Pyspark and/or other languages relevant to data processing

  • Extensive experience in dbt and ideally Airflow (or other orchestration tools)

  • Extensive experience in Entity-Relationship modelling and Dimensional modelling

  • Experience with Cloud Data Warehousing (eg Snowflake, Databricks or BigQuery) and Cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure)

  • Familiarity with Tableau

  • Excellent communication and problem solving skills and the ability to translate business requirements into technical requirements

  • Able to architect custom AI solutions and smart automated systems that are safe, maintainable, and aligned with our long-term mission

  • Act as a technical bridge and mentor, training “builders" across the company to move from basic AI usage to sophisticated system creation

Experience we’d love to see:

  • Working background in Fintech/Financial Services would be highly preferred, but not essential.

We’re building a place where everyone truly feels they belong. Even if your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement, we'd still love to hear from you.

Why join us? 💜

We back you to build an incredible career and by joining us, you'll be part of one of The Sunday Times Best Companies to Work For 2026! As a flexible-first employer, we use a "best of both" approach. We’ll see you in our London office to collaborate – with barista coffee and subsidised Just Eat lunches on us!

  • Flexibility: We provide a benefit allowance you can tailor to your own life and family.

  • Health: This includes private medical and dental, health assessments, and access to a digital GP.

  • Wealth: We offer life assurance, share schemes, and financial coaching.

  • Development: You get a dedicated annual learning allowance to help you level up.

  • Lifestyle: We have electric car and cycle-to-work schemes, plus season ticket loans.

We also have award-winning parental leave policies. We're here to support you through the big life moments, from fertility treatments to new additions to the family.

title: Lead Applied AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Why loveholidays?

We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway.

Our trailblaze together culture is what drives our success, powered by our people and the way they work. Using progressive technology, we drive cutting-edge innovation and improve how our customers discover, book and experience their holidays. You’ll have the opportunity to accelerate your growth through meaningful challenges, new experiences and the freedom to shape your own path. You’ll create impact for our future by taking ownership, contributing to shared goals and helping shape what comes next, all as part of our enhanced international community of talented, collaborative and passionate teams.

 

The difference you’ll make

You’ll lead the Applied AI team within the wider AI Centre of Excellence, setting technical direction and managing the engineers who build, administer and improve the AI-enabled systems and SaaS platforms that support our customers and colleagues. You’ll work closely with business verticals, engineering, security and senior stakeholders to turn business priorities into a clear roadmap and measurable outcomes.

You’ll combine people management with hands-on technical leadership across applied and agentic AI workflows, SaaS services, integrations and data pipelines. You’ll guide architecture and delivery, develop the team’s capabilities and own relationships with third-party SaaS suppliers, ensuring our platforms are reliable, secure and deliver value for money.

The team sits within Business IT & AI Operations. You’ll provide the direction, governance and operational ownership that help loveholidays scale intelligent automation and well-run business systems safely and effectively, balancing new opportunities with service quality, cost and long-term maintainability.

Your day-to-day:

  • Lead and line-manage Applied AI engineers, setting clear goals, providing regular feedback and coaching, supporting career development and managing performance. Help recruit and onboard new team members as the team grows.

  • Set the team’s technical direction and delivery roadmap with business and technology stakeholders, prioritising work, allocating capacity and managing dependencies to deliver measurable business outcomes.

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership for applied and agentic AI workflows, integrations and automation pipelines, guiding architecture, reviewing designs and code, and contributing to complex or high-impact engineering work.

  • Set standards for building, testing and evaluating tool-using agents with Google ADK or similar frameworks, including safe tool access, human oversight and production readiness.

  • Own operational performance across AI-enabled services and SaaS platforms, including service health, access, releases, usage and cost. Lead incident escalation and continuous improvement, with clear evaluation criteria and service measures.

  • Own account management for third-party SaaS suppliers, acting as the primary relationship owner and running regular service and roadmap reviews. Hold suppliers accountable for agreed service levels, resolve escalations and coordinate their delivery with internal priorities.

  • Manage the supplier and contract lifecycle with procurement, finance, legal and security, covering selection, onboarding, licensing, commercial negotiations, contractual obligations, renewals, notice dates and exit planning. title: Lead Backend Engineer, Service Standards
descriptionHtml:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As a Lead Backend Engineer in the Service Standards team, you will shape how services are built, deployed, and operated across all of Vinted. You will work closely with a team on the development of our core service framework—providing engineering teams with golden paths, robust service contracts, standardized tooling, and performance benchmarks to ensure high reliability and developer velocity at scale.


You will sit in the Service Standards team, part of the Service Ecosystem domain, reporting to the Engineering Manager of that team.


The Service Standards team is responsible for standardizing service startup, consumer APIs, and foundational backend frameworks across Vinted's engineering landscape. Within it, this is a senior individual-contributor role combining technical leadership with high autonomy—you will define architectural directions, establish best practices, and guide engineers across domains without requiring full management overhead.


You will collaborate closely with platform, observability, and product engineering teams to ensure our service framework and standards seamlessly integrate into daily workflows. Your work will directly impact developer experience, platform reliability, and system performance as Vinted continues to scale.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Lead the technical direction and design around service standards and golden paths.
  • Define and evolve company-wide service standards, including consumer APIs, service contracts, startup routines, and performance guidelines.
  • Build reusable backend libraries, tools, and scaffolding to streamline new service creation and maintenance.
  • Partner with backend engineers across domains to drive adoption of framework updates and gather continuous feedback.
  • Evaluate pragmatic trade-offs between architectural consistency, delivery speed, and technical debt across the platform.
  • Collaborate with Observability and Infrastructure teams to integrate telemetry, SLOs, and resilience practices into standard service templates.
  • Ensure security, privacy, and compliance guidelines are embedded directly into service contracts and framework templates.
  • Mentor senior backend engineers, participate in architectural design reviews, and foster high engineering standards across teams.
  • Drive architectural proposals (RFCs/ADRs) for platform-wide backend standardization.

About you 

  • Have deep backend engineering experience and strong architectural intuition, with proven success building scalable services and frameworks.
  • Demonstrate a track record of driving cross-team technical alignment and leading complex initiatives across multiple engineering groups.
  • Possess expert knowledge in designing API contracts, service startup patterns, and performance optimization.
  • Understand trade-offs in platform design and know how to build golden paths that engineers love to use.
  • Communicate technical vision and architectural choices clearly to both technical leads and engineering leadership.
  • Enjoy mentoring engineers, conducting design reviews, and sharing best practices to level up the backend engineering community.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
  • Company bike leasing scheme
  • Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
  • Work from Home allowance 
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:€93.500—€126.500 EUR

title: Lead Country Commercial Manager for Business Management Software
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

  • Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
  • Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
  • Over $300 million raised in funding
  • 3,000 Tideans globally
  • Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
  • We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About the team 

The Business Management Software commercial team are responsible for driving adoption and usage of essential products for Small Business Owners. This includes Tide’s range of accounting packages, as well as invoicing, expense management, payroll and Company Formations / Company consistent value to members and a consistent revenue stream to Tide. The team works closely with Product, Finance, Business Insights, CRM and Operations teams to translate member and commercial insights into appealing product enhancements, effective positioning, and strategies that enhance engagement and retention. 

About the role 

We’re looking for an exceptional Lead Country Commercial Manager to scale revenue growth across our Accounting, Tax and Payroll products (part of our BMS suite, known internally as ‘Admin Services’) and build an indirect distribution channel via Partners & Accountants.

You will sit at the heart of Tide’s commercial function and be responsible for collaborating with cross-functional teams (mainly Marketing, Product, Finance) to understand funnel conversion, campaign(s) performance and product prioritisation, whilst owning competitor and market insight and leading new product go-to-market (GTM) launch plans. Excellent organisation, strategy and communication skills essential.

Key areas of this role:

  • Revenue Ownership & Forecasting: Partner closely with Finance and key stakeholders to set, track, and refine commercial projections for the Accounting, Tax & Payroll products ensuring revenue accountability and proactive identification of risks and opportunities.
  • Accountants Strategy & GTM planning: Research UK Accountants market and build a clear, concise and financially robust indirect model to help Tide scale their BMS products and others with Accountants.
  • Competitor and Market insight: Regularly analyse key competitor movements and wider industry trends - relevant to Accounting, Tax, Payroll and Accountants - translating insight into actionable strategies that strengthen and differentiate Tide’s positioning and value proposition.
  • Analytics-Driven Insight: Analyse (via BI team) member behaviour, segment audiences, subscription cohort performance and create clear recommendations to shape product prioritisation, pricing, positioning and communications.
  • Product Development: Partner with the Product teams to assess opportunities to shape product positioning, product led growth, aligning on roadmaps and supporting  successful product launches with tailored GTM strategies.
  • Launch Strategy: Support new feature launches across channels and operational teams to deliver best-in-class experiments. 
  • Stakeholder Management: High levels of communication with a wide range of stakeholders, including Tide’s Senior Leadership Team and Executives.
  • Member Obsession: You will be or become an expert in the core motivations of our members in order to focus on bringing their voice to commercial and product design discussions.

What we are looking for 

  • Strong commercial acumen:  Proven experience in driving commercial impact, partnering with finance to understand performance and identify opportunities to improve.  Able to set and track clear KPIs across all initiatives to meet revenue goals.
  • Accountancy software experience: Understanding of software and experience scaling software at either an Accountancy software company or with Accountants.
  • 5+ years’ experience leading ‘always on’ activity to drive commercial performance.   This will ideally be with specific experience in Accounting, Invoicing or Expense Management products, ideally in a fintech environment – key is demonstrated ability to plan and deliver consistent activity that drives commercial impact.
  • Strong analytical mindset: Able to review and interpret data to develop hypotheses and assumptions, turning insights into clear, actionable plans.
  • Proven GTM track record – delivering holistic, high impact omni-channel campaigns  (across sales, CRM, in-app contact points)
  • Exceptional project management skills, able to juggle multiple launches and tactical tests in a fast-moving environment.
  • Creative collaborator: Builds relationships across teams, crafts compelling messaging and navigates ambiguity with confidence.
  • Self-starter attitude: Works backwards from targets, removes blockers proactively and adapts when priorities shift.

What you’ll get in return

  • Competitive salary 
  • Vitality Health Insurance, with a proactive focus on mental and physical wellbeing
  • Hundreds of perks and discounts through Vitality Health Insurance (fitness watches, Waitrose cashback, gym membership etc.)
  • 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme
  • 25 days holiday with the ability to buy extra days
  • Professional L&D budget per year
  • Referral bonus when you bring your friends to join Tide 
  • Access to ‘salary sacrifice’ benefits such as Cycle to Work scheme and pension contribution
  • Spacious brand new office in Liverpool street with an all-day snacks bar
  • Enhanced family-friendly leave
  • 24 hours paid volunteering time off per year
  • Flexible work from home or at the office arrangements
  • Monthly team socials (we’ve had themed bingo, online cocktail making sessions, wellbeing challenges and themed virtual pub quizzes)
  • Sabbatical leave 

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

title: Lead Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

 

About the team

 

Our Public Services Business Unit is committed to leveraging AI for the benefit of individual citizens and the public good.

From our work informing strategic government decisions, to optimising our NHS, through to reducing bureaucratic backlogs - we know that AI offers opportunities to drive improvements at every level of Government and we are proud to lead on some of the most impactful work happening in the sector.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work on site with these clients from time to time.

  

About the role

 

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will lead high-impact AI projects and shape the technical direction of bespoke solutions. This role requires hands-on technical excellence combined with crucial team leadership.


You will define data science approaches, design robust software architectures, mentor junior colleagues, and ensure delivery rigour across projects all while building deep client relationships and solidifying our reputation as a leader in practical, measurable AI.

#LI-PRIO

  

What you'll be doing:

 

  • Leading project teams that deliver bespoke algorithms and high-stakes AI solutions to clients across the sector.

  • Conceiving the core data science approach and designing the associated robust software architecture for new engagements.

  • Mentoring a small number of data scientists and supporting the professional growth of technical team members on projects.

  • Partnering with commercial teams to build client relationships and shape project scope for technical feasibility.

  • Contributing to Faculty’s thought leadership and reputation through delivering courses, public speaking, or open-source projects.

  • Ensuring best practices are followed throughout the project lifecycle to guarantee high-quality, impactful delivery.

     

Who we're looking for:

 

  • You possess senior experience in a professional data science position or a quantitative academic field.

  • You demonstrate strong programming skills, with the ability to be a fluent Python programmer, using core libraries (NumPy, Pandas) and a deep-learning framework (e.g., PyTorch).

  • You have a deep expertise in core data science paradigms (supervised/unsupervised, NLP, validation), demonstrating a proficiency across the standard data science toolkit, including the ability to develop new, innovative algorithms.

  • You bring a leadership mindset, focused on growing the technical capabilities of the team and nurturing a collaborative culture.

  • You exhibit commercial awareness, with experience in client-facing work and the ability to translate business problems into a rigorous mathematical framework.

  • You are skilled in project planning, assessing technical feasibility, estimating delivery timelines, and leading a team to deliver high-quality work on a strict schedule.

 

Our Interview Process

 

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Take Home Technical Assessment

  3. Technical Interview (90 minutes)

  4. Commercial Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.
