title: Lead Database Administrator
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Overview

We are at a pivotal point in our tech progression. We're looking to grow our technical estate, architect new systems, remove technical debt and scale our platform. It's an exciting time to join Partnerize, and we are looking for a technical leader to help spearhead this evolution.

As a database engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, acting as the principal technical authority and taking end-to-end ownership of our database estate. You will be a strategic anchor within the Technical Operations team, interfacing directly with business, development, and IT functions. While you will own the database architecture and design solutions for the future, a fundamental, non-negotiable part of this role is hands-on Business As Usual incident management. You must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves to handle daily operations, backups, and performance tuning alongside project delivery.

Your deep expertise in MySQL, alongside strong Linux system administration and a working knowledge of network troubleshooting, will be critical to your success. You will design, build, and secure the underlying servers our databases run on, proactively analyse current implementations, and act as the ultimate technical escalation point for our database infrastructure in both our physical datacenters as well as our public cloud estate.

While we need your advanced technical skills, we are equally focused on character. We are looking for a highly proactive communicator who collaborates seamlessly without needing to be prompted. Crucially, you must be able to independently plan out complex technical work, such as database upgrades, and clearly articulate the step-by-step process and business impacts to stakeholders. You must thrive both when working independently to tackle complex problems and when operating collaboratively within a broader team. Furthermore, you will actively seek out opportunities to coach and mentor other engineers, elevating the overall DBA knowledge across the company. This role is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in the UK or the US.

As a Database Engineer at Partnerize, You Will:

  • Primary Operational Ownership: Take complete, hands-on ownership of daily database operations. Managing and maintaining the database infrastructure for day-to-day use, including backup management, resolving slow-running queries, and performance tuning, is a fundamental pillar of this role.
  • Infrastructure & Server Support: Be comfortable in providing operational support by designing, securing, and robustly maintaining the underlying Linux servers that our large distributed databases run on.
  • Project Planning & Stakeholder Communication: Plan, manage, and deliver large technical projects like database upgrades and migrations. You will autonomously map out step-by-step execution plans, proactively communicate technical considerations, and clearly articulate the business impact of your work to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Technical Leadership & Strategy: Scope incoming work, delegate to team members where appropriate, and act as the definitive database escalation point for support teams within the wider organisation.
  • Proactive Optimisation & Automation: Measure and optimise system performance to push our capabilities forward. Lead the automation of management and monitoring for the database platform infrastructure.
  • Collaboration & Documentation: Partner closely with development teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure database needs are met and to improve the testability of database aspects within software deployments. Document procedures, best practices, and troubleshooting steps for knowledge sharing.
  • Delivery & Out-of-Hours/On-Call Support: Plan, prioritise, and estimate tasks using Jira, and provide essential support for any critical database-related issues both during and outside of normal business hours.
  • Mentorship: Actively mentor and coach other engineers, providing technical leadership on database design, optimisation, and migration strategies to elevate overall team knowledge.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • MySQL & On-Premise Infrastructure: Advanced administration of MySQL in production environments, whether on-premise or in the cloud. Crucially, as our primary database is on-premise, you must possess strong Linux system administration and networking awareness to independently support, secure, and maintain the underlying servers.
  • Independence: Experience as either the sole or lead owner for large production database infrastructure within a SaaS environment with demonstrable accountability for its availability and performance. A proven track record of managing these responsibilities while coordinating with external technical stakeholders and adhering to light change management processes.
  • High Availability & Replication: Advanced experience configuring and troubleshooting complex MySQL replication setups (such as primary-replica, multi-master, and GTID). Proven ability to quickly resolve replication lag, manage smooth failovers, and execute disaster recovery plans.
  • Monitoring: A working understanding of database monitoring tools and patterns. What to measure, appropriate thresholds, and response mechanics.
  • Performance Optimisation: Deep expertise in query tuning, slow query analysis, and advanced schema optimisation (including normalisation, partitioning, query rewrites, and indexing strategies).
  • Upgrades, Migrations & Scripting: Proven track record of executing minimal-downtime upgrades and complex migrations (in-place, cross-database, or migrating ancillary workloads). Highly skilled in automating these processes using Python and/or Bash to build robust, version-controlled scripts.
  • Database Security & Compliance: Experience securing database infrastructure through SSL/TLS encryption, user access control, audit logging, and automated backup encryption.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • Automation, Containers & CI/CD: Hands-on expertise using Ansible for configuration management, deploying and managing databases within Kubernetes/containerised environments, and managing version control and pipelines via GitLab for any database related change.
  • Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Hands-on experience deploying and configuring monitoring/alerting stacks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Percona Monitoring and Management) for proactive issue resolution and database health tracking.
  • PostgreSQL & Hybrid Estates: Advanced administration of PostgreSQL, alongside experience managing database workloads across a hybrid environment (e.g., combining on-premise architecture with AWS).
  • OLAP & Data Warehousing (Apache Druid / Snowflake): Familiarity with columnar databases and cloud data platforms, particularly Apache Druid and Snowflake. Experience with schema design, data sharding strategies, OLAP query optimisation for long-running queries, and managing zero-downtime upgrades in distributed environments.
  • Service Management Tooling: Experience using Jira and Confluence for managing workflows, project tracking, and creating technical documentation.

Growth & Innovation:

    • Openness to learn the required technologies.
    • An interest in development, new technologies and innovation.
    • Supporting development teams into the refactoring of technical debt.

At Partnerize, we recognise it is unrealistic for a candidate to fulfil 100% of the criteria in this job description. We encourage you to apply if you feel you meet the majority of the requirements above. We know that skills evolve over time, so if you have a keen appetite to learn and evolve alongside us over time, come join our team!

US Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible Time Off Policy – Take the time you need
  • Enhanced parental leave (16 weeks for birth parent, 8 weeks for non-birth parent at full pay)
  • Regular company events and activities
  • Robust Company Sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits
  • 401k Plan – 4% employee match
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

Privacy and data protection. The data collected as part of this application will be used for the recruitment process and any subsequent employment. You can find further information in Partnerize privacy policy here: https://partnerize.com/privacy-policy/

Notice to Recruiters and Staffing Agencies: To protect the interests of all parties, Partnerize will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate or an approved vendor that has a written and signed agreement in place with Partnerize. Please do not contact or forward resumes to our company employees or locations. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered Partnerize property. Partnerize is not responsible for any charges or fees related to unsolicited resumes.

As a database engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, acting as the principal technical authority and taking end-to-end ownership of our database estate. You will be a strategic anchor within the Technical Operations team, interfacing directly with business, development, and IT functions. While you will own the database architecture and design solutions for the future, a fundamental, non-negotiable part of this role is hands-on Business As Usual incident management. You must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves to handle daily operations, backups, and performance tuning alongside project delivery.

Your deep expertise in MySQL, alongside strong Linux system administration and a working knowledge of network troubleshooting, will be critical to your success. You will design, build, and secure the underlying servers our databases run on, proactively analyse current implementations, and act as the ultimate technical escalation point for our database infrastructure in both our physical datacenters as well as our public cloud estate.

While we need your advanced technical skills, we are equally focused on character. We are looking for a highly proactive communicator who collaborates seamlessly without needing to be prompted. Crucially, you must be able to independently plan out complex technical work, such as database upgrades, and clearly articulate the step-by-step process and business impacts to stakeholders. You must thrive both when working independently to tackle complex problems and when operating collaboratively within a broader team. Furthermore, you will actively seek out opportunities to coach and mentor other engineers, elevating the overall DBA knowledge across the company. This role is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in the UK or the US.

As a Database Engineer at Partnerize, You Will:

  • Primary Operational Ownership: Take complete, hands-on ownership of daily database operations. Managing and maintaining the database infrastructure for day-to-day use, including backup management, resolving slow-running queries, and performance tuning, is a fundamental pillar of this role.
  • Infrastructure & Server Support: Be comfortable in providing operational support by designing, securing, and robustly maintaining the underlying Linux servers that our large distributed databases run on.
  • Project Planning & Stakeholder Communication: Plan, manage, and deliver large technical projects like database upgrades and migrations. You will autonomously map out step-by-step execution plans, proactively communicate technical considerations, and clearly articulate the business impact of your work to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Technical Leadership & Strategy: Scope incoming work, delegate to team members where appropriate, and act as the definitive database escalation point for support teams within the wider organisation.
  • Proactive Optimisation & Automation: Measure and optimise system performance to push our capabilities forward. Lead the automation of management and monitoring for the database platform infrastructure.
  • Collaboration & Documentation: Partner closely with development teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure database needs are met and to improve the testability of database aspects within software deployments. Document procedures, best practices, and troubleshooting steps for knowledge sharing.
  • Delivery & Out-of-Hours/On-Call Support: Plan, prioritise, and estimate tasks using Jira, and provide essential support for any critical database-related issues both during and outside of normal business hours.
  • Mentorship: Actively mentor and coach other engineers, providing technical leadership on database design, optimisation, and migration strategies to elevate overall team knowledge.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • MySQL & On-Premise Infrastructure: Advanced administration of MySQL in production environments, whether on-premise or in the cloud. Crucially, as our primary database is on-premise, you must possess strong Linux system administration and networking awareness to independently support, secure, and maintain the underlying servers.
  • Independence: Experience as either the sole or lead owner for large production database infrastructure within a SaaS environment with demonstrable accountability for its availability and performance. A proven track record of managing these responsibilities while coordinating with external technical stakeholders and adhering to light change management processes.
  • High Availability & Replication: Advanced experience configuring and troubleshooting complex MySQL replication setups (such as primary-replica, multi-master, and GTID). Proven ability to quickly resolve replication lag, manage smooth failovers, and execute disaster recovery plans.
  • Monitoring: A working understanding of database monitoring tools and patterns. What to measure, appropriate thresholds, and response mechanics.
  • Performance Optimisation: Deep expertise in query tuning, slow query analysis, and advanced schema optimisation (including normalisation, partitioning, query rewrites, and indexing strategies).
  • Upgrades, Migrations & Scripting: Proven track record of executing minimal-downtime upgrades and complex migrations (in-place, cross-database, or migrating ancillary workloads). Highly skilled in automating these processes using Python and/or Bash to build robust, version-controlled scripts.
  • Database Security & Compliance: Experience securing database infrastructure through SSL/TLS encryption, user access control, audit logging, and automated backup encryption.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • Automation, Containers & CI/CD: Hands-on expertise using Ansible for configuration management, deploying and managing databases within Kubernetes/containerised environments, and managing version control and pipelines via GitLab for any database related change.
  • Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Hands-on experience deploying and configuring monitoring/alerting stacks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Percona Monitoring and Management) for proactive issue resolution and database health tracking.
  • PostgreSQL & Hybrid Estates: Advanced administration of PostgreSQL, alongside experience managing database workloads across a hybrid environment (e.g., combining on-premise architecture with AWS).
  • OLAP & Data Warehousing (Apache Druid / Snowflake): Familiarity with columnar databases and cloud data platforms, particularly Apache Druid and Snowflake. Experience with schema design, data sharding strategies, OLAP query optimisation for long-running queries, and managing zero-downtime upgrades in distributed environments.
  • Service Management Tooling: Experience using Jira and Confluence for managing workflows, project tracking, and creating technical documentation.

Growth & Innovation:

    • Openness to learn the required technologies.
    • An interest in development, new technologies and innovation.
    • Supporting development teams into the refactoring of technical debt.

Crucially, as our primary database is on-premise, you must possess strong Linux system administration and networking awareness to independently support, secure, and maintain the underlying servers.
  • Independence: Experience as either the sole or lead owner for large production database infrastructure within a SaaS environment with demonstrable accountability for its availability and performance. A proven track record of managing these responsibilities while coordinating with external technical stakeholders and adhering to light change management processes.
  • High Availability & Replication: Advanced experience configuring and troubleshooting complex MySQL replication setups (such as primary-replica, multi-master, and GTID). Proven ability to quickly resolve replication lag, manage smooth failovers, and execute disaster recovery plans.
  • Monitoring: A working understanding of database monitoring tools and patterns. What to measure, appropriate thresholds, and response mechanics.
  • Performance Optimisation: Deep expertise in query tuning, slow query analysis, and advanced schema optimisation (including normalisation, partitioning, query rewrites, and indexing strategies).
  • Upgrades, Migrations & Scripting: Proven track record of executing minimal-downtime upgrades and complex migrations (in-place, cross-database, or migrating ancillary workloads). Highly skilled in automating these processes using Python and/or Bash to build robust, version-controlled scripts.
  • Database Security & Compliance: Experience securing database infrastructure through SSL/TLS encryption, user access control, audit logging, and automated backup encryption.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • Automation, Containers & CI/CD: Hands-on expertise using Ansible for configuration management, deploying and managing databases within Kubernetes/containerised environments, and managing version control and pipelines via GitLab for any database related change.
  • Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Hands-on experience deploying and configuring monitoring/alerting stacks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Percona Monitoring and Management) for proactive issue resolution and database health tracking.
  • PostgreSQL & Hybrid Estates: Advanced administration of PostgreSQL, alongside experience managing database workloads across a hybrid environment (e.g., combining on-premise architecture with AWS).
  • OLAP & Data Warehousing (Apache Druid / Snowflake): Familiarity with columnar databases and cloud data platforms, particularly Apache Druid and Snowflake. Experience with schema design, data sharding strategies, OLAP query optimisation for long-running queries, and managing zero-downtime upgrades in distributed environments.
  • Service Management Tooling: Experience using Jira and Confluence for managing workflows, project tracking, and creating technical documentation.

Growth & Innovation:

    • Openness to learn the required technologies.
    • An interest in development, new technologies and innovation.
    • Supporting development teams into the refactoring of technical debt.

At Partnerize, we recognise it is unrealistic for a candidate to fulfil 100% of the criteria in this job description. We encourage you to apply if you feel you meet the majority of the requirements above. We know that skills evolve over time, so if you have a keen appetite to learn and evolve alongside us over time, come join our team!

US Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible Time Off Policy – Take the time you need
  • Enhanced parental leave (16 weeks for birth parent, 8 weeks for non-birth parent at full pay)
  • Regular company events and activities
  • Robust Company Sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits
  • 401k Plan – 4% employee match
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

title: Lead Delivery /Senior Project Manager (F/H)
descriptionHtml:
LE CONTEXTE :

Fondée en 2017 par des ingénieurs de CentraleSupélec, ILLUIN Technology est une scale-up française en pleine effervescence de plus de 200 passionnés.

Notre mission ? Déployer l'IA et les solutions digitales de pointe à grande échelle, avec une culture de l’excellence forgée sur le plateau de Paris-Saclay.

Notre force repose sur une double approche unique :

  • MAKE : Des réalisations tech sur-mesure en GenAI, Data Science et Software Engineering.

  • BUY : Une suite de produits propriétaires de pointe (Dialogue, Automate, Analyze) orchestrée par notre plateforme low-code nAixt.

Propulsés par une croissance ultra-dynamique (15 M€ de CA en 2025 et une récente levée de fonds), nous structurons notre département Delivery. Nous recherchons un(e) leader capable d'allier rigueur opérationnelle et excellence technologique.

VOTRE RÔLE :

Rattaché(e) directement au pôle Delivery, vous occuperez un poste pivot de Lead Delivery / Senior Project Manager. Véritable "Leader de terrain", vous mènerez de front plusieurs projets complexes engagés au forfait dans un univers Data / IA stimulant, tout en devenant l’artisan de l'industrialisation de nos processus internes.

Le match parfait : Vous disposez de 7 à 10 ans d'expérience, dont au moins 5 ans passés à piloter des projets au forfait au sein d'une ESN, le tout porté par une solide culture Data / IA.

VOS MISSIONS :

1. Chef d'Orchestre des Projets au Forfait (Engagement de résultats)

  • Pilotage transversal : Vous gérez de A à Z les projets au forfait (Forfait traditionnel, C2S) et pilotez les aspects contractuels ainsi que les avenants, main dans la main avec l'équipe Sales.

  • Garant du triptyque : Coût, Qualité, Délais. Vous êtes responsable de la valeur et de la qualité des livrables de nos équipes tech.

  • Pilotage financier : Vous maîtrisez la rentabilité et la marge de votre portefeuille de projets (suivi des indicateurs clés : ETC, EAC).

  • Gouvernance de haut niveau : Vous êtes l'interlocuteur direct des décideurs chez nos Grands Comptes. Vous préparez et animez les Comités de Pilotage et de Suivi avec une posture de conseiller stratégique.

2. Business Development & Animation

  • Partenaire du Business : Vous soutenez l'équipe BizDev grâce à votre vision 360° des écosystèmes clients (besoins, roadmap, contraintes).

  • Croissance organique : Vous détectez de nouvelles opportunités de business au sein de vos comptes existants.

  • Alignement stratégique : En binôme avec les Sales, vous veillez au cadrage des dispositifs pour maximiser la satisfaction client et la performance des équipes.

3. Industrialisation du Delivery

  • Process & Outils : Vous structurez les backlogs, optimisez les workflows de delivery dans Jira et automatisez les reportings pour faire gagner tout le monde en efficacité.

  • Amélioration continue : En collaboration avec les Delivery Managers, vous participez activement à la transformation et à l'industrialisation du Delivery au sein du SI d'Illuin (processus, intégration d'outils corporate, KPIs internes).

VOTRE PROFIL

  • Formation : Diplôme d'ingénieur (Bac+5) issu d’une école de premier rang.

  • Expérience : Plus de 7 ans d'expérience minimum, impérativement marquée par la gestion de projets au forfait dans le monde des ESN ou des cabinets de conseil.

  • Hard Skills :

    • Un background technique solide (Java, Python, SQL) pour pouvoir challenger intelligemment les équipes tech.

    • Une maîtrise avancée et incontournable de Jira.

    • Une expertise éprouvée en gestion de projet (Agile, Cycle en V, SAFE, gestion des risques).

  • Langues : Français et Anglais courants (contexte international).

LES INFOS À CONNAÎTRE

  • Le spot : Bureaux situés au cœur de l'écosystème affaires : 20 place de la Défense, 92800 Puteaux.

  • Télétravail : Jusqu'à 2 jours de remote par semaine pour un juste équilibre pro/perso.

  • Déplacements : Ponctuels en province pour aller à la rencontre de nos clients.

title: Lead Deployment Architect
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team

Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: initial value realization, adoption, and the long-term success of our customers.

The Role

As a Lead Deployment Architect, you are the technical authority for our strategic accounts within Celonis delivery. You shape how Celonis solutions are designed, architected, and delivered across your portfolio of strategic customer engagements. You define what good delivery looks like - setting architectural standards, designing end-to-end solution strategies, and ensuring that AI-augmented and agentic workflows are deployed effectively at scale.

You operate at the intersection of deep platform expertise, domain knowledge, and customer strategy. You are equally comfortable leading a technical design review with Celonis engineers and presenting a transformation roadmap to a customer’s C-suite. You bridge the gap between pre-sales and post-sales, ensuring that what was promised can be delivered - and often shaping the promise itself.

This role carries significant organizational leverage. You set delivery patterns that other teams follow. You define how AI agents should be orchestrated for complex, multi-workstream engagements. You work in close collaboration with Deployment Engineers and raise the bar for the entire practice.

The Work You’ll Do

Solution Architecture & Design

  • Support Services scoping in pre-sales, ensuring the right Services are positioned in line with the Celonis solution architecture proposed
  • Design end-to-end Celonis solution architectures for complex enterprise deployments, spanning multiple process areas, business units, and geographies
  • Define the technical blueprint for how the Celonis platform integrates with customer systems, data strategies, and transformation goals
  • Designing secure, scalable architectures tailored to complex enterprise requirements, optimizing for long-term usage growth and high concurrency.
  • Make architectural trade-off decisions: build vs. configure, custom vs. standard, phased vs. big-bang - with clear rationale tied to customer outcomes
  • Own solution quality & outcome delivery across engagements, conducting design reviews, and ensuring delivery teams follow architectural standards

AI Orchestration & Delivery Innovation

  • Design how AI deployment agents (Apollo) should be used across complex, multi-workstream engagements, defining agent workflows, validation checkpoints, and quality gates
  • Develop reusable specifications, templates, and patterns that enable Deployment Engineers to direct AI agents more effectively
  • Pioneer new delivery approaches that leverage AI to compress timelines, improve quality, or unlock use cases that were previously impractical
  • Set standards for AI output validation, ensuring the organization maintains quality as delivery accelerates

Customer Strategy & Advisory

  • Serve as the senior technical advisor to strategic customers, building trusted relationships with VP and C-level stakeholders
  • Translate customer business challenges into Celonis platform strategies, identifying high-impact use cases and defining success metrics
  • Support pre-sales by providing technical credibility in complex deals, validating solution feasibility, and shaping project scope
  • Guide customers through their Process Intelligence maturity journey, advising on platform expansion, AI readiness, and organizational change
  • Leverage the broader ecosystem of Celonis experts to remove potential blockers in customer engagements
  • Establish deep, technical advisor relationships with customer stakeholders (Lead Data Engineers and Architects, Head of Data Intelligence, Head of Business Transformation) to provide technical reassurance and maintain "Expert-to-Expert" alignment during the course of the deployment 

Successful Implementation

  • Work together with Deployment Engineers on delivery projects to implement the most complex and cutting edge use cases for our customers
  • Stay on top of the newest technologies Celonis has to offer and own the implementation of early stage products for our customers, ensuring close feedback cycles with Product & Engineering
  • Review Solution(s) Blueprint to ensure quality, scalability and production readiness of business critical and operational use cases

Domain & Industry Depth

  • Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals
  • Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage
  • Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain in collaboration with the Deployment Engineer, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap

Practice Development

  • Contribute to hiring: define what great looks like for the Deployment job family, conduct interviews, and calibrate candidate assessments
  • Share knowledge across the organization through internal enablement sessions, documentation, and community of practice leadership
  • Ensure the link with Product & Engineering to feed customer insights and field experience back into platform development, and to influence the platform roadmap

What Distinguishes This Role from Deployment Engineer

  • Scope: You work across multiple engagements and shape solutions across a portfolio/cluster/industry vertical (4+ concurrent clients)
  • Influence & Practice Development: your Scope allows you to identify and set standards that other teams follow - for solution architecture, AI orchestration patterns, and delivery quality
  • Bridge: You span pre-sales and post-sales, ensuring continuity between what’s sold and what’s delivered
  • Force multiplier: Your work multiplies the effectiveness of Deployment Engineers rather than substituting for it

The Qualifications You Need

  • Experience: 8+ years in technical consulting, solution architecture, or delivery leadership within enterprise software, consulting firms, or system integrators. At least 3 years in a senior or lead technical role with multi-stakeholder responsibility in large-scale projects at tier-1 organizations (e.g. digital twin implementations, global AI transformations, near-real-time data pipelines, etc.) 
  • Architecture skills: Proven ability to design complex, multi-component solutions that span data integration, process intelligence, automation, and AI, while remaining grounded in the “so-what” of a customer’s process. Deep understanding of enterprise architecture patterns and trade-offs.
  • Platform mastery: Expert-level knowledge of the Celonis platform, including the Process Intelligence Graph, data modeling, advanced PQL, automation and orchestration engine, and AI modules. Ability to push the platform’s boundaries via a working knowledge of Python.
  • AI & agent orchestration: Demonstrated ability to design AI-augmented delivery workflows leveraging frontier tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Experience with context engineering, multi-agent system design, or AI validation at scale. Ability to define how AI should be used, not just use it.
  • Domain expertise: Deep knowledge in at least one major process domain or industry vertical. Ability to translate domain expertise into scalable solution patterns and credible customer advisory.
  • Customer executive presence: Track record of building trusted advisor relationships with VP and C-level stakeholders. Ability to present transformation strategies, defend architectural decisions, and navigate complex organizational dynamics. Demonstrated experience navigating complex IT landscapes and communicating technical trade-offs to senior leadership.
  • Consulting & communication: Exceptional ability to translate between technical and business audiences. Experience leading workshops, design sessions, and strategic reviews with senior stakeholders.
  • Leadership & mentoring: Demonstrated ability to raise the performance of teams around you. Experience mentoring technical staff, setting quality standards, and contributing to organizational capability development.
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, Technology Management, Business Informatics, or a comparable field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English and German required. 

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here.

title: Lead Designer
descriptionHtml:
Lead Designer (FDE)

  • Location: Paris, France (hybrid, three days a week in the office)
  • Team: UX Team (FDE)
  • Salary: €63,000 - €75,000
  • Contract: Permanent
  • Reporting To: Head of User Experience

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in France. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you’ll do

  • Own UX strategy for our EU programme end to end, with real judgement over what to prioritise and how, as the market and the team's shape itself still takes form
  • Partner directly with Product, Engineering, and Data on the ground locally, including wider teams and client-side engineers,bringing user needs into decisions from the start, not added on afterward
  • Use our established research methods to bring real insight into your own design work, and feed what you learn locally back into the wider team's shared understanding
  • Lead and grow two designers based in London, building one genuinely connected team across EU and the UK from early on
  • Shape how local work becomes part of our shared platform and design system, so what you build here compounds for every client after, not just this one
  • Build directly in code where useful, using AI-assisted tools to prototype or ship small front-end changes yourself, closing the gap between design and delivery
  • Go beyond representing UX, be an active voice in the trade-offs between PMs and Design, holding the right balance between client-specific needs and our global approach, including directly with clients and stakeholders in workshops, showcases, and pre-sales conversations across the EU market
  • Help define what design leadership looks like across a genuinely distributed function, UK, EU, and Australia, while it's still being built

What you’ll bring

Ideally you’ll have/be

  • A track record owning UX strategy and delivery end to end for a complex, multi-stakeholder product, ideally in a regulated or operationally complex industry
  • Experience designing in B2B or B2B2C environments, for professional, repeat users rather than casual consumers
  • Direct experience managing or mentoring other designers, comfortable leading a small team while still doing hands-on design work yourself
  • Experience working from, and contributing back to, a shared platform or design system, not just consuming one
  • Comfort working close to code, confident using AI-assisted development tools (such as Claude Code) to go from design to a working interface yourself
  • A genuine appetite for building something from an early stage, comfortable with ambiguity that comes with shaping a team and a market presence, not just operating inside one already settled

Where you'll work
We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Our Values

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.
  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.
  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.
  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.
  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Financial & Insurance: Discretionary bonus, Alan Mutuelle Health Insurance, x3 Life & Death insurance (Prévoyance) via Alan, and standard Sécurité Sociale contributions (pension, family allowance, unemployment insurance)
  • Allowances: 50% commuting expense reimbursement, €200 Home Working Allowance, and €150 Learning Fund
  • Time Off & Flexibility: 25 days holiday + bank holidays + RTT days, Moments That Matter Leave, Compassionate Leave, two paid Volunteering Days, Flexible Working, and Career Break eligibility

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

title: Lead EDD
descriptionHtml:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot,based on 60,000 reviews. Our cultureputs customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here).

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 byAlexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.


Join us as a Lead EDD to give a critical Enhanced Due Diligence process dedicated operational leadership. Your focus will be on operational excellence: delivering consistent, high-quality production, developing a growing team and continuously improving how we work.

You will report to Florence, Anti-Financial Crime Director (Western Europe), and lead Qonto’s EDD production team. Working closely with KYC/KYB, Operations and Anti-Financial Crime stakeholders—including colleagues responsible for regulatory and project-related matters—you will translate agreed requirements into effective day-to-day practices and give the team the support, guidance and production visibility it needs to succeed.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Lead production with rigor: organize daily workloads, monitor incoming cases, backlog and output, and resolve blockers. Establish clear KPIs to track volumes, progress and performance.

  • Support sound EDD decisions: provide second opinions and four-eyes checks, guide complex investigations and risk assessments, and ensure verified sources and clear assessment memos support conclusions. Help the team escalate high-risk cases appropriately.

  • Raise review quality: deepen customer-profile reviews and improve consistency as capacity grows, balancing thorough investigation with prioritization and timely delivery.

  • Keep the customer experience in view: work with customer-facing and Operations teams to make EDD requests clear and reduce unnecessary back-and-forth and delays, while maintaining robust controls and acting firmly when risks warrant it.

  • Develop a growing team: onboard and coach team members through real cases, share best practices and build autonomy. Step into production during workload spikes or capacity gaps.

  • Drive continuous improvement: improve EDD workflows and handoffs with KYC/KYB and Operations, using production insights and quality findings to reduce friction and strengthen delivery. Keep operational procedures clear and current, working with regulatory and project colleagues to embed agreed changes into daily practice.

  • Use AI with judgment: monitor AI-assisted EDD activity and control coverage, and coordinate improvements and bug fixes with Security.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • Relevant experience: you bring solid KYC/AML, EDD or related financial-crime experience, including hands-on production work.

  • Regulatory and investigative expertise: you apply KYC/KYB and AML/CFT requirements to complex customer profiles, verify sources, identify risk patterns and document clear, well-supported conclusions.

  • Production management: you organize work, prioritize cases, monitor backlog and capacity, and use KPIs to improve delivery without compromising quality.

  • Leadership potential: you guide colleagues, give practical feedback and help a relatively junior/new team grow. Formal management experience is not essential; understanding the lead role and being ready to step up are.

  • Stakeholder management and customer focus: you collaborate across teams, communicate clearly and stay composed under pressure. You reduce customer friction without compromising controls or regulatory requirements, challenging requests and escalating when needed.

  • Continuous improvement and technical curiosity: you seek better ways to work, use EDD tools confidently and explore AI with a critical eye on its outputs and limitations.

  • Languages: you are fluent in English and French; another European language is a plus.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • A role with tangible impact: improve EDD production quality, stability and visibility, supporting sound risk decisions and Qonto’s growth.

  • An opportunity to support a growing team: share your expertise and help colleagues build confidence and autonomy as the team expands.

  • A practical improvement mandate: turn production insights into clearer processes, stronger reviews and better collaboration with Operations, AFC and Security.

  • Exposure to evolving compliance operations: help scale operations as Qonto progresses toward becoming a bank, including responsible AI use in EDD.

  • Room to grow: deepen your EDD expertise and develop leadership and coaching skills, with potential future expert opportunities in AFC, Risk & Compliance, AML or Operations, depending on your development and business needs.

➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Florence, our Anti-Financial Crime Director (Western Europe).

title: Lead Forward Deployed Designer
descriptionHtml:
About Artificial

Help shape the future of specialty insurance

At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.

We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth.

You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry.

We've just raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally.

Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations.

About the role

Today, a key part of delivery has no clear owner: problem framing before configuration begins.

  • On the customer side, there are rarely UX specialists - only domain experts and sponsors who describe needs as pre-formed solutions.

  • On our side, configured workspaces are built by Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) in our Transform team: experts in the platform, accountable for shipping to a deadline, but not trained designers.

  • Our Platform teams have design expertise but are often too far removed from individual implementations to influence the moments that matter most.

The result is pretty predictable: we move quickly into “how” before we are confident about the “what” and “why.”

Your mandate is to slow down at the right moment and make sure we’re solving the right problem - then help the team implement the best platform-valid solution.

This is a founding role. You would be the first Forward Deployed Designer (FDD) at Artificial, hired into an enabling function within the Platform team, with the mandate to define how the function works and to build it out. Later, FDDs would join the Transform teams in hands-on client roles: you’d take part in hiring them (with our support), then line-manage them directly.

Responsibilities

You would work closely with the Transform team and customers throughout discovery and delivery. In practice, that means:

  • Establish the FDD function. Define the operating model, the patterns, and the ways of working from scratch.

  • Grow and manage the team. Take part in hiring subsequent FDDs and line-manage them as they join.

  • Join customer + FDE sessions early (problem framing and discovery), not only at reviews once decisions are already fixed.

  • Translate requests into problems. For example, turn “we need a confirmation button before this step” into:

    • the user behaviour driving the request

    • two or three platform-valid approaches

    • a recommendation, with trade-offs explained

  • Prototype and test ideas quickly using the most effective medium (written specs, wireframes, workflows, or light code). We care more about clarity and platform realism than polished artefacts.

  • Provide credible pushback when the customer’s proposed solution doesn’t address the underlying problem.

  • Codify patterns and precedents so knowledge moves from individual memory into shared team infrastructure.

  • Level up the FDE team’s design instincts over time. You shouldn’t be the only person who can think about UX across the two teams; part of the job is coaching, so the capability can spread.

  • Use workspace signals (e.g. session data and call analysis) to surface risks early - before they become escalations.

About you

You are a designer who thrives in ambiguity and constraints, someone who can bring structure, judgement, and clarity to complex, real-world delivery.

You likely have experience in enterprise/B2B software where:

  • the design system already exists

  • the hard part is framing the right problem and navigating stakeholders

  • solutions must work within meaningful technical and organisational constraints

You understand technical concepts fluently. Part of the role would involve writing code (with plenty of LLM and human assistance) using our in-house DSL (Domain Specific Language). We don’t want you to be an engineer, but we do need you to be comfortable reading and writing some code, reasoning about how a configurable system behaves, and understanding what the platform can and can’t express, well enough to hold a credible conversation with engineers and to explain these constraints to customers when necessary.

You have managed designers. You’re comfortable with line management of a small team (roughly three to five people) and have hired designers before. Early on, you’d do this hands-on yourself; as the function grows, you’d manage the FDDs who follow.

Insurance or Lloyd’s experience is a plus, but is not a requirement. We care more about how you think about complex platforms and stakeholders than about prior domain knowledge, which you can learn here.

We especially want to hear from you if you have

  • Collaborative skills with an emphasis on product quality.

  • Experience in insurtech, insurance or related industries.

  • Strong problem-solving skills.

  • Experience in a distributed work environment.

Benefits

  • Private medical insurance

  • Income protection insurance

  • Life insurance of 4 * base salary

  • On-site gym and shower facilities

  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay

  • Team social events and company parties

  • Salary exchange on pension and nursery fees

  • Access to Maji, the financial wellbeing platform

  • Company stock options managed through Ledgy

  • Milestone Birthday Bonus and a Life Events leave policy

  • Generous holiday allowance of 28 days plus national holidays

  • Home office and equipment allowance, and a company MacBook

  • Learning allowance and leave to attend conferences or take exams

  • YuLife employee benefits, including EAP and bereavement helplines

  • For each new hire, we plant a tree through our partnership with Ecologi Action

  • The best coffee machine in London, handmade in Italy and imported just for us!

    We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities around us. If there’s anything you need to make the hiring process more accessible, just let us know—we’re happy to make adjustments. You’re also welcome to share your preferred pronouns with us at any point.

    Think you don’t meet every requirement? Please apply anyway. We value potential as much as experience, and we know that raw talent counts.

    As part of our hiring process, we’ll carry out some background checks. These may include a criminal record check, reviewing your credit history, speaking with previous employers and confirming your academic qualifications.

Your role in our Space Mission...

Systems Integration & Data

  • Work with relational databases, structured and unstructured data, and modern data management approaches.

Technical Leadership & AI-Assisted Development

  • Act as a technical leader, setting engineering direction and guiding architectural decisions.
  • Champion modern software development approaches, including AI-assisted coding and agentic development tools.
  • Use technologies such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or OpenAI Codex to accelerate prototyping, development, testing, and documentation where appropriate.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and development approaches, selecting tools based on practical business value.
  • Contribute to the growth of internal software engineering capabilities, including mentoring future team members.
  • Foster a culture of ownership, experimentation, continuous improvement, and high-quality engineering.

What you´ll need to thrive...

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial hands-on full-stack development.
  • Strong proficiency in modern frontend development using TypeScript/JavaScript and frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.
  • Experience developing backend applications and APIs using Python, Node.js, Java, C#, or comparable technologies.
  • Strong knowledge of relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server, including data modeling and query optimization.
  • Experience designing and delivering production applications, including authentication, authorization, testing, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Solid understanding of software architecture, distributed systems, and application integration patterns.
  • Experience with Git, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and modern development workflows.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently take an idea from requirements through implementation and deployment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and a pragmatic approach to engineering.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders from different technical and business backgrounds.
  • Excellent communication skills in English.

Nice to have...

  • Experience building internal tools, operational applications, or enterprise software platforms.
  • Experience developing software for manufacturing, automotive, aerospace, logistics, or other complex operational environments.
  • Familiarity with ERP, PLM, or other enterprise systems and their integration interfaces.

  • Builds, not just designs. You are comfortable making architectural decisions but equally happy writing code, debugging issues, and delivering working software.

  • Takes ownership. You are comfortable being accountable for the applications you build, from initial concept through production operation.
  • Embraces new tools. You actively explore modern development techniques, including AI-assisted software engineering, while maintaining high standards for code quality and security.

title: Lead Fullstack Engineer - CDI Paris - Theodo AI-Modernisation
descriptionHtml:

Aujourd’hui, l’ambition du groupe est de se positionner comme le leader de l’IA appliquée au développement logiciel, c’est pourquoi nous avons lancé la practice AI Modernisation. Au sein de cette practice, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la modernisation de leurs systèmes legacy. Grâce à une IA maîtrisée et une méthode éprouvée, nous allons 3 fois plus vite sur le delivery de ces projets critiques.
La practice accompagne principalement des scale-ups comme Qonto ou Doctolib et des grands groupes comme Carrefour, Pernod Ricard, Les Mousquetaires, Urgo, Cdiscount ou Edenred. Si tu veux rejoindre le futur de la tech, tu es au bon endroit !

Ton équipe :

Tu rejoindras une communauté tech de plus de 350 Theodoers : software engineers, tech leads, engineering managers et architectes, avec lesquels tu pourras échanger, apprendre et progresser au quotidien.

Chez Theodo, les techs travaillent en équipes projet, constituées en fonction des besoins de chaque client. Tu feras partie d’une équipe de Theodoers à taille humaine (4 à 5 personnes), réunissant Software Engineers, Tech Lead et Product Manager. Ensemble, vous collaborerez étroitement avec le client, avec des échanges réguliers pour partager vos avancées, approfondir la compréhension de son problème et faire évoluer le produit au plus près des besoins de ses utilisateurs.

Les métiers du Software Engineering évoluent avec l’IA : viens apprendre à devenir un Tech Lead AI Native.

Tes futures missions :

Nous recrutons un·e Tech Lead pour concevoir et développer des produits digitaux utiles, performants et durables pour répondre aux problématiques de nos clients et de leurs utilisateurs.

En tant que Tech Lead, tu es garant du rythme et de la qualité de delivery de ton projet. Tu mobilises ton équipe, fais les choix techniques adaptés au contexte et accompagnes les Software Engineers dans leur progression, avec l’objectif de faire grandir à la fois le produit et les personnes qui le construisent.

  • Garantir le delivery et la qualité du projet

Tu vises un niveau de qualité radicalement supérieur, en structurant le delivery autour de standards :

    • Concevoir des architectures évolutives et résilientes (diagrammes d’architecture clairs et partagés)
    • Rédiger des spécifications précises pour permettre le développement sans bugs de fonctionnalités
    • Mettre en place une stratégie de qualité basée sur : le Clean Code, les tests automatisés, les code reviews
    • Assurer un environnement de travail structuré avec les principes 5S (organisation, clarté, efficacité)
    • Accélérer la vitesse de développement grâce au déploiement des agents IA
  • Être le partenaire technique du client
    • Participer aux routines projet (backlog refinement, daily, cérémonies) et veiller à la satisfaction continue du client
    • Expliquer et défendre les choix techniques pour créer de la confiance et aligner toutes les parties prenantes
  • Créer les conditions de performance de l’équipe
    • Mettre en place un environnement de travail efficace et structuré pour l’équipe projet
    • Mettre en place des boucles de résolution des problèmes via le Daily Problem Solving
    • Créer les conditions pour que l’équipe exploite les LLM et gagne en productivité dans son quotidien
  • Faire progresser les Software Engineers de ton équipe
    • Analyser de manière appronfondie les défauts à la source dans le but d’améliorer les connaissance des équipes (Dantotsu)
    • Former et accompagner l’équipe (pair programming, code reviews, formation)

Les problématiques sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples :

  • HealthHero : leader européen de la télémédecine, ils souhaitent moderniser leur plateforme française, Qare, en vue d’une fusion avec la plateforme UK. L’objectif est de passer de Loopback2 à Nest pour pouvoir upgrade de Node 10 vers Node 20. Grâce à notre méthode de modernisation accélérée par l’IA, nous passons d’une estimation à 70 semaines sans IA à une migration terminée en 21 semaines et accélérons la vitesse de delivery par 5.
  • Pernod Ricard : souhaitait moderniser une application interne utilisée pour gérer leur campagnes marketing, des millions d’euros en jeu. L’impact de Theodo : 23 semaines pour moderniser complètement l’application de Vue Express vers React Nest avec une réécriture plus pragmatique. Nous avons également effectué la connection à leur nouvel ERP, auparavant impossible sans la migration.

Tes perspectives d’évolution :

2 axes d’évolutions s’offrent à toi:

  • Architecte senior : développer une expertise technique
  • Solution Architect: participer à le vente de projets complexes en définissant les solutions techniques les plus ingénieuses pour nous permettre de gagner
  • Managériale : Engineering Manager

Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu :

Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits.

Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients.

Profil recherché :

  • 4 à 8 ans d’expérience en développement
  • Solide maîtrise des architectures web (front, back, BDD, infra, déploiement) et des pratiques DevOps (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Capacité à concevoir des architectures scalables, faire des choix techniques pertinents et garantir un haut niveau de qualité de code.
  • Expérience dans le coaching et l’accompagnement de développeurs, en restant connecté·e à la tech (veille, code, pair programming).
  • Orientation création de valeur et compréhension des enjeux métier du client.

Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 De l’épargne salariale avec un mécanisme d’intéressement en partenariat avec Epsor 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile 🧒 Aides et places en crèche réservées Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

title: Lead/ Head of Sales Europe (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe's leading Fintechs and Financial Institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26, and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 330 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, Bessemer Venture Partners, BlackRock, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experiences.

As Upvest enters the next stage of growth, we are looking for an exceptional sales leader for continental Europe. You will work directly with our Director of Growth Alexander Reichhardt owning the topics most critical to Upvest's expansion beyond its current home markets:

About the role:

Own the go-to-market for Europe's next investment markets

We aim high at Upvest. Over the last years we have built one of Europe's most relevant B2B fintechs: an Investment API on top of a self-developed core banking engine, with full regulatory licences and investment operations included. Germany and the UK are proven, with more than 20 clients live and over 110 million trades processed in 2025. Our licences are passported across 20+ EEA countries, which means the infrastructure for the rest of Europe is already in place. From here we’re on a journey to enter market by market in Europe, starting with France, Spain, and Italy.

This is your opportunity to turn our foundation into a flywheel for new markets. You will own the go-to-market for continental Europe end-to-end: defining which client segments we go after first, from fast-growing fintechs to established banks, building the target list and the pipeline behind it, and shaping the commercial case that wins against local incumbents and against the instinct of large banks to build it all themselves.

Lead high-stakes sales and win complex deals with financial institutions

Our clients include the most ambitious fintechs and the most demanding financial institutions in Europe. Winning their business requires enterprise commercial rigour, deep domain knowledge, and genuine client partnership. Deals run over many months, involve procurement, risk, compliance and IT, and are won on substance rather than volume. Since inception we have been delivering on such high touch deals with clearly defined sales journeys, strong materials, and a unique approach now amplified by AI.

You will lead those deals personally before you lead them through others. That means owning the largest opportunities in your region yourself, from first conversation to signature, while bringing the discipline that makes the motion repeatable: rigorous qualification, value-based and consultative selling, predictable forecasting, and a clear view on where not to spend time. You use AI actively to increase your own coverage and later that of your team, and you feed what you learn from clients back into product, solutions, and marketing.

Attract, develop and lead a best-in-class sales team in European fintech

Building world-class financial infrastructure requires world-class people. At Upvest we put hiring excellence and people development front and centre. The Growth team today features talented, driven people coming from Europe's leading fintechs, financial institutions, and technology companies, with Sales working side by side with revenue ops, marketing, partnerships, and solutions engineering on shared targets.

With inspiring yet pragmatic and hands-on leadership you will build the European sales team around you. You will set the bar for the talent you hire, ramp new Account Executives fast, set and steer their targets, and coach them through cycles that few people have run before. You will be measured on what your team closes as much as on what you close yourself, and you will keep carrying a quota personally for as long as this stage of the business asks for it.

What you’ll do:

  • The complexity and richness of financial infrastructure: Working at the intersection of API-first SaaS and regulated financial services, with clients ranging from hypergrowth fintechs to global banks, is one of the most strategic and commercially interesting places to be. Every client relationship and every deal teaches you something new. If you are intellectually curious about how financial markets and products are being rebuilt from the ground up, this is the role for you.

  • Flexibility with a European footprint: We are a Berlin- and London-headquartered company with a growing presence across Europe. We are equally open to candidates based in one of Europe's financial hubs, in particular Paris, Madrid, and Milan, who are willing to spend meaningful time in Berlin. What matters most is the quality of your leadership and the results you deliver.

What you bring:

  • 5+ years in senior sales roles, including at least two years leading a team, within high-growth B2B technology and financial services. You have sold API-based enterprise SaaS into fintechs, banks, brokers or wealth managers, and you know financial infrastructure such as core-banking or securities processing.

  • A proven track record of closing complex, high-value deals with financial institutions, and of building the foundations that make doing so repeatable. You have taken a sales team from first foundations to early scale, with a proven track-record of exceeding ambitious revenue targets

  • Genuine European reach: You have sold across several European countries, with direct experience in at least one of France, Spain or Italy, a strong network in the world of banking and finance

  • A modern approach to sales: customer-centric, value-based, data-driven, and AI-enabled. You have strong views on what great looks like, from qualification frameworks to CRM hygiene to how account plans and collaboration roadmaps have the highest impact and are enabled by and enhanced with AI, and you turn those views into standards the team works to.

  • Hands-on ownership with strategic foresight: You operate practically, think in second-order effects to get complex deals across the line, and you are genuinely comfortable carrying quota yourself at this stage rather than only managing others who do.

  • Outstanding people leadership: You hire exceptional people, develop them continuously, and create a non-hierarchical, inclusive and respectful environment where the best talent chooses to stay and grow. You lead with clarity, empathy, and high standards.

  • Fluent English plus native-level in either French, Spanish, or Italian. Investment domain knowledge, experience selling regulated products, and time at a tier-1 growth company are a strong plus.

How we Upvest in you:

  • Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

  • Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.

  • Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.
