title: Lead Legal Counsel, Regulatory and Financial Services
descriptionHtml:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

We are currently operating approximately 30k business accounts under a BaaS model with Swan.

The role of Financial Services in our strategy is set to grow, both in terms of revenue and product contribution, to serve our 800k current customer base.

As such, we are initiating a process to get licensed as Etablissement de paiement et Société de financement. Our ambition is to start onboarding new customers by mid 2027 before starting migrating existing customers.

To meet this ambition, we are starting to hire our Tech, Product, Compliance, Legal and Ops leaders.

We are looking for a Lead Legal Counsel to drive the legal function of our Financial Services activity and build our regulatory legal team.

From the day you join until we are fully licensed, you will structure and execute the legal path to authorization: interpret requirements, translate them into an internal plan, and ensure deliverables are complete, consistent, and aligned across teams. You will help define the target operating model (intra-group and outsourced) and ensure it is legally defensible and well documented for the application.

After licensing, you will shift from “building the file” to running and scaling the legal function of the regulated entity: ensuring ongoing compliance with ACPR expectations, enabling product growth safely, and keeping the operating model (including outsourcing) continuously audit-ready. You will own the legal oversight of day-to-day legal and corporate matters (policies, governance, reporting support, inspections), lead the legal work for launching new regulated products and entering new partnerships, and manage the legal aspects of onboarding and migrating customers to the licensed subsidiary (terms, communications, complaints/conduct risk).

This is a greenfield project with high autonomy and responsibility, and the opportunity to shape the legal culture of a fast-growing fintech while managing and mentoring an experienced Legal Counsel, with the ambition to scale the team further as the business grows.

Organisation & Reporting

You will be part of the core Legal Department. Your reporting line will be Stanislas, our General Counsel.

You will manage a seasoned Legal Counsel and will be responsible for planning the future growth of the Financial Services Legal team. You will also partner closely with our Financial Services Chief Compliance and Risk Officer, Chief Operational Officer and the contract team.

Mission & Objectives

Team Leadership & Structuring

  • You manage, mentor, and develop your team member(s), fostering a high-performance, autonomous, and pragmatic legal culture.

  • You structure the team’s workload and roadmap, delegating effectively while remaining deeply hands-on.

  • You anticipate future hiring needs and actively participate in scaling the regulatory legal team.

Corporate and governance You design, document and run the legal aspects of corporate governance: delegation of powers, board/committee charters, conflicts management, inter-company arrangements on payment services outsourcing, governance narrative for the ACPR reports, and ongoing legal compliance cadence once authorized.

Products, contracts and customer legal architecture

  • You own the legal design of the FS product perimeter (payments services, account services, credit/financing products as applicable).

  • You work with the contractual team (Roland) on the associated contractual framework: customer terms, disclosures, pricing documentation, complaint handling language, and operational/legal flows (including KYC/AML handoffs, incident handling and customer communications).

Outsourcing / BaaS transition & vendor contracting You own legal matters relating to critical outsourcing and third-party reliance (including existing BaaS arrangements): contract negotiation, regulatory outsourcing clauses, audit/access rights, sub-outsourcing controls, exit plans, SLAs, data protection allocation, operational resilience expectations, and documentation suitable for ACPR scrutiny.

Migration readiness In close collaboration with the operation team (Maxime), you lead the legal plan for migrating customers from Swan (sequencing, consent/novation approaches, customer communications from a legal standpoint, continuity of mandates, handling of incidents/complaints, and safeguards to minimise conduct risk).

Privacy and Security In close coordination with our DPO (Léa) and security stakeholders, you ensure that our Financial Services operating model address data processing roles, cross-border flows (if any), retention, incident response, recordkeeping, and contractual protections with key providers.

Regulatory engagement support & internal enablement

  • Until we are fully licenced, you help prepare ACPR interactions (Q&A packs, position papers, meeting preparation).

  • Once authorized, you own the relationship with ACPR from a legal perspective, supporting the CCRO with legal opinions, advisory etc.

  • You train internal stakeholders on the legal/regulatory constraints that shape product and operations, and build a “legal-by-design” approach for Financial Services.

Culture, Training & Advisory You will be expected to operate as an owner, not a “support function,” and to produce pragmatic, regulator-ready outcomes.

About you

  • You have 8+ years of relevant experience, including in-house legal experience at a regulated entity (payments, EMI/PI, bank, lending/consumer credit, factoring, etc.), fintech, or BaaS.

  • You have a proven track record or a strong aptitude for managing, mentoring, and developing team members in a fast-paced environment.

  • You have substantial experience in regulated financial services legal work, and you are comfortable owning cross-functional programmes.

  • Senior legal expert in a French ACPR-regulated entity (établissement de paiement, établissement de crédit, société de financement or similar).

  • Hands on contract experience and knowledge about our regulatory environment (arrêté du 3 novembre 2014, PSD2, DORA, EBA Guidelines, etc).

Skills & mindset

Technical strengths You can credibly lead on :

  • ACPR/European regulatory frameworks for payments and/or lending/financing;

  • Outsourcing and third-party risk legal frameworks in regulated environments;

  • Governance and regulated-entity corporate law basics.

Soft skills

  • Player-coach mentality: capable of executing complex individual contributions while guiding and empowering your team.

  • You can work fast without losing rigour.

  • Strong pedagogy: able to explain complex regulatory legal topics to product managers, engineers and founders in simple, actionable terms.

  • Pragmatic, impact-driven approach, capable of operating under strong regulatory constraints without blocking innovation.

  • Very strong written and oral communication skills in both French and English.

Languages, presence and location

  • Fluent French and English are mandatory.

  • Based in France, with a strong preference for Paris.

  • Regular on-site presence in Paris is expected. Partial remote is possible. This is not a fully remote role.

Recruitment Process

1. Interview with Lucie (30-45 min), Senior Recruiter

2. Interview with Stanislas (1h), Head of Legal, Risk & Compliance

3. Case Study with Stanislas & Maxime (1h)

4. Last round with Laurent and Felix (45 min)

 

What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

-To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

-To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

-Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

 

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains ----- or ----- style="min-height:1.5em">We will never ask you for payment or financial information

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately.

 

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

title: Lead Plant Robotics Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Lead Plant Robotics Engineer to develop the manufacturing solutions that allow us to mass-produce solid rocket motors. As the lead, you will own the robotic handling strategy for our pilot plant, from the first layout concept through commissioning and scale-up, and you will lead the robotics team.

This is a unique opportunity to define how rockets are built at scale. The pilot plant is the blueprint for the production lines that follow, and the robotic cells you lead will handle containers, motor casings and energetic materials every day.

About us

We're a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications. We are building our first production facility, and are applying our knowledge toward serial production of solid rocket motors.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you're excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you're ready to rise to the challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the robotics architecture of the pilot plant: robot selection, cell layouts, end-effectors, and handling concepts for buckets, transport boxes, motor casings and carriers.

  • Lead the development of robotic handling solutions for dosing, mixing, casting, curing and demolding stations, including the explosion-protection concept (enclosure, pressure-resistant encapsulation or ATEX-certified equipment).

  • Define robotics requirements for the full line and manage the interfaces with automation, process engineering, ERP/MES and external integrators.

  • Lead the robotics engineering team and external suppliers, including specification, tendering, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT).

  • Drive cycle-time, throughput and availability targets using offline programming, simulation and data from the pilot line.

  • Lead the risk assessment and safety concept for robotic cells together with safety engineering (Machinery Directive, ISO 10218, ISO 13849).

What we are looking for

  • Significant professional experience (typically 3+ years) designing and commissioning industrial robotic systems, ideally in manufacturing or process environments.

  • Lead-level experience: you have led technical teams or acted as technical authority on a robotic project from concept to production.

  • Strong knowledge of industrial robot platforms (ideally ABB, Fanuc), including programming, offline programming and simulation.

  • Solid understanding of machine safety (Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC, ISO 10218, ISO 13849) and of structured risk assessment.

  • A hands-on engineering mindset: you can move from a concept sketch to a CAD layout, and you can debug a cell on the shop floor.

  • The ability to work with autonomy and at pace, and to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • A degree in robotics, mechatronics, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience may also be relevant.

Desirable experience

  • Robotic handling in explosion-protected or hazardous environments (Directive 2014/34/EU, TRGS 720 ff.), or with powders, pastes or chemicals.

  • Vision systems, force-torque sensing, or automated quality checks (X-ray or CT integration).

  • Multi-robot coordination, gantry systems, or AGV integration at production scale.

  • Experience with manufacturing execution systems (MES) and PLC integration.

  • Experience building production capability from zero in a startup or scale-up environment.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

  • Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

title: Lead / Principal Deployment Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team

Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers.

The Role

As a Lead / Principal Deployment Engineer, you are the backbone of Celonis delivery. You lead the hands-on implementation of Celonis solutions for enterprise customers, combining platform expertise with AI-augmented workflows to deliver high-quality outcomes, fast. You use Celonis’s AI deployment tools as your primary instruments - directing agents to build data models, generate analyses, and configure operational solutions, while applying your own judgment to validate outputs, adapt to customer context, and ensure business relevance.

This is not a traditional consulting role where you build everything manually. You are an AI-augmented delivery professional: you specify what needs to be built, direct AI agents to execute wherever possible, validate the results, and iterate with the customer. You generate value by understanding the customer’s business, translating their needs into technical specifications and solutions, and ensuring the platform delivers measurable impact.

The Work You’ll Do

Initiate and Connect

  • Conduct business discovery workshops to translate customers’ strategic objectives into high-impact Celonis use cases
  • Collaborate with the customer’s IT and business stakeholders to define project scope, data requirements, and success criteria
  • Ensure data connectivity and extraction pipelines are properly configured, working with specialist resources if required

Build & Value

  • Direct AI deployment agents (Apollo) to build data models, process analyses, KPIs, and dashboards - writing clear specifications and validating agent outputs against business requirements
  • Build and configure Celonis solutions across the platform: Process Intelligence Graph, data transformations, process analysis, operational solutions, and AI-powered insights
  • Identify process inefficiencies and root causes using Celonis technology, always in close collaboration with the customer
  • Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, business relevance, and alignment with customer context - applying domain knowledge where the AI cannot
  • Lead value creation workshops and define measures to improve process inefficiencies
  • Define and build KPIs measuring the customer’s success and quantify business impact
  • Design and build operational solutions to drive value, adoption and improve process conformance

 Rollout, Adoption, and Handover

  • Enable key customer users to use and extend the solution independently, setting the foundation for long-term adoption
  • Manage project outcomes against timelines, scope, and customer expectations
  • Train and demonstrate to customer users, guiding them on the path to sustained value
  • Document solution design decisions and configurations for future reference and handoff

Domain & Industry Depth

  • Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals
  • Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage
  • Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap

What Makes This Role Different in the AI Era

  • You work with AI agents as your primary tools - your job is to direct, validate, and refine their output, not to write every line of code or build every analysis manually
  • You need strong specification and context engineering skills - the ability to translate a customer’s ambiguous business need into a precise instruction that an AI agent can execute correctly
  • You are expected to continuously learn and adapt as AI capabilities evolve, experimenting with new approaches and sharing what works with your peers
  • You balance speed with quality - AI accelerates execution, but you own the judgment calls on whether the output is right for this customer
  • You think in sustainable software solutions. While AI agents will generate first results quickly, you need to ensure that the operational solutions you build in Celonis are robust, user friendly, maintainable, and scalable

The Qualifications You Need

  • Experience: 7+ years minimum in Management or IT consulting, data/solution consulting, or process improvement consulting within software vendors, consulting firms, or system integrators.
  • Platform skills: Ability to build and configure solutions on the Celonis platform, including data modeling, process analysis, KPI definition, and automation. Proficiency in PQL, SQL, and Python.
  • AI fluency: Comfort working with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Ability to write clear specifications, evaluate AI-generated outputs, and iterate effectively. Experience with prompt engineering or context engineering is a strong plus.
  • Business and process domain expertise : Strong understanding /deep expertise (based on seniority level) of enterprise business processes and financial metrics. Knowledge of standard ERPs (SAP, Oracle) and process areas (Inventory Management, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Accounts Payable) is a strong plus.
  • Consulting skills: Ability to steer customer workshops, present findings to management, manage stakeholder expectations, and deliver outcomes in the face of adversity and ambiguity. Comfortable working with both technical and business audiences. 
  • Analytical mindset: Excellent problem-solving skills with a value-driven orientation. Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and quantify business impact.
  • Learning agility: Willingness to continuously develop expertise through experimentation. Comfort with ambiguity and evolving tools.
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Technology Management, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a comparable field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English and German required. 
  • Travel: Willingness to travel to customer location up to 50%, according to customer requirement and project delivery phases.

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

descriptionHtml:

The role

As a Principal Consultant, you're often the first person a customer meets to brainstorm a business problem. You should be at home debating distributed systems with engineers and framing decisions with leadership. You'll frame the problem with customers, shape the approach with the team, provide technical direction, and stay hands-on through delivery. You will work in self-managing, experienced, small, and high-impact teams, solving hard problems. This is a consulting & tech delivery role  and while you will not have direct reports, you will regularly influence teams, mentor practitioners, manage stakeholders, and guide organisations through complex technology and business decisions.

What the work looks like

We can't promise which problem you'll pick up, but the menu right now looks something like this:

  • Redesign a ClickHouse schema so an ad buyer can query 85 billion rows in under two seconds, and discover that pre-exploding the rows 168x is actually the right answer.
  • Keep a vehicle telemetry platform moving billions of messages a day without the Kafka consumers falling over.
  • Build the engineering spine of a mobile wallet used by more than two billion people across four continents.
  • Ship the data product behind peer-review submissions for one of the world's largest scientific publishers.

The list changes every quarter. The pattern doesn't: data-heavy, distributed, and often sitting on top of something that already exists and isn't perfect.

What you'll do

Frame Problems & Propose Solutions

  • Help customers find the right problem before jumping to a solution.
  • Facilitate discovery sessions, architecture reviews, and technical workshops.
  • Translate business goals into a technology strategy and an execution plan.

Lead Through Technical Excellence

  • Stay hands-on; contribute directly to design, architecture, implementation, and review.
  • Make pragmatic calls balancing business needs, engineering quality, and delivery timelines.
  • Guide teams to build scalable, resilient, secure systems  and the practices that keep them that way.

Influence, Advise, and align

  • Act as a trusted advisor on technology and investment decisions; assessments, due diligence, advisory.
  • Build trust and alignment across Sahaj and customer teams
  • Converge competing priorities into a path forward.
  • Communicate complex ideas clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Shape new work through discovery and proposals; mentor others and raise the bar as you go.

Operate Across Technology Domains

Distributed systems, data engineering, AI & agentic systems, DevOps/SRE. Depth in few areas; breadth across, and appreciation for trade-offs in context.

You'll thrive here if

  • You reach for the simplest solution that gets the job done and distrust accidental complexity.
  • You think in systems, not isolated parts.
  • You stay calm when the path is unclear and build clarity for those around you.
  • You move easily between the org-level picture and the technical detail.
  • You're curious by default and pick up new domains fast.
  • You'd rather be in the room with a customer solving a real problem.

What we're looking for

  • Demonstrable building software systems in complex environments.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals; expert in at least one language, ideally polyglot.
  • Hands-on experience designing and delivering distributed systems at scale.
  • Deep grasp of architecture, system design, and engineering trade-offs.

What will you experience in terms of culture at Sahaj?

What are the benefits of being at Sahaj?

title: Lead Product Manager - AI Platform
descriptionHtml:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

📱 Our Product Team

Led by Fabien, our VP Product, Joko's Product team groups the passionate individuals behind our users' delight! From brainstorming to development to launch, the Product team's main mission is to turn ideas into reality by working hand-in-hand with the Engineering, Design, and Business teams.

Joko is organized into four product tribes, each owning a key dimension of the company's value:

  • Business lines owns the current core value proposition, covering online shopping, in-store experiences, and gift cards, each run as a dedicated team.

  • Scale focuses on growing and amplifying this value through growth, international expansion, and shared core user experiences across the app.

  • Juno builds the next value proposition: an AI shopping assistant that finds the right product at the best price in seconds, backed by a universal catalog of what merchants actually sell.

  • AI Platform helps Joko become a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside, owning the internal agent infrastructure, automation layer, internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security and operational scalability.

⚡ The AI Platform tribe

AI Platform's mission is to turn Joko into a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside. The tribe builds the internal agent infrastructure that will let every team work faster, automate complex workflows, and create new 0-to-1 features with AI.

Its flagship product is Joker, Joko's internal AI teammate. Already live in Slack, Notion and Linear, Joker can understand context, use tools, act across systems, and take real work from idea to execution. The ambition is not just to automate repetitive tasks, but to make agents a new production layer for how Joko builds and operates.

For this to work at company scale, AI Platform also owns the backbone underneath: Gotham, the identity and permission layer that lets agents act with exactly the access of the person they work for; plus the internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security, reliability and server-cost foundations that keep Joko fast, safe and scalable.

The tribe's users are the teams inside Joko. Its goal is simple: help them run extremely efficient processes, remove operational bottlenecks, and give the company the leverage it needs to scale in the coming years.

🎯 What you will do

As Lead Product Manager for the Platform tribe, your mission is to make Joko's own machine faster, safer and increasingly agentic. You will report to Fabien, our VP Product, own the tribe's roadmap end to end, and lead the Product Managers on its task forces as the team grows. The tribe is being staffed right now, so expect to be hands-on from day one on scopes you own personally, and to build the function as the team grows.

  • Set the tribe's strategy: You will decide what Platform builds, in what order, and what it stops doing. You will map what teams across the company do today in our internal tools, what it costs them and what they need next, then turn that into a roadmap you can defend in front of leadership. This intake runs permanently, as a standing part of the job.

  • Own Joker and Gotham: These are the tribe's most strategic bets and you will drive them personally. Taking Joker from what it is today to a production-grade agent platform, and shipping Gotham's permission model so agents never hold more access than the person they act for, is the highest-leverage work in your scope.

  • Build the automation layer: The approach is capability first: expose an action as a scoped tool, write the instructions an agent needs to use it well, then let the agent run the job. Interfaces come only where they earn their place, and deciding what still deserves a screen is a genuinely new kind of product judgment.

  • Retire what should not exist: Part of the mandate is subtractive: migrating off tools that have outlived their purpose and progressively switching off legacy systems, without breaking the teams that depend on them every day.

  • Own security, compliance and reliability: Identity and access, data retention and minimization, log centralization, audit, test coverage. The requirement often comes from Legal or an auditor, and still has to be shaped into something people will actually adopt.

  • Lead and grow the team: You will hire, mentor and lead the Product Managers who own the tribe's task forces, set the bar on discovery and delivery, and be the person the tribe's engineers and designers look to for product direction.

  • Be the interface for the whole company: You will be the point of contact for Engineering, Ops, Finance, Legal, Data and Care, structuring their demands and arbitrating between them. You will define success in time saved, cost removed, risk reduced and adoption by internal teams, and report on it in those terms.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have 5+ years of experience in Product, including experience leading or mentoring other Product Managers. A background on internal tools, back-office products, APIs, platforms or complex B2B products is a strong plus.

  • AI fluency, hands-on: This scope is being rebuilt around agents, so this criterion carries the most weight. You use AI tools daily in your own work, you understand what agents are actually good and bad at, and you have opinions about where automation belongs and where a human interface still earns its place.

  • Product for teams mindset: You are comfortable building for internal users, where the bar is efficiency, robustness and adoption rather than polish. Problems nobody outside the company will ever see still energise you. If what drives you is craft on a consumer surface seen by millions, this scope will frustrate you.

  • Strong technical appetite: You are curious and hands-on with infrastructure, identity, permissions, reliability, security, compliance and data architecture. Coding is not required, but you need to understand how things work.

  • Management: You have a proven track record in people management. You know how to grow Product Managers, set a high bar for rigor, and give direction without taking every decision yourself.

  • Stakeholder leadership: You are excellent at alignment, prioritization and saying no. You can navigate many dependencies, arbitrate between senior stakeholders, and make trade-offs explicit.

  • Analytical & pragmatic: You are data-driven, impact-oriented, and you go straight for the real operational problem.

  • Communication: You are a clear, structured communicator, able to translate complex technical topics into business impact for the exec team.

  • Location: Based in France or Spain.

  • Languages: Fluent in English, both written and spoken. French is a plus, but it is optional.

  • Mindset: You are ownership-driven, resilient, and motivated by solving hard, unglamorous but high-impact problems that make the whole company better. You have an entrepreneurial mindset, you like challenges, you welcome feedback and you love constantly learning and getting better.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Compensation: €78.3K – €125.9K

  • 💳 In-Store owns card-linked offers, where users link their bank card and earn cash back when they pay at partner merchants in physical stores. It is a very different product line, closer to banking, payment integrations and merchant operations.

  • 🎁 Gift Cards lets users buy or earn gift cards from a catalog of brands, and already represents a significant and fast-growing share of company revenue.

Across these scopes, the tribe works on hard, high-impact product problems: improving catch and track rates, reducing funnel leaks, adapting to privacy and browser changes, strengthening payment and affiliate flows, and creating better customer experiences.

As Lead Product Manager for the Business Lines tribe, your mission is to grow and strengthen the revenue Joko runs on today, across Online, In-Store and Gift Cards. You will make sure the tribe knows exactly where the chain leaks, sizes each lever properly, and prioritises accordingly.

  • Go deep where it matters: Affiliate tracking and attribution, card-linked payment integrations, checkout and coupon flows. You will not be the PM writing every spec, but you will be expected to understand these mechanics well enough to challenge a diagnosis and make the final call.

  • Champion the user experience: You will stay close to user needs and pain points across each business line, and make sure the tribe turns them into dedicated features, sharp product improvements and astonishing customer experiences.

  • Navigate the structural challenges: Privacy regulation, browser tracking restrictions, payment ecosystem changes and last-click competition keep changing the rules. You will build the product strategy that keeps the business healthy as conditions shift, rather than reacting to each change as it lands.

  • Lead and grow the PMs: You will manage and mentor the Product Managers on Online, In-Store and Gift Cards, set the bar on funnel analysis, experimentation and delivery, and grow people who can own a revenue stream on their own.

  • Define what healthy looks like: You will set the metrics that matter for each business line, hold the tribe to them, and be accountable for the tribe's contribution to company revenue.

  • Work across the company: You will partner with the B2B teams who own merchant relationships, with Care on the user pain that untracked transactions create, with Data, and directly with the affiliate and payment partners themselves.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have 5+ years of experience in Product, including experience leading or mentoring other Product Managers, ideally on consumer products. Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, payments, adtech or affiliate marketing is a strong plus.

  • Data fluency: This is the criterion that carries the most weight here. You can interrogate a funnel yourself, break a metric into its components, and tell a real signal from noise. Much of this job is diagnosis before it is delivery, and you need to be able to do it yourself, not just ask for it.

Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.
Tes futures missions : En tant que Lead Product Manager, tu pilotes des projets produits complexes en portant la vision produit, en orchestrant le delivery et en garantissant la création de valeur pour le client comme pour les équipes. - Définir et porter la stratégie produit avec le client : modélisation de la valeur, architecture produit, EPICs, arbitrage des trade-offs et alignement technico-fonctionnel. - Assurer un delivery réussi en coordonnant plusieurs squads pour livrer des projets complexes dans les temps, le budget et le niveau de qualité attendu. - Créer les conditions de réussite des équipes en définissant le bon set-up (équipes Theodo ou partenaires), en négociant les moyens nécessaires et en adaptant l’organisation aux contraintes du projet. - Apporter de la visibilité et de la clarté via des dispositifs de gouvernance adaptés, pour aligner l’ensemble des parties prenantes. -Selon la composition de l'équipe, tu pourras être responsable de faire monter en compétence les Products Managers, en créant un environnement propice à leur réussite, leur montée en compétences et leur projection chez le client et/ou chez Theodo. - Garantir la satisfaction client sur le long terme, en construisant une relation de confiance, en identifiant de nouvelles opportunités et en collaborant avec les équipes Sales, Staffing et People. Après 2 mois de cadrage, les équipes Theodo ont piloté une approche design-to-cost permettant de modulariser la plateforme et de migrer 20 ans d’historique en 14 mois, dans le respect du budget et du planning. - Sevetys : refonte complète d’une web app métier avec deux volets stratégiques : un outil de prise de rendez-vous pour les propriétaires d’animaux et un back-office dédié aux vétérinaires. Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Aujourd’hui, l’ambition du groupe est de se positionner comme le leader de l’IA appliquée au développement logiciel, c’est pourquoi nous avons lancé la practice AI Modernisation. Au sein de cette practice, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la modernisation de leurs systèmes legacy. Grâce à une IA maîtrisée et une méthode éprouvée, nous allons 3 fois plus vite sur le delivery de ces projets critiques.
La practice accompagne principalement des scale-ups comme Qonto ou Doctolib et des grands groupes comme Carrefour, Pernod Ricard, Les Mousquetaires, Urgo, Cdiscount ou Edenred. Si tu veux rejoindre le futur de la tech, tu es au bon endroit !

Ton équipe :

Tu rejoindras une communauté tech de plus de 350 Theodoers : software engineers, tech leads, engineering managers et architectes, avec lesquels tu pourras échanger, apprendre et progresser au quotidien.

Chez Theodo, les techs travaillent en équipes projet, constituées en fonction des besoins de chaque client. Tu feras partie d’une équipe de Theodoers à taille humaine (4 à 5 personnes), réunissant Software Engineers, Tech Lead et Product Manager. Ensemble, vous collaborerez étroitement avec le client, avec des échanges réguliers pour partager vos avancées, approfondir la compréhension de son problème et faire évoluer le produit au plus près des besoins de ses utilisateurs.

Les métiers du Software Engineering évoluent avec l’IA : viens apprendre à devenir un Tech Lead AI Native.

Tes futures missions :

Nous recrutons un·e Tech Lead pour concevoir et développer des produits digitaux utiles, performants et durables pour répondre aux problématiques de nos clients et de leurs utilisateurs.

En tant que Tech Lead, tu es garant du rythme et de la qualité de delivery de ton projet. Tu mobilises ton équipe, fais les choix techniques adaptés au contexte et accompagnes les Software Engineers dans leur progression, avec l’objectif de faire grandir à la fois le produit et les personnes qui le construisent.

  • Garantir le delivery et la qualité du projet

Tu vises un niveau de qualité radicalement supérieur, en structurant le delivery autour de standards :

    • Concevoir des architectures évolutives et résilientes (diagrammes d’architecture clairs et partagés)
    • Rédiger des spécifications précises pour permettre le développement sans bugs de fonctionnalités
    • Mettre en place une stratégie de qualité basée sur : le Clean Code, les tests automatisés, les code reviews
    • Assurer un environnement de travail structuré avec les principes 5S (organisation, clarté, efficacité)
    • Accélérer la vitesse de développement grâce au déploiement des agents IA
  • Être le partenaire technique du client
    • Participer aux routines projet (backlog refinement, daily, cérémonies) et veiller à la satisfaction continue du client
    • Expliquer et défendre les choix techniques pour créer de la confiance et aligner toutes les parties prenantes
  • Créer les conditions de performance de l’équipe
    • Mettre en place un environnement de travail efficace et structuré pour l’équipe projet
    • Mettre en place des boucles de résolution des problèmes via le Daily Problem Solving
    • Créer les conditions pour que l’équipe exploite les LLM et gagne en productivité dans son quotidien
  • Faire progresser les Software Engineers de ton équipe
    • Analyser de manière appronfondie les défauts à la source dans le but d’améliorer les connaissance des équipes (Dantotsu)
    • Former et accompagner l’équipe (pair programming, code reviews, formation)

Les problématiques sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples :

  • HealthHero : leader européen de la télémédecine, ils souhaitent moderniser leur plateforme française, Qare, en vue d’une fusion avec la plateforme UK. L’objectif est de passer de Loopback2 à Nest pour pouvoir upgrade de Node 10 vers Node 20. Grâce à notre méthode de modernisation accélérée par l’IA, nous passons d’une estimation à 70 semaines sans IA à une migration terminée en 21 semaines et accélérons la vitesse de delivery par 5.
  • Pernod Ricard : souhaitait moderniser une application interne utilisée pour gérer leur campagnes marketing, des millions d’euros en jeu. L’impact de Theodo : 23 semaines pour moderniser complètement l’application de Vue Express vers React Nest avec une réécriture plus pragmatique. Nous avons également effectué la connection à leur nouvel ERP, auparavant impossible sans la migration.

Tes perspectives d’évolution :

2 axes d’évolutions s’offrent à toi:

  • Architecte senior : développer une expertise technique
  • Solution Architect: participer à le vente de projets complexes en définissant les solutions techniques les plus ingénieuses pour nous permettre de gagner
  • Managériale : Engineering Manager

Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu :

Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits.

Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients.

Profil recherché :

  • 4 à 8 ans d’expérience en développement
  • Solide maîtrise des architectures web (front, back, BDD, infra, déploiement) et des pratiques DevOps (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Capacité à concevoir des architectures scalables, faire des choix techniques pertinents et garantir un haut niveau de qualité de code.
  • Expérience dans le coaching et l’accompagnement de développeurs, en restant connecté·e à la tech (veille, code, pair programming).
  • Orientation création de valeur et compréhension des enjeux métier du client.
Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo ? L’environnement: 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 De l’épargne salariale avec un mécanisme d’intéressement en partenariat avec Epsor 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile 🧒 Aides et places en crèche réservées Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

title: Lead Software Engineer / Energie-Startup (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the job

Wir bei Gridty entwickeln eine KI-Plattform, die Unternehmen dabei unterstützt, ihren Energieverbrauch intelligent zu analysieren und nachhaltig zu reduzieren. ⚡️

Unsere Software verbindet Energiedaten aus vielen Standorten und technischen Anlagen, erkennt automatisch Anomalien und Ineffizienzen und unterstützt Energie- und Nachhaltigkeitsteams mit KI-Agenten bei der Analyse und Optimierung ihres Betriebs.

Unser Fokus liegt insbesondere auf Unternehmen mit vielen Standorten – etwa im Einzelhandel, in der Logistik und anderen energieintensiven Branchen.

Wer sind wir?

Wir sind ein junges Energie- und KI-Startup aus Köln und gerade in einer spannenden Wachstumsphase.

Unsere Plattform ist live und bei ersten Kunden im Einsatz. Jetzt wollen wir den nächsten Schritt gehen: mehr Standorte, mehr Datenquellen, bessere automatisierte Analysen und eine Plattform, die mit unseren Kunden skalieren kann.

Dafür suchen wir einen Senior Software Engineer & Platform Lead (m/w/d), der Lust hat, früh Verantwortung zu übernehmen und unsere technische Plattform entscheidend mitzugestalten. 🚀

Unser Stack

Unter anderem arbeiten wir aktuell mit:

Python · FastAPI · React · TypeScript · PostgreSQL / Timeseries · Google Cloud · Docker · LLMs / AI Agents

Du musst nicht jedes einzelne Tool davon bereits beherrschen.

Wo arbeiten wir?

Gridty hat seinen Sitz in Köln. Wir arbeiten hybrid und treffen uns regelmäßig persönlich als Team.

Daher wäre es ideal, wenn du aus Köln oder der weiteren Region kommst bzw. regelmäßig vor Ort sein kannst. Gleichzeitig ist uns wichtiger, die richtige Person zu finden, als jeden Tag gemeinsam im selben Büro zu sitzen. 💻

Wie läuft unser Bewerbungsprozess?

  1. Kurzes Kennenlernen per Google Meet – ca. 15–30 Minuten
  2. Technisches und persönliches Gespräch – ca. 60 Minuten
  3. Persönliches Kennenlernen in Köln
  4. Willkommen bei Gridty! ⚡️

Interesse?

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

Du übernimmst eine zentrale technische Rolle bei Gridty und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns unsere Plattform weiter.

Konkret bedeutet das unter anderem:

  • Technische Ownership für zentrale Teile unserer Plattform und Software-Architektur
  • Weiterentwicklung unserer Backend-Services und APIs mit Python/FastAPI
  • Weiterentwicklung unseres React-/TypeScript-Frontends
  • Aufbau und Skalierung unserer Datenarchitektur für große Mengen an Energie- und Zeitreihendaten
  • Weiterentwicklung unserer KI-basierten Analysefunktionen und Integration von LLM-/Agenten-Workflows
  • Integration neuer Datenquellen, Messsysteme und externer APIs
  • Umsetzung technischer Kundenintegrationen und Unterstützung bei komplexem Troubleshooting
  • Sicherstellung von Code-Qualität durch Testing, Reviews und sinnvolle Engineering-Standards
  • Weiterentwicklung unserer Cloud-Infrastruktur, Deployments und CI/CD-Prozesse
  • Monitoring, Security und Performance-Optimierung unserer Plattform
  • Mitgestaltung unserer technischen Roadmap und zukünftigen Architektur

Und vor allem: Du bekommst viel Gestaltungsspielraum und Verantwortung.

Wir sind ein kleines Team – gute Ideen verschwinden bei uns nicht in fünf Abstimmungsebenen, sondern können direkt Teil des Produkts werden.

Qualifikation

Wer bist du?

Du…

  • hast Lust, an einem Produkt mit echtem Impact auf Energieverbrauch und CO₂-Emissionen zu arbeiten.
  • magst Verantwortung, Gestaltungsspielraum und die Geschwindigkeit eines Startups.
  • bringst mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung mit.
  • fühlst dich im Backend und bei Software-Architektur zu Hause und hast gleichzeitig keine Angst davor, auch mal ins Frontend zu schauen.
  • hast Erfahrung mit Python und idealerweise FastAPI oder vergleichbaren Frameworks.
  • kennst dich mit JavaScript/TypeScript und modernen Frontend-Technologien wie React aus.
  • hast Erfahrung mit relationalen Datenbanken und idealerweise auch mit größeren Zeitreihendaten.
  • denkst nicht nur in Features, sondern auch in skalierbarer Architektur, sauberem Code, Testing, Security und zuverlässigem Betrieb.
  • kannst technische Entscheidungen eigenständig treffen und verständlich kommunizieren.
  • sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.

Nice to have: Erfahrung mit Cloud-Infrastruktur, Data Engineering, LLMs/AI Agents, Energiesystemen oder IoT-/Messdaten. Entscheidend ist aber vor allem, dass du Lust hast, dich in diese Themen einzuarbeiten.

title: Lead Supply Chain Coördinator
descriptionHtml:
Bij Crisp hebben we een missie: eten met meer smaak bereikbaar maken voor iedereen, waarbij we onze kracht van de kortste keten van boer tot bord inzetten op een manier waar je trots op kunt zijn. Als Lead Supply Chain Coördinator geef jij leiding aan het team dat iedere dag opnieuw zorgt dat de korte keten tussen leverancier en ons Warehouse zo goed mogelijk loopt. Zo kunnen we onze knetterverse producten altijd op tijd bij onze klanten bezorgen.

Je staat zelf midden in de operatie, maar kijkt ook verder: je maakt de supply chain elke dag een stukje slimmer, bouwt aan de processen en manier van werken binnen je team, en zorgt voor een sterke samenwerking met ons warehouse. Zo bouw je mee aan een Supply Chain-afdeling waarmee we kunnen blijven groeien.

Wat je gaat doen

Als Lead Inbound Supply Chain Coördinator zorg jij er samen met je team voor dat onze leveranciers de juiste producten, op het goede moment, in de juiste hoeveelheid leveren. Hierdoor krijgen onze klanten hun producten vers bezorgd en kunnen we op ons Warehouse de voorraad zo laag mogelijk houden. Dat is een ingewikkelde puzzel die we elke dag een stukje slimmer willen oplossen. Jij geeft het team daarin richting, houdt de dagelijkse operatie scherp en verbetert tegelijk structureel. Je hebt veel contact met externe partijen zoals leveranciers, en met andere teams binnen Crisp zoals ons warehouse en het commerciële team.

Een aantal van jouw verantwoordelijkheden zijn:

  • Je bent leidinggevende van het Inbound Supply Chain-team. Je coacht en ontwikkelt je teamleden, voert de gesprekken die daarbij horen en zorgt dat iedereen weet wat je van hem of haar verwacht.

title: Lead Tech SRE
descriptionHtml:
About Kestra

Kestra is the universal orchestration platform: open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems.

Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide, including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole, Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars, hundreds of contributors, and a fast-growing global community.

About the role

Kestra Cloud is our fully managed SaaS edition of Kestra. Each customer gets a dedicated Kestra instance on dedicated infrastructure, so the platform is a fleet of isolated stacks rather than one shared cluster. It is in Beta today, running production workloads for early customers, with General Availability planned for 2027. Each instance runs arbitrary user code (scripts, containers, queries against their own systems) through hundreds of plugins, and the fleet grows with every new customer. Provisioning, upgrading, and observing dozens to hundreds of identical stacks without drift is the core problem.

We're looking for a Lead Tech SRE to own Kestra Cloud end to end: the architecture and specs, the delivery, the monitoring, and the continuous improvement of the platform. You decide how the platform should evolve, write it down, split it into work, and ship it with your team.

You would lead a team of three, yourself included. That means you stay hands-on (a large share of your week is Terraform, Kubernetes manifests, and incident work) while setting the technical direction, reviewing designs, and dispatching work to two SREs.

You work closely with the CTO, the platform engineering teams building the Kestra core, and our security engineer. This is an engineering leadership role, not a people-management-only one.

What you would do

Architecture & specs

  • Own the target architecture of Kestra Cloud on GCP: the per-customer dedicated stack (cluster, network, databases, queues), how it is templated and versioned, regions, and the path from Beta to GA.

  • Write the specs (design docs, RFCs, ADRs) that turn product needs into infrastructure work, and defend the trade-offs: cost per customer vs isolation level, GCP project vs cluster vs node pool per customer, managed service vs self-run.

  • Define SLOs and error budgets per service and per tier, and make them the basis for prioritization.

Delivery

  • Break specs into work and dispatch it across the team, then review and unblock. You set the bar for Terraform modules, Helm charts, and GitOps conventions.

  • Automate the customer instance lifecycle: provisioning, upgrades, scaling, backups, migration, and decommissioning, with no manual steps.

  • Own the release path of Kestra Cloud with ArgoCD and GitHub Actions: progressive rollouts, rollback, and upgrade safety across the whole fleet of customer instances.

Monitoring & operations

  • Build the observability stack (metrics, logs, traces, alerting) so that issues are caught before customers report them.

  • Run on-call and incident response for the team: rotation, runbooks, blameless postmortems, and follow-ups that actually ship.

  • Plan capacity for a workload that is bursty by nature, and keep autoscaling honest.

Continuous improvement

  • Drive cost efficiency (FinOps) on GCP: per-customer cost visibility, right-sizing, committed use, and spot where it fits.

  • Harden the platform with our security engineer: network policies, workload identity, secrets, and audit trails toward SOC 2 expectations.

  • Feed back into the product: when Kestra itself makes the cloud hard to run, you write the issue, propose the fix, and work with core engineering to land it.

Our Tech Stack

  • Cloud: GCP (GKE, Cloud SQL, GCS, Cloud Load Balancing, IAM / Workload Identity)

  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Helm

  • Orchestration: Kubernetes, Docker

  • Deployment & Repository: GitHub Actions, ArgoCD

  • Monitoring & Logs: OpenTelemetry, Elastic, Prometheus, Grafana

  • Datastore: PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch

  • Queuing: Redis, Kafka, AMQP

  • Programming language: Java, TypeScript (you read it; you don't need to write it daily)

What we are looking for

  • 8+ years in SRE, platform, or infrastructure engineering, including at least 2 years leading the technical direction of a team or a platform.

  • Deep, production-grade Kubernetes expertise: you have operated fleets of clusters at scale and know where they break (upgrades, configuration drift, networking, resource sizing).

  • Strong Google Cloud experience: GKE, IAM, networking (VPC, private clusters, load balancing), and managed data services. Equivalent depth on AWS or Azure is not a substitute here.

  • Expert Terraform: you have designed module structures and state layouts that scale to many identical customer environments, not just written resources.

  • Proven ability to architect, spec, and dispatch: you can show design docs you wrote, explain the trade-offs you made, and describe how you split the work and delivered it.

  • Real on-call and incident experience, including running postmortems and turning them into durable fixes.

  • SaaS operations background: you have run a product for paying customers, with SLOs that mattered.

  • Fluent in English and comfortable working autonomously in a fully remote environment.

  • Pragmatism: you pick the boring solution when it works and can explain why.

Nice to have

  • Experience running workloads that execute untrusted or user-defined code (sandboxing, gVisor, node pool isolation).

  • Built or operated a fleet control plane for per-customer environments (Kubernetes operators, Crossplane, GKE Fleet / Config Sync, or custom provisioning services).

  • FinOps practice on GCP: per-customer cost attribution, committed use discounts, spot node pools.

  • Exposure to SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audits from the infrastructure side.

  • Familiarity with workflow orchestration (Kestra, Airflow, Temporal, or similar) or the JVM in production.

Your first six months

  1. Month 1: take over the current architecture, audit the current Kestra Cloud architecture, and map the gaps between Beta and GA.

  2. Months 2 to 3: publish the GA architecture spec and the SLOs, agree on them with the CTO, and turn them into a roadmap the team can execute.

  3. Months 4 to 6: deliver the first GA milestones (one-click provisioning of a customer instance, observability coverage, safe upgrade path) with your two SREs.

  4. After month 6: drive continuous improvement of the platform, including a re-architecture of the first version of Kestra Cloud based on what Beta and the first GA customers taught us.

Perks & Benefits

  • Work from anywhere: We're a remote-first company, so you can work from wherever feels like home. Plus, you'll have access to coworking spaces worldwide if you ever need a change of scenery.

  • Health coverage: From medical support, dental, and vision, we've got you covered.

  • Home office setup on us: We'll provide all the equipment you need to work comfortably.

Our Hiring Process

We aim to move quickly (2-3 weeks), but we can adjust the timeline if needed.

  • Intro call with our CEO (30 min)

  • Technical scenario / Practical assessment (2 hours, asynchronous: write a short design spec for a Kestra Cloud scenario on GKE and Terraform, including how you would split the work across a team of three)

  • Architecture review with our CTO, walking through your spec and the trade-offs (45 min)

Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. title: Learning Design & Training Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Location: Bracknell, UK (hybrid, 2 days per week in office) | Type: Full-time, 37.5 hour

Reports to: Head of Portfolio

The role in brief

Most learning designers build courses. In this role, you will own them.

As our Instructional Design & Training Products Manager, you will take a portfolio of professional training products from first idea to finished, quality-assured release, and keep them at their best for as long as they are in use. The training you build is used by aviation (civil and defence) professionals whose decisions keep people safe, so getting it right matters.

You will work alongside some of the most respected subject matter experts in aviation safety, helping them turn deep technical knowledge into learning that is clear, engaging and works in the classroom, online and in blended formats. You will have real influence over how we design, develop and quality-assure our training, including how we use AI to do it better.

If you have a background in learning design or training product development, a sharp eye for quality, and want to see your work make a visible difference, we would like to hear from you.

Why this role matters

This role owns the full lifecycle of a defined segment of our training and consulting portfolio. You will be the bridge between our subject matter experts and the wider business – sales, marketing and delivery – making sure every product is high-quality, ISO-compliant and commercially sound.

Just as importantly, you will help make our portfolio more scalable, so that great products no longer depend on SMEs doing all of the development themselves.

What you will do

  • Own the product lifecycle: take a defined set of training and consulting products through design, development, QA, release and maintenance, delivering against timelines, budgets, quality standards and commercial goals.

  • Identify learning needs: use training needs and gap analysis, customer insight and delivery feedback to shape new products and refresh and improve existing ones.

  • Lead learning design with SMEs: turn expert knowledge into clear learning objectives, specifications, storyboards and design documentation.

  • Shape new products: work with Business Development and SMEs to define market needs, build the case for new products and position them for sale.

  • Create high-quality materials: presentations, workbooks, facilitator guides, lesson plans, marketing collateral and digital content.

  • Champion quality: run QA, proofreading, brand, IP and publication checks before anything is released.

  • Keep products current: manage version control, maintenance cycles and product KPIs.

  • Improve the learner experience: raise the standard of design and usability across classroom, virtual and blended formats.

  • Work smarter with AI: use AI tools to speed up development and reduce SME drafting time.


What you will bring

  • At least 2 years’ experience in training product development, instructional or learning design, or L&D content development.

  • A track record of designing professional training materials for classroom, virtual or blended delivery.

  • A solid grounding in learning design principles (for example ADDIE) and in training needs and gap analysis.

  • A strong eye for quality and detail – you notice what others miss, from a weak learning objective to an inconsistent heading.

  • Strong project management skills, and the ability to juggle several products, deadlines and stakeholders at once.

  • Confidence working with subject matter experts: asking the right questions, challenging constructively, and turning expertise into effective learning.

  • Advanced skills in PowerPoint, Word, Excel and Adobe Acrobat.

  • Excellent written English, to publication standard.

Nice to have

  • Experience in aviation, defence or another safety-critical or regulated industry.

  • E-learning or blended learning development experience.

  • A recognised L&D or instructional design qualification.

  • An understanding of IP and contract frameworks.

  • Experience using AI in content development.

What success looks like

  • 90% or more of product milestones delivered on time.

  • 100% of releases meet QA, brand and IP standards.

  • A 40% reduction in SME effort on repeatable development tasks.

  • Fewer maintenance requests and releases each year.

  • AI used effectively across the development process.

  • Positive feedback from stakeholders and learners on usability and quality.

Join Baines Simmons

Baines Simmons builds the competence behind aerospace and defence safety. For 25 years we have delivered expert, approachable training and consulting to civil and military aviation organisations worldwide: more than 750 organisations served, over 200,000 professionals trained, and 40 or more regulatory authorities advised.

We work as one with our clients, sharing serious know-how, rigour and expertise. Across every sector, and alongside global regulators, we help organisations continuously improve safety, airworthiness and compliance. We go beyond helping them comply with regulations; we empower them to excel in operational and safety performance.

We look for curiosity, passion, leadership and impact. Our people do not just advise on safety. They change how clients manage it. If you want your work to make a measurable difference to aviation safety, we would like to hear from you.

One organisation, four brands

Baines Simmons is one of four TrustFlight brands. TrustFlight is the Aerospace Safety Intelligence Platform, building the technology that helps aviation operate safely and stay compliant. Redline Assured Security delivers government-standard aviation security, and Kenyon International delivers crisis management and response. Each brand keeps its own name, heritage and team. Together we share one platform, one set of values and one purpose: closing the gaps between disconnected tools and providers, because those gaps are where risk accumulates. Working at Baines Simmons means your expertise connects to all four.

Why people stay

We believe people do their best work when they have the freedom to do their job without too many rules and barriers getting in the way. Our culture is built on empowerment and trust: we hire good people and expect them to make the right calls for the customer, company, and themselves. Transforming an industry means our people have to keep learning. We earn our clients' confidence by being honest and dependable with each other, and that includes caring about the important things in life outside of work.

Our offices in the UK, Canada, the US and Jersey are where teams meet to collaborate and plan. People who deliver earn more say in how their career develops, from the path they take to the flexibility they need.

If you want to make a real difference to safety, this is the place to be.

How we work with AI

TrustFlight is an AI-first organisation, and we provide AI training where it is appropriate for your role. In this role that means using AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Copilot and Gamma) to draft and structure content, accelerate documentation and reports, and support knowledge management, while critically reviewing and refining every AI-generated output for accuracy, clarity and professional quality. You will design and apply AI-enabled workflows that make product development faster and more consistent, look for new places to integrate AI into our processes, and share what works with the team. You will complete our AI fluency onboarding within your first 30 days and spend four hours a month experimenting with AI tools and building your skills.

Where and how you will work

  • Working hours: 37.5 hours per week, core hours 09:00–17:00

  • Work pattern: Hybrid, 2 days per week in our Bracknell office

  • Travel: Occasional travel as required

  • On-call or shift work: None

  • Screening or clearance: Criminal record check required

What we offer

  • Competitive salary of £38,000 to £44,000

  • Generous holiday allowance

  • Company pension contribution

  • Healthcare cover for everyone, including dental and optical

  • Support for personal career development

  • Flexible working arranged with your manager

Ready to apply?

Send us your CV. We would also love a short cover letter telling us about a training product you designed and are proud of: what the need was, how you approached it, and what difference it made.

About Nomos

Europe pays more than twice as much for electricity as the US or Asia. To reach competitive price levels, Europe has to lean on solar and deliver the flexibility that makes this feasible. At Nomos, we care about our craft and take full responsibility for what we build. We hire for spikes, not an absence of weaknesses, and look for exceptional ability backed by a record of achievement. Why join us?

As an early member of Nomos, you’ll help shape the company and share in its financial upside. Backed by Index Ventures, we’re building a European category leader in one of the world’s largest industries, making electricity affordable and Europe more competitive.

Building a power company from scratch brings complex, rewarding challenges and the chance to solve Europe’s energy crisis for the long term. You’ll learn from people with exceptional depth in their fields, challenge each other’s thinking and take responsibility from the start.
