We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

You will join Alan's Corporate team, the unit that covers legal, privacy, governance, risk, compliance and security as Alan scales.

Alan wants to be in 10 countries within five years, and that only works with corporate processes built to scale with it. This is a newly created role, and your job is to make Alan's regulated development seamless and integrated with how we build product.

  • Supporting the Regulatory Legal team on new licence applications to support global expansion.

  • Collaborating with the Corporate Secretarial team on corporate governance.

  • Helping the business continue to grow by providing creative, proactive and results orientated advice to stakeholders across the business.

title: Legal Engineer - In-House
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.


What you'll do

Let's get the tricky part out of the way: this role doesn't fit neatly into a box. It's part legal ops, part product specialist, part solutions architect, and part trusted advisor. If you want a role that stays static, this isn't it.

Your mission is to help some of the world's leading in-house legal teams get the absolute most out of Legora. You'll understand how legal teams operate inside complex businesses, identify where AI can make the biggest difference, and turn that potential into workflows that deliver real value.

You'll be the person clients call when they want to rethink how their legal function works — whether that's transforming a high-volume process, embedding Legora across a global team, or building the case for AI with senior stakeholders.

Specifically, you will

  • Act as a genuine thought partner to in-house legal teams — understanding their business, priorities and constraints, then identifying high-value opportunities to transform how legal work gets done.

  • Own the journey alongside Customer Success from early pilots through onboarding to enterprise-wide adoption, turning initial use cases into sustained, measurable impact across the legal function.

  • Design and implement workflows around the realities of in-house legal work — from contracts and commercial advisory to regulatory, compliance, disputes and knowledge management.

  • Partner with General Counsel, legal operations leaders and legal teams to build the case for AI adoption, connecting Legora's capabilities to the outcomes that matter to their business.

  • Be the voice of the in-house lawyer inside Legora — bringing a deep understanding of their needs, constraints and workflows into product development, roadmap priorities and strategic direction.

  • Deliver clear, confident product demos, workshops and training that make the potential of Legora tangible for everyone from individual lawyers to legal leadership.

  • Help clients navigate one of the most significant shifts in how in-house legal teams operate — moving beyond individual productivity gains towards fundamental changes in how legal services are delivered to the business.

  • Document what works, build scalable playbooks and help shape how Legora serves corporate legal teams as we grow globally.

What you'll bring

You've worked inside an in-house legal team and understand the reality of being a lawyer within a business. You know that great in-house legal work isn't just about giving the right legal answer — it's about balancing risk, commercial priorities, speed and the needs of stakeholders across the organisation.

But you've also never been entirely satisfied with how legal work has always been done. You're curious about technology, drawn to better ways of working, and excited by the opportunity to fundamentally change how legal teams operate.

We're looking for

  • Meaningful experience working within an in-house legal function, giving you a strong understanding of its workflows, pressures and relationship with the wider business.

  • Strong legal judgement and credibility. A legal qualification is valuable, but we're ultimately interested in your ability to understand sophisticated legal work and how it can be transformed.

  • Tech-curious and product-savvy — not necessarily a coder, but someone who leans into technical conversations around generative AI, implementation and workflow transformation.

  • Commercially minded — you can connect changes in legal workflows to outcomes that matter to a General Counsel and the wider business.

  • A natural translator — comfortable moving between lawyers, legal operations teams, business stakeholders, product teams and engineers.

  • Someone who brings structure to ambiguity and energy to complexity — the calm, credible presence clients rely on when they're navigating significant change.

  • Proactive and self-directed, with the ability to manage multiple complex client relationships without losing quality or pace.

  • High standards without perfectionism — you ship, you learn, and you make it better over time.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

  • Du baust interne Wissensdatenbanken auf und schulst intern unser Team zu den entwickelten Features, um die Qualität unserer Produkte nachhaltig zu sichern.

Qualifikation

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Jurastudium (1. oder 2. Staatsexamen) oder eine vergleichbare juristische Qualifikation sowie mindestens 6 Jahre Berufserfahrung — idealerweise in einer Kanzlei, Rechtsabteilung oder im Legal-Tech-Umfeld — zeigen, dass Du juristische und technologische Anforderungen gleichermaßen durchdringst.

  • Wir wünschen uns darüber hinaus:

  • ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Kanzleimanagement und juristische Arbeitsabläufe

  • technische Affinität: Erfahrung mit No-Code-/Low-Code-Tools, Datenmodellierung, Anforderungsbeschreibungen oder Grundkenntnissen in Scripting (Python o. ä.)

  • strukturiertes, analytisches Denken und die Fähigkeit, juristische Komplexität verständlich zu kommunizieren

  • Von Vorteil sind Erfahrungen mit Legal-Tech-Plattformen (Contract Lifecycle Management, eDiscovery, Document Automation), Kenntnisse im Prompt Engineering im juristischen Kontext sowie Erfahrung mit dem deutschen oder europäischen Regulierungsumfeld (AI Act, DSGVO, GwG).

  • Deine sehr guten Deutschkenntnisse ermöglichen eine reibungslose Kommunikation im Team, mit Kunden und juristischen Stakeholdern.

Benefits

  • Wir bieten eine sehr gute Work-Life-Balance durch flexible Arbeitszeiten.
  • Wir leben ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell — Homeoffice ist bei uns selbstverständlich möglich.
  • Neben 30 Urlaubstagen erhältst Du eine sehr gute Vergütung und zusätzliche finanzielle Benefits (Kitazuschuss, steuerfreier Sachbezug als Deutschlandticket oder 50€-Gutschein).
  • Wir statten Dich mit modernen Arbeitsgeräten und einer zeitgemäßen Entwicklungsumgebung aus — Du entscheidest, womit Du am liebsten arbeitest.
  • Dich erwarten flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege.
  • Dich begrüßen erfahrene Teamplayer in einem motivierten, inklusiven Team. Nach Deiner ausführlichen Einarbeitung arbeitest Du eigenverantwortlich in diesem.
  • Dich erwarten vielfältige Möglichkeiten für Deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung sowie eine optionale betriebliche Altersvorsorge.

Werde Teil unseres Teams und revolutioniere mit uns die Arbeitswelt in Anwaltskanzleien. Gestalte Deine Zukunft bei dokSAFE GmbH und bewirb Dich jetzt - wir freuen uns auf Dich!

Strategische Kommunikation: Du entwickelst die Kommunikationsstrategie kontinuierlich weiter und sorgst dafür, dass die Maßnahmen auf die übergeordneten Unternehmens- und Geschäftsziele einzahlen.

Vorstandskommunikation: Du berätst den Vorstand bei kommunikativen Fragestellungen, bewertest Themen und Botschaften und entwickelst passende Kommunikationsansätze. Dabei hast Du auch die interne Kommunikation und die Stimmung innerhalb der Organisation im Blick.

PR & Öffentlichkeitsarbeit: Du verantwortest die externe Kommunikation, pflegst die Beziehungen zu regionalen Medien und steuerst auch anspruchsvolle Kommunikationssituationen – beispielsweise bei Veränderungsprozessen, Krisen oder öffentlich sensiblen Themen.

Führung & Teamentwicklung: Du führst ein sechsköpfiges Team mit unterschiedlichen fachlichen Hintergründen, förderst die Zusammenarbeit und entwickelst Kompetenzen und Strukturen weiter.

Digitale Kommunikation: Du treibst die Weiterentwicklung der digitalen Kommunikation voran. Insbesondere Social Media und die Ansprache jüngerer Zielgruppen sollen künftig einen noch höheren Stellenwert erhalten. Dabei liegt Dein Fokus auf der strategischen Ausrichtung und Steuerung.

Gesellschaftliches Engagement: Du begleitest die strategische Ausrichtung des regionalen Spenden- und Sponsoringengagements und wirkst bei der Verteilung eines Budgets von rund 1,5 Millionen Euro mit.

Vertriebsunterstützung: Du entwickelst Kommunikationsmaßnahmen und Kampagnen, die insbesondere die Gewinnung junger Kundinnen und Kunden unterstützen und darüber hinaus das Firmenkundengeschäft sowie das Private Banking stärken.

Besondere Kommunikationsthemen: Du steuerst das Beschwerdemanagement bei eskalierten oder öffentlich sensiblen Fällen und begleitest die regionale Kunstsammlung gemeinsam mit der zuständigen Kuratorin.

Du arbeitest überwiegend strategisch und steuernd. Für die operative Umsetzung steht Dir ein erfahrenes Team zur Seite. Gleichzeitig hast Du die Möglichkeit, die zukünftige Ausrichtung und Organisation der Kommunikation aktiv mitzugestalten.

  • Sie klären Zuständigkeiten, Übergaben, Freigaben und Vertretungen und verfolgen Vereinbarungen verbindlich nach.

  • Sie erkennen Informationslücken, unnötige Arbeitsschritte und wiederkehrende Fehlerquellen und entwickeln mit den Beteiligten praktikable Lösungen.

  • Sie erstellen und pflegen verständliche Prozessbeschreibungen, Arbeitsanweisungen, Handbücher, Checklisten und Vorlagen.

  • Sie setzen digitale Werkzeuge zur Arbeits- und Projektorganisation ein, um Aufgaben, Termine, Ziele und Verantwortlichkeiten transparent zu machen.

  • Zusammen mit dem Vertriebscontrolling sorgen Sie für aussagekräftige Kennzahlen, nachvollziehbare Auswertungen und eine verlässliche Datengrundlage.

  • Sie bereiten Informationen für den Head of Sales verständlich auf und geben einen realistischen Überblick über laufende Themen, Entwicklungen und mögliche Engpässe.

  • Auch wenn viel gleichzeitig zusammenkommt, setzen Sie klare Prioritäten und geben Ihrem Team Orientierung.

Qualifikation

Was Sie mitbringen:

Für diese Aufgabe suchen wir keine reine Verwaltungskraft, sondern eine Führungspersönlichkeit mit ausgeprägtem Prozess-, Zahlen- und Datenverständnis.

title: Lending Completions Officer
descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Role Description

This is a key role in delivering a fast, accurate and well-controlled lending journey. You will manage a portfolio of cases from offer and post-sanction administration through to drawdown and completion, making sure every case is progressed efficiently and every condition is properly satisfied.

Commercial mortgages will be a core part of the role, alongside other commercial lending products such as GGS loans, overdrafts, business loans, asset finance, non-property-backed lending and unsecured lending. You will work closely with Relationship Managers, Underwriting, legal and valuation partners and other teams across the bank.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Manage a pipeline of lending cases from offer to completion, meeting service levels, quality standards and expected completion timelines.

  • Deliver post-sanction administration, including releasing communications, instructing legal and valuation partners and coordinating payments.

  • Review and satisfy Conditions Precedent and other completion requirements, escalating risks, gaps and delays early.

  • Coordinate drawdown and completion activity accurately, ensuring the right approvals, documentation and controls are in place.

  • Build effective working relationships with Relationship Managers, Underwriting, solicitors, valuers and other internal and external stakeholders.

  • Maintain clear, accurate and audit-ready case records, including sanction audit trails, customer records and updates to the core banking system.

  • Communicate relevant information clearly so that colleagues and decision-makers understand the position, risks and actions required.

  • Work in line with bank policies, procedures, regulatory requirements, Conduct and Treating Customers Fairly expectations.

  • Support wider lending and Operations activity, including cross-skilling, issue resolution, quality improvements and change initiatives.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Experience in lending, credit operations, mortgage completions, loan administration or a similar financial services environment.

  • A practical understanding of the commercial lending journey and pipeline management, ideally including commercial mortgages.

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to analyse information, identify issues and make sound, timely decisions.

  • A customer-focused approach and a track record of delivering a high standard of service in a fast-paced environment.

  • Good financial and commercial awareness, with an understanding of the importance of risk, controls and accurate record keeping.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to build relationships and have constructive conversations.

  • Strong organisation and IT skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and maintain momentum across a live pipeline.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

title: Light Amplification Lead (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to provide clean, safe, and virtually unlimited energy to the world. We are rapidly scaling and looking for talented individuals who thrive in building clarity and structure within fast-growing environments.

Your Role
The laser amplification chain scales the beam energy needed by our fusion system. Developing it involves complex technical decisions, interdependent teams and requirements that evolve as the programme advances.

We are looking for a Light Amplification Lead (f/m/d) to give this function clear direction and accountability. Your mission is to lead the amplification team, critically evaluate technical information and turn stakeholder input into decisions, priorities and a credible development roadmap. You will guide the function towards delivery of a subsystem that meets agreed requirements and can integrate with the wider laser system.

You do not need to be an expert in every amplifier technology. You do need strong engineering judgement, extensive technical leadership experience and enough laser understanding to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions and work effectively with domain specialists.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and develop the function. Provide line management for technical teams, set clear expectations, give feedback and develop their capabilities. Build a view of the skills and capacity needed as the programme evolves, and contribute to hiring and team development.

  • Provide technical decisions and steering. Listen to different stakeholders, critically review their input and challenge assumptions. Work with specialists to assess options and make reasoned decisions, identifying where further evidence or expertise is needed.

  • Own the development roadmap. Translate system requirements and programme priorities into a function-level plan that goes beyond individual task lists. Establish milestones, identify dependencies and capability gaps, and adapt the plan as requirements and evidence change.

  • Guide complex project delivery. Lead larger technical projects through uncertainty. Keep priorities, resources, risks and trade-offs visible, coordinate with programme management and lab operations, and escalate issues early.

  • Connect amplification to the wider system. Take accountability for the amplification architecture, requirements and interfaces, drawing on the team's specialist expertise. Coordinate with adjacent laser functions and system integration so technical decisions support agreed performance and integration needs.

Who You Are

  • You have some laser exposure and a general understanding of amplification. You have enough relevant background to understand the function, engage with specialists and assess how its decisions affect the wider system. Direct hands-on amplifier development is an advantage, not a prerequisite.

  • Extensive technical leadership experience. You have led technical teams and larger, complex engineering projects, with responsibility for people, priorities and delivery. You can develop specialists and provide direction across disciplines.

  • Strong engineering judgement. You can evaluate technical arguments, distinguish assumptions from evidence, identify risks and challenge recommendations constructively. You do not need to know every answer yourself, but you know how to reach a sound decision with the right experts.

  • Experience leading through uncertainty. You have worked on development programmes with incomplete information, evolving requirements or changing technical priorities. You can maintain direction while adapting plans as new evidence emerges.

  • People and stakeholder leadership. You listen carefully, reconcile different perspectives, communicate decisions clearly and remain close to the team. Your leadership experience includes line management and developing technical colleagues, not only coordinating schedules.

  • Your background may be in laser systems, photonics, optical systems or a broader complex-engineering programme that includes relevant laser work. Your current title is less important than the scope of technical and people leadership you have exercised.

    Nice to have

  • Direct experience developing laser amplifiers or high-energy/high-power laser systems.

  • Familiarity with solid-state, fibre or diode-pumped amplification, CPA/OPCPA, or relevant pulsed and ultrafast systems.

  • Systems engineering, requirements traceability, technology-maturity planning and subsystem integration.

  • Industrialisation, supplier coordination, budget and resource planning, or design for cost and manufacture.

  • Experience in fusion, a high-power laser facility or a defence laser programme.

  • A PhD or equivalent depth of experience in physics, photonics or a related engineering discipline.


Why work with Us?

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers, and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges, and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Flexibility: Work should fit around your life, not the other way around. We offer the ability to work from our office, but some flexibility to work from home as well.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide on a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

 


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

title: Location Design and Rollout Architect
descriptionHtml:
🌍 Do you value sustainable design and want to actively shape a greener future?

💪 Are you fascinated by the idea of being your own client and only designing what you believe in?

Then join a fast-growing company with a mission and help us build a network of modern fast-charging stations for electric cars – the service stations of the future! At Fastned, you will have the opportunity to work as Location Design and Rollout Architect at our Cologne office, actively contribute to the energy transition and continue your career in a future-proof industry. Become part of our innovative industry, work independently from the start and help us plan, design and obtain building permits for the service stations of the future. Fastned is a fast-growing international company with over 500 employees in 10 countries. Our Cologne Team, consisting of 50 + people including 4 architects cannot wait to meet you! Go check out our Architecture Career Hub to meet your future colleagues and learn all about it: https://t.ly/Av_1Y

Your role

We are looking for a Location Design and Rollout Architect who combines architectural creativity and technical expertise with a structured process oriented mindset. You will translate Fastned’s corporate vision into operational reality. You will take ownership of our location design, drive the permitting process and preparation for execution to support the delivery of high quality charging stations at scale. Your role is crucial to our multidisciplinary team to envision the full potential and feasibility of a site. In your day-to-day job, you will focus on our expansion in Germany.

Key responsibilities:

  • Develop site-specific architectural planning for Fastned charging stations translating our corporate architectural design into functional and feasible solutions.

  • You own the design process from initial sketch to contract drawings, manage the permitting process and the creation of execution drawings.

  • Own and manage the technical feasibility report, identify local building regulations and approval constraints with relevant authorities at an early stage to support business decisions.

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders from our german Expansion and Construction Teams as well as our international Product Owners to align site requirements, design solutions and lead-times for project deliveries.

  • You manage the communication with authorities and ensure the permitting process is followed up on to receive building approvals as fast as possible.

  • Ensure results while managing multiple projects in parallel, balancing priorities, timelines and project requirements.

  • Appoint and supervise external service providers such as engineers, technical experts and architects.

  • Monitor the quality and timelines of external deliverables and contribute to the development of a strong partner network.

  • Maintain clear and proactive communication in providing regular project reporting on key milestones, risks and achievements.

  • Contribute to build a scalable design process, to improve workflows and to identify cost optimizations that enable Fastned to increase its rollout capacity without compromising quality.

  • Ensure project documentation is properly maintained in accordance with our standards.

title: M&A – Praktikum / Intern (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Rolle

Die Steuerberatung erlebt eine Konsolidierungswelle: Tausende Häuser suchen in den nächsten Jahren eine Nachfolge, und nur wenige Käufer prüfen sie mit derselben Sorgfalt wie ein professionelles Transaktionsteam. Hier lernst du M&A auf der Käuferseite, an echten Transaktionen und von der ersten Ansprache bis nach dem Abschluss.

Vogel berät mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen in steuerlichen, kaufmännischen und strategischen Fragen und erwirbt eigenständige Beratungsunternehmen, um sie weiterzuentwickeln. Wir prüfen laufend neue Ziele, bewerten, verhandeln und schließen ab. Anders als bei einem Finanzinvestor endet unsere Arbeit nicht beim Abschluss, sie fängt dort an.

Du studierst Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder ein verwandtes Fach im fortgeschrittenen Bachelor oder im Master und willst den Transaktionsprozess vollständig kennenlernen, nicht nur einen Ausschnitt davon. Das Praktikum dauert drei bis sechs Monate in Vollzeit. Du arbeitest im Finance-Team und direkt mit der Geschäftsführung an laufenden Transaktionen.

Deine Verantwortung

Zielsuche und Marktanalyse

  • Du baust Longlists und Shortlists möglicher Ziele, recherchierst Märkte, Wettbewerber und Nachfolgesituationen und bereitest Erstansprachen vor.

  • Du wertest Teaser und erste Unterlagen aus und hältst in einer kurzen Einschätzung fest, ob sich eine vertiefte Prüfung lohnt.

Bewertung und Due Diligence

  • Du erstellst Bewertungen nach Multiplikatoren, Transaktionsvergleichen und Ertragswert, normalisierst Jahresabschlüsse und rechnest Kaufpreis-Mechanik und Sensitivitäten durch.

  • Du strukturierst Datenräume, koordinierst Fragenlisten mit dem Verkäufer und unseren Beratern und benennst Auffälligkeiten für die Verhandlung.

  • Du rechnest die Finanzierungsseite mit: Kapitaldienst, Rückbeteiligung, Zahlungsstruktur über die Zeit.

Verhandlung und Abschluss

  • Du bereitest Präsentationen und Entscheidungsvorlagen für die Geschäftsführung vor: eine Empfehlung mit Begründung, keine Sammlung von Kennzahlen.

  • Du arbeitest an Absichtserklärungen, Term Sheets und Verhandlungsunterlagen mit und begleitest Gespräche mit Inhabern.

  • Nach dem Abschluss hilfst du, das übernommene Haus in unser Berichtswesen zu überführen, und machst sichtbar, ob die Annahmen der Bewertung eintreten.

Deine Perspektiven

Was du nach 3 Monaten geliefert hast:

  • Du hast an mindestens einer Transaktion durchgehend mitgearbeitet, von der Analyse bis zur Verhandlung.

  • Ein Bewertungsmodell von dir ist in eine Entscheidungsvorlage eingegangen, und ein Dritter kann es weiterrechnen.

Was du nach 6 Monaten geliefert hast:

  • Du trägst die Erstprüfung eines Ziels eigenständig, vom Teaser bis zur Empfehlung.

  • Du kennst den Prozess so gut, dass du die nächste Prüfung strukturieren könntest.

Wohin sich die Stelle entwickelt:

Wer im Praktikum überzeugt, hat die Tür für den Einstieg in Finance & M&A offen. Fachliche Expertenlaufbahn und Führungslaufbahn stehen danach beide offen, entschieden am Beitrag und nicht am Berufsjahr.

Das bringst du mit

Erfahrung & Track Record

  • Fortgeschrittenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten Fach mit Vertiefung in Finance, Corporate Finance oder Rechnungswesen.

  • Erste Praxis in M&A, Transaction Services, Corporate Finance, Private Equity oder einer Unternehmensberatung ist ein Plus, aber keine Bedingung.

  • Profile, die nicht in dieses Raster passen, sind ausdrücklich eingeladen. Konkret: Steuerfachangestellte mit laufendem Studium, die Jahresabschlüsse von innen kennen, Mathematik- oder Physikstudierende mit Interesse an Bewertung, Gründer eines eigenen kleinen Unternehmens. Wir bewerten am Beitrag, nicht am Etikett.

Skills & Arbeitsweise

  • Du bist sicher in Excel und PowerPoint und baust Modelle, die ein Dritter verstehen und weiterrechnen kann.

  • Du liest einen Jahresabschluss so, dass du erkennst, was erklärungsbedürftig ist, statt Kennzahlen abzuschreiben.

  • Du arbeitest mit KI als selbstverständlichem Werkzeug für Recherche, Aufbereitung von Datenräumen und Drafting.

  • Du sprichst und schreibst Deutsch auf einem Niveau, das für Verhandlungsunterlagen trägt.

Mindset & Persönlichkeit

  • Du behandelst Vertrauliches selbstverständlich vertraulich und interessierst dich für das Unternehmen hinter den Zahlen.

  • Du hast den Anspruch, in allem, was du ablieferst, den höchsten Standard zu setzen, nicht weil jemand es kontrolliert, sondern weil Mittelmaß dich persönlich stört.

Was du bei uns nicht finden wirst

  • Keine zweite Reihe. Deine Arbeit geht in eine Verhandlung, die diesen Monat stattfindet.

  • Keine Deal-Romantik. Wir kaufen, um zu behalten. Wer nach dem Abschluss das Interesse verliert, verpasst den besten Teil.

  • Keine Übungsfälle. Du arbeitest an echten Zielen mit echten Inhabern.

FAQ

1. Was ist Vogel – und wo arbeitet ihr?

Vogel ist eine der führenden Mittelstandsberatungen Deutschlands – seit 1959, inhabergeführt in zweiter Generation, mit eigenem Kapital – und baut daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den Mittelstand. Wir arbeiten an drei Standorten: Aalen als gewachsenem Stammsitz, Bopfingen im Kerngeschäft und München als neuem Hub. An allen dreien suchen wir quer durch die Funktionen – von Steuerberatung über Beratung bis zu den Teams, die das Fundament darunter bauen.

2. Wie sind die Gehaltsbänder zu verstehen?

Bewusst breit – und an jeder Stelle ausgewiesen, bevor du dich bewirbst. Wir differenzieren nach Track Record und Marktwert, nicht nach Abschluss: knappe, stark gefragte Profile am oberen Ende, weniger knappe am unteren. Die ausgewiesene Spanne ist kein Verhandlungsspielraum, sondern eine Profil-Skala – zwei Menschen mit ähnlicher Erfahrung können bei uns unterschiedlich verdienen. Was das obere Ende bestimmt, ist der Reifegrad, nicht die Zahl der Berufsjahre und nicht das Verhandlungsgeschick.

3. Wie viel – und wie – wird bei Vogel gearbeitet?

Gemessen wird an dem, was du bewegst, nicht an Stunden. Ehrlich ist aber auch: Wer 9-to-5 sucht, ist bei uns nicht die erste Adresse. Wir suchen Menschen, die aus eigenem Antrieb intensiv arbeiten, weil die Aufgaben es wert sind. Wie du deine Zeit verteilst, ist weitgehend deine Sache. Was wir teilen: Wir arbeiten präsent zusammen und sehen uns im Normalfall täglich im Büro – Kultur, Sparring und die besten Ideen entstehen in der täglichen Nähe. Wir sind keine Remote-Company und haben keine großen Home-Office-Policies; einzelne Remote-Tage sind kein Problem.

4. Wie läuft die Bewerbung?

Schlank, schnell, transparent – und nach Profil gestaffelt. In der Regel sind es vier Schritte: eine schriftliche Aufgabe, in der du zu acht Fragen Position beziehst – KI ist ausdrücklich erlaubt, wir bitten nur um eine kurze Selbstauskunft dazu; ein Gespräch von einer halben Stunde; eine gemeinsame Arbeitssitzung an einem echten Problem aus unserem Alltag; und ein Termin vor Ort mit dem Team und gemeinsamem Essen. Wie viele Schritte es tatsächlich werden, hängt von der Rolle ab: Bei Praktikum und Werkstudium fällt der Vor-Ort-Termin weg, für Schülerjobs genügt ein Gespräch, bei Senior-Rollen kommt ein gemeinsamer Arbeitsnachmittag dazu. Vorab kannst du einen Zehn-Minuten-Call buchen, in dem nur du fragst. In der Regel hörst du nach jedem Schritt innerhalb von 48 Stunden von uns.

5. Wie funktioniert die variable Vergütung?

Quartalsweise an Leistung gekoppelt, qualitativ bewertet. Die Skala steigt mit dem Level: bis 20 % Associate, 27,5 % Manager, 35 % Senior Manager, 42,5 % Director, 50 % VP. Erwartungswert bei guter Leistung – du erfüllst die Anforderungen, setzt eigene Akzente, bestehst den Keeper Test – liegt bei rund 50 % des Maximums; der Maximalbonus ist nicht der Normalfall. Im Fokus steht eine ganzheitliche Beurteilung durch deine Führungskraft anhand von sechs Kriterien: Impact, Judgement, Communication, Execution, Growth und Values.

6. Wie entwickle ich mich – welche Karrierewege gibt es?

Zwei aktive Wege: die IC-Karriere (fachliche Tiefe, Expertenlaufbahn) über die Stufen Expert, Senior, Lead und Principal – und die Management-Karriere (Führung, Personalverantwortung) über Manager, Senior Manager, Director und VP. Beide werden gleich vergütet, und beide müssen nicht nach oben führen: Wer auf einer Stufe bleibt und dort weiter in die Tiefe geht, ist bei uns genauso richtig. Die Richtung wählst du nach dem Onboarding, meist in Jahr 1–3. Berufseinstieg ist kein Sonderweg, sondern der frühe Teil derselben Strecke – vom Werkstudenten oder Praktikanten zum Associate, für die Besten ohne erneutes Bewerbungsverfahren.

7. Team, Kultur, Urlaub?

Das gemeinsame Mittagessen ist der tägliche Ankerpunkt – wer im Büro ist, isst mit; erwartet, nicht kontrolliert. Das Abendessen ist dasselbe Angebot ohne jede Erwartung. Beides ohne Eigenanteil. Dazu Social Events und Offsites in regelmäßigem Rhythmus – nicht als Pflichtprogramm, sondern weil ein gutes Team auch abseits der Arbeit Zeit teilt.

Benefits sind bei uns nicht das Sahnehäubchen, sondern das, was Intensität über Jahre tragbar macht: Examensförderung mit 25.000 EUR Qualifizierungsbudget und drei Monaten Freistellung, 100-prozentige Übernahme der Kinderbetreuung, EGYM Wellpass, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Job-Ticket mit 90 % Zuschuss, Homeoffice-Ausstattung und ein Gerät deiner Wahl aus unserem Katalog, ein Buch im Monat aus dem Vogel-Kanon – und KI-Tools ohne Token-Limit und ohne Budgetdeckel. Urlaub: 28 Tage.

Compensation: €4K per month

title: Machine Learning Data Scientist posting
descriptionHtml:
Role summary:

At Differential Bio, our mission is to unlock the potential of the bioeconomy by fixing how biological R&D and scale-up are done.

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Data Scientist to join our growing cutting-edge modelling team. You will develop novel machine learning algorithms and mechanistic models of bioprocess systems and push them from research proof-of-concept into production-ready commercial use.

This role is focused on research, including creating hybrid models that combine mechanistic and machine learning approaches to predict how microbial fermentations behave, and that keep working when we move to a new organism, a new sensor, or a larger reactor. You’ll play an instrumental role on two existing grants and work with leading academic groups and industrial partners on pilot- and production-scale data. In addition, you’ll develop new research projects and drive them to completion and application on customer projects.

We’re interested in researchers who want their work to end up in real bioreactors and are excited about working at an early-stage startup. You should be comfortable owning hard, open-ended problems where nobody has the answer yet, making evidence-based decisions under uncertainty, and shipping real solutions.

How you’ll work

  • You’ll collaborate with technical leads and academic/industry external partners to design and execute research that meets our commitments in both consortia and strengthens our own platform.

  • You’ll own your research projects from scoping to delivery, with support from our modelling lead but with autonomy and independence.

  • You’ll work closely with our wet lab, dry lab and software teams, and identify which data you need to generate from our robotic lab.

Key responsibilities:

Hybrid bioprocess modelling

  • Develop hybrid mechanistic/ML cell response models that predict fermentation outcomes (growth, titer, yield, productivity) from process and sensor data.

  • Fuse time-series signals from process analytical technology (Raman, NIR, dielectric spectroscopy, dissolved oxygen, off-gas) with offline analytics.

  • Build mechanistic backbones (e.g., kinetic/ODE models, genome-scale metabolic models) that constrain learning and generate synthetic training data.

  • Develop machine learning surrogate models for computationally costly mechanistic simulations.

  • Quantify uncertainty so that models can be trusted in high-stakes production settings.

Transfer across organisms and scales

  • Design models that carry over from benchtop to pilot and production scale, and across various microbes including bacteria and yeast.

  • Use transfer learning and representation learning to make good predictions for new strains and processes with little data.

  • Develop scale-transferable reactor characterisations and predictive KPI models for scale-up.

Real-time Model-Predictive Control

  • Build the AI/ML layer for Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) and reinforcement-learning-based feeding strategies to optimize titer, rate, and yield dynamically.

  • Fuse real-time data from Process Analytical Technology (PAT) and soft sensors (e.g., Raman, NIR) into dynamic state estimators to drive closed-loop bioreactor actuators (feed, air, agitation).

  • Prototype simpler, deployable steps along the way, such as deviation detection and operator alerts

  • Design control frameworks to proactively resolve metabolic bottlenecks and robustly account for model uncertainty, batch-to-batch variability, and inherent bioprocess stochasticity.

Qualifications:

  • PhD in machine learning, bioengineering, computational biology, or a related field, or a Master’s degree with 3+ years of relevant industry experience.

  • Strong research independence; ability to scope and execute novel scientific work from start to finish.

  • Demonstrated evidence of research contributions, including (but not limited to): peer-reviewed journal or conference papers, conference attendance, open-source contributions.

  • Strong Python and modern ML tooling (e.g., PyTorch/JAX, scikit-learn).

title: Machine Learning Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the role

Linkup is the web search engine built for AI. Our infrastructure crawls, indexes and serves the live web to AI agents, and it’s scaling fast.

We’re looking for a top‑tier Machine Learning Engineer to join Linkup and work hand‑in‑hand with our CTO, Denis Charrier, and the rest of the tech team.

Your core responsibilities will be to:
Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents

  • Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents

  • Bring new ranking signals into the engine, beyond pure relevance

  • Build the evaluation framework that tells us what really improves search quality

  • Optimize model serving for latency and GPU cost

  • Turn customer and benchmark feedback into ranking improvements, with clear before/after numbers

     
 

Requirements

You’re a great match if you:

  • Are excited to help build Google for AI agents- and believe in Linkup’s mission

  • Have strong hands-on experience in information retrieval, ranking or search in production.

  • Build rigorous evals and check the data behind every number

  • Care about latency, cost and reliability as much as model quality

  • Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment

 

Example Projects

  • Ship a new ranking model to production and prove the gain on our eval sets

  • Push our models to the next level: better answers, lower latency, lower cost per query

  • Build and maintain the evaluations framework that measures every change to our search engine

 

Our Stack

Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, vLLM, Ray, Spark / Databricks, Vespa, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Terraform

Details

The ideal candidate will play a central role in our engineering team, partnering closely with the founders. The models you ship will decide what thousands of AI products read every day.

We offer a flexible remote‑work policy- see the details here.

Join us and leverage your expertise to push the boundaries of AI!

 

About Linkup

 

Our Vision

We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web. These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information.

AI agents need web search. To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off.

Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs. Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space.

Web 2.0 is sunsetting. The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home.

Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up. We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone.

Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup.

 

Our Mission

Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Linkup reconnects language models to a living stream of verified facts, ensuring AIs remain as current and insightful as the world they serve.

Our mission is to deliver the world’s freshest, most trusted knowledge to AIs.

 

Our Culture

Our culture is built on the following values:

  • Mission. We believe we play a critical role in building the agentic web. We are 100% committed to our mission of bringing the reality of the world to AI agents.

  • Speed. We build fast, we build to last. We get things done, well.

  • Ownership. We empower every team member to take ownership of their projects, ensuring they see them through to successful completion.

  • Teamwork. Our strength lies in our unity. We rely on one another and embrace our diversity as a core asset.

  • Humility. We maintain low egos, showing respect for others and continuously learning from their insights and experiences.

We expect all team member to take an active role in shaping our company culture.

 

Our Team

We are a small technical team, working shoulder to shoulder to build the web of agents.

A bit more about our 3 co-founders:

  • Philippe Mizrahi- Led the development of Lyft’s Autonomous Vehicles marketplace. Previously launched Amundsen, an open source search engine.

  • Denis Charrier- Founding Engineer at Niland, an audio search company (acquired by Spotify), then Staff Engineer at Spotify. 15y of software development experience.

  • Boris Toledano- Led robotics at Carrefour, after 3y at McKinsey & Co working on public affairs and digital transformation.

Performance & Optimisation - Optimisation des temps de réponse (latence) et de l'utilisation des ressources de calcul (CPU/GPU). - Refactoring de code pour respecter les standards de Software Craftsmanship (Clean Code, TDD). - Gestion des Feature Stores pour centraliser et servir les variables calculées en temps réel. Votre rôle inclura également : Monitoring avancé : Mise en place de sondes pour détecter le "Data Drift" (dérive des données) ou le "Model Drift" et déclencher des alertes proactives. Collaboration transverse : Faire le pont entre les Data Scientists (mathématiques/modélisation) et les Data Engineers (infrastructure/données) pour fluidifier les mises en production. Évangélisation : Diffuser les bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel au sein des équipes Data Science. Profil recherché Nous cherchons un profil hybride, à la frontière entre le Software Engineering et la Data Science, capable de comprendre les mathématiques sous-jacentes tout en maîtrisant les contraintes de production informatique. - Formation : Bac+5 (école d’ingénieur, université) en Informatique ou Mathématiques Appliquées. - Compétences Techniques Cœurs : * Maîtrise avancée de Python et des bonnes pratiques logicielles (Git, Tests unitaires/d'intégration, Packaging). * Solide expérience sur les plateformes Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) et l'IaC (Terraform est un plus). * Maîtrise de l'écosystème MLOps : MLflow, Kubeflow, Docker, Kubernetes. - Connaissances Data : Bonne compréhension des bibliothèques ML (Scikit-learn, Pandas) et Deep Learning (TensorFlow, PyTorch) pour pouvoir optimiser le code des Data Scientists. - Expérience : Vous avez une expérience significative dans le déploiement de modèles ML en production (batch ou temps réel). - Mindset : * Rigueur absolue sur la qualité du code et l'automatisation. * Goût pour la résolution de problèmes d'architecture complexes. * Capacité à travailler dans des environnements techniques hétérogènes. Build depth while keeping your horizons wide.

Bring your experience and an appetite to learn

Ideally, you will have experience in consulting, the public sector or a relevant industry role, with strong analytical and communication skills, and practical proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.

Procurement, supply chain, commercial delivery, or transformation experience is particularly relevant. Familiarity with UK public-sector governance, regulated procurement or business case approvals are also a positive.

title: Manager, Account Management
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

We are looking for a Manager, Account Management to join our Account Management team. This is an opportunity to lead strategic relationships with some of our most important merchants and help them get more value from their partnership with Checkout.com.

You will be a trusted business advisor and a senior point of contact for a portfolio of enterprise merchants. You will own the account strategy, build executive-level relationships, identify opportunities for growth, and coordinate the internal teams required to deliver an outstanding merchant experience.

This role is suited to a commercially minded account management leader who can operate with strategic perspective while staying close to execution. You will bring structure to complex work, influence stakeholders across the organization, and help merchants use payments as a lever for better customer experiences and business performance.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Own and execute account development plans for a portfolio of strategic merchants.

  • Build high-touch, consultative relationships with merchant stakeholders from day-to-day operators through executive leadership.

  • Serve as the primary commercial and relationship lead during the post-integration lifecycle, ensuring clear ownership, communication, and follow-through.

  • Develop a deep understanding of each merchant’s business model, customer journeys, payment performance, priorities, and growth plans.

  • Identify and advance opportunities across payment volumes, product adoption, market expansion, and broader commercial growth.

  • Lead commercial conversations and negotiations in partnership with Sales, Finance, Legal, Product, and other relevant teams.

  • Translate merchant needs into clear internal priorities and influence product roadmaps, go-to-market motions, and service improvements.

  • Project-manage complex merchant initiatives, including cross-border expansion, new payment methods, optimization programs, and operational improvements.

  • Use data and customer insights to diagnose performance, quantify opportunities, and make compelling recommendations.

  • Provide regular account updates, risk visibility, and forward-looking plans to leadership.

  • Share market feedback and best practices that improve how Checkout.com serves enterprise merchants.

What we’re looking for

  • 6+ years of experience in B2B Account Management, Relationship Management, Customer Success, Strategic Partnerships, or a related commercial role, ideally in payments, fintech, technology, banking, or consulting.

  • Experience managing complex enterprise accounts and building trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders.

  • Strong commercial judgment, including experience identifying growth opportunities and leading or supporting negotiations.

  • A strategic, analytical, and data-driven approach to account planning and decision-making.

  • Excellent project management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple workstreams and maintain momentum in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong understanding of digital commerce, payments, fintech, and the competitive dynamics shaping the payments market.

  • Clear and compelling communication skills, with the ability to influence internally and externally at all levels.

  • Customer-first judgment and the ability to balance merchant outcomes, commercial performance, and operational realities.

  • High ownership, organization, and follow-through, especially when priorities shift or information is incomplete.

  • Intellectual curiosity and the ability to learn complex products and apply new technologies, including AI, to improve account performance.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

title: Manager AI Advisory - CDI Paris - Theodo Data & AI
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Créée en 2016, Theodo Data & AI est l'entité Data et IA de Theodo. Notre ambition est d'accompagner nos clients dans la conception et le déploiement de leur stratégie data ainsi que la recherche et le développement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle à l’état de l’art. L'entreprise est en pleine croissance : chaque année, Theodo Data & AI enregistre une croissance de plus de 30 % de son chiffre d'affaires, ouvrant ainsi de nouvelles opportunités passionnantes pour les Theodoers !

Ton équipe :

Tu rejoins AI Advisory, l’activité de conseil IA que lance Theodo. Notre mission : aider les directions générales à passer de l’expérimentation IA à un impact business massif, en réconciliant vision stratégique et réalité technologique.

En tant que Manager, tu es garant de la qualité de tes missions et de la satisfaction des décideurs C-level. Tu produis et tu challenges le travail de ton équipe, tu fais grandir les consultants, tu conçois les offres du cabinet et tu portes l’avant-vente.

Tu es rattaché au responsable AI Advisory et tu travailles avec les équipes tech de Theodo, qui mettent en production ce que tu cadres.

Tes missions :

  • Piloter des missions de conseil IA de bout en bout : tu es l’interlocuteur de confiance des décideurs (DG, CDO, Directeur IA, DSI…) et garant de leur satisfaction
  • Cadrer et structurer : transformer un besoin flou en plan d’action (Audit > MVP > Scale) et construire des business cases IA chiffrés (ROI, gouvernance, dépendances) que tu défends en Comex
  • Produire et challenger : tu réalises toi-même les livrables clés (schéma directeur, roadmap IA, business case) et tu garantis la qualité de ceux de ton équipe
  • Faire grandir l’équipe : encadrer et coacher 3 consultants ou plus, les former au cadrage, à l’animation d’atelier et à la synthèse top-down
  • Développer le business : porter l’avant-vente, rédiger les propositions commerciales, défendre tes convictions en soutenance et assurer le foisonnement sur tes comptes
  • Construire le cabinet : concevoir de nouvelles offres et méthodologies de conseil IA, et participer au recrutement de la future équipe

Tes perspectives d’évolutions :

Le passage Directeur AI Advisory est clairement défini. Tu pilotes un compte client en autonomie, de la première mission à la revente. Tu deviens une voix de référence sur l’IA auprès de tes clients et tu portes la parole du cabinet à l’extérieur (conférences, publications). Tu peux aussi évoluer vers le pilotage de programmes de transformation IA à grande échelle.

Profil recherché :

  • Tu as 5 à 10 ans d’expérience en conseil, dans un cabinet de premier plan (Big 4, Capgemini Invent, Accenture…) ou une boutique Data/IA reconnue, et tu manages déjà des missions
  • Tu as mené au moins 2 missions de transformation de plus de 6 mois pour des clients SBF 120 / CAC 40 ou des scale-ups à forte complexité organisationnelle
  • Tu as encadré au moins 3 consultants et tu as un track-record d’upsell ou de propositions commerciales gagnées
  • Tu es tech-fluent : sans forcément coder, tu comprends l’architecture d’un SI et tu testes toi-même les outils (LLMs, agents) pour en connaître les limites réelles
  • Tu portes une vision personnelle et structurée du marché de l’IA, et tu sais chiffrer l’impact financier d’une mission (gain d’EBITDA, réduction de churn), pas seulement l’impact technique
  • Tu as une posture de trusted advisor et tu maîtrises la synthèse top-down : tu captives un Comex en 3 slides et tu sais descendre dans le détail quand il le faut
  • Tu parles français et anglais couramment
Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo Data & IA ? L’environnement: 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 Prime d’intéressement indexée sur la croissance de Theodo 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

title: Manager, Applied AI Engineering (Codex)
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

The Applied AI Engineering team is responsible for helping customers turn frontier AI capabilities into real products, workflows, and business impact. We act as trusted technical partners across solution design, architecture, implementation, evaluation, and adoption, working alongside customers to build and scale effective AI applications with OpenAI’s technologies.

The Codex Applied AI Engineering team focuses on helping organizations transform how software is built with AI. We partner directly with engineering teams and technical leaders to integrate Codex into their software development lifecycle — from identifying high-impact use cases and designing AI-enabled workflows to implementation, evaluation, and scaled adoption. Our work helps ensure AI-powered software development is effective, reliable, secure, and deeply integrated into how engineering organizations operate.


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced technical leader to join as Manager, Applied AI Engineering (Codex), leading a team of Applied AI Engineers responsible for driving successful Codex adoption across strategic customers. Your team will work hands-on with customer engineering organizations to design and build AI-enabled development workflows, solve complex implementation challenges, and establish scalable patterns for AI-powered software development.

As a manager, you will shape how these technical engagements operate at scale — setting strategy, coaching engineers, determining where the team can have the greatest impact, and ensuring consistently strong execution across customers. You will serve as both a people leader and senior technical advisor, partnering closely with Sales, Product, Research, and Engineering to translate customer needs and real-world usage into better technical approaches, reusable patterns, and product insights.

Success in this role will be measured by meaningful and sustained Codex adoption, successful customer outcomes, and the creation of repeatable technical patterns that help engineering organizations get more value from AI.

This role is open in our Munich and Berlin offices. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.


In This Role, You Will

  • Lead, hire, and mentor a high-performing team of Applied AI Engineers supporting Codex customers across strategic accounts.

  • Own the operating model and technical engagement strategy for Codex Applied AI Engineering, helping customers move from initial exploration to meaningful, scaled adoption.

  • Guide teams in designing and implementing AI-enhanced development workflows, agentic systems, automations, evaluations, and scalable application architectures.

  • Act as the senior technical escalation point and thought partner for complex customer implementations and engineering challenges.

  • Partner with Sales, Product, Research, and Engineering teams to align customer outcomes with product direction and roadmap priorities.

  • Establish repeatable technical patterns, playbooks, reference architectures, and best practices that enable broader adoption of AI-powered software development.

  • Coach Applied AI Engineers to operate as trusted technical partners to engineering leaders, executives, and highly technical customer teams.

  • Synthesize insights from customer engagements and translate them into actionable feedback for Product, Research, and Engineering.

  • Develop a deep understanding of how customers are using Codex, where they encounter friction, and where new technical approaches or product capabilities could unlock greater impact.

  • Champion safe, reliable, and effective adoption of AI-powered development workflows across industries.


You’ll Thrive in This Role If You

  • Have 8+ years of experience in deeply technical, customer-facing roles such as applied engineering, solutions architecture, deployment engineering, technical consulting, or similar roles.

  • Have 2+ years of experience leading technical teams, including hiring, mentoring, and developing engineers.

  • Have experience building or deploying generative AI, developer platforms, agentic systems, or cloud-based software solutions in production environments.

  • Possess strong hands-on software engineering experience and fluency with programming languages such as Python or JavaScript.

  • Understand modern software development lifecycles and have strong intuition for how AI and coding agents can change how software is designed, built, tested, and maintained.

  • Can work directly with customer engineering teams to understand ambiguous problems, develop technical approaches, and turn ideas into working solutions.

  • Are an effective communicator who can translate complex technical and business topics for both engineering teams and executive stakeholders.

  • Thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and enjoy building new operating models, technical patterns, and teams from first principles.

  • Demonstrate strong ownership, humility, technical judgment, and a commitment to helping both customers and teammates succeed.

  • Are personally committed to fostering the safe and beneficial development of AI.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Manager, Architecture
descriptionHtml:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Technology practice are looking for an experienced Architecture Manager to join the team. 

In Technology, we help clients define, drive and deliver technology-led change. We have deep experience in the strategy, design, delivery and assurance of large-scale transformation across financial services, energy, commodities, utilities, telecoms and government. Our people become trusted advisors, independent of any technology provider, and deliver real value for our clients.

AI is changing how organisations work, compete and invest, and it’s changing architecture with it. Our clients need architects who can cut through the hype, turn ambition into practical action and create value without losing control of cost, risk or complexity.

In our Architecture practice we bring the right balance of innovation, pace and control to technology-enabled change. We work on our clients’ most complex and highest-return challenges. Commodity or ivory-tower architecture isn’t where we play.

As a Manager, you’ll lead architecture work, use AI to raise the pace and quality of what we deliver, and play an active part in growing our business. You’ll spot opportunities, shape compelling work and build relationships that last well beyond a single engagement.

What you will be doing

Lead architecture that delivers real value

You’ll lead architecture work that turns strategy into practical change. That means owning architecture engagements and workstreams, shaping target architectures and roadmaps, and helping clients make better decisions about where to invest, what to simplify and how to manage risk.

  • Lead engagements with clear ownership of scope, quality, outcomes and client relationships
  • Help organisations improve their architecture functions, operating models and governance
  • Communicate complex ideas clearly, from delivery teams through to CTOs and CIOs

Help clients navigate AI-enabled change

You’ll help clients move from interest in AI to safe, valuable adoption. We’ll look to you to cut through the noise, design for change and make sure AI-enabled solutions have the foundations they need: data, integration, security, identity, governance and clear ownership.

  • Shape AI-ready architectures that balance innovation, pace and control
  • Help clients move beyond disconnected pilots to reusable services, governed delivery and measurable value
  • Use AI tools to speed up research, analysis, option development and architecture artefacts, with strong quality assurance throughout

Create and convert commercial opportunities

You’ll play an active part in growing our business. That means spotting where we can help, shaping work that clients value and building the confidence to convert good conversations into deliverable opportunities.

  • Qualify opportunities through delivery, market insight and trusted relationships
  • Shape proposals, statements of work, team shapes and commercial models with discipline
  • Build architecture propositions that match our growth priorities and the challenges our clients face

Lead people and build our capability

You’ll help build the kind of team people want to work in and clients want to work with. You’ll coach others, share what works and help us turn individual expertise into reusable capability across the practice.

  • Lead mixed Baringa and client teams with clear expectations and a strong coaching mindset
  • Coach colleagues on effective and responsible use of AI
  • Help grow the practice through training, thought leadership, reusable assets and recruitment

 
Your skills and experience  

  • Experience leading architecture work within complex technology-enabled change, with a strong delivery focus
  • Experience in both enterprise and solution architecture, translating strategy into deliverable target architectures and roadmaps, and designing and assuring solutions to achieve it
  • Broad experience across architecture domains (business, application, integration, data, infrastructure and security), with deep expertise in at least one
  • Cloud experience across XaaS offerings, with knowledge of cloud-native services and how to use them in cloud and hybrid solutions
  • A practical understanding of AI and the architecture considerations needed to adopt it safely and at scale. Hands-on AI design experience is a bonus, not a must
  • Experience contributing to proposals, bids or account growth, and the commercial awareness to shape work that is valuable and deliverable
  • The ability to take ownership of projects and teams, sell work and deliver results
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain the complex in simple terms, concisely and with clarity
  • Experience managing stakeholders from C-suite through to engineering, and a desire to build lasting relationships
  • A collaborative style, real curiosity and a genuine interest in helping others grow 

What a career at Baringa will give you 


Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. 
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. 
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice. 
  • Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success. 

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people. 

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this. 

Using business as a force for good. 

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve. 

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

Join us
