title: Manager: Compliance Advisory (and Data Protection)
descriptionHtml:
About Griffin

Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.

We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.

We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.

Learn more about what we do

Our culture

We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.

We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life.

We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.

Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.

Learn more about our culture.

The Team

You'll join our Service guild and work across first line operations, sales and produt. Working closely with Protect (our second line) you'll be the first person dedicated to compliance within the team. You'll define what great compliance solutions look like. Then implement them , keeping Griffin's products and customer outcomes in shape as we grow.

The opportunity

We want compliance and data protection built into how we design, sell and run our products, not bolted at the end.

As our hands on compliance adviser in the first line (the teams who run the business and own its risks), you'll bring regulatory expertise to help our operations, commercial and product teams do exactly that. With card issuing and other launches coming up, there's plenty to get stuck into.

Compliance advisory is the heart of this role and will take around 70% of your time. You’ll also pick up a smaller, complementary slice of work as our Data Protection Officer (DPO), around 30% of your time. DPO experience is a plus but not essential, and we’ll train you if you need it.

What success looks like

In your first year, compliance advisory is where you’ve made your mark. You’ve sought out our operations, sales and product teams and shown them that working with you makes things smoother, not slower. Now they bring you in early by default. You’ve guided at least one major launch, like card issuing, from first idea to go live. You’ve put clear governance and outcome monitoring in place for our live products, so Protect (our second line risk and compliance team) sees fewer surprises and finds a stronger compliance foundation.

Alongside that, in the smaller DPO part of your role, you’ve taken ownership of our data protection agenda. You’ve gone looking for ways to improve, made the changes happen, and given our senior leaders an honest picture of where we stand.

To do this you'll be involved in:

Compliance advisory (around 70% of your time)

  • Product development: turning regulation into clear requirements, customer journeys, T&Cs and fair value assessments, from first idea through product approval to launch, with data protection built in from the start.

  • Product lifecycle management: keeping live products compliant through periodic fair value assessments, outcome monitoring, reviews, changes and closures.

  • Sales: helping our commercial team check early whether potential partners fit our risk appetite, and reviewing sales material.

  • Marketing: working on marketing materials, both ours and our customers’, to make sure they comply with regulation and our own policies, and that our financial promotions are properly challenged.

  • Service (Operations): building regulatory and data protection requirements into how Service works day to day, with procedures and controls people actually use.

  • Regulatory change: working out what new rules mean for us, and making sure the right teams make the right changes on time.

  • Issues and reporting: investigating and fixing compliance issues, including personal data breaches, and reporting clearly on compliance risks and customer outcomes.

  • Working with second line (Protect): bringing them in early, sharing the evidence they need, and acting on their challenge.

Data Protection Officer (around 30% of your time - training will be provided if needed)

Being our DPO means:

  • advising our teams on their obligations, including data protection impact assessments (DPIAs) and transfer risk assessments (TRAs)

  • monitoring how well we comply with the UK GDPR, other global data protection laws and our own policies

  • training colleagues and raising awareness of data protection

  • being our contact point for the ICO and for people with questions or requests about their data

As our DPO, you’ll report directly to our COO and have the independence you need to do the job well. We’ll involve you early in anything that affects personal data.

We expect you to shape this role: This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how this role evolves—that's for you to define as you learn what our customers need and where our technical gaps are.

Your background

We need a proactive compliance doer first and foremost. You get stuck in without waiting to be asked, and you’re comfortable tackling regulations you haven’t met before. You use your experience and expertise to help our teams find simple, clear and compliant solutions. Your advice is balanced, easy to follow and focused on the risks that matter most. You want to push the business forward, and you see good compliance as part of how we get there.

To ensure this, we're looking for people who have:

  • Compliance experience in the first (preferred) or second line of a UK regulated firm, ideally a bank, e-money institution or payments firm.

  • Practical knowledge of the rules behind our products, like Consumer Duty, BCOBS, CASS, FISMA, the Payment Services Regulations and the Money Laundering Regulations. As well as familiarity with HMRC requirements like BBSI and AEOI reporting.

  • Hands-on experience turning regulation into practical requirements for product, sales or operations teams.

  • An openness to picking up data protection as part of the role: a genuine interest is enough, DPO experience isn’t required.

  • A curious, questioning approach. You know the right questions to ask before signing something off, not just the rules to check it against.

  • The confidence to challenge, clearly and kindly, when something isn’t right.

  • A love of writing. We have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write).

Ideally, you would also:

  • Have deep expertise in at least one specialist area, such as payments, cards, Consumer Duty, BCOBS, financial promotions or similar.

  • Have been a DPO, or worked closely with one, in a regulated firm.

  • Have worked in finance or banking.

What can we offer you?

We are an early stage startup and we're working hard to expand our benefits package. We're planning to add to this list in the future.

  • Salary: £ 80-90 (DOE)

  • Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere in the UK

  • Work from abroad: Up to 20 days a year

  • Time off: 25 days’ holiday, bank holidays and a winter break (we shut down between Christmas and New Year)

  • Share options: Own a part of what we’re building together

  • Pension: Auto-enrolment into our Penfold scheme

  • Insurance: Private medical with Bupa (including family cover) and life insurance with AIG

  • Wellbeing: 1:1 coaching and therapy session available through Oliva

  • Family leave: Enhanced parental leave with up to 6 months on full pay after two years’ service

  • AI tools: Everyone has a Claude subscription on us and access to other premium tools

  • Your setup: We’ll support you in creating a comfortable and effective WFH environment.

As a bank, we’re committed to maintaining the highest standards of security. This means that the successful candidate will need to complete background screening, and our offer will be conditional upon satisfactory review of these checks. This would include verification of right to work, criminal record, credit history, social media and professional reference checks

How long will the process take?

We move as fast as possible, but it normally takes us about 2-3 weeks to get to know to each other.

  • Step 1: An initial phone call with our Talent Team for us to tell you more about Griffin and learn about your recent experience.

  • Step 2: Meet your manager to talk through your experience and how that relates to the requirements.

  • Step 3: A task based on what you’ll be doing on a day to day at Griffin.

  • Step 4: Meet with peers in your team for a more in-depth technical interview.

  • Step 5: Culture and Founder interview: Learn more about this here.

How do I apply?

Are we your next move? Apply via the link below, if there's a match our Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial conversation and talk you through what happens next.

We’re remote-first

We trust people to do great work wherever they are. We hire across the UK and most of our team works remotely full-time. We have a small London office in Moorgate for those who want it, and about a third of the company is close enough to use it occasionally, but there's no expectation to be there. What matters is the work, not where you do it.

Under representation

At Griffin, we’re looking for people who instinctively vibe with our values, behaviours and mission. You’re encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn’t tick every box. Careers, like life, can take many twists and turns. Your technical expertise and path to where you are today will stand out. We're committed to creating a place where everyone belongs and we welcome diverse perspectives, backgrounds and people who are ready to build a global platform for programmable finance

Griffin Bank Ltd request that recruitment agencies do not speculatively submit CVs to any employee or associate of our company unless explicitly asked to do so by a member of our Talent team.

Any CVs sent to any member of our team on a speculative basis will not be recognised and we will not accept liability for any fee or commission should we subsequently employ a candidate who applied to us directly or was introduced by an instructed agency that may also have been submitted speculatively by an uninstructed agency.

title: Manager CTO Office
descriptionHtml:
Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en we willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Manager CTO Office rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CTO en geef je leiding aan circa 16 IT-professionals. Het CTO Office is het centrale regie- en ondersteuningsorgaan binnen het CTO-domein.

Vanuit het team zorg je ervoor dat het Technology - domein aantoonbaar in control is, met geïntegreerde sturing op onder andere governance, risk, performance, change portfolio en Third Parties.

Samen met je team zorg je voor betrouwbare, veilige en klant- en businessgerichte Technology-dienstverlening. Je bouwt aan een professionele, resultaatgerichte werkomgeving waarin continu leren, talentontwikkeling, vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en continu verbeteren centraal staan.

Als Manager CTO Office heb je een sleutelrol binnen het MT Technology en rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CTO. Je verbindt leiderschap en strategisch inzicht met een pragmatische aanpak. Zo zorg je voor samenhangende sturing en beheersing van het Technology-domein, waarbij governance en control bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming en een effectieve IT-organisatie.

Sturing en beheersing
Je ontwikkelt en implementeert een integrale visie op governance en control, waarmee Athora effectief voldoet aan interne en externe verplichtingen en tegelijkertijd ruimte creëert voor innovatie en groei. Je geeft richting aan governance, quality & risk management, procesmanagement, compliance, performance management, service management en demand & delivery management. Daarbij stuur je actief op kwaliteit, voorspelbaarheid en continue verbetering, zodat managementbeslissingen gebaseerd zijn op heldere inzichten en meetbare resultaten.

Verandering en verbetering
Je ontwikkelt en bestuurt het change portfolio voor het CTO-domein. Daarbij zoek je continu naar manieren om de organisatie slimmer, eenvoudiger en effectiever te laten werken en zorgt dat veranderingen bijdragen aan de strategische doelen van Athora.

Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Je leidt het CTO Office, ontwikkelt talent en versterkt vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en een professionele, resultaatgerichte cultuur;

  • Je stuurt het Technology changeportfolio aan en zoekt daarbij actief de verbinding met de betrokken Change & Agility managers en de centrale portfoliofunctie;

  • Je ontwikkelt en verbetert de IT-governance: je verduidelijkt verantwoordelijkheden, versterkt de besluitvorming en geeft richting en waarborgt aansluiting tussen Technology Governance en Data & AI Governance belegd bij het Data & AI Office;

  • Je borgt samen met de relevante stakeholders kwaliteit, risicobeheersing en compliance binnen Technology;

  • Je bereidt namens Technology de overleggen voor met toezichthouders zoals DNB, de externe accountant, Internal Audit en tweedelijns controlefuncties;

  • Je voert de regie over Third Party Risk Management en waarborgt dat risico's, prestaties en compliance van strategische IT-sourcingpartners effectief worden beheerst;

  • Je ontwikkelt en bewaakt de sourcingstrategie en het outsourcingbeleid. Ook organiseer en bewaak je de governance en monitoring van kritieke uitbestede activiteiten;

  • Je levert heldere operationele, tactische en strategische stuurinformatie en versterkt daarmee transparante besluitvorming en een sterke performancecultuur.

  • Je bewaakt budgetten, beheerst kosten en maakt de financiën binnen Technology en de onderliggende dienstverlening inzichtelijk;

  • Je coacht en geeft functioneel leiding aan Product Owners, Release Train Engineers en Scrum Masters binnen Technology.


Wat vragen we van jou?

Voor deze rol zoeken we een ervaren manager die overzicht weet te houden in een complex Technology-landschap en tegelijkertijd dicht genoeg op de uitvoering zit om daadwerkelijk verandering te realiseren.

Dit breng je minimaal mee:

  • WO-werk- en -denkniveau en een relevante opleiding, bij voorkeur in informatiemanagement, IT, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • Minimaal 10 jaar relevante ervaring binnen de financiële dienstverlening, met een sterk trackrecord op het gebied van strategisch advies, Governance, IT-governance, IT-procesmanagement, quality & risk control en performance-, service- en demand & delivery management;

  • Ruime ervaring met het aansturen, ontwikkelen en inspireren van teams van vergelijkbare omvang, waarbij je medewerkers in staat stelt het beste uit zichzelf te halen;

  • Diepgaande kennis van IT4IT, COBIT en andere toonaangevende IT-standaarden en frameworks, en het vermogen deze effectief toe te passen in een complexe organisatieomgeving;

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met SAFe-principes en Agile werken, inclusief incrementplanning, sprintcadans, backlogmanagement en het succesvol managen van afhankelijkheden tussen teams;

  • Sterke verandermanagementvaardigheden, waarbij je strategische ambities vertaalt naar concrete initiatieven en blijvende resultaten realiseert;

  • Uitstekende stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden en het vermogen om effectief samen te werken met senior management, Legal & Compliance, Risk, Internal Audit en externe accountants;

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels, mondeling en schriftelijk.

Wat krijg je van ons?

Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega’s die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag.

Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten.

In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een OV-kaart of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten.

Salaris per maand:
Op basis van cao schaal 19 HAY is de range € 7.872,85 tot € 10.497,13 op basis van 36 uur.

Enthousiast?

Reageer dan snel via de sollicitatie button!

descriptionHtml:

Ekimetrics transforms how organisations make critical business decisions. Since 2006, we’ve been helping companies build sustained competitive advantage through AI-powered Managed Solutions. Our dual purpose is Competitiveness and Sustainability, because lasting leadership is built on both.

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Manager Design Engineer - Facilities (f/m/d) at Black Semiconductor to provide senior-level technical leadership in the design, modification, and commissioning of semiconductor manufacturing facility infrastructure. title: Manager, GTM Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

At Checkout.com, we create marketing that moves people to choose our products, builds a brand where great marketers want to work, and fuels the growth of our business.

We’re looking for a GTM Engineer to join Marketing and help transform how we work internally. You’ll design and build AI-assisted workflows, agents and integrations that reduce manual effort, improve how information moves across the team and give marketers more time to focus on high-value work.

Marketing Operations Team owns our marketing technology and tools, and the automation that supports go-to-market execution across our channels. This role works alongside Marketing Operations, with a different starting focus: improving the internal processes, workflows and systems that help Marketing plan and deliver its work. The aim is to 10x our impact.

This is a hands-on technical role in a marketing team. You’ll spend around 70% of your time building: understanding how work gets done, finding where it is manual or breaking down, and shipping practical solutions. You’ll partner closely with Marketing Operations to make sure what you build fits our existing tools and standards.

You’ll work across Marketing, in close partnerships across Marketing Operations, Commercial AI Transformation and the AI Centre of Excellence. You’ll bring a clear technical point of view on what is scalable and reliable, while making sure the systems you build are useful to the people who need them.

How You’ll Make an Impact

Find the problems worth solving

Work with teams across Marketing to understand their processes and the work behind their requests. Map workflows, identify manual effort, duplicated work, missing context and avoidable errors, then prioritise opportunities based on their potential value. You’ll use your creativity and judgement rather than simply build to a ticket.

Build AI-assisted workflows and integrations

Create and ship agents, automations, skills and integrations that make internal marketing work easier. You might use Claude Enterprise, Copilot Studio, Clay, MCP connectors, coding agents or other tools across our marketing stack. Work with Marketing Operations when a solution involves our marketing technology or channel tools.

Make internal marketing work more efficient

Build workflows that help teams do the work behind marketing more efficiently, from briefing, research and insight gathering to planning, content development and hand-offs. Connect information and tools so people spend less time on repetitive coordination and more time on work that needs their expertise. Partner with Marketing Operations where workflows touch marketing technology or channel execution.

Build systems people can rely on

Design beyond the individual task. Consider the data, context, tools, users, hand-offs, controls and feedback loops a workflow needs to work well. Identify where information is missing, where an agent needs better direction or where teams need support to use and improve the system.

Help marketers build with AI

Work alongside marketers to show what is possible and help them use AI with confidence. Create reusable patterns, skills, playbooks and guardrails so teams can solve more problems themselves and repeat good practice.

Test, learn and improve

Prototype and test workflows, learn from how people use them, and improve or retire them based on the results. Identify design, security, privacy, brand and scale risks early, and follow our AI governance and review processes.

Keep up with the tools

Stay curious about new models, coding tools, connectors and agent patterns. Be able to explain which tools are right for a particular job and why, whether you’re comparing Claude, ChatGPT, coding agents or emerging platforms.

What We’re Looking For

You build things

You’ve made working automations, prototypes, integrations, agents, internal tools or products, and enjoy taking a messy problem through to something people can use. Your job title matters less than what you’ve built and the value it creates.

You use AI hands-on

You use LLMs to get work done, not just to talk about what they could do. You’re comfortable prototyping with AI coding tools, testing different approaches, debugging and improving the result. You can show us something you’ve built with Claude, Codex, ChatGPT or another LLM platform, at work or in your own time.

You have sound technical judgement

You can reason about systems, APIs, data flows, permissions and failure modes. You understand the difference between a promising demo and a dependable workflow. You don’t need a traditional software engineering background, but you do need to be comfortable working directly with technical tools and making sensible implementation choices.

You understand marketing and GTM

You understand how demand generation, growth, customer marketing, marketing operations, sales and revenue processes connect. You’re familiar with concepts such as campaign briefs, segmentation, ABM, lead scoring, MQLs, MQAs, pipeline, attribution and lifecycle stages. You’re interested in the business outcomes behind the work.

You’ve worked across marketing or RevOps tools

You’ve built or supported workflows across platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Asana, Clay or similar tools. You can think across a stack rather than optimise one tool in isolation, and you’re comfortable with connectors, APIs, webhooks or MCP-style integrations.

You know how to design useful workflows and agents

You can give a workflow the context it needs, choose the right tools, define hand-offs, involve people at the right points and make outputs easy to review. You understand that an agent’s performance depends on its data and operating environment as well as the model.

You prioritise for value

You can judge which problems are worth solving, which should remain manual and where a simpler answer will work better. You balance speed, quality, risk, maintainability and commercial impact, and can make a clear case for what to build next.

You measure and improve your work

You’re comfortable defining success measures, tracking usage and output, and deciding what to improve, stop or scale. You care about measurable gains in productivity, quality, speed or business impact.

You think in systems

You look for the process behind the immediate pain point. When a spreadsheet is difficult to use, for example, you’re curious about the data, decisions and hand-offs that created it, and what would make the process work better. You can hold the bigger picture while working through the details needed to ship.

You communicate clearly and bring people with you

You can explain technical ideas to marketers, commercial leaders, Product, Engineering, Security, IT and Operations in a way that helps them make decisions. You listen well, communicate simply and influence through your work and judgement.

You’re curious and self-starting

You’re comfortable with ambiguity and motivated to learn. You’ve taught yourself new tools, built something outside your formal remit or pursued a technical interest in your own time. A personal project, prototype, automation, community contribution or other example could show us how you learn.

You use AI responsibly

You understand that marketing systems need to be accurate, secure, explainable and aligned with our brand and company standards. You know when people need to review an output, when data should not be used and when an experiment is not ready to scale.

You might come from marketing technology, marketing operations, growth engineering, RevOps, automation engineering, product, full-stack engineering or another technical role close to commercial teams. What matters most is your curiosity about marketing, your judgement about what is worth improving and your ability to build practical solutions.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

title: Manager Organisational Transformation
descriptionHtml:
About the job

Please note that fluency in Dutch is mandatory for this role.

Do you have a passion for organisational design and a drive to boost effectiveness?

At Valcon, we are looking for experienced candidates with an ambition to improve organisational effectiveness and a passion for organisational design. Besides a proven track record in this domain, we value strong team players with an entrepreneurial spirit and the ability to carry out great ideas in practice. You fit in our team when you have highly developed analytical and conceptual thinking skills and when you can easily draw insights and conclusions from complex matters.

What will you do?

Your primary focus lies in the organisational transformation process, where translation of ambition and strategy to an effective organisational design take a centre stage. In close collaboration with our clients, you analyse challenges and identify improvement potential in the integral organisational design, such as processes, systems, functions and organisational structure. You play an important role in advancing Valcon’s capabilities with a strong emphasis on the People & Organisational Transformation domain.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Managing organisational changes, from problem analysis, optimisation of processes to designing and implementing new business models.

  • Developing different organisational transformation strategies and approaches (making an ambition strategy, design and guiding principles, organisational structure and required communication and engagement plans) that fits the client’s challenge best.

  • Managing and regulating Organisational Transformation projects, with high emphasis on both delivery as stakeholder management.

  • Building and maintaining a relevant network with current and new clients.

  • Managing and guiding consultants during projects and in their personal development.

  • Co-develop one of the industries in which Valcon is present.

  • Building and promoting ‘Valcon’; focus on expanding the People & Organisational Transformation competence team, and primary Organisational Transformation.

What do you bring to the table?

  • A completed bachelor’s and master’s degree with a numerical component.

  • At least 5 years of relevant work experience including experience in consultancy.

  • At least 3 years of experience with the implementation of new business models.

  • The ability to translate strategic goals into implications for employees.

  • We don’t stop at design; we support our clients through implementation. Our integrated transformation projects connect strategy, data, AI and organisational change. An interest in data, AI, change management and the human side of change is therefore essential.

  • Strong personality; you can retain your point of view while managing difficult stakeholders.

  • Real team-player with excellent communication & analytical skills.

  • Commercial expertise; experience in building and maintaining customer relationships.

  • Fluent in Dutch and English.

What do we offer you?

  • Personal development: a tailor-made growth path with training, courses, certification and mentoring by experienced colleagues.

  • An innovative work environment: collaborate with a team of experts pushing boundaries in data, technology, and consulting.

  • Immediate impact and responsibility: you’ll make a difference for our clients from day one and are entrusted with responsibilities that challenge you to bring the best out of yourself.

  • Inspiring work culture: a supportive, flexible, and no-nonsense environment that fosters your growth and fully allows you to be yourself.

Additionally, we offer:

  • Competitive and transparent salary according to our pay structure, an annual bonus (depending on seniority level, individual performance, and company results), and a monthly expense allowance of €95.

  • A company car or mobility budget.

  • A workplace that prioritises and respects your work-life balance (for example by offering you the option of taking a sabbatical or expand the number of holidays per year).

  • An affordable sports membership that allows you to participate in 50 different sports offered by over 10,000 partners.

  • The opportunity to work remotely from abroad for 10 days per year.

  • A vibrant community that organises both professional and social events.

Ready to apply?

Has the above sparked your interest and are you ready to join our innovative and impactful environment? And do our core values - Together, Joy, Curious, Can do, and Integrity - resonate with you? Our recruitment team would be happy to hear from you!

Please apply directly using the button on this page or get in touch with our recruitment team to schedule a coffee meeting at our office first.

title: Managing Principal – Capital Markets
descriptionHtml:
Capco est un cabinet de conseil international, spécialisé dans les services financiers.
Fondé en 1998, le cabinet compte aujourd’hui plus de 7 000 collaborateurs dans 36 bureaux à travers le monde, dont 160 à Paris. 

Challenger reconnu face aux grands noms du conseil, Capco se distingue par sa double expertise métier et technologique, au service de la stratégie comme de l’exécution.

Notre promesse : accompagner la transformation de nos clients dans un monde en constante mutation – réglementaire, technologique et opérationnel.

Nous intervenons à l’intersection du business, de la réglementation et de la tech, en mobilisant des équipes pluridisciplinaires, expérimentées et engagées.

Nos marqueurs distinctifs

  • Une spécialisation sectorielle forte
    Nous apportons à nos clients une compréhension approfondie de leurs enjeux métiers, en particulier dans la banque, les marchés de capitaux et l’énergie.
  • Une approche collaborative et sur mesure
    Nous intégrons les équipes clients, adaptons nos méthodes à leur culture et co-construisons des solutions concrètes et opérationnelles.
  • L’excellence comme exigence
    Notre ambition est d’obtenir des résultats mesurables et durables pour nos clients – et de toujours viser la valeur ajoutée.
  • Un esprit “One Capco”
    Nos équipes collaborent à l’échelle internationale pour mobiliser les meilleures expertises et partager les bonnes pratiques.
  • Une culture entrepreneuriale et inclusive
    L’innovation, l’initiative et le mérite sont au cœur de notre modèle. Nous valorisons les idées, la diversité et le progrès collectif.

Nos expertises s’articulent autour de 6 métiers complémentaires

  1. Stratégie & Transformation
  2. Finance, Risque & Conformité
  3. Product, Innovation & Design
  4. Data & Analytics
  5. Conseil Tech (Advisory)
  6. Engineering (Delivery)

Descriptif du poste

En tant que Managing Principal au sein de Capco France dans le domaine des marchés de capitaux, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l’accompagnement de nos clients, Banque de Financement et d’Investissement, Asset Servicers et Asset Managers, en France et à l’international, afin de contribuer à la croissance du cabinet.

En collaboration avec les autres partners en charge des comptes clients et nos practices, vous serez en charge d’identifier et de transformer de nouvelles opportunités d’affaires auprès de nos clients.

Dans ce cadre, vous piloterez également l’exécution des projets vendus, qui sont de nature complexe et à forte valeur ajoutée, couvrant l’un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants :

  • Transformation organisationnelle et opérationnelle : Redéfinir les modèles opérationnels, organisationnels et l’architecture fonctionnelle pour les départements de marchés de capitaux (Front, Middle, Back-office, Risques), déploiement de processus optimisés et alignés sur les meilleures pratiques du marché.
  • Cadrage et gestion de programmes complexes : superviser, du cadrage à la mise en œuvre, des plans moyen-termes et des projets de transformation à grande échelle (ex : refonte des systèmes, mise en conformité réglementaire, réorganisation…).
  • Accompagnement de projets réglementaires : Accompagner les clients dans la mise en conformité avec les principales réglementations des marchés de capitaux (MiFID 2, EMIR, Dodd-Frank, PRIIPS, SFTR, FATCA…).
  • Transformation Finance & Risques : Refonte des dispositifs de contrôle des risques (marché, contrepartie, crédit, opérationnels), des outils et processus de reporting, pilotage de la performance.
  • Mise en œuvre de technologies et d’innovations : concevoir des architectures fonctionnelles alignées avec les stratégies métiers, superviser l'implémentation de progiciels financiers (ex. : Murex, Calypso, Simcorp…) et de nouvelles technologies innovantes (IA, automatisation des processus, big data, blockchain) pour améliorer la performance des opérations de marché.
  • Stratégie et gouvernance de la donnée : définir et mettre en œuvre une stratégie de gestion des données, accompagner les enjeux d’exploitation, de confidentialité et de sécurité des données.

Au-delà de vos interventions et des missions que vous superviserez, votre rôle consistera également à assurer :

  • Le développement commercial du cabinet dans le domaine des marchés de capitaux : pilotage de relations clients en direct ou en appui des équipes clients, origination d’opportunités business, contribution à la transformation des opportunités en missions concrètes.
  • Le développement de nos offres et services et la croissance des équipes Marché de Capitaux : développement de contenu, partage de nos visions et convictions, développement des compétences internes (recrutement et formation).

Savoir-Faire et Savoir-être

Les caractéristiques suivantes sont requises :

  • Expérience :
    • 12/15 ans d’expérience minimum dans le domaine des marchés de capitaux, dont un minimum de 7/8 ans dans le Conseil.
    • Expérience confirmée dans la gestion de programmes et projets de transformation complexes, depuis le cadrage jusqu’au pilotage, et dans des missions métiers (gestion post-trade, finance, risque et conformité) et/ou technologiques.
  • Compétences techniques :
    • Expertise en stratégie d’une banque de financement et d’Investissement, de son architecture fonctionnelle, de son organisation, de ses métiers et processus et de ses enjeux.
    • Maîtrise des méthodes de gestion de programme / projet, en cycle V ou en agile.
    • Connaissance des instruments financiers et des principes de gestion des risques (marché, contrepartie et crédit).
    • Connaissance des progiciels de marché.
    • Connaissance des nouvelles technologies, des progiciels de marché et des systèmes d’informations des BFI, ainsi qu’une expérience dans le cadrage ou la réalisation de projets de transformation IT dans le domaine des marchés de capitaux serait un réel atout pour ce poste.
  • Soft skills :
    • Leadership avéré et capacité à encadrer des équipes seniors.
    • Excellent niveau de communication, grande aisance rédactionnelle.
    • Fortes compétences en gestion de la relation client.
    • Esprit analytique et capacité à structurer des démarches et à résoudre des problématiques complexes.
    • Orienté résultats, avec un sens aigu du client et de ses enjeux métiers et technologiques.
    • Forte autonomie en matière de relation client, de développement commercial, de pilotage de missions et de développement des collaborateurs.
    • Appétence à challenger le statuquo et capacité à s’adapter aux évolutions technologiques
  • Formation et langues
    • Diplômé(e) d’une grande école d’ingénieurs ou école de commerce (Bac+5)
    • Maîtrise impérative du français et de l’anglais dans un environnement professionnel.
    • Vous savez évoluer dans un contexte international.


Chez Capco, nous vous offrons

  • Un environnement de travail international centré sur l’innovation et la création de valeur pour nos clients bancaires et assuranciels
  • Un parcours de formation continu adapté à vos besoins, pour acquérir de nouvelles compétences et développer une réelle expertise
  • Une organisation de travail hybride (charte télétravail de 2 jours par semaine)
  • Un PEE avec un abondement de 2903€ par an
  • Une culture d’entreprise entrepreneuriale, inclusive et méritocratique, de nouveau certifiée Great Place To Work ®.
  • Des initiatives pour construire le Capco de demain :

    • Woman@capco
    • RSE (forfait mobilité durable, jour de solidarité, etc.)
    • Des communautés métiers, sportives et culturelles

title: Manufacturing Test Engineer
department: Tech Maritime Div Manufacturing : Undersea Dominance - Production : Manufacturing Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Job Overview:
We are seeking a Manufacturing Test Engineer to join Anduril, working in a cutting-edge start-up environment to advance the state-of-the-possible in subsea robotics. The Manufacturing Test Engineer will be charged with developing and implementing high-fidelity, automated test processes on both the component and system level. Working closely with engineering staff and a team of skilled electro-mechanical technicians, this role is key to advancing our testing capabilities to ensure the highest levels quality are achieved as we continue drive scalability into our production operations.

About the Team
Anduril’s Manufacturing team is producing the next generation of Autonomous Underwater Vehicles globally at rate. The Manufacturing Engineering team owns production readiness and process engineering across the Undersea Dominance product range — from core vehicle platform to specialised mission payloads, spanning mechanical and electrical hardware build through to full system integration & test.

About the Job
You will own the test software, automation and tooling that proves every Dive-XL vehicle works before it leaves the building — the Python frameworks that drive instruments and vehicle hardware, the operator-facing GUIs that make complex test sequences safe and repeatable under production pressure, and the interlocks that protect people and product when the system is commanding real high-voltage DC. You will also own the infrastructure underneath: NixOS-based station builds, test result flow into MES, and the configuration management that keeps a fleet of test stations reproducible and rollback-safe. If you thrive hands-on — oscilloscopes and protocol analysers as often as a code editor — in a fast-paced environment where the architecture is yours to build, this role is for you.


What You'll Do

  • Build a broad range of test capabilities across the manufacturing value stream - PCBA bring up, electrical boxes/bottles bring-up, system level checkouts and acceptance testing to key component level in process validation.
  • Develop, execute, and manage test eco-system to de-risk hardware and ensure product meets target reliability levels and ultimate design intent.
  • Perform hands-on and data-driven root cause analysis of electromechanical subsystems utilizing structured problem solving methodologies.
  • Design, implement and maintain semi-automated testing equipment/protocols for subsystem characterization and testing.
  • Diagnose production test issues hands-on as fist point of contact for test technicians. Isolate the failure mode, work with Electrical Design and Software when escalation is needed.
  • Collaborate with the design/systems team throughout product development cycles to perform risk assessments, maintain ownership of test deployment activities in production, oversee technician training, burn down bug fixes/improvements as needed.
  • Produce and maintain testing logs/data, develop library of error codes with troubleshooting logic/diagrams for fast issue resolution.
  • Generate controlled test instructions that can be easily followed by technician team in MES or other test execution systems.
  • Optimize test design and execution of full system “end of line” factory acceptance test (FAT) of AUVs
  • Design and execution of PCBA and electrical system components with hands on testing and rework as necessary


REQUIRED QUALIFIACTIONS

  • Degree in Software, Computer, Electrical, Mechatronic or related field, or equivalent work experience
  • Experience in hardware testing and automated test systems (LabVIEW, Test Stand, etc.)
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Matlab, SHELL, or others
  • Experience with computer hardware communication protocols: USB, Ethernet, RS232, RS485, PCIe, HDMI, CAN, etc
  • 3+ years of experience in a relevant field, preferably test design of electro-mechanical hardware in a manufacturing environment
  • Are well versed with complex electromechanical systems and are passionate about understanding what it takes to make them work reliably
  • Have experience developing full system test plans and know how to execute them on fast-paced product development timelines
  • Have experience with programming/testing a wide range of sensors, actuators, and electrical components
  • Can prototype and run your own tests, from experimental setup to hardware and software implementation
  • Ability to obtain and maintain an Australian Government NV2 Security Clearance (Australian citizen).


PREFERRED QUALIFIACTIONS

  • Experience in sub-sea robotics or AUV/UUV industries
  • Familiar with Product Life Cycle (PLM) systems, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), and Test Execution Systems (TES)
  • Demonstrated ability to learn new skills or adapt to new situations. Un-phased by challenges that go beyond the traditional comfort zone or work experience. Multidisciplinary approach to problem solving
  • Comfortable with high project ownership under technical and schedule pressure, particularly where the scope and definition are limited
  • Experience testing and operating with or around hazardous systems (high voltage up to 400V)
  • Experience working on projects that involve the integration of electrical, mechanical, and software/firmware systems
  • Experience with NixOS, or anydeclarative-configuration background (Ansible, Puppet, Chef).
  • Test frameworks — pytest-based harnesses, LabVIEW, TestStand or equivalent. Exposure to more than one is a plus.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. title: Marketing Lead (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your Role

As Marketing Lead, you turn marketing into a reliable source of qualified pipeline across the UK, Luxembourg and Germany. You report to the Co-Founder and own the marketing plan, budget and team.

Our buyers are GPs, CFOs, COOs and fund operations teams at VC and PE managers. Trust in this market comes from expertise, references and the institutions they already rely on, and almost nobody speaks to the CFO and operations team directly. We will. The founders set the company narrative; you build the engine that carries it to market.

Top priorities

Own marketing’s pipeline contribution

  • Set marketing’s pipeline target by market with the CEO and own the result: qualified pipeline in euros across the UK, Luxembourg and Germany.

  • Define and run the marketing plan and budget for each market, and decide which programmes to scale and which to stop.

  • Grow our presence beyond our current client base and build our position with larger fund managers.

Build the engine across three vectors

  • Content and credibility: a weekly publishing cadence built on what our fund specialists, founders and clients know (operational deep dives, migration and capital-call guides, case studies with named clients), co-publications and webinars with the institutions and voices our buyers trust, and the data and insights lane: bunch as the source the market and journalists call about European private markets operations. You orchestrate; you run the writer.

  • Field: an events programme you produce in-house for fund CFOs and COOs, who rarely attend the investor events, built as a ladder: a 10-person series per market, seller-owned events, partner events with law firms, auditors and banks, and from there larger flagship formats, eventually a bunch conference.

  • Growth and online: with our Growth Marketing Manager and our sales ops and data team, the digital channels, pooled audiences and the HubSpot attribution and MQL→SQL layer that turn attention into qualified pipeline.

Own positioning and product marketing, with Product

  • Positioning and messaging by tier, release go-to-market, and sales enablement (one-pagers, battlecards, demo narratives). Product owns the roadmap and release notes; you own how the market hears about them.

  • Become an expert in our product: sit with client onboarding and the fund specialists until you can demo and explain the platform yourself.

Work hand in hand with sales

  • Run the marketing surround on named target accounts in HubSpot and hand engagement signals on to the sales team, so their next touch lands warm. Sellers own their accounts; marketing never emails a prospect one-to-one.

  • Bring market insight back to the commercial team: what our buyers read, discuss and care about, in a weekly market brief you own.

Build the function

  • Set up the marketing scoreboard (attribution, shared definitions of MQL, SQL and sourced vs influenced pipeline, reporting) with our sales ops and data team.

  • Lead and grow the team: a Growth Marketing Manager today, a writer on retainer, an events coordinator as the series scales; manage agencies and freelancers.

About you

  • 5+ years in total, including 2+ in growth or marketing at a B2B scale-up selling to expert or regulated buyers (fintech, financial services, legal, insurance). You have built a marketing function or content programme from near zero: hired for it, set its budget, chose its agencies, and it kept running when you stepped back. Consulting or GTM-practice years count; private markets experience puts you at the top of our list.

  • You have built or run attribution and steer on pipeline in euros, not MQL counts, with a number you moved to show for it. Hands-on in HubSpot, and you build your own workflows and agents (automations, LLM pipelines for content and signals), not just prompts.

  • Player-coach. You ship before you delegate, turn subject-matter experts into a publishing engine, and learn a market by sitting in its sales calls and reading what its buyers read.

  • Fewer things, done brilliantly. You cut what you can't measure, automate prep but never relationship touches, and know that sellers own their accounts.

Full professional English; German is a plus. Comfortable spending regular time in the UK, Luxembourg and Germany.

Workplace & Benefits

  • Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food and more)

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Hybrid setup (3 days/week in office)

  • Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 120+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring process

  1. People Team Interview (30 min) — Meet us and check initial fit.

  2. Founder’s Interview (60 min) — Role deep dive, sales leadership and commercial scope.

  3. Case Study (60 min).

  4. Final Round (3 × 45 min) — Meet our leadership team.

  5. In-person Meet & Greet with team members. Duration to be confirmed.

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

title: Marketing Lead
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are:
At Omaze, we give our community in the UK and Germany the chance to win luxury homes and other life-changing prizes all while raising money for the causes they love.

Thanks to our Omaze Community, we’ve raised over £150 million for UK charities in just five years. That’s millions helping organisations like Age UK, the RSPCA, British Heart Foundation and Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity deliver life-saving work.

And the best part? We’re only just getting started. Omaze is building a business and culture committed to growth and creating significant social impact on a global scale.

🔑 About The Job

Having launched the Million Pound House Draw in 2020, one of the UK’s fastest ever growing products that to date has raised over £150M for charity, Omaze is preparing to build and launch our next big thing. Designed to take our playbook of dream property prizes to new audiences we are seeking a talented and hungry marketeer to help us make it all happen.

Alongside the General Manager you will shape the new proposition and the strategy to bring it to a new audience defining that audience, positioning the brand and running the creative platform, launching the proposition, and creating a sustainable engine for both brand and commercial growth.

This is a rare opportunity to take something from zero to one and then build the operating rhythm that allows it to grow. You'll start by developing a deep understanding of the customer, defining our positioning and go-to-market strategy, and leading the launch. From there, you'll own the marketing approach for a regular cadence of new campaigns, using customer insight, brand signals and performance data to improve the proposition each time.

You won't have a large dedicated marketing team around you. Instead, you'll need to roll your sleeves up and get it all done, with support from specialists inside and outside of Omaze — including Creative, Performance Marketing, CRM, Brand, PR, Analytics and Product — bringing it all together, delivering a clear strategy and executing brilliantly.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong consumer marketing instincts, brand and creative judgement, commercial thinking and hands-on execution.

🔧 What You’ll Be Doing

Build the go-to-market strategy

  • Develop the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for a new Omaze proposition, from initial customer understanding through launch and scale.

  • Define our priority audiences, their motivations and barriers, and the occasions that will drive participation.

  • Define what this new product should stand for in customers' minds, how it should differentiate itself and how it should relate to the wider Omaze brand and product set.

  • Develop the brand positioning, messaging architecture and creative platform that can build recognition, relevance and desire over time.

  • Determine how the new proposition should relate to the broader Omaze brand and existing product portfolio - including driving incrementality

  • Partner with Product, Commercial, Analytics and Research teams to shape decisions around the customer experience, offer and proposition.

  • Build a clear acquisition and retention strategy, identifying the channels, messages and customer journeys most likely to drive sustainable growth.

title: Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
BeyondMath is a pioneering startup, backed by top-tier VCs, on a mission to reshape the frontiers of engineering through Foundational AI models for Physics. We are replacing traditional, slow, and expensive simulation methods with AI that rivals accuracy at orders of magnitude higher speed.

We are moving beyond the "generic AI" hype to solve the world's hardest physical engineering challenges in automotive, consumer electronics, aerospace, and energy. We are looking for a Marketing Manager to be our first dedicated marketing hire: a hands-on operator who will build and run the channels, materials and events that put our technology in front of the engineers who need it.

The Role

As Marketing Manager, you are the person who makes BeyondMath's marketing actually happen. This is an execution role, not a strategy role: you will report to our GTM Lead, who sets direction with the CEO and COO, and you own turning it into a steady, high-quality stream of output across our social channels, our go-to-market materials and our events calendar.

You will work closely with the leadership team, our GTM and technical account teams, and our engineers and researchers, turning deeply technical work with global OEMs, Formula 1 teams and aerospace innovators into content and moments the market notices. You will not inherit a marketing machine; you will build one, with real autonomy, a direct line to leadership, and the BeyondMath brand system already in place to work from.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own Our Social Channels: Run BeyondMath's LinkedIn and other relevant channels day to day — content calendar, copy, visuals, scheduling, community engagement and reporting — with a consistent voice and an on-brand look.

  • Content Production: Turn product releases, customer results, research and team news into posts, short articles, case studies, one-pagers and short-form video, working directly with engineers and researchers to get the technical detail right.

title: Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we're changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK's leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We're growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we're hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We're on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the Role

Content and events. Two engines of Flock's marketing, and you own the execution of both.

Today the marketing team is one Senior Marketing Manager, who owns the brand and website, publishes the content, launches the products and runs up to nine events a year, getting it all out of the door by pushing AI hard. We're doubling the team and backing it with 3.5x the budget.

You're the second person in, owning events and content.

Events. You'll plan the calendar with the Senior Marketing Manager and own delivery: trade shows and conferences, plus our own broker and customer events. On each one you'll set the budget, build the stand, run the day, chase the leads and report on whether it was worth repeating.

Content. You'll shape the strategy with the Senior Marketing Manager, then produce it. Volume and quality both count. LinkedIn and the Flock blog are the priorities, plus video and website copy. The stories sit with underwriting, distribution and product, so getting good material out of busy people is a big part of the job.

AI. Flock runs on AI and we build AI products for customers too. Marketing is held to the same standard. We want you to be the person who brings the newest tool into the office and shows everyone what it does. Brokers and customers still respond to work that feels human, so you'll be someone who writes excellently and still has creative flair.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Own social media. Run our social strategy, with LinkedIn as the primary channel: product videos, carousels, infographics, and PDF’s, posted consistently and measured for engagement.

  • Create content at volume. Case studies, articles, industry news, thought leadership and product launch material, several times a month.

  • Make video. Film and produce videos with our team in and around the office: people stories, product walkthroughs and interviews.

  • Deliver events. Work with the Senior Marketing Manager Coordinate and execute our calendar of seven to nine events a year: trade shows, conferences and our own customer and broker events.

  • Design your own assets in Claude Design and Figma, to a standard that holds up next to agency work.

  • Work with AI daily. Draft, edit, repurpose and scale content with AI tools, applying your own voice and judgement so nothing reads machine-written.

 

What you'll need

  • Significant content creation and social media experience, ideally in B2B tech, with measurable results from owning and executing a social strategy.

  • A portfolio of work you can share on the spot.

  • Strong copywriting and communication, proven in published work.

  • A track record organising and coordinating trade shows, conferences or business events, plus internal events for customers and stakeholders.

  • Hands-on design skills in Figma and Claude Design. Adobe Creative Cloud would be a bonus.

  • Startup pace and ownership: you've worked somewhere small enough to own outcomes end to end, spot what needs improving and act without waiting for a brief.

  • Confident, critical use of AI across your marketing work.

Nice to have: video editing experience, and exposure to insurance, fleet or telematics.

 

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖️

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that's a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don't tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

title: Mechanical Engineer - Equipment Engineering
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

 

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

 

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Build the machine that builds the machine. Join TechOps at the forefront of advanced manufacturing, we’re building the production system that will enable commercial fusion. The Production lines, tooling, and processes are being developed from the ground up; you'll create the ways of working, not inherit them.

  • Work at the frontier of manufacturing technology. Bring your creativity to evaluate, qualify, and deploy processes with no industry playbook, every component you build and every process you shape goes directly into the core of the stellarator magnet technology.

  • Do work that matters, and see it grow. The hardware you build is the product and your career grows with it, from prototyping and process development through quality and industrialization, alongside exceptional colleagues from around the world.

  • Make an impact you can point to. In a small, fast-moving team, your calls on equipment, quality, and process directly shape how a world-class deep-tech company produces superconducting magnets with results visible on the shop floor, not buried in a slidedeck.

YOUR IMPACT

Design and build the machines, fixtures, and tooling used to manufacture HTS magnet coils.

Develop the manufacturing processes that turn new equipment into a repeatable production line.

Work hands-on with technicians to build, debug, and commission equipment on the shop floor.

Own equipment and process development together, from clean-slate concept through production readiness.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Design new manufacturing equipment and fixtures for magnet manufacturing; from concept generation and trade studies through the whole equipment life cycle.

Perform proof-of-concept calculations, benchtop testing, and tolerance stack-up analysis to validate design decisions before committing to build.

Own subsystem designs, BOMs (Bills of Materials), specifications, and drawings, and manage changes as designs mature.

Develop, coordinate and document assembly procedures, commissioning and operation for the equipment you design.

Support technicians during equipment build, assembly, and commissioning.

Supporting the production team troubleshooting issues and iterating on design or process as needed.

Drive non-conformances to root cause and turn findings into concrete process or design improvements.

Provide DFM (Design for Manufacturing)/DFA (Design for Assembly) input to magnet design engineers to keep coil designs manufacturable.

Select and manage external vendors and machine shops for components, subassemblies, and fabricated parts.

Recommend equipment, tooling, or facility improvements needed to scale manufacturing capacity as production ramps.

Participate in design reviews, and communicate design and process decisions clearly to cross-functional partners.

WHO YOU ARE

4–6 years of experience in mechanical design or manufacturing engineering, ideally building complex electromechanical systems, automated equipment, or precision assemblies.

Strong CAD skills (SolidWorks preferred) including GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing) and drawing creation for fabrication and inspection.

Experience designing parts and equipment across multiple manufacturing processes: machining, sheet metal, welding, fabricated assemblies.

Hands-on experience building, assembling, and debugging equipment or prototype, not just designing on paper.

Solid technical writing skills for work instructions, assembly procedures, and design documentation.

Comfort with ambiguity and rapidly changing requirements in a fast-paced startup environment.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Nice to have:

Exposure to automation systems, control cabinets, PLCs (Programmable Logic Controllers), or industrial sensors.

Experience with FEA (Finite Element Analysis) tools (SolidWorks Simulation, Ansys) for structural or thermal analysis.

Familiarity with cryogenics, vacuum systems, or superconducting/high-precision electromechanical hardware.

Experience with PLM (Product Lifecycle Management)/MES (Manufacturing Execution Systems) tools for BOM and change management.

Rapid prototyping skills: 3D printing, mill, lathe, or hand tools.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

descriptionHtml:

Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups.
We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential.

Wingtra builds professional drones that help people map and understand the world. Join the team creating our next aircraft and the tools that build and test it. You’ll be a hands-on generalist who combines mechatronic design and system integration. You’ll work for drone operators and for our colleagues on the production floor.

We’re early adopters of AI and build agents into everyday engineering. We want you to keep expanding what we can design, build and test.


Responsibilities

En France, des millions de personnes renoncent aux soins faute de temps, d'accès ou de moyens. Alan est né pour changer ça — en combinant assurance santé et clinique virtuelle dans une seule application pour devenir un vrai partenaire santé.

La Clinique Alan réunit plus de 120 professionnels de santé disponibles 7j/7 : médecins généralistes, sages-femmes, psychologues, kinésithérapeutes, dermatologues, pédiatres, nutritionnistes, infirmières puéricultrices.

Nos membres bénéficient d'une prise en charge véritablement intégrée :

  • 🩺 Téléconsultation vidéo : pour les situations qui nécessitent une consultation médicale en direct

  • 💬 Chat médical : conseils de professionnels de santé, 7j/7, réponse en moins de 30 minutes

  • 🎯 Des programmes de prévention (mal de dos, gestion du stress) : guidés et personnalisés

  • 🧘 Alan Play : une approche ludique de la prévention autour de l'activité physique, du bien-être mental et de la cohésion d'équipe

🩸 Qu’est-ce qu’Alan Précision ?

Il s’agit de notre tout nouveau programme de prévention ; un service de santé préventive avancée, à la croisée de la médecine de précision, de la biologie et du mode de vie.

Le constat : en France, il y a environ 12 ans d’écart entre l’espérance de vie et l’espérance de vie en bonne santé, et plus de la moitié des maladies chroniques sont évitables. Plutôt que d’attendre les symptômes, nous repérons les signaux biologiques précoces et nous les traduisons en actions concrètes.

Le service repose sur trois briques :

  • 💉 Un bilan sanguin de plus de 80 biomarqueurs et ratios, réalisé dans plus de 300 laboratoires partenaires. Il couvre le cardiovasculaire (ApoB, Lp(a)…), le métabolisme (insuline, HOMA-IR, HbA1c), le foie, le rein, la thyroïde, l’inflammation (hs-CRP), les micronutriments et les hormones.

  • 💬 Un questionnaire d’environ 200 questions sur le mode de vie, les objectifs et les antécédents.

  • 🎯 Un rapport personnalisé généré par IA et validé par nos médecins, qui contient l’analyse de chaque biomarqueur en contexte, un Score de Santé, un Âge Biologique, des recommandations sur le mode de vie et un plan d’action avec 3-5 objectifs prioritaires basés sur les grands “piliers” de la prévention (activité physique, nutrition, santé mentale, sommeil, …).

🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Nous recrutons des médecins généralistes curieux de prévention et de médecine de précision, pour rejoindre le petit groupe de médecins qui relisent et valident les rapports Alan Précision.

  • ✅ Curieux(se) de ce que l’IA peut apporter à la pratique

  • ✅ Convaincu(e) que prévention et accompagnement changent vraiment la vie des patients

  • ✅ Un vrai intérêt pour la thématique et l'envie d'apprendre : un DU (nutrition, prévention…) est un plus, mais pas indispensable

  • ✅ Disponible au moins 4h par semaine (horaires flexibles)

  • ✅ Statut libéral

🧠 Votre rôle : le regard médical qui fait la différence

L’IA prépare, vous validez. Avant d’arriver chez le membre, chaque rapport passe entre vos mains : vous en êtes le garant médical, et c’est votre expertise qui en fait un rapport fiable et utile.

Concrètement, vous :

  • Relisez le rapport généré par l’IA et vérifier son exactitude médicale

  • Vous vous assurez que les interprétations collent au profil de la personne (âge, sexe, activité, habitudes)

  • Apportez la nuance que seul un médecin sait apporter :

    • un lien de causalité trop affirmatif (« est causé par » doit devenir « peut être lié à »)

    • une formulation anxiogène

    • une incohérence entre les sections du rapport

    • une recommandation qui ne correspond pas au profil

    • une supplémentation exotique ou mal étayée

  • Êtes le filet de sécurité : vous bloquez et faites remonter les situations qui sortent du cadre de la prévention (valeur critique, pathologie active suspectée, interaction médicamenteuse…)

  • Signalez les erreurs récurrentes de l’IA : vos corrections servent directement à améliorer les rapports suivants

A noter:

  • Vous n’écrivez pas les rapports, vous ne prescrivez pas, et vous n’échangez pas directement avec les utilisateurs. Les résultats biologiques arrivent automatiquement par MSSanté.

  • Tout se fait en asynchrone : pas de créneau fixe, pas de patient qui attend. Vous relisez les rapports quand vous voulez — le soir, entre deux consultations, le week-end.

  • Il s'agit donc d'une activité complémentaire idéale pour diversifier votre exercice, sans salle d’attente ni urgence.

     

🙌 Pourquoi rejoindre Alan ?

  • 🔬 Une thématique passionnante. Médecine de précision, biomarqueurs, prévention avancée qui associe biologie et mode de vie : une approche encore rare en France, que vous pratiquerez au quotidien. Enfin le temps de faire de la prévention approfondie, celle qu'une consultation de 15 minutes ne permet pas.

  • 🎓 Une expertise qui enrichit votre pratique. Vous développez des compétences rares (ApoB, Lp(a), insulinorésistance, micronutrition…) que vous pourrez aussi mobiliser auprès de vos propres patients.

  • 📚 Formation et partage. Onboarding et formation à la médecine de précision, sessions d'échange entre médecins, veille scientifique.

  • 🏥 Un cadre médical structuré. Vous exercez dans un cadre clair, conforme aux exigences réglementaires et déontologiques, pour des prises en charge cohérentes, harmonisées et sécurisées. Des médecins référents vous accompagnent dans les situations cliniques difficiles.

  • 🤝 Un petit groupe de pionniers. Au-delà de la mission freelance, vous rejoignez la communauté d'une dizaine de médecins qui construisent Alan Précision : partage de connaissances, échanges sur les cas, et vos retours qui orientent directement l'évolution du produit. Vous faites aussi partie de la Clinic Alan et de ses plus de 120 professionnels de santé.

  • 🤖 Co-construire l'avenir de la médecine. Quelle place pour l'IA dans le parcours de soin? Chez Alan, les médecins sont au cœur de ces réflexions et impliqués dans son développement.

  • 💰 Des conditions attractives. Nous proposons une rémunération attractive (70€/h), une grande flexibilité d’organisation (travail 100 % asynchrone et à distance) et l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une communauté médicale engagée.
