title: Migrations Architect
descriptionHtml:
• Location: London/ Bristol UK OR  Paris France. (Hybrid) 

  • Level: TL1

  • Team: Client Delivery

  • Salary: £80,000-£90,000

  • Reporting To: Head of Migration Enablement and Architecture

This role can be based in the UK (Bristol or London) or France (Paris). You'll need existing right to work in whichever country you're applying to.

At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship.

Kaluza Overview

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

A technical leader in our Migration Enablement team, you will be responsible for the design, plan and build of the data migration for each of Kaluza’s platform deployments. The Migration Architect will be well-versed in the complexities and risks associated with data migration programmes, and be well-equipped to develop methodologies that reduce and remove these risks. 

You will be a key member of the Deployment Design team: a specialist unit focused on winning Kaluza new business and then delivering on the deals made. The team’s mission is to create seamless, scalable, and secure deployment solutions that empower our clients to accelerate innovation, achieve operational efficiency and business success. Through collaboration, a focus on repeatability, and a user-centred approach, we design and implement reliable SaaS deployment architectures that enhance performance, minimise risk, and support future growth.

Responsibilities will include -

  • Source System & Data Architecture Analysis: Gaining a detailed understanding of clients’ existing systems, data models, integrations, business processes and data dependencies to determine migration requirements and complexity.

  • Source-to-Target Data Mapping: Leading analysis and definition of mappings between legacy data structures and the Kaluza target data model, including transformation rules, defaults, derivations and handling of data gaps.

  • Migration Solution Architecture: Designing end-to-end migration solutions covering data extraction, transformation, validation, loading, reconciliation and exception management, ensuring alignment with Kaluza architecture and engineering standards.

  • Data Extraction Strategy: Consulting with and supporting clients in designing and developing robust extraction capabilities, including defining extract specifications, formats, sequencing, dependencies and data quality expectations.

  • Migration Tooling & Engineering Collaboration: Working closely with Engineering teams to define requirements for migration tooling, APIs, ETL processes, validation frameworks and automation required to execute migrations safely and efficiently.

  • API, Integration & ETL Expertise: Applying a strong understanding of APIs, integration patterns, ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines and large-scale data processing to design scalable migration approaches.

  • Data Quality & Validation: Defining validation rules and data quality controls across extraction, transformation and loading, identifying data issues early and agreeing remediation approaches with clients and engineering teams.

  • Migration Reconciliation: Designing reconciliation frameworks to demonstrate completeness and accuracy of migrated data, including source-to-target reconciliation, control totals, exception reporting and business validation.

  • Client Solution Design: Architecting and presenting client-specific Kaluza migration solutions, clearly explaining technical design decisions, trade-offs, dependencies and the business outcomes the proposed approach will deliver.

  • Migration Strategy & Planning: Developing client-specific migration strategies and plans, including migration cohorts, sequencing, volumes, frequency, throughput, eligibility criteria and migration windows.

  • Migration Performance & Scalability: Assessing data volumes, processing capacity and system constraints to ensure migration solutions can achieve required throughput and scale while protecting platform stability.

  • Migration Testing Strategy: Defining the technical migration testing approach across component testing, integration testing, end-to-end testing, migration dry runs, trial migrations and production readiness.

  • Cutover & Production Migration Architecture: Designing the technical approach for migration cutover, including sequencing, dependencies, entry/exit criteria, rollback or recovery approaches, monitoring and operational readiness.

  • Technical Migration Leadership: Acting as the technical authority for migration throughout implementation and live execution, providing technical direction, resolving complex issues and coordinating decisions across client, Engineering, Product and programme teams.

  • Technical Governance & Design Assurance: Representing migration within programme and architecture governance, reviewing technical designs, managing architectural risks and dependencies, and ensuring migration solutions remain aligned with agreed standards.

  • Issue & Root Cause Analysis: Leading investigation of complex migration failures and data issues, distinguishing between source-data, transformation, integration, platform and migration-tooling problems and driving appropriate resolution.

  • Requirements & Technical Analysis: Translating business and migration requirements into clear technical requirements, specifications and acceptance criteria, while challenging assumptions and identifying gaps, dependencies and constraints.

  • Migration Optimisation: Using evidence from testing, dry runs and live migrations to fine-tune migration rules, tooling, performance, sequencing and operational processes.

  • Commercial & Pre-Sales Support: Leading the migration architecture elements of commercial proposals, including solution definition, technical feasibility, assumptions, dependencies, complexity assessment and estimation.

  • Deployment & Implementation Architecture: Leading migration architecture within the broader client deployment and implementation design, ensuring migration is integrated effectively with platform configuration, integrations, testing and operational readiness.

  • Technical Documentation & Migration Playbooks: Producing high-quality architecture documentation, technical specifications, data mapping artefacts and client-specific migration designs, while developing reusable Kaluza standards, patterns and playbooks to accelerate and standardise future migrations.

  • Knowledge Sharing & Technical Enablement: Building migration capability across Kaluza by documenting lessons learned, establishing reusable architectural patterns and providing technical guidance and mentoring to engineering, implementation and migration teams.

About You 

You are a hands-on, analytical problem-solver who thrives at the intersection of technology and business. You have a passion for detail and a proven ability to translate complex client needs into practical, scalable solutions. You are comfortable working with large, diverse datasets and possess a strong understanding of how enterprise systems function.

Ideally, you'll have/be:

  • Experience: 

    • Experience within data migration programmes, with specific experience of developing Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) processes

    • Experience in a technical/engineering leadership role, able to demonstrate leadership qualities

    • Technical experience of Energy industry or utilities is a significant benefit

  • Skills:

    • Data analysis and management

    • Systems architecture and software development

    • Verbal and written communication including the ability to convey complex technical information to non-technical audiences

    • Delivering impactful presentations as part of Kaluza sales activities

  • Other Requirements: Kaluza is a global business, as a result the person in this role will be required to travel as part of commercial and deployment activities. By way of a guide, it’s expected that between 9 and 12 business trips a year will be required.

What will set you apart

  • A passion for solving problems with multiple varied experiences of doing so;

  • The determination to see a job done well from start to finish;

  • A deep curiosity that can be applied to Kaluza’s clients and their customers, enabling you to devise customer-centric approaches.

  • A leadership style that multiplies the talents of the teams around you.

Where you'll work

We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Kaluza Values

Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business:

Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together.

Our Perks

  • Pension Scheme

  • Discretionary Bonus Scheme

  • Private Medical Insurance + Virtual GP

  • Life Assurance

  • Access to Furthr - a Climate Action app

  • Free Mortgage Advice and Eye Tests

  • Perks at Work - access to thousands of retail discounts

  • 5% Flex Fund - to spend on the benefits you want most

  • 26 days holiday

  • Flexible Bank Holidays - Giving you an additional 8 days which you can choose to take whenever you like

  • Progressive Leave Policy - With no qualifying service periods, including 26 weeks full pay if you have a new addition to your family

  • Personal Learning Budget - Upskill, learn and grow!

  • Home Office Budget

  • And more!

We want the best people

We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.

Find out more about working in Kaluza on our careers page and LinkedIn. You can also find our Applicant Data Protection Policy here.

title: Mixed-signal IC Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago is an AI and computer hardware company whose mission is to drive the course of history forward. We do so by accelerating breakthroughs at the intersection of AI and semiconductors.

Founded in 2024 by AI researchers and physicists with deep expertise in photonics, electronics, software, mathematics, and machine learning, Arago brings together a lean team of engineers and scientists from the world’s top companies and research labs.

Composed of nine nationalities and operating from hubs in France, North America, and Israel, we believe in great science and fast achievements. Our work is guided by these core principles:

  1. Do great things: we deliver work we’re proud to sign our name to.

  2. High velocity: speed matters. We move quickly, one step at a time.

  3. One unit: we’re all in this together, with relationships grounded in trust, respect, and camaraderie.

Arago is backed by executives from Apple, Arm, Nvidia, Microsoft, and Hugging Face, as well as prominent US and European deeptech venture firms and exited founders.

What you’ll do

Design, integrate, and deliver high-performance digital subsystems within mixed-signal ICs, enabling control, calibration, and high-speed data movement in analog-centric environments — owning the flow from RTL to physical implementation and tape-out.

Responsibilities

  • Design and verify digital subsystems that interface directly with high-speed analog and mixed-signal circuits — including calibration engines, control FSMs, data converters, and multiplexing logic.

  • Contribute to the design of analog components at the digital-analog interface: calibration circuits, DACs/ADCs, comparators, and others.

  • Integrate and customize external IP blocks (e.g., GPIOs, LVDS I/Os, serial interfaces), ensuring compliance with analog signal and timing requirements.

  • Lead the digital implementation flow for mixed-signal blocks: from RTL to synthesis, floorplanning, P&R, timing closure, physical signoff, and tape-out.

  • Collaborate closely with analog, layout, and system teams to co-optimize digital-analog boundaries, resolve cross-domain issues, and ensure robust high-speed performance.

  • Contribute to the development of high-speed serial I/O subsystems — experience in the design and implementation of SerDes blocks is a significant advantage.

  • Language: English at a proficient level. French is a plus.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong experience in digital RTL design (Verilog/SystemVerilog), particularly for mixed-signal systems involving high-speed calibration/control loops, converters, multiplexers, and serial/parallel data paths.

  • Experience with analog IC development environments (Virtuoso or equivalent).

  • Deep understanding of digital-analog integration challenges, including timing closure, noise coupling, clock domain crossing, and analog-aware floorplanning in high-speed environments.

  • Proven ability to drive digital blocks from design through verification, synthesis, floorplanning, P&R, and tape-out, especially in the context of analog or RF ICs.

  • Skilled in integrating and adapting external IPs such as GPIOs, LVDS, SPI/I²C interfaces; experience with high-speed serializers/deserializers (SerDes) is a highly valued plus.

  • Proficient with industry-standard EDA toolchains for both front-end (design/verification) and back-end (physical implementation), with a strong grasp of mixed-signal layout constraints.

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

  • Meaningful stock option plan offered at the earliest stage of the company (included in the majority of full time offers).

  • Relocation bonus and coverage of moving expenses for relocation within 20 minutes of the company’s location.

  • Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.

  • Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.

  • Reimbursement of 50% of the public transport subscription fee.

  • A high-paced, multicultural (with 9 nationalities), and engineering-led environment.

title: ML Compiler & System
descriptionHtml:
What Quadrants is

Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research.

The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton.

It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public.

The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast.

 

The role

You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap.

Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further.

It calls for two things at once: the low-level GPU and compiler skill to make a single kernel optimal, and the ability to keep the whole system coherent as it grows.

The core tradeoff is settled: usability comes first. When usability and performance collide, usability wins, unless the cost is severe. We will limit what the system supports to go fast (static shapes and fixed-size allocation baked into kernels, say), but never the convenience of the API itself. Experts who want maximum performance and full control over the generated code get lower-level escape hatches, down to inline assembly, C, or PTX.

 

What you’ll own

  • API & authoring experience. The surface that physics and numerical-computing engineers write against, and, as an open-source library, the product’s face to the world. Idiomatic, natural to Python users, never a separate language bolted onto Python. Clean decorators, legible constraints, sharp errors, real escape hatches.

  • IR, lowering & backends. A stable IR that lowers to multiple backends, with room to grow and the door kept open for differentiable simulation. Today the computation graph is expressed through Quadrants’ own constructs. Recovering it automatically from ordinary Python is hard, and a long-term goal rather than today’s reality.

  • Optimization. Turn naive code into strong execution plans: vectorization, register and shared-memory usage, barriers and atomics, cooperative threading, dead-buffer and redundant-traffic elimination, dropping needless synchronization. Move low-level optimization off users and into the platform.

  • Primitives. Cholesky, eigendecomposition, matmul, reductions, solver kernels. Each owned with its correctness, benchmarks, and regression tracking.

  • Watching Genesis and the compiler together. Hunt for performance wins on both sides, in Genesis and in Quadrants itself. Propose API changes that cut duplication, improve readability, and reduce platform-specific special-casing. Less to maintain, more that simply works.

  • The project as a product. Benchmark real workloads, track performance over time, catch regressions early. Stay close to users (Genesis first), find friction and missing abstractions, drive adoption, set direction.

Who you are

You reason about whole systems and have taste for where complexity should live. You measure before you optimize, and you reach for memory traffic and launch overhead before FLOPs. You have opinions about API design. You write tests and benchmarks as you go, not afterward.

The ground that judgment stands on:

  • GPU. What optimal looks like and why: access patterns, registers, shared memory, barriers, atomics, threading. CPU intuition a plus.

  • Python & API taste. Idiomatic Python. A feel for what’s natural to Python users. APIs that free users rather than constrain them.

  • Compilers. The path from authoring to kernels (IR, lowering, optimization), weighed against maintainability.

And how you work: proactive and largely self-directed. You fetch context across the company instead of waiting for it. You’re comfortable talking to the engineers who use what you build, and at ease designing in the open for users you’ll never meet. Ready to grow into leading a small team (a couple of people, near term).

 

What great looks like

People adopt Quadrants from outside Genesis. Engineers write clearer code with less boilerplate. Kernels keep getting faster. Performance is tracked, not guessed. The architecture gets easier to extend, not harder.

 

What we’re uncompromising about

How you work is up to you. What matters is that your ownership grows over time: blind spots shrink, the parts you can vouch for expand, technical debt goes down, the core stays sound.

That takes treating understanding as real work, not overhead. You read and challenge the codebase instead of just stacking features on it. You take nothing you did not write for granted. You watch the competition and what’s coming next, and you bring it in and ship it.

Use AI agents if they help. They are productivity tools, not code owners. You are.

Your manager will be Alicia, our Performance Marketing Global Expert.

title: Modelling Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

About the Software organisation at Fractile

PerfSim sits within the Software organisation at Fractile, which is responsible for developing a full software stack for our groundbreaking AI inference systems. That's everything from ML compilers, device drivers and systems firmware, application level runtime and ecosystem integrations, ML and compute libraries, great developer tooling and a full portfolio of simulators, through to datacenter scale workload deployment solutions. At Fractile, we know that a fantastic software stack is a critical and central part of any AI inference solution and it sits at the heart of everything we're doing.

About the team and role

To build hardware that doesn't yet exist, you first have to model it — with precision, depth, and an eye for the trade-offs that matter. At Fractile, high-fidelity pre-silicon models shape our architecture, performance, and product design long before hardware exists. The Simulation team includes C++ and SystemC specialists, verification and validation engineers, system architects, and embedded engineers. This is not a support function — it is the group that defines how Fractile's hardware behaves.

As a Modelling Engineer you will develop the pre-silicon models of Fractile's AI acceleration hardware, enabling architectural exploration and definition, functional modelling, performance modelling and bottleneck analysis, and early software development on virtual platforms. You will work closely with hardware, software, and ML teams in a true hardware–software co-design loop.

About you

You have a genuine curiosity for hard problems and the depth to operate across architecture, performance, and functional correctness. You understand that the models you build will shape the architecture of Fractile's accelerator, determine performance trade-offs, enable early runtime and compiler development, unblock software teams months before silicon exists, and reduce risk across the entire product lifecycle. You take that responsibility seriously and bring the rigour it demands.

Key Requirements

  • Experience in pre-silicon modelling of complex semiconductor IP

  • SystemC or equivalent modelling frameworks

  • C++ for high-performance simulation

  • Performance modelling and architectural analysis

  • Verification and functional modelling

Nice to Have

  • Experience with ML workloads or ML accelerator architectures

  • Prior startup or small-team experience

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

 

Export controls

Our work involves technologies subject to UK, US and other international export control regulations. Certain roles may require additional eligibility checks to ensure compliance with applicable law. We'll be transparent about this throughout the hiring process.

title: Moodle & E-Learning Specialist (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Moodle & E-Learning Specialist (m/w/d)

Schwerpunkt: Interaktive Lernmedien, Didaktik und digitale Lernplattformen

Vollzeit (40 Stunden/Woche)
Arbeitgeber: XRbit gUG (haftungsbeschränkt)
Arbeitsort: Dortmund - 100 Prozent Home Office eventuell möglich

Über uns

Die XRbit gUG entwickelt innovative digitale Anwendungen für Bildung, Forschung und Kultur. Unsere Schwerpunkte liegen auf Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), Künstlicher Intelligenz (KI) und interaktiven Lerntechnologien.

Gemeinsam mit Hochschulen, Forschungseinrichtungen, Unternehmen und Bildungspartnern entwickeln wir neue Wege der Wissensvermittlung – von virtuellen Trainingsumgebungen bis hin zu digitalen Weiterbildungsangeboten.

Für den Aufbau und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Moodle-basierten Lernplattform suchen wir Verstärkung in Vollzeit.

Deine Aufgaben

Du übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle bei der Konzeption, Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung unserer digitalen Lernangebote. Dabei verbindest du technische Möglichkeiten mit kreativer Mediengestaltung und didaktischem Verständnis.

Deine Schwerpunkte:

  • Moodle-Plattform: Du gestaltest die Struktur unserer Lernplattform, entwickelst Kurskonzepte und nutzt die vielfältigen Möglichkeiten von Moodle und seinen Erweiterungen.

  • Interaktive Lerninhalte: Du erstellst abwechslungsreiche Lernmodule mit H5P, interaktiven Videos, Quizformaten, Lernspielen, Verzweigungen und multimedialen Übungen.

  • 2D-Animation und Mediengestaltung: Du entwickelst anschauliche Grafiken, einfache Animationen, Erklärsequenzen und visuelle Elemente für unsere digitalen Kurse.

  • Didaktische Konzeption: Du übersetzt komplexe Fachinhalte in verständliche, motivierende und zielgruppengerechte Lernangebote. Dazu gehören Lernziele, Lernpfade, Übungen und Feedbackmechanismen.

  • Weiterentwicklung und Innovation: Du erprobst neue Moodle-Funktionen, Plugins und Autorentools und entwickelst Ideen, wie KI, Gamification und perspektivisch auch VR-/AR-Inhalte sinnvoll in Lernprozesse eingebunden werden können.

  • Qualitätssicherung: Du testest Lernangebote mit Blick auf Verständlichkeit, Benutzerfreundlichkeit, Barrierearmut und Lernerfolg.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Entwicklerteam und den fachlichen Projektpartnern zusammen. Bei komplexeren technischen Aufgaben, beispielsweise Serveradministration, Programmierung oder Schnittstellenentwicklung, wirst du von unseren Softwareentwicklern unterstützt.

Dein Profil

Wir suchen eine vielseitige Persönlichkeit, die technische Neugier, Kreativität und Freude an der Wissensvermittlung miteinander verbindet.

Das solltest du mitbringen:

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Moodle oder vergleichbaren Lernmanagementsystemen und die Bereitschaft, dich intensiv mit Moodle auseinanderzusetzen.

  • Erfahrung mit der Erstellung digitaler Lerninhalte, insbesondere interaktiver Übungen, Quizformate oder multimedialer Kurse.

  • Kenntnisse in H5P oder vergleichbaren Autorentools.

  • Fähigkeiten in der visuellen Gestaltung und idealerweise praktische Erfahrung bei der Erstellung von 2D-Animationen, beispielsweise mit After Effects, Adobe Animate, Rive oder vergleichbaren Werkzeugen.

  • Didaktisches Verständnis und die Fähigkeit, fachliche Inhalte in sinnvoll strukturierte Lernprozesse zu überführen.

  • Eine selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Freude daran, neue Werkzeuge und Technologien auszuprobieren.

  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse zur Erstellung und Abstimmung deutschsprachiger Lerninhalte.

Besonders interessant sind außerdem:

  • Erfahrungen mit Gamification, adaptiven Lernpfaden oder spielerischen Lernformaten.

  • Kenntnisse in HTML, CSS, JavaScript oder der Anpassung von Moodle-Themes und Plugins.

  • Erfahrungen mit SCORM, xAPI oder der Einbindung externer Lernanwendungen.

  • Kenntnisse in der beruflichen Bildung, Erwachsenenbildung oder Medienpädagogik.

  • Erfahrungen mit KI-gestützten Werkzeugen für die Erstellung von Lernmaterialien, Grafiken und Animationen.

Ein bestimmter Studienabschluss ist für uns nicht entscheidend. Ob du deine Fähigkeiten im Studium, in einer Ausbildung, im Beruf oder autodidaktisch erworben hast: Entscheidend ist, was du praktisch umsetzen kannst.

Du musst nicht alles bereits beherrschen. Wichtig ist uns, dass du mehrere dieser Bereiche miteinander verbinden kannst und dich gerne in neue Themen einarbeitest.

Das erwartet dich bei XRbit

  • Ein abwechslungsreiches Aufgabengebiet an der Schnittstelle von Bildung, Technologie und Mediengestaltung.

  • Die Möglichkeit, eine digitale Lernplattform von Beginn an maßgeblich mitzugestalten und langfristig weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum für eigene Ideen und die Erprobung neuer Lerntechnologien.

  • Die Zusammenarbeit mit einem interdisziplinären Team aus Softwareentwicklung, 3D-Gestaltung, Forschung und Bildung.

  • Spannende Forschungs- und Entwicklungsprojekte, unter anderem in der beruflichen Bildung, im Handwerk und in der Kreislaufwirtschaft.

  • Die Möglichkeit, neue Werkzeuge und KI-Anwendungen in die eigene Arbeit einzubinden.

  • Eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit in einem gemeinnützigen Unternehmen mit dem Ziel, Bildung innovativer und zugänglicher zu gestalten.

Deine Bewerbung

Du findest dich in diesem Profil wieder und möchtest digitale Bildung aktiv mitgestalten?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Schicke uns bitte einen Lebenslauf und, soweit vorhanden, Beispiele deiner bisherigen Arbeiten. Besonders interessant sind für uns selbst entwickelte Moodle-Kurse, H5P-Anwendungen, interaktive Lernmodule, Animationen oder vergleichbare Projekte.

Ein Bewerbungsfoto oder Angaben zu deinem Geburtsdatum benötigen wir nicht.

title: Motion Designer

Motion Designer

London / Edinburgh

Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we are growing fast.

We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents, and disconnected systems.

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with.

More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling, and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe, and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI.

Why this role is different

Motion is one of the fastest ways to show people what Wordsmith actually does.

A strong product animation can communicate more in 30 seconds than a long case study ever will.

This is a founding motion role. You’ll define how Wordsmith moves, feels, and tells product stories through video. You’ll build the systems that let us scale high-quality output and shape how the market experiences our brand.

If you care about craft, speed, and work that directly drives growth, this is a rare opportunity.

The Role

We’re hiring a Motion Designer to own video and motion across Wordsmith.

You’ll create launch videos, feature announcements, social assets, and product storytelling that turns complex workflows into clear, compelling narratives.

You’ll work closely with Design, Growth, Product Marketing, and Founders to bring ideas to life quickly and at a high standard.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership from day one.

What you’ll do

What we’re looking for

How we work

We’re an in-office team. We work together because it helps us move faster, collaborate closely, and produce better work. You should expect to be in the office as your default in your chosen hub.

This is a high trust environment. You’ll have real ownership, clear responsibility, and room to shape how things are done.

We care about pace, but also craft. The standard matters.

This role suits people who want responsibility, autonomy, and visible impact.

What you can expect

Why Wordsmith

We’re growing quickly, shipping fast, and building products customers genuinely need.

There is huge demand, strong momentum, and no shortage of meaningful stories to tell.

If you want your motion work to influence brand, pipeline, and product perception at scale, this is a strong place to do it.

title: Named Core Account Executive - Retail
descriptionHtml:
SLSQ427R383

Databricks operates at the leading edge of the unified data, analytics and AI space. Our customers turn to us to lead the accelerated innovation their businesses need to gain first‑mover advantage in today’s ultra‑competitive landscape.

As we continue our rapid expansion across Central Europe, we are looking for a creative, execution‑oriented Named Core Account Executive to join the team in Germany and maximise the phenomenal market opportunity that exists for Databricks within the Retail vertical. Reporting to our Senior Director of Enterprise Sales, you will focus on building relationships and closing new business opportunities within two of Germany’s largest Retail companies. Leveraging your consultative sales experience in the Retail vertical, you will help shape the data and AI strategy, identify and progress high-value opportunities, and deliver tangible business outcomes.

The impact you will have:

  • You will take ownership of your accounts, define a clear strategy, and relentlessly drive it to exceed revenue and consumption goals.

  • You will turn that strategy into action, executing with urgency and discipline to consistently overachieve your targets.

  • You will build boardroom‑level relationships, becoming the trusted advisor on all things data and AI for senior stakeholders up to and including C‑level.

  • You will uncover and shape new business, expanding use cases and driving deeper platform consumption across your account.

  • You will orchestrate the full Databricks ecosystem, mobilising internal teams to maximise impact and customer value.

  • You will demonstrate compelling value in every engagement, leading confident, insight‑led negotiations that take opportunities all the way to close.

What we look for

  • A proven record of exceeding revenue targets in complex enterprise sales environments.

  • Recognised Retail domain expertise preferred.

  • Proven success selling data, analytics, big data, AI, or other highly technical cloud software solutions through complex, multi-stakeholder, multi-year enterprise sales cycles

  • Strong understanding of consumption-based, land-and-expand models, with the ability to drive sustained growth within a single strategic account.

  • A track record of building executive-level champions and cross-functional account teams to execute against a defined account and territory strategy.

Databricks is the Data and AI company. title: National Key Account Manager DIY (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Rolle bei Tekpoint

Du kennst den deutschen DIY-Handel, verfügst über ein belastbares Netzwerk zu relevanten Entscheidern und weißt, wie man Marken erfolgreich im Baumarktgeschäft positioniert? Du verstehst die Strukturen des Handels, kennst die Abläufe im Zentraleinkauf und weißt, worauf es bei Listungen, Sortimenten, Platzierungen und der Umsetzung am Point of Sale ankommt?

Dann suchen wir dich.

Als National Key Account Manager DIY (m/w/d) übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die strategische und operative Entwicklung unserer bestehenden Handelspartner sowie die Gewinnung neuer Kunden im deutschen DIY-Markt. Du entwickelst Geschäftsbeziehungen auf zentraler Ebene weiter, erschließt neue Umsatzpotenziale und baust die Distribution unserer Marken und Produkte nachhaltig aus.

Dabei arbeitest du mit einem vielseitigen Portfolio namhafter Technologiemarken wie Roborock, Segway Navimow, Xiaomi und Govee sowie weiteren innovativen Marken und Produktkategorien. Von Bodenpflege und Rasenrobotik über Beleuchtung bis hin zu weiteren Consumer-Electronics- und Home-Technologie-Produkten entwickelst du gemeinsam mit unseren Handelspartnern attraktive Sortimente und erfolgreiche Vermarktungskonzepte.

Du verbindest strategisches Key Account Management mit ausgeprägter Neukundenorientierung und einem tiefen Verständnis für die operativen Anforderungen des deutschen DIY-Handels. Du weißt, wie Entscheidungen im Zentraleinkauf getroffen werden, wie regionale Strukturen funktionieren und wie aus einer Listung ein nachhaltig erfolgreiches Geschäft entsteht.

Bei der Umsetzung deiner Kundenstrategien arbeitest du eng mit unserem Area Sales Management sowie den internen Teams aus Marketing, Produktmanagement und Supply Chain zusammen.

Du berichtest direkt an den Director Sales Deutschland und gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung unseres DIY-Geschäfts aktiv mit.

Deine Aufgaben

1. Key Account Management & Geschäftsentwicklung

  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für bestehende Key Accounts und entwickelst diese strategisch und operativ weiter.

  • Du identifizierst und gewinnst neue Handelspartner und erschließt zusätzliche Geschäftspotenziale im deutschen DIY-Markt.

  • Du baust nachhaltige Geschäftsbeziehungen zu relevanten Entscheidern im Zentraleinkauf und Category Management auf und entwickelst dein Netzwerk kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Du erarbeitest kundenindividuelle Geschäfts- und Wachstumspläne und setzt diese konsequent um.

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinen Kunden neue Sortiments-, Listungs- und Vermarktungsmöglichkeiten für unser Markenportfolio.

  • Du verantwortest die Umsatz-, Absatz- und Margenentwicklung deiner Accounts und stellst eine nachhaltige, profitable Geschäftsentwicklung sicher.

2. Kundenbeziehungen, Verhandlungen & Vertragsmanagement

  • Du führst Jahresgespräche, Sortimentsverhandlungen und Vertragsverhandlungen eigenständig und auf Augenhöhe.

  • Du verhandelst Listungen, Konditionen, Rahmenvereinbarungen, Marketingbudgets und Promotions.

  • Du verstehst die Entscheidungswege und Prozesse deiner Handelspartner und nutzt dieses Wissen gezielt zur Weiterentwicklung der Geschäftsbeziehungen.

  • Du identifizierst zusätzliche Potenziale innerhalb bestehender Kundenorganisationen und baust die Zusammenarbeit auf unterschiedlichen Ebenen aus.

  • Du entwickelst langfristige Partnerschaften, erkennst Marktchancen frühzeitig und setzt diese in konkrete Geschäftsergebnisse um.

3. Sortimentsentwicklung, Distribution & Point of Sale

  • Du treibst die Listung und den Ausbau unserer Marken und Produktkategorien bei relevanten DIY-Handelspartnern voran.

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Kunden attraktive Sortimente und überzeugende Produktplatzierungen.

  • Du kennst die Abläufe und Anforderungen im deutschen Baumarkthandel und weißt, wie nationale Vereinbarungen in die regionalen Strukturen und Märkte übertragen werden.

  • Du verhandelst und koordinierst Regalplatzierungen, Zweitplatzierungen, Aktionsflächen und saisonale Verkaufsmaßnahmen.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Area Sales Management zusammen, um vereinbarte Maßnahmen in den Märkten erfolgreich umzusetzen.

  • Du analysierst Sell-in- und Sell-out-Daten und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen zur Steigerung von Distribution, Abverkauf und Markenpräsenz ab.

  • Du begleitest Produkteinführungen und entwickelst neue Vermarktungsansätze für unser vielseitiges Marken- und Produktportfolio.

4. Markt- und Kundenentwicklung

  • Du beobachtest Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Sortimentsentwicklungen und identifizierst neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten.

  • Du analysierst Kundenpotenziale und entwickelst gezielte Strategien für die Gewinnung neuer Handelspartner.

  • Du baust bestehende Geschäftsbeziehungen aus und erschließt zusätzliche Umsatzpotenziale durch neue Produkte, Sortimente und Vertriebskonzepte.

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsame Wachstumsinitiativen mit unseren Handelspartnern und überführst diese in konkrete Maßnahmen.

  • Du bringst deine Marktkenntnis und dein Netzwerk aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Vertriebsstrategie ein.

5. Steuerung & Zusammenarbeit

  • Du verantwortest die Umsatz-, Margen- und Budgetplanung deiner Accounts sowie eine belastbare Forecast-Qualität.

  • Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit mit Area Sales Management, Marketing, Produktmanagement und Supply Chain.

  • Du stellst sicher, dass Warenverfügbarkeit, Lieferperformance und interne Prozesse die vereinbarten Kundenaktivitäten unterstützen.

  • Du überwachst relevante KPIs, erstellst Business Reviews und leitest bei Abweichungen geeignete Maßnahmen ein.

  • Du berichtest regelmäßig an den Director Sales Deutschland und sorgst für Transparenz über Geschäftsentwicklung, Kundenpotenziale und Vertriebsmaßnahmen.

Das bringst du mit

Deine fachliche Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige, erfolgreiche Berufserfahrung im Key Account Management des deutschen DIY-Handels.

  • Ein belastbares Netzwerk zu relevanten Entscheidern im deutschen Baumarkthandel, insbesondere im Zentraleinkauf und Category Management.

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse der Strukturen, Entscheidungswege und Abläufe deutscher Baumarktketten sowie idealerweise regionaler Handelsorganisationen.

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge bei der Gewinnung neuer Kunden, der Umsetzung von Listungen und dem Ausbau bestehender Geschäftsbeziehungen.

  • Erfahrung mit Jahresgesprächen, Konditionsverhandlungen, Sortimentsentscheidungen und der wirtschaftlichen Steuerung von Kundenaccounts.

  • Ein gutes Verständnis für Distribution, Platzierungsmanagement, POS-Aktivierung und Sell-out-Steuerung.

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit regionalen Vertriebsstrukturen und im Zusammenspiel zwischen zentralen Vereinbarungen und deren Umsetzung in den Märkten.

  • Unternehmerisches Denken, ausgeprägte Verhandlungsstärke und ein sicherer Umgang mit Umsatz-, Margen- und Abverkaufsdaten.

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Hohe Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands.

  • Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung bei einem Markenhersteller oder Lieferanten aus dem DIY-, Home-, Garden- oder Consumer-Electronics-Umfeld mit. Entscheidend ist nicht, dass du bereits exakt unsere Produktkategorien betreut hast, sondern dass du den deutschen DIY-Handel verstehst, über die richtigen Kontakte verfügst und nachweislich Geschäft entwickeln kannst.

Deine Persönlichkeit

  • Du bist eine überzeugende Vertriebspersönlichkeit, die auf Augenhöhe mit Einkäufern und Entscheidern kommuniziert.

  • Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Kundenbedürfnisse, Marktchancen und kommerzielle Zusammenhänge.

  • Du kombinierst strategisches Denken mit konsequenter Umsetzungsstärke und einem ausgeprägten Abschlusswillen.

  • Du gehst aktiv auf neue Kunden zu, baust Netzwerke aus und entwickelst bestehende Geschäftsbeziehungen kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Du verhandelst souverän, handelst unternehmerisch und behältst auch bei anspruchsvollen Verhandlungen deine Ziele im Blick.

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, strukturiert und ergebnisorientiert und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Kunden und Ergebnisse.

  • Du schätzt die Zusammenarbeit im Team und weißt, wie du gemeinsam mit dem Area Sales Management und internen Schnittstellen nachhaltiges Wachstum erzielst.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Eine verantwortungsvolle Schlüsselposition mit direktem Einfluss auf die Entwicklung unseres Geschäfts im deutschen DIY-Markt.

  • Die Möglichkeit, bestehende Kundenbeziehungen auszubauen und neue Handelspartner für unser Markenportfolio zu gewinnen.

  • Ein vielseitiges Portfolio mit etablierten und innovativen Marken wie Roborock, Segway Navimow, Xiaomi und Govee sowie weiteren spannenden Produktkategorien.

  • Großen Gestaltungsspielraum und kurze Entscheidungswege mit direkter Anbindung an das Management.

  • Unterstützung durch unser Area Sales Management bei der Umsetzung von Kundenstrategien und Vertriebsmaßnahmen in den Märkten.

  • Einen Firmenwagen, auch zur privaten Nutzung.

  • Flexible Arbeitsmöglichkeiten inklusive Homeoffice.

  • Ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld und die Zusammenarbeit mit engagierten Teams aus Vertrieb, Marketing, Produktmanagement und Supply Chain.

  • Individuelle Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten und attraktive zusätzliche Benefits.

Bereit, den deutschen DIY-Markt mit uns weiterzuentwickeln?

Du verfügst über das richtige Netzwerk, kennst den Handel aus der Praxis und möchtest mit starken Marken neue Geschäftspotenziale erschließen? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

title: Network Architect / Network Specialist (On‑Prem, Global)
descriptionHtml:
Position Overview

Agile Robots SE is seeking a Network Architect / Network Specialist to define and operate our global on‑premise network across multiple geographies and regional offices. You will lead the design and lifecycle of our campus, branch, and data‑center networks—including high‑performance NVIDIA InfiniBand fabrics that power AI/HPC workloads—while ensuring our controls meet TISAX expectations and internal ISMS requirements.

Key Responsibilities

1) Global Architecture & Standards (On‑Prem Only)

  • Design and document end‑to‑end on‑prem architectures (core/distribution/access/WLAN; DC leaf‑spine).
  • Establish and maintain global standards: IP addressing & IPAM (NetBox), routing policy, QoS, naming, security baselines, and change control (HLD/LLD, MOP/SOP, rollback).
  • Define network zoning & segmentation (VLAN/VRF; optional EVPN/VXLAN where justified) across Officeand DMZ networks with clear trust boundaries.

2) Routing, Switching, WLAN & Regional Sites

  • Engineer BGP/OSPF for WAN & DC; deliver redundancy/failover across carriers and sites.
  • Own Aruba campus/branch switching and WLAN (coverage, capacity planning, RF hygiene, roaming, WPA2/3‑Enterprise).
  • Plan and execute site builds/moves/expansions (circuits, last‑mile, demarc, handoffs, cutovers) with measurable downtime windows.

3) Security, Remote Access & Identity

  • Lead FortiGate policy architecture (zones, NAT, segmentation, IDS/IPS) and FortiGate VPN (IPsec/SSL) for site‑to‑site and remote access, including HA and posture checks.
  • Implement 802.1X NAC (e.g., Aruba ClearPass) with RADIUS/Active Directory integration; enforce device posture and guest segmentation.
  • Operate DMZ patterns (reverse proxying, jump hosts, constrained admin planes) and align with TISAX/ISMSrequirements.

4) High‑Performance Networking for AI/HPC

  • Design, deploy, and maintain NVIDIA InfiniBand fabrics (topology, cabling/optics, partitioning), including subnet managers (UFM/opensm), congestion control, and path optimization.
  • Coordinate with compute/storage teams (e.g., DGX/HPC clusters) on throughput, latency, and scale; plan upgrades and fabric expansions.

5) Reliability, Observability & Automation

  • Deliver high availability (fast convergence, dual‑homing, link aggregation/MLAG/VLT) and tested DR/failover.
  • Implement proactive monitoring/alerting (e.g., Zabbix), telemetry/SNMP, and capacity trends; maintain RCAs and SLOs.
  • Centralize logging with rsyslog and FortiAnalyzer; enforce retention and integrity for audits.
  • Use NetBox, Ansible/Python, and Git‑based workflows for configuration management, drift control, and repeatable changes.

6) Compliance, Risk & Vendor Management (TISAX Focus)

  • Map network controls to TISAX expectations (ISMS governance, secure remote access, logging, supplier access, data protection).
  • Partner with ISMS owner/CISO on risk assessments, controls testing, and evidence preparation for audits (policies, diagrams, logs, change records).
  • Manage carriers and vendors (Fortinet, Aruba, Dell; integrators); lead RFPs, SLAs, and lifecycle planning.
  • Mentor regional IT; act as L3 escalation for incidents and major changes.

Core Technologies @ Agile Robots SE

  • Security & Remote Access: FortiGate NGFW, FortiGate VPN (IPsec/SSL), FortiManager/FortiAnalyzer.
  • Campus/Branch & WLAN: Aruba CX/AOS switching, controllers/APs, ClearPass (802.1X), AirWave (on‑prem mgmt).
  • Data Center & Fabric: Dell PowerSwitch (OS10), VLT/MLAG; NVIDIA InfiniBand (UFM/opensm).
  • Foundational Services: VLAN/VRF, BGP/OSPF, QoS; DHCP/DNS, Active Directory, RADIUS; NetBox(IPAM/DCIM).
  • Observability & Automation: Zabbix, rsyslog (retention policy), NetFlow/sFlow; Ansible/Python, Git.

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years in enterprise on‑prem networking across multi‑site/multi‑region environments.
  • Deep hands‑on with FortiGate, Aruba (switching/WLAN), Dell data‑center switching, and NVIDIA InfiniBand basics.
  • Strong routing/switching (BGP, OSPF, VLAN, VRF), segmentation, and DMZ design; HA and fast convergence patterns.
  • Proven delivery of secure remote access, 802.1X NAC, and logging/monitoring at scale (rsyslog, analyzers, NMS).
  • Experience aligning network controls to ISMS/TISAX (policy ↔ design ↔ evidence).
  • Excellent documentation (HLD/LLD, diagrams) and stakeholder communication.

Preferred

  • Certifications: Fortinet NSE (4/5/7+), Aruba (ACMA/ACMP/ACSP/ACDX), CCNP/CCIE, Dell networking, and/or NVIDIA networking.
  • ClearPass NAC depth, FortiManager/FortiAnalyzer, Aruba AirWave; EVPN/VXLAN familiarity.
  • Exposure to RADIUS/AD integration and FreeRADIUS stack.
  • Familiarity with Zabbix tuning, syslog retention strategies, and ITSM/change tooling.
  • Experience segmenting AI/HPC clusters and integrating with storage/compute pipelines.

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots is a leading provider of AI-powered robotics solutions. By combining artificial intelligence and robotics, the company makes industries smarter, more flexible, and more efficient. 

Founded in Munich in 2018 by renowned robotics researchers from the German Aerospace Center (DLR), Agile Robots has experienced rapid global growth. Today, more than 3,500 highly skilled robotics and AI enthusiasts are employed worldwide. The company has one of the largest research and development teams in the AI and robotics industry. 

Agile Robots has built a unique portfolio, together with the subsidiaries BÄR Automation, Franka Robotics, idealworks, and Krause Automation, the company covers all areas of AI-driven robotics.

Find out more at: https://www.agile-robots.com/en/

title: Network Engineer
descriptionHtml:

We are at the forefront of banking and trading infrastructure, serving clients globally with offices in New York, Chicago, Toronto, London, Cambridge, Paris, Hong Kong, Tokyo, Singapore, and Auckland.   • Desire to travel and see the world.

Family Support: Enhanced family leave benefits.

Professional Growth: Access to professional learning platforms and internal development programs.

Retirement: Pension/retirement schemes to support your long-term financial planning.

 

How to apply

 

Please submit a CV and cover letter to the Network Engineer position. On your CV, please include a section on your Hobbies and Interests. On the covering letter please detail the role you are applying to, along with your availability.

 

We look forward to discussing how you can make an impact at Options Technology!

title: Non-Destructive Testing Technician – Level 2
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


We are developing, producing and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable orbital vehicle designed to carry cargo and, in the longer term, potentially crew.

To support the ramp-up of our production activities in Munich, we are looking for a Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) Technician - Level 2 with strong practical experience in radiographic testing (RT/X-ray) and penetrant testing (PT). Ultrasonic testing (UT) experience is an advantage.

You will perform and document inspections on critical space components and assemblies. In your day-to-day work, you will collaborate with Production, Quality and Engineering teams, as well as external providers and the appointed Responsible Level 3. Your rigor will directly contribute to the conformity, traceability and reliability of flight hardware.

Your mission

You will prepare and perform NDT inspections in accordance with approved procedures and acceptance criteria, assess results within the scope of your qualification, and alert the relevant stakeholders when you identify a discrepancy or technical concern.


What you will do

  • Perform radiographic testing (RT/X-ray) and penetrant testing (PT) on production parts, welds, structures and other hardware in accordance with applicable procedures.

  • Prepare parts, verify inspection conditions, and use the required equipment and consumables.

  • Interpret and evaluate indications within the scope of your qualification and against approved acceptance criteria; seek guidance or escalate complex or ambiguous cases.

  • Produce complete inspection reports and maintain traceability of results, equipment, parameters and applicable documents.

  • Check the condition and validity of inspection equipment, and report any need for maintenance, verification or replacement.

  • Coordinate with Production to schedule inspections at the right stage and help resolve inspection-related production blockers.

  • Raise non-conformities and contribute to root-cause investigations, corrective actions and their follow-up.

  • Contribute to updating work instructions, procedures, inspection plans and report templates, under the coordination of authorized personnel.

  • When needed, coordinate inspections performed by external providers and check that their deliverables and supporting documentation are complete.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of NDT practices and the development of internal capabilities, including UT where your experience allows.

  • Follow the site’s safety, quality and document-control requirements.


What you bring

  • Level 2 qualification in radiographic testing (RT/X-ray) and penetrant testing (PT) under EN 4179, NAS 410, ISO 9712; current qualifications are strongly preferred.

  • Professional experience in the space industry is required, ideally involving flight hardware or critical equipment.

  • Practical experience inspecting welds, metallic structures, pressure vessels, propulsion systems, machined parts or composite components.

  • Ability to read drawings, specifications, procedures and acceptance criteria, and produce accurate, clear inspection reports.

  • Good understanding of inspection traceability, equipment control and the handling of non-conforming results.

  • Ability to work within the scope of your qualification and consult the Level 3 or technical focal points whenever a decision falls outside that scope.

  • Professional working proficiency in English, both spoken and written, to operate in an international environment.


Especially valuable

  • UT qualification or practical experience, particularly inspecting critical parts or structures.

  • Experience with digital radiography, phased-array UT, automated inspection or composite inspection.

  • Experience working with a Responsible Level 3, external NDT providers or certification bodies.

  • Experience preparing or reviewing procedures, technical instructions or inspection plans.


How you work

  • Rigorous and detail-oriented, with a consistent focus on conformity and traceability.

  • Sound technical judgment and a pragmatic, production-focused mindset.

  • Autonomous and organized, with clear communication whenever a discrepancy or concern arises.

  • Comfortable collaborating with Production, Quality, Engineering and external providers.

  • Motivated to help build robust NDT capabilities for demanding space hardware.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

title: Nordics Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
Nordics Marketing Manager

Retire the ERP

Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our Smart Financial Platform gives modern, global companies superpowers - automated accounting, real-time reporting, and financial flows that move at the speed of the business.

We build with our customers, ship fast, and obsess over craft. In a short time, Light has gone from idea to the operating core for leading companies like Lovable, Legora, and Fuse Energy.

We're an early team defining a new software category. Think engineers who love debits and credits, designers who care about reconciliation states, and operators who treat finance as a product. If you're excited to modernise how companies run money, you're in the right place.

Backed by world-class investors including Balderton and Atomico and advised by industry titans, we're building category-defining products with the freedom to ship ambitiously and own outcomes. Come help us make Light the global default for next-gen finance.

Finance deserves better

Finance teams at fast-growing companies run global, real-time businesses on a patchwork of legacy ERPs and point solutions. Every new entity, market or tool adds another system to stitch together and another hire to keep the numbers reconciled.

Light gives them a way out. We build the finance solution that lets finance teams have it all, through three parts that work as one:

  • Our ledger records every transaction across every entity in real time, so the numbers hold up from day one.

  • Our apps adapt Light to how each business runs, from procurement to billing to reporting.

  • Our agents operate the repetitive work that used to need another hire, so finance teams spend their time on the decisions that matter.

We take on the ERP and the legacy point solution world with something fast to implement, AI-native from the ground up, and better the more you use it.

Today we run the finance function for companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot, with backing from Atomico, Balderton, Seedcamp, Cherry and Entrée, and teams across Copenhagen, London and Stockholm, with remotes world over.

The Role

We're looking for a Nordics Marketing Manager to make Light the default finance platform for scaling companies across Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland. You can base yourself in Copenhagen or London.

Light started life in Copenhagen, and the Nordics already know us. Founders, CFOs and finance leaders in the region backed us from the start, and our local community gives us a head start most challengers would envy. Your job is to take that energy to new heights, so that when a Nordic finance team outgrows its current setup, Light is the obvious next move.

You'll own the Nordics marketing plan end to end. You'll have a B-line into our Nordics GTM pod, which spans sales, implementation and customer success, and you'll work closely with our central growth team to find new ways to drive demand through digital channels.

What you'll be doing

  • Building and running the Nordics marketing plan, with pipeline targets you share with the GTM pod.

  • Running a field and events programme across Copenhagen, Stockholm, Oslo and Helsinki and… any other city you think makes sense. From intimate CFO dinners to flagship moments people talk about for months.

  • Growing partnerships with the accounting firms, advisors, investors and communities that Nordic finance leaders trust and extends our voice across the region.

  • Localising our story, content and campaigns so they land with Nordic finance teams in their own language and context.

  • Creating content with our customers, product and design teams that turns what Light does into stories people want to share.

  • Working with our central growth team to test and scale digital demand generation in the region.

  • Building relationships with local press and the people who shape the Nordic tech and finance conversation.

What we think* you'll need

  • Enough years in the seat to know what works at a fast-growing company, ideally because you've built the ground game for a scaling B2B SaaS business before.

  • A track record across field, events, partnerships and content, and the judgment to know which lever to pull and when.

  • Experience localising a brand and its message for a region, with a feel for what lands with Nordic audiences.

  • Comfort working with sales, implementation and customer success as one team, with pipeline as the shared goal.

  • Deep curiosity about how AI is reshaping finance teams and the companies they serve.

  • A great storyteller across video, text and meme.

  • A can-do, empathetic and collaborative spirit. No brilliant assholes here, please.

  • Fluency in English and at least one other Nordic language.

  • A passport. Expect regular trips across the Nordics and to our teams in London, Munich, New York and elsewhere.

*If the core of the role sounds compelling but you don't tick every box, we'd still love for you to reach out and convince us you're the right person.

The Good Stuff

  • A five-day, in-office culture with a high-density team in Copenhagen or London.

  • A competitive salary and potential stock options.

  • 25 days of annual leave plus public holidays in the country where you're based.

  • Regular socials and two company off-sites a year.

  • The chance to shape a category from the inside, in the region where Light began.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

The Famous Last Words

The Nordics gave Light its first customers, its first champions and its first team. We want to repay that by becoming the finance platform every scaling Nordic company runs on, and we want you to lead the charge. If you know the region, love building from the ground up and want to help retire the ERP for good, let's talk.

title: Nyx PMO
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

As we continue to develop the Nyx vehicle and prepare its future missions, strong program coordination is essential. We are looking for a motivated and structured Nyx PMO to support the Chief Program Manager and the Project Management teams in preparing, integrating and tracking schedules across our international organisation.

Your Mission

As a member of the Nyx Program Management Office, you will support the preparation and integration of project schedules and help maintain reliable, up-to-date program data. You will work closely with Project Managers and teams across Munich, Bordeaux and Turin to ensure that planning information is collected, structured and available for effective programme decision-making.

This is a junior position offering broad exposure to program management, project planning and the development of a complex space vehicle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the preparation and integration of Nyx project and program schedules.

  • Collect schedule inputs from project managers and consolidate them into coherent planning views.

  • Maintain schedule data, activity progress, milestones, dependencies and tracking information up to date.

  • Follow up with stakeholders to obtain status updates and clarify missing or inconsistent information.

  • Support Project Managers in the preparation, review and maintenance of their schedules.

  • Support the use of scheduling and project-management tools across the Nyx program.

  • Prepare schedule updates, progress overviews and inputs for program reviews.

  • Help identify schedule risks, delays, dependencies and conflicts, and raise them to the relevant stakeholders.

  • Contribute to the development and improvement of PMO processes, templates and reporting routines.

  • Support the consistent application of planning practices across the different Nyx locations.

What You Bring

  • First experience in project management, program management, PMO, planning, engineering coordination or a similar environment.

  • A degree or equivalent experience in engineering, business, project management or a related field.

  • A structured and detail-oriented approach to work.

  • Good working knowledge of spreadsheets and a willingness to learn scheduling and project-management tools.

  • The ability to collect, organise and communicate information clearly.

  • A proactive mindset and the confidence to follow up with stakeholders across different teams.

  • The ability to identify inconsistencies, raise risks early and support the resolution of planning issues.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in an international and cross-functional environment.

  • A genuine interest in space exploration and complex technical programmes.

  • Professional fluency in English. Additional languages are a plus.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.
