title: Outcome Testing and Controls Assurance Officer
descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Role Description

This role is responsible for delivering Outcomes Based Testing (OBT), providing independent, evidence-based assurance that Allica is consistently delivering good customer outcomes in line with the FCA's Consumer Duty. The role also undertakes Secondary Controls Testing in accordance with Allica's Risk Management Framework.

The successful candidate will plan and execute a portfolio of testing activities, communicate findings clearly to stakeholders, and agree, monitor, and support action plans through to resolution. They will work collaboratively with Risk Business Partners and the wider First Line of Defence (1LoD) Controls team.

Beyond completing testing against a defined framework, the role requires a proactive and analytical approach. The role holder will identify root causes, drive meaningful remediation, and provide constructive challenge to stakeholders, helping to improve customer outcomes and strengthen Allica's control environment.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Conduct outcome-based testing across Allica’s customer facing journeys to assess whether customer outcomes are consistent with Consumer Duty obligations. 

  • Review customer cases, communications and operational activity to identify potential customer harm, process weaknesses or customer experience issues, including the treatment of vulnerable customers. 

  • Assess both process execution and customer experience, ensuring documentation is complete, communications are clear and customers do not face unnecessary barriers or delays. 

  • Communicate Outcomes Based Testing results clearly to relevant stakeholders, ensuring findings are understood and owned. 

  • Agree appropriate action plans with stakeholders to remediate instances of poor outcomes and track these through to closure. 

  • Deliver Secondary Controls Testing, assessing the design and operating effectiveness to obtain an overall rating for each control, in line with Allica’s Control Testing Standards. 

  • Communicate control testing output to stakeholders and agree action plans where control weaknesses or failures are identified. 

  • Accurately update RiskSmart with control test results, ratings, findings and associated action plans. 

  • Maintain regular engagement with Risk Business Partners across the wider 1LoD Controls team on control testing outputs, sharing themes and supporting a consistent testing approach. 

  • Escalate significant issues, risks or thematic concerns in a timely manner. 

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of Outcomes Based Testing and controls testing methodology, templates and reporting. 

  • Ensure all testing is conducted objectively and independently, in line with Allica's Risk Management Framework and relevant regulatory requirements, including the FCA Consumer Duty and Conduct Rules. 

  • Support reporting and insight through dashboards and analysis, contributing to root cause identification and continuous improvement initiatives.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Capable of working in a fast-paced environment, managing complex, competing and alternating priorities across control testing and outcomes based testing with a constant focus on delivery. 

  • Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify root causes behind poor customer outcomes or control failures, not just symptoms. 

  • A confident, clear communicator, able to present findings and constructively challenge stakeholders at varying levels of seniority. 

  • Show curiosity and sound judgement when assessing customer journeys and identifying potential customer harm or process weaknesses. 

  • Demonstrate a proactive and solution-focused mindset, with a desire to improve processes and customer experience. 

  • Be able to work independently with minimal supervision, while remaining a collaborative and engaged member of the wider team. 

  • Have experience of controls testing, quality assurance, outcomes-based testing, or 1st/2nd line risk and assurance work, ideally within Financial Services. 

  • Have a working knowledge of the FCA Consumer Duty and Conduct Rules, and how these apply in practice to Allica’s products and supporting customer journeys. 

  • Be explicit in demonstrating where they've gone the extra mile, embraced new challenges, or stood out from their peers in a previous testing, assurance or risk role.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

title: Paid Marketing Manager (m/w/d) - Germany
descriptionHtml:
Pennylane ist ein französisches Fintech, das 2020 gegründet wurde und seinen Hauptsitz in Paris hat. Wir entwickeln ein Finanzbetriebssystem für europäische KMU und ihre Steuerkanzleien, bei dem KI von Anfang an mitgedacht ist. Unsere Plattform vereint Buchhaltung, Rechnungsstellung, Ausgabenmanagement und Business Banking. Unternehmen und Steuerkanzleien arbeiten damit auf einer gemeinsamen Datenbasis – in Echtzeit.

  • 1.200 Mitarbeiter und ein Team, das schnell wächst.

  • Über 1,5 Millionen Unternehmen und 6.000 Steuerkanzleien auf der Plattform.

  • 200 Mio. Euro jährlich wiederkehrender Umsatz (ARR) im Jahr 2025 – rund doppelt so viel wie im Vorjahr.

  • 175 Mio. Euro Finanzierung im Januar 2026 bei einer Bewertung von 3,5 Mrd. Euro. Zu unseren Investoren zählen TCV, Blackstone, Sequoia, DST Global, CapitalG und Meritech.

  • Expansion in Europa: Seit Ende 2025 sind wir in Deutschland aktiv. Die Einführung der E-Rechnung gibt der Digitalisierung des Finanzwesens zusätzlichen Rückenwind.

Deutschland ist ein zentraler Baustein unserer europäischen Expansion. Mit dieser Rolle gestaltest du den Erfolg direkt mit.

Warum wir dich suchen

Paid Marketing ist einer unserer schnellsten Hebel, um in Deutschland qualifizierte Nachfrage aufzubauen. Bisher fehlt uns dafür eine Person, die den deutschen Markt eigenständig verantwortet und unser Wachstum bei Vertriebspipeline und monatlich wiederkehrendem Umsatz (MRR) gezielt vorantreibt.

Als Paid Marketing Manager Germany übernimmst du unsere bezahlte Kundenakquise von der Strategie bis zur Optimierung. Du machst aus Werbebudget qualifizierte Leads und behältst dabei die Kundenakquisekosten im Blick.

Deine Mission

Du baust unsere bezahlte Kundenakquise für Deutschland aus und skalierst sie über SEA, Paid Social, Display und – wo sinnvoll – Affiliate-Marketing. Dein Ziel: qualifizierte Leads zu unseren angestrebten CAC- und CPA-Werten sowie ein starker Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).

Dafür entwickelst du Kampagnen und Landingpages, die deutsche KMU und Steuerkanzleien gezielt ansprechen.

Dein Team und Umfeld

Du wirst Teil unseres Growth-Teams und arbeitest in der Demand-Generation-Squad. Du berichtest direkt an Hervé Gaborieau, Demand Generation Manager.

Für den deutschen Markt liegt Paid Acquisition vollständig in deiner Hand: Strategie, Budget, Umsetzung und Performance. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren internationalen und lokalen Teams zusammen:

  • Paid-Team in Frankreich: Du nutzt bestehende Playbooks, Kampagnenstrukturen und Erkenntnisse aus SEA und Affiliate-Marketing als Grundlage für den deutschen Markt.

  • Growth Engineering und Data: Gemeinsam sorgt ihr für zuverlässiges Tracking, aussagekräftige Attribution, Dashboards und fundierte Performance-Analysen.

  • Website-Team: Ihr stimmt Paid-Landingpages auf die Kampagnen ab und verbessert gemeinsam die Conversion.

  • Brand & Design, Content und Product Marketing: Zusammen entwickelt ihr Creatives und Botschaften, die im deutschen Markt überzeugen.

  • GTM- und Sales-Team Deutschland: Ihr stimmt Lead-Volumen und Lead-Qualität aufeinander ab und nutzt das Feedback aus dem Vertrieb zur laufenden Optimierung.

Deine Aufgaben

1. Paid-Strategie entwickeln und Kampagnen umsetzen

  • Du verantwortest den deutschen Kanal-Mix: Google Ads mit Search, Display und Performance Max, Paid Social auf LinkedIn und Meta sowie bei Bedarf Affiliate-Marketing.

  • Du entwickelst, startest und optimierst Kampagnen – von Targeting, Gebotsstrategien und Zielgruppen über Keywords bis zu Creatives.

  • Du passt Kampagnen und Botschaften an den deutschen Markt und die Bedürfnisse unserer Zielgruppen an.

2. Budget und Performance steuern

  • Du verantwortest das deutsche Paid-Budget, verteilst es auf die passenden Kanäle und optimierst die Effizienz anhand unserer CAC-, CPA- und ROAS-Ziele.

  • Du steigerst das Volumen qualifizierter Leads und stellst gemeinsam mit dem deutschen Sales-Team sicher, dass die Qualität stimmt.

  • Du berichtest Ergebnisse und Erkenntnisse an das Growth-Leadership-Team und leitest konkrete nächste Schritte ab.

3. Wirkung messen und kontinuierlich optimieren

  • Gemeinsam mit Growth Engineering und Data entwickelst du Tracking, Attribution und Dashboards weiter.

  • Du testest laufend neue Creatives, Zielgruppen, Landingpages und Gebotsstrategien und überführst erfolgreiche Ansätze in die Skalierung.

  • Mit dem Website-Team optimierst du die Landingpages und verbesserst die Conversion entlang des gesamten Funnels.

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung im Performance Marketing: Du hast 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Paid- oder Performance-Marketing, idealerweise im B2B- oder SaaS-Umfeld.

  • Offenheit für KI: Du setzt KI selbstverständlich als Unterstützung in deiner Arbeit ein – idealerweise bereits im Paid Marketing.

  • Operative Kanalexpertise: Du arbeitest sicher mit Google Ads und mindestens einer Paid-Social-Plattform wie LinkedIn oder Meta.

  • Sicherheit bei Budget und Kennzahlen: Du kennst dich mit CAC, CPA, ROAS und CPL aus und weißt, wie du Budgets wirkungsvoll steuerst.

  • Analytische Stärke: Attribution, Funnel-Analysen und Reporting-Tools gehören zu deinem Handwerkszeug. Du leitest aus Daten klare Entscheidungen ab.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder zweisprachigem Niveau sowie fließend Englisch.

  • Eigeninitiative und Verantwortung: Du kannst den deutschen Markt eigenständig steuern und arbeitest erfolgreich mit einem verteilten, überwiegend in Frankreich ansässigen Team zusammen.


Nice to have

  • Erfahrung in einem Scale-up oder einem anderen stark wachsenden Unternehmen.

  • Kenntnisse des deutschen B2B-, Fintech- oder Buchhaltungsmarkts.

  • Technisches Verständnis für Tracking, etwa Tags, Data Layer und Conversions API, um dich mit Growth Engineering auf Augenhöhe auszutauschen.

  • Französischkenntnisse.

You will own a portfolio of strategic clients, shape how we grow our MMM and marketing effectiveness business in the UK and build the next generation of Ekimetrics talent. You will work alongside the London General Manager and be trusted with increasing autonomy and strategic ownership.

What you will do

Lead strategic clients and world-class MMM delivery
  • Lead a portfolio of strategic, multi-account clients, or a major programme for a Tier 1 client, as Key Account Manager.
  • Define and drive the road map for each programme, from MMM and marketing effectiveness through to commercial and business-wide effectiveness, using our solutions model and the Eki.Decisions platform.
  • Safeguard scientific quality: robust MMM and econometrics, causal inference, incrementality and experimentation, and models clients can understand and trust.
  • Turn model outputs into decisions: budget optimisation, scenario planning and forecasting that change how clients allocate their investment.
  • Steer the delivery excellence, impact and profitability of your portfolio, securing the right teams for every programme.
  • Build and manage relationships with key media, platform and technology partners to drive innovation and growth across our accounts.
  • Share best practice and reusable assets across the Ekimetrics community.

Grow the business

  • Build long-term, trusted relationships with CMOs, CFOs and commercial leaders, securing renewals and positioning Ekimetrics as their strategic partner.
  • Identify and convert growth opportunities across your accounts, extending the value we deliver as client needs evolve.
  • Lead pitches and RFPs to win new logos and keep a strong pipeline.
  • Be the face of Ekimetrics in the market: speak at conferences and client forums, and lead thought leadership on the future of measurement, including AI and GenAI.
Build the team and the UK office
  • Lead by example, managing and coaching a team through regular 1:1s, performance reviews and talent assessments.
  • Play a key role in recruiting, developing and retaining top talent in London, and in succession planning for the office.
  • Contribute to our upskilling strategy with the Eki Academy team, and help shape the strategy of Ekimetrics globally and in the UK.
  • Champion our culture and values: Curiosity, Creativity, Excellence, Generosity and Enjoyment.

What success looks like

Given the strategic nature of this role, this advert provides an overview of its scope and expectations. Detailed objectives, KPIs, commercial targets and strategic priorities are confidential and will be discussed with shortlisted candidates at the appropriate stage.

  • A portfolio of strategic accounts that delivers measurable client impact, strong delivery standards and sustainable commercial growth.
  • Trusted senior client relationships that lead to renewals, broader partnerships and long-term value.
  • Healthy profitability, supported by disciplined management of scope, resources and delivery.
  • A strong contribution to new business, through the origination and conversion of opportunities.
  • A visible market presence that strengthens Ekimetrics’ reputation and opens doors.
  • An engaged, high-performing team, with developing leaders and clear succession opportunities.
  • A meaningful contribution to the direction and performance of the UK business.

About You

Ideally, you have:

  • Extensive experience leading strategic client relationships and complex programmes in consulting or a comparable professional services environment, typically gained over 15 or more years.
  • Accountability for the commercial performance of a portfolio, including revenue growth, profitability and resource decisions.
  • Deep expertise in marketing effectiveness and MMM, with a track record of turning analytical work into decisions at senior client level.
  • Strong grounding in econometrics and statistical modelling, with the technical judgement to challenge assumptions, guide specialists and safeguard scientific quality.
  • A clear understanding of how complementary approaches—including incrementality testing, experimentation and attribution—support a coherent measurement strategy.
  • An informed perspective on the role of AI and data science in marketing effectiveness and business decision-making.
  • Strong knowledge of the UK market and an established network, with the credibility to build senior relationships and create commercial opportunities.
  • A track record of advising CMOs, CFOs, Chief Commercial Officers or Chief Data Officers, securing renewals and expanding strategic partnerships.
  • Experience originating and winning new business, including leading pitches, RFPs and commercial negotiations.
  • Strategic judgement and the ability to translate ambition into priorities, align resources and manage commercial trade-offs.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn complex evidence into a clear recommendation and influence executive decisions.
  • A track record of developing high-performing teams and future leaders, alongside contributions to recruitment and succession planning.
  • The confidence to take ownership and make decisions autonomously, combined with a collaborative approach across clients, teams and geographies.
  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Data Science, Economics, Applied Mathematics, Marketing Analytics or a related field, and fluent English.
  • An entrepreneurial outlook and the motivation to help shape a growing UK business within an international organisation.

Why join us?

At Ekimetrics, your ideas truly matter. We embrace an entrepreneurial spirit and encourage you to push boundaries to achieve meaningful impact. We thrive on collaboration, learning and growing together, through personalised career paths, challenging projects and mentorship and we believe in enjoying what we do.

In 2023, Ekimetrics obtained the “mission-driven company” status, reflecting our commitment to CSR, and we are part of the French Tech 120, the group of top French scale-ups recognised for their potential to become international leaders.

What we offer

  • A highly competitive package comprising base salary, sales and individual performance bonuses, a £5,000 corporate bonus and equity, so you share in the success you help build. Detailed bonus arrangements will be discussed during the recruitment process.
  • A seat at the table: direct influence over the future of Ekimetrics in the UK, with the autonomy and backing to grow our MMM and marketing effectiveness business.
  • The opportunity to advise leading brands on consequential investment decisions and work at the forefront of AI-powered decision-making.
  • An international community of in-house experts in marketing, commercial effectiveness and data science.
  • Private medical cover with Vitality, alongside benefits including GP access, physiotherapy, mental health support, consultant care, optical and dental cover, and worldwide travel insurance.
  • Life assurance at four times salary, critical illness cover at twice salary, and a 4% matched pension contribution.
  • 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, rising with tenure to up to 30 days.
  • Wellbeing support through our employee assistance programme, including counselling, physiotherapy and unlimited GP access.
  • Continuous development through certifications, online learning, training and knowledge-sharing sessions, including the Eki.Academy catalogue and the Climate School.
  • A vibrant community, with team socials, offsite seminars, hackathons, recognition schemes and perks including discounted gym memberships and retail discounts.
  • Modern premises in the heart of London and flexible hybrid working.

As an employer, Ekimetrics offers equal employment opportunities to all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, social status, disability, or age. Ekimetrics strives to develop an inclusive work environment that reflects diversity within its teams.

title: Partner Development Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

This Role

The Solution Partner Ecosystem is the second biggest growth lever at Dust, yet Europe's agency and consultant market is still almost entirely untapped.

As Partner Development Manager (EU) at Dust, you will build a volume engine to boost partner-led revenue. Your job is to find the right partners across Europe, recruit them, and get them to their first win fast, and then transform into a repeatable motion. Working directly with our global partnerships team, you'll own the outreach motion, the onboarding, and the early relationship with every new partner you bring in, primarily digital transformation agencies and AI consultants.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can build a relationship from a cold message, run a disciplined process, and never lose the human touch that makes partners want to show up. You will be part of a growing partnerships team of 6 people, with partner managers distributed by location and a global partner operations and a solutions engineer.

Key Responsibilities

Hunt and recruit partners across Europe

  • Map the agency and consultant landscape across key European markets and identify highest-leverage entry points

  • Build and run an outbound motion to engage high-potential agencies and AI consultants: cold outreach, events, referrals, and everything in between

  • Develop targeted messaging tailored to different partner profiles, geographies, and languages

  • Qualify and prioritise your pipeline based on partner fit, client base relevance, and activation potential

Qualify partners and shape their Dust proposition

  • Run discovery conversations with prospective partners to assess their client base, AI readiness, and commercial fit before investing further

  • Help partners articulate how Dust fits into their service offering, whether that's a new AI practice, an add-on to existing engagements, or a standalone product recommendation

  • Make the call on which partners are worth advancing and move quickly on the ones that aren't

Onboard and enable new partners to go to market

  • Run structured onboarding for every new partner: product training, sales methodology, and deployment fundamentals

  • Own product training sessions with new partners and make sure they can demo, pitch and deploy Dust independently before going live

  • Get partners to first deal fast and track time-to-activation as a core success metric

Manage your partner portfolio and drive performance

  • Own quarterly business reviews with active partners: pipeline, escalations, and partnership trajectory

  • Keep the account management layer efficient and systematic to handle a high volume of partners

Support partners through live deals

  • Coach partners through sales cycles where Dust expertise is needed on the call

  • Build shared accountability for revenue outcomes between Dust and the partner network

Requirements

  • 5+ years of partnership management or business development experience in B2B SaaS, with proven track record of driving revenue through partner channels

  • Outbound-first mindset with a proven ability to recruit cold partners into active pipeline contributors, without relying on warm intros or an established brand to open doors

  • Relationship building expertise with ability to establish trust and drive action with consulting firms and system integrators

  • Strong enablement instincts — you can translate a technically complex product into a partner-ready sales motion and get partners to first deal without hand-holding

  • Excellent communication skills in English and French, nice to have a third European language

  • Entrepreneurial background or mindset: you've built something from scratch before, whether a territory, a partner channel, or a program, and you can show the impact

  • Self-starter mentality comfortable with ambiguity and can easily iterate on a built playbook

  • Nice to have: Existing network of agencies or consultants across Europe is a strong plus; we're looking for someone who brings complementary reach, not just experience in the category

What Makes This Role Unique

  • Direct revenue impact: You'll be directly involved in signing partners, closing deals and driving measurable business results

  • AI-native partner operations: Build and shape the partner operations in a AI-native team

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with sales, partnerships, and product teams

  • High-growth environment: Join at a pivotal moment as we scale from €1M to €40+M ARR

  • Innovation opportunity: Help define how AI companies should approach partnership development

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

title: Partner (m/w/d) einer etablierten Unternehmensberatung
descriptionHtml:
Argon & Co ist eine weltweit tätige Strategieberatung mit Fokus auf Operationsstrategie und Transformation. Die Argon & Co Deutschland GmbH unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, ihre Leistungsfähigkeit nachhaltig zu steigern und Veränderungen erfolgreich umzusetzen. Unsere Expertise umfasst Supply Chain & Operations, Procurement, Performance Improvement, Restructuring, Digital Transformation sowie Solutions & Analytics.

Gemeinsam mit unseren Kund:innen verbinden wir tiefes Branchenverständnis, methodische Expertise und Umsetzungserfahrung, um strategische und operative Herausforderungen in nachhaltige Ergebnisse zu übersetzen. Als Teil unseres internationalen Netzwerks mit mehr als 17 Standorten arbeitest du an anspruchsvollen Projekten, übernimmst früh Verantwortung und entwickelst dich in einem leistungsorientierten Umfeld mit klaren Karriereperspektiven weiter. See real change bedeutet für uns, Veränderungen nicht nur zu planen, sondern sie gemeinsam mit unseren Kund:innen sichtbar und dauerhaft zu bewirken.

Um unser Führungsteam zu verstärken, suchen wir einen engagierten und erfahrenen Partner (m/w/d), der mit uns gemeinsam den nächsten Schritt auf unserem Wachstumspfad geht.

Aufgaben

Deine Tätigkeitsbereiche:

  • Verantwortung für den Geschäftserfolg: Du übernimmst die Leitung und strategische Weiterentwicklung von Projekten und Kundenbeziehungen in der Beratung und trägst maßgeblich zum Wachstum und Erfolg unserer Firma bei.

  • Entwicklung des Inneren: Du hast ein sehr gutes Verständnis von unternehmerischem Handeln und entwickelst als Teil des Führungsteams das Unternehmen im Wachstum weiter.

  • Kundenneugewinnung und -bindung: Du bist für den Ausbau und die Pflege eines starken Netzwerks sowie die Akquise neuer Kunden verantwortlich und sorgst zugleich für eine langfristige Partnerschaft mit unseren Bestandskunden.

  • Führung und Entwicklung des Teams: Du bist ein:e Mentor:in für unsere Beratenden, übernimmst die Führung in strategischen Projekten und förderst die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung und das Wachstum unseres Teams.

  • Strategische Gesprächspartner:in auf C-Level: Du berätst unsere Kunden auf höchster Ebene und hilfst, komplexe, unternehmensweite Strategien und digitale Transformationsprozesse erfolgreich zu gestalten.

  • Innovationsmanagement: Du erkennst Trends und neue Technologien, die für unsere Kunden von strategischem Wert sein können, und integrierst diese in unsere Beratungslösungen.

  • Repräsentation des Unternehmens: Du vertrittst unser Unternehmen auf Branchenevents und auf der Unternehmensführungsebene der Kunden. Du stärkst unsere Marke und unseren Ruf als etablierter Anbieter in der Beratungswelt.

Qualifikation

Wen suchen wir?

  • Langjährige Berufserfahrung (mind. 15 Jahren) in der Unternehmensberatung, idealerweise im Bereich der digitalen Business Transformation, mit nachweisbaren Erfolgen in der Beratung von Unternehmen auf C-Level.

  • Umfassende Expertise in der Leitung von Transformationsprojekten, von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung.

  • Starke Führungskompetenzen: Du hast Erfahrung in der Leitung von Teams, Freude an der Entwicklung von Talenten und im Coaching von Beratenden.

  • Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung: Du bist in der Lage, neue Kunden für uns zu gewinnen, langfristige Kundenbeziehungen zu etablieren und deren Bedürfnisse auf höchster Ebene zu verstehen und zu adressieren.

  • Exzellente Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten: Du verstehst es, komplexe Themen verständlich zu kommunizieren und Kunden zu überzeugen.

  • Unternehmerisches Denken und Handeln: Du bringst ein hohes Maß an Selbstmotivation, Innovationsgeist und die Fähigkeit zur Weiterentwicklung des Unternehmens mit.

  • Akademischer Hintergrund: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium (z. B. Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder vergleichbare Qualifikationen) gerne mit Zusatzqualifikation MBA oder Dissertation wird vorausgesetzt.

Benefits

Was bieten wir?

  • Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum: Als Partner hast Du die Möglichkeit, die Zukunft des Unternehmens maßgeblich mitzugestalten und den Erfolg unserer Kunden zu sichern.

title: Partner - Head of Data & AI (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:

The ambition: building the leading Financial-Services-specific entrepreneurial holding — Fortune 500 access, PE discipline, Silicon Valley technology-depth and thinking. Three networks that compound and multiply.

Founded in October 2022 by Johanna von Geyr (build-up and led Financial Services Practice for a NASDAQ-listed strategy consultancy) and Harald Braunstein (serial entrepreneur with exits incl. IPO), we bring together deep functional domain expertise and networks in global Financial Services, with a proven track record in building, scaling, and investing in leading software product companies.  

Curious what ALAIKA is all about? Explore our website and introduction deck. 

Join the movement — apply now.

  • Lead. Run the Data & AI practice as a whole — strategy, structure, hiring, IP, and P&L. Build the leadership team and develop the next generation of partners. Set the bar for what Data & AI advisory looks like in Financial Services. 
  • Build. You are not joining a practice; you are building one. Shape what ALAIKA’s Data & AI franchise becomes — and co-build the firm around it. That is not a slogan — it is your Tuesday.

— Kenneth C. Griffin, Founder of Citadel

  • Book-smart. Strong academic foundation. Think in structures, not gut feel.

What you bring 

  • Track Record. A track record of building — a Data & AI practice, a Data & AI-native company, or a senior data and AI function at a majorstrategic consultancy or Financial Services firm.  
  • Senior Network. Established relationships across data, AI, and Financial Services — C-suite, technical leadership, regulators, and the broader ecosystem. Your network walks in with you. 
  • Sales Track Record. Proven ability to originate and close mandates at €3m+ scale. You have built a book before.

Why join ALAIKA

Advise the leaders. Build what comes next.
Invest in the future of Financial Services. 

Apply with CV, transcripts, and references. Let’s see if you are the one. 

Equal Opportunities for all (f/m/d)

ALAIKA is an equal-opportunity employer. We hire on merit and welcome applications from people of all genders, backgrounds, ages, and identities. Our team spirit celebrates diversity. We want you to be your true “you” and offer everyone an open culture and safe space

title: Partner Manager - Agency Partnerships
descriptionHtml:
Tracksuit exists to help marketers prove their brand building is working. We give teams the data they need to make smarter decisions, convince stakeholders, defend budgets, and track their progress. The brand tracking industry is dominated by 100-page reports, static data and big price-tags. We're doing things differently by being built for the modern marketer: always-on, accessible, and approachable.

We're now tracking more than 1,000 brands across 25 countries globally. With offices in Auckland, Sydney, London and New York City, we're scaling fast with a brilliant team of collaborative and ambitious humans. Our culture is defined by "high care, high performance". We strive to be the best and look after each other while we do it.

Agencies are how a lot of brands find Tracksuit. We're looking for someone to grow those partnerships across the UK.

As a Partner Manager, you'll own our agency partnerships in the UK, from finding and winning new agencies to onboarding them and growing them into partners who regularly bring Tracksuit to their clients. title: Partner Sales Executive
descriptionHtml:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

As a Partner Sales Executive focused onFinancial Crime Compliance (FCC), you'll navigate partner ecosystems, building strong executive relationships, trust, and new revenue streams through value-based selling. You'll grow revenue and drive adoption of the UiPath platform for FCC use cases — such as anti-money laundering, KYC, and fraud — by partnering with world-class consulting and service organizations, and build the plans that help those partners deliver maximum success for their financial services customers.

This is a unique overlay role: you'll drive partner sales for FCC across the entire company, and no two days will look the same. You'll build offerings and go-to-market strategies — and see them through to execution — with sophisticated, non-transactional partners such as global systems integrators and advisory firms.

What you'll do at UiPath

  • Analyze market potential and build strategic go-to-market plans with partners to maximize revenue

  • Hit agreed sales targets and outcomes each quarter, growing partner-sourced revenue, registered deals, and joint solutions

  • Evangelize the UiPath brand and value proposition so UiPath becomes the automation platform of choice for your partners' customers

  • Show partners how our solutions benefit their customers financially and support their strategic initiatives

  • Build trusted relationships with partner automation practices, account owners, vertical leaders, and executives

  • Work with regional sales leadership and partner leadership on a coordinated go-to-market strategy for high-value solutions

  • Coach UiPath sales reps on working with your partner, managing joint pursuits and keeping communication tight

  • Respond quickly to partner leads, agree deal-support priorities, and nurture opportunities into expansion

  • Drive ongoing partner enablement: training and certification, product updates, quotes, and new release information

  • Team up with field sales, Customer Success Managers, and pre-sales to make sure customers get maximum value and issues are resolved fast

  • Track competitors, new products, and market conditions, and report partner needs, competitive activity, and new opportunities to leadership

  • Keep the UiPath CRM accurate and up to date

What you'll bring to the team

  • 10+ years of business and sales experience, including developing sales with partners and building offerings and go-to-market strategies with sophisticated partners (consulting backgrounds welcome)

title: Partner Solutions Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Retire the ERP.

Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our AI-native financial platform gives modern, global companies automated accounting, real-time reporting and financial flows that move at the speed of the business. In a short time we've become the operating core for companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot.

The largest finance transformations don't start with a demo. They start with a Big 4 firm or a technology partner putting Light through its paces on behalf of their clients. Come help us win those rooms and make Light the global default for next-gen finance.

The role

TLDR: Be the technical lead when Big 4 firms and technology partners evaluate Light, and turn those evaluations into strategic enterprise deals.

Before a Deloitte, PwC, EY or KPMG practice recommends Light to its clients, or a tech vendor builds Light into its offering, they test us hard: scripted scenarios, self-paced proof-of-value windows, architecture and security reviews, then a readout to their partners. You run that cycle end to end. You'll work directly with our founders, Partnerships, Sales and Product, and as an early member of the team you'll write the playbook every future partner evaluation follows.

What you'll do

  • Run partner evaluations end to end. Turn a partner's test scenarios into scripts, environments and success criteria; run self-paced proof-of-value windows with weekly check-ins; lead the final readout.

  • Be the technical voice in the room. Run tailored demos and deep dives for Big 4 advisory and audit teams, CFO-office practices and vendor architects. Own objections on integrations, data migration, security, controls and audit trail.

  • Map Light to complex finance. Translate multi-entity, multi-currency, consolidation, revenue recognition and statutory reporting requirements into how Light handles them, and say clearly where it doesn't yet.

  • Enable partners to sell and deliver Light. Build demo environments, playbooks, reference architectures and certification content so partner teams can run Light without us in the room.

  • Close strategic deals. Partner with Sales and Partnerships on joint account plans, enterprise scoping and solution design through to signature and handover to Implementation.

  • Feed the roadmap. Bring patterns from every evaluation back to Product and Engineering, and build AI-powered tooling that makes the next evaluation faster.

What you'll bring

  • 4+ years as a Solutions Engineer, Solutions Consultant or Pre-Sales lead for ERP or finance software (vendor side preferred), or in a Big 4 ERP / finance transformation practice.

  • A strong accounting foundation: close, consolidation, intercompany, multi-currency, revenue recognition and controls. You can hold your own with a Big 4 partner or a group controller.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one major ERP (NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics or Workday) and real implementation projects: data migration, integrations, APIs.

  • A track record of running structured evaluations, RFPs or proofs of concept with large or demanding buyers, and winning them.

  • Executive presence and crisp writing. You make complex things simple, in a demo, a workshop or a one-page readout.

  • Genuinely AI-native. You've changed how you work because of AI tooling, not just added it to your workflow.

Bonus points

  • Ex-Big 4 (advisory or audit) and a qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CPA or equivalent).

  • Experience in a partner or alliances SE role, building channel enablement programs.

  • Exposure to IFRS and local GAAP across several European markets, and SOC 2 / ISO 27001 security reviews.

  • You've configured AI agents in production or built your own tools with them.

Probably not for you if: you've used ChatGPT once and weren't impressed, or you prefer a polished demo script to a hard question from an auditor.

title: Partnership Manager - Accountant Sector
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

We are looking for an experienced Partnership Manager to join our Accountant Partnerships team in France, specifically focused on building and developing relationships with accounting firms and accountant networks.

The core purpose of this role is to turn accounting firms into long-term Alan partners and advocates. You will help them recommend Alan to their clients, improve their day-to-day experience with health insurance and payroll administration, and generate qualified business opportunities for Alan’s Sales teams.

The accountant ecosystem represents a significant growth opportunity for Alan. France has approximately 22,000 accounting firms supporting around 3.5 million companies, and Alan’s existing Accountant Partnership channel has already generated significant ARR through a relatively small number of partners.

The team is now entering a new phase of development. We are hiring new Partnership Manager to help build a scalable, high-performing partner network and contribute to Alan’s ambition to make Accountant Partnerships a strategic growth channel.

Here is how your key outcomes will look like:

  1. Build and grow a strong partner network: Identify, prioritise and develop relationships with high-potential accounting firms and networks.

  2. Drive partnerships from discussion to activation: Lead partnership discussions, onboarding and launch, ensuring that Alan creates value for both accountants and their clients.

  3. Activate partners and generate business opportunities: Build engagement plans, support partner enablement and work closely with Sales to turn recommendations into qualified opportunities.

  4. Help scale the Accountant Partnerships model: Manage partner performance, share insights with internal teams and contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, tools and processes.

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

We’re looking for someone who combines strong partnership and commercial skills with the ability to build trusted relationships in a complex and evolving B2B ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable managing partnerships from initial contact to activation and long-term development. They should enjoy working autonomously in an environment where there is still a lot to build.

You may be a great fit at Alan if you have/are:

  • 5+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, account management or customer success in a B2B environment

  • Experience managing partnerships throughout the full lifecycle, from prospecting and closing to activation and ongoing relationship management

  • Experience managing a portfolio of partners, ideally in a fast-growing company

  • Strong negotiation, communication, presentation and relationship-building skills

  • A data-oriented mindset, with the ability to track performance and prioritise opportunities

  • The ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, Marketing, Product, Data and Operations teams

  • An entrepreneurial mindset, strong ownership and the ability to work autonomously

  • Full professional fluency in French and professional fluency in English

Experience working directly with accounting firms, payroll providers, HR software or insurance companies would be a strong plus.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience with B2B distribution partnerships, where a third party recommends or distributes a solution to its own customers. Experience limited to technology integrations, co-marketing or visibility partnerships would be less relevant for this role.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles.

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

descriptionHtml:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

About the Role

We are looking for an ambitious, commercially driven Partnerships Lead to build and scale Tandem Health's strategic partnerships across the UK. You will play a key role in accelerating our growth by identifying and securing high-impact partnerships across the healthcare ecosystem, including NHS organisations, private healthcare providers, hospital groups and healthtech platforms.

You'll own the full partnership lifecycle, from identifying opportunities and building senior relationships through to negotiating agreements, launching partnerships and driving commercial value. Working closely with our commercial, product and leadership teams, you'll help unlock new routes to market, expand our distribution and establish Tandem as a leading AI partner to UK healthcare.

What You Will Do

  • Own and execute Tandem's UK partnerships strategy, identifying the relationships and channels that will have the greatest impact on our growth.

  • Identify and secure strategic partnerships across the UK healthcare ecosystem, including NHS organisations, private healthcare providers, hospital groups and specialist clinic networks.

  • Develop relationships with EHR/EMR providers, digital health platforms and complementary technology businesses to unlock new distribution and integration opportunities.

  • Originate and manage partnership opportunities end-to-end, from initial outreach and business development through to commercial negotiations, contracting and launch.

  • Develop compelling partnership propositions and commercial models that create value for both Tandem and its partners.

  • Drive tangible outcomes from partnerships, including revenue generation, customer acquisition, clinician adoption and market expansion.

  • Work closely with sales, product, project delivery, medical operations and marketing teams to ensure successful implementation and maximise the value of strategic partnerships.

  • Represent Tandem at industry events and conferences, building our profile and network across the UK healthcare market.

  • Monitor market developments and identify new opportunities to strengthen Tandem's competitive position and accelerate growth.

What You Bring

  • Proven experience in strategic partnerships, ideally within healthcare, healthtech or enterprise technology.

  • Strong understanding of the UK healthcare landscape, including NHS structures, private healthcare and the wider digital health ecosystem.

  • An established network of relevant industry contacts, with the ability to build credibility and influence senior decision-makers.

  • Demonstrable track record of originating and closing complex, high-value commercial partnerships.

  • Experience developing partnership strategies, identifying new routes to market and creating scalable commercial opportunities.

  • Strong commercial acumen, including the ability to assess opportunities, develop business cases and negotiate sustainable agreements.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with confidence engaging C-suite executives and senior healthcare leaders.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset, high ownership and ability to operate autonomously in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Collaborative approach and ability to bring together cross-functional teams to deliver results.

  • Genuine interest in AI, healthcare innovation and transforming how healthcare is delivered.

How to Apply

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of stages:

  1. Screening interview with Talent Acquisition

  2. First interview with Head of Sales UK&I

  3. Sales Demo with Country Director UK&I

  4. Working Day - Join us in the London office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

 

Benefits

  • Competitive salary & company stock options

  • 30 days/year of paid vacation

  • £800 wellness budget per year

  • Generous Parental leave top-up for new parents

  • Private Medical Insurance to stay healthy

  • Mental health support through our partner Mindler

  • Pension program

  • Social and team-building activities (off-sites, after works, winter/summer parties)

  • An opportunity to make a real positive impact in the world of healthcare

  • Work with some of the best minds in AI, healthcare, and engineering.


We review our benefits packages on a regular basis and might modify our benefits from time to time.

Culture at Tandem

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our culture:

  • We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.

  • We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.

  • We're a remote-first team spread across time zones, so no office to report to - work from wherever helps you do your best work. Just a couple of things to keep in mind: pay is based on where you're located, and you'll need to keep a home base in the country you're hired in. Location:

  • Remote - London, UK

About the Role:
As the Partnerships Manager at Sardine, you’ll report directly to our Head of Partnerships. This is a quota-carrying role that combines growing and activating our signed partners with bringing new partners into the ecosystem. You will own a portfolio of strategic partners and drive revenue through them. Additionally, you will help lead partner recruitment efforts from inception.

You’ll work closely with Sardine and partner-side sales teams to drive revenue, and collaborate with our Product, Sales Engineering, and Marketing teams to make sure partners are equipped to succeed. You’ll also help shape our channel strategy and position Sardine as the premier fraud and compliance platform within our partners’ customer bases.

This is a high-impact role that will drive meaningful revenue over time and help make partnerships one of the largest channels for Sardine. You’ll work directly with the Head of Partnerships, Sales leadership, and other members of the leadership team, and play a key role in taking Sardine to the next level.

  • Drive revenue: Own a partner portfolio and carry a quota across straight reseller, co-sell, and referral relationships, working with partner and Sardine sales teams to close deals

  • Grow across three motions: Partner with Platforms including Payments, Networks, Processors, Banking, AI Ecosystem and other players that embed Sardine, SIs and consultancies that resell, and advisory firms, data partners and VCs who refer prospects

  • Enable partners: Enable partner sales and customer support teams to effectively pitch and demo Sardine through training, material creation, and more.

  • Generate demand: Collaborate with partners to build and execute joint marketing and BDR campaigns directed at their prospects and clients.

  • Recruit and expand: Recruit, onboard, and launch new partners from outreach through first deal, and broaden the scope of signed partners over time

  • Plan and optimize: Set targets, build channel strategies, and report on performance, including product gaps and pricing considerations to optimize distribution

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work with Product, Sales Engineering, Marketing, and Sales to ensure Sardine is ready on partner platforms, including embedded deployments

What You’ll Need:

  • 8+ years of partnership management or years of related experience in B2B software/SaaS, with a record of consistently exceeding quota

  • Experience managing a mix of partner types such as resellers, SIs, platform partners, and referral partners

  • Executive presence and the ability to build long-term partner relationships

  • Hands-on experience with CRM/Salesforce, reporting, and analytics

  • Strong project management, communication, and strategic thinking, with the ability to collaborate in virtual, matrixed teams

  • Avid user of Agentic AI tools to optimize performance with a lifetime learning mindset

  • Highly preferred: Background in financial services, fintech, AI or fraud and compliance software

  • Highly preferred: Existing network within the financial services or partner ecosystem

Benefits we offer:

  • Generous compensation in cash and equity

  • Early exercise for all options, including pre-vested

  • Work from anywhere: Remote-first Culture

title: Patent Engineer (Life Sciences)
descriptionHtml:
The way companies innovate is broken. The systems built to create and protect ideas can’t keep up with the pace of change. Today, 90% of S&P 500 company value is intangible (e.g., in intellectual property) - yet R&D and IP teams spend half their time buried in manual work, sifting through patents and paperwork instead of pushing the frontier forward. The tools of creating and protecting are stuck in the past. We’re here to fix that.

Ankar is building the R&D tools for the AI era and defining what applied research will look like in the next 20 years. We’re building infrastructure and product experiences our customers rely on every day. You’ll translate messy, ambiguous problems into clean, dependable software—and you’ll do it at the cutting-edge of AI.

We’re at an inflection point:

  • We’ve raised >$24M to date from Tier-1 VCs like Atomico, Index Ventures, Norrsken, Daphni, and angels like the Founder of Hugging Face, CEO from Datadog, and Leaders from DeepMind and OpenAI.

  • We’re already working with the world’s most innovative companies including Fortune 500 company L’Oréal and global law firm Vorys

  • Expanding our world-class team with alumni from Palantir, Amazon, and BCG to tackle the $1T+ innovation market. We’re just getting started.

What you’ll be doing
We’re looking for a patent professional with deep large-molecule life sciences expertise who can bridge product development, engineering and IP protection. You’ll work hands-on with pharmaceutical and biotech customers to design AI-powered patent solutions that understand the nuances of biologics—including antibodies, proteins, peptides, nucleic acids, vaccines and cell and gene therapies—and the conventions that govern their patent protection.

  • Build life sciences-specific patent products: Partner with product and engineering teams to develop AI tools tailored to large-molecule patents—from protein and antibody sequence analysis to biologics claim generation, sequence-listing support and prior-art searching across life sciences databases.

  • Embed with pharmaceutical and biotech customers: Work directly with in-house patent counsel and prosecution teams to design, prototype and deploy high-value proofs of concept for large-molecule patent workflows.

  • Shape product development with biologics expertise: Translate complex large-molecule patent challenges into product requirements, ensuring our AI understands sequence data, CDR and epitope definitions, functional claim language, sequence variants, experimental data and biologics drafting conventions.

  • Drive customer success in large-molecule patents: Lead technical sessions with patent professionals to ensure our products deliver measurable value across biologics patent portfolios.

  • Identify emerging biologics patent opportunities: Recognize evolving needs across therapeutic antibodies, recombinant proteins, vaccines, nucleic acid technologies, cell and gene therapies, biologics formulations and regulatory IP strategy.

What we’re looking for

  • Large-molecule patent expertise: At least two years of experience in biologics patent prosecution, pharmaceutical or biotech IP, or other large-molecule-focused patent work, with a strong understanding of the patent lifecycle from invention disclosure through prosecution, grant and enforcement.

  • Technical life sciences foundation: Strong knowledge of molecular biology, biochemistry, immunology or a related discipline, including an understanding of protein and nucleic acid sequences, antibody structure and function, biologics development, and how these translate into patentable subject matter.

  • Strong biologics drafting skills: Experience developing claim strategies for antibodies, proteins, nucleic acids or other biologic modalities, with an understanding of written-description, enablement, sequence-listing and functional-claiming requirements.

  • Builder’s mindset: You thrive in ambiguity, iterate quickly on prototypes and enjoy creating order from complexity. You can move seamlessly between high-level patent strategy and detailed biologics claim construction.

  • Extreme ownership: You anticipate problems, take responsibility for outcomes and consistently deliver. This is how you grow—and how we win.

  • [Bonus points]: Experience at a patent law firm representing pharmaceutical or biotech clients; in-house patent counsel experience at a pharmaceutical or biotech company; expertise in emerging modalities such as antibody-drug conjugates, bispecific antibodies, RNA therapeutics or cell and gene therapies; or an advanced life sciences degree combined with patent training.

     
 

This role is not for you if...

  • You need a highly structured environment, a predefined playbook, regular working hours, or a schedule that never requires travel. We operate with high autonomy and ownership, expect our team to go above and beyond, be obsessed with our mission and thrive in ambiguity rather than wait for direction.

  • You prefer long planning cycles and certainty before acting. We move quickly, ship often, and adapt based on customer feedback and new information.

  • You want to manage the work rather than do the work. We're builders first, and everyone is expected to contribute directly to creating exceptional products.

  • You take it personally when ideas are challenged, priorities shift, or work gets redirected. We care more about finding the right answer than defending a particular one.

 

What we put behind our people

Building at the frontier takes exceptional people. We invest accordingly.

  • Health Insurance : Full private health & dental coverage for you and your dependents.

  • Pension: Flexible pension scheme with up to 5% employer matching on qualifying earnings.

  • Food on us: Team lunches twice a week, plus dinner when working late in the office.

  • Cycle to work: Green Commute initiative scheme (up to £3k) to help you get a new bike tax-free.

  • Way we work: We combine deep, in-person collaboration (3 days/week in our Shoreditch office) with flexibility and trust. What matters is ownership, impact, and results, not where you work from.

title: Payroll Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them.

 

Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past.

 

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

 

About the Role

 

We're hiring a Payroll Specialist to join Sona's payroll bureau, taking hands-on ownership of UK payroll processing for a portfolio of our customers.

Our bureau is growing fast. We're moving from around 15,000 payslips a month to roughly 22,000 by the start of Q4, driven by new customer go-lives in hospitality and care. That means the pace of the role is genuinely high, and we're hiring ahead of that curve rather than catching up after the fact.

Day to day, you'll manage a portfolio of standard and mid-complexity clients across multiple pay frequencies: statutory payments, pension auto-enrolment, HMRC filings and payroll journal reconciliation. You'll also handle client queries through our support desk, working to fast turnaround times. Your work is checked by a Senior Payroll Specialist before it reaches clients, as part of our standard quality process.

This isn't a conventional bureau role. Sona is a startup and the payroll team is still building its own processes and tools, so there's genuine room to shape how things work and to grow as the bureau scales. You'll be working on a product in a sector most software has ignored, and once you're through probation we support CIPP study through the apprenticeship levy.

 

Responsibilities

 

  • Own end-to-end UK payroll processing for a portfolio of Sona customers across multiple pay frequencies, covering standard and mid-complexity clients

  • Manage payroll queries through our support desk, giving clients fast, proactive updates and resolving within SLA

  • Process statutory payments, court orders, standard holiday pay calculations, Alabaster reviews and NMW checks for your own portfolio

  • Handle workplace pension auto-enrolment, contributions, reconciliations and submissions, flagging any miscalculated contributions for investigation

  • Upload, reconcile and submit payments across BACS, Faster Payments and SEPA, and manage payroll journal uploads and reconciliations

  • Manage HMRC filings (FPS, EPS) and year-end processing for your portfolio, escalating disputed or mis-allocated PAYE cases to your Senior or the Payroll Manager

  • Build strong working relationships with clients, including attending client meetings when needed, and flag product bugs to Engineering as you spot them

  • Spot and flag process gaps or improvements within your own portfolio, and support Payroll Assistants and Senior Payroll Specialists with day-to-day queries

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years hands-on experience processing multiple UK payrolls independently

  • Experience within a bureau or outsourced payroll environment is a bonus

  • Good working knowledge of UK payroll and tax compliance, including tax calculations and filing and payment requirements

  • Confident managing a busy queue of support tickets, with strong organisational skills and clear written and verbal communication

  • Comfortable in Excel (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, concatenation) and Google Suite

  • Methodical and accurate under volume, and quick to flag issues rather than let them become problems

  • Bonus: CIPP or equivalent qualification, exposure to Irish payroll (PAYE, PRSI, USC), or confidence using AI tools in your day-to-day work

 

Benefits

 

  • Salary: £35,000 - £45,000

  • Hybrid working - 2+ days/week in our London office (Soho)

  • Share options

  • 35 days annual leave (25 days standard plus 10 flexible public holiday days)

  • Extra day of leave for every year of service

  • Salary sacrifice childcare scheme (Workplace Nursery)

  • Annual all expenses paid team retreats

  • The latest Macbook and equipment budget for your home office

  • Unlimited free books

The People Operations team's mission is to attract, develop and retain high performers who genuinely love being part of iwoca. It looks after HR systems like BambooHR and Peakon, keeps policies up to date, and manages benefits and payroll. The team is the first point of contact for most People Operations questions.

As our People Experience Administrator, you'll be the first point of contact for iwocans and the person who keeps the employee journey running smoothly, from someone's first day to their last.

Supporting payroll across our UK and German teams is a key part of the role, so you'll play a direct part in making sure every iwocan gets paid correctly and on time.

It's a broad, hands-on role at the heart of our People Operations team, with the flexibility to shape your days and hours around your life, so it suits anyone balancing work with other commitments. You'll own your work and be someone the team relies on.

title: People Operations Lead (Fixed term Contract)
descriptionHtml:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we're changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK's leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We're growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we're hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We're on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

About the role

You'll own the people engine room at Flock: the employee lifecycle, payroll input, benefits, the HRIS, the office and our in-person events. Your job is to design how a modern People function should work at a company where repetitive admin is automated out of existence and every process is simple, scalable and AI-native by default. You'll report to our Senior People Partner and work with everyone here, from a new joiner on day one to the CEO, who cares deeply about our culture. Please note this role is a 12-18 month fixed term contract.

What you'll be doing

People Operations

  • Own the full employee lifecycle: contracts, right-to-work, starter and leaver logistics, probations and changes. Shape the first day and first week alongside managers, delivering a strong employee experience across the lifecycle.

  • Be the first point of contact for people queries and audits. Own the People inbox and core HR templates, and drive every query to resolution.

  • Own the HRIS (HiBob) and people data: records, workflows, surveys and data integrity. Deliver monthly People reporting and metrics that spot and close gaps early.

  • Own payroll input end to end: collate, calculate and submit each month, including bonuses and comp changes. Manage the provider and partner with Finance on reporting and year-end.

  • Own benefits end to end as the main contact for providers, systems, data and employee advice, keeping policies and materials current.

  • Cut manual effort across the lifecycle by building AI-native workflows, so every routine people process is automated by default, then coach the business to use them. Own continuous improvement across People Ops.

  • Partner with IT on joiner and leaver access automation, and on cost and data audits.

Office Management & Socials

  • Run the office environment and vendor relationships, including routine upkeep like weekly snack orders and post. Cover health and safety as a trained First Aider and Fire Marshal, and provision hardware fast.

  • Own the company social calendar and rituals, from bi-weekly Flock o'Clock (working closely with the CEO) to quarterly Town Halls and larger events, keeping them engaging and on budget.

What you'll need

  • Hands-on People or HR Operations experience, ideally in a fast-moving scale-up, with real ownership of end-to-end processes. CIPD or equivalent experience required.

  • Hands-on payroll input and benefits administration. HiBob experience is a plus.

  • Strong HRIS skills across workflows, automations and integrations, plus confident data and spreadsheet ability.

  • Real evidence of building with AI: workflows or tools you've shipped and use, not ones you've only read about.

  • Exceptional organisation and judgement. You spot what needs doing and get ahead of it, you build the credibility that lets you influence without leaning on authority, and you treat confidential matters with discretion.

  • A quick, first-principles learner who is comfortable with pace, ambiguity and autonomy.

  • Working knowledge of UK employment law, compliance and people governance.

  • Low ego and high standards. You care most that the work is right and well run.

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that's a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don't tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.
