title: Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day.

We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.

Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.

  • Taking ownership and driving impact 
  • Being open to change and feedback
  • Being passionate about our mission and our customers. 

Your Mission

At Catawiki, our Platform Horizontal has evolved from solely managing the cloud into a broad function supporting Reliability, Developer Experience, Security, and Quality. We take a holistic approach to creating systems and tools that help developers deliver applications seamlessly and reliably without getting bogged down in infrastructure complexity.
As a Platform Engineer, you’ll work at the intersection of development, infrastructure, and operations. You’ll help shape and execute our long-term platform vision, empowering Catawiki teams to deliver value to customers with speed, reliability, and security.

What You'll Do

You’ll build and improve the platform capabilities that enable our engineering teams to develop, deploy, and operate applications effectively at scale.

  • Build a self-service developer platform with a particular emphasis on developer experience, designing and maintaining platforms that abstract complexity and give teams the tools to deploy, monitor, and optimise their applications.
  • Orchestrate cloud-native infrastructure, manage Kubernetes clusters and other cloud resources, focusing on performance, scalability, and cost efficiency through FinOps practices.
  • Boost developer productivity by building and enhancing CI/CD pipelines, GitOps workflows, and reusable templates that accelerate development and deployment cycles.
  • Drive reliability and scalability through applying practices for fault tolerance, disaster recovery, and scaling so applications run smoothly under changing conditions.
  • Improve platform operations usage and enhance our observability stack to monitor platform health and resolve incidents proactively.
  • Collaborate and innovate by partnering with product teams to understand their needs, build simple and impactful solutions, and champion cloud-native best practices across Catawiki.

What You'll Bring

You measure what matters, introduce changes gradually, and treat failure as a normal part of learning. You use tooling and automation wherever possible to reduce toil, and enjoy sharing knowledge with others.

  • Cloud-native expertise: At least 5 years of production experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, and cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.
  • Automation mindset: Experience automating workflows and CI/CD pipelines and working with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
  • Observability experience: Hands-on experience using and maintaining tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or OpenTelemetry to improve reliability and performance.
  • Strong ownership: You proactively address platform issues and work toward long-term scalability and resilience.
  • Collaborative approach: You work effectively with developers and cross-functional teams to align goals and deliver impactful yet simple solutions.
  • Continuous learning: You keep developing your knowledge of cloud-native tools, technologies, and practices in a fast-moving ecosystem.

How We Work

The Platform Horizontal supports engineering teams across Catawiki by reducing infrastructure complexity and providing reliable, secure, and scalable foundations.

  • We collaborate closely with product teams to understand their challenges and improve their development experience.
  • We favour self-service capabilities, reusable solutions, automation, and measurable, gradual improvements.
  • We share knowledge and treat reliability, security, quality, and developer experience as shared responsibilities.

Where You'll Be

This is a Hybrid role based in Amsterdam. You will work from our Amsterdam HQ a minimum of 2 days per week.
This role is open to candidates worldwide. For selected candidates, Catawiki can provide visa sponsorship and relocation support to the relevant location, subject to eligibility and applicable restrictions.

In Return

You’ll be part of an enthusiastic, highly motivated team of 800+ Catawikians.

  • A competitive Annual Gross Base Salary depending on your level, competencies, and overall experience.
  • A Work From Home Allowance to help with your monthly household bills.
  • Commuting between your home and our office is covered by Catawiki.
  • Amazing Office right in the centre of Amsterdam.

Why You'll Love Working with Us

  • Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.
  • Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.
  • A culture of connection defines us. We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.
  • Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion”. We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.

Our Offices and Way of Working

Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.

Interested?

Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support the review of your application. AI may help us assess how your experience matches the requirements of the role, but hiring decisions are always made by our recruitment team

title: Platform engineer
descriptionHtml:
Hybrid with travel to Bath, London and Edinburgh a couple times a month

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

The role

We're looking for a Platform engineer to shape and evolve the platform that underpins our investment products. You’ll be someone who loves understanding engineering problems and enabling teams to self-serve their needs. You view the cloud platform as a product, and engineering as your customer.

The role is within our Cloud Resilience team - a critical squad within our engineering organisation responsible for empowering squads to build and run their own services.

We’re primarily in AWS, utilising Lambda, ECS, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway, Aurora, Redshift among others. Our main data store is MongoDB Atlas and our observability platform is Datadog. Our application is written in Typescript/NodeJS and our infrastructure is defined in Terraform.

On a typical day you will be…

  • Architecting, implementing, and maintaining scalable, secure infrastructure in AWS using Terraform.

  • Designing cloud-native solutions using MongoDB, Lambda, API Gateway, and other AWS services with a strong focus on serverless.

  • Contributing to incident response efforts, production readiness, and reliability initiatives across engineering squads.

  • Enhancing observability and platform insight through actionable alerting and data visibility using Datadog.

  • Continuously improving CI/CD processes with GitHub Actions, reducing friction in delivery pipelines.

  • Collaborating with software engineers (working in Node.js/TypeScript) to ensure secure, performant, and resilient applications.

  • Mentoring engineers and champion DevOps culture and best practices across teams.

This role’s for you if...

  • You’re a pragmatic platform engineer with experience in regulated environments, balancing delivery with compliance and operational excellence.

  • You’re confident working with JavaScript/TypeScript-based applications and collaborating closely with development teams.

  • You know what “good” looks like for databases like MongoDB and Postgres and can diagnose, design, and optimise for scale and resilience.

  • You care deeply about observability - you don’t just monitor systems, you build alerts that engineers can act on.

  • You’re fluent in AWS best practices, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), and CI/CD tooling like GitHub Actions.

  • You’ve had exposure to architectural decisions and willingness to own of platform-level outcomes.

This role isn’t for you if...

  • You rely on a lot of top-down direction. Here, you’ll have a lot of freedom and ownership of your role, and you’ll be expected to shape your own progression

  • You’re not comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Our speed and scalability are what set us apart; you need to be able to act quickly and think on your feet

  • You struggle to follow through on ideas. We value people who do what they say they will. If you care about something, you have the freedom here to make it happen

  • You don’t like change. You’ll get on great here if you relish the ambiguity of rapid growth and are willing to embrace uncertainty

What’s in it for you…

We offer a generous mix of benefits for the things that really matter to our people, including:

💰 A salary between £55,000 and £75,000 – dependant on experience + reviewed annually

🌴 27 days holiday + bank holidays (some can be flexible) + day off on your birthday + three days (full time) per year for Dependant leave

💙 Two volunteering days per year

🌎 Option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

🌟 Secclbrate - our recognition programme that offers a mix of flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

🏅 Length of service award – one month paid sabbatical at eight years

✅ 6% employer pension contribution, and life assurance

🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

👪 Enhanced Parental leave

💻 MacBook and up to £500 home office set up budget

📖 £750 per person learning budget

🌻 Health and wellbeing initiatives including free therapy via Wellness Cloud, mental health support via Headspace

🌱 Strong financial wellbeing focus including access to Octopus Money, Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing offering via Octopus Legacy

🎁 Perkbox – Flexi-points giving you a range of discounts and perks including free weekly coffee, gym and retail discounts

🚲 Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

Our culture

We're proud to put people first, creating a culture where we truly listen to what matters most to them. Our transparent and inclusive environment encourages diversity of thought, challenge and experimentation.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way thing, and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you. Our interviews are conversational, so come with questions and be curious. In general, you can expect the interview process to look a bit like this, (following an initial chat with one of our Talent team):

  • First stage – 60 mins Cloud System Design interview

  • Second stage – 60 mins Terraform Code Review Interview

  • Final stage – 45 mins bar-raiser culture-based interview

⏳ We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out and you should expect to hear back from us within one to two weeks of applying.

🌈 Our aim is to build a diverse and inclusive company of awesome people, with unique skills, passions and experiences. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you!

Compensation: £55K – £75K

title: Platform Reliability Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.  

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability. 

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally. 

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers. 

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale. 

AI FactoryOS Operations 

AI FactoryOS is Firmus' proprietary operating system for the AI Factory. It governs GPU telemetry, cooling, power and grid interaction as one integrated layer, so that every Firmus site can be optimised and monitored as a single system. 

AI FactoryOS Operations runs that platform in production and owns the 24/7 reliability of AI FactoryOS, Firmus AI Cloud and the platforms built on them, together with the service levels the estate is measured against. 

The remit is an engineering one. The function builds the guarded automation, remediation and operational tooling that turn manual response into a software-defined capability, and builds and operates the shared services the estate's own operation depends on. The function works closely with the engineering teams that build the platform, supplying the production evidence that shapes what they fix and what they build next. 

Role Summary  

Firmus runs large-scale, state-of-the-art AI infrastructure built on the latest generation of GPU rack-scale systems and operated as one estate to power the next generation of AI innovation. The Platform Reliability Engineering Manager leads the platform reliability team: the engineers who take on incidents escalated from the Global and Site Operation Centres and manage them through to resolution, and the Service Delivery Managers who run incident, change and problem management. Together they work with the operations centres and the specialist engineering teams to keep the estate within the service levels it is measured against. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, and strong technical competence is a core requirement of it. The role is expected to step into complex faults alongside the engineers, guide the diagnosis and recovery, and judge the technical quality of the team's work. The role manages the team's 24/7 on-call operation, its escalation paths to the specialist engineering teams, and its service level objectives. The team treats operations as a software problem, and the role leads the work of turning what the team learns into runbooks, guarded automation and permanent fixes. 

 Key Responsibilities 

  • Lead and manage the platform reliability team, including hiring, onboarding, performance, development and wellbeing across regions. 
  • Manage the team's 24/7 on-call and incident command rosters, with cover across regions. 
  • Serve on the incident command roster and act as incident commander for major incidents on rostered weeks, alongside the Service Delivery Managers. 
  • Act as a senior technical escalation point for the team: join complex faults, guide diagnosis and recovery, and review the technical quality of the root cause analysis, runbooks and automation the team produces. 
  • Manage the service level objectives for the services the team supports, and report service performance to leadership. 
  • Work with the specialist engineering teams on clear escalation paths and response commitments. 
  • Hold the team to its incident, change and problem management practice, and arbitrate when speed and process pull in different directions during an incident. 
  • Drive the team's runbook and automation work, so that common faults are fixed once and handled by runbooks or automation, and engineers have time to build automation between on-call weeks. 
  • Build a clear development path for the team's engineers into senior specialist roles, with mentoring and rotations agreed with the other engineering managers. 
  • Work with the Service Delivery Managers and the engineering teams so that new and changed services are ready to support in production. 
  • Turn production evidence, such as incident trends and repeat causes, into clear improvement requirements for the engineering teams, and follow them to closure. 
  • Manage customer and leadership reporting on service health with the Service Delivery Managers, and attend customer service reviews where contractual response commitments are discussed. 
  • Keep the team's ITSM, on-call and operational tooling fit for purpose. 

Skills & Experience 

  • Solid hands-on engineering experience in infrastructure operations or site reliability engineering (Linux, networking, storage, Kubernetes or virtualisation), with the technical depth to lead a recovery, question a diagnosis and judge whether an escalation carries enough evidence. 
  • Significant experience leading a 24/7 operations, SRE or production engineering team in a large-scale hosting, HPC, telecommunications, data centre or service provider environment, including running on-call rosters and incident response. 
  • Working ability in scripting or programming (for example Python, Go or Bash) and in infrastructure as code, enough to review the team's automation and runbook code. 
  • Working knowledge of site reliability engineering practice, including service level objectives, error budgets, toil reduction, runbook automation and production readiness, applied alongside formal incident, change and problem management. 
  • Clear communication and sound judgement, including under pressure. 
  • Experience with ITSM, on-call and observability tooling (for example Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, PagerDuty and Grafana). 
  • Experience building and developing engineering teams, including hiring at pace, coaching early-career engineers, setting performance expectations and growing people into senior roles. 

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience as a major incident commander, including communicating with stakeholders under pressure and leading post-incident reviews. 
  • Experience operating GPU, HPC or AI infrastructure, including the failure modes of large-scale distributed training and inference. 
  • Experience in a multi-tenant service provider, cloud or colocation environment with customer-facing reporting. 
  • Experience working under contractual response commitments and compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001 or SOC 2. 
  • Experience setting up a new operations function or team, including rosters, escalation paths and standards. 
  • Experience leading teams across time zones with follow-the-sun handovers. 
  • ITIL or an equivalent service management qualification. 

Location & Reporting 

Location: Based in Australia or Singapore, with travel to Australian AI Factory sites as required. 

On-call: The function runs 24/7. First line monitoring and first response sit with the operations centre. This role serves on the incident command roster with the Service Delivery Managers and is the escalation point for the team outside hours. 

Reporting to:  Reports to the Head of AI FactoryOS Operations, working under broad direction with a high degree of autonomy. This role leads a team of 5 to 10 engineers and service delivery staff. 

Employment Basis

Permanent full-time

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

title: Post-doctorant : « Artificial Intelligence for Sustainable Renewable Energy Production and Storage in Subsurface Reservoirs”
descriptionHtml:
Contexte :

ENSTA est un établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées. L’école a pour mission la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, dont les ingénieurs de l'armement et les ingénieurs des études et techniques de l'armement, ainsi que des cadres et docteurs hautement qualifiés pour les secteurs public et privé, en particulier dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et des technologies de pointe.

ENSTA accompagne par sa recherche, son innovation et son offre de formation la transformation des grands secteurs stratégiques nationaux répondant ainsi aux enjeux de souveraineté nationale. Elle dispose de 3 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR) organisées autour de 9 laboratoires de recherche (UER) qui mènent une recherche appliquée en relation étroite avec l’industrie.

ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID)). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans, inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment.

ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne. Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027.

Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle.

Sujet : « Artificial Intelligence for Sustainable Renewable Energy Production and Storage in Subsurface Reservoirs”

Ce poste fait partie de la subvention « Leveraging AI for Sustainable Renewable Energy Production and Storage », financée par Hi ! Paris (https://www.hi-paris.fr/). La recherche sera menée à l'ENSTA, Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Le poste offre l'opportunité de travailler sur un sujet de recherche stimulant et impactant. Les connaissances, l'innovation et les compétences développées dans le cadre de ce poste offriront d'excellentes perspectives d'évolution de carrière tant dans l'industrie que dans le monde universitaire.

Le changement climatique exige des stratégies innovantes pour exploiter les énergies renouvelables. Le sous-sol de la Terre offre un potentiel important grâce à des technologies telles que l'énergie géothermique profonde, le stockage souterrain de l'hydrogène et le captage, l'utilisation et le stockage du carbone (CCUS). Ces méthodes pourraient transformer le paysage énergétique de la France et de l'Europe, mais elles sont souvent entravées par la sismicité induite par l'injection de fluides dans la croûte terrestre.

Pour relever ce défi, il faut des solutions avancées. La théorie du contrôle mathématique, telle qu'explorée dans le projet INJECT du CER (https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101087771), offre des stratégies pour minimiser les risques sismiques tout en optimisant la production d'énergie. Par ailleurs, l'intelligence artificielle (IA), en particulier l'apprentissage par renforcement (AR), présente une approche transformatrice grâce à sa nature agnostique et orientée vers la performance. L'apprentissage par renforcement peut développer des politiques très efficaces pour la gestion des systèmes souterrains et sert de paradigme pour aborder des systèmes complexes avec des incertitudes et des contraintes similaires, débloquant ainsi des applications plus larges dans divers domaines. Pour plus d'informations, veuillez contacter : ----- class="Default" style="text-align:justify;">Missions / Activités principales :

En tant que post-doctorant, vous ferez progresser les méthodes d'intelligence artificielle pour relever les défis du monde réel en matière de contrôle des systèmes régis par des équations différentielles partielles (EDP) non linéaires et non lisses. Les objectifs clés comprennent le développement d'algorithmes RL robustes, stables et adaptables, qui peuvent améliorer les modèles prédictifs pour la sismicité induite, le contrôle et l'optimisation de la production.

Le poste met l'accent sur la recherche interdisciplinaire, en intégrant l'IA à la géomécanique et à la théorie du contrôle pour approfondir la compréhension scientifique de l'injection de fluides dans le sous-sol et de la mécanique des tremblements de terre. Les résultats contribueront à des avancées scientifiques de pointe ayant un impact sur les communautés universitaires et industrielles.

Missions / Activité annexe :

· Contribuer à toute activité du service en fonction des priorités retenues.

· Contribuer à la démarche Qualité, notamment via la rédaction et la mise à jour des procédures, le renseignement et le suivi des indicateurs

Contribuer à la démarche RSE de l’Ecole dans le cadre de ses missions et de ses activités

Durée d’affectation souhaitée : CDD de 2 ans

Date de prise de fonctions prévue : dès que possible

Lieu de travail :

ENSTA Campus Paris-Saclay, 828 boulevard des Maréchaux 91762 Palaiseau – Cedex

Le site est accessible en voiture (parking pour le personnel) mais également par les transports en commun

Poste à temps complet (25 jours de congés annuels, 18 RTT annuels)

Avantages :

  • Transports (participation forfaitaire de l’employeur à hauteur de 75 %)

  • Forfait mobilité durable (jusqu’à 300€/an)

  • Possibilité de télétravail (après accord du manager et dépôt d’une demande)

  • Subvention employeur au restaurant administratif et/ou à la cafétéria de l’établissement

  • Comité d’action sociale, avec notamment des événements et animations proposés au personnel, salle de sport sur adhésion, centre de loisirs pour les enfants du personnel à partir de 6 ans avec tarifs préférentiels (campus Paris-Saclay)

  • Mutuelle (participation à hauteur de 50% de l’établissement)

Aménagement du poste de travail et recrutement inclusif :

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux candidats en situation de handicap.

ENSTA s’engage à un recrutement favorisant l’égalité, la diversité et l’inclusion. Toutes les candidatures sans aucune distinction (âge, handicap, sexe, nationalité, religion, orientation sexuelle…) ont leur place dans notre processus de recrutement.


Les candidats retenus doivent posséder de solides compétences scientifiques et être très motivés. La maîtrise de l'anglais parlé et écrit est obligatoire.

Les candidats effectueront des recherches, développeront des dispositifs et des outils expérimentaux et rédigeront des articles scientifiques en étroite collaboration avec le PI du projet, Pr. Ioannis Stefanou, et les membres du groupe INJECT.

Connaissances :

  • Solide formation en mathématiques appliquées

  • Compétences en programmation (par exemple Matlab/Python/C++).

  • Connaissance de l'apprentissage automatique

  • Connaissances en dynamique/mécanique/géomécanique/géophysique.

  • Connaissance du contrôle des EDO et/ou des systèmes non lisses et/ou des EDP.

  • Expérience en laboratoire et esprit d'équipe.

title: Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en fondements quantiques et méthodes algébriques - CDD de 18 mois
descriptionHtml:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en fondements quantiques et méthodes algébriques pour rejoindre le département INFRES à Télécom Paris.

Le poste est accueilli au sein de Quriosity, équipe commune à Inria et Télécom Paris, au laboratoire LTCI et au département Informatique et Réseaux (INFRES). Située à Palaiseau, sur le plateau de Saclay, l’équipe bénéficie d’un environnement actif en information quantique et en fondements de la théorie quantique.

Le recrutement relève du projet PIQ « Nouveaux outils algébriques pour les décompositions causales des processus quantiques », sous la responsabilité d’Augustin Vanrietvelde. Il porte sur la phase 1 du projet, pour une durée de 18 mois.

Le projet étudie la conjecture des décompositions causales : tout canal unitaire admettrait une décomposition dont les connexions reflètent fidèlement sa structure causale. L’objectif est de développer des outils algébriques et syntaxiques pour étudier des cas ouverts, construire des décompositions ou identifier des obstructions. La recherche est exploratoire ; les résultats partiels et les limites des méthodes seront documentés.

Vos principales missions seront de :

Mener des recherches sur les décompositions causales des processus quantiques dans le cadre de la phase 1 du projet PIQ.

Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat de projets étudiants et de stages.

Contribuer au rayonnement scientifique de Télécom Paris, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris.


Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat ou équivalent en physique, mathématiques, informatique ou dans une discipline pertinente pour le projet, obtenu au plus tard à la prise de fonctions.

Vous devez posséder de solides connaissances en fondements quantiques, notamment en causalité quantique, ou en méthodes algébriques avancées, ainsi que de bonnes capacités de raisonnement mathématique, de démonstration et d’analyse critique. Vous devez être autonome dans la conduite de recherches théoriques, savoir rédiger des travaux scientifiques rigoureux et maîtriser l’anglais scientifique, à l’écrit comme à l’oral.

Des connaissances en algèbres d’opérateurs, en information quantique et en formalismes diagrammatiques sont souhaitées. Une expérience en calcul symbolique ou numérique appliqué à des problèmes théoriques, ainsi qu’en encadrement d’étudiants, constitue un atout. Enfin, vous devez faire preuve d’un bon esprit d’équipe, de capacités de dialogue et de synthèse, ainsi que de solides qualités rédactionnelles et pédagogiques.

Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers).

title: Post-doctorat en Métrologie des Réseaux, Intelligence Artificielle et Modélisation Stochastique
descriptionHtml:
Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation.

Dans le cadre du projet « Métrologie des réseaux augmentée par l'IA générative et l'apprentissage automatique pour les réseaux autonomes », qui vise à explorer les apports de l’intelligence artificielle appliquée à la métrologie et au diagnostic réseau, nous recrutons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant au sein de notre Département Informatique (campus de Brest).

En collaboration avec l’équipe du projet et l'équipe ERMINE du laboratoire IRISA, vous explorerez le potentiel de nouvelles approches en IA (IA générative, apprentissage automatique) pour la métrologie des réseaux. Vous développerez et structurerez un ou plusieurs axes de recherche conjoints (diagnostic QoS, optimisation du split computing, supervision de CDN) et valoriserez vos travaux par des publications et du code. Enfin, vous ferez la passerelle vers la pédagogie en encadrant des étudiants et en participant à la dissémination scientifique.

title: Power BI Developer
descriptionHtml:
Over Verzuimdata

Verzuimdata is een gespecialiseerde dienstverlener in het uitwisselen van verzuim-, loon- en werknemersgegevens tussen werkgevers, verzekeraars, arbodiensten en de overheid. Naast standaard dienstverlening leveren wij oplossingen ter ondersteuning van de dagelijkse processen van verzekeraars, volmachten en intermediairs, waaronder polisbeheer, premie- en schadeberekening, schadelastbeheersing, diverse dashboards en een digitale documentenkluis.

Wat je gaat doen

Als Power BI Developer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van datagedreven oplossingen binnen ons team in Ridderkerk. Je werkt aan heldere dashboards en rapportages die onze processen op het gebied van gegevensuitwisseling inzichtelijk maken.

Wat we vragen

  • Ervaring met Power BI en het bouwen van dashboards

  • Affiniteit met data-analyse en business intelligence

  • Zelfstandige en nauwkeurige werkhouding

Wat we bieden

  • Je werkt op basis van een vast contract van 40 uur per week met een proeftijd van 1 maand.

  • Je ontvangt 33 vakantiedagen per jaar.

  • Er is een bedrijfspensioenregeling aanwezig.

  • Je krijgt de beschikking over een laptop van de zaak en thuiswerkuitrusting.

  • Profiteer van flexibele werktijden, de mogelijkheid om te telewerken en een openbaarvervoervergoeding.

  • Het kantoor in Ridderkerk beschikt over barrièrevrije toegang en gratis parkeergelegenheid.

  • Geniet op locatie van gratis drankjes en maak gebruik van de aanwezige cafetaria.

Salaris

Het salaris bedraagt EUR 3,000–3,500 per maand.

Jouw eerste maanden bij Verzuimdata

In je eerste maanden maak je kennis met onze datastromen en systemen, en ga je direct aan de slag met het ontwerpen van overzichtelijke dashboards voor onze gebruikers. Je werkt nauw samen met collega's om gegevensstromen optimaal te vertalen naar waardevolle inzichten. Ook als je nog niet op elk vlak aan alle eisen voldoet maar wel de juiste ervaring meebrengt, nodigen we je van harte uit om te reageren.

title: Power Platform and Azure DevOps Expert - remote from EU
descriptionHtml:
This is an experienced architect-level position. The appointed resource will be expected to serve as the Power Platform administrator, administering and supporting approximately 100 Power Platform environments. A significant part of the role will involve establishing guidelines and providing direction to approximately 150 developers across multiple teams and throughout the organization. At least 2 years of demonstrable experience is required for each of the following mandatory requirements.

REQUIREMENTS

Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering or a related field.

Proven experience as a Power Platform architect, administrator or DevOps lead in an enterprise environment.

Demonstratable experience of leading multiple teams.

Deep practical knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform suite (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages).

Strong experience with Azure DevOps, including pipeline creation, variable groups, service connections, and release management.

Strong experience with Git-based ALM for Power Platform, including solution unpacking/packing and automated versioning.

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive mindset toward governance and automation.

Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with cross-functional technical and business teams.

Preferred certifications (non-mandatory):

• Microsoft Certified: PL-600 (Power Platform Solution Architect)

• Microsoft Certified: PL-400 (Power Platform Developer)

• Microsoft Certified: AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer Expert)

• Microsoft Certified: AZ-104 (Azure Administrator)

Extensive hands-on experience administering enterprise-scale Power Platform environments across a full DTAP pipeline (DEV, TEST, ACC/UAT, PRE-PROD, PROD).

Experience designing enterprise-scale governance and ALM strategies, including DLP policies, managed environments, and environment groups.

Demonstrated expertise in Dynamics 365 solution architecture, including advanced knowledge of solution layering, dependencies, patches, upgrades, and holding solutions.

Proven experience decomposing large, monolithic Dynamics 365 solutions with multiple inter-dependencies into modular, independently deployable units.

Experience designing and operating Git-based ALM workflows for Power Platform, including full solution unpacking/packing, automated versioning, and repository-only deployments.

Experience building and maintaining Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for Power Platform solution deployment, connection reference activation, and flow management.

Experience managing Dynamics 365 security, including security roles, business units, application users.

Highly valued but not mandatory:

Experience integrating Azure Key Vault with Azure DevOps pipelines for secure credential, secret, and certificate management.

Experience deploying master and configuration data across environments using Configuration Migration Tool, PAC CLI, KingswaySoft SSIS Integration Toolkit, or equivalent tooling.

Experience with enterprise Dynamics 365 implementations (>500 users) in regulated environments requiring strict auditability and controlled deployments.

Experience managing Power Pages and Dynamics 365 AI features security, including user experience profiles, table permissions, and portal web roles.

Power Platform Administration & Governance

Administers multiple Power Platform environments, covering strategy design, lifecycle management, environment groups, and managed environments governance.

Designs and implements Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies with environmentspecific governance, connector classification, and compliance best practices.

Establishes and maintains Power Platform governance standards, development and deployment standards, and monitors platform usage, capacity, and health.

Dynamics 365 Solution Architecture & ALM

Demonstrates expert understanding of managed vs unmanaged solutions, solution segmentation, dependencies, patches, upgrades, holding solutions, and solution layering concepts.

Identifies and resolves solution layer conflicts, customization precedence issues, and dependency chains across environments.

Analyses large Dynamics 365 implementations, identifies cross-solution dependencies, and decomposes monolithic solutions into modular deployment units to minimise risk.

Manages multi-team development environments, multiple release streams, feature branching strategies, hotfix releases, and parallel development approaches.

Source Control & Git Integration

Manages Azure Repos with branching strategies, pull request governance, and code review processes for Power Platform development.

Implements solution unpacking/packing using Power Platform Build Tools and PAC CLI, ensuring fully repository-based deployments with no manual production releases.

Deployment Automation

Designs and maintains CI/CD pipelines and release orchestration for environment promotion of Power Platform solutions.

Automates deployment of Dynamics 365 solutions, Power Apps, Power Pages, Power Automate flows, environment variables, and connection references.

Automates connection reference deployment and activation, environmentspecific configuration, post-deployment validation, and connector authentication handling.

Manages automated activation of Power Automate flows, environment migration, service account configuration, and deployment validation.

Master Data & Environment Configuration Deployment (Highly valued but not mandatory)

Deploys configuration data, reference data, lookup data, security configuration, and application configuration across environments.

Uses Configuration Migration Tool, PAC CLI, deployment settings files, KingswaySoft SSIS Integration Toolkit or other similar tools for deployment automation including .

Synchronises master data across environments, maintains DTAP consistency, automates configuration deployment, and prevents manual configuration drift.

Security & Access Management

Applies deep knowledge of Dynamics 365 security roles, teams, business units, field-level security, record ownership models, and hierarchical security.

Manages service principals, application users, non-interactive access, API authentication, and least-privilege access models.

Configures Power Pages web roles, table permissions, authentication providers, external user access, API security, and portal governance. (valued but not mandatory)

Conducts security reviews, designs least-privileged access solutions, troubleshoots access issues, and supports audit and compliance requirements.

Azure DevOps CI/CD Pipelines

Builds CI/CD pipelines from scratch for Power Platform deployments, optimises existing pipelines, troubleshoots deployment failures, and standardises deployment frameworks.

Integrates Power Platform pipelines with Azure AD, service principals, Key Vault, and monitoring platforms within Azure DevOps. (valued but not mandatory)

Azure Key Vault Integration (valued but not mandatory)

Manages secure credential storage, certificates, managed identities, and service principals via Azure Key Vault.

Implements Key Vault linked variable groups, secret rotation practices, and credential-free deployment approaches in CI/CD pipelines.

Automated Quality Controls (valued but not mandatory)

Creates automated pipelines for solution checker execution, code quality gates, dependency validation, deployment validation, security validation, and policy compliance checks.

Implements approval gates, deployment stage controls, segregation of duties, and release auditing.

Monitoring & Operations

Integrates deployments with Application Insights, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Power Platform Admin Centre monitoring.

Implements alerting mechanisms, deployment health monitoring, production diagnostics, audit reporting, and disaster recovery and environment restore management.

Agile Collaboration

Actively participates in SAFe Agile ceremonies, supporting backlog refinement, planning, and reviews.

Works with cross-functional teams including developers, analysts, and product owners to deliver governed, automated, and auditable Power Platform solutions.

Delivery mode: Remote from EU with occasional visits

Only Eu Citizens can apply

title: PR Account Director
descriptionHtml:
Consumer PR - Account Director
Large Beauty FMCG 

Department: Consumer PR & Influence 
Location: London 
Contract type: 12-Month FTC 
Full Time/Part time: Full Time 
Reporting into: Business Director 
 
 

About Ogilvy:  

Ogilvy UK has been creating iconic ideas that deliver impact at scale for clients ever since David Ogilvy founded the company in 1948. The agency specialises in bringing together brand advertising, customer experience marketing, PR, influence and consulting, all fueled by Behavioural Science. Our world-class award-winning creative campaigns deliver solutions for clients including Sainsbury’s, Lloyds Banking Group, Madri, Unilever and Mondelēz International. 

Ogilvy’s influencer marketing practice is the largest globally and the agency also hosts the world’s biggest festival of behavioural science and creativity, Nudgestock – which is now in its 12th year. James Murphy is the CEO of Ogilvy Group UK, which includes Ogilvy UK and New Commercial Arts (NCA), a boutique creative agency he co-founded in 2020, recently acquired by WPP. 
 
  

The Role:  
As Account Director, you'll champion "earned first" thinking to create impactful, culturally relevant consumer PR campaigns. You'll lead a team, build strong client relationships, and drive innovative strategies that generate buzz and deliver measurable results. This role is fun and energetic, offering great opportunities to learn and develop with a variety of complex but rewarding clients. You will be responsible for fostering a positive and collaborative work environment within the account management team, encouraging open communication and constructive feedback. You will manage relationships with third-party vendors, to ensure the agency delivers high-quality work that meets client expectations. You will also act as a liaison between the client and the agency's internal teams, providing clear communication and direction to ensure all parties are aligned on project goals and timelines. You can see opportunity in risk and you’re not afraid to be brave and challenge your clients to want to achieve a better result for all. 
  
 

Key Responsibilities:  

  • Inspire & Lead: Mentor a team to develop and execute breakthrough, "earned first" PR & Influence campaigns. 
  • Client Partnership: Build trusted advisor relationships with clients, understanding their business and anticipating their needs. Guide them across media and social communications. 
  • Creative Strategy: Collaborate with creative teams to develop compelling narratives and assets that resonate with target audiences. 
  • Data-Driven Optimization: Monitor campaign performance, leveraging data and analytics to optimize results and demonstrate ROI. 
  • Innovation & Trends: Stay ahead of industry trends, identifying new opportunities and approaches to enhance campaign effectiveness. 
  • Budget Management: Manage client budgets effectively, ensuring campaigns are delivered on time and within budget. 
  • New Business: Support new business efforts, participating in pitches and developing compelling proposals. 
  • Crisis Management: Develop and implement crisis management plans to protect client reputation. 
  • Inclusivity: Champion inclusiveness, diversity, and equity in all aspects of work. 

Requirements: 

  • Extensive experience in consumer PR and influence, with a proven track record of driving successful campaigns.

  • Interest and desire across beauty and FMCG projects

  • Share and use media knowledge to guide clients on what you believe is the best for their brand 
  • Deep understanding of consumer behavior and ability to develop creative strategies that resonate with target audiences. 
  • Demonstrated ability to think "earned first" and create campaigns that generate organic buzz. 
  • Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.  
  • Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. 
  • Data-driven mindset and analytical skills. 
  • Knowledge of industry trends and best practices. 
  • Experience in crisis management. 

  • Champion inclusiveness, diversity, and equity in all aspects of work.
     

How we help you Thrive: 

  •  25 days annual leave + 1 Volunteer Day   
  • Bupa Healthcare  
  • Enhanced Maternity, Adoption and Shared Parental Leave  
  • We have a Flexible Working Model with core working hours: 10am – 4pm  
  • A 1.5:1 Matching Pension Structure  
  • Wellbeing and Health: Up to £25.00 per month towards physical or online exercise class membership, Unmind membership, LifeWorks tool and annual eye tests and development budgets and Wellbeing incentives and activities throughout the year   
  • Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work Scheme  
  • Life Assurance  

Our ambition is to attract the very best diverse talent to Ogilvy, and to be the employer of choice in the UK. We want everyone to feel welcome when they join us, and once they’re here, for them to want to stay with us, grow their career, and to feel they belong with us.

We are an equal opportunity employer and we’re committed to creating an inclusive, welcoming environment for everyone who wants to work at Ogilvy. For us, diversity, equity and inclusion is integrated into everything that we do. We believe that for creativity to flourish, everything about how we work must have diversity at its core. Your race, colour, ethnic, religion, gender, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, have no bearing on our hiring decisions, but we encourage everyone to feel free to express their true selves in an environment we are consistently striving to make as inclusive as possible.

We aim to facilitate an accessible and positive application experience for all candidates. If you require any adjustments from us to support you through the process or expect to require any adjustments to working conditions to be able to best perform in the role, please let us know. We are happy to consider all reasonable adjustments.

If you live with a disability and you would like to take advantage of our offer of a guaranteed interview under the Disability Confident Scheme, please ensure you fill out our voluntary Equal Opportunities Questionnaire when applying.

descriptionHtml:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:
This role offers the opportunity to develop under the guidance of some of the best in the industry and gain first-hand experience working on high-profile international brands. The experience of the 20+ team enables us to deliver integrated communications, from corporate, B2B and consumer communications, to digital & social, influencers, analyst relations, content marketing and public affairs. We understand technology ecosystems, consumer and business audiences, and the power of the influencer.  

Having a passion for technology is essential for this role as you will be working with several of the world’s leading technology brands. We believe that technology has the power to enhance human experience and performance as we enter a new era of intelligence. Whether it’s the latest enterprise software or the hottest consumer device, as we progress into a new era defined by the advancements in AI, it’s crucial we continue to tell human-first stories. 

The team is looking to recruit an Account Executive to work with some of its leading global technology brands (opportunities to work for B2B and consumer). The role involves working on media relations, network coordination and account management to reach primarily B2B audiences. 

What you'll do:

  • Supporting on day-to-day media liaison, developing solid media relationships and managing media requests and product reviews 
  • Developing press materials, from press releases and blogs to Q&As and briefing documents, with a high level of attention to detail 
  • Handling junior client relationships, developing a strong rapport with your day-to-day contact 
  • Overseeing the creation of coverage and activity reports for clients   
  • Managing press briefings, product launches, conferences and similar events for clients 
  • Attending and contributing ideas in internal brainstorms, contributing to generating creative ideas in response to client briefs 
  • Monitoring and keeping abreast of relevant industry news to build an understanding of industry trends, competitive landscape and how they impact clients 

Experience that contributes to success:

  • A positive and proactive attitude to seeking out opportunities to add value to clients and teams 
  • A fan of technology that enhances human progress, with an understanding of the consumer technology market, who is excited by its future within society and business 
  • Experience in the technology and/or telecoms sectors – ideally both, but technology experience is a must 
  • A media hound and storyteller who loves to craft compelling pitches and knows how to sell them to business, trade and national media 
  • A global outlook, with the ability to transfer skills across both UK and global client work 
  • Organisational skills and the ability to tightly manage relationships with international Burson offices 
  • Attention to detail and an appreciation of time management 

Burson UK was named Cannes Lions Agency of the year 2026!

#LI-CY1

You belong at Burson:

title: PR & Communications Manager - Germany
descriptionHtml:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Role Overview

Cohere has a strong AI narrative, the most deployable product, and a CEO who co-authored the foundational paper of modern AI. Following its recent partnership with Aleph Alpha, the company is positioned to become the transatlantic leader in sovereign AI for enterprise and government, and needs a storytelling engine to deliver that story at scale. This role sits within the team that is building that engine.

In this cross functional role, you will stand up our PR and Communications function in the German market. You'll partner with the Global Corporate Communications team and EMEA Communications team to create a regional communication plan that fuels our growth among governments and enterprises in the most highly-regulated industries across DACH. You’ll nurture how we talk to customers, partners, and employees, ensuring that the corporate message resonates culturally for the German market and its audiences.

This is a rare opportunity to build a comprehensive German PR function at a fast-growing company in the most dynamic space in technology. This is a role for someone who likes to take big swings – and have fun doing it – where no job is too big or too small.

Key Responsibilities

As the Communications Manager for Germany, you will:

  • Own and drive Cohere’s German communications strategy, aligning corporate priorities, business objectives, product innovation, executive visibility and technical differentiation to strengthen the company’s reputation in Germany

  • Translate Cohere’s innovations and customer success stories into compelling, locally relevant narratives for German-speaking audiences

  • Lead proactive media engagement and newsjacking opportunities in close collaboration with EMEA Communications and EMEA Government Affairs, capitalising on relevant industry and policy developments to amplify Cohere’s voice

  • Elevate the profile and influence of Cohere’s German leadership and spokespeople by partnering with Executive Communications to develop strategic messaging, thought leadership, media opportunities and executive visibility programmes, including for the German Country Manager.

  • Strengthen Cohere’s reputation through customer- and partner-led storytelling, working closely with Partner Marketing to showcase German customer outcomes, deepen strategic relationships and amplify the impact of Cohere’s ecosystem in the local market.

  • Lead and coordinate German crisis and issues communications, partnering with Corporate Communications and relevant local and regional teams to anticipate reputational risks, develop response strategies and ensure clear and timely communications.

Qualifications

  • Have 7-10 years of experience in B2B communications in DACH, or technical content, ideally in AI, enterprise software, or developer‑focused environments

  • Have a talent for translating complex topics into different languages without losing nuance

  • Are experienced at managing PR agencies in the German market

  • Have experience and/or heavy interest in policy and regulatory communications, particularly within the German/EU regulatory environment

  • Have experience running communications strategies for the DACH region

  • Are highly organized and detail‑oriented with strong project management skills and a bias for action

  • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and thrive in fast‑moving, high‑growth environments

  • Build strong cross‑functional relationships to drive clarity, consistency, and alignment across teams

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks:

  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

  • Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

  • Annual enrichment benefits:

    Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

    Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:

  • Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

  • For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

  • For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

  • Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs.

descriptionHtml:
Über uns

Über 5 Millionen Menschen in Deutschland sind pflegebedürftig, und jedes Jahr werden es mehr. Ihnen stehen Leistungen zu, die oft nie ankommen, weil Formulare, Zuständigkeiten und Behördensprache dazwischenstehen.

Jeden Fall einzeln zu prüfen und bis zur Entscheidung zu begleiten, war bisher zu aufwendig. Mit KI geht das zum ersten Mal für viele Familien gleichzeitig. Genau das macht Decari: Wir prüfen, welche Leistungen infrage kommen, etwa ein höherer Pflegegrad, Hilfe zur Pflege oder Eingliederungshilfe, und begleiten die Anträge bis zur Entscheidung. Pflegedienste in mehreren Bundesländern arbeiten bereits mit uns. Unser Ziel: Jede Familie in Deutschland bekommt die Pflegeleistungen, die ihr zusteht.

Wir sind ein kleines, AI-natives Team mit Erfahrung aus der Versicherungs- und Pflegebranche. Wir waren frühe Mitarbeiter in Startups, die von Sequoia, Accel, Index Ventures und Y Combinator finanziert wurden und zusammen über 100 Mio. Euro eingesammelt haben. Neue Ideen testen wir erst einfach und von Hand, was funktioniert, automatisieren wir, und unsere Abläufe ändern wir jede Woche, manchmal täglich. Wir übernehmen Ownership und haben wenig Ego.

Deine Rolle

In dieser Rolle baust du Decari mit uns auf. Du arbeitest direkt mit Julien (Operations) und den Gründern und bist operativ und taktisch mittendrin: Du sprichst jeden Tag mit Familien und Pflegediensten, siehst, wo es hakt, und gestaltest den Prozess aktiv mit. Das geht als Pflichtpraktikum oder als Werkstudent:in (bis 20 Stunden pro Woche, tagsüber). Du suchst ein anderes Modell? Sprich uns an.

Berlin, hybrid: im Praktikum mindestens 4 Tage pro Woche im Office, als Werkstudent:in mindestens 2. Start ab sofort, für mindestens 6 Monate, bezahlt, danach ist eine Festanstellung möglich.

Was du machst

  • Du bist der erste Kontakt der Familien zu Decari und verbringst den größten Teil deines Tages am Telefon. Im Gespräch findest du heraus, ob und wie wir helfen können.

  • Du bringst Fälle ins Ziel. Aus einem guten Gespräch machst du einen vollständigen Fall und bleibst dran, bis alles da ist, was wir für den Antrag brauchen.

  • Du betreust unsere Pflegedienste mit. Für sie bist du die erste Ansprechperson zu ihren Familien.

  • Du verbesserst den Funnel. Du kennst die Zahlen von der Anfrage bis zum Antrag, bringst Ideen ein und testest sie direkt.

  • Du baust mit uns Automatisierungen. Was wir oft genug von Hand gemacht haben, übernimmt danach die KI.

Du passt gut zu uns, wenn

  • Du gern telefonierst, auch 50 Mal am Tag, und dich eine Mailbox oder ein Nein nicht aus dem Takt bringt

  • Du gut zuhörst, empathisch bist und schnell und fehlerfrei schreibst

  • Du anpackst und dir für unglamouröse Arbeit nicht zu schade bist

  • Du Ownership übernimmst: Dinge jetzt erledigst, die einfachste Lösung suchst und selbst einen Weg findest, wenn du feststeckst

  • Du KI im Alltag nutzt und neue Tools schnell lernst

  • Du sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift besitzt (C1), weil du täglich mit Familien telefonierst und diese berätst. Eine weitere Sprache wie Polnisch, Türkisch, Russisch oder Arabisch ist ein Plus

  • Du studierst und suchst ein Pflichtpraktikum oder einen Werkstudentenjob, zum Beispiel in BWL, Gesundheitsmanagement, Sozialer Arbeit oder Jura.

  • Du schon Kundenkontakt hattest, etwa im Nebenjob, in einem Praktikum oder in einem eigenen Projekt

Eher nichts für dich, wenn

  • Du nicht gern telefonierst

  • Du noch nie mit KI- oder Automatisierungstools gearbeitet hast oder dir technisches Grundverständnis fehlt

  • Du nur „strategisch“ arbeiten willst

descriptionHtml:
Was wir tun
"Eine enkeltaugliche Welt hinterlassen"

Mit dieser Zielsetzung hat sich VISPIRON ENERGY eine strategische Position im Zukunftsmarkt der erneuerbaren Energien erarbeitet. Das ursprünglich auf Photovoltaikparks spezialisierte Unternehmen legte im Jahr 2017 den Fokus auf die Vernetzung regenerativer Energiesysteme und konzipierte das Ökosystem ENERGY WORLD. Regenerative Energieerzeuger, Verbraucher, Speicher und Hochleistungsladesäulen werden in diesem Ökosystem vernetzt und intelligent bewirtschaftet. Wir decken die Wertschöpfungskette von der Projektstrukturierung über den Anlagenbau bis hin zur Energievermarktung, zum Kapazitätshandel und zur Betriebsführung ab.

Hierzu arbeiten die hochspezialisierten Unternehmen VISPIRON ENERGY, VISPIRON EPC und SEtrade als Einheit zusammen und decken die Wertschöpfungskette von der Projektstrukturierung über den Anlagenbau bis hin zur Energievermarktung, zum Kapazitätshandel und zur Betriebsführung ab.

Sind wir ein Match?

Du

  • hilfst gern Menschen und liebst Tools, die den Alltag leichter machen.
  • Vertraulichkeit ist für dich kein Buzzword: Du bewahrst Geheimnisse, statt sie zu erzählen.
  • organisierst und optimierst gern: To‑dos, Termine, Unterlagen bringst du in Ordnung.
  • kommunizierst offen und freundlich: Faire und wertschätzende Personalarbeit ist für dich eine Selbstverständlichkeit.hast Lust, die Energiewende mit uns voranzubringen.

Wir

  • arbeiten seit 20 Jahren täglich daran, die Abhängigkeit von fossilen Energieträgern zu beenden.
  • wollen eine enkeltaugliche Welt hinterlassen.
  • glauben an das Potential unserer Mitarbeiter:innen.
  • sind Pioniere und haben neue Technologien entwickelt.
  • sind neugierig, leben eine offene Fehlerkultur und teilen unser Wissen.
  • setzen innovative Geschäftsmodelle nachhaltig um.

Aufgaben

Job Results (Aufgaben)

  • Personio HR Core zum Herzstück machen

Erkunde die Möglichkeiten, die dieses Tool bietet, und mach Personio zu deinem Projekt! Du konzentrierst dich zunächst voll und ganz darauf, das Maximum an Effizienz aus dem Tool herauszuholen. Dafür überführst du fehlende Mitarbeiterdaten aus dem Altsystem, prüfst und ergänzt Felder und schaffst eine saubere Datenbasis. Du erstellst praxistaugliche Vorlagen (z. B. Onboarding-Checklisten, Bestätigungen und Verträge) und konfigurierst Workflows, Reports, Berechtigungen sowie Abwesenheiten sinnvoll. Dein Know-how hältst du in verständlichen Tipps & Tricks fest und bereitest kurze How-tos für HR und Teamleads auf. Ziel: Personio ist zu 100 % nutzbar, spart spürbar Zeit im Tagesgeschäft und macht unsere HR-Prozesse transparent.

  • Mein GPT als perfekter HR-Helfer

Du setzt „Mein GPT“ gezielt für HR ein und baust eine digitale HR-Assistenz auf. Dafür entwickelst du klare Prompts für wiederkehrende Aufgaben, optimierst Vorlagen wie Stellenausschreibungen, E-Mails und Onboarding-Informationen und sorgst so für schnellere und konsistente Ergebnisse. Dabei behältst du die Qualität im Blick: Du prüfst Inhalte sorgfältig, achtest auf eine passende Tonalität und stellst sicher, dass Datenschutz und Vertraulichkeit jederzeit eingehalten werden.
Ziel: KI unterstützt unser HR-Team sinnvoll im Arbeitsalltag und schafft mehr Zeit für die Themen, die wirklich zählen.

  • Kommunikation & Employer Branding mitgestalten

Zeig, wer wir als Arbeitgeber sind, und gestalte unsere Kommunikation aktiv mit. Du unterstützt sowohl die interne als auch die externe Kommunikation, entwickelst Inhalte für unseren Social-Media-Auftritt und unsere Karrierewebsite und erstellst ansprechende Grafiken und Materialien mit Tools wie Canva. Außerdem wirkst du bei internen wie externen Veranstaltungen mit und bringst deine Ideen ein, um unsere Arbeitgebermarke weiterzuentwickeln. Ziel: Unsere Kommunikation ist fair, transparent und sorgt dafür, dass wir intern wie extern weiterhin als attraktiver Arbeitgeber wahrgenommen werden.

Qualifikation

Deine Kompetenzen

  • Background: Laufendes Studium im Bereich Personal/HR, Psychologie, Sozial- oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder vergleichbar. Wichtig ist dein echtes Interesse an People-Themen und Prozessen.

  • Persönlichkeit: Neugierig, teamorientiert, hilfsbereit und vertrauenswürdig. Du hörst zu, fragst nach und willst Kolleg:innenwirklich weiterhelfen. Diskretion ist für dich selbstverständlich.

  • IT & Tools: Sicher im Umgang mit MS Office. Große Lust, Personio tief zu verstehen und hands-on zu konfigurieren. Affinität zu KI-Tools (z. B. „Mein GPT“) und Spaß daran, effiziente Prompts und kleine Automatisierungen zu bauen.

  • Kommunikation: Klar in Wort und Schrift, sehr gutes Deutsch; gutes Englisch von Vorteil. Du formulierst adressatengerecht — von kurzen Mails und Anleitungen bis zu Karriereweb-Texten.

  • Kreativität & Branding: Freude an Employer Branding und Content wie z. B. smarte Social-Media- Posts, Bilder/Slides mit Canva, authentische Firmeneinblicke auf unserer Karriereseite.

  • Organisations- und Prozesssinn: Du denkst in sauberen Daten, sinnvollen Feldern und schlanken Workflows. Qualitätssicherung und Datenschutz behältst du im Blick.

  • Verfügbarkeit: Du hast 5-6 Monate Zeit um im Rahmen eines Hochschulpraktikums dein erlerntes Wissen einzusetzen

  • Plus: Erste HR-Erfahrung (Praktika/Werkstudent), Organisation/Projektaufgaben oder Marketing/ Employer Branding.

Benefits

Was wir dir bieten

  • Wirkung: Du trägst aktiv dazu bei, dass Projekte wie unser Energiepark Egling Realität werden – und damit zur Energiewende und zu einer enkeltauglichen Zukunft.
  • Team & Kultur: Sei du selbst und wachse mit uns (Wissenstransfer). Du wirst von einem freundlichen und leistungsstarken Team aus Energieexpertinnen und Experten mit langjähriger Unternehmenszugehörigkeit herzlich empfangen, die ihr tiefes akademisches und praktisches Wissen gerne teilen.
  • Arbeitsumgebung: Wir pflegen eine offene Arbeitskultur, in der Ideen und Initiativen gefördert werden.
  • Wir bieten dir einen modernen Arbeitsplatz mit betriebsinterner Kantine und Barista
  • Der Umwelt zuliebe stellen wir eine Fahrradinfrastruktur für alle Mitarbeiter und Mitarbeiterinnen zur Verfügung (Dusche, überdachte Stellplätze & Werkstatt).
  • Benefits: Du bekommst Zugang zu unserem Firmen-Carsharing (Pkw, E-Bike, E-Autos), frisches Obst, Bezuschussung zum Essen in der Kantine, MVV-Zuschuss, Tischtennisplatte und Kicker. Die Poolfahrzeuge können auch privat genutzt werden.
  • Teambuilding: Du kannst an regelmäßigen Firmenveranstaltungen wie Kick Off, Sommerfest, Grillen im Sommer, Wiesn, Eisstockschießen und Weihnachtsfeier teilnehmen.
  • Standort: Unser Büro befindet sich in München und ist öffentlich gut erreichbar.

Warum brauchen wir dich im Team?

Unser Wachstum entsteht durch Menschen, die gerne hier arbeiten. Mit deiner Art hältst du diese Energie hoch: Du bis Teil eines fairen, effizienten und verlässlichen HR, damit Recruiting rund läuft, Onboarding wirklich ankommt und Prozesse einfach funktionieren. So bleibt unser Kununu‑Score  von 4,6 kein Zufall. Vor allem schaffst du eines: mehr Zeit für das, was zählt — Menschen.

Wenn du Freude daran hast, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Strukturen zu schaffen und mit Weitblick zu handeln, trägst du in dieser Rolle maßgeblich zum Erfolg unserer Mission – eine enkeltaugliche Welt hinterlassen – bei.

title: Praktikum Junior Community Management & Customer Engagement
descriptionHtml:

title: Pre-Sales Engineer - Energy Retail
descriptionHtml:
Location: London or Bristol, UK (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Level: Senior Engineer C3

Team: Growth

Salary: £60,000 - £75,000 + discretionary bonus

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: Head of Sales Engineering

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.


About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you’ll do

As a Pre-Sales Engineer, you are a trusted technical contributor within our team, helping deliver impactful sales engagements through configuration and development in our demo environments. You’ll play a contributor role to larger deals, and often lead pre-sales activities for smaller or less complex opportunities. You are a key part of the commercial engine, helping us scale by ensuring our technical pre-sales efforts are thorough, accurate, and client-focused.

This role will report to the Head of Demo Engineering and you’ll be part of a team that works on sales to Kaluza’s largest clients globally. You will have broad expertise on Kaluza’s product suite and our value differentiators and will develop depth in particular areas of our products. You will have a good understanding of the challenges facing energy retailers from a client or user perspective and be able to show-case how our solutions solve them.. 

You will play a crucial role in building product demonstrations and collateral that evangelises the Kaluza platform.

  • Own and deliver demo activities for small to mid-size opportunities, especially during high team capacity periods. This includes configuring and delivering tailored product demonstrations and responding to client technical questions with clarity and confidence.

  • Support technical delivery on complex deals, working alongside senior team members to prepare solution configurations, contribute to discovery conversations, and ensure client requirements are well captured and translated.

  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering teams to scope solutions, validate feasibility, and communicate trade-offs in a clear and client-friendly manner.

  • Lead or contribute to proof-of-concept (PoC) projects, ensuring they reflect client needs and demonstrate our platform’s ability to deliver measurable outcomes. Track PoC success criteria and highlight risks or gaps to the wider team.

  • Represent the Pre-Sales function in internal planning and alignment sessions, helping ensure technical accuracy, smooth handovers, and clear documentation for post-sale teams.

  • Document and share learnings from client engagements, including product feedback, recurring questions, and potential areas for improvement in our pre-sales approach or demo assets.


What you’ll bring 

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Software development experience in a regulated industry using TypeScript, with a track record of designing and building complex solutions to customer problems

  • Experience architecting solutions on AWS, knowing which technologies to use when and the trade-offs involved

  • Confidence working with and explaining event-driven architectures and asynchronous APIs

  • Experience in a commercial or client-facing technical role, ideally selling SaaS in a regulated industry, with examples of adapting a solution to meet a customer’s unique needs

  • The ability to distil complex concepts into clear, simple points, and to work through differing opinions with empathy

  • Comfort working autonomously across multiple opportunities, handling ambiguity and knowing which data to use to measure success

An interest in renewable energy and the challenges facing energy retailers will help you hit the ground running.

Tech stack: TypeScript, AWS, event-driven architectures, asynchronous APIs


Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.


Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app


Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.
