title: Process / Production Engineer (Equipment Design)
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Process / Production Engineer to design the hardware that turns our process into a repeatable, scalable production line. As hardware designer, you will develop the equipment, tooling and fixtures for dosing, mixing, casting, curing and demolding of solid rocket motors, and take them from concept to installed machines.

Good production equipment starts with a good process understanding. You will work at the interface between process engineering, mechanical design and the shop floor, and your designs will decide how fast, how safe and how reliable our production becomes.

About us

We're a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications. We are building our first production facility in Steyerberg, Lower Saxony, and are applying our knowledge toward serial production of solid rocket motors.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you're excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you're ready to rise to the challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop process equipment concepts for dosing, vacuum mixing, vacuum casting, curing and demolding, from requirement definition to detailed design.

  • Design tooling, mandrels, carriers, transport boxes and fixtures for motor casings and containers, with a focus on manufacturability and safe handling.

  • Translate process parameters (pot life, mixing profiles, vacuum levels, flow behaviour) into equipment specifications and design requirements.

  • Create release-quality 3D models, assemblies, drawings and tolerances, and maintain the CAD baseline.

  • Lead design reviews, FMEA and risk assessments together with process safety and quality assurance, and close design-related non-conformances.

  • Work with suppliers and the workshop to build, install and commission equipment, and support process validation and trials.

  • Improve equipment throughput, uptime and cost as we move from pilot to series production.

What we are looking for

  • A degree in mechanical engineering, process engineering or a related discipline.

  • Strong CAD skills (ideally Siemens NX) with clean modelling practice and accurate drawings.

  • Working knowledge of process engineering fundamentals.

  • Experience with design for manufacturability and production ramp-up.

  • Familiarity with FMEA and structured risk assessment.

  • Fluent English. German is an advantage.

Desirable experience

  • Several years of hardware design experience in process equipment, machinery, or a comparable process industry (chemical, pharmaceutical, food or similar).

  • Handling of energetic materials, powders or pastes (dust, compaction, electrostatics, pot life).

  • Knowledge of explosion protection (Directive 2014/34/EU, TRGS 720 ff.), pressure equipment (Directive 2014/68/EU) or hazardous-materials handling.

  • FEA or CFD for equipment design.

  • Process simulation or material-flow simulation.

  • Experience building production capability in a startup or scale-up environment.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

  • Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

Please submit applications in English

As Procurement & Supply Chain Lead, you will own the purchasing and supply chain for the materials, equipment, parts and services that keep our prototype, pilot and volume production on track – from negotiating with suppliers to coordinating with contract manufacturers and logistics partners. You will partner closely with Engineering to translate technical requirements into sourcing decisions, and help build our purchasing processes as we scale.

This role is for you if you’ve negotiated with component suppliers yourself, like being hands-on, and enjoy building processes rather than following them – ideally with experience buying electronic components for B2B hardware such as power electronics, industrial equipment or automation systems. It isn’t for you if you prefer managing a team, require an established ERP and approval chain to work well, or a clearly defined, stable scope. It would not be a fit if your procurement background is mainly consumer goods, retail or indirect spend without hands-on exposure to electronic components.

What you will do

  • Contract and purchase raw materials, equipment, tools, parts, services and supplies needed for prototype, pilot and volume production.

  • Negotiate pricing, terms and delivery schedules with suppliers for critical components – power semiconductors, magnetics, PCBs, and mechanical/enclosure parts.

  • Issue and manage purchase orders; track order status and expedite as needed to meet production schedules.

  • Source and coordinate with suppliers and contract manufacturers (EMS, PCB vendors, logistics partners) on order status, lead times and quality issues.

  • Work closely with Engineering to understand technical requirements, communicate them clearly to suppliers, and identify alternate sourcing options for critical or long-lead-time components.

  • Support supplier qualification and specification compliance for new and existing vendors.

  • Maintain purchasing records, the Bill of Materials (BOM) and sourcing data; track lead times, inventory levels and supplier performance, and flag supply chain risks.

  • Drive logistics and inbound/outbound shipments together with our logistics partners.

  • Scale the supplier base and purchasing processes as we move from Alpha Customer readiness to Production and Volume Readiness.

What you bring

  • BSc in supply chain management, business administration, engineering or comparable education, or equivalent experience.

  • Several years of hands-on experience in procurement, purchasing or supply chain, specifically in electronics or hardware manufacturing.

  • Strong negotiation skills; track record of managing supplier contracts and pricing.

  • Specific experience sourcing electronic or mechanical components (semiconductors, PCBs, magnetics, enclosures); experience with contract manufacturers (EMS) is a plus.

  • Organised and detail-oriented, comfortable managing multiple supplier relationships.

  • Team player, comfortable working cross-functionally with Engineering and Operations in a fast-paced start-up environment with evolving priorities.

  • Fluent in English, spoken and written; German language skills helpful, but not mandatory.

What we offer

  • Equity + competitive salary.

  • Unique technology and market opportunity – validated prototype and first paying customers on the path to volume shipments.

  • Hybrid work with flexible working times.

descriptionHtml:

Where 50 Billion Daily Predictions Begin

The User Experience team is the origin point of adjoe Ads. Everything the system knows about a user, every prediction the ML models make, every bid placed in an auction. It all starts with code this team ships.

The team owns two responsibilities. On the SDK side, a native Kotlin and Swift code runs inside hundreds of publisher apps. 🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

What’s in It for You?

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

title: Product Certification Engineer, Fuel Cell Systems
descriptionHtml:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

     

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

     

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

     

Start date: Immediately

We’re looking for a world-class product designer who’s obsessed with craft & excited about AI. You’ll join +60 builders shipping one of Europe’s biggest consumer AI products, shaping how millions of students learn.

Why Knowunity?

We're building the #1 AI learning companion for 1 billion students. A future where every student on the planet can access, enjoy & benefit from the highest quality education. Since founding Knowunity straight out of high school in 2020, we've been committed to revolutionising how students learn.

Millions of students already use our AI learning companion weekly. We just raised €27m - Europe’s largest education round in the past three years. The AI learning market is at an inflection point, finally enabling true personalisation at scale, and we're determined to build the first AI learning unicorn in this space.

You will join an elite team of +60 hands-on builders serving 1 billion students worldwide. If we execute on our product vision, you will have built something generational that transforms education globally. This is your chance to build a generational company that shapes how an entire generation learns.

Why now?

Design is the single highest-leverage investment at Knowunity right now. You’ll be at the center of that shift.

We’ve built a product millions of students love, powered by an engineering team that ships & learns extraordinarily fast. Now we’re going all-in on craft. The kind of UI excellence, motion design, and systematic thinking that turns a loved product into a world-class one.
We just brought on a new Head of Design. We’re building a design system from the ground up. And we’re working with Ragged Edge (the agency behind the Transferwise & Granola rebrands) on a major brand evolution.

You won’t be maintaining someone else’s vision. You’ll be shaping it from the start.

Who you are

Your portfolio matters more than your years of experience. Show us work that moved metrics & delighted users:

  • Craft-obsessed: The details are the design. You push back until the bar is raised.

  • AI enthusiast: From prototyping to research to shipping. You see AI tools as a multiplier, not a threat.

  • Systems thinker: You care about scaling quality across a product, not a pretty Figma library. Code-first design systems, AI-powered design reviews, whatever works at speed & scale.

  • Simplifier: Education is messy. AI is unpredictable. You turn complicated user journeys into experiences that feel obvious.

  • Biased to action: You move fast by default. Prototypes over presentations, experiments over endless debate.

  • Builder: You like getting your hands dirty. Bonus if you’ve shipped a side project end to end, or opened a merge request.

  • Team-first: Direct feedback, no preciousness, no territory. Engineers prototyping features? More builders means better outcomes.

  • Curious: New tools, new patterns, new ways of thinking. You stay up to date & experiment continuously because you want to, not because someone told you to.

What you'll do

Raise the bar on everything students see, touch & feel. Make the Knowunity product undeniably world-class.

  • Set the standard: UIs students want to screenshot & details they feel, but can’t name. Your work is the reference point.

  • Scale it: Curated references, stellar components & sharp reviews. Make it easy even for vibe-coding PMs to hit the standard.

  • Pioneer AI-native design: AI changes how we research, ideate, ship, as well as what we ship. You’ll figure out both, from AI-assisted workflows to AI-native product experiences.

  • Idea to production, fast: Work directly with C-level & engineering. Concept on Monday, shipped on Wednesday, live for a million students on Thursday.

What we offer

Not for everyone. Everything for the right ones:

  • Impact at scale: Your work reaches millions of students daily. Future generations will know what you build.

  • Elite team, real ownership: +60 exceptional people. Direct access to C-level & founders. You own entire areas from conception to delivery.

  • Compensation & equity: Competitive salary paired with meaningful equity in a company with genuine unicorn potential.

  • Benefits: 28 days annual leave, 40 days work from anywhere, personal development budget, mental health support, Urban Sports Club, monthly retail vouchers, team & company events.

Next steps

  2. 5 minute Loom: walk us through something you’re proud of. A feature you shipped, an app you vibe-coded. Your pick.

  3. Deep-dive call: Unpack your Loom case with our head of design/CPO, discuss your experience & perspective.

  4. On-site day: Meet our CEO, CPO & the team. Work together, get a real feel for the culture. We’ll cover travel.

title: Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

We are growing our product design team and looking for an experienced mobile designer to expand features on our Android and iOS apps. You will have the opportunity to make financial services more accessible and inclusive for millions of people through working with thoughtful product managers, researchers, and engineers!

In this role, you'll:

  • Work closely with product managers, user researchers, engineers, and data analysts from the start to end of a feature.
  • Create high quality designs, interactions, and prototypes to explore ideas in service of the best solution for the project (Wave uses Figma).
  • Craft user research plans and work directly with our user researchers to identify problems and validate solutions in user testing.
  • Contribute to Wave's design system and component library.
  • Talk to customers and find solutions to their problems by thinking critically from their perspective.
  • Communicate the reasoning behind your product decisions in review sessions and in conversation with PMs.
  • Prototype visual and UX concepts and iterate towards the right solution (Wave uses Claude for mobile prototyping with Android apks).

Key details

  • This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our hiring hubs (US, UK, Spain, Kenya, Ghana, Canada) or in one of our operating markets in Africa, including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, and Burkina Faso.
  • You'll travel to one of our key markets for a 1 week immersion trip with your immediate team (Wave covers all costs). Outside of this 1 week immersion, you'll also travel to a market country with our product design lead and PMs, for a total of travel 2x a year. You're highly encouraged to visit market counties more often! We also provide a yearly stipend of $1,200 USD to meet with coworkers every year.
  • Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, we are offering a salary of up to $187,000 USD based on your location (paid in your local currency equivalent), plus a generous equity package.
  • Major benefits:
    • Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country)
    • 6 months fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance
    • Unlimited vacation with a 20-day minimum requirement, with most folks taking between 21-30 days exclusive of statutory holidays
    • $10,000 annual charitable donation matching

Requirements

  • Experience with low and high-fidelity design & prototyping with LLMs on Android mobile apps
  • Fluency in English. French language skills are a plus.
  • At least 6 years of end-to-end in-house experience, with a consumer focus on product design with mobile apps.

  • Exposure to designing AI-powered experiences (e.g., conversational interfaces, intelligent assistants, contextual recommendations, or generative AI features).

  • Basic understanding of HTML/CSS and how design decisions translate into technical implementation.

  • Familiarity with web accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1+) and inclusive design practices.

  • Experience in enterprise SaaS, financial systems, business planning software, or complex B2B solutions.

  • Experience operating within Agile, cross-functional product teams.

Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to shape the future of enterprise software at a pivotal moment for Anaplan. You’ll join a collaborative team of talented designers and researchers working on products trusted by many of the world's leading organizations.

You’ll have the opportunity to solve complex design challenges, influence product direction, and grow your career in a culture that values curiosity, collaboration, design excellence, and continuous learning. Whether you're refining core workflows or exploring the frontiers of AI-driven planning, your work will make a measurable impact on thousands of businesses across the globe.

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. Design decisions depend on information that lives outside the CAD model: customer requirements, design rules, manufacturing and assembly constraints, and cost targets. This information is spread across specification documents, handbooks, ERP systems, requirements management tools, and system models. Engineers gather it by hand, often late in the process, and conflicts surface at design reviews or on the production line.

We call the capability that closes this gap Design Engineering Knowledge. It connects the design to the information ecosystem around it, so requirements, constraints, and trade-offs are available to engineers and AI agents while they work on the design itself.

As a Product Engineer, you will build this capability. Requirements are the first focus area: extracting them from customer specifications and requirements management systems, structuring them, and keeping them traceable. You will then extend the same foundation to design rule checks, Design for Manufacturing (DfM), Design for Assembly (DfA), and Design for Cost, and connect it to the enterprise systems where this knowledge already lives.

You will work with the Product Manager, solution engineers, and customer engineering teams, as the primary developer from the first customer conversation to the version running in production.

What you will do

  • Build the requirements foundation: ingest customer specifications and RFQ packages, extract requirements with LLM and agent-based pipelines, and keep each one traceable to its source document and page.

  • Extend this foundation to design rules, DfM, DfA, and Design for Cost, turning standards, handbooks, and company know-how into constraints that software and agents can use.

  • Bring requirements, constraints, and trade-offs into the design workflow, so engineers can check a design against them at any stage and see which ones apply to the part they are working on.

  • Build integrations with the systems around the design: requirements management systems, ERP (cost, materials, and supplier data), and system design and MBSE tools for architecture and system-level requirements.

  • Design the data model that links requirements, rules, and constraints to parts, design parameters, and simulation results.

  • Create evaluation sets and quality metrics with customers, so extraction and checking accuracy is measured and improves with every release.

  • Design human-in-the-loop review flows where engineers validate and edit AI output, with versioning and a full audit trail.

  • Spot recurring patterns across customers and turn them into reusable components of the Neural Concept platform.

Who you are

Must have

  • Experience building and shipping production Python software in fast-moving, cross-functional teams.

  • Hands-on experience with LLM applications in production: structured outputs, retrieval-augmented generation, agents, and evaluation.

  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems through APIs and data models, for example ERP, PLM, or requirements management tools.

  • Experience with document processing, such as PDF parsing, OCR, or information extraction.

  • Strong software practices: testing (pytest), CI, packaging, code review, and git.

  • A product mindset. You talk to users, understand the problem before writing code, and ship in small, measurable steps.

  • Clear, concise communication with both customer engineers and internal teams.

  • Based in Cambridge (UK) or willing to relocate.

Nice to have

  • Background in mechanical engineering or physics, with exposure to DfM, DfA, or design-to-cost practices.

  • Familiarity with requirements engineering and model-based systems engineering (MBSE, SysML).

  • Experience working with CAD data or geometry processing.

  • Experience with vision-language models, vector databases, or search ranking.

What you get

  • Ownership of a product capability that customers use in real engineering programs, with direct access to the engineers who use it.

  • A competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we continue to scale.

  • A collaborative, multicultural team where your work is visible and recognized.

  • Colleagues who share knowledge freely and support each other.

  • A hybrid model and flexible hours. We focus on results and trust you to organize your time.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

title: Product Integration Engineer, Defence
descriptionHtml:
We're looking for a Product Integration Engineer to develop and prove out our products with military customers, starting with the Field Operator HUD (FOH): a head-mounted, always-on visual intelligence system built from Distance hardware, a HUD operating system and AI-assisted data processing that pulls sensor, feeds and command-and-control into the operator's field of view. Your job is to make it work on a specific customer's platform, in the field, not just on a bench, as part of our core R&D team. If you're a hands-on generalist who knows VR or XR and would rather be where the tech meets the user than stuck at a desk, this one's for you.

WHY DISTANCE?

At Distance Technologies, the problem we're solving is simple to state and hard to solve: the amount of data in the world is endless, but human capacity is not. We are building a fundamentally new perception layer between humans and machines, transforming transparent surfaces into interfaces unlike the world has ever seen. Think of the windscreen of a car, the visor of a helmet, or a sight device, each becoming a new front-end for AI. The way we turn bits and atoms into expanded human perception is protected by over 50 granted international patent families. We build it for two demanding worlds: defence and automotive. And we build it from a single foundation fusing software, hardware and computational optics.

There are 60 of us today, with decades-long experience building world's best products, optics, and open-source operating systems. We partner and build with globally leading companies like KIA, Supacat, and Galvion, and we were Google Ventures' first investment in Finland.

THE ROLE

The FOH is already in field trials with military users. Your first project is getting it working with British Army equipment and defence primes, building the integration around what the customer actually needs. As our product line grows you'll take on a widening set of customer integrations across our defence work, each one a different platform, stack and set of interfaces.

Your core responsibilities include:

  • Owning customer integrations end to end. Make the FOH work inside a customer's platform: adapt the software, wire it into their sensors, displays, video and connectivity, and get it demo- and trial-ready. Prototype fast in dedicated environments to prove value with a client before it hits the shared codebase.

  • Being Distance in the field. Join demos, trials and exercises with defence clients, support on-site deployments when needed, and bring back what you see and hear on real kit.

  • Bridging the field and the core. Turn what customers need into concrete integration work with the R&D and commercial teams, spot what should become shared product capability, and feed it into the roadmap and, eventually, the shared codebase.

You won't be a satellite. You'll join the software standups and reviews and be a real part of R&D.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Your work ships and gets used. What you integrate goes into real kit already in trials with military users, and what you learn from demos, trials and exercises with them feeds straight back into the product.

  • You own the whole thread. From first prototype to working integration in the field, it's yours, not passed between five teams.

  • New display tech. Glasses-free computational optics and a see-through HUD, the kind of problem you won't find at most XR jobs.

  • A small team backed to move fast. Around 60 of us, Google Ventures' first investment in Finland, and flat enough that your calls count.

OUR EXPECTATIONS

What we're looking for:

  • A builder, not a passenger: a hands-on self-starter who takes ownership, works things out when docs are missing, and would rather be with a customer or in the field than at a desk.

  • At least a couple of years of software engineering experience with VR or XR, plus generalist instincts.

  • Comfort across a mixed software stack. You've worked with some of C++, Unity and embedded, and you pick up the rest quickly.

  • Some exposure to electrical integration or software-to-hardware interfaces. We're not expecting deep hardware experience on top of strong software.

  • You're at home in prototype and integration work: incomplete docs, customer-specific stacks, messy interfaces.

descriptionHtml:

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you’ll do

  • Own the Roadmap: Lead the end-to-end strategy for Kaluza Agent Experience (KAE) within the European market—grounded in global product goals but sharpened by local client needs and agent behaviors. Driving core operational metrics (AHT, FCR, CSAT, AI adoption, onboarding)ensuring capabilities improve agent/customer outcomes.

  • Drive Journey Design & UX Consistency: Act as guardian of agent UX across KAE to ensure coherence across the experience. Partnering with UX and domain teams to apply shared patterns consistently, reduce agent cognitive load, and maintain alignment and compliance with the design system as new automation and assistive/AI capabilities are introduced.

  • Lead Integrations & Client Onboarding: Drive technical and product integrations with third-party platforms and oversee spinning up new KAE instances end-to-end for incoming clients from discovery through go-live.

    (Note: Travel to client sites e.g., Brussels, is expected at roughly 1–3 trips a month initially, tapering to 1–2 times a quarter.)

What you’ll bring

  • EU Accessibility & Platform Integration: Strong working knowledge of EU accessibility standards alongside proven experience integrating products with complex third-party platforms and vendor ecosystems.

  • Client Delivery & Market Expansion: Successful track record implementing or localizing a product for external enterprise clients, taking solutions from zero to live through discovery, configuration, and change management.

  • Data-Informed Judgement & Influence: Demonstrated ability using operational metrics (AHT, FCR, CSAT, agent effort) to defend product decisions, coupled with a platform-first mindset that prioritizes existing capabilities over custom code.

  • Bilingual Capability: Full professional bilingual fluency (written and spoken) in both English and French.

What will set you apart 

  • Experience leveraging AI tools, machine learning capabilities, or LLM integrations within product workflows to enhance platform intelligence and automation directly into customer service desktop environments.

  • Hands-on experience to scale UI consistency across different product teams.

Where you'll work
We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.
Tes futures missions : En tant que Product Manager, ton rôle est d’aider l’équipe à maximiser la valeur du produit en priorisant et livrant des fonctionnalités de qualité, au service de la satisfaction client. - Prioriser et livrer des fonctionnalités à forte valeur ajoutée, en respectant les jalons et les engagements pris auprès du client. - Montrer la valeur et l’avancement de l’équipe en rendant le travail visible et en facilitant les décisions du client (review decks, daily mails,…). - Comprendre les préférences du client et organiser une réaction rapide et adaptée en cas de problème, en s’appuyant sur des outils comme le modèle de valeur, les questionnaires clients et les résolutions de problème. - Piloter le delivery au quotidien en appliquant la méthodologie Lean : gestion du backlog, rédaction de user stories claires et planification des sprints. - Collaborer étroitement avec le client pour comprendre ses besoins, faciliter ses décisions et co-construire les solutions. - Traduire les enjeux produit en exigences claires pour l’équipe technique, en t’appuyant sur l’analyse des usages, l’étude de l’environnement et les benchmarks. - Aider l’équipe à tenir ses engagements en anticipant les risques, en résolvant les problèmes et en contribuant aux routines d’amélioration continue (résolution de problèmes, rétrospectives). Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples : - iDealwine® : leader mondial des enchères de vins en ligne a engagé la migration de son site e-commerce monolithique vers une architecture composable pour gagner en évolutivité, en sécurité et en maîtrise technologique. Après 2 mois de cadrage, les équipes Theodo ont piloté une approche design-to-cost permettant de modulariser la plateforme et de migrer 20 ans d’historique en 14 mois, dans le respect du budget et du planning. - Sevetys : refonte complète d’une web app métier avec deux volets stratégiques : un outil de prise de rendez-vous pour les propriétaires d’animaux et un back-office dédié aux vétérinaires. Deux équipes produit ont piloté la reconstruction des plateformes de bout en bout, rejointes en fin de projet par une équipe data pour structurer et valoriser les données. Principal défi : une mise en production coordonnée à grande échelle, impliquant de nombreuses cliniques vétérinaires, sans interruption d’activité. Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu : Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits. Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. Profil recherché : - Diplômé·e d’une grande école d’ingénieur, entre 2 et 5 ans d’expérience, idéalement en conseil ou dans un contexte avec forte exposition client. - Intérêt marqué pour la conception de produits à fort impact business, avec une appétence pour la tech et de bonnes connaissances sur le sujet. - Excellente aisance relationnelle : à l’aise face aux clients, capable d’adopter la bonne posture et de créer une relation de confiance. - Posture client first : disponible, réactif, à l’écoute, capable de prioriser le client, d’intégrer les retours et d’anticiper les besoins. - Forte envie d’apprendre et de progresser, capable de challenger son équipe, de demander de l’aide et d’accepter d’être challengé.Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo ? Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 De l’épargne salariale avec un mécanisme d’intéressement en partenariat avec Epsor 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile 🧒 Aides et places en crèche réservées Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

title: Product Manager - AI Platform
descriptionHtml:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

📱 Our Product Team

Led by Fabien, our VP Product, Joko's Product team groups the passionate individuals behind our users' delight! From brainstorming to development to launch, the Product team's main mission is to turn ideas into reality by working hand-in-hand with the Engineering, Design, and Business teams.

Joko is organized into four product tribes, each owning a key dimension of the company's value:

  • Business lines owns the current core value proposition, covering online shopping, in-store experiences, and gift cards, each run as a dedicated team.

  • Scale focuses on growing and amplifying this value through growth, international expansion, and shared core user experiences across the app.

  • Juno builds the next value proposition: an AI shopping assistant that finds the right product at the best price in seconds, backed by a universal catalog of what merchants actually sell.

  • AI Platform helps Joko become a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside, owning the internal agent infrastructure, automation layer, internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security and operational scalability.

⚡ The AI Platform task force

AI Platform's mission is to turn Joko into a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside. The tribe builds the internal agent infrastructure that will let every team work faster, automate complex workflows, and create new 0-to-1 features with AI.

Its flagship product is Joker, Joko's internal AI teammate. Already live in Slack, Notion and Linear, Joker can understand context, use tools, act across systems, and take real work from idea to execution. The ambition is not just to automate repetitive tasks, but to make agents a new production layer for how Joko builds and operates.

For this to work at company scale, AI Platform also owns the backbone underneath: Gotham, the identity and permission layer that lets agents act with exactly the access of the person they work for; plus the internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security, reliability and server-cost foundations that keep Joko fast, safe and scalable.

The tribe's users are the teams inside Joko. Its goal is simple: help them run extremely efficient processes, remove operational bottlenecks, and give the company the leverage it needs to scale in the coming years.

🎯 What you will do

As Product Manager for the AI Platform task force, you own your roadmap end to end. You will identify the highest-impact internal workflows to transform, define what should be automated or productized, build the roadmap yourself, and ship with a Product Designer and software engineers. You will report to Fabien, our VP Product, who leads the tribe. Your users sit a few desks away, which makes discovery fast and accountability unavoidable.

  • Build and own your roadmap: You will map what teams do today, where their processes break, what it costs them, and where AI or better tooling can create the most leverage. You will turn that discovery into a clear roadmap, prioritize it yourself, and be accountable for its impact.

  • Ship with Engineering: You will work very closely with software engineers to scope, sequence and deliver complex technical products. You will write clear specs, make trade-offs, unblock decisions, test what ships, and keep the team focused on real user impact.

  • Build the agent layer: The approach is capability first: expose an action as a scoped tool, write the instructions an agent needs to use it well, then let the agent run the job. Interfaces come only where they earn their place. Deciding what deserves a screen is a genuinely new kind of product judgment.

  • Own Joker use cases: You will identify where Joker can take work from idea to execution, automate end-to-end workflows, or help teams create new 0-to-1 features. You will turn these opportunities into production-grade products used every day.

  • Retire what should not exist: Part of the mandate is subtractive: migrating off tools that have outlived their purpose and progressively switching off legacy systems. You will sequence those migrations without breaking the teams that depend on them every day.

  • Design for trust and scale: You will work on permissions, reliability, security, compliance and data access as product problems. Agents must act safely, every action must be attributable, and the systems you ship must be robust enough for company-wide adoption.

  • Measure efficiency: You will define success in time saved, cost reduced, risk removed, and adoption by internal teams, and prioritise against it.

  • Align stakeholders: You will be the point of contact for internal stakeholders across Engineering, Ops, Finance, Legal, Data and Care, structuring their demands and arbitrating between them.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have 2+ years of experience as a Product Manager. A background on internal tools, back-office products, APIs, platforms, or complex B2B products is a strong plus.

  • Product for teams mindset: You are comfortable building for internal users, where the bar is efficiency, robustness and adoption. Problems nobody outside the company will ever see still energise you.

  • AI fluency — hands-on: This scope is being rebuilt around agents, so this criterion carries the most weight. You use AI tools daily in your own work, you understand what agents are actually good and bad at, and you have opinions about where automation belongs.

  • Strong technical appetite: You are curious and hands-on with infrastructure, permissions, reliability, security, compliance, and data architecture. Coding is not required, but you need to understand how things work.

  • Stakeholder leadership: You are excellent at alignment, prioritization, and saying no. You can navigate many dependencies and make trade-offs explicit.

  • Analytical & pragmatic: You are data-driven, impact-oriented, and you go straight for the real operational problem.

  • Communication: You are a clear, structured communicator, able to translate complex technical topics into business impact.

  • Location: Based in France or Spain.

  • Languages: Fluent in English, both written and spoken. French is a plus, but it is optional.

  • Mindset: You are ownership-driven, resilient, and motivated by solving hard, unglamorous but high-impact problems that make the whole company better. You have an entrepreneurial mindset, you like challenges, you welcome feedback and you love constantly learning and getting better.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Compensation: €64K – €104K • Offers Equity

title: Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Hi, I'm Maria, Interim VP Product at FeedbackFruits. 👋

FeedbackFruits is moving from a founder-led company to a product-led one, which means Product is taking on a much bigger role in deciding what we build and why. Before stepping into this role I worked as a PM here myself, with the squads and within the details, so I know how much depends on the PMs who work with those squads every day. I'm building a team of PMs who care about the craft: who do the discovery before committing to a build, make clear calls about priorities, and follow their work through to how teachers end up using it.

I'm looking for a Product Manager to lead one of our squads and own how teachers go from setting up their first activity to making FeedbackFruits part of how they teach every week. That means helping instructors see which students are stuck while there's still time to step in, making grading faster and less painful, and making it easy for a great activity to travel from one teacher to the next across an institution. You'll decide what the squad works on and why, and you'll have the room to set that direction yourself.

The EdTech market is tough right now, so every product decision has to earn its place. I like working this way, because a PM with sharp judgment sees their impact fast. You’ll also help shape how product works here as we raise the bar together: how we find the right problems, make calls and bring people along, and what great looks like for the PMs who join after you.

What you'll do:

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for your squad, and keep its work tied to what matters most to us right now: teachers getting value from FeedbackFruits early and coming back for more

  • Run discovery with teachers, institutions and partners, dig into the data, and frame each problem clearly before anyone starts designing a solution

  • Make the prioritisation calls, including the "not now"s, and explain them with enough context that people follow your reasoning even when they'd have chosen differently

  • Work side by side with engineers on technical approach and feasibility, and with designers on critiques and validating solutions with users

  • Write specs and acceptance criteria clear enough that the squad can move without waiting on you, then review what gets built and keep iterating

  • Define MVPs that get something useful into teachers' hands quickly, and after launch, look at the results and decide whether to scale it, rework it or retire it

  • Keep Sales, Partner Success and leadership aligned by documenting decisions, presenting strategy and progress, and keeping the roadmap visible

  • Help the squad see how its work lands with teachers and students, and make time to celebrate the wins

What you bring:

  • You have 3+ years of product management experience, and you've shipped B2B SaaS features that measurably changed how people use a product

  • You spot opportunities before anyone asks for them, and you'd rather spend an extra day understanding a problem than a month building the wrong solution

  • You can say "no" to a request and keep the relationship intact, because you back your reasoning with data and strategy

  • You write and speak with the kind of clarity that saves everyone a follow-up meeting. Your expectations are set before the work starts, and your feedback is direct

title: Product Manager* – Artificial Intelligence
descriptionHtml:

Location: Frankfurt am Main, Düsseldorf, Berlin, München (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent

Die Rolle

AlsProduct Manager* – Artificial Intelligence bei Capco gestaltest du die Entwicklung und erfolgreiche Vermarktung innovativer AI-Produkte, Lösungen und Acceleratoren.

Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Business, Technologie und Innovation. Dabei vernetzt du unterschiedliche Stakeholder, entwickelst unser AI-Produktportfolio strategisch weiter und übersetzt technologische Möglichkeiten in messbaren Mehrwert für unsere Kunden.

Du begleitest AI-Produkte von der ersten Idee über die Entwicklung bis zur erfolgreichen Markteinführung. Dabei setzt du auf AI-gestützte Arbeitsweisen, intelligente Automatisierung und den verantwortungsvollen Einsatz von AI-Technologien, um Produktentscheidungen zu verbessern, Entwicklungsprozesse effizienter zu gestalten und Innovationen schneller nutzbar zu machen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • AI Product Portfolio Management: Du verantwortest die Weiterentwicklung eines Portfolios aus AI-Lösungen, Demonstratoren und Acceleratoren und identifizierst Potenziale für Skalierung und kommerzielle Nutzung.
  • Stakeholder Management: Du koordinierst Product Owner, Business-Stakeholder und Engineering-Teams über verschiedene Geschäftsbereiche und internationale Standorte hinweg und sorgst für gemeinsame Prioritäten.
  • Product Development & AI-Enabled Delivery: Du übersetzt Geschäftsanforderungen und Marktpotenziale in Produktstrategien, priorisierte Backlogs und Roadmaps. Dabei nutzt du geeignete AI-Tools und automatisierte Workflows, um Analysen, Produktentwicklung und Entscheidungsprozesse zu unterstützen.
  • Go-to-Market & Commercialisation: Du entwickelst überzeugende Value Propositions, unterstützt die Produktpositionierung und Sales-Enablement-Aktivitäten und arbeitest eng mit Business- und Account-Teams zusammen, um AI-Lösungen erfolgreich am Markt zu etablieren.
  • AI Innovation & Strategic Alignment: Du identifizierst neue AI-Anwendungsfelder, einschließlich Generative AI und Agentic AI, und stellst die Abstimmung mit Unternehmensstrategien und globalen Initiativen sicher. Dabei berücksichtigst du Responsible-AI-Prinzipien, Governance-Vorgaben und menschliche Qualitätskontrollen.

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst Erfahrung im Produktmanagement, in der Technologieberatung oder im Innovationsmanagement mit und kannst komplexe Themen in strukturierte Produktstrategien übersetzen.
  • Du verfügst über ein gutes Verständnis moderner AI-Technologien, einschließlich Generative AI, Large Language Models und Agentic AI, sowie ihrer geschäftlichen Einsatzmöglichkeiten.
  • Du verstehst wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und kannst technologische Fähigkeiten in überzeugende Value Propositions, Business Cases und konkrete Produktanforderungen übersetzen.
  • Du kommunizierst klar, arbeitest gerne mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern zusammen und kannst interdisziplinäre Teams koordinieren sowie unterschiedliche Interessen miteinander verbinden.
  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert. Du bist offen für den Einsatz freigegebener AI-Tools, hinterfragst AI-generierte Ergebnisse kritisch und berücksichtigst Datenschutz, Governance und menschliche Entscheidungsverantwortung.

Nice to have

  • Erfahrung in der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche oder in einem Beratungsunternehmen.
  • Erfahrung mit der Entwicklung, Skalierung oder Vermarktung digitaler Produkte und AI-basierter Lösungen.
  • Kenntnisse im Aufbau von AI-Produktportfolios, Acceleratoren oder wiederverwendbaren Technologiekomponenten.
  • Erfahrung mit AI-Governance, Responsible AI oder der Integration von AI-Lösungen in bestehende Unternehmensprozesse.
  • Erfahrung mit internationalen, funktionsübergreifenden Teams sowie agilen Produktentwicklungsprozessen.

Warum Capco

  • Gestalte innovative AI-Produkte und Lösungen mit echtem Mehrwert für führende Finanzdienstleistungsunternehmen.
  • Arbeite in einer kollaborativen, offenen und unternehmerisch geprägten Beratungskultur mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen.
  • Profitiere von kontinuierlicher Weiterbildung, Trainings und branchenspezifischen Zertifizierungen.
  • Werde Teil internationaler Teams und arbeite mit AI-Expertinnen und -Experten an zukunftsweisenden Technologien.
  • Übernimm Verantwortung für eigene Initiativen und gestalte die digitale Transformation der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche aktiv mit.

Benefits

Wir bieten dir ein attraktives Benefits-Paket, das deine persönliche Entwicklung, dein Wohlbefinden und deine individuellen Bedürfnisse unterstützt:

  • Flexible Arbeitsmodelle: Hybrides Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitsmodelle sind abhängig vom jeweiligen Projekteinsatz möglich.
  • Persönliche Begleitung: Ein umfassendes Onboarding sowie ein persönlicher Coach und Buddy unterstützen dich beim Einstieg.
  • Mobilität: Profitiere von unseren Bike-Leasing-Programmen.
  • Capco Benefits Card: Monatliche Gutschrift in Höhe von 44 EUR.
  • Gesundheit & Wohlbefinden: Regelmäßige Gesundheitschecks und Mental-Health-Kurse.
  • Familienservice: Der PME-Familienservice bietet Unterstützung in unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen.
  • Learning & Development: Kontinuierliches Feedback, interne Trainings und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, beispielsweise über Udemy Business.
  • Community & Networking: Regelmäßige Firmenevents und After-Work-Veranstaltungen.
  • Langfristige Perspektive: Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag und vielfältige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Arbeitskultur: Eigenverantwortung, flache Hierarchien und schnelle Entscheidungswege.
  • Internationales Umfeld: Ein dynamisches, wachsendes Unternehmen mit vielfältigen Möglichkeiten, eigene Ideen und Talente einzubringen.

Inklusion bei Capco

Wir möchten unseren Bewerbungsprozess für alle Menschen zugänglich und unkompliziert gestalten. Solltest du während des Bewerbungsprozesses Unterstützung oder individuelle Anpassungen benötigen, sprich uns gerne an – wir helfen dir weiter.

Bei Capco schätzen wir unterschiedliche Perspektiven, Erfahrungen und individuelle Stärken. Wir sind überzeugt, dass Vielfalt und authentische Zusammenarbeit entscheidend zu unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg beitragen.

Unsere #BeYourselfAtWork-Kultur fördert Individualität, gegenseitigen Respekt und Zusammenarbeit. Diese Werte prägen unseren täglichen Umgang miteinander sowie unsere Partnerschaften mit unseren Kunden.

descriptionHtml:
Before jumping into all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick.
About us

Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry-first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices. With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels, including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search.
We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic. We are backed by top-notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst, and trusted by 2000+ customers from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino's, and the list goes on.
Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it — see for yourself. We consistently outperform and continue our leadership, and the results speak for themselves.
From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world-class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables, our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.
Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers that moves fast and agile, creating cutting-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading.

We are looking for a Product Manager who wants to make the dream a reality. What is our mission? We are visionaries who guide new product ideas. We are setting the vision for our growing family of products. We use data, research, strategy, and empathy to guide development and design teams toward a common goal since we believe that only our products can alter Insider One`s destiny. We are Insider One’s innovators, our impact starts on day one, and our mission is to prove that break-through products can be created outside Silicon Valley. What are we offering? Impact; be a part of a world-class product team where we constantly get challenged with new things and the results of our actions create an impact for hundreds of millions of users every day. Personal Growth; work closely with experienced PMs, get mentored by some of the best people in their fields, join tons of different training like sales, design, customer communication. Develop the skills that you need to become a successful product manager. Experience; get important responsibilities, learn from your mistakes without getting blamed, watch experienced people work on complex matters, gain one of the most important things to become a great product manager, experience. Delight; make tough decisions, release new features, create innovating products which bring ease and joy to the life of many individuals who use them. Community; surround yourself with great people who constantly help each other and push each other to be better, join many different events, and become a part of the Insider One Community. What are we searching for? Leadership, you can make decisions and set direction while motivating and inspiring people around you to follow you in that direction. Communication, you serve as the diplomat of the team, you can transmit complex information to different audiences clearly and you are talented in reaching the information you need on the people you are talking to. Problem Solving, you are a natural-born problem solver, finding solutions to complex problems motivates and excites you, and at that moment when you solve the problem, feeling that sense of accomplishment is worth all the effort. Listening, despite the fact that communicating effectively is extremely important, you should also be able to gather information from many sources around you to help you make better-informed decisions on guiding and improving your products and services. Entrepreneurial Spirit, rather than waiting to adapt to change, you are actively seeking out change. You have a mindset that embraces critical questioning, innovation, and improvement. You can see the big picture, you are willing to take risks, you constantly seek new opportunities for innovation and you take ownership and pride in what you do. What are you going to do?

title: Product Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Product Manager – Finanzierung & Integrationen (m/w/d)

Die meisten Product-Rollen geben dir ein Backlog und ein Engineering-Team. Diese gibt dir zusätzlich einen Verhandlungstisch: Du überzeugst die Produktteams von Banken, ihr eigenes Engineering-Budget in eine Anbindung zu stecken. Danach gehört dir die Schnittstelle – auch nach dem Go-live.

Standort: Zentral in Berlin – Du arbeitest vor Ort in unserem Büro, hybrid mit 3 Tagen Office und 2 Tagen Homeoffice.

Über uns

CarOnSale ist die KI-gestützte Plattform für den B2B-Gebrauchtwagenhandel in Europa. Über 40.000 Käufer aus mehr als 20 Ländern handeln auf unserer Plattform – und 85 % des Inventars ist exklusiv bei uns. Wir verbinden Software, Pricing-Intelligenz, Logistik und Finanzierung in einer Schicht – als Betriebssystem für eine ganze Branche.

One Platform. One Profit Engine.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest die Anbindung unserer Finanzierungs- und Bankpartner – von der Anforderung über die Umsetzung mit Engineering bis zum Betrieb nach dem Go-live.
  • Du überzeugst die Produktteams unserer Partner, eigenes Engineering-Budget in die Integration zu investieren, und führst diese Gespräche bis zur Entscheidung.
  • Du analysierst, wo Händler zwischen Fahrzeugansicht und abgeschlossenem Gebot abspringen, und erhöhst die Conversion messbar.
  • Du ziehst deine Daten selbst, begründest jede Priorisierung damit und verfolgst die KPIs deiner Features nach dem Launch.
  • Du baust Prototypen, um eine Idee zu testen, bevor du Engineering-Zeit dafür einplanst.
  • Du sprichst regelmäßig mit Händlern, sammelst Feedback strukturiert ein und übersetzt es in konkrete Anforderungen.

Die Stelle ist eine Nachbesetzung in einer gewachsenen Produktorganisation – acht Product Manager, zehn Engineering-Teams.

Was du mitbringst

  • 3–6 Jahre im Produktmanagement in einem digitalen B2B-, Plattform- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld, mit breitem Verantwortungsbereich
  • Du hast eine Funnel- oder Conversion-Kennzahl bewegt und kannst Ausgangswert und Ergebnis nennen – mit Daten, die du selbst gezogen hast
  • Erfahrung mit externen Partnern, deren Prioritäten du verstehen und beeinflussen musstest – nicht nur interne Stakeholder
  • Technisches Verständnis für API-Integrationen: Du musst nicht selbst entwickeln, aber verstehen, worüber Engineering spricht
  • Eine klare Vorstellung davon, wo KI diese Arbeit konkret besser macht – ob dein aktueller Arbeitgeber dir die Tools zur Verfügung stellt, spielt für uns keine Rolle
  • Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, Englisch verhandlungssicher

Von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung mit einer zweiseitigen Plattform – du hast für Angebot und Nachfrage gearbeitet, nicht nur für eine Seite
  • Erfahrung mit Checkout-, Payment- oder Finanzierungsprozessen (z. B. BNPL)
  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit dem Automotive-Umfeld

Was du nicht brauchst: Erfahrung im Banking oder Fintech. Die Finanzierungswelt lernst du hier – das Gespür für Partner bringst du mit.

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Hybrides Arbeiten: 3 Tage Office, 2 Tage Homeoffice – plus 10 Tage „Work from Anywhere" pro Jahr
  • 28 Tage Urlaub
  • 2× jährliches Karriere- & Entwicklungsgespräch
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 20 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss
  • Bezahltes Deutschlandticket
  • FitX-Mitgliedschaft oder Urban Sports Club-Zuschuss
  • Virtual Stock Options – du beteiligst dich am Erfolg
  • Moderne IT-Ausstattung für dein tägliches Arbeiten
  • Strukturiertes Onboarding mit Buddy-Programm und Social Events
  • Gelebte Vielfalt: aktives Frauennetzwerk, Meditations- & Gebetsraum

Der Prozess: drei Gespräche, rund 2,5 Stunden. Kein Case-Study-Paket für zu Hause – die Aufgabe lösen wir gemeinsam im Raum.

Bewirb dich jetzt – dein Lebenslauf reicht.

title: Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Upsun

Upsun is the software factory for human-AI workflows. We give teams one unified platform to create, review, deploy, and run software, with AI agents and humans working in sync. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build and ship with confidence, without wrestling with infrastructure.

Upsun brings this together through two products: one that shapes the work, and one that runs it.

  • Upsun Dispatch™: the AI-first product accelerator. Dispatch governs and simplifies collaboration between AI agents and cross-functional human teams, so work gets shaped, reviewed, and moved to production faster. Ship better code, not just more code.
  • Upsun Cloud: the Cloud Application Platform for AI acceleration. Cloud is where that software runs. It helps organizations launch agentic software into production confidently and reliably, with:
    • Predictable performance, even at scale
    • Secure, compliant environments by default
    • Real-time observability and profiling built in
    • Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds
    • Sandbox environments where AI agents can build and test safely

The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation. 

What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.

Our values: 

🌿 We make a positive impact.

✨ We aim for the stars.

💚 We care for each other. 

Impact of a Product Manager

As a Product Manager at Upsun, you own a significant area of Upsun Cloud, our cloud application platform, and the outcomes it delivers for the developers who build on it. The team you join owns the platform's foundations: the API, the runtime, environments, and the reliability every application running on Upsun depends on. And because Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love, much of what you build will be used by AI agents as much as by people.

This is a hands-on, technically rich role that bridges product strategy and deep infrastructure understanding. You own the strategy and the roadmap for your area, working closely with engineering to define platform behavior, build scalable abstractions, and shape workflows that empower modern development teams. Throughout, you act as the key voice for the user, making sure everything we ship contributes meaningfully to an exceptional developer experience.

What to expect

  • Strategy and roadmap: Own the strategy, roadmap, and priorities for your area of Upsun Cloud, balancing established foundations with uncharted territory.

  • Problem definition: Synthesize inputs from customers, support, sales, and engineering into clear problem statements, constructively testing underlying assumptions.

  • Solution definition: Explore options with your team, weigh trade-offs, and land on the right scope.

  • Ship small, iterate fast: Release in increments and shorten the loop between shipping and learning.

  • Technical execution: Collaborate with engineering (especially infrastructure and systems teams) to deliver platform capabilities that are reliable, scalable, and developer-friendly.

  • Design for humans and agents: Build with two audiences in mind—ensuring features, APIs, documentation, and error messages serve both people and AI agents.

  • Customer and data authority: Connect with customers regularly, serve as an internal advocate for their needs, and define metrics that demonstrate value for users and the business.

  • Influence across teams: Build alignment across engineering, design, Product Marketing, support, and leadership.

  • Go-to-market: Partner with Product Marketing early so go-to-market strategy helps shape the product, not just the launch.

What you bring

  • Product management experience: Proven experience in product management owning a distinct product area, ideally focused on developer platforms, PaaS, or cloud infrastructure.

  • Technical depth: Understanding of building, deploying, and running applications in the cloud, with the ability to collaborate closely with infrastructure engineers on multi-tenant architectures or distributed systems.

  • Software development background: Familiarity with building software using languages such as Python, Ruby, JavaScript, PHP, Go, or Rust.

  • CI/CD, containers & APIs: Hands-on experience or close collaboration with CI/CD workflows, Docker/OCI container technologies, and a clear vision for intuitive API design.

  • AI fluency: Daily use of modern AI tools to research, draft, and prototype workflows, paired with a realistic understanding of where current tools and models fall short.

  • Agentic development: A strong perspective on autonomous agent architecture and how agentic workflows are transforming modern software engineering.

  • Navigating ambiguity: Comfort with turning unstructured problem spaces into clear strategies and taking thoughtful action even with incomplete information.

  • Collaborative communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of listening, building consensus, and uniting teams around a shared vision.

  • Data-informed decision making: Ability to seek out and evaluate data to guide decisions and track success.

Bonus points for

  • Enthusiasm for using and testing the platform capabilities you help build.

  • Experience using Kubernetes, or building self-service platforms on Kubernetes

Where we hire

At Upsun, remote work isn’t just a trend. It’s our foundation. Upsunners are a global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We’re committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans more than 30 countries and a wide range of experience levels, and we’re currently hiring for this role in Germany, Canada, Spain, France, and the UK. We’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, but we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries.

How we hire

Our interview process is a chance for us to understand how you think, what you’ve built, and what you want to take on next, and for you to get to know us. Together, we’ll explore where your strengths and interests meet the challenges our teams are solving.

We know a great hire won’t meet every requirement above. If you can see yourself making the team better, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here if someone hadn’t taken a chance on us.

You can expect 5 video interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. 

  1. 45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition 
  2. 60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (Director, Product)
  3. 60 Minutes with Team (IC's)
  4. 60 Minutes with Product Leaders
  5. 45 Minutes with Executive (CTO)

All roles require background checks.

What we offer

💡 A product you can believe in - Join us in transforming how businesses build and manage web applications, driven making a positive impact as a proud B Corp.

🏆 An Award-Winning Workplace - We’ve been recognized by Forbes’ Top 30 Companies for Remote Jobs and France’s Best Workplaces for Women.

🗣️ A culture that values your voice - Join a flexible, open, and inclusive work environment where your voice is encouraged, and your ideas shape our growth and evolution.

🌎 A global team - Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives

🎉 Benefits and perks - Make the most of what matters to you

🏝 Flexible PTO

🩺 Comprehensive healthcare coverage (UK, Canada, France, Spain, USA)

📈 Company stock options

🧠 Professional development budget

💻 Office equipment budget

💆‍♀️ Wellness budget

🧳 Annual team gatherings

🛜 Internet reimbursement

👶 Inclusive parental leave

✈️ Remote work travel program

You belong here

At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. If you need accommodations at any stage of our hiring process, please let us know. We're here to ensure an accessible and comfortable experience for you.
