title: Product Manager Supply Chain & Transport - F/H
descriptionHtml:
Le Product Management, c’est notre ADN.

Chez Hubvisory, tu ne te contentes pas de gérer un backlog : tu deviens la référence produit incontournable pour accompagner nos clients grands comptes sur les produits digitaux qui tiennent leur chaîne d’approvisionnement debout. Référencement transporteurs, flux maritimes, routiers et ferroviaires, données critiques, maîtrise des coûts réels. Des sujets denses, peu spectaculaires vus de loin, et parmi les plus structurants qu’un Product Manager puisse porter.

Ce que tu fais concrètement :

  • Tu pars du terrain avant de concevoir. Cartographie des flux de données, entretiens avec les coordinateurs transport parfois répartis sur plusieurs pays, identification des vrais irritants. Tu traduis ce qui remonte en parcours cibles, pas en liste de demandes.

  • Tu portes une vision à deux ou trois ans. Tu construis la roadmap d’une plateforme de référencement et de pilotage : automatisation des appels d’offres, gestion des quotas, prévision des délais d’acheminement. Tu décides ce qu’on construit, et ce qu’on laisse tomber.

  • Tu prends la donnée en main. Modèles interconnectés, qualité de la donnée, écarts entre coûts réels transporteurs et refacturation interne. Tu interprètes toi-même les indicateurs, tu structures des hypothèses, tu mesures pour décider, pas pour afficher.

  • Tu pilotes le cadrage et la delivery. Briefs produit et scénarios d’usage pour ta squad technique, animation des rituels, validation de la conformité à chaque jalon, mise en service et formation des utilisateurs. Un outil historique ne disparaît que si le nouveau tient vraiment la route.

  • Tu mesures l’impact. Réduction de la charge manuelle des équipes transport, fiabilisation des délais, tenue des coûts. Tu définis les KPI et les OKR qui comptent et tu les défends.

  • Tu participes à la vie d’Hubvisory. Tu consolides ta posture de consultant, tu partages tes retours d’expérience et tu évolues, selon tes aspirations, vers des rôles de Product Leader ou Manager Conseil.

  • Tu as déjà vu ce que l’automatisation des flux ou un algorithme de prévision change sur un produit supply chain ? On cherche des PM qui qualifient les cas IA avant de les mettre en place, pas des PM qui militeraient pour de l’IA partout.


👉 Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory ?

  • Hubvisory est le seul cabinet en France focalisé exclusivement sur le Product Management et l’IA. Pas de practice data généraliste, pas de conseil en transformation sur tous les sujets. On fait une chose, on la fait bien, on la fait avec les meilleurs clients.

  • Un parcours d'accompagnement sur-mesure. Si tu es PO aujourd'hui et que tu veux devenir PM, on te donne les moyens : mentorship, cas complexes, retours structurés. Nos rituels collectifs (Hub'Times) et nos revalorisations bi-annuelles récompensent la vraie progression, pas l'ancienneté.

  • Une communauté interne engagée : 20% des collaborateurs qui se sont volontairement engagés à travers plus de 20 projets à impact menés depuis 2022 (mécénat de compétence, organisation de maraudes, fresque du climat, etc.)

  • Des valeurs fortes : depuis 8 ans Hubvisory grandit autour de la bienveillance, la méritocratie, l’ambition, l’expertise et l’apprentissage.

Le package : 42.000-52.000€ fixe brut, revalorisations bi-annuelles, intéressement jusqu’à 22% des profits redistribué de façon égalitaire.



👉 Le profil que nous recherchons

  • Tu justifies d’au moins 3 ans d’expérience en tant que Product Owner ou Product Manager sur des produits digitaux avec un passage par la supply chain, la logistique, le transport international ou les référentiels de données critiques.

  • Tu es à l’aise dans des architectures fonctionnelles denses et des modèles de données interconnectés, avec une exigence forte sur la qualité de la donnée. Le pilotage de roadmap et de backlog fait partie de ton quotidien, et ton orientation valeur est ton moteur.

  • Trois qualités qui font la différence ici : une autonomie opérationnelle réelle, une communication capable d’embarquer des interlocuteurs internationaux et dispersés, et une rigueur analytique à toute épreuve.

  • Anglais professionnel attendu.

  • Environnement technique que tu croiseras : Jira, Confluence, Figma, data lakes, API REST, écosystèmes ERP et TMS.

Comment se déroule le processus de recrutement ?

Étape 1 : Echange avec un RH pour valider l’adéquation entre ton projet et notre modèle

Etape 2 : Validation de tes hard skills avec cas pratique avec un manager

Étape 3 : Validation de tes soft skills avec un entretien avec un VP

Etape 4 : Echange téléphonique avec un RH pour la proposition d’embauche

Quelle que soit l’issue de ton process, tu reçois un retour de notre part sous 7 jours maximum !

Si tu veux plus d’information sur notre processus de recrutement, on en a fait un article sur notre blog.

title: Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Wanna join the adventure?

At Loft, we are convinced that space programs should not have to be rebuilt from scratch every time. Our philosophy has been to productize them: we develop our own proprietary technology blocks, hardware and software, so that a customer payload can be integrated faster and more reliably than any bespoke program allows. That approach has delivered — it is why our customers reach orbit in months rather than years, and it is what makes working here different from working in the rest of the industry.

We are now taking the next step: launching and operating our own constellations, and building a new set of services on top of them. That includes a full product suite enabling third-party AI applications to run directly onboard our satellites, and a growing ecosystem of partners whose needs we have to understand and design for. Loft is expanding at a very high pace, and the range of what we build is expanding just as fast.

This is why Product Management matters so much here. Someone has to hold the whole picture — what is technically possible, what customers actually need, what we should build first — and turn it into something engineering and leadership can act on. As a Product Manager, you will own a significant perimeter and the autonomy that goes with it. We are growing the team precisely so that each of us can go deeper on our topics, anticipate rather than react, and have more impact across the company.

You will need to be comfortable talking to anyone here. In the same week you might sit with a system engineer to understand a design constraint, join a BD call with an institutional customer, and present a recommendation to the executive team. Ideas at Loft get discussed openly and on their merits, wherever they come from, so being able to ask a naive question without ego — and to disagree with someone senior without making it personal — matters more than seniority.


About this role:
Understand what is possible, and turn it into requirements
  • Spend the bulk of your time with engineering: understanding architectures, constraints, and dependencies well enough to judge what is realistically doable in a given timeframe.
  • Translate strategic direction into clear requirements and use cases that engineering can act on directly, and follow them down to the Jira tickets.
  • Surface and shape the good ideas that come from engineering — many of the best ones do — and connect them to a product rationale.
  • Define success criteria for each capability, and verify they are actually met through implementation and delivery.
  • Maintain an accurate, shared view of Loft's product capabilities, what is in development, and where the gaps are.

    • Bring the outside in

    • Run customer discovery interviews alongside business development, and debrief missions to see how Loft's capabilities are actually used in operations.
    • Engage directly with the partners building on our platform, including the onboard AI application ecosystem, to understand their needs and constraints.
    • Track market trends and competitive moves closely enough to know where our offering stands.

      • Decide and prioritize

      • Own the roadmap for your perimeter, reconciling customer needs, engineering reality, and Loft's strategy into a single coherent plan.
      • Build the analysis behind every recommendation — sizing, segmentation, business cases, operational data — so decisions are grounded in evidence rather than intuition alone.
      • Negotiate scope and delivery commitments with engineering leadership, and re-plan when capacity or mission timelines shift.
      • Challenge, constructively and with data, business development, engineering leadership, and your own assumptions.

        • Communicate

        • Own internal communication on your perimeter: keep engineering, program leadership, and executives working from the same technical reality.
        • Develop the technical narratives and proof points that marketing and BD then turn into their own customer-facing material.
        • Prepare recommendations and presentations for top-executive-level audiences.

Must Haves:
  • 7+ years of professional experience, including hands-on product management.
  • Domain experience in at least one of: earth observation, embedded systems, aerospace systems, security & defense.
  • Comfort at both ends of the spectrum — understand the market, and the technology
  • Structured and data-driven: you bring your experience and your intuitions, but when you put a recommendation on the table you can show the analysis it stands on.
  • Real product obsession: you think about the bigger picture and product-market fit before you think about features.
  • Relentless curiosity. In a single month you might move from a satellite bus constraint, to onboard AI inference, to a defense accreditation requirement — and you need to find that stimulating rather than exhausting.
  • High autonomy and a bias for action: handed a broad perimeter, you organize it yourself and come back with a plan.
  • At ease being challenged, and challenging others, in a fast-moving and demanding environment.
  • Working knowledge of both hardware and software development lifecycles.
  • Proficient using and configuring Atlassian tools (Jira and Confluence).
  • Fluency in English, written and spoken.
  • Willingness to travel to other Loft offices and to customers.

Nice to Haves:
  • Fluency in French.
  • Experience with AI/ML products, edge computing, or developer and partner platforms and ecosystems.
  • Experience with satellite operations, constellation services, or ground segment products.
  • Exposure to institutional and defense customers and their procurement cycles.
  • Experience in a fast-growing, entrepreneurial NewSpace company or venture-backed deep-tech startup.
  • Professional experience working with international teams across time zones.

Some of Our Awesome Benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
  • Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences
  • Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together
  • Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable
    • *Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.
    Who We Are
    Loft: Space Made Simple.
    Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.
    We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.
    With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.
    As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.

title: Product Manager – Traffic (Flow, Jams, Speed Profiles & Moderation)
descriptionHtml:
Introduction
Real-time traffic is at the heart of TomTom's mission to engineer the smartest, most useful map on the planet. Our live and historical traffic products — flow, jams, and speed profiles — power navigation, ADAS, and mobility decisions for the world's leading automotive OEMs, enterprises, and ride-hailing companies. As these customers move faster and expect richer, more accurate content, the way we generate, moderate, and deliver traffic data becomes a decisive competitive advantage.
As Product Manager for Traffic Flow, Jams, and Speed Profiles, you will own a core part of TomTom's real-time traffic portfolio and set its multi-year roadmap, grounded in a deep understanding of traffic processing technology and customer needs. You will also own TomTom's traffic moderation tool — enabling the world's leading ride-hailing companies to submit event reports, such as closures — running its user operations and prioritizing its feature roadmap.
What you'll do
  • Own and deliver against Traffic Flow, Traffic Jams, and Speed Profiles — setting the roadmap, OKRs, and quality bar, and taking a leading role in product quality.
  • Own and operate TomTom's traffic moderation tool, enabling the world's leading ride-hailing companies to submit event reports such as closures; run user operations and prioritize the tool's feature backlog.
  • Bring a deep understanding of real-time traffic processing and jam detection, and use it to manage tradeoffs effectively.
  • Focus on outcomes over outputs, tracking metrics such as ETT accuracy, jam detection quality, traffic coverage, and speed profile coverage.
  • Lead brainstorms and drive product exploration through prototypes and wireframes.
  • Gather deep customer insights from automotive OEMs, government agencies, and enterprise clients, separating high-value initiatives from nice-to-haves.
  • Data acumen — able to analyze data from multiple sources, such as GPS traces, probes, STOs, camera observations, and traffic authorities, to drive decisions and assess tradeoffs.
  • Build strong cross-functional relationships and steer the product team by removing blockers and escalating appropriately.
  • Communicate effectively to internal teams (automotive, navigation, delivery) and external stakeholders using customer problem statements and business logic; deliver concise presentations and lead meetings from standups to stakeholder reviews.
  • Maintain product strategy and vision, and contribute to broader Traffic discussions; formulate compelling value propositions tied to articulated problems and product metrics.
  • Establish yourself as the subject-matter expert and go-to person for live and historical traffic data products, maintaining trust across product and business teams with visible, citable personal impact.

    • What you'll need
  • A minimum of 5 years' experience as a Product Manager, preferably in traffic, geospatial, mobility, or automotive domains.
  • A bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, or a related field.
  • Familiarity with real-time data processing, GPS/probe data, or traffic and mobility analytics (preferred).
  • Experience or technical training in data science, analytics, or related disciplines.
  • Strong ability to understand, articulate, and represent customer needs and requirements.
  • Proven ability to coordinate people and technical resources across multiple teams.
  • Effective time management and strong interpersonal communication skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including with senior technical and executive audiences.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and creative, structured thinking.
    • What we offer
    A competitive compensation package, of course.
    Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning.
    Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities.
    Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. It’s all about getting the best out of both worlds – we ask TomTom’ers to come to the office two days a week, and the remaining three are free to be worked in either location.
    Improve your home office with a setup budget and get extra support with a monthly allowance.
    Enjoy options to work from your home country and abroad for a set number of days each year, to visit family and friends, or to simply explore the world we’re mapping.
    Take the holidays you want with a competitive holiday plan, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday.
    Join annual events like our Hackathon and DevDays to bring your ideas to life with talented teammates from around the world.
    Become a part of our inclusive global culture and have the chance to collaborate with a diverse community – we have over 80 nationalities at TomTom!
    Find out more about our global benefits and enjoy additional local benefits tailored to your location.
    Meet your team
    We’re the User Experience Design team. Fueled by user insights and data analytics, our mission is to create powerful, easy-to-use products that delight our customers, from millions of drivers to automotive customers who embed our technologies in their vehicles. We deliver the design specifications for all TomTom’s products. Joining us, you'll be part of a team that brings together design disciplines from user research to interaction, concept and visual design. Together, we'll continue to develop a map that people trust all around the world.

    At TomTom...
    You’ll help people find their way in the world. In 2004, TomTom revolutionized how the world moves with the introduction of the first portable navigation device. Now, we intend to do it again by engineering the first-ever real-time map, the smartest and most useful map on the planet.
    Work with a team of 3,600+ unique, curious and passionate problem-solvers. Together, we’ll open up a world of possibilities for car manufacturers, enterprises and developers to help people understand and get closer to the world around them.

    After you apply
    Our recruitment team will work hard to give you a meaningful experience throughout your journey with us, no matter the outcome. Your application will be screened closely and you can rest assured that all follow-up actions will be thorough, from assessments and interviews all the way through onboarding. To find out more about our application process, check out our hiring FAQs.

    TomTom is an equal opportunity employer
    TomTom is where you can find your place in the world. Every day we welcome, nurture and celebrate differences. Why? Because your uniqueness is what makes you, you. No matter your culture or background, you’ll find your impact at TomTom. Research also shows that sometimes women and underrepresented communities can be hesitant to apply for positions unless they believe they meet 100% of the criteria. If you can relate to this, please know that we’d love to hear from you.

descriptionHtml:
Lust auf Produktgestaltung und Innovation?

Willst du Features bauen oder echte Probleme lösen?
Wir suchen keinen bloßen „Verwalter von Anforderungen“, sondern einen strategischen Kopf, der unser Produkt zum Marktführer macht. Wir sind ein SaaS-Startup mit einer klaren Mission: Mehrweg in der Logistik so einfach wie Einweg zu machen. Wir reduzieren nicht nur den CO₂-Fußabdruck einer ganzen Branche, sondern optimieren einen ihrer nervigsten Prozesse.

Als Product Manager bist du nicht dafür da, Tickets zu schreiben. Du bist dafür verantwortlich, dass unser Produkt wertvoll für den Kunden und rentabel für unser Business ist.

Aufgaben

  • Product Discovery statt bloßer Ausführung: Du bekommst keine fertigen Lösungen vorgesetzt. Stattdessen arbeitest du eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, um herauszufinden, was wir bauen müssen. Du validierst Hypothesen schnell und minimierst das Risiko, Dinge zu bauen, die niemand braucht.

  • Outcome über Output: Dein Erfolg misst sich nicht an der Anzahl der geschriebenen Tickets oder pünktlichen Releases, sondern an messbaren Geschäftsergebnissen (z.B. Adoption-Rate von Features, Prozess-Effizienz beim Kunden).

  • Tiefes Kundenverständnis: Du wirst zum Experten für unsere Nutzer. Durch kontinuierliche User Interviews und Datenanalysen verstehst du deren Schmerzpunkte besser als sie selbst und leitest daraus die Produktstrategie ab.

  • Business Viability: Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Lösungen nicht nur nutzbar sind, sondern auch in unser Geschäftsmodell passen und rechtlich sowie technisch realisierbar sind.

  • Deutsch fließend in Wort und Schrift, Englisch gute Kenntnisse

Qualifikation

  • Liebe zum Problem: Du verstehst den Unterschied zwischen Projekt- und Produktmanagement. Du liebst es, komplexe Probleme zu lösen und übernimmst Verantwortung für den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg deines Produktbereichs.

  • Evidenzbasierte Entscheidungen: Du verlässt dich nicht auf Bauchgefühl. Du hast Erfahrung mit modernen Discovery-Methoden (Prototyping, A/B-Testing, Customer Interviews) und weißt, wie man Daten nutzt, um Argumente zu stützen.

  • Kollaboration & Kommunikation: Du siehst Entwickler und Designer nicht als "Ressourcen", sondern als Partner. Du kannst Stakeholdern souverän "Nein" sagen, um den Fokus auf das Wesentliche zu wahren, und kannst deine Produktvision begeisternd vermitteln.

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

Earlier this year, we launched ElevenLabs for Government, and are now looking for an exceptional product marketer to help us scale this story into global government and public sector markets.

Government agencies everywhere are being asked to answer more calls, in more languages, with the same amount or less staff. ElevenAgents resolves support, cuts hold times, and reaches people who cannot navigate a website or sit on a phone line. This role is to help us shape these capabilities into every market where governments serve citizens by voice.

  • Own positioning and packaging for ElevenLabs for Government

  • Scale the narrative across regions: National and Local government in the UK, EU, Federal, State and Local in the US, and public sector agencies across APAC, LATAM, and more

  • Anchor everything in citizen outcomes: non-emergency contact centers (311), benefits and eligibility, health and social services, licensing and permitting, and more

  • Position our solution for accessibility, compliance, language requirements, and the security and data residency mandates

  • Lead industry content, landing pages, and thought leadership pieces

Who You Are

  • You are an experienced product marketer who has scaled messaging into Government and Public Sector segments, from a growth or product marketing seat, ideally both

  • You've sold or marketed into more than one segment of public sector

  • Technical enough to become our internal expert on conversational agents: latency, telephony, tool calls, evals, and guardrails

  • Excellent project management across multiple countries, regulatory regimes, and simultaneous launches

  • You take initiative and work autonomously from day one, prioritizing learning and contribution while leaving ego aside

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Bangalore, Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco, Tokyo, and Warsaw.

title: Product Marketing Associate
descriptionHtml:
An Introduction to Primer

Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.

Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.

Watch our showcase >

Read up on our $100m Series C

Learn more about our culture >

Which team will you be joining?

You're joining our Product Marketing team that owns product positioning, launch strategy, and market adoption for Primer's core product lines. We operate as strategic partners embedded in each major domain, working alongside Product and Sales leadership to define how our products win in market. Our PMMs own end-to-end strategy and execution for a significant product area, which means your work gets seen, shaped, and acted on by senior leadership from day one. You'll report to our Product Marketing Lead and work directly with product leads, marketing leads and senior stakeholders across the business.

What will you be doing?

  • Build the partner marketing engine end-to-end in collaboration with the Product Marketing Lead, delivering messaging assets and post-launch reporting

  • Collaborate closely with the marketing and product teams to build product positioning, value propositions, and messaging for partner features, ensuring they roll out consistently in market

  • Collaborate with the marketing and partner teams to produce impactful campaigns for our partner ecosystem

  • Collect and analyze market insights to update and refine customer/persona journeys for targeted marketing.

  • Report on how your initiatives perform - adoption, engagement, and activation - on an agreed cadence

  • Write campaign assets, briefs, and enablement material, adapting them across channels without needing a new template each time.

What we're looking for

Must-haves:

  • 2-3 years of B2B SaaS marketing or product marketing experience, having owned go-to-market launches end to end.

  • Comfort turning technical product detail into messaging that actually lands with a technical buyer or partner, not just a simplified summary

  • A skilled communicator with expertise in writing, storytelling, and creating engaging content across multiple channels and formats

  • A motivated team player who is humble, ambitious, and eager to drive impact - someone who wants ownership over their work rather than executing a brief

Nice-to-haves:

  • Background in payments (a big plus!), fintech or a marketplace with deep understanding on how the industry works

  • Experience marketing a two-sided marketplace, balancing supply-side and demand-side value props

You may not like it here

  • You'll be building infrastructure as much as writing copy, so there's no established process to lean on yet

  • The roadmap is still forming, so your priorities may shift as things evolve

  • This role blends strategy and execution, so you'll want to be comfortable doing both

  • It's a highly collaborative role, so it suits someone who enjoys working closely across teams rather than independently

✅ A typical interview process

  • An initial intro call with a Talent Partner

  • An interview with the Hiring Manager

  • Challenge Stage - Contextualised to the role

  • A final, values-alignment interview

What's the culture like at Primer?


We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants.

We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. We invest in our relationships through great remote working practices and thoughtfully designed face-to-face time, including workations, our annual company retreat, and access to co-working spaces across most major cities.

The work is challenging. Scaleups are a challenge, and building category-defining products is a challenge. But there's a meaningful difference between a challenge and a struggle. At Primer, the right challenge comes with the right support: strong onboarding, a collaborative environment, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. It's never something you face alone.

Our benefits

🌍 We are fully remote and globally distributed; and have been since day one
💰 Competitive share options
🌴 Flexible holiday, with 25 days minimum to be taken
🗣️ Co-working space access across major cities
📅 Workations & Company Retreat
💻 The best equipment for your role
🏠 £500 towards your home office setup
🔎 Generous learning budget
🏥 Private Medical Insurance
📈 A broad set of additional perks and benefits (depending on location)

Don’t meet every single requirement?

At Primer, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Product Marketing & Brand Manager (Mensch)
descriptionHtml:
Worum gehts?

Event Inc stellt sich als AI-First-Plattform für Events, Meetings und Hotels neu auf, und dafür braucht es eine klare Stimme. Als Product Marketing & Brand Manager gestaltest Du mit, wie wir uns positionieren und wie unsere Marke bei Kunden, Partnern und Investoren wirkt. Du berichtest an unseren CRO und arbeitest eng mit unserem Content-, SEO- & GEO-Manager sowie unserem Data Analyst (Go-to-Market & Insights) zusammen.

Deine Rolle

Du entwickelst unsere Positionierung und unseren Markenauftritt weiter und arbeitest dabei eng mit unserer Content-, SEO- & GEO-Rolle zusammen.

  • Positionierung & Produkt-Story: Du arbeitest unsere AI-First-Story und unser Produktportfolio gemeinsam mit dem CRO aus. Die KI liefert Entwürfe, Du schärfst sie und gibst sie frei.
  • Marke mit Wiedererkennungswert: Du kümmerst Dich um unsere Markenidentität und sorgst für einen konsistenten Auftritt gegenüber Kunden, Partnern und Investoren.
  • Story nach außen tragen: Du übersetzt Marken- und Produktstory in die externe Kommunikation, z. B. beim Aufbau und bei der Pflege unserer Homepage-Story.
  • Content mit Plan: Du entwickelst Content-Ideen, Strategie und Planung und beantwortest die Frage, was wir wann und wo kommunizieren. Auch für Newsletter und Marketing Automation lieferst Du den Story- und Portfolio-Input.
  • Sales stark machen: Du unterstützt bei Pitch-Decks, Battlecards und RFP/RFI-Antworten. Die Begleitung unserer Go-to-Market-Aktivitäten gehört für Dich ganz selbstverständlich dazu.
  • Eigene Events & MICE Report: Du verantwortest Konzept und Ownership unserer Kunden- und Branchenformate. Beim MICE Report hast Du die Projektleitung und sorgst dafür, dass er bei C-Level und in der PR ankommt. Die Redaktion liegt bei Content, SEO & GEO.
  • Datenbasiert entscheiden: Du formulierst gezielte Analyse-Anfragen an unseren Data Analyst und übersetzt die Empfehlungen in GTM-Entscheidungen.
  • Mitgestalten auf Führungsebene: Du bringst Deine Perspektive in die Team-Priorisierung ein und stimmst Dich regelmäßig mit dem CRO ab.

Was uns gefällt

  • Erfahrung, die zählt: Erste Erfahrungen (ca. 2 Jahre) im Product Marketing oder in einer vergleichbaren Positionierungs- oder Brand-Rolle mit, idealerweise im B2B-SaaS-Umfeld.
  • Enterprise-Know-how: Idealerweise hast Du schon mit Enterprise-Zielgruppen gearbeitet. Erfahrung mit Procurement- oder RFP-Prozessen ist ein Plus.
  • Storytelling im Blut: Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Geschichten und Marken und weißt, wie man komplexe Produkte greifbar macht.
  • Markenführung mit System: Du sorgst für Konsistenz von Ton, visueller Identität und Botschaften über mehrere Touchpoints und Websites hinweg. Mit Marken-KPIs wie Awareness, Sentiment und Preference kennst Du Dich in den Grundzügen aus.
  • Den Markt im Blick: Du hast Spaß daran, den Wettbewerb zu beobachten.
  • Tool-sicher: Du bist mit Marketing-Automation-Tools wie HubSpot vertraut.
  • Souverän auf jeder Ebene: Du präsentierst Deine Ideen sicher, auch vor der Geschäftsführung.
  • Macher-Mentalität: Du arbeitest strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich und fühlst Dich in einem kleinen Team wohl.

Was Dir gefällt

  • Teamspirit, der Spaß macht: Freu Dich auf ein motiviertes, hochqualifiziertes Team mit flachen Hierarchien und echtem Zusammenhalt. Dazu gibt's regelmäßige Teamevents wie Afterwork-Drinks auf der Dachterrasse, Culture Nights oder Spieleabende.
  • Sei ein Sparfuchs: Profitiere von exklusiven Rabatten auf Top-Marken und Reisen über PepXpress und Corporate Benefits.
  • Gut versorgt: Natürlich stehen Dir der obligatorische Obstkorb, eine Müslibar sowie kalte und warme Getränke jederzeit zur Verfügung.
  • Individuelle Hardware-Wahl: Du entscheidest, ob Du mit einem Mac oder einem Windows-Gerät arbeitest.
  • Arbeitszeiten: Unsere Kernarbeitszeit ist von 10 bis 17 Uhr. Den Rest gestaltest Du nach Deinem Rhythmus.
  • Büro mit Wow-Faktor: Du arbeitest mit Blick auf die Elbe und einige der schönsten Sehenswürdigkeiten Hamburgs.
  • Pick your Perk: Du wählst 20 € Benefitsy, 20 € Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket oder 20 € Zuschuss für Urban Sports.
  • Wachstum: Wir fördern Deine Weiterentwicklung mit einem Learning Budget von 300 € pro Jahr.
  • Für später schon heute gesorgt: Du bekommst bis zu 100 € monatlich für Deine Altersvorsorge und Vermögensziele (bAV & VWL).

title: Product Marketing Manager - Launches & Adoption
descriptionHtml:
Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work.

Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual.

Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate.

A bit about us:

🚀 We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on.

🏢 Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision.

💰 We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date.

🤝 We're trusted by 5,000+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster.

💡 Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one.

About the role

Orbital is looking for a Product Marketing Manager to lead how our product releases are brought to market and adopted.

As our product and release cadence continue to grow, this role will turn a steady stream of new capabilities into clear, compelling stories for customers, prospects and the wider market. You’ll work across the product roadmap to understand what matters most, shape how releases are positioned, and coordinate how and when they reach the right audiences.

You’ll independently lead a broad portfolio of product and feature launches, while playing a key supporting role in Tier 1 launches alongside our Senior Product Marketing Manager. You’ll also help embed and evolve the systems that enable us to launch consistently at scale, from our existing launch framework and calendar to our changelog, in-product communications and Help Centre.

This is a high-autonomy role at the intersection of Product, Marketing and Customer Success. It’s a great opportunity for a product marketer who combines strong messaging skills with excellent execution and enjoys creating structure around a fast-moving product organisation.

What you’ll do

  • Lead product launches end to end. Own the go-to-market strategy and execution for a portfolio of product and feature launches, from defining the audience and customer value through messaging, channel strategy, timing and measurement.

  • Run and evolve our launch programme. Implement our existing launch framework across Product and Marketing, managing roadmap intake, launch tiering and a single launch calendar. You’ll help teams apply the framework consistently and iterate it over time based on what we learn from launches and adoption.

  • Develop positioning and messaging. Turn complex product capabilities into clear, compelling value propositions and messaging that resonate with customers, prospects and the wider market.

  • Drive awareness and adoption. Plan how releases are brought to market across in-product messaging, email, the changelog, website and other channels, ensuring the right audiences understand what’s new, why it matters and how it strengthens the value of Orbital.

  • Own our product changelog. Build and manage an external changelog that gives customers and prospects a clear, useful and always-current view of what’s new in Orbital.

  • Evolve our Help Centre. Partner with Product and Customer Support to keep product education accurate, useful and up to date, and improve the experience through stronger written, visual and video content.

  • Raise the quality of product marketing. Create clear standards, templates and guidance that help teams communicate new capabilities effectively across customer and market-facing channels. You’ll act as an editor and trusted partner to Product, helping turn subject-matter expertise into high-quality product marketing.

  • Measure launch impact. Define and track success metrics across awareness, activation and adoption, using the results to improve how we prioritise, plan and execute future launches.

  • Partner across go-to-market teams. Work closely with Revenue Enablement, Customer Success and the wider Marketing team to ensure launches translate into effective market education, customer adoption, campaigns and commercial readiness.

How you’ll work with the team

You’ll work closely with our Senior Product Marketing Manager, who leads overarching product positioning and Tier 1 launches. You’ll independently own a high volume of product and feature launches, while contributing to Tier 1 launches and helping ensure our overall launch programme works as one coherent system.

You’ll also partner closely with Product Managers across our UK and US products, as well as Revenue Enablement, Customer Success, Product Design and the wider Marketing team.

Your first few months

You’ll start by building a deep understanding of our product, customers, market and current launch process, working closely with Product teams and spending time with customers.

From there, you’ll embed our launch framework and calendar across the product organisation, launch our external changelog, and take ownership of your first major product launch.

You’ll also refine the playbooks and templates that help teams execute great launches consistently as Orbital continues to grow.

About you

  • 4+ years of experience in B2B SaaS product marketing, with a strong track record of leading product launches end to end.

  • A strong product storyteller. You can quickly understand a technical or complex capability, identify why it matters to the market, and turn that into clear, differentiated messaging.

  • An excellent writer and editor. You write with clarity and precision, know the difference between a feature and a benefit, and can improve other people’s work without losing the underlying expertise.

  • A strong cross-functional operator. You’re comfortable managing multiple launches, stakeholders and timelines at once, and know how to create the structure that keeps work moving.

  • Good judgement and influence. You can make clear recommendations about priorities, timing and messaging, build alignment across teams, and challenge constructively when needed.

  • Able to see the bigger picture. You can look across a portfolio of releases and understand how individual capabilities contribute to a broader product and market narrative.

  • Customer and data-led. You want to understand how customers use the product and use qualitative and quantitative signals to improve launches and adoption over time.

  • Comfortable working at pace. You enjoy working with a product that evolves quickly and can balance speed with a high standard of execution.

  • Confident using AI in your own work. You use AI tools to speed up and refine your processes, deploying it thoughtfully to work more effectively while bringing the judgement and editorial quality needed for external-facing work.

  • Experienced working across global teams and markets. This role supports both our UK and US products, so you’ll be comfortable collaborating across time zones.

  • Familiar with product adoption and customer communication tools, such as Intercom, Pendo, Appcues, Beamer or similar.

Nice to have

  • Experience in legal tech, real estate, proptech or another complex or expertise-led B2B market.

  • Experience owning or significantly contributing to a Help Centre, knowledge base or customer education programme.

  • Experience marketing AI products, particularly products that evolve quickly and where trust matters.

🔒 Security is everyone’s responsibility at Orbital. We ask all team members to follow our security policies, complete regular awareness training, and handle sensitive data with care in line with ISO 27001 standards. Spot something unusual? Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on.

💡 At Orbital, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially welcome applications from people who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, or if the right role isn’t listed yet, we’d still love to hear from you.

💰 This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on several factors, which may include job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and business requirements.

Everyone who works with Orbital goes through background screening before they start. It's part of how we keep Orbital secure, for the people who work here and for the client information we're trusted with.

title: Product Marketing Manager (Legal Tech)
descriptionHtml:
About DeepJudge:

Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.

Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.

Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you.

 

About the role:
DeepJudge is a fast-growing venture-backed startup at the forefront of applying Artificial Intelligence in the legal domain. Founded by ex-Googlers and ETH PhDs, our mission is to help legal teams harness their collective knowledge so they can focus on the strategic aspects of their work. DeepJudge’s state-of-the-art knowledge retrieval system directs legal professionals to the internal insights that matter most, providing a strong foundation for AI-powered workflows. We’re headquartered in Zurich, with a team in the United States and Canada, and cater to clients all around the world.

We are looking for a thoughtful and strategic Product Marketing Manager to help shape how we communicate the value of AI-powered legal solutions to the market. As a subject matter expert on our products, you will craft compelling messaging, develop go-to-market strategies, and collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure our positioning resonates with customers.

This is an exciting opportunity for a marketer who is passionate about making complex technology approachable and valuable for legal professionals. You are a great fit for this role if you have a proven track record in B2B SaaS product marketing, a talent for crafting compelling messaging, and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally to drive product launches, customer adoption, and market success.

What you’ll be doing

  • Craft compelling messaging and positioning that articulates the value of DeepJudge to our core audiences, ensuring consistency across all touchpoints.

  • Lead the launch of new features and products, collaborating closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to ensure successful adoption and engagement.

  • Act as a proactive advocate for DeepJudge’s product by sharing product features, use cases, and insights across the company.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders in Product, Marketing, and Commercial teams to create effective enablement materials and ensure alignment with strategic goals.

  • Gather and synthesize customer and market insights to provide actionable feedback that informs product development and enhances product-market fit.

  • Translate data and findings into actionable insights that drive decisions and fuel impactful product and feature updates.

  • Collaborate with the Marketing team to support marketing campaigns for new product features and updates.

  • Create, monitor, and analyze product marketing performance metrics to guide strategic actions.

  • Use tools such as Hubspot, Figma, Webflow, Linear, and G Suite to manage projects, analyze data, and create content, with a focus on data-driven decision-making

What we are looking for

  • 3+ years of product marketing experience, in the B2B SaaS or technology space (legal tech strongly preferred but will consider experience within complex data/AI enterprise software space)

  • Overall 5-8 years of experience as product marketer, marketing solutions, product management or product strategy

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills. Writing experience is important (share your portfolio or submit a writing sample with your application)

  • Comfortable with user data and have experience in industry and customer research

  • Translate data into actionable insights, ensuring decisions are grounded in evidence, not assumptions

  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment, managing multiple priorities with attention to detail

  • Analytical data-driven mindset, but orientation towards getting things done quickly and efficiently

  • Ideally, experience collaborating with Marketing on account-based and content strategies

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field

What you can look forward to

  • You will be able to take on full ownership of your projects and tasks from day 1

  • You will have a stake in shaping the future of a high-impact, high-growth deep-tech startup

  • Competitive compensation, flexible working arrangements

     

At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If this role excites you, but you feel you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a great fit.

title: Product Ops IA / Product Manager Ops - (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
Mindset

Chez Thiga, nous sommes convaincus que l’IA ne transforme pas seulement les produits, mais aussi la façon de les concevoir, de les construire et de les faire évoluer. Discovery, delivery, coordination, documentation, pilotage : tout le Product Development Lifecycle est en train d’être réinventé.

La plupart des entreprises ont déjà démarré. Elles ont des POCs, des power users, des outils partout, parfois des gains individuels visibles. Mais elles peinent encore à transformer cette énergie en gain collectif, en nouveaux standards de travail et en performance durable.

C’est là qu’intervient l’AI Product Ops.

Pas pour agir comme théoricien, mais pour repenser concrètement les modes de fonctionnement produit-tech, designer des équipes hybrides humains-agents, outiller les bons workflows, et faire de l’IA un levier d’efficience organisationnelle dans le delivery de produits digitaux.

Chez Thiga, nous ne nous arrêtons pas à la recommandation. Nous construisons avec nos clients. Nous testons, nous outillons, nous faisons adopter.

Le job

En immersion chez le client, tu interviens au cœur de l’organisation produit-tech pour refondre le Product Development Lifecycle avec l’IA.

Ton rôle : identifier où l’IA crée le plus de valeur, repenser les processus, faire émerger de nouveaux standards de travail, et construire les premiers outils, skills ou agents qui rendent cette transformation réelle.

Tu es à la fois :

  • un profil hands-on, capable de builder pour montrer l’exemple ;

  • un profil ops, capable de simplifier et fiabiliser les workflows ;

  • un profil change, capable d’embarquer les équipes dans de nouvelles pratiques ;

Concrètement, dans le cadre de tes missions, tu seras amené·e à

  • Auditer les processus de discovery, delivery et go-to-market pour identifier les frictions, les tâches à faible valeur, les dépendances inutiles et les opportunités de délégation à l’IA.

  • Reconcevoir des processus de travail plus simples, plus rapides et plus robustes, en intégrant nativement l’IA dans le fonctionnement des équipes.

  • Designer des équipes hybrides humains-agents, en clarifiant les rôles, les responsabilités, les points de contrôle et les conditions de réussite.

  • Mettre en place les outils, standards et rituels nécessaires à une exécution plus fluide : documentation, pilotage, reporting, coordination, partage de connaissance, qualité d’exécution.

  • Builder toi-même des skills, assistants, automatisations ou agents simples adaptés au contexte client, pour outiller des usages concrets et immédiats.

  • Contribuer au product building de manière très opérationnelle, pour démontrer par la preuve ce que de nouveaux modes de travail rendent possible.

  • Former et accompagner les équipes produit, design, tech et métier dans l’adoption de nouvelles pratiques, de nouveaux outils et de nouveaux réflexes de travail.

  • Mesurer l’impact des évolutions mises en place et ajuster en continu ce qui doit l’être.

  • Aider les clients à éviter trois écueils fréquents : beaucoup d’énergie pour peu d’impact, des POCs qui ne scalent pas, et des gains individuels qui ne se traduisent jamais en gains système.

À quoi ressemble le succès dans ce rôle

Au bout de quelques mois chez un client, tu as contribué à faire émerger des résultats visibles et mesurables :

  • des workflows de discovery et de delivery revus, simplifiés et mieux maîtrisés ;

  • des usages IA prioritaires cadrés, outillés et réellement adoptés ;

  • plusieurs agents ou assistants internes en production d’usage ;

  • une baisse nette du temps passé sur les tâches à faible valeur ;

  • une amélioration tangible de la rapidité d’exécution et de l’efficience collective.

  • la satisfaction des équipes accompagnées ;

Ce que ce rôle n’est pas

Ce poste n’est pas fait pour toi si tu cherches principalement à faire :

  • du conseil hors sol, très conceptuel, sans opérationnalisation rapide ;

  • du portfolio management ;

  • de la gestion d’infrastructure ou de plateforme ;

  • de l’industrialisation technique à grande échelle ;

L’AI Product Ops n’est ni un PMO, ni un architecte de plateforme, ni un ML engineer. C’est un rôle à l’intersection de l’efficience organisationnelle, du build, et de la conduite du changement.

Qui es-tu ?

Tu as au moins 6 ans d’expérience, avec un parcours qui t’a donné une compréhension forte du fonctionnement réel des équipes produit-tech.

Tu es probablement :

  • un·e coach agile aguerri au passé de dev, ayant une approche hands-on

  • un·e Product Ops senior ;

  • ou un·e Product Manager avec une très forte fibre ops ;

Et surtout :

  • Tu as déjà travaillé au sein d’équipes produit, au plus près du delivery et de la réalité terrain.

  • Tu sais analyser un flux de valeur de développement, repérer les goulots d’étranglement, et transformer une friction en dispositif concret.

  • Tu utilises déjà l’IA au quotidien dans ta pratique professionnelle (claude code, cursor, …).

  • Tu sais tirer parti de copilotes, assistants, outils d’automatisation, outils de documentation augmentée et solutions d’orchestration légère.

  • Tu es capable de builder toi-même des agents ou assistants simples, sans prétendre être la personne qui les industrialisera techniquement à grande échelle.

  • Tu sais passer de l’idée à l’outil, puis de l’outil à l’adoption.

  • Tu es à l’aise aussi bien avec des équipes opérationnelles qu’avec des interlocuteurs de direction.

  • Tu as suffisamment de culture produit pour ne pas confondre vitesse et valeur.

  • Tu parles anglais couramment.

Ton savoir-être

  • Tu es énergique, pragmatique et orienté impact.

  • Tu aimes autant transformer un mode de fonctionnement que mettre les mains dans les outils.

  • Tu sais embarquer sans évangéliser dans le vide.

  • Tu as une posture de partenaire exigeant : direct, utile, crédible.

  • Tu navigues bien entre technique, produit, organisation et business.

  • Tu sais faire avancer un sujet même quand tout n’est pas encore cadré.

Et en interne, au sein de Thiga

  • Tu interviens comme consultant·e en mission, au plus près des enjeux clients.

  • Tu contribues au développement de l’offre AI Product Ops / POM-AI avec le référent de l’offre.

  • Tu participes à la production de contenu, à la capitalisation, au partage interne et à certaines démarches d’avant-vente.

  • Tu contribues à faire monter Thiga en niveau sur les nouvelles pratiques d’organisation produit à l’ère de l’IA.

Les étapes 🎢
  • Un pré-entretien téléphonique avec un membre de l’équipe recrutement.
  • Une rencontre avec un des Directeurs de la Tribe Conseil
  • Une étude de cas afin de confirmer ce que vous savez mettre en pratique.
  • Un dernier échange pour apprécier l’entente mutuelle 🤝
Thiga accueille toutes les personnes compétentes et passionnées et s'engage en faveur de la diversité culturelle, l'égalité de genre et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés — au contraire nous considérons la diversité comme une grande richesse !

title: Product Owner - Acquitech
descriptionHtml:
Product Owner - Sales & Marketing, Acquisition Technology

Hybrid in London, UK

We're looking for a Product Owner to join the Acquitech team.

You'll own the roadmap for the team behind iwoca's acquisition data, technology and models.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star service ensure business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £5 billion in funding. Our team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they power.

The team

Acquitech builds and maintains the data infrastructure behind iwoca's direct acquisition channels. The team's aim is to get the right data to the right places – so ad platforms find businesses worth reaching, analysts trust the reports they build, and the sales team knows who to call first.

The team works across four areas:

  • Tracking and attribution. Recording every lead and sign-up accurately, and sending conversion data back to ad platforms so their algorithms improve over time.

  • Customer value prediction. Building models that estimate a potential customer's expected value, used to guide where marketing spends, who receives direct mail and which businesses a salesperson prioritises.

  • The data layer. Providing a clear, trusted foundation so analysts and channel managers can build reporting without second-guessing the numbers.

  • Team tooling and automation. Building tools and automated workflows, from automating sales task assignment to running LLM analysis on sales calls so the team can review performance at scale.

The team is small – three engineers, two data scientists and you – with the senior engineer sharing the day-to-day leadership. You'll report to a Senior Product Owner in an adjacent team.

The role

As Product Owner in Acquitech, you'll turn requests from marketing and sales into well-scoped work the team can deliver, and own the roadmap. You'll have real ownership of systems that directly shape acquisition spend, and the space to move quickly in a small, capable team. The work mixes delivery – compliance sign-offs, ad platform integrations and product changes – with discovery cycles where you prototype and test ideas quickly.

You'll become the go-to person for Acquitech systems and processes, and you'll use AI to multiply what a small team can deliver – from prototyping ideas to automating workflows for the team and its stakeholders.

  • Roadmap and priorities. You'll own priorities across Acquitech's work, writing clear requirements and seeing them through to release. You'll set direction with the Head of Direct Acquisition and the channel leads who depend on the team.

  • Tracking and ad platform integrations. You'll lead the team's work on conversion tracking, custom audiences and API migrations. You'll own the product change documentation that comes with them, working through Compliance, Data Privacy and Legal.

  • Discovery. You'll run discovery work to find new opportunities, using AI to prototype and test ideas quickly, and bring findings back to the wider business – for example through weekly learning sessions.

  • Ways of working. You'll run the team's rhythms – stand-ups, retros and monthly reviews – and set clear quarterly goals.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Product ownership. You've worked in a product role, managing several projects end to end – writing requirements, owning priorities and being accountable for results.

  • Data literacy. You use data to diagnose problems, size opportunities and evaluate whether a release delivered what you hoped.

  • Technical fluency. You can discuss trade-offs with engineers around APIs, tracking pipelines and data flows. You follow the argument without needing everything translated.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly. You adapt technical detail for commercial colleagues and commercial context for engineers.

  • Leadership. You're comfortable running stand-ups and retros, setting quarterly goals and keeping priorities clear.

  • AI leverage. You've built AI workflows, or used AI to produce specs, analysis, or prototypes beyond what you could deliver alone. You judge when to use it and when not to.

Bonus:

  • Marketing technology. You've worked with tools such as Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4, Google Ads or Meta Ads, or on conversion tracking and attribution.

  • Analytics tools. You've used Looker, Amplitude or a similar analytics platform to build or maintain reporting.

  • Data pipelines. You understand ETL concepts or database architecture.

  • Data science collaboration. You've worked alongside data scientists or contributed to a modelling project.

  • Regulated products. You've worked in fintech, lending or another regulated product area.

The salary

We expect to pay from £50,000 to £70,000 for this role. We're open-minded, so include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every team member always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days' holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we've been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Compensation: £50K – £70K

title: Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
Location: London (Next to East Croydon Station)

Hybrid: 3 days in office, 2 days from home

Reports to: CTO

About Us

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities.

With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

Role Overview

You will be the product owner for one of our product teams. You own that team’s backlog, the discovery work behind it, the acceptance of what the team builds, and the conversations with the customers it is built for. You report to the CTO, and our product manager, who owns product strategy and the roadmap across the teams, supervises your work day to day.

This is a product role first and a coding role second. You also generate code with AI tools, mostly on the front end, at roughly the level of a junior to mid-level engineer. We expect you to build working prototypes and small features that an engineer then takes over. We do not expect back-end work, architecture or being on call.

Our teams are formed from the people we have at the time, so you are not being hired into a named team. You will work with the engineers in your team, the product manager, the CTO and our customer-facing colleagues.

In your first year, you will get a team running on your backlog without the CTO or the product manager stepping in, and you will have personally shipped front-end changes and prototypes that engineers took forward.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own your team’s backlog: decide what goes in, what stays out and what comes next, and keep it in order.

  • Run discovery with customers, so that what the team builds is something customers need and will use.

  • Turn messy requests, rules and processes into small slices of work with precise acceptance criteria that an engineer can build and a customer can recognise.

  • Accept the team’s work against the acceptance criteria.

  • Say no, or reshape the request, when a customer asks for something that does not fit, and agree a next step with them.

  • Build prototypes and small front-end features with AI tools, check what the tools produce, and hand the work to an engineer to take forward.

  • Work with the product manager so that your backlog fits the roadmap, and tell them early when it does not.

Who we’re looking for

  • You have owned a team’s backlog. You decided what was built next and what was not, you accepted the work, and you can say what you decided and why.

  • You have told a customer no, or changed what they asked for. You can say what they wanted, what you said and what happened next.

  • You find out what customers need before building. You can show us a time you did discovery and what it changed.

  • You turn messy requests, rules and processes into small slices with precise acceptance criteria. You can show us a time you did it, how you knew you had it right, and what you got wrong.

  • You build working front-end prototypes or small features with AI tools, in the last 12 months, and an engineer took them forward. You can say what you built and what the engineer changed.

  • You check what AI tools produce. You can describe a time the output was wrong and how you caught it.

  • You work well with engineers: you hand work over clearly and accept the finished work against what you agreed.

Knowledge of parking or of any one industry is welcome, but none of it is required.

What We Offer

  • Hybrid working, 3 days in the office and 2 days from home.

  • Real ownership of a team’s backlog and its customer conversations, with a product manager alongside you.

  • A small team and real influence over what we build.

  • A strong, high performing culture, with genuine influence over how that culture develops as Hozah grows.

  • A fully refurbished, modern office, right next to East Croydon Station (with a fully stocked kitchen, offering free breakfast, lunch and drinks!).

title: Product Owner Gemeentepas
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij maximale waarde creëren voor gemeenten, aanbieders en eindgebruikers met de Gemeentepas? Het kan als Product Owner. Je vormt de spil tussen business, technologie en operatie en is in staat om de strategische doelen van de organisiatie te vertalen naar tactische doelen en het opzetten van een duidelijke productvisie, roadmap en backlog.

Wat jij doet

Als Product Owner ontwikkel en onderhoud je een heldere productvisie en -strategie voor de stadspasoplossing, afgestemd op de behoeften van gemeenten en het portfolio van Centric. Je richt je op het bepalen van de productrichting, het vertalen van wensen en behoeften naar concrete verbeteringen en het onderhouden van sterke relaties met stakeholders.

In deze rol gaan we een maximaal beroep doen op je commerciële vaardigheden. De Gemeentepas is een nieuwe oplossing binnen ons portfolio. Dat betekent dat je veel contact met potentiële klanten zult hebben. Hun wensen weet te vertalen naar standaardoplossingen en daarvoor een marktconforme vergoeding weet te verantwoorden. Je zult actief in aanbesteding trajecten een inhoudelijk en commerciële rol gaan vervullen.

Je wordt daarin uiteraard ondersteund door onze product sales en productmanager. Wij denken dat dit een hele mooie kans is voor een zeer ondernemende product owner die in zichzelf en een nieuw product wil investeren.

Wat doe je nog meer?

  • Productstrategie en roadmap: Je stelt een roadmap op voor de doorontwikkeling van de Gemeentepas. Hierbij kijk je naar integraties met gemeentelijke systemen, waaronder Suites voor het Sociaal Domein, en onderzoek je nieuwe mogelijkheden, zoals koppelingen met Europese wallets.

  • Klant- en stakeholdermanagement: Je vertegenwoordigt de stem van de klant en zorgt ervoor dat wensen, behoeften en eisen van gemeenten, aanbieders en eindgebruikers worden vertaald naar concrete productverbeteringen.

  • Backlogbeheer en prioritering: Je beheert en prioriteert de productbacklog op basis van businesswaarde, wettelijke vereisten, strategische doelstellingen en gebruikersfeedback.

  • Samenwerking met het ontwikkelteam: Je werkt nauw samen met het scrumteam om epics en user stories op te stellen, te verfijnen en te valideren, zodat de ontwikkelwerkzaamheden aansluiten bij de productvisie.

  • Analyse en optimalisatie: Je identificeert hiaten in de functionaliteit door middel van fit-gapanalyses en initieert verbeteringen op het gebied van gebruikerservaring (UX), toegankelijkheid en systeemintegraties.

  • Markt- en trendontwikkeling: Je volgt marktontwikkelingen, relevante wet- en regelgeving en technologische innovaties en vertaalt deze naar nieuwe functionaliteiten en proposities.

  • Monitoring en waardecreatie: Je bewaakt de voortgang en de gerealiseerde waarde per sprint en release en stuurt waar nodig bij om de productdoelstellingen te behalen.

  • Rapportage en KPI’s: Je monitort en rapporteert over relevante KPI’s, zoals gebruikerstevredenheid en de adoptie van de stadspasoplossing door gemeenten en aanbieders

Dit krijg je

Bij Centric kun je als Product Owner/ Productmanager rekenen op:

  • Een brutosalaris van €4.500,- tot € 5.250,- per maand afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring

  • Mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken en een goede werk-privébalans doordat je de ruimte krijgt om te bepalen hoe jij jouw werkweek indeelt

  • Uitgebreide opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden

  • 26 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantietoeslag (uitbetaling in mei) en loyaliteitsdagen: hoe langer je in dienst bent, hoe meer vrije tijd

  • Een bijdrage aan je pensioen en korting op je collectieve zorgverzekering

  • Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak

  • Een thuiswerkplekvergoeding van € 15,- per maand plus € 2,45 netto per thuiswerkdag

  • Een mobiliteitsbudget omdat jij zelf wil bepalen hoe je van werk naar huis reist

  • Personeelsaanbiedingen bij toonaangevende merken

  • Een bonus tot € 1.500,- als jij een nieuwe collega aan ons voorstelt

  • Een personeelsvereniging die écht leuke dingen organiseert. Ga je mee naar Praag, de Efteling of skiën?

Dit breng je mee

Je hebt strategisch inzicht, bent besluitvaardig en beschikt over sterke analytische vaardigheden. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende profiel:

  • Je hebt hbo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in de richting van IT, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied.

  • Je hebt enkele jaren ervaring als Product Owner of Product Manager binnen softwareontwikkeling.

  • Je hebt ervaring binnen de publieke sector. Kennis van het Sociaal Domein is een sterke pré.

  • Je hebt kennis van systeemintegraties, security en privacy, waaronder de AVG en Secure Software Development.

Het maken van een assessment kan onderdeel uitmaken van deze sollicitatieprocedure.

Omring jezelf met mogelijkheden bij Centric

Hier starten jouw kansen
Zonder dat je het misschien weet, ben je al eens met Centric in aanraking geweest. Als je betaalt in de winkel. Als je een glas kraanwater drinkt. Als je een paspoort aanvraagt. Duizenden organisaties en hun miljoenen klanten rekenen elke dag weer op onze 200+ technologische oplossingen, hoogwaardige IT-diensten en 3.700 gekwalificeerde professionals. Samen zorgen we dat belangrijke processen in onze samenleving altijd doordraaien.

Zodra je Centric komt versterken, omring jij jezelf met mogelijkheden. Zo kun je jouw kennis vergroten door samen te werken met de ongeveer 500 collega’s van Digitale Overheid. Als partner van meer dan 300 gemeenten zorgen wij er dagelijks voor dat de dienstverlening van decentrale overheden aan inwoners en bedrijven niet komt stil te vallen. Want wist jij dat bijna alles wat inwoners van Nederland met de overheid regelen via onze oplossingen verloopt? Denk aan lokale belastingen en vergunningen, maar ook aanvraag van reisdocumenten en een uitkeringsaanvraag. Al die gegevens zorgen voor steeds meer inzicht en daarmee voor een nog betere dienstverlening richting inwoners.

We only have positions available for Dutch-speaking applicants residing in the Netherlands.

Wil jij bouwen aan het verschil? Solliciteer via onze website naar deze vacature Product Owner Gemeentepas. Voor meer informatie over de functie kun je contact opnemen met onze Recruiter, Danitsha Abdul via +31 6 10053663 of

Centric aanvaardt geen ongevraagde hulp van intermediairs/uitzendbureaus of andere derden voor onze vacatures. Toegestuurde cv’s (in welke vorm dan ook) door genoemde partijen aan enige medewerkers van Centric zonder geldige schriftelijke zoekopdracht van onze HR Afdeling of Recruiters, worden beschouwd als publieke informatie. Er zal aan genoemde partijen geen vergoeding zijn verschuldigd in geval dat een kandidaat wordt aangenomen van wie ongevraagd het cv en/of andere gegevens zijn toegestuurd.
