title: Product Owner Hardware (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
What We're Building Towards

At Omegga, we're on a mission to reinvent how AI and spectroscopy can drive positive change for animals, people and the planet. We started with a clear objective: eliminate chick culling on a global scale through early, non-invasive detection. This outdated practice still impacts billions of lives, and we're here to change that. We're not building for the niche, we're building for the global standard.

Today, our systems are already in use, and the focus is on scaling performance, robustness, and deployment across an international customer base. For us, scaling means more than growth. It means changing an industry for the better.

We are looking for people who take ownership, think in systems, and want to help turn a working product into the industry benchmark. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a Technical Project Manager who runs our hardware development projects end to end and holds the thread between our engineers, our external partners, and our leadership. Our system combines optics, mechanics, electronics, and embedded control with machine learning on top. Most of what you manage is hardware, but every hardware decision touches software and data science, and you make sure those pieces move together.

Development happens in-house, but parts of it are outsourced to production partners and component suppliers. You keep those external work packages aligned with our internal timelines, specifications, and quality standards. Our Sales Engineering team owns the customer relationship; you make sure their requirements turn into delivered systems.

You take ownership end to end, hold yourself to a high standard, and focus on outcomes that matter for the customer. You communicate openly, give honest feedback, and build trust through your actions.

What You'll Build

  • Own the plan for our hardware development projects, from concept and prototypes to release for series production

  • Keep hardware, software, and data science development in sync: interfaces, test campaigns, integration milestones, and releases

  • Prioritize the integration backlog together with our tech leads and align it with customer commitments

  • Manage the outsourced parts of our development with production partners and component suppliers: scope, specifications, timelines, and quality

  • Integrate partner timelines into the overall project plan and resolve conflicts before they become blockers

  • Plan and coordinate system deployments together with Sales Engineering: installation scheduling, spare parts, and incident handling

  • Plan and monitor project budgets, track risks, and initiate corrective measures early

  • Deliver clear, regular reporting on milestones, trial outcomes, and project status to leadership

What You Bring

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in technical project management in a hardware development environment: machinery, medtech, robotics, optics, or comparable

  • Solid understanding of hardware development, from prototyping to release for small series production

  • Experience coordinating outsourced development work with manufacturers or key suppliers

  • Enough understanding of software and data science to spot dependencies to the hardware and plan integration realistically

  • Experience with project budgets and risk tracking

  • Strong communication skills: you naturally become the connective tissue between engineers, partners, and leadership

  • A structured, hands-on working style and an affinity for using AI tools in your daily workflow

  • Fluent English. Fluent German is a strong plus for working with our partners and suppliers

  • Willingness to travel occasionally to our partners

  • Nice to have: experience with embedded systems, optics, or agile product ownership

Not ticking every box? That's okay. If this role excites you and you bring most of what we've described, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Get

Mission & Technical Challenge: At Omegga, you work on problems that are both technically demanding and globally relevant. We build deep-tech solutions with real-world impact, pushing the boundaries of what's currently possible.

Relocation Support: Moving to Munich? We are part of the WERK1 incubation program, which gives us access to apartments in the Werksviertel that never hit the open market. With enough lead time we reserve one for you before you arrive, minutes on foot from the office.

Work Environment: Located in Munich's Werksviertel, we combine a focused, high-performance culture with flexibility. Up to 50% remote work, depending on role and execution needs.

Ownership: VSOPs (Virtual Stock Options) so you share in the value you help create.

Time Off: 28 vacation days per year, plus December 24th and 31st off.

Benefits & Growth

  • Monthly meal budget for whatever keeps you going, from quick lunches to proper team dinners

  • Monthly perks budget to spend where it actually matters to you — fitness, mobility, or the occasional "I earned this" purchase

  • Annual learning budget to invest in your growth, from conferences to deep dives into new domains

  • Free drinks, coffee, and snacks in the office to keep you focused throughout the day

title: Product Owner (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Die dokSAFE GmbH ist ein Leipziger Softwareunternehmen, das sich auf die Entwicklung der SaaS-Lösung Actaport spezialisiert hat. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, mit unserer Kanzleisoftware die Arbeitswelt in der Anwaltskanzlei zu revolutionieren.

Du übersetzt juristische und gesetzliche Anforderungen in konkretes Produktdesign — und sorgst dafür, dass das, was wir bauen, auch wirklich genutzt wird.

  • Du agierst als enger Sparringspartner für das Entwicklungsteam, um Rückfragen zu klären, Scope zu schärfen, Prioritäten verständlich zu machen und Blocker früh aufzulösen.

Qualifikation

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Rechtswissenschaften, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, der IT oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation bildet die Grundlage — entscheidend ist Dein Verständnis für juristische Prozesse und Nutzerbedürfnisse.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, detailorientiert und eigenverantwortlich und hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für UI/UX.
  • Du interessierst Dich für digitale Trends, KI und Legal Tech und bringst technische Affinität für Cloud-Software mit.
  • Deine sehr guten Deutsch- sowie Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen eine reibungslose Kommunikation im Team und mit Stakeholdern, um Ideen effektiv zu teilen und Ziele gemeinsam zu erreichen.

Benefits

  • Wir bieten eine sehr gute Work-Life-Balance durch flexible Arbeitszeiten.
  • Wir leben ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell — Homeoffice ist bei uns selbstverständlich möglich.
  • Neben 30 Urlaubstagen erhältst Du eine sehr gute Vergütung und zusätzliche finanzielle Benefits (Kitazuschuss, steuerfreier Sachbezug als Deutschlandticket oder 50€-Gutschein).
  • Wir statten Dich mit modernen Arbeitsgeräten und einer zeitgemäßen Entwicklungsumgebung aus — Du entscheidest, womit Du am liebsten arbeitest.
  • Dich erwarten flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege.
  • Dich begrüßen erfahrene Teamplayer in einem motivierten, inklusiven Team. Nach Deiner ausführlichen Einarbeitung arbeitest Du eigenverantwortlich in diesem.
  • Dich erwarten vielfältige Möglichkeiten für Deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung sowie eine optionale betriebliche Altersvorsorge.

Werde Teil unseres Teams und revolutioniere mit uns die Arbeitswelt in Anwaltskanzleien. Gestalte Deine Zukunft bei dokSAFE GmbH und bewirb Dich jetzt - wir freuen uns auf Dich!

Cosuno is the platform where construction companies run their tenders: general contractors invite subcontractors to bid, compare the offers and award the contracts. More than €100 billion in bid volume has already been tendered on our platform.

Our customers run complex procurement processes on Cosuno, and our commercial teams need someone who knows the product in every detail. As our Product Specialist, you'll be that person. You'll lead the customer meetings that need deep product knowledge, from custom development projects to strategic conversations with our enterprise customers. You'll report directly to our Head of Product.

  • Find solutions within the product. Sit down with customers, understand the problem behind the request and find creative ways to solve it with what we already have.

  • Turn feedback into decisions. Back customer requests with usage data, check them against our product principles and give our PMs clear, prioritized input. When we won't build something, you explain to the customer why.

  • Run custom developments. Project-manage custom developments for important customers: agree on scope, coordinate with Product and Engineering and deliver on time.

  • Close to the customer. We're very close to our customers and talk to them every week.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 2–4 years in a customer-facing product role in B2B SaaS, e.g. as Product Specialist, Solutions Consultant, Customer Success Manager or Implementation Manager

title: Product Support Engineer - EMEA
descriptionHtml:
Hello!

I’m Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. I’m excited to share that we’re hiring a Product Support Engineer in EMEA 🎉

We’re expanding our global Support team to provide 24/7 coverage across time zones. You’ll join a global team while establishing the technical Support Engineering presence in EMEA, with the ownership and visibility that come from being one of the first Support Engineers across European time zones. We staff across regions rather than relying on on-call rotations; we’ll discuss the specific schedule for this opening during the process.

Not sure which Support role is right for you?

We’re hiring for both Product Support Specialist and Product Support Engineer roles.

  • Support Specialist owns cases and customer communication end-to-end. Troubleshoots complex issues by navigating internal tooling — audit logs, user experience testing, and API testing — to help customers reach successful outcomes.

  • Support Engineering serves as the escalation point between Support Specialists and Product Engineering. Owns integrations, supports data mapping and data migrations for customers, and resolves escalated tickets that don't require product code changes.

Please choose the role that best reflects your experience and interests rather than applying to both. If another Support role seems like a closer match, we’ll consider that in our review.

About the role

Support Engineering is the technical layer between frontline Support and Engineering. You’ll take on complex issues involving integrations, APIs, permissions, data, reporting, migrations, and workflows—using application behavior, logs, databases, and customer context to determine whether an issue can be resolved through Support or represents a product defect.

You’ll investigate issues end to end using tools such as Plain, GitHub, Datadog, databases, and the codebase. You won’t write the fix; you’ll give Engineering a well-validated escalation with reproduction steps, relevant evidence, customer impact, and a root-cause hypothesis when possible. You’ll also identify recurring issues, improve documentation and enablement, and partner with Product and Engineering on improvements. As an early Support Engineer in EMEA, you’ll establish regional operating practices and handoff norms across European time zones while bringing EMEA customer patterns to a global team.

What you’ll own

  • Own complex technical issues from intake through resolution or escalation—investigating APIs, integrations, logs, data, configuration, and workflows to determine whether Support can resolve them or Engineering should be involved.

  • Set a high bar for complex technical investigations and ensure Engineering receives clear, actionable, well-validated product issues.

  • Build trusted working relationships with frontline Support, Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and customers.

  • Identify recurring problems and turn them into documentation, enablement, tooling, process improvements, or product feedback.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering on recurring product improvements by synthesizing customer patterns, validating defects, and sharing the technical context needed to choose between a product change, documentation, tooling, or process improvement.

  • Establish EMEA coverage, handoff, and operating practices across European time zones while bringing regional customer patterns to the global Support Engineering team.

  • Track and improve the outcomes that matter: resolution speed, escalation quality, fewer avoidable Engineering escalations, frontline self-sufficiency, reduced customer effort, and customer confidence.

You should apply if:

  • You’ve worked in a hands-on, customer-centric technical role where you independently investigate ambiguous issues involving APIs, integrations, logs, data, and application behavior.

  • You’re comfortable moving between customer conversations, APIs, logs, databases, product behavior, and code-level context to find root causes.

  • You can distinguish a configuration, data, documentation, or enablement issue from a true product defect—and explain your reasoning clearly.

  • You write precise investigations that others can quickly understand and act on, and communicate thoughtfully with technical and non-technical audiences across time zones.

  • You naturally look beyond the immediate ticket and improve the systems around it through documentation, enablement, tooling, or process design.

  • You want to be an early technical owner for EMEA and are energized by building regional structure within a global team.

You should not apply if:

  • You’re looking primarily for a high-volume support role centered on predefined troubleshooting steps, rather than open-ended technical investigation and ownership.

  • Most of your experience is in internal IT, help desk, endpoint, hardware, network, infrastructure, cloud operations, systems administration, infrastructure maintenance, or service deployment—and you haven’t worked extensively with customer-centric SaaS applications, APIs, logs, or data-backed troubleshooting.

  • You prefer to pass difficult issues to another team rather than reproduce, investigate, and explain them yourself.

  • You’re looking for a role focused mainly on writing production code; this role diagnoses and escalates bugs but does not own code changes.

  • You prefer clear-cut problems and predefined answers over working through ambiguity with careful documentation, focused questions, and evidence-based decisions.

  • You want a narrowly defined role without regional operating ownership or projects that improve how the broader Support team works.

About Ashby

Ashby builds a suite of products that helps talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run their hiring process significantly better. We raised a $50M Series D in July 2025 and support nearly 5,000 customers, including Shopify, Snowflake, OpenAI, Deliveroo, and Confluent. We’re growing much faster than 100% year over year, with a team of roughly 300 people across 22+ countries. Learn more at ashbyhq.com.

About Go To Market

We view our Support team as an extension of the product itself, one that ensures an optimal customer experience for customers ranging across all market segments. Here are a few points that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us:

  • We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is easier to sell.

  • We also spend a lot of time building a best-in-class customer experience. We aim to offer deep expertise whenever we interact with prospects and customers.

  • We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people and the right work environment deliver much better performance than teams with large headcount.

We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication (we put a lot of effort into using the right communication channels) - we’ll get into these and other values during the hiring process. You can take a look at our Leadership Principles to get a sense of what we value in People Leaders at Ashby.

Interview process

Our interview process is thorough and designed to give you enough information to assess whether Ashby is the right fit for you, while helping us evaluate technical reasoning, communication precision, and ownership.

  • Intro call with Recruiting — 30 min

  • Take-home assessment — 5 days to complete

  • Hiring Manager interview — 45–60 min

  • Virtual onsite — 120 min

    • Meet the team — 30 min

    • Technical & integration skills — 45 min

    • CS and Support leadership — 30 min

    • Closing questions — 15 min

Onboarding

Your onboarding will combine Ashby-wide product and company training with a Support Engineering-specific ramp plan. You’ll learn the product and support workflow, get familiar with the tools and systems used for technical investigations, and build relationships across Support, Product, and Engineering. With support from your manager and onboarding buddy, you’ll take on increasingly complex investigations as you build context, with regular check-ins throughout your first 90 days.

Benefits

Benefits vary by country and are shared in more detail during the process. International employees receive statutory benefits and, where available, employer-paid supplemental health coverage.

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅

  • A $1,200 annual learning and professional-development budget.

  • A one-time $2,000 home-office setup budget for furniture, monitors, peripherals, and ergonomic equipment, plus a company-provided laptop.

  • Opportunities to spend time with teammates through an annual company offsite, team offsites, local meetups, and virtual events.

  • Extended health benefits for you and your dependents (subject to availability with our Employer of Record)

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

title: Product & Yield Engineer (Data-focused)
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

We are looking for an Engineer to play a key role in the development and manufacture of Fractile's silicon products, with a particular focus on product, yield and manufacturing data analysis. Working across New Product Introduction (NPI), Yield Engineering and Product Quality, you will analyse large and complex semiconductor datasets to identify trends, isolate sources of variation, improve yield and reliability, and provide clear technical insight to engineering teams and manufacturing partners. This is a highly hands-on individual contributor role for someone who enjoys working directly with data, investigating complex technical problems and turning analysis into actionable engineering conclusions.

Skills and Experience

  • Demonstrable experience within the semiconductor industry in Product Engineering, Test Engineering, Yield Engineering, Data Analytics or Quality Engineering, ideally spanning NPI through to high-volume production

  • Strong experience analysing semiconductor manufacturing and test data to identify trends, correlations, excursions, yield loss mechanisms and opportunities for improvement

  • Solid experience in as many of the following areas as possible:

    • Wafer fab: analysis of Process Integration, Yield Enhancement, D0 Control, defect reduction and process variation data

    • IC Assembly: Assembly Process or Package Design, 3D IC and wafer stacking, Assembly Quality Control, BOM optimisation and Yield Engineering

    • Fabless Semiconductor: IC Product Qualification, reliability and failure analysis, RMA investigation and production monitoring

  • Strong knowledge of WAT, WS/CP and FT datasets, including correlation across manufacturing and test stages

  • Excellent data mining, statistical analysis and root-cause investigation skills, with the ability to turn complex datasets into clear engineering conclusions

  • Experience identifying yield signatures, parameter distributions, outliers, spatial patterns, lot-to-lot variation and systematic versus random failure mechanisms

  • Extensive hands-on use of semiconductor industry data analysis tools and software such as yieldHUB, Spotfire, JMP or equivalent

  • Ability to create scripts, automated analyses, dashboards and repeatable analytical workflows for standard engineering investigations and reporting

  • Experience applying statistical methods to semiconductor manufacturing data, including SPC, Cp/Cpk, distributions, correlation analysis, hypothesis testing and trend analysis

  • Ability to combine data from multiple sources and manufacturing stages to investigate complex product and process issues

  • Familiarity with FMEA-derived semiconductor qualification plans and relevant standards such as JEDEC

  • Understanding of semiconductor failure analysis methods and the ability to use analytical data to guide selection of destructive and non-destructive investigation techniques

title: Production Scheduler
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

 

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

 

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Build the machine that builds the machine. Join TechOps at the forefront of advanced manufacturing, we’re building the production system that will enable commercial fusion. The Production lines, tooling, and processes are being developed from the ground up; you'll create the ways of working, not inherit them.

  • Work at the frontier of manufacturing technology. Bring your creativity to evaluate, qualify, and deploy processes with no industry playbook, every component you build and every process you shape goes directly into the core of the stellarator magnet technology.

  • Do work that matters, and see it grow. The hardware you build is the product and your career grows with it, from prototyping and process development through quality and industrialization, alongside exceptional colleagues from around the world.

  • Make an impact you can point to. In a small, fast-moving team, your calls on equipment, quality, and process directly shape how a world-class deep-tech company produces superconducting magnets with results visible on the shop floor, not buried in a slidedeck.

YOUR IMPACT

Create and maintain detailed, day-to-day production schedules that translate the production plan into executable work on the manufacturing floor.

Monitor progress, resolve scheduling conflicts, and adapt plans in real time as priorities and conditions change.

Enable predictable delivery of critical fusion hardware while improving efficiency, coordination, and transparency across manufacturing operations.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Develop, maintain and continuously optimize detailed production schedules across multiple manufacturing work centers.

Sequence and re-sequence work orders day-to-day to reflect real-time engineering priorities, material availability and manufacturing constraints.

Monitor manufacturing progress in real time and proactively resolve scheduling conflicts and bottlenecks, implementing mitigation plans to protect critical program milestones.

Coordinate with the Procurement & Logistics Department to flag near-term material shortages and adjust the schedule to keep work centers running.

Balance day-to-day workloads across internal and external manufacturing resources in line with the capacity plan.

Work closely with Manufacturing Engineering to reflect process changes in the active schedule as soon as they take effect.

Partner with Program Managers to keep them informed of schedule status and re-prioritize work when program objectives shift.

Analyze schedule performance and identify emerging risks to delivery timelines, escalating issues before they impact critical milestones.

Generate and monitor key execution metrics, including schedule adherence, work order completion, lead times and work-in-progress.

Contribute to the development of scalable scheduling processes and tools as Proxima transitions from prototype manufacturing to industrial deployment.

WHO YOU ARE

You have a degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in production scheduling, manufacturing operations or supply chain within a complex engineering environment (aerospace, fusion, automotive, energy or other high-tech manufacturing industries).

You have experience with production scheduling systems, MRP/ERP workflows and manufacturing data management and are excited by the opportunity to help implement and shape planning tools in a rapidly growing manufacturing organization.

You thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments where priorities evolve quickly and scheduling decisions have a direct, immediate impact on manufacturing execution.

You are comfortable working close to the shop floor, spotting bottlenecks early and driving conflicts to resolution.

You communicate effectively across multidisciplinary teams and can balance competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

You are proactive, detail-oriented and comfortable working in an evolving hardware development environment.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

  • CEO call (30 min)

This role sits at L2/L3 of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: Productmanager Data & Webdiensten
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij een inspirator die strategische IT-doelen weet te operationaliseren en innovatie binnen je team stimuleert? Wil jij een veilige en moderne generieke technische IT-infrastructuur ontwikkelen en onderhouden? En zorg jij ervoor dat de dagelijkse operatie veilig en efficiënt verloopt?

Dan zijn we op zoek naar jou!

Waar jij het verschil maakt

Als Productmanager Data en Webdiensten ben je verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling en realisatie van de productroadmap en begeleid je de processen die nodig zijn om onze producten en diensten conform de geldende kaders te realiseren. Samen met 13 collega's werk je aan het dagelijks operationeel houden en verder ontwikkelen van onze technische IT-dienstverlening.

Een belangrijke ontwikkeling is de verdere uitbreiding van selfservice, onder andere door de inzet van Infrastructure as Code en het via API's ontsluiten van onze diensten. Daarbij staan veiligheid, compliance en efficiëntie centraal. Onze diensten voldoen vanaf het ontwerp aan de geldende CIS- en ISO-kaders, waarbij het naleven van security- en compliancebeleid prioriteit heeft.

Je begeleidt een team van 10 tot 15 engineers en senior engineers bij Agile werken en de inhoudelijke productontwikkeling. Je stimuleert een proactieve werkwijze en zorgt voor de verbinding tussen strategische doelstellingen en de dagelijkse uitvoering. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega-productmanagers, architecten, servicemanagers, beheerteams en andere stakeholders.

Je belangrijkste werkzaamheden zijn:

  • Je ontwikkelt een samenhangende productstrategie en visie voor de productsuite van het team Data en Webdiensten en stemt deze af met het hoofd IGI en andere stakeholders. Hierin borg je naast vernieuwing ook veiligheid, compliance en efficiëntie.

  • Je vertaalt de vastgestelde productstrategie en visie naar een meerjarige roadmap, kwartaalplanningen en een productbacklog.

  • Je organiseert en begeleidt Agile-events, waaronder dagstarts, sprintplanningen, sprintreviews, retrospectives en refinements, zowel binnen als buiten het eigen team. Daarnaast coach je teamleden.

  • Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor technische teams, architecten, Security Services, Contracts & Finance en servicemanagement. Je bevordert de samenwerking en zorgt voor afstemming over productdoelen en -strategieën.

  • Je onderhoudt contact met afnemers en andere productmanagers, verzamelt feedback en vertaalt hun uitdagingen en behoeften naar de verdere productontwikkeling.

  • Je ontwikkelt samen met het hoofd IGI en andere productmanagers KPI's en succesmaatstaven, bijvoorbeeld voor adoptie, efficiëntie, kosten en productiviteit van engineers. Je maakt de prestaties van geleverde diensten inzichtelijk en houdt toezicht op veiligheid, compliance, beschikbaarheid en performance. Hiervoor benut je bestaande inzichten vanuit servicemanagement en ontwikkel je waar nodig aanvullende inzichten.

Je toekomstige collega's

Je werkt in het team Data en Webdiensten van de afdeling Generieke Infrastructuur (IGI). Deze afdeling bestaat uit ongeveer 30 experts, verdeeld over onze locaties in Heerlen en Den Haag. Het team Data en Webdiensten telt circa 15 collega's die eveneens op beide locaties werkzaam zijn.

We werken volgens een Agile-methodiek in combinatie met ITIL. Een actieve bijdrage aan deze werkwijze vinden we belangrijk. Dit betekent onder andere het opstellen van kwalitatief goede stories en epics, het actueel houden van stories op het Azure DevOps-bord en een actieve, constructieve deelname aan dagstarts, planningen, reviews en retrospectives.

Samenwerking, continu verbeteren en plezier in het werk vinden we belangrijk. Dit is dan ook verankerd in onze kernwaarden.

Dit ben jij

Je bent een initiatiefrijke, ondernemende en zelfstandige productmanager die strategisch inzicht weet te combineren met technische basiskennis. Je begrijpt de technische uitdagingen van onze infrastructuurdiensten en kunt hierover effectief communiceren met zowel engineers als andere stakeholders.

Je beschikt over methodische kennis van Agile en Scrum en weet hoe je samenwerking en continue verbetering binnen een team stimuleert. Je kunt strategisch denken, relevante markttrends herkennen en deze vertalen naar een productvisie. Daarbij weet je verschillende belangen en behoeften met elkaar te verbinden.

Je hebt een sterke ambitie om de user- en customer experience maximaal te faciliteren. Continu samen verbeteren zit in jouw DNA. Je ziet kansen om onze dienstverlening verder te ontwikkelen en neemt initiatief om verbeteringen daadwerkelijk te realiseren.

Daarbij herken je jezelf in het volgende:

  • Je beschikt over technische basiskennis en hebt begrip van API's, cloudsystemen en software- en/of infrastructuurarchitectuur.

  • Je hebt kennis van Agile en Scrum en beschikt over de methodische vaardigheden om deze werkwijzen toe te passen.

  • Je beschikt over sterke sociale en communicatieve vaardigheden om effectief samen te werken met engineers en stakeholders.

  • Je bent in staat om strategisch te denken en markttrends te vertalen naar een duidelijke productvisie.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig en ondernemend, neemt initiatief en stimuleert een proactieve manier van werken.

  • Je bent gericht op continu samen verbeteren en hebt oog voor de behoeften en ervaringen van gebruikers en afnemers.

Feitelijk goed geregeld

Voor onze arbeidsvoorwaarden volgen wij de CAO Rijk. Dat betekent dat je onder andere kunt rekenen op het volgende:

  • Een salaris van minimaal € 4818,- en maximaal € 7094,- bruto per maand op basis van 36 uur. Afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring. Als je bij de start van je functie nog niet over alle benodigde kennis en ervaring beschikt, kan worden gekozen voor tijdelijke inschaling in een lagere salarisschaal. Hierover maak je bij de start van je functie afspraken met je leidinggevende.

  • 8% vakantiegeld en een 13e maand. In totaal is dit 16,5% bovenop je salaris. Dit noemen wij het Individueel Keuze Budget (IKB). Je bepaalt zelf hoe, wanneer en op welke manier je dit budget wilt inzetten.

  • Pensioenopbouw bij het ABP Pensioenfonds.

  • Een laptop (Microsoft of Apple) en mobiele telefoon (Android of iOS).

  • Twee tot drie dagen thuiswerken, de rest ben je aanwezig in ons onlangs gerenoveerde gebouw. In je team maak je daar verder afspraken over.

Kom werken aan de feiten

De sluitingsdatum voor deze vacature is woensdag 25 november 2026.

title: Productmanager Parts & Tyres
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij commercieel ingesteld, analytisch sterk en heb je interesse in techniek en automotive? Krijg je energie van het ontdekken van nieuwe kansen en wil je zelf invloed hebben op het succes van jouw productgroepen? Dan is deze functie bij BAS Parts & Tyres iets voor jou!

BAS Parts & Tyres is een grote speler in de internationale handel van truckonderdelen en banden. We leveren nieuwe, gebruikte en gereviseerde onderdelen aan klanten in meer dan 100 landen. Van complete motoren met meer dan 700 pk tot truckcabines die in containers de hele wereld overgaan: bij ons draait alles op grote schaal!

Als Productmanager Parts & Tyres ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling en groei van jouw eigen assortiment. Je krijgt veel vrijheid om initiatief te nemen, nieuwe ideeën uit te werken en direct bij te dragen aan het commerciële succes van BAS Parts & Tyres.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Productmanager ben jij het aanspreekpunt voor jouw productgroepen. Je combineert markt- en data-analyse met inkoop, assortimentsbeheer en samenwerking met verschillende afdelingen.

Je houdt ontwikkelingen binnen de markt in de gaten, onderzoekt welke producten goed verkopen en kijkt waar nieuwe commerciële kansen liggen.

Je krijgt de verantwoordelijkheid om jouw eigen productgroepen verder uit te bouwen. Daarbij combineer je analytisch werken met commercie en ben je dagelijks bezig met het ontdekken en benutten van nieuwe kansen.

Wat maakt deze functie zo leuk?

Bij BAS Parts & Tyres krijg je de kans om zelfstandig aan jouw eigen assortiment te werken. Je hebt direct invloed op welke producten we aanbieden, hoe we deze presenteren en hoe succesvol ze worden verkocht.

Je werkt in een internationale omgeving met uiteenlopende technische producten en krijgt volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Of je nu nieuwe leveranciers ontdekt, verkoopresultaten analyseert of samen met collega's verbeteringen doorvoert: geen dag is hetzelfde!

  • Een jong, ambitieus en gezellig team waarin successen samen worden gevierd;

  • Een informele werksfeer met korte lijnen en ruimte voor ondernemerschap;

  • Deelname aan het BAS Fit-programma met sportactiviteiten zoals de marathon van Eindhoven, het BAS Voetbaltoernooi en het BAS Padeltoernooi;

  • Gezellige borrels, teamuitjes en natuurlijk de legendarische BAS-feesten!


Jouw specificaties

We zoeken een ondernemende en analytische collega die commerciële kansen herkent, initiatief neemt en graag verantwoordelijkheid draagt.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je beschikt over hbo-werk- en -denkniveau;

  • Je bent analytisch sterk en weet data om te zetten naar concrete commerciële kansen;

  • Je bent commercieel ingesteld en krijgt energie van het ontwikkelen en laten groeien van een assortiment;

Nog geen uitgebreide kennis van truckonderdelen? Geen probleem! Met jouw analytische vaardigheden, commerciële instelling en interesse in techniek kun je bij ons volop leren en jezelf ontwikkelen.

Een nieuwe locatie, volop groeimogelijkheden

BAS Parts & Tyres blijft groeien en investeert daarom in een gloednieuwe vestiging in Veghel. Hier vind je een modern kantoor met ruimte voor 100 collega's, een uitgebreide kantine en twee magazijnhallen met samen 2.500 m² opslagruimte en een hoogte van 15 meter.

Interesse?

Wij zijn BAS!

BAS Parts & Tyres is onderdeel van BAS Group, een internationaal familiebedrijf dat sinds 1962 actief is in de automotive sector. Met meer dan 1.000 collega's zijn we wereldwijd actief in de handel van vrachtwagens, trailers, machines, onderdelen en banden.

Bij BAS houden we van aanpakken, samenwerken en kansen benutten. Brabantse nuchterheid, passie, teamwork en ondernemerschap vormen de basis van onze organisatie. Samen blijven we groeien en onze dienstverlening verbeteren!

title: Produkt- & Kundenmanager (m/w/d) – Software für die Energiewirtschaft
descriptionHtml:
Die envago GmbH aus Leipzig entwickelt Software für Netz- und Messstellenbetreiber. Mit envago.EAST digitalisieren wir die Zählerablesung, inklusive KI-gestützter Zählerstandserkennung und Ableseportal für Endkunden. envago.WEST bildet Geräteprozesse wie den Zählerwechsel ab. Unsere Kunden sind Unternehmen der Energiewirtschaft, die sich auf funktionierende Prozesse verlassen müssen. Deshalb ist uns wichtig, dass unsere Software genau das tut, was der Kunde im Alltag braucht.

Deine Rolle

Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden und unserer Software. Du kennst unsere Produkte so gut wie ein Anwender und prüfst neue Funktionen, bevor sie zum Kunden gehen. Genau dieses Produktwissen macht dich im Gespräch mit Bestands- und Neukunden glaubwürdig.

Deine Aufgaben

Produkt & Test

- Du testest neue Funktionen und Releases fachlich aus Sicht unserer Kunden und nimmst sie ab.

- Du erstellst strukturierte Testszenarien und Testfälle und dokumentierst die Ergebnisse.

- Du beschreibst Fehler und Verbesserungsvorschläge so, dass unsere Entwicklung damit arbeiten kann.

- Du bringst Anforderungen und Feedback unserer Kunden in die Weiterentwicklung der Produkte ein.

Kunden & Vertrieb

- Du betreust unsere Bestandskunden als feste Ansprechperson: von Fragen zur Anwendung bis zur Weiterentwicklung der Zusammenarbeit.

- Du gewinnst neue Kunden. Dazu gehören Produktpräsentationen, Angebote und Verhandlungen.

- Du stellst envago auf Fachmessen und bei Kundenterminen vor (bis zu ca. 12 Veranstaltungen im Jahr).

Dein Profil

- Du hast mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Kundenbetreuung, im Vertrieb oder im Produktumfeld, idealerweise mit B2B-Software.

- Du musst nicht programmieren können, hast aber ein gutes technisches Verständnis. Du willst verstehen, wie Software funktioniert und wie Kunden sie nutzen.

- Du arbeitest sorgfältig und strukturiert. Fehler, die anderen entgehen, fallen dir auf.

- Du trittst sicher und verbindlich gegenüber Kunden auf und verhandelst gern.

- Kenntnisse der Energiewirtschaft (Netzbetrieb, Messstellenbetrieb, Zählerwesen) sind von Vorteil.

- Deutsch sprichst du verhandlungssicher.

- Du besitzt einen Führerschein der Klasse B.

Was wir bieten

- Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen und direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung und zur Entwicklung

- Direkten Einfluss darauf, wie sich unsere Produkte weiterentwickeln

- Eine abwechslungsreiche Rolle zwischen Produkt, Kunden und Messe

title: Professional Services Director
descriptionHtml:
E-commerce is booming — but independent brands still struggle to match the seamless logistics of giants like Amazon. At Bigblue, we’re on a mission to change that. We help brands turn fulfillment into a competitive advantage: scaling faster while delivering a five-star customer experience. Since 2018, we’ve built a tech-driven logistics platform powering 500+ brands — from fast-growing DTC players to global names like MUJI, Aigle, and Cabaïa. With 110+ employees across Paris, Madrid, and London, our proprietary WMS (Warehouse Management System) Atlas, and a network of 8 warehouses across Europe, we’re solving logistics challenges that others haven’t dared to tackle — making fulfillment faster, smarter, greener — and more cost-efficient. Backed by $20M+ in funding, we’re scaling rapidly — from 10 million orders in 2024 toward bold enterprise expansion. To deliver on this ambition, we are looking for a leader who will drive operational excellence and innovation at scale. The role: Professional Services Manager Merchants often need more guidance than our product alone can provide. They struggle with optimizing delivery options, managing customer support or demand planning and streamlining other operational processes. While our product addresses part of this need, merchants require structured, expert advice to grow and optimize their business. That’s why we’re launching a new Professional Services program — to help brands unlock the full potential of Bigblue Operations. As Head of Professional Services, you will build and lead this new function from the ground up: designing offers, structuring delivery, and ensuring execution at scale. Your mission is to sell (and sometimes offer) operational consulting, providing tailored support across logistics, transport, and commerce operations — while capturing and distributing the knowledge that will shape internal training, product development, and merchant strategy. This is a cross-functional leadership role, reporting directly to the co-CEOs, with strong exposure to sales, merchants, product and ops teams, and the executive leadership. What you’ll do 📦 Design and launch Bigblue’s Professional Services program: define the service offering, pricing models, and delivery frameworks for operational consulting. 🧠 Deliver structured, high-impact advice to merchants: help brands streamline their operations, unlock growth, and make the most of Bigblue’s operational capabilities. 📊 Create and track performance metrics: define success KPIs — including merchant satisfaction, project ROI, and delivery timelines — and build the tools and processes to monitor and improve them. 📚 Generate and structure company knowledge: turn field experience into scalable insights that fuel internal training, merchant enablement, and product roadmap decisions. 🤝 Work hand-in-hand with Sales, Product, Ops, and Customer teams: scope merchant needs, influence product direction, and ensure Professional Services are tightly integrated into the overall customer journey. 🧩 Handle both repeatable and bespoke projects: from standardized onboarding packages to tailored merchant migrations, flex between industrialized delivery and custom-built solutions. 💸 Make Professional Services a profitable growth engine: design revenue models, forecast team utilization, and ensure strong project economics while delivering value to merchants.
Who you are
  • You have 5+ years of experience in consulting, professional services, or implementation at a high-growth scale-up, logistics player, eCom or SaaS company.
  • You’re customer-obsessed, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to turn complex needs into actionable plans.
  • You know how to balance execution, people management, and financial performance.
  • You are a builder — ready to design and scale processes from scratch, not just operate what exists.
  • You thrive in cross-functional environments, collaborating across product, ops, tech, and commercial teams.
  • You are both strategic and hands-on — comfortable driving the roadmap while jumping into project firefighting when needed.
  • Fluent in English and ideally French or Spanish.
    • Why join Bigblue? 💼 High-impact leadership role at the heart of Bigblue’s growth and customer success. 🚀 Fast-growing scale-up with a well-funded roadmap and bold ambitions. ⚙️ Room to build and innovate: create a PS function from the ground up. 🌍 Pan-European scope: support leading omnichannel brands across multiple markets. 🍱 10€ meal voucher per worked day (55% paid by Bigblue) 🧘‍♀️ ClassPass membership for fitness & wellness. 🖥️ MacBook or your preferred setup to do your best work. 🩺 100% health insurance coverage with Benefiz. 💙 Founders-led company where operations are truly core to the mission. Regardless of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, origin, disability, age… At Bigblue, we create equal opportunities for all and make our culture as inclusive as possible. Because we believe that challenging assumptions and embracing diversity in experiences and backgrounds is what makes us stronger. Because what we value first and foremost are curiosity and growth-driven minds. So, regardless of who you are and how many “boxes” you tick on the job description, if you have the energy and passion to help shape Bigblue’s entrepreneurial adventure, APPLY.

title: Program Director - CDI Paris - Theodo
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. La practice AI Build accompagne les entreprises de tous secteurs dans la conception et le développement d’applications web sur-mesure. Habitués à intervenir au sein d’écosystèmes IT existants, nous intégrons nos solutions avec des outils imposés - ERP, CRM, plateformes métiers complexes - et savons nous intégrer efficacement dans les systèmes développés par nos clients.

Ton équipe

Tu manages une équipe de Lead Product Managers (LPM) et de Product Managers (PM) répartis sur différents projets. Tu es responsable de leur carrière, de leur progression et de la réussite de leur delivery.

Tu rejoins l’équipe des Group PM, avec qui tu partages un weekly dédié pour avancer ensemble sur le management, la structuration de la practice et le développement des talents.

Tes futures missions

En tant que Program Director, tu portes deux responsabilités complémentaires : faire grandir tes PM/LPM et garantir la réussite de leur delivery.

Manager et faire progresser les PM/LPM :

  • Accompagner tes PM/LPM sur leurs projets : suivre leur delivery, les aider à débloquer les situations, leur donner des retours réguliers et exigeants dans une logique de progression.
  • Être responsable de leur carrière : construire avec chacun·e un plan de progression clair et les projeter sur leurs prochaines étapes, chez le client comme chez Theodo.
  • Mener les évaluations annuelles de ton équipe, en objectivant les progrès et en fixant des objectifs ambitieux et atteignables.

Garantir un delivery de qualité

  • Sécuriser la réussite des projets de ton périmètre : qualité, délais et création de valeur pour le client comme pour les équipes.

Structurer la practice

  • Contribuer au staffing : participer aux décisions d’affectation et à l’adéquation entre les talents et les besoins des projets.
  • Animer les temps collectifs (all-hands, rituels de practice) pour renforcer la cohésion et la dynamique d’équipe.
  • Participer aux avant-ventes pour faire grandir le portefeuille de la practice et ouvrir de nouvelles opportunités.

Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu

Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits.

Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients.

Ce que tu auras pour réussir

  • Une formation dispensée par un Group PM expérimenté, pour monter en compétence sur la posture de management et la structuration de practice.
  • Une intégration dans l’équipe des Group PM, avec un weekly dédié pour avancer collectivement et trouver du soutien au quotidien.

Profil recherché

  • Diplômé(e) d'une grande école d'ingénieur, avec plus de 8 ans d'expérience professionnelle, dont au moins 6 ans en product management (Senior PM / Lead PM / Head of Product) en startup, ESN ou cabinet de conseil
  • Capacité à porter le delivery de projets complexes : qualité, délais, création de valeur.
  • Aisance relationnelle et client : créer une relation de confiance, échanger avec des interlocuteurs de top management, gérer des situations sensibles avec calme et clarté.
  • Solides compétences en feedback et en management : écoute active, capacité à challenger et à délivrer des retours exigeants dans une logique de progression collective.
  • AI-oriented
  • Envie d’apprendre, de challenger son équipe, de demander de l’aide et d’accepter d’être challengé(e)
Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo ? L’environnement: 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 700 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 De l’épargne salariale avec un mécanisme d’intéressement en partenariat avec Epsor 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile 🧒 Aides et places en crèche réservées Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

title: Program Director - Hardware Systems (All Genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

YOUR MISSION

As a Program Manager at STARK, you will lead one of our core hardware programs taking it from early R&D all the way to production readiness. You’ll be responsible for translating ambitious technical concepts into operational products and building the team that makes it happen.

You’ll work hand-in-hand with a dedicated Chief Engineer, combining program leadership with technical direction. Together, you’ll shape the vision, align priorities, and drive execution across engineering, production, and business functions.

A key part of your mission will be to build and scale a world-class engineering team, recruiting top talent, defining structure, and fostering a high-performance culture that moves fast, collaborates openly, and delivers. You’ll also coordinate with shared engineering functions (simulation, testing, systems, etc.) to allocate resources effectively and ensure critical work gets the attention it needs.

This role is about ownership and leadership: Building both a product and the organization that delivers it.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • End-to-End Program Leadership: Own the delivery of a major hardware program from R&D, to go-to-market verification to production readiness.
  • Team Building: Build, structure, and grow a high-performing multidisciplinary team. Recruit top engineering talent and create an environment where they can deliver their best work.
  • Partnership with Chief Engineer: Co-lead the program, pairing strong technical direction with decisive program leadership.
  • Strategic Planning: Translate strategic goals into clear milestones, deliverables, and resource plans.
  • Execution & Prioritization: Drive focus on what matters most. Keep teams aligned, proactive, and moving fast.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Connect the dots across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and business functions to maintain alignment and momentum.
  • Program–Portfolio Alignment: Work closely with the VP Programs to ensure key programs get the focus and resources needed to deliver cutting-edge technology to customers at record speed.
  • Leadership & Culture: Set high standards, communicate clearly, and keep teams motivated and accountable even in demanding phases.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Deliver concise, transparent updates on progress, risks, and key decisions to leadership.
  • Process & Structure: Implement pragmatic governance and scalable processes that enable speed without bureaucracy.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Experience: 4–10 years in program or project management, ideally in hardware, aerospace, robotics, or defense. Proven experience leading complex technical programs and growing teams.
  • Background: Technical or technically literate background: e.g. engineering, industrial engineering, or technical management. You don’t need to design systems yourself, but you must understand how engineers think and work.
  • Leadership: Proven ability to build and lead high-performing teams. You attract talent, set structure, and keep people aligned through clarity and purpose.
  • Mindset: Mission-driven, decisive, and pragmatic. You thrive in ambiguity and bring structure to complexity. You seek feedback, learn fast, and raise your own bar continuously.
  • Communication: Clear, direct communicator with strong written and verbal skills in English and German.
  • Execution: Strong bias for action: >ou get things done, stay close to the details, and drive accountability.
  • Tools: Comfortable with modern program tools (e.g. Jira, Confluence, Excel, and PMO systems).

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

SECURITY CLEARANCE

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

DATA PRIVACY STATEMENT

This data privacy statement, which refers exclusively to data collected as part of the online application process, is to inform you about how your personal data that is collected as part of the online application process is handled at our end.

The controller

Data Protection officer: heyData GmbH, Schützenstraße 5, 10117 Berlin, www.heydata.eu, -----

Personal data collected as part of the application process

Personal data means any information concerning the personal or material circumstances of an identified or identifiable individual. This includes information such as, for example, your name, address, telephone number and date of birth, but also data relating to your specific career etc. by reference to which a specific individual can be identified with reasonable effort. However, information which cannot be (in)directly associated with your real-life identity is not personal data.

Fundamentals and purposes of processing personal data collected from application documents and during the application process

If you apply to us electronically, i.e. via e-mail or using our online form, we will collect and process your personal data for the purpose of executing the application process and preparing contracts.

By submitting an application via our recruitment website, you express your interest in taking up work with us. In this context, you transmit personal data, which we will use and store exclusively for the purpose of your job search / application process.

In particular, the following data is collected during this process:

  • name (first and last names)
  • e-mail address
  • phone number
  • LinkedIn profile (optional)
  • channel through which you found us

Furthermore, you can choose to upload expressive documents such as a cover letter, your CV and reference letters. These may contain additional personal data such as date of birth, address etc.

Only authorized HR staff and/or staff involved in the application process have access to your data.

The personal data is stored, as a rule, exclusively for the purpose of filling the vacancy for which you have applied.

Your data will be stored for a period of 180 days after the application process has been concluded. This is usually done to fulfill legal requirements and/or defending ourselves against any claims arising from legal provisions. After this period, we are obligated to delete or anonymize your data. In case of anonymization, the data will only be available to us in the form of so-called metadata, without any direct personal reference, for statistical analysis (for example, share of male and/or female applicants, number of applications per specified period of time etc.).

Furthermore, we reserve the right to store your data for 180 days after the application process has been concluded for the purpose of adding it to our Talent Pool in order to identify any other vacancies that may be of interest to you. This includes, for example, applications for apprenticeships or internships. By accepting the data privacy statement, you consent to any further storage of your data as well as its inclusion in our Talent Pool.

Should you be offered and accept a position with us during the application process, we will store the personal data collected as part of the application process for at least the duration of your employment.

Disclosure of data to third parties

Data transmitted as part of your application will be transferred using TLS encryption and stored in a database. This database is operated by Greenhouse, which offers a human resource and applicant management software solution (https://www.greenhouse.com/data-processing-addendum). In this context, Greenhouse is our processor under article 28 of the GDPR. In this case, the processing is based on an agreement for the processing of orders between us as the controller and Greenhouse.

Rights of data subjects

If we as the controller process personal data, you as the data subject have certain rights under Chapter III of the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), depending on the legal basis and the purpose of the processing, in particular the right of access (article 15 of the GDPR) and the rights to rectification (article 16 of the GDPR), erasure (article 17 of the GDPR), restriction of processing (article 18 of the GDPR), and data portability (article 20 of the GDPR), as well as the right to object (article 21 of the GDPR). If the personal data is processed with your consent, you have the right to withdraw this consent under article 7 III of the GDPR.

To assert your rights as a data subject in relation to the data processed during this online application process, please refer to our Data Protection Officer (see item 2).

Concluding provisions

We reserve the right to adjust this data privacy statement at any point in time to ensure that it is in line with the current legal requirements at all times, or in order to accommodate changes in the application process or other processes. In this case, the new data privacy statement applies to any later visit of this recruitment website or any later job application.

title: Programmatic Analyst - Alternance (H/F/X)
descriptionHtml:
Biggie est l’agence globale de stratégie et activation media & marketing de Biggie group, groupe international indépendant de solutions marketing intégrées. Biggie est le fruit du rapprochement de plusieurs entités du groupe : l’expert en activations digitales Gamned!, l’agence conseil en achat média Repeat ainsi que l’agence média & cabinet de conseil en marketing 3qtz. Avec pour signature « Partners in growth », Biggie ambitionne d’être partenaire de la croissance des marques, en mettant l’excellence stratégique et opérationnelle au service de leur performance et en leur proposant un accompagnement sur-mesure (stratégie marketing, planning stratégique, data & analyse, media, performance digitale, création et adaptation de contenus ou encore consulting business) pour répondre à leurs problématiques business. L’agence regroupe 300 experts, dont 150 en France, présents dans 7 pays à travers 9 bureaux internationaux (Paris, Marseille, Bruxelles, Milan, Genève, Zurich, Prague, Dubaï et Sao Paulo). Pour en savoir plus : www.biggie.co

🗒️ Missions


En tant que Programmatic Analyst, tu participes activement aux opérations, à l'analyse et au développement commercial de notre activité programmatique, en lien direct avec les équipes Trading, MediaBuying, Sales et Conseil.

Tu interviens sur des missions variées et à fort impact, allant de la création d'offres programmatiques, en passant par l'analyse stratégique des résultats et le suivi financier.

Au quotidien, tu t'occuperas de :

• Template de setup & vérification des créas : Préparer et compléter les templates de setup pour chaque nouvelle campagne, contrôler la conformité des créations publicitaires par rapport aux spécifications techniques des régies et DSP, et réaliser des audits pour identifier les éventuelles anomalies.

• Partage de résultats & bilans de campagne : Préparer les supports de bilan, compiler les données de performance issues des DSP et outils de reporting, participer aux réunions de restitution avec les clients et formuler des recommandations pour les futures campagnes.

• Analyse des résultats des top campagnes : Analyser en profondeur les résultats des campagnes les plus stratégiques, identifier les facteurs clés de performance et produire des insights actionnables pour nourrir les équipes commerciales.

• Analyse macro des résultats : Réaliser une analyse transversale de l'ensemble des campagnes pour identifier les tendances globales, les patterns de succès et les causes récurrentes d'échec, et alimenter une base de connaissance interne.

• Compréhension de l'univers programmatique & développement du catalogue : Monter en compétence sur l'écosystème programmatique (DSP, SSP, audiences, formats), maîtriser notre catalogue d'offres, effectuer une veille active du marché et participer à la création de nouvelles offres programmatiques.

• Projections dans les Plans Média & réponses aux Appels d'Offres : Participer à la construction des projections intégrées dans les Plans Média et contribuer aux réponses aux Appels d'Offres programmatiques, en lien avec les équipes Sales.

• Gestion de la facturation : Assurer le suivi de la facturation clients, vérifier la cohérence entre les réservations et les montants facturés, et contribuer à la résolution des anomalies via Salesforce.

👉 Profil Recherché

Prérequis :
• Être curieux(se) et avoir envie d'apprendre un métier au cœur du digital
• Être à l'aise avec les chiffres et l'analyse de données
• Aimer le challenge et travailler en équipe
• Être rigoureux(se) et organisé(e)

Compétences :
• Formation en cours en Bac+3 à Bac+5 (marketing digital, commerce, communication, école de commerce)
• Bonne maîtrise d'Excel et des outils bureautiques
• Capacité à analyser, comprendre et restituer les performances d'une campagne
• Français indispensable, anglais apprécié
• Proactif(ve), dynamique et force de proposition
• Bien sûr… sympa et team player !

🎁 Nos avantages: • Un groupe international présent dans le monde entier • Des entités pluridisciplinaires expertes dans leur domaine : programmatique, influence, RP, 360, création de contenus… • Possibilité de mobilité interne au sein des différentes entités du groupe • De la formation continue avec une Digital Academy • Un accès à la plateforme HappyPal qui vous donnera accès à des réductions sur de nombreuses marques et loisirs (cinémas, concerts, parcs d’attractions, musées…) • Des cours de sports quotidiens dans nos locaux : pilates, cross training • Un forfait mobilité durable qui vous permet de louer un vélo auprès de notre partenaire BeeToGreen ou de vous faire rembourser à hauteur de 45€/mois votre location de vélo • Prime de cooptation Biggie Group propose des opportunités d'emploi sans distinction d’origine, de sexe, de moeurs, d’orientation sexuelle, d’identité de genre, d’âge, de situation familiale, d’apparence physique, de handicap, de religion, d’opinion politique… Biggie Group se conforme aux réglementations luttant contre la discrimination en entreprise. title: Programme/Delivery Manager
descriptionHtml:
Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe's software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics. Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 7 countries, and growing.

About usDepotnet is a provider of work management software for the utilities, and infrastructure space. We are a team of 50+ people based in Henley-in-Arden, Warwickshire.

Our team is made up of people with software & technology backgrounds, and others with deep expertise in the end-markets we serve. We all share a common goal, which is to be the number one SaaS solution in the utilities and infrastructure space.

We are a passionate team who genuinely enjoy working together, and it shows in how we operate. We set a high bar because we're proud of what we do, and we know how important it is to our customers and the critical work which they deliver, building and maintaining the UK's infrastructure.

Depotnet joined Everfield in 2023

About the Role

The Program / Delivery Manager owns the sprint cycle end to end for Depotnet - taking signed-off change requests and roadmap items and turning them into a sprint plan the development team can deliver against, on time and to the expected quality.

What you will do:

  • Own the sprint cycle end to end, from planning through to release

  • Take signed-off change requests (CRs) and roadmap items prioritised by our Product and Client teams and turn them into an actionable sprint plan

  • Run sprint planning, allocating work across developers and contractors against known capacity

  • Protect the sprint from mid-flight scope changes, working alongside the Tech Director and Heads of Tech to keep delivery on track

  • Plan QA windows and UAT alongside the delivery schedule

  • Own the release schedule and resource availability planning

We Are Looking For:

  • Strong capacity planning skills - able to allocate work across developers and contractors against known constraints

  • Comfortable saying no politely and protecting the team from mid-flight scope creep

  • Enough technical literacy to challenge an estimate and hold your own in a conversation with developers

  • Fluency with Azure DevOps

  • A dynamic, energetic approach - genuinely up for a challenge, with the resilience to manage a huge range of competing priorities

  • Confidence holding your own with senior stakeholders, balanced with the rapport-building of a natural team player

Interview Process:

Here's what to expect and who you'll meet during the recruitment process:

  • First interview with Talent Acquisition Manager Holly (0.5h)

  • Second interview with Operations Director Michelle Morgan (45mins)

  • Final interview with Technical Director Ben Squibb (1h)

We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, gender identity, marital status, race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, responsibilities for dependants, physical or mental disability. Any hiring decision is made based on skills, qualifications and experiences.

We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Programme Manager - UK Government
descriptionHtml:
What we’re all about.

It isn’t often you get to be part of a tech company that, since 2016, has been innovating the data analytics market in ways no-one else can. Our technology started out in FinTech, helping tackle serious criminal activity. Now, its potential is virtually limitless. Working at Quantexa isn't just intellectually stimulating. We’re a real team. Collaborating and constantly engineering better and better solutions. We’re ambitious, we think things through and we’re on a mission to discover just how far we go. Nearly half of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We’re made up of people from 47 nationalities who speak over 20 languages. As a diverse mix of individuals, we make one big unstoppable team.

If our incredible culture sounds like you, we’d love you to join us.

The opportunity.

As a Programme Manager, you will lead the end-to-end delivery of complex Quantexa programmes for customers using our Decision Intelligence platform across multiple business use cases, workstreams or releases.

You will own the overall success of the programme, providing strategic oversight across all projects and initiatives, driving business value realisation, shaping and prioritising the delivery pipeline, owning programme P&L, and enabling sustainable account growth through effective delivery.

You will be part of the Project Management practice, a global network of project and programme management professionals within Quantexa, a group designed to support your career development and ensure you fulfil your full potential.

As well as working with some of the largest and most prestigious organisations in the world, you will work hand in hand with our delivery partner network, including the big four consultancies and major systems integrators.

What you’ll be doing.

  • Provide strategic direction and leadership for complex Quantexa programmes, setting clear objectives, priorities, success measures and an executable roadmap aligned with the customer’s strategic objectives and desired business outcomes.

  • Establish the programme organisation, governance forums, roles, controls and reporting, coordinating dependent projects, workstreams, releases, with clear accountability across Quantexa, customer and partner delivery teams.

  • Drive successful outcomes, owning value realisation and ensuring the programme delivers measurable business outcomes for the customer in the most effective and commercially sustainable way.

  • Own an integrated programme plan covering scope, milestones, dependencies, resources, critical path, risks and benefits, identifying roadblocks early, managing programme level risks and escalationsand driving corrective action.

  • Build trusted relationships with customer executives, programme sponsors and delivery leaders, influencing decisions and maintaining alignment across Quantexa, the customer and delivery partners.

  • Enable customers and partners to build the capability to adopt, operate and extend Quantexa successfully.

  • Take full ownership of P&L and commercial performance including budgets, forecasts, revenue, margin, contracts, change control, , resource and capacity planning and the cost-effective use of people and resources.

  • Embed Quantexa delivery methodologies, quality controls and best practice across the programme, ensuring solutions are operationally stable and aligned to current product capabilities and recommended technology.

  • Set the culture for collaboration, accountability and wellbeing, coaching Project Managers and cross-functional leads and resolving delivery tensions constructively.

  • Provide concise executive reporting on programme status, outcomes, financials, risks, decisions and key metrics, with clear recommendations and actions.

  • Identify opportunities to expand customer value and support account growth through delivery, improve delivery effectiveness and strengthen Quantexa’s programme management capability through lessons learned and reusable practice assets.

What you’ll bring.

  • You are an accomplished programme management professional with a strong track record of leading and delivering large, complex technology or data programmes spanning multiple teams, workstreams and releases.

  • You have led customer-facing delivery in a consultancy, professional services, systems integrator or enterprise technology environment and are credible with senior executives and programme sponsors.

  • You have strong commercial judgement and experience owning programme P&L and commercial performance, including budgets, forecasting, margin, contracts, change control and resource and capacity planning.

  • You understand the full software delivery lifecycle and the factors required to deliver secure, high-quality and operationally stable enterprise platforms.

  • You are experienced in Agile delivery and can apply the right blend of Agile, iterative and programme controls across multiple teams and dependencies.

  • You are adept at leading in complex ecosystems involving customer teams, product and engineering functions, consulting teams and delivery partners., establishing clear accountability and alignment across organisations.

  • You communicate with clarity and gravitas, can simplify complex topics, influence senior stakeholders and challenge constructively to drive decisions and achieve the right outcome.

  • You bring strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills and can navigate ambiguity, make effective trade-offs and resolve complex delivery and commercial challenge while maintaining momentum and control.

  • You are a collaborative, emotionally intelligent leader who inspires others, develops talent and creates an inclusive, accountable culture.

  • Experience delivering programmes within Government or the wider Public Sector, particularly UK Central Government, would be advantageous.

  • Existing clearance to work within UK Government environments would be advantageous, with BPSS and ideally SC clearance.

  • Experience delivering data, analytics, AI, decision intelligence, financial crime, customer intelligence or public-sector transformation programmes would be advantageous.

  • A recognised programme or project management qualification such as MSP, PgMP, PRINCE2 or PMP would be beneficial.

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Company bonus

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

  • Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover

  • Life Insurance and Income Protection

  • Regularly bench-marked salary rates

  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave

  • Well-being days

  • Volunteer Day off

  • Work from Home Equipment

  • Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes

  • Continuous Training and Development
