title: Regional Operations Director-Based in Munich/Berlin
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Indie Campers is the leading campervan marketplace, on a mission to make road trips accessible to everyone. With a fully digital booking experience and a customer-first approach, we have welcomed more than 300,000 travellers from 170 countries and delivered over one million nights on the road. We offer short-term RV rentals, long-term campervan subscriptions, and the option to buy one of our vehicles.

We are a fast-growing, technology-driven company, and our challenges are both exciting and demanding. We are looking for top talent to help build the future of road travel.

The Role

As Regional Operations Director, you lead local operations across a group of countries. Each depot has Operations Supervisors on the floor; clusters of depots are led by Operations Managers; the Operations Managers report to you. You report to the EMEA Operations Vice President.

You will own results on fleet availability and quality, Customer satisfaction and public profile, operational efficiency and profitability, ensuring high service standards and consistent execution of the central procedures and SOPs defined for our operating model.

You will sit on the regional management team alongside peers from Revenue & Growth, People and Finance, and you will be accountable for your region's operational targets and for the operational cost of the service delivered to our customers.

What You Will Work On

Leadership and performance

  • Lead, coach and develop the regional team and the Depot Leaders across your locations
  • Oversee day-to-day regional operations and drive the region's results on fleet availability, customer satisfaction and profitability
  • Monitor KPIs daily, follow up on action plans and implement improvements
  • Ensure operating standards and SOPs are followed consistently across all depots
  • Safety, legal compliance and audit readiness at every site, under several sets of national law.

Customer first

  • Customer satisfaction and recurring issues across every country in your district, with corrective plans that actually close

P&L and cost ownership

  • Own the regional P&L from an operational standpoint, including budgeting and cost control
  • Identify and deploy efficiency initiatives
  • Keep resources aligned with activity levels, expanding and contracting cost structure based on seasonality
  • Manage relationships with international suppliers serving the region

Collaboration and growth

  • Work closely with Central Ops, Revenue & Growth, Finance, People & Talent Acquisition, and so that processes are well defined and adapted to your region
  • Lead, coordinate and deliver projects related to operational expansion in the region
  • Travel frequently to support depot teams (up to 75% of the time)

Who We Are Looking For

Must have

  • Degree in Engineering, Business Management or a similar field (higher education)
  • 10 years or more of operational leadership in mobility, logistics, hospitality, rental or multi-site management, including several years running operations in more than one country.
  • You have run a profit and loss account of meaningful size and are comfortable owning a commercial result rather than contributing to one.
  • You manage through managers who themselves manage managers. Your effectiveness depends on your Operations Managers being good, not on you being everywhere.
  • You can diagnose across a portfolio and across borders, telling apart a problem with one depot, one manager, one country, or the way we operate.
  • You have worked inside more than one employment-law regime and know where local practice genuinely constrains a standard and where it is being used as an excuse.
  • You make sound people decisions at Supervisor and Manager level in reasonable time, and build a pipeline rather than filling vacancies.
  • You handle capital decisions with finance, and can flex a cost base seasonally across several labour markets without letting service or safety slip.
  • You get results through functions that do not report to you. In this structure that is not a nice-to-have: fleet, revenue, customer experience, people and finance all hold things you need and none of them are yours.
  • You treat safety and compliance as yours, at the same standard at your smallest depot as at your largest.
  • You protect the integrity of what gets reported, and would rather receive a bad number that is true than a good one that is not.
  • You are steady in a crisis and willing to be in the field: every country monthly, a frontline shift monthly, present when it matters.
  • Strong Excel or Sheets. Fluent English and at least one other language used in your district. Full driving licence, category B. Free to travel across your countries without restriction.

Nice to have

  • Multi-country general management in rental, logistics, hospitality or retail, rather than single-market experience repeated.
  • A strongly seasonal business, or one where the asset is the product.
  • Experience of a structure where the functions you depend on report elsewhere.
  • Opening new markets, integrating an acquisition, or setting up a new operating model rather than inheriting a settled one.
  • A third language used in your region

The Indie Commitment

  • A fast-growing, dynamic environment where you make a real impact
  • Career growth in Field Operations, with potential moves to Lisbon, Mexico City or Manila
  • Continuous training and coaching
  • Free road trips across Europe, North America and Oceania

Are you ready to Go Indie?

title: Regulatory & Certification Engineer, Hydrogen Energy
descriptionHtml:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

     

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

     

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

     

Start date: Immediately

title: Regulatory Compliance Director
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

BJAK is Southeast Asia’s largest digital insurance platform, expanding financial access through automation, data, and digital scale. As we grow across markets, we are committed to building a platform that is safe, compliant, and trusted.

We are hiring a Regulatory Compliance Director to lead regulatory strategy, risk governance, and compliance operations for our UK market entry and expansion alongside the CEO. This role is expected to hold the SMF16 (Compliance Oversight) Senior Management Function once approved, and will act as our primary point of contact with the FCA.

This is a build role: you'll be creating frameworks, policies, and controls from scratch rather than inheriting an existing function.

 

Why This Role Matters

The Regulatory Compliance Director will:

  • Design and enforce compliance frameworks that enable safe scaling of digital financial services.

  • Ensure BJAK operates in accordance with UK regulatory standards, especially FCA requirements.

  • Protect consumers through transparent, fair, and ethical practices.

  • Establish BJAK as a trusted partner with regulators, partners, and industry stakeholders.

  • Build compliance capability and culture across the company.

 

What You Will Do

Regulatory Leadership & Strategy

  • Develop and maintain compliance frameworks aligned with UK regulatory requirements.

  • Lead regulatory readiness for market entry, licensing, and ongoing supervision.

  • Serve as the primary contact with the FCA and relevant UK bodies.

  • Interpret regulatory changes and guide business strategy accordingly.

 

Risk Governance & Compliance Operations

  • Build policies and controls covering AML, KYC, data privacy, consumer duty, distribution, and claims-related compliance.

  • Conduct risk assessments and implement remediation plans for identified gaps.

  • Establish monitoring, testing, and reporting processes for ongoing compliance.

  • Ensure internal audits, compliance reviews, and control testing are operationalised.

 

Consumer Protection & Business Integrity

  • Embed fairness, transparency, and responsible selling throughout the organisation.

  • Oversee product compliance, marketing reviews, pricing governance, and distribution oversight.

  • Implement complaint handling frameworks aligned with regulatory standards.

 

Cross-Functional Support & Training

  • Partner with product, operations, legal, marketing, and commercial teams to ensure compliant execution.

  • Provide guidance on regulatory implications of new products, partnerships, or distribution models.

  • Deliver training to ensure teams understand and execute compliance responsibilities.

 

You Will Thrive in This Role If You

  • See compliance as a strategic enabler, not a blocker.

  • Operate with high integrity, sound judgment, and strong attention to detail.

  • Communicate clearly and influence leaders using data and logic.

  • Enjoy building frameworks and scaling systems from early-stage to mature environments.

  • Thrive in fast-paced, evolving settings where regulation meets innovation.

 

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of compliance, risk, or regulatory experience within financial services, insurance, insurtech, or fintech.

  • Deep understanding of UK regulatory frameworks, including FCA rules and consumer duty requirements.

  • Experience in compliance for digital platforms, distribution, or insurance products (preferred).

  • Proven ability to design policies, conduct risk assessments, and manage complex compliance programs.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including dealing with regulators.

 

Bonus (Nice to Have)

  • Experience in start-up or high-growth environments.

  • Previous SMF experience.

  • Background in insurtech, digital distribution, or online marketplaces.

  • Knowledge of GDPR, AML, sanctions, or cross-border compliance.

 

Location Requirement

  • This role is based in the UK. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our London office at least 3 days per week.

 

Why Join Us

  • Shape compliance for a fast-growing international fintech-insurtech platform.

  • Build frameworks that enable safe, inclusive financial access at scale.

  • Work closely with leadership and regulators to drive responsible innovation.

  • Competitive compensation with long-term growth and international career opportunities.


Compensations Range

  • We offer a highly competitive package, ranging from £100,000 to £150,000, reflecting both experience and suitability for this pivotal role.

descriptionHtml:
Release, Environments, and Change Engineer (C2)

Location: London or Bristol (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Level: C2

Team: Quality Engineering 

Contract: Permanent 

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

 

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you'll do

The Release, Environments and Change Engineer (REC Engineer) has three key areas of responsibility. You will operate Release, Environments and Change processes and procedures, and you’ll be involved in, and often lead, the identification and implementation of process improvements using AI and other tools.

You will work closely with the REC Manager and Environments Manager and operate the processes they define. These processes may rely on manual activities and controls at first, so you’ll take a leading role in replacing them with appropriate automation, and then identify mechanisms and methods to govern those automated controls.

You will collaborate with Enablement teams and engineering teams across Kaluza to make sure processes are understood, embedded and followed. You’ll be a decision maker with the authority to decline or postpone releases and changes, and you’ll handle client communication where approval is required for a change or release.

  • Operating promotion gates, making promote or block decisions between environments in line with contractual and ways-of-working agreements, and escalating high-risk calls.

  • Facilitating change approvals, release Go/No-Go meetings and release trains, preparing releases against readiness criteria and tracking per-team readiness and environment-deployed status.

  • Using AI-assisted checks to confirm quality gates are met, summarise what changed in a release, score change risk and flag incomplete or stale records, applying your own judgment to improve the reliability of the results.

  • Maintaining complete, accurate change and configuration records, keeping every change traceable across the full environment stack, and managing the change and release calendar.

  • Building and maintaining release automation, including readiness checks, artefact promotion, AI-drafted release notes and notifications, and reporting feeds.

  • Working with engineering teams in real time to roll back failed releases or apply fixes, and coordinating with incident and problem management so planned changes, hotfixes and major incidents stay in sync.

  • Communicating changes and releases internally and externally, supporting environment coordination and validation, running post-implementation reviews and retros, and giving operational input into gate definitions and the wider process.

What you’ll bring 

  • Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to juggle multiple moving parts and spot incomplete records or inconsistencies.

  • Clear communication and strong facilitation skills, comfortable coordinating across teams, leading check-ins, keeping everyone aligned, driving decisions and chasing things through to completion.

  • The confidence to say no and hold the line when something isn’t ready, and to escalate when you’re unsure.

  • Comfort with Jira (or similar), including configuring boards, workflows and tickets.

  • Scripting and automation skills to build and maintain the automation around a release process (readiness checks, artefact promotion, release notes and reporting), plus familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated testing into deployment workflows.

  • Day-to-day use of AI tooling with a critical eye, catching what it gets wrong rather than waving it through.

  • Experience building or integrating AI agents (e.g. LangChain, AutoGen, custom frameworks, MCP-based tooling), with an understanding of prompt engineering and LLM evaluation techniques such as faithfulness, relevance and LLM-as-a-judge, since traditional pass/fail assertions don’t translate well to testing AI agents.

What will set you apart

  • Any exposure to how software gets released or how environments work, even informally.

  • Light scripting or automation experience, or the appetite to learn it.

  • A calm head under time pressure.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

title: AI Research Engineer (Model Compression & Quantization)
descriptionHtml:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As a member of our AI research team, you will drive innovation in model compression and efficient deployment for advanced multimodal AI systems, including large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). Your work will focus on reducing model footprint and computational cost while preserving accuracy, enabling high-performance AI to run efficiently across resource-constrained edge devices. You will apply and advance compression techniques such as quantization, knowledge distillation, and pruning to streamline complex multimodal architectures that integrate text, images, and audio.

We expect you to have deep expertise in model compression methods and a strong background in multimodal model architectures. You will adopt a hands-on, research-driven approach to develop, test, and implement novel compression strategies that balance model size, latency, throughput, and accuracy. Your responsibilities include building robust compression pipelines, establishing performance and fidelity metrics, and addressing bottlenecks in production inference. The ultimate goal is to deliver scalable, low-memory, low-latency AI systems on edge devices (i.e., smartphones) that maintain high fidelity and tangible real-world value.

Responsibilities

Break down the key responsibilities in bullet points. It’s helpful to make them actionable and measurable. This could also be grouped into categories for more complex roles.

  • Apply low-bit quantization to reduce model size and inference latency for generative AI models (LLMs, VLMs, multimodal) while maintaining accuracy and output quality.

  • Leverage knowledge distillation to transfer capabilities from larger teacher models to smaller student models, enabling efficient multimodal reasoning across text, image, and audio inputs.

  • Implement pruning techniques to remove redundant parameters and attention heads, reducing computational overhead without sacrificing task performance.

  • Analyze trade-offs between model efficiency (size, latency, memory) and accuracy across quantization, distillation, and pruning methods; propose improvements based on empirical findings.

  • Research and apply mixed-precision quantization and other advanced compression strategies (e.g., adaptive pruning schedules, distillation with intermediate feature matching) to optimize the accuracy–performance balance.

  • Stay current with the latest research in model compression, including emerging techniques for multimodal and generative architectures.

  • Document methodologies, experiments, and results clearly to support reproducibility, internal collaboration, and stakeholder communication.

  • Author technical papers and publish findings in top-tier conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ACL, AAAI) to advance the field of model compression for multimodal AI.


  • A degree in Computer Science or related field. Ideally PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D (with good publications in A* conferences).

  • Experience with PyTorch deep learning frameworks or equivalent frameworks

  • Hands-on experience with model quantization including both Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) and Post-Training Quantization (PTQ).

  • Research and hands-on experience with knowledge distillation for compressing large models into smaller, efficient ones.

  • Research and hands-on experience with model pruning for compressing large models into smaller, efficient ones.

  • Solid understanding of neural network architectures and training processes – Including transformers (e.g., LLMs, VLMs), backpropagation, optimization, and fine-tuning techniques.

  • Familiarity with C++ is a plus (especially for implementing low-level quantization kernels or inference optimizations).

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

About the job

As a member of our AI research team, you will drive innovation in model compression and efficient deployment for advanced multimodal AI systems, including large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). Your work will focus on reducing model footprint and computational cost while preserving accuracy, enabling high-performance AI to run efficiently across resource-constrained edge devices. You will apply and advance compression techniques such as quantization, knowledge distillation, and pruning to streamline complex multimodal architectures that integrate text, images, and audio.

We expect you to have deep expertise in model compression methods and a strong background in multimodal model architectures. You will adopt a hands-on, research-driven approach to develop, test, and implement novel compression strategies that balance model size, latency, throughput, and accuracy. Your responsibilities include building robust compression pipelines, establishing performance and fidelity metrics, and addressing bottlenecks in production inference. The ultimate goal is to deliver scalable, low-memory, low-latency AI systems on edge devices (i.e., smartphones) that maintain high fidelity and tangible real-world value.

Responsibilities

Break down the key responsibilities in bullet points. It’s helpful to make them actionable and measurable. This could also be grouped into categories for more complex roles.

  • Apply low-bit quantization to reduce model size and inference latency for generative AI models (LLMs, VLMs, multimodal) while maintaining accuracy and output quality.

  • Leverage knowledge distillation to transfer capabilities from larger teacher models to smaller student models, enabling efficient multimodal reasoning across text, image, and audio inputs.

  • Implement pruning techniques to remove redundant parameters and attention heads, reducing computational overhead without sacrificing task performance.

  • Analyze trade-offs between model efficiency (size, latency, memory) and accuracy across quantization, distillation, and pruning methods; propose improvements based on empirical findings.

  • Research and apply mixed-precision quantization and other advanced compression strategies (e.g., adaptive pruning schedules, distillation with intermediate feature matching) to optimize the accuracy–performance balance.

  • Stay current with the latest research in model compression, including emerging techniques for multimodal and generative architectures.

  • Document methodologies, experiments, and results clearly to support reproducibility, internal collaboration, and stakeholder communication.

  • Author technical papers and publish findings in top-tier conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ACL, AAAI) to advance the field of model compression for multimodal AI.


  • A degree in Computer Science or related field. Ideally PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D (with good publications in A* conferences).

  • Experience with PyTorch deep learning frameworks or equivalent frameworks

  • Hands-on experience with model quantization including both Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) and Post-Training Quantization (PTQ).

  • Research and hands-on experience with knowledge distillation for compressing large models into smaller, efficient ones.

  • Research and hands-on experience with model pruning for compressing large models into smaller, efficient ones.

  • Solid understanding of neural network architectures and training processes – Including transformers (e.g., LLMs, VLMs), backpropagation, optimization, and fine-tuning techniques.

  • Familiarity with C++ is a plus (especially for implementing low-level quantization kernels or inference optimizations).

title: AI Solution Architect (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Als IT-Dienstleister treiben wir die Digitalisierung des öffentlichen Sektors voran und schaffen echten Mehrwert für Millionen Menschen in Deutschland. Wir können vieles richtig gut, aber eben noch nicht alles. Darum suchen wir immer wieder neue Kolleg:innen, die mit ihren Ideen, ihrem Können und Engagement etwas bewegen wollen. Fühlst du dich angesprochen? Dann gestalte Deine Welt zum Besseren und werde Teil unseres Customer Cluster Environment, Transportation & Energy.

DEINE MISSION

Als AI Solution Architect (m/w/d) gestaltest Du die KI-/ML-Gesamtarchitektur für komplexe Enterprise-Umgebungen in der Cloud mit Schwerpunkt Microsoft Azure. Du verbindest fundiertes Know-how in ML Engineering, RAG-Architekturen und MLOps, um KI-Lösungen produktionsreif, skalierbar und sicher umzusetzen. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit technischen Expert:innen, Fachbereichen und Entscheidungsträgern zusammen und trägst maßgeblich dazu bei, innovative KI-Lösungen erfolgreich zu etablieren.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Entwurf und Weiterentwicklung der KI-/ML-Gesamtarchitektur als Enterprise-KI-Plattform mit Schwerpunkt Microsoft Azure

  • Technische Leitung von ML-Pipeline-Projekten, insbesondere in den Bereichen Training, Deployment, Monitoring und Drift Detection

  • Konzeption und Optimierung von RAG-Architekturen, beispielsweise hinsichtlich Chunking, Retrieval, Guardrails und Context Orchestration

  • Definition und Weiterentwicklung von MLOps-Strategien einschließlich CI/CD für Modelle, Experiment-Tracking und Model Registry

  • Technische Führung und Koordination interdisziplinärer Teams aus ML/AI Engineers, LLM Engineers und MLOps Engineers

  • Beratung interner und externer Stakeholder zu KI-Architekturen sowie Präsentation technischer Konzepte gegenüber IT-Leitung und Fachbereichen

DAS IST UNS WICHTIG

  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit cloudbasierten KI-/ML-Lösungen, idealerweise auf Microsoft Azure, insbesondere Azure Machine Learning und Azure OpenAI Service. Kenntnisse weiterer Cloud- und AI-Services sind von Vorteil.

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit MLOps-Konzepten und entsprechenden Werkzeugen wie MLflow, Kubeflow oder Azure ML Pipelines.

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau von RAG-Architekturen, Prompt Engineering und im Umgang mit Vektordatenbanken.

  • Kenntnisse in der Integration und Orchestrierung von Sprachmodellen, idealerweise mit Frameworks wie LangChain oder LlamaIndex.

  • Erfahrung mit CI/CD für ML-Anwendungen sowie sehr gute Python-Kenntnisse.

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit mindestens zwei gängigen Machine-Learning-Frameworks, beispielsweise scikit-learn, PyTorch oder TensorFlow.

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau von Enterprise-Architekturen in Cloud-Umgebungen.

  • Kenntnisse in angrenzenden Bereichen wie Datenplattformen, Containerisierung, Container-Orchestrierung, Infrastructure as Code und Observability sind von Vorteil, beispielsweise mit Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Prometheus, Grafana oder Application Insights.

  • Grundlegendes Verständnis von AI Governance, Responsible AI sowie Sicherheits- und Datenschutzanforderungen im Enterprise-Umfeld.

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit ML-/AI-Architekturen oder vergleichbaren technischen Aufgaben in Enterprise-Umgebungen.

  • Erfahrung in einer technischen Leitungs- oder Architekturrolle ist wünschenswert.

  • Azure-, AWS- oder Google-Cloud-Zertifizierungen sind ein Plus.

  • Idealerweise Erfahrung in der Energiebranche oder Versorgungswirtschaft sowie mit datengetriebenen Anwendungsfällen.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

DEIN NEUER ARBEITSPLATZ

  • Was bei uns zählt? Klar definierte Rollen, echtes Miteinander und ein gemeinsames Ziel. Wir nennen das Responsiveness – transparent, wertschätzend und zielorientiert.

title: Android Developer
descriptionHtml:
At Luscii, we work on several applications within the OMRON Digital Health Circle, including the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect. Together with our colleagues, we build technology that takes the burden off patients and healthcare professionals, creating more space for care. As an Android Developer, you will help make this happen by building and improving the mobile applications that connect people, devices and healthcare.

We create technology to make healthcare more accessible, as our digital health solutions help healthcare professionals monitor patients remotely, so people can receive the right care in the right place. As an Android Developer, you will help us build and improve the mobile applications that make this possible.

Your work goes beyond writing code. You will help shape technical direction, share your expertise with colleagues and explore new technologies that can improve our apps. At Luscii, our Holacratic way of working also gives you the autonomy to take initiative, pick up responsibilities and contribute beyond your core role.

The applications you build need to work reliably in a healthcare context, where stability and usability matter. You are going to make sure that our apps remain performant, scalable and easy to maintain, while exploring new ways to improve the experience for patients and healthcare professionals. By combining solid engineering with thoughtful technical choices, you will help us continue to develop its digital healthcare platform.

Your role

As Android Developer at Luscii, you will combine hands-on development with technical ownership, working closely with colleagues across development, QA and support to build, improve and maintain our applications. You turn ideas into useful, intuitive digital health solutions. Whether you are exploring a new technology, building a proof of concept or solving a production issue, you will have the autonomy to make technical decisions and the opportunity to influence how we build our apps.

What you will be doing:

  • Develop and optimise Android applications in Kotlin, with a focus on performance, stability and user experience.

  • Shape mobile architecture and technical solutions, applying sound software design principles and patterns.

  • Build prototypes and proof of concepts to explore ideas and validate technical approaches early.

  • Develop features that communicate with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices.

  • Investigate and resolve production issues, using debugging and performance analysis to keep our apps reliable.

  • Review code, share technical guidelines and collaborate with development, QA and support colleagues.

  • Explore relevant developments in mobile technology, including Jetpack Compose and Kotlin Multiplatform, and recommend improvements where they add value.

Why Luscii?

Read more about working at Luscii and how we work at Luscii/OMRON. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy.

Most important benefits

  • Salary: € 4.600 - € 5.900 gross per month (based on 32 hours per week – that’s full-time at Luscii).

  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii.

  • Flexible setup: Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here.

The ideal candidate…

… probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for somebody who is comfortable in taking ownership and making well-considered decisions independently. title: Customer Success Onboarding Specialist (m/w/d) - Germany
descriptionHtml:
Möchtest du das tägliche Leben von Millionen von Unternehmern in Deutschland (und bald in Europa) beeinflussen? Suchst du nach einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Vertrauen, Proaktivität und Autonomie schätzt? Stimmen unsere Company Values mit deiner Vision überein? Dann ist Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich!

 

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

 

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 1 300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

Deine Mission

Du bist die Stimme unserer deutschen Kunden und trägst direkt dazu bei, dass sie mit Pennylane erfolgreich sind. Du hilfst kleinen und mittleren Unternehmen (KMU), ihre Finanzprozesse zu vereinfachen und das volle Potenzial unserer Finanzmanagement-Plattform auszuschöpfen. Gleichzeitig gestaltest du mit uns den Aufbau von Pennylane in Deutschland.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Onboarding mit Wirkung: Du begleitest neue KMU-Kunden und ihre Steuerkanzleien durch den gesamten Onboarding-Prozess. Du sorgst dafür, dass der Einstieg reibungslos gelingt und Unternehmen schnell von den Möglichkeiten unserer Plattform profitieren.

  • Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen und weiterentwickeln: Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für unsere bestehenden KMU-Kunden. Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf, erkennst Potenziale für zusätzliche Funktionen und eine erweiterte Nutzung und hilfst deinen Kunden, ihre unternehmerischen und finanziellen Ziele mit Pennylane zu erreichen.

  • Proaktiv beraten: In regelmäßigen Gesprächen prüfst du, wie erfolgreich deine Kunden mit Pennylane arbeiten und wo sie Unterstützung brauchen. Du steigerst ihre Zufriedenheit, optimierst die Nutzung der Plattform und erkennst frühzeitig, wenn eine Abwanderung droht.

  • Gemeinsam den deutschen Markt gestalten: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem deutschen Sales-Team und dem lokalen Leadership-Team zusammen. Gemeinsam entwickelt ihr Abläufe weiter, bündelt Produktfeedback und treibt das Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland voran.

  • Expertise aufbauen und teilen: Du entwickelst dich zur gefragten Ansprechperson für unsere Plattform und die deutsche Finanz- und Buchhaltungslandschaft. Dein Wissen und bewährte Vorgehensweisen gibst du direkt an unsere KMU-Kunden weiter.

Das bringst du mit

  • Relevante Erfahrung: Du hast 2–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung, im Finanzmanagement, in Corporate Finance oder in einer vergleichbaren unternehmensinternen Rolle. Idealerweise hast du selbst mit Finanzprozessen, Rechnungsstellung oder Buchhaltungsabläufen gearbeitet. Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Umfeld, bei einem Fintech oder in einer Steuerkanzlei ist ein Plus.

  • Fachliche Grundlage: Du hast ein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen, Rechnungswesen oder Betriebswirtschaft abgeschlossen. Alternativ bringst du eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellter, eine Weiterbildung als Steuerfachwirt oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation im Rechnungswesen mit.

  • Verständnis für den deutschen Markt: Du kennst die Anforderungen von KMU an ihr Finanzmanagement und verstehst die zentralen Abläufe rund um Rechnungswesen, Rechnungsstellung und das finanzielle Tagesgeschäft in Deutschland.

  • Kommunikationsstärke und Empathie: Du hörst aufmerksam zu, versetzt dich in deine Kunden hinein und erklärst komplexe finanzielle oder technische Themen einfach und verständlich.

  • Lust, selbst anzupacken: Du möchtest Teil eines Teams sein, das in Deutschland noch am Anfang steht und wächst. Du ergreifst die Initiative, denkst in Lösungen und hast Freude daran, Prozesse von Grund auf mitzugestalten.

  • Reisebereitschaft: Du freust dich darauf, unser Team beim Onboarding im Pariser Headquarter kennenzulernen, und bist bereit, gelegentlich Kunden in Deutschland zu besuchen – etwa einmal im Monat.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder verhandlungssicherem Niveau (C2) und fließend Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren internationalen Teams.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

🏢 Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.

🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

 

Wen wir suchen

Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:

- Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).

- Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.

- Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).

- Ausreichend Erfahrung, um deine täglichen Aufgaben nach geschäftlichen Prioritäten auszurichten.

 

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

 

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

title: Developer Relations Engineer (London, UK)
descriptionHtml:
About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

We're looking for a Developer Relations Engineer based in London to join our team and help more developers discover, learn, and build with Supabase. You'll create high-impact content, build real-world projects, and represent Supabase across communities and events. If you're equally energized by writing code and teaching others, this is the role for you.

Why This Role Matters

Supabase is growing fast with 350,000+ developers, 1,000+ OSS contributors, and a thriving open source ecosystem. Our users are builders, startup founders, weekend hackers, and engineers scaling to millions of users. DevRel is how we meet them where they are: through content, community, and code.

We're building a community of communities that brings together developers from many backgrounds, including first-time open source contributors. As a DevRel Engineer, you'll be a bridge between Supabase and the broader developer ecosystem, helping people get started, go deep, and feel connected.

What You'll Do

  • Make content — Publish compelling technical content, especially video, to help developers learn Supabase quickly

  • Build demos and tutorials — Ship real-world apps using Supabase and tools like Next.js, React, and Stripe. Write guides that others can follow and remix

  • Represent Supabase — Speak at meetups, livestream builds, and engage with the developer ecosystem. You'll be a visible and trusted voice of the platform

  • Support and grow the community — Celebrate contributors, answer questions, highlight cool projects, and bring developer feedback to the team

  • Collaborate across the company — Work with engineering, product, and growth to amplify launches, prioritize content, and reduce friction for new users

You Might Be a Good Fit If

  • You've built full-stack apps and enjoy sharing your knowledge

  • You create content that makes people want to open their code editor

  • You're equally comfortable writing a video script and TypeScript

  • You're energized by community whether it's on Discord, Twitter, YouTube, or in person

  • You're self-directed, organized, and excited to contribute to open source

Requirements

This role is based in London to support regular in-person DevRel video shoots, attend local events, and be an active presence in the London tech ecosystem.

  • Strong engineering skills, especially with JavaScript or TypeScript, Postgres, and modern frontend frameworks (React, Svelte, Vue, etc.)

  • Experience creating technical content (written or video)

  • Comfortable representing a product publicly (on camera, on stage, or online)

Bonus Points If You Have

  • A growing audience on YouTube, Twitch, or Twitter

  • Prior experience in DevRel or open source

  • Have used (and loved) Supabase

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Director of Sales, Europe
descriptionHtml:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:  

The Director of Sales, Europe will be responsible for leading our regional sales organization, driving Planet’s Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy, and accelerating revenue growth across national security, defense, and government sectors.

As a people manager and business leader, you will own the regional revenue target, drive executive alignment, and establish disciplined pipeline governance to ensure forecast predictability. You will be responsible for building, mentoring, and coaching a team of direct reports—fostering a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous professional development. In addition to team development, you will architect large-scale strategic programs, lead high-stakes commercial negotiations, and scale partner ecosystems to penetrate priority markets. Above all, you will leverage your leadership experience to elevate Planet’s market presence across NATO and the Nordics in alignment with our mission to see change and change the world.

The ideal candidate is an accomplished sales leader with deep defense domain expertise and a track record of managing high-performing teams across Alliance structures and Northern European markets. You will bring an established executive network spanning NATO HQ, allied Defense Ministries, Armed Forces Commands, Intelligence Agencies, and key European Prime Contractors/System Integrators. Combining strategic commercial acumen with an understanding of collective defense and national security priorities, you will position Planet as a trusted capability provider for mission-critical operations.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United Kingdom or Germany. If located near an office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Drive Strategic Revenue Growth: Own and execute a result-oriented Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy to build, negotiate, and close high-value, complex deals across sovereign defense and government sectors, consistently hitting or exceeding regional quota targets.
  • Forecast Governance & Predictability: Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene (Salesforce.com) and deliver accurate, data-driven revenue forecasts to executive leadership through disciplined deal inspection and pipeline management.
  • Capture Strategy & Value Messaging: Engineer tailored capture strategies and high-impact executive narratives that align with agency-level priorities, resonate with key decision-makers, and win competitive procurements.
  • Manage, Coach & Empower: Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing sales team, establishing a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous professional development.
  • Methodology Alignment: Train and inspect direct reports on core sales methodologies and capture frameworks (e.g., MEDDPICC, Shipley), coaching them on deal qualification, stakeholder mapping, and win strategies.
  • Talent Bench & Scaling: Proactively recruit, onboard, and retain elite commercial and defense-domain talent to build a solid talent bench as the regional footprint expands.
  • Cross-Functional Matrix Alignment: Orchestrate seamless collaboration across internal matrix teams including Government Affairs, Product, Engineering, and Field Marketing to align corporate capabilities with regional market opportunities.
  • Technical & Post-Sales Win Alignment: Partner closely with Pre-Sales/Solutions Engineering to secure technical wins, and collaborate with Post-Sales teams to ensure flawless customer onboarding, retention, and long-term expansion.
  • Deal Cadence & Executive Escalation: Communicate deal velocity transparently across internal business units, mobilizing executive sponsorship and cross-functional support when needed to de-risk complex pursuits.

What You Bring:

  • 8+ years of relevant work experience and 6+ years supervisory / leadership experience, with a track record of driving revenue growth, building high-performing teams, and consistently exceeding multi-million-dollar individual and team quotas.
  • Ability to recruit, mentor, and retain top-tier talent, instilling a high-accountability culture and coaching direct reports through complex, multi-year deal cycles.
  • Deep experience establishing pipeline discipline, accurate revenue forecasting, and thorough deal inspection using Salesforce.com and modern sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC).
  • Extensive background navigating complex government, NATO, and defense procurement frameworks (e.g., NCI Agency, FMS/DCS, national MoD acquisition bodies) across Northern Europe and Allied Command structures, with a focus on key Nordic nations (Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark).
  • An established, C-level network across Defense Ministries, Intelligence Agencies, Allied Commands, and European Defense Primes / System Integrators.
  • Deep understanding of how commercial technology and advanced data feeds support Allied posture, sovereign defense, intelligence, and ISR missions.
  • Success collaborating across internal matrixed teams (Government Affairs, Product, Engineering, Legal) to align corporate capabilities with regional opportunities.
  • A strategic, self-directed leader with commercial judgment, adept at leading teams through dynamic, high-growth, or startup-like market environments.
  • Professional working proficiency in English, the language of the company.

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • 5+ years of progressive sales leadership and enterprise business development experience within the defense, national security, or government technology sectors, with a track record of building high-performing teams and consistently exceeding revenue targets.
  • Operational understanding of NATO defense priorities, Nordic security dynamics, joint acquisition processes, and agency decision-making across Allied Ministries of Defense and Tier-1 Defense Primes.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-year deal cycles, with the ability to lead sales teams through disciplined capture frameworks, pipeline governance, and accurate revenue forecasting.
  • Professional proficiency in a Nordic language (Swedish, Finnish, Norwegian, Danish) is a plus for engaging senior government ministers, military command leadership, and internal executives.

title: Director of Strategic Accounts
descriptionHtml:
The Basics

As a Director of Strategic Accounts (DSA) on the Tanium field sales team, you will be responsible for generating opportunities to position the Tanium platform within an assigned territory and/or accounts. You’ll be equally as comfortable with the CIO, CISO or VP Ops as you would hosting a room of Red Team members; from talking business benefits to bits and bytes. The successful DSA drives a superior customer experience by delivering technology solutions tailored to customer needs and is able to exceed their assigned quota. 

What you’ll do

  • Articulate the value of the Tanium platform to decision makers and expertly manage the complex sales cycle 
  • Nurture and develop relationships within the assigned territory and/or accounts, presenting to the C-suite the value of the Tanium platform 
  • Work with the Partner and Marketing teams to define and support prospecting and sales efforts within assigned territory and/or accounts 
  • Generate appropriate sales development activity to ensure healthy pipeline management 
  • Accurately forecast, maintaining excellent SFDC hygiene 
  • Conduct online webinars or in-person presentations to generate qualified leads 
  • Travel as needed 

We’re looking for someone with

  • Significant enterprise software sales experience, generating and closing large & complex software transactions with the biggest customers in the region 
  • A strong team mentality - selling is a team sport at Tanium, where managing and using virtual resources to tackle large and complex sales cycles is a must have skill 
  • Proven track record of exceeding quota 
  • Experience calling on and presenting to C-Suite level contacts 
  • Background building and cultivating relationships with partner ecosystems to bring a partner-centric go-to-market approach to our customers 
  • The ability to evangelize and build new business opportunities within an assigned territory and/or accounts. 
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills 

About Tanium 

Tanium is the Autonomous IT company. As Al accelerates both innovation and risk, Tanium Atlas, the company's autonomous operating system, puts the full depth of the Tanium Autonomous IT Platform behind every IT and security operator - human and agentic. Tanium provides the real-time intelligence, agentic decision-making, and autonomous execution operators needed to detect, decide, and remediate at machine speed across their endpoint estate. 

The company is recognized as a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Endpoint Management Tools, as a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Client Endpoint Management Software for Windows Device Management 2025-2026 Vendor Assessment, and as a Leader in The Forrester Wave™. Endpoint Management Platforms, Q2 2026.

To learn how Tanium delivers Autonomous IT for unstoppable business, visit www.tanium.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

On a mission. Together. 

At Tanium, we are stewards of a culture that emphasizes the importance of collaboration, respect, and diversity. In our pursuit of revolutionizing the way some of the largest enterprises and governments in the world solve their most difficult IT challenges, we are strengthened by our unique perspectives and by our collective actions.   

As a global organization with stakeholders around the world, it’s imperative that the diversity of our customers and communities is reflected internally in our team members. We strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels they have opportunities to succeed and grow because we know that only together can we do great things.  

Our commitment to excellence and innovation has earned us a place on the Forbes Cloud 100 list for ten consecutive years, and we continue to be recognized worldwide as a great place to work. 

Taking care of our team members 

Each of our team members has 5 days set aside as volunteer time off (VTO) to contribute to the communities they live in and give back to the causes they care about most. 

Tanium is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, protected Veteran status, or other legally protected categories. If you require a reasonable accommodation in searching for a job opening, completing an application, interviewing, or completing any pre-employment testing or requirements, please contact https://www.eeoc.gov/poster.

title: Director, Product-Led Growth
descriptionHtml:
About Upsun

Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It’s built for hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and people focus on the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale with confidence, without wrestling with backend infrastructure.

Upsun Dispatch, our newest offering, brings that same idea to the whole team. It’s the platform for governed collaboration between AI agents and cross-functional humans. Agents handle the volume in isolated sandboxes. People make the decisions that matter, with every approval and every cost on the record.

We give you your time back. You get:

  • Predictable performance, even at scale
  • Secure, compliant environments by default
  • Real-time observability and profiling built in
  • Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds
  • AI-ready features that plug directly into your stack

The name says it all. “Up” stands for uptime, reliability, and acceleration. “Sun” reflects our follow-the-sun support: a 24x7, globally distributed team keeping the lights on while you rest. We believe software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.

Upsunners are a remote, global team, and we thrive in a multicultural one. We’re committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment, and our people span the whole experience spectrum. What ties us together is curiosity, a thirst for knowledge, and an eagerness for new ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together when the environment frees you to do your best work.

Our values:
🌿 We make a positive impact.
✨ We aim for the stars.
💚 We care for each other.

Impact of a Director, Product-Led Growth

As Director, PLG, you’ll lead the strategy, execution, and commercial success of Upsun’s product-led revenue engine. Upsun is expanding its portfolio with Upsun Dispatch, a strategic new offer that joins Upsun Cloud, and this role will turn that expansion into measurable growth. 

Reporting directly to the Chief Marketing Officer, you will own the revenue target for product-led experiences, building a scalable engine across developer recruitment, freemium conversion, and customer retention. Working at the intersection of Marketing, Product Management, and Engineering, you will bridge technical platform capabilities with market-driven execution to scale Upsun’s global footprint. 

What to expect

  • Own product-led revenue: Be accountable for ARR from self-serve experiences, from first signup through conversion, expansion, and retention. 

  • Drive growth goals: Build and execute PLG programs to achieve clear top-line ARR milestones and hit aggressive user acquisition targets with specific focus in Europe and North America.  

  • Connect growth and product: Partner closely with the Head of Growth (Marketing), Head of User Acquisition and Conversion (Marketing)  and Upsun Dispatch Product Managers (Product/Engineering) to translate product strategy into measurable customer and business outcomes.  

  • Optimize the funnel: Define in-product monetization levers, optimize self-service funnels, and partner with Sales to refine Product-Led Sales (PLS) handoffs for enterprise accounts.  

  • Build tight feedback loops: Analyze intent data, user behavior, and churn metrics to continuously iterate on user onboarding, NPS, and lifetime value.  

What you bring

  • PLG and growth leadership: A track record as a Senior Product Manager or Director with growth and commercial revenue responsibilities at a developer-focused, SaaS, or cloud platform company driven primarily by a PLG model.  

  • Strategic judgment: Ability to turn complex developer platform capabilities into intuitive self-service user experiences that drive clear, measurable business value.  

  • Cross-functional execution: A record of leading cross-functional growth initiatives across Marketing, Product Management, and Engineering.

  • Data-driven approach: Hands-on depth in growth analytics, conversion funnels, freemium-to-paid activation, and retention.

  • Developer and AI fluency: Practical understanding of modern developer workflows, cloud infrastructure, and how AI-assisted development tools are reshaping user expectations.  

Bonus points

  • Dual-funnel experience: Running both self-serve funnels (PLG) and enterprise sales handoffs (PLS).

  • Platform background: Cloud infrastructure, PaaS, DevOps, or developer platforms.

  • Global scale: Scaling product-led revenue across remote-first, international teams.

Where we hire

At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend - it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in Canada, France, Germany, Spain, the United Kingdom, and the United States. Although we’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries. 

How we hire

We know that a great hire won’t meet every requirement that we’ve outlined. If you can see yourself elevating the team, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here had we not taken a chance.   

You can expect 5 interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. Should you successfully move through the entire process you will have the opportunity to meet with a variety of Upsunners. Our goal is to ensure you can make the most informed decision on whether this role, and our culture aligns with what you’re looking for in your future working environment. 

  1. 45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition 
  2. 60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (Chief Marketing Officer)
  3. 60 Minutes with Team (IC)
  4. 60 Minutes with Team (Head of Growth)
  5. 45 Minutes with Executive (CFO)

All roles require background checks.

What we offer

💡 A product you can believe in - Join us in transforming how businesses build and manage web applications, driven making a positive impact as a proud B Corp.

🏆 An Award-Winning Workplace - We’ve been recognized by Forbes’ Top 30 Companies for Remote Jobs and France’s Best Workplaces for Women.

🗣️ A culture that values your voice - Join a flexible, open, and inclusive work environment where your voice is encouraged, and your ideas shape our growth and evolution.

🌎 A global team - Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives

🎉 Benefits and perks - Make the most of what matters to you

🏝 Flexible PTO

🩺 Comprehensive healthcare coverage (UK, Canada, France, Spain, USA)

📈 Company stock options

🧠 Professional development budget

💻 Office equipment budget

💆‍♀️ Wellness budget

🧳 Annual team gatherings

👶 Inclusive parental leave

✈️ Remote work travel program

You belong here

At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. If you need accommodations at any stage of our hiring process, please let us know. We're here to ensure an accessible and comfortable experience for you.

An overview of this role

As Engineering Manager, Architecture Engineering: Async, you'll lead a distributed group of Site Reliability Engineers and Backend Engineers. You'll support their development and balance production reliability with platform projects, including zero-downtime Redis upgrades, support for single-tenant and cell-based deployments, and the move from queue-based job orchestration to a durable workflow engine.

What you'll do

  • Lead, hire, and grow a team of site reliability engineers and backend engineers, supporting career development, promotions, and onboarding.
  • Own reliability for the job processing and caching platforms, including service-level objectives, error budgets, alerting, and weekly operational reviews.
  • Manage capacity planning, support escalations, and incident follow-ups, balancing operational work with roadmap projects and rescoping work when deadlines can't be met.
  • Run the team's part of GitLab.com's first-tier on-call rotation, including shift coverage, onboarding, and handovers, and serve as incident commander for high-severity incidents.
  • Drive zero-downtime Redis version upgrades and automate operating system patching and reboots.
  • Adapt job processing to run in single-tenant and cell-based deployments.
  • Own the migration from queue-based job orchestration to a durable workflow engine, defining the first use cases, a measurable migration path, and the roadmap.
  • Own quarterly planning and the team roadmap, and clarify shared operational responsibilities with partner teams, including Git storage.

What you'll bring

  • Experience managing an engineering team delivering high-performance services at scale, ideally site reliability engineers or infrastructure engineers running production software as a service systems.
  • Technical depth in background job processing and caching technologies such as Redis and Sidekiq, sufficient to guide decisions about upgrades, capacity, and failure modes.
  • Experience managing reliability against service-level objectives, including defining service-level indicators, setting up burn-rate alerting, and planning capacity.
  • Experience running a 24/7 on-call rotation and coordinating high-severity incidents.
  • A track record of balancing operational work and incident follow-ups with roadmap projects, and pushing back on scope when deadlines can't be met.
  • Experience leading a fully remote team across time zones in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific.

About the team

The Async team runs GitLab.com's background processing layer, from the Sidekiq infrastructure to the shared code that enqueues jobs. Product teams build the jobs; we keep the platform that runs them fast and reliable. Our Redis clusters support caching, sessions, rate limiting, queues, and shared state. We also support data durability through backup and restore verification, object storage, and operational support for Git repository storage. That work includes restore drills, capacity rebalancing, and provisioning. We staff GitLab.com's first-tier production on-call rotation in 8-hour shifts across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific, triaging every paging alert and bringing in the right team when needed.
