title: Founding ML Engineer (Spectrum)
descriptionHtml:
Software engineers and AI agents alike suffer from the same problem: finding that one person or place that will answer their tough, specific question. Many solutions promise to solve this with similarity search in vector databases. Unfortunately, finding the answer is often a puzzle with pieces to be collected across a myriad of contradictory sources and cannot be solved without surgical search and careful reasoning. 

Spectrum collects data from an organization’s code, docs, and issues, and organizes knowledge in a unified ontology that AI agents can efficiently search through and reason over. We aim to revolutionize the semantic layer space for software-building organizations and move beyond specs that fall out of sync with code, introducing a living spec – one that’s extracted from the whole system and used to keep it aligned. Spectrum is meant to be the single source of truth for all product and architectural knowledge.

Spectrum is a resident of JetBrains' startup incubator, with startup speed and autonomy, and backed by 25 years of developer tooling expertise. We are looking for a top-class ML Engineer who will help us shape the future of software development. You will own our AI and ML engineering stack and help define the research agenda for our team. Your technical vision and design decisions will directly shape the product and determine its success.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Designing and building the ML/LLM solution for data ingestion, knowledge extraction, retrieval, and subsequent reasoning.
  • Creating the datasets, metrics, and pipelines that drive measurable improvements across the system.
  • Architecting and improving agents for context retrieval, knowledge extraction, and data alignment, which includes prompt engineering, model selection, and inference optimization.
  • Establishing MLOps practices, including orchestration, observability, and experiment tracking.
  • Collaborating with the engineering team on system design and with JetBrains Research on the research agenda.
  • Defining hiring criteria, growing the ML team, and shaping the ML team culture.

We expect you to have:

  • A proven track record as an ML/AI Lead.
  • At least five years of experience in ML/AI systems, with at least two years focused on LLMs and generative AI.
  • A deep understanding of the LLM ecosystem, including model architectures and fine-tuning approaches.
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Prompt engineering and LLM pipeline design, including evaluation.
    • Agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangSmith, smolagents, or an equivalent.
    • Vector databases and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns.
    • Deploying and scaling LLM-powered applications using APIs (e.g. OpenAI or Anthropic) or open-source models.
  • Strong Python skills – Kotlin knowledge would be a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
  • Proficiency in English, both written and verbal. 

Our ideal candidate would have:

  • Experience with ontologies, knowledge graphs, or graph-based reasoning.
  • Experience in early-stage startups – you enjoy the zero-to-one phase.
  • The ability to think strategically about product-led AI, beyond just training models in isolation.
  • A background in code analysis, developer tools, or software engineering research.
  • Experience with multi-agent systems or complex agentic workflows.
  • Actively contributed to relevant open-source projects or publications.

What we offer

  • A competitive salary and JetBrains benefits.
  • A generous runway and corporate resources with startup autonomy.

descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
Studio is where creators build and finish video on ElevenLabs, powered by our generative graph engine, Flows. You’ll own our “produce once, distribute everywhere” workflow. It takes a finished Studio project and runs it through our dubbing pipeline to produce it in many languages and aspect ratios, with auto-translated captions. Today that means duplicating and rebuilding projects by hand.
This work is entirely greenfield: the specs aren’t written yet. You’ll shape them through written proposals (RFCs), pressure-test data structures with the team lead, and carry the project from first draft to launch.
You’re a strong backend generalist who is good with complex data structures and has the product instincts to decide what’s worth building.

Requirements

  • Strong backend generalist who has designed and shipped complex, data-heavy systems end to end.

  • Comfortable with enterprise-grade concerns such as usage reporting and accounts.

  • Evidence of product ownership: side projects, open source, or work in a product-facing context.

  • Has taken projects from inception to launch with little hand-holding.

Bonus: experience with media or video-processing pipelines (helpful, not required)

descriptionHtml:
About us

Hey there! We're Lleverage, and we're making the Autonomous Back Office actually achievable for businesses. We enable European companies to integrate AI agents into their business, because AI is only useful when it actually fits into daily operations.

We’re a fast-growing, VC-backed scale-up based in Amsterdam, with big ambitions for 2027 and beyond. This is your chance to join early, have real impact, and grow alongside the company. If that sounds something you want to help build, we'd love to have you on board!

About the role

We're looking for a Go-To-Market Lead to open and lead the German market for Lleverage. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role: you set the strategy for Germany, build the first pipeline yourself, close our first German customers and own the German number. You'll work directly with our founding team, including our CCO, and you'll be the face of Lleverage in Germany.

As the market grows, you'll lead a small German pod. A Go-To-Market Associate will join you to run revops and German-language outreach and calling, and a Forward Deployed Engineer will join once the first deals are signed, to deliver for those customers.

Responsibilities

  • Open and lead the German market: build pipeline from scratch and close our first German customers, focused on mid-size and larger manufacturing, logistics and wholesale companies

  • Own the German number: set targets with the founding team and be accountable for pipeline and revenue in Germany

  • Own the full sales cycle: from first contact to signed contract, including C-level conversations and complex, multi-stakeholder deals

  • Build the German playbook: ICP, German-language messaging, channels and partners

  • Lead the pod: coach the Go-To-Market Associate on pipeline and work with the Forward Deployed Engineer on first deliveries

  • Represent Lleverage: with German customers, partners and at industry events

  • Work directly with the founding team: on strategy, targets, approach and customer feedback

  • Bring insights: from German customers back into product development


What we’re looking for

  • Around 10 years of B2B sales experience, with a strong track record of closing complex deals and hitting targets

  • You have opened a market or built a sales territory from scratch before, and you have taken ownership of a number

  • A senior seller who still loves running deals yourself and is ready to lead a small team as it grows, not a sales executive who manages from a distance

  • You're an excellent relationship builder. You win trust fast, communicate with confidence at all levels, and genuinely enjoy the process of turning a cold conversation into a long-term partnership.

A network in the German Mittelstand. Experience in B2B sales, partnerships, or business development. Background in SaaS, AI, or Consultancy. Previous entrepreneurial experience is a big plus, built something, ran something, grew something. 50% of our team are former founders, that tells you something.

Change the world, literally. Traditional industries are sitting on a massive AI opportunity and most of them haven't been reached yet. You'll be the one opening those doors.

Work, learn, have fun. We're building one of the strongest commercial teams in Europe. You'll work directly with the founding team, surrounded by exceptional talent, and genuinely enjoy the people around you.

Build a unique network. Lleverage is a global top AI brand. You'll connect with industry leaders and some of the most important operators in tech and traditional industry.

title: GTM Lead, APAC
descriptionHtml:
Why work at Higgsfield AI?

We're the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $1B in annual revenue run rate, 30M+ users worldwide, 6M+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands. We're building at the absolute frontier of AI-powered video creation and next-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high-impact team shaping the future of AI-native experiences, at a company that isn't just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like.

About the role

Higgsfield AI is looking for a GTM Lead, APAC to build and own our commercial business across Asia-Pacific (excluding Japan, which has its own dedicated lead). APAC is already one of our largest regions by creators and generations; this role turns that usage into agency, brand and enterprise revenue.

You will define the APAC go-to-market, source and close the region's first lighthouse accounts yourself, open the partner routes to market that matter in Asia, and set the playbook that the next wave of APAC hires will follow. You will work closely with our Asia-based Growth team, our US-based Enterprise team, and directly with company leadership.

The ideal candidate has sold creative, marketing or AI technology across at least three APAC markets with distinct buying cultures, knows when a partner is the right route in and when direct is, and is energised by owning a region from zero.

What you'll do

Open the APAC market

  • Build and execute Higgsfield's APAC go-to-market strategy, tiered by market: active selling in Singapore, Australia and New Zealand, Korea and Hong Kong; relationship building in Southeast Asia, India and Taiwan; later investment elsewhere.

  • Segment the region by readiness to buy: advertising and creative agencies, consumer brands, production companies, broadcasters and streamers, K-content, gaming and sports media.

  • Personally source, run and close the region's first enterprise and agency deals, from first touch through negotiation and signature, adapting to how each market buys: procurement-led in ANZ, relationship-first in Korea and Greater China, partner-led and price-sensitive in Southeast Asia and India.

  • Convert high-usage APAC creators, teams and agencies already on the platform into team and enterprise accounts.

Build pipeline and revenue

  • Own APAC pipeline, forecast and bookings; keep 3x+ pipeline coverage and report weekly to leadership.

  • Run an outbound-first motion in markets where inbound is thin, alongside platform-driven inbound where it is strong: executive outreach, events, partner introductions and creator-community referrals.

  • Lead commercial negotiations, enterprise agreements, and multi-year, usage-based and local-currency deal structures.

  • Build regional references and case studies that make the next APAC deal easier than the last.

Work the ecosystem

  • Build relationships with senior decision-makers at regional agency holding-company offices, independent agencies, consumer brands and media groups.

  • Identify and activate the partners that are the primary route to market in Asia (regional agency networks, telcos and platforms, production studios, system integrators, local resellers) with the Head of Partnerships.

  • Represent Higgsfield at APAC industry events and in regional media as the leading AI video platform for creative work.

  • Localise positioning, pricing packaging and campaigns for APAC buyers with Marketing and Product, and coordinate with our existing APAC content and community efforts.

  • Surface market, competitive, platform and regulatory signals from the region to Product, Legal and leadership.

  • Define what the APAC team should look like at 5 and 15 people, and help hire it.

What success looks like in year one

  • A tiered APAC market plan and sales playbook that leadership has signed off.

  • Marquee customers live in production in at least two active-selling markets, with public references.

  • Two or more partner channels producing qualified pipeline.

  • A forecast that is accurate within 15% quarter over quarter.

Requirements

  • 8+ years in enterprise sales, business development, partnerships or GTM leadership, including 3+ years selling SaaS, AI, creative technology, marketing technology or media technology in APAC.

  • A track record of sourcing and closing six- and seven-figure deals yourself, not only through a team.

  • Multi-country APAC experience: you have sold or led commercial efforts in at least three APAC markets with distinct buying cultures.

  • Partner and channel experience in APAC markets where partners are the primary route to market.

  • An existing network of senior buyers in APAC agencies, brands, media or entertainment companies.

  • Comfortable opening a region alone and far from HQ: no local marketing, SE or RevOps bench on day one, and independent decision-making across time zones.

  • Fluent English; Korean, Mandarin, Cantonese, Bahasa or Thai is a strong plus.

  • Based in, or willing to relocate to, Almaty; or based in Singapore, Australia, Hong Kong or Korea with the right to work there and able to travel across the region and to Almaty regularly.

  • Genuine enthusiasm for generative AI and hands-on fluency with Higgsfield or comparable creative AI tools.

Nice to have

  • Experience at an AI-native company, a creator platform, a social or short-video platform, or a usage-based software business.

  • Relationships in K-content, gaming, or broadcaster and streamer ecosystems in Asia.

  • Prior experience as a first or founding commercial hire in a region.

What we're not looking for

  • A strategy-only leader who needs a team before they can produce results.

  • Someone whose success has depended on a large inbound brand and a full supporting bench.

  • A single-market seller; APAC is too diverse for one-country experience.

What we offer

  • Competitive base salary in USD, based on your experience, skills, and the scope of the role.

  • Equity participation through the company's stock option program, giving you the opportunity to share in Higgsfield's long-term growth.

  • Relocation support for candidates moving from another city or country.

  • A highly collaborative, fast-paced environment where you can work directly with experienced leaders and have a meaningful impact on the product and company.

  • Opportunities for professional growth, ownership, and career development as the company scales.

Location and working model

We would prefer this person to be based in Almaty, where much of our Growth team sits and which keeps workable overlap with every APAC time zone. We are equally happy with a fully remote hire based in Singapore, Sydney, Hong Kong or Seoul, with regular travel to customers across the region and to Almaty and San Francisco for planning sessions and company events. Team members are expected to maintain sufficient overlap with the Growth team's working hours and to be active, responsive and close collaborators across time zones.

title: Head of Engineering, Sales Management Tools
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month. 

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why the UK

The UK is home to our headquarters where more than 70 team members are based, with team members joining us from companies like Tide, Klarna, Revolut, Capital One, Teya, Wise, Starling, Monzo, and many others! Our London office is located at Sea Containers, just by London Bridge - this is also where a significant number of our most senior leaders sit, which makes it a natural base for a Head of Engineering.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Sales Management Tools, to join us in UK.

About The Role

Sales Management Tools owns MonieCRM, the operating system for Moniepoint's 50,000-strong sales network. This is not a CRM we bought — it is a workforce operations platform built entirely in-house for a multi-level field sales hierarchy, and it is how those teams run their day to day: the portfolio of businesses they manage, their own teams, their goals and performance, the physical and digital resources they need in the field, and an emerging AI-assisted support layer. Sixteen capabilities span onboarding and network management, pipeline and portfolio, performance and goals, compensation, and sales experience and support.

A significant part of the domain moves money. The platform owns wallets, commission calculation and attribution, cashout and welfare funds for a network that drives the overwhelming majority of company revenue — which makes financial correctness, not just availability, a core engineering requirement of the role.

Alongside that, the domain covers partner management, a rewards and retention platform serving tens of millions of users, and our marketing technology stack, including the engineering and customisation of Braze, the platform we use for customer engagement. The mandate is modernisation and reliability: re-architecting systems that have grown very quickly and making them dependable at a scale of more than 20 million users. This is a platform engineering and legacy modernisation challenge first and foremost, and prior CRM or SalesTech experience is genuinely not required.

Who You Are 

  • You have 10–15 years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases.
  • 5+ years of hands-on, production-level experience writing and shipping Java code as a practising engineer. This means years spent writing Java yourself, not years spent overseeing teams who write it.
  • At least 5 years of experience managing managers — leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, rather than running a single team.
  • You have proven platform engineering experience at scale — building and running complex distributed systems, not feature delivery alone.
  • You have navigated legacy migrations and re-architecture projects at 20M+ user scale.
  • You have strong backend engineering skills in high-throughput, data-intensive distributed systems, and are proficient in Java and Spring Boot.
  • You have managed and developed large engineering teams of 20 or more members.
  • Experience building systems where financial correctness matters — commissions, payouts, wallets, ledgers or equivalent — is a strong advantage.
  • A fintech or payments background is strongly preferred. CRM or SalesTech domain experience is nice to have and explicitly not required.
  • Exposure to customer engagement or marketing automation platforms such as Braze is a plus, but not a requirement.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
  • Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
  • No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
  • Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What Success Looks Like In The Role

  • Legacy systems modernised and re-architected, with measurable improvement in reliability and performance.
  • Commissions and earnings calculated, attributed and paid accurately and on time, at network scale.
  • A sales and marketing platform that scales with a rapidly growing agent network across multiple markets.
  • Commercial teams able to move faster because the tooling beneath them is dependable.
  • A high-performing engineering team with a strong bench of managers and senior engineers.

Why Join Us

  • Own the platform behind the commercial engine of one of Africa's largest digital banks — the system 50,000 people rely on to do their jobs and to get paid.
  • A genuine platform modernisation mandate with the autonomy and backing to see it through.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company impacting millions of businesses and individuals across Africa and beyond.

What To Expect In The Hiring Process

  • 60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
  • 60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes.
  • 60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business.
  • 60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

title: Head of Engineering | xpate
descriptionHtml:
Role: Head of Engineering
Company: xpate
Location: London or remote
Job Type: Full-time

About xpate

xpate has been a card acquirer since 2019. It combines acquiring and banking for B2B clients only, with €100M+ in annual revenue. About 100 people work there, around 15 of them in engineering. HQ is in London, and the team is spread across Latvia, Cyprus, Serbia and Singapore.

The business is changing. xpate is moving from direct sales to distribution through platforms and partners: embedded finance and Payfac-as-a-Service. The platform has to change with it. Tooling, data flow, processes and the release cycle all need a rebuild, and much of the workflow is still tracked by hand.

xpate also wants to become AI-native. Guardrails go around the core – the data layer and financial data – so it can’t be lost, rewritten or broken. Everything else runs through an agentic harness on top, so non-engineering teams can build their own tools by prompting agents.

What you will do

  • Lead the platform and organizational transformation from the inside, together with the current team.

  • Own the whole technical picture: infrastructure, architecture and vendors.

  • Replace the traditional PM → engineer handoff. Test the idea that engineering and product can work as one, with engineers talking directly to the business and domain experts.

  • Move code writing to LLMs with automated QA. Start where mistakes are cheap and reach the critical financial components later.

  • Hire engineers who talk to people and ask questions, not only write code. You can bring in 1–2 people who share the vision.

  • Focus on internal efficiency. The business sets the direction – the job is not to set a product or market vision of your own.

First 6 months

  • Months 1–3: bring all data flow – customer, financial and manual – into one clear perimeter.

  • Months 4–6: build the harness on top, so non-engineering teams can prompt agents, create their own tools and run their workflows.

What you need to succeed

  • You have built financial systems: ledger, reconciliation, processing, gateway, double-entry accounting. Ideally you wrote them yourself, and you know what a few cents of error cost at scale.

  • You have a strong data architecture background.

  • You can hold the full technical picture: infrastructure, architecture and vendors.

  • You are a senior engineer with proven results. Team size doesn’t matter – leading 4–5 people is fine.

  • You know code quality and review still matter, and you are ready to change how the work gets done.

  • You think and talk like a business person.

  • You are a mature operator: collaborative, transparent, no “I know best”. You change things carefully and still make bold calls.

  • Payments or acquiring background is not required – any financial systems experience works.

  • Nice to have: you have rebuilt or transformed a team before.

  • Nice to have: you are based in London.

What you get

  • A new role with a clear mission: transform the platform and the way the company works.

  • Direct work with the founders, reporting to the CEO.

  • A team of about 15 engineers to inherit and reshape.

  • A profitable company moving into Payfac-as-a-Service and embedded distribution.

  • An AI-native setup where non-engineers build their own tools.

  • Year 1 is fixed pay. From year 2, shadow equity tied to P&L performance, with a path to real equity. Details to be agreed.

title: Head of Product (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über DrAnsay

DrAnsay wurde 2018 gegründet und gehört heute zu den führenden digitalen Gesundheitsplattformen in Deutschland. Als digitales HealthTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Patient:innen, Ärzt:innen und Apotheken und entwickeln technologische Lösungen, die Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher, schneller und zugänglicher machen. Mehr als 1 Million Patient:innen nutzen unsere Plattform bereits. Unser Anspruch ist klar: digitale Medizin so zu gestalten, dass sie im Alltag wirklich funktioniert.

Wir arbeiten schnell, direkt und mit viel Eigenverantwortung. Wer zu uns kommt, übernimmt nicht einfach nur eine bestehende Rolle, sondern gestaltet Strukturen, Prozesse und Entscheidungen aktiv mit.

Warum es diese Rolle gibt

DrAnsay befindet sich in einer Scale-up-Phase: Die Grundstrukturen der Produktorganisation stehen. Der Fokus liegt jetzt auf Optimierung, Effizienz und der Weiterentwicklung bestehender sowie neuer Produktinitiativen. Unser CPO verantwortet gleichzeitig kommerzielle und strategische Themen der Unternehmensführung. Neue Initiativen brauchen deshalb eine Person, die produktübergreifend Struktur schafft und den Takt hält.

Die Position wird neu geschaffen, um diese Lücke zu schließen. Das ist keine Rolle, in der du Grundlagen aufräumst. Es geht darum, dass wir neue Produkte schneller starten und bei bestehenden Produkten an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten.

Deine Rolle

Als Head of Product übernimmst du die Koordination produktübergreifender Roadmaps und OKR-Zyklen, verantwortest das unternehmensweite Produkt-Reporting und sorgst dafür, dass Metriken, Feature-Impact und Produktstrategie intern klar kommuniziert werden. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO und bist Schnittstelle zu einem neunköpfigen Produktteam aus Senior Product Managern und einem UX-Team sowie zu Data, Marketing und Engineering.

Dein Ziel in den ersten Monaten ist es, alle Produktbereiche, unseren Markt und das Team gründlich zu verstehen. Du erkennst, wo Planung, Zusammenarbeit und Dokumentation besser werden können, machst einen Plan und setzt ihn um.

Was du konkret machst

  • Produktübergreifende Roadmaps über mehrere Produktlinien und Teams hinweg koordinieren, aktuell halten und Abhängigkeiten zwischen Teams früh erkennen und auflösen

  • OKRs und Key Results auf Team-Ebene mit der übergeordneten Produktstrategie verknüpfen und die Zyklen von der Planung bis zur Auswertung begleiten

  • Die Produkt-Metriken und das unternehmensweite Reporting zum Feature-Impact verantworten, gemeinsam mit unserem Data-Team

  • Vorhaben hinterfragen, die zu wenig Kunden- oder Geschäftswert schaffen, und Alternativen vorschlagen

  • User Research strukturiert in laufende Produktentwicklung einbinden, gemeinsam mit unserem Head of UX und dem UX-Team

  • Die Arbeitsweise unserer Product Manager weiterentwickeln, besonders Planung, Dokumentation und Reporting

  • Product Discovery und die frühe Teamstrukturierung neuer Produktinitiativen unterstützen, inklusive Abstimmung mit Engineering

  • Die unternehmensweite Kommunikation zur Produktstrategie aufbauen und Produktentscheidungen für alle nachvollziehbar dokumentieren


Das brauchst du

  • Erfahrung in einer Product-Leadership-Rolle, etwa als Head of Product, Product Lead oder Group Product Manager. Du hast über dein eigenes Produkt hinaus Verantwortung getragen, für mehrere Product Manager, Teams oder Produktbereiche, fachlich oder disziplinarisch

  • Erfahrung mit digitalen Produkten für Endkund:innen (B2C) in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen

  • Praxis mit OKRs und Roadmapping: Du hast OKR-Zyklen produktübergreifend koordiniert und Roadmaps für mehrere Teams gepflegt und kommuniziert

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Produktkennzahlen: Du hast Metriken definiert, Feature-Impact gemessen und Reporting für interne Stakeholder aufgebaut

  • Du überzeugst über Argumente und Zahlen, nicht über deine Position, und diskutierst auch mit erfahrenen Product Managern auf Augenhöhe

  • Die Bereitschaft, auch die Strukturarbeit selbst zu machen: Roadmaps pflegen, Updates einfordern, Reporting am Laufen halten

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens C1), weil du täglich in beiden Sprachen mit Product, Engineering und Leadership arbeitest

  • Du kannst die Tätigkeit dauerhaft aus Deutschland ausüben und verfügst zum Start über die hierfür erforderliche Arbeitserlaubnis

Das fällt positiv auf

  • Erfahrung als Head of Product. Voraussetzung ist sie nicht

  • Mehrjährige eigene Produktverantwortung als Product Manager, bevor du in eine Leadership-Rolle gewechselt bist

  • Erfahrung aus einer größeren Produktorganisation mit ausgereiften Arbeitsweisen

  • Erfahrung mit Roadmap- und Produktmanagement-Tools wie airfocus, Productboard, Jira Product Discovery oder Aha!

  • Erfahrung mit Produktanalyse-Tools wie PostHog, Amplitude oder Mixpanel

  • Produkterfahrung in E-Commerce, Marktplätzen oder Digital Health

  • Erfahrung in stark regulierten Produktumfeldern

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit UX-Teams und der Einbindung von User Research

Was wir bieten

  • Vollzeit und unbefristet, Start ab November 2026

  • 100% Remote: Du arbeitest aus Deutschland, Vollzeit, ohne Standortbindung

  • Eine Rolle, die mitwächst: Je tiefer dein Verständnis von Produkten, Markt und Team, desto mehr Entscheidungen übernimmst du

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem CPO und Zeit, alle Produktbereiche gründlich kennenzulernen

  • Sichtbare Wirkung: Du prägst, wie DrAnsay neue Produkte startet und woran das Product-Team arbeitet

  • Kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen, Low-Ego-Kultur und direktem Feedback

  • Ein Produkt mit realem Nutzen: Wir helfen täglich Menschen, Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher zu bekommen

Wie du dich bewirbst

Bewirb dich direkt über das Bewerbungsformular. Kein Anschreiben erforderlich, wir stellen dir einige kurze Fragen, die uns helfen zu verstehen, wie du arbeitest. Diese Antworten sind uns wichtiger als dein LinkedIn-Profil.

Du hörst von uns innerhalb von fünf Arbeitstagen.

DrAnsay ist ein chancengleicher Arbeitgeber. Bewerbungen werden auf Basis von Qualifikationen und Berufserfahrung bewertet. Alle Bewerbenden werden unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Herkunft, Behinderung, Religion oder anderen geschützten Merkmalen berücksichtigt. DrAnsay verarbeitet die mit deiner Bewerbung übermittelten personenbezogenen Daten zur Durchführung des Recruitingprozesses.

title: Head of Revenue Operations
descriptionHtml:
At Haut.AI, we make skin measurable.

We give beauty and wellness brands skin intelligence: AI that analyzes skin from a selfie, simulates how it may change over time, and guides every consumer to the right products. Our technology, including AI Skin Analysis, SkinGPT and Skin.Chat, powers personalized, science-backed experiences online and in store.

Today, more than 100 global beauty brands use our technology, including enterprise companies like Neutrogena, Beiersdorf, Ulta Beauty, Grupo Boticário and OLAY.


We are looking for a Head of Revenue to own Haut.AI’s full commercial engine: new business and customer success in one function and lead a team of six exceptional teammates. This is a player-coach role reporting directly to our CEO.

What you will do:

  • Own the revenue number. You own new business, renewals and expansion, plus the forecast and the commercial KPIs. You give leadership a clear view of where things really stand.

  • Lead and grow the team. Hire, coach and develop three Account Executives and Account Managers. Run weekly pipeline reviews and one-on-ones that focus on growth as much as on numbers.

  • Coach deal by deal and account by account. Join calls and demos, and give specific feedback while it is fresh. Set a clear standard for discovery, proposals, pricing and demo prep.

  • Carry the biggest deals yourself. Lead a small set of our largest, most strategic enterprise opportunities. Personally manage our most valuable client relationships at senior level.

  • Keep complex buying groups moving. Enterprise beauty deals involve brand and marketing, e-commerce, IT, data privacy, legal and procurement. You map the group, align it and keep it moving toward signature.

  • Build the system the team runs on. This means playbooks and objection handling, and a clean handoff from Account Executive to Account Manager once a deal closes. It also means CS operations from onboarding to renewal and expansion, and health scores that surface risk early.

  • Put AI to work across revenue. Find where AI cuts busywork and sharpens decisions: call prep, deal reviews, proposals, account health. Get hands-on with the tools; don’t stop at writing the plan.

  • Stay close to clients and bring back what you learn. Sit in on onboarding and business reviews. Turn client feedback into real input for Product and Marketing, and bring pricing and packaging signals back from the market.

What makes you a fit:

  • An experienced commercial leader. You have 8+ years in B2B SaaS commercial roles, including 3+ years leading a team. Ideally you have owned both new business and account management or customer success.

  • A player-coach. You have built and led a commercial team, and you still enjoy running a deal, reviewing the proposal and joining the call. Your team follows your example.

  • At home with enterprise. You have closed complex enterprise deals with many stakeholders and long sales cycles. You are comfortable in the room with senior leaders, with exceptional English and real executive presence.

  • A high-agency builder. You have built commercial processes, playbooks and KPI frameworks yourself, not just run someone else’s. You would rather put a working playbook in front of the team this week than perfect it for next quarter.

  • Evidence over opinion. You know HubSpot or a similar CRM inside out. You read call recordings, check CRM hygiene and turn activity data into clear next actions. You can explain a forecast in plain language.

  • You own outcomes, not activities, and you finish what you start, even with a lot on your plate in a small, fast-moving remote team.

  • AI-native in how you work. You use AI tools daily and have clear views on where they help a revenue team and where they do not.

  • Curious about skin science. You want to understand how our science turns into business value for beauty brands, and you learn fast.

Nice to have: experience selling to beauty, retail or e-commerce brands and retailers, selling API or platform products, or selling across Europe and North America.

Why Haut.AI

  • Competitive base salary plus a clear, transparent bonus structure

  • Fully remote, with flexibility across UK and EU time zones

  • A MacBook and the equipment you need for a productive remote setup

  • Paid time off: vacation, personal days, sick leave and Estonian public holidays

  • A rare chance to build the whole commercial function, with your fingerprints on everything

  • A collaborative, supportive team that ships

  • Direct impact on product and company growth

  • Room to grow at the intersection of AI, science and beauty

title: Influencer Marketing Manager (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.


Role Overview

As Influencer Marketing Manager, you will develop and run Hilo’s influencer marketing program across our key markets. You will find creators whose voices and audiences fit our brand, negotiate effective partnerships, and shape content that makes Hilo relevant and credible. The role combines brand and performance: you will use data to estimate the potential of each partnership before we invest, measure its results, and apply what you learn to future campaigns.

Work location: Our company operates on a remote-first model. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in Europe. Fluent English and German are a must. Occasional travel to our office in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, or to team events may be required.

Core Responsibilities

  • Identify, assess, and recruit creators across relevant platforms and markets.
  • Develop campaign concepts that balance Hilo’s brand goals with measurable commercial outcomes.
  • Forecast likely reach, engagement, traffic, and acquisition outcomes to guide creator selection and budgets.
  • Negotiate fees, deliverables, timelines, and content usage rights, including rights to use creator content in paid campaigns.
  • Manage partnerships end to end, from briefing and content review through publication and reporting.
  • Build and nurture long-term relationships with creators and brand ambassadors to drive sustained awareness, trust, and advocacy.
  • Collaborate with paid media teams to amplify high-performing creator content across paid social and other relevant channels.
  • Set clear goals, track brand and performance metrics, and compare results with initial estimates.
  • Use campaign data and audience insights to improve creator selection, content formats, and investment decisions.
  • Work across marketing and product to align campaigns with Hilo’s priorities and approved health claims.
  • Build repeatable processes that support growth across the US, UK, Germany, and other markets.

Requirements

Background & Experience

  • At least 2 years of hands-on influencer or creator marketing experience, including managing partnerships from start to finish.
  • A data-driven mindset: you can estimate campaign outcomes, assess performance, and turn findings into better decisions.
  • Strong creative judgment and an understanding of how creator content builds both brand trust and customer demand.
  • Strong negotiation skills and confidence working with creators and their representatives.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and attention to detail.
  • Fluency in English; German is a plus.
  • Experience in health tech, wellness, medical devices, or another category where trust and accurate claims matter is welcome.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:

Move the Needle — You focus on what truly drives impact for our customers and company. You use data and clarity to guide your decisions and prioritize what matters most. You push boundaries with bold, thoughtful innovation and hold yourself accountable for results.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with high quality. You treat mistakes as learning opportunities, experiment thoughtfully and iterate quickly. You take ownership, act hands-on and always look for smarter, faster ways to get things done, including leveraging AI and new tools.

Team First — You put the team above individual interests, building trust through openness and respect. You encourage healthy debate, challenge directly while caring personally and stand behind team decisions. You act as an owner, stepping in when needed and doing what’s necessary for the team’s success.

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies and you can be part of this exciting story.
  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate and talented team.
  • Competitive compensation, equity program and other benefits (depending on location).

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

title: Infrastructure / Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:

Type: Full-time, remote

About Neuphonic

Neuphonic is building the next generation of voice AI, making natural, real-time speech accessible across devices, languages, and applications.

Our technology enables ultra-low-latency text-to-speech, voice cloning, and multilingual speech generation. We're pushing the boundaries of what's possible with speech models, from high-performance cloud inference to running AI directly on everyday devices without expensive GPUs or an internet connection.

We're a small, ambitious team of researchers and engineers building technology used by developers and businesses around the world. Our open-source releases have reached millions of downloads, and we're growing quickly.

Why we're hiring

As our customer base grows, we need to scale our production infrastructure while maintaining the performance, reliability, and low latency that our products depend on.

We're looking for an Infrastructure / Platform Engineer to take ownership of our cloud infrastructure and inference systems. You'll work closely with our engineering and ML teams to build scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient systems.

A key part of this role is extending our production support coverage beyond UK working hours. We're hiring in Australia or New Zealand to help us work towards 24/7 support for our production customers, so we're looking for someone comfortable taking ownership of live systems, responding to incidents, and making independent technical decisions.

Importantly, this isn't just about keeping our systems running. We want someone who will actively look for ways to improve how we build, deploy, and serve our models, continually experimenting, optimising, and evolving our infrastructure as we scale.

What you'll own

  • Cloud infrastructure: Build, manage, and scale our production infrastructure across GCP and GPU cloud providers using Kubernetes, Docker, and Terraform.

  • Inference optimisation: Continuously improve inference performance, latency, throughput, GPU utilisation, and infrastructure costs through profiling, experimentation, and iteration, rather than simply maintaining the status quo.

  • Platform evolution: Identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in how we build, deploy, and serve models, and take ownership of implementing improvements.

  • Production reliability: Monitor critical systems, respond to incidents, and help ensure reliable service for our customers outside UK working hours.

  • Infrastructure architecture: Make autonomous technical decisions that balance scalability, reliability, performance, and cost.

  • CI/CD and automation: Improve deployment pipelines, infrastructure automation, monitoring, and observability.

  • Security and enterprise readiness: Support secure infrastructure practices and enterprise deployment requirements.

What we're looking for

  • Strong experience building and operating production cloud infrastructure at scale, ideally supporting applications with significant user traffic.

  • Hands-on experience with GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, and Python.

  • Experience with CI/CD, monitoring, observability, and production incident response.

  • A strong understanding of infrastructure performance, scalability, and cost optimisation.

  • Experience participating in on-call rotations or taking responsibility for production incidents.

  • A proactive approach to engineering, with experience identifying bottlenecks, experimenting with improvements, and optimising production systems.

  • Comfortable working autonomously, making architectural decisions, and taking ownership of critical systems.

  • Based in Australia or New Zealand and comfortable providing production support during agreed hours that complement our UK and India engineering teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience with AI/ML inference, GPU infrastructure, or vLLM.

  • Experience hosting audio, speech, or real-time AI applications.

  • Experience with C++.

  • Familiarity with SOC 2, ISO 27001, or other security compliance frameworks.

  • Experience with private cloud or on-premise enterprise deployments.

Who you'll work with

You'll work directly with our engineering and ML teams, helping shape the infrastructure behind Neuphonic's production models and services.

We're a small team, so you'll have real ownership and the freedom to make meaningful technical decisions. We value people who take initiative, solve problems independently, and enjoy building systems that work reliably in the real world.

You'll collaborate closely with our UK and India teams, with clear handovers between time zones to help ensure our production customers are supported around the clock.

The role combines technical leadership with hands-on engineering, helping clients modernise their data estates while ensuring solutions are secure, reliable and scalable.

Working across multiple projects, you will lead the development of batch and real-time data pipelines, support architectural decision-making, and help establish engineering best practices across delivery teams.

Strong experience with real-time streaming technologies is essential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development and deployment of secure, scalable data pipelines and data platform components.

Essential Skills & Experience

Real-Time Streaming & Data Engineering

Data Engineering & Databases

Cloud & Software Engineering

  • Experience working within Agile delivery environments.
  • Strong understanding of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and automated testing practices.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and engineering automation.
  • Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code principles.
  • Experience using version control systems such as Git.

Regulated Environments

  • Experience delivering technology solutions within UK Public Sector, Utilities, Energy, Water, Financial Services or other highly regulated industries.
  • Understanding of security, governance and compliance considerations within regulated environments.

Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Terraform.
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Knowledge of Ansible and Packer.
  • Linux and Windows administration experience.
  • Experience supporting AI, machine learning or advanced analytics platforms.
  • Experience working on programmes requiring UK Government security clearance.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong technical leadership and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working in complex, regulated environments.
  • A collaborative approach and willingness to support and mentor others.
  • A focus on delivering practical solutions that create value for clients.
  • A passion for building reliable, scalable and secure data platforms.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Mathematics or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

At Aker we work as a team; we are collaborative, hardworking, open, and delivery obsessed. There is no blame culture here: try things, and take responsibility for the outcomes. You are always part of the wider Aker. We help our colleagues and take pride in successfully achieving difficult tasks. We run towards problems and help to solve them. Communicate always, do so accurately and in a timely fashion.

In return, we offer a competitive salary, 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, company paid medical insurance and life assurance, pension scheme, annual training allowance, wellbeing allowance, virtual GP, Employee Assistance plan and more.

Equal Opportunities

Aker Systems fosters a diverse environment that encourages openness in its communications and is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people regardless of race, religion, gender or sexual orientation, age, marital status, national origin, citizenship status, disability, veteran status or other personal characteristics. We embrace differences of opinion and diversity because they help challenge us and find new groundbreaking technical solutions.

title: Lead Engineer, Air
descriptionHtml:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the role

UFORCE is looking for a Lead Engineer, Air to take hands-on technical ownership of our first Western-facing air product, turning operational lessons from Ukraine into a reliable, manufacturable system that customers can test, deploy and reorder.

Your initial focus will be one product. You’ll bring engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and field teams together around a controlled design and a clear delivery plan, resolving the reliability and integration challenges that stand between today’s product and repeatable production.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a management-only position. You’ll stay close to the hardware, own system-level engineering decisions and ensure that changes are proven through testing and reflected in what we build.

As our air portfolio expands, there is potential to grow into broader technical leadership, including Chief Engineer, Air. Progression will depend on business need and demonstrated performance, rather than a fixed promotion timetable.

What you’ll do

  • Establish product ownership and a delivery plan. In your first 30 days, assess the current design, customer requirements and test evidence with engineering, manufacturing and field teams. Identify the highest-priority risks and agree a 90-day plan with clear owners, milestones and acceptance criteria.

  • Create a controlled technical baseline. By day 60, establish practical requirements, configuration records, bills of materials, interface definitions and change control so teams know what has been approved, built, tested and deployed.

  • Lead end-to-end systems integration. Own technical trade-offs across airframe, propulsion, power, avionics, flight control, communications, navigation, payload interfaces and ground systems, drawing on specialist expertise where needed.

  • Improve reliability and demonstrate performance. During the initial three to five months, establish a failure-reporting and corrective-action process, address priority failure modes and verify improvements through repeatable ground and flight testing against agreed requirements.

  • Prepare the product for repeatable production. Partner with manufacturing and supply chain on design for manufacture, component qualification, approved substitutions and supplier risks. Release a production package covering drawings, BOM, assembly requirements, inspection and acceptance tests, supported by a costed BOM and cost-reduction priorities.

  • Enable credible customer trials and delivery. Define approved configurations, test plans and readiness criteria. Validate capability claims, document operating limits and provide clear engineering input on delivery feasibility, support needs and technical risks.

  • Connect operational experience to product development. Work closely with Ukrainian product experts and international teams to preserve field knowledge, manage configuration differences and translate operator and customer feedback into prioritised product changes.

  • Build a foundation for portfolio growth. Identify reusable architecture, components and engineering practices, recommend capability and resource needs, and review the scope for broader ownership with leadership as the portfolio develops.

Required Skill

  • Hands-on UAS engineering ownership: Experience leading delivery of a complete air vehicle or substantial integrated UAS product, with clear evidence of your own technical decisions and their impact on flight performance.

  • Systems integration judgement: The ability to reason across mechanical, electrical, flight-control, communications, navigation and software interfaces, and recognise when specialist depth is needed.

  • Prototype-to-production experience: Meaningful involvement in taking an aerial product into repeatable production, including design for manufacture, configuration control and production testing.

  • Reliability and test discipline: A track record of diagnosing flight or field failures, identifying root causes and proving corrective actions through repeatable testing.

  • Cross-functional technical leadership: The ability to set priorities, coordinate engineers and specialist partners, and drive delivery through influence as well as formal authority.

  • Cost and component judgement: Practical understanding of how design decisions affect availability, qualification, unit cost, manufacturing quality and applicable sourcing requirements.

  • Operational awareness: Understanding of how GNSS denial, jamming, communications resilience and operator feedback influence UAS design and testing.

  • Startup execution: Comfort working close to hardware, making decisions with incomplete information and balancing delivery speed with appropriate engineering control.

  • Clear communication and ownership: The ability to distinguish demonstrated capability from development goals, explain limitations and escalate technical, safety or resource risks early.

  • Willingness to travel regularly to engineering teams, manufacturing sites, test ranges and customers.

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience working with Ukrainian UAS teams, products or operators.

  • Experience adapting products for Western defence customers.

  • Familiarity with applicable NDAA, Blue UAS and export-control requirements.

  • Experience supporting customer trials, military qualification or airworthiness activity.

  • Experience with payload integration or payload-release systems.

  • Experience coordinating engineering and manufacturing across countries.

  • Evidence of growing from hands-on product ownership into broader technical leadership.

The nature of combat has changed.

Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability.

And UFORCE is ready.

Are You?

title: Lead Product Designer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

Role overview

UX is our number one priority, and we need a design leader who consistently turns design into business outcomes. As Lead Product Designer, you set the quality bar for our app, own our design system and drive our biggest product bets from first idea to shipped result. You are hands-on: you prototype, you craft, you ship.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. You will be the design partner who keeps the whole product consistent and high quality, together with our Lead UX Writer and a Senior Product Designer.

You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical, high-visibility role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.

Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.

Core responsibilities

Direction & Outcomes

  • Set the design direction and quality bar across the app, from new features to health insights and early vision work.
  • Define the success measures for your work and own the business results.

Design System & Prototyping

  • Own our design system, built to work with AI tools, and keep it consistent through tokens and clear decisions.
  • Show instead of tell, with high-fidelity prototypes and motion built with AI tools and our design system.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Raise the bar for the team. Support, coach and unblock other designers, and give clear feedback.
  • Challenge product and engineering with evidence, persuade stakeholders and make clear, documented decisions.
  • Work daily with product managers and design engineers.

Requirements

Background & Experience

Essential

  • Proven design leadership, with a track record of consistently delivering strong business outcomes.
  • 2 to 3 shipped case studies that demonstrate high impact: the problem, your hypothesis, your decisions, the measured result.
  • Outstanding visual design craft: hierarchy, typography, motion and attention to detail.
  • High-fidelity prototypes and videos of your work, ideally built with AI tools such as Claude or Lovable.
  • Daily, practical use of AI tools and experience with AI-ready design systems.
  • Fluent Figma, including components, variables and tokens.
  • Strong product thinking: you work with data, hypotheses and measurements.
  • Ideally health, consumer, behavior change or regulated products.
  • A public portfolio website (required with your application).

Nice to Have

  • Mobile apps, connected devices, simple prototypes in code.

How you work

  • AI first — You are already playing with AI tools and you are excited about what they make possible.
  • Builder — You ship, and you can spin up something from nothing.
  • Bias for action — You are autonomous and self-sufficient. You don't wait for a brief and you don't need chasing.
  • Disciplined — Tokens, not screenshots. Decision logs, not memories.
  • Curious — You want to know why, not just what. You can explain who made each decision and how.
  • Clear under pressure — Medical regulation and different market rules are design problems, not excuses.

This isn't for you if

  • You need all requirements, research and data before you start.
  • You measure screens shipped, not outcomes moved.
  • You'd rather list risks than own one.

How we hire

  1. Recruiter screen (30 min)
  2. Portfolio interview with the Head of Design (60 min): visual craft, prototyping, AI fluency
  3. Product thinking and interaction design deep dive
  4. Cross-functional conversation with design engineers and product
  5. Final conversation with senior leadership (finalists)

What success looks like

  • You take something off our plate and it gets done.
  • If it won't happen, you tell us first.
  • You bring the problem, the root cause and options.
  • You flag risk to dates early, while we can still change it.
  • The product feels consistent, fast and high quality, and design outcomes show up in the numbers.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:

Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You understand that a great product experience is fundamental to good decision-making and growth, and you take accountability for the quality and outcomes of your work, from first idea through to shipped result.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with craft. You continuously improve the way Design operates, experiment with better tools and processes, including AI, and solve root causes rather than accepting repetitive manual work.

Team First — You collaborate effectively with colleagues, engineers, product managers and stakeholders across countries and functions. You build trust by being reliable, clear and constructive, while maintaining high standards for quality and consistency.

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story.
  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team.
  • Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location).

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

descriptionHtml:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As the Manager, Professional Services Engineers, you will manage a team that works directly with customers to deliver installation, migration, training, and advisory services across the full GitLab platform. In this role, you will be accountable for the performance, development, and day-to-day management of a team of Professional Services Engineers based across Europe, helping them deliver high-quality outcomes in a remote, asynchronous environment.

You will partner closely with Technical Architects and Professional Services management to enable consistent delivery across implementation projects, migrations, and statement of work engagements. This is a people-first role with meaningful technical depth. You will step in hands-on with your team when needed while also building the operating rhythm, team culture, and delivery approach that help the broader practice scale. You will also work closely with cross-functional partners to improve utilization, customer satisfaction, and delivery execution.

In your first year, you will help strengthen team capability, improve delivery consistency, and create the conditions for a high-performing services team across the region. This is an opportunity to manage a team doing technically complex, customer-facing work that directly helps customers realize value from GitLab.

Some examples of our projects:

  • Leading a team of Professional Services Engineers through end-to-end GitLab implementation and migration engagements for enterprise customers across Europe
  • Partnering with Sales, Customer Success, and Technical Architects to support statement of work scoping and align the right technical resources to customer needs

What you’ll do

  • Lead and manage a team of Professional Services Engineers, supporting their growth, performance, and day-to-day delivery across customer engagements.
  • Develop team members through regular 1:1s, coaching, feedback, and career conversations that help them grow their technical and consulting skills.
  • Own delivery outcomes across your team’s portfolio, including implementations, migrations, advisory services, and statement of work engagements.
  • Monitor project health, identify delivery risks early, and step in directly or escalate when needed to keep customer work on track.
  • Partner with Technical Architects, Engagement Managers, Sales, and Customer Success to plan, scope, resource, and support successful services engagements.
  • Track team utilization, customer satisfaction, and escalation trends, and use those insights to improve team performance and operational effectiveness.
  • Act as a senior escalation point for complex customer situations, helping guide resolution while maintaining a high bar for service quality.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of Professional Services processes, tooling, knowledge sharing, and delivery standards across the broader organization.

What you’ll bring

  • Significant experience leading and developing high-performing technical teams in a customer-facing environment.
  • A strong technical foundation in software delivery, DevSecOps, platform engineering, or a related area, with the ability to engage credibly in technical discussions.
  • Experience managing or supporting professional services, implementation delivery, migration programs, or technical consulting engagements for enterprise customers.

About the Role 

Veeam is seeking a technically strong, customer-focused Strategic Partner Solutions Architect – Securiti.ai to accelerate Securiti.ai business through the established Veeam partner ecosystem. This individual will serve as the trusted technical advisor to Veeam partners, working closely with Veeam’s Channel Managers, Strategic Partner Specialists and Systems Engineers to design, demonstrate and validate Securiti.ai solutions for partners and their customers. This position adds deep technical expertise to the partner motion while preserving the Channel Manager’s ownership of the overall partner relationship. 

The Solutions Architect will bring hands-on expertise in Data Security, DSPM, AI Security, AI Governance, Privacy and GRC. Together with Veeam channel and partner teams, this individual will build partner technical capability, lead solution design and proofs of value, and help convert partner-led opportunities into measurable Securiti.ai pipeline and revenue. 

 Success requires technical depth, strong collaboration and the ability to translate complex data security and AI governance requirements into clear, deployable solutions. The ideal candidate is a credible pre-sales architect who excels in an overlay model — someone who strengthens existing Veeam partner relationships while contributing the architecture, demonstrations and enablement needed to build a successful Securiti.ai practice. This person can earn the confidence of partner engineers and customer security leaders alike and turn technical engagement into repeatable, partner-delivered outcomes. 

 What You’ll Do 

 Veeam Channel and Technical Alignment 

Operate as the technical overlay within the Veeam channel organization: 

  • Partner with Veeam Channel Managers, Strategic Partner Specialists and Systems Engineers to support each assigned partner with a consistent technical engagement cadence. 
  • Own the Securiti.ai technical strategy, solution architecture and pre-sales motion within each partner relationship, while the Veeam Channel Manager retains ownership of the overall relationship. 
  • Jointly engage partner technical leaders with Veeam teams to align on priority use cases, solution roadmaps and technical investments. 
  • Equip Veeam Systems Engineers and Channel Managers with the technical messaging, demo assets and training needed to introduce Securiti.ai into partner and customer conversations. 
  • Set clear rules of engagement for technical support, opportunity handoffs and escalations so partners experience Veeam and Securiti.ai as one team. 
  • Serve as the bridge between partners and Veeam and Securiti.ai product management, engineering, support and services teams, relaying field feedback and feature requirements. 

 Partner Technical Planning 

  • Develop technical enablement and certification plans for assigned partners alongside their Veeam Channel Managers and Partner Specialists, setting goals for certified engineers, demo capability, proofs of value and delivery readiness. 
  • Assess partner technical maturity, including security expertise, cloud and platform skills, services capacity and integration capabilities. 
  • Incorporate Securiti.ai technical priorities into existing Veeam partner plans and quarterly business reviews. 
  • Identify the lab, demo, training and technical resources each partner requires and review readiness on a regular cadence with Veeam and partner stakeholders. 

 Solution Architecture and Practice Enablement 

  • Recruit, train and certify partner solution engineers, architects and services teams on Securiti.ai. 
  • Lead the technical build-out of partner Data Security, DSPM and AI Governance practices, defining reference architectures, delivery methodologies, skills and certification paths. 
  • Deliver technical training, workshops and hands-on labs that enable partner and Veeam teams to demonstrate and position Securiti.ai Data Security, DSPM, AI Security, AI Governance, Privacy and GRC capabilities. 
  • Help partners design repeatable technical assessments, workshops, managed services and implementation offerings. 
  • Architect joint solutions that integrate Securiti.ai with the partner’s own services and their existing Veeam portfolio, creating differentiated, repeatable solutions for their customers. 
  • Create and maintain technical assets, including demo environments, reference architectures, solution briefs, discovery guides and competitive technical positioning. 

 Pre-Sales and Opportunity Support 

  • Lead technical discovery, solution design, demonstrations and proofs of value with partners for priority customer opportunities. 
  • Align Veeam, Securiti.ai and partner technical teams around priority customers, supporting opportunities from technical qualification through close. 
  • Respond to technical requirements, RFPs and security questionnaires, and address architecture, integration and compliance questions from customer stakeholders. 
  • Support a smooth transition from sale to implementation, ensuring partner delivery teams are prepared for successful deployment and adoption. 

 Measures of Success 

  • Securiti.ai pipeline and revenue influenced through partner technical engagement. 
  • Number of partner engineers trained and certified on Securiti.ai and partners able to independently demonstrate, sell and deliver solutions. 
  • Technical win rate and conversion of proofs of value into closed business. 
  • Number of joint solutions, reference architectures and partner-led assessments and services brought to market. 
  • Customer deployment success, partner satisfaction and strength of alignment with Veeam channel and technical teams. 

What You’ll Bring 

  •  7+ years of experience in pre-sales engineering, solutions architecture, sales engineering or technical consulting for enterprise technology. 
  • Demonstrated success in a channel-facing, partner technical or overlay pre-sales role. 
  • Proven ability to collaborate with existing account and relationship owners while leading the technical sale for a specialized solution portfolio. 
  • Experience enabling and supporting technical teams at VARs, solution providers, MSPs, integrators, or advisory partners. 
  • Strong ability to lead technical discovery, solution design, product demonstrations and proofs of value. 
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity, data security, data governance, privacy or AI security. 
  • Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), SaaS applications, data platforms and identity and access management. 
  • Ability to translate technical capabilities into business outcomes, architectures and use cases that both sales and technical audiences can act on. 
  • Ability to influence internal and external stakeholders without relying on direct authority. 
  • Strong communication, presentation, whiteboarding and technical writing skills. 
  • Ability to manage multiple partner and customer engagements while maintaining accountability for measurable results. 
  • Willingness to travel for partner meetings, enablement sessions, customer engagements and industry events. 

 Bonus Skills 

  • Hands-on experience with Securiti.ai or comparable DSPM, data discovery and classification, AI governance, privacy management, or GRC platforms. 
  • Experience designing partner-led assessments, managed services, workshops, or professional services offerings. 
  • Familiarity with privacy and AI regulations and frameworks such as GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, the EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF. 
  • Relevant security, privacy, or cloud certifications (for example CIPP, CISSP, CCSP, or an AWS, Azure or GCP architect or security credential). 

What You'll Get

Veeam, following its acquisition of Securiti AI - the leader in AI-powered data security posture management (DSPM) - is seeking Business Development Representatives to drive growth in this innovative business. 

You will generate new demand and build qualified pipeline, working both self-generated outbound and inbound demand from marketing. You will run discovery conversations that produce genuinely qualified opportunities, and stay with them until they are established with a Sales Specialist.
