title: Senior Full Stack Developer - Deepdesk
descriptionHtml:
About Deepdesk

Deepdesk, part of AnywhereNow, powers AI Assistants and Virtual Agents for enterprise contact centres, helping brands such as Achmea, Vodafone and DHL boost productivity today while scaling for the future of customer experience. As part of AnywhereNow, a global leader in customer experience technology with 220 colleagues worldwide, we combine the agility of a scale-up with the strength of an established enterprise provider.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced developer to join our small engineering team. The centre of the role is backend development in Python or Go and cloud infrastructure, with some front-end work alongside.

At Deepdesk, we are building “Augmented Intelligence” for the enterprise. Think Gmail Smart Compose for contact centres. We use machine learning to provide agents with real-time recommendations and autocomplete suggestions, supporting them in efficiently assisting customers. Alongside recommendations, we offer fully virtual assistants that can take care of repetitive tasks.

You will work on the services behind this: the Python and Go services and APIs, the data stores and the cloud infrastructure that run our product for enterprise customers, including the services that serve our recommendation models. You will also pick up front-end work where it helps the product, for example in our admin interface and widgets.

We are also building voice agents: AI that talks with customers in real time. Speech is turned into text, a language model works out the answer, and the answer is spoken back, all within a fraction of a second. You will help build and run the services behind this, in Python and Go.

We have a start-up culture, but your code is directly used and proven at scale. Our technology is cutting-edge and continually evolving.


What You’ll Be Doing

• Build and maintain backend services and APIs in Python and Go, with background processing for heavy work.

• Keep our databases fast and reliable.

• Run and improve our infrastructure on Google Cloud: Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines.

• Build and run the real-time voice agent services: speech to text, language model and text to speech, with low latency, in Python and Go.

• Help deploy and run the machine learning services behind our recommendations. Machine learning experience is not required.

• Design and provide complete and accurate end-to-end metrics.

• Write and review well-tested, clean and maintainable code.

• Follow software engineering best practices while staying pragmatic and avoiding over-engineering.

• Contribute to front-end features in TypeScript and React when needed.

Our Stack

• Backend: Python (Django REST framework, FastAPI and Celery) and Go.

• Voice: Go for our real-time voice AI service, with WebSockets, speech to text, language models, text to speech and the OpenAI Realtime API.

• Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse and Elasticsearch.

• Cloud: Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Flux and Cloud Build.

• Front end: TypeScript and React.

• Quality: automated tests (pytest, and BDD integration tests written in Go), code review on every change, and automation to keep our code and delivery practices in shape.

What We’re Looking For

• Strong professional experience building backend services in Python or Go. In Python, Django or FastAPI is a plus.

• Solid knowledge of relational databases, in particular PostgreSQL.

• Hands-on experience with containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD. Google Cloud is a plus.

• Working knowledge of TypeScript and React, enough to build and fix front-end features. It does not need to be your strength.

• A disciplined approach to testing, code review, maintainability and delivery.

• Comfort working with autonomy and taking full ownership in a fast-moving environment.

• Interest in voice and real-time systems, and willingness to also work in the other language. Our voice AI service and our integration tests are written in Go, and most of the backend is in Python.

• A plus: experience with Celery, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, serving machine learning models, or real-time audio.

Why Join Us?

• Based in the Netherlands, with flexibility over how you organise your time. [HR: confirm office and hybrid details]

• A small team working with major enterprise clients.

• Start-up culture combined with enterprise demands and production scale.

• Full autonomy and full ownership of your work.

• High standards, trust and plenty of humour.

• The opportunity to shape real-time AI experiences used in enterprise contact centres.

• Full-time (40 hours), permanent contract.

Information Security Responsibilities

All employees are responsible for supporting and maintaining the organisation’s information security standards. This includes:

• Adhering to all applicable information security policies, procedures and guidelines at all times.

• Protecting company, customer and partner data from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration or loss.

• Using company systems, devices and networks in a secure and compliant manner.

• Promptly reporting any suspected or actual security incidents, breaches or vulnerabilities to the appropriate team.

• Completing mandatory information security and data protection training as required.

• Ensuring that confidential information is handled and stored securely in line with company policies and legal requirements.

Failure to comply with information security responsibilities may result in disciplinary action.

title: (Senior) Full Stack Engineer (m/f/x) - Based in Germany
descriptionHtml:
Cara Care, a digital health company backed by Bayer AG, is on a mission to improve people’s digestive health through technology. As we expand our product portfolio and modernize our platform, we’re looking for a versatile, pragmatic, and forward-thinking (Senior) Full-Stack Engineer (m/f/x) to help shape the future of digital therapeutics.

Your Role

You’ll join a cross-functional product team with high ownership, lean processes, and a clear focus: deliver real impact to patients. We’re looking for someone who thrives on solving real-world problems with code, is technology-open, and knows when to build fast and when to build right. Your main focus will be building and improving our backend services, while also contributing to our React Native apps. You’ll also help us use AI tools and coding agents thoughtfully in day-to-day engineering, turning emerging capabilities into reliable workflows that improve how we design, build, test, and operate patient-facing products.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate reliable backend services and APIs, primarily using Python, Django, and PostgreSQL, and contribute targeted changes to our React Native applications with TypeScript.
  • Use AI coding agents to implement features, refactor code, and generate tests. Define clear tasks and constraints, provide relevant context, Provide clear context and constraints, and validate changes through code review, automated tests, and application-level checks.
  • Take an end-to-end view of features: understand how mobile clients, APIs, data models, and infrastructure interact, and make pragmatic technical decisions across these boundaries.
  • Own backend delivery from architecture and implementation to automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and iteration, and continuously improve our CI/CD pipelines.
  • Improve the performance and reliability of our backend services, APIs, and databases.
  • Connect AI-assisted development to engineering and design tools via MCP, for example to automate repetitive coding tasks or check frontend changes against Figma designs. Keep patient data, credentials, and other sensitive information out of unapproved tools and workflows.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Medical to explore, define, and deliver patient-centric features across our platform, supporting regulated digital health products for IBS, GERD, and upcoming indications.
  • Uphold technical excellence in architecture, code quality, and security, including applicable requirements under IEC 62304, BSI TR-03161, and the MDR.
  • Mentor other developers and help raise the technical bar across the team.

Requirements

Your Profile

Must haves

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong backend focus and an understanding of how complete applications work from user interface to infrastructure.
  • Strong backend development skills in an established language such as Python, TypeScript, Java, or PHP. Our current stack includes Python, Django, and PostgreSQL.
  • Working knowledge of React Native and TypeScript, with the ability to implement and test changes in an existing mobile application.
  • Solid understanding of relational databases, API design, distributed systems and services.
  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests for backend services and APIs, including unit and integration tests.
  • Solid understanding of backend security and privacy, including authentication, authorization, secrets management, and secure handling of personal and patient data.
  • Strong practical knowledge of containers, Kubernetes, and cloud-native architecture, with experience using GCP or another major cloud provider such as AWS or Azure.
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding agents to implement features, refactor code, and write automated tests, including connecting agents to engineering tools via MCP. You can explain how you scoped the work, verified the results, and handled tool permissions and sensitive data.
  • A pragmatic product mindset: you collaborate effectively with non-technical stakeholders, understand the impact of technical decisions on patients and UX, and continuously improve both product and platform.

Nice-to-have

  • Strong Linux administration skills, including setting up, operating, and securing self-managed cloud instances; familiarity with monitoring and observability concepts.
  • Experience with Prometheus, Loki, and Grafana; GitOps using ArgoCD or FluxCD; or configuration management using Ansible or similar tools.
  • Networking knowledge and experience with mobile CI/CD, release automation, or application monitoring tools such as Sentry.
  • Experience in regulated industries, healthcare, or other security-conscious environments.


💡Please note: Cara Care is a remote-first company with a fully distributed team. All team members are based in Germany so candidates must reside in Germany to join us.

Benefits

💸 Fair compensation: We offer fair pay, regular salary reviews, and the equipment you need to do your best work.

🫶 Great team spirit: Join a vibrant, interdisciplinary team and enjoy a friendly, supportive working atmosphere, with regular in-person team events.

👨‍💻 Remote-first working: Prefer working from home? No problem. Want to join us at our Berlin office? That works too. Our remote-first approach gives you the flexibility to work where it suits you best.

🏝️ 30 days off per year: Rest matters. You’ll get 26 vacation days plus 4 additional company-wide mental health days each year to take a breather and recharge.

🦉 Flexible working hours: Whether you’re an early bird or prefer a later start, you can shape your working day around what works for you.

🏋️ Urban Sports Club (USC): Enjoy access to a wide range of sports, fitness, and wellness activities at discounted rates.

🧠 OpenUp: Access a variety of resources and services to support your mental health and personal wellbeing.

🛍️ Corporate Benefits: Get attractive discounts and exclusive offers from a wide range of well-known brands and providers.

🚀 Make a real impact: Be involved, contribute your ideas, and help shape what comes next. Your voice matters, and you can make a real difference.

About Cara Care

Cara Care is a digital health company on a mission to improve the lives of people with digestive health conditions through holistic, science-based digital therapies.

Our established IBS therapy, Cara Care für Reizdarm, provides personalised content, practical exercises, and symptom tracking to help people better understand and manage their condition. It is listed in the German Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices’ (BfArM) directory of digital health applications (DiGA) and is covered by statutory health insurance in Germany.

We are expanding our product portfolio and evolving our technology platform to bring digital therapies to more people across a broader range of conditions.

Backed by Bayer

We’re proud to share that Cara Care has recently joined the Bayer Group, a move that strengthens our mission and enables us to scale our impact even further. With Bayer’s global healthcare expertise and our innovative digital approach, we’re poised to redefine care for digestive health.

What It’s Like to Work With Us

At Cara Care, you’ll be part of an interdisciplinary team of doctors, designers, engineers, and creatives who are deeply passionate about improving lives. We’re inspired by our patients and driven by real-world impact. We move fast, collaborate closely, and never lose sight of the importance of well-being—both for our users and ourselves.

Diversity Matters to Us

We believe that diverse teams build better products. That’s why we’re committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone—regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or disability.

We know that applying for a new job is a big step, and we genuinely appreciate your time and effort. We’re excited to get to know you!

title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager (App Installs)
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, our annual revenue is in the hundreds of millions USD and millions use our browser on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place.

 

Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role

Working on the Marketing & Communications Functional Team, you'll manage paid media channels to drive profitable acquisition of new app users, aim to help millions of people take back control of their personal information, and work on related projects. Recent projects include:

  • Scaling and optimizing app acquisition campaigns in Google, Microsoft and Apple ad platforms

  • Launching new ad channel tests and measuring incremental lift

  • Executing in-market tests for new creative and messaging to improve app install conversion

As a Senior Growth Marketing Manager, you'll manage high priority marketing campaigns, including planning, hands-on execution, testing, optimization, and analysis to optimize spend and drive profitable user growth. You'll deliver results from new channel testing, app acquisition, subscriber growth, paid advertising, and creative testing. Responsibilities may also include owning a portfolio of existing channels (Google ads, paid social, app install campaigns) with the goal of efficiently scaling profitable advertising. The right person is excited to prove that paid marketing growth and privacy-respecting advertising practices aren’t at odds — they’re our edge. You know how to use aggregate measurement, experimentation, and strong judgment rather than user-level targeting and tracking.

 

About You

  • 7+ years of experience in digital advertising roles with 2+ years of experience in marketing consumer apps preferred.

  • Hands-on expertise standing up and managing paid digital advertising programs (Google Ads, Apple Ads, etc.) as well as familiarity with non-digital paid media management (CTV, TV, etc.).

  • Demonstrated track record of profitably scaling app install growth programs while improving efficiency and unit economics as volume materially scales.

  • Ability to execute highly complex and ambiguous projects, working across business strategy and marketing tactics.

  • Experience designing and running incrementality tests (geo holdouts, lift studies, PSA/ghost ads) to validate true channel impact and guide investment decisions.

  • Advanced analytical abilities, including modeling app economics (payback, LTV), data analysis, scenario planning, and projecting campaign outcomes across spend and volume curves.

  • Track record of running creative testing as an always on pipeline, consistently shipping new concepts to prevent performance decay and unlock incremental scale.

  • Passion for ideating and problem solving to deliver creative solutions for profitable user growth.

  • Excellent communication skills — you can clearly articulate recommendations and rationale, whether verbal or written.

Compensation

Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation, plus stock options:

  • United States: $190,500 USD

  • United Kingdom: £134,600 GBP

  • Canada: CA$253,500 CAD

  • All other regions*: €157,350 EUR

*Team members outside the US, UK and Canada are currently paid $178,500 USD. Pay converts to the EUR amount above on January 1, 2027 for Spanish team members, and approximately February 1, 2027 in all other regions.

 

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

 

Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

 

Hiring Process

Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire.

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

 

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to  

Please note that

  • You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing

  • Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.

  • While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.

  • A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.

  • By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.

 

Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process

As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.

 

Key Principles:

  • Data Privacy: All information provided in your application will be handled in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Policy. We ensure that your personal information is protected and used solely for recruitment purposes.

descriptionHtml:
Our vision
We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones). We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

About us
Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants
💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.
🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe
🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings
🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 7000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

🚀Job description

To support our scale, we are looking for an experienced HR Business Partner to join the People team. Reporting into our Lead HRBP, you will contribute at both hands-on and strategic levels, as a trusted partner to our teams and as a program manager to cultivate and develop a best-in-class employee experience.You act as a partner to our People team. You have strong decision-making skills with a thorough understanding of talent management and also organizational design within technology companies, to support our teams’ rapid growth. The HRBP will be responsible for supporting and executing all the projects and functions that will be designed by the HR Development Manager.

Your role will comprise of

HR Business Partnering
- You set up rituals with managers and team members to build relationships of trust and become the preferred contact for the teams.
- With a deep understanding of the population you support, you are the privileged HR point of contact to accompany teams at all steps of the employee life cycle (on-boarding, 3-month and 6-month feedback, performance assessment, compensation review, internal transfer, off-boarding…).
- You advise our people managers on organization design, individual performance review, promotions, compensation.
- You also advise our employees on learning & development opportunities, career pathing and evolution.
- You are the internal communication relay of your perimeter, you ensure a good respect of the rules in force in the company, and you contribute to the animation of new HR processes and of the company's culture in order to maximize retention.

Talent development
- You participate and establish projects related to the People team roadmap
- You will build and run rigorous data analysis and reporting solutions based on business needs, to inform on program or process impact measurements

The profile we are looking for :
- You have a strong experience in a similar position ; having worked in a fast-growing environment is a strong plus
- You have a well-rounded experience on a variety of HR-related topics: onboarding, learning & development, legal, compensation & benefits.
- You excel at creating trust and developing strong working relationships at all levels of an organization
- You demonstrate excellent writing and conversational communications skills in both French and English
- You know how to drive performance management in a fast growing company (+500 hires / year)

title: Senior Manager, FP&A
descriptionHtml:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionaryin 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

We are looking for a Senior Manager, FP&A to be the finance business partner to our Corporate or GTM organization. You will own the overall or GTM P&Ls and build the driver-based models behind some of the most consequential questions in SaaS finance today: what is the right plan, where we should invest, and make course corrections. You will partner directly with our Senior Leadership Team on investment decisions, headcount, and unit economics, and manage and develop a Senior Financial Analyst. You will join our global Finance team, report to the VP of FP&A, and work alongside the other FP&A leads - with scope that will grow as Camunda does.

What you'll be doing:

  •  Business Partnership: Serve as the primary finance partner to SLT, supporting decisions on hiring, investment prioritization, and resource allocation

  • P&L Ownership: Own the P&Ls end to end — budgeting, monthly forecasting, variance analysis, and the "what changed, why it matters, what we do next" narrative for leadership.

  • Financial Modeling: Build and continuously improve driver-based models, such as the long-range plan, bookings model, and ad hoc analyses.

  • Planning & Forecasting: Lead planning cadences (annual, quarterly, monthly outlooks) and integrate business partners' inputs into the corporate forecast alongside our FP&A leads.

  • Team Leadership: Manage and develop one Senior Financial Analyst, setting priorities and raising the bar on quality and speed of analysis.

  • Systems & Automation: Own Adaptive Planning administration and maintenance, and drive AI-augmented workflows that make FP&A faster and more scalable.

What you bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

  • 6+ years of progressive FP&A or strategic finance experience, including directly partnering with C-Level, and/or CRO/CMO

  • Direct people management experience (you've hired, coached, and managed the performance of finance team members, not just mentored or led projects)

  • Deep fluency in SaaS cost structures and unit economics — cloud/hosting costs, CoGS vs. OpEx, gross margin drivers — with proven driver-based modeling skills (forecasting from usage and consumption drivers, not trending actuals)

  • Hands-on experience building in an enterprise planning platform (Adaptive, Anaplan, Pigment, Planful, or similar) plus advanced spreadsheet skills — we'll ramp you on Adaptive Planning

  • Clear, executive-ready communicator who works autonomously and with focus, integrity, and humility

Nice-to-haves:

  • Adaptive Planning experience specifically (you'll own our instance)

  • Salesforce

  • Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude) to automate finance workflows — this team builds with AI daily

This role is an existing vacancy

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

United States: $179,400.00 to $289,200.00

United Kingdom: £112,600.00 to £185,300.00

Singapore: S$222,800.00 to S$334,100.00

Canada: C$190,500.00 to C$313,300.00

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

AI in our hiring process:Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here

”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

Come join us and be part of Camunda’s incredible journey: Make an impact at a pivotal moment in our story!

Camunda will only contact candidates from an email address ending in @camunda.com or @talent.camunda.com. title: Senior Manager, Global Benefits
descriptionHtml:
Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.

The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

Senior Manager, Global Benefits

We’re ~1,300 builders across 18 countries. We share context openly, work across functions and borders, question defaults, and own our outcomes. Our People team runs on Dataiku too, with AI agents and automated workflows.

The role

Location: EMEA - Remote · Reports to: Global Total Rewards Lead

You’ll own Dataiku’s global benefits programs across all countries where we operate. The goal: benefits that help us win AI talent, feel consistent and fair wherever people work, meet local requirements, and stay financially sustainable.

Our People function is lean and decentralized. You’ll set benefits strategy with the Global Total Rewards Lead, partner directly with Finance, Legal, Payroll and our brokers, lead day-to-day benefits operations, and have real autonomy. This is a builder role: you’ll challenge how benefits work today and use AI to make them simpler to run and easier for employees to use.

What you’ll do

  •         Shape the strategy. Define and evolve our global benefits philosophy with the Global Total Rewards Lead, balancing market competitiveness, consistency across countries and cost discipline.
  •         Own the global portfolio. Design and manage health, retirement, insurance, leave and wellbeing programs across our entities and EOR countries, setting a clear global floor with smart local variation.
  •         Run renewals and vendors. Lead annual renewals, broker and carrier relationships, and RFPs. Negotiate on data, not habit, and hold vendors to clear service levels.
  •         Keep us compliant. Make sure plans meet local rules in every country. You’ll own US compliance directly (ERISA, ACA, COBRA, nondiscrimination testing, Form 5500) as well as statutory and collective-agreement obligations in Europe and beyond.
  •         Manage cost. Own the global benefits budget and forecasts with Finance. Model plan changes, track claims and utilization trends, and bring clear trade-offs to decision-makers.
  •         Lead benefits operations. Lead the team that runs enrollment, life events, leaves, payroll and HRIS integrations, and EOR coordination. Build processes that scale without adding headcount.
  •         Use AI to reinvent the experience. Automate enrollment, eligibility checks, reconciliations and employee questions with AI agents and workflows. Make it easy for employees to understand and use what we offer.
  •         Support growth and change. Set up benefits for new countries, entity conversions from EOR, and acquisitions, with clean harmonization plans.
  •         Communicate clearly. Build benefits guides, open-enrollment campaigns and manager resources that people actually read.

What we’re looking for

  •         Extensive global benefits experience in a global, high-growth tech or enterprise software company.
  •         Deep expertise in benefits design, renewals, vendor/broker management and benchmarking across multiple countries.
  •         Strong, hands-on US benefits compliance experience, plus experience with European programs and statutory requirements, including UK and French benefits and pensions.
  •         Experience managing benefits through both owned entities and Employer of Record providers (e.g. Deel, Remote).
  •         A track record of building or transforming benefits programs, not just administering them.
  •         Experience leading a team and influencing senior stakeholders in lean, fast-moving environments.
  •         Strong analytical skills for cost modeling and claims analysis, and real curiosity for AI and automation (Workday a plus).

Why join us

  •         Real impact: shape benefits for a global AI company helping the world’s largest enterprises make AI work.
  •         Ownership: the autonomy to build, with direct access to Total Rewards, Finance and People leadership.
  •         Growth: help reinvent how People programs are delivered, with AI-powered workflows.

title: Senior Mobile Quality Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

Our mobile app, Zable, is how most of our customers experience all of our products in one centralised space. It's written in React Native and TypeScript with a Kotlin backend, shipped to iOS and Android from a single codebase. We are now looking to level up the quality engineering so that we can raise release cadence without losing sleep over regressions.

This is an automation-first role. You'll spend most of your time writing code - test frameworks, CI tooling, helpers, rather than executing test scripts by hand. You'll work alongside software engineers, product, and design, setting direction.

You'll also be working at the frontier of AI-assisted quality, using LLMs and AI tooling to speed up test authoring, triage failures, and surface coverage gaps, while applying the engineering judgement to keep tests trustworthy.

What you'll be doing

Own the mobile test strategy:

  • Define and evolve a pragmatic test pyramid for React Native - deciding where E2E is worth the weight and where logic belongs in faster layers (Jest, React Testing Library, component tests).

  • Make deliberate calls about coverage, reliability, and speed trade-offs across the app.

  • Set the bar for what "ready to ship" looks like on mobile, and hold the line on it.

Build reliable E2E automation:

  • Create and maintain mobile E2E suites in Maestro, including the scaffolding around them - test data, device configuration, helpers, reporting.

  • Integrate suites into CI (GitHub Actions) so engineers get fast, trustworthy feedback on every PR and release candidates carry a signal people actually believe.

  • Drive flakiness down and time-to-diagnosis down. We treat a flaky test the same way we treat a broken test, and we expect root-cause work rather than retry-until-green.

Bring AI into the SDLC:

  • Use AI tools day-to-day to accelerate test authoring, cluster failures, surface coverage insights, and propose fixes.

  • Decide where AI adds leverage and where a human eye is needed. A suite that looks comprehensive but isn't trustworthy is worse than a smaller one we rely on.

  • Help shape how the mobile team uses AI-assisted workflows more broadly - prompts, guardrails, review patterns.

Prevent defects, not just catch them:

  • Partner with product and engineering on shift-left quality: join specs early, push back on ambiguous acceptance criteria, and surface risk before code is written.

  • Close the loop on production issues using our observability stack (Datadog, Sentry, Grafana) - tying test coverage back to real customer impact.

  • Run targeted exploratory testing on high-risk releases when it's the right call.

What we're looking for

Essential:

  • Hands-on experience with Maestro or Detox.

  • 6+ years in quality engineering or test automation, with a track record of keeping automated suites stable rather than letting them rot into a graveyard of quarantined tests.

  • Experience introducing AI-assisted testing practices (test generation, failure clustering, coverage analytics) with sensible controls around review and trust.

  • Strong TypeScript and JavaScript - not just writing test scripts, but building helpers, tooling, and debugging into the app when needed.

  • Experience shaping CI/CD pipelines for test reliability (GitHub Actions or similar), including flakiness reduction, parallelisation, artefact management, and runtime control.

  • Comfortable with mobile E2E automation, or strong E2E experience on another platform plus a credible plan for getting productive on mobile quickly.

  • Able to operate independently and drive improvements end-to-end (frameworks, CI, test data, reporting).

Desirable:

  • Hands-on experience testing React Native apps.

  • Mobile performance and reliability work (crash reporting, startup time, memory and battery awareness).

  • API and contract testing experience, with a point of view on test data and environment strategy.

Our tech stack

Mobile: TypeScript, React Native, Expo, EAS, GraphQL, Relay, Jest, React Testing Library, Maestro.

Backend: Kotlin, PHP 8 (Symfony), AWS, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes.

Tooling and observability: GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jira, Confluence, Datadog, Sentry, Grafana.

Interview process

  1. Quick call with a Recruiter

  2. 15 minute cognitive test

  3. Hiring manager interview (30 minutes)

  4. Technical interview (90 minutes)

  5. Culture-add interview (60 minutes)

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

title: Senior Netwerk Consultant
descriptionHtml:

Samen met een team van gespecialiseerde netwerk consultant zorg je ervoor dat onze diensten veilig, beschikbaar, geautomatiseerd en efficiënt worden geleverd aan onze klanten.

Wij zorgen voor een werkomgeving waar jij blij kunt zijn en gewaardeerd wordt. Andersom voeg jij als Netwerk Consultant

waarde toe met jouw:

  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal;

  • Je bent communicatief sterk, oplossingsgericht, zelfstandig en klantgericht;

  • Je bent bereid om deel te nemen aan stand-by diensten en incidenteel buiten kantooruren werkzaamheden uit te voeren.

Bij Centric vind je veel flexibiliteit en vrijheid om jouw vak als Netwerk Consultant succesvol uit te oefenen. Zo heb je veel ruimte om te bepalen hoe jij jouw werkweek indeelt. Ook kies je (deels) zelf waarvandaan jij werkt: vanaf kantoor, thuis of andere locaties. Verder kun je voor deze functie rekenen op:

Zonder dat je het misschien weet, ben je al eens met Centric in aanraking geweest. Als je betaalt in de winkel. Als je een glas kraanwater drinkt. Als je een paspoort aanvraagt. title: Senior Product Builder - Hub
descriptionHtml:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionaryin 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

Camunda Hub is where enterprises run Camunda at scale. From Hub they manage their clusters and tenants, decide who can do what, and roll changes out across the whole organization. We’re looking for a Senior Product Builder to own the backend and architecture that let Hub manage a whole fleet of clusters. Your first focus will be the mechanism that sends access, secret, tenant and licence changes out to every connected cluster and brings deployments, health and audit records back. From there, you’ll shape Hub’s foundations: its event model, the service boundaries and data model other teams build on, and how Hub behaves when things fail or get upgraded. The platform is your product. Your users are platform administrators, Centres of Excellence and the builders across Camunda who depend on what you create. You’ll join a new two-person pod in our remote-first team. You’ll have real ownership as the person who makes the call, and you’ll build AI-first, from written specs through to production. Our customers run mission-critical processes on Camunda, so your work will matter to them every day.

What You Will Do:

  • Take over Hub's fleet propagation mechanism from the team building its first version, and make it work for access, secrets, tenants, licences and custom roles

  • Write short design documents for foundational changes, get them reviewed by the teams that depend on them, and turn them into tested, shipped code

  • Design how Hub behaves when things go wrong: offline clusters, partial failures, Hub outages, and clusters being adopted or detached

  • Build the path from clusters back to Hub, starting with deployment inventory, health, audit records and licence status

  • Design Hub's first event and webhook mechanism, so admins and agents can react to changes instead of polling for them

  • Join the pod's rotations and Hub on-call, and help other builders take on backend work through reviews, guidelines and contract tests

What You Will Bring to the Role:

  • Experience building and running backend systems in production that other teams or customers depend on

  • Comfort taking a problem nobody owns yet and turning it into a design, a plan and shipped code

  • Product judgment for technical users: you talk to the people who use your APIs and make trade-offs on their behalf

  • Clear, short writing that lets a remote team review and decide asynchronously

  • Care for how a system behaves when parts of it fail, not only for the happy path

Must Haves:

  • Designed and shipped a control plane or similar system that pushes desired state to many targets. Knows outbox or event-log patterns, idempotent apply, versioning, retries and drift reconciliation

  • Senior backend engineering in Java (API design, relational data models, multi-tenant SaaS services) and hands-on Helm and Kubernetes for self-managed installations

  • Software architecture and failure analysis: partial failure, blast radius, consistency trade-offs. Has debugged production incidents in a distributed system and is ready for on-call

  • Has shaped an API or platform as a product, and writes design docs other teams can build on. Gets agreement across teams without formal authority

  • Builds AI-first from written specifications and checks AI output as carefully as any other code

Nice to Haves:

  • Kubernetes operators or GitOps tools, for example Argo CD

  • OIDC, SCIM and permission models, or secret managers and licence systems

  • Camunda 8 or another workflow or orchestration engine

  • Enough frontend skill to build a thin UI on top of a backend capability

This role is an existing vacancy

#LI-AM1 #LI-Remote #C1 #USEAST #USWEST

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

  • United States: $143,800.00 to $231,900.00

  • United Kingdom: £90,300.00 to £148,500.00

  • Singapore: S$178,600.00 to S$267,900.00

  • Canada: C$152,700.00 to C$251,200

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

AI in our hiring process:Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here

”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

title: Senior Product Designer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

Role overview

UX is our number one priority. As a Series B scale-up, we are investing heavily in the product experience, and you will be central to it. You will own our biggest new product bets: new features, health insights and early vision work across the app. You will bring ideas to life fast, with polished high-fidelity prototypes and motion, then take them to a shipped result.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. Alongside you are a Lead Product Designer and a Lead UX Writer, who keep the whole product consistent and high quality.

You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.

Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.

Core responsibilities

Ownership & Outcomes

  • Own your product areas from first idea to shipped result.
  • Set the measures for your work and own whether it succeeds.
  • Turn research, feedback and data into clear decisions.

Prototyping & Design

  • Spin up working prototypes with AI tools and our design system, not just static screens.

Collaboration & Continuity

  • Work daily with design engineers and product managers, and unblock them fast.
  • Take over existing product design work and keep quality high.

Requirements

Background & Experience

Essential

  • Senior product design experience, ideally in health, consumer, behavior change or regulated products.
  • 1 to 3 shipped case studies that show the problem, your role, your decisions and the measurable impact.
  • Strong UX and UI craft: visual hierarchy, typography, motion and attention to detail.
  • High-fidelity prototypes you can screen-share and walk through (Figma, AI tools such as Claude or Lovable).
  • Daily, practical use of AI tools, and enthusiasm for trying new ones.
  • Fluent Figma, including components, variables and tokens.
  • Close work with engineers, and clear, short communication.
  • A public portfolio website (required with your application).

Nice to Have

  • AI-ready design systems, mobile apps, connected devices, simple prototypes in code.

How you work

  • AI first — You'd rather show a working thing than describe one.
  • Builder — You ship, starting from nothing if you have to.
  • Bias for action — You don't need to be told what to do or be chased. You spot what could go wrong, pick the one that matters most and fix it.
  • Disciplined — Tokens, not screenshots. Decision logs, not memories.
  • Curious — You want to know why, not just what.
  • Clear under pressure — Medical regulation and different market rules are design problems, not excuses.

This isn't for you if

  • You need a finished brief, all the requirements or all the research before you start.
  • You measure screens shipped, not outcomes moved.
  • You'd rather list risks than own one.

How we hire

  1. Recruiter screen (30 min)
  2. Portfolio interview with the Head of Design (60 min)
  3. Product thinking and interaction design deep dive
  4. Cross-functional conversation with design engineers and product
  5. Final conversation with senior leadership

What success looks like

  • You take something off our plate and it gets done.
  • If it won't happen, you tell us first.
  • You bring the problem, the root cause and options.
  • You flag risk to dates early, while we can still change it.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:

Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You understand that a great product experience is fundamental to good decision-making and growth, and you take accountability for the quality and outcomes of your work, from first idea through to shipped result.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with craft. You continuously improve the way Design operates, experiment with better tools and processes, including AI, and solve root causes rather than accepting repetitive manual work.

Team First — You collaborate effectively with colleagues, engineers, product managers and stakeholders across countries and functions. You build trust by being reliable, clear and constructive, while maintaining high standards for quality and consistency.

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story.
  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team.
  • Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location).

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

You will own our biggest new product bets: new features, health insights and early vision work across the app. You will bring ideas to life fast, with polished high-fidelity prototypes and motion, then take them to a shipped result.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. Alongside you are a Lead Product Designer and a Lead UX Writer, who keep the whole product consistent and high quality.

You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.

Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.

Core responsibilities

Ownership & Outcomes

  • Own your product areas from first idea to shipped result.
  • Set the measures for your work and own whether it succeeds.
  • Turn research, feedback and data into clear decisions.

Prototyping & Design

  • Spin up working prototypes with AI tools and our design system, not just static screens.

Collaboration & Continuity

  • Work daily with design engineers and product managers, and unblock them fast.
  • Take over existing product design work and keep quality high.

Requirements

Background & Experience

Essential

  • Senior product design experience, ideally in health, consumer, behavior change or regulated products.
  • 1 to 3 shipped case studies that show the problem, your role, your decisions and the measurable impact.
  • Strong UX and UI craft: visual hierarchy, typography, motion and attention to detail.
  • High-fidelity prototypes you can screen-share and walk through (Figma, AI tools such as Claude or Lovable).
  • Daily, practical use of AI tools, and enthusiasm for trying new ones.
  • Fluent Figma, including components, variables and tokens.
  • Close work with engineers, and clear, short communication.
  • A public portfolio website (required with your application).

Nice to Have

  • AI-ready design systems, mobile apps, connected devices, simple prototypes in code.

How you work

  • AI first — You'd rather show a working thing than describe one.
  • Builder — You ship, starting from nothing if you have to.
  • Bias for action — You don't need to be told what to do or be chased. You spot what could go wrong, pick the one that matters most and fix it.
  • Disciplined — Tokens, not screenshots. Decision logs, not memories.
  • Curious — You want to know why, not just what.
  • Clear under pressure — Medical regulation and different market rules are design problems, not excuses.

This isn't for you if

  • You need a finished brief, all the requirements or all the research before you start.
  • You measure screens shipped, not outcomes moved.
  • You'd rather list risks than own one.

How we hire

  1. Recruiter screen (30 min)
  2. Portfolio interview with the Head of Design (60 min)
  3. Product thinking and interaction design deep dive
  4. Cross-functional conversation with design engineers and product
  5. Final conversation with senior leadership

What success looks like

  • You take something off our plate and it gets done.
  • If it won't happen, you tell us first.
  • You bring the problem, the root cause and options.
  • You flag risk to dates early, while we can still change it.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:

Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You understand that a great product experience is fundamental to good decision-making and growth, and you take accountability for the quality and outcomes of your work, from first idea through to shipped result.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with craft. You continuously improve the way Design operates, experiment with better tools and processes, including AI, and solve root causes rather than accepting repetitive manual work.

Team First — You collaborate effectively with colleagues, engineers, product managers and stakeholders across countries and functions. You build trust by being reliable, clear and constructive, while maintaining high standards for quality and consistency.

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story.
  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team.
  • Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location).

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

title: Senior Product Designer - Growth
descriptionHtml:
Fully Remote (UK based) | Competitive Salary + Bonus + Generous Equity | B Corp Certified TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel. Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world. We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all. But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles. The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question: Could that be you?

This is the role that owns the first impression. From the moment someone lands on our homepage to the point they hand over their payment details, you’ll shape every critical step. We’re redesigning how millions of pet lovers discover and join TrustedHousesitters - and this hire will lead that work. If you’ve spent your career moving conversion needles, experimenting relentlessly, and building beautiful product at speed, this is your next chapter.

The Role: Experimental, Visual, and Commercial

You’ll own the full acquisition and onboarding experience at TrustedHousesitters - web and mobile - sitting within the New Member Revenue squad. That means everything from the homepage and landing pages through to registration flows, onboarding nudges, and first payment. You’ll work directly with product, engineering, data, CRM, and our CRO Manager, and you’ll have real ownership of the experimentation roadmap for your area.

The challenge is genuinely interesting. Our product is loved - but our acquisition experience needs to match that. We’re running a push to make TrustedHousesitters feel as aspirational as Airbnb, peppering real trust signals and community moments into journeys that currently skew too utilitarian. You’ll need to balance a high visual bar with a rigorous test-and-learn mindset. Neither alone is enough.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Own the acquisition journey end-to-end: From homepage to first payment - web-first, with mobile increasingly in scope - including landing pages, onboarding flows, and lifecycle nudges.

  • Drive conversion through experimentation: Co-own the experimentation roadmap with our CRO Manager: frame hypotheses, define success metrics, and ship rapid tests. You should be able to name the number your last test moved.

  • Raise the visual bar: Strong UI craft is a non-negotiable - every surface you touch should feel considered, current, and well-executed.

  • Translate insight into shipped product: Self-serve with Amplitude, turn quantitative and qualitative signals into testable ideas, and move quickly from insight to design.

  • Shape strategy, not just output: Partner with product, engineering, data, and commercial teams - your voice should be in the room before decisions are made, not after.


    Who you are:

    • The Growth Designer: You’ve owned acquisition or conversion work in-house, at pace - and you can tell the story of an experiment you ran, the hypothesis behind it, and the number it moved.

    • The Visual Craftsperson: Your portfolio stops people. You’ve worked where the visual bar is genuinely high and you hold yourself to that standard regardless of where you are.

    • The Hypothesis Writer: You think in problems before solutions - you can frame a clear problem statement, propose a test, and explain why that test design makes sense.

    • The Collaborator: You treat design as a shared effort, not a hand-off - you partner closely with PMs, engineers, data, and CRM and you’re a stronger designer for it.

    • The B2C Product Thinker: You’ve worked on consumer products - ideally marketplaces or subscriptions - and you understand how trust is built digitally and what actually makes someone convert.

    The Process:

    We value your time and aim for a transparent, efficient process:

    1. Talent Screen: A 20-minute conversation with our Talent team to cover your background, motivations, and the role in detail.

    2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 30-minute call with our Director of Design - a two-way conversation about your craft, your approach to growth design, and whether TrustedHousesitters is the right fit for you.

    3. Portfolio & Technical Review: A deeper session with the team focused on your case studies, your experimentation thinking, and your approach to strategic and UX challenges.

    4. Final Stage: You’ll share a high-level view of what you’d focus on in your first 90 days - not a polished strategy, just your honest read of the opportunity and what you’d want to dig into.

title: (Senior) React Native Engineer (m/f/x) - Based in Germany
descriptionHtml:
Cara Care, a digital health company backed by Bayer AG, is on a mission to improve people’s digestive health through technology. As we expand our product portfolio and modernize our platform, we’re looking for a versatile, pragmatic, and forward-thinking (Senior) React Native Engineer (m/f/x) to help shape the future of digital therapeutics.

Your Role

You’ll join a cross-functional product team with high ownership, lean processes, and a clear focus: deliver real impact to patients. We’re looking for someone who thrives on solving real-world problems with code, is technology-open, and knows when to build fast and when to build right. You’ll also help us use AI tools and coding agents thoughtfully in day-to-day engineering, turning emerging capabilities into reliable workflows that improve how we design, build, test, and operate patient-facing products.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and ship high-quality React Native apps for iOS and Android with TypeScript.
  • Use AI coding agents to implement features, refactor code, and generate tests. Define clear tasks and constraints, provide relevant context, and validate the resulting changes through code review, automated tests, and checks on real devices.
  • Own the full mobile lifecycle: architecture, implementation, automated testing, release management, monitoring, and iteration.
  • Integrate native capabilities (push notifications, deep links, biometric auth, camera/sensors); write and maintain native modules when needed (Swift/Kotlin).
  • Drive mobile performance and reliability (startup time, bundle size, memory, battery) and meet accessibility best practices.
  • Set up and evolve mobile CI/CD (e.g., Fastlane, GitHub Actions/Bitrise), internal testing (TestFlight/Play Console), and release pipelines.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Medical to explore, define, and deliver patient-centric features, and to improve our current platform.
  • Connect AI-assisted development workflows to design and engineering tools via MCP, for example to access Figma specifications and components, check implementations against designs, and automate repetitive coding and validation tasks. Keep patient data, credentials, and other sensitive information out of unapproved tools and workflows.
  • Uphold technical excellence in architecture, code quality, and security, especially in a regulated healthcare environment, including applicable requirements under IEC 62304, BSI TR-03161, and the MDR.
  • Contribute to a platform that powers multiple regulated digital health products across indications like IBS, GERD, and upcoming expansions.
  • Mentor other developers and help raise the technical bar across the team.

Requirements

Your Profile

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 3 years focused on React Native and shipping production apps.
  • Expert with React Native and TypeScript, React Navigation, state management, and testing (Jest, React Native Testing Library; Detox a plus).
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding agents to implement features, refactor code, and write automated tests, including connecting agents to engineering tools via MCP. You can explain how you scoped the work, verified the results, and handled tool permissions and sensitive data.
  • Proven track record delivering to App Store and Google Play, including handling certificates/provisioning, in-app updates, and staged rollouts.
  • Solid understanding of mobile security and privacy: secure storage, keychain/keystore, certificate pinning, data minimization, and PII handling.
  • Experience with mobile CI/CD and release automation (Fastlane, GitHub Actions or Bitrise), and tools like Sentry.
  • Product mindset: you’ve worked in product-centric teams, collaborated closely with non-technical stakeholders, and care deeply about UX and accessibility.
  • Bonus: experience in regulated industries, healthcare, or other security-conscious environments; native iOS/Android development (Swift/Kotlin)

What you’ll need:

  • 7+ years prior experience as a Sales Engineer, System Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or similar roles

  • Prior experience in similar roles within the Risk, Fraud, or Compliance domain

  • Experience with APIs, a strong understanding of JSON, and proficiency in one or more of the following languages: Python, JavaScript, Ruby, Go, or Java. Bonus points for knowledge of web development principles and/or the ability to build internal tools using one of these languages.

title: Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Location: UK. Fully remote, or from our London office next to East Croydon Station

Working pattern: Fully remote working is allowed, and the London office is available to you

Reports to: CTO

About Us

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities.

With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

Role Overview

You will build the products drivers and car park operators use every day: ANPR camera enforcement, pay-by-web, Autopay, permits, a client console and a motorist account app, across about 160 sites, and the new products we build next. We are a small engineering team, and we form teams around the work from the people we have.

We work in Kotlin on the backend (Spring Boot WebFlux, a domain-driven layering of domain, edge services and repository, Postgres, Axon event sourcing and Pub/Sub) and in TypeScript with Next.js and React on the front end, on GCP and Kubernetes. You do not need to know Kotlin to apply. Our engineers work with AI coding agents day to day, and we are looking for people who use them well and check what they produce.

Every engineer here is product-minded. You will talk to the people who use what you build, decide with product people what is worth building, and find out afterwards whether it worked.

You will report to the CTO and work with a team that reviews each other’s work.

The Senior level

Senior Software Engineer. You own a product area: its architecture, how it is staged, its quality bar, and working out with customers what is needed. You may be the only engineer on a new product area, so you need to be able to work alone for weeks at a time and keep quality high without a peer reviewer. Other engineers will come to you for design review.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the delivery of what you are given, from the first ticket to production, with tests, and be the person who fixes it if it breaks.

  • Talk to the people who use what you build, and use what you learn to shape and cut scope.

  • Write acceptance criteria, and check a feature after release to see whether it was used and whether it worked.

  • Work in our existing codebase and its layering, and keep it consistent for the next engineer.

  • Use AI coding agents as part of how you work, and be accountable for everything you ship, however it was written.

  • Take part in the on-call rota and look after what you ship.

  • Review other engineers’ pull requests, and welcome review of your own.

  • Own the architecture and staging of a product area, and the quality bar for it.

  • Work out with customers what is needed, and give design review to other engineers.

Who we’re looking for

  • You’re product-minded. In the last 12 months you’ve talked to real users or customers, and what you learned changed or cut the scope of what you built. You write acceptance criteria, you check a feature after release, and you can say whether something you shipped got used.

  • You’ve shipped production code end to end in the last 12 months, in any language. You can say what you personally built, and what happened after it went live.

  • You test as you build. You can describe a bug you shipped and the test that would have caught it.

  • You use AI coding agents in real work today, and you can describe how you check what they produce, including a time one was wrong.

  • You’re willing to be on call, and you take ownership of what you ship. You don’t need to have been on call before.

  • You work well in an existing codebase with a layered or domain-driven structure that you did not design, and you read before you write.

  • You’re comfortable across the stack. You’ve changed a React or Next.js front end, or worked properly against an API contract, even if you lean backend.

  • You review others’ pull requests, finding real problems and saying so well, and you change your own design when review shows you a better way.

  • You’ve owned a product area on your own, from first design to production, and staged it so each stage delivered something usable.

  • Ideally, you’ve modelled a domain in which the rules change over time (such as pricing, eligibility, tax or regulation) and can answer “what was true on a given date”.

  • You’ve kept quality high without a peer reviewer, and other engineers have come to you for design review.

You do not need a degree, a particular programming language, or Kotlin. Experience of Axon, Temporal, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, parking or payments is welcome, but none of it is required.

We are hiring software engineers at two levels, Mid-level and Senior. This advert is for the Senior level. If you are earlier in your career, see our post for a Mid-Level Software Engineer.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote working in the UK if you want it, with our London office next to East Croydon Station available to you.

  • Real ownership: mid-level engineers own whole features, and senior engineers own a product area.

  • A team that works with AI coding agents every day and measures what they do for us.

  • A strong, high performing culture, with genuine influence over how that culture develops as Hozah grows.

  • A fully refurbished, modern office, right next to East Croydon Station (with a fully stocked kitchen, offering free breakfast, lunch and drinks!).
