title: Senior Software Engineer (AI/Data)
descriptionHtml:
About Codat

Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work.

Founded in 2017 and backed by JPMorgan, PayPal, Amex, Plaid, and Shopify, Codat has successfully powered over 350,000 connections to business customers’ financial systems — and is trusted by industry leaders to turn scattered information into actionable, strategic advantages in real time, every time.

The Role

We're building the Advisory Intelligence Platform: Codat's client intelligence delivered inside the assistant a banker already uses (Microsoft Copilot first). Ask it anything about a client and it answers from the client's real books. Don't ask, and it still tells you what's changed, why it matters and what to do about it. Under it we're building the semantic layer, so every answer uses the same definitions, the signal layer that spots what's changed for a client, and the reasoning layer, a Codat-side LLM that turns those signals into advice. The first bank goes live this year. You'll be building the data and reasoning behind all of it.

This is a hands-on job for software engineers who want to build the systems a model reasons over, not configure a warehouse. Codat is AI-first, not AI bolted onto SaaS. The product lives inside the AI assistant our clients already use, and we build it the same way: agents do the repetitive work, engineers do the hard parts. You'll build it and you'll run it. Nobody hands it over the wall once it's live. You'll also get a real say in where it goes next. That means making your case to engineers, product and the commercial team, and bringing them along with you.

What You'll Work On

  • The semantic layer. Measures, dimensions and definitions the model is allowed to use, so every answer it gives is the same answer. Yours to grow, persona by persona.

  • The signal layer. Detecting what's changed for a client and surfacing it before the banker asks. You'll be designing and building this.

  • The reasoning layer. A Codat-side LLM that turns signals into advice. Our calculations are the ground truth it reasons over. You own the calculations the model relies on, and the names, definitions and structure that let it pick the right one.

  • The agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers behind the assistant. What tools it has, how they're built, how they fail, and the evals that prove they work.

  • Everything from raw source data to the number the assistant quotes: the pipelines, services and data models, with the testing and observability to prove the number is right and the evals that catch the model quoting the wrong one.

You'll Probably Have

  • Built production systems from scratch, writing the code yourself rather than configuring managed services. You think about interfaces, failure modes and how the next person will change your code. If we ask about the hardest system you've built, you'll have a story ready.

  • Served data to an LLM and seen where it goes wrong: ambiguous definitions, poor retrieval, no evals. You know why "the model will work it out" isn't a data strategy.

  • Worked with data along the way, and liked it. You may never have been called a data engineer. You've built things that move, shape and serve data, and you know how they break, and how a model breaks on top of them.

  • Solid C#, Python or another backend language. Your code comes with tests, and you leave things tidier than you found them.

  • Depth in at least one of SQL, Spark, Databricks/Delta Lake, Dagster/Airflow/Temporal or dbt. Bonus if you've shaped any of them into something a model can query, through a metrics layer, metric views or an MCP server.

  • Time with CI/CD, Docker, cloud infrastructure (we're on Azure) and observability. Even better if you set them up for a team.

  • An interest in the business behind the data. If someone asks for a number the data can't support, you'll say so, and you'll build the guard-rail so the model says so too.

  • Treated your own workflow as something to engineer. AI has already taken over the repetitive parts of it, and you're the person others ask how to do the same.

How We Work

We're a small team with plenty to do. Things move fast: we'd rather ship something useful and improve it than polish it in private. What you build is yours from start to finish.

There’s no return-to-office mandate, and you can work hybrid or fully remote. We trust you to be around when the team needs you and to deliver what you said you would. What we don’t want is anyone staying online late to prove a point.

Compensation: £90K – £110K • Offers Equity

About the role:

As a Senior Software Engineer on Camunda's new Data Streaming team, you'll help build a foundational new piece of architecture that changes how customers and internal products access process data. Today, customers have no first-class way to stream their own process data out of Camunda, and Camunda's own analytics product is bottlenecked by querying the same storage the live engine depends on. You'll be part of a greenfield team rebuilding how process data is consumed and served at scale, built on top of a durable, continuously-written streaming layer that decouples data consumption from the live engine. You'll be part of a small team from day one, with real room to shape both the architecture and the team's scope as it matures.

At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, the Data Layer and Distributed Systems teams, QA, and support, and work closely with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence how our data streaming architecture evolves to meet our customers' needs.

What You Will Do:

  • Help rebuild how Camunda's analytics product consumes and serves process data at scale, moving it off the engine's critical path entirely.

  • Design and build the core streaming infrastructure that decouples process data access from the live execution engine, backed by durable, object storage.

  • Build customer-facing data streaming capabilities, including a supported way to integrate with systems like Kafka, so customers can reliably get their process data into their own tools.

  • Make foundational architecture decisions as part of a small, high-ownership team, including how the system guarantees consistency and durability across a distributed streaming pipeline.

  • Participate in L3 support and on-call rotations, partnering with Support and SRE to investigate data layer production issues, and feeding what you learn back into the product.

What You Will Bring to the Role:

Must Haves:

  • 7+ years of experience as a backend engineer, in Java, with a strong focus on distributed or data-intensive systems.

  • Hands-on experience building or operating an analytical serving layer over a table format such as Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake - including experience with an embedded/lightweight query engine (e.g. DuckDB, or similar), or a stateful stream-processing framework (e.g. Flink, Kafka Streams).

  • A track record of working with object storage systems (S3/GCS/Azure or similar) and building reliable, idempotent upload/commit protocols against them.

  • Solid grounding in the reasoning behind correctness and consistency in data-intensive systems (e.g. concurrent writes, atomicity, idempotency).

  • A demonstrated track record of driving a technical initiative through genuine ambiguity in a still-being-designed system, not just extending an established one.

  • Proven experience leading medium-to-large engineering initiatives (3+ months) end-to-end, from solution design, project planning, and coordinating across teams, right through to driving predictable delivery.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in a remote-first environment: you translate requirements into actionable technical work with Product, and give and receive clear, direct feedback in code review.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience with Kafka or a similar streaming/event-log system

  • Experience with embedded state stores (RocksDB or similar) for projection/checkpointing workloads.

  • Experience with stream processing frameworks (e.g. Apache Flink), particularly stateful processing with local state backends and checkpointing.

  • Familiarity with object-storage-native streaming architectures (e.g. systems like WarpStream) is a plus, even without direct hands-on experience.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Location: Fully remote within the UK, or our London office next to East Croydon Station

Reports to: CTO

About Us

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities.

With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

Role Overview

You will be Hozah’s first Site Reliability Engineer, and the person who owns how our platform runs. Our parking and payments systems take money from motorists (pay by web, Autopay, kiosks) and pay it on to landowners, and our ANPR enforcement runs around the clock. Those paths have to stay up and stay correct. You own the platform they run on: GKE and Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform for our Google Cloud organisation and projects, SOPS-encrypted secrets, the Semaphore CI/CD pipelines, Temporal for the ANPR workflows, and Postgres. You also own the reliability practice around it: uptime targets, alerting, on-call, incident response and the cost of running it all.

Product engineers keep ownership of the code in their services. You own the ground it runs on, and you make it easy for them to ship safely. Our engineers use AI coding tools every day, which means more code reaches production each week, so release safety and observability matter more than ever.

This is a new role. We are hiring a senior engineer to own cloud cost, uptime and on-call, set up a proper incident process, and make the platform something engineers trust. You’ll support all of Hozah’s engineering teams, and you’ll work daily with their engineers. The data engineer owns the data warehouse; you’ll work with them, and infrastructure for data still goes through engineering. This is a newly created role with no direct reports.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the production platform: GKE and Kubernetes, Helm, Postgres, Temporal and the environments (staging and production) and how a change is promoted between them.

  • Own uptime and reliability. Agree service level objectives for the money-moving and enforcement paths with the engineers and the business, and alert a named owner when they are at risk.

  • Own on-call: the rota, the runbooks and the incident process, including postmortems that lead to changes rather than reports.

  • Own observability across Cloud Monitoring, Logging and Trace, so the team finds problems before motorists and clients do.

  • Own our infrastructure as code. Everything changes through Terraform and CI, with no console click-ops, including our SOPS-encrypted secrets.

  • Own the Semaphore CI/CD pipelines and safe release: rollbacks, progressive rollout and promotion between environments.

  • Own cloud cost. Know what we spend and why, reduce it with measured results, and keep it down as volume grows.

  • Work with product engineers as a partner and not a ticket queue: help them design for reliability, and review changes that affect production.

Who we’re looking for

  • You’ve owned production reliability for a Kubernetes-based platform (GKE, EKS or AKS) in the last 12 to 24 months, as the person who gets called when it breaks. You can say exactly what you were accountable for and what you personally changed.

  • You write and maintain infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform, and you’ve built CI/CD pipelines with safe release: rollbacks and promotion between environments. You can walk through a change of yours that went wrong, what it affected and what you changed afterwards.

  • You’ve cut cloud cost with a measured result and kept it down. You can say what you spent before and after, what you changed, and what you checked before you changed it.

  • You’ve set up or rebuilt on-call and incident response in a small team: the rota, the runbooks and the postmortems. You can describe the last real incident you handled and what changed because of it.

  • You’ve built observability and service level objectives that changed what got fixed, not just dashboards that nobody opened.

  • You work with product engineers without becoming a ticket queue. You can describe how you got engineers to take on reliability work themselves.

  • You use AI tools sensibly for operations work, and you know where not to. You can describe real recent use and a time you did not trust the output.

  • You’re comfortable setting your own priorities in a fast-moving SME, and you’re happy being the only SRE in the company.

Experience of Google Cloud itself, Temporal, Semaphore or SOPS is welcome, but none of it is required.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote working within the UK, or a London office next to East Croydon Station if you prefer to be in.

  • Sole ownership of the platform and reliability practice, reporting directly to the CTO.

  • The chance to build Hozah’s reliability function from a working base as we scale.

  • A strong, high performing culture, with genuine influence over how that culture develops as Hozah grows.

  • A fully refurbished, modern office, right next to East Croydon Station, open to you whenever you want it (with a fully stocked kitchen, offering free breakfast, lunch and drinks!).

title: SME Onboarding Specialist - Germany (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Möchtest du das tägliche Leben von Millionen von Unternehmern in Deutschland (und bald in Europa) beeinflussen? Suchst du nach einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Vertrauen, Proaktivität und Autonomie schätzt? Stimmen unsere Company Values mit deiner Vision überein? Dann ist Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich!

 

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

 

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 1 300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

Deine Mission

Du bist die Stimme unserer deutschen Kunden und trägst direkt dazu bei, dass sie mit Pennylane erfolgreich sind. Du hilfst kleinen und mittleren Unternehmen (KMU), ihre Finanzprozesse zu vereinfachen und das volle Potenzial unserer Finanzmanagement-Plattform auszuschöpfen. Gleichzeitig gestaltest du mit uns den Aufbau von Pennylane in Deutschland.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Onboarding mit Wirkung: Du begleitest neue KMU-Kunden und ihre Steuerkanzleien durch den gesamten Onboarding-Prozess. Du sorgst dafür, dass der Einstieg reibungslos gelingt und Unternehmen schnell von den Möglichkeiten unserer Plattform profitieren.

  • Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen und weiterentwickeln: Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für unsere bestehenden KMU-Kunden. Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf, erkennst Potenziale für zusätzliche Funktionen und eine erweiterte Nutzung und hilfst deinen Kunden, ihre unternehmerischen und finanziellen Ziele mit Pennylane zu erreichen.

  • Proaktiv beraten: In regelmäßigen Gesprächen prüfst du, wie erfolgreich deine Kunden mit Pennylane arbeiten und wo sie Unterstützung brauchen. Du steigerst ihre Zufriedenheit, optimierst die Nutzung der Plattform und erkennst frühzeitig, wenn eine Abwanderung droht.

  • Gemeinsam den deutschen Markt gestalten: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem deutschen Sales-Team und dem lokalen Leadership-Team zusammen. Gemeinsam entwickelt ihr Abläufe weiter, bündelt Produktfeedback und treibt das Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland voran.

  • Expertise aufbauen und teilen: Du entwickelst dich zur gefragten Ansprechperson für unsere Plattform und die deutsche Finanz- und Buchhaltungslandschaft. Dein Wissen und bewährte Vorgehensweisen gibst du direkt an unsere KMU-Kunden weiter.

Das bringst du mit

  • Relevante Erfahrung: Du hast 2–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung, im Finanzmanagement, in Corporate Finance oder in einer vergleichbaren unternehmensinternen Rolle. Idealerweise hast du selbst mit Finanzprozessen, Rechnungsstellung oder Buchhaltungsabläufen gearbeitet. Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Umfeld, bei einem Fintech oder in einer Steuerkanzlei ist ein Plus.

  • Fachliche Grundlage: Du hast ein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen, Rechnungswesen oder Betriebswirtschaft abgeschlossen. Alternativ bringst du eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellter, eine Weiterbildung als Steuerfachwirt oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation im Rechnungswesen mit.

  • Verständnis für den deutschen Markt: Du kennst die Anforderungen von KMU an ihr Finanzmanagement und verstehst die zentralen Abläufe rund um Rechnungswesen, Rechnungsstellung und das finanzielle Tagesgeschäft in Deutschland.

  • Kommunikationsstärke und Empathie: Du hörst aufmerksam zu, versetzt dich in deine Kunden hinein und erklärst komplexe finanzielle oder technische Themen einfach und verständlich.

  • Lust, selbst anzupacken: Du möchtest Teil eines Teams sein, das in Deutschland noch am Anfang steht und wächst. Du ergreifst die Initiative, denkst in Lösungen und hast Freude daran, Prozesse von Grund auf mitzugestalten.

  • Reisebereitschaft: Du freust dich darauf, unser Team beim Onboarding im Pariser Headquarter kennenzulernen, und bist bereit, gelegentlich Kunden in Deutschland zu besuchen – etwa einmal im Monat.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder verhandlungssicherem Niveau (C2) und fließend Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren internationalen Teams.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

🏢 Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.

🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

 

Wen wir suchen

Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:

- Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).

- Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.

- Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).

- Ausreichend Erfahrung, um deine täglichen Aufgaben nach geschäftlichen Prioritäten auszurichten.

 

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

 

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

title: Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Location: UK. Fully remote, or from our London office next to East Croydon Station

Working pattern: Fully remote working is allowed, and the London office is available to you

Reports to: CTO

About Us

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities.

With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

Role Overview

You will build the products drivers and car park operators use every day: ANPR camera enforcement, pay-by-web, Autopay, permits, a client console and a motorist account app, across about 160 sites, and the new products we build next. We are a small engineering team, and we form teams around the work from the people we have.

We work in Kotlin on the backend (Spring Boot WebFlux, a domain-driven layering of domain, edge services and repository, Postgres, Axon event sourcing and Pub/Sub) and in TypeScript with Next.js and React on the front end, on GCP and Kubernetes. You do not need to know Kotlin to apply. Our engineers work with AI coding agents day to day, and we are looking for people who use them well and check what they produce.

Every engineer here is product-minded. You will talk to the people who use what you build, decide with product people what is worth building, and find out afterwards whether it worked.

You will report to the CTO and work with a team that reviews each other’s work.

The Mid-level

Mid-level Software Engineer. You own features end to end: you shape them with a product person, build them, test them, release them and look after them once they are live. You work inside an existing architecture with senior review. The work is mostly Kotlin backend plus Next.js and React front end.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the delivery of what you are given, from the first ticket to production, with tests, and be the person who fixes it if it breaks.

  • Talk to the people who use what you build, and use what you learn to shape and cut scope.

  • Write acceptance criteria, and check a feature after release to see whether it was used and whether it worked.

  • Work in our existing codebase and its layering, and keep it consistent for the next engineer.

  • Use AI coding agents as part of how you work, and be accountable for everything you ship, however it was written.

  • Take part in the on-call rota and look after what you ship.

  • Review other engineers’ pull requests, and welcome review of your own.

Who we’re looking for

  • You’re product-minded. In the last 12 months you’ve talked to real users or customers, and what you learned changed or cut the scope of what you built. You write acceptance criteria, you check a feature after release, and you can say whether something you shipped got used.

  • You’ve shipped production code end to end in the last 12 months, in any language. You can say what you personally built, and what happened after it went live.

  • You test as you build. You can describe a bug you shipped and the test that would have caught it.

  • You use AI coding agents in real work today, and you can describe how you check what they produce, including a time one was wrong.

  • You’re willing to be on call, and you take ownership of what you ship. You don’t need to have been on call before.

  • You work well in an existing codebase with a layered or domain-driven structure that you did not design, and you read before you write.

  • You’re comfortable across the stack. You’ve changed a React or Next.js front end, or worked properly against an API contract, even if you lean backend.

  • You review others’ pull requests, finding real problems and saying so well, and you change your own design when review shows you a better way.

You do not need a degree, a particular programming language, or Kotlin. Experience of Axon, Temporal, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, parking or payments is welcome, but none of it is required.

This advert is for the Mid-level. If you have more senior experience, see our Senior Software Engineer vacancy here.

What We Offer

  • Real ownership: mid-level engineers own whole features, and senior engineers own a product area.

  • A team that works with AI coding agents every day and measures what they do for us.

  • A strong, high performing culture, with genuine influence over how that culture develops as Hozah grows.

  • Fully remote working in the UK, with access to a fully refurbished, modern office, right next to East Croydon Station (with a fully stocked kitchen, offering free breakfast, lunch and drinks!).

title: Solutions Architect
descriptionHtml:
About LiveKit

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the agentic era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe AI agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice and agentic AI applications for OpenAI, Salesforce, Spotify, Meta, and tens of thousands of other developers, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

 

About This Role

We're hiring a Solutions Architect (Pre-Sales) to be the technical partner to the engineers and enterprises building on LiveKit.

You'll work alongside an account executive to understand what a customer is trying to build, design the right architecture, and bring it to life with live demos and proofs-of-concept — guiding teams from first conversation to production.

This role is ideal for someone who loves to build, is energized by talking with other engineers, and takes pride in turning a hard technical problem into something that just works. Real-time voice and video is visceral — latency, quality, and reliability are felt, not read about — so the best conversations include something live. You'll collaborate closely with our Sales, Engineering, Product teams to win technical decisions and to make sure what you hear in the field informs how we build.

You'll thrive here if you:

  • love to build and solve the most challenging customer problems with LiveKit

  • have a curious mind with a continuous desire to learn and improve

  • enjoy demoing and presenting, whether to a room or engineer, to a CTO or at a conference

  • have a team first mentality, seeking to lift others around you as you progress in your career

 

What You'll Do

  • Partner with an account executive as the technical lead on strategic deals — from discovery and architecture design through demos, POCs, and technical decisions

  • Advise customers on cloud architecture and deployment across self-hosted and LiveKit Cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure)

  • Build live demos and reference applications — voice agents, video pipelines, telephony integrations — tailored to each customer's use case, and reusable by the wider team

  • Scope and run proofs-of-concept against clear, shared success criteria, guiding customers all the way to production

  • Reason with customers about connectivity, infrastructure, and end-to-end latency to design for scale and reliability

  • Create technical content — blog posts, guides, webinars, and conference talks — that helps developers and enterprises build with LiveKit

  • Act as the technical enabler for your region's pod, and share field insight with Product and Engineering to help shape the roadmap

 

Who You Are

  • 4+ years in solutions architecture, sales engineering, or a customer-facing engineering role (or equivalent hands-on engineering experience with strong customer instincts)

  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — you can architect, deploy, and debug real applications

  • Comfortable with the modern deployment toolchain: containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, and networking fundamentals (load balancing, DNS, firewalls/NAT)

  • Able to reason about connectivity, infrastructure, and latency end to end — how architecture, network path, compute, co-location, and model choice shape the AI agentic experiences of today

  • Strong programming ability in at least one of our core SDK languages — Python, TypeScript/Node, or Go

  • A clear communicator who can demo, present, and write for technical audiences

 

Nice to Have

  • Working knowledge of real-time media protocols and their latency/quality trade-offs (WebRTC, RTP/SRTP, WebSockets)

  • Familiarity with the AI voice stack: STT/TTS providers, LLM integration, speech-to-speech models, turn detection, and telephony/SIP

  • Experience speaking at meetups or conferences, or a track record of technical writing or open-source contributions

 

Our Commitment to You

  • An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

  • Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Health, dental, and vision benefits

  • Flexible vacation policy

descriptionHtml:
About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️

Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!

We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates.

With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️

Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation.

Your Role

As Senior Product Manager for one of our Revenue Management teams at RoomPriceGenie, you'll own the experience where hoteliers see, trust and act on our AI-powered pricing, both in our app and embedded in our partners' PMSs through Revenue Intelligence. This is not a feature-delivery role. We're looking for a senior PM who sets the strategy and direction, makes hard trade-offs, and turns complex pricing logic into decisions a hotelier can make in seconds.

You'll lead a team of engineers, collaborate closely with design and research and work closely with leadership, Account Management, Integrations, Customer Success and Sales. Your mission: make RoomPriceGenie the pricing tool thousands of independent hotels rely on every day.

What you'll do

Product Vision & Strategy

  • Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area, anchored in clear business goals: adoption, retention, revenue uplift and expansion.

  • Decide what not to build, and bring stakeholders along on why.

  • Shape how pricing shows up across surfaces, from our core app to partner integrations and multi-property accounts.

  • Champion simplicity and explainability: hoteliers should understand why a price was recommended and feel confident acting on it.

Discovery & Delivery

  • Talk to hoteliers regularly and, with UX research, turn hidden friction in their revenue management workflows into strategy, not just backlog items.

  • Work closely with the other RM team to turn forecasting and pricing model output into clear experiences that build trust and drive action.

  • Drive solutions end to end, from opportunity assessment to measured impact, knowing when to move fast and when to dig deeper.

Your Profile

  • A track record of making complex systems radically simple

  • Comfortable setting strategy in ambiguous spaces and making trade-offs with incomplete information.

  • Genuine excitement about how AI is reshaping software and how it´s build.

  • Plus: Experience in hospitality tech, revenue management systems or pricing.

  • You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences, including leadership.

  • You're a curious, structured thinker with strong product intuition.

  • You can say no to a stakeholder and keep the relationship intact.

  • You ask "why" until it's clear, and explain "how" until it clicks.

  • You reflect honestly on what didn't work.

What We Offer at RoomPriceGenie 💪

At RoomPriceGenie, we don’t just offer jobs; we offer an adventure! 🚀 Join us in an exciting startup atmosphere where you can grow your career while changing the world for tens of thousands of independent hoteliers. 🌍 Our global and diverse team is fueled by passion and a shared mission. We thrive in a culture that’s all about transparency, respect, and making a real impact together.

Here’s what you can expect when you become part of our Genie family:

  • Remote-First Model: Work from (almost!) anywhere. 🌍🧑‍💻 Some roles need you in a specific country or time zone — we'll always flag that in the job ad. And whenever you like, come co-work with us in Mannheim, Berlin, or Sydney. 🏢

title: Staff Engineer | Voyagu
descriptionHtml:
Role: Staff Engineer (Integrations / Supply, air travel)

Company: Voyagu

Location: Fully remote, Europe preferred. European time zone; about two hours of difference is fine. About eight hours online, and some overlap with US time zones helps because many users are there.

Job Type: Full-time. Contract model is flexible: contractor, payroll provider or direct employment.

About Voyagu

Voyagu builds one platform that runs several travel businesses. Today the focus is air travel. The platform covers client management (CRM), ERP modules for finance and accounting, travel operations, and integrations with travel supply systems.

The model is offline travel: agencies that sell through people. Voyagu does not sell the software and does not plan to, but agencies work with it in different models. It is a bootstrap scaleup, so teams are lean and money is counted.

Development leans heavily on AI. Teams of AI agents run big features under a business operator and a technical operator. Sometimes this turns two half-years of work into two weeks. It does not always work. When code is cheap, product vision and architecture become the bottleneck, and that is where you come in.

This role owns the integrations and supply direction. Air travel alone is deep: every airline has its own distribution channels and APIs. You would lead one of five platform development streams and report to the CTO. There is no product manager in between, and you work directly with the founder and other business stakeholders. The team has no one with your profile today, so you would be the first.

What you are expected to do

Technical ownership

  • Lead the integrations and supply direction as its technical owner.

  • Build integrations with GDS systems. Voyagu works with one today and needs more.

  • Connect airline direct APIs and non-GDS protocols across multiple sources.

  • Handle servicing after sale: changes, cancellations, refunds, and group bookings split into parts.

  • Work with live, real-time availability. Seat availability does not depend on price.

  • Prevent costly errors. One missed booking can mean tens of thousands of dollars. Design for reliability, for example with idempotency, so nothing is paid or bought twice.

  • Keep the solution sized to Voyagu’s scale and avoid over-design. This is not internet-scale work.

  • Keep the system stable. Speed and error rate are the measures.

Vision and delivery

  • Shape the technical vision with stakeholders and defend it. They will challenge it.

  • Expect no ready-made tasks. Business stakeholders give you a direction, not a finished task.

  • Turn the agreed platform capabilities into features and give estimates. Several dozen capabilities are written down, such as search and booking.

  • Success means Voyagu accepts your estimates and you deliver them, or come close. Part of the plan will be agreed together with you.

AI-driven development

  • Build and direct teams of AI coding agents instead of writing code by hand.

  • Explain and defend how to use AI effectively.

  • Bring AI practices that are as good as Voyagu’s, or better.

Team

  • Lead the two people already working in this direction, once you have onboarded.

  • Hire as little as possible. Hiring is a last resort. Long term the direction may grow to one to three people.

What you need to succeed

  • You have worked in the travel domain, especially on integrations with supply systems. About two or more years is likely enough.

  • You understand booking versus ticket, and the statuses and states of each.

  • You have owned a large piece of a product, not a small slice.

  • You work at staff or senior level, as architect and technical lead.

  • You understand what Voyagu does and why, and you talk well with stakeholders.

  • You use AI well beyond the beginner level and have a clear view on how to use it effectively.

  • You believe small teams work. You do not think in big organisations.

  • You work in a European time zone; ideally you are based in Europe.

  • You speak Russian: engineering works mostly in Russian. Business teams speak English, and English B2 is enough.

  • Nice to have: you have seen both corporate and lean startup worlds, or a bootstrap scaleup. You may be an ex-founder or a small-company CTO who stayed hands-on.

  • Nice to have: you have run teams of agents, not only asked an agent to write a feature.

  • Nice to have: vendor-side experience building for end users. Python is the current main stack, but language skill is not important.

  • Not required: high-load experience, writing agent skills, or deep C#/legacy aviation knowledge.

What you get

  • You own a whole direction, with responsibility handed over fully.

  • You are the technical lead for integrations and supply, with no product-manager layer in between.

  • You work with AI agent teams. Voyagu will invest heavily in tokens and compute where it pays off.

  • You can bring AI practices better than Voyagu’s own, and the team will share theirs.

  • A large, technically hard platform: real-time inventory, many sources, money at stake.

  • A lean environment with few meetings and flexible hours.

  • Fully remote in Europe, with flexible contract models.

  • Equity is not standard, but it is negotiable for an exceptional candidate.

How to apply

Apply through hirehire, the agency running this search for Voyagu. The process has three stages: an engineering interview with the CTO, a travel-domain interview with the founder, and a practical case with a defence.

As artificial intelligence transforms how software is developed, organisations are facing unprecedented challenges around open source security, software supply chain integrity, developer productivity and governance.

Sonatype operates at the intersection of these challenges, helping some of the world's largest organisations build and deploy software securely through industry-leading software supply chain intelligence and an integrated platform spanning repository management, application security and malware prevention.

The territory presents an opportunity for a commercially ambitious seller to develop strategic enterprise relationships, challenge established technology providers and build a significant new-business pipeline.

You will own a defined portfolio of enterprise prospects, with a clear mandate to identify, develop and close new-logo opportunities.

This is not an account management position, nor is it a role designed around managing an inherited customer portfolio.

Your success will be defined by the new customers you acquire, the competitive opportunities you create and the revenue you generate.

You will be expected to operate confidently against an annual quota, bringing the commercial discipline, enterprise sales experience and competitive intensity required to deliver sustained performance.

We're particularly interested in speaking with consistently high-performing enterprise sellers who have achieved President's Club, Pinnacle Club or equivalent recognition and can demonstrate repeated success in complex, competitive technology markets.


Our role in detail:

Territory Development & Strategic New-Logo Acquisition:

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive enterprise territory strategy across prospect accounts.

  • Take full accountability for new-logo acquisition, building and converting a sustainable pipeline of high-value enterprise opportunities.

  • Identify and prioritise strategic prospects based on enterprise size, software development complexity, security maturity, competitive landscape and commercial potential.

  • Build sophisticated account plans identifying organisational structures, executive stakeholders, buying committees, incumbent technology providers and potential entry points.

  • Generate significant self-sourced pipeline through proactive outbound prospecting, executive engagement, targeted account-based campaigns and strategic networking.

  • Establish relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, VP Engineering, DevSecOps, Platform Engineering and Application Security leadership.

  • Engage enterprise prospects before formal buying processes begin, helping customers recognise challenges and opportunities they may not yet be actively addressing.

  • Collaborate with Marketing, Sales Engineering, Channel and executive leadership to develop coordinated account acquisition strategies.

  • Identify opportunities to position Sonatype's broader software supply chain platform through compelling customer-specific business cases.

  • Maintain strong commercial discipline around pipeline coverage, opportunity qualification, deal progression and forecasting.

    • Competitive Displacement & Enterprise Deal Execution:

    Competitive displacement will be a significant component of this role.

    We are looking for someone who understands the enterprise cybersecurity, DevSecOps and developer tooling landscape and is confident challenging established technology providers.

    You will be expected to:

    • Identify enterprise accounts using competing or incumbent software supply chain, repository management and application security technologies.

    • Develop account-specific competitive displacement strategies based on customer challenges, technical requirements and business outcomes.

    • Demonstrate a strong understanding of the competitive landscape, including organisations such as JFrog, Snyk, Black Duck, Mend, GitHub, GitLab, Checkmarx and Veracode.

    • Understand where Sonatype's intelligence, security capabilities, platform breadth and preventative approach provide meaningful customer differentiation.

    • Lead sophisticated enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, technical evaluations, proofs of value, procurement and executive decision-making.

    • Develop strong economic buyer relationships and build compelling financial, operational and security business cases.

    • Apply structured enterprise sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC to establish clear qualification, decision criteria, competitive positioning and mutual action plans.

    • Navigate complex negotiations and commercial discussions while maintaining strong customer relationships.

    • Build internal and external champions capable of influencing enterprise purchasing decisions.

    • Demonstrate the judgement to qualify out opportunities where genuine customer value or a viable purchasing path cannot be established.

      • We want a seller who knows how to win when the customer already has a solution, not someone who only succeeds when there is no competition.

      Industry Knowledge & Technical Credibility:

      This role requires a strong understanding of the market in which Sonatype operates.

      You should be comfortable discussing how modern enterprise organisations develop, secure and deploy software, and how AI is changing the speed and complexity of those processes.

      You will:

      • Understand the commercial and technical challenges associated with open source software, software composition analysis, DevSecOps and application security.

      • Engage confidently with technical and executive buyers around software supply chain risk, developer productivity, governance and security.

      • Position Sonatype's platform capabilities across Nexus Repository, Firewall, Lifecycle and related solutions.

      • Understand how software supply chain intelligence can help organisations identify vulnerable components, prevent malicious packages entering development and make better risk decisions.

      • Translate technical capabilities into measurable business outcomes rather than relying on feature-led selling.

      • Recognise opportunities to position Sonatype as a strategic enterprise platform rather than a standalone point solution.

      • Stay informed about emerging technology, AI-assisted development, competitive market movements and evolving enterprise security requirements.

        • Channel & Cross-Functional Enterprise Selling:

        Enterprise sales success requires the ability to bring the right expertise together around the customer.

        You will:

        • Build productive relationships with regional channel partners, systems integrators and enterprise solution providers.

        • Identify partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities that support new-logo acquisition.

        • Collaborate with Sales Engineering to develop effective technical validation strategies and proofs of value.

        • Partner with Marketing on account-based campaigns, executive engagement and targeted enterprise outreach.

        • Engage executive sponsors where appropriate to support strategic opportunities.

        • Coordinate internal resources effectively while retaining clear ownership of the commercial outcome.

        • Share competitive intelligence, customer insights and market feedback to improve Sonatype's broader enterprise go-to-market execution.

          • Role Outcomes:

          Success in this role means establishing a high-performing, predictable new-logo acquisition engine across the assigned territory.

          You will be expected to:

          • Deliver against an annual new-business quota.

          • Consistently originate and close new enterprise customer opportunities.

          • Build a sustainable, self-generated enterprise pipeline.

          • Win strategically important competitive displacement opportunities.

          • Establish relationships with senior technology and security decision-makers across priority accounts.

          • Increase Sonatype's presence within major enterprise organisations.

          • Demonstrate strong enterprise deal qualification, commercial judgement and forecast accuracy.

          • Build effective relationships with Sales Engineering, Marketing and Channel partners.

          • Create repeatable territory development and enterprise acquisition practices that support long-term growth.

            • What Success Looks Like:

            First 30 Days — Understand, Assess & Prioritise

            You will develop a deep understanding of Sonatype's technology, competitive positioning, customer value proposition and enterprise go-to-market strategy.

            You will assess your assigned territory, identify priority accounts, evaluate competitive incumbents and develop relationships with the wider Sales, Sales Engineering, Marketing and Channel teams.

            You will begin building an evidence-based view of where the strongest new-logo opportunities exist.

            First 60 Days — Build the Acquisition Strategy

            You will have developed a prioritised territory plan, identifying target accounts, executive stakeholders, competitive displacement opportunities and clear outbound engagement strategies.

            You will be actively building relationships with prospective customers, generating qualified pipeline and coordinating account-based activity with the wider go-to-market organisation.

            Your opportunities will reflect clear customer challenges, credible buying processes and measurable business value.

            First 90 Days — Demonstrate Commercial Momentum

            You will be independently driving enterprise pursuits, demonstrating meaningful self-generated pipeline creation and establishing relationships with key decision-makers.

            You will be progressing opportunities through technical validation, commercial discovery and structured enterprise qualification.

            Your territory plan, pipeline coverage and forecasting will provide leadership with confidence in your approach to delivering against quota.

            First 12 Months — Deliver High Performance

            You will have established a sustainable enterprise acquisition engine and demonstrated the ability to deliver against a quota circa $1.5-2m.

            You will have acquired new enterprise customers, progressed competitive displacement opportunities and built a strong forward-looking pipeline.

            You will be recognised for your commercial judgement, proactive hunting mentality, enterprise customer credibility and ability to win complex opportunities.

            Who You Are:

            You are an accomplished enterprise technology sales professional with a demonstrable track record of acquiring new customers, exceeding ambitious revenue targets and winning in highly competitive markets.

            You are a hunter by nature, motivated by opening doors, creating opportunities and winning business that would otherwise remain with a competitor.

            Essential Experience & Capabilities

            Proven Enterprise New-Business Performance

            • Demonstrated success carrying and achieving substantial enterprise new-business quotas, ideally around $2 million annually or at a comparable level of commercial complexity.

            • A track record of consistent quota attainment and strong new-logo acquisition.

            • Evidence of personally originating, developing and closing complex enterprise opportunities.

            • Ability to quantify pipeline creation, average contract values, competitive wins and revenue performance.

              • Consistent High Performance

              • A history of operating among the strongest performers within your sales organisation.

              • President's Club, Pinnacle Club or equivalent recognition is particularly attractive.

              • Evidence of sustained performance across multiple sales periods, rather than reliance on one exceptional transaction or favourable territory.

                • Competitive Enterprise Selling

                • Proven experience winning business against established technology providers.

                • Ability to develop differentiated competitive strategies and challenge incumbent solutions.

                • Strong negotiation, executive engagement and commercial deal leadership skills.

                  • Enterprise Territory Development

                  • Experience developing a geographic or named-account territory through proactive outbound activity.

                  • Strong account prioritisation, stakeholder mapping and territory planning.

                  • Ability to generate your own pipeline rather than relying predominantly on inbound demand.

                    • Technical & Industry Understanding

                    • Strong familiarity with cybersecurity, DevSecOps, application security, developer tooling, cloud infrastructure or adjacent enterprise technology.

                    • Confidence engaging technical and executive stakeholders in complex buying environments.

                    • Ability to translate sophisticated technical capabilities into clear commercial value.

                      • Sales Methodology & Commercial Discipline

                      • Experience applying structured enterprise qualification methodologies such as MEDDPICC.

                      • Strong forecasting, opportunity management and pipeline discipline.

                      • Ability to manage complex enterprise opportunities involving multiple stakeholders, technical evaluations and procurement processes.

                        • Preferred Experience:

                        We would particularly welcome candidates with experience from:

                        • Software supply chain security and software composition analysis.

                        • Application security and DevSecOps platforms.

                        • Repository management and developer infrastructure.

                        • Enterprise cybersecurity and cloud-native security.

                        • Enterprise platform selling and competitive displacement.

                        • Global 2000, Fortune 500 or similarly complex enterprise customers.

                        • Working with channel partners and enterprise systems integrators.

                        • Selling across the technology and enterprise ecosystem.

                        • Consumption-based, platform-led or land-and-expand commercial models.

Things that we are proud of

title: Strategic Project Lead - AI Post-Training (London)
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

The Strategic Project Lead – AI Post-Training will help lead AI companies develop and improve frontier models through high-quality data programs. We’re looking for someone with experience in AI post-training, preference data, or model evaluation to lead projects that shape how models respond, reason, and perform.

You’ll own delivery while bringing practical knowledge of the data, evaluation methods, and quality standards behind model improvement. Working closely with clients and internal teams, you’ll help translate evolving AI research needs into clear workflows, reliable datasets, and measurable outcomes.


Your Impact
  • Own end-to-end project delivery, including scope, timelines, budgets, staffing, and risk management.
  • Lead client communication, status reporting, planning sessions, and escalations.
  • Translate model improvement objectives into data requirements, workflows, rubrics, and evaluation plans.
  • Define quality standards and acceptance criteria for preference data, model comparisons, and evaluation outputs.
  • Monitor delivery quality, investigate inconsistencies, and resolve ambiguous requirements with clients.
  • Advise on data design, evaluation approaches, and project feasibility based on your domain expertise.
  • Develop reusable guidelines, SOPs, and QA frameworks to improve consistency across programs.
  • Mentor Operations Specialists and contribute to project scoping, pilots, and new capability development.

    • What You Bring
  • 1–2+ years of experience in AI data operations, project coordination, or delivery, ideally in a GenAI or frontier AI environment.
  • Familiarity with at least one AI post-training or model evaluation workflow.

  • Understanding of data quality, annotation workflows, and quality assurance methods.
  • Ability to translate evolving requirements into clear workflows, rubrics, and measurable quality standards.
  • Strong troubleshooting and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Interest in current AI developments, including frontier models and post-training approaches.

  • Experience assessing model responses for quality, accuracy, reasoning, or instruction following.
  • Exposure to AI companies, frontier AI labs, or model evaluation programs.
  • Bilingual capabilities, particularly German or a Nordic language.

    • Why You'll Love Working Here

    At Appen, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We value curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to delivering the highest quality AI solutions for frontier models.

You'll have the flexibility to deliver in a way that works for you and your team, supported by tools, resources, and development opportunities to continue to build your capability over time.

Our AI assisted data annotation platform and global crowd of more than 1 million contributors in over 200 countries support model pre training, supervised fine tuning, evaluation and benchmarking, safety and red teaming, and multilingual global expansion.

descriptionHtml:
AGFH huishoudelijke hulp

Ons doel is ervoor te zorgen dat mensen die ondersteuning nodig hebben, kunnen wonen op de plek waar zij zich het meest op hun gemak voelen – thuis. Sinds 2018 zijn wij met meer dan 14.000 medewerkers uitgegroeid tot de toonaangevende aanbieder van huishoudelijke hulp en dagelijkse begeleiding in Duitsland, waar wij ruim 114.000 cliënten ondersteunen.
Wil je werk doen dat er echt toe doet? Dan ben je bij ons aan het juiste adres!

Onze spirit

  • We hebben teamgeest en weten dat we samen de beste resultaten behalen

  • We bouwen op waardering, respect, motivatie, vertrouwen en verantwoordelijkheid

  • We communiceren eerlijk en fair

  • We maken fouten, maar leren daarvan

  • We stimuleren individuele talenten

  • We zijn intercultureel

Dit bieden wij je

  • Flexibele werktijden en werkdagen – maandag t/m vrijdag, afgestemd op jouw wensen en de personeelsbehoefte

  • Arbeidsovereenkomst – een nulurencontract voor onbepaalde tijd met een schriftelijk overeengekomen proeftijd van twee maanden

  • Salaris volgens de cao VVT – inschaling volgens de FWG VVT, op basis van je functie, relevante werkervaring en aantoonbare kwalificaties

  • Vakantiegeld en eindejaarsuitkering – 8% vakantiegeld en 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering, met inachtneming van de minimumbedragen uit de cao VVT

  • Pensioenopbouw – volgens de geldende pensioenregeling

  • Reiskostenvergoeding – vanaf je eerste werkdag ontvang je een vergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer, reizen naar en tussen cliënten of locaties en dienstreizen, volgens de geldende bepalingen van de cao VVT

  • Fiets- en scootervergoeding – extra vergoeding bij gebruik van een fiets, e-bike, bromfiets of scooter

  • Digitaal onboardingprogramma – met e-learnings en leermogelijkheden voor je professionele ontwikkeling

  • Persoonlijke trainingen en begeleiding – je kunt rekenen op individuele ondersteuning en begeleiding door onze teamcoördinatoren

  • Teamevenementen – zoals het zomerfeest en kerstfeest

  • Werksfeer – een open, divers en dynamisch team en zinvol werk


Je rol

  • Je bent het gezicht van het bureau voor huishoudelijke hulp in jouw regio

  • Marketing- en verkoopactiviteiten – opbouwen van je eigen team van huishoudelijke hulpen en cliënten

  • Coördinatie van je team – zorgen voor begeleiding van alle cliënten die ondersteuning nodig hebben in jouw gebied

  • Contactpersoon voor jouw gebied – je vertegenwoordigt jouw gebied bij alle zaken en beslissingen richting de Centrale

Natuurlijk sta je er niet alleen voor. Ons team op de Centrale ondersteunt je actief bij de uitbreiding van je gebied en bij het aansturen van je team.

Wat je meebrengt

  • Open houding, communicatief sterk en plezier in contact met mensen

  • Nauwkeurige, gestructureerde en betrouwbare manier van werken

  • Motivatie om nieuwe dingen te leren – ervaring in de sociale sector is een plus, maar geen vereiste

  • Interesse om contacten te leggen en je netwerk uit te breiden

  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk (minimaal C1)

Solliciteer nu en verander je leven!

title: Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties
descriptionHtml:
Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties

Ben jij een ervaren installatietechnicus die klaar is voor een leidinggevende rol? Of geef je al leiding aan monteurs en wil je meer verantwoordelijkheid binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek? Dan hebben we bij Campus Installatietechniek in Barneveld een mooie uitdaging voor je! Als Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties combineer je jouw technische kennis met het aansturen en begeleiden van een team monteurs. Je zorgt dat werkzaamheden goed worden voorbereid, projecten volgens planning verlopen en jouw collega's hun werk optimaal kunnen uitvoeren. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen de monteurs, werkvoorbereiding, projectleiding en opdrachtgevers. Daarbij houd je overzicht, denk je mee over technische oplossingen en zorg je voor een prettige samenwerking.

Wat we je bieden

Bij Campus Installatietechniek krijg je de ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, jouw team verder te ontwikkelen en mee te bouwen aan mooie installatieprojecten. Daar staat natuurlijk iets tegenover:

  • Een goed salaris dat past bij jouw kennis, ervaring en verantwoordelijkheden;

  • Een afwisselende functie voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

  • Veel zelfstandigheid en vrijheid om jouw werkzaamheden te organiseren;

  • Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden;

  • Afwisselende projecten binnen de utiliteitsbouw en gebouwgebonden installatietechniek;

  • Opleidingen, cursussen en doorgroeimogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen;

  • Moderne middelen en gereedschappen om je werk goed uit te voeren;

  • Een informele werksfeer met betrokken collega's en korte communicatielijnen;

  • De voordelen en ontwikkelmogelijkheden van de VDK Groep, gecombineerd met de persoonlijke sfeer van Campus.

Wat je gaat doen

Als Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing en coördinatie van werkzaamheden binnen verschillende installatieprojecten. Je zorgt dat jouw team weet wat er moet gebeuren en dat projecten veilig, efficiënt en volgens afspraak worden uitgevoerd.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Aansturen, begeleiden en motiveren van monteurs en technici;

  • Coördineren en verdelen van werkzaamheden binnen werktuigbouwkundige installatieprojecten;

  • Bewaken van de planning, voortgang, kwaliteit, veiligheid en kosten;

  • Afstemmen met projectleiders, werkvoorbereiders, opdrachtgevers en leveranciers;

  • Zorgen dat materialen, informatie en middelen tijdig beschikbaar zijn;

  • Meedenken over technische vraagstukken rondom klimaatinstallaties, verwarming en luchtbehandeling;

  • Signaleren van verbeterkansen en bijdragen aan efficiëntere werkprocessen;

  • Onderhouden van goede contacten met klanten en andere betrokken partijen.

Je staat dicht bij de techniek, maar houdt tegelijkertijd het overzicht over het grotere geheel. Dankzij jouw inzet kunnen de monteurs hun werk goed uitvoeren en worden projecten succesvol opgeleverd.


Wat neem je mee?

Je hebt een stevige technische basis binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek en vindt het leuk om collega's aan te sturen en verder te helpen. Je kunt goed organiseren, communiceert duidelijk en weet ook bij onverwachte situaties het overzicht te bewaren.

Daarnaast herken jij jezelf in het volgende:

  • Een afgeronde mbo- of hbo-opleiding richting installatietechniek, werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbaar;

  • Enkele jaren werkervaring binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek, bijvoorbeeld als Eerste Monteur, Leidinggevend Monteur of Teamleider;

  • Kennis van gebouwgebonden installaties, zoals verwarmingsinstallaties, klimaatinstallaties en luchtbehandeling;

  • Leidinggevende kwaliteiten en het vermogen om collega's te motiveren;

  • Organisatorisch inzicht en een goed gevoel voor planning en kwaliteit;

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een klantgerichte instelling;

  • Een proactieve houding en het vermogen om technische en organisatorische uitdagingen op te lossen.

Heb je ruime ervaring als Eerste Monteur of Leidinggevend Monteur en ben je toe aan een volgende stap? Ook dan komen we graag met je in contact!

Waar ga je het doen?

Campus Installatietechniek is een installatiebedrijf gevestigd in Barneveld. We werken aan uiteenlopende werktuigbouwkundige installaties binnen de utiliteit en gebouwgebonden installatietechniek.Bij Campus houden we van korte lijnen, duidelijke afspraken en een praktische aanpak. We zorgen voor een goede voorbereiding en ondersteunen elkaar waar nodig. Hierdoor kunnen onze monteurs zich richten op hun vak en kunnen projecten efficiënt worden uitgevoerd.

Als Teamleider krijg je de ruimte om mee te denken, verbeteringen door te voeren en jouw eigen stempel te drukken op de dagelijkse werkzaamheden. Je werkt samen met betrokken collega's die elkaar kennen, helpen en samen zorgen voor tevreden klanten.

Wij zijn een trots onderdeel van de snelgroeiende VDK Groep (185 bedrijven, 9.000 collega’s), maar opereren met een eigen identiteit en cultuur. title: Teamleiter Kalkulation Schlüsselfertiger Hochbau (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Teamleiter Kalkulation Schlüsselfertiger Hochbau (m/w/d)

Standort: Berlin | Vollzeit | Unbefristet

Für unseren Mandanten, ein etabliertes Bauunternehmen im Bereich schlüsselfertiger Hochbau mit anspruchsvollen Projekten ausschließlich im Berliner Raum und modernen, digital geprägten Planungs- und Bauprozessen, suchen wir im exklusiven Auftrag zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Teamleiter Kalkulation (m/w/d). Das Unternehmen steht für ein positives Betriebsklima, offene Kommunikation und eine Kultur, in der individuelle Entwicklung aktiv gefördert wird. Sie erwartet eine Führungsposition mit echtem Handlungsspielraum und Rückhalt durch erfahrene Führungskräfte, bei Projekten mit Volumina von ca. 20 bis 150 Mio. €.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Teamführung: Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung des Kalkulationsteams sowie Organisation des operativen Tagesgeschäfts

  • Mitarbeiterentwicklung: Begleitung der fachlichen Entwicklung der Mitarbeitenden und Umsetzung individueller Entwicklungsmaßnahmen in enger Abstimmung mit dem Leiter Angebotsbearbeitung

  • Ressourcensteuerung: Projektbezogene Zuordnung der Kalkulatoren sowie Priorisierung und Steuerung der laufenden Kalkulationsaufgaben

  • Kalkulationssteuerung: Koordination und Qualitätssicherung der Kalkulation anspruchsvoller schlüsselfertiger Hochbauprojekte innerhalb des übergeordneten Angebotsprozesses

  • Qualität & Plausibilisierung: Bewertung wesentlicher Kalkulationsansätze, Mengen, Kostenkennwerte und Annahmen

  • Preiskommissionen: Vorbereitung der Kalkulatoren und ihrer Projekte auf die internen Preiskommissionen sowie Aufbereitung von Chancen, Risiken und wesentlichen Kalkulationsannahmen

  • Risiken & Chancen: Sicherstellung einer strukturierten Identifikation und Bewertung technischer und wirtschaftlicher Projektrisiken und -chancen

  • Schnittstellenmanagement: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Leiter Angebotsbearbeitung sowie mit Ausschreibung/Vergabe, Einkauf, Arbeitsvorbereitung, Projektleitung und Management

  • BIM & Digitalisierung: Weiterentwicklung der Zusammenarbeit zwischen BIM-Modellierung und Kalkulation sowie schrittweise Verbesserung modellbasierter Kalkulationsprozesse

  • Prozessentwicklung: Weiterentwicklung und Standardisierung von Kalkulationsmethoden, Kennwerten, Vorlagen und digitalen Arbeitsabläufen, insbesondere in RIB iTWO

  • Verhandlungen: Fachliche Unterstützung bei Bietergesprächen und Auftragsverhandlungen

Ihr Profil

  • Fachliche Qualifikation: Abgeschlossenes Studium des Bauingenieurwesens, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens Bau oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation, beispielsweise als Bautechniker

  • Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige, fundierte Erfahrung in der Kalkulation anspruchsvoller Hochbauprojekte, idealerweise im schlüsselfertigen Hochbau auf Seiten eines Generalunternehmers oder Generalübernehmers

  • Führungserfahrung: Erfahrung in der fachlichen und/oder disziplinarischen Führung sowie Freude daran, Mitarbeitende im operativen Alltag anzuleiten, Verantwortung zu übertragen und ihre Entwicklung gemeinsam mit der übergeordneten Führungskraft zu begleiten

  • Kalkulationskompetenz: Sicheres Verständnis von Mengen, Leistungen, Kostenstrukturen, Nachunternehmerleistungen sowie technischen und wirtschaftlichen Projektrisiken

  • Digitale Kompetenz: Sehr gute Kenntnisse moderner Kalkulationsprozesse. Erfahrung mit RIB iTWO sowie modellbasierter Kalkulation / BIM ist von Vorteil

  • Unternehmerisches Denken: Ausgeprägtes wirtschaftliches Verständnis, analytische Stärke und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte auf die entscheidenden Stellhebel zu reduzieren

  • Persönlichkeit: Klarer, verbindlicher Führungsstil, Entscheidungsstärke und souveräne Kommunikation gegenüber Mitarbeitenden, Projektteams, Geschäftspartnern und Management

Ihre Vorteile

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Leistungsbezogene Bonusmodelle sowie weitere Zusatzleistungen, darunter vermögenswirksame Leistungen und ein Zuschuss zu einem Fitness- und Gesundheitsprogramm

  • Anspruchsvolle Projekte: Hochbauprojekte mit Volumina von ca. 20 bis 150 Mio. € und entsprechend vielseitigen technischen und organisatorischen Herausforderungen

  • Arbeiten in Berlin statt auf Montage: Projekte ausschließlich im Berliner Raum, ohne lange Reisetätigkeiten oder bundesweite Baustelleneinsätze

  • Entwicklung mit klarem Zielbild: Gemeinsam erstellte Entwicklungspläne, die Ihre Stärken und Interessen mit den aktuellen und zukünftigen Anforderungen Ihrer Rolle verbinden

  • Verantwortung mit Rückhalt: Der nötige Handlungsspielraum für Ihre Aufgaben und der Zugriff auf die Erfahrung von Führungskräften und Kollegen

  • Teamkultur: Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier und ein jährliches gemeinsames Wochenende außerhalb der Stadt

  • Stabilität: Sicherer Arbeitsplatz mit langfristiger Perspektive, getragen von einer nachhaltigen Unternehmensentwicklung und einer stabilen Projektbasis

Hypertrics GmbH
Schürmannstraße 22a
45136 Essen

title: Technical Account Manager- DACH
descriptionHtml:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionaryin 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

At Camunda, our Technical Account Managers (TAMs) are trusted technical advisors, partnering closely with our most strategic customers to help them turn their process orchestration vision into measurable business value. In this highly impactful role, you’ll be “in the boat together” with clients from day one – navigating technical challenges, providing expert guidance, and ensuring smooth adoption of our platform at scale. Success means building lasting relationships, accelerating customer outcomes, and making complex technology feel approachable for diverse teams. If you thrive on collaboration, love solving unique challenges, and are excited to empower companies across industries, we want you on our fast-growing, innovative Customer Success team.

What You Will Do

  • Serve as the primary technical contact and trusted advisor for designated enterprise customers, leading them through all stages of their Camunda adoption journey

  • Guide the creation and execution of tailored technical adoption plans, designed to maximize business outcomes and ensure long-term success

  • Deliver hands-on technical guidance, best practices, and advisory services to both business and technical stakeholders – from onboarding through ongoing operations

  • Identify and remove execution risks by proactively conducting platform and solution health checks, facilitating escalation management, and advocating for customer needs internally

  • Foster strong, collaborative relationships with cross-functional Camunda teams such as Customer Success Managers, Consulting, Support, Product, Engineering, Sales and Pre-Sales to drive measurable customer outcomes at scale

  • Regularly spend time on-site with accounts for key milestone interactions (as needed, up to 50% during busy periods) to deepen partnerships and accelerate strategic initiatives

What You Will Bring to the Role

  • At least 3 years of experience as a Technical Account Manager or a directly comparable role in enterprise software

  • Demonstrated technical expertise: hands-on with a high-level programming language (such as Java, C#, or Python) and relevant enterprise software frameworks

  • Solid understanding of modern solution architectures and associated paradigms, including DevOps topics (especially Kubernetes)

  • A proven track record of building trusted relationships and providing advisory services to both technical and business stakeholders—able to synthesize and explain complex

  • issues clearly to varied audiences

  • Strategic problem solving competencies with a collaborative, impact-driven mindset; comfortable tailoring approaches to unique customer situations

  • Willingness and flexibility to spend time on-site with clients as account needs dictate (up to 50% during busy periods)

  • Fluency in German

Nice to haves:

  • Experience in enterprise automation, business process management, process orchestration, or robotic process automation

  • Relevant industry certifications (AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, CKAD, CKA, etc.)

  • Familiarity with Camunda products

This role is an existing vacancy
