What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

  • United States: $150,100.00 to $242,000.00

  • United Kingdom: £94,200.00 to £155,000.00

  • Singapore: S$186,400.00 to S$279,600.00

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

AI in our hiring process:Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here

”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

Come join us and be part of Camunda’s incredible journey: Make an impact at a pivotal moment in our story!

Please be aware that scammers may impersonate Camunda by reaching out about job opportunities. Camunda will only contact candidates from an email address ending in @camunda.com or @talent.camunda.com. We will never ask candidates for bank account details, checks, payment, or other sensitive financial information as part of our hiring process. If you receive a suspicious message, please do not respond, click any links, or share personal information.

Note for recruiting and placement agencies: Camunda does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our careers site, employees, or any other Camunda contact unless we have specifically engaged your firm for that search. Camunda will not pay fees related to unsolicited resumes.

For information about how your personal data is processed, please refer to Camunda’s Applicant Privacy Policy. We note that phone numbers and SMS opt-in data are not shared, sold, or rented to third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes.

By opting in to SMS use, please be aware that:

  • By opting in, you will be enrolled directly in ongoing recruiting text messages from Camunda.

title: Technical Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

You'll co-own the roadmap with the Product Manager and you'll specifically own delivery health and technical outcomes. The role combines people leadership with hands-on technical accountability.

  • Reports to - Head of Engineering / Director of Engineering

  • Team span - 1 Engineering Team

  • Works closely with - Product Manager (equal counterpart on the team)

  • Role type - Full-time, people leadership with hands-on technical accountability

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Co-own the roadmap with your Product Manager, balancing delivery, quality and technical health as genuine equals.

  • Own delivery health for your team - predictability, throughput and the quality of what ships.

  • Hold technical accountability by default. Ownership of technical quality of the teams work, including architecture and SLOs

  • Stay close to the codebase so you can make informed calls on technical trade-offs, risk and quality.

  • Read code, review PRs and pair-programme regularly, both to maintain technical quality and to mentor engineers.

  • Manage, coach and develop the engineers on your team, and own hiring from sourcing through to close.

  • Set and track team-level goals in partnership with your direct reports.

  • Own your team's budget, including software spend and headcount planning.

  • Own SLOs and operational health for the systems your team is responsible for.

  • Drive adoption of AI tooling and practices within your team.

 

REQUIREMENTS - TECHNICAL BAR

  • Read and understand code across the team's primary stack.

  • Pair-programme effectively with engineers on real work.

  • Review pull requests with meaningful, technically credible feedback.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Previous experience managing engineers, ideally within a product-led organisation.

  • A track record of owning delivery outcomes, not just team happiness and process.

  • Comfort holding both the people and technical threads of a team at once.

  • Experience (or real enthusiasm for) hiring, budget ownership, and operational metrics like SLOs.

SUCCESS IN THE ROLE

  • Your team ships predictably, and you can speak to technical trade-offs as fluently as delivery ones.

  • Engineers on your team are growing, well-supported, and clear on how they're doing.

  • Your roadmap decisions hold up because you and your PM are genuinely aligned

 

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Fully remote working

  • Competitive salary to fund that dream holiday to Bali

  • Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Bupa Private Healthcare, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

  • Life Assurance for (even more) peace of mind

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays

    • 28 days annual leave

    • 1 day for your wedding

    • 1 day off when you move house - because moving is hard enough without work!

    • For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year

    • For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year

    • Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year

  • Work from abroad for a month

  • Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

  • The latest tech (Macbook or Surface) to power your gif-sending talents

  • Up to £500/€550 home office allowance for that massage chair you’ve been talking about

  • Generous learning and development budget to help you master your craft

  • Regular social events: tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, lunch 8 learns, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for

  • Refer a friend, get paid. Repeat for infinite money

We know that diverse teams are strong teams, so we welcome those with alternative identities, backgrounds, and experiences to apply for this position. We make recruiting decisions based on experience, skills and potential, so all our applicants are treated fairly and equally.

title: Website Growth Marketing Manager (m/w/d) - Germany
descriptionHtml:
Möchtest du das tägliche Leben von Millionen von Unternehmern in Deutschland (und bald in Europa) beeinflussen? Suchst du nach einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Vertrauen, Proaktivität und Autonomie schätzt? Stimmen unsere Company Values mit deiner Vision überein? Dann ist Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich!

 

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

 

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 1 300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

Dein Team und Umfeld

Pennylane wächst international: Nach Frankreich bauen wir unsere Websites und Conversion-Funnels für Spanien, Deutschland und die USA aus. Deutschland ist dabei ein strategischer Fokusmarkt. Dafür suchen wir dich: Du entwickelst die deutsche Website als eigenständiges Produkt weiter – mit einem klaren Blick auf den Markt, unsere Zielgruppen und ihre Bedürfnisse.

Du wirst Teil unseres Website-Teams im Bereich Growth und berichtest direkt an den Head of Growth. Gemeinsam mit Growth Engineers und Designern arbeitest du in einer festen Squad. Dabei bist du täglich mittendrin, packst selbst mit an und bringst Verbesserungen gemeinsam mit deinem Team live.

Deine Mission

Du verantwortest und optimierst die Conversion-Rate unserer Websites für den deutschen Markt: pennylane.com/de und start.pennylane.com. Für jede Zielgruppe schaffst du ein passendes Nutzererlebnis: Selbstständige, kleine und mittlere Unternehmen, größere Mittelständler und Steuerkanzleien.

Von der ersten Analyse bis zur umgesetzten Verbesserung liegt der gesamte Prozess bei dir. Du erkennst Hürden, entwickelst die Strategie, testest neue Ansätze und machst ihren Erfolg messbar.

Deine Aufgaben

1. Conversion optimieren und kontinuierlich experimentieren

  • Du entwickelst die Conversion-Strategie für den deutschen Funnel – von der Startseite über Preis- und Produktseiten bis zur Demo-Buchung und eigenständigen Registrierung.

  • Du treibst einen kontinuierlichen A/B-Testprozess voran: Ideen entwickeln, Tests planen, live bringen, auswerten und weiterentwickeln. Laufende Experimente gehören für dich zum Alltag.

  • Mit Analytics, Heatmaps und Verhaltensanalysen identifizierst du Hürden und Potenziale entlang der Nutzerreise, unter anderem mit Amplitude und Tracking-Daten.

  • Du führst ein umfassendes CRO-Audit der deutschen Website durch und vergleichst Funnel, Preisseite und Startseite mit führenden B2B-Websites.

2. Die deutsche Website als Produkt weiterentwickeln

  • Du verantwortest die Roadmap der deutschen Website und priorisierst nach Wirkung und Umsetzbarkeit.

  • Du entwickelst das Portal für Steuerkanzleien, die Marketplace-Integration und den Demo-Buchungsprozess für den deutschen Markt weiter.

  • Du verantwortest unser CMS Contentful: von einer klaren Struktur über wiederverwendbare Komponenten bis zum Aufbau neuer Seiten.

  • Gemeinsam mit Growth Engineering verantwortest du den gesamten Self-Service-Registrierungsprozess für Deutschland: das deutsche Formular, die automatische Ergänzung von Unternehmensdaten und eindeutige Unternehmenszuordnung über Northdata, die Datenübertragung an Salesforce und die Kontoerstellung über die Produkt-API.

3. Die Umsetzung im Team vorantreiben

  • Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit von UX, Engineering und Data – mit einem priorisierten Backlog, klaren Spezifikationen, konsequenter Nachverfolgung und Qualitätssicherung.

  • Du moderierst Weeklys, Dailys und Retros und sorgst dafür, dass Tickets zügig von der Planung bis zur Veröffentlichung vorankommen.

  • Du koordinierst Content, Product Marketing und Lokalisierung: von der KI-gestützten Übersetzung über die Prüfung durch Muttersprachler bis zur Integration ins CMS.

  • Du nutzt KI, um Prozesse und Reporting zu automatisieren.

4. Teams und Stakeholder zusammenbringen

  • Du arbeitest eng mit SEO, SEA, Content, Product Marketing, Product, Legal und dem deutschen Marktteam zusammen – unter anderem an Landingpages zu RFE, Compte Pro und E-Rechnung.

  • Du bringst unterschiedliche Stakeholder auf einen gemeinsamen Kurs und gewinnst ihre Unterstützung, auch ohne disziplinarische Führungsverantwortung.

  • Du kommunizierst Prioritäten, Zeitpläne und wichtige Neuerungen klar und teamübergreifend.

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung mit messbarer Wirkung: Du hast 3–4 Jahre Erfahrung im Product Management oder in der Conversion-Rate-Optimierung, idealerweise im B2B-SaaS- oder B2C-Umfeld. Du hast Features von der Idee bis zum Launch verantwortet und kannst anhand konkreter Kennzahlen zeigen, was sich dadurch verbessert hat.

  • Eigenständiger Umgang mit Daten und CRO-Tools: Du arbeitest sicher mit Tools wie Amplitude, GA4, Contentsquare oder Hotjar. Du ziehst deine Daten selbst, erkennst Muster und leitest Hypothesen ab, ohne auf eine Analyse durch andere angewiesen zu sein.

  • Fundierte A/B-Testing-Kenntnisse: Du weißt, wie du die nötige Stichprobengröße bestimmst, eine klare Erfolgskennzahl definierst und typische Fehler vermeidest – etwa Tests aufgrund vorläufiger Ergebnisse zu früh zu beenden oder mit zu kleinen Stichproben zu arbeiten.

  • Klare Kommunikation: Du schreibst präzise Briefings für Designer, erklärst Priorisierungsentscheidungen auch gegenüber skeptischen Stakeholdern und präsentierst Ergebnisse verständlich für ein nichttechnisches Publikum.

  • Sprachkenntnisse und Marktverständnis: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder vergleichbarem Niveau und kennst den deutschen Markt. Für die internationale Zusammenarbeit bringst du verhandlungssicheres Englisch mit. Französisch ist ein Plus.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

🏢 Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.

🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

 

Wen wir suchen

Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:

- Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).

- Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.

- Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).

- Ausreichend Erfahrung, um deine täglichen Aufgaben nach geschäftlichen Prioritäten auszurichten.

 

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

 

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) – Finance & Beratung (unternehmerisch, leistungsbasiert)
descriptionHtml:
Du studierst und willst mehr als einen „Nebenjob“? Du willst Verantwortung, klare Ziele und ein Umfeld, in dem Leistung zählt? Dann ist diese Werkstudentenrolle dein Einstieg in die Finanzberatung, mit strukturiertem Onboarding, Coaching und einem klaren Weg in ein Trainee-Programm.

Diese Rolle ist unternehmerisch geprägt und bietet dir die Möglichkeit, dich aktiv einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. Leistung und Eigeninitiative spielen dabei eine zentrale Rolle, gleichzeitig wirst du durch strukturiertes Onboarding, Coaching und ein erfahrenes Team unterstützt.

Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1+) sind erforderlich, da die Ausbildung, die Kommunikation im Team sowie die Perspektive Richtung IHK vollständig auf Deutsch stattfinden.

Dein Aufgabenbereich

Startphase (erste Wochen):

  • Terminaufbau: Du vereinbarst Kundentermine (Telefon, Netzwerk, Leads) und baust eine saubere Pipeline auf.

  • Prozesslernen: Du lernst Gesprächsleitfäden, Bedarfsermittlung, Nachbereitung und Dokumentationsstandards.

  • Performance-Optimierung: Du arbeitest mit KPIs, bekommst Feedback und verbesserst systematisch deine Ergebnisse.

Im weiteren Verlauf:

  • Analyse & Vorbereitung: Du unterstützt bei der Analyse von Kundensituationen und bereitest Beratungsunterlagen strukturiert vor.

  • Kundenkontakt: Du begleitest Gespräche (je nach Stand), übernimmst Follow-ups und sorgst für klare nächste Schritte.

  • Dokumentation & Organisation: Du hältst Prozesse sauber, dokumentierst konsequent und stellst Verlässlichkeit sicher.

  • Teamarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit einem leistungsstarken Team und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgabenpakete.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Strukturierter Einstieg: Trainingsplan, Leitfäden, klare Standards

  • Mentoring & Coaching: regelmäßiges Feedback, klare Ziele

  • Leistungsorientierte Vergütung (Erfolgslogik – du wirst für Output belohnt)

  • Skalierbare Perspektive: Option auf Übernahme ins Trainee-Programm

  • Remote möglich – eigenverantwortlich statt “nach Uhr”

  • Team mit Performance-Kultur: klare Kommunikation, klare Ergebnisse


Nichts für dich, wenn…

  • du einen typischen Werkstudentenjob mit “ein paar Stunden nebenbei” suchst

  • du Telefon/Terminaufbau vermeiden willst

  • dein Deutsch unter C1 liegt

  • du lieber Sicherheit als Entwicklung priorisierst

Muss

  • Immatrikuliert (Uni/FH)

  • Deutsch mindestens C1 (mündlich & schriftlich)

  • Kommunikationsstärke, Verbindlichkeit, Zuverlässigkeit

  • Eigeninitiative und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

  • Lust auf Leistung und messbare Ergebnisse

Wunsch

  • Erste Erfahrung in Vertrieb, Service, Beratung, Sport-/Leistungskultur

title: Reporting & Data Analyst (6-Month FTC)
descriptionHtml:
THE ROLE📝 

We’re looking for a Reporting & Data Analyst to help Form3 develop a more reliable, scalable and accessible reporting capability across the organisation. 

This is a six-month fixed-term contract with two clear priorities: completing and enhancing the Customer Service reporting suite in AWS QuickSight, and building trusted, reusable datasets that enable teams to create and maintain their own reporting. 

You’ll work across the business to improve data quality, reduce manual reporting and establish stronger documentation, governance and knowledge transfer for the future. 

  • Complete and enhance the Customer Service reporting suite and reporting deck in AWS QuickSight. 
  • Design, build and document reusable datasets for multiple reporting use cases. 
  • Integrate key business systems into curated reporting datasets. 
  • Translate stakeholder questions into clear data and dashboard requirements. 
  • Establish consistent business metrics, definitions and reporting logic. 
  • Automate manual reporting and duplicated data preparation where possible. 
  • Validate reporting outputs and investigate data-quality issues. 
  • Provide knowledge transfer to internal teams and support a longer-term reporting roadmap. 

WE’RE LOOKING FOR 🔍 

Essential 

  • Experience in a Reporting Analyst, Data Analyst, BI Analyst or similar role. 
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining dashboards using AWS QuickSight or a comparable BI platform. 
  • Practical experience using SQL and Python for reporting, data transformation or analysis. 
  • Experience working with multiple data sources and translating stakeholder requirements into accurate, maintainable reporting. 
  • A self-sufficient and pragmatic approach, with the ability to take ownership and deliver within a focused six-month engagement. 

Desirable 

  • Experience using Amazon Athena or a similar cloud-based data querying service. 
  • Experience creating curated datasets for self-service reporting. 
  • Experience improving data quality, reporting governance and technical documentation. 
  • Experience working in a start-up, scale-up or small team where you have had broad ownership. 

TECH STACK ⚙️ 

  • AWS QuickSight - building dashboards, reporting suites and reusable datasets. 
  • SQL - querying, transforming and validating reporting data. 
  • Python - supporting data transformation, automation and reporting workflows. 
  • Business and operational systems - integrating data sources into trusted reporting datasets.

INTERVIEW PROCESS ✍️ 

Stage 1: Screening Call with Talent Team 

Stage 2: Practical Technical Task 

Stage 3: Interview with the Hiring Manager, including a discussion of your technical task and your approach to reporting, data quality, stakeholder requirements and self-service analytics 

We always aim to stick to the above process, however there may be occasions when an additional interview stage is needed for us to be sure we’re hiring the right fit for the role. 

HIRING LOCATIONS📍 

Here are the locations that we are hiring from for this position. 

  • United Kingdom 

All new joiners start their first day in our office to collect the equipment needed to work remotely. We'll also arrange for some of your team to come in to say hi, ensuring you're supported and have a positive first few days with Form3! 

BENEFITS 🏝️ 

Form3 are a 100% remote, flexible business and are able to offer part-time working arrangements. We believe this enables our people to achieve amazing things with a healthy work-life balance. 

For further information on what it’s like to work here, and for more information on our full benefits package, visit our careers page. If you have any other questions, we’d be happy to discuss these with your during the interview process. 

ABOUT FORM3 💭 

Revolutionising the world of payments with our cloud-native, multi-cloud platform. For more information about Form3, check out the following pages: 

What we do | Life at Form3 | Benefits | Payments Cannot Fail Series | .Tech Podcast 

OUR DEI&B COMMITMENT 

We hire talented people from a variety of backgrounds and experiences and are committed to a work environment based on diversity, open-mindedness and curiosity. We’re united by our company values (we even created them together!) and we celebrate our unique differences. 

Our employee lifecycle processes are designed to embrace equal opportunity and prevent discrimination against our people regardless of personal characteristics. It is our strong belief that the more inclusive and belonging we are as a business, the better our work will be. 

As an inclusive employer, we guarantee to interview all neurodiverse and physically disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria for this role. We also encourage candidates to notify us of any reasonable adjustments that may be required during the recruitment process. This includes providing job adverts in alternative, accessible formats or adjustments required at interview stage. 

If you consider yourself to be neurodiverse or physically disabled under the UN definition of disability and would like to be considered under this scheme and/or require any reasonable adjustments please let us know by sending an email to clearly stating your consent for us to process this data.

For more information please refer to our Recruitment Data Policy.

title: Représentant(e) commercial(e) - Avignon et alentours
descriptionHtml:
Salonkee est l'une des entreprises beauty-tech à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous aidons des milliers de salons à simplifier leurs opérations quotidiennes et à offrir une expérience client hors du commun.

Notre logiciel tout-en-un simplifie la prise de rendez-vous, les paiements et la gestion client, permettant ainsi aux professionnels de se concentrer sur l'essentiel : délivrer une prestation exceptionnelle. Nous sommes fiers de façonner l'avenir de l'industrie de la beauté grâce à l'innovation, la collaboration et une approche résolument humaine.

Après avoir digitalisé le secteur de la beauté en Europe et lancé notre déploiement en France, nous continuons notre expansion à travers le pays et recrutons de nouveaux profils commerciaux pour porter notre croissance sur le terrain.

L'opportunité

Rejoins notre équipe en tant que représentant(e) commercial(e) et deviens l'un des visages de la révolution digitale du secteur. Chez Salonkee, tu as l'opportunité unique de piloter des projets ambitieux, de collaborer avec des experts passionnés et de marquer de ton empreinte l'expansion d'une scale-up en plein essor.

Tes missions

  • Maîtrise du cycle de vente (A à Z) : tu pilotes l'intégralité du parcours d'acquisition de nouveaux clients pour Salonkee. Cela inclut la chasse initiale, la prise de rendez-vous qualifiés, la réalisation de démonstrations percutantes et le closing des contrats.

  • Ambassadeur(rice) de terrain : tu mènes des présentations produits directement sur site pour démontrer, avec clarté et conviction, la valeur ajoutée de nos solutions pour le business de tes clients.

  • Conseil stratégique & optimisation : tu accompagnes tes prospects avec expertise en leur proposant des solutions digitales sur mesure pour optimiser leurs processus et libérer tout leur potentiel de croissance.

  • Stratégie multicanale : tu utilises différents canaux de communication pour approcher les clients potentiels et développer des relations de confiance durables.

  • Accompagnement & formation : tu assures la formation de tes nouveaux clients pour garantir une adoption parfaite de l'outil et un succès immédiat dès le premier jour d'utilisation.

Ton profil

  • Expérience sales : pas besoin d'un CV parfait; ce qu'on cherche avant tout, c'est quelqu'un avec la fibre commerciale et le drive pour aller chercher le client. Une première expérience en vente terrain B2B ou en prospection téléphone/physique est un vrai atout: tu sais ce que c'est que d'aller chercher le client là où il est

  • Tempérament chasseur : tu as le goût du challenge, une résilience à toute épreuve et une appétence naturelle pour la prospection active

  • Autonomie & organisation : véritable self-starter, tu planifies tes journées de façon stratégique et trouves les meilleurs leviers pour établir Salonkee dans ton secteur

  • Excellent relationnel : tu sais instaurer une confiance immédiate et créer un lien fort avec des entrepreneurs indépendants

  • Digital native : tu es à l'aise avec les outils SaaS et les environnements tech: la maîtrise d'un CRM est un vrai plus.

  • Mobilité : le permis B est indispensable. Tu gères en totale autonomie la région d'Avignon

  • Langues : français natif. Un anglais professionnel est apprécié pour collaborer avec nos équipes internationales.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Un salaire fixe entre 28.000 € et 34.000 € brut annuel + variable déplafonné (OTE cible : 39.000 € – 45.000 €). Ton succès, ton revenu

  • Véhicule de fonction + carte essence + badge télépéage

  • Organisation autonome. Tu gères ton agenda dans un cadre de confiance

  • 25 jours de congés + repos supplémentaire (sous conditions)

  • Mutuelle

  • Tickets-restaurant

  • Un parcours d'intégration structuré : formation produit, accompagnement terrain avec ton manager les premières semaines, et accès à l'expérience de nos équipes déjà en place dans 6 autres pays

  • Un accès direct au leadership et une vraie capacité d'influence sur la stratégie commerciale dès tes premiers mois

  • L'opportunité de participer à une success story et d'avoir un impact tangible sur l'avenir du secteur de la beauté et du bien-être

  • Des événements d'entreprise réguliers pour renforcer la cohésion d'équipe et créer des opportunités de networking et de collaboration

Chez Salonkee, nous sommes convaincus que l'innovation s'épanouit dans un environnement où chacun se sent inclus et valorisé. Nous bâtissons une équipe diversifiée à l'image de l'industrie que nous servons : créative, passionnée et riche de perspectives variées. Peu importe qui tu es ou d'où tu viens, tu trouveras ici ta place pour grandir, contribuer et être toi-même.

Salonkee promeut l'égalité des chances et la diversité. Nous accueillons toutes les candidatures, indépendamment du genre, de l'origine, de l'âge, du handicap ou de l'identité.

title: Research Engineer, Content Understanding
descriptionHtml:
Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

 

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

 

As a backend engineer, you'd play a critical role in our search architecture. We're pretty flexible on what projects people work on based on their skills and interests.

Search quality is bounded by what we understand about a page. Before anything can be retrieved, something has to work out what the page actually says. That means parsing it into the parts that are content and the parts that are furniture, classifying what kind of page it is and what it is about, telling whether the page is usable at all, extracting when it was published, judging how good it is and whether it can be trusted, and working out whether it says anything that a page we already have does not. All of this has to work on every page on the web, in every language, in every shape the web comes in.

Some of this is classic document understanding. Some of it is much more open. Credibility and misinformation, AI-generated and machine-spun content, and pages written to be found rather than read are all unsolved, and search results are only as trustworthy as our answers to them.

We are looking for a research engineer to work on this. There is a lot of room to do it well.

Desired Experience

  • Graduate-level ML experience (Master’s or PhD with at least 2 years of relevant experience), or an exceptionally strong undergrad

  • You can build a transformer from scratch in PyTorch, and you have trained models that then had to be cheap enough to run everywhere

  • You like building large-scale datasets and living in the data. Most of the wins here are in the supervision rather than the architecture

  • You are comfortable with problems where the ground truth does not exist yet and defining it is part of the job

  • You care about the problem of finding high quality knowledge and recognize how important this is for the world

Example Projects

  • Make parsing work on the pages where it currently does not, and prove the improvement rather than assert it

  • Teach a model to judge page quality, and get everyone to agree on what quality means well enough to supervise it

  • Work on credibility and misinformation as a modelling problem: what a page claims, whether it is a reliable source of it, and whether it was written for a reader or for a crawler

  • Decide whether two documents are semantically the same or genuinely different, so we can deduplicate the web without collapsing pages that a user would want to see separately

  • Build classification and extraction that is accurate at web scale and cheap enough to run on all of it

  • Design the supervision for something nobody has labels for, and find out whether it is learnable at all

  • Trace a bad search result back to the page-level prediction that caused it, and fix it at the source

title: Research Engineer, Index Intelligence
descriptionHtml:
Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

 

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

We crawl the web continuously and cannot keep all of it, refresh all of it, or spend a GPU on all of it. Something has to decide which pages are worth indexing, which links are worth following, which pages say the same thing as pages we already have, what has gone stale, and what we should never have picked up. These decisions are worth more than most ranking work. The cheapest way to improve search is to stop indexing pages nobody should ever retrieve, and to start indexing the ones we are missing. Today they run on a mix of learned signals and thresholds someone picked.

We are looking for a research engineer to own the signals behind those decisions, and the decisions themselves.

Desired Experience

  • You are comfortable owning a problem with no ground truth, where the first job is defining what the right answer means

  • Hands-on ML experience with classifiers, rankers and calibration, plus strong data instincts at web scale

  • You think in end-to-end impact. A signal only counts if a decision changes and search gets better

  • You like working across teams. Crawling, indexing and retrieval all consume what you build

  • You care about the problem of finding high quality knowledge and recognize how important this is for the world

Example Projects

  • Make parsing work on the pages where it currently does not, and prove the improvement rather than assert it

  • Teach a model to judge page quality, and get everyone to agree on what quality means well enough to supervise it

  • Work on credibility and misinformation as a modelling problem: what a page claims, whether it is a reliable source of it, and whether it was written for a reader or for a crawler

title: Research Engineer, Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As a Member of Technical Staff, Infrastructure in Harvey Research, you’ll build the systems that power how we adapt and improve leading open-weight models for legal work.

We recently post-trained our first model built for legal work, and we’re now building the team to scale up our post-training efforts. You’ll own the infrastructure behind that effort: distributed training, RL rollout systems, the environments where models learn to use tools and complete complex legal workflows, and the internal systems the team uses to manage data, run evals, and launch and track training jobs. You’ll help decide what we build, what we adopt, and how the pieces fit together. You’ll join a small, high-bar team of hands-on engineers and researchers, where each person owns a large part of the stack.

We’re looking for research engineers who have built demanding ML or distributed systems, can debug across the stack, and want to work closely with researchers to make training faster, more reliable, and easier to iterate on.

Learn more about our work at harvey.ai/research.

What You'll Do

  • Scale our post-training stack, supporting SFT and RL on leading open-weight models.

  • Build distributed rollout infrastructure that coordinates model inference, tool execution, and collection of training experience for long-horizon tasks.

  • Build the infrastructure for reproducible agent environments where models can interact with documents, tools, and external systems during training and evaluation.

  • Own the performance and reliability of training runs, including GPU utilization, checkpointing, failure recovery, and observability.

  • Identify and remove bottlenecks across training and inference to shorten the path from research idea to useful result.

  • Build the internal tools and services the team runs on: training data management and versioning, running evals and browsing results, and launching and tracking training jobs and experiments.

  • Integrate models into production, including serving, latency, cost, and online evaluation, so research reaches customers quickly and safely.

  • Partner closely with researchers to turn experimental workflows into dependable systems while keeping room for rapid experimentation.

What You Have

  • Experience building ML infrastructure, distributed systems, or research tooling, with ownership of performance, reliability, and operation.

  • Strong Python and generalist software engineering skills across backend services, data systems, and internal tools, with familiarity with PyTorch, JAX, or similar ML frameworks.

  • Experience with distributed training or inference, including diagnosing performance bottlenecks and failures across the stack.

  • Understanding of post-training workflows; experience with RL rollouts, agent environments, or sandboxed tool execution is a plus.

  • Practical judgment about what to build versus adopt, and the ability to partner with researchers and ship quickly as needs evolve.

We are hiring for this role across multiple levels.

L'équipe mondiale de Développement Commercial rassemble des collaborateurs partageant les mêmes valeurs et les ambitions d'Ajax Systems. L'alliance du meilleur logiciel et d'un matériel haute performance a définitivement transformé la perception des systèmes de sécurité, tant pour les utilisateurs que pour les professionnels du secteur. Présente dans les plus grands salons spécialisés — IFSEC, Expoprotection, Intersec — et récompensée par des prix prestigieux décernés par des médias de référence tels que PSI Magazine et GIT SECURITY, Ajax figure aujourd'hui parmi les systèmes de sécurité les plus primés d'Europe.

La production d'Ajax Systems repose sur quatre usines : deux implantées en Ukraine, une en Turquie et une au Vietnam. La certification ISO 14001 de l'entreprise garantit un impact environnemental maîtrisé tout au long du processus de fabrication. Le choix des composants entrant dans la conception des dispositifs Ajax est conditionné par la fourniture de déclarations de fabricants attestant de leur conformité aux exigences RoHS.

L'entreprise est née dans un contexte de révolution et de guerre. La résilience est donc au cœur de l'ADN de la marque, et la lutte contre le mal — par la création des meilleurs dispositifs de sécurité et d'automatisation — constitue la mission indéfectible d'Ajax.

Ajax Systems est une success-story ukrainienne, portée par une force et une énergie hors du commun.

title: Revenue Enablement Lead
descriptionHtml:
Revenue Enablement Lead

Hi, I'm Romain - SVP Global Sales at hx.

I joined hx six months ago because I saw a rare mix of things: a deeply talented team, a product that is genuinely changing how insurers make decisions, and the ambition to build something category-defining in one of the world's most important industries.

The commercial opportunity in front of us is huge, but it is also complex. We sell into a market where credibility matters, where our customers are actuaries, underwriters and senior insurance leaders, and where AI needs to create real business value, not just a better story.

That is why we are hiring for our first Revenue Enablement role. This person will help us build the operating rhythm, onboarding, materials and enablement programmes that make our global Revenue team sharper, more consistent and more credible in the field.

A note on level: we're open on seniority for this hire. What matters most is finding the right person to build this function hands-on, not matching a specific title. If your experience sits closer to a Head of function than a Lead, see our companion Head of Revenue Enablement posting for a version calibrated closer to that level.

This is not a role where you inherit a finished playbook, and it doesn't come with a team to manage. It is a role for someone who wants to build the first version properly, hands-on, working closely with Revenue leadership, and help shape how hx sells as we continue to scale.

About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurers have been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision, helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally, already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do, from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure, it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the team

hx's commercial engine is scaling rapidly, and Revenue Enablement sits at the heart of making that scale sustainable. Today, enablement happens across pockets of the organisation, Revenue leadership, RevOps, Sales Ops, Product Marketing, and Marketing, but there's no single owner, no operating cadence, and no clear system for turning commercial strategy into repeatable field execution.

This is where you come in. You'll be building hx's first dedicated Revenue Enablement function, working in close partnership with Romain and the wider commercial leadership team. Your mission is to close the gap between intent and execution: improving how our sellers are trained, equipped, motivated, and held to a consistent operating rhythm that drives revenue.

You'll take an AI-first approach to how enablement gets built at hx. That means using AI tools directly to accelerate content creation, calibrate messaging against live deal data, and build feedback loops faster than a traditional enablement function could.

In this role, you'll treat enablement as a system, not a content library. You'll get close to the customer, the field, and the behaviours that actually move deals forward. This is a builder role for someone who thrives in ambiguity and wants hands-on ownership of how a world-class commercial team operates.

Check out our Sales and Partnerships Candidate Hub for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining!

What you'll be doing

  • Help build hx's Revenue enablement operating model, working with Romain to define scope, intake processes, prioritisation frameworks, and success metrics.

  • Contribute to the 2026 Revenue enablement roadmap, turning commercial priorities into training, content, and rhythms that improve seller effectiveness.

  • Design and run enablement programmes that strengthen qualification, discovery, deal progression, sales process adherence, Salesforce hygiene, and forecasting accuracy.

  • Build out customer insight, references, case studies, and value messaging that make sellers more credible and commercially sharp in the field.

  • Work closely with Marketing, Product Marketing, and ABM so sellers can confidently use messaging, launch materials, competitive positioning, and customer stories.

  • Build onboarding and continuous learning content with clear curriculum and measurable ramp indicators for commercial hires.

  • Use AI tools hands-on to build and iterate enablement assets and programmes, rather than relying solely on manual content production.

What you'll need to have done

  • Worked in Revenue enablement in a B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or complex commercial environment, with evidence you understand enablement is about changing seller behaviour, not just producing training content.

  • Built or contributed to enablement processes such as intake, content calibration, or measurement, even if not the sole owner of the full operating model.

  • Delivered work that measurably improved seller effectiveness, such as better discovery execution, faster ramp times, improved Salesforce adoption, or stronger commercial discipline in live deals.

  • Worked cross-functionally with commercial stakeholders, earning trust through pragmatic judgement and clear prioritisation rather than relying on formal authority.

  • Built or contributed to onboarding and learning content that shortened time-to-productivity for new hires.

  • Used customer insight and proof points to improve how sellers engage with prospects.

  • Been comfortable building hands-on, without a team, at least in the first phase of the role.

You're unlikely to thrive here if

  • Your experience is mainly in content production, LMS administration, or training delivery without exposure to the operating system and structure around enablement.

  • You need an existing playbook to follow, or see enablement as separate from sales execution, commercial strategy, customer insight, and cross-functional operating cadence.

  • You prefer strategy over hands-on delivery, or prefer working independently rather than collaborating closely with Revenue leadership, Marketing, RevOps, and frontline sellers.

  • You're looking for a role that comes with people management from day one.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energized, hx may not be the place where you will do your best work. We are building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process, our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations, and we're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  1. Initial call with our Talent team to kick things off.

  2. Manager interview with our SVP of Sales.

  3. Skills assessment: 60-minute working session where you'll present your diagnosis of the enablement opportunity at hx, a proposed 6-month enablement plan, your approach to intake and prioritisation, and one example enablement programme designed to improve seller behaviour in practice.

  4. Values interview + Meet the CEO

  5. We offer!

Our commitment to Diversity

hxer's are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

title: Revenue Enablement Manager (m/f/d), Just-in-Time Enablement
descriptionHtml:
SoSafe has the ambition to become the leading human risk management provider in Europe. Our award-winning awareness platform triggers behavioural change by providing effective and engaging training and simulations on cybersecurity and data protection. Cybercrime is costing the world >$10 trillion annually and growing by 15% p.a. - we invite you to be part of the solution!

About the role

Every month, something new reaches our field teams from Product, Product Marketing and Marketing: a new use case, a fresh sales narrative, a campaign, a product update. Too often it arrives as a Slack post or a long deck, and sellers never really pick it up.

As Revenue Enablement Manager, Just-in-Time Enablement, you own that last mile. You are the front door between the teams who create news and the teams who use it, and you make sure every launch reaches Sales, Customer Success and Partnerships across Europe at the right time, in a format they can use in their next conversation.

What you'll do:

  • Run the launch intake. Be the single entry point for PMM, Product, Marketing and others who want something to reach the field. Prioritize with clear criteria so sellers aren't overloaded.

  • Own the field release calendar. Keep one view of what's coming, when, and for whom, shared with creators and sales managers.

  • Turn launches into what sellers need. Shape each release into: what's new, who it's for, why customers care, how to talk about it, and how to handle the likely questions.

  • Coach the creators. Brief PMM, Product and Marketing on what the field needs and review their materials before they go out. When the input is raw (specs, messaging docs, long decks), write the enablement content yourself: short, clear and practical.

  • Deliver just in time. Pick the right format and moment: a 20-minute live session, a short recording, a one-pager, a talk track. Not so early it's forgotten, not so late it's useless.

  • Make it stick. Run practice sessions, give managers simple talking points, and check that sellers can explain the new thing in their own words.

  • Check it landed. Track attendance, usage in calls and deals, and rep feedback. Share what you learn with the creators so the next launch is better.

  • Keep one home for launch material. Everything findable in one place with an owner and a review date; retire what's outdated.

  • Hand over to curriculum. Work closely with your colleagues in the revenue enablement team, who fold a launch into the regular training once it is no longer new. Agree what moves over, when, and in what form, so nothing is built twice.

What you'll bring:

  • 5+ years in revenue enablement, product marketing, sales training or a similar role in B2B SaaS, ideally at a scaleup.

  • Experience rolling out launches, messaging or campaigns to sales teams, with examples you can share.

  • Ability to explain a product use case or sales narrative simply, and to spot what a seller really needs from it.

  • Strong stakeholder skills: you can say "not this month", ask for a 3-slide version of a 40-slide deck, and keep the relationship strong.

  • Well organized: you juggle several launches at once and hit dates.

  • Clear writing and confident live facilitation.

  • Hands-on with LMS, AI, video editing tools, a CRM and call recording tools, and a habit of using data to check adoption.

  • Fluent English and German.

Nice to have:

  • Background in product marketing or product management.

  • Experience with security, compliance or HR-related products.

  • Familiarity with a structured sales methodology such as SPICED or MEDDICC.

How success looks like:

First 30 days: learn

  • Meet the leads in PMM, Product, Marketing, Sales and Customer Success. Learn how launches reach the field today and where they get lost.

  • Review the last 3-5 launches: what reached the field and what stuck.

  • Agree which upcoming launches come first and who owns what, intake process and readiness gates.

Days 31-60: set up and pilot

  • Start the launch intake and a first field release calendar.

  • Take 1-2 launches through the process, writing the enablement content from the raw input.

  • Agree with the Curriculum team how a launch moves into regular training once it's no longer new.

Days 61-90: prove and adjust

  • Run 2-3 launches end to end; sellers can explain each one in their own words within two weeks of release.

  • Collect feedback from reps, managers and creators, and fix what slowed things down.

  • Share first results with leadership (reach, use in real calls) and a plan for the next quarter.

Who you'll work with:

  • Reports to the Head of Revenue Enablement.

  • Product Marketing and Product, who own the narratives and use cases.

  • Marketing, who run campaigns that sellers need to follow up on.

  • Sales, Customer Success and Partnerships leaders and frontline managers, who receive and reinforce the message.

  • The Curriculum team in Revenue Enablement, who take over launch content for the long-term training programs.

  • Revenue Operations for tools and data.

What we offer*:

  • Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days, and parental leave support

  • Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, Corporate Discounts, Wellbeing & Fitness Benefits

  • Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups

  • And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, an individual development budget, dog-friendly HQ

*Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample — you'll learn more during the interview process.

About Us

At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.

Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.

If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!

title: Revenue Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Vergiss, was du über Hotellerie weißt. Das PIERDREI ist kein klassisches Hotel – es ist ein Ort des Erlebens und Entdeckens. Vom Campingplatz auf dem Dach über unsere Hafenbühne bis zum Dachgarten: Wir haben den Ort geschaffen, an dem Hamburgs Herz schlägt.

Aber mal ehrlich: Die schönste Bühne nützt nichts ohne die richtigen Hauptdarsteller. Wir suchen Menschen, keine Lebensläufe. Bei uns bringst du deine eigene Geschichte mit ein und machst das PIERDREI zu dem, was es ist: Einem Ort mit Seele. Hast du Lust, mit uns Gastfreundschaft neu zu definieren?

Wir suchen für das PIERDREI Hotel HafenCity Hamburg zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt

einen Revenue Manager (m/w/d) in Voll- oder Teilzeit.

Aufgaben

Du bist der strategische Kopf hinter unseren Zahlen. Mit Weitblick und analytischem Geschick steuerst du die Preisgestaltung und sorgst dafür, dass das PIERDREI sein volles Potenzial entfaltet.

  • Yield- & Revenue-Management: Durch tägliches Yieldmanagement maximierst du unsere Hotelumsätze und Marktanteile. Du entwickelst smarte Strategien basierend auf fundierten Statistikanalysen.

  • Channel-Optimierung: Du hast die Performance unserer Vertriebskanäle und Segmente stets im Blick und optimierst diese kontinuierlich für das bestmögliche Ergebnis.

  • Strategische Führung: Du bereitest die Revenue Strategy Meetings vor, führst diese durch und erstellst präzise Prognosen sowie das jährliche Logisbudget.

  • Team-Lead Support: Du schulst neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen und förderst unsere Auszubildenden und Praktikanten.

  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Auch im operativen Geschäft behältst du den Durchblick und unterstützt bei der Bearbeitung von Einzel- und Gruppenreservierungen.

Qualifikation

Du bist ein Stratege mit Zahlen im Blut und verstehst es, Daten in Erfolg zu verwandeln. Das ist dein Fundament bei uns:

  • Expertise: Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung in der Hotellerie und bringst fundierte Berufserfahrung im Reservierungs- und Revenue-Management mit.

  • Analytik & Strategie: Ein ausgeprägtes analytisches Denken und eine unternehmerische Denkweise zeichnen dich aus. Du liebst es, Ziele zu definieren und diese strategisch zu erreichen.

  • System-Know-how: Du bist sicher im Umgang mit den Extranets gängiger Onlineportale. Du beherrschst idealerweise Tools wie Protel, HotelNetSolutions, Duetto, HQ-Plus sowie Revinate und die MS-Office-Palette.

  • Teamplayer mit Drive: Du hast große Freude an der Teamarbeit, teilst dein Wissen gerne mit anderen und bringst die nötige Flexibilität für ein dynamisches Hotelumfeld mit.

  • Arbeitsweise: Eigenverantwortliches, strukturiertes Arbeiten ist für dich ebenso selbstverständlich wie Belastbarkeit und ein professionelles Auftreten.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du kommunizierst fließend auf Deutsch und Englisch und bringst interkulturelle Kompetenz im Umgang mit internationalen Gästen und Kollegen mit.

  • Mindset: Bei aller Liebe zu Zahlen verlierst du die Gast- und Serviceorientierung nie aus den Augen und hast Spaß an der Arbeit in einem dynamischen Umfeld.

Benefits

  • 3 Tage mehr Freizeit: Bei uns startest du direkt mit 3 Urlaubstagen extra, on Top auf den Manteltarifvertrag

  • Elektronische Zeiterfassung: Es geht keine Minute verloren, Überstunden gleichst du ganz einfach in Freizeit aus

  • Faire Bezahlung: Wir schätzen deine Arbeit, deshalb zahlen wir dir ein übertarifliches Gehalt

  • Zuschläge, wenn andere Frei haben: 50% Sonntagszuschlag und 100% Feiertagszuschlag

  • Freie Fahrt in Bus und Bahn: Die HVV-Proficard übernehmen wir komplett

  • Bonus für angeworbene Mitarbeiter: Empfiehl uns deinen Freunden und erhalte attraktive “Mitarbeitende werben Mitarbeitende” Prämien

  • Täglich Frisch: Wir bieten dir morgens, mittags und abends kostenfreie und abwechslungsreiche Mahlzeiten

  • Rabatt im F&B: Bei uns bekommen Mitarbeitende (mit Gästen) 30% Rabatt in unserem Restaurant und der THREE Fingers Bar

  • Family & Friends: Du und Deine liebsten übernachten bei uns zu besonderen Konditionen

  • Exklusive Crew-Deals: Sonderkonditionen im Miniatur Wunderland, im Schmidts Tivoli und über unser Corporate Benefits Portal

  • Dein Sport-Plus: Wenn du dich nach der Arbeit auspowern willst, kannst du unseren Zuschuss für das Firmennetzwerk EGYM-Wellpass nutzen

  • Ein “echtes” Team: Bei uns gilt offene und professionelle Kommunikation losgelöst von Hierarchien

  • Gemeinsam Feiern: Wir laden gerne auf Sommer- und Teamevents ein, bei denen du abschalten, Spaß haben und das Team kennen lernen kannst

  • Lerne unser Hotel kennen: Wir laden dich und deine Begleitung zu einer Inhouse-Experience ein, bei der du das PIERDREI aus Gastperspektive erlebst

  • Regelmäßiges Feedback: Wir sprechen regelmäßig über unsere Zusammenarbeit und bieten dir individuelle Weiterbildungen, die zu Dir und Uns passen

  • Dein Arbeitsplatz: Mit dem Reservierungs-Team zusammen befindet sich dein Büro in unmittelbarer Nähe zum Hotel

Du bist dabei? Prima, wir freuen uns auf Dich!

Schick uns deine Bewerbung – inklusive Startdatum und Gehaltsvorstellung. Wir freuen uns darauf, deine Geschichte kennenzulernen und gemeinsam mit dir loszulegen!

Wenn Du wissen möchtest, wie wir Deine personenbezogenen Daten verarbeiten und welche Rechte Dir als „betroffene Person“ zustehen, schau Dir unsere Datenschutzerklärung an, die Du auf unserer Website.

title: Revenue Operations Engineer | AI & Automation (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath.

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

As a Revenue Operations Engineeer you anchor the build end of Revenue Operations - our internal product team whose customers are the GTM functions: Sales, CS, Marketing, and Finance. You build the AI, automation, and data foundations that make these teams faster, smarter, and more scalable, owning the end-to-end delivery of internal tools, integrations, and AI-powered workflows - from problem framing and architecture through launch, adoption, and measurable business impact.

Who We Want

Proven GTM Systems Builder.
You bring 3+ years of hands-on experience in RevOps, GTM Engineering, SalesOps, Business Systems, or a comparable B2B SaaS role, and can show production systems you personally built.

AI-Native Builder.
You've integrated LLMs into real workflows or tools through APIs and understand how to move beyond prompting into reliable, production-ready use cases.

Product-Minded Systems Thinker.
You start with the user and business problem, map the relevant process and data dependencies, and choose the simplest scalable solution rather than defaulting to a particular tool.

Integration & Data Fluent.
You're comfortable working with APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication, data models, and the movement of data between multiple systems.

End-to-End Owner.
You can take a project from discovery and architecture through building, testing, rollout, documentation, monitoring, and ongoing improvement.

Pragmatic Production Engineer.
You ship quickly without treating reliability as optional, including appropriate testing, error handling, security, observability, and documentation.

Business-Impact Oriented.
You connect technical work to measurable outcomes such as pipeline, productivity, data quality, speed, cost, or customer experience.

Clear Cross-Functional Communicator.
You can explain technical decisions simply, manage trade-offs, work through ambiguity, and collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You are fluent in written and spoken English; German is a plus.

Curious & Self-Directed.
You actively experiment with new technologies, learn through building, and share useful findings without chasing novelty for its own sake.

Who We Don’t Want

Uses tools without hands-on depth.
You've used CRM and AI tools but lack hands-on experience building automations, configuring systems, or solving operational problems end-to-end.

Struggles with cross-functional GTM processes.
You find it hard to understand how operational decisions ripple across the wider GTM motion and the business as a whole.

Weak on the technical fundamentals.
You struggle with APIs, JSON, data models, authentication, debugging, or moving data reliably between systems.

Can't connect the build to the business.
You can't explain technical choices clearly, manage trade-offs, influence stakeholders, or connect a build to its wider business impact.

Uses AI without shipping anything real.
You use ChatGPT or Claude but can't point to an LLM-powered workflow, integration, or tool you've personally built and shipped.

Builds without thinking about what comes after.
You've built isolated automations without considering maintainability, documentation, ownership, failure handling, or how the solution fits into the wider architecture.

Your Day To Day

Building: AI, Automation & Systems (~ 65%)

  • You identify and productionize high-leverage AI use cases across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Finance, including LLM integrations, workflow design, evaluation, guardrails, and monitoring
  • You design and build lightweight internal applications and interfaces that remove recurring manual work, improve decision-making, and are simple for teams to adopt
  • You build end-to-end workflows using Make, n8n, and custom logic, including business rules, system handoffs, error handling, alerts, and ongoing monitoring
  • You create clean, maintainable data flows between HubSpot, the data warehouse, billing, support, and other GTM tools using APIs, webhooks, enrichment pipelines, and data activation
  • You work deeply within HubSpot's objects, properties, workflows, and integration layer to support complex use cases without creating fragile or unnecessarily complicated architecture

Discovery & Solution Design (~ 15%)

  • You translate scoped or ambiguous business problems into clear technical solutions, define success metrics, and choose the simplest approach that can deliver meaningful impact

Deployment, Adoption & Documentation (~ 20%)

  • You test, document, deploy, and iterate on solutions with end users so they remain secure, maintainable, reliable, and useful after launch

Stakeholders

RevOps: Your peers and manager to collaborate on projects and daily initiatives
Engineering team: Coordinate with engineers for projects that may require product know how and integration across the engineering tool stack GTM teams as and when required

Why People Choose Us

  • We believe in the power of in-person collaboration: We genuinely love being together in the Berlin office. That's where the best ideas happen, decisions move faster, and we learn from and grow with each other every day. We do offer some flexibility for remote work, but our default and our energy is being in the room together.
  • We're an international team with diverse cultural backgrounds and languages. Openness, mutual respect, and the exchange of different perspectives shape the way we work together.
  • We value ambition and drive. We're looking for people who take ownership, show initiative, and are excited to grow quickly.
  • We work with a high degree of ownership and a strong learning mindset. Asking questions, staying curious, and continuously improving are part of our everyday culture.
  • We care deeply about humility and teamwork. No egos, open feedback, and a willingness to learn from one another matter more to us than titles.

Benefits & Culture

  • Choose between an Urban Sports Club or John Reed membership, or a public transport pass/Dance subscription.
  • Regular company-wide and team events.
  • An annual €500 learning and development budget that you can use for conferences, courses, books, career coaching, and more.
  • An inclusive and exciting startup culture that supports rapid professional and personal growth.
  • A beautiful office in the heart of Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) with free snacks, drinks, and top-notch equipment.

We want to build a community, not just a company.

Creating an environment where people genuinely enjoy spending time together is important to us - whether that's through HYROX training, golf, beer pong tournaments, running clubs, Warhammer, weekend activities, or any other community you'd like to build here.

We believe that diversity makes companies stronger. We welcome applications from everyone, regardless of gender, background, nationality, or religion. Feel free to apply - we'd love to hear from you!

By submitting your application, you agree to our Privacy Policy.

We look forward to receiving your application! 🙂
