title: Revenue Operations Engineer
descriptionHtml:
As a Revenue Operations Engineer at vCluster Labs, you aren't just keeping the CRM tidy; you are building the automated engine that tells our sellers which accounts matter and why. You will design Clay pipelines, enrichment workflows, and AI agents that surface the right accounts to sales and SDRs, and you will make sure they keep working long after launch. You own the GTM stack for our EMEA team, from Salesforce workflows to the integrations that tie HubSpot, Notion, and Slack together.

As a Revenue Operations Engineer, your role will include:

  • Account intelligence and enrichment: You will build and extend Clay tables, enrichment, and discovery pipelines that find new accounts and surface the right ones to sales and SDRs. You will push the tool well past its current setup and get the full value out of it.

  • AI agents and automation: You will turn manual GTM workflows into automated ones using agents in Clay, Salesforce, and Claude. You build them to run end to end and stay useful, not to demo once and break a month later.

  • Data quality that stays clean: You will design repeatable processes that keep account and contact data accurate over time. When a cleanup happens, it happens once, and the workflow behind it prevents the mess from coming back.

  • Scoring and top-of-funnel signals: You will own account and MQL funnel scoring and the signal workflows that route intent to the right seller at the right time.

  • Systems and integrations: You will build Salesforce workflows and maintain integrations across Salesforce, HubSpot, Momentum, Chili Piper, Notion, and Slack. When a new tool or feature beats what we built six months ago, you will make the call to replace it.

  • EMEA RevOps support: You will own the RevOps ticket queue during EMEA hours, partnering with our US-based RevOps teammate for follow-the-sun coverage. That includes helping reps with live opportunity questions, not only systems work.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • Hands-on Clay experience: You have built Clay tables, enrichment waterfalls, and pipelines yourself, and can explain what you would build next.

  • Salesforce depth: You can build Salesforce flows and automation, not just run reports. HubSpot fluency is expected alongside it.

  • AI-forward building: You have built AI agents or automations that run in production, using tools like Claude, Clay agents, or Salesforce automation, and you can show what they do today.

  • Systems thinking for GTM: You understand how scoring, routing, enrichment, and CRM hygiene connect, and you design for the whole loop rather than one fix.

  • EMEA-based and self-directed: You are based in EMEA, comfortable owning a queue without a teammate in your time zone, and you decide what to fix next without waiting to be told.

Bonus points for:

  • Salesforce Admin certification: Or equivalent admin-level experience owning an org.

  • Code and CLI comfort: Experience with scripting, APIs, the Claude CLI, or MCP integrations.

  • Startup scaling experience: You have helped a company grow from Series A toward later stage and built the systems that growth needed.

  • Advanced Clay or Anthropic tooling: You are the person others ask when they want to know what Clay or Claude can actually do.

About vCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.

  • Premium Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).

  • Flexible Working Schedule:  You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.

  • Workplace Flexibility:  We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:

  1. Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.

  2. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.

  3. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.

  4. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.

  5. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

Compensation: £75K – £95K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

title: Revenue Operations
descriptionHtml:
About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

What you’ll do

  • Support our Sales, Marketing, and customer-facing teams, which might include:

    • Driving end-to-end GTM processes, including building pricing proposals, developing customer presentations, and delivering financial analyses to enable team success.

    • Analyzing, optimizing, and implementing sales territories and processes for a fast-growing sales team.

    • Building out prospecting programs, marketing campaigns and events cadences, helping the sales team to drive net new demand.

    • Help define and scale the playbook for how Sierra builds, evaluates, launches, and expands AI agents at large enterprises.

  • Take on special projects and initiatives related to international expansion, pricing, marketing, legal, deal strategy, and agent development

  • Work with Pricing, Legal, Operations, Sales, Agent Development & Finance teams to identify inefficiencies in current GTM operations and design solutions to help Sierra scale.

  • Turn insight into action: Analyze complex datasets and translate findings into clear, executive-ready recommendations that drive high-leverage decisions.

  • Serve as a versatile, proactive team player, taking on both foundational tasks and high-impact strategic initiatives that drive the GTM team’s success.

  • Leverage AI-native tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex to build lightweight internal systems, automate workflows, and create operational leverage.

What you’ll bring

  • 4+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, management consulting, corporate strategy, or business operations.

  • Proficiency in financial modeling and data analysis (e.g., Excel, Google Sheets); experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, or Power BI).

  • A detail-oriented, methodical, and process-driven mentality that is focused on both accuracy and efficiency.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines.

  • A proactive mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguity, drive and execute initiatives, and deliver results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex ideas and problems into straightforward, actionable recommendations, especially to executives.

Even better…

  • SQL experience.

  • Familiarity with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and marketing automation tools.

  • Previous 0-1 startup or operational experience.

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. We strive to evaluate all applicants consistently without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

Compensation: £135K – £210K • Offers Equity

title: Revenue Operations Manager (HubSpot)
descriptionHtml:
Revenue Operations Manager - HubSpot (w/m/d)

Deine Rolle

Du entwickelst das HubSpot-Setup von LIQID weiter: Du baust Workflows, Automationen und Integrationen, die Sales und Relationship Management im Tagesgeschäft unterstützen und machst aus den Daten im System ein Reporting, auf das sich Team und Führung verlassen können.

Den laufenden Betrieb der Plattform hältst du dabei stabil: Berechtigungen, Lizenzen, Datenqualität, Dokumentation. Der Schwerpunkt deiner Arbeit liegt jedoch auf dem Bauen, nicht auf dem Verwalten.

System und Team

HubSpot Sales Hub und Service Hub sind in diesem Jahr frisch implementiert. Du triffst also kein fertiges System an, das verwaltet werden will, sondern eine Plattform im Aufbau. Entsprechend groß sind der Gestaltungsspielraum und die Verantwortung für saubere Grundlagen.

Du berichtest an den Lead Revenue Operations und arbeitest eng mit Sales und Relationship Management zusammen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Baue Workflows, Sequences, Pipelines und Lead Routing in HubSpot Marketing Hub, Sales Hub und Service Hub: von der Verteilung eingehender Leads über Meeting-Links bis zu automatischen Aufgaben in Sales und Relationship Management.

  • Übersetze Anforderungen aus Sales und Relationship Management in konkrete HubSpot-Logik und löse wiederkehrende Handarbeit durch Automationen ab.

  • Kollaboriere mit unserem Data Team bezüglich Datenaustausch und -aufbereitung zwischen den relevanten Kernsystemen.

  • Verbinde HubSpot mit dem übrigen TechStack, also Aircall, Google Workspace, Notion und Slack, über native Connectoren, APIs, Webhooks oder Automatisierungstools. Entwickle das Toolstack sinnvoll weiter.

  • Entwickle unseren Sales Prozess kontinuierlich inhaltlich weiter und optimiere die technische Implementierung und Erfolgsmessung.

  • Baue Reports und Dashboards, die Pipeline, Aktivitäten und Ergebnisse für Sales, Relationship Management und Führung nachvollziehbar machen.

  • Verwalte Nutzer, Teams und Berechtigungen im laufenden Betrieb und halte die Konfiguration dokumentiert, statt sie im Kopf zu behalten.

  • Schule Kolleginnen und Kollegen im Umgang mit HubSpot und beantworte als erste Anlaufstelle Fragen zum System.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre praktische Arbeit mit HubSpot oder einem vergleichbaren CRM wie Salesforce.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit HubSpot Marketing Hub, Sales Hub und Service Hub, insbesondere als Admin und mit Workflows, Properties, Pipelines und Reporting.

  • Erfahrung im Bau von Integrationen über APIs, Webhooks oder Automatisierungstools wie Zapier oder Make.

  • Verständnis für CRM-Datenmodelle und die Fähigkeit, Datenqualität über Standards und Automationen zu sichern statt über Nachpflege.

  • Erfahrung mit der Prozessgestaltung erfolgreicher Vertriebsprozesse sowie deren Umsetzung in CRM-Systemen.

  • Erfahrung darin, fachliche Anforderungen aufzunehmen, in Systemlogik zu übersetzen und Entscheidungen so zu dokumentieren, dass andere daran weiterarbeiten können.

  • Fähigkeit, technische Zusammenhänge verständlich zu erklären und Kolleginnen und Kollegen ohne Systemhintergrund zu schulen.

  • Deutsch auf verhandlungssicherem Niveau (B2) für die Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen und Englisch auf gutem Arbeitsniveau.

Von Vorteil

  • HubSpot-Zertifizierungen

  • Erfahrung mit gängigen Automatisierungslösungen wie n8n, zapier oder make.com

  • Erfahrung in einem regulierten Umfeld, etwa Finanzdienstleistungen

  • Erfahrung mit einer CRM-Migration oder einem CRM-Rollout

  • Grundkenntnisse in JavaScript oder Python für Custom-Code-Actions

Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen? Bewirb dich trotzdem bei uns! Wir sind gespannt auf deine Bewerbung!

Das bieten wir dir

  • Vielfalt: Flache Hierarchien und kulturelle Offenheit machen dich ab Tag 1 zum integralen Bestandteil unseres bunten Teams aus internationalen Talenten.

title: Revenue Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

The Role

We're looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to join our Revenue Operations team and act as a broad, senior partner to our revenue organization. You'll set and execute the strategy for how we build revenue analytics across Salesforce and Looker, run insights that shape how revenue leadership sees the business, partner closely with revenue leadership on the full range of topics they face, and, as you ramp up, take on growing ownership of the forecasting cadence alongside the Director of Revenue Operations.

This is a generalist role by design: analytics is the foundation, especially in your first two quarters, and the role broadens from there to include business partnering and forecasting. What matters most is the versatility to move across all three, not depth in any single one.


What You'll Do

  • First 90 days: Scope the revenue analytics strategy and build the core dashboards.

  • First 180 days: Build a highly automated revenue insights engine using AI, while establishing yourself as the business partner revenue leadership.

  • First 12 months: Broaden into leading and supporting the forecasting cadence.


What Will You Be Doing?

Revenue Analytics & Insights

  • Partner with the Director of Revenue Operations to define the revenue analytics strategy: what we need to build across Salesforce and Looker, and in what order.

  • Map the current reporting landscape — what exists, what's trusted, what's duplicated or out of date — and use that map to shape the build plan.

  • Own execution of that plan: build and maintain the core dashboards and reports that revenue leadership and the wider revenue leadership team rely on.

  • Launch and run a recurring insights digest for revenue leaders, turning dashboards and data into a clear narrative — what changed, why it matters, what to do about it.

  • Bring a point of view on what's worth building versus what's noise, and be willing to push back on requests that don't earn their keep.

Business Partnership to Revenue leadership

  • Become the go-to Revenue Operations partner for revenue leadership, covering reporting, insights, and the broader range of topics that come up in running a sales organization.

  • Translate revenue leadership's open questions into structured analysis and clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Represent revenue's priorities into the Revenue Operations roadmap, and vice versa.

  • Support revenue leaders in business reviews, planning moments, and ad hoc requests with credible, fast turnaround.

Forecasting

  • Run the forecasting cadence with sales leaders alongside the Director of Revenue Operations — forecast calls, pipeline reviews, and accuracy tracking.

  • Build and refine forecasting models based on pipeline, productivity, and historical conversion.

  • Conduct strategic analyses to determine forecasting trends and identify opportunities for process improvement.


What Will You Need to Succeed?

  • 5+ years of experience in Revenue or Sales Operations, preferably in a SaaS or technology company operating at a global or European level.

  • Exposure to Account Executive (AE) or similarly quota-carrying organization.

  • Strong Salesforce reporting skills and working fluency in a BI tool (Looker or equivalent), with a practical, business-first approach to data.

  • A genuine generalist mindset — as comfortable building a dashboard or an insights report, as running a forecasting call.

  • A track record of setting direction and quality bar for analytical work.

  • Strong stakeholder management, with the ability to work with and influence sales leadership and revenue executives.

  • Comfortable owning ambiguous problems end to end: framing the question, choosing the method, landing the recommendation.

  • Excellent written communication — the insights digest is a core, ongoing deliverable of this role.

  • Experience partnering with global or multi-region teams is a plus.


What we Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

Morpho's GTM motion has grown faster than the operations behind it.   • You own the full RevOps stack and bridge GTM and Finance.

Must Have Skills & Experience

title: RF Test & Validation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As RF Test & Validation Engineer, you own the characterization and validation of Harmattan’s in-house radio, from boards to integrated systems. You take RF measurement work off the designers’ plate and turn it into a repeatable, automated discipline: setups, measurements, and clear results fed back to the design team. You also keep the RF lab in working order as test capacity grows. You work primarily within the Radio team, with occasional exposure to other RF-based teams.

Responsibilities

  • Run RF characterization and validation of radio boards and integrated radio systems.

  • Build and maintain automated RF test benches, including interconnects, harnesses, and fixtures.

  • Develop reusable Python suites for instrument control and data capture across standard RF measurements.

  • Perform pre-compliance and compliance-support measurements, including EMC and thermal testing.

  • Test antennas, both standalone and integrated on systems.

  • Support the integration of the radio on our systems.

  • Analyze results, flag anomalies, and deliver clear, structured reports to RF designers.

  • Own the RF lab: track calibration, manage fixtures and accessories, and identify equipment gaps.

  • Support team members who are less experienced in RF testing.

Candidate Requirements

  • Hands-on experience running RF characterization with VNA, spectrum analyzer, signal generator, power meter, AWG, and oscilloscope.

  • Solid grasp of standard measurements such as S-parameters, P1dB, IIP3, sensitivity, and spurious.

  • Experience building reusable test automation, Python preferred.

  • Skilled in fine-pitch SMD and coaxial-cable rework on RF boards.

  • Careful around input-power damage thresholds, protecting both instruments and devices under test.

  • Rigorous and perceptive: interprets results before reporting and spots anomalies early.

  • Writes clear, structured reports.

  • Keeps a shared lab tidy and works well alongside designers.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Risk Analyst
descriptionHtml:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

We’re looking for a Risk Analyst

You'll support & refine our lending strategy within Germany, including supporting new growth initiatives, designing & analysing tests, supporting the development of our scorecards and underwriting strategy, and managing our portfolio risk.

Working closely with data scientists, credit analysts and cross functional teams, you’ll solve analytical problems to help us provide small & medium size businesses in Germany with the funds they need to grow.

The team

The Lending Strategy team decides who iwoca lends to in Germany, and on what terms. Its work covers model development, lending strategy, and portfolio risk. The team works closely with Data Science (credit models), Product, tech teams, Operations Strategy, and our team of Credit Analysts. The team’s work is central to iwoca Germany’s growth and has a direct impact on both customer outcomes and business performance. The team includes data scientists, developers, and risk analysts, all working hybrid schedules in London.

 

The role

We're looking for a curious and motivated individual to join our Lending Strategy team as a Risk Analyst. You’ll work with analysts, data scientists, and senior stakeholders to shape iwoca Germany’s lending strategy.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Build expertise in the credit domain.

  • Develop your analytical skills through exposure to different experimental approaches and complex analysis.

  • Play a leading role in providing insightful analytics on the risk profile of our lending book and assisting with lending strategy decisions.

  • Partner with key stakeholders within Team Germany in order to provide credit risk expertise to multi-disciplinary projects.

  • Work closely with the data science teams to improve our credit assessment scorecards & strategies (both for our automated and manual underwriting processes).

  • Develop and maintain reporting dashboards, presenting a clear picture of the state of our lending.

  • Practice turning data into information, and information into insights, so that you and various stakeholders can deliver improvements with real impact for our customers.

The requirements

We look for people that are smart, humble, motivated and who are always looking to improve.

Essential:

  • A degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or similar.

  • Ability to analyse data and generate insights to support decisions.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to tailor analysis and recommendations to different audiences.

  • An analytical mindset with a practical approach to problem solving.

  • A bucket-load of common sense.

  • A commitment to using modern tools effectively – including AI – to maximise quality, speed, and rigour, while retaining responsibility for accuracy and outcomes.

Bonus:

  • Experience in B2B or B2C credit risk lending and strategy.

  • Experience with SQL and Python

  • Experience with data visualisation tools like Looker

The salary

We expect to pay from £40,000–£55,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

title: Safety Officer
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Safety Officer to support the safe day-to-day operation of our facilities, workshops, test areas, construction activities, and wider company operations.

This is a practical, site-focused role for someone who is comfortable working directly with employees, contractors, engineers, technicians, and visitors. You will help ensure that safety procedures are followed in practice, risks are identified early, and the company maintains a strong and consistent safety culture.

Fluent German and experience working with German authorities are essential.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, have just crossed €10m in revenue for our first operating year and are applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Carry out regular site inspections, safety walks, toolbox talks, and operational safety checks.

  • Support the implementation of safe working procedures, permits, PPE requirements, signage, and access controls.

  • Monitor the work of contractors, technicians, and operational teams, raising and helping resolve unsafe conditions.

  • Support emergency preparedness, drills, incident response, near-miss reporting, and corrective actions.

  • Maintain safety records, inspection reports, training records, action trackers, and compliance documentation.

  • Liaise with German authorities, inspectors, emergency services, and external safety partners when required.

What we are looking for

  • Experience in a safety officer, site safety, HSE, workshop safety, construction safety, or similar operational role.

  • Experience working in an industrial, technical, construction, manufacturing, aerospace, or high-risk environment.

  • Fluent German and proven experience communicating with German authorities, inspectors, contractors, or regulatory bodies.

  • A practical understanding of workplace hazards, risk controls, safe systems of work, and incident reporting.

  • A confident and approachable communication style, with the ability to influence behaviour at every level.

  • A hands-on, organised, and highly visible approach to supporting safe day-to-day operations.

Desirable experience

  • Aerospace, space, rocketry, propulsion, manufacturing, construction, testing, or hazardous-process environments.

We’re inviting sales and account executives based in the UK to take part in a research study run by an institution focused on global policy change. This is a paid research participation opportunity, not a job as a sales or account executive. Quick signup, flexible schedule, real payouts.

Akur8 works with customers across multiple entities, currencies and billing processes. This role ensures that signed contracts are accurately reflected in our systems, invoices are issued on time and payment issues are followed up efficiently.

You will work at the intersection of Finance, Sales Ops and our customers. You will also play an important role in improving the Salesforce to Maxio process, replacing manual checks with automated controls and making contract and billing data more reliable for the Finance team.

You will join Akur8’s Finance team and own the process from contract signature to payment collection. Your scope will cover all entities and currencies, including new contracts, renewals, upsells, amendments and terminations. You will register each signed contract in Salesforce, create the corresponding customer and contract in Maxio, issue invoices and follow up on outstanding payments.

You will work closely with Sales Ops on contract information and with customers, procurement teams and accounting departments on invoicing and payment follow-up. Accounting activities such as recording cash receipts and revenue recognition are outside the scope of this role.

This will include, but not be limited to, the following responsibilities:

  • Reviewing signed contracts and amendments, comparing them with the information recorded in Salesforce and identifying specific cases such as prorated contracts, in-period upsells and terminations.

  • Creating customers and contracts in Maxio, including the identifiers required for electronic invoicing.

  • Issuing invoices and credit notes in Maxio and uploading them to customer portals such as Coupa and Ariba when required.

  • Reviewing automated annual indexation results, handling exceptions such as inflation caps or specific contractual clauses and ensuring updated values are reflected in Salesforce.

  • Contacting customers with overdue invoices and working with their accounting and procurement teams on purchase orders, portals and disputes.

  • Sharing payment delays with Sales Ops, supporting follow-up with the relevant sales teams and helping address the underlying causes.

  • Tracking the monthly accounts receivable ageing report, overdue balances and DSO.

  • Acting as the Finance point of contact for Salesforce data-entry rules, Salesforce to Maxio integration testing and recurring data discrepancies.

  • Identifying repetitive tasks that can be automated with Claude and other team tools, then supporting their implementation through to production.

title: Sales Consultant (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Werde Sales Consultant (m/w/d) bei Carwow!

UNSERE MISSION

Carwow ist Europas führende Plattform für den Autowechsel – wir verändern, wie Menschen Autos kaufen, verkaufen, inserieren und leasen. Mit Technologie, Medien und Automotive-Expertise haben wir uns von einer reinen Bewertungsplattform zu einem der größten Online-Marktplätze entwickelt. 2024 wurden über unsere Plattform fast 3 Mrd. £ an Autokäufen und 1,8 Mrd. £ an Fahrzeugverkäufen abgewickelt. Durch die Übernahme von Autovia (AutoExpress und Evo) haben wir unsere Reichweite verdoppelt: 10 Mio. YouTube-Abonnenten, 1,2 Mio. Magazinverkäufe und mehr als 350 Mio. jährliche Online-Leser:innen. Und wir stehen gerade erst am Anfang.

DEINE MISSION

Als Sales Consultant (m/w/d) bist du neben unserem Business Development und dem Account Management der dritte wichtige Baustein unserer Vertriebsspitze. Denn als Sales Consultant sorgst du für ein erstklassiges (Ver)Kaufserlebnis unserer Kund:innen und Partner auf unserer Plattform.

DEINE AUFGABEN

  • Du berätst Verkäufer:innen beim Verkauf ihrer Autos über unsere "Sell My Car"-Plattform und stellst den Kontakt zu Partnerhändlern her, um so ein reibungsloses Kundenerlebnis auf beiden Seiten zu schaffen

  • Dabei kommunizierst du über verschiedene Kanäle wie zum Beispiel Telefon, E-Mail oder WhatsApp, um einen effizienten Verkaufsprozess zu gewährleisten und steigerst so die Zufriedenheit von Verkäufer:innen und Händlern

  • Denn ohne dein Zutun würden viele Verkäufe sprichwörtlich auf der Strecke bleiben, du bist das Bindeglied zwischen Verkäufer:innen und Händlern und sorgst so kontinuierlich für hohe Verkaufsquoten


DEIN PROFIL

Hinweis: Niemand erfüllt alle Anforderungen zu 100 %. Wenn du dich stark mit der Rolle identifizierst und Lust auf Automotive hast, dann freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung.

  • Kommunikationsstärke und ein sicheres Auftreten - auch bei unterschiedlichen Zielgruppen

  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb, idealerweise aus dem Automotive Retail / Autohandel oder vergleichbaren Rollen, sowie Empathie und zwischenmenschliches Gespür

  • Begeisterung für die Automobilbranche: Du bist bestens über Trends und Entwicklungen informiert und weißt, was “da draußen im Markt” passiert

  • Analytisches Denken: Die Fähigkeit, Daten zu nutzen, um Chancen und Risiken zu erkennen

  • Hands-on-Mentalität, hohe Eigenmotivation und Belastbarkeit in einem dynamischen Scale-up


UNSER INTERVIEWPROZESS

In der Regel kannst du etwa mit zwei bis drei Wochen für den Bewerbungsprozess rechnen.

  • Talent Screen (telefonisch) mit unserem Recruiting Team - ca. 30 Minuten

  • Video Interview (online) mit dem Fachbereich - ca. 30 Minuten

  • Case Study (vor Ort) mit dem Fachbereich - ca. 60 Minuten

  • Final Values & Team Fit (vor Ort oder online) nach Möglichkeit im Anschluss an deine Case Study - ca. 30 Minuten

UND WAS SPRINGT FÜR DICH DABEI RAUS?

  • Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehaltspaket

  • 28 Urlaubstage, die mit der Betriebszugehörigkeit auf bis zu 35 Tage steigen, plus Sonderurlaub für Umzüge, Hochzeiten und mehr!

  • Möglichkeit auf bis zu vier Wochen Workcation im Jahr

  • Hybrides Arbeiten (3 Tage Office, 2 Tage Home Office – für dessen Ausstattung du noch ein Budget von 500 Euro on top bekommst)

  • Neueste Technik: MacBook oder Windows Laptop

  • Bezuschussung der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge

  • ... und eine ehrliche Work-Life-Balance

Vielfalt und Inklusion sind fest in unserer Unternehmenskultur verankert. Wir freuen uns über jede Bewerbung und treffen unsere Entscheidungen fair, transparent und ausschließlich auf Basis von Fähigkeiten, Erfahrung und Potenzial.

About Dotfile

Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally.

Compliance remains one of the most manual functions in financial services. While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. Our ambition is to build Level 5 Compliance: software that can gather evidence, investigate complex situations, assess risk and execute defensible decisions under defined policies.

Dotfile has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing compliance technology companies. Today, 100+ financial institutions across 15 countries rely on Dotfile for critical compliance operations, with a rapidly growing presence in the US.

We recently raised our Series A from leading US and European investors and software operators. We’re now entering our next chapter: investing heavily in product and AI, expanding internationally, and building the team that can make Dotfile the global standard for compliance infrastructure.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Sales Development Representative to help build the top of our sales funnel. You will be the first point of contact for many of our future customers: fintechs, crypto companies and financial institutions looking to modernise their compliance operations.

Your mission will be to identify, engage and qualify high-potential prospects, and to book meetings for our Account Executives. You will work hand in hand with Sales and the Growth team to test new outreach strategies, sharpen our messaging and turn what works into a repeatable pipeline engine.

The position is based in London, with a hybrid remote policy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prospect & qualify leads: identify and engage potential customers through outbound calls, emails, LinkedIn and other channels

  • Educate & build interest: communicate our value proposition and show how Dotfile helps fintechs, crypto companies and financial institutions streamline onboarding, strengthen compliance and scale efficiently

  • Fuel the sales funnel: book qualified meetings with high-potential prospects for our Account Executives

  • Collaborate with Sales & Growth: work closely with AEs and the Growth team to refine targeting, messaging and sequences, and to improve conversion rates

  • Track & optimise performance: keep accurate records in our CRM (HubSpot) and keep improving your outreach based on data and feedback

About you

  • You have at least 1 year of experience in a similar role, ideally in fintech, regtech or a fast-growing tech company selling to fintechs, crypto companies or financial institutions

  • Knowledge of the AML, KYC/KYB or risk management space is a strong plus

  • You are familiar with structured sales methodologies (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message…)

  • You are creative and never run out of new ideas to test, and you’re not afraid to make bold bets

  • You have strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to your work

  • You are fluent in English and in a second language (French preferably), with excellent communication and interpersonal skills

What we offer

  • A front row seat at a fast-growing startup with global ambitions

  • A fast-learning environment with diverse career development options

  • Competitive package and medical plan

  • Hybrid remote policy with an office in Paris

The interview process

Round 1: First conversation to get to know you, understand what drives you, and explore why this role excites you.

Round 2: Deep dive into your past experiences and the choices that shaped your career.

Round 3: Case study tailored to the role, giving you the opportunity to showcase your skills on a real-world challenge.

Round 4: Reference check.

Round 5: Final conversation with our founder.

📝 Overview

The Sales Development Representative is responsible for qualifying and routing inbound leads across two channels: self-service and inside sales. This role involves frequent engagement with prospects through phone calls, emails, live chat, and internal tools such as Slack and Salesforce. This role runs inside that same AI-native approach we build for customers. Leads and account data flow into an AI-populated Salesforce, so reps start from a clean, enriched pipeline instead of manual entry. Every call is coached live by ClaudeMate, giving real-time feedback on framing, objection handling, and next steps as the conversation happens. Success in the role is measured by the number of product demonstrations booked and completed, with a strong track record of team performance consistently meeting or exceeding monthly targets.

 

Room to grow, fast-tracked

We hire SDRs expecting you to grow past the role. “Grow from Within" is one of our leadership operating principles - meaning proven performance gets noticed and backed fast, and that managers and leaders are encouraged to gravitate towards internal promotions vs. external hires

For SDRs, that typically means a path to Account Executive within 9 to 12 months, based on performance, not tenure. One of our SDRs moved into a leadership role running Sales Development for all of North America within 8 months. Others have made the jump from SDR to Enterprise AE and describe the same pattern from the other side: "Sitemate is process-driven (everything engineered), so if you can learn and grow from these processes and you’re open to honest, constructive feedback while giving your best every day, you'll level up quickly".

🔧 Day-to-Day

  • You will be qualifying and routing inbound leads through two channels; self service & inside sales

  • You’ll be spending most of your time with prospects across phone calls, emails and live chat on our website, as well as internal tools like slack and salesforce.

  • Your quota is measured by the number of demonstrations booked and completed at the subsequent stage of the process. Our current team in this role have achieved >=95% of their targets each month since starting

 

⚡ Challenges

  • Learning about the built world if you haven’t had any exposure to it - there are a lot of different types of companies and plenty of new terminologies to learn.

  • Up-skilling your call/phone and email skills - although we have plenty of examples for you to learn from during your onboarding.

  • Understanding SaaS financial acronyms and common terminology - if you have not worked in a SaaS company before, there is going to be a lot of metrics to learn. This cheat sheet is a good resource: The Ultimate SaaS Acronyms Cheat Sheet

  • We move very quickly, so you’ll need to be excited to come in and learn extremely fast.

 

✅ Who This Role is For

  • Ambitious individuals wanting to pursue a career in SaaS

  • People who thrive in a structured, high-agency, KPI-driven environment

  • Strong communicators who enjoy building relationships

  • Resilient individuals who can persevere and perform with high-volume tasks

 

🚫 Who This Role is Not For

  • Those unwilling to handle rejection frequently

  • People uncomfortable with people and conversations

 

🎯 Skills & Tools

  • Confident and clear communication skills, with excellent writing and presentation skills over email, phone, video conferencing and in-person.

  • Excellent task organization and prioritization skills, you’re able to multi-task efficiently.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with modern tooling - CRMs, Health Scoring, Live chat, Knowledge bases.

  • Experience conducting customer meetings digitally (e.g. Zoom/Teams) and/or physically (in person/face to face with customers).

  • Patience working in an industry where not all users are tech-savvy.

About Sitemate:

Sitemate builds best-in-class software and AI agents for the built world, helping construction, infrastructure and industrial companies work smarter and faster. Our mission is to multiply the engineering power of the built world.

Storm is the #1 data capture agent for the front line of the built world - converting audio, photos and videos into clean structured records.

With conversational support in-app and across SMS, Whatsapp and phone calls, Storm is shifting front line workers from paperwork and clunky digital forms, to natural language and multi-channel data capture.

Our core platforms are Dashpivot (safety, quality and field reporting), Gearbelt (fleet and asset management), Flowsite (no-code integrations), and the Sitemate mobile app for every worker on site.

We have strong product-market fit, generating thousands of new leads per month through word of mouth and organic channels. We are backed by Blackbird, with 200 people across 18+ countries and entities in Australia, the UK, the US and Canada.

 

Life at Sitemate

At Sitemate, you’ll join a team that values transparency, high velocity, hustle, diversity, and innovation - not as buzzwords, but as the principles we work by every day.

We move fast, communicate openly, and operate with trust and autonomy. You’ll have access to key company metrics, clear career development plans, and the opportunity to grow your career based on performance, not tenure.

We believe diverse teams build better products. Our team includes members from 18+ countries - 55% identify as coming from underrepresented ethnic backgrounds, 43% identify as female, and our team spans ages 22–51.

 

Our Core Values

Our core values dictate “how we work”. We believe that basic human values such as honesty, trust and integrity are required to simply ‘get in the door’. Our values are designed to help us determine if an already great person, will be a great fit at Sitemate.

  • Handle with Care: Handle with thought and care, decisions are considered and consciously delivered

  • Everything Engineered: Everything engineered, intentional, planned and systematic

  • Quality Certified: Do it well, with attention to detail and accuracy, or don’t do it at all

  • Fast Tracked: Fast, incremental, and constant delivery of change

  • High Vis: A high visibility, transparent and  open environment

  • Rain, Hail or Shine: Show up for your team, your customers and yourself

  • Parental leave - 16 weeks for primary and 6 weeks for secondary carers (including adoption and stillbirth support)

title: Sales Development Representative
descriptionHtml:
Über uns
Lupa entwickelt ein Produkt, das eine völlig neue Kategorie schafft und das es in der Branche so noch nicht gegeben hat.

Wir sind das KI-native Betriebssystem für Tierarztpraxen und Tierhalter. Unsere intelligente All-in-one-Plattform ersetzt die fragmentierten, umständlichen Systeme, mit denen Tierarztpraxen seit Jahren arbeiten müssen. Sie vereint Terminplanung, Kundenkommunikation, klinische Dokumentation und KI-gestützte Behandlungsempfehlungen. Praxen arbeiten dadurch effizienter, Tierärzte können sich wieder auf das konzentrieren, was sie lieben, und Tierhalter sind enger mit der Gesundheit ihrer Tiere verbunden als je zuvor.

Unsere Erfolge sprechen für sich: 2023 gegründet, sind wir heute Marktführer in Großbritannien, gehören zu den 100 führenden KI-Start-ups Europas und sind in zwölf Monaten um das Zehnfache gewachsen. Unser Team zählt inzwischen 70 Mitarbeitende und wächst schnell weiter. Jetzt expandieren wir mit voller Kraft in die USA und nach Europa. Wir haben 25 Millionen US-Dollar an Finanzierung erhalten, betreuen mehr als 2,5 Millionen Haustiere auf unserer Plattform und haben ein lebendiges Büro in München. Außergewöhnliche Talente von Unternehmen wie Palantir, Google, DeepMind, BCG, Meta und AWS sind bereits Teil unseres Teams, und wir stehen erst am Anfang.

Dies ist die seltene Gelegenheit, genau zum richtigen Zeitpunkt Teil eines rasant wachsenden Unternehmens zu werden. Deshalb suchen wir außergewöhnliche Menschen, die dieses Wachstum aktiv mitgestalten möchten.

In dieser Rolle wirst du:

  • Die Outbound-Akquise für Tierarztpraxen und Tierkliniken verantworten. Diese Pipeline baust du selbst auf

  • Hochwertige Leads identifizieren, recherchieren und per Kaltakquise über Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn ansprechen

  • Interessenten qualifizieren und Termine für unsere Account Executives vereinbaren, inklusive einer Übergabe mit allem relevanten Kontext

  • Ein tiefes Verständnis für das Produkt, die Kunden und den Markt von Lupa aufbauen, damit deine Ansprache beratend ist und nicht nach Skript klingt

  • Eng mit Marketing und Produkt zusammenarbeiten, um Messaging und Positionierung auf Basis deiner Erfahrungen aus der Praxis zu schärfen

  • Die Pipelinedaten im CRM korrekt und aktuell halten, denn unser Team arbeitet mit sauberen Daten

  • Erkenntnisse aus deinen Gesprächen mit Interessenten an das Team weitergeben und so unsere Go-to-Market-Strategie und Produktentwicklung mitgestalten

Dein Hintergrund könnte wie folgt aussehen:

  • Fundierte Vertriebserfahrung als SDR, BDR oder in einer anderen Outbound-Rolle. Erfahrung in B2B SaaS oder Tech ist von Vorteil, aber auch andere Branchen sind willkommen!

  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Muss

  • Bereitschaft, vor Ort in unserem Büro in München zu arbeiten

  • Du bist sicher in der Akquise per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn und gehst dabei beratend vor

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke: Du kannst den Mehrwert eines Produkts klar vermitteln, sowohl gegenüber medizinischem Fachpersonal als auch gegenüber nicht technischen Ansprechpartnern

  • Sehr gute Organisation und hohe Eigenmotivation: Du behältst mehrere Interessenten und Pipelines gleichzeitig im Blick, ohne an Schwung zu verlieren

  • Erfahrung mit einem CRM und ein datengetriebener Ansatz zur Verbesserung deiner Outreach-Ergebnisse sind von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb von Vertical SaaS oder im Umfeld professioneller Dienstleistungen ist von Vorteil

Als Person:

  • Interessierst du dich ehrlich für die Herausforderungen deiner Kunden und willst sie lösen, anstatt nur eine Anrufquote zu erfüllen

  • Bist du hungrig auf Wachstum und bereit, alles für deinen Erfolg zu geben

  • Bist du belastbar: Absagen bringen dich nicht aus der Ruhe, sie machen dich besser

  • Möchtest du dich in eine Closing-Rolle entwickeln und siehst die SDR-Position als Sprungbrett, nicht als Endstation

  • Freust du dich darauf, vor Ort in unserem Büro in München zu arbeiten, mit gelegentlichen Reisen zu unserem Hauptsitz in London

  • Arbeitest du gerne mit Menschen, die freundlich, ambitioniert und pragmatisch sind

  • Liebst du Tiere? Das ist ein Bonus, denn du verkaufst an Menschen, die ihr Berufsleben den Tieren gewidmet haben

Wie sieht Erfolg nach sechs Monaten aus?

  • Du vereinbarst kontinuierlich qualifizierte Termine, und deine Pipeline ist eine, mit der unsere Account Executives wirklich gerne arbeiten

  • Du kennst Produkt, Markt und Kunden so gut, dass du Discovery Calls eigenständig führen kannst

  • Du prägst bereits, wie das Team über Outbound denkt. Deine Erkenntnisse aus der Praxis verändern, wie wir in den Markt gehen

title: Sales Development Representative - Nordics + Benelux
descriptionHtml:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

3 days per week in our London office

Build your enterprise sales career at n8n

n8n is growing rapidly at the intersection of AI, automation and enterprise software. More than 1.7 million active builders use n8n each month, and we’re scaling our enterprise business as more organisations look for ways to connect AI with the systems, data and workflows that run their businesses.

We’re building our SDR team in London and looking for a Sales Development Representative to join us.

You’ll partner closely with Enterprise Account Executives to break into some of the largest organisations in the Nordics/Benelux region. This isn’t about maximising email volume. You’ll take a thoughtful, account-based approach: researching strategic companies, identifying the right stakeholders, understanding their priorities, and creating relevant conversations around automation and AI.

If you’re succeeding in an SDR/BDR role and want greater exposure to enterprise selling, strategic account planning, technical buyers and a genuine path towards AE, this could be a great next step.

Why you will thrive at n8n?

Serious momentum. n8n has grown rapidly into a major player in workflow automation and AI, with more than $100M in ARR, 1,400+ enterprise customers, and a $5.2B valuation following strategic investment from SAP.

Build towards AE. We want the SDR role to be a platform for your next step. High-performing SDRs can develop through our structured SDR → AE programme, with live deal exposure, discovery and MEDDPICC coaching, call reviews, and opportunities to take greater ownership of real opportunities alongside experienced AEs.

Learn enterprise selling. Work alongside Enterprise AEs on account strategy, stakeholder mapping, messaging, discovery and opportunity creation - gaining exposure to how complex enterprise deals are built from the start.

Sell where the market is going. You’ll engage technical and executive buyers around AI, automation and some of the most important technology challenges businesses are tackling today.

Use AI to sell smarter. Experiment with AI, n8n and modern sales technology to research accounts, understand buyers, personalise outreach and improve how you work. You don’t need to be an engineer - but you should be curious about technology and excited to learn.

What you’ll do;

  • Build enterprise pipeline: Prospect into a focused set of strategic accounts and create qualified opportunities.

  • Develop account strategies: Partner with Enterprise AEs to identify priority companies, stakeholders, challenges, use cases and engagement strategies.

  • Research your prospects: Understand the business and technical priorities of stakeholders across IT, DevOps, SecOps, Engineering and related teams.

  • Create outreach that gets attention: Develop thoughtful, personalised messaging tied to real account priorities rather than generic sequences.

  • Prospect across channels: Engage prospects through email, phone, LinkedIn and other relevant channels.

  • Lead early-stage discovery: Understand business needs, technical environments, priorities, urgency and potential fit with n8n.

  • Continuously improve: Use Salesforce, Outreach, Apollo, AI tools, coaching and performance data to sharpen your approach.

What we’re looking for;

We’re looking for someone with a strong SDR foundation who wants to develop into an excellent enterprise seller.

You’ll likely be a good fit if you have:

  • SDR or BDR experience in B2B SaaS, software or technology

  • Experience generating pipeline through outbound prospecting within mid- market or enterprise accounts

  • A strong sales track record against your targets

  • Fluency in English (verbal and written) + an additional language is beneficial

  • Confidence engaging senior business and technical stakeholders

  • A thoughtful approach to account research, personalisation and qualification

  • Curiosity about technical products, automation and AI

  • Resilience, consistency and ownership of your results

  • The ability to work from our London office three days per week

Bonus points if you have: experience prospecting into technical audiences; familiarity with buying committees, Salesforce, Outreach, Apollo or MEDDPICC; experience using AI or automation in your own sales workflow.

What success looks like

Success here is about quality, not just activity.

You’ll build a deep understanding of your accounts, identify the right stakeholders, create messaging that earns attention and generate qualified enterprise opportunities that can turn into meaningful revenue.

Along the way, you’ll build experience in enterprise account strategy, technical selling, discovery, AI and automation, and complex B2B sales - giving you a strong foundation for the next stage of your career.

Interested?

You don’t need to meet every requirement to apply.

If you have a strong foundation in outbound sales, you’re curious about technology, and you’re excited by the opportunity to help build n8n’s enterprise business while developing towards your next step in sales, we’d love to hear from you.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

  • Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

*Country and/or State specific details provided in your employment agreement.

title: Sales Development Representative
descriptionHtml:
About Dotfile

Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally.

Compliance remains one of the most manual functions in financial services. While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. Our ambition is to build Level 5 Compliance: software that can gather evidence, investigate complex situations, assess risk and execute defensible decisions under defined policies.

Dotfile has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing compliance technology companies. Today, 100+ financial institutions across 15 countries rely on Dotfile for critical compliance operations, with a rapidly growing presence in the US.

We recently raised our Series A from leading US and European investors and software operators. We’re now entering our next chapter: investing heavily in product and AI, expanding internationally, and building the team that can make Dotfile the global standard for compliance infrastructure.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Sales Development Representative to help build the top of our sales funnel. You will be the first point of contact for many of our future customers: fintechs, crypto companies and financial institutions looking to modernise their compliance operations.

Your mission will be to identify, engage and qualify high-potential prospects, and to book meetings for our Account Executives. You will work hand in hand with Sales and the Growth team to test new outreach strategies, sharpen our messaging and turn what works into a repeatable pipeline engine.

The position is based in Paris, with a hybrid remote policy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prospect & qualify leads: identify and engage potential customers through outbound calls, emails, LinkedIn and other channels

  • Educate & build interest: communicate our value proposition and show how Dotfile helps fintechs, crypto companies and financial institutions streamline onboarding, strengthen compliance and scale efficiently

  • Fuel the sales funnel: book qualified meetings with high-potential prospects for our Account Executives

  • Collaborate with Sales & Growth: work closely with AEs and the Growth team to refine targeting, messaging and sequences, and to improve conversion rates

  • Track & optimise performance: keep accurate records in our CRM (HubSpot) and keep improving your outreach based on data and feedback

About you

  • You have at least 1 year of experience in a similar role, ideally in fintech, regtech or a fast-growing tech company selling to fintechs, crypto companies or financial institutions

  • Knowledge of the AML, KYC/KYB or risk management space is a strong plus

  • You are familiar with structured sales methodologies (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message…)

  • You are creative and never run out of new ideas to test, and you’re not afraid to make bold bets

  • You have strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to your work

  • You are fluent in English and in a second language (French preferably), with excellent communication and interpersonal skills

What we offer

  • A front row seat at a fast-growing startup with global ambitions

  • A fast-learning environment with diverse career development options

  • Competitive package and medical plan

  • Hybrid remote policy with an office in Paris

The interview process

Round 1: First conversation to get to know you, understand what drives you, and explore why this role excites you.

Round 2: Deep dive into your past experiences and the choices that shaped your career.

Round 3: Case study tailored to the role, giving you the opportunity to showcase your skills on a real-world challenge.

Round 4: Reference check.

Round 5: Final conversation with our founder.

Als Sales Development Representative bist du der erste persönliche Kontakt für Praxen, die Interesse an Luna zeigen: du rufst unsere eingehenden Leads an, begeisterst sie für unser Produkt und bringst sie in eine Demo. Damit legst du den Grundstein für unseren gesamten Vertrieb.

Wieso praxipal?

Der Fachkräftemangel ist die größte Herausforderung für unser Gesundheitswesen. Zehntausende Stellen bleiben jedes Jahr unbesetzt und der demografische Wandel sorgt dafür, dass sich diese Entwicklung immer weiter zuspitzt. Arztpraxen setzen auf unsere KI-Rezeptionistin Luna, um ihr Personal zu entlasten und die Versorgung für alle zugänglich zu halten.

Wir sind ein tech-driven Unternehmen und setzen bewusst auf ein kleines, hochtalentiertes Team. Was uns ausmacht, ist das Tempo und die Intensität, mit der wir arbeiten, aber ebenso wichtig ist uns das Miteinander. Deshalb kommen wir jeden Tag ins Büro: um uns auszutauschen, voneinander zu lernen und gemeinsam zu wachsen.

Was du tun wirst

In einem Satz: du verwandelst das Interesse unserer eingehenden Leads in gebuchte Demos – und wächst dabei selbst schnell in mehr Verantwortung rein.

  • Du rufst unsere Inbound-Leads an und bringst sie in eine Demo

  • Du bist schnell am Telefon, gehst neue Leads zügig an und bleibst hartnäckig dran, bis der Termin steht

  • Du qualifizierst Leads, verstehst ihre Situation und weckst Begeisterung für Luna

  • Du steuerst deine Pipeline mit vielen offenen Kontakten, bleibst mit sauberen Follow-ups am Ball und pflegst unser CRM

  • Du baust einen wiederholbaren Prozess auf, testest Gesprächsleitfäden und schärfst laufend, wie wir Leads am besten überzeugen

Wonach wir suchen

  • Du bringst erste Vertriebs- oder Telefonerfahrung mit

  • Du liebst das Telefon, führst gerne viele Gespräche am Tag und lässt dich von einem „Nein" nicht bremsen

  • Du bist hartnäckig und diszipliniert bei Follow-ups, kein Lead geht bei dir verloren

  • Du packst gerne selbst an und scheust dich auch vor unglamourösen Aufgaben nicht

  • Du kommunizierst sicher und überzeugend auf Deutsch und Englisch, schriftlich wie mündlich

  • Du willst 5 Tage die Woche vor Ort in Berlin arbeiten

Deine Vorteile

  • Kompetitives Grundgehalt plus attraktive, ungedeckelte Provision und Beteiligung an unserem VSOP-Programm

  • Steile Lernkurve: du baust unseren Sales-Prozess von Grund auf mit auf und wächst mit außergewöhnlichem Tempo in mehr Verantwortung rein
