title: Second Charge Mortgage Underwriter
descriptionHtml:
About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.


And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.


Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced Second Charge Mortgage Underwriter to join our underwriting team.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a successful business that is expanding into secured lending. We are bringing Open banking and AI to the secured lending process to save customers money.

We are looking for someone with strong property underwriter experience in a second charge lending space, someone who can work to targets and thrives in a startup environment.

We have great opportunities for progression in an ever-growing business.

About the Team

Unlike traditional lenders, we’re focused on doing things differently. Our underwriting approach combines a state-of-the-art in-house built technology that blends traditional lending methods with Open Banking analysis to create a smoother and more flexible experience for our customers.

We work together to our common goals using Ai to assist our daily lives. We are always working towards improvement and encourage feedback from everyone; you can see your ideas comes to life.

Working Hours

Monday to Friday, 9:00am – 6:00pm

What You'll Be Doing

  • Assess and underwrite second charge mortgage applications, using Open banking, affordability, credit history, and security property details against lending policy and regulatory requirements

  • Liaise directly with brokers, request further information, and keep cases progressing to completion within SLA

  • Ensure every decision is fully documented and auditable, meeting FCA and internal compliance standards (including affordability, vulnerable customer, and consumer duty requirements)

  • Provide clear, constructive feedback to brokers and internal sales teams on declined or conditioned cases

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of underwriting policy, criteria, and process as the second charge product and book matures

  • Work cross-functionally with Risk, Compliance, and Operations to ensure underwriting practices support both growth and good customer outcomes.

Skills & Experience

  • Minimum of 2 years' experience in second charge mortgages

  • You'll be comfortable working to targets, driving month-on-month growth as the book expands.

  • Good understanding of property as security — including valuation approaches, equity position, LTV and combined LTV calculations, existing charge structures, and title issues — with the ability to lead confidently on lending decisions where property equity is the primary basis for risk.

  • Strong working knowledge of FCA regulation, UK responsible lending rules, affordability assessment, MCOB requirements, fraud prevention, and AML regulations, with the credibility to interpret and apply these commercially.

  • Proven track record in manual underwriting of complex, high-value, and non-standard cases, with the judgement to make balanced decisions beyond a tick-box approach.

  • Relevant industry qualifications (e.g., CeMAP, CeRER, DipFA or equivalent) are highly desirable.

How We Work

• We prioritise sound credit decisions and continuous learning from outcomes.

• We take ownership of our work and support one another to achieve shared goals.

• We work collaboratively across the business and contribute beyond individual responsibilities.

• We encourage open discussion, constructive challenge, and accountability.

• Strong performance and positive contribution are recognised and rewarded.

What we offer

  • Everyone owns a piece of the company - equity

  • Hybrid with 3 days a week in the office

  • 25 days’ holiday a year, plus 8 bank holidays

  • 2 paid volunteering days per year

  • One month paid sabbatical after 4 years

  • Employee loan

  • Free gym membership

  • Team wellness budget to be active together - set up a yoga class, a tennis lesson or go bouldering

title: SecOps Engineer - Stage Paris - Theodo Cloud
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Theodo Cloud est la practice DevSecOps de Theodo, spécialisée dans la construction d’infrastructures et la cybersécurité cloud. Notre mission : aider les scale-ups et grands comptes à résoudre leurs problématiques business grâce à la tech. Nos équipes construisent des infrastructures scalables, résilientes et sécurisées pour les développeurs et les utilisateurs finaux. L’objectif : faire de l’infrastructure un levier de croissance plutôt qu’un frein.
En 2021, Theodo Cloud lance Theodo Security : notre équipe experte en cybersécurité pour aider nos clients à sécuriser leur environnement Cloud. Pour continuer à nous développer, nous faisons grandir l’équipe et recrutons un ou une SecOps Engineer en stage de fin d’études. Les missions d’un(e) SecOps Engineer : Theodo Cloud intervient sur deux typologies de projets : - des projets spécifiques, liés à la sécurisation des infrastructures de nos clients (pentest, forensic et remédiations) - des projets transverses à Theodo Cloud pour implémenter la sécurité By-Design chez nos clients Dans tous les cas, nous intervenons toujours en équipe : Lead SecOps, SecOps, SRE, Agile Project Managers travaillent main dans la main pour garantir l’impact de nos actions chez nos clients ! En tant que SecOps Engineer, tu interviendras sur des projets : - d’audit et de pentest - en boîte blanche, grise ou noire selon les besoins du client, sur des périmètres qui peuvent aller des applications mobiles aux clusters Kubernetes, en passant par les applications web et les infrastructures cloud - de sécurisation d’infrastructure, avec une équipe 100% SecOps ou intégré à une équipe Ops - ces projets mélangent construction d’infrastructure, sécurisation, outillage et formation des équipes client Ton rôle sera de comprendre et répondre aux besoins d’un client à l’aide des outils les plus pertinents sur le marché. Kubernetes, Checkov, Falco, AWS, Google Cloud, Github Actions, Argo CD, Terraform… feront partie de ton quotidien ! Theodo Cloud est encore une jeune entreprise où il y a de la place pour construire des choses. En parallèle de ton projet, tu auras du temps dédié pour t’investir sur des sujets qui te tiennent à coeur : la formation des équipes business, le Green IT, la diversité, le marketing technique... Les opportunités d’évolution : Nous recrutons exclusivement des stagiaires de fin d’études sur ce poste, avec l’objectif de convertir ensuite le stage en CDI. Sur du plus long terme, la première étape d’évolution chez Theodo Cloud est de devenir Lead SecOps sur les projets, et d’être ainsi garant de la stratégie technique et de la montée en compétences de ton équipe. Nous proposons ensuite deux tracks d’évolution possibles : - une track Management, qui t’emmènera vers un rôle d’Engineering Manager - une track Expertise, qui te permettra d’accéder à un rôle de Staff Engineer Ton profil : Nous recherchons une personne ayant : - une solide formation académique en école d’ingénieur - une 1ère expérience (pro ou perso) avec les technologies infra / Cloud (Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, GCP...) et une appétence pour la cybersécurité ou une 1ère expérience (pro ou perso) en cybersécurité avec une appétence infra/Cloud - une forte envie de progresser - l’envie de travailler en équipe Tu ne coches pas 100% des critères mais tu penses tout de même correspondre à notre recherche ? Ne t’auto-censure pas et envoie-nous ta candidature, on se fera un plaisir de l’étudier ! Le processus de recrutement : Nous répondons à toutes les candidatures dans un délai de 3 jours. Si ton profil nous plait, nous te proposons le process suivant : - un appel téléphonique de 30 minutes avec un membre de l’équipe recrutement, pour comprendre tes critères de recherche - un entretien d’une heure avec le recruteur ou la recruteuse avec qui tu as échangé à la première étape, pour parler plus en détail de la culture Theodo Cloud - un entretien technique de débug de 45 minutes sur Docker compose avec un Ops - un entretien technique de 45 minutes avec de l'offensif et du défensif avec un SecOps Engineer - un entretien de motivation de 30 minutes avec un dirigeant de Theodo Notre process dure 2 semaines en moyenne. Tu seras accompagné(e) par une personne de l’équipe recrutement, qui sera là pour te coacher tout au long du process. Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo ? 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🚇 Remboursement de 50% de l'abonnement de transport ou mobilité durable 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

title: Security and Compliance Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Griffin

Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.

We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.

We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.

Learn more about what we do

Our culture

We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.

We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life.

We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.

Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.

Learn more about our culture.

The Team

The Craft function has seven small, cross-functional engineering teams - each with engineers, an engineering manager, and a product manager, working closely with designers.

You will work across the whole Craft function, with the remit of improving our controls and cyber security governance. You will initially work with and report to the Engineering Manager for Infrastructure as you establish yourself and take on your day to day responsibilities, additionally you will work closely with our CTO and Founder, Allen Rohner.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an Engineer 1.5 to become the engineering voice of security, compliance and assurance at Griffin. Sitting across engineering, security, risk and operational resilience, you'll turn standards and regulatory expectations into practical controls that engineers actually want to use and you’ll build those controls yourself, shipping code to production alongside the engineering team. You’ll also give our second and third lines real confidence in what we’ve built. It’s a rare hybrid role with broad ownership and a direct hand in strengthening Griffin’s security.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 6 months, you'll have taken ownership of our certification, attestation and audit work including ISO 27001 and SWIFT, with evidence organised and findings driven through to closure. Our engineering risks and controls will be well maintained, and our release, change and post-incident processes will be stronger. You’ll have shipped code that automates control checks and evidence collection, and you’ll be a regular contributor to our codebase.

By month 12 our resilience plans, including Important Business Service technical mapping, B& Continuity Planning and disaster recovery, will be current, and security and compliance will be easier to run and easier to demonstrate to customers, thanks to clearer ownership and smart automation.

To Do This You’ll Own

  • Control design and cyber security governance: translating standards into practical engineering controls and building and shipping the code that puts them in place, working with Engineering teams to get them live

  • Certifications and attestations, from SWIFT and FPS today to schemes like SOC 2 and ISO 27001 in the future, including the documentation behind them

  • Internal and external audits and customer due diligence requests, owning findings and driving them to closure

  • Engineering Risk and Controls Self Assessments, controls and actions, plus recurring control activity such as chaos testing and backup/restore

  • Code release and change management, improving the process and sampling releases to check adherence to policy

  • Post-incident reviews, including follow-up actions and sharing learnings with the right stakeholders

  • Engineering's contribution to operational resilience (DR plans and IBS technical mapping) and to managing engineering third parties alongside Operations

We expect you to shape this role

This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how this role evolves—that's for you to define as you learn what our customers need and where our technical gaps are.

Your background

To ensure this, we're looking for people who have:

  • A hands-on engineering or technical background, including experience writing and shipping production code with an engineering-first approach to turning standards into practical controls and technical delivery

  • Experience in security, compliance, risk or assurance within a technical environment, including owning or significantly contributing to audits, certifications or attestations

  • Strong knowledge of compliance, risk and cyber security principles, and a broad understanding of change and release management, incident management, operational resilience and third-party governance

  • Sharp analytical and assurance skills: spotting gaps, assessing adherence to standards and following actions through

  • Stakeholder management and influencing skills across Engineering, SMEs, auditors and control functions, with a pragmatic, proportionate approach to governance

  • A love of writing - we have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write)

Ideally, you would also:

  • Be familiar with frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, SWIFT and FPS, ideally from a regulated fintech or challenger bank environment

  • Have used automation and code to improve security, compliance or control processes and documentation

What can we offer you?

We are an early stage startup and we're working hard to expand our benefits package. We're planning to add to this list in the future.

  • Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere in the UK

  • Work from abroad: Up to 20 days a year

  • Time off: 25 days’ holiday, bank holidays and a winter break (we shut down between Christmas and New Year)

  • Share options: Own a part of what we’re building together

  • Pension: Auto-enrolment into our Penfold scheme

  • Insurance: Private medical with Bupa (including family cover) and life insurance with AIG

  • Wellbeing: 1:1 coaching and therapy session available through Oliva

  • Family leave: Enhanced parental leave with up to 6 months on full pay after two years’ service

  • AI tools: Everyone has a Claude subscription on us and access to other premium tools

  • Your setup: We’ll support you in creating a comfortable and effective WFH environment.

As a bank, we’re committed to maintaining the highest standards of security. This means that the successful candidate will need to complete background screening, and our offer will be conditional upon satisfactory review of these checks. This would include verification of right to work, criminal record, credit history, social media and professional reference checks.

 

How do I apply?

Are we your next move? Apply via the link below, if there's a match our Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial conversation and talk you through what happens next.

We’re remote-first

We trust people to do great work wherever they are. We hire across the UK and most of our team works remotely full-time. We have a small London office in Moorgate for those who want it, and about a third of the company is close enough to use it occasionally, but there's no expectation to be there. What matters is the work, not where you do it.

Under representation

At Griffin, we’re looking for people who instinctively vibe with our values, behaviours and mission. You’re encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn’t tick every box. Careers, like life, can take many twists and turns. Your technical expertise and path to where you are today will stand out. We're committed to creating a place where everyone belongs and we welcome diverse perspectives, backgrounds and people who are ready to build a global platform for programmable finance

Griffin Bank Ltd request that recruitment agencies do not speculatively submit CVs to any employee or associate of our company unless explicitly asked to do so by a member of our Talent team.

Any CVs sent to any member of our team on a speculative basis will not be recognised and we will not accept liability for any fee or commission should we subsequently employ a candidate who applied to us directly or was introduced by an instructed agency that may also have been submitted speculatively by an uninstructed agency.

title: Security Engineer III - Detection & Response
descriptionHtml:
An Introduction to Primer

Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.

Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.

Watch our showcase >

Read up on our $100m Series C

Learn more about our culture >

Primer processes payments for some of the world's best companies, which makes us an attractive target and means getting detection and response right really matters. We're looking for a Security Engineer to join our Detection & Response function and own a meaningful slice of how we detect, investigate and respond to threats across our cloud infrastructure and SaaS estate.

You'll write and tune the detections in our SIEM, build the automation that speeds up how we react, and be a first responder when something looks wrong. You'll have real ownership of the areas you work on, and the freedom to shape how we detect and respond to threats across them.

You'll also work closely with our Application Security/Product Security engineers: what we learn from detections and incidents shapes how we build, and what they know about our products shapes what we look for.


What you'll be doing

Detection

  • Build, tune and maintain detections in our SIEM (Elastic), and identify opportunities to onboard new log sources (e.g. AWS, Google Workspace, Kubernetes) and build new detections on top of them.

  • Find what our current detections miss, and keep the rule set lean by removing what no longer adds value.

  • Use Python and Terraform to build and maintain the infrastructure behind your detections and tooling.

Response

  • Own investigation: triage, investigate, escalate and resolve security incidents, and write up findings clearly enough to stand on their own

  • Lead routine incidents end to end, and take a clear role in larger ones, whether that's driving the investigation or keeping stakeholders informed

  • Build runbooks and automations (Python, Tines or similar) to cut manual work out of triage and response

  • Join our on-call rotation for incident response and monitoring

Across both

  • Make and document risk decisions in your area, and know when to pull in others.

  • Keep the controls you own audit-ready and contribute evidence for audits (e.g. SOC 2, PCI DSS).

  • Use AI tools to work faster across detection and response, from drafting rules and queries to summarising investigations, while maintaining a healthy level of scepticism.

What we're looking for

  • Real experience responding to security incidents, from first alert through to write-up

  • Hands-on experience writing and tuning detections in a SIEM (Elastic, Splunk or similar), using frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK to reason about coverage

  • Experience with cloud-native detection and response in AWS or Google Cloud

  • Comfortable with Python or Go for scripting and automation

  • Clear, structured written communication, including under pressure

Nice to have

  • Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code

  • Experience with no-code security automation or SOAR-style tooling

  • Exposure to compliance frameworks like PCI DSS, SOC 2 or ISO27001

  • Background in fintech, payments or another regulated industry

  • Experience using AI tools or agents in security work, and a clear view of where they help and where they don't

✅ A typical interview process

  • An initial intro call with a Talent Partner

  • An interview with the Hiring Manager

  • Challenge Stage - Contextualised to the role

  • A final, values-alignment interview

What's the culture like at Primer?


We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants.

We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. We invest in our relationships through great remote working practices and thoughtfully designed face-to-face time, including workations, our annual company retreat, and access to co-working spaces across most major cities.

The work is challenging. Scaleups are a challenge, and building category-defining products is a challenge. But there's a meaningful difference between a challenge and a struggle. At Primer, the right challenge comes with the right support: strong onboarding, a collaborative environment, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. It's never something you face alone.

If you bring that same drive, we will make sure this is the place you do yours too.

Who we hire

We work with some of the largest enterprises in the world, and security is core to earning and keeping that trust. We're looking for someone who takes real ownership of our security posture and genuinely cares about getting it right. This is a builder's role as much as an operator's: you'll design and ship the security features our enterprise customers need, not just run controls and tooling.

You'll stand out if you:

  • Have shipped security features as a software engineer - things like BYOK per tenant, SSO/SCIM, or SIEM-compatible audit logging - not just configured or audited them

  • Have hands-on experience with enterprise security requirements - completing security questionnaires, navigating customer requirements around data handling and contractual agreements

What you'll own

You'll own our security posture end to end: the day-to-day operational work of keeping us secure, the security capabilities our enterprise customers demand, and the bigger initiatives on our security roadmap as we build out the function. This is as much a software engineering role as a security ops one - expect to spend real time in our codebase building features, alongside hands-on investigation, remediation, and shaping how security scales as we grow from 20 to 40+ engineers.

Day to day, you'll:

  • Design and build security features that ship in our product - like BYOK per tenant, SIEM-compatible audit logs, and SSO/SCIM - working directly in the codebase alongside product engineers

  • Own enterprise security end to end - completing customer security questionnaires, working through requirements around data handling and contractual agreements, and acting as the technical point of contact for our clients’ CISOs and security teams

  • Background can come from any type of security engineering; what matters most is that you're comfortable reading and writing code - you'll be building product features and tooling, not just operating them

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

As Security Operations Lead, you’ll own and grow the Security Operations function, leading a team across the UK and Australia. You’ll also be:

title: Semiconductor Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

Summary

We are seeking an experienced Semiconductor Product Engineer to lead the development and deployment of manufacturing test solutions for next-generation AI accelerator devices. This role spans the full silicon lifecycle from first silicon bring-up through high-volume production, with responsibility for defining test strategy, developing ATE test content, debugging complex silicon issues, and optimizing yield, coverage, and test cost. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in DFT methodologies, high-speed interface testing, and advanced CMOS manufacturing, and will work closely with design, DFT, packaging, and manufacturing partners to ensure robust, scalable production of high-performance compute silicon.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and develop test methods and strategies for an AI accelerator chip targeting high-volume manufacturing.

  • Plan and manage manufacturing test content for advanced CMOS designs including high-speed logic, SRAM, DRAM, and high speed IO blocks.

  • Develop and debug structural and functional test content such as scan/ATPG, LBIST, MBIST, JTAG, and HSIO tests.

  • Bring up first silicon on ATE, including pattern debug, tester correlation, shmooing, and corner analysis.

  • Support testing of high-speed interfaces such as PCIe Gen6 and multi-GHz LPDDR, including at-speed tests and margining features.

  • Execute silicon characterization and failure analysis to identify yield limiters and defect mechanisms.

  • Optimize test coverage, test time, and cost while maintaining manufacturing robustness.

  • Work with DFT and design teams to improve testability and close coverage gaps.

  • Collaborate with OSATs and external partners on test program deployment.

  • Support advanced packaging test flows, including die-to-die interconnect testing and package-level thermal considerations.

  • Contribute to documentation of test programs, debug procedures, and manufacturing release materials.

  • Support qualification, reliability testing, and high-volume manufacturing ramp.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on semiconductor test engineering experience.

  • Experience developing ATE test programs (Advantest 93K, Teradyne, or similar).

  • Solid understanding of DFT methodologies (scan, ATPG, MBIST, LBIST) and memory test techniques.

  • Experience debugging silicon issues and correlating failures to design or process causes.

  • Familiarity with advanced CMOS nodes and production test challenges.

  • Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional engineering environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience testing AI accelerators, GPUs, networking ASICs, or other high-performance compute ICs.

  • Experience with PCIe Gen5/Gen6, LPDDR4/5/6, or other high-speed interfaces.

  • Exposure to advanced packaging, chiplets, or multi-die test flows.

  • Experience improving yield, reducing test time, or optimizing cost in high-volume manufacturing.

How we work

  • Ownership and execution: you will have full agency to drive your work forward

  • Rapid iteration: we all work directly with top leadership to move from idea to hardware on ambitious timelines

  • Full-stack engagement: hardware, software, silicon, and modelling teams all work closely together to create a product with generational impact

  • Optimistic and pragmatic: we possess the will to win, and to do the hard work to get us there

  • Team player mentality: the mission is bigger than any of us, and we have the curiosity and technical focus to see the best idea shipped, no matter who’s it is

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

Our work involves technologies subject to UK, US and other international export control regulations. Certain roles may require additional eligibility checks to ensure compliance with applicable law. We'll be transparent about this throughout the hiring process.

Great benefits make a big difference. Not just to employees, but to the whole vibe of a business. That’s why when you work for us, you’ll enjoy a full spectrum of generous perks, rewards and office benefits.

GWI was founded with the knowledge that understanding your audience is really important for business. When you know who you’re speaking to and why, you can create content and campaigns that stand out to the people that matter.

Through our global online survey, we gather data on the behaviour and perceptions of consumers across the world. This provides businesses with deep, actionable insights on their audience, revealed from data they trust.

descriptionHtml:
Bei Superchat gestalten wir neu, wie Unternehmen mit ihren Kund:innen kommunizieren. KI wird dabei immer mehr zum Motor dieser Kommunikation. Integrationen sind das, was diesem Motor echte Power gibt: die Daten, Tools und Systeme, die aus einem cleveren AI-Agenten einen machen, der Prozesse wirklich automatisiert und Probleme löst.

Gegründet im Jahr 2020, ist Superchat heute die Plattform für über 10.000 Unternehmen weltweit - von bekannten Marken wie Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone und GASAG bis hin zu kleinen Unternehmen, Zahnarztpraxen und Solo-Founder:innen, die professioneller auftreten möchten.

Inzwischen laufen täglich Millionen von Nachrichten über Superchat.

Gestartet sind wir als Unified Inbox – ein zentraler Ort für alle Kommunikationskanäle wie WhatsApp, E-Mail, SMS oder Instagram. Mit dem Aufstieg von ChatGPT begann unser nächstes Kapitel: AI Agents, die über Chat, E-Mail und Voice in einer Qualität kommunizieren, die mit den besten menschlichen Teams mithalten kann.

Heute sind wir ein Team von rund 100 Mitarbeitenden, arbeiten profitabel und haben insgesamt 18 Millionen Euro Funding eingesammelt (unsere letzte Finanzierungsrunde liegt bereits 4,5 Jahre zurück – seitdem wachsen wir aus eigener Kraft weiter).

Unser Hauptsitz ist in Berlin.

In dieser Rolle bist du verantwortlich für den gesamten Sales-Zyklus im DACH-Markt. Du bearbeitest warme Inbound-Anfragen und akquirierst gleichzeitig eigenständig neue Leads, vereinbarst und führst Demo-Termine durch und begleitest den gesamten Prozess bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Darüber hinaus unterstützt du bei der technischen Implementierung, um sicherzustellen, dass neue Kund:innen erfolgreich starten.

Who We Want

2-3 Jahre B2B Sales Experience.
Du hast bereits mehrere Jahre im B2B-Vertrieb gearbeitet und kennst den gesamten Sales-Zyklus von der Akquise bis zum Abschluss aus erster Hand.

Self-Confident.
Du glaubst an deine Fähigkeit, ein Gespräch zu führen und abzuschließen, ohne dabei arrogant zu wirken.

Self-Starter.
Du baust dir deine eigene Pipeline auf, statt auf eingehende Leads zu warten, und nutzt eine ruhige Woche, um noch aktiver zu prospektieren.

Coachable.
Du nimmst direktes Feedback an, ohne defensiv zu werden, und wendest es sichtbar im nächsten Gespräch an.

Resilient.
Du erholst dich schnell von einem verlorenen Deal oder einer schwierigen Woche und hältst deine Aktivität konstant hoch.

Fast Learner.
Du arbeitest dich schnell in ein technisches Produkt ein und kannst es Kund:innen verständlich erklären.

Structured.
Du hältst deine Pipeline sauber und deine CRM-Notizen zuverlässig, ohne dass man dir hinterherlaufen muss.

Strong communicator.
Du sprichst muttersprachliches Deutsch und verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.

Who We Don’t Want

Relies on leads being handed over.
Du bist darauf angewiesen, dass Leads dir zugeteilt werden, und kannst oder willst nicht selbst aktiv Kund:innen akquirieren.

Gets defensive with feedback.
Du reagierst bei direktem Feedback defensiv, statt es anzunehmen und dich weiterzuentwickeln.

Weak written communication.
Du drückst dich schriftlich nicht klar und professionell aus.

In it for the paycheck alone.
Du jagst nur dem Gehalt hinterher und bringst kein echtes Interesse am Handwerk des Verkaufens mit.

Your Day To Day

Pipeline & Outbound (ca. 20%)

  • Neben eingehenden Leads baust du dir eigene Pipeline auf: Per Telefon, LinkedIn und E-Mail sprichst du Unternehmen im DACH-Raum an, für die Superchat einen echten Unterschied macht
  • Du entscheidest mit, welche Branchen und Accounts sich lohnen, und findest heraus, welche Ansprache funktioniert

Discovery & Demos (ca. 60%)

  • Im Erstgespräch findest du heraus, wo es in der Kundenkommunikation hakt, zum Beispiel bei unbeantworteten WhatsApp-Nachrichten, überlasteten Teams oder verstreuten Kanälen
  • In der Demo zeigst du nicht jedes Feature, sondern genau das, was das Problem deines Gegenübers löst
  • Du sprichst mit Geschäftsführer:innen und Teamleads auf Augenhöhe und übersetzt das Produkt in konkreten Business-Mehrwert

Closing & Forecast (ca. 20%)

  • Du verhandelst, räumst Einwände aus und bringst deine Deals selbstständig zum Abschluss
  • Forecast, Deal-Stages und nächste Schritte pflegst du sauber in HubSpot, sodass du jederzeit weißt, wo deine Zahl steht
  • Was du in Kundengesprächen hörst, gibst du an Marketing und Produkt weiter

Stakeholders

Kund:innen: deine wichtigste Ansprechgruppe im täglichen Austausch - von der ersten Ansprache über Demos bis zum Abschluss
Sales Team: für gemeinsames Training, Knowledge-Sharing und den Austausch von Best Practices im Sales-Zyklus
Customer Success Team: für die Übergabe nach erfolgreichem Abschluss und einen reibungslosen Start ins Onboarding

Why People Choose Us

  • Wir glauben an Zusammenarbeit vor Ort: Wir sind gerne gemeinsam im Berliner Office. Genau dort entstehen die besten Ideen, Entscheidungen werden schneller getroffen, wir lernen voneinander und wachsen als Team enger zusammen. Etwas Flexibilität für Remote Work bieten wir, aber unser Default und unsere Energie liegen im gemeinsamen Office-Alltag
  • Wir sind ein internationales Team mit unterschiedlichsten kulturellen Hintergründen und Sprachen - Offenheit, gegenseitiger Respekt und der Austausch verschiedener Perspektiven prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit
  • Wir schätzen Ambition und Motivation - wir suchen Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Initiative zeigen und Lust haben, sich schnell weiterzuentwickeln
  • Wir arbeiten mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und einer starken Lernmentalität - Fragen stellen, neugierig bleiben und sich kontinuierlich verbessern gehört bei uns dazu
  • Wir legen Wert auf Humbleness und Teamgeist - no Ego, offenes Feedback und die Bereitschaft voneinander zu lernen sind uns wichtiger als Titel

Benefits & culture

  • Du hast die Wahl zwischen einer Urban Sports Club/John Reed Mitgliedschaft oder Fahrkarten/Dance-Abo
  • Regelmäßige Firmen- und Teamevents
  • Jährliches Budget für persönliche Weiterbildung in Höhe von 500 € für zum Beispiel Konferenzen, Kurse, Bücher, Karrierecoach usw.
  • Eine integrative und aufregende Start-up-Kultur, die schnelles berufliches und persönliches Wachstum ermöglicht
  • Schönes Büro im Herzen von Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) mit kostenlosen Snacks, Getränken und bester Ausstattung

We want to build a community, not just a company.

Uns ist wichtig, ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem Menschen wirklich gerne Zeit miteinander verbringen - egal ob beim HYROX-Training, Golfen, Beer-Pong-Turnieren, Running Clubs, Warhammer, gemeinsamen Wochenendaktivitäten oder welcher Community auch immer du hier aufbauen möchtest!

Build account plans that map each client's regulatory agenda, such as the Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA), Consumer Duty, the Senior Managers and Certification Regime (SM&CR) and operational resilience, to where Decision Focus can add value next.

Identify, qualify and close expansion opportunities: new modules, entities, business units and geographies.

Client Relationships

Build multi-threaded relationships from practitioner to executive sponsor, and lead quarterly or annual business reviews.

Work with risk, compliance and operational resilience leaders and, as accounts grow, at Chief Risk Officer (CRO) and Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) level.

Advocacy and Client Insight

Work closely with Pre-sales, Customer Success, Product and Partnerships.

Feed structured client insight back to Product and Marketing so that what clients ask for shapes a more repeatable proposition.

Develop references, case studies and advocates that help the new business team win.

Candidate Profile

Experience

Proven experience in an account management or business-to-business (B2B) software sales role, with at least five years selling into financial services (banks, insurers, asset managers or pension providers).

Experience working in a scaling organisation, ideally within a technology, software as a service (SaaS) or high-growth environment.

A track record of hitting retention and expansion targets, with numbers you can talk through.

Enough working knowledge of the regulation your clients face to hold a credible conversation with a Head of Compliance or a CRO.

Experience selling governance, risk and compliance (GRC), regulatory technology (RegTech) or risk software would help but is not essential, and neither is experience of long, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles.

Experience in the Nordic, DACH (Germany, Austria and Switzerland) or French markets, a Nordic language, German or French, or exposure to a structured sales methodology such as MEDDICC would also help.

Capabilities and Approach

Intelligent and curious: you want to understand the client's business, not just the renewal date.

Commercially sharp: you protect value and know when to walk away from a bad deal.

Credible with senior people, and pleasant to work with internally.

Comfortable operating with autonomy in a scale-up: you build the process where none exists yet.

Clear, concise written and spoken English: you can write a board-ready business case.

High standards and ownership: you finish what you start.

Background

Likely currently working in account management, selling software into financial services.

Looking for ownership of client relationships from day one, and a clear path to larger, strategic accounts, with a short line to the leadership team.

Compensation and Benefits

Competitive market salary.

30 days of annual leave.

8% employer pension contribution.

Additional Information

Decision Focus is a European-owned GRC SaaS company serving regulated financial services firms across the UK, the Nordics and the US. We are profitable and commercially disciplined.

We are a lean team. That means real independence, direct access to senior leadership and clients, and a high bar for everyone. We are moving from complex, bespoke sales cycles towards growth that is more repeatable and product-led, and we want people who will help shape that shift.

This position offers high visibility, autonomy, and the chance to shape how account management works as we scale.

title: Senior Account Manager | Toxic
descriptionHtml:
Op duizenden werkvloeren in Nederland wordt dagelijks gewerkt met gevaarlijke stoffen. Dat kan veilig, als je weet wat je in huis hebt, wat het doet en welke regels erbij horen. Daar helpt Sdu Toxic organisaties bij. Toxic is de meest complete SaaS-oplossing voor wet- en regelgeving rond gevaarlijke stoffen in Nederland. Organisaties registreren er hun stoffen mee, beoordelen blootstelling, leggen maatregelen vast en informeren hun medewerkers. Zo helpen we QHSE-professionals om mensen veilig te laten werken en aan de arbowetgeving te voldoen. Achter Toxic staat een team met diepgaande kennis van chemische producten en de regels die erbij horen. En een succesvol marketing- en salesteam dat zorgt dat steeds meer organisaties ons vinden.

Toxic is onderdeel van Lefebvre Sdu, dat al 200 jaar bouwt aan juridische en fiscale kennis, en van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider op dat gebied. De vraag groeit. Onze Commercieel Medewerkers Binnendienst en marketing plannen meer afspraken in dan we nu kunnen afronden. Daarom zoeken we een Senior Accountmanager die van die gesprekken klanten maakt.

HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT

Jij bent het gezicht van Toxic. Voor de veiligheidskundigen, managers en directies die met ons werken, word jij degene die ze kennen en vertrouwen. Je leert hun organisatie kennen, luistert naar wat er speelt en denkt mee over wat ze nodig hebben. Zo bouw je relaties die jaren meegaan, en groeit Toxic met je klanten mee.

  • Je leert je klanten kennen: hun mensen, hun processen en wat er bij hen speelt. Zo word je hun vaste gesprekspartner en denk je mee over de volgende stap.

  • Elke nieuwe relatie begint met een goed gesprek. De binnendienst en marketing plannen de afspraken, jij bereidt je voor en ontdekt wat een organisatie nodig heeft. Daarnaast zoek je zelf nieuwe kansen.

  • In je demo's laat je zien hoe Toxic werkt en wat het oplevert. Gaat de vraag verder dan het standaardplatform? Dan werk je met collega's een oplossing op maat uit, met API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen.

  • Je bouwt relaties met veiligheidskundigen, inkopers en directie, brengt hun belangen samen in 1 voorstel en sluit deals met een hogere dealwaarde.

  • Met strategische accountplannen houd je overzicht op je belangrijkste klanten. Je ziet kansen voor up- en cross-sell en herkent retentierisico's vroeg. Samen met Customer Success zorg je dat nieuwe klanten goed starten.

  • Je houdt je pipeline en forecast actueel in Salesforce en deelt wat je bij klanten hoort met marketing en product.

  • Als senior ben je mentor en sparringpartner voor collega-accountmanagers.


DIT ZOEKEN WIJ

Je bent iemand bij wie klanten zich gehoord voelen. Je luistert goed, stelt de juiste vragen en vertaalt een complex vraagstuk naar een helder voorstel. De markt van gevaarlijke stoffen hoef je nog niet te kennen. Wat je wel meebrengt, is ervaring met het opbouwen van klantrelaties en interesse in software.

  • Je hebt meerdere jaren ervaring als accountmanager, bij voorkeur in SaaS of met digitale oplossingen.

  • Je hebt interesse in software en wilt begrijpen hoe een platform als Toxic werkt, inclusief API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen.

  • Je bouwt relaties met meerdere stakeholders tegelijk en beheerst het volledige salesproces, van eerste kennismaking tot getekend contract.

  • Je stuurt op data en haalt je targets, met nieuwe klanten en binnen je eigen portefeuille.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands.

  • Je hoeft de markt nog niet te kennen. Klanten, stoffen en regelgeving leer je bij ons, van collega's die het vak door en door kennen.

HIER TEKEN JE VOOR

Je tekent voor een rol die past bij je ambitie. Je werkt aan grotere deals, bouwt je eigen netwerk op en ontwikkelt je in een groeiend SaaS-team. Dat doe je binnen Lefebvre Sdu, een legaltechbedrijf met 200 jaar kennis en de energie van een scale-up. Dit krijg je ervoor terug:

  • Een inwerkperiode waarin je Toxic, de markt en onze klanten leert kennen.

  • Een plek waar je vanaf dag 1 invloed hebt op de aanpak, de processen en de richting.

  • Collega's met diepgaande kennis van stoffen en regelgeving, van wie je elke dag leert.

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden naar Teamlead, Key Accountmanager of Propositiemanager.

  • Een salaris vanaf €4.477 per maand, op basis van een werkweek van 36 uur.

  • Een variabele bonusregeling die kan oplopen tot 30% van je jaarsalaris.

  • 23 vakantiedagen en een persoonlijk keuzebudget van 12%, waarvan 8% vakantiegeld en 4% vrij besteedbaar aan extra vakantiedagen of salaris.

  • Een goede pensioenregeling via PGB, inclusief aanvullende partnerverzekering.

  • Een leaseauto of een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer, en een aantrekkelijke fietsregeling. Voor een reisafstand onder de 10 km of boven de 60 km geldt een aangepaste regeling.

  • Thuiswerkvergoeding en hybride werken: reken op 2 dagen per week op kantoor in Den Haag.

MEER WETEN?

Benieuwd hoe Toxic werkt? Kijk alvast op toxic.nl/en. We vertellen je graag meer over het team en de rol. Stuur je cv en je hoort binnen 2 werkdagen van ons. Eerst nog vragen? App of bel Mak via +31 6 18 60 98 89.

2007 in Hamburg gegründet, haben wir uns schnell zu einem globalen Unternehmen mit Büros in Metropolen wie London, New York und Tokio entwickelt. Und wir haben auch weiterhin viel vor. Deine Geschichte ist wichtig – schreibe sie weiterhin als Teil unseres Teams. Überzeuge dich selbst und werde Teil unseres Teams!

Dein Profil

• Sprachen: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Was wir bieten

Neben unserem großartigen Team, unserer Unternehmenskultur und dem gemeinsamen Ziel, Menschen mit Daten zu empowern, gibt es viele weitere Gründe, warum Statista ein großartiger Arbeitsplatz ist! Werde Teil unseres Teams und profitiere von folgenden Vorteilen:

title: Senior accountant
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

📈 Finance community at Alan

Finance & Strategy exists to enable better decisions, faster, at every level of the company, in a regulated, diverse and ever changing business.

We succeed when ambitious goals become credible plans, when strategic bets are grounded in financial reality, and when the entire company (not just Finance!) speaks the language of performance.

We set the right ambition, we monitor whether we're getting there, and we raise our hand when something needs to change.

We are not record-keepers. We are builders, partners, and challengers. We are looking for people who want to build, support decision making processes and challenge the status quo.

 

The core responsibilities of the Finance & Strategy community are:

  • Strategy & Planning: steers Alan's financial performance through business planning, financial and operational monitoring, investor relations and financing

  • Financial Reporting: is the steward of Alan's financial truth, ensuring that we produce accurate, timely financial data. It owns the reporting to all key stakeholders (board, leadership team, tax authorities, and regulators like the ACPR) and ensures that financial data is the single, uncontested source of truth for the company's performance.

  • Finance Data and Operations: Build and own the core finance data and tooling infrastructure (models, pipelines, and concepts that connect business operations to financial reality). This is where Finance meets product thinking

  • Functional poles with end-to-end ownership of their domain: Treasury, Procurement, M&A

⭐️ Your mission ⭐️

We are looking for a rigorous and hands-on accountant to help shape and run Alan's closing production process.

You will be part of our Financial Reporting area, focusing on Financial production. This area ensures that every number in our books is accurate, timely, and trustworthy, and serves as the source of truth for all financial decisions across the company.

Your role will be twofold:

  • Run our key accounting processes: Lead monthly, quarterly, and year-end closings

  • Ensure a feedback loop to drive process improvements, surface anomalies, flag data gaps, and actively contribute to making the closing faster, more automated, and more reliable over time. You will be a key partner to our Financial Operations and Data teams.

 

⭐️ What you will do ⭐️

  • Month-end close: own the end-to-end closing cycle across multiple legal entities; push pre-formatted journal entries into NetSuite, ensure completeness and accuracy, and deliver on schedule every month (target: J+5)

  • Accounting review: perform a thorough first-level review of balance sheet and P&L accounts at each close; identify unusual movements, resolve discrepancies, and ensure the overall reliability of the financial statements; build processes (routines, verification files, control procedures)

  • Account and bank reconciliation: maintain clean, up-to-date reconciliations across all balance sheet accounts and entities on a daily basis;

  • Contribute to finance transformation and system improvements: identify manual or repetitive tasks and collaborate with Financial Data to drive automation and reduce closing friction over time ; translate new business streams and P&L lines into accounting (acting as an interface between business teams and Finance)

  • Tax and statutory compliance: prepare and file VAT returns, URSSAF declarations, and other statutory filings accurately and on time; coordinate with external advisors where needed

⭐️ Qualifications ⭐️

Experience and technical skills

  • 4 to 6 years of accounting experience minimum, in an accounting firm or in-house at a fast-paced startup/scale-up

  • Languages: full fluency in French and English

  • Deep command of French accounting standards: VAT rules, URSSAF declarations, bank reconciliation, general ledger management, and month-end close processes

  • Proven ability to own a closing cycle end-to-end, including identifying and resolving issues independently

  • Hands-on experience with an ERP (NetSuite is a strong plus)

  • Comfortable with spreadsheets (Google Sheets or Excel); familiarity with modern accounting tools (Pennylane, Payflows, etc.) is a plus

 

Mindset and soft skills

  • Reliable and detail-oriented: you deliver on time, every time, and keep a clean audit trail

  • Autonomous and self-directed: you don't wait to be told what to do next; you manage your priorities, make decisions independently, and know how to take a step back to distinguish what truly matters from day-to-day noise

  • Process-driven: you naturally question how things are done and come with concrete ideas to improve them

  • Curious about automation and tooling; comfortable working in a data-driven environment

  • Clear communicator: you know when to move independently and when to escalate

For this role we are looking to hire within the B0-C0 level range.

 

🌍 How we work

  • Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France.

  • Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration

     

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

 

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

  • Run the core processes: Own revenue recognition, purchase-to-pay, and order-to-cash accounting, as well as correct balance sheet bookings and asset tracking.
  • Bring the group together: Design and run a clear consolidation process across both entities.
  • Choose the tools: Select and roll out a scalable global accounting and consolidation solution, building on today's setup of DATEV in Germany and NetSuite in the US.
  • Partner with experts: Work with our tax advisors and with auditors as the go-to person for accounting.
  • Grow fast: Take on new challenges as our business, products, and reporting requirements grow, with a steep learning curve.
  • Work your way: Work fully remote from anywhere in Germany, in close collaboration with our VP Finance and a small, hands-on finance team.

Become part of our team if you 

  • Bring experience: Have ideally 3 to 8 years of accounting experience, including accounting in a startup. Experience at a Big 4 or mid-tier audit firm is a plus.
  • Know German GAAP: Have strong knowledge of German GAAP (HGB), including experience with consolidation.
  • Understand SaaS revenue: Have experience with revenue recognition in a SaaS or subscription business.
  • Have a solid foundation: Hold a university degree in accounting, finance, or business. A professional qualification such as ACCA or CPA is a plus.
  • Add an international view: Bring knowledge of US accounting standards (US GAAP), or experience with DATEV, NetSuite, or implementing accounting software. Each is a plus.
  • Automate where it counts: Look for ways to automate processes, including with AI tools.
  • Like to get hands-on: Enjoy making the bookings yourself while keeping the bigger picture in view.
  • Take ownership: Work independently, stay pragmatic and solution-oriented in a scaling company, and enjoy building processes from scratch.
  • Keep growing: Are eager to learn and constantly seek new challenges.
  • Speak fluently: Are fluent in German and English.

You can expect 

  • A remote-yes company, where you can decide every day whether you work from home, at our Stuttgart or Munich office, or at any Design Office in Germany.
  • A permanent employment contract, 30 days of vacation, and the opportunity to participate in the company's success through our VSOP program.
  • Modern hardware and the frame for a height-adjustable desk.
  • An annual training budget of 1000€ for your professional development.
  • A subsidized job bike to escape city traffic and a Wellpass gym membership to stay active.
  • To enjoy Corporate Benefits, including discounts on fashion, travel, and much more from various companies.
  • A dynamic start-up atmosphere and an international team in which new ideas, creative approaches, and cooperation at eye level are valued.

About SPARETECH

SPARETECH's vision is to empower the zero-waste industrial sharing economy by enabling maintenance and procurement teams at manufacturing leaders like Bosch, Porsche, and Nestlé to reduce MRO spend and optimize inventory through accurate part information, internal transparency, and market visibility.

To achieve this, we have built, and continue to build, an AI-powered MRO software that connects all players in the spare parts ecosystem, from manufacturers and suppliers to the people working behind the machines. By facilitating the exchange of data, knowledge, and expertise, we create shared visibility that empowers smarter decisions, reduces waste, and drives seamless collaboration. This connected spare parts intelligence unlocks value that extends far beyond software.

Backed by Insight Partners, SPARETECH is accelerating its growth with a strong focus on product innovation and team excellence. We take pride in our inclusive and collaborative culture, as well as our energetic and committed team.

title: Senior Adobe Project Manager
descriptionHtml:
Senior Adobe Project Manager
London, hybrid
6 month FTC

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

JOB PURPOSE

The Project Manager will work directly with customers to initiate and lead their digital marketing and transformation projects using the Adobe Marketing and Commerce Solutions.

Working at multiple levels with the customer, you will evaluate the proposed solution, assess risks, confirm requirements, manage scope, and work on team staffing. You will coordinate and lead all aspects of project delivery from initiation through planning, delivering, monitoring to closing.

Aid customers in improving Adobe solutions by understanding their challenges and crafting innovative, measurable solutions.  

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead teams in scoping activities to identify, gather and analyze requirements, define key business drivers and define an effective and innovative solution
  • Management of end-to-end project life cycle: effort estimation, scope management, planning, monitoring and execution (including risks management, budget, timeline and others) and related reporting
  • Management of project resourcing and commercials including forecasting, time management and invoicing
  • Project communication to client and/or partner and internally
  • Accountable for ensuring projects are delivered to quality standards
  • Customer focus and results driven - help customer to succeed in their digital transformation journey by providing mentorship, industry leading practices and advice on Adobe Marketing and Commerce Solutions
  • Active participation in PMO practice development

WHAT YOU’ll BRING

  • Strong foundational project management skills delivering digital marketing implementation projects for a software vendor (or mixed vendor / customer background)
  • Demonstrated project management experience with experience in Digital Marketing & Automation, Campaign or Content Management solutions
  • Experience in implementing Adobe solutions: AEM, AEP, and ideally other solutions like Campaign, Commerce
  • Ability to handle large single projects or multiple concurrent smaller projects
  • Outstanding at problem-solving, with expertise in risk management, prioritization, and delivering presentations up to the Executive level within an organization
  • Experience in delivering projects using an agile methodology, e.g. SCRUM
  • A professional project management qualification & business consulting background
  • Minimum of 6 years project management experience in the industry
  • Ability to work with virtual internal teams across geographies and time zones & full fluency in English. Other European languages is a plus.

WE OFFER:

  • A flexible, hybrid working policy (2 days from the office, depending on location).
  • An excellent salary based on experience and equal pay policies
  • Pension, free private healthcare, mental health support, and company sick pay scheme.
  • 26 days paid holiday (plus UK Bank Holidays).
  • Help getting you to work with a season ticket loan and cycle to work scheme.
  • Enhanced family friendly policies to support new parents.
  • Social and Cultural Events, plenty of opportunities to connect with colleagues through organised activities and celebrations.
  • Inspirational Talks, bringing the outside in with regular guest speakers and events.
  • Learning and Development, supporting your growth with continuous opportunities to learn and advance.
  • Buddy Programme: You will be paired with a ‘Buddy’ to help you through your first weeks’ at DEPT®.
  • A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021 and named ‘Agency of the Year’ at both The Lovies and The Webby Awards.
  • Awesome clients. Whether big or small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with clients of all sizes and across all industries. And we celebrate all of our successes together!
  • The opportunity for possibility. We want to enable you to do what you do best and help you develop your skills further with training, development and certifications.
  • Global annual DEPT® Cares Month in which employees come together and donate their skills to support local charities.

WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION 

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

title: Senior Adviseur Energie En Laadinfrastructuur Goederenvervoer
descriptionHtml:
Werken aan de energietransitie in transport.

De transportsector staat voor een fundamentele verandering. Elektrificatie en de ontwikkeling van laadinfrastructuur zijn cruciaal voor de toekomst van het goederenvervoer. Panteia ondersteunt overheden, brancheorganisaties en bedrijven met onafhankelijk onderzoek en advies.

Voor ons team Transport en Mobiliteit zoeken wij een senior adviseur die dit werkveld verder uitbouwt.

Wat ga je doen?

Je werkt aan complexe vraagstukken op het snijvlak van energie, logistiek en beleid. Denk aan de ontwikkeling van laadpleinen, depotladen en de integratie van energie in logistieke systemen.

Jij:

  • leidt onderzoeks- en adviesprojecten van offerte tot oplevering;

  • stuurt op kwaliteit, planning en budget van projecten;

  • vertaalt beleidsvragen naar concrete onderzoeksopzetten en werkplannen;

  • ontwikkelt nieuwe proposities rond laden en energie in transport;

  • onderhoudt en bouwt relaties met opdrachtgevers zoals ministeries, brancheorganisaties en bedrijven;

  • speelt een actieve rol in acquisitie en het binnenhalen van nieuwe opdrachten;

  • werkt samen met nationale en - waar relevant - Europese partners.


Deze vacature daagt jou uit

…om op strategisch niveau bij te dragen aan de oplossing van grote maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Je richt je hierbij op een breed spectrum van goederenwegtransport tot energietransitie vraagstukken als gevolg van strengere klimaat- en energiedoelen. Binnen Panteia is Team Transport & Mobiliteit een onafhankelijke intermediair tussen de transportsector en beleidsmakers en richt zich bijvoorbeeld op onderzoek en advisering van de introductie van batterij elektrische voertuigen, laadinfra tot biobrandstoffen en bijbehorende complexe rekendossiers met forse maatschappelijke belangen en grote financiële gevolgen. Projecten van Panteia hebben vaak een omgeving met meerdere stakeholders en grote politieke aandacht. Panteia T&M biedt scherp inzicht op goederenwegvervoerbeleid en de daarbij behorende omgevingsfactoren, zodat opdrachtgevers verantwoorde beslissingen en beleidskeuzes kunnen maken. Wie die opdrachtgevers zijn? Denk aan lokale, regionale, nationale, en internationale overheden, en brancheorganisaties. Zij kunnen rekenen op gedegen en toepasbaar onderzoek en advies van Panteia. Aan afwisseling en uitdaging geen gebrek dus! Als onze nieuwe senior adviseur zit jij boven op de ontwikkelingen in de samenleving en weet je precies wat onze opdrachtgevers drijft en waar zij behoefte aan hebben.


Wat breng je mee?

Je combineert inhoudelijke kennis met gevoel voor de praktijk en weet hoe beleid, markt en techniek samenkomen.

Jij:

  • hebt ruime ervaring (minimaal 5 jaar) opgedaan met energie- en mobiliteitsvraagstukken;

  • hebt kennis van laadinfrastructuur en/of aanverwante thema’s;

  • kent de transport- en logistieke sector goed;

  • hebt ervaring met het leiden van projecten;

  • kunt zelfstandig opdrachten verwerven en uitbouwen;

  • begrijpt beleidsprocessen en schakelt gemakkelijk met publieke en private partijen;

  • bent een teamspeler die energie krijgt van samen resultaten behalen;

  • werkt gestructureerd en bewaakt de kwaliteit van resultaten;

  • communiceert helder en overtuigend;

  • beschikt over een goede beheersing van de Nederlands en Engelse taal op professioneel niveau.

Wat bieden wij?

Je krijgt de ruimte om een groeiend en relevant thema verder vorm te geven binnen onze organisatie.

Wij bieden:

  • projecten met directe impact op beleid en praktijk in de transportsector;

  • veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ondernemerschap;

  • een compact en deskundig team van collega’s;

  • goede arbeidsvoorwaarden en ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden waaronder 22 vakantie – en 12 ATV-dagen;

  • station Zoetermeer op 6 min. loopafstand en een NS kaart voor woon-werk verkeer en zakelijke reizen;

  • een informele werksfeer met bevlogen collega’s en een actieve personeelsvereniging.

  • een hybride werkomgeving met standplaats Zoetermeer.

Je wordt onderdeel van een enthousiast team van transport- en mobiliteitsexperts die actief zijn in de Nederlandse en Europese markt. Jouw toekomstige collega’s staan midden in de samenleving en omschrijven zichzelf als professioneel, gedreven en met passie voor hun vak.


Interesse?

Enthousiast over deze vacature? Wij ontvangen jouw sollicitatie graag!

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

title: Senior adviseur geotechniek
descriptionHtml:
Jouw impact bij Movares

Jouw geotechnisch advies bepaalt of civiele projecten veilig, uitvoerbaar en toekomstbestendig gerealiseerd kunnen worden.

Dit ga je doen bij Movares

  • Je werkt aan geotechnische analyses, adviezen en ontwerpen voor civiele en infrastructurele projecten;

  • je pakt, afhankelijk van je ervaring, projecten zelfstandig op, van vraagstelling tot advies en ontwerp;

  • je bent sparringpartner voor collega’s en opdrachtgevers bij complexe geotechnische vraagstukken.

Geotechniek bij Movares is breed en adviserend. Je werkt voor verschillende opdrachtgevers aan uiteenlopende projecten, zoals spoor- en railinfrastructuur, civiele constructies en waterbouwkundige werken. Je combineert technische analyse met advies en denkt mee over oplossingen die veilig, uitvoerbaar en duurzaam zijn.

Binnen het team deel je actief je kennis en draag je bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van Geotechniek. Heb je meer ervaring, dan begeleid je ook junior-adviseurs inhoudelijk.

Dit ben jij bij Movares

Je bent een ervaren geotechnisch adviseur die verder kijkt dan zijn eigen berekening. Je overziet het geheel, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en weet collega’s daarin mee te nemen. Je vindt het leuk om kennis te delen en bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van collega’s en het team.

Werk je nu bij een gespecialiseerd bureau en mis je de breedte van projecten, de invloed op inhoudelijke keuzes of de ruimte om collega’s te begeleiden? Of wil je jouw geotechnische expertise inzetten in projecten met grote maatschappelijke impact? Dan past deze rol goed bij jou.

Dit breng je ook mee:

  • meerdere jaren ervaring binnen de geotechniek, passend bij een medior-of senior rol;

  • ervaring met Deltares-software (D-serie); ervaring met Plaxis is een pre, net zoals affiniteit met lijninfrastructuur;

  • sterke schriftelijke en mondelinge vaardigheden in zowel het Nederlands als Engels.

Dit krijg je bij Movares

Bij Movares werk je aan opgaven die Nederland verder helpen. Tegelijk krijg je de ruimte om je werk en loopbaan in te richten op een manier die bij jou past. Met goede arbeidsvoorwaarden, veel flexibiliteit en volop mogelijkheden om je te ontwikkelen.

Een sterk fundament

Een goede basis begint bij voorwaarden waarop je kunt rekenen:

  • een salaris tussen € 4.650 en € 7.580 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur;

  • een flexibele pot van minimaal 15% van je jaarsalaris, inclusief vakantiegeld;

  • een goede pensioenregeling bij Zwitserleven, waarbij Movares twee derde van de pensioenpremie betaalt;

  • een NS Business Card voor woon-werkverkeer en zakelijke reizen. Privé profiteer je met de kaart van de dalurenkorting.

Maximaal flexibel

Vorm een manier van werken die aansluit bij jouw leven én jouw ambities. Maak keuzes die bij jou passen:

  • flexibel werken volgens ons Any Time Any Place-principe, passend bij je team, klanten en projecten;

  • De mogelijkheid om twee weken per jaar te werken vanaf je vakantieadres binnen de EU;

  • 20 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen te kopen vanuit je flexibele pot;

  • met je flexibele pot kies je wat voor jou belangrijk is, bijvoorbeeld voor extra inkomen, pensioen, een fiets, bedrijfsfitness, verduurzaming van je woning of het aflossen van je studieschuld;

  • € 750 budget per vijf jaar om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten;

  • € 2,45 netto thuiswerkvergoeding per thuiswerkdag.

Veel ontwikkelmogelijkheden

  • Ontwikkel een loopbaan die past bij jouw talenten en ambities. Kies jouw eigen pad:

  • ruimte om je expertise, ambitie en loopbaan verder te ontwikkelen;

  • leren door te doen, samen met ervaren collega's en met gebruik van een breed aanbod aan ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • de kans om actief kennis te delen en mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van ons vakgebied.

Samen groeien

Deel mee in de waarde die we samen creëren en de groei van onze organisatie. Samen voor succes:

  • je flexibele pot groeit mee met de resultaten van Movares;

  • een winstdeling met een doelbedrag van 5% van je brutojaarsalaris, afhankelijk van de resultaten;

  • en de mogelijkheid tot participeren in de waardeontwikkeling van Movares door middel van aankoop van phantom-aandelen.

Jouw team bij Movares

Je werkt samen met een hechte groep geotechnische adviseurs die elkaar makkelijk weten te vinden. Eén dag per week – op woensdag – werken jullie sowieso samen op kantoor in Utrecht. Daarnaast is twee dagen per week op kantoor gangbaar, maar stemmen we locatie en werktijden flexibel af. Er is altijd iemand aanwezig en de lijnen zijn kort.

De sfeer in het team is open en gelijkwaardig. Er is weinig hiërarchie: senioriteit gaat hier niet over ‘boven iemand staan’, maar over kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Collega’s kunnen goed met elkaar opschieten, schakelen snel en staan voor elkaar klaar. Samenwerken doen we bewust, omdat we geloven dat je daar betere oplossingen van maakt.

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work

⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.
