title: Senior AI - Computer Vision Engineer - UK
descriptionHtml:
Senior AI / Computer Vision Engineer

Build the spatial AI behind the future of construction

At XYZ Reality, we've created the world's first engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution for construction. Our technology, The Atom, is already being used on major construction projects around the world to help teams build more accurately, efficiently and with fewer mistakes.

Our R&D team applies computer vision, spatial AI and machine learning to one of the most demanding real-world settings there is: the active construction site.

We’re looking for a Senior AI / Computer Vision Engineer with deep expertise in 3D computer vision and spatial AI to join the team and help develop the perception technology behind our products.

As a Series B business entering our next phase of growth, we're investing in our R&D capability and growing our team. This great opportunity will be based out of our Angel, London office on a hybrid basis, 2-3 days per week.

The Role

This is an opportunity to solve computer vision problems that exist at the intersection of the digital and physical world.

You’ll develop the perception and scene-understanding systems that enable our wearable technology to recognise construction objects, understand complex 3D environments, and relate what’s on site to the design model, using real-world sensor data.

For this role, 3D / spatial computer vision expertise is fundamental. We’re looking for someone who understands how AI and computer vision can reason about physical space, not simply someone with broader AI or machine learning experience.

You’ll work across research, algorithm development, optimisation, deployment and productisation, taking sophisticated computer vision techniques and turning them into robust technology capable of performing on active construction sites.

You’ll bring senior technical expertise to the team as we build our capability and presence in Calgary. You’ll also collaborate closely with our Navigation, Embedded Software, Hardware and Product teams across the wider business.

This is a role where you can combine deep technical work with real-world impact, seeing the algorithms and systems you develop ultimately deployed through wearable technology on some of the world's most complex construction projects.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Develop advanced computer vision algorithms for construction scene understanding and spatial intelligence.

  • Design and develop semantic segmentation, object detection and instance segmentation models.

  • Build algorithms capable of understanding 3D environments, spatial relationships and physical geometry.

  • Develop automated BIM correspondence and object-matching capabilities.

  • Develop algorithms using multi-modal sensor data.

  • Combine AI, 3D vision, SLAM and BIM to develop geometric and spatial reasoning capabilities.

  • Explore emerging scene representation techniques including Gaussian Splatting and NeRFs.

  • Improve localisation-assisted perception and robustness across varying lighting, weather and real-world site conditions.

  • Design, train and evaluate large-scale deep learning models.

  • Develop data pipelines supporting supervised, self-supervised and semi-supervised learning.

  • Evaluate emerging foundation models, multimodal AI and modern computer vision techniques where they can add meaningful value.

  • Optimise models for embedded deployment, improving inference speed, accuracy and robustness.

  • Deploy and optimise models for embedded GPU platforms.

  • Build and improve production inference pipelines, benchmarking performance, latency and accuracy.

  • Contribute to technical architecture, design reviews and our technical direction.

  • Share knowledge and mentor other engineers as the team continues to grow.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years’ industrial experience in Computer Vision, with strong hands-on experience solving complex technical problems.

  • MSc or PhD in Computer Vision, AI, Computer Science or a related discipline.

  • Experience with perception for autonomous or embodied systems, such as SLAM, sensor fusion or state estimation, would be valuable.

  • Deep expertise in 3D Computer Vision / Spatial AI, this is a core requirement for the role.

  • Strong understanding of geometry, spatial relationships and scene understanding.

  • Experience developing and deploying computer vision and deep learning systems in production.

  • Strong Python development skills and expert knowledge of PyTorch.

  • Experience with semantic segmentation, object detection, image understanding and modern computer vision architectures.

  • Experience designing and training large-scale deep learning models and working with large image datasets.

  • Strong mathematical foundations in machine learning and computer vision.

  • Ability to bridge research and production engineering, comfortable exploring emerging techniques while remaining focused on building robust, deployable products.

  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills and the ability to work through complex, ambiguous technical challenges.

  • A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary engineering teams.

What matters most for this role is genuine depth in 3D / spatial computer vision and the ability to apply that expertise to complex, real-world engineering problems.

We’re particularly interested in someone who is curious about where computer vision and AI are heading, but who also has the practical engineering mindset to turn emerging research into technology that works reliably outside of the lab.

What You Could Be Working On

From the outset, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to some of our highest-priority R&D initiatives, including:

  • 3D construction scene understanding

  • Construction semantic segmentation

  • Automated BIM understanding and object correspondence

  • Spatial reasoning across wearable sensor data

  • Embedded AI deployment

  • Foundation models for construction understanding

  • Perception for wearable AR

Why Join Us

  • 🚀 Work at the intersection of Spatial AI, 3D Computer Vision, AR and real-world engineering

  • 🧠 Solve genuinely difficult perception and scene-understanding problems

  • 🥽 Develop AI that ultimately runs through physical, wearable technology – not just software on a screen

  • 🏗️ See your work applied to some of the world’s most ambitious construction projects

  • 📈 Join a Series B business at an exciting stage of international growth

  • 🔬 Work alongside specialists across Computer Vision, AI, Navigation, Embedded Software and Hardware

  • 💡 Have meaningful influence over technical architecture and the future direction of our perception technology

  • 🌍 Build technology with tangible, real-world impact

If you’re passionate about 3D computer vision and spatial AI, enjoy solving difficult problems at the intersection of research and engineering, and want to see your work move from algorithms into technology being used in the physical world, we’d love to hear from you.

This role sits at the intersection of two things that are rarely mastered together: shipping LLM-powered systems that actually work in messy enterprise reality, and the discipline of a real engineer - evals, observability, cost, latency, failure modes. Models get smarter every month. What stays scarce is the engineering judgment to make them reliably useful on top of SAP, Oracle, and the mess of real operational data.

You will be a senior individual contributor working directly with the founders. The person in this role won’t be handed a roadmap - they’ll help define it, and build the AI practice around it.

What you will do

AI Ownership

  • Own the agent layer end-to-end: prompt and context design, tool use, orchestration, evals, and long-term technical direction.

  • Be the person who understands why an agent made the decision it made - and who other engineers come to when a model behaves in ways they can’t explain.

  • Set the bar on how we build with LLMs: eval-driven development, context engineering, structured outputs, cost and latency discipline.

  • Make foundational decisions with conviction - which model, which pattern, which guardrail - document the reasoning, and evolve them as the system grows.

LLM Systems in Production

  • Design agents that survive real enterprise environments: ambiguous inputs, flaky upstream systems, exception cases that weren’t in anyone’s spec.

  • Build the eval harness that lets us ship confidently: offline evals, online evals, regression suites, human-in-the-loop review.

  • Think in failure modes: hallucinations, silent drift, prompt injection, tool misuse. Build the detection before you need it.

  • Own cost and latency as first-class product requirements, not afterthoughts.

Agent & Context Engineering

  • Design agent architectures that compose cleanly: tool selection, state, memory, planning, escalation.

  • Build the context layer that makes agents actually useful on top of SAP and Oracle data - retrieval, grounding, schema awareness, auditability.

  • Evolve agents without breaking live customer deployments; manage prompt and model versioning with intention.

  • Know when the right answer is a bigger model, a better prompt, a fine-tune, a tool, or just classical code.

Reliability & Systems Thinking

  • Detect regressions in agent behavior before a customer does; build the evals and observability to catch them early.

  • Own the operational posture of the AI systems you ship: alerting, runbooks, replay, on-call readiness.

  • Identify structural debt in prompts, pipelines, and context before it compounds; refactor with thought.

What we are looking for

  • Experience: 6+ years building production software, with clear ownership of LLM-powered systems in real customer environments - not demos, not notebooks.

  • LLM depth: Non-negotiable. You’ve shipped agents or LLM features that run on live traffic. You have strong opinions about prompting, context, tool use, structured outputs, and what breaks in production.

  • Evals as a first instinct: You don’t ship LLM code without a way to measure it. You’ve built eval pipelines that actually catch regressions, not just vibes.

  • Python depth: You’re fluent in Python and comfortable in production service codebases. You make deliberate calls about async, framework choice, and performance.

  • Reliability instinct: Hallucination containment, idempotency on tool calls, graceful degradation when a model is wrong - part of how you design, not patched in later.

  • End-to-end ownership: You’re comfortable being the person who holds the full agent picture - from prompt to production incident. You identify what’s broken or missing before you’re asked.

  • A real spike: We’re a strong team with broad coverage. What we’re hiring for is someone who brings a 10x improvement in an area we’re currently underinvested in. That might be agent evaluation, context engineering on enterprise data, agentic reliability, deep NLP/LLM internals, or domain-specific grounding. We don’t know exactly what shape it takes - but you should know what yours is, and be able to articulate why it matters.

descriptionHtml:
Worum es geht

MAIA ist eine KI-Plattform für Unternehmen. Mit MAIA durchsuchen Teams ihre internen Daten und verankern Agenten tief in ihren Prozessen. Wir begleiten Unternehmen dabei, KI nicht nur in einzelnen Abteilungen, sondern im ganzen Unternehmen einzusetzen.

Technisch heißt das: Wir bauen eine GenAI-Anwendung mit eigenen Agentensystemen, RAG-Pipelines und agentenbasierten Workflows, binden externe Systeme unserer Kunden an und analysieren ihre Daten. Wir nutzen die besten verfügbaren Modelle, betrieben in der EU, und machen sie verlässlich für anspruchsvolle Arbeit mit großen, komplexen Datenmengen.

Zahlreiche Industrieunternehmen arbeiten seit Jahren intensiv mit MAIA. Nach unserer erfolgreichen Finanzierungsrunde 2026 bringen wir MAIA jetzt in die Breite. Entwickelt wird MAIA seit 2021 in Leipzig.

Was du bei uns machst

Als AI Engineer entwickelst du MAIA weiter und bestimmst von Anfang an mit, wie wir Probleme lösen.

Woran du arbeiten kannst:

  • Vom Konzept zum Feature. Gemeinsam mit dem Produktmanagement schärfst du grobe Konzepte und verantwortest Features vom Prototyp bis zur Weiterentwicklung anhand von Feedback und Nutzungsdaten.

  • Chat und Agenten. Du gestaltest, wie Menschen mit MAIA arbeiten: Fragen stellen, Kontext mitgeben und Agenten mehrstufige Aufgaben erledigen lassen – mit nachvollziehbarem Fortschritt und prüfbaren Ergebnissen.

  • Unternehmenswissen erschließen. Du bindest externe Systeme an und machst Wissen aus unterschiedlichen Dateiformaten nutzbar. So findet MAIA die richtigen Stellen, liefert Antworten mit Quellen und hält dabei bestehende Zugriffsrechte ein.

  • Modelle und Qualität. Du integrierst neue Sprachmodelle und vergleichst Qualität, Kosten und Geschwindigkeit. Mit Evals erkennst du Fehler und verbesserst Antworten und Agenten systematisch.

  • Sicher, schnell und stabil. Du baust isolierte Umgebungen für die Ausführung von Code und Tools und verbesserst Antwortzeiten und Datenverarbeitung, damit MAIA auch bei großen Wissensbeständen zuverlässig läuft.

Was wir suchen

  • Solides Software Engineering. Du hast Backend-Systeme gebaut, ausgeliefert und über längere Zeit in Produktion betrieben. Architektur, API-Design, Datenmodellierung und asynchrone Verarbeitung sind dir vertraut. Schwache Architektur erkennst du auch dann, wenn ein Coding Agent sie geschrieben hat.

  • Sehr gut in mindestens einer unserer Sprachen. TypeScript, Python oder Go, am besten eine der statisch typisierten. Alle drei musst du nicht mitbringen. In die anderen arbeitest du dich ein.

  • Zu Hause im LLM-Ökosystem. Du hast echte Anwendungen mit LLMs gebaut, beruflich oder in komplexen eigenen Projekten. RAG, Embeddings, Vektorsuche und Tool Calling kennst du aus der Praxis, auch die Stellen, an denen sie scheitern. Neue Modelle und Frameworks probierst du aus eigenem Antrieb aus und trennst dabei Substanz von Hype. Produktionserfahrung mit LLM-Systemen ist ein großes Plus.

  • Messen statt vermuten. Du weißt, wie man Systeme testet und evaluiert, die auf dieselbe Frage nicht immer gleich antworten. Du baust die einfachste Lösung, die das Problem löst. Weitere Retrieval-Stufen, Prompt-Ketten oder Abstraktionen kommen erst dazu, wenn Messungen sie rechtfertigen.

  • Produktdenken. Du denkst an die Person, die mit MAIA unter Zeitdruck ein Angebot fertigstellen oder eine technische Frage klären muss. Du steigst gern früh in die Konzepte des Produktmanagements ein, stellst die richtigen Fragen und bringst eigene Lösungsideen ein, auch wenn noch nicht alles feststeht.

  • Agentisch arbeiten. Coding Agents gehören für dich zum Alltag. Du schreibst Pläne, die andere prüfen und auf denen Coding Agents aufbauen können, prüfst die Ergebnisse kritisch und weißt, wo sie helfen und wo nicht.

  • Sicherheit mitdenken. Unsere Kunden vertrauen uns ihr internes Wissen an. Mandantentrennung, Zugriffsrechte und sichere Entwicklung sind für dich selbstverständlich.

  • Klar kommunizieren. Du erklärst technische Zusammenhänge verständlich, auch gegenüber Produktmanagement, Customer Success und Vertrieb. Du sprichst sehr sicher Deutsch und ebenso Englisch.

Die Rolle umfasst keine Personalverantwortung. Ob du als AI Engineer oder Senior AI Engineer einsteigst, besprechen wir spätestens nach dem technischen Interview offen mit dir.

Arbeiten bei MAIA

Uns verbindet ein gemeinsames Ziel: ein richtig gutes Produkt zu bauen. Jede und jeder übernimmt Verantwortung für das eigene Thema. Wir haben Spaß an der Arbeit und sind stolz auf das, was unsere Kunden mit MAIA erreichen. Die Wege sind kurz, und Entscheidungen fallen schnell. Im Engineering-Team hinterfragen wir kritisch, wie wir entwickeln, und verbessern unsere Prozesse laufend, gerade in der agentischen Entwicklung.

Wir arbeiten gern zusammen in unserem Büro, zentral zwischen Innenstadt und Zoo, und kochen fast jeden Tag gemeinsam. An mindestens drei Tagen pro Woche sind wir vor Ort, an den übrigen arbeitest du, wo du möchtest. Wann dein Tag beginnt, legst du selbst fest.

  • Zugang zu aktuellen Frontier-Modellen und Coding Agents

  • Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungen, die zu deiner beruflichen Entwicklung passen

  • Zugang zu einer Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft

Vergütung

Das Jahresbruttogehalt liegt bei 75.000 bis 95.000 €. Wo du in dieser Spanne liegst, hängt von deinem Level ab. Darüber sprechen wir spätestens nach dem technischen Interview. Dazu kommt eine virtuelle Beteiligung über unser VSOP.

Bewerbung und nächste Schritte

Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte uns in ein paar eigenen Sätzen eine Frage: Warum willst du MAIA mitgestalten?

Wir arbeiten jeden Tag mit KI. Für diese Antwort zählt aber deine eigene Perspektive. Schreib sie deshalb bitte selbst, gern kurz und ohne Feinschliff.

Passt es, folgen ein 30-minütiges Kennenlernen, ein 90-minütiges technisches Interview und ein Abschlussgespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Nach jedem Schritt hörst du in der Regel innerhalb von zwei Werktagen von uns. Unser Ziel ist eine Entscheidung in rund drei Wochen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Senior AI Engineer, Location AI
descriptionHtml:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What you'll do

This role is scoped by skill rather than by product. The problems below span multiple departments and show up across our Search and Places data work, our Location and Navigation Intelligence work, and the Platform work that makes Mapbox usable by agents. You'll be hired into one specific team or product area, but you'll work across teams where your expertise meets the highest-priority AI problems. You should expect to move between teams and tech stacks as the work demands.

At this level you own the technical design and delivery of a multi-component AI system, and you are accountable for the quality of what ships in your area.

In this role, you will:

  • Define how the products you own should work, build a measurement framework for it, and build evaluation systems for non-deterministic behavior. Formulate hypotheses around the products we build and seek the signal needed to validate them. Define what a correct result is for a given input and state, determine whether to assemble datasets from real usage or hand-written cases, and gate changes on regression results.

  • Run continuous evaluation of the products we build, whether APIs, SDKs, data representations, or reference applications, from the position of the end user, whether developer, agent, or consumer. Assess the gaps such as misuse of parameters or integration anti-patterns, recommend the fixes, and make sure they land.

  • Own the MVP against an agreed north star technical design, and balance technical perfection against shipping useful increments.

  • Build data pipelines and the tooling around them: ingestion, conflation, entity resolution, quality checks, and the batch and streaming jobs that keep a large dataset current.

  • Track and pull external datasets, models, and benchmarks from published research and open-source releases. Evaluate what fits the problem and constraints , and decide when to adopt what exists versus build your own.

  • Design feedback loops so that using a product generates data that improves it. Instrument systems so failures arrive with enough context to reproduce, then turn the recurring ones into evaluation cases.

  • Design the boundary between a model and the tools it calls. Build or improve the model harness, decide what the model handles, what it delegates, and how to keep it working from the state it actually fetched.

  • Work to a latency and cost target per request: streaming, partial results, caching, model routing, prompt structure.

  • Build the internal harnesses and tools (CLI, MCP, and others) your team needs to iterate quickly, and share the parts that generalize with other teams.

  • Raise the bar on your team through code and design review, and bring other engineers up on eval practice.

  • Some of the technical questions in this area are still open. You will help answer them.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our systems remain available to customers 24/7. Team members alternate as the on-call primary responder, which may require immediate response outside normal working hours, including weekends.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • Required Education/Certification:

    • Bachelors Degree in STEM discipline and 5+ years of software engineering experience, with production ownership of services, pipelines, or SDKs.

  • Technical Skills & Tools (Must-Haves):

    • 2+ years shipping LLM-backed features to real users, in systems that carried error budgets, on-call rotations, and customers who noticed regressions.

    • Data engineering depth: SQL, at least one distributed processing framework, and experience with pipelines where a wrong record mattered more than a slow one.

    • Fluency with tool calling and agent orchestration, including the failure modes: stale context, hallucinated arguments, silent partial success, unbounded loops.

    • Strong Python or TypeScript, and comfort reading code in whatever language the caller happens to be written in.

  • Core Competencies & Scope:

    • Direct experience or deep understanding of designing evaluations for non-deterministic systems. You can describe a dataset you built and the failure it caught.

    • Working knowledge of more than one agent harness, and opinions about where each of them is weak.

    • Experience diagnosing latency in a distributed request path.

    • Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to ship something narrow that works while the general solution is still unclear.

Nice to Have Traits for this Role

  • Geospatial data experience: routing, geocoding, POI or address data, OpenStreetMap, or conflation of overlapping sources.

  • Public API or SDK design experience, particularly for developers you never talk to.

  • Experience building against MCP or similar tool transports.

  • Experience running evals in CI, with a commercial harness or one you built.

  • Automotive, in-vehicle infotainment, CarPlay, or Android Auto experience.

  • Voice pipeline experience: streaming ASR, TTS, barge-in, endpointing, wake word.

  • Work under constrained compute, offline, or intermittent connectivity.

  • Experience operating a product through its first external integrations, where the customer finds the gaps before you do.

Employment Requirements

  • Employment Type: Full-time

  • Weekly Hours: 40 h per week

  • Location/Hybrid Policy: Remote (from any city in Germany)

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

 

How we support you

  • Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable.

  • Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits.

  • Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family.

  • Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth

  • Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents.

  • Rest & Recharge: Paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies.

  • Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have received the Mapbox Non-US Privacy Notice for applicants, which is linked here. We are committed to a fair and equitable hiring process. We do not discriminate against any protected class.

descriptionHtml:
What we do

MAIA is an AI platform for companies. With MAIA, teams search their internal data and embed agents deep into their processes. We help companies use AI not just in individual departments, but across the entire organisation.

On a technical level, this means: we build a GenAI application with our own agent systems, RAG pipelines and agent-based workflows, connect our customers' external systems and analyse their data. We use the best available models, operated in the EU, and make them reliable for demanding work with large, complex datasets.

Many industrial companies have been using MAIA intensively for years. Following our successful 2026 funding round, we are now taking MAIA to a broader market. MAIA has been developed in Leipzig since 2021.

What you'll do

As an AI Engineer, you develop MAIA further and help decide from the start how we solve problems.

What you can work on:

  • From concept to feature. Together with product management, you sharpen rough concepts and own features from prototype to continuous improvement based on feedback and usage data.

  • Chat and agents. You shape how people work with MAIA: asking questions, providing context and letting agents complete multi-step tasks, with traceable progress and verifiable results.

  • Unlocking company knowledge. You connect external systems and make knowledge from many different file formats usable. This way, MAIA finds the right passages, delivers answers with sources and respects existing access rights.

  • Models and quality. You integrate new language models and compare quality, cost and speed. With evals, you detect errors and systematically improve answers and agents.

  • Secure, fast and stable. You build isolated environments for running code and tools and improve response times and data processing, so that MAIA runs reliably even with large knowledge bases.

What we're looking for

  • Solid software engineering. You have built and shipped backend systems and operated them in production over a longer period. Architecture, API design, data modelling and asynchronous processing are familiar to you. You recognise weak architecture even when a coding agent wrote it.

  • Very strong in at least one of our languages. TypeScript, Python or Go, ideally one of the statically typed ones. You don't need all three. You'll get up to speed in the others.

  • At home in the LLM ecosystem. You have built real applications with LLMs, professionally or in complex personal projects. You know RAG, embeddings, vector search and tool calling from practice, including where they fail. You try out new models and frameworks on your own initiative and separate substance from hype. Production experience with LLM systems is a big plus.

  • Measure, don't guess. You know how to test and evaluate systems that don't always give the same answer to the same question. You build the simplest solution that solves the problem. Additional retrieval stages, prompt chains or abstractions only come in when measurements justify them.

  • Product thinking. You think about the person who needs to finish a quote under time pressure or clarify a technical question with MAIA. You like to get involved early in product management's concepts, ask the right questions and contribute your own ideas, even when not everything is settled yet.

  • Agentic engineering. Coding agents are part of your daily work. You write plans that others review and that coding agents can build on, you review the results critically, and you know where agents help and where they don't.

  • Security-minded. Our customers trust us with their internal knowledge. Tenant isolation, access rights and secure development are second nature to you.

  • Remote-ready. You communicate proactively, document your work so others can follow it, and move things forward without constant coordination.

  • Clear communication. You explain technical topics clearly, including to product management, customer success and sales. You are fluent in English. German is a plus.

This role has no people management responsibility. Whether you join at regular or senior level is something we'll discuss openly with you after the technical interview at the latest.

Working at MAIA

We share a common goal: building a really great product. Everyone takes ownership of their own area. We enjoy our work and are proud of what our customers achieve with MAIA. Paths are short and decisions are made quickly. In the engineering team, we critically question how we develop and continuously improve our processes, especially in agentic development.

Much of the team works together in our office in Leipzig, centrally located between the city centre and the zoo, where we cook together almost every day. You work remotely from anywhere in Germany. You need to live in Germany for this role. Twice a year, we meet in person for team events, and from time to time there are team days in Leipzig. When your day starts is up to you.

  • Access to the latest frontier models and coding agents

  • Support for training that fits your professional development

  • Access to a Wellpass membership

Compensation

The annual gross salary is €75,000 to €95,000. Where you fall within this range depends on your level. We'll discuss this after the technical interview at the latest. On top of that, you receive a virtual share in our VSOP.

Application and next steps

You don't need a cover letter. Send us your CV and answer one question in a few sentences of your own: Why do you want to help shape MAIA?

We work with AI every day. For this answer, though, your own perspective is what counts. So please write it yourself. Short and unpolished is fine.

If there's a fit, you'll have a 30-minute intro call, a 90-minute technical interview and a final conversation with our management. After each step, you'll usually hear from us within two business days. Our goal is a decision in about three weeks.

We look forward to your application.

Rivia’s ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end.

 

About AI Engineering at Rivia

Given the highly complex nature of clinical trials and how they interface with our technology, the AI Engineering team at Rivia is pivotal in ensuring our clients achieve their desired outcomes and derive maximum value from our platform.

The team designs and operates agentic, production-grade AI workflows that power critical monitoring, data quality, and insight-generation capabilities for clinical trial stakeholders.​

By building reliable, auditable, and scalable AI systems, AI Engineering helps transform fragmented clinical data into actionable intelligence and positions Rivia as the AI-first platform for clinical trial intelligence.

 

The Role

As a Senior AI Engineer at Rivia, you will architect and ship high-impact AI workflows that materially improve how clinical trial teams monitor studies, assess data quality, and make operational decisions.​

You will work as a key technical contributor embedded in product initiatives, owning AI features end-to-end from design and evaluation through to deployment, observability, and continuous improvement.​

The ideal candidate is a product-minded engineer who combines deep LLM and agentic systems expertise with strong software engineering skills, a bias to action, and a passion for turning cutting-edge AI into reliable, commercially impactful products in a complex, regulated domain.

 

What excites you

  • Being part of a collaborative startup where you can make a direct impact on the product, the business, and the team.

  • Working in a fast-paced environment where you can leverage your AI engineering expertise to solve complex, real-world problems in clinical trials.

  • Building AI systems that customers rely on for critical decisions, where trust, traceability, and auditability are essential.

  • Owning outcomes end-to-end, driving clarity, momentum, and quality without heavy oversight, and continuously learning and experimenting in the rapidly evolving LLM landscape.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and ship production-grade agentic AI workflows, including tool use, orchestration, planning, memory, and structured outputs, for clinical trial intelligence use cases.

  • Translate user workflows and product requirements into pragmatic, measurable AI solutions that work reliably in production and optimize for user and business value.

  • Design and maintain evaluation pipelines, including gold sets, metrics, and experiments, and use them to drive iteration with rigor.

  • Implement robust LLMOps practices, including tracing, monitoring, cost and latency management, safe deployment, and continuous improvement of AI systems in production.

  • Design high-quality retrieval and context pipelines with strong guarantees on correctness, provenance, and auditability, particularly in regulated environments such as clinical trials.

  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, Design, Sales, and Customer teams to ensure AI features are usable, trusted, and commercially impactful.

  • Stay deeply current with the LLM ecosystem, actively experiment with new models and tools, and translate innovation into practical product advantage.

 

What Excites us

  • Product mindset, with a demonstrated ability to translate user workflows into pragmatic, measurable AI solutions that work reliably in production

  • Deep familiarity with the current LLM ecosystem and active experimentation with new models, tools, and techniques.

  • Proven experience building and shipping production-grade AI or agentic systems, ideally in high-stakes or complex domains.

  • Strong software engineering skills and comfort owning systems end-to-end, from design to deployment and maintenance.

Hiring Process

Our hiring process takes 2-5 weeks over four distinct stages:

  1. Meet and greet: 30-minute call with the HR team to get to know each other. This is an informal chat.

  2. Technical Screening: 60-minute interview to delve into high-level technical concepts and your problem-solving approaches.

Our Values

At Rivia, we are committed to excellence, continuous learning, and the success of both our customers and our team. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale. 

Role Summary (Location Melbourne or Sydney)

The Senior Kubernetes Engineer, AI Infrastructure owns the technical design and delivery of the backend infrastructure that powers the Firmus Kubernetes platform. This is a hands-on principal-level individual contributor role, responsible for building production-grade cluster lifecycle, control-plane, networking, storage, security, observability, and automation capabilities across GPU-accelerated bare-metal environments.

They solve the hardest platform engineering problems, set Kubernetes engineering standards, and provide domain-level technical sign-off for platform designs. They work across AI Platforms, Solutions Architecture & Delivery, networking, security, and operations to create a secure, resilient, multi-tenant platform that can be deployed and operated consistently at AI-factory scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and own the Kubernetes platform reference architecture across management and workload clusters, including control-plane topology, cluster lifecycle, multi-tenancy, workload isolation, and failure-domain design.
  • Build and maintain the backend services, APIs, controllers, operators, and automation required to provision, configure, upgrade, scale, and retire Kubernetes clusters reliably.
  • Engineer repeatable bare-metal Kubernetes deployment and lifecycle workflows using infrastructure-as-code and automated provisioning technologies such as Cluster API, kubeadm, Redfish, PXE, Ironic, or Metal3.
  • Design and operate cluster networking across CNI, ingress, service discovery, DNS, load balancing, network policy, and service mesh; integrate Multus, SR-IOV, BGP, InfiniBand, or RoCE where required for high-performance AI workloads.
  • Define persistent-storage and data-service patterns using CSI, Ceph, local NVMe, object storage, backup and restore, and disaster-recovery mechanisms appropriate for stateful platform and AI workloads.
  • Integrate and productionise NVIDIA GPU and Network Operators, device plugins, drivers, DCGM telemetry, scheduling, quotas, and topology-aware placement for multi-node accelerated workloads.
  • Establish GitOps and CI/CD patterns for platform software, configuration, policy, and release management, with safe testing, progressive rollout, rollback, and upgrade practices.
  • Build platform security into the architecture through identity and access control, RBAC, secrets management, policy-as-code, image and software-supply-chain controls, tenant isolation, and auditable change management.
  • Define service-level objectives and engineer observability for metrics, logs, traces, events, capacity, and performance; lead diagnosis of complex distributed systems failures and eliminate recurring operational toil.
  • Set engineering standards, design patterns, review practices, and operational readiness criteria; mentor senior engineers and resolve cross-team technical decisions while remaining directly involved in implementation.

Skills & Experience

  • 7+ years of progressive infrastructure, systems, or platform engineering experience, including substantial ownership of production Kubernetes platforms and at least 3 years operating at senior staff, principal, or equivalent level.
  • Deep knowledge of Kubernetes internals, including the API server, etcd, scheduler, controller manager, kubelet, admission, CRI, CNI, CSI, reconciliation patterns, cluster performance, upgrades, and control-plane failure modes.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating highly available, large scale and multi-cluster Kubernetes platforms on bare metal, private cloud, or hybrid infrastructure.
  • Strong software engineering ability in Go and/or Rust, with practical Python and Bash skills; experience building Kubernetes operators, controllers, admission webhooks, CLIs, or platform services.
  • Expert Linux systems knowledge, including namespaces, cgroups, systemd, kernel, host networking and container runtime behaviour, performance analysis, and low-level troubleshooting.
  • Strong Kubernetes networking expertise across Cilium, Calico, or equivalent CNI implementations, plus load balancing, DNS, ingress, BGP, network policy, and multi-network architectures.
  • Strong infrastructure automation and GitOps experience with tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Argo CD, Flux, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins.
  • Practical experience with Kubernetes security and governance, including RBAC, OPA Gatekeeper or Kyverno, secrets management, certificate lifecycle, image security, and workload isolation.
  • Experience implementing production observability with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Loki, Elasticsearch, or equivalent technologies, and using telemetry to manage reliability, capacity, and performance.
  • Experience with GPU-enabled Kubernetes infrastructure, NVIDIA GPU Operator, accelerator scheduling for AI workloads at large scale, RDMA networking, and distributed AI workload requirements.
  • Experience with distributed storage and data services such as Ceph, CSI-backed storage, object storage, backup and restore, and disaster recovery.
  • CKA-level expertise is expected; CKA, CKS, or relevant cloud-native certifications are strongly preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent depth of practical engineering experience.
  • Clear technical judgement and communication, with a record of influencing architecture across software, networking, security, platform, and operations teams.

Location & Reporting

  • Australia (Sydney, NSW or Launceston, TAS)
  • Reporting to Head of AI Platform

Employment Basis

Full-time

Diversity

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

title: (Senior) AI Product Manager (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Unsere Opportunity

Predium hat in den letzten drei Jahren die führende ESG-Intelligence-Plattform für institutionelle Immobilienunternehmen in der DACH-Region gebaut - mit den stärksten Namen der Branche als Kunden: Asset Manager, Wohnungsbaugesellschaften, Banken. Unsere Kundenbasis, die Daten, unsere Glaubwürdigkeit sind wertvolles Kapital für den nächsten Schritt. Investment-, Kredit- und Asset-Management-Entscheidung werden in der Real Estate Branche noch immer in Excel getroffen, Fall für Fall. Wir bauen jetzt den AI-Analysten, der diese Arbeit übernimmt. Direkt auf den Daten des Kunden, skalierbar ohne zusätzliche Köpfe. Wir sind stark finanziert und bringen KI in die Real Estate Branche.

Deine Mission

Du verantwortest das Produkt auf beiden Ebenen: das bestehende ESG-Produkt weiterentwickeln und die nächste Evolutionsstufe mitgestalten, den AI-Analysten für Asset Manager, Credit Officers und Transaction Manager. Du arbeitest eng mit Engineers, Kunden und unserem Gründer- und Führungsteam zusammen. Du bist verantwortlich für Kundennutzen und Umsatz, nicht für Features. Du gehst zum Kunden mit, verstehst ihre Welt, und übersetzt das in validierte Prototypen und klare Build-Entscheidungen.

Was du konkret tust

  1. Own strategic product development: Du gehst raus zu unseren Kunden, verstehst ihre Prozesse sowie pain points, die sie selbst ohne dein Zutun nicht erwähnen. Du baust eigenverantwortlich Produkte, die die Nachhaltigkeit von Immobilien fördern und einen messbaren finanziellen Impact auf unsere Kunden und unser Produkt haben.
  2. Collaborate closely: Du arbeitest eng mit Gründern / Geschäftsleitung und einem starken Engineering-Team zusammen und erhältst jegliche Unterstützung, um die richtigen Produkte schnell an den Kunden zu bringen.
  3. Iterate fast, finish fully: Du erstellst Prototypen mit AI-Tools und hast die Freiheit, selbständig und schnell zu iterieren, um Ideen in Stunden zu testen statt in Wochen. Speed und Urteilsvermögen sind dein Kompass. „Shipped" bedeutet für dich: der Kunde nutzt es, und es liefert Wert.

Woran wir Erfolg messen

Du hast in den ersten 6 Monaten zu 2-3 vielversprechenden Product Bets durch echte Iteration mit Kundenfeedback beigetragen. Du bist in mindestens einem Kernbereich so tief drin, dass Engineers und Kunden dir vertrauen, wichtige Entscheidungen zu treffen.

Was du mitbringst

  1. Du hast bereits digitale B2B-Produkte end-to-end entwickelt und erfolgreich iteriert. Du verstehst Kundenprobleme, denkst wirtschaftlich und hast nachweislich Mehrwert für Kunden und das Business geschaffen.
  2. Du gehst souverän mit Unsicherheit um. Du definierst Hypothesen, testest schnell, triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis unvollständiger Informationen und übernimmst Verantwortung, statt auf perfekte Anforderungen zu warten.
  3. AI ist fester Bestandteil deiner täglichen Arbeitsweise. Du nutzt LLMs, Agents und moderne AI-Tools wie Cursor oder Claude produktiv und hast bereits AI-Features oder AI-Workflows entwickelt – inklusive der typischen Herausforderungen wie Evals, Latenz, Halluzinationen oder Human-in-the-Loop.
  4. Du kommunizierst klar und überzeugend. Du arbeitest eng mit Kunden, Design, Engineering und Go-to-Market zusammen und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich vermitteln.
  5. Du kommunizierst souverän auf Deutsch und Englisch.
  6. Du glaubst daran, dass außergewöhnliche Produkte durch enge Zusammenarbeit entstehen. Deshalb bist du vier Tage pro Woche mit dem Team im Münchner Büro.

Bonus Punkte

  1. Du hast selbst ein Unternehmen gegründet oder kommerzielle AI Lösungen gebaut.
  2. Erfahrung mit Immobilien-, ESG- oder Finanzdaten.

Dealbreakers

  1. Du willst primär selbst Production-Code besitzen. Diese Rolle entscheidet, was gebaut wird und warum, und misst sich am Kundennutzen, nicht an gemergten PRs.
  2. Du brauchst klare Spezifikationen und abgestimmte Roadmaps, bevor du anfängst. Ambiguität verlangsamt dich, statt dich neugierig zu machen.
  3. AI-Tools sind für dich noch kein Teil deines täglichen Workflows, nicht als Lernbereitschaft, sondern als aktuelle Realität.
  4. Du arbeitest lieber im Stillen als im engen Austausch mit Kunden, CS und Product. Bei Predium gibt es keine Rolle, die hinter Prozessen verschwindet.

Warum Predium?

  • Stage: ~40 Leute, stark finanziert, auf dem Weg die Kategorie zu definieren. Früh genug, dass vieles noch gebaut werden muss. Ja, es ist manchmal messy - aber genau das ist der Punkt. Wenn du einen fertigen Playbook-Job suchst, ist das hier nicht der richtige Fit.
  • Impact: Du bist nicht Rädchen #100 in einer Company. Was du hier aufbaust - Produkt, das Kunden wirklich nutzen - bleibt. Dein Beitrag ist direkt sichtbar, im Revenue und im Produkt.
  • Ownership: Wir managen nicht deine Zeit, wir messen deine Ergebnisse. Du bekommst Verantwortung und Freiraum - und die Erwartung, beides zu nutzen.
  • Compensation: Competitive Salary, Bonus und Equity-Beteiligung. Wir wollen, dass du am Erfolg partizipierst, den du mitaufbaust.
  • Team: Office-first im Werksviertel München, 3,5 Tage/Woche.

descriptionHtml:

Why Firmus?

We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.

What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.

Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.

ROLE SUMMARY

The Senior AI Security Engineer, AI Products & Applications will be embedded within the AI & Applications team to enable the secure design, development, release, and operation of AI products and applications. The role works directly with AI engineers, application engineers, product managers, inference engineers, DevOps, and platform teams to build practical security controls into agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), model-serving APIs, enterprise-data integrations, and user-facing AI experiences.

This is a product- and application-oriented security role. The engineer will help teams deliver trusted AI features without unnecessarily slowing innovation, while ensuring that AI products protect customer, enterprise, and operational data. The role reports operationally to the Head of AI & Applications, with a dotted-line reporting relationship to the Head of Cybersecurity to maintain alignment with enterprise security strategy, risk management, compliance requirements, and incident-response processes.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Partner with AI product, application, and engineering teams from discovery through production to define secure-by-design architectures for AI-powered products and services.
  • Threat-model LLM-enabled and agentic workflows, including direct and indirect prompt injection, data exfiltration, unsafe tool use, excessive agent permissions, cross-tenant access, model abuse, and unintended autonomous actions.
  • Design secure patterns for agent identity, delegated authorization, scoped credentials, tool allowlists, approval gates, action validation, execution sandboxing, rollback, and auditability.
  • Secure RAG and enterprise-knowledge workflows, including document ingestion, indexing, retrieval permissions, metadata filtering, source attribution, tenant isolation, sensitive-data classification, and data-retention controls.
  • Define security controls for user-facing AI products, including authentication, authorization, consent, rate limiting, abuse detection, content and output controls, conversation-data handling, and customer-facing audit trails.
  • Secure model-serving and inference APIs through workload identity, API authentication, tenant-aware access controls, quotas, request validation, model access policies, usage monitoring, and logging controls.
  • Build reusable AI security guardrails, libraries, reference architectures, templates, policy-as-code, and developer tooling that make secure implementation the default path for product teams.
  • Work with DevOps and Platform teams to ensure Kubernetes, custom job-scheduler integrations, CI/CD pipelines, secrets management, containers, and runtime environments provide the required security posture for AI applications.
  • Lead vulnerability management for AI application dependencies, model-serving runtimes, agent frameworks, SDKs, APIs, containers, CUDA and GPU software components, and related infrastructure.
  • Embed security requirements into application design reviews, pull-request and CI/CD controls, release processes, operational runbooks, and incident-response procedures.
  • Develop security telemetry and detections for anomalous agent actions, unsafe tool calls, unusual data retrieval, credential misuse, inference API abuse, suspicious workload behavior, and policy violations.
  • Act as the principal security liaison between AI & Applications and the Cybersecurity function, coordinating architecture reviews, security exceptions, risk acceptance, compliance evidence, incident response, and remediation tracking.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • 5+ years of experience in security engineering, application security, cloud security, platform security, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience embedding security practices into software engineering or product-development teams and supporting secure delivery from design through production.
  • Strong understanding of application security, API security, secure software development lifecycle practices, threat modeling, vulnerability management, and security automation.
  • Practical understanding of AI and LLM application security risks, including prompt injection, indirect prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure tool use, excessive agency, model abuse, sensitive-data exposure, cross-tenant data leakage, and supply-chain risks.
  • Experience securing agentic applications, RAG systems, enterprise search, vector databases, model-serving APIs, enterprise-data connectors, or comparable AI-enabled systems.
  • Experience designing identity and access controls using OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SSO, RBAC, ABAC, workload identity, service accounts, secrets management, and least-privilege principles.
  • Strong knowledge of Kubernetes and container security, including admission controls, network policies, RBAC, runtime protection, image scanning, software supply-chain security, and policy engines.
  • Experience with secure CI/CD, dependency governance, SBOMs, image signing, provenance, artifact management, and controlled-release processes.
  • Proficiency in Python, Go, or a similar language for automation, security tooling, integrations, and analysis.
  • Familiarity with cloud and infrastructure security, including logging, monitoring, incident response, encryption, key management, and security controls for multi-tenant systems.
  • Knowledge of security and compliance frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, CIS Controls, OWASP ASVS, OWASP API Security Top 10, or equivalent frameworks.

KEY COMPETENCIES

  • Secure-by-design AI product and application engineering.
  • Threat modeling for LLM, RAG, agentic, and autonomous workflows.

  • Secure AI data flows, retrieval controls, and tenant isolation.
  • Agent governance, tool authorization, human-in-the-loop controls, and action auditability.
  • Kubernetes, container, CI/CD, and software supply-chain security.

  • Developer enablement through reusable guardrails, secure patterns, automation, and clear documentation.

SUCCESS METRICS

  • Percentage of AI products, agentic workflows, RAG systems, and inference services that complete security design review before production release.
  • Adoption rate of reusable security patterns, guardrails, libraries, templates, and policy controls across AI & Applications projects.

title: Senior AI Solutions Engineer (m/w/d)- Beratung und Umsetzung im Mittelstand
descriptionHtml:
Du verstehst KI-Systeme bis ins Detail. Und Du kannst sie einem Geschäftsführer so erklären, dass er die richtige Entscheidung trifft.

Wir wollen die KI-Expert:innen im Mittelstand sein. Nicht die, die am lautesten über KI reden, sondern die, die wissen, warum ein RAG-System schlechte Antworten liefert, welches Modell lokal betrieben werden kann und welcher Use Case in drei Monaten Wirkung zeigt. Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die beides mitbringen: echte technische Tiefe und Erfahrung darin, Kunden durch Projekte zu führen.

Als Senior AI Solutions Engineer bei Neurawork verantwortest Du Kundenprojekte von der ersten Analyse bis zum Go-live. Du nimmst Prozesse und Datenlage auf, bewertest Use Cases auf Machbarkeit und Wirkung, entwirfst die Architektur und setzt die Lösung selbst um, auf Basis unserer standardisierten Produkte und bis zur vollständigen Integration in die Systemlandschaft des Kunden. Der Kunde vertraut Dir, weil Du technisch weißt, wovon Du sprichst.

Wir arbeiten nach unserem eigenen Operational-AI-Vorgehensmodell. Wir sind keine Automation-Agentur und keine Custom-Softwareentwickler: Standardisierte Produkte sind unser Hebel, und wir passen sie bis zur vollständigen Integration an. Wir schaffen echten, messbaren Mehrwert und stehen dafür ein.

Aufgaben

Was Du bei uns machst

  • Projekte verantworten: Kundenprojekte im Mittelstand führen, vom Kick-off bis zur Übergabe in den Betrieb

  • Bewerten: Prozesse und Daten beim Kunden verstehen, Use Cases auf Machbarkeit, Kosten und Grenzen prüfen und nach Wirkung priorisieren

  • Selbst bauen: Architektur entwerfen, unsere Produkte konfigurieren und erweitern, Retrieval und Prompting optimieren, Qualität messbar machen

  • Integrieren: Schnittstellen, Datenanbindung, Sicherheit und Betrieb gemeinsam mit der Kunden-IT umsetzen

  • Beraten mit Substanz: Fachabteilung, IT und Geschäftsführung fundiert begleiten, Erwartungen klar steuern, Roadmaps entwickeln, die technisch tragen

  • Menschen mitnehmen: Workshops moderieren und Teilnehmende befähigen, damit die Lösung im Alltag ankommt

  • Weitergeben: Erkenntnisse in unsere Frameworks und Produkte zurückspielen; Live-Sessions in unserer KI-Ausbildung mit TÜV Süd Zertifikat und im KI-Business-Coaching

Nicht passend für Dich, wenn...

Nicht passend für Dich, wenn …

  • Du KI-Projekte bisher gesteuert oder begleitet, aber nicht selbst technisch umgesetzt hast,

  • Deine KI-Systeme ausschließlich mit No-Code-Tools entstanden sind,

  • Du am liebsten nur im Code bleibst und Kundentermine, Workshops oder Gespräche mit der Geschäftsführung lieber anderen überlässt

Qualifikation

Was Du mitbringst

Technisches Fundament:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im MINT-Bereich (z. B. Informatik, Mathematik, Physik, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Data Science). Alternativ mehrere Jahre professionelle Softwareentwicklung. Zertifikatskurse und Weiterbildungen ersetzen das nicht.

  • Mindestens ein KI-System, das Du selbst konzipiert und umgesetzt hast und zeigen kannst, z. B. eine RAG-Pipeline, einen produktiven Agenten oder eine technisch verantwortete Automatisierung

  • Du programmierst sicher (z. B. Python) und arbeitest mit APIs, Datenbanken und Deployment. Reine No-Code- oder Low-Code-Erfahrung reicht für diese Rolle nicht.

  • Du kannst technische Entscheidungen begründen, z. B. warum Du ein Modell, eine Chunking-Strategie oder einen Cloud- statt lokalen Betrieb gewählt hast und wo deren Grenzen liegen

Beratungserfahrung:

  • 4+ Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon mindestens 2 Jahre mit direktem Kundenkontakt in technischen Projekten, z. B. als Technical Consultant, Solutions Engineer, Solution Architect, Data-/AI-Consultant, technische Projektleitung oder Freelancer mit eigenen Kunden. Interne Fachbereiche als Kunden zählen auch.

  • Du hast Anforderungen aufgenommen, Workshops moderiert und Entscheidungen bei Stakeholdern herbeigeführt, auch auf Geschäftsführungsebene

  • Du kannst einem Kunden sagen, dass sein Wunsch-Use-Case keinen Sinn ergibt, und ihm eine bessere Alternative zeigen

Außerdem wichtig:

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2) in Wort und Schrift

  • Gutes Englisch, Wohnsitz in Deutschland und Bereitschaft zu Kundenterminen vor Ort

Was wir bieten

  • Projektverantwortung ab dem ersten Mandat, ohne Layer über Dir; direkter Draht zum Founding-Team

  • Beide Welten in einer Rolle: selbst bauen und selbst beraten, ohne Übergaben zwischen Beratung und Entwicklung

  • Ein Team, das technisch auf Augenhöhe diskutiert: Austausch mit der KI-Elite in Deutschland

  • Framework-driven statt ad hoc, und Du gestaltest die Frameworks mit

  • Wert statt Stunden: Uns zählen Ergebnisse, nicht Tagessätze

  • Moderner Tech-Stack und Raum zum Experimentieren

  • Sichtbarkeit als Expertise über unsere KI-Business-Coaching-Community und die TÜV-SÜD-Kooperation

  • Voll-remote möglich; Teamtage und Kundenworkshops vor Ort, üblicherweise 2–4 Tage im Monat im DACH-Raum

Bewerbung: Bring Dein Projekt mit!

Schick uns Deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte kurz zwei Fragen:

  1. Dein Projekt (3–5 Sätze): Welches KI-System würdest Du uns im Zweitgespräch zeigen? Was löst es, wie ist es aufgebaut, welchen Teil hast Du selbst umgesetzt, und welche technische Entscheidung hast Du dabei bewusst getroffen? Ein Link zu GitHub, einem Demo-Video o. Ä. ist willkommen.

  2. Dein Kunde (2–3 Sätze): Beschreib eine Situation, in der Du einen Kunden oder Fachbereich von einer technischen Entscheidung überzeugt oder seine Erwartungen korrigiert hast. Was war die Ausgangslage, was hast Du getan, was kam heraus?

Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich, Dein Projekt und Deine Kundengeschichte kennenzulernen!

title: AI Specialist (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du brennst für KI und willst sie in einem ganzen Unternehmen zum Leben erwecken?

Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Wir suchen einen AI Specialist (m/w/d) mit echtem KI-Mindset: Ideengeber, Sparringspartner und Antreiber, der KI bei uns in der Entwicklung und im gesamten Unternehmen voranbringt.

Wir sind ein junges Tech-Unternehmen und entwickeln eine innovative Softwarelösung für die Logistik. Unser Ziel: Mehrweglösungen so einfach wie Einweg machen und damit einen der nervigsten Prozesse der Branche optimieren – während wir gleichzeitig den CO₂-Fußabdruck der Logistik deutlich reduzieren.

In dieser Rolle schaust du über den Tellerrand: Du erkennst, was wir mit unseren vorhandenen Daten alles möglich machen können, und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns die KI-Strategie von Loopario – für unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und unsere tägliche Arbeit als Team. Dabei musst du die KI-Features nicht selbst programmieren, sondern gibst die Richtung vor und zeigst, wie KI sinnvoll eingesetzt wird.

Aufgaben

  • Ideengeber für KI: Du bringst proaktiv neue Ideen ein, wo und wie wir KI bei Loopario sinnvoll nutzen können – im Produkt, in der Organisation und in unseren Workflows.

  • Blick auf unsere Daten: Du analysierst die bei uns vorhandenen Daten und entwickelst Ideen, was sich damit alles umsetzen lässt und wie KI dabei echten Mehrwert für unsere Kunden schafft.

  • KI-Strategie mitgestalten: Du entwickelst die gesamte KI-Strategie von Loopario mit, baust sie kontinuierlich aus und behältst dabei Nutzen, Kosten und Machbarkeit im Blick.

  • Sparringspartner fürs Unternehmen: Du stehst allen Teams – von Sales über Customer Success bis Product – bei KI-Themen mit Rat und Tat zur Seite und hilfst, aus Ideen konkrete Lösungen zu machen.

  • KI in der Entwicklung: Du unterstützt unsere Entwicklungsabteilung dabei vorhandene KI-Tools weiterzuentwickeln und optimierst die entsprechenden Prozesse und Workflows.

  • Schulungen & Enablement: Du behältst die rasante Entwicklung im KI-Bereich im Blick und schulst die unterschiedlichen Teams im Unternehmen zu KI-Themen und –Nutzung. Dabei befähigst du alle Kolleg:innen, KI im Arbeitsalltag selbstbewusst einzusetzen.

  • Prototyping: Du baust schnell eigene KI-Tools und Prototypen, um Ideen zu testen, und entscheidest gemeinsam mit dem Team, was daraus weiterverfolgt wird.

Qualifikation

  • KI-Mindset: Du hast Bock auf KI, brennst für die schnellen Entwicklungen in diesem Bereich und willst dich und deine Arbeitsweise ständig weiterentwickeln.

  • Claude-Erfahrung: Du hast bereits intensiv mit Claude gearbeitet und kennst seine Möglichkeiten aus der Praxis.

  • Trendkenntnis: Du kennst die aktuellen KI-Trends und Tools und kannst einordnen, was davon Hype ist und was echten Mehrwert bringt.

  • Praxiserfahrung: Du hast bereits eigene, coole Tools mit KI gebaut und kannst uns zeigen, was du damit erreicht hast.

  • Programmierkenntnisse: Du bringst Programmierkenntnisse als solide Grundlage mit, um technische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und eigene Prototypen umzusetzen (C# von Vorteil.

  • Datenverständnis: Du denkst in Daten und hast ein gutes Gespür dafür, wie sich vorhandene Daten für den Einsatz von KI nutzen und aufbereiten lassen.

  • Kommunikation & Vermittlung: Du erklärst komplexe KI-Themen verständlich, begeisterst auch nicht-technische Kolleg:innen und gibst dein Wissen gerne in Schulungen weiter. Hierzu verfügst du über fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift und gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Was du nicht brauchst: Du musst keine KI-Modelle selbst programmiert oder trainiert haben – uns kommt es auf die sinnvolle Anwendung von KI an.

Benefits

  • Dein Buden-Buddy, unsere Welcome-Box sowie eine strukturierte Einführungsphase helfen dir dich schnell bei uns zurechtzufinden und bei uns anzukommen

  • Du erlebst eine positive Teamkultur durch regelmäßige Buden-Spieleabende, wöchentliche Coffee Dates, gemeinsame sportliche Aktivitäten (Firmenläufe, …), spannende Sommerevents, u.v.m.

  • Bei der Wahl deines Arbeitsstandorts sind wir flexibel und du entscheidest, ob du ins Büro kommen möchtest oder von Zuhause aus arbeiten möchtest

  • Wir wollen gemeinsam „groß“ werden und freuen uns, wenn du Teil der Reise bist und aktiv an der Entwicklung der Bude mitwirkst

  • Deine Arbeit hat einen nachhaltigen Impact, denn wir verkleinern den CO2-Fußabdruck der Logistik

  • Wähle die Incentives, die zu dir passen: Wir bezuschussen das Deutschland-Ticket, EGYM Wellpass und das Jobrad

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge

  • 30 Urlaubstage

  • Sollte selbstverständlich sein, haben wir aber auch: Kostenlose Getränke, Auswahl deiner Arbeitsgeräte, regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

title: Senior AI Transformation Lead
descriptionHtml:
TLDR: We’re looking for top 1%, high agency, AI-forward transformation leads to be part of our early team at Resonance in Berlin. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital, to deploy AI into the economy and rebuild businesses for the AI era. You’ll work at the frontier and solve real problems in an environment that champions ownership, autonomy and innovation at pace.

Who we are

Resonance is an applied AI company. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital. Our mission is to close the AI diffusion gap and rebuild businesses for the AI era. We're looking to hire Europe’s elite AI talent, and we're building our Berlin hub to serve clients across Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

Why now

We believe the economic diffusion of AI is the major challenge of the next decade. Foundation models are advancing far faster than organisations can absorb them; the bottleneck is embedding AI deeply into the core processes of a company to drive an inflection in pace and create organisational advantage. Europe is falling behind on AI, and we exist to help its businesses build real, defensible advantage from it rather than simply adopting it.

The role

As a Senior AI Transformation Lead in Berlin, you’ll run our most ambitious client engagements across DACH. You’ll own relationships with C-suite leaders, PE sponsors and management teams, and lead a team of transformation leads and AI engineers. You’ll map how a business runs its key processes, find where AI fundamentally changes the economics, and redesign them agentic-first rather than bolting AI onto today’s process. You’ll prototype the new workflows yourself with Claude Code or similar, build the business case, and lead the change through to the people who have to adopt it. Every engagement starts with a value case and ends with the metric that moved in the client’s P&L. As one of our first 100 and one of our first leads in Berlin, you’ll also coach your team, turn each engagement into playbooks the next team starts from, and help shape how Resonance hires, operates and grows in DACH.

What we’re looking for: You’re a senior operator, typically with 5+ years of experience in equivalent roles, including running AI client engagements or transformation programmes end to end. You might be a senior consultant, engagement manager or associate partner at a top-tier strategy firm, a VP or Director on a PE value creation team, an AI director, or an operator who has led a transformation from inside a business. You’re a builder with a deep understanding of technology. You don’t need to write production code, but you use AI every day, prototype with new models and tools the day they land, and know where to challenge your engineering counterparts. Just as important, senior executives trust you with their most important outcomes, you frame hard trade-offs clearly, and you bring resistant organisations through change. We want both in one person. You have extreme agency, operate with urgency, and have consistently been among the very top performers of your peers. PE portfolio or value creation experience, operating experience in software or services, and German for client work in DACH are a plus. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway.

What we offer: Competitive total compensation plus equity. Frontier AI work with real stakes, driving tangible outcomes for consequential companies. A team built to be one of the most talent-dense in Europe, and the autonomy to shape how the firm delivers and grows in Berlin as an early leader. A chance to help close Europe’s AI gap, moving European businesses to the right side of the productivity chasm.

Logistics: Berlin, 3+ days a week in the office or at client sites, mostly in DACH and Europe. English is our working language; German is a plus. We can sponsor visas for eligible candidates, start dates are flexible, and we're open to people relocating to Berlin.

Apply

Send your CV and a short note on the transformation you're proudest of leading and the impact it delivered.

We hire people from every background and judge them on what they've built. If you don't tick every box, apply anyway.

Resonance is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. If you need adjustments at any stage, tell us and we'll make them.

title: Senior Aircraft Performance Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

We are looking for a Senior Aircraft Performance Engineer to join the Flight Physics team. You will further evolve the already existing performance evaluation framework and datasets for the Microliner aircraft. You will actively contribute to expanding the capabilities of aircraft performance codes and evaluate the aircraft’s flight and ground performance.

You will work closely with Propulsion, Systems, and Certification teams for data exchange and planning of compliance demonstration campaigns. Your work will also directly support the Commercial team for the evaluation of routes for future and current customers of the aircraft.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Conduct comprehensive simulation campaigns using in-house tools: from pre-processing and execution to post-processing, dataset management and interpretation/visualisation.

  • Set-up and further development of simulation toolchains.

  • Participate on activities related to aircraft design and analysis.

  • Closely collaborate with your colleagues specialized in flight dynamics, loads, aeroelasticity, and aerodynamics.

  • Create and maintain documentation for development and certification purposes.

  • Determine the impact of real-life factors on aircraft performance.

  • Ensure consistent data as part of aircraft baselining and quantify uncertainty.

  • Support and participate in design reviews and customer visits

 

Your Profile:

  • Master’s and/or PhD degree in Aerospace Engineering.

  • Minimum 6 years of hands-on experience in aircraft performance determination, preferably within CS 23 aircraft programs operating under a DOA environment or international equivalent.

  • Demonstrated expertise in the aircraft flight performance calculation, flight mechanics, aerodynamics, and propulsion.

  • Proficiency in coding (Matlab or alternatively Python).

  • Proficiency in PLM; Dassault’s 3DX platform is a plus.

  • Previous participation in flight test campaigns is a plus.

  • Proven experience across the full product development lifecycle, from conceptual and preliminary design through detailed design, verification, validation, and certification (CS 23 or CS 25).

  • Solid understanding of airworthiness and certification processes.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; additional European languages are an asset.

  • Self-driven, solution-oriented professional with strong ownership mindset and the ability to operate effectively in a dynamic development environment.

  • Strong personal motivation for aviation and the advancement of electric aircraft technologies.

  • Experience working in an EASA Part 21J Design Organization, or international equivalent.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

title: Senior Amazon Retail Media Consultant (d/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

This posting is intended for talent pipelining and anticipated project needs. Your application will be added to our talent network for upcoming opportunities. Please note that aside from the application confirmation email, no additional emails will be sent.

Should an active opening match your background and experience, our recruitment team will reach out directly to discuss next steps.

JOB PURPOSE

We are looking for a Senior Retail Media Consultant (div/f/m) who is passionate about Amazon and the broader retail media ecosystem. Joining our team of 100+ marketplace specialists across diverse disciplines, you will lead complex, multi-market client portfolios and drive growth across the entire customer journey. In this role, you will connect the dots between Retail, Sponsored Ads, Amazon DSP, AMC, and overarching digital marketing strategies. You will act as a trusted strategic advisor for clients, a mentor for junior colleagues, and a key driver of innovation within our team.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Client Management & Strategy

  • Manage Complex Portfolios: Oversee large-scope, multi-market client accounts and comfortably manage annual advertising budgets exceeding €1,000,000;
  • Full-Funnel Strategy: Develop out-of-the-box, full-funnel strategies connecting Sponsored Ads, Amazon DSP, AMC, and other marketplaces/channels, as well as hybrid seller/vendor models;
  • Workshops & Business Reviews: Lead client calls, QBRs, and strategic workshops, providing advanced forecasts, budget allocations, and overarching recommendations both inside and outside of Amazon DSP;
  • Analytics & Reporting: Build reporting structures from scratch, customizing them to client preferences and using strategic performance analyses (market insights, share, audience, and inventory insights) to form actionable conclusions;
  • Commercial Ownership: Involvement in pitches from preparation to presentation, identify upsell opportunities (SA, DSP, AMC, Retail, Strategic Consulting), and manage the process through to new contracts.

Team Mentorship & Knowledge Sharing

  • Mentorship & Development: Act as a go-to technical expert and mentor, leading by example in quality assurance, task briefings, and communication while supporting Juniors and Professionals with advanced forecasts, business reviews, and strategic guidance;
  • Shape Team Knowledge: Actively drive digital advertising expertise by creating and delivering proactive trainings to the team.

 

WHAT YOU BRING

  • At least 4 years of experience in Amazon, E-Commerce, Online Marketing, or Retail Media (including at least 3 years dedicated to Amazon Advertising);
  • Master of Amazon Sponsored Ads; familiar with AMC, DSP, ARA, Vendor/Seller Central, hybrid models, programmatic advertising/optimization, and other marketplaces/DSPs;
  • Expert level in Excel/Google Sheets and PowerPoint/Google Slides;
  • Comfortable using AI tools to streamline daily workflows, create new processes, and continuously improve team operations;
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and collaborative with a track record of driving change, leading side projects, and mentoring peers;
  • Directly located and available to work in Germany;
