title: Senior Analog IC Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago is an AI and computer hardware company whose mission is to drive the course of history forward. We do so by accelerating breakthroughs at the intersection of AI and semiconductors.

Founded in 2024 by AI researchers and physicists with deep expertise in photonics, electronics, software, mathematics, and machine learning, Arago brings together a lean team of engineers and scientists from the world’s top companies and research labs.

Composed of nine nationalities and operating from hubs in France, North America, and Israel, we believe in great science and fast achievements. Our work is guided by these core principles:

  1. Do great things: we deliver work we’re proud to sign our name to.

  2. High velocity: speed matters. We move quickly, one step at a time.

  3. One unit: we’re all in this together, with relationships grounded in trust, respect, and camaraderie.

Arago is backed by executives from Apple, Arm, Nvidia, Microsoft, and Hugging Face, as well as prominent US and European deeptech venture firms and exited founders.

What you’ll do

Design high-performance analog and mixed-signal ICs optimized for precision, power, and area, driving Arago’s prototype and product iterations from architecture to silicon validation.

Responsibilities

  • Design and simulate analog and RF integrated circuits, including critical blocks such as amplifiers, mixers, PLLs, ADCs, DACs, and bias/reference circuits, with a focus on signal integrity, linearity, and precision.

  • Optimize circuits for power, area, and performance trade-offs, ensuring designs meet system-level requirements across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) variations.

  • Collaborate closely with optics, simulation and PCB teams to define architecture and block-level specifications for Arago’s successive prototypes and product iterations, ensuring tight alignment with overall performance and integration goals.

  • Work with layout engineers to guide floor-planning and physical design, minimizing parasitic effects and preserving analog precision in layout-sensitive blocks.

  • Support post-silicon validation and bring-up, defining test plans, analyzing lab measurements, and correlating results with simulation to refine future design iterations.

  • Language: English at a proficient level. French is a plus.

Required Skills and Experience

  • A sound mathematical understanding and deep physical intuition of analog electronics, as well as analog voltage-to-current and current-to-voltage conversion at low and high frequencies.

  • Experience in designing high-precision analog systems for signal processing or power electronics. Experience working with high-frequency analog signals is valued.

  • Extensive experience in IC design and post-layout design methodology using standard industry tools like Cadence Virtuoso.

  • Proficiency in designing and optimizing mixed-signal circuits, including DACs and ADCs at low (kHz-MHz) and high (>GHz) frequencies, and signal conditioning circuits, ensuring flawless integration between analog RF components and digital processors.

  • Strong understanding of signal integrity, crosstalk, and noise reduction techniques in mixed-signal environments, particularly in high-frequency RF systems interfacing with digital processors.

  • Advanced node experience required (<28nm).

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

  • Meaningful stock option plan offered at the earliest stage of the company (included in the majority of full time offers).

  • Relocation bonus and coverage of moving expenses for relocation within 20 minutes of the company’s location.

  • Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.

  • Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.

  • Reimbursement of 50% of the public transport subscription fee.

  • A high-paced, multicultural (with 9 nationalities), and engineering-led environment.

descriptionHtml:
Build the Software Foundation for Next-Generation Mobility

At Apex.AI, we develop safety-certified software for mobility systems and intelligent machines. Our products power applications in automotive, trucking, robotics, aerospace, agriculture, and industrial automation. We are looking for a Senior Applications Engineer who combines strong C++ engineering skills with a passion for solving complex customer challenges.

In this role, you will work directly with global customers and internal product teams to design, build, deploy, and support advanced software solutions based on Apex.OS. You will help customers bring real-world systems to production while contributing improvements and features back into our core platform.

This is a highly technical, hands-on role ideal for someone who enjoys deep systems engineering, customer collaboration, and writing production-quality C++ software.

If you thrive in fast-moving environments, enjoy solving difficult distributed and embedded systems problems, and want to help shape the future of software-defined mobility, we’d love to talk with you.

This role is located in our Munich office. Authorization to work in the Germany is required.


What You’ll Do
  • Roll out Apex.AI software to customers and provide technical support solutions using Apex.AI products
  • Collaborate closely with customers to understand technical requirements and deliver high-quality implementations
  • Deploy, integrate, and support Apex.AI software in customer environments
  • Troubleshoot complex software, networking, middleware, and embedded systems issues
  • Partner with internal engineering teams to improve product capabilities, usability, and performance
  • Contribute features, fixes, and enhancements directly to Apex.OS
  • Deliver technical presentations, workshops, and customer training sessions
  • Help accelerate customer adoption and success across automotive and intelligent machine platforms

    • What You Bring
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related technical field
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience in modern C++
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across complex software systems
  • Experience developing software for embedded or distributed systems
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to work directly with customers and cross-functional teams
  • Experience using modern development workflows and tools such as Git, GitLab, CI/CD pipelines, and issue tracking systems
  • Self-driven and comfortable operating independently in dynamic technical environments

    • Nice To Have
  • Experience in automotive, robotics, aerospace, industrial automation, or other safety-critical domains
  • Familiarity with operating systems, networking, and communication protocols (UDP, multicast, TCP/IP, DDS, ROS/ROS 2)
  • Understanding of real-time systems and automotive software architectures such as AUTOSAR
  • Experience in technical consulting, field engineering, developer support, or professional services
  • Customer enablement or technical training experience
  • Familiarity with build systems such as Bazel or CMake
  • Experience working with Linux-based development environments

    • Apex.AI is an international software company specializing in the development of safety-certified, developer-friendly, and scalable software for mobility systems, aiming to accelerate the transition to software-defined vehicles and mobility. Founded in 2017 by Jan Becker and Dejan Pangercic, the company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with additional offices in Munich, Stuttgart, Gothenburg, Tokyo, and Pangyo. To date, Apex.AI has raised over $75 million USD from world-class venture, financial and strategic investors including AGCO, Airbus Ventures, Canaan, Continental AG, Daimler Truck, HELLA Ventures, Jaguar Land Rover’s InMotion Ventures, LG Electronics, Lightspeed, Orillion, Toyota Ventures, Volvo Group Venture Capital and ZF.

    The company’s flagship product, Apex.OS, consists of two core components: Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida.

    • Apex.Grace is an application runtime framework in the form of a software development kit (SDK). It provides a robust framework for developing real-time, reliable, and safe applications. Core APIs are based on ROS 2 APIs with numerous extensions enabling real-time execution, reliable performance, deployment into large fleets, system state management, safety, security, and much more. It is safety-certified to ISO 26262 ASIL D.
    • Apex.Ida is a communication middleware delivering optimal high-performance data transport across use cases. These use cases range from fully autonomous vehicles with dozens of high-resolution cameras to small signals with ultra-high frequencies in safety-critical domains. Its core is based on a shared memory data transport with connectors into DDS, SOME/IP, MQTT, CAN, and many more protocols, all abstracted into a single application-facing API.

    Additionally, Apex.AI offers:

    • Apex.Alan provides customers with a highly optimized and efficient software integration, development environment, build, test, and delivery process.
    • Apex.OS for V&V enables record and playback of very large and diverse data streams, both time- and data-deterministically, which is crucial for replay, analysis, and performance evaluation of complex autonomous systems.

    Apex.AI’s software solutions are utilized across a diverse range of industries, including automotive, agriculture, medical, and defense sectors. The products enable developers to efficiently create and deploy safe, reliable, and high-performance applications, thereby accelerating the adoption of software-defined mobility systems. Through its innovative software solutions and strategic partnerships, Apex.AI is at the forefront of transforming the mobility industry, facilitating the development of next-generation vehicles and systems.

title: Senior Associate (European Competition practice) - m/f/d
descriptionHtml:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analyses that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.

CRA's European Competition practice specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation. We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings:  firms considering merger and acquisition opportunities or involved in merger control proceedings; and firms undergoing investigations relating to cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, abuse of dominance or state aid.  We also provide advice to firms involved in regulatory proceedings and sector inquiries. We offer assistance on the estimation effects of damages in cartel cases, international arbitration and intellectual property disputes.

Position Overview

The Senior Associate position is the entry-level position for applicants with a PhD in Economics and limited work experience. The Senior Associate position is also open to applicants with a Master of Economics and at least 3 years of relevant work experience, within economic consulting or with a competition authority. Candidates will be expected to rapidly take on genuine responsibility, working closely with senior consultants, scholars and industry experts on project teams, and will have the opportunity to immediately work on some of the largest, high-profile and most significant competition cases in Europe, providing conceptual and practical input to projects. A Senior Associate would typically:

  •  Conduct analyses and collect evidence from data and research that support our expert opinions and business recommendations
  •  Perform regression analyses in statistical analysis programs (such as Stata, Python, R), including large data projects requiring the use of cloud computing
  •  Build economic models tailored to the issues at hand and supporting our expert opinions and business recommendations
  •  Contribute to the development and presentation of client deliverables, including expert reports and white papers
  •  Interact with clients and communicate complicated economic concepts and arguments to non-experts in an understandable, accessible manner
  •  Manage and mentor junior staff
  • Ensure the integrity and accuracy of analyses and opinions
  • Participate in practice-building activities (training, recruiting, publication, expertise sharing, etc.)

Desired Qualifications

  • PhD in economics from a well-regarded institution with a strong foundation in microeconomics, preferably with a specialisation in industrial economics and/or econometrics; non-PhD applicants should have a Master of Economics and at least 3 years of relevant work experience, within economic consulting or with a competition authority
  • Fluency in English, other language skills are considered an asset
  • High degree of numeracy, ability to analyse data, familiarity with econometric techniques
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration capabilities
  • Excellent time management and task prioritisation skills
  • Clear and demonstrated interest in economic consulting through coursework, work experience, or activities

To Apply

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. To be considered for this position, submit through this job posting:

  • Curriculum Vitae – please include current address, email and telephone number;
  • Covering letter – please describe your interest in a role with CRA's Antitrust and Competition Economics practice in Germany and how this role matches your goals;
  • Writing Sample (optional) – we prefer a sole-authored submission from an existing work (work product, published article or job market paper) that includes your commentary on a quantitative analysis and/or relevant to the field of economics;
  • Transcripts (optional) - from the most recent academic training (may be unofficial copies).

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognise that individuals realise a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

Responsible AI Use in Recruiting

We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is consistent, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA on our website.  

Our Commitment to Diversity

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer. As part of our focus on equity and inclusion, we work to ensure a fair and consistent hiring process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.

The statements included in this job description are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified.

Early-Stage Venture Capital & Talent


At Atlantic, we back founders in AI, compute, spacetech, and deep tech, often when it's still just a few people and a big idea. What happens next depends less on the idea and more on who joins them: the first engineer who can actually build it, the CTO who scales it, the commercial lead who gets it into the world.

That's why talent sits at the heart of our Venture Development work. We go out and find those people ourselves, and we help our companies build the organizations around them: how teams are structured, how people are paid, and how they grow.

Why we are looking for you now

The breakthroughs we're most excited about will come from people who aren't on anyone's radar yet. We want to find them first and put them where they can have the biggest impact. Talent is scarcer than money in today's VC climate. Promising startup ideas are often replicable. People are not. Together with you, we will:

  • Find and win top talent for our portfolio companies, with a focus on senior and leadership hires

  • Run searches end to end, from mapping the market to closing the candidate

  • Advise our companies on comp, equity, org design, and hiring, and turn what works into playbooks

  • Translate business plans into hiring plans, and step in on urgent people topics when needed

  • Use AI and automation to make all of this faster and better

Your role

Headhunting is the core of the job. You'll spend your days finding people others miss and convincing them that this is the company worth joining. But you won't just fill roles. You'll sit with our investment team and portfolio CEOs to work out what team a company actually needs, what to pay, and how to structure it, then go and build it. You own your projects and make your own calls. This isn't a standard recruiting gig.

Who you will work with

  • Our Investment team

  • CEOs and leadership teams across our portfolio, from pre-seed to exit

  • External partners, from recruiters to employment lawyers

What you must have done before

  • Placed the top %: You've found and closed exceptional people, the ones everyone wanted, in fast-growing startups or scale-ups.

  • Set the bar high: Your standards for excellence are very, very high, for the people you hire and for your own work.

title: Senior Automation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Roboyo AI is a category shaper in Applied AI and Agentic Automation. We help leading enterprises move from automation projects and AI experiments into governed, production-grade systems that execute real work across workflows, processes, products and services. 

Our heritage is in scaled enterprise automation; our future is Applied AI and Agentic Automation: autonomous agents, AI engineering squads, process orchestration, data and knowledge foundations, and human-in-the-loop governance embedded deeply into how our clients operate. 

We are not here to sell AI theatre. We are here to turn AI into working systems, measurable outcomes and repeatable transformation programs. 

ABOUT THE ROLE 

We are looking for a Senior Automation Engineer to design, develop and deliver enterprise-scale automation solutions using UiPath, Automation Anywhere and Python. This is a genuinely hands-on, multi-platform role: you will actively build solutions in all three technologies, not simply oversee delivery. 

You will own technical delivery from design and development through testing, deployment and optimisation, working with clients and distributed delivery teams. This is a UK-based remote position with occasional travel for client engagements, project workshops and team activities. 

As an L3 engineer, you will tackle complex technical problems independently, contribute to code quality and engineering standards, and support less experienced colleagues without being expected to act as a dedicated people manager. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Design, develop, test and deploy robust automation solutions using UiPath, Automation Anywhere A360 and Python. 
  • Own technical delivery across the automation lifecycle, including solution design, documentation, release and post-deployment optimisation. 
  • Build integrations with REST APIs, databases and enterprise applications; create maintainable Python applications and components beyond basic scripting. 
  • Develop reusable components and frameworks, applying secure coding, exception handling, logging and operational monitoring practices. 
  • Diagnose and resolve complex automation failures, integration issues and performance bottlenecks in development and production. 
  • Apply engineering standards across Git, peer review, automated testing and CI/CD; contribute to reliable deployments. 
  • Collaborate with architects, technical leads, analysts and clients to translate business needs into practical technical solutions. 
  • Support effort estimation, technical documentation, knowledge sharing and mentoring for junior and mid-level engineers. 
  • Keep current with automation technologies and identify practical opportunities to improve delivery and client outcomes. 

MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS & COMPETENCIES 

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience designing, developing and delivering RPA or intelligent automation solutions; this does not mean four years in each individual technology. 
  • Strong hands-on UiPath development experience, including Studio, Orchestrator and REFramework. 
  • Strong hands-on Automation Anywhere development experience, particularly Automation 360 (A360) and Control Room. 
  • Strong practical Python development capability beyond basic scripting, including maintainable code, applications, integrations or reusable components. 
  • Demonstrable experience actively developing solutions across UiPath, Automation Anywhere and Python. 
  • Experience owning solutions from technical design and development through testing, deployment and support. 
  • Solid software engineering foundations, including debugging, exception handling, reusable code and testing. 
  • Experience with REST APIs, SQL/databases, JSON, Git and enterprise-system integration. 
  • Ability to investigate complex problems, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and work independently in distributed teams. 
  • Based in the UK and willing to travel occasionally for client engagements, project workshops and internal collaboration. 

NICE-TO-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS & COMPETENCIES 

  • UiPath Advanced RPA Developer or equivalent certification; Automation Anywhere Advanced or Master RPA Professional certification. 
  • Experience with Power Automate, Power Platform or other automation technologies. 
  • Experience integrating with SAP, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics or similar enterprise applications.

  • Experience with intelligent document processing, such as UiPath Document Understanding or Azure Document Intelligence. 
  • Exposure to generative AI, Agentic AI or AI-enabled automation use cases. 
  • Experience in consultancy, client-facing delivery or Agile teams. 

IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE 

You are a pragmatic, hands-on engineer who enjoys building reliable solutions and solving difficult problems. You can move confidently between UiPath, Automation Anywhere and Python, take ownership with limited supervision, work directly with clients, write clear and maintainable code, and share knowledge with colleagues. You value delivery quality and practical outcomes over technology for its own sake.

  • Opportunities to broaden your technical skills and contribute to the development of our automation practice.

title: Senior AWS Consultant
descriptionHtml:
CloudNation helpt organisaties om het maximale uit de cloud te halen. We combineren diepgaande technische expertise met een pragmatische aanpak en bouwen samen met onze klanten aan schaalbare, veilige en toekomstbestendige oplossingen.

We geloven in doen wat werkt: geen dikke rapporten, maar concrete oplossingen met zichtbare impact. Onze consultants staan midden in de uitvoering, werken nauw samen met klanten en zoeken continu naar manieren om te verbeteren en te innoveren met cloud en AI.

Wat ga je doen?

Als AWS Cloud Consultant sta je midden in de uitvoering:

  • Je ontwikkelt cloudstrategieën en vertaalt businessdoelen naar concrete AWS-oplossingen, op basis van een grondige analyse van de bestaande IT-omgeving en het AWS Well-Architected Framework.

  • Je onderzoekt samen met klanten waar AI echt waarde toevoegt, van slimme automatisering tot generatieve AI met Amazon Bedrock.

  • Je neemt de rol van meewerkend voorman: je stuurt engineers aan en werkt zelf actief mee aan de implementatie van cloudoplossingen.

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de delivery binnen scope, stelt een Work Breakdown Structure op en bewaakt samen met de projectmanager de voortgang, kwaliteit en planning.

  • Je coacht en ontwikkelt je team volgens het ‘To do, To participate, To do it yourself’-principe.

  • Je zorgt dat oplossingen schaalbaar, veilig en toekomstbestendig zijn en blijft na oplevering betrokken bij optimalisatie en doorontwikkeling.

Over deze rol

Dit is een senior rol met een duidelijke Customer Lead-overlay. Naast een sterke basis als AWS Cloud Consultant ben jij het vaste aanspreekpunt voor de klant en verantwoordelijk voor de waarde die we samen realiseren, over de hele lifecycle.

Je combineert technische kennis met leiderschap, neemt teams en partners mee en vertaalt cloudmogelijkheden naar concrete impact. Tegelijk bouw je aan sterke, langdurige klantrelaties en help je zowel de klant als het team steeds een stap verder.

Als Customer Lead:

  • Ben je het vaste aanspreekpunt en escalatiepunt voor de klant.

  • Neem je eigenaarschap over de klantroadmap en stuur je op bedrijfswaarde.

  • Ben je verantwoordelijk voor de uitkomsten van de delivery en stuur je bij wanneer resultaten afwijken van de verwachtingen.

  • Vorm je tijdens Continuous Delivery samen met de People & Process Officer het governance-model richting de klant.

  • Vertegenwoordig je intern het perspectief van de klant en breng je collega’s en partners op één lijn.

  • Signaleer je kansen om de samenwerking verder uit te bouwen.

Onze gedachte

We werken volgens ons 6D Delivery Model. Als Customer Lead houd je de rode draad vast over alle fasen. Het zwaartepunt van jouw deliverywerk ligt hier:

DISCOVER, DEFINE & DESIGN

Je analyseert IT-omgevingen, voert Well-Architected Reviews uit en vertaalt businessdoelen naar concrete AWS-strategieën, migratieplannen, roadmaps en toekomstbestendige oplossingen.

DEVELOP & DEPLOY

Als meewerkend voorman stuur je engineers aan en werk je zelf mee aan de implementatie en uitrol. Je bewaakt scope, voortgang en kwaliteit, stelt de Work Breakdown Structure op en neemt eigenaarschap over de delivery, in nauwe afstemming met de klant en projectmanager.

CONTINUOUS DELIVERY

Je zorgt voor een succesvolle oplevering en blijft betrokken bij optimalisatie, innovatie en doorontwikkeling. In deze fase komt de Customer Lead-rol het sterkst naar voren: je bewaakt de klantwaarde en geeft samen met de People & Process Officer richting aan de governance.


Wat neem je mee?

  • Ruime ervaring, doorgaans 5+ jaar, met AWS-services, architectuur en cloudoplossingen.

  • Ervaring met AWS-frameworks zoals Well-Architected, AWS CAF en landing zones, inclusief migraties en optimalisatie.

  • Sterke hands-on ervaring met Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD en het realiseren van AWS-oplossingen.

  • Ervaring met het aansturen van technische teams en het nemen van eigenaarschap over complexe klantprojecten.

  • Je combineert technische expertise met sterk stakeholdermanagement en stuurt op bedrijfswaarde en resultaat.

  • Ervaring met AI-assisted development en AI in je dagelijkse werk, bij voorkeur met een agentic way of working.

  • Goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels. Relevante AWS-certificeringen zijn een pré.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een marktconform salaris van 66k-115k per jaar.

  • Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsbudget, laptop, telefoon, pensioenregeling en 26 vakantiedagen.

  • Een persoonlijk opleidings- en certificeringsbudget voor jouw ontwikkeling in AWS en AI.

  • Ondersteuning bij het behalen van certificeringen, waarbij behaalde certificeringen terugkomen in je salaris.

  • Een rol met veel eigenaarschap, waarin je een eigen klantportfolio draagt en stuurt op waarde en groei.

  • Volop ruimte voor innovatie, eigen initiatief en het werken met de nieuwste cloud- en AI-technologie.

  • Hybride werken, met Bunnik als thuisbasis en vrijdag als gezamenlijke kantoordag.

  • Een open en ondernemende cultuur waarin we samenwerken, van elkaar leren en successen vieren.

Over CloudNation

CloudNation, an IG&H company, helpt organisaties versnellen met cloud en AI. Als AWS Premier Tier Services Partner combineren we diepgaande technische expertise met strategisch inzicht om organisaties niet alleen te moderniseren, maar ook toekomstbestendig te maken.

We geloven dat echte impact ontstaat wanneer strategie en uitvoering samenkomen. Daarom adviseren onze consultants niet alleen, maar bouwen en realiseren ze ook: van de eerste strategie tot implementatie, optimalisatie en doorontwikkeling.

AI? Wij maken het werkend.

We geloven in AI voorbij de hype. We bouwen het, passen het toe bij klanten én gebruiken het iedere dag zelf.

  • Claude op AWS: we bouwen veilige AI-gateways in het AWS-account van de klant, met EU-inference via Amazon Bedrock en een AI Center of Excellence eromheen.

  • Een AI-agentframework: we ontwikkelen agentic AI die onze delivery versnelt, bijvoorbeeld met autonome agents die audit-ready Infrastructure-as-Code opleveren.

  • Productie-AI voor klanten: samen met TOPdesk ontwikkelden we TicketBuddy, een GenAI-servicedeskassistent.

  • AI in ons DNA: van AI Readiness Scans bij klanten tot interne hackathons en AI-literacy, we passen zelf toe wat we adviseren.

Interesse?

Wil jij AWS-expertise combineren met technisch leiderschap en verantwoordelijkheid voor langdurige klantwaarde? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

title: Senior Backend Developer
descriptionHtml:
Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it.

quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end.

We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll.

We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all.

Why this role exists

Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries.

The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now.

This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it.

What you will own

  • Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket.

  • The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent.

  • The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current.

  • Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms.

  • The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns.

  • The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team.

Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. You agree the API contract together, and Product decides what gets built.

How we work

We are AI-native, operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how a small team ships like a large one, and how one engineer can hold the standard described here.

We expect you to live in these tools and build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, test generation, migration checks, and whatever else takes manual work out of the way.

And we expect the judgement that comes with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production. In payroll, an amount is either right or wrong. You take the speed and keep the standard.

Your first year

In your first month, you set up, learn the system and the people, and merge your first changes. Within 100 days, you have delivered the platform’s audit trail, tested and documented, and fixed the first risks you spotted on arrival.

By month nine, you are the person the team turns to for the quinn backend, and a developer you mentored is delivering features on their own. By the end of the year, the major backend roadmap items are live (logging, the database upgrade, versioning for our APIs and services), and at least one standard you introduced is used beyond your own team.

Who we are looking for

  • You have shipped and run production systems in C# and modern .NET / ASP.NET Core, and you know how they behave under load.

  • You know PostgreSQL properly: schema design, transactions, locking, indexing and query optimisation. You read the execution plan before you add a cache.

  • You have designed APIs and modules with clear boundaries and manageable dependencies.

  • You treat personal and financial data with care. Security is part of how you design, not a review at the end.

  • You use AI tools every day, and you can show where they made you faster and where you caught them being wrong.

  • You own initiatives independently and raise risks before they become surprises.

  • You review constructively, mentor willingly, and write code others can take over.

  • English is your working language. German is a plus.

What makes you stand out

  • You have worked where an amount is either right or wrong: payroll, banking, insurance, accounting or tax.

  • You have built foundations others relied on for years: an audit trail, observability, API versioning, a data model.

  • You have taken a major database upgrade or migration through production without drama.

  • You can explain what you built, why you chose your approach, and what changed because of it.

The team

We are a small, fast and direct team: engineers in Zurich working closely with our Armenia team, and colleagues across Switzerland, Germany and the UK, 40 people in all. Not much process, not much hierarchy. A clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we mean: be open, own it, speak up, keep it simple, bias for action.

We are not filling a seat. If you would rather build the core than maintain the plumbing, we would like to hear from you.

The facts

  • Location: Zürich Wiedikon, hybrid with three days a week in the office; occasional travel to the UK, Germany and our Armenia team

  • Role: Senior Backend Developer, individual contributor with technical leadership

  • Reporting line: Our Lead Engineers

  • Stack: C#, .NET 10, PostgreSQL; modular monolith

  • Pensum: 100%

  • Start: As soon as possible

  • Language: English; German a plus

  • Process: A 20–30 minute screening call, an in-person interview in Zürich on your career so far, a focused technical interview with the team (where we may work through a real quinn problem together), and reference calls

How to apply

Apply with your CV and two short paragraphs: why this role, and why now. If you have something you shipped and are proud of, a system, a module or a write-up of a hard problem, include it. It tells us more than a CV does.

descriptionHtml:
Senior Backend Engineer - Credit Card Payments

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Payments Infrastructure team.

You’ll design and build the payments platform behind iwoca’s business credit card – the services that approve each payment, monitor transactions for fraud, and pay out cashback.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

iwoca launched its business credit card in 2026. It gives small businesses a fast, flexible way to pay for what they need and control their cash flow, alongside iwoca’s loans. The card is a core part of iwoca’s long-term growth.

The Payments infrastructure team builds iwoca’s card payments platform. Its job is to approve each payment in moments when a customer uses their card. The team also builds the platforms that pay out rewards as customers spend and monitor every transaction.

The team is small – a principal engineer, a product manager with a background in payments, and you. It works closely with iwoca’s ledger, fraud and customer product teams.

The role

As a senior backend engineer, you’ll own services and projects end to end, and shape the platform’s architecture with the principal engineer, from service boundaries to how authorisation, rewards, and transaction monitoring fit together. You’ll work closely with product to decide what the team builds and how. There’s still plenty to build, and you’ll take new services into production.

You’ll build on your payments expertise alongside the principal engineer, with scope to grow as the platform matures. Most of the challenge is technical: scaling payments within card scheme rules and the regulation iwoca has to meet. Your code will run every time a small business uses its iwoca card.

Live project examples:

  • Payment authorisation. Extending the service built to approve or decline each card payment in real time, using data held in other services. It places a hold on available credit in the ledger and applies iwoca's own checks, such as account status, merchant category code restrictions, and spend limits.

  • Transaction monitoring. Building the service that will screen card transactions for fraud and financial-crime risk as customers spend, so iwoca will rely less on third parties.

  • Rewards. Extending the service that pays out cashback, as the team adds to what the card offers.

  • Testing for failure. Designing sandbox tests that cover edge cases and failures across the card transaction lifecycle.

  • Ledger cutover and go-live. Moving the card platform onto iwoca's own ledger and infrastructure with as little downtime as possible, then fixing the issues that only show up in production.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Payment systems. You've designed and run highly available, low-latency payment systems in production, ideally on the issuing side.

  • Card payment flows. You've worked on card authorisation and clearing, and traced transactions from the terminal, through the acquirer and card scheme, to the issuer. You've used response codes to diagnose declined transactions.

  • Backend engineering. You have deep expertise in at least one object-oriented language. You've written and run backend services in it.

  • Distributed systems. You've built microservices, REST APIs, and asynchronous messaging with queues or topics, and designed the database schemas behind them, ideally in PostgreSQL.

  • AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone, at work or in your own projects. You judge when to use it and when not to, and you check its output before it reaches production.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Ledgers and clearing. You've worked on a ledger, reconciliation, or clearing system – for cards, loyalty points, bank transfers, or money remittance.

  • Testing. You've written automated tests for payment systems, ideally test-first.

  • Python. You've used Python in production. It's the language the team works in.

The salary

We expect to pay from £100,000 to £120,000 for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Developer Experience & Productivity
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Taktile helps financial institutions make smarter, safer decisions with the power of AI. Internally, AI coding agents have made writing code dramatically faster. The bottleneck is now everything around the code: builds, tests, reviews, merges, and deploys.

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer focused on Developer Productivity and Developer Experience to remove that bottleneck. This is a high-leverage, internal engineering role on our Platform Team: your users are Taktile's backend and frontend engineers and the AI agents working alongside them, and your product is the path from first commit to production.

You'll make CI fast and reliable, make our serverless stack easier to build on, and turn "how fast can we ship safely?" into metrics we move every quarter.

What you’ll do

  • Build the deployment services that ship Taktile. Own the systems behind tens of thousands of stack deployments a week across dev, staging, production, and per-customer AWS accounts: progressive rollouts through monitoring and canary stages, deployment windows and gates, and fast rollbacks.

  • Keep our AI developer tooling sharp. Maintain and extend Claudius, our in-house AI engineering agent that investigates CI failures, triages issues, and opens PRs, and metadev, our sandboxed Claude Code and OpenCode setup that packages Taktile's engineering knowledge for every engineer.

  • Own the build → test → merge loop. Drive down CI runtime and flakiness across our main monorepos. Find the slowest and least reliable steps, fix them, and keep them fixed.

  • Evolve our CI/CD architecture. Build on our move to per-module GitHub Actions workflows and a self-hosted runner fleet. Improve caching, parallelism, and cost per build.

  • Shorten the inner dev loop. Make developing on our AWS Lambda stack fast, from running services locally against preview environments to faster, container-based deploys, so engineers aren't waiting on CloudFormation to test a change.

  • Build paved roads. Ship templates, CLIs, and self-service tooling so any team can take a new module from first commit to a running dev workspace in under a day.

  • Design for humans and agents. Make our tooling fast, deterministic, and scriptable so engineers and AI coding agents get quick, trustworthy feedback.

  • Measure what matters. Own DevProd metrics like PR lead time, CI runtime, CI flakiness, and PRs per engineer-day. Use them to decide what to fix next and to prove the impact of what you ship.

  • Own our AI developer tooling. Take ownership of Claudius, our in-house AI engineering agent, and decide where it goes next.

  • Treat engineers as customers. Talk to teams, triage CI incidents, write clear docs, and drive migrations and deprecations to completion.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional backend engineering experience, with a track record of shipping and operating production systems end-to-end and leading technical projects across teams.

  • Strong, production-grade skills in at least one backend language. Python is our main language today, but we're open to others. This role is mostly writing software (tools, services, bots, and CI logic), not only configuring it.

  • Hands-on experience owning CI/CD at scale (for example, GitHub Actions): build and test performance, caching, parallelization, and debugging flaky tests and pipelines.

  • Solid AWS experience, ideally with serverless (Lambda, CloudFormation/SAM) and infrastructure as code (Terraform).

  • Comfortable with the latest AI coding and agent-orchestration tools (for example, Claude Code, OpenCode, subagents, and MCP). You use them daily and know how to make them work reliably for a whole engineering org.

  • A product mindset for internal tooling. You talk to your users, measure outcomes, and judge success by adoption and time saved.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management. You can drive a change across many teams you don't manage: write the proposal, plan the rollout, and see it through.

Ideal, but not required

  • Prior experience on a developer productivity, developer experience, build/release engineering, or platform team.

  • Experience as a product-facing backend engineer, so you know firsthand where the development loop hurts.

  • Experience with frontend build and test tooling in the TypeScript/React ecosystem, so you can support our frontend engineers too.

  • Experience running self-hosted CI runners or build infrastructure at scale.

  • Experience with progressive delivery: canary deployments, automated rollbacks, and deployment gates.

  • Experience with monorepo tooling, build systems, or dependency management at scale.

  • Experience building AI agents or agent infrastructure, such as MCP servers, agent harnesses, or evals.

Our Stack

  • AI: Claude, Claude Code, OpenCode

  • Programming Languages: Python and TypeScript (React) today; open to others where they fit better

  • Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (Lambda, SAM/CloudFormation, ECR, CodeDeploy), Docker, Terraform

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions, self-hosted runners

  • Internal Tools: GitHub, Linear, Notion, Metabase

Our Stance

  • We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply.

  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears.

 

About Us

Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents.

With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding.

Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo.

With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. Learn more at taktile.com.

Depending on the location of this role, your employment or engagement will be with Taktile LLC (US), Taktile GmbH (Germany), Taktile Ltd (UK), or Taktile SRL (Romania). The applicable entity will be confirmed during the offer process.

Come Shape the Future of Sustainable Energy with Priva

Our Digital Twin and optimization technologies exist to meet that shift at scale, delivering measurable results such as lower energy intensity, greater flexibility and reliability, reduced operating costs, and structurally lower emissions.

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll help turn that ambition into production reality: building the services, integrations, and cloud foundation that put our optimization and forecasting capabilities to work for customers every day.

Your work will directly contribute to:

  • Reducing and optimizing energy costs and emissions across Europe

  • Enabling customers to participate in future energy flexibility and trading markets

  • Optimizing multi-energy systems (heat, cold, electricity, storage, HVAC)

  • Driving the transition toward autonomous, intelligent buildings and greenhouses

  • Helping customers stay compliant with increasing regulatory pressure (e.g., CSRD)

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Introducer Tech
descriptionHtml:
Senior Backend Engineer - Introducer Tech - DE

Hybrid in London / Remote within the UK

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer

You'll own the Lending API in Germany, which banks, fintechs, brokers, and comparison sites build on to offer iwoca's finance to their customers. You'll decide how it evolves and help build the features that make partners choose iwoca.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £5 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

Introducer Tech builds the systems that partners in Germany use to refer businesses to iwoca. The aim is to get new partners integrated quickly and to make applying simple for their customers. The team also looks after how partners earn commission.

Its work covers three main areas:

  • The Lending API. Developing the versioned API and the webhooks that keep partners up to date on their customers.

  • The Introducer Portal. Building the web app that German brokers log in to, to submit applications and upload documents.

  • The sign-up journey. Improving how businesses apply and how well they convert, after a partner referral.

The team is growing to have two product managers, who each focus on either the broker or the partner flow, and three engineers across the backend and frontend, including this hire.

The team currently works in sprints, with three stand-ups a week and planning every two weeks. However, there is room to adapt how it works as it grows.

The role

You'll be the senior engineer behind iwoca's broker and partner channels in Germany, from the tools partners integrate with to the internal systems that broker account managers use.

Ownership and autonomy

  • Own the Lending API in Germany end to end, deciding what to build, when to release a new version, when to retire an old one, and what iwoca can promise partners.

  • Own the developer portal and every tool partners use to integrate, from documentation that their developers and coding agents can build from to self-serve testing that needs no help from iwoca.

Impact

  • Ship the features that make partners choose iwoca, starting with pre-qualification, which shows a customer what they could borrow before they apply.

  • Make integration quick and simple, so a partner can go live with few questions and little hand-holding.

  • Automate parts of the broker funnel and the internal CRM that broker account managers use, cutting friction and the lag between a decision and the action that follows, and building agents wherever they help.

Growth trajectory

  • Set the team's technical direction and shape the product and technical roadmap alongside the product manager.

  • Align designs with the UK engineers who share the API, so German requirements shape the design from the start.

  • As well as being hands on, you’ll develop your mentoring and coaching skills. You’ll help lead the team as the most senior engineer.

You'll work with the commercial colleagues who bring in new partners, and join the team's weekly support rotation.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Backend engineering. You've designed and built production backend systems in Python – ideally with Django, though FastAPI or Flask count too. You've used PostgreSQL or another relational database in production, and kept it fast and maintainable.

  • API design. You've built and evolved APIs that other teams or companies depend on, and made the decisions on structure, versioning, and change.

  • Ownership. You've taken work from a commercial problem through to production – scoping the solution, making the trade-offs, and iterating based on how people use it.

  • Mentoring. You've helped other engineers grow through code reviews and design sessions.

  • AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone. You judge when to use it and when not to.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Partner onboarding. You've helped external developers integrate with an API – through documentation, test environments, or working with them directly.

  • Full-stack. You've contributed to frontend codebases, particularly in React or TypeScript.

  • CI/CD. You've set up or maintained the pipelines that test and release a production service.

  • Measurement. You've used data, metrics, or A/B tests to check whether a change had the effect you intended.

The salary

We expect to pay from £80,000 to £100,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Useful links:

  • iwoca benefits & policies.

  • Interview welcome pack.

Compensation: £80K – £100K

What You’ll Do

 

At M-KOPA, you’ll build sophisticated event-driven microservices with real-world impact. Our engineering teams own their solutions end-to-end, from architecture decisions to production monitoring, using AI coding tools like Claude Code to move faster along the way. Join us in combining cutting-edge .NET development with purpose-driven engineering that makes digital and financial inclusion possible across Africa.

 

Technical Environment 💻

title: Senior Backend Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Unsere Opportunity

Predium hat in den letzten drei Jahren die führende ESG-Intelligence-Plattform für institutionelle Immobilienunternehmen in der DACH-Region gebaut - mit den stärksten Namen der Branche als Kunden: Asset Manager, Wohnungsbaugesellschaften, Banken. Unsere Kundenbasis, die Daten, unsere Glaubwürdigkeit sind wertvolles Kapital für den nächsten Schritt. Investment-, Kredit- und Asset-Management-Entscheidung werden in der Real Estate Branche noch immer in Excel getroffen, Fall für Fall. Wir bauen jetzt den AI-Analysten, der diese Arbeit übernimmt. Direkt auf den Daten des Kunden, skalierbar ohne zusätzliche Köpfe. Wir sind stark finanziert und bringen KI in die Real Estate Branche.

Deine Mission

Als Senior Backend Engineer verantwortest du die Systeme hinter unserer Plattform: die GraphQL-API, das relationale Datenmodell, die Hintergrundverarbeitung, die Dokumente und Excel-Dateien unserer Kunden in strukturierte Daten verwandelt, und das Berechtigungsmodell, mit dem ein einzelner Eigentümer und eine Bank mit hunderten Portfolios dasselbe Produkt nutzen. Der Großteil deiner Arbeit läuft vom Schema-Design bis zum Resolver.
Du arbeitest eng mit Product, Design und den anderen Engineers zusammen, damit wir das bauen, was zählt - nicht nur das, was dir gesagt wurde. Du übernimmst echte Verantwortung für Production: Wenn etwas langsam ist, findest du heraus, warum – egal ob die Antwort eine schlechte Query, Anwendungscode oder die Infrastruktur darunter ist.
Du hilfst uns außerdem, KI in Production zuverlässig zu machen. Dokumentenextraktion, lang laufende Analyse-Jobs und agentische Features sind zentral für die Richtung des Produkts - und wir brauchen Leute, die diese Workflows testbar und verlässlich machen, statt nur in der Demo beeindruckend.
Bei uns gewinnt die beste Idee - egal von wem sie kommt. Mit 40 Leuten gibt's einfach keinen Raum für Politik. Und: Jede Zeile Code trägt dazu bei, den CO2-Fußabdruck von Immobilien zu verbessern.

Tech-Stack: TypeScript (NestJS im Backend, React im Frontend), Hasura/GraphQL, PostgreSQL (mehrere Datenbanken inkl. PostGIS), Queue-basierte Job-Verarbeitung, AWS (ECS / Elastic Beanstalk, S3, SES, Textract), Infrastructure-as-Code, Claude

Was du konkret tust

  • Du baust Features über unsere Hasura GraphQL-API, NestJS und Postgres - vom Schema-Design bis zum Resolver.
  • Du modellierst komplexe Immobilien- und ESG-Domänen in relationalen Schemas. Wir betreiben mehrere Postgres-Datenbanken parallel (eine davon geospatial), und Schema-Entscheidungen haben hier langfristige Konsequenzen.
  • Du verantwortest die Hintergrundverarbeitung: Excel-Importe, Dokumentenextraktion, lang laufende Analyse-Jobs. Queues, Retries, Jobs, die andere Jobs starten - und die Frage, was passiert, wenn Schritt 3 von 7 um 2 Uhr nachts fehlschlägt.
  • Du entwickelst unser Berechtigungsmodell weiter. Unsere Kunden reichen vom einzelnen Eigentümer bis zum Konzern mit Zugriff auf Organisations-, Portfolio- und Gebäudeebene. Das richtig zu bauen ist echte Design-Arbeit, keine Middleware-Konfiguration.
  • Du integrierst LLMs in Backend-Workflows - vor allem für Dokumenten- und Datenextraktion - und machst sie zuverlässig und testbar.
  • Du debuggst Production. Du nutzt Grafana Dashboards und Traces, um herauszufinden, warum etwas langsam ist oder fehlschlägt - ob in der App, der CI/Build-Pipeline oder der Infrastruktur.
  • Du erkennst überwucherte oder unnötig komplexe Teile der Codebase und vereinfachst sie, ohne dass dich jemand darum bitten muss. Komplexität abzubauen gehört zum Job, ist kein Nebenprojekt.

Woran wir Erfolg messen

  • Du hast Features end-to-end über Schema, API und Hintergrundverarbeitung ausgeliefert, die unsere Kunden aktiv nutzen.
  • Unsere asynchrone Verarbeitung (Importe, Extraktion, Analyse-Jobs) ist messbar robuster: weniger stille Fehler, klare Retry- und Recovery-Pfade und Observability, die uns sagt, was kaputt ist und warum.
  • Du hast Ownership für mindestens einen Kernbereich übernommen - z. B. das Berechtigungsmodell, die Job-Orchestrierung oder die LLM-Extraktions-Pipeline - und bist dafür die Anlaufstelle im Team.
  • Du hast Testing und Developer Experience im Backend auf ein neues Level gehoben, und andere Engineers liefern dadurch schneller.
  • Du bist für Product und das Team ein verlässlicher Sparringspartner, wenn wir entscheiden, was wir bauen und wie.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du bist stark in Postgres. Schema-Design fällt dir leicht, du kannst einen Query Plan lesen und weißt, wann das ORM dich anlügt. Geospatial-Erfahrung ist ein Bonus, keine Voraussetzung.
  • Du bist fließend in typisiertem Backend-TypeScript. Wir arbeiten täglich mit NestJS und GraphQL; wenn deine Erfahrung aus einem vergleichbaren Stack kommt, ist das völlig okay - du arbeitest dich ein.
  • Du hast echte Queue-basierte Verarbeitung gebaut. Nicht „ich habe mal einen Job in eine Queue gelegt", sondern Worker designt, Retries und Teilausfälle behandelt, mehrstufige Workflows orchestriert.
  • Du hast Authorization für ein Multi-Tenant-Produkt designt und weißt, wo es haarig wird.
  • Du hast lieber einen Integrationstest gegen eine echte Datenbank als zehn Unit-Tests, die alles mocken. Du schreibst den Test, der die kaputte Migration erwischt.
  • Du behandelst Production als debuggbares System. Du findest über Dashboards und Traces heraus, warum etwas langsam ist, und Infrastruktur ist für dich nicht das Problem von jemand anderem.
  • Du kommunizierst klar - mit Engineers, Product und bei Bedarf direkt mit Kunden.
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder besser und fließend Englisch. Unsere Kunden sind deutsche Banken und Asset Manager, und du wirst mit ihnen sprechen.

Bonus:

  • AWS (S3, SES, ECS, RDS, …) sowie Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • LLMs in Production, vor allem Dokumenten- oder Datenextraktion - und die Fähigkeit, sie zuverlässig statt nur beeindruckend zu machen.
  • Data-Pipeline-Erfahrung: stufenweise, reproduzierbare Verarbeitung, Dataset-Versionierung.
  • Mentoring oder Führung von Engineers - oder der Wunsch, da reinzuwachsen.
  • Debugging von Tooling- und Build-Problemen, nicht nur von Anwendungscode. Unsere Toolchain entwickelt sich schnell und ist gelegentlich nicht Standard.

Warum Predium?

  • Stage: ~40 Leute, stark finanziert, auf dem Weg die Kategorie zu definieren. Früh genug, dass vieles noch gebaut werden muss. Ja, es ist manchmal messy - aber genau das ist der Punkt. Wenn du einen fertigen Playbook-Job suchst, ist das hier nicht der richtige Fit.
  • Impact: Du bist nicht Rädchen #100 in einer Company. Was du hier baust, ist das, worauf sich unsere Kunden jeden Tag verlassen. Dein Beitrag ist direkt sichtbar, im Revenue und im Produkt.
  • Ownership: Wir managen nicht deine Zeit, wir messen deine Ergebnisse. Du bekommst Verantwortung und Freiraum - und die Erwartung, beides zu nutzen.
  • Compensation: Competitive Salary, Bonus und Equity-Beteiligung. Wir wollen, dass du am Erfolg partizipierst, den du mitaufbaust.
  • Team: Office-first im Werksviertel München, 2,5 Tage/Woche.

30 Urlaubstage · Wellpass · Deutschland-Ticket · Jobrad · Team-Events

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Platform (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech

Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform, powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Our modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.

If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you.

About the role

You'll join our Platform team as an individual contributor, working directly with our Platform Lead, who sets Platform's technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering organisation. It's a small team, so you'll cover a wide surface area, with no dedicated DevOps or QA function to hand work to.

This is a high-ownership seat. You'll take on substantial, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives, agree the direction with the Platform Lead, then drive them from first analysis through to completion with real autonomy over how you get there.

We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a significant topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role. If you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in.

What you'll be up to

  • Designing and building scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems.
  • Spotting and scoping problems and initiatives yourself, not just picking up assigned tickets: weighing impact, priority and timing.
  • Contributing to architectural decisions and design discussions, and bringing other teams along.
  • Driving substantial, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, coordinating with stakeholders across engineering.
  • Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that help teams deliver faster and more reliably.
  • Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available.
  • Sharing knowledge through code reviews, design reviews and pairing, and helping raise technical standards.
  • Spotting where AI and automation can improve how we build and run software.

Some of the challenges waiting for you

You'll take ownership of one of these as your first initiative, with no other distractions.

  • Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database.
  • Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery.
  • Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform.
  • Extracting and reworking common services to get us ready for our next scale level.

What you'll bring to the team

  • 5+ years of backend development experience, with a track record of owning significant technical work from ambiguity through to completion.
  • Substantial hands-on ownership of infrastructure, reliability or performance, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms. We care more about how you think than which stack you've used.
  • Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals and genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well).
  • Comfort with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack).
  • Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests, as we don't have a dedicated QA function.
  • A project you can talk about in depth: the problem, what you did and the impact it had.
  • Fluent English.

Nice to have

  • Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS or Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong.
  • Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other approaches (like CloudFormation).
  • Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ or SQS are good transferable equivalents).
  • Experience owning observability and logging for highly available systems.
  • Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement.
  • Experience mentoring other engineers, and introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams.

Culture & Growth

What We Offer

  • An International Team: Work alongside colleagues from over 20 nationalities.
  • Growth and Development: 360° feedback reviews, an evolving career framework and an annual learning budget of €1,000+.
  • Autonomy and Ownership: Great ideas can come from anywhere. We trust you to make decisions and contribute directly.
  • Real Impact: Join a fast-growing scale-up transforming hospitality. From day one, your work drives real impact.
  • Fair Pay: Competitive salaries guided by benchmarking data, with recognition for performance and contribution.
  • Flexible Work: Work from home, the office or a hybrid mix. We focus on results, not clocking hours.
  • Time Off and Wellbeing: 30 days of vacation and an EGYM Wellpass membership.
  • Free Public Transport: A fully covered Deutschland Ticket for travel across Germany.
  • Team Connection: Regular team dinners, company meetups and offsite events.

How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo is more than taking on a role. It's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued and your impact is tangible. Be part of a team where your work fuels progress, collaboration sparks innovation and growth is a shared journey.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.
