title: Senior Backend Engineer - Run & Grow
descriptionHtml:
About the Run & Grow:

Run & Grow is where SumUp builds the platforms and capabilities that help merchants discover, join, use, and continue growing with our products. The tribe brings together engineering, product, design, and revenue operations teams around two connected goals: helping SumUp serve and retain merchants, and accelerating acquisition, activation, and engagement.

Our work sits at the heart of SumUp's growth engine. We turn complex challenges across merchant acquisition, identity, marketing technology, commercial systems, operations, risk, and compliance into reliable products and services that other teams can build on. The systems we create help SumUp move faster, make better decisions, and deliver a simpler experience to millions of small businesses.

Joining Run & Grow means working on high-impact engineering problems with a broad view of the business. You'll collaborate across disciplines and teams, shape the foundations behind important merchant journeys, and help create a more connected, scalable way for SumUp to run and grow.

What you'll do:

  • Design, build, and operate production-grade backend services, APIs, and integrations, primarily using Go.
  • Build event-driven workflows and distributed systems using technologies such as Kafka and asynchronous processing.
  • Define clear service boundaries, data models, schemas, and API contracts that other teams can use confidently.
  • Build capabilities supporting merchant acquisition, identity, marketing technology, operations, risk, and compliance.
  • Own technical work end to end, from discovery and system design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production follow-up.
  • Modernise existing services and improve reliability through observability, security, failure handling, and incident response.
  • Collaborate with Product, Data, Operations, Compliance, Risk, Sales, Marketing, and other engineering teams to turn complex requirements into practical solutions.
  • Review code and designs, make pragmatic technical trade-offs, share knowledge, and mentor engineers around you

You'll be great for this role if you:

  • Bring a strong backend engineering background in Go, or are a typed-language generalist ready to ramp up quickly
  • Have designed APIs and distributed systems with clear contracts, versioning, and integration patterns
  • Are fluent in relational and analytical databases (PostgreSQL, Snowflake) and comfortable making the right choice for the right use case
  • Have built Kafka-based, event-driven systems and understand event sourcing and CDC patterns
  • Have experience in auditable, high-trust systems where every decision must be traceable fintech, payments, or similar domains
  • Have experience with testing, observability, and incident response practices and treat them as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts
  • Take ownership of ambiguous problems and turn them into clear, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
  • Communicate clearly, collaborate effectively, and explain technical concepts and trade-offs to different audiences.
  • Value pragmatic engineering, continuous improvement, mentoring, and reliable production operations.

Why you should join SumUp:

🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup

🧑‍🔬 We take learning and experimentation seriously with Hack Days every second Friday, and entire global Hack Weeks.

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: Be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2,000 for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education

🚀 Enrolment onto our VSOP program: You will own a stake in SumUp's future success

💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions

🔄 30 Days Sabbatical: Enjoy the unique opportunity to take a well-deserved break with our 30 days sabbatical benefit after completing 3 years of employment with SumUp

🔗 Referral Bonus: Earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

🚵🏾‍♂️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, relocation assistance, subsidised office lunches

SumUp is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. SumUp does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by Company policy. SumUp also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind.

About us:

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 36 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited.

Explore career opportunities with us and join a team driven by collaboration, innovation, and a shared vision of creating a world where everyone can build a thriving business. Discover more about our vibrant and inclusive work culture and how we work on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

title: Senior Battery Management System (BMS) Hardware Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

As a Senior Battery Management System (BMS) Hardware Engineer (all genders), you will own the development of safety-critical electronics for the Microliner’s propulsion battery system. You will design compact, high-density mixed-signal hardware that accurately monitors, controls and protects large lithium-ion battery assemblies during charging, ground operation and flight.

This is a hands-on role covering the complete hardware lifecycle: requirements, architecture, circuit design, prototype bring-up, verification, qualification, production release and certification evidence.

Working closely with BMS software, battery systems, safety, PCB layout, mechanical integration, thermal systems, testing and manufacturing, you will turn the propulsion battery’s safety and control concepts into flight-ready, certifiable electronic hardware.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Own the architecture and detailed design of battery management units, cell-monitoring electronics and associated sensing, communication and protection circuits.

  • Translate system, interface and safety requirements into complete, traceable and verifiable hardware requirements.

  • Design accurate measurement circuits for cell voltage, temperature, pack voltage, current and other battery sensors.

  • Develop high-density mixed-signal electronics incorporating battery-monitoring AFEs, balancing circuits, microcontrollers, watchdogs, memory, isolated communications and power supplies.

  • Define the PCB architecture and layout constraints for multilayer HDI assemblies, including fine-pitch components, microvias, grounding, signal and power integrity, EMC, thermal management, creepage and clearance.

  • Perform circuit simulation, tolerance analysis, worst-case circuit analysis, component derating, FMEA/FMECA and reliability assessment.

  • Work with Systems and Safety Engineering to implement fault detection, diagnostic coverage, independence and safe-state behaviour in accordance with the allocated Design Assurance Level.

  • Develop and maintain DO-254/ED-80 lifecycle evidence, including hardware requirements, design data, traceability, verification results, review records and problem reports.

  • Lead prototype bring-up, debugging, integration and fault-injection testing using cell simulators and flight-representative hardware.

  • Support DO-160G environmental and EMC qualification, DO-311A battery-system testing and transfer into repeatable production through DFM, DFT and manufacturing-test development.

  • Collaborate closely with BMS software, battery systems, PCB layout, mechanical, thermal, testing, manufacturing and certification teams.

  • Lead hardware design reviews, resolve test and production failures and mentor less-experienced engineers.

 

Your Profile:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering or a related field.

  • Seven or more years of experience developing complex electronic hardware from architecture through verification and production release.

  • Proven experience with BMS hardware, battery-monitoring electronics or comparable high-channel-count, safety-critical mixed-signal systems.

  • Strong expertise in precision analogue measurement, ADC signal chains, filtering, current and voltage sensing, galvanic isolation and fault-tolerant power supplies.

  • Demonstrable experience designing high-density multilayer electronics, including HDI technology, fine-pitch BGA/QFN devices, microvias, power distribution, grounding and thermal constraints.

  • Strong digital-hardware knowledge involving microcontrollers, memories, watchdogs, CAN/CAN FD, SPI, I²C and isolated serial interfaces.

  • Hands-on experience developing airborne electronic hardware under DO-254/ED-80 is essential. Experience at DAL B or DAL A and supporting formal certification reviews is strongly preferred.

  • Proficiency with professional ECAD and simulation tools such as Altium Designer, Cadence, Siemens EDA, LTspice or equivalent. Altium experience is preferred.

  • Confident laboratory skills and experience with prototype bring-up, automated testing, environmental qualification, failure analysis and electronics manufacturing.

  • Familiarity with CS-23, ARP4754A/B, ARP4761/ARP4761A, DO-160G and DO-311A is advantageous.

  • Fluent English is essential; German is beneficial.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

title: Senior BI Analytics Engineer
descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer / BI Analyst to bridge the gap between data engineering and business insight. You’ll take ownership of transforming raw data into trusted, well modelled datasets and deliver impactful reporting that drives decision making across the business. This role combines strong technical data modelling skills with stakeholder-facing analytics and BI development.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data models using dbt on Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery)

  • Create and maintain dashboards and explores in Looker, enabling self-serve analytics

  • Translate business requirements into clear data models, metrics, and visualisations

  • Define and maintain core business metrics and data definitions in partnership with stakeholders and the wider analytics team

  • Implement data quality checks, testing, and documentation within dbt

  • Partner with stakeholders across all parts of the business including commercial, product, marketing, finance, and operations

  • Optimise query performance and manage cost efficiency in BigQuery

  • Mentor junior analysts and promote best practices in analytics engineering across the wider analytics team

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Previous experience in analytics engineering, BI or data analytics roles

  • Strong SQL skills (expert level, performance tuning experience preferred)

  • Experience working with modern cloud data platforms and distributed data warehouses (e.g. BigQuery, Snowflake)

  • Proven experience with dbt (modelling, testing, documentation)

  • Experience building dashboards in Looker (LookML is a strong plus)

  • Solid understanding of data modelling concepts (star schema, dimensional modelling)

  • Experience working with large-scale datasets

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work with non-technical stakeholders

NICE TO HAVE

  • Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform, especially BigQuery

  • Experience with orchestration tools (e.g. Airflow)

  • Knowledge of data governance and data quality frameworks

  • Exposure to reverse ETL tools (e.g. Hightouch)

  • Familiarity with AI coding assistants and a habit of integrating them into day-to-day analytics workflows

SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE LOOKS LIKE

  • Clean, well-documented, and trusted data models used across the company

  • High adoption of Looker dashboards and self-serve analytics

  • Reduced time-to-insight for stakeholders with the use of AI tooling to accelerate delivery

  • Clear, consistent definitions of key business metrics

  • Improved data reliability and fewer reporting discrepancies

    WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • The transformation layer (dbt) and semantic layer (Looker)

  • Core business metrics and reporting definitions

  • Data quality and testing frameworks

  • BI best practices and documentation standards

    WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Hybrid working

  • Competitive salary to fund that dream holiday to Bali

  • Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Bupa Private Healthcare, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

  • Life Assurance for (even more) peace of mind

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays

    • 28 days annual leave

    • 1 day for your wedding

    • 1 day off when you move house - because moving is hard enough without work!

    • For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year

    • For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year

    • Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year

  • Work from abroad for a month

  • Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

  • The latest tech (Macbook or Surface) to power your gif-sending talents

  • Up to £500/€550 home office allowance for that massage chair you’ve been talking about

  • Generous learning and development budget to help you master your craft

  • Regular social events: tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, lunch 8 learns, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for

  • Refer a friend, get paid. Repeat for infinite money

Diversity and inclusion is an integral part of our culture. We know that diverse teams are strong teams, so we welcome those with alternative identities, backgrounds, and experiences to apply for this position. We make recruiting decisions based on experience, skills and potential, so all our applicants are treated fairly and equally.

title: Senior Bids Manager
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the role

We are looking for a strategic and ambitious Senior Bids Manager to lead our most complex, high-value opportunities across the public and private sectors. At Faculty, we are transforming how organisations operate using AI, and you will be at the heart of this mission.

You will orchestrate end-to-end bid processes, distilling technical brilliance into persuasive, customer-centric proposals. As a core role within our Central Sales function, you will drive revenue growth and refine the frameworks that empower Faculty to win and scale our global impact.

What you'll be doing:

  • Leading the end-to-end bid lifecycle for high-value strategic opportunities, from initial kick-off through to final presentation. You're comfortable both writing and managing bids when needed.

  • Driving critical Bid/No Bid evaluations and defining comprehensive resource requirements to ensure we pursue the right opportunities with excellence.

  • Crafting high-quality, persuasive prose by synthesising intricate technical and commercial information into compelling value propositions.

  • Collaborating with senior subject matter experts and C-suite stakeholders to align complex bid strategies with Faculty’s broader commercial objectives.

  • Optimising our bid operations by identifying process improvements and implementing best practices for framework management and tender monitoring.

  • Mentoring junior bid managers and co-ordinators, fostering a culture of technical excellence, professional growth and continuous learning.

  • Facilitating milestone meetings and managing client interactions to ensure clarity, alignment, and high-quality outcomes throughout the delivery phase.

Who we're looking for:

  • You bring advanced experience in managing large-scale, complex bids within the private or public sectors, backed by a proven track record of success.

  • You possess exceptional communication skills, with a flair for translating sophisticated AI concepts into clear, actionable, and persuasive narratives for diverse audiences.

  • You are a natural relationship-builder, comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders to extract high-quality insights under tight deadlines.

  • You exhibit a highly organised and proactive mindset, thriving in fast-paced environments where you can navigate multiple priorities with scientific rigour.

  • You demonstrate strong commercial acumen and a strategic lens, allowing you to identify market opportunities and drive meaningful business growth.

  • You lead with integrity and a collaborative spirit, enjoying the process of guiding team members and contributing to a high-performing, inclusive culture.

The Interview Process

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Introduction interview with Hiring Manager (45 mins)

  3. Written / Take Home Task

  4. Final Panel Interview (60 mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Senior Bilanzbuchhalter*in (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Werde Teil unseres Teams

Apaleo ist die offene Hospitality-Plattform, die Hotels die Freiheit gibt, ihre Technologie so zusammenzustellen, wie sie sie wirklich brauchen. Wir waren von Anfang an API-first, und jetzt denken wir unsere Plattform AI-first weiter: Mit Agent Hub, dem ersten KI-Agenten-Marktplatz der Hotellerie, geben wir Hotels die Freiheit, autonome Agenten für ihr Business einzusetzen. Denselben Anspruch haben wir an unser eigenes Finance: Wir bauen es konsequent AI-native auf.

Dafür suchen wir eine*n Senior Bilanzbuchhalter*in, die oder der fundiertes Buchhaltungs-Know-how mit echter Begeisterung für agentische Workflows verbindet und mit uns Strukturen, Prozesse und Kontrollen für ein skalierbares Finance aufbaut. Du übernimmst zunächst eigenverantwortlich das operative Tagesgeschäft in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem dreiköpfigen Finance-Team. Mittelfristig verschiebt sich dein Fokus vom Buchen zum Orchestrieren: KI-Agenten übernehmen Belegverarbeitung, Kontierung und Abstimmungen, du definierst die Regeln, überwachst die Ergebnisse und verantwortest Qualität und Compliance als Human in the Loop. Mittelfristig gestaltest du mit uns den Weg zu einem AI-native Accounting- und ERP-Setup und wirst zur zentralen Ansprechperson für alle buchhalterischen Fragen bei Apaleo.

So bringst du dich ein:

  • Du bearbeitest eigenverantwortlich sämtliche in der Finanzbuchhaltung anfallenden Geschäftsvorfälle (Rechnungskontrolle, Debitoren-, Kreditoren-, Anlagen-, Sachkonten- und Bankbuchhaltung) und stellst eine jederzeit prüfungssichere, GoBD-konforme Datenbasis für Reporting und Steuerung sicher.
  • Du übernimmst zusammen mit unserem Team die Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB mit festen Deadlines und treibst einen schnelleren, zunehmend automatisierten Close (Fast Close) voran.
  • Du konzipierst und implementierst agentische Workflows für wiederkehrende Prozesse wie Belegerfassung, Kontierung, Bankabstimmung, Rückstellungen und Intercompany und gestaltest damit, wie sich deine eigene Rolle über die Zeit entwickelt: weg vom manuellen Buchen, hin zum Orchestrieren, Überwachen und Freigeben der Arbeit von KI-Agenten.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit externen Steuerberater*innen und Wirtschaftsprüfer*innen zusammen.
  • Du gestaltest mit, wie sich unser Finance-Tech-Stack mittelfristig zu einem AI-native Accounting- und ERP-Setup entwickelt: von Tool-Auswahl und Datenmodell über saubere Stammdaten und Schnittstellen bis zu skalierbaren End-to-End-Prozessen, die mit uns mitwachsen.
  • Du wirst über Zeit zur zentralen Ansprechperson für alle buchhalterischen Fragen bei Apaleo und bringst die Erfahrung und Übersicht mit, um Themen auch über dein eigenes Gebiet hinaus einzuordnen.

Das bringst du mit:

Must-haves

  • Abgeschlossene Aus-/Weiterbildung zum/zur Bilanzbuchhalter*in (IHK) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation, mit mehrjähriger praktischer Erfahrung in der Finanzbuchhaltung.
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse im deutschen Handelsrecht (HGB); IFRS-Kenntnisse sind von Vorteil.
  • Sehr gute DATEV- und Excel-Kenntnisse sowie ein ausgeprägtes Prozess- und Systemverständnis: Du denkst in Datenflüssen, nicht in Einzelbuchungen.
  • Erfahrung mit Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen unter echtem Zeit- und Deadlinedruck im Unternehmen.
  • Nahezu muttersprachliches Deutsch (für die Kommunikation mit Steuerberater*innen, Wirtschaftsprüfer*innen und Behörden sowie für statutarische Meldungen) und gutes Arbeitsenglisch (für die Zusammenarbeit mit Legal und weiteren internationalen Stakeholdern).
  • Strukturierte, eigenständige und proaktive Arbeitsweise, du sprichst Unklarheiten direkt an, statt sie auflaufen zu lassen.
  • Du bist mindestens zweimal pro Woche in unserem Büro in München, idealerweise wohnst du bereits in München oder im Umkreis.
  • Du bist komfortabel mit Prozessambiguität und schnellem Wandel, triffst pragmatische 80/20-Entscheidungen und lieferst gleichzeitig hohe Qualität, wo es darauf ankommt.
  • Echte Neugier auf KI: Du nutzt Tools wie ChatGPT oder Claude bereits im Arbeitsalltag, prüfst ihre Ergebnisse kritisch und willst Prozesse grundlegend neu denken, statt sie nur zu digitalisieren.

Nice-to-haves

  • Du hast bereits agentische Workflows oder Automatisierungen im Finanzbereich aufgesetzt (z. B. mit LLMs, RPA oder Tools wie n8n oder Make) und kannst konkret zeigen, wie sich dadurch Qualität, Durchlaufzeit und Close verbessert haben.
  • Erfahrung in einem Software-/SaaS-Unternehmen oder einem wachstumsstarken Start-up/Scale-up; Vertrautheit mit SaaS-Kennzahlen.
  • Erfahrung in einem Private-Equity-Umfeld.
  • Berührungspunkte mit Verrechnungspreisthemen (Transfer Pricing).
  • Vertrautheit mit Employer-of-Record-Strukturen (EOR) und ihren

Das kannst du von uns erwarten:

  • Ein vielfältiges und internationales Team – Arbeite mit engagierten Experten aus verschiedenen Fachbereichen und mit unterschiedlichem Hintergrund zusammen und entwickele eine wirklich globale Lösung.
  • Flache Hierarchie und flexible Struktur – Genieße Autonomie und Eigenverantwortung in einem Umfeld, in dem Zusammenarbeit mehr geschätzt wird als starre Hierarchien.
  • Eine Schlüsselrolle in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen – Werde Teil eines der vielversprechendsten internationalen Software Unternehmens der Hotellerie im Herzen Münchens und gestalte den Finanzbereich aktiv mit.
  • Faire und transparente Vergütung – Profitiere von einem klaren Peer-Review-System und einem Career Progression Plänen, der Ihr Wachstum unterstützen.
  • Ein AI-native Arbeitsumfeld: Arbeite mit aktuellen KI-Tools und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum, um Finance von Grund auf neu zu denken.
  • Hybrides Arbeiten mit Teamtagen in München: Mindestens zweimal pro Woche arbeiten wir gemeinsam im Münchner Büro, den Rest der Woche gestaltest du flexibel.
  • Ansprechende Team-Events – Nimm an unseren Teamessen, Meet-ups und den legendären Partys teil.

title: Senior BMS Software Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

In this BMS Software Engineer role, you will join the VÆRIDION Airborne Software team within the Technology division. You will be responsible to lead the design of software required for our propulsion battery management and power distribution for VÆRIDION’s CS-23 all-electric aircraft. Your contributions will be instrumental in ensuring the safety, reliability, and performance of the High Voltage Propulsion Battery System at the core of VÆRIDION’s novel propulsion system.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead the design, development, and implementation of embedded software for propulsion battery and power distribution from prototypes to future airworthy systems.

  • Implement software development processes and toolchains in compliance with aviation standards and regulations.

  • Define and document software requirements, specifications, and interfaces for the high voltage electrical power system.

  • Collaborate closely with cell, electrical, and thermal engineers to integrate algorithms for battery state estimation, cell balancing, fault detection, power control, and thermal management.

  • Conduct thorough testing and validation of the software, including integration testing with other aircraft systems.

  • Support system integration, iron bird/field testing, and certification efforts, providing expertise on software functionality and performance.

  • Stay current with advancements in battery technology, software development methodologies, and aviation regulations.

 

Your Profile:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related field. A Master's degree is preferred.

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in software development, with a focus on embedded systems and real-time applications.

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in software design, with a focus on embedded systems and real-time applications.

  • Proven track record of designing and implementing software for safety-critical systems, preferably in the aerospace or comparable safety-critical industries.

  • Strong proficiency in C/C++ programming languages and experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS).

  • Experience with battery management systems, electric propulsion, power electronics, or related fields is highly desirable.

  • Familiarity with aviation standards such as RTCA DO-178C and DO-254 is a plus.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to convey complex technical concepts to cross-functional teams.

  • Fluent English language skills are essential, fluent German or other language would be beneficial.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

title: Senior Branch Nurse
descriptionHtml:
At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners.

We are looking for an enthusiastic and experienced RVN to join us as Senior Branch Nurse and lead our Tadley Surgery.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an RVN looking to take the next step in their career and play an important role in the leadership and development of our friendly Tadley team.

Donnington Grove Veterinary Group is an established three-branch practice, with our main RCVS Tier 3 Hospital in Newbury and branches in Thatcham and Tadley.

We have a large and varied client base, a supportive nursing team and excellent opportunities for professional development. We encourage our nurses to develop their own interests and pursue further qualifications.

We have a team of 17 vets, including certificate holders in small animal surgery, ophthalmology and exotics, as well as vets with an interest in internal medicine. This makes us more than a first-opinion practice as we often perform surgeries and treat cases that may otherwise have been referred. Having been established for decades, and with two branch practices in Thatcham and Tadley, we have a huge client base which comes with lots of variety in our caseload. Our nursing team is made up of 15 RVNs and 8 SVNs in various stages of their training. We are supported by a team of 7 nursing assistants. We also have a dedicated team of 3 night nurses.

We encourage our nurses to pursue special interests as much as possible; for example, we currently have nurses studying towards nutrition and small animal medicine certificates

How You’ll Make a Difference

As Senior Branch Nurse, you will provide day-to-day leadership to the nursing team while remaining hands-on clinically. You will work closely with our vets, nurses and support staff to ensure we deliver excellent patient care, outstanding client service and high clinical standards.

Alongside your clinical responsibilities, you’ll help lead standards within theatre, support and mentor junior colleagues and contribute to the ongoing development of our nursing protocols and ways of working.

Working Pattern

* 40 hours per week across 5 days * Shifts between 8:30 am - 7 pm * No weekend work but OOH cover required with TOIL

General Responsibilities

* Leading and supporting the nursing team at Tadley * Delivering high standards of medical and surgical nursing * Supporting perioperative care and anaesthesia * Providing nurse consultations and excellent client care * Supporting the training and development of RVNs, SVNs and nursing assistants * Taking responsibility for stock control, including monitoring stock levels, placing orders, checking expiry dates, stock rotation and reducing wastage * Taking responsibility for clinical equipment, including regular checks, servicing, maintenance and arranging repairs where required * Helping organise workloads and the smooth running of the branch * Working closely with the vets and Nurse Management Team * Promoting high clinical standards and continuous improvement * Ensuring a positive and supportive working environment

You Might Be a Great Fit If...

We’re looking for an experienced and confident Registered Veterinary Nurse who enjoys working as part of a team and is ready to take greater responsibility within a busy theatre environment. You’ll bring:

* Registration as a Veterinary Nurse with the RCVS * Confidence supporting anaesthesia, surgical procedures and peri-operative patient care * Strong communication skills and the ability to build positive working relationships with colleagues * Good organisational skills and the ability to manage priorities effectively within a busy clinical environment * An interest in supporting, mentoring and developing other members of the nursing team * A proactive approach to learning, reflection and continuous improvement

How We’ll Support You

At inspiring vet care, we’re committed to supporting your ongoing development and wellbeing. When you join us, you’ll benefit from:

* A varied and rewarding senior nursing role within a specialist-led equine hospital * Opportunities to develop your theatre, surgical and leadership experience * Clear career pathways with progression opportunities into senior nursing, referral and leadership roles, as well as Clinical Coach, mentoring and certificate pathways * Ongoing learning and development supported by experienced colleagues and specialist clinical teams * A collaborative, values-led culture focused on care, community and continuous improvement

What We Offer Our Team

* 6.6 weeks' annual leave plus your birthday off * Increasing holiday allowance based on length of service * Enhanced family-friendly policies, including maternity, paternity, adoption, shared parental and surrogacy pay * Private Medical Insurance * Employee wellbeing initiatives including Healthcare Cash Plan and Cycle to Work scheme * £550 CPD allowance plus 24 hours' paid CPD leave * Certificate support * RCVS and VDS fees covered * Pension scheme * Discounted veterinary care * Voluntary benefits including Green Cars salary sacrifice scheme and access to discounts and cashback with hundreds of participating retailers

We’re committed to supporting our people through career development opportunities, wellbeing initiatives and access to world-class learning resources.

Whether you’re looking to build on your theatre experience, develop your leadership skills or take the next step in your nursing career, inspiring vet care offers the support, opportunity and community to help you grow.

title: Senior Brand Designer
descriptionHtml:
Senior Brand Designer

OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

BRAND CREATIVE @ CARWOW

Brand Creative is the central creative studio for all brands within the Carwow Group. We’re an ambitious team who thrive on storytelling, craft and collaboration.

We bring our portfolio of brands to life across every channel; from large-scale campaigns to social-first paid marketing creative, events, brand identity, commercial initiatives and internal culture-building.

We move quickly, adapt often and work closely with colleagues across the whole business. Due to the scale up nature of the business you’ll enjoy a unique mix of variety, ownership and creative exploration.

YOUR MISSION

Your mission is to elevate how our brands show up visually; taking ownership of everything from early creative concepts to final delivery across a wide mix of channels.

As the sole permanent designer in the team, you will play a central role in shaping how we communicate visually, balancing conceptual thinking with hands-on craft, and ensuring our brands remain consistent, recognisable and creatively ambitious. You will support onboarding and coaching our freelancers in the guidelines and internal systems, taking ownership of both.

You’ll collaborate closely with marketing, content, product and editorial teams, while being confident operating independently, solving problems proactively and bringing structure to a fast-moving creative environment. You’ll also be an active contributor to our Creative Community, helping connect, inspire and align creatives across the wider business (there are plenty of creative pockets at Carwow Group!).

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Deliver high-quality design across brand, campaign, social, print, CRM, paid media and editorial channels.

  • Partner with the Head of Creative, Creative Strategist and Copywriters to develop clear, insight-led creative ideas and campaign directions.

  • Interpret brand guidelines pragmatically, knowing when to follow, when to adapt and when to propose improvements.

  • Produce assets that scale: layouts, toolkits, templates and visual systems that support efficiency across the group.

  • Concept and create social-first paid video content that reflects platform behaviours and audience expectations, particularly across YouTube and Meta.

  • Work with Product Designers to ensure brand and campaign creative translates effectively into digital journeys.

  • Present your work with clarity, explaining rationale, constraints, and the impact of design decisions.

  • Provide constructive, objective feedback to freelancers and ensure their work aligns with brand expectations.

  • Bring structure and consistency to design delivery through thoughtful file organisation, templating and process improvements.

  • Contribute actively to Carwow’s Creative Community, sharing inspiration, collaborating across teams and helping strengthen our creative culture.

  • Proactively explore AI solutions in the creative workflow without compromising on execution.

KEY REQUIREMENTS

  • A strong portfolio showcasing both concept development and crafted design across digital and print, preferably including a 360 campaign from ATL to tactical performance assets.

  • Proficiency in Figma, Illustrator, InDesign and Photoshop, with consistent attention to detail.

  • Ability to create coherent campaign executions, from early concepts to multi-channel rollouts.

  • Experience adapting design to fit channel needs, especially across social and performance environments.

  • Comfortable collaborating creatively with copywriters and stakeholders, and able to offer clear, thoughtful feedback.

  • Self-sufficient, organised and proactive, confident managing multiple projects without heavy oversight.

  • Strong understanding of visual trends, social formats and the role of motion in brand expression.

  • A natural collaborator who enjoys working across disciplines and connecting with other creatives.

BONUS POINTS

  • Motion design capability (After Effects + Premiere Pro)

  • Interest or experience in shooting UGC-style short form content

  • Illustration or iconography skills

  • An interest in creative operations, workflow improvements or building toolkits (including AI solutions)

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Introductory call with our Talent team

  • Step one: Video call with Head of Creative (30 mins)

  • Step two: Concepting or design task presented to two members of the Brand Creative team (1 hr)

  • Step three: Interview with our Brand and Comms Director (30 mins)

Default on all JDs:

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Competitive compensation package

  • 28 days’ holiday + bank holidays (up to 35 with service)

  • Share options

  • Pension via Royal London (up to 5% company contribution)

  • Bupa private healthcare

  • Life assurance (4x salary)

  • Monthly wellbeing coaching with Spill

  • Inclusive parental leave policies

  • Bubble childcare support & discounted nanny fees

  • Work-from-abroad scheme

  • Generous learning & development budget

  • £500 / €550 home office budget

Diversity and inclusion are integral to our culture. We know that diverse teams are strong teams, so we welcome those with alternative identities, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. We make recruiting decisions based on experience, skills and potential, and treat all applicants fairly and equally.

descriptionHtml:
Regentonnen, Biomülleimer, Komposter, Brotboxen: Produkte, die man jeden Tag benutzt und über die man selten nachdenkt.

Genau hier setzen wir an. YourCasa verbindet funktionale Alltagsprodukte für Haus, Küche und Garten mit klarer Gestaltung und einer Qualität, die hält. Qualität Hochwertige Materialien, sorgfältige Verarbeitung und Produkte, die lange halten.

Design Zeitlose Formen und moderne Farben, die sich in jedes Zuhause einfügen.

Unser Ziel: die Go-to-Brand für funktionale Home-&-Living-Lösungen in Europa werden.

Du machst YourCasa zur Marke, an die Kundinnen und Kunden bei Haus, Küche und Garten zuerst denken. Und Du baust die Abläufe, mit denen unser Wachstum planbar und skalierbar wird.

WAS DU BEWEGST

Marke & Wachstum

  • Du schärfst Positionierung und USP von YourCasa und verantwortest Markenauftritt und Content über alle Kanäle.

  • Du priorisierst das Portfolio, planst und timst Launches und sorgst dafür, dass wir uns klar von Nachahmern abheben.

  • Du entwickelst unsere internationalen Märkte weiter: Frankreich und Italien gezielt ausbauen, UK, USA und weitere EU-Märkte erschließen.

Marktplätze & Performance

  • Du steuerst das Amazon-Tagesgeschäft mit Blick auf Buy-Box, Rankings und Bewertungen.

  • Du legst gemeinsam mit unserem Advertising-Freelancer die PPC-Strategie fest und misst sie an klaren TACoS-Zielen.

  • Du briefst unsere Content-Agentur für Bilder und Videos und passt Visuals bei Bedarf selbst mit KI-Tools an.

Einkauf & Operations

  • Du platzierst Bestellungen bei unseren Lieferanten in Europa und Asien, verfolgst Mengen, Termine und Verschiffung und steuerst die Lagerreichweiten.

  • Du pflegst Lieferantenvereinbarungen, gleichst Rechnungen mit Liefer- und Versanddaten ab und klärst Abweichungen.

  • Du wertest Retourengründe aus, stellst Ursachen ab und bist erste Anlaufstelle für unseren Kundenservice bei kniffligen Fällen.

Zahlen, Compliance & Prozesse

  • Du behältst Umsatz, Marge, Bestand und Werbekosten täglich im Blick (Sellerboard und internes Dashboard) und kalkulierst Margen pro Produkt und Marktplatz.

  • Du verantwortest das monatliche KPI-Reporting mit TACoS, SKU-Profitabilität, Deckungsbeiträgen und Sondereffekten.

  • Du stellst EPR-Meldungen, Verpackungslizenzen und GPSR-Angaben in allen Ländern fristgerecht sicher.

  • Du machst unsere Abläufe mit KI und Automatisierung schneller und sauberer.

Klingt nach viel? Ist es auch. Deshalb arbeitest Du nicht allein: Freelancer und Partner übernehmen PPC, Retouren, Kundenservice und Fulfillment, eine Agentur Bilder und Videos. Du setzt die Prioritäten.

DEINE ERSTEN 12 MONATE

NACH 1 MONAT Ankommen: Du kennst Portfolio, Kanäle, Partner und Zahlen und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt das Amazon-Tagesgeschäft.

NACH 3 MONATEN Übernehmen: Listings, Einkaufsplanung und Reporting laufen über Deinen Tisch. Erste eigene Optimierungen sind live.

NACH 12 MONATEN Gestalten: Du treibst Launches und Länderausbau eigenständig voran und verantwortest erste Bereiche komplett.

WAS DU MITBRINGST

Das brauchst Du

  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Amazon-Seller-Erfahrung auf Marken- oder Agenturseite

  • Erfahrung mit einem weiteren Kanal, z. B. Otto, Kaufland, D2C-Shop, bol.com oder TikTok Shop

  • Unternehmerisches Denken: Du entwickelst eigene Lösungen, statt nur Vorgaben umzusetzen. KI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude oder Bild-KI nutzt Du selbstverständlich

  • Fließendes Deutsch und Englisch sowie Erreichbarkeit zu deutschen Kernarbeitszeiten (ca. 9–17 Uhr MEZ)

Ein Plus, aber kein Muss

  • Internationale Marktentwicklung über DACH hinaus, idealerweise FR, IT oder UK

  • Praxis mit Amazon Advertising (Sponsored Products, Brands, Display)

  • Kenntnisse in EPR, Verpackungsgesetz oder GPSR

  • Einkaufs- oder Lieferantenerfahrung, gern mit China-Import

  • Französisch, Italienisch oder Polnisch

  • Grundkenntnisse in Canva oder Bildbearbeitung

Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Bewirb Dich trotzdem. Uns ist wichtiger, wie Du denkst und arbeitest, als eine perfekte Liste.

WAS WIR DIR BIETEN

  • Gehalt: 60.000–80.000 € brutto pro Jahr je nach Erfahrung, unbefristete Vollzeitstelle

  • Freiheit: 100 % remote, auch aus dem Ausland möglich (nach Absprache), mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten rund um gemeinsame Kernzeiten, ohne Pendeln und ohne Bürokratie

  • Kurze Wege: Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung, Entscheidungen fallen schnell

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Deine Ideen für Produkte, Märkte und Prozesse werden umgesetzt

SO BEWIRBST DU DICH

As a Senior Accountant, you will oversee end-to-end accounting operations, statutory reporting, and financial compliance across our operations. You will drive process improvements, maintain precise financial records, and provide key financial insights to empower data-driven strategic decisions.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Optimize internal controls, accounting workflows, and financial systems to support scalable company growth.
  • Collaborate with Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) to align accounting outputs with budgeting and forecasting models.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in accounting or auditing, preferably within a fast-growing tech or manufacturing environment.
  • Strong expertise in HGB accounting principles; thorough familiarity with IFRS is highly desirable.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field (CPA/Steuerberater qualification is a plus).
  • Proficiency with modern ERP systems (e.g., DATEV, SAP, NetSuite) and advanced Excel financial modeling skills.

NICE TO HAVE

title: Senior business analyst - deadline 03/11/2026
descriptionHtml:
Job description :

We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst to work closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and technical teams to analyze business needs, define requirements, and ensure successful delivery of features within an Agile/SAFe environment.

The role involves managing the product backlog, preparing and refining user stories, facilitating requirements workshops, supporting PI Planning and sprint execution, and coordinating User Acceptance Testing (UAT). The ideal candidate will have knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power BI, Power Pages, and Dataverse, as well as the ability to leverage AI tools to improve requirements gathering and business process analysis.

Key responsibilities :

  • Requirements Gathering & Analysis: Collaborate with business stakeholders, Product Owners, and SMEs to gather, analyze, validate, and document business and technical requirements.

  • Feature & Backlog Management: Analyze upcoming roadmap features, identify business value, dependencies, risks, and gaps, and continuously refine the product backlog.

  • User Stories & Acceptance Criteria: Create and refine Epics, Features, and User Stories with clear scope, detailed acceptance criteria, dependencies, and relevant functional and non-functional requirements.

  • Business Process Documentation: Prepare process flows (as-is/to-be), mockups, business rules, data mappings, impact assessments, and other supporting documentation as required.

  • Microsoft Power Platform: Understand Power Apps (Canvas and Model-driven), Power BI, Power Pages, Dataverse, access structures, data models, solution architecture, and inbound/outbound data flows.

  • Agile & SAFe Delivery: Participate in PI Planning, backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily meetings, system demos, and other Agile/SAFe ceremonies.

  • PI Preparation: Support pre-PI planning activities, identify knowledge gaps and dependencies, prepare refinement materials, and coordinate with relevant teams to ensure feature readiness.

  • Definition of Ready & Definition of Done: Ensure that User Stories meet the agreed Definition of Ready (DoR) before entering a sprint and contain the necessary information to support the Definition of Done (DoD).

  • Technical & Cross-Team Coordination: Collaborate with development leads, testers, Product Owners, and other teams to clarify technical feasibility, resolve dependencies, and maintain alignment on scope and responsibilities.

  • User Acceptance Testing (UAT): Prepare UAT scenarios, use cases, and sample test data; coordinate end-user testing; collect and analyze feedback; and document decisions and follow-up backlog items.

  • Delivery & Release Support: Verify that delivered functionality meets business requirements, prepare sprint release notes, and ensure that documentation, user guidance, and training materials are updated.

  • Documentation & Traceability: Maintain centralized and accessible project documentation in tools such as SharePoint or Wiki, ensuring traceability from Epics and Features through User Stories, acceptance tests, and releases.

  • AI-Assisted Analysis: Use AI capabilities such as Copilot, AI agents, and other relevant tools to support requirements gathering, process analysis, validation of assumptions, and initial solution ideation.

  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to simplify business processes, improve requirements quality, and maintain a backlog buffer of approximately 1.5–2 sprints of ready User Stories.


Job requirments:

  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst in Agile/Scrum and SAFe environments.

  • Strong experience in requirements elicitation, stakeholder management, business process analysis, and documentation.

  • Practical knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, including:

    • Power Apps (Canvas and Model-driven apps)

    • Power BI

    • Power Pages

    • Microsoft Dataverse

    • Data models, access structures, and data integrations.

  • Experience defining and refining Epics, Features, User Stories, and detailed Acceptance Criteria.

  • Knowledge of backlog management, refinement sessions, sprint planning, and PI Planning.

  • Experience with business process modelling, process flows, mockups, business rules, data mappings, and impact assessments.

  • Understanding of functional and non-functional requirements, including performance, scalability, availability, security, auditability, and GDPR/privacy.

  • Knowledge of Definition of Ready (DoR), Definition of Done (DoD), and requirements traceability.

  • Experience supporting UAT, including test scenario preparation, test data coordination, feedback analysis, and defect or backlog item management.

  • Ability to identify dependencies, clarify scope, assess gaps, and coordinate with technical teams and business stakeholders.

  • Familiarity with technical documentation, solution architecture, data models, APIs, and integration flows.

  • Experience using documentation and collaboration tools such as SharePoint, Wiki, and backlog management platforms.

  • Awareness of AI tools, including Copilot and AI agents, for requirements analysis, process improvement, and solution ideation.

  • Strong communication, analytical, facilitation, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple features and priorities in a structured delivery environment.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Senior Business Analysts specializing in the mining sector to support M&A advisory and investment banking activities focused on mining-related opportunities. The role bridges technical geological expertise with commercial and financial analysis, evaluating mining assets, transactions, and investment opportunities across the resources value chain.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct due diligence on mining assets and companies, integrating geological, technical, and commercial assessments.

  • Build and maintain financial models (DCF, NAV, comparable transactions and companies) for mining projects and corporate transactions.

  • Analyze mineral resource and reserve statements (JORC, NI 43-101, or equivalent) and assess their commercial implications.

  • Evaluate mining project economics, including capex/opex profiles, production schedules, commodity price assumptions, and risk factors.

  • Prepare investment memoranda, pitch books, valuation summaries, and board-level presentations.

  • Monitor commodity markets, mining sector trends, M&A activity, and the competitive landscape.

  • Support deal execution, including coordination with technical consultants, legal teams, and counterparties.

  • Assess geopolitical, permitting, environmental, and ESG risks affecting mining investments.

  • Structure and evaluate alternative and structured financing schemes for mining operations, including metal prepays, royalties, streaming agreements, offtake and marketing arrangements, and debt/equity hybrids, and assess their impact on project economics and counterparty risk.


Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Geology, Geological Engineering, Mining Engineering, or Earth Sciences.

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in mining, investment banking, corporate finance, equity research, or technical/financial advisory within the resources sector.

  • Exposure to M&A transactions, project finance, or asset valuation in mining is highly desirable.

  • Formal business education or training is a plus (MBA, finance/business degree, CFA progress, or equivalent practical commercial experience).

  • Demonstrated understanding of mineral resource classification codes (JORC, NI 43-101, SAMREC, or similar).

  • Working knowledge of structured financing instruments used in the mining sector, including prepays, royalties, streams, and offtake agreements.

  • Strong financial modelling and valuation skills.

  • Ability to translate technical geological data into commercial and financial insight.

  • Advanced proficiency in Excel; familiarity with mining technical software (e.g., resource and mine-planning tools) is an advantage.

  • Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving abilities.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including report and presentation preparation.

  • Ability to manage multiple workstreams under deadline pressure.

  • Attention to detail and sound commercial judgement.

Preferred / Advantageous

  • Experience across multiple commodities (e.g., base metals, precious metals, bulk commodities, battery metals).

  • Knowledge of ESG frameworks relevant to mining.

  • Additional languages and willingness to travel to project sites.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: (Senior) Business Controller  (m/f/x)
descriptionHtml:
Your Role

As a (Senior) Business Controller, you play a key role in steering FINN’s financial and operational performance. You drive transparency on planned and actual unit economics, deep-diving into profitability drivers and P&L Gross Margin deviations against plan to identify actionable countersteering measures. Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you translate complex financial and operational data into clear recommendations that support business decision-making, optimize profitability, and drive sustainable growth.


Your Mission

  • Drive Unit Economics Transparency & Improvement: Own unit economics calculation methodologies, reporting, and analyses to provide transparency on planned and actual profitability per subscription. Deep-dive into underlying drivers, explain deviations against plan, and identify countersteering measures to improve profitability and support financial planning.

  • Analyze & Steer Financial Performance: Own the analysis and steering of Gross Margin P&L line items, explaining deviations against plan and translating unit economics and KPI performance to financial results. Partner closely with business stakeholders to identify performance drivers, manage provisions, and implement and track initiatives to improve profitability.

  • Improve Data-Driven Business Steering: Own the tactical Demand & Supply Steering process, balancing demand generation, fleet availability, utilization, and profitability against company targets. Evaluate financial trade-offs, identify opportunities to optimize operational performance and translate demand and supply forecasts into actionable recommendations for fleet planning and steering.

  • Management & Board Reporting: Contribute to the monthly management and board reporting by translating findings on Gross Margin and unit economics into concise, insightful commentary on performance, drivers, risks and opportunities.


    • Your Profile

    Must have:

title: Senior Campaign Manager (Temp Contract)
descriptionHtml:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Integrated Campaign Manager, Brand & GTM to join our Integrated Marketing team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help architect, roll out, project manage, and drive the Go-To-Market (GTM) execution for our major 2027 brand marketing strategy and campaigns and be part of turning brand strategy, positioning, and creative concepts into operational GTM blueprints as we scale our multi-segment (SMB, Mid-Market, Enterprise) reach across 6 key European markets. If you're excited about high-visibility, full-funnel orchestration and balancing long-term brand equity building with full-funnel conversion, and are passionate about integrated brand and GTM marketing in high-growth B2B SaaS, then this is the opportunity for you!

Please bear in mind this role is a temporary contract of 1 year.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Director of Integrated Marketing and work closely with teams in Brand Marketing, Digital, Field/Events, Content, PR, Product Marketing (PMM), Marketing Ops, Data, and Sales/Growth channels. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to bridging top-of-funnel brand awareness with lower-funnel acquisition, ensuring every campaign moment translates into market salience, customer engagement, and measurable business impact. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across country teams, local market stakeholders, Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field squads to ensure success.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Campaign Manager, you will:

  • Integrated GTM Architecture & Strategic Planning: Translate the overarching 2027 brand strategy into actionable, full-funnel GTM campaign blueprints across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments, architecting campaign flighting and distribution models across 6 European markets.

  • The "Master Brief" & Cross-Functional Squad Leadership: Own and author comprehensive Integrated Campaign Master Briefs, leading the operational rhythm of cross-functional squads to execute multi-channel strategies (OOH, Paid Social, VIP activations, Digital, ABM) on time and within scope.

  • Localization & Regional Adaptation: Partner with country teams and local market stakeholders to ensure master campaign frameworks balance global consistency with local relevance and execution precision.

  • Strategic Brand Partnership & Enablement: Serve as the strategic execution peer to the Brand Marketing Lead, while partnering with Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field teams to equip customer-facing squads with the stories, tools, and campaign momentum needed to capitalize on campaign-generated intent.

  • Campaign Operations, Budget & ROI Accountability: Maintain and protect the integrated campaign master calendar, manage and allocate the multi-country integrated campaign budget, and partner with Marketing Ops, Data, and Brand Intelligence to track brand lift, consideration, pipeline growth, and closed-won impact.

What you bring


You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • A proven track record leading multi-million dollar, multi-country, full-funnel integrated campaigns in high-growth B2B SaaS or tech environments.

  • Deep experience taking high-level brand frameworks and translating them into multi-channel GTM blueprints across varied audience segments (SMB to Enterprise).

  • High proficiency in aligning cross-functional teams (Creative, Digital, PR, Ops, Sales) and holding squads accountable to tight deadlines and complex campaign launches.

  • Deep understanding of how to run campaigns across diverse European markets, with a clear perspective on modular campaign design and local adaptation.

  • Experience with tracking brand-to-pipeline performance metrics, campaign flighting dynamics, brand lift, consideration, and total ROI.

  • A background in integrated marketing, GTM campaign management, or brand marketing orchestration within B2B technology or SaaS.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You thrive as the operational bridge between high-level brand strategy and lower-funnel demand generation, turning concepts into structured GTM blueprints.

  • You love leading cross-functional squads across multiple international markets, balancing consistency with local nuances across 6 key European countries.

  • You take pride in end-to-end accountability, from authoring master briefs and handling multi-country budgets to tracking downstream pipeline velocity and closed-won revenue impact.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer focusing purely on high-level creative ideation, copy, or audience insight development without building the operational execution machinery.

  • You prefer running single-channel or single-market marketing initiatives rather than orchestrating complex, multi-segment (SMB to Enterprise), multi-channel matrices.

  • You are uncomfortable navigating data, campaign flighting performance, budget allocations, and downstream pipeline attribution alongside brand metrics.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Lead the architecture and rollout of the 2027 integrated brand campaign calendar across all target European markets.

  • Collaborate with the Brand Marketing Lead, country teams, and Marketing Ops to stand up the Master Briefing framework and streamline cross-functional execution rhythms.

  • Grow your skills in full-funnel orchestration and multi-market scale, driving measurable brand lift, consideration, and downstream pipeline velocity as Pleo continues to expand.

The location


Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 minute chat to deep dive into your experience

  3. Challenge & Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role

  4. Final Interview: A final interview with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for this role, we received a total vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call.Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Senior Category Manager - Strategic Sourcing (Packaging)
descriptionHtml:
The role

At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. As the Category Manager for Packaging, you will report directly to the Director of Packaging and take full ownership of creating and developing our Primary packaging category (ingredient packaging, plastic film…). You will be responsible for developing and executing sourcing strategies to improve our cost structure, the quality of our products, and the reliability of our supply chain, while playing a leading role in supporting innovation and new product development. 

We are looking for an ambitious, confident, and entrepreneurial procurement professional who can balance the analytical requirements of the role with the collaborative skills needed to elevate our customer experience.

What you’ll do

  • Drive Innovation: Source primary suppliers that can co-create and develop best-in-class primary packaging solutions tailored specifically to our unique business model.
  • Data-Driven Execution: Leverage large internal datasets and industry benchmarks (including market, supplier, and SKU analysis) to identify opportunities for cost reduction and implement best practices.
  • Develop the Supply Base: Build and maintain a strong pool of primary packaging suppliers capable of providing all of our ingredient packaging requirements, taking full ownership of vendor selection, specs definition, KPIs and relationships.
  • Elevate Customer Experience: Work closely with the packaging design team to improve the overall look and feel of our ingredient packaging.

What you’ll bring

  • Preferably deep knowledge and interest in food, Ideally working within a similar environment and sector
  • Masters degree in Supply Chain / Procurement / Business (or equivalent) 
  • 5+ years of strategic procurement / supply chain / consulting experience in operations practise
  • Proven track record of entrepreneurial mindset, and ability to prioritize workload in a fast-paced environment 
  • Quantitative and analytical experience, including solid comfort with the Gsuite
  • Proactive, flexible, ambitious, and assertive: you take ownership of your work

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS: 10% - 25% (Flexible)

What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.

  • Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
  • Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
  • Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
  • Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

Are you up for the challenge?

Please submit your complete application below including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.

After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within 5 business days.
