title: Senior Channel Field Marketing Manager, Benelux & Nordics
descriptionHtml:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

Role Overview

We are seeking a high-impact, results-driven Field & Channel Marketing Manager to lead integrated marketing execution across the Nordics & Benelux region.

This is a highly visible manager-level role designed to accelerate pipeline growth through a balanced mix of field marketing, channel partner marketing, demand generation, executive engagement, and regional go-to-market execution.

The successful candidate will build and execute scalable regional programs that strengthen partner relationships, create demand, support sales priorities, and elevate brand presence across key Nordics & Benelux markets. This role will be supporting both Enterprise and Commercial Sales reps.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and execute the integrated marketing plan for the Nordics and Benelux, aligned to EMEA revenue priorities and sales targets.

  • Translate corporate campaigns into localised regional programs that drive measurable pipeline and partner engagement.

  • Develop multi-touch programs including, but not limited to, events, webinars, direct mailers, roundtables, digital, social and ABM.

  • Support regional sales teams with campaign strategy, market insights, and program execution.

  • Build and execute partner marketing plans with strategic resellers, distributors, MSSPs, alliances, and channel ecosystem partners.

  • Drive MDF / co-marketing investment toward measurable pipeline outcomes.

  • In partnership with the channel team, launch partner-led demand generation campaigns, enablement programs, and joint market initiatives.

  • Strengthen relationships with channel sales leaders and partner account teams.

  • Manage lead flow, nurture alignment, conversion optimisation, and follow-up processes with SDR and sales teams.

  • Monitor campaign performance and continuously optimize based on ROI, conversion, and pipeline metrics.

  • Build quarterly business reviews and performance updates for leadership.

  • Share best practices across EMEA and contribute to scalable regional programs.

Requirements

  • 6+ years in B2B technology marketing, ideally within Cybersecurity

  • Experienced in marketing to the Nordics & Benelux region

  • Strong experience across field marketing + channel/partner marketing + demand generation

  • Proven success supporting revenue teams and delivering measurable pipeline growth

  • Experience working with indirect routes to market including VARs, distributors, alliances, and service providers

  • Strong commercial acumen and ability to prioritise investment by market opportunity

  • Comfortable operating in matrixed, fast-growth environments

  • Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills

  • Experience in using technologies such as SDFC, Asana, Reachdesk, G-Suite, Zoom Info, ON24

  • Fluent in English and Swedish OR Dutch

Preferred Experience

  • Understanding of cybersecurity categories such as cloud security, endpoint, identity, SOC, threat intelligence, zero trust, or managed security

  • Experience with ABM strategy and enterprise account engagement

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits.

Compensation and Values

title: Senior Client Partner
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Why Deliveroo (part of DoorDash)

Deliveroo, part of the DoorDash group, is building the leading local commerce platform, connecting consumers, merchants, and couriers in real time. Paris is one of our most strategic and complex markets globally, with unmatched density, brand concentration, and competitive intensity.

As we move towards our 2026 ambition, we are evolving our commercial organisation to match the scale and sophistication required to win in Paris. This includes increased seniority, clearer regional ownership, and stronger execution across Inner and Outer Paris.

The Senior Client Partner – Paris Inner Ouest role is a newly strengthened position, designed to combine strategic partner leadership, regional ownership, and organisation building.

The Role

As a Senior Client Partner, you'll lead a team of Account Management Lead, Senior Account Manager and Account Manager and you will report to the Regional Director of Paris, part of the Commercial team. The position is based in Paris. 

You are accountable for the growth and performance of strategic brand portfolios across one of Paris’ most critical zones. You will act as the senior commercial owner for your territory, ensuring alignment between Paris-wide strategy and local execution. Beyond partner management, this role plays a central part in aligning the organisation to business challenges and ambitions. You will design, lead, and continuously evolve the account management setup to ensure the right level of seniority, coverage, and execution quality across the territory. 

This is a senior leadership role with direct impact on revenue, partner satisfaction, and team development.

Key Responsibilities

1. Lead Commercial Strategy & Execution Excellence 

  • Own the end-to-end growth of brand portfolios within your Paris Inner cluster

  • Ensure 5★ account management standards across the team, with clear portfolio sizing

  • Build and maintain relationships with senior and C-level stakeholders

  • Lead contract negotiations, renewals, and upsell strategies

  • Create and execute joint business plans addressing partner growth, profitability, and operational performance

  • Act as a trusted advisor, providing insights on Deliveroo capabilities, competitors, and market trends

  • Responsible for a commercial initiative for Paris : engage team, drive performance and proactively adjust structure, focus, or processes

2. Regional & Portfolio Ownership

  • Own a zone cluster, defining and executing the strategy to win

  • Translate Paris-wide and national priorities into clear, actionable regional strategies

  • Improve Client Value Proposition (CVP) across the territory in collaboration with other commercial departments

3. Talent Development & Succession

  • Lead and develop a team of up to 10 AMs / SAMs, either directly or through mid-management

  • Coach and mentor high-potential talent, building a strong internal succession pipeline

4. Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Operations, Marketing, Product, Strategy, and Finance

  • Represent your portfolio and organisation in Paris and France leadership forums

  • Influence roadmap and prioritisation through structured partner and market feedback

What We’re Looking For

Experience

  • 10+ years in commercial, client partnership, or account management roles
  • Proven experience managing complex, strategic brand portfolios
  • Demonstrated success leading multi-layered teams in fast-paced environments
  • Experience in F&B, Hospitality, Retail, FMCG, or Marketplace businesses preferred
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen (P&L understanding)
  • Excellent negotiation and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to design and scale organisations and coverage models
  • Data-driven, structured, and execution-focused
  • Senior, credible, and resilient leader
  • High ownership mindset with a bias for action
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving change
  • Passionate about people development and raising standards

Life at Deliveroo

At Deliveroo, you’ll work on some of the most complex and impactful challenges in local commerce. We move fast, value ownership, and believe that strong teams build great outcomes.

This role offers significant scope, visibility, and influence in shaping how Deliveroo wins in Paris.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Senior Client Partner (Public Sector)
descriptionHtml:
Waracle are looking for a Senior Client Partner to join our Public Sector New Business Team for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy and home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.

This is a Hybrid role working from any of our UK offices (Dundee, Glasgow, Edinburgh and London) 2 days a week

Are you a collaborative leader who excels at building meaningful relationships and shaping transformative digital solutions in the Public Sector? As our Senior Client Partner, you will play a key role in growing our Public Sector practice, acting as a trusted advisor to senior public sector stakeholders. You will work closely with our cross-functional teams to foster strategic partnerships, inspire creative proposals, and drive intelligent digital transformation that delivers real public value

Key aspects of the role include:

  • Creating Demand & Nurturing Relationships: Find, qualify, and develop opportunities with prospects and clients. Build and maintain trusted, peer-level relationships from delivery teams through to executive stakeholders.

  • Pitching & Proposals: Inspire and lead collaborative, cross-functional teams to win new business. Uncover client needs, articulate compelling win themes, and co-create high-impact proposals.

  • Planning & Pipeline Management: Develop systematic Account and Go-To-Market plans. Accurately forecast pipeline growth, extensions, and revenue alongside colleagues in delivery and finance.

  • Commercial Negotiation: Partner with tech, strategy, and delivery leaders to estimate and shape balanced commercial proposals. Negotiate long-term, win-win contracts that bring genuine value to both Waracle and our public sector partners.

  • Adding Strategic Value: Stay ahead of Public Sector and technology trends to bring valuable insights to clients, enhancing Waracle’s reputation as expert thought partners.

Research shows that underrepresented groups tend to only apply for roles that they believe they meet 100% of the criteria for. At Waracle, we want to buck that trend! We hire for passion, potential and mindset as much as credentials. If you think you'd be incredible in the role, then apply - even if you don't think you tick every box


What you'll bring

  • Proven track record of nurturing relationships and securing impactful work within central government departments or enterprise clients.

  • Strong relational skills, with an empathetic and collaborative approach to negotiation, problem-solving, and stakeholder management in complex organisations.

  • Sound commercial stewardship and written/verbal communication skills, with comfort presenting ideas to executive and board-level audiences.

  • Strong understanding of Waracle's services, digital technology trends, and the Public Sector landscape.

  • Deep experience navigating public sector procurement frameworks (e.g., DOS6/7, GCloud 14/15, Tech Services 3/4, Public Contracts Scotland, Public Tender Scotland).

  • High level of integrity, empathy, and resilience, alongside enthusiasm for continuous learning and innovation.

  • Prior experience within the civil service or as a civil servant is welcomed, though not required.

What to expect from our hiring process

  • 1. First Hello: An informal chat with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner to talk about Waracle, what you want out of your next move, salary, benefits, and office hybrid working model.

  • 2. Talking Impact: A collaborative deep dive into how you solve problems, work with others, and raise the bar, guided by our core values and competency framework.

  • 3. Craft Showcase: A chance to demonstrate your real-world expertise. This will be a practical presentation.

Your Talent Attraction Partner will be in your corner through every step right up to your Welcome Ritual on day one

Our Benefits

We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Rest & Recharge: You'll receive 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays, totaling 35 days of holiday to unwind and pursue your passions.

  • Financial Future & Security: Plan for retirement with our company-matched 5% pension contribution. For added peace of mind, we also offer a Death in Service benefit, providing 2 x your annual salary for your loved ones.

  • Health & Wellness: Our Medicash Health Cash Plans help cover everyday healthcare costs, complemented by an Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support, and Group Sickness Cover for peace of mind.

  • Flexible Working: We champion hybrid working, providing a home office setup budget to ensure you're comfortable and productive wherever you are.

  • Learning & Development: Invest in yourself with access to Udemy Business and a dedicated learning and development budget for continuous growth.

  • Lifestyle Perks: Make the most of our Cycle to Work Scheme, and enjoy exclusive gym and retail discounts.

  • Family First: Our enhanced parental leave policies include support for fertility journeys, recognising diverse family needs.

  • Community & Connection: We foster a vibrant culture with regular fun meet-ups and lunch on us in the office once a month. You'll also have the opportunity to make a local impact through Spirit of Waracle, our initiative for getting involved in charitable causes locally, building strong team bonds and giving back.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

title: Senior Cloud / DevOps Engineer – AWS, Kubernetes/OpenShift (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wer wir sind

Rockstardevelopers, gegründet 2015 in Mannheim, weitere Büros in Stuttgart und München. Wir sind ein Software-Entwickler mit Erfahrung aus hunderten von individuellen Projekten für Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden.

Kurze Wege, ehrliches Feedback, keine politischen Spielchen. Keine Hierarchie-Ebenen zwischen dir und den Leuten, die Entscheidungen treffen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Aufbau und Betrieb von Cloud-Infrastruktur (AWS, teils Azure) in Enterprise- und regulierten Umgebungen
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), CI/CD-Pipelines, Container (Docker/Kubernetes)
  • Cloud-Architektur mitgestalten – Kosten, Security, Skalierung
  • Automatisierung, Monitoring/Observability, Troubleshooting zeitkritischer Vorfälle
  • DevOps-Kultur: enge Zusammenarbeit mit Dev-Teams, Security und Product Ownern
  • Produktiv mit AI-Tools entwickeln (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor)

Die meisten kommen ein bis zwei Tage die Woche in eins der Büros. Zwang ist keiner. Beim Kunden vor Ort nur für einzelne Termine alle paar Wochen, meist in Frankfurt am Main.

Wo du landest

Je nach Projekt: Großkonzerne wie Deutsche Bahn / DB Systel, öffentlicher Sektor (Bundesagentur für Arbeit, ITZBund, Bundesdruckerei) sowie Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden – jeweils die Cloud- und Plattform-Themen.

Unsere Kunden besetzen diese Projekte fast nur mit Festangestellten. Deshalb suchen wir dich in Festanstellung.

Was du mitbringst

Senior-Level. Unsere Kunden brauchen Leute, die ab Tag eins liefern und eigenständig arbeiten.

  • AWS in der Tiefe – Architektur und Betrieb (idealerweise AWS-Zertifizierung: Solutions Architect oder DevOps Engineer)
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform (oder CloudFormation), Docker, Kubernetes oder OpenShift
  • CI/CD: Jenkins, GitLab CI oder GitHub Actions; Git, agiles Arbeiten
  • Linux sowie Netzwerk- und Security-Grundlagen
  • Scripting: Python, Bash oder Go

Von Vorteil: IAM (One Identity, Keycloak), Cloud Security, Monitoring (Grafana, Prometheus), Apache Kafka, Azure oder GCP, Go für Plattform-Tooling, Event-driven Architekturen, GitOps (ArgoCD), AWS-Kostenoptimierung.

Du musst nicht alles können. Wichtig ist, dass du dich schnell in neue Umgebungen reinfindest. Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder höher.

AI-Tools sind Pflicht, kein Bonus

Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor: Damit musst du produktiv arbeiten können. Nicht weil wir hip sein wollen, sondern weil unsere Kunden das erwarten und wir auch so arbeiten. Wenn du AI-Tools für einen Hype hältst und lieber alles selbst tippst: falsche Firma. Intern investieren wir in deine AI-Skills.

Was wir bieten

  • Homeoffice, Büro oder Mix, du entscheidest
  • MacBook (außer der Kunde stellt eigene Hardware)
  • Verschiedene Kunden, verschiedene Projekte
  • Die Gründer sind deine direkten Ansprechpartner
  • Internes Upskilling in AI-Entwicklung

Bewerbung

Lebenslauf reicht. Kein Anschreiben nötig. Nach einer kurzen Video-Frage-Runde (2×90 Sekunden) melden wir uns innerhalb weniger Tage.

Who is ControlPlane?

ControlPlane is a London-headquartered consultancy specialising in cloud-native, Kubernetes, and open-source security solutions. Our expertise lies in helping organisations adopt and secure complex cloud infrastructures by implementing security measures that are "secure-by-design" and "secure-by-default." This engineering excellence drives ControlPlane deep into cybersecurity, providing services like zero-trust architectures, threat modeling, supply chain security, and platform engineering.

We are acclaimed for our work in highly regulated industries, such as finance, healthcare, and national infrastructure. We help clients consume next-generation and open-source projects safely and securely. In addition to consulting, we are active contributors to the open-source community supporting projects like Flux CD, OpenBao, and FINOS AI Readiness.

What We’re Looking For in a Cloud Native Consultant

We are looking for cloud native engineers and consultants at all levels to represent the technical and cultural values of ControlPlane, leading our customers by example in the complex and fast-changing world of cloud native technology. You will perform a mix of client consulting, working on internal labs projects, and contributing to Open Source projects on ControlPlane’s behalf.

This is a remote position, but we invite you to spend time in person at our London office: this is optional and we aim to be entirely flexible to your needs. 

As part of the engineering team we may ask you to be involved in pre-sales or business development activities to support the ongoing growth of our organisation.

Role, Responsibilities and Requirements of Our Cloud Native Consultant

  • Experience and a deep understanding of Kubernetes using GKE, EKS or OpenShift

  • Experience with GitOps tooling such as FluxCD or ArgoCD

  • Understanding of CI/CD best practices and a range of build tools
  • Cloud security awareness and a desire to build hardened systems
  • Customer facing/Consulting experience. 

What you'll bring (Desirable):

  • Experience with SPIFFE/SPIRE

title: Senior Commercial Counsel
descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Opportunity:

We’re looking for an exceptional commercial lawyer to join our lean, high-impact legal team as our second commercial lawyer. This role is for someone who thrives at the intersection of law and business strategy — a deal-maker with sharp instincts, sound judgment, and genuine excitement about what Deepgram is building and how we are changing what is possible with speech.

Our legal team has a real seat at the table. You’ll close deals that matter, shape legal strategy at the frontier of AI, and craft commercial frameworks that are being built for the first time in this space. You’ll also help establish a legal function that scales with a company on a steep trajectory, reporting directly to our AssociateGeneral Counsel (Commercial). This role will be based in the UK/EU and will play a lead role in supporting our growing UK/EU and APAC business, including our expanding presence in the UK, EU, India, Australia, and Singapore.

This is a role for a builder.

What You’ll Do

  • Structure, negotiate, and close enterprise sales and partnership agreements, along with supporting a range of other commercial deals (including vendor and services agreements, data licenses, and marketing arrangements)

  • Serve as a trusted partner to our sales and business development teams, helping them move faster and smarter

  • Bring customer empathy to every negotiation, understanding the businesses we serve well enough to craft agreements that close faster and hold up longer

  • Design and implement scalable legal processes — standardizing deal terms, building templates, and streamlining the path to signed agreement

  • Provide clear, practical guidance on privacy, intellectual property, data security, and AI-specific legal issues as they arise

  • Navigate cross-border commercial and regulatory issues across the UK/EU and APAC and structure appropriate data transfer mechanisms (SCCs, adequacy decisions, BCRs) for our voice data processing

  • Stay ahead of the evolving legal landscape for AI technologies and their impact on customers, translating developments into actionable guidance for our teams

  • Roll up your sleeves on the full breadth of legal issues that come with being a fast-growing startup

You’ll Love This Role If You

  • Value working with leadership that has tenure and a track record of success, along with A Players as cross-functional partners

  • Get energized by building systems from scratch and establishing foundational practices

  • Are very practical in addressing legal issues and allergic to unnecessary friction

  • Have an abiding spirit of idealism about your chosen profession — you’re not just closing deals, you’re building something that matters

  • Have a point of view on what good lawyering looks like and a healthy sense of humor about everything else

It’s Important To Us That You Have

  • JD, LLM, or equivalent law degree/qualification from an accredited institution and 5–12 years of experience in legal practice (or more), in-house, at a firm, or both

  • Demonstrated strength in commercial transactions internationally, particularly across UK/EU and APAC markets, across enterprise deals, partnerships, and other strategic relationships

  • Fluency in the issues that matter most to us: IP, privacy, data security, and data licensing. A successful candidate will have depth of experience in at least some of these areas, and a willingness to learn the rest.

  • Practical experience with data protection regimes relevant to our footprint and with structuring cross-border transfer mechanisms

  • Recognize that law is about the grey areas, and are comfortable living in them, while giving clear and actionable advice.

  • Exceptional writing — precise, plain, and compelling

It Would Be Great if You Had

  • Experience helping a high-growth startup scale its sales motion — you know what good looks like and how to build legal infrastructure that accelerates rather than slows the business.

  • Hands-on experience with commercial and legal issues in the AI space

  • Prior experience supporting a U.S.-headquartered company’s commercial expansion into the UK/EU and/or APAC

We read cover letters! If you want to stand out: Tell us about your strategy for effectively closing deals, or how you’ve used AI to increase the impact of your work

descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril is the world's fastest-growing defence technology company, bringing commercial technology talent and venture funding to the defence and security sectors. Our technology helps Australia, the United States, and allied nations solve their hardest national security challenges by enabling operators to make better, more informed decisions in life-and-death situations. We have assembled a diverse team of experts in artificial intelligence, computer vision, sensor fusion, optics, and data analysis that are creating software and hardware solutions to radically evolve the capabilities of Australia, the United States, our allies, and commercial customers. If you are passionate about solving problems that have a real impact, come join Anduril and build the future of defence.

A critical part of the Anduril team is its Contracts / Commercial Managers, who play a crucial role in program success. They interface daily with a motivated team of program leadership, functional leadership, and customers in fast-paced environments.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril is seeking a talented Contracts / Commercial Manager to support a variety of Government, International, and Commercial contracts and programs. In this role, you will oversee the full contract lifecycle for Anduril's government and commercial contracts, ensuring compliance, minimizing risk, and optimizing contract performance. The ideal candidate will combine deep knowledge of commercial and defence contracting with strong negotiation skills and a passion for supporting national security through technological innovation.

The position will be responsible for providing contract support for various Government contracts and commercial contracts. Support of these contracts will involve proposal support, contract negotiation, contract compliance, contract management, contract modifications, and contract close-out. This role works closely with the legal and proposal teams as well as across the spectrum of Anduril’s accounting, business operations, program, and engineering teams.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Execute contract management throughout the life of each contract.
  • Complete contract review and acceptance.
  • Oversee and prepare contract proposal planning and management and support preparation of proposals.
  • Ensure compliance with government regulations, legal requirements, and company policies.
  • Assist in identification, development, and implementation of new contract policies and processes.
  • Maintain comprehensive contract documentation and compliance records.
  • Provide contract summaries and ensure contract execution in accordance with government and company requirements.
  • Provide program managers and executives with contract briefs during the life of contracts.
  • Provide guidance on ASDEFCON requirements and other regulatory considerations.
  • Cultivate strong, ongoing relationships with internal/external customers.
  • Provide contractual guidance and risk mitigation strategies for contractual and business obligations.
  • Negotiate complex contractual terms with government agencies, prime contractors, and subcontractors.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 6+ years of relevant contract management experience.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in business administration, government, or a related field.
  • A strong working knowledge of Australian Government contracting including ASDEFCON, Commonwealth Procurement Rules (CPRs), and/or Defence Security Principles Framework (DSPF) experience.
  • Experience with full life cycle contract management for various types of contract agreements
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities. You are highly respected amongst your peers and/or counterparts and known as someone who gets things done.
  • Australian citizenship and ability to obtain and maintain an NV1 security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Direct experience working for or with major Australian defence primes
  • IACCM/World Commerce & Contracting certification, Certified Professional Contracts Manager (CPCM), or similar professional credentials
  • Graduate degree in business, law, government, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of AUKUS initiatives and Australia-US-UK defence collaboration framework

Benefits

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. title: Senior Computational Physicist, Stellarator Optimization
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

TEAM AND ROLE

  • Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in industry – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product.

  • Build real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

 

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

 

YOUR IMPACT

As a Senior Computational Physicist - Stellarator Optimization, you will design the magnetic fields and coils at the core of our stellarators. You will balance plasma performance with engineering requirements, prioritizing simple, practical designs that can be built. Your work will directly shape Stellaris, our first commercial fusion power plant.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

You will shape the “heart” of the stellarator: the magnetic field that confines the plasma and the coils that create it.

  • Release optimized plasma and coil geometries that engineering teams use to design magnets, supporting structures, and surrounding sub-systems.

  • Resolve design trade-offs between physics, engineering and assembly requirements.

  • Own research projects that overcome technical challenges. Choose questions by their impact to the stellarator and carry the answers through to engineering decisions.

  • Deliver results in time for design milestones, with clear recommendations, checked assumptions, and uncertainties that engineers can work with.

    WHO YOU ARE

  • You have strong mathematical reasoning and experience solving difficult computational problems. You can work from first principles and choose methods that fit the question.

  • You have independently driven research to useful outcomes, in academia or industry. You can frame an ambiguous problem, set priorities, and deliver without waiting for detailed instructions.

  • You understand that designs need to meet requirements and deadlines. You know when to investigate further and when to commit to a validated solution.

  • You write clear, reliable scientific code. You are comfortable with Python, or can become productive in it quickly, and use testing, version control, and code review.

  • You have a master’s degree in a STEM field, or equivalent experience. We welcome physicists, mathematicians, engineers, computer scientists, and researchers from other quantitative backgrounds. A PhD is not required.

  • Prior fusion, tokamak, or stellarator experience is not required. You bring the computational attitude and willingness to learn the physics.

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

title: Senior Computer Vision / Photogrammetry Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Mission

Wir sind ein wachsendes PropTech-Startup aus Münster. Unsere KI-gestützte Software ist die Entscheidungsgrundlage für die Immobilienentwicklung. Projektentwickler, Bestandshalter, Banken und Makler nutzen syte, um in Sekunden zu entscheiden, ob, was und wo gebaut, saniert oder gekauft wird. Ausgezeichnet wurden wir mit dem Deutschen KI-Preis 2023 und dem PropTech of the Year Award 2025 des ZIA (Zentraler Immobilien Ausschuss). Heute bildet unsere Plattform auf Basis von über 300 Terabyte Geodaten digitale Zwillinge für 62 Millionen Gebäude und Grundstücke in Deutschland ab.

Für den nächsten Sprung, von unseren heutigen Gebäudemodellen zum texturierten LoD3-Gebäude, suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Senior Computer Vision / Photogrammetry Engineer (m/w/d) in Münster oder deutschlandweit remote.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Alle Quellen in einem Modell vereinen: Du kombinierst 2D-Katasterdaten, LiDAR-Punktwolken, Schrägluftbilder, Nadir-Satellitenbilder und weitere Quellen zur genauestmöglichen Abbildung der realen Welt.
  • Unsere 3D-Modelle verbessern: Du bringst Bilddaten und moderne 3D-Rekonstruktionsverfahren in das Produkt, von Multi-View Stereo bis zu Methoden wie Gaussian Splatting und verbesserst damit unsere Gebäudemodelle erheblich.
  • Texturiertes LoD3 erreichen: Du texturierst unsere Modelle aus Schrägluftbildern und erkennst Fenster, Türen und Fassadenelemente. Diese projizierst du konsistent auf die richtige Fläche des richtigen Gebäudes, damit Geschossflächen, Nutzflächen und Oberflächen deutlich präziser berechnet werden können.
  • Mehr aus den Bildern herausholen: Du implementierst Methoden wie Multi-Image Super-Resolution und Occlusion-Aware Reconstruction. So überwindest du begrenzte Bildauflösung und Verdeckungen durch Bäume und andere Objekte.
  • Forschung in die Produktion bringen: Gemeinsam mit unseren Data Engineers, die Pipelines und Plattform verantworten, skalierst du Methoden von einer Handvoll Gebäude auf Millionen.
  • AI-native entwickeln: Du nutzt das volle Potenzial moderner AI-Coding-Tools wie Claude Code und Copilot und identifizierst proaktiv neue KI-Use-Cases im Kontext von Computer Vision und 3D-Rekonstruktion.

Dein Profil

  • Ausbildung: Masterabschluss in einem technischen Fach (z. B. Informatik, Geoinformationssysteme, Geoinformatik, Physik, Mathematik).
  • Erfahrung: Mindestens vier Jahre Praxis- oder Forschungserfahrung (z. B. Promotion, wissenschaftliche Mitarbeit) im Bereich (urbane) 3D-Rekonstruktion, Computer Vision und Photogrammetrie, inklusive der Entwicklung funktionierender Produkte oder Prototypen.
  • Photogrammetrie: Fundierte Kenntnisse in Photogrammetrie und Fernerkundung: Sensor- und Kameramodelle, Kalibrierung sowie innere und äußere Orientierung. Praktische Erfahrung darin, Airborne-LiDAR und Luftbilder zu metrisch belastbaren, georeferenzierten Daten zu kombinieren.
  • Computer Vision: Starker Hintergrund in geometrischer und 3D-Computer-Vision: Structure-from-Motion, Dense Multi-View Stereo und Punktwolkenverarbeitung. Praktische Erfahrung darin, aus Punktwolken und Bildern Gebäudemodelle zu erzeugen.
  • Tech-Stack: Sicherer Umgang mit Python, insbesondere mit den relevanten Bibliotheken (NumPy, SciPy, PDAL, GDAL, OGR etc.).
  • Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest gern im Team und hast Erfahrung mit Versionsverwaltung (Git).
  • Interesse an der Domäne: Du hast Lust, in den anspruchsvollen PropTech-Bereich einzutauchen. Erfahrung in PropTech, Architektur oder Immobilienwirtschaft ist ein Plus.
  • Lernbereitschaft: Du willst in einem schnell wachsenden Startup schnell wachsen, echten Impact haben und technologisch vorne bleiben, besonders bei Cloud-Technologien und KI.
  • Sprache: Du sprichst fließend Englisch (mind. C1 Niveau).

Cherry on top

  • Erfahrung mit Cloud-Technologien, idealerweise Google Cloud Platform.
  • Deutsche Sprachkenntnisse sind ein Plus

Dein Einstiegstermin und Einsatzort

  • Einstiegstermin: zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt
  • Einsatzort: Münster oder deutschlandweit remote

Deine Benefits

  • Dein attraktives Gehalt: Wir sorgen dafür, dass jeder Aspekt deiner Reise bei syte motivierend ist. Wir kennen deinen Wert!

  • Deine Hardware: Unser syte-Team ist mit modernster Hard- und Software ausgestattet.

  • Dein Team: Einmal im Quartal trifft sich das gesamte Team für zwei Tage zum Arbeiten und um gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern.

  • Deine Flexibilität: Neben gemeinsamen Workations hast du auch privat die Möglichkeit, aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten.

  • Dein Hund im Büro: Dein vierbeiniger Begleiter ist bei uns herzlich willkommen und darf jederzeit mit dir ins Office kommen.

  • Dein persönliches Benefit-Budget: 2.200,00 € jährlich für das, was dir wichtig ist:

    • Upskilling: Dir steht jeweils ein Budget für betriebliche als auch für private Weiterbildung zur Verfügung.
    • Equipment: Neben der initialen Ausstattung mit modernster Apple-Hardware erhältst du zusätzlich ein Budget für die Ausstattung deines Arbeitsplatzes.
    • Steueroptimierte Benefits: Du kannst dein Budget u. a. für steueroptimierte Angebote wie den steuerfreien Sachbezug, einen Internet-Zuschuss, den Mobilitäts-Zuschuss, eine Erholungsbeihilfe oder einen KITA-Zuschuss nutzen.
    • Gesundheit & Wellbeing: Dein Budget kannst du zudem für alles einsetzen, was Körper und Geist guttut, so z. B. für eine Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft, Physiotherapie, Urlaubsreisen etc.
    • BusinessBike: Durch unsere Zusammenarbeit mit BusinessBike kannst du ganz einfach dein Wunschrad leasen.

descriptionHtml:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

As a Senior Consultant (Account Director) in the Burson Tech PR team you will be heading up business technology accounts for some of the biggest businesses in this space. We are looking for someone with deep knowledge of B2B technology comms, with an understanding of the B2C landscape also, who can lead a team to deliver outstanding work for clients who are the industry leaders in this space. You’ll be someone who thrives in fast paced environments and experienced in working with globally recognised businesses who lead their fields and expect their communications to as well.  

We treat our Senior Consultants as both client and business leaders, expecting strong client counsel, energetic and committed team leadership, ambition to create award-winning work, and a consistent commitment to day-to-day excellence. 

What you'll do:

  • Trusted client counsel: Serve as the trusted senior point of contact for clients, providing strategic counsel and developing a comprehensive understanding of client objectives and industry.
  • Planning and Creativity: Know what gets cut through in the business space and be able to develop and deliver creative storytelling that lands great coverage and content 
  • Day to day leader & Quality control: Direct overall account activity, ensuring seamless execution, brilliant delivery, and consistently high levels of client service.
  • Team leader: Provide clear direction, motivate, and foster the professional growth of your team members, embodying strong leadership qualities.
  • Proactivity: Drive innovative execution for day-to-day press office work and campaigns
  • Confident problem solver: Apply strong analytical and problem-solving skills, confidently challenging senior members and/or clients in pursuit of strategic integrity.
  • Team player: Play an active and helpful part in client teams and broader Burson initiatives, demonstrating effective time management and acting as an agency ambassador
  • Media Knowledge: You’ll have a nose for news and know how to develop excellent and insightful media strategies.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • Established B2B Tech Senior Manager or Account Director experience, with broad expertise across areas such as Enterprise Tech, Cyber Tech or Fintech preferred.
  • A strong understanding of how to build and deliver effective media strategies for the new media era.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of media tech and enterprise technology with a 'nose for news'.
  • A robust network of relevant media contacts.
  • Proven ability to manage fast-paced, ambitious clients and dynamic portfolios, providing exceptional client counsel.
  • Energetic and committed team leadership experience, capable of inspiring and motivating teams.
  • High levels of Intelligence, Initiative, and Integrity, with an ambition to create award-winning work.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and time management skills, coupled with a commitment to day-to-day excellence

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. title: (Senior) Consultant Customer Engagement D365
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij als Senior Consultant D365 CE klaar om jouw carrière naar het volgende niveau te tillen bij HSO, één van de grootste Microsoft Gold Partners ter wereld? Sluit je aan bij ons CE team en maak het verschil!

Join the journey


Wat ga je doen?

  • Als D365 CE Senior Consultant werk je aan uitdagende projecten voor nationale en internationale klanten in diverse sectoren. Je speelt een cruciale rol in het adviseren, ontwerpen en implementeren van Dynamics 365 CE oplossingen die klanten helpen hun bedrijfsprocessen te optimaliseren en klantrelaties te verbeteren. Je werkt nauw samen met interne teams, projectmanager en stakeholders bij de klant om oplossingen te leveren die voldoen aan de specifieke zakelijke behoeften van elke klant. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden:
  • Adviesrol: in nauwe samenwerking met de klant analyseer je bedrijfsprocessen en adviseer je over de beste Dynamics 365 CE oplossingen om klantdoelen te bereiken.
  • Implementatie: je geeft leiding aan, en bent functioneel eindverantwoordelijk voor, de implementatie van Dynamics 365 CE inclusief configuratie, aanpassing en integratie met andere systemen.
  • Projectmanagement: je werkt samen met projectmanagers om de scope, planning en kwaliteit van projecten te bewaken.
  • Klantcontact: jij fungeert als sparringpartner voor klanten. Je begrijpt de klantbehoeftes en vertaalt deze naar oplossingen. Je bent op de hoogte van de laatste AI ontwikkelingen en AI functies binnen D365 en zet deze in om klanten te helpen slimmer te werken, betere inzichten te krijgen en klantrelaties op een meer gepersonaliseerde manier te beheren.
  • Teamontwikkeling: jij coacht Junior en Medior Consultants binnen het Dynamics-team en bevordert kennisdeling. Je zet je in op een professionele samenwerking met je collega’s.
  • Op de hoogte blijven: jij volgt actief de technologische trends en innovaties binnen het Microsoft ecosysteem en vertaalt deze naar verbeteringen voor onze klanten.


Over het team
Jij komt in een toegewijd team van bijna 100 CE professionals die elkaar waarderen en ondersteunen. HSO is Microsoft Gold Partner en behoort tot de top 2 van de wereld op het gebied van Dynamics 365 implementaties. De serviceline biedt op maat gemaakte oplossingen die organisaties transformeren en helpen hun digitale ambities waar te maken. Als pionier in de industie, met een focus op innovatie, klantgerichtheid en duurzame groei, is het de ideale plek voor CE professionals die hun carrière willen versnellen. Om jouw kennis te verbreden zijn er maandelijks team meetings, expertsessies en is er alle ruimte voor het volgen van trainingen, conferenties en workshops. 

Wat breng jij mee?

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring ervaring met Dynamics 365 CE implementaties, bij voorkeur in een consultancy-omgeving;
  • Kennis: diepgaande kennis van Dynamics 365 CE modules zoals Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, Project Operations en Marketing;
  • Technische vaardigheden: ervaring met Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps), Azure en integraties met derde partijen;
  • Projectervaring: ervaring met zowel agile als watervalprojectmethodologieën;
  • Communicatie: uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk;
  • Leiderschap: ervaring in het aansturen en coachen van teams en het fungeren als trusted advisor voor klanten.

Voldoe je niet aan bovenstaand profiel en heb je nog geen Dynamics 365 ervaring maar heb je wel proceskennis en ben je in staat om als sparringpartner te fungeren omdat je de uitdagingen waar onze klanten mee worstelen van dichtbij, aan bijvoorbeeld de klantkant, hebt meegemaakt. Twijfel dan niet en solliciteer!

Wat bieden we jou?    
Werken bij HSO is uitdagend, we willen je daar graag een goede beloning voor teruggeven. Naast goede primaire voordelen bieden wij:  

  • Een competitief salaris, een jaarlijkse bonus op basis van bedrijfs-, team- en individuele prestaties;  
  • Mobiliteitsvergoeding waarbij je of een auto kunt leasen of het bedrag toe kunt voegen aan je salaris. Daar bovenop krijg 100% betaald van de ov-kosten; 
  • 25 Vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er 35 van te maken;  
  • Hybride werken, vanuit huis, op kantoor (Rotterdam, Veenendaal) of zelfs tijdens je Workation;  
  • EUR 65,- netto vitaliteitsbudget – we vinden het belangrijk dat we gezond blijven en een veilige werkplek hebben, zowel op kantoor als remote;  
  • Je kunt deelnemen aan het leasefietsplan;  
  • En vooral een leven lang leren. Op dag één start jouw onboardingprogramma, daarnaast krijg je een persoonlijk studiebudget dat je kunt inzetten voor jouw professionele ontwikkeling en ontvang je ook een GoodHabitz account, een online trainingstool voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling.   


Vrijheid, flexibiliteit en fun  
Je werkt in een internationale omgeving met professionals met verschillende nationaliteiten. Een flexibele werkweek van 40, 36 of 32 uur behoort tot de mogelijkheden omdat wij van mening zijn dat jouw manier van werken bij jouw levensstijl moet passen. HSO heeft professionals in dienst die plezier hebben in hun werk en klaar staan voor elkaar. Om het plezier in ons werk nog groter te maken, organiseren we uiteraard teamuitjes en bedrijfsfeesten, maar ook wekelijkse zomerborrels op ons dakterras, allerlei sportactiviteiten en is er de mogelijkheid bij te dragen aan onze Maatschappelijk Verantwoord Ondernemen-werkzaamheden. 

Over HSO   
HSO is de eerste full-service Microsoft Partner in Nederland. Samen met ruim 2500 getalenteerde medewerkers in Europa, Azië en Noord-Amerika verlenen we ondersteuning op lokaal en internationaal niveau aan industriële bedrijven, retailers, financiële en zakelijke dienstverleners en overheidsinstellingen.  

HSO is voortdurend op zoek naar nieuw talent. We blijven onze wereldwijde community uitbreiden en scheppen er plezier in om samen te werken met prestatiegerichte mensen met een ondernemersgeest. Professionals die voortdurend willen leren en innoveren.

descriptionHtml:
Immer einen Schritt voraus, schon seit über 30 Jahren. Mit dieser Überzeugung begeistern wir uns für Technik, Prozesse und Digitalisierung. Gemeinsam mit unseren Mitarbeitern und für unsere Kunden gestalten wir den digitalen Wandel mit innovativen Softwarelösungen, maßgeschneiderten Services – von der Beratung über die Implementierung bis zum Betrieb - an mehr als 20 Standorten weltweit, mit ca. 900 Mitarbeitern.

title: Senior Consultant (m/f/d) Data & AI Strategy
descriptionHtml:
Who/What is Artefact?

Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organizations through data and AI. We combine the rigor of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital, and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact. With 2,000+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 26 countries, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange, and Sanofi. At our German offices, we are on a rapid growth trajectory, advising leading national and international clients cross-industry on how to unlock the full potential of their data, build scalable data architectures, and implement cutting-edge AI solutions.

As a Senior Consultant (m/f/d) Data & AI Strategy, you will sit at the center of this mission. You won't just deliver static slides; you will bridge the gap between technical possibilities and business imperatives, guiding clients from a focused short-term engagement with Mittelstand manufacturers to multi-phase AI transformations with enterprises. In this role, you will take ownership of cross-functional workstreams, drive data-driven decision-making, and actively shape the digital future of our clients.

What you will do:

  • Client advisory & strategy: Work closely with (international) clients to understand their business needs and translate them into data-driven recommendations that support strategic decision-making and business transformation.
  • Data & analysis: Collect, synthesise and iterate data to create actionable insights. You work with a modern, AI-native toolstack - from LLM-powered environments (e.g. Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) and agentic workflow tools (e.g. n8n, Lovable) to coding assistants and automation platforms - and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Familiarity with SQL or Python remains a plus, but the ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate analysis and delivery is what we value most.
  • Project delivery: Take ownership of project workstreams and ensure high-quality, timely delivery in alignment with overall project goals. Work collaboratively within interdisciplinary teams across consulting, data, and tech functions.
  • Data & AI solutions: Support the development of data strategies, AI use cases, and business intelligence solutions, contributing to governance frameworks and implementation roadmaps where relevant.
  • Knowledge sharing & collaboration: Contribute to a strong team culture by sharing knowledge, staying up to date with digital and AI trends, and supporting continuous team development.
  • Business development & thought leadership: Actively contribute to Artefact’s growth in Germany - supporting client proposals, shaping new service offerings, and creating intellectual capital such as frameworks, point-of-views, and benchmarks that strengthen our market position.

Candidate Profile

At our heart, we define ourselves by a culture of ownership, intellectual curiosity, and cooperation. We are looking for driven, capable talents who bring strong motivation and curiosity for new challenges. 

  • Experience: You have at least 2–3 years of experience in management consulting, technology consulting, or in-house corporate strategy roles, with a proven track record of participating in data/AI strategy, cloud transformation, or applied AI/Machine Learning projects.
  • Education: A completed university degree (Bachelor’s or Master's) in Business Administration, Economics, Computer Science, Business Informatics, Physics, Mathematics, or a comparable quantitative field.
  • Data & AI Fluency: You possess a strong affinity for data management and modern AI technologies. You are familiar with concepts like Generative AI, LLMs, or predictive analytics and are eager to bridge the gap between business needs and AI deployment. Ideally, you have hands-on experience in AI use case conceptualization or data platform tracking.
  • Business & analytical mindset: You combine strong analytical skills with a business-oriented perspective. You enjoy identifying business problems and translating them into practical AI and data-driven solutions.
  • Technical skills: You are confident working with PowerPoint and Google Slides to produce polished client-ready output. More importantly, you know how to leverage AI tools - from LLM environments to agentic workflows - to run analysis, generate insights, and accelerate delivery. Experience with SQL, BI tools, or programming languages is not a requirement, but comfort with structured data and a hands-on attitude toward new tools is expected.
  • Communication & collaboration: You communicate complex technical topics clearly in both German and English. You enjoy working in interdisciplinary teams and collaborating across different levels and functions (e.g., translating requirements between business stakeholders and data scientists).
  • Personal attributes: You are proactive, structured, and solution-oriented, with a strong client focus and stakeholder understanding. You thrive in dynamic environments and enjoy solving complex problems.
  • Languages: Business-fluent German and English are required - you will participate in client workshops, present to senior stakeholders, and write deliverables in both languages. Additional languages are a plus.
  • Work Eligibility: A valid work permit for Germany.

Why ARTEFACT?

  • Impactful client work: Work on challenging projects with leading national and international clients across data, digitalisation, and advanced data strategy.
  • Career growth opportunities: We believe in performance over tenure. Your growth is driven by your impact, not your length of service, with clear opportunities to progress and diverse career prospects.
  • Competitive rewards: A strong compensation package including a performance-based bonus, which is paid out half-yearly.
  • Learning & development: Join a team of passionate Data Consultants who actively support each other. You'll learn through diverse projects, collaboration, and exposure to leading experts in the field - including international work.
  • Flexibility & time off: Hybrid working model, 28 days of annual leave, plus your birthday as well as Christmas & New Year's Eve off.

This position is based in Berlin or Munich.

Don't worry if you don't meet all the criteria! At Artefact, we value motivation, pragmatic problem-solving, and potential above all else.If you are excited about shaping the future of AI and ready to make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Diversity & Inclusion at Artefact > We believe that unique perspectives fuel innovation. At Artefact, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome and consider all applications purely based on merit, skills, and potential - regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, religion, age, background, or disability. Come as you are!

Ready to take the next step? Please submit your CV showcasing your experience and passion for this role as a Senior Consultant (m/f/d) Data & AI Strategy. We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Senior Consultant - Financial Services / Data & AI (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Advise. Invest. Build. Meet ALAIKA — a new kind of Financial Services firm — globally scaling, headquartered in Munich. The work is hard. The bar is high. Partner in 5-6 years possible, for the ones who can keep up and actually build a business themselves on our platform. 

Stop reading if any of these describe you: 

  • Specialisation. You are a generalist with shallow expertise and a thin network → AI will eat your lunch. We bet on depth. 
  • Ownership. You spot the problem and walk it to your boss → We fall in love with problems. Own them. Solve them. Ship solutions. 
  • Speed. Slow is your default → Speed compounds. Be smart and brave enough to select 80/20 in the right way. 
  • Mindset. "Not possible" is part of your vocabulary → We hire people who always find a way. 

Still there? Then ALAIKA might be for you. 

At ALAIKA, our vision is to build the future of Financial Services with three brands under one roof — Advisory (Strategy Consulting), Capital (Private Equity), Building (Company Builder). Right now, trojan horse ALAIKA Advisory. 

The ambition: building the leading Financial-Services-specific entrepreneurial holding — Fortune 500 access, PE discipline, Silicon Valley technology-depth and thinking. Three networks that compound and multiply. 

  • One industry. Financial Services. Nothing else. 
  • One focus. The intersection of business and technology — across Strategic Transformations, AI & Data Intelligence, and Cybersecurity. 
  • One goal. Being the go-to partner for the world's leading Fortune 500 financial services companies — and the ones we might help build into that. 

Founded in October 2022 by Johanna von Geyr (build-up and led Financial Services Practice for a NASDAQ-listed strategy consultancy) and Harald Braunstein (serial entrepreneur with exits incl. IPO), we bring together deep functional domain expertise and networks in global Financial Services, with a proven track record in building, scaling, and investing in leading software product companies.  

Curious what ALAIKA is all about? Explore our website and introduction deck. 

Join the movement — apply now. 

The role and what you will work on 

  • Advise. Take on the most pressing strategic and technology challenges of the world’s leading financial services companies — across Strategy, Data & AI, and Cyber. In the room with decision-makers from day one. 
  • Own. Own your deliverables, client relationships, and the quality of everyone working in it end-to-end. You are not support staff for the partnership — you aim to become the standard. 
  • Lead. Run workstreams and project teams independently. Set the bar for junior consultants — challenge them, develop them, raise their game. Multiply the output of everyone around you — not just your own. 
  • Sell. Drive business development that other strategic consultancies reserve for managers and partners. At ALAIKA, building the business is not a privilege reserved for managers and partners. It is an expectation. 
  • Grow. Become the rare profile the market is short on — analytical mastermind, financial services expert, entrepreneurial dealmaker. Partner-track from day one. 
  • Build. We are scaling, with real building left to do — IP, processes, go-to-market, strategy. You do not just deliver client work; you co-build the firm. That is not a slogan — it is your Tuesday. 

When you are a fit 

“Show me an athlete who did well academically. An athlete because they know what it takes to win and they have had to experience loss.” 

— Kenneth C. Griffin, Founder of Citadel 

You will work alongside intrinsically driven people chasing an uncapped career — people who do "what it takes". You fear "being one more number stuck in middle management". 

Your goal is to make it to the top: at ALAIKA itself, at a leading investment or financial services firm, or in a company you build yourself — ALAIKA can help with that too. 

  • Book-smart. Strong academic foundation. Think in structures, not gut feel. 
  • Street-smart. Read the room fast. Prioritise ruthlessly. Grasp commercial reality. 
  • People-smart. Communicate with precision — clear, direct, persuasive. Build trust across functions and seniority. 
  • Athlete performance mindset. High aspirations. Grit. Learn faster than the environment changes. 
  • Entrepreneurial guts. Self-confident achiever. Act first, apologise later — speed is everything. Take full ownership of work normally reserved for far more senior profiles. 

What you bring 

  • Background. Top 10–20% of your class at a top-tier university. Analytical field — CS, Math, Physics, Finance, or equivalent rigour. 
  • Experience. On average 4 years in a high-pressure, results-driven environment — top strategy consultancy, PE/VC-backed company, fast-growing tech, or demanding corporate financial services role. Hands-on Data & AI experience required. Financial services experience preferred. 
  • Leadership. You have led — a team, a club, a project, a cause. We hire people who make things happen. 
  • Analytical edge. Data-driven by default. Leverage data to drive decisions, not just decorate slides. 
  • Languages. Fluent in English and German. Additional languages are a plus. 

Why join ALAIKA 

  • Partner track from day one. Five years from senior to partner possible. 
  • Compensation. Above market with very entrepreneurial-driven bonus structures. 
  • Stellar Network. Shoulder-to-shoulder with financial services executives running today’s giants and the founders + investors building tomorrow’s. 
  • Offices. Munich and Barcelona. More coming. 

Plus: the essentials done right — EGYM Wellpass, bike leasing, a kitchen stocked with healthy food and team events worth showing up for: Oktoberfest, team dinners, and more. 

Advise the leaders. Build what comes next.
Invest in the future of Financial Services.

title: (Senior) Consultant Financial Services (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wer wir sind

EMPA ist eine Beratung für Data & Management Consulting mit Sitz in Frankfurt am Main. Im Bereich Financial Services unterstützen wir Banken, Asset Manager, Kapitalverwaltungsgesellschaften, Depotführer und Verwahrstellen dabei, ihr Geschäft weiterzuentwickeln, Abläufe zu verbessern und neue Lösungen einzuführen.

Bei uns bringst du deine Erfahrung und deine Ideen in Kundenprojekte ein. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinem Team Lösungen und begleitest deren Umsetzung beim Kunden. Gleichzeitig hast du die Möglichkeit, eigene fachliche Schwerpunkte zu setzen, neue Beratungsangebote zu entwickeln und unseren Financial-Services-Bereich mit aufzubauen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Als (Senior) Consultant begleitest du unsere Kunden von der fachlichen Fragestellung bis zur Umsetzung. Je nach Projekt und Erfahrung arbeitest du als Business Analyst, Requirements Engineer, Scrum Master oder im PMO. Perspektivisch kannst du auch als (Teil-)Projektleiter oder Product Owner Verantwortung übernehmen.
  • Du analysierst Abläufe im Banking, Asset Management und Depotgeschäft und entwickelst Vorschläge, wie sich diese verbessern lassen.
  • Du übersetzt fachliche Fragestellungen in verständliche Konzepte und konkrete Anforderungen, die du mit Fachbereichen und IT abstimmst.
  • Du gestaltest digitale Produkte und Onboarding-Prozesse mit und unterstützt die Weiterentwicklung von Plattformen und Schnittstellen.
  • Du arbeitest an Daten- und KI-Vorhaben, verbesserst die Datenqualität und identifizierst Möglichkeiten zur Automatisierung.
  • Du unterstützt unsere Kunden dabei, regulatorische Anforderungen in ihren Prozessen und Systemen umzusetzen.
  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Arbeitspakete, führst Workshops durch und begleitest Tests sowie die Einführung neuer Lösungen.
  • Du entwickelst mit uns Beratungsangebote, Methoden und Fachbeiträge und bringst dein Wissen in Kundengespräche ein.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast ein Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung abgeschlossen oder verfügst über eine entsprechende berufliche Qualifikation.
  • Du bringst erste oder mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Banking oder Asset Management mit – aus einer Linienfunktion bei einem Finanzinstitut oder aus Beratungsprojekten für Banken, Asset Manager oder andere Finanzdienstleister.
  • Du kennst dich in mindestens einem unserer Themenfelder aus – Depotgeschäft, Investment Operations, digitale Plattformen, Datenmanagement oder Projektsteuerung.
  • Du hast Erfahrung im fachlichen Test, etwa bei der Erstellung von Testfällen, der Durchführung von Tests oder der Dokumentation und Nachverfolgung von Fehlern.
  • Du arbeitest dich zügig in neue Themen ein, erkennst Zusammenhänge und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich erklären.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, stimmst dich mit deinem Team ab und bringst eigene Vorschläge ein.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse und bist bereit, abhängig vom Projekt auch vor Ort bei unseren Kunden zu arbeiten.

Erfahrung mit Atlassian-Tools wie Jira und Confluence sowie ALM Octane ist willkommen. Zusätzliche Pluspunkte sind Kenntnisse in BPMN, SQL oder Power BI. Wünschenswert sind Zertifizierungen in Scrum, PRINCE2, Requirements Engineering oder im Softwaretest, etwa ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level (CTFL) oder ISTQB Certified Tester Acceptance Testing (CT-AcT).

Was wir dir bieten

  • Anspruchsvolle Kundenprojekte, in denen du Lösungen von der Konzeption bis zur Einführung begleiten kannst.
  • Die Möglichkeit, neue Beratungsangebote mitzuentwickeln und beim Ausbau unseres Financial-Services-Bereichs Verantwortung zu übernehmen.
  • Schulungen und Weiterbildung, mit denen du dein Wissen vertiefen und neue fachliche Schwerpunkte erschließen kannst.
  • Ein Team, das Erfahrungen teilt, gemeinsam an Lösungen arbeitet und sich gegenseitig unterstützt.
  • Eine attraktive Vergütung, die deine Erfahrung und deine Fähigkeiten berücksichtigt.
  • Moderne Ausstattung, ein zentral gelegenes Büro in Frankfurt, regelmäßige Teamevents und eine Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft.

Dein nächster Schritt

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und deinen möglichen Eintrittstermin. Gemeinsam besprechen wir, ob der Einstieg als Consultant oder Senior Consultant zu deiner Erfahrung passt.

title: Senior consultant financiën overheid
descriptionHtml:
0,8- 1 fte | Utrecht | Hybride | Openbaar Bestuur| €5.086 - €8.377| Wo-master

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Wil jij bijdragen aan een financieel gezonde publieke sector? En krijg je energie van complexe financiële vraagstukken binnen de overheid? Dan ben jij misschien de nieuwe senior consultant financiën overheid die we zoeken!

Dit ga je doen

Als senior consultant financiën overheid werk je aan diverse opdrachten binnen de publieke sector, met een focus op financiële vraagstukken bij gemeenten, provincies en het Rijk. Je ondersteunt overheden bij het op orde brengen en houden van hun financiën en zorgt ervoor dat zij grip krijgen op hun begroting. Daarbij ben je breed inzetbaar en krijg je de kans om nieuwe onderwerpen op te pakken. Jouw taken en verantwoordelijkheden zijn onder andere:

  • Adviseren over financiën, begrotingen en bezuinigingsvraagstukken.

  • Uitvoeren van haalbaarheidsstudies en businesscases voor publieke organisaties.

  • Ondersteunen van concerncontrolfuncties binnen gemeenten, provincies en ministeries.

  • Het analyseren van de financiële en beleidsmatige ruimte en adviseren over strategische keuzes.

  • Bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van digitale tools en AI-toepassingen binnen financiën.

  • Actief bijdragen aan de groei en ontwikkeling van de adviesgroep door jouw commerciële vaardigheden en netwerk.

Quote

‘Overheden staan voor complexe financiële uitdagingen. Samen met mijn collega's help ik hen om grip te krijgen op hun financiën en strategische keuzes te maken die écht impact hebben.’ – Senior managing consultant financiën Openbaar Bestuur

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid vanaf dag één, krijg je de kans om te ontdekken wat je belangrijk vindt, waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen.

Dit zijn je directe collega’s

Je maakt deel uit van het team Financiën, bedrijfsvoering en control, binnen de adviesgroep Openbaar Bestuur. Samen met je collega's werk je aan de verantwoorde en effectieve besteding van publieke middelen. Je werkt in een hecht en gezellig team van ervaren consultants en experts, waar samenwerken en kennisdeling centraal staan.

De adviesgroep Openbaar Bestuur bestaat uit ongeveer honderd adviseurs met ieder hun eigen specialisatie. Er werken financieel deskundigen, crisis- en veiligheidsexperts, bestuurskundigen, juristen, politicologen, experts binnen de kunst- en cultuursector en communicatiespecialisten. We zijn een jonge, eigenzinnige club die in wisselende samenstellingen aan projecten werkt. Onze adviseurs zijn intelligente mensen met een duidelijke mening vanuit stevige kennis en professionaliteit.

Werken bij Berenschot | Hoe is het om te werken bij ons adviesbureau


Dit neem je mee

Herken jij jezelf in de volgende punten? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

  • Academisch werk- en denkniveau. Een afgeronde opleiding in bijvoorbeeld (bedrijfs)economie, Certified Public Controller, registeraccountant, bestuurskunde, politicologie of rechten.

  • Werkervaring bij een adviesbureau of bij een gemeente, provincie of het Rijk, bij voorkeur in een financiële rol of controlrol.

  • Flexibiliteit in tijd en inzet en de vaardigheid om zelfstandig te werken.

  • Sterke analytische en cijfermatige vaardigheden.

  • Affiniteit met cijfers in een bestuurlijke context is een pré.

  • Affiniteit met digitale ontwikkelingen zoals AI en robotisering.

  • Ervaring met commerciële activiteiten en relatiemanagement is een pré.

  • Een proactieve en ondernemende instelling.

Dit bieden we jou

Bij Berenschot bieden we een unieke commerciële omgeving zonder aandeelhouders of partners. Dit geeft ons veel ruimte en vrijheid om te ondernemen en de mogelijkheid om ons in te zetten voor belangrijke maatschappelijke thema’s. Kenmerkend is onze informele cultuur. Berenschot is een platte organisatie met korte communicatielijnen waar echt naar je geluisterd wordt. Er zijn volop mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele groei, waarbij jouw initiatief wordt omarmd en gefaciliteerd. Je hebt hier de vrijheid om te ondernemen. Ons diverse en inclusieve personeelsbeleid omarmt diversiteit en biedt iedereen gelijke kansen.

Natuurlijk hebben we daarnaast ook uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden en geweldige ontwikkelmogelijkheden:

  • een jaarcontract, met de absolute intentie om je na één jaar een contract voor onbepaalde tijd aan te bieden

  • een aantrekkelijk salaris tussen de € 6.100,– en € 9.295,–, afgestemd op jouw kennis en ervaring

  • een representatievergoeding van € 3.000,- per jaar

  • een reguliere collectieve winstdelingsregeling (afhankelijk van het resultaat van de onderneming)

  • een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling

  • 27 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om bij een fulltime dienstverband maximaal 20 vakantiedagen bij te kopen

  • flexibele feestdagen. We bieden de mogelijkheid om officiële feestdagen te verschuiven naar dagen die voor jou van betekenis zijn.

  • een mobiliteitsregeling naar keuze: een auto van de zaak of een mobiliteitsbudget

  • een laptop en telefoon

  • de vrijheid om, in afstemming met je collega’s, te bepalen waar en wanneer je werkt

  • volop ruimte voor ontwikkeling via interne én externe opleidingen

Solliciteer meteen

Wil jij ook een trotse Berenschotter worden? Wacht niet langer en solliciteer. Dat kan door contact op te nemen met Mariëlle Boer via WhatsApp 06-10487159 of per e-mail je inhoudelijke vragen over deze vacature? Collega Peter Arnoldus beantwoordt al jouw vragen met plezier.

Zo ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit

Heb je gesolliciteerd? Dan ontvang je binnen één werkweek een reactie. Is die positief? Dan nodigen we je graag uit voor een kennismaking. Zijn we na dit gesprek allebei enthousiast? Dan volgt een gesprek met collega-adviseurs en je toekomstige manager. Dat is het moment om jouw laatste vragen te stellen. Gaan die gesprekken goed? Dan vragen we je om ons assessment te doen. Blijkt daaruit dat jij een echte Berenschotter bent? Dan gaan we snel over tot een concreet aanbod. Hierna ben je een echte Berenschotter en heten we je graag welkom in ons team.
