title: Senior Consultant Logistiek
descriptionHtml:
Wat ga je doen?
Wil je samen bouwen aan leuke projecten? Krijg je energie van het uitwerken van complexe vraagstukken en het adviseren van klanten in hun bedrijfsprocessen? Als senior consultant manufacturing sleutel je in wisselende projectteams aan het ontwerp, de realisatie en implementatie van Microsoft Dynamics 365 voor klanten in de productie-industrie. Met jouw kennis zet je rock-solid oplossingen neer bij onze klanten, stuk voor stuk indrukwekkende spelers die jou een unieke inkijk geven in hun business (van shopfloor tot data analytics).

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je bent een ondernemende teamspeler en een pro actieve consultant op alle niveaus, van eindgebruiker tot management.
  • Je bent zelfstandig, communicatief vaardig, leergierig en analytisch.
  • Je wil het naadje van de kous weten (en kunnen uitleggen) als het gaat om bedrijfsapplicaties en hoe deze bedrijfsprocessen van de klant kunnen ondersteunen en verbeteren.
  • Je integreert soepel in een team en gaat voor een goede samenwerking met klanten en collega’s.
  • Je bent ambitieus en je wilt je graag verbinden aan een organisatie die gaat voor de lange termijn.
  • Oftewel: jij zoekt uitdaging om je te ontwikkelen en om je loopbaan verder vorm te geven.


Je beschikt over

  • Een afgeronde HBO- of WO opleiding, bij voorkeur in de richting van Engineering (Industrial of logistics), Supply Chain Management of een vergelijkbare opleiding;
  • Minimaal 5+ jaar ervaring als ERP-consultant of in een functie waarin je intensief hebt gewerkt met ERP binnen het logistieke domein;
  • Deze kennis en ervaring heb je bij voorkeur aangevuld met ervaring in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management of een vergelijkbaar ERP systeem;
  • Goede kennis van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.

Wat bieden we jou?   

Werken bij HSO is uitdagend, we willen je daar graag een goede beloning voor teruggeven. Naast goede primaire voordelen bieden wij:  

  • Een competitief salaris, een jaarlijkse bonus op basis van bedrijfs-, team- en individuele prestaties; 
  • Mobiliteitsvergoeding waarbij je of een auto kunt leasen of het bedrag toe kunt voegen aan je salaris. Daarbovenop krijg 100% betaald van de ov-kosten;
  • 25 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er 35 van te maken; 
  • Hybride werken, vanuit huis, op kantoor (Rotterdam, Veenendaal) of zelfs tijdens je Workation; 
  • EUR 65,- netto vitaliteitsbudget – we vinden het belangrijk dat we gezond blijven en een veilige werkplek hebben, zowel op kantoor als remote; 
  • Je kunt deelnemen aan het leasefietsplan; 
  • En vooral een leven lang leren. Op dag één start jouw onboardingprogramma, daarnaast krijg je een persoonlijk studiebudget dat je kunt inzetten voor jouw professionele ontwikkeling en ontvang je ook een GoodHabitz account, een online trainingstool voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling.   

Vrijheid, flexibiliteit en fun  

Je werkt in een internationale omgeving met professionals met verschillende nationaliteiten. Een flexibele werkweek van 40, 36 of 32 uur behoort tot de mogelijkheden omdat wij van mening zijn dat jouw manier van werken bij jouw levensstijl moet passen. HSO heeft professionals in dienst die plezier hebben in hun werk en klaar staan voor elkaar. Om het plezier in ons werk nog groter te maken, organiseren we uiteraard teamuitjes en bedrijfsfeesten, maar ook wekelijkse zomerborrels op ons dakterras, allerlei sportactiviteiten en is er de mogelijkheid bij te dragen aan onze Maatschappelijk Verantwoord Ondernemen-werkzaamheden. 

Over HSO   

HSO is de eerste full-service Microsoft Partner in Nederland. Samen met ruim 2500 getalenteerde medewerkers in Europa, Azië en Noord-Amerika verlenen we ondersteuning op lokaal en internationaal niveau aan industriële bedrijven, retailers, financiële en zakelijke dienstverleners en overheidsinstellingen.  
 HSO is voortdurend op zoek naar nieuw talent. We blijven onze wereldwijde community uitbreiden en scheppen er plezier in om samen te werken met prestatiegerichte mensen met een ondernemersgeest. Professionals die voortdurend willen leren en innoveren.

title: Senior Consultant | Manager (m/w/d) - Operational Transformation in Energy, Utilities & Resources
descriptionHtml:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Operational Transformation practice is looking for a Senior Consultant (m/w/d) or Manager (m/w/d) to join the team in Düsseldorf or Munich. 

As a member of our team, you will help shape and drive a breadth of exciting transformational work across one of our core sectors, Energy & Resources. Within our Organisational Transformation practice, we partner with clients to solve complex business challenges through operational excellence, process optimisation and people-led transformation.   Our approach combines expertise in leadership and culture change, organisational design, operating model definition, agile, automation and AI to create solutions tailored to our clients' specific needs. We are passionate about delivering lasting change initiatives that place the user experience at the heart of both design and execution.   We are growing our team to meet future demand and would love you to be part of our exciting growth ambitions. We pride ourselves on being a bit more geek than generalist and live by the mantra: Be kind, be curious, be great at work.  

What you will be doing

As part of our Organisational Transformation team, you will:
  • Get involved from the outset by engaging with clients, developing propositions and proposals, and showcasing our expertise during business development and acquisition meetings.
  • Lead or support the delivery of consulting projects focused on streamlining client processes and improving operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate closely with our clients to develop, coordinate, and implement sustainable improvements and new ways of working.
  • In the spirit of continuous improvement, you will be instrumental in developing our operational excellence approaches, techniques and tools.

 
Your skills and experience 
 

We're interested in people who bring a combination of the following: 
  • At least 3 years of experience in management consulting or in an internal Operational Excellence, Process Excellence, or similar continuous improvement role.
  • Demonstrated experience in digitalisation, automation, and Lean methodologies, including their practical application to drive business improvements.
  • Experience in process optimisation within the energy sector, commodity trading environment, or related industries.
  • Exposure to transformation programmes, organisational change initiatives, reorganisation projects, and/or change management activities.
  • A solid understanding of business process management, automation technologies, and the potential of AI to support continuous improvement.
  • A proactive and results-oriented mindset, with the ability to take ownership and deliver outcomes in a complex, client-focused environment.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
  • Essential: Advanced (C1) proficiency in both German and English, written and spoken.

What a career at Baringa will give you 

Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. 
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 days every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. 
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice. 
  • Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success. 

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people. 

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this. 

Using business as a force for good. 

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve. 

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

Join us

All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We never rely solely on automated screening or AI tools to make hiring decisions. Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. We do not filter applications by university background and encourage those who have taken alternative educational and career paths to apply. We would like to actively encourage applications from those who identify with less represented and minority groups. We operate an inclusive recruitment process, ensuring reasonable adjustments where needed. Please contact a member of our Recruitment Team to discuss further.

Baringa Privacy Notices

For UK & EU

Your personal data will be retained by Baringa for up to two years, in accordance with our UK Recruitment Privacy Notice / EU Recruitment Privacy Notice, to evaluate your application and meet our legal and reporting obligations. In line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to request access to, rectification, or erasure (subject to legal limitations) of your personal data. For more information, please contact us at For the USA

Your personal data may be retained by Baringa for up to two years, as outlined in our Recruitment Privacy Notice (AMER & APAC), to support the recruitment process and internal reporting requirements. Where applicable, and in accordance with relevant federal and state laws, you may have the right to request access to or correction of your personal information. For further details, please contact For Australia & Singapore

Your personal data will be retained by Baringa for up to two years, in accordance with our Recruitment Privacy Notice (AMER & APAC), to assess your application and meet applicable reporting and legal obligations. In line with the Australian Privacy Act and Singapore’s Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA), you may have rights to access, correct, or request limited deletion of your personal data. title: Senior Consultant/Manager - Sécurité Financière & Conformité (LCB-FT, KYC, AMLR) H/F
descriptionHtml:
Avec une stratégie de croissance, le groupe Capco renforce le développement de son pôle FRC (Finance, Risques & Conformité) et tout particulièrement son offre Conformité.

Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons pour notre bureau parisien des Senior consultant(e)s, managers ou senior manager afin d’accompagner ses clients sur leurs enjeux de transformation réglementaire et organisationnelle liés à la conformité.

Votre rôle :

Vous participez, pour nos clients du secteur bancaire et financier, à des missions variées qui couvrent plusieurs thématiques :

  • Réaliser des diagnostics de dispositifs LCB-FT (KYC, AML framework, transaction monitoring, filtrage sanctions).
  • Participer à des programmes de remédiation KYC / AML, revues d’efficacité et optimisation des dispositifs existants
  • Contribuer aux programmes AMLR : analyse d’impact réglementaire, déclinaison opérationnelle, gouvernance et trajectoires de mise en conformité
  • Participer à la mise en conformité réglementaire : exigences ACPR, FATF, réglementations locales et européennes (AMLR, eIDAS, DORA, …)
  • Participer à des missions impliquant des outils de sécurité financière (transaction monitoring, sanctions, KYC / CDD), avec une connaissance générale du fonctionnement de solutions du marché (ex. Actimize, NetReveal, Fenergo ou équivalents)
  • Contribuer à la définition ou l’évolution des Target Operating Models conformité (processus, gouvernance, outils, data)
  • Rédiger des politiques, procédures, méthodologies et supports de formation
  • Conduire des évaluations de risques, cartographies, analyses de contrôles et plans de mitigation.
  • Contribuer à l’amélioration des frameworks de gestion des risques : gouvernance, KPI/KRI, reporting.
  • Participer à la conception ou à l’évolution de dispositifs de contrôle interne.
  • Garantir la qualité et la robustesse des livrables produits
  • Préparer et animer des ateliers, comités et restitutions.

Au sein de Capco :

  • Participer à l’animation de la communauté Conformité (veille réglementaire, supports de communication, Points of view, évènements clients, etc.)

Le profil recherché :

Vous avez une expertise dans les domaines suivants

  • Titulaire d’un diplôme de formation supérieure type école de commerce ou école d’ingénieur, vous justifiez d’une expérience significative en cabinet de conseil et/ou au sein d’institutions financières, sur des sujets de conformité, sécurité financière ou transformation réglementaire
  • Vous disposez d’une excellente compréhension des thématiques LCB-FT, des standards internationaux et des enjeux relatifs à la conformité et sécurité financière (AML, KYC, Sanctions, etc.)
  • Vous disposez d’une solide compréhension des cadres réglementaires applicables à la sécurité financière et à la conformité, notamment :
    • LCB-FT / KYC
    • Pack AML européen (AMLR, AMLD6, AMLA)
    • Interactions avec les superviseurs (ACPR, ECB, autorités locales)
    • Cadres réglementaires : AMLR / AMLD6 / AMLA, recommandations FATF, attentes ACPR / ECB, dispositifs KYC / CDD / EDD, sanctions internationales, MiFID II
  • Vous disposez d’une expérience ou d’une appétence forte pour les outils de sécurité financière (Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, KYC), notamment des solutions du marché telles que Fircosoft, Actimize, NetReveal, Fenergo ou équivalents

De plus, vous avez :

  • Une bonne connaissance des problématiques traditionnelles de la conformité et du risque, mais aussi sur la mise en œuvre de nouvelles règlementations ou de transformations digitales appliquées à la conformité.
  • Vous êtes reconnu pour votre flexibilité, votre curiosité, votre créativité et vous avez envie d’accompagner activement la croissance d’un cabinet dynamique qui mise sur le management de proximité.
  • La maîtrise du français et de l’anglais en langues de travail est indispensable.

Vous faites preuve de leadership, d’un excellent niveau de communication, d’une aisance rédactionnelle, d’un sens aigu de la coordination et d’une capacité à mettre en oeuvre une méthodologie pragmatique et efficace. Vous avez un esprit de synthèse et le sens du détail.

L’anglais courant et la mobilité à l’international sont indispensables.

Rejoignez-nous et prenez une part active à la croissance d’un cabinet à taille humaine, original et dynamique, à dimension internationale et multi-culturelle, avec un fort esprit entrepreneurial.

Pourquoi rejoindre Capco

  • Un environnement de travail international centré sur l’innovation et la création de valeur pour nos clients bancaires et assuranciels
  • Un parcours de formation continu adapté à vos besoins, pour acquérir de nouvelles compétences et développer une réelle expertise
  • Une organisation de travail hybride (charte télétravail de 2 jours par semaine)
  • Une rémunération compétitive avec un bonus lié à la performance
  • Une entreprise inclusive, méritocratique, entrepreneuriale où vos idées comptent
  • Des initiatives pour construire le Capco de demain :
    • #BeYourselfAtWork
    • Woman@capco
    • RSE (forfait mobilité durable, jour de solidarité, etc.)
    • Des communautés métiers, sportives et culturelles

  • Fachliche Bewertung regulatorischer Änderungen und Ableitung nachhaltiger Umsetzungsmaßnahmen für Prozesse, Datenhaushalte und Systemlandschaften
  • Erstellung und Abstimmung von Fachkonzepten, Anforderungen sowie Zielprozessen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen, Operations und IT
  • Unterstützung bei Transformations-, Implementierungs- und Optimierungsprojekten sowie Begleitung der Einführung und Weiterentwicklung von Meldewesenlösungen
  • Sicherstellung hoher Datenqualität durch Definition und Weiterentwicklung von Governance-, Kontroll- und Validierungsprozessen

Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im transaktionsbasierten regulatorischen Meldewesen im Banken- oder Kapitalmarktumfeld mit fundierten Kenntnissen in EMIR REFIT, MiFIR/MiFID II und SFTR
  • Tiefes Verständnis des End-to-End-Meldeprozesses einschließlich Datenerfassung, Anreicherung, Validierung, Meldung, Fehlerbearbeitung und Abstimmung
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Nasdaq AxiomSL sowie Regnology Abacus Transactions und deren fachlicher Konzeption oder Weiterentwicklung
  • Erfahrung in regulatorischen Transformations- oder Implementierungsprojekten sowie ausgeprägte Fähigkeit, komplexe regulatorische Sachverhalte adressatengerecht aufzubereiten
  • Erfahrung in der Definition fachlicher Anforderungen für regulatorische Reporting-Lösungen
  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie eine hohe Reisebereitschaft

Nice to have

  • Kenntnisse moderner Datenqualitäts- und Governance-Frameworks
  • Erfahrung im Stakeholder-Management auf Management- und Projektleitungsebene
  • Beratungserfahrung bei internationalen Banken oder Finanzdienstleistern
  • Erfahrung in agilen Projektmethoden und interdisziplinären Teams

Warum Capco

  • Arbeite an anspruchsvollen Transformationsprojekten bei führenden Banken und Kapitalmarktteilnehmern
  • Profitiere von einer kollaborativen, internationalen und unternehmerischen Beratungskultur
  • Nutze umfangreiche Weiterbildungs- und Zertifizierungsmöglichkeiten sowie individuelle Entwicklungspfade
  • Übernimm früh Verantwortung und gestalte innovative Lösungen im regulatorischen Umfeld
  • Werde Teil eines Teams, das die Zukunft des Financial Services Consulting aktiv mitgestaltet

Benefits

  • Flexible Arbeitsmodelle und hybrides Arbeiten je nach Projekteinsatz möglich
  • Ein umfassendes Onboarding sowie Ihr persönlicher Coach und Buddy für einen erfolgreichen Start
  • Kontinuierliche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten (u. a. interne Trainings und Udemy Business), Bike Leasing sowie Capco Benefits Card
  • Regelmäßige Gesundheitschecks, Mental Health Angebote sowie Unterstützung durch den PME-Familienservice
  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag, flache Hierarchien, internationale Projekte und regelmäßige Firmenevents

Inklusion bei Capco

Wir setzen uns für einen barrierefreien und inklusiven Bewerbungsprozess ein. Sollten Sie während des Bewerbungsprozesses Unterstützung oder Anpassungen benötigen, sprechen Sie uns jederzeit an. title: Senior Consultant - Risque de crédit H/F
descriptionHtml:
Avec une stratégie de croissance, le groupe Capco renforce le développement de son pôle FRC (Finance, Risques & Conformité) et tout particulièrement son offre Risque, et recherche pour son bureau parisien des Senior consultant(e)s pour accompagner ses clients sur leurs enjeux de transformation réglementaire et organisationnelle liés au risque de crédit.

Votre rôle :

Vous participez, pour nos clients du secteur financier, à des missions variées qui couvrent plusieurs thématiques :

  • Accompagnement dans la gestion de projets de mise en conformité réglementaire : analyse des textes réglementaires, gap analysis méthodologique/système/data/gouvernance/processus, préconisations et mise en œuvre, documentation et accompagnement du changement
  • Participation à des missions d’inspections et des exercices de supervision (QIS, Benchmarking, Stress Testing, TRIM, mission d’homologation) : cadrage, coordination, documentation, traitement des recommandations
  • Mise en place et optimisation de dispositif d’encadrement et de suivi des risques de crédit
  • Refonte des processus d’octroi ou revue de dossier, de surveillance et de reporting des risques

Au sein de Capco :

  • Participer à l’animation de la communauté Risques (veille réglementaire, supports de communication, Points of view, évènements clients, etc.),

Le profil recherché :

  • Une bonne expertise de l’environnement des banques ainsi que des sujets de transformation de la fonction Finance et Risque au sein d’institutions financières ou bancaires.
    • Connaissance de la règlementation : IRRBB, NDOD, ALM, IFRS9, etc. 
    • Target Operating Model
    • Mise en place de reporting règlementaire (Corep, Finrep et Pilier 3)
    • Revue de modèle en Liquidité et Solvabilité
  • Un excellent relationnel et un bon esprit d’équipe, vous avez envie d’accompagner activement la croissance d’un cabinet dynamique qui mise sur le management de proximité et vous êtes reconnu pour votre flexibilité et votre créativité.  
  • Une bonne appétence et mobilité pour travailler avec un réseau de consultants à dimension internationale au service de nos clients en France et à l’étranger. La maîtrise du français et de l’anglais en langues de travail est indispensable.
  • Une expérience de 5 ans minimum dans un cabinet de conseil, ou en gestion de projet au sein d’une institution financière. Vous êtes doté d’un diplôme Bac+5 de type école de commerce ou d’ingénieur ou universitaire.

Qui sommes-nous ?

Créé en 1998, Capco est un cabinet de conseil en management et en organisation spécialisé dans le secteur des services financiers. Avec 35 bureaux répartis en Europe, en Asie et en Amérique, Capco regroupe 7 000 collaborateurs dont 180 en France.

Depuis plus de 20 ans, Capco Paris accompagne les établissements financiers français et internationaux grâce à une réflexion innovante et une expertise dans les domaines bancaires.

title: Senior Consultant - Satcom Constellation Design & simulation
descriptionHtml:
Are you a highly-motivated, technically-minded, critical thinker with 3-5 years of experience in consulting, looking for your next challenge? Join a leading consulting player in the booming space industry! The Technology Consulting business line is the technology and operations’ arm of the Novaspace group. It has more than 50 customers in developed and emerging space markets, in all regions of the world and across the space ecosystem, including satellite operators, governmental and international organizations (Space agencies, Defense agencies, regulatory bodies, etc.), financial institutions (private banks, commercial banks, private equity funds, etc.) and insurance brokers and insurance companies. Novaspace Technology has developed expertise and know-how around a portfolio of services and capabilities covering the complete lifecycle of a space project, from feasibility studies and project development to operations and training support. We are looking for a motivated Senior Consultant - Satcom Constellation Design & Simulation to join our team in Toulouse to support clients in technical consulting projects on future & current Satcom Constellations Systems mainly for concept analysis (early-stage definition of Satcom payloads by generating and assessing innovative design concepts) and system feasibility analysis (generation, trade-off & comparison of several preliminary communication system high level design). If this sounds like you, then read on!
Primary role and responsibilities
  • End to End Engineering of Satcom Constellation System to support customer in designing, sizing, optimization, specification, assessment, construction, testing, & operation of satellite communication systems.
    • It includes:
  • Transformation of Customer’s need into key parameters driving the Satcom Constellation Design, production and justification of several Satcom Constellation preliminary design answering customer’s requirements, underlining solutions/recommendation/adjustments when trade off (cost/time/complexity) are necessary, assessment of costs of a Communication System (CAPEX, OPEX) and performance of cost trade-offs,
  • Generation of simulations to asses/demonstrate performance/limitation/uses cases
  • Production of payload technical analysis (performance & capacity assessment, , assessment of intersystem and intra-system interference, Traffic pattern, Hand Over , Gateway positioning, Intersatellite links…)

    • Desired skills & experience
  • MSc in space engineering with a major preferably in telecommunications
  • At least 7 years of practical industry experience in satellite communications field including at least 3 years of proven practical experience in supporting Satcom Constellation Design (using different type of payload processed or not, passive or active antennas, using intersatellite links), technical performance assessment and simulation with deep understanding of the key performance parameters driving the design /trade offs in operational scenarios
  • Knowledge of spectrum regulatory aspects
  • Proven ability to address technical problems using the most efficient means, including mathematical analysis, computer simulation and experimentation. You will be expected to maintain a high level of computer literacy (python, matlab, etc..)
  • Proven ability to appreciate the commercial and operational requirements in order to define the best compromise between price, performance and operational aspects (complexity, easy implementation, development risks and implementation costs).
  • Well organized and autonomous
  • Great team spirit and rigor.
  • Ability to summarize efficiently complex information to a short presentation or produce a single intelligible content from multiple sources.
  • Proficiency in writing reports and presentations with a high level of quality.
  • Good presentation and communication skills, able to present content with ease in front of an audience, to interface smoothly with other Novaspace team member and customers, from different cultures and background.
  • Ability to travel, as you will be able to work at our clients' sites or operations anywhere in the world: Europe, Middle East, Asia, the Americas, etc
  • Fully fluent in English
  • EU citizen
    • About Novaspace Novaspace is the global leading consulting firm in the space sector. With a robust 40-year legacy of expertise in guiding private companies and government entities through strategic decisionmaking processes, Novaspace offers end-to-end consulting services, from project strategy definition to implementation, providing data-led perspectives on critical issues. Our mission is to empower clients with strategic and technical insights, enabling them to navigate and seize new opportunities within the rapidly evolving space sector. As a privately owned and fully independent organization, Novaspace presents an expanded portfolio of services, featuring combined expertise in management and technology consulting, top-tier executive summits, and market intelligence. Trusted by 1,200 clients in over 60 countries, Novaspace has offices strategically located in Brussels, Montreal, Munich, Paris, Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo, Toulouse, and Washington D.C. Working at Novaspace will give you the opportunity to boost your career in the space/consulting industry where our role is to support the decision-makers by providing them the highest quality support in everything we do: consulting, market intelligence, training and summits. Only Applications containing a Motivation Letter and a CV in English will be considered.

title: Senior Consultant (w/m/d) - Supply Chain Planning
descriptionHtml:
Bei Miebach Consulting erwarten dich anspruchsvolle Aufgaben entlang der gesamten Supply Chain. Von Anfang an übernimmst du Verantwortung in spannenden Beratungsprojekten, unterstützt durch ein fundiertes, individuelles Trainingsprogramm.

Du arbeitest analytisch und lösungsorientiert an komplexen Fragestellungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinem Team innovative Lösungen für unsere Kunden.

In einem dynamisch wachsenden Umfeld entwickelst du dich fachlich und persönlich weiter und findest bei uns den richtigen Platz, wenn du Leidenschaft für komplexe Fragestellungen und smarte Lösungen mitbringst.

Diese Aufgaben erwarten Dich:

  • Integrierte Planung: Du entwickelst integrierte Planungsansätze, um schwankende Nachfrage, begrenzte Kapazitäten und strategische Geschäftsziele aufeinander abzustimmen und begleitest deren Umsetzung

  • Bestandsoptimierung: Du analysierst Bestände und Lieferengpässe und entwickelst Lösungen, um Servicegrad, Bestände und Kosten optimal aufeinander abzustimmen

  • Planungsprozesse: Du gestaltest Planungsorganisationen, definierst Rollen und Entscheidungswege und unterstützt Teams dabei, neue Prozesse und Arbeitsweisen nachhaltig im Unternehmen zu verankern

  • Digitale Planung: Du bewertest geeignete Advanced-Planning-and-Scheduling-Lösungen (APS), übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in technische Lösungen und begleitest deren Auswahl und Implementierung bis zum Go-live

  • Projektleitung: Du leitest Beratungsprojekte, führst Dein Projektteam und übernimmst Verantwortung für den Projekterfolg, die Qualität der Ergebnisse und die Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden

  • Methodenentwicklung: Du bringst Deine Projekterfahrung in die Entwicklung neuer Methoden, Tools und Beratungsangebote ein, unterstützt die Angebotserstellung und teilst Dein Wissen mit dem Team und unseren Kunden


Das bringst Du mit:

  • Abschluss & Fachwissen: Du hast ein Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Logistik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang erfolgreich abgeschlossen

  • Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 5–6 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Supply Chain Planning, Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP), Integrated Business Planning (IBP) oder verwandten Themenfeldern mit, idealerweise in der Beratung

  • Fachliche Expertise: Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse integrierter Planungsprozesse und deren Schnittstellen zur Finanzplanung und strategischen Unternehmensplanung. Zudem hast Du Erfahrung in der Analyse und Optimierung von End-to-End-Supply-Chain-Prozessen

  • Teamwork & Kundenorientierung: Du erkennst gemeinsam mit Deinem Team die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden und entwickelst kreative und praxisorientierte Lösungen, die echten Mehrwert schaffen

  • Kommunikationsfähigkeit: Du kannst komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich vermitteln, gehst offen auf Menschen zu und kommunizierst sowie präsentierst souverän auf unterschiedlichen Stakeholder-Ebenen

  • Analytische Fähigkeiten: Du überzeugst durch eine strukturierte, analytische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise und legst besonderen Wert auf die pragmatische Umsetzung Deiner Lösungen

  • Reisebereitschaft: Du bist flexibel und offen für dienstliche Reisen im In- und Ausland

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du kommunizierst für die Zusammenarbeit in regionalen und internationalen Projekten sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift


Das bieten wir Dir:

  • Offene, dynamische Unternehmenskultur mit flachen Hierarchien, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und Zusammenarbeit in kleinen, leistungsstarken Teams – geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung und konstruktivem Feedback

  • Strukturiertes Onboarding sowie kontinuierliche fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung durch anspruchsvolle Projekte bei renommierten Unternehmen in einem internationalen Umfeld

  • Attraktives Vergütungs- und Karrieremodell mit Entwicklungspfaden und vielfältigen Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten

  • Internationales Trainingsprogramm zur gezielten Förderung fachlicher, methodischer und persönlicher Kompetenzen

  • Moderne Büros in attraktiver City-Lage in Frankfurt am Main, Berlin oder München – sehr gute Verkehrsanbindung, kostenfreie Parkplätze sowie Obst und Getränke inklusive

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit ausgewogenem Mix aus Arbeit beim Kunden, im Büro und in Mobilarbeit

  • Umfassendes Benefit-Paket: 24/7-Unfallversicherung, Wertkontenmodell, JobRad, Mobilitätsbudget, Internetkostenzuschuss, Edenred Karte, Gesundheitsförderung mit machtfit sowie betriebliche Altersversorgung

Wer wir sind:

Miebach Consulting berät seit 1973 Unternehmen vom Mittelstand bis zum globalen Konzern im Supply Chain Management, in Logistik und Produktion. Mit 26 Büros weltweit und über 600 Mitarbeitenden zählen wir zu den führenden Beratungen in diesem Bereich.

Als globaler, integrierter Supply-Chain-Partner verbinden wir Strategie, Engineering und digitale Expertise, um Lieferketten sowie Produktions- und Logistikstrukturen effizient, resilient und nachhaltig zu gestalten. Unsere Lösungen gehen über das Operative hinaus: Siestärken unsere Kunden, fördern Innovationen und helfen Unternehmen, ihre Ziele zu erreichen und ihr volles Potenzial zu entfalten.

Werde Teil von Miebach und gestalte gemeinsam mit uns die Supply Chains von morgen!

Diese Aufgaben erwarten Dich:

  • Transportstrategien: Du analysierst Transportstrukturen, Prozesse und Kosten und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden Strategien für ein effizientes und zukunftsfähiges Transportation Management

  • Operating Models: Du konzipierst Target Operating Models für das Transportmanagement und gestaltest Organisationsstrukturen, Rollen, Prozesse und Governance sowie die Zusammenarbeit mit Logistikpartnern, 4PL-Dienstleistern und Control Towers

  • IT-Strategien: Du entwickelst Zielarchitekturen und Roadmaps für die digitale Transportsteuerung und berücksichtigst dabei bestehende IT-Systeme, Integrationsanforderungen und zukünftige Entwicklungen

  • TMS-Auswahl: Du übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in konkrete Auswahlkriterien, bewertest geeignete Transport-Management-Systeme (TMS) und Anbieter und begleitest Ausschreibungen, Systemdemonstrationen und Entscheidungsprozesse

  • Implementierung: Du begleitest die Einführung neuer Transportprozesse und TMS-Lösungen und stellst dabei das Zusammenspiel von fachlichen Anforderungen, organisatorischen Veränderungen und technischer Umsetzung sicher

  • Projektleitung: Du leitest Beratungsprojekte, führst Dein Projektteam und übernimmst Verantwortung für den Projekterfolg, die Qualität der Ergebnisse und die Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden

  • Methodenentwicklung: Du entwickelts unsere Methoden und Beratungsansätze im Transportation Management gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter und teilst Deine Expertise mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen und unseren Kunden

  • Marktbearbeitung und Akquise: Du identifizierst Beratungsbedarf im Transportation Management, baust Kundenbeziehungen auf und entwickelst passgenaue Angebote – vom ersten Austausch bis zur Präsentation unseres Beratungsansatzes


Das bringst Du mit:

  • Abschluss: Du hast ein Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Logistik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang erfolgreich abgeschlossen – idealerweise mit einem Masterabschluss oder einer vergleichbaren Qualifikation

  • Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 5–6 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im Transportation Management mit und hast bereits Erfahrung in der Beratung sowie in der Leitung von Projekten gesammelt

  • Fachliche Expertise: Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in mehreren der folgenden Bereiche mit: Transportstrategien, Target Operating Models, IT-Strategien sowie in der Auswahl und Implementierungsbegleitung von TMS-Lösungen. Zudem kennst Du die Anforderungen an moderne Transportmanagement- und Control-Tower-Lösungen und kannst die Eignung von TMS-Lösungen für unterschiedliche Kundenanforderungen einschätzen

  • Projekt- & Teamführung: Du strukturierst komplexe Aufgaben, führst Projekt- und Kundenteams und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden praxisorientierte und nachhaltige Lösungen

  • Kommunikationsfähigkeit: Du überzeugst durch eine klare und verständliche Kommunikation, moderierst Workshops souverän und förderst eine vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit zwischen Fachbereichen, IT, Softwareanbietern und Implementierungspartnern

  • Reisebereitschaft: Du bist flexibel und offen für projektbezogene Reisen im In- und Ausland. Wie häufig Du vor Ort bist, hängt vom jeweiligen Projekt ab

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du kommunizierst für die Arbeit in regionalen und internationalen Projekten sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift


Das bieten wir Dir:

  • Offene, dynamische Unternehmenskultur mit flachen Hierarchien, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und Zusammenarbeit in kleinen, leistungsstarken Teams – geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung und konstruktivem Feedback

Wie zijn wij?

Het mooie van Univé? Dat zijn de mensen, de resultaten, de geschiedenis, de cultuur, het ontstaan en de betrokkenheid. Dat is samenwerken. Een coöperatie zijn zonder winstoogmerk. Dicht bij onze leden staan. En samen bouwen aan een organisatie die betrouwbaar, toekomstbestendig en wendbaar is.

Wij richten ons op het voorkomen van risico’s, het beperken van gevolgen en we verzekeren alleen als het echt nodig is. Coöperatie Univé bestaat uit zeven verschillende Regionale Univé’s, zodat we op landelijk én lokaal niveau altijd dichtbij onze leden zijn. Dat is het mooie van Univé.

Waar kom je te werken?

Je komt te werken binnen de afdeling Inkoop & Facilitaire Zaken, in het team Inkoop & Contractmanagement. Dit team voert binnen Univé de regie op inkoop-, contract- en leveranciersmanagement. Ons doel? Grip op uitgaven en risico’s, professionele en efficiënte processen én optimale ondersteuning van de business.

We zijn volop in ontwikkeling. Inkoop & Contractmanagement groeit verder naar een professionele, businessgerichte en datagedreven regiepartner. Dat betekent dat we niet alleen kijken naar wat er contractueel is afgesproken, maar vooral ook naar de waarde die contracten en leveranciers gedurende de looptijd daadwerkelijk voor Univé realiseren.

Als contractmanager speel jij daarin een belangrijke rol. Je werkt intensief samen met contracteigenaren, management, inkopers, Risk, Compliance en Juridische Zaken. En natuurlijk met onze leveranciers.

Jouw uitdaging

Als contractmanager ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het realiseren en bewaken van contractwaarde gedurende de volledige looptijd van onze contracten.
Je voert regie op het contract- en leveranciersmanagement van de aan jou toegewezen contracten en leveranciers. Daarbij stuur je op naleving van afspraken, kosten, kwaliteit, risico’s, performance, compliance en duurzaamheid.

Je zorgt ervoor dat Univé grip houdt op de ingekochte dienstverlening en dat afspraken niet alleen op papier goed geregeld zijn, maar in de praktijk ook worden nagekomen.

Daarbij ben je een stevige gesprekspartner voor zowel de business als leveranciers. Je organiseert en leidt leveranciersoverleggen, maakt prestaties en risico’s inzichtelijk en zorgt dat acties daadwerkelijk worden opgevolgd. Zie je afwijkingen, kansen of risico’s? Dan wacht je niet af, maar kom je in actie.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • regie voeren op complexe, risicovolle en/of strategische contracten;

  • sturen op contractnaleving, kosten, kwaliteit, performance, risico’s, compliance en duurzaamheid;

  • organiseren en leiden van leveranciersoverleggen;

  • bewaken van SLA’s, KPI’s, afspraken en verbetermaatregelen;

  • begeleiden van wijzigingen, indexaties, evaluaties, verlengingen en beëindigingen;

  • signaleren en beheersen van contractuele, leveranciers- en continuïteitsrisico’s;

  • initiëren en begeleiden van verbeterplannen, disputen en escalaties;

  • ondersteunen van contracteigenaren en management bij besluitvorming over contracten en leveranciers;

  • opstellen van analyses en managementrapportages over contractstatus, prestaties, risico’s, acties en besluitpunten;

  • tijdig signaleren wanneer hercontractering of een nieuwe marktbenadering nodig is;

  • bijdragen aan de verdere professionalisering van contract- en leveranciersmanagement binnen Univé.

De inhoudelijke beoordeling van de dienstverlening ligt primair bij de business en contracteigenaar. Jij zorgt ervoor dat deze prestaties periodiek worden beoordeeld en voert regie op de contractuele borging, opvolging en eventuele escalatie. Je kijkt daarbij verder dan één overleg of één contractmoment.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een contractmanager die regie pakt. Je brengt structuur, houdt overzicht en weet wanneer je moet verbinden, adviseren, onderhandelen of juist escaleren.

Je voelt je comfortabel in een omgeving waarin verschillende belangen samenkomen. Je kunt schakelen tussen de dagelijkse praktijk en tactisch-strategische vraagstukken en bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor contracteigenaren, management en leveranciers.

Je bent analytisch en risicobewust, maar vooral ook gericht op resultaat. Een contract is voor jou geen statisch document: je gebruikt het als instrument om prestaties te verbeteren, risico’s te beheersen en waarde voor Univé te realiseren.

Je bouwt aan professionele leveranciersrelaties waarin transparantie, voorspelbaarheid, continue verbetering en wederzijdse aanspreekbaarheid centraal staan. Je durft leveranciers uit te dagen en weet tegelijkertijd hoe je een constructieve langetermijnrelatie onderhoudt.

Verder breng je mee:

  • HBO/HBO+ werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld in bedrijfskunde, rechten, economie of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring binnen contractmanagement, bij voorkeur domein IT;

  • aantoonbare ervaring met complexe, risicovolle en/of strategische contracten en leveranciers, binnen het domein IT;

  • kennis van contract lifecycle management, leveranciersrelatiemanagement, prestatiesturing en contractgovernance;

  • ervaring met leveranciersoverleggen, prestatiebeoordelingen, contractevaluaties en escalatiemanagement;

  • kennis van risicomanagement, compliance-eisen en interne beheersing;

  • kennis van relevante wet- en regelgeving en uitbestedingskaders;

  • bij voorkeur een aanvullende opleiding op het gebied van contractmanagement, zoals CATS, NEVI 2 of vergelijkbaar.

Daarnaast herkennen we in jou initiatief, regievoering, risicobewustzijn en resultaatgerichtheid. Je bent communicatief sterk, kwaliteitsgericht en analytisch, kunt goed samenwerken en beschikt over overtuigingskracht en onderhandelingsvaardigheden op tactisch-strategisch niveau.

Wat bieden wij?

We vragen veel van je, maar daar geven we je ook graag veel voor terug:

  • een salaris passend bij jouw kennis, opleiding en ervaring op basis van een 38-urige werkweek, inclusief vakantiegeld en een dertiende maand;

  • een collectieve prestatiebeloning;

  • een arbeidsvoorwaardenkeuzesysteem: tijd voor geld of geld voor tijd;

  • 26 vakantiedagen bij een 38-urige werkweek;

  • een studiekostenregeling en volop ruimte om jezelf professioneel verder te ontwikkelen;

  • een goede pensioenvoorziening;

  • hybride werken: thuiswerken is bij ons heel normaal en je hebt de vrijheid om samen met je team je ideale werkplek te bepalen;

  • een reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en een thuiswerkvergoeding op de dagen dat je vanuit huis werkt;

  • een laptop en telefoon;

  • korting op schade- en zorgverzekeringen.

Maar minstens zo belangrijk: je krijgt bij ons ruimte om impact te maken. Contract- en leveranciersmanagement is binnen Univé volop in ontwikkeling. Je krijgt daarmee de mogelijkheid om niet alleen contracten professioneel te managen, maar ook actief bij te dragen aan hoe we ons vakgebied verder vormgeven.

Enthousiast?

Wil jij samen met ons bouwen aan professioneel contract- en leveranciersmanagement binnen Univé? Solliciteer dan via de sollicitatiebutton. Je kunt tot en met 30 november 2026 reageren.

title: Senior Control Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About EH Energy

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To help bring this vision to life, we are looking for a Senior Control Engineer to coordinate our efforts in designing control strategies for containerized systems integrating our fuel cell technology alongside equipment such as gas reformers, batteries, and climate control units. You will coordinate the control team and play a key role in shaping how these complex, multi-equipment systems operate safely and efficiently in the field.

Please note we would require you to be onsite, full-time in Switzerland. For details on the visa requirements for relocating to this exceptional Swiss canton, please get in touch and a member of our team will be happy to advise.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate the control engineering activities and define the control architecture and technical roadmap for our fuel cell and containerized power systems

  • Develop control strategies, models and algorithms for test-benches, fuel cell system and containerized power supply systems using Matlab/Simulink and Siemens PLCs

  • Coordinate the transition of prototype control algorithms from Simulink to industrial-quality code in TIA Portal Step 7

  • Implement, tune and validate controllers for thermal, air, fuel and power subsystems

  • Define and own control requirements, state machines and safety/diagnostic logic

  • Drive the continuous improvement (performance, efficiency and robustness) of our products

  • Define and oversee model-in-the-loop (MIL) testing and validation procedures

  • Manage the complete software life cycle, from requirements through release and maintenance, including dataset management

  • Establish coding standards, conduct code reviews and ensure compliance with industrial and certification requirements

  • Coordinate and develop the control team, including task planning and prioritization

  • Act as the main control interface with embedded, test and electrical engineering, as well as external partners and suppliers

 

Skills and Experience Required:

  • BSc/MSc in control, electrical, mechatronic or automation engineering is mandatory

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in control engineering, including at least 2 years in a technical lead or senior role

  • Skill 1 : Strong experience in process control engineering, particularly with containerized power supply systems; knowledge of programming and implementing safety PLCs is a strong plus

  • Skill 2 : Strong experience with TIA Portal (Step 7, WinCC, Test Suite), with the ability to structure code to industrial standards and meet certification requirements

  • Experience with functional safety (e.g. IEC 61508, ISO 13849), including SIL/PL determination and implementation of safety functions

  • Experience across the complete V-model development cycle, including hazard and risk assessment, requirements definition, safety requirements specification (SRS), verification and validation, and dataset management

  • Experience with stationary and maritime power applications, with a focus on the US and EU markets and their respective standards and certification requirements

  • Proven team player, with the ability to:
    (i) Coordinate and mentor the control team by clearly explaining your code and helping the team adopt robust industrial methods: you will take the responsibility in developing Skill 1 and Skill 2 across the team
    (ii)Collaborate effectively within interdisciplinary teams

  • Solid knowledge of control theory, state machines and system identification

  • Strong experience with MATLAB/Simulink and model-based design is a plus

  • Professional working language is in English.

     

Start date: Immediately

title: Senior Controls Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Voor onze afdeling Controls Engineering in Gorinchem zijn we per direct op zoek naar een ervaren Senior Controls Engineer voor het programmeren van de aansturing van onze nieuwste voedselproductie lijnen voor onze klanten van het merk Tromp uit Gorinchem. Dit betreft een full time functie, met veel afwisseling en hulp van betrokken teamgenoten om de meest slimme/ efficiënte besturingsoplossingen te bouwen.

Ontwerp en programmeer jij graag de nieuwste deegverwerkingsmachines van AMF Bakery Systems? Step dan in als Senior Controls Engineer! Heb je ervaring als software, controls of mechatronica engineer in machinebouw, ben je vertrouwd met programmeren in structured text en ben je bekend met Siemens besturingstechniek? Hecht je aan betrokken en slimme collega's waarmee je samen 'state of the art' voedselproductielijnen ontwerpt, programmeert en bouwt? Super, dan zijn we op zoek naar jou!

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Maandsalaris tussen €4.00,00 en €5.800,00 o.b.v. 40 uur; afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring, excl. toeslagen

  • Reiskostenvergoeding (€0,25 / km); vitaliteitsbudget tot €25,00 netto per maand en een zeer goede pensioenvoorziening (PME)

  • Flexibele werktijden, deels thuiswerken mogelijk

  • Vakantiegeld 8%

  • CAO Metalektro waaronder 27 vakantiedagen en 13 adv dagen per jaar

  • Winstdeling, afhankelijk van de winst betreffende het jaar, tot max. €2.000,00

  • Uitstekende opleidingsmogelijkheden zodat jouw vakkennis up to date is en blijft

  • Werken in een enthousiast en innoverend team

  • Informele werksfeer, teamuitjes, vrijdagmiddagborrel

  • Alle ruimte om te groeien in je functie afhankelijk van jouw ambities

Wat ga je doen:

  • Ontwikkelen / programmeren, configureren en integreren van software van onze machines (PLC + HMI). We passen veel techniek toe van Siemens en Allen Bradley.

  • Testen op locatie Gorinchem (IO, netwerk, drives, functioneel)

  • Softwarematig helpen met voorbereiden van productielijnen voor de FAT

  • Inzetten van jouw software expertise voor ondersteuning van Assembly, Buitendienst en aan klanten bij complexe software gerelateerde issues

  • Incidenteel naar de klant voor ondersteuning van commissioning van nieuwe productie lijnen

  • Als onze software expert werk je intensief samen met Electrical en Mechanical engineers, collega's van Sales, Projectmanagers, Assembly Engineers etc. Je bent dan vraagbaak en neemt besluiten mbt onze software oplossingen.

  • Bijdragen aan het continue verder verbeteren van onze technische controls oplossingen conform onze Markel Business aanpak

  • Helpen met verder standaardiseren van onze software oplossingen van onze product portfolio van het merk Tromp in Gorinchem.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig aan jouw projecten


  • HBO Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar, of ROC Mechatronica niv 4 met ruime ervaring

  • Gedegen kennis van en ervaring met Siemens Tia Portal en of Allen Bradley Studio 5000

  • Kennis van hogere programmeertalen (vb. Structured text of VBA)

  • Teamplayer, pragmatisch en leergierig

  • Communicatief vaardig (goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal)

In wat voor bedrijf kom jij te werken?

Bij AMF Bakery Systems ben je onderdeel van een hechte en trotse groep collega’s die wereldwijd bijdraagt aan het succes van industriële bakkerijen. Wat ons verbindt, is onze drive om te innoveren én onze zorg voor de wereld om ons heen. Zo ontwikkelden wij samen de eerste industriële oven op waterstof – een grote stap richting een duurzamere toekomst.

We werken met ruim 220 collega’s in Nederland – vanuit Gorinchem, Amersfoort en Nieuwleusen – en maken deel uit van de internationale Markel Food Group. Binnen AMF voelt iedereen zich thuis: of je nu op kantoor werkt, in de werkplaats of bij de klant op locatie. We geloven dat we samen sterker zijn als iedereen zich welkom, gehoord en gewaardeerd voelt.

Diversiteit en inclusie zitten dan ook in ons DNA. We staan open voor mensen met verschillende achtergronden en ideeën, omdat we weten dat juist die mix leidt tot slimme oplossingen en sterke teams. Jij hoort erbij – precies zoals je bent.

Samen bouwen we aan iets groters dan alleen machines. We bouwen aan een toekomst waarin we samen kunnen groeien, leren en impact maken.

title: Senior Corporate FP&A Specialist
descriptionHtml:
The Senior Corporate FP&A Specialist focuses on supporting all Distalmotion entities on driving strategic management decisions through financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting. The role works closely with FP&A Leadership and is cross-functional with the teams’ stakeholders to track performance, analyze variances, develop financial outlooks, and support key business initiatives.

The Senior Corporate FP&A Specialist has the capacity to operate autonomously and maintain a high standard of accuracy and consistency in financial outputs and supports ongoing improvements to FP&A processes and reporting.

TASKS:

Financial Planning:

• Support the development of Distalmotion’s short-, medium-, and long-term financial plans by preparing analyses, models, and inputs that align with corporate objectives

• Assist in the annual budgeting, rolling forecast, and long-range planning processes by collecting inputs from departments, validating assumptions, and ensuring data accuracy and consistency

• Build, maintain, and update financial and forecasting models under guidance from FP&A Leadership, including scenario and sensitivity analyses to support planning and decision-making

• Support the preparation and financial evaluation of business cases for new investments and strategic initiatives, including analysis of costs, benefits, and key risks

• Prepare financial analyses and summaries that provide management with forward-looking insights on performance, profitability, and resource allocation

Financial Analysis & Performance Management:

• Support month and quarterly performance reviews by preparing standard reports, ad hoc analyses, and management presentations ensuring accuracy within communicated timelines

• Support FP&A Leadership in the preparation of budgets and forecasts by completing analysis that is presented accurately and timely

• Develop ad hoc analysis to support strategic and operational decision making

• Perform financial and operational performance analysis across functions, programs, and projects, supporting management’s understanding of business results

• Prepare and maintain KPI reports, dashboards, and performance tracking tools to provide clear visibility into actuals versus budget and forecast

• Analyze variances and key performance drivers, clearly explaining results, risks, and opportunities

• Present findings and recommendations clearly to both finance and non-finance stakeholders

• Review historical budgets, expenditures, and forecasts to identify trends and opportunities to improve planning and forecasting accuracy

• Provide meaningful insights by challenging business assumptions and educating business partners on financial issues and concepts

• Contribute to competitor, market, and industry analyses by gathering data and assessing financial implications to support strategic planning

Requirements

Qualifications :

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance or Accounting, Master’s degree preferred

• Minimum of 7 years of progressive FP&A experience, in a medical device company

• Knowledge of US GAAP financial reporting requirements

• Proven expertise in financial modelling, accounting, forecasting, and variance analysis skills

• Experience working in multinational organization and collaborating with global finance teams

Skills & Competencies :

• Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities with strong attention to detail and accuracy

• Strong business acumen and understanding of P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow dynamics

• Experience with cross functional business partnering in a medical device company

• Good interpersonal skills and proven track record of working independently and adapting quickly in a dynamic, evolving environment

• Established proficiency with inventory management and margin improvement initiatives

• Result & performance driven: assumes full ownership and accountability for delivering accurate and timely results while seeking guidance only when needed

• Able to translate FP&A Leadership instructions and requests into meaningful output within required timelines

• Demonstrated ability to work multiple projects and priorities simultaneously under time pressure while keeping high level of quality and accuracy

• Sense of urgency: ability to identify, prioritize, and execute work/project plans

• High level of integrity, professionalism, and sound judgment when handling confidential information

• Proven track record of developing and maintaining cash forecasting models to support cash flow scenario analysis within a complex accounting structure in a global organization

• Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage effectively across cultures and organizational levels, and to build trusted, culturally sensitive partnerships in a global environment

• Willingness to adjust work schedule to ensure time sensitive deliverable commitments are achieved

• Fluent in English

Benefits

What we offer:

  • A dynamic, innovative environment with cutting-edge medical technology that is shaping the future of robotic surgery.
  • Fast-growing Company where innovation meets agility.
  • Structured onboarding program and training, ensuring a confident start.
  • High degree of autonomy and flexibility.

title: Senior Counsel, Privacy & AI Compliance (EU)
descriptionHtml:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.   We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

What You’ll Do:

The Legal and Government Affairs team at CoreWeave is highly collaborative and partners closely with teams across the company to navigate complex legal landscapes while enabling innovation and growth. The team is pragmatic, solutions-oriented, and deeply engaged in strategic decision-making, with a strong emphasis on building trusted relationships across the organization.

As Senior Counsel, Privacy & AI Compliance (EU), you will serve as a key legal advisor on European privacy, data protection, and artificial intelligence requirements. If you thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, enjoy solving complex problems, and are eager to make a significant impact, CoreWeave is the place for you.

About the role:

Reporting to the Senior Director & Lead Managing Counsel, Privacy, Regulatory & Compliance, you will independently advise on complex regional matters, help operationalize evolving legal requirements, and partner closely with Privacy, Product, Engineering, Security, Commercial Legal, Government Affairs, and business teams across Europe. You will play a central role in scaling practical, risk-based privacy and AI compliance frameworks for CoreWeave’s cloud infrastructure, products, and European operations.

In this Role You Will:

  • Advise on EU and UK privacy, data protection, and AI laws and regulatory developments, including the GDPR, UK GDPR, ePrivacy requirements, the EU AI Act, the EU Data Act, and related national implementing laws and guidance.
  • Translate complex legal requirements into clear, practical, and scalable guidance for Product, Engineering, Security, Commercial, Marketing, HR, Procurement, and operational teams across Europe.
  • Lead or support privacy and AI assessments for new and evolving products, features, data uses, vendors, and business initiatives, including DPIAs, legitimate-interest assessments, transfer impact assessments, AI risk and classification analyses, and documented compliance decisions.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to embed privacy by design and default, responsible AI, data minimization, transparency, security, retention, and governance requirements into product architecture and development processes.
  • •  Advise on international data transfers, data localization and residency requirements, cross-border access, and related contractual and operational mechanisms, including EU Standard Contractual Clauses and the UK International Data Transfer Addendum or Agreement.
  • Support implementation of CoreWeave’s AI compliance framework in Europe, including role and use-case classification, risk management, transparency, recordkeeping, human oversight, technical documentation, contractual allocation of responsibilities, and governance for internal and customer-facing AI uses.
  • Provide regional guidance on data subject rights, records of processing, privacy notices, consent and cookies, retention and deletion, data sharing, direct marketing, and other core privacy program requirements.
  • Advise on European product launches, market entry, strategic partnerships, customer and vendor arrangements, and commercial terms involving privacy, data use, AI, and regulatory responsibility.
  • Support cybersecurity and privacy incident response in Europe, including assessment of regulator and data subject notification obligations, engagement with relevant stakeholders, and documentation of defensible legal decisions.
  • Lead or support responses to inquiries, audits, consultations, and investigations involving European data protection authorities, AI regulators, and other governmental bodies; coordinate with local counsel and drive follow-up and remediation.
  • Develop and maintain regional policies, procedures, playbooks, training, control mappings, and evidence of compliance, and monitor emerging legal and enforcement trends to inform business strategy and program priorities.

Who You Are:

  • 4+ years of relevant legal experience, including substantial experience advising on European privacy and data protection matters; a mix of law firm, regulatory, and in-house experience is preferred.
  • Qualified to practice law in an EU member state or the United Kingdom and in good standing with the applicable professional body.

descriptionHtml:
About Yepoda

Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.

Yepoda is a clean K-Beauty brand that actually proves it works. We make Korean skincare without any of the compromises. Everything is clinically tested, 100% vegan, and formulated above EU standards. So you get the innovation and the results that K-Beauty is known for, plus a real commitment to sustainability. And we make it genuinely fun and easy to use — skincare you actually look forward to.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a certified B Corp™ and 1% for the Planet member, based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available through our own online shop and, since March 2025, at Sephora Europe — online and in over 650 stores. With a team of 140+ brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda's story every day.

As Senior Creative Strategist, you will sit at the intersection of performance marketing and our creative team, translating data into the stories, hooks, and formats that drive Yepoda's paid social growth. Your focus is to turn day-to-day performance metrics into actionable creative direction, keeping design, content, and influencer teams aligned on what's winning and why, while building the testing roadmaps that keep our creative pipeline ahead of platform trends.

Your Tasks

  • Deliver detailed, actionable creative briefs, direct-response copy, and frame-by-frame storyboards for the design team.

  • Monitor day-to-day micro-metrics (thumb-stop ratios, 3-second hold rates, CTR) to rapidly diagnose asset performance and propose modular iterations.

  • Act as the bridge between performance and creative by streamlining the asset request pipeline and managing the feedback loop between media buyers and designers.

  • Supply the in-house production and influencer teams with data-backed insights, winning hooks, and performance trends to guide their shoots.

  • Proactively design and build A/B testing roadmaps for new hooks, visual formats, and messaging angles.

  • Define and map specific creative concepts and angles to targeted consumer personas for both evergreen (BAU) and seasonal campaigns.

  • Spot native platform trends by maintaining a swipe file of Meta vs. TikTok content and mapping competitor strategies.

  • Present monthly reviews by synthesizing weekly learnings into macro-level creative presentations for stakeholders.

  • Own post-click/CRO alignment by auditing and advising on e-commerce landing pages to ensure the post-click experience matches the ad narrative.

  • Build secondary channel playbooks by adapting winning Meta/TikTok creatives for expansion channels like Pinterest, Snapchat, or Reddit.

Your Profile

  • 4+ years of experience in a creative strategy or content strategy, ideally within a D2C or e-commerce brand and in touch with performance marketing.

  • Proven experience optimizing paid social creative assets for Meta and/or TikTok, with a strong understanding of how platform algorithms use creative signals to define audience targeting.

  • Comfortable working with performance data (thumb-stop ratios, hold rates, CTR) to diagnose what's working and translate it into new creative angles, not just report on it.

  • Experience writing creative briefs, scripts, or storyboards for a design team; visual production skills (e.g. Canva) are a plus but not required.

  • Strong cross-functional collaborator, comfortable aligning performance marketing, design, content, and influencer teams around a shared creative direction.

  • Familiarity with workflow and creative analytics tools (e.g. Motion or similar).

  • Fluent in English; Italian or French language is a plus.

What We Offer

  • Dynamic Environment: The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team.

  • Accelerate Your Career: Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand.

  • Inspiring Workspace: Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks.

  • Hybrid Working: We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery.

  • We Value Diversity: We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default.

  • Employee Discounts: You’ll get to enjoy the Yepoda products at a discount and share it with friends and family to keep your glow going!

  • Unique Add Ons: A monthly benefits budget that's yours to spend. Through the Probonio app you pick what actually fits your lifestyle.

title: Senior Creative Strategist
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Senior Creative Strategist 

The Sr. Creative Strategist for UK/EU is a performance-minded, market-savvy leader who bridges global creative output with the nuances of European consumer behaviour. This person excels at identifying what's working in the US market and translating it for UK and German/French audiences; while also building the infrastructure to test, learn and scale independently. This person is energized by solving complex business problems, making high-judgment decisions in ambiguous environments, and turning insights into scalable, revenue-driving creative strategy.

Success in this role looks like:

  • Consistently identifying high-performing US creative and adapting it to drive customer acquisition and revenue growth in UK & DE/FR markets
  • Owning the experimentation framework that enables the EU/UK team to move fast, document learnings, and scale winners while maintaining strong alignment with brand identity
  • Serving as the primary creative liaison between UK & DE/FR market needs and the US creative and production teams
  • Improving win rates and spend efficiency through a rigorous, data-backed testing cadence
  • Acting as a strategic partner to the Director of Paid Social UK & DE/FR and cross-functional brand, design, and marketing teams
  • Leveraging data to inform strategic direction
  • This role is critical to establishing Paid Social as a core growth engine in the UK, Germany and France.

This role will be onsite 4-days a week based in London, Madrid, or Berlin. 

Responsibilities

Creative Adaptation & Briefing

  • Audit US creative performance regularly to identify high-potential concepts for UK & DE/FR adaptation
  • Brief the US creative team on market-specific adaptation needs; adjusting copy, tone, cultural references, pricing, and product focus for UK & DE/FR audiences
  • Commission net-new creative concepts where US assets are insufficient or market-specific angles are required
  • Write clear, detailed high converting ad briefs for video, static, UGC, and other ad formats with UK & DE/FR market context embedded
  • Ensure all adapted and net-new creative aligns with brand identity while resonating locally
  • Provide strategic feedback to designers and execute on feedback from leadership

Experimentation & Performance

  • Build and own a structured experimentation framework for UK & DE/FR paid social; covering hypothesis formation, test design, documentation, and results reporting
  • Prioritise and manage a live test pipeline across Meta (and other channels) to continuously improve creative performance
  • Analyse performance data in Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, and Looker; translate findings into clear strategic recommendations
  • Conduct consumer, competitor, and trend research specific to UK & DE/FR markets to inform creative direction
  • Identify winning patterns and codify them into repeatable brief templates and creative playbooks

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Serve as the EU/UK creative point of contact for the US production and strategy teams
  • Partner with the Director of Paid Social EU/UK on channel strategy, creative priorities, and growth planning
  • Collaborate with Brand, Design, and broader Marketing teams to align creative output across channels including affiliate, CRM, and PR

Qualifications

Required: 

  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • 5+ years of relevant creative and marketing experience
  • Paid Social and/or Direct Response experience required, with strong Meta expertise
  • Demonstrated experience working across markets; ideally including UK and/or DACH, with an understanding of how to adapt creative for different audiences
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make confident creative decisions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to write compelling briefs and copy across formats
  • Experience managing creative testing frameworks and reporting on results
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple briefs, markets, and workstreams simultaneously
  • Comfortable working across Google Suite (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Gmail)
  • Fluency in English required; German/French language skills a plus
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • Strong collaboration skills across creative and marketing teams

Preferred: 

  • Familiarity with TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat, or other paid platforms
  • Experience briefing and working with UGC creators
  • Background in DTC, fashion or e-commerce brands

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range£92,000—£101,000 GBP

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
