title: Senior CX Strategist
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore. 

VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. 

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on  LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

Senior CX Strategist

Company: VML UK
Location: London – Sea Containers House, SE1
Working Model: Hybrid
Reporting to: Head of Planning

Who We Are

At VML, we are a global creative company that brings together brand experience, customer experience and commerce to create connected brands and drive growth.

We combine creativity, strategy, data and technology to help some of the world's biggest brands build meaningful relationships with their customers. From shaping brand experiences to designing connected customer journeys, we believe the best work happens when different perspectives and capabilities come together.

We're now looking for a Senior CX Strategist to join our London strategy team.

The Opportunity

Most brands don't have a communications problem. They have an experience problem. A gap between what they promise and what customers actually experience at the moments that matter.

We're looking for a Senior CX Strategist who can help close that gap.

Someone who understands that great customer experience isn't just about individual touchpoints, CRM campaigns or digital journeys. It's about connecting the entire customer experience, from the first interaction with a brand through to building long-term relationships, loyalty and advocacy.

You'll bring together CX, CRM and brand-level thinking, using customer insight, creativity and data to develop strategies that make experiences better for customers and more effective for businesses.

You'll work across a range of exciting clients, including major global brands, helping them understand their customers, identify opportunities and create more connected, meaningful experiences.

This is a role for someone who enjoys getting under the skin of a business challenge, asking the right questions and turning complex customer problems into clear, inspiring strategic thinking.

You'll be comfortable working with creative teams, collaborating with data and experience specialists, and presenting your thinking to clients.

Above all, you'll be someone who sees the bigger picture but isn't afraid to get into the detail.

What You'll Be Doing

Connecting Brand, CX and CRM

  • Develop integrated customer experience strategies that connect brand ambition with real customer needs and behaviours.

  • Look across the entire customer journey, identifying opportunities to create more seamless, engaging and valuable experiences.

  • Bring together brand strategy, CRM, digital experiences and customer engagement to create joined-up strategic thinking.

  • Understand how different channels and touchpoints work together, from brand communications and social to digital, commerce, CRM and physical experiences.

  • Help clients move beyond individual campaigns and channels to think about the wider customer relationship.

Turning Insight into Strategy

  • Use customer research, behavioural insights, data and market understanding to uncover meaningful opportunities.

  • Map customer journeys, identify pain points and understand the moments that matter most.

  • Translate complex business and customer challenges into clear strategic recommendations and compelling creative briefs.

  • Develop customer propositions, experience principles and strategic frameworks that inspire creative and experience design teams.

  • Challenge existing thinking and bring fresh perspectives to how brands engage with their customers.

Making Customer Experience More Effective

  • Work closely with data and analytics teams to understand customer behaviour and identify opportunities for growth.

  • Develop strategies that improve customer acquisition, engagement, retention, loyalty and lifetime value.

  • Understand how to measure the effectiveness of customer experiences and connect customer outcomes to business performance.

  • Help define meaningful KPIs and measurement frameworks that demonstrate the impact of strategic recommendations.

  • Use performance insights to identify what's working, what isn't and where experiences can be improved.

Bringing Strategy to Life

  • Partner with Creative, Experience Design, Data, Technology and Client Services teams to turn strategic thinking into meaningful customer experiences.

  • Write clear, inspiring briefs that give creative teams a strong foundation to develop ideas.

  • Contribute strategic thinking throughout the creative development process, ensuring ideas remain grounded in customer insight and business objectives.

  • Help connect strategic ambition with practical execution across different channels and customer touchpoints.

  • Bring curiosity, fresh thinking and a willingness to challenge the expected.

Building Strong Client Relationships

  • Build trusted relationships with clients, becoming someone they turn to for thoughtful, informed strategic advice.

  • Present recommendations clearly and confidently, making complex thinking easy to understand.

  • Work alongside senior strategists and wider teams to identify opportunities to develop existing client relationships.

  • Contribute to pitches, proactive ideas and new business opportunities.

  • Support and mentor more junior team members, sharing knowledge and helping strengthen the wider strategy team.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with genuine curiosity about people, brands and the experiences that connect them.

You don't need to have worked across every aspect of CX, but you should have a strong understanding of how customer experience, CRM and brand strategy come together.

Ideally, you'll bring:

  • Solid experience in CX, CRM, customer engagement or integrated strategy, gained within an agency, consultancy or client-side environment.

  • A strong understanding of end-to-end customer journeys, including acquisition, conversion, onboarding, engagement, retention and loyalty.

  • The ability to connect customer experience thinking with wider brand strategy and business objectives.

  • Experience developing customer-centric strategies, journey maps, propositions and creative briefs.

  • Confidence working with customer data, research and behavioural insights to inform strategic recommendations.

  • An understanding of how customer experience can drive measurable business outcomes.

  • Experience working across multiple channels and touchpoints, including digital, CRM, content, social and physical experiences.

  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to present strategic thinking to clients and internal teams.

  • A collaborative approach and the ability to work closely with creative, data, technology and experience specialists.

  • A genuine interest in how customer behaviours, technology and emerging trends are changing the way people interact with brands.

It would also be great if you have:

  • Experience working with automotive, FMCG or other major consumer brands.

  • An understanding of retail, dealership or complex customer journeys.

  • Experience contributing to pitches or identifying opportunities for client growth.

  • An interest in AI and emerging technologies and how they can improve customer experiences.

The Kind of Person You'll Be

Curious about people

You're genuinely interested in understanding what makes people tick. You ask questions, challenge assumptions and look beyond the obvious to uncover what customers really need.

Creative in your thinking

You believe strategy should inspire great work, not just explain a problem. You can turn insight into ideas and enjoy collaborating with creative teams to bring those ideas to life.

Comfortable with complexity

You can see the bigger picture while understanding the detail. You're able to connect different parts of a customer journey and turn complicated challenges into clear, actionable thinking.

Commercially minded

You understand that great customer experiences need to deliver value for both customers and businesses. You're interested in effectiveness and can connect strategic recommendations to meaningful outcomes.

Collaborative and confident

You enjoy working with different disciplines, sharing ideas and learning from others. You're confident expressing a point of view, but equally open to being challenged.

What's in It for You?

  • The opportunity to work with some of the world's most recognised brands on meaningful customer experience challenges.

  • A genuinely integrated environment where CX, brand strategy, creativity, data, commerce and technology come together.

  • The chance to shape experiences across the entire customer journey rather than being limited to a single channel.

  • A collaborative and supportive strategy team where your ideas and perspective will be valued.

  • Opportunities to develop your strategic craft, broaden your experience and progress your career.

  • Hybrid working from our London office at Sea Containers House.

  • A competitive salary and access to VML and WPP benefits.

Our Commitment to Inclusion and Belonging

At VML, we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences and backgrounds make us stronger and help us create better work.

We're committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, supported and able to thrive.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, and if you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Interested?

If you're a strategist who loves understanding people, connecting the dots between brands and customer experiences, and creating work that makes a real difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Come and help us shape experiences that are as creatively ambitious as they are commercially effective.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

title: Senior Data Analyst - CRM (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable. 

As a Senior Data Analyst (m/f/d), you will join our global CRM team. This is an important role for CRM at Flix as we expand our capabilities, redefine our communication strategy and constantly optimize for maximum growth, as well as scalability and efficiency. We support global market growth with our marketing activities to increase repeated purchases and prevent churn. We always aim for cutting-edge technologies and a high level of innovation. By joining our team, you will be a crucial part of driving the team forward, developing our brands and customer communication throughout the globe.

About the Role

  • Own CRM analytics and reporting across 45+ markets, delivering clear visibility into performance, customer behavior, and commercial impact
  • Build and maintain Power BI dashboards providing real-time tracking of CRM performance, targets, and business trends
  • Deliver actionable insights on campaign performance, drivers of customer behavior, value-generating segments, and cross-market differences
  • Develop scalable, automated reporting solutions alongside deep-dive analyses and ad hoc business investigations
  • Monitor and optimize key CRM KPIs (engagement, conversion, retention, reactivation, communication effectiveness) and customer lifecycle performance
  • Partner with CRM, data, and product teams to improve segmentation, personalization, experimentation, tracking quality, and data reliability
  • Evaluate A/B tests and proactively identify trends, anomalies, risks, and opportunities, presenting clear recommendations to senior stakeholders

About You

  • 5+ years of experience in data analytics or BI, ideally within CRM, marketing, or e-commerce environments
  • Proven track record of building dashboards and automated reporting solutions for non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong SQL expertise (CTEs, window functions, multi-table joins) in a modern cloud data warehouse, preferably Snowflake
  • Advanced Power BI skills including data modeling, DAX, and best-practice dashboard design and visualization
  • Solid understanding of marketing and CRM KPIs (conversion, engagement, attribution, customer lifetime value)
  • Experience working cross-functionally with product, engineering, and marketing/CRM teams; familiarity with marketing automation tools (e.g., Braze is a plus)
  • Strong data storytelling, statistical literacy (e.g., significance testing), and a structured, detail-oriented, and autonomous working style
  • Proficiency in English

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you! 

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills.
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Senior Data Analyst (f/m/x)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission

This is a company built for growth, not comfort.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone.

We build high-performing consumer products across multiple brands in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming. You will be part of a company on a path of hyper-growth, spearheading one of the largest innovations in the mobile gaming industry, rewarded user acquisition.

At exmox, data is the compass that guides product, commercial, and financial decisions. We are moving away from siloed analyst roles and building interdisciplinary data teams where AI, specifically Claude, handles the heavy lifting of routine analysis, freeing analysts to focus on judgment, framing, and impact.

As a Senior Data Analyst (f/m/x), you will operate as a generalist across product, commercial, and financial questions, using Claude and Databricks daily rather than as an occasional tool, and you will grow alongside the team as it evolves toward deeper data engineering and ML capability. At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in.

If you're energized by dynamic markets, complex products, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Own:

  • Partner with Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Support, Fraud, and LiveOps teams to bring clarity to ambiguous problems and support decisions with evidence.
  • Turn vague business questions, product or commercial, into structured hypotheses, experiments, and decision-ready analyses.
  • Use Claude and Databricks as core tools for analysis and automation, not just for dashboarding, including working with high frequency data updating every few minutes rather than static daily aggregates.
  • Track and analyze performance across product, campaign, revenue, and profitability dimensions, adapting focus to wherever decision support is most needed.
  • Build dashboards and self-service tools that let teams monitor performance without repeated ad hoc requests.
  • Identify gaps in tracking and data quality early, and help improve instrumentation across domains.
  • Absorb new business context quickly when redeployed to a different stakeholder team, contributing decision-ready work within weeks.
  • Share your thinking openly, from quick prototypes to final recommendations, to help the team learn faster.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Product, commercial, and financial decisions are driven by evidence: Your work directly shapes prioritization, budget allocation, and go/no go calls across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Finance.
  • Risks and opportunities are identified early: Margin erosion, engagement drops, and high-LTV pockets are surfaced before they become obvious.
  • You operate across domains without losing time: When moving from one business question to another, you ramp quickly and start contributing within weeks, not months.
  • You drive the shift toward AI-heavy analytics: You use Claude to move faster and push the team's tooling forward rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.

What You Bring

  • Experienced: 5+ years of experience in product, business, or behavioral analytics, ideally spanning more than one domain (product, marketing, finance, or commercial operations); B2C, mobile gaming, or AdTech experience is a plus.
  • AI Fluency: Genuine hands-on experience working with AI tools like Claude as part of your daily workflow, not just occasional use.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong Databricks and/or Spark experience with several years of real, hands on exposure; strong SQL and Python skills for analysis, automation, and modeling; BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar) for dashboarding.
  • Analytical and Performance-Driven Mindset: Comfortable framing ambiguous questions into structured hypotheses and evaluating experiments (A/B tests, incrementality).
  • Communication and Collaboration: Strong communication skills, able to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders through structured, data-driven argumentation.
  • Independent and solution-oriented mindset: Comfortable operating in fast-paced, international environments.

How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany, working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

title: Senior Data Analyst - Marketplace
descriptionHtml:
Senior Data Analyst, Marketplace

  Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditised, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models.

The role

As Prolific scales, maintaining a healthy and sustainable marketplace will be critical to our ability to meet growing demand for high-quality human data. We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to help us understand how well our marketplace is working, identify where supply and demand are not connecting effectively, and measure whether product and algorithmic improvements are delivering better outcomes. You will work closely with Product, Engineering and Operations teams, using data to answer important marketplace questions and support better product decisions.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • Strong Analytics Skills: Strong SQL skills and experience analysing complex datasets. Python experience for analysis and experimentation is beneficial.
  • Marketplace or Product Analytics: Experience working with marketplace, product or operational data and using metrics to understand user and business behaviour.
  • Marketplace Metrics: Ability to work with measures such as supply and demand, fill rate, time-to-fill, availability, quality and concentration to understand marketplace performance.
  • Experimentation: Experience analysing A/B tests or other experiments, including defining success metrics, interpreting results and communicating findings.
  • Product Thinking: Ability to turn product or marketplace questions into measurable hypotheses and structured analysis.
  • Analytical Curiosity: Comfortable exploring data to understand why something is happening, rather than only reporting what happened.
  • Commercial Awareness: Ability to understand how marketplace performance affects customer experience and wider business outcomes.
  • Collaboration: Comfortable working with Product, Engineering and Operations teams and contributing analytical thinking to cross-functional work.
  • Clear Communication: Ability to translate analysis into simple, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What you'll be doing

  • Help define, monitor and improve the metrics we use to understand marketplace health, including supply-demand balance, fulfilment, quality and concentration.
  • Analyse marketplace performance and investigate changes in metrics such as fill rate, time-to-fill, participant availability and quality.
  • Work with product and engineering teams to define success metrics and measure the impact of product and algorithmic improvements.
  • Analyse experiments to understand whether changes to matching, ranking, recommendation or other marketplace experiences are improving outcomes.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that make marketplace performance visible and actionable.
  • Use SQL and other analytical tools to investigate marketplace behaviour, identify trends and surface opportunities or problems.
  • Explore how marketplace outcomes differ across customers, participants, use cases and segments.
  • Communicate findings clearly and help teams make data-informed product and operational decisions.

Why Prolific is a great place to work

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity.

Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.

title: Senior Data Center Pre-Construction and Capacity Delivery Manager, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Senior Data Center Preconstruction & Capacity Delivery Manager at Anthropic, you'll make sure our EMEA deals are ready to execute before we commit to them, and you'll take time out of every program before the lease is signed. Delivery dates and costs on AI infrastructure deals are largely fixed at signature. What is missed before then is hard to recover afterwards, and our leverage over the schedule is at its highest while the deal is still open.

About 75% of your time goes to preconstruction and pre-lease management, from first desktop review through Letter of Intent (LOI) to lease execution. You'll test whether each opportunity can be delivered, rigorously accelerate its program, and shape the deal so that what a developer commits to can be held to, verified and delivered.

The other 25% goes to delivery. You'll carry that work through mobilization, embed with the partners building leased and partnered capacity, and lead them to deliver on the fastest possible schedule while maintaining a safe construction site and protecting the finished quality of the data center.

Our EMEA pipeline is getting off the ground, so you'll set the standard for how deals become ready for execution here. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how Anthropic secures and activates the compute infrastructure needed to train and deploy frontier AI systems, working at the intersection of real estate, construction, and cutting-edge AI infrastructure.

Responsibilities - preconstruction and pre-lease management (about 75%):

  • Lead.  This is a role where leadership trumps management and process.  You will be expected to engage developers, contractors, utilities and our transaction teams early enough to shape the outcome of each deal rather than report on it afterwards.

  • Confirm deal readiness and serve as the gatekeeper to validate transaction viability from LOI through lease execution, ensuring all predevelopment, planning, technical and business requirements are met before commitment

  • Give transaction leads an early delivery view from desktop study on capacity, power, permitting, connectivity, schedule and cost, so that the sites moving to LOI are ones that can be delivered

  • Run independent, evidence-based delivery due diligence on each opportunity, tested against source documents rather than relayed claims, covering capacity, power, permitting, connectivity, procurement, schedule, cost, and whether the developer's team, contractors and supply chain can deliver

  • Interrogate every developer schedule from the native file rather than summary dates, testing logic, durations, production rates and critical paths, planning backwards from commissioning, and establishing the unconstrained date before any commercial protection is added

  • Rigorously accelerate programs during the pre-lease phase by making schedule work a priority for the developer while the deal depends on it, pulling forward design, permitting, power, early works and procurement, and sequencing the build around how capacity turns up

  • Assess contractor and supply-chain capacity and long-lead equipment needs for each opportunity, setting a long-lead strategy that secures delivery capacity ahead of need and making the case for early equipment funding where it protects a date

  • Challenge Total Development Cost and delivery schedules against the assumptions behind Yield-on-Cost and IRR, flagging where time-to-power or cost exposure puts the investment case at risk

  • Shape the delivery terms of the LOI, lease and supporting exhibits with transaction and legal teams, including phasing and target dates, landlord scope, diligence cost, ownership and reliance, risk allocation and governance, and check that the developer's contract with its general contractor carries the same milestones and aligns incentives around accelerated delivery

  • Give deal and delivery leadership a clear go/no-go recommendation at each decision point up to signature, with the risks, conditions and mitigations behind it

  • Keep one delivery-readiness record and one risk register across all EMEA opportunities, assigning every risk to an accountable owner, tracking it to resolution, and escalating where cost or schedule is threatened

  • Direct owner's representatives and third-party advisers and assure what they produce, bringing design and engineering, cost, schedule, commercial, contracts and procurement into a single view of risk and readiness

  • Develop and refine the preconstruction playbook, a reference log of unit costs and benchmarks, and the operating model needed to scale the function, using AI tools including Claude for first-pass assessment, document review and benchmarking so your time goes to judgment and negotiation

  • Prepare and present regular executive reporting on readiness and risk for each opportunity and across the portfolio, including time from signature to construction start, risks found before versus after signature, and baseline-to-actual variance, supporting forward capacity planning and strategic decision-making

Responsibilities - delivery leadership (about 25%):

  • Document the baseline at signature for design, budget, schedule, long-lead position, open risks and conditions, so delivery starts from an assured position whether you carry the project forward yourself or hand it to a delivery colleague

  • Partner with landlords and developers post-deal to serve as Anthropic's primary point of contact, coordinating across internal stakeholders, tracking construction progress, and facilitating critical information exchange between development partners and Anthropic stakeholders

  • You will be expected to be at one or more project sites in adequate amount to shape the culture, approach, and aggressiveness that define those extended site teams. The goal is to impact outcomes in a favorable manner.

  • You are expected to be a force multiplier that develops and enhances the skillset that development partners, contractors, and key trades bring to the project(s) you are overseeing.  That means being a subject matter expert in the various cross functional elements of data center delivery and increasing the team's performance with that knowledge and commitment to alignment.

  • Represent Anthropic in key technical and operational decisions required by partners during the development process, ensuring our infrastructure requirements are met while maintaining strong partnerships

  • Drive seamless handoffs to operational state with heavy focus on engagement across networking and deployment teams, enabling rapid workload turn-ups and minimizing time-to-production

  • Identify and mitigate risks throughout the delivery lifecycle, proactively addressing blockers that could impact timeline, cost, or technical requirements, and feed what you learn on site back into diligence and the playbook

You may be a good fit if you:

  • Have 8+ years of experience in preconstruction, development, or cost and commercial management on data center or other large mission-critical programs within EMEA, including time leading delivery on site.  You won't have a big direct team to delegate to but will instead be able to treat the entire cross functional organizations around each deal and jobsite as your team.

  • Have a track record of testing developer and contractor claims on cost, schedule, power and permitting against source documents, and of telling a deal team when a date does not hold up.

  • Have taken time out of programs before construction started, and can show how.  You read a native schedule fluently and know which levers in design, permitting, power and procurement move a date.

  • Have shaped delivery terms in development, lease or construction agreements, working with legal teams, and have led tendering and bid analysis.  You understand how cost and schedule flow through to the investment case.

  • Have a strong understanding of the end to end (dirt to delivery) data center development process to include entitlements and permitting, planning and supply chain, execution, commissioning, and handover. You are not an administrator but an active player in the arena comfortable making decisions without the need to consult across multiple external parties.

  • You should understand the nuances of data center design and construction across EMEA markets- who the players are, how power and permitting differ, what contractual norms get in the way of speed of delivery, how teams can be incentivized to build and deliver faster than normal.

  • Have built or scaled a team or function, including directing third-party advisers.

  • In this role you will often be on an island and responsible for your own destiny.  You will have free rein to develop your own approaches with the mission guidance being your only bounds.  No one will be there to empower your efforts, you will create your own influence by building relationships and diving in at all phases to deliver success.

  • You must thrive operating with ambiguity and have a willingness to own outcomes, knowing that the buck stops with you.

It's a bonus if you:

  • Understand AI/ML infrastructure requirements, including high-density power and advanced cooling systems

  • Have had preconstruction or leadership positions (Preconstruction Manager, General Superintendent, Project Manager) within a GC, EPC or developer on hyperscale data center projects or in self performance of hyperscale data center development projects.

  • Prioritize extreme ownership and have the ability to create winning cultures across diverse teams and job sites.

  • Are deeply familiar with lease negotiations, construction contracts, or real estate development processes and have strategies to move those arrangements from traditionally transaction and risk managed arrangements to collaborative efforts that align incentives around accelerated delivery of facilities.

  • Have secured long-lead equipment or manufacturing capacity ahead of a signed deal, including through frame agreements or early funding arrangements.

  • Have run quantitative schedule risk analysis, or built parametric cost benchmarks across a portfolio of sites.

  • Speak additional European languages.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:£1—£1 GBP

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Senior Data Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Présentation du poste : 

Nous recherchons un(e) Senior Data Consultant(e) pour accompagner la transformation Data & IA de nos clients C-Level (COMEX, marketing, digital, supply-chain, opérations, customer support, IT...). Le/la consultant(e) pilote avec une large autonomie des projets complets de bout en bout, supervisé(e) par un n+1 (manager, directeur, partner), et encadre les consultants plus juniors. 

Missions : 

  • Piloter un ou plusieurs streams : garantir le delivery, identifier les points de blocage, proposer des solutions, assurer la gestion de projet (documentation, planning, comptes-rendus)
  • Encadrer et donner des feedbacks constructifs aux membres juniors de l'équipe
  • Produire de manière autonome les livrables de mission : présentations, benchmarks, études de cas, workshop decks, sections steerco
  • Rédiger des storylines et concevoir des slides percutantes
  • Animer les interviews et workshops clients
  • Construire une relation de confiance avec les clients et identifier des opportunités business
  • Contribuer au développement d'Artefact : développement d'une offre, d'une industrie, d'un chapter ou d'un partenariat école ; participation au recrutement et à la formation des nouveaux arrivants
  • Soutenir et développer une ou plusieurs expertises internes (stratégie, data governance, data marketing...) via la construction d'offres, la formation, ou des actions marketing

Profil recherché :

  • 2 à 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle en cabinet de conseil
  • Double profil "business" et "data" : curieux(se), passionné(e) par la data et les évolutions technologiques
  • Esprit analytique, goût pour la résolution de problèmes
  • Expérience en gestion de clients et identification d'opportunités commerciales
  • Maîtrise de la Suite Google/Pack Office et des outils de workshop ; excellente communication en français et en anglais (écrit/oral)

Pourquoi nous rejoindre : 

  • Localisation en plein cœur de Paris (9ème arrondissement)
  • Environnement pluridisciplinaire en forte croissance
  • Formations régulières et montée en compétences sur les méthodes de travail tech (product mindset, agilité)
  • Culture entrepreneuriale fondée sur l'innovation, la collaboration et l'action

Process de recrutement : 

  • HR Interview : 30/45' - entretien de motivation, culture et éligibilité avec un(e) Talent Acquisition Specialist
  • Consulting Manager : Business case - partie fit (motivation, soft skills, valeurs) puis use case avec synthèse de la solution (réponse, durée, équipe)
  • Consulting Director : Business case - partie fit (motivation, soft skills, valeurs) puis use case avec synthèse de la solution (réponse, durée, équipe)
  • Partner : Business case - partie fit (motivation, soft skills, valeurs) puis use case avec synthèse de la solution (réponse, durée, équipe)

Rémunération : 53 000€ à 63 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + jusqu’à 5 000€ de variable selon expérience et séniorité

Présentation entreprise : 

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable. A la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients.

Envie d'en savoir plus? Découvrez Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : https://www.artefact.com

Inclusion et diversité : 

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l'adéquation avec le rôle.

title: Senior Data Engineer - AWS
descriptionHtml:
Senior Data Engineer – AWS

Location: London (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent

Engineer future-ready data platforms that power financial transformation.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Data Engineer with AWS to join our growing team of engineering experts driving next-generation transformation for Tier 1 financial services clients. You’ll play a pivotal role in designing, building, and deploying cloud-based data pipelines. Working across greenfield projects and enterprise-scale platforms, your work will directly impact how data is ingested, transformed, and served at scale across the financial services industry. You'll also embrace AI-enabled ways of working, using approved AI and automation tools where appropriate to improve engineering productivity, accelerate delivery, and enhance solution quality while applying sound engineering judgement and responsible AI practices.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and build end-to-end data pipelines leveraging AWS-native services and modern data architectures.
  • Collaborate with clients to gather requirements, define technical solutions, and deliver production-grade systems that meet business needs.
  • Apply AWS Well-Architected Principles, CI/CD practices, and AI-enabled engineering approaches to deliver scalable, secure, resilient, and high-quality solutions.
  • Develop robust, tested, and fault-tolerant data engineering solutions while promoting engineering best practices and data governance.
  • Mentor junior engineers, contribute to knowledge sharing, and encourage the responsible use of approved AI tools and automation to improve collaboration and delivery.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong proficiency in Python, Scala, or Java with hands-on experience in Big Data technologies including Spark, Hadoop, or similar distributed processing frameworks.
  • Practical experience building real-time event streaming pipelines using technologies such as Kafka, Spark Streaming, or Amazon Kinesis within AWS environments.
  • Proven expertise designing modern Data Lakehouse and Data Warehousing architectures, alongside a solid understanding of CI/CD, DevOps practices, and GDPR-compliant data governance.
  • Experience delivering scalable cloud-based data solutions and using AI-enabled tools responsibly to improve engineering efficiency while maintaining appropriate human oversight and quality assurance.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams and client environments.

Bonus Points For

  • Expertise in data modelling, schema design, and working with structured and semi-structured datasets.
  • Experience with distributed technologies including Hadoop, Spark, HDFS, Hive, Databricks, or AWS Lake Formation.
  • Knowledge of automating cloud-based ingestion and transformation frameworks.
  • Experience delivering data engineering solutions within highly regulated industries such as financial services.
  • Passion for mentoring others, promoting engineering best practices, and exploring responsible AI and automation to continually improve delivery.

Why Join Capco

  • Deliver high-impact technology solutions for Tier 1 financial institutions.
  • Work in a collaborative, flat, and entrepreneurial consulting culture.
  • Access continuous learning, training, and industry certifications.
  • Be part of a team shaping the future of digital financial services.
  • Help shape the future of digital transformation across FS & Energy.

Benefits

We offer a competitive, people-first benefits package designed to support every aspect of your life:

  • Core Benefits: Discretionary bonus, competitive pension, health insurance, life insurance and critical illness cover.
  • Mental Health: Easy access to CareFirst, Unmind, Aviva consultations, and in-house first aiders.
  • Family-Friendly: Maternity, adoption, shared parental leave, plus paid leave for sickness, pregnancy loss, fertility treatment, menopause, and bereavement.
  • Family Care: Eight complimentary backup care sessions for emergency childcare or elder care.
  • Holiday Flexibility: Five weeks of annual leave with the option to buy or sell holiday days based on your needs.
  • Continuous Learning: Your growth, your way—minimum 40 hours of training annually through workshops, certifications, and e-learning. You'll also be assigned a Business Coach from day one to support your development and career progression.
  • Healthcare Access: Convenient online GP services.
  • Extra Perks: Wellhub (Gympass), travel insurance, Tastecard, season ticket loans, Cycle to Work, and dental insurance.

Inclusion at Capco

We’re committed to making our recruitment process accessible and straightforward for everyone. If you need any adjustments at any stage, just let us know—we’ll be happy to help. We value each person’s unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration—a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day.

#LI-DNI

title: Senior Data Engineer - Azure Cloud (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du willst in Microsoft Azure Datenplattformen bauen, die Unternehmens- und Maschinendaten unserer Kunden für Auswertungen und KI nutzbar machen – mit klarer Perspektive zum Principal Architect? Dann lies weiter.

Die KRALLMANN AG ist ein inhabergeführtes Familienunternehmen, 2006 gegründet von Prof. Dr. Hermann Krallmann, emeritiertem Professor der TU Berlin, der bis heute aktiv mitwirkt. Wir bieten Strategieberatung, KI-Beratung und -Implementierung, Business Process Management, Enterprise Architecture Management und Software-Engineering aus einer Hand – wissenschaftlich fundiert und als Partner in Forschungsverbundprojekten. Dabei verbinden wir die organisatorische, technische und psychosoziale Dimension, denn Veränderung gelingt nur, wenn die Menschen mitgehen.

Namhafte Kunden aus Logistik, Finanzen und Industrie begleiten wir als Partner über den gesamten Transformationszyklus, auch über den Go-Live hinaus. Wir hören zu und sprechen die Sprache unserer Kunden. Intern erwarten Dich flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein direkter Draht zum Gründer.

Für unser Team KI & Software Engineering suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die zentrale Datenplattformen in Microsoft Azure bei unseren Kunden konzipiert, aufbaut und fachlich verantwortet – von der Anbindung der Quellsysteme bis zum fertigen Dashboard. Typische Einsatzfelder liegen bei Kunden aus Logistik, Finanzen und Industrie, etwa die Zusammenführung von Unternehmens- und Maschinendaten auf einer gemeinsamen Plattform. Mit wachsender Erfahrung entwickelst Du Dich in der Fachlaufbahn zum Principal Architect Data & Cloud weiter.

Das sind Deine Aufgaben

  • Du konzipierst zentrale Datenplattformen in Microsoft Azure, baust sie auf und entwickelst sie weiter – fachlich verantwortlich gegenüber dem Kunden, eigenständig oder als Senior im Projektteam.

  • Du bindest Unternehmenssysteme und Maschinendaten über Schnittstellen an und modellierst die Daten so, dass sie für KI-Anwendungen, Auswertungen und Dashboards bereitstehen.

  • Du baust für unsere Kunden die Cloud-Infrastruktur mit Infrastructure as Code auf und automatisierst Bereitstellung und Betrieb über CI/CD.

  • Du setzt Sicherheit, Berechtigungen und Mandantentrennung um, sodass jede Nutzergruppe genau die Daten sieht, die sie sehen darf.

  • Du wirkst im Pre-Sales mit, baust Wissen im Team auf und entwickelst unser Daten- und Cloud-Angebot weiter.

Das bringst Du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Data Engineer in der Cloud (idealerweise 4+ Jahre), idealerweise in Microsoft Azure, mit sehr guten Kenntnissen in SQL und Python

  • Erfahrung mit Datenintegration über Schnittstellen sowie mit Datenmodellierung und Reporting, idealerweise mit Power BI

  • Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code und CI/CD sowie gute Kenntnisse in Cloud-Sicherheit und Berechtigungskonzepten, idealerweise mit Entra ID

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch (C1) für die Arbeit mit unseren Kunden

  • Den Wunsch, Dich in der Fachlaufbahn zum Principal Architect Data & Cloud weiterzuentwickeln

Das ist ein Plus

Kein Muss, aber ein Plus – wenn Du die Kriterien oben erfüllst, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung:

  • Praxis mit Microsoft Fabric – alternativ mit Azure Synapse oder Databricks und die Bereitschaft, auf Fabric umzusteigen

  • Grundlagen in Machine Learning

  • Erfahrung mit Maschinen- und IoT-Daten, z.B. über OPC UA, MQTT oder Azure IoT Hub

  • Branchenkenntnisse in Logistik, Finanzen oder Industrie

Das bieten wir

  • Gehalt und Vorsorge: Zielgehalt von 70.000–100.000 € brutto pro Jahr je nach Erfahrung, inklusive variabler Vergütung nach Projekt- und Unternehmenserfolg, plus betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit Arbeitgeberzuschuss

  • Karriere: Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad zum Principal Architect Data & Cloud mit transparenten Kriterien und regelmäßigen Entwicklungsgesprächen

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Du prägst Architektur und Vorgehen unserer Datenplattform-Projekte und hast echten Einfluss auf unser Daten- und Cloud-Angebot

  • Weiterbildung und Sichtbarkeit: Persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget, bezahlte Zertifizierungen (z.B. Microsoft Azure und Fabric) und Raum für Konferenzen, Fachbeiträge und Vorträge

  • Reisen: Bis zu 20 % Deiner Arbeitszeit beim Kunden vor Ort

  • Arbeitsort und Flexibilität: Büro in Berlin-Wilmersdorf (direkt an der U7/U9 Berliner Straße), plus ein Homeoffice-Tag pro Woche,

  • flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Arbeitszeitkonto, Voll- oder Teilzeit sowie bis zu 2 Wochen Workation pro Jahr im EU-Ausland

  • Urlaub, Ausstattung und Extras: 28 Tage Urlaub, Mac oder PC nach Wahl, Firmenmobiltelefon, Mobilitätszuschuss, flexible Benefits über ProBonio inklusive Gesundheit und Sport sowie regelmäßige Teamevents

Unsere Werte

Unser Markenkern: Partnerschaft. Ob mit Kunden, Kolleg:innen oder Forschungspartnern – wir arbeiten auf Augenhöhe und auf Dauer. Drei Werte machen das konkret:

Zuhören: Wir verstehen erst, dann gestalten wir. Wir sprechen die Sprache unserer Kunden und nehmen die Menschen mit – im Projekt wie im eigenen Team.

Substanz: Wir arbeiten wissenschaftlich fundiert, sorgfältig und technologisch auf der Höhe der Zeit. Wir empfehlen nur, was wir begründen können.

Verbindlichkeit: Wir übernehmen Verantwortung, als wäre es unser eigenes Unternehmen. Wir halten, was wir zusagen, und bleiben, wenn es darauf ankommt – beim Kunden über den Go-Live hinaus und füreinander im Team.

title: Senior Data Engineer - Cloud Transfo
descriptionHtml:
Chez MARGO, nos consultants travaillent sur ce qui compte vraiment : des projets complexes qui allient challenge intellectuel et impact business réel.
C’est pourquoi nous accompagnons les plus grands acteurs de la finance, de l’industrie et de la tech sur leurs projets les plus stratégiques en Data Science, Machine Learning et Intelligence Artificielle.

Vos missions

Nous recherchons un Senior Data Engineer pour participer à la construction d’une plateforme Data développée from scratch, destinée à des équipes travaillant sur des problématiques de recherche et de calcul intensif.

L’objectif de cette plateforme est de gérer l’ensemble du cycle de vie des données : ingestion, traitements distribués, backtesting à grande échelle et mise à disposition des données pour des usages de recherche et de production.

L’un des enjeux techniques majeurs du projet concerne le calcul distribué et l’intégration de Spark au cœur de l’architecture de la plateforme.

Dans ce contexte, vous interviendrez notamment sur :

title: Senior Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities.

With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte's Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we're one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

Role Overview

You will own the Hozah data platform. At its centre is the BigQuery and Dataform warehouse: you'll model raw data into the management-information measures and KPI views the business runs on, and build the Metabase dashboards on top of them. We run ELT on managed connectors, so ingestion is yours too, but it is mostly configuration rather than pipeline engineering. The Pub/Sub streams and the Terraform that provisions them stay with our engineering team, and you request and review those changes rather than write them. You are the person finance, operations and the wider business go to when they need to trust a number.

This role exists because the platform has outgrown what one person can carry alongside everything else. Demand for management information has grown faster than ad-hoc effort can keep up with, and the business needs numbers it does not have to double-check. We are hiring a senior engineer to take full ownership, make those numbers reliable, and build the dashboard layer the business runs on.

You'll work alongside backend engineers on the source systems that feed the warehouse, and directly with the CFO, COO, Client Service and the wider leadership team as the people who depend on what you build. This is a newly created role with no direct reports.

In your first quarter, you'll agree one new data capability with the CTO, and take it into production over your first year.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the Hozah data platform, from ingestion through to the dashboards the business relies on.

  • Take full ownership of the BigQuery and Dataform warehouse, including CI and the path a change takes from a branch to production.

  • Look after ingestion from source systems, mostly through managed tools such as Airbyte or Fivetran for SaaS connectors, alongside database replication and file loads.

  • Produce every department's KPIs from versioned, tested models, and deliver them on Metabase with no manual spreadsheet step in between.

  • Set and monitor freshness expectations for every ingested source, so a stale source alerts a named owner rather than surfacing in a board pack.

  • Work with the CFO, COO, CRO and other stakeholders to define and defend metric definitions, pushing back where a requested number would mislead.

  • Agree one new data capability with the CTO in your first quarter, then see it into production and adopted by a named business owner.

  • Be the platform's sole owner: triage issues, promote changes safely, and be the person the business trusts for numbers.

Who we're looking for

  • You've owned a data warehouse or platform alone, or as its lead, including being the one who fixes it when it breaks. You can say exactly what you were accountable for and what you personally changed.

  • You write deep SQL and model data properly on a cloud warehouse such as BigQuery or Snowflake, inside a versioned transformation framework such as Dataform or dbt, with CI around it. You can explain how you turned raw data into measures the business trusts, how a change gets from a branch to production, and what stops a bad one getting there.

  • You've made a disputed number trusted. You can walk through a specific incident from the last 12 months: how you found it, what the root cause was, and what now stops it happening again.

  • You work directly with non-technical stakeholders, and you've refused or reshaped a metric definition you thought was wrong. You can say what you said, and what happened next.

  • You've worked with at least one of change-data-capture or replication, SaaS connectors, or file loads, and know what tends to go wrong. Streaming experience is not required.

  • You've built the analytics layer yourself for business users (the measures, KPI views and dashboards), not just fed the data underneath it. You can describe something you built that changed a decision.

  • You've shipped one new data capability end to end, whether that's a machine learning model in production, a near real-time feed or a new data product. You can say who used it and whether it stuck.

  • You're comfortable setting your own priorities in a fast-moving SME, and you're happy being the only data person in the company.

  • Experience of GCP itself, Terraform, streaming, Kotlin or another JVM language, or Metabase is welcome, but none of it is required.

What We Offer

  • Hybrid working, 3 days in the office and 2 days from home.

  • Sole ownership of the data platform, reporting directly to the CTO.

  • The chance to build Hozah's data function from a working base as we scale.

  • A strong, high performing culture, with genuine influence over how that culture develops as Hozah grows.

  • A fully refurbished, modern office, right next to East Croydon Station (with a fully stocked kitchen, offering free breakfast, lunch and drinks!).

Job title: Senior Data Engineer

Department: Data team

Location: Paris, France

Contract: Permanent, local and full-time

PUR Description

PUR is a global B Corp helping companies act for climate, nature and people through nature-based projects.

Since 2008, we have worked with leading companies to restore ecosystems, support farmers and communities, and build more resilient supply chains. Our projects include agroforestry, regenerative agriculture, reforestation, and ecosystem restoration, across more than 30 countries.

We work closely with local partners, farmers, cooperatives, NGOs and businesses to design projects that are adapted to each landscape and community. This local approach is key to creating long-term impact — for the climate, biodiversity, soil, water, and livelihoods.

Today, PUR has more than 200 team members across 16 countries, with key offices in Paris and Toronto. As the world faces growing climate and biodiversity challenges, PUR is helping global companies move from ambition to action.

About the role

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data processing solutions that power analytics, reporting, and data-driven decision making. You will play a key role in transforming raw project data into reliable, high-quality datasets through robust ETL processes, modern data architectures, and Python-based engineering practices.

Working closely with business and technical stakeholders, you will ensure that data is accessible, trustworthy, and aligned with analytical requirements while contributing to the continuous improvement of our data platform and cloud-based ecosystem.

Your responsibilities will be, but not limited to:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Python.

  • Build and optimize data ingestion, transformation, and validation processes for large datasets.

  • Design and maintain data models supporting reporting, analytics, and business applications.

  • Implement and monitor data quality controls to ensure reliability and accuracy.

  • Manage and optimize workflows using orchestration tools such as Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster.

  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of cloud-based data platforms (preferably Azure).

  • Support CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and infrastructure-as-code practices (Terraform).

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and reliable data solutions.

  • Maintain technical documentation and promote data engineering best practices.


We are looking for someone with:

  • 3-5 years of experience in Data Engineering, with strong Python skills and experience building production-grade ETL pipelines.

  • Strong SQL expertise and solid understanding of relational and analytical databases, data modeling, and data warehousing concepts.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools (Airflow, Prefect, Dagster) and implementing automated testing for data pipelines.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably Azure) and Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform is a strong plus).

  • Familiarity with AI tools (Claude is a plus).

  • Strong knowledge of Git and software engineering best practices.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills, focus on data quality and reliability, and ability to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Fluent English with strong written and verbal communication skills.

  2. Interview with the manager and case study

title: Senior Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

The Role

We're hiring a Senior Data Engineer.

Data sits at the core of what tem does. Our time-series data is the spine that runs from pricing through to billing: every transaction depends on it working. You'll be working across a genuinely varied set of workloads: textual data, time-series data, and event streams, each with its own ingestion and reliability challenges, including TSDS.

You'll join our Data Service team of 4, owning the design, reliability, and recovery strategy of specific ingestion pipelines and systems end-to-end. This is an individual contributor role: no team to manage, full ownership of the work you do. The team has more work than hands right now, and this role exists to close that gap so the business can move faster on the data it depends on.

You'll also work closely with our AI initiatives as they grow: the platform you own increasingly becomes the foundation those efforts depend on.

You will:

  • Own the design, reliability, and recovery strategy for the ingestion pipelines and systems in your domain.

  • Maintain and improve the data platform, including working through the existing tech debt backlog.

  • Build monitoring and alerting so issues surface before they become incidents.

  • Set the data quality checks that make an SLA commitment possible, and hold the line on them.

  • Help take the number of data products with a defined SLA from 2 to 10.

Responsibilities

Data Ingestion

  • Own the design, reliability, and resilience of ingestion pipelines end-to-end, including TSDS, with a clear recovery strategy when things break.

  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines for new and existing data sources.

  • Decide the right approach (batch vs. streaming) for each pipeline in your domain, including high-scale, low-latency requirements for time-series data.

  • Set data quality checks that make an SLA commitment possible, and hold the line on them.

Platform Maintenance

  • Own the day-to-day reliability of the data platform: monitoring, testing, and fixing issues before they become firefights.

  • Own code quality and standards for the systems you're responsible for, including CI checks (linting, tests, coverage).

  • Work through the existing tech debt backlog, prioritising fixes that unblock SLA commitments.

  • Optimise pipelines for performance and cost as data volumes grow.

  • Handle the failure modes specific to energy data: late arrivals, reprocessing, backfills.

Monitoring & Alerting

  • Build and improve observability across your systems so problems surface before they cause downstream impact.

  • Set up alerting tied to the SLAs the team is committing to.

  • Investigate and resolve issues within your domain, escalating genuinely cross-system problems.

Supporting Expansion

  • Help scope and prepare the platform for new data sources tied to international expansion.

  • Flag where current architecture won't hold up as scope grows, even if fixing it isn't your call to make alone.

  • Work closely with the AI team as their data needs on the platform grow.

Requirements

Must haves

  • Strong Python skills, with proven experience building and maintaining production data pipelines.

  • Experience owning the design, reliability, and resilience of a data pipeline or system end-to-end, not just writing pipeline code.

  • AWS or GCP experience.

  • Great communication skills, comfortable working directly with stakeholders to scope and agree SLAs, and explaining technical trade-offs to non-technical audiences.

  • Strong team player, comfortable working independently against a backlog and making judgement calls on prioritisation, while fitting into an existing team of 4.

  • Terraform experience.

Bonus points

  • Experience with time-series data at scale.

  • Experience with modern data stack tooling (Airflow, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, ClickHouse).

  • Experience in energy or climate tech.

  • Background in high-growth startups or scale-ups.

  • Genuine interest in how AI tooling and workflows intersect with data engineering.

We're open to someone who doesn't tick every box here, as long as they bring solid AWS or GCP experience and the ability to own their own work end-to-end.

Benefits & Perks

  • Salary aligned to internal benchmarks and reviewed twice a year.

  • Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off.

  • Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

Home working and wellbeing budgets:

  • Up to GBP1,200 or EUR1,200 per year for your remote setup.

  • Up to GBP150 or EUR150 per month for wellbeing.

Interview Process

We move fast. Most processes take 2 to 3 weeks from first chat to offer. If you need us to adapt anything, let us know.

  • Intro call with Talent, 30 minutes.

  • Behavioural interview, 60 minutes.

  • Skills interview with cross-functional leaders, 60 to 90 minutes, including a practical exercise.

  • Bar Raiser interview with leadership stakeholders, 45 minutes.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

descriptionHtml:
About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

The role

We are looking for a curious engineering mind to lead the scaling of Orakl’s omics data within the Computational Biology team.

Every organoid grown in our lab is sequenced (WGS and RNA-seq). Our pipelines turn the raw reads into processed molecular profiles, and our models turn those profiles into clinical trial predictions, patient segments and new target candidates. Your mission will be to make omics data available to computational biologists and research engineers in a form they can build on. You will gather their needs and, in coordination with the Data & Infra team, design the data representations, storage layouts and access patterns that make model training and experimentation fast and reproducible. As our biobank expands, this will become a massive omics corpus that must efficiently serve client contracts, strategic partnerships and internal R&D projects.

Starting from processed omics data, you will assess how it is stored and served today, propose solutions to scale it, and drive their implementation, so our scientists and models can rely on it. You will build this hand in hand with our data engineering team, keeping our omics infrastructure consistent with the rest of the company’s stack. You will report to the Head of Computational Biology.

Experience with omics data is a strong plus, not a prerequisite. If you come from the conventional tabular data world and want to master data that is massive, multi-layered and regularly reprocessed, this role is built for you.

What you will do

  • Design and build the omics data architecture. Together with our data engineering team, define and evolve how omics data is stored as the corpus grows: what lives in a database, what stays in columnar files on S3, and how it all fits the company’s stack.

  • Guarantee reliable ingestion. Make sure every new batch of processed omics data (variant calls, expression, CNV, QC metrics, sample and sequencing tracking) lands reliably and consistently with our data model definition.

  • Build and maintain the omics data model. Maintain a curated reference layer as the single source of truth, keep model-ready datasets derived from it separate, and track lineage between the two so every model input can be traced back to its source.

  • Make the data easy to use. Build and evolve the access layer so scientists and models get what they need for client contracts, strategic partnerships and internal R&D, without writing joins or asking someone.

What you bring

Must-haves

  • 4+ years as a data engineer, with ingestion pipelines you built running in production.

  • Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering (or equivalent experience)

  • Hands-on experience setting up and maintaining CI/CD for data pipelines and code libraries.

  • Strong data modeling experience: you have designed schemas that handle evolving identifiers, versioning and lineage.

  • Deep relational database expertise: schema design, partitioning, indexing, query plans, migrations on a live database.

  • Deep cloud infrastructure skills: AWS (S3 and core services), infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent) and containers (Docker), with sound judgment on what belongs in a database and what stays in files.

  • Strong experience in Python and SQL; comfortable with Git, CI and the command line.

  • You can propose architecture choices, defend them and converge with engineering peers.

  • A real drive to understand omics, including how our data is processed, so you can step in for our Senior Bioinformatician when they are away.

Nice-to-haves

  • Omics experience: you have loaded VCF/MAF files or expression matrices. Familiarity with Nextflow / nf-core pipelines.

  • Columnar formats and engines (Parquet, Arrow, DuckDB) and an orchestrator (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect).

  • Metabase or another BI layer on top of a relational database.

  • LIMS or biobank sample-tracking integration.

  • A tech-bio background, or prior work next to bioinformaticians.

What we offer

  • Mission: work in a cutting-edge environment, on the forefront of cancer research.

  • Role: be the engineer behind the data backbone of a distinctive oncology discovery platform — designing, with our data engineering team, how one of the world’s rarest PDO multi-omics and functional datasets is stored, served and scaled, so that scientists and models can build on it every day.

  • Impact: take ownership of a critical piece of an early-stage, fast-moving company, with the opportunity to shape it; your engineering decisions will carry through to our science and, ultimately, to patient outcomes.

  • Team: join a collaborative, multidisciplinary team where you’ll work alongside stellar clinicians, biologists, and engineers towards a common mission.

Interview Process

  1. Hiring Manager Call: Getting to know each other, aligning on expectations and context.

  2. Technical Deep Dive: A deep conversation on your experience with production data pipelines, data modeling, and scientific data processing.

  3. Technical Case: A system-design and problem-solving exercise representative of the real wet-lab data challenges you'll face at Orakl.

  4. Reference Call: A conversation with one or two people you've worked with closely.

  5. Founder Interview: A final discussion with our founders on vision, culture fit, and mutual ambitions.
