title: Senior Data Scientist — Data Cloud Acceleration
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE 

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.

About the team 

The Data Cloud Acceleration team identifies gaps and opportunities across clients and business units, then moves quickly to deliver practical new capabilities. We often develop and deploy the first version of a model, workflow, dataset, or application in days or weeks, learn from real usage, and improve it iteratively. 

We are business-minded technologists who care more about impact than technical novelty. We use sophisticated methods when the problem requires them and simpler approaches when they will deliver a better result faster. Our work should be predictable, demoable, trusted, reusable, measured, and amplified by AI. 

About the role 

The Senior Data Scientist will build models, analyses, and supporting ML components that improve business decisions, intelligence products, and client outcomes. You will independently own defined deliverables—from understanding the requirement and preparing the data through modeling, validation, documentation, and delivery. 

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will work across varied revenue and intelligence initiatives, often in partnership with a Lead Data Scientist, application engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders. The right candidate can move quickly without sacrificing trustworthiness and knows how to balance statistical rigor with the practical needs of the business. 

What you’ll do

  • Own model and analysis deliverables. Take a defined business problem and independently deliver a reliable model, analysis component, scoring workflow, or supporting dataset.  

  • Translate business questions into analytical approaches. Ask clarifying questions, understand how the output will be used, and recommend an approach that fits the decision, timeline, and available data.  

  • Build and test models quickly. Develop practical solutions using statistical methods, machine learning, deep learning, or existing models and services where appropriate.  

  • Prepare trustworthy data. Profile, cleanse, join, and validate noisy datasets while checking completeness, freshness, distributions, nulls, duplicates, and match rates.  

  • Create repeatable scoring workflows. Move useful work beyond the notebook by building reusable Python components, batch-scoring processes, APIs, or lightweight services.  

  • Evaluate results responsibly. Establish baselines, select appropriate metrics, perform statistical reasonableness checks, reconcile unexpected results, and clearly document limitations.  

  • Support intelligence products and applications. Work with application and data teams to define the right data ingredients, test hypotheses, and integrate model outputs into usable experiences.  

  • Add operational discipline. Include validation, monitoring, failure handling, refresh expectations, documentation, and a clear usage path in delivered work.  

  • Use AI to improve your own productivity. Apply tools such as Claude, Codex, and similar assistants to accelerate coding, testing, research, debugging, and documentation while independently verifying the results.  

  • Communicate progress early and clearly. Make milestones, assumptions, risks, dependencies, and issues visible rather than waiting until delivery.  

What ownership looks like at this level

You are expected to own the deliverable. That means: 

  • Working independently on a well-defined model, workflow, dataset, or component  

  • Producing reliable and repeatable outputs rather than one-time analyses  

  • Adding appropriate validation and basic monitoring  

  • Documenting assumptions, methodology, limitations, and usage  

  • Demonstrating the output and explaining how it supports the business  

  • Raising risks and ambiguity early  

  • Leaving the work in a condition that another team member can operate or extend  

You will receive guidance on broader product direction, methodology, and complex stakeholder decisions, but you should not require step-by-step direction to complete the work. 

Experience that can set you up for success

These are useful indicators rather than absolute requirements: 

  • Experience applying statistical analysis and machine learning to real business problems  

  • Strong Python skills and familiarity with libraries such as pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch, or TensorFlow  

  • Strong SQL skills and experience analyzing large datasets  

  • Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Athena, Hive, BigQuery, or similar technologies  

  • Experience developing classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, recommendation, optimization, or anomaly-detection solutions  

  • Familiarity with model evaluation, experimental design, feature engineering, and statistical validation  

  • Experience creating repeatable batch-scoring workflows or exposing model outputs through APIs or services  

  • Familiarity with orchestration and automation tools such as Airflow, AWS Glue, Prefect, or similar platforms  

  • Experience using version control, testing, and reproducible development practices  

  • Ability to explain analytical results and trade-offs to technical and nontechnical stakeholders  

  • Meaningful use of GenAI tools to improve the speed and quality of day-to-day work  

You’ll thrive here if you 

  • Are pragmatic. You select the simplest credible approach that can deliver useful business impact.  

  • Move quickly with discipline. You can produce an initial version rapidly while still validating the fundamentals.  

  • Care about trust. You check the data, question surprising results, and make limitations visible.  

  • Work well with ambiguity. You can turn an incomplete request into a clear set of questions, assumptions, and next steps.  

  • Think beyond the notebook. You consider how a model will be refreshed, accessed, demonstrated, monitored, and reused.  

  • Understand the business context. You evaluate technical decisions through the lens of client outcomes, revenue, cost, adoption, and decision quality.  

  • Are curious and low-ego. You are comfortable learning from others, revising an approach, and using an existing solution when it is better than building a new one.  

Early indicators of success 

Within the first several months, a successful candidate will have: 

  • Independently delivered a model, analysis workflow, or scoring component used in an active business or intelligence initiative  

  • Added repeatable validation and documentation to their deliverables  

  • Converted at least one exploratory analysis or prototype into a reusable workflow  

  • Demonstrated clear understanding of how their work supports a client, product, revenue, or operational outcome  

  • Used AI-assisted development to improve delivery speed without compromising accuracy or trust  

  • Earned confidence from data science, application, and business partners through reliable execution and clear communication 

BENEFITS & PERKS

  • Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage

PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA

Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.  

We’re committed to building a workplace culture of trust and belonging, so everyone feels invited to bring their whole selves to work. We provide a forum for employees to celebrate, support and advocate for one another. We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

 

About the team

 

Our Public Services Business Unit is committed to leveraging AI for the benefit of individual citizens and the public good.

From our work informing strategic government decisions, to optimising our NHS, through to reducing bureaucratic backlogs - we know that AI offers opportunities to drive improvements at every level of Government and we are proud to lead on some of the most impactful work happening in the sector.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work on site with these clients from time to time.

  

About the role

 

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will lead high-impact AI projects and shape the technical direction of bespoke solutions. This role requires hands-on technical excellence combined with crucial team leadership.


You will define data science approaches, design robust software architectures, mentor junior colleagues, and ensure delivery rigour across projects all while building deep client relationships and solidifying our reputation as a leader in practical, measurable AI.

#LI-PRIO

  

What you'll be doing:

 

  • Leading project teams that deliver bespoke algorithms and high-stakes AI solutions to clients across the sector.

  • Conceiving the core data science approach and designing the associated robust software architecture for new engagements.

  • Mentoring a small number of data scientists and supporting the professional growth of technical team members on projects.

  • Partnering with commercial teams to build client relationships and shape project scope for technical feasibility.

  • Contributing to Faculty’s thought leadership and reputation through delivering courses, public speaking, or open-source projects.

  • Ensuring best practices are followed throughout the project lifecycle to guarantee high-quality, impactful delivery.

     

Who we're looking for:

 

  • You possess senior experience in a professional data science position or a quantitative academic field.

  • You demonstrate strong programming skills, with the ability to be a fluent Python programmer, using core libraries (NumPy, Pandas) and a deep-learning framework (e.g., PyTorch).

  • You have a deep expertise in core data science paradigms (supervised/unsupervised, NLP, validation), demonstrating a proficiency across the standard data science toolkit, including the ability to develop new, innovative algorithms.

  • You bring a leadership mindset, focused on growing the technical capabilities of the team and nurturing a collaborative culture.

  • You exhibit commercial awareness, with experience in client-facing work and the ability to translate business problems into a rigorous mathematical framework.

  • You are skilled in project planning, assessing technical feasibility, estimating delivery timelines, and leading a team to deliver high-quality work on a strict schedule.

 

Our Interview Process

 

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Take Home Technical Assessment

  3. Technical Interview (90 minutes)

  4. Commercial Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

title: Senior Data Scientist/ML Ops Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Responsibilities

With a mission to empower 15.6 million house owners across Germany and the broader DACH region, we at Aroundhome are building a platform where every strategic decision is powered by data. We’re a team of around 250 people, and to take the next step, we’re looking for an experienced and hands-on Senior Data Scientist (all genders) to bring machine learning into the heart of our product.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will build Aroundhome’s first machine learning model in production: the logic that decides which partners each homeowner is matched with. You will start from the problems homeowners and partners actually have, and own the solution end to end, in a small new team with a product manager, an engineer and the team lead.

Responsibilities:

  • Start from the Customer: Understand what homeowners and partners need from a match, and turn that into the outcomes and guardrails your models optimize for, not just model metrics.
  • Own Our Matching Models: Build and run the models behind our partner matching, end to end: data, features, training, evaluation, deployment and monitoring.
  • Make Every Match Count: Improve our matching logic with deployed models that make the most efficient use of partner capacity, raise match rates, and account for regional supply and demand.
  • Prove Impact: Measure every improvement against our current logic in controlled experiments designed for a two-sided marketplace, before it scales.
  • Build the Data Foundation: Create the datasets and pipelines your models need, together with our engineer and the Data Engineering team. In the first months, this is a big part of the role.
  • Shape Our ML Stack: Decide with the team how and where models run, and set the practices for machine learning at Aroundhome.
  • Translate Models into Decisions: Explain trade-offs between customer experience, partner fulfillment and revenue to product managers, partner category managers, key account managers and senior leadership.

Skills

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics).
  • Proven experience (5+ years) in applied data science, including at least one ads, ranking, pricing or marketplace model you took to production.
  • Production-grade Python and advanced SQL, plus hands-on experience with modern data tooling (e.g., dbt, Airflow, Spark).
  • Experience deploying and monitoring models on a cloud ML platform (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI, MLflow).
  • Solid foundation in experiment design and causal inference, ideally in a marketplace where test and control groups affect each other.
  • Hands-on experience with classical machine learning (e.g., gradient-boosted trees), probability calibration and offline vs online evaluation.
  • A product mindset: you define success in homeowner and partner outcomes, challenge assumptions with evidence, and add complexity only where it earns its place.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain models and trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A plus: experience with recommender systems or search ranking.

What we offer

Hybrid Work // Stay flexible: Decide freely whether you want to work from our office in Berlin, from home throughout Germany, or fully remote from Portugal. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries.

Room to grow // Stay curious: In regular/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. In addition, we offer monthly Tech Talks, an annual training budget, free access to LinkedIn Learning as well as great workshops to seek new input and specific training for your personal development.

Mental & physical health // Stay healthy & active: We care about your well-being and support your health with a discounted membership at Urban Sports Club. In addition, our cooperation partner “Fürstenberg Institute” is available to you and your family members with advice and support when it comes to mental health & coaching.

Taking responsibility // We #care: We care for our planet and the people who are living on it. To make our world a little bit better, our ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) promotes our awareness for environmentally friendly behavior. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back.

Teamspirit // Stay connected: What drives us is our sense of community. That's why we celebrate our Company Day once a month at our Potsdamer Platz office, where everyone gets together in person. In addition to a comprehensive update of our C-Board, the main focus is on togetherness and the exchange of ideas over lunch and dinner together.

title: Senior Database Engineer (Oracle/PostgreSQL), 80–100 %
descriptionHtml:
Im Auftrag unseres Kunden Concordia AG suchen wir einen Senior Database Engineer (Oracle/PostgreSQL), 80–100 %

Werde Teil eines erfahrenen Teams, das gemeinsam eine moderne, skalierbare Datenbank- und Infrastrukturplattform gestaltet und betreibt. Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung, gestaltest Architektur‑Entscheide und bringst eigene Ideen ein.

Das erwartet dich

  • Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit dem Team den stabilen Betrieb, das Engineering und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Oracle- und PostgreSQL-Datenbankplattform sowohl im Daily Business als auch in Projekten und Releases.
  • Du arbeitest an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Datenbank- und Data-Warehouse-Plattformen, bei der Migration von Oracle nach PostgreSQL und beim Ausbau unserer Datenbankplattformen in der Azure Cloud.
  • Du unterstützt das Team bei der Automatisierung, Performance-Analyse, Scripting, Monitoring und Logging.
  • Infrastructure as Code ist fester Bestandteil unserer Arbeitsweise: Du entwickelst unsere Automatisierung und Infrastruktur-Standards aktiv weiter. Gemeinsam treiben wir Themen wie deklarative Infrastruktur, versionierte Changes und reproduzierbare Deployments voran – mit Tools wie Ansible, Terraform und CI/CD Pipelines.
  • Du unterstützt die Weiterentwicklung unseres Data Warehouse mit GoldenGate und DataHub und trägst dazu bei, manuelle Prozesse weiter zu automatisieren.
  • Austausch und Weiterentwicklung sind uns wichtig: Du hast regelmässig die Möglichkeit, User Groups und Hersteller-Events zu besuchen.
  • Dich erwartet ein starkes Team: 3 weitere DBAs und 8 Linux Engineers arbeiten mit engem technischem Austausch und kurzen Entscheidungswegen zusammen.
  • Wir sprechen CH-Mundart & Deutsch und sind mindestens 3 Tage pro Woche im Büro Luzern.
  • Du arbeitest in einem selbstorganisierten Umfeld mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum, Flexibilität, Eigenverantwortung und Vertrauen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Betrieb und Engineering von Oracle oder PostgreSQL Datenbanken.
  • Begeisterung für moderne Plattform- und Cloud-Technologien.
  • Erfahrung in der Automatisierung (z. B. Bash, Python, Ansible) und Freude daran, Dinge nachhaltig zu verbessern.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (Firmensprache) sowie die Fähigkeit, englische Dokumentationen sicher zu verstehen.

Nice to have / Dein Entwicklungspotenzial

  • Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD und deklarativen Systemen.
  • Automatisierung mit Ansible Automation Platform, GitHub Actions oder Chef.
  • Infrastruktur-Provisionierung mit Terraform (On-Prem & Azure).

Darum CONCORDIA

Als Expertin für Gesundheit setzt sich die CONCORDIA für ein Arbeitsumfeld ein, in dem sich Mitarbeitende wohlfühlen und verwirklichen können. Es ist geprägt von abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben, vielseitigen Teams und einem familiären Umgang. Zudem motivieren wir unsere Mitarbeitenden, sich weiterzuentwickeln und voranzukommen. Menschen, die Spass an der Arbeit haben und beruflich vorwärtskommen wollen, finden bei uns, was sie suchen: Jobs, die zu 100 % gesund sind.

Deine Vorteile

  • Arbeitszeit: Du hast eine 41-Stunden-Woche und kannst Teilzeit oder flexibel arbeiten. Für ausgewählte Tätigkeiten kannst du regelmässig von zu Hause aus arbeiten.
  • Familienfreundlich: Voller Lohn während 14 Mutterschaftswochen. Zusatzbeiträge zu Kinder- und Ausbildungszulagen. Bis zu 90 % Kostenübernahme für die Fremdbetreuung deiner Kinder.

Ausgezeichnet von den Mitarbeitenden

Im Jahr 2020 holten wir uns dann sogar den ersten Platz in der Kategorie für grosse Unternehmen mit mehr als 1000 Mitarbeitenden und im Jahr 2022 wurden wir mit dem zweiten Platz ausgezeichnet. title: Senior Databasebeheerder (deeltijd 16 uur)
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij een ervaren databasespecialist die zijn technische expertise wil inzetten voor complexe vraagstukken en de verdere ontwikkeling van een modern dataplatform? Wil je bijdragen aan veilige, betrouwbare en toekomstbestendige databasediensten binnen een maatschappelijke organisatie, maar zoek je bewust een functie voor 16 uur per week? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou.

Waar jij het verschil maakt

Als Senior Database Specialist versterk je ons team met specialistische kennis van Microsoft SQL Server en PostgreSQL. Je richt je vooral op complexe technische vraagstukken, verbeteringen en vernieuwing. De dagelijkse operatie ligt bij het team; jij helpt juist daar waar extra expertise, verdieping of richting nodig is.

Onze databasediensten vormen een belangrijk onderdeel van de technische infrastructuur van het CBS. Beschikbaarheid, performance, veiligheid en continuïteit zijn daarbij essentieel. Tegelijkertijd ontwikkelen we onze dienstverlening verder door meer te automatiseren, nieuwe databaseservices te onderzoeken en onze infrastructuur verder te moderniseren.

Met jouw ervaring help je het team bij vraagstukken die verder gaan dan het dagelijkse beheer. Je analyseert complexe problemen, adviseert over technische keuzes en helpt structurele verbeteringen te realiseren. Daarbij werk je zowel met onze bestaande MSSQL- en PostgreSQL-omgevingen als aan de ontwikkeling van toekomstige databasediensten.

Omdat je 16 uur per week werkt, ligt de nadruk op werkzaamheden waarvoor jouw senior expertise de meeste waarde toevoegt:

  • analyseren en oplossen van complexe vraagstukken rondom MSSQL en PostgreSQL, waaronder performance, troubleshooting en database-optimalisatie;

  • adviseren over databasearchitectuur, high availability, disaster recovery, lifecycle management en de verwerking van grote hoeveelheden data;

  • initiëren en uitvoeren van structurele technische verbeteringen en bijdragen aan upgrades, migraties en automatisering van databasewerkzaamheden;

  • bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van nieuwe databasediensten, waaronder Database as a Service en toekomstige technologieën zoals graphdatabases;

  • meedenken over de verdere modernisering van het platform, waaronder containerisatie, Docker, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code en CI/CD;

  • verbeteren van monitoring, logging, capaciteitsbeheer, back-up- en restorevoorzieningen, encryptie, autorisaties en informatiebeveiliging en jouw kennis delen met collega’s en andere technische specialisten.

Je toekomstige collega's

Je komt te werken in Team Data & Webdiensten van de afdeling Generieke Infrastructuur (IGI). De afdeling bestaat uit ongeveer 30 IT-professionals die werkzaam zijn vanuit Heerlen en Den Haag. Het Team Data & Webdiensten bestaat uit ongeveer 15 collega’s.

Binnen het team werken we Agile in combinatie met ITIL. We gebruiken Azure DevOps om het werk inzichtelijk te maken en werken met stories en epics. Ook nemen we deel aan vaste momenten zoals dagstarts, planningen, reviews en retrospectives.

Met 16 uur per week maak je volwaardig onderdeel uit van het team, maar verwachten we niet dat je iedere operationele taak oppakt. In overleg bepalen we waar jouw expertise het meeste verschil kan maken. Je werkt daardoor nauw samen met de collega’s die dagelijks verantwoordelijk zijn voor de databasediensten en ondersteunt hen bij complexere technische vraagstukken en ontwikkelingen.
We werken met collega’s op verschillende locaties en vanuit verschillende specialismen. Kennisdeling, samenwerking en plezier in het werk vinden we belangrijk.

Dit ben jij

Je bent een ervaren databasespecialist die snel tot de kern van een technisch vraagstuk komt. Je hoeft niet voortdurend bij de dagelijkse operatie betrokken te zijn om te begrijpen wat er speelt en bent in staat om binnen je beschikbare tijd duidelijke prioriteiten te stellen.

Je combineert diepgaande databasekennis met een bredere blik op infrastructuur, automatisering en security. Je denkt niet alleen in tijdelijke oplossingen, maar zoekt naar structurele verbeteringen die ook op langere termijn waarde toevoegen.

Daarnaast kun je jouw technische afwegingen helder uitleggen. Je werkt gemakkelijk samen met andere technische disciplines, deelt je kennis en kunt collega’s adviseren zonder het werk van hen over te nemen.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • hbo-werk- en denkniveau en meerdere jaren relevante ervaring met het ontwerpen, beheren en optimaliseren van databaseomgevingen;

  • aantoonbare en diepgaande ervaring met Microsoft SQL Server en PostgreSQL, waaronder performance tuning, troubleshooting, back-up/restore en high availability;

  • ervaring met Windows- en Linux-serveromgevingen en automatisering met bijvoorbeeld PowerShell, Bash en/of Python;

  • kennis van databasebeveiliging, waaronder encryptie, autorisaties, informatiebeveiliging en compliance;

  • kennis van Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD en DevOps-werkwijzen en bij voorkeur ervaring met Infrastructure as Code, bijvoorbeeld Ansible;

  • kennis van ITIL-processen, sterke analytische en communicatieve vaardigheden en een proactieve houding gericht op kennisdeling en continue verbetering.

Certificeringen op het gebied van Microsoft SQL Server en/of PostgreSQL zijn een pré.

Feitelijk goed geregeld

Voor onze arbeidsvoorwaarden volgen wij de CAO Rijk. Dat betekent dat je onder andere kunt rekenen op het volgende:

  • Een salaris van minimaal € 4132,- en maximaal € 6275,- bruto per maand op basis van 36 uur. Afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring. Als je bij de start van je functie nog niet over alle benodigde kennis en ervaring beschikt, kan worden gekozen voor tijdelijke inschaling in een lagere salarisschaal. Hierover maak je bij de start van je functie afspraken met je leidinggevende.

  • 8% vakantiegeld en een 13e maand. In totaal is dit 16,5% bovenop je salaris. Dit noemen wij het Individueel Keuze Budget (IKB). Je bepaalt zelf hoe, wanneer en op welke manier je dit budget wilt inzetten.

  • Pensioenopbouw bij het ABP Pensioenfonds.

  • Een laptop (Microsoft of Apple) en mobiele telefoon (Android of iOS).

  • Twee tot drie dagen thuiswerken, de rest ben je aanwezig in ons onlangs gerenoveerde gebouw. In je team maak je daar verder afspraken over.

Kom werken aan de feiten

We sluiten de vacature bij voldoende kandidaten.

title: Senior Delivery Manager, WebShop
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT YOU

Xsolla is looking for a Senior Delivery Manager to help bring greater clarity, coordination, and operational discipline across our product development teams.

This role sits at the center of product execution, working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Analytics, Marketing, and other Delivery Managers to ensure teams are aligned on priorities, dependencies, timelines, and changes.

The Senior Delivery Manager will own the operating rhythm of the team: maintaining the backlog and roadmap, running engineering ceremonies, surfacing risks and blockers, and ensuring that changes are communicated clearly—not just what is changing, but why.

Beyond day-to-day delivery, this person will also play an important role in identifying broader operational challenges and working with leadership to improve how the team plans, communicates, prioritizes, and executes.

ABOUT US Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game. For more information, visit xsolla.com.
Key Responsibilities

Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Analytics, Marketing, Project Managers, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment across initiatives.

  • Maintain visibility into dependencies, timelines, priorities, and risks across teams.

  • Proactively identify areas where teams are becoming misaligned and drive the conversations necessary to resolve them.

  • Ensure stakeholders understand both what the team is doing and how individual activities connect to broader product and business priorities.

    • Team Execution & Scrum

  • Run and facilitate engineering scrum ceremonies, including stand-ups, sprint planning, refinement, retrospectives, and other working sessions as needed.

  • Ensure teams leave meetings with clear decisions, owners, and next steps.

  • Track blockers and risks through resolution rather than simply documenting them.

  • Help create a predictable and effective operating cadence between Product and Engineering.

    • Backlog & Roadmap Management

  • Build, maintain, and continuously improve the team backlog and roadmap in partnership with Product and Engineering leadership.

  • Ensure work is clearly prioritized, appropriately structured, and visible to stakeholders.

  • Maintain clarity between committed roadmap work, future opportunities, operational improvements, and unscheduled backlog items.

  • Identify dependencies, sequencing challenges, and resource conflicts before they become delivery issues.

    • Change Management & Communication

  • Communicate changes to priorities, timelines, scope, and direction clearly and proactively.

  • Help teams understand the why behind changes so that Engineers, Designers, and other stakeholders have the context necessary to make better decisions.

  • Ensure important decisions and changes are documented and communicated consistently across impacted teams.

  • Help reduce confusion caused by fragmented or inconsistent communication.

    • Operational Improvement

  • Identify recurring execution challenges, process breakdowns, organizational friction, and operational gaps.

  • Work with leadership to understand root causes and define strategies for addressing them.

  • Translate operational strategies into actionable improvements for the team.

  • Continuously evaluate how planning, prioritization, communication, and execution processes can be improved.

  • Encourage accountability across teams and help ensure problems are driven toward resolution rather than passed between functions.


    • What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means teams have greater clarity and predictability in how they operate.

    The right candidate will help create an environment where:

  • Teams understand what the highest priorities are and why.

  • Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, and Marketing remain aligned as plans evolve.

  • Roadmaps and backlogs accurately reflect the work of the team.

  • Risks and dependencies are surfaced early rather than discovered late.

  • Changes are communicated clearly and with appropriate context.

  • Meetings result in decisions and action rather than additional ambiguity.

  • Operational problems are identified proactively and systematically improved.

  • Leadership has confidence in the team’s ability to execute against its commitments.


    • Skills & Experience

    Strong Communication

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

  • Able to communicate effectively across technical, product, creative, and business teams.

  • Comfortable facilitating discussions involving competing priorities or viewpoints.

  • Able to simplify complex situations and provide teams with clear direction and context.

    • Highly Organized

  • Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives, dependencies, stakeholders, and timelines simultaneously.

  • Strong attention to detail while maintaining awareness of broader strategic priorities.

  • Comfortable creating structure in environments where processes or responsibilities may not yet be clearly defined.

    • Diligent & Proactive

  • Does not wait for problems to become urgent before addressing them.

  • Proactively identifies risks, gaps, dependencies, and areas of confusion.

  • Consistently follows through on decisions, commitments, and open items.

  • Takes ownership of driving issues toward resolution.

    • Strategic & Operational Thinking

  • Able to distinguish between isolated execution problems and broader systemic challenges.

  • Comfortable working with leadership to improve how teams operate.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to identify root causes rather than treating symptoms.

  • Able to balance immediate delivery needs with longer-term improvements to team effectiveness.

title: Senior Detection and Response Engineer - UK
descriptionHtml:
Senior Detection and Response Engineer (Cheltenham, UK)

Location: Cheltenham, UK

Team: Product & Engineering

Employment Type: Full-Time, Remote

About VulnCheck

Exploitation prevention is only as strong as the intelligence driving those efforts, and most of the industry is still running on intelligence that lacks exploit context. VulnCheck, The exploit intelligence company, delivers structured exploit intelligence on what is actively weaponized in the wild, purpose-built for the data lakes, ETL pipelines, automation, and AI and LLM workflows your infrastructure already runs on, raising the capability of everything it powers.

About the Role

Our Target and Canary Intelligence products provide unique visibility into vulnerable assets on the internet, attacker infrastructure, and attacks that leverage vulnerabilities for initial access. Target Intelligence maintains a continuously updated view of internet-facing systems — the services and versions they run, and their exposure to vulnerabilities. Canary Intelligence deploys intentionally vulnerable systems across the internet and captures real exploitation attempts as they happen.

We are looking for an experienced detection and response engineer to help scale the durable detections behind these products. These detections generate world-class, vulnerability-centric threat intelligence our customers rely on to defend themselves against exploitation activity on the internet.

You'll have wide latitude to shape how VulnCheck stays ahead of an accelerating volume of vulnerabilities - the tooling, the workflows, and the standards for detection engineering at scale. Although this is a 100% remote role, candidates must be located in or around Cheltenham, United Kingdom.

What You'll Do

  • Design and direct AI-assisted, agentic detection workflows that scale coverage to an accelerating volume of vulnerabilities, with you on the loop for quality
  • Author and ship network signatures and detections against internet-scale scan and probe data to identify services, versions, and whether hosts are vulnerable.
  • Build detections against Canary telemetry that separate real exploitation signal from internet noise, and synthesize that signal into threat intelligence customers can act on
  • Drive feedback loops into our probing and collection capabilities - identifying what data we should collect, what we shouldn't, and where coverage gaps exist
  • Continuously evaluate detection quality, measuring and tuning false positive and false negative rates
  • Respond rapidly when high-impact vulnerabilities drop - analyze, build coverage, ship
  • Work alongside our vulnerability researchers and threat hunters to connect detection engineering with exploit intelligence

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience building and shipping durable detections over network and host data
  • Experience scaling detection development and continuous evaluation processes using AI and agentic workflows with humans on the loop
  • A track record of researching, engineering, and validating durable detections across network and host telemetry, with a disciplined approach to false positives and false negatives
  • Expertise in device fingerprinting and protocol analysis. You understand the nuances of how services manifest on the wire, and how these signals stack to passively uncover what is running behind an open port on an internet address
  • Knowledge of attacker command-and-control techniques, covert channels, and exploitation artifacts — and how to identify them through network traffic analysis
  • A background in host-based analysis and DFIR. You know what telemetry is worth collecting from sensors to identify exploitation activity and attacker behaviors, and how to synthesize it into high-quality, actionable threat intelligence
  • Strong programming or scripting ability — you can codify detection logic so it is performant and integrates cleanly with VulnCheck’s engineering system
  • Familiarity with CVE, NVD, KEV, or exploit intelligence datasets
  • A response mindset — when a new vulnerability drops, you're the first to dig in, analyze it, and ship detection coverage

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing and tuning detections in Suricata, Snort, Zeek, or similar, and writing Nuclei templates or other scanner signatures
  • Published detection research, signatures, or open-source detection content
  • Experience with streaming systems or real-time data processing
  • Background in high-growth or startup environments

What We Offer

We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted, and valued. VulnCheck offers benefits designed to meet a wide range of needs and lifestyles, tailored to your country of employment:

  • Generous, flexible time off
  • Retirement/pension plan contributions (e.g., 401k with match in the US; local pension schemes elsewhere)
  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage
  • Generous paid parental leave
  • Remote-friendly environment with flexibility
  • Support for home office costs (phone & internet)

Specific benefit details vary by country and are confirmed during the offer process.

Why Join Us

Built on over two decades of cybersecurity experience, our team of experts understands the intricacies of vulnerabilities, their exploitation in the wild, and how to leverage this data to build more effective cybersecurity products that produce better outcomes for organizations.

VulnCheck gives organizations a tactical advantage by providing best-in-class exploit & vulnerability intelligence information. We have a sense of duty to protect the critical infrastructure we rely on including medical devices, power grids and telecommunication networks. We were founded in 2021 in Lexington, Massachusetts.

VulnCheck has a transparent, collaborative, and supportive culture — we are looking for people who have a growth mindset, are curious and innovative. Our team is smart, but humble, hardworking, and supportive.

VulnCheck is proud to be an Equal Employer Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. VulnCheck is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. title: Senior DevOps Engineer

Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. 

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

Developer Operations (DevOps) at Ripple manages communication, collaboration, and integration between Development and Operations teams. They ensure infrastructures, tools, and processes are streamlined and effective for automated product delivery.

The Senior Software Engineer, DevOps will contribute to the discovery, development, and implementation of solutions to improve infrastructure and release pipelines. These solutions will include developer infrastructure, production infrastructure layout and maintenance, capacity and load testing, CI/CD infrastructure, and release process automation. You will push the boundaries with new tools and technologies and use a data-driven approach for achieving desired results. You will play a critical role helping to advance Ripple's development and production infrastructure, improving our DevOps process including deployment, monitoring, instrumentation and overall infrastructure management.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Develop, deploy, and maintain Ripple’s multi-region, multi-provider service platforms
  • Supply build and development of tools for automation, monitoring, and instrumentation to reduce operational friction and increase engineering efficiency
  • Work with wider engineering teams on implementation, adoption, and continuous improvements
  • Build and automate new and existing platform and application lifecycle services, using data to converge on declared states with minimal human interaction
  • Collaborate with product engineering to ensure code is production-ready
  • Participate in the adoption of DevOps-first principles within the organization

WHAT YOU'LL BRING: 

  • 6+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering.
  • Extensive hands-on experience managing cloud infrastructure, deployments, and large-scale, multi-region distributed systems, preferably on Azure and AWS
  • Strong proficiency in Kubernetes and experience managing container orchestration platforms and runtimes, including Docker and OCI.
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform , Azure Bicep and AWS CloudFormation.
  • Strong understanding of platform engineering fundamentals, including automation, reliability, scalability, high availability, and operational excellence.
  • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, including automated environment provisioning, regression testing, and containerized build and deployment workflows.
  • Experience managing artifact repositories and storage systems for build dependencies and pipeline artifacts.
  • Strong knowledge of Linux operating systems, networking fundamentals, and scripting languages such as Bash and Python.
  • Experience operating, administering, and troubleshooting production infrastructure, with a focus on performance, security, and reliability.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments and collaborating with cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a team-oriented mindset.

Do Your Best Work

title: Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer – AI Infrastructure (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Worum es geht

MAIA ist eine KI-Plattform für Unternehmen. Mit MAIA durchsuchen Teams ihre internen Daten und verankern Agenten tief in ihren Prozessen. Wir begleiten Unternehmen dabei, KI nicht nur in einzelnen Abteilungen, sondern im ganzen Unternehmen einzusetzen.

Technisch heißt das: Wir bauen eine GenAI-Anwendung mit eigenen Agentensystemen, RAG-Pipelines und agentenbasierten Workflows, binden externe Systeme unserer Kunden an und analysieren ihre Daten. Wir nutzen die besten verfügbaren Modelle, betrieben in der EU, und machen sie verlässlich für anspruchsvolle Arbeit mit großen, komplexen Datenmengen.

Zahlreiche Industrieunternehmen arbeiten seit Jahren intensiv mit MAIA. Nach unserer erfolgreichen Finanzierungsrunde 2026 bringen wir MAIA jetzt in die Breite. Entwickelt wird MAIA seit 2021 in Leipzig.

Was du bei uns machst

Als unsere erste dedizierte DevOps-Person verantwortest du Infrastruktur und Betrieb von MAIA und entwickelst unsere bestehende Plattform für den nächsten Wachstumsschritt weiter. Die Rolle lebt von enger Abstimmung mit dem Engineering-Team.

Woran du arbeiten kannst:

  • Plattform und Deployments. Der Großteil unserer Infrastruktur läuft bei Hetzner, auf dedizierten Servern und Cloud-VMs. Du betreibst diese selbst administrierten Linux-Systeme und bindest ergänzend Dienste von AWS, Azure und GCP an, vor allem für KI-Services. Mit Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD und erprobten Rollbacks machst du Änderungen sicher und reproduzierbar.

  • PostgreSQL im Betrieb. Du verantwortest Performance, Connection Pooling und Kapazitäten und stellst mit getesteten Backups und Restores sicher, dass wir Daten zuverlässig wiederherstellen können.

  • Observability. Du entwickelst unseren selbst betriebenen Observability-Stack weiter, verbindest Metriken, Logs und Traces und etablierst Alerting, das zu konkreten Handlungen führt.

  • Sicherheit und Compliance. Du setzt Least Privilege, Secrets Management, Vulnerability Scanning und Patch Management konsequent um. Für unser laufendes ISO-27001-Vorhaben automatisierst du prüfbare Nachweise.

Was wir suchen

  • Selbst betriebene Systeme. Du hast produktive SaaS-Systeme auf selbst administrierten Linux-Servern betrieben. Erfahrung ausschließlich mit vollständig gemanagten Cloud-Diensten reicht für diese Rolle nicht aus. Erfahrung mit Hetzner ist ein Plus.

  • Container und Automatisierung. Docker und Docker Compose setzt du sicher in Produktion ein, ebenso Reverse Proxies oder API Gateways wie Traefik oder Kong. Infrastruktur verwaltest du mit Terraform, NixOS oder vergleichbaren Werkzeugen, CI/CD baust du mit GitHub Actions oder ähnlichen Systemen.

  • PostgreSQL in Produktion. Backups und Restores hast du selbst eingerichtet und getestet. Performance-Analyse und Connection Pooling sind dir vertraut.

  • Observability und Sicherheit. Du hast einen Observability-Stack selbst betrieben, etwa mit Grafana, Loki und Prometheus. Sicherheit setzt du im Alltag um, von Berechtigungen und Secrets bis zu Sicherheitsupdates.

  • Verständnis für KI-Systeme. Du kennst die Grundlagen von RAG-Systemen und ihre typischen Fehlerquellen im Betrieb. Bei LLM-Serving kannst du Zielkonflikte zwischen Latenz, Durchsatz, Kosten und Betriebsaufwand einordnen. Neue Modelle und Anbieter verfolgst du aus eigenem Interesse.

  • Eigenständig und sorgfältig. Du treibst Themen selbst voran, untersuchst unbekannte Systeme, bis du sie verstehst, und priorisierst nach Risiko und Wirkung. Komplexität hältst du beherrschbar, und Verbesserungen bringst du bis in den laufenden Betrieb.

  • Agentisch arbeiten. Coding Agents gehören für dich zum Alltag, auch bei Infrastruktur. Du prüfst ihre Ergebnisse kritisch, besonders bevor etwas in Produktion geht.

  • Klar kommunizieren. Auch bei Störungen bleibst du ruhig und klar. Technische Zusammenhänge erklärst du verständlich, auch Menschen ohne technischen Hintergrund. Du sprichst sehr sicher Deutsch und ebenso Englisch.

Die Rolle ist eine Senior-Rolle ohne Personalverantwortung.

Arbeiten bei MAIA

Uns verbindet ein gemeinsames Ziel: ein richtig gutes Produkt zu bauen. Jede und jeder übernimmt Verantwortung für das eigene Thema. Wir haben Spaß an der Arbeit und sind stolz auf das, was unsere Kunden mit MAIA erreichen. Die Wege sind kurz, und Entscheidungen fallen schnell. Im Engineering-Team hinterfragen wir kritisch, wie wir entwickeln, und verbessern unsere Prozesse laufend, gerade in der agentischen Entwicklung.

Wir arbeiten gern zusammen in unserem Büro, zentral zwischen Innenstadt und Zoo, und kochen fast jeden Tag gemeinsam. An mindestens drei Tagen pro Woche sind wir vor Ort, an den übrigen arbeitest du, wo du möchtest. Wann dein Tag beginnt, legst du selbst fest.

  • Zugang zu aktuellen Frontier-Modellen und Coding Agents

  • Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungen, die zu deiner beruflichen Entwicklung passen

  • Zugang zu einer Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft

Vergütung

Das Jahresbruttogehalt liegt bei 80.000 bis 90.000 €. Wo du in dieser Spanne liegst, besprechen wir spätestens nach dem technischen Interview. Dazu kommt eine virtuelle Beteiligung über unser VSOP.

Bewerbung und nächste Schritte

Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte uns in ein paar eigenen Sätzen eine Frage: Warum willst du MAIA mitgestalten?

Wir arbeiten jeden Tag mit KI. Für diese Antwort zählt aber deine eigene Perspektive. Schreib sie deshalb bitte selbst, gern kurz und ohne Feinschliff.

Passt es, folgen ein 30-minütiges Kennenlernen, ein 90-minütiges technisches Interview und ein Abschlussgespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Nach jedem Schritt hörst du in der Regel innerhalb von zwei Werktagen von uns. Unser Ziel ist eine Entscheidung in rund drei Wochen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Location: London | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent

Build the platforms that power secure, intelligent and scalable enterprise engineering.

At Capco, we're looking for a Senior DevSecOps Engineer to help design, build and modernise enterprise software delivery capabilities for leading financial services organisations.

You'll also explore approved AI-enabled engineering tools and workflows to improve development productivity, automation and delivery quality, while maintaining appropriate human oversight, security controls and responsible AI practices.

  • Technical leadership and delivery: Ability to take architectural designs through implementation, collaborate with engineering teams and support knowledge transfer, with an interest in applying approved AI tools and automation responsibly to improve engineering outcomes.

Bonus Points For

Why Join Capco

  • Be part of a team shaping the future of digital financial services.

We value each person's unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration – a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day.

  • Compliance & Governance – Perform compliance analysis, identify security requirements, and implement controls aligned to regulatory standards on client projects.
  • Mentoring & Onboarding – Coach and onboard DevSecOps engineers, and development teams on modern security practices.
  • Stakeholder Communication – Present security posture, risk findings, and remediation roadmaps clearly to senior stakeholders.
What we're looking for

Essential

  • Production experience operating in a multi-region Azure environment
  • Proven experience in a senior DevSecOps / Application Security engineering role
  • Proven experience working in SDLC as Dev, Quality engineer or DevOps
  • Proven experience working in a consulting setting and mindset
  • Strong infrastructure-as-code skills, particularly Terraform
  • Azure security experience (Entra ID, PIM, CAP, Policy, Defender, Sentinel)
  • Practical experience with CI/CD security integration (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions)

  • Experience conducting or coordinating penetration testing and threat modelling
  • Experience with secure code and architecture review, ideally in regulated or high-compliance environments such as iGaming, fintech, or healthcare
  • Hands-on involvement in security incident response and handling
  • Familiar with how the infosec team operates, including GRC, TPRM and SOC capability.
  • Familiar with common SIEM and SOAR platforms, their workflows and underlying data structure.
  • Strong communication skills
  • Experience  with  compliance and regulatory analysis (GDPR, PCI DSS, or similar)

Desirable

Tech Stack
Azure | Terraform | GitHub Actions | Azure DevOps | JavaScript | C# | Java | .NET | React Native | Node.js | Claude Code | OWASP ZAP | Burp Suite | Sentinel | Defender

title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The DevSecOps Engineer at Shield AI is responsible for designing, building, securing, and operating the software delivery infrastructure required to develop and deploy advanced autonomous systems for defence applications.
This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, platform engineering, cyber security, and defence systems engineering. The DevSecOps Engineer works alongside autonomy, software, systems, integration, and test engineers to create secure and reliable development environments and delivery pipelines that enable teams to rapidly develop, integrate, test, and deploy mission critical software.
The ideal candidate has a strong software and platform engineering background combined with significant experience operating within UK defence environments. They have a strong understanding of the UK Ministry of Defence/NATO approach to DevSecOps, Secure by Design, cyber risk management, security assurance, and the delivery of software into classified and operational environments.
What You’ll Do
  • Design, build, and operate secure development and deployment infrastructure for Shield AI autonomy and defence programmes.
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines that enable rapid, repeatable, and secure delivery of autonomy and mission software.
  • Embed security throughout the software development lifecycle, ensuring security controls, testing, evidence, and assurance are integrated into engineering workflows rather than treated as separate activities.
  • Apply UK MOD Secure by Design principles throughout the development lifecycle and help engineering teams understand and meet their responsibilities for cyber security and technical assurance.
  • Work closely with software, autonomy, systems, cyber security, integration, and test engineers to establish development environments that support rapid engineering while meeting defence security requirements.
  • Design and maintain development and deployment environments spanning cloud, on premises infrastructure, laboratory environments, simulation, hardware in the loop, and operational platforms.
  • Enable secure software development and deployment across different security classifications and appropriately segmented development environments.
  • Implement automated security controls within CI/CD pipelines, including static analysis, dependency scanning, container scanning, secrets detection, software composition analysis, vulnerability management, and policy enforcement.
  • Champion a DevSecOps culture where software engineers take ownership of the security, reliability, deployability, and operational performance of the systems they develop.

    • Required Qualifications
  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cyber Security, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, DevSecOps, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, software engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Significant experience delivering software or digital capabilities within UK defence or another highly regulated national security environment.
  • Strong understanding of the UK Ministry of Defence/NATO approach to DevSecOps and Secure by Design, including the integration of cyber security and risk management throughout the capability lifecycle.
  • Experience applying MOD security policies, security assurance processes, and technical security requirements to software intensive defence programmes.
  • Experience developing and operating CI/CD pipelines using modern source control, build, test, artefact management, and deployment technologies.
  • Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code, configuration management, containerisation, and infrastructure automation
  • Experience with technologies such as Git, GitLab or GitHub, or equivalent tooling.

    • Desirable Qualifications
  • Experience supporting DevSecOps, software delivery, or digital engineering activities across NATO nations or multinational defence programmes.
  • Understanding of DevSecOps approaches, security frameworks, and software assurance practices used by other NATO nations, particularly the United States and European NATO partners.

title: Senior Digital Content Consultant Adobe
descriptionHtml:
Digital Content Consultant
London, hybrid
6 month FTC 

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

JOB PURPOSE 

Working with customers pursuing personalisation at scale, an optimal content supply chain is a necessity.  With the emergence of generative AI and its potential to supercharge the supply of hyper personalised  content we are seeking a Senior Content Supply Consultant to help customers assess, optimise and manage their content supply processes, delivering content seamlessly and efficiently to execute outstanding consumer experiences.  

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

  • Lead inspiring business discovery workstreams and align with customers on relevant business goals and critical metrics  
  • Map the content lifecycle from creation to distribution, including all stages and touchpoints.  
  • Assess the customer’s content supply process to identify inefficiencies and bottlenecks  
  • Define the role of Generative AI and automation capabilities to reduce cost and time to create, produce and deliver content  
  • Perform complex process re-design to align the content supply process to a customer’s strategy  and drive dramatic improvements in productivity, cycle time, quality, and customer satisfaction.  
  • Define workflows to outline the sequence of tasks, responsibilities, dependencies, and approvals  required to move content from one stage to the next.  
  • Guide customers to train AI models on data to ensure a consistent and aligned brand representation across channels  
  • Help customers to assess current brand guidelines and define AI integration objectives, develop  AI-specific guidelines, train the team and implement monitoring and evaluation processes.  
  • Design effective content approval processes to ensure published content aligns with a customer’s  policies and expectations.  
  • Develop the implementation strategy & roadmap in partnership with Technical Architects and customer teams for Adobe solutions that enable content supply, e.g. Adobe Experience Manager,  Workfront, Creative Cloud, Express, Frame.io etc  
  • Research and define relevant content performance and content process benchmarks 
  • Design and implement content performance and content process reporting mechanisms to  monitor progress against KPIs  
  • Analyse performance and surface insights informing continued optimisation and validating  business outcomes.  
  • Perform organisational analysis to assess barriers to adoption and develop mitigation strategies.  Advise and lead customers through the change required to adopt optimised content tools and  processes across the customer org and involved 3rd parties  
  • Identify and enable customers teams on the required capability, functionality and features across  Adobe technologies that facilitate content supply requirements with a specialist focus on Adobe  Experience Manager and Workfront  
  • Support the enablement of customer teams across roles, responsibilities and process that  facilitate the customer’s optimised content supply chain.  
  • Continually grow your footprint and role within the client engagement and relationship.  

WHAT YOU’LL BRING 

  • 5+ Years of content supply optimisation experience – as a Product Owner, Product Manager or  Lead Business Consultant  
  • The ability to translate business requirements into a technical solution and an understanding of  how to leverage content solutions to meet business needs is important.  
  • A deep understanding of Content Management platforms and technologies (AEM, Workfront  preferred) from a business perspective and standard methodologies around implementations.  AEM + Workfront Certified Business Practitioner.  
  • Complex process re-design expertise coupled with change management experience.  ξ Experience with AI and automation with a strong understanding of how AI, machine learning, and  generative AI can revolutionise the content supply chain.  
  • Experience with AI model training and the development of processes to secure adherence to  brand standards  
  • Understanding or experience in using productised APIs, SaaS, SOA, Cloud Services, and Content  Management Systems is beneficial  
  • Extensive Agile experience and with product backlog management experience  Customer-centric approach  
  • Outcome mentality and strong ability to plan for and realise business value.  
  • Demonstrated experience working with business users and senior stakeholders, software  engineers, application architects and digital marketing agencies  
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills presenting outcomes, sharing information, and  leading meetings  

WE OFFER:

  • A flexible, hybrid working policy (2 days from the office, depending on location).
  • An excellent salary based on experience and equal pay policies
  • Pension, free private healthcare, mental health support, and company sick pay scheme.
  • 26 days paid holiday (plus UK Bank Holidays).
  • Help getting you to work with a season ticket loan and cycle to work scheme.
  • Enhanced family friendly policies to support new parents.
  • Social and Cultural Events, plenty of opportunities to connect with colleagues through organised activities and celebrations.
  • Inspirational Talks, bringing the outside in with regular guest speakers and events.
  • Learning and Development, supporting your growth with continuous opportunities to learn and advance.
  • Buddy Programme: You will be paired with a ‘Buddy’ to help you through your first weeks’ at DEPT®.
  • A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021 and named ‘Agency of the Year’ at both The Lovies and The Webby Awards.
  • Awesome clients. Whether big or small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with clients of all sizes and across all industries. And we celebrate all of our successes together!
  • The opportunity for possibility. We want to enable you to do what you do best and help you develop your skills further with training, development and certifications.
  • Global annual DEPT® Cares Month in which employees come together and donate their skills to support local charities.

WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION 

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

title: Senior Director, Brand Partnerships EMEA
descriptionHtml:
👫 About the team

Equativ's EMEA Demand team is responsible for growing relationships with agencies, advertisers, DSPs and other demand partners across the region, helping them leverage Equativ's full suite of omnichannel advertising solutions.

As we continue to strengthen our position with the world's leading agencies, we are also increasing our engagement directly with brands - understanding their business and media challenges, and ensuring Equativ's capabilities are represented in the conversations that shape future investment.

We are looking for a Senior Director EMEA, Brand Partnerships to define and lead this strategy, reporting to our VP Demand, EMEA.

This role is about creating stronger connections between brands, their agencies and Equativ, helping us build more strategic relationships with advertisers while creating incremental opportunities for our existing agency ecosystem.

This is a highly visible, entrepreneurial role for someone who knows the European advertising industry exceptionally well, has strong relationships with senior marketers, and can build a new commercial motion from the ground up.

✍️What you'll do

  • Define and lead Equativ’s EMEA Brand Partnerships strategy, identifying priority brands, verticals and markets, and building a scalable plan to strengthen Equativ’s position with advertisers across the region.

  • Build senior relationships with leading brands, engaging CMOs, Media Directors, Digital, Programmatic and Marketing leaders to understand their priorities and position Equativ as a strategic partner across programmatic, CTV, data, curation, commerce media and omnichannel activation.

  • Work closely with Equativ’s agency teams and partners to ensure Brand Direct initiatives complement — rather than compete with — existing agency relationships. Develop coordinated account strategies for shared clients and identify opportunities to create incremental value for both brands and their agencies.

  • Develop strategic commercial partnerships, from initial engagement through proposals, joint business plans, pilots and long-term agreements, while building a strong pipeline of advertiser opportunities across EMEA.

  • Act as the voice of the advertiser within Equativ, bringing market insight back to Product, Marketing and Commercial teams, helping shape Equativ’s proposition and representing the company across key advertiser forums, industry events and senior-level conversations.

💪 About you

We are looking for someone who combines industry relationships, strategic thinking and commercial execution.

You will ideally have:

  • 10+ years of experience in advertising technology, digital media, programmatic advertising, media, data or a related sector.

  • A strong and active network of senior brand-side relationships across EMEA, particularly among CMOs, Media Directors, Heads of Digital, Programmatic and Marketing.

  • A proven track record of opening doors and building meaningful commercial relationships directly with major advertisers.

  • Deep knowledge of the European advertising ecosystem and a strong understanding of how brands, agency holding companies, independent agencies, trading desks and technology platforms work together.

  • Strong knowledge of programmatic advertising and the broader adtech ecosystem, including DSPs, SSPs, CTV, data, identity, curation and omnichannel media.

  • Experience developing sophisticated strategic partnerships, annual agreements or Joint Business Plans with large advertisers.

  • A demonstrated ability to turn senior relationships into measurable commercial outcomes.

  • The ability to navigate complex brand/agency dynamics with diplomacy, transparency and sound commercial judgement.

  • Strong executive presence and the ability to engage credibly with C-level marketing executives.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset: you are comfortable building a strategy and operating model where there is not yet a complete playbook.

  • Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.

  • Strong internal collaboration skills and the ability to bring multiple stakeholders together around shared commercial objectives.

  • A willingness to travel regularly across EMEA.

Above all, you should be someone who is deeply connected to the advertising industry, intellectually curious about where the market is heading, and excited about helping Equativ build a significantly stronger position with the world's leading brands.

👊 Growth Expectations

Within your first 90 days, you will have developed a deep understanding of Equativ's EMEA demand business, product portfolio and existing agency relationships. You will have identified priority advertiser accounts and verticals, established an initial EMEA Brand Partnerships strategy, and defined clear rules of engagement between Brand Direct and Agency teams.

Within 6 months, you will have developed senior relationships across a focused portfolio of strategic advertisers, built a meaningful pipeline of opportunities, launched the first strategic partnerships or pilots, and demonstrated an effective model for collaborating with agencies on shared clients.

Within 12 months, you will have established a repeatable Brand Partnerships motion across EMEA, generated measurable incremental revenue and strategic product adoption, built a portfolio of flagship advertiser relationships, and created the foundation for Equativ to further scale its Brand Direct organisation.

title: Senior Director, Destination Management, Supply
descriptionHtml:
Senior Director, Destination Management, Supply I Tripadvisor

About Tripadvisor 

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Tripadvisor Experiences is the world's leading marketplace for tours, activities, and experiences. Our mission is to bring more wonder to the world by delivering exceptional experiences to travelers wherever they are. We offer an unparalleled opportunity to be part of the future of the travel experiences industry.


The Opportunity

Reporting to the Chief Commercial Officer, Experiences, the Senior Director of Destination Management leads Viator's global destination management team. You will bring a deep understanding of the global operator community and use it to develop strategies that solve business problems and support our mutual goal with operators: delivering exceptional experiences to travelers. 

This is an operational role. You will be expected to deliver significant business outcomes by leading and motivating a global team, with decisive leadership and a strong bias for action.

Job Location: Hybrid

This role is a hybrid position that requires 2 to 3 days per week in our London Office.

Key Responsibilities: 

Operator Community and Destination Strategy

  • Hold a deep, current understanding of the operator community: its needs, economics, competitive options and pain points. Use it to shape how we win and retain supply.

  • Own the 3 year destination management strategy and translate it into clear regional charters and measurable KPIs, growing revenue and market share in leading destinations.

  • Develop strategies that solve business problems for both operators and Viator, in support of delivering exceptional traveler experiences.

  • Own financial rigor: use fresh business data and pacing to steer the business, and help your team understand the financial impact of its decisions and be accountable for it.

Team Leadership and Talent

  • Act as chief architect of the global destination management organization. Lead and mentor Regional Managers, and design an organization and operating model that fits the business as it evolves.

  • Set and hold the hiring bar, run rigorous and consistent performance management, and calibrate with peers across Supply.

  • Build and retain top talent, and maintain a leadership bench and succession plan for Regional Manager roles.

  • Set the standard for leadership: humble, open to feedback, and skilled at leading teams through change.

  • Be clear on what each person and region owns, and hold them accountable for it. Push decisions to the lowest appropriate level while stepping in personally on cross-regional or cross-functional problems no one else owns.

Data-Driven Decision Making

  • Set the standard for hypothesis quality and test design. Define what the team needs to learn, require evidence and experimentation over opinion, and prioritize what operators and travelers actually do over what they say.

Connectivity

  • Ensure industry-leading connectivity with the features and support operators need. Oversee the connectivity support team and partner with R&D to build enhanced connectivity features.

Innovation and AI

  • Drive innovation by bringing in outside ideas through industry conferences, councils and competitor insight, and share what works across functions.

  • Advocate for and implement AI and automation to transform productivity and quality, including rethinking roles and workflows. Scale proven wins across regions, build team AI skills, and use AI responsibly within our governance and data-privacy guidelines.

  • Monitor competitive dynamics, regulatory environments and industry trends affecting supply.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Align with Supply Sales, Marketing, R&D and Support, and act as an integrator on OKRs and problems that cut across functions, so operators and customers have a seamless end-to-end experience.

  • Partner as one team across Supply and Tripadvisor Experiences, and hold cross-functional partners accountable as well as being held accountable by them.

Skills & Experience

  • Global Leadership: 10+ years leading and scaling global teams in market management, account management or a combination, including leading managers of managers.

  • Operator and Marketplace Expertise: Extensive experience with two-sided marketplaces, a deep understanding of supply-side dynamics, technologies and operator communities, ideally in travel.

  • Strategic Thinking: A track record of setting multi-year strategy and turning it into goals, KPIs and results.

  • Operational Excellence: Data-driven operational leadership with a strong bias for action. Skilled at KPIs, pacing and scalable processes to improve global efficiency.

  • Quality Orientation: Experience defining and enforcing quality standards across a catalog or supplier base.

  • Tech Savvy and AI Proficiency: A proven history of using AI and technology to improve business outcomes and create transformational change.

  • Commercial Acumen: Strong commercial and financial acumen, with advanced negotiation and relationship management skills to build and sustain key operator partnerships.

  • Inspirational Leader: An authentic, humble leader who builds trust, develops talent and cultivates a winning culture.

What We Offer 

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars:

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us. 

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges. 

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.
