title: Senior Engine Cycle Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Mission Brief 

You will own the engine cycle and the top level technical architecture of a pump fed liquid rocket engine. As the responsible engineer you translate mission and vehicle needs into an integrated engine design, establish the key performance trades, and make sure every major sub system converges on one coherent, testable and manufacturable solution.

Your Role in Our Space Mission: 

  • Build, maintain and validate engine cycle models across nominal, throttled and off nominal operating conditions, including start up and shutdown transients.
  • Lead cycle trade studies and sensitivity analyses to optimise performance and identify design drivers, constraints and technical risks.
  • Perform top level engine sizing and define the principal operating points and component interface conditions.
  • Drive architecture and design trade offs across combustion devices, turbomachinery, valves, feed systems, ignition, controls, structures, thermal management and engine layout.
  • Own the top level engine requirements, assumptions, interface definitions and technical budgets.
  • Act as the technical decision driver for cross functional design issues, and keep decisions documented, traceable and backed by analysis and test evidence.
  • Own the technical development roadmap and timeline: guide design iterations, prioritise maturation activities, and define the analyses, breadboards and tests that retire the highest risks.
  • Coordinate technical reviews and give clear recommendations to Propulsion leadership and to the programme and vehicle teams.

Qualification Checklist 

  • MSc in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering or a comparable technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Several years in liquid rocket engine development, with real responsibility for engine cycle analysis, engine architecture or propulsion system integration.
  • Hands on experience with high pressure, pump fed liquid rocket engine cycles: designing, analysing, developing or testing them.
  • Excellent understanding of engine cycles, thermodynamics, fluid dynamics and turbomachinery power balance.
  • Steady state cycle modelling, top level engine sizing and performance prediction.
  • Experience planning and coordinating multidisciplinary engine development or test campaigns, and driving a technical roadmap to agreed timelines.
  • Proficiency in Python, MATLAB or a comparable programming language.
  • Strong technical ownership and systems thinking, and the confidence to decide with incomplete information.
  • Fluent in English.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally for test and launch operations.

Bonus Skills

  • Experience with transient cycle modelling: start up, shutdown, throttling and off nominal conditions.
  • Experience taking an engine design from cycle definition and system level trades into hardware and test.
  • Experience analysing engine control, operability, stability or failure cases.
  • Enough breadth across valves, feed systems, ignition, controls, structures and thermal management to arbitrate trade offs between those disciplines.
  • Experience correlating models against hot fire test data.

Benefits 

  • Employee Participation Program: Share in our success through our virtual company share program
  • 30 days of vacation: Enjoy the days off to relax and recharge
  • Company pension plan: Secure your future with our company pension plan, featuring a 20% employer contribution after the probation period
  • Subsidised lunch: Stay energised with delicious, subsidised lunches every day
  • Rental clothing with laundry service: Enjoy hassle-free workwear with our convenient rental clothing and laundry service  
  • Sport Clubs membership: Stay fit with our sponsored sports club memberships (EGYM Wellpass)
  • Individual learning allowance: Grow your skills with an individual learning budget granted after the probation period
  • Childcare allowance: Receive a childcare allowance for your non-school-age children
  • Flexible mobility budget: Travel your way with a choice between a fully financed Deutschlandticket, JobRad bicycle leasing, FINN JobAuto, or a fuel allowance
  • And Much More! Discover additional perks and benefits when you join our team 

Who we are

We are Isar Aerospace and we are at the forefront of New Space building a modern space business to enable faster, better and cheaper access to space.

Our mission is to help democratise space and use it for good in order to improve life on Earth now and for the future generations.

We are a fast-growing company aiming to provide sustainable and environmentally friendly launch solutions for small and medium-sized satellites and constellations into Low Earth Orbit. The company is privately funded by world-leading technology investors with strong commitment and support and our team is made of driven and talented people with a real passion for space innovation.

We're making rockets in a way that hasn't been done before disrupting a traditional industry. If you are up for the challenge, want to work on cutting-edge projects and be part of a team changing the world for better, come, join us and launch your career!

Want to find out more about us?

Visit www.isaraerospace.com

title: Senior Engineer II, Chromium
descriptionHtml:
Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Data Security & AI Engineering team. In this role, you will bring strong systems engineering skills—ideally with hands-on Chromium experience across core layers—to build, expand, and harden the runtime capabilities that power Menlo's next-generation AI security platform. You will work at the intersection of browser engine internals, systems architecture, and AI security, expanding our detection surfaces to safeguard enterprise workforces and AI agents against modern threats like Prompt Injection (PI) and Shadow AI usage. The role blends deep C++ browser engineering with work on Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP), and the cloud infrastructure supporting them. You’ll collaborate closely with engineers across Chromium, AI, and security disciplines to ship high-performance, evasion-resistant protections, leveraging AI-assisted development tools to move fast while maintaining an uncompromising bar for quality and security.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain Chromium-based browser components in C++, working across layers such as content, browser, core, compositor, skia, and networking, that power Menlo's security and AI-driven capabilities.

  • Architect and embed controls for detecting Prompt Injection (PI) and managing Shadow AI activity directly within browser execution and agent workflows.

  • Apply strong networking fundamentals and HTTP security expertise to harden Menlo's browser isolation, proxy/gateway intercepts, and network-facing infrastructure.

  • Partner with the MARS and AI teams to build and integrate AI agent capabilities and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers into Menlo's security platform.

  • Use Python or Rust to build supporting tooling, detection microservices, and prototypes alongside core C++ systems work.

  • Deploy and operate the cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP) and orchestration (Kubernetes, Terraform) needed to run agent/MCP and threat-detection workloads reliably.

  • Debug and optimize performance-critical, high-scale systems across the browser and supporting backend infrastructure.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, security, and AI engineering teams to ship capabilities end-to-end.

  • Apply AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate development, testing, and code review as part of your daily workflow.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering with strong C++ systems programming skills.

  • Strong networking fundamentals, including solid knowledge of HTTP security, web protocols and / or client-side security architecture.

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Preferred / Nice to Have:

  • Experience across Chromium layers such as content, browser, core, compositor, skia, and networking (or equivalent large-scale, high-performance C++ systems experience).

  • Experience or strong interest in AI/LLM security / guardrails domains (e.g., Prompt Injection defense, Shadow AI detection, intent classification, context aware DLP/PII detection, and agentic workflows).

  • Python or Rust experience.

  • Experience building or integrating AI agents, Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP), and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers.

  • Experience with AWS, GCP, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Linux.

Follow us on LinkedIn!

Why Menlo?

At Menlo, we don't settle for the status quo — in our technology or our culture. How we think and act is just as important as what we build. Our culture is defined by five core mindsets: Proactive Leadership, Straight Talk, United Impact, Elevated Talent, and Customer-Compelled. We take ownership and drive outcomes without waiting to be told. We communicate directly and seek hard truths. We break down silos and win together. We hold a high bar for ourselves and the people around us. And we treat every customer interaction as mission-critical. If you're someone who sees it, owns it, solves it, and does it — you'll thrive here.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

title: Senior Engineer, iOS - Instant Rips
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. 

About the Team

Fanatics Collectibles is the home of sports cards, trading cards, and collectibles for over 100 million fans worldwide. As part of the global Fanatics platform, we're rebuilding how collectors discover, buy, sell, and experience their hobby — live, in real time, at scale.

Our flagship mobile product, Fanatics Live, is where that experience comes to life: live card breaks, real-time auctions, high-traffic chat, marketplace transactions, and deep collection management tools. The stakes are high and the traffic is real — we build for peak-load moments where latency is visible and reliability is nonnegotiable.

Role Summary

You'll join the Instant Rips iOS team — the group responsible for the live-break commerce experience on Fanatics Live. We build the surfaces millions of collectors use in real time: bidding in live auctions, joining breaks, navigating a high-velocity chat stream, and transacting in the marketplace.

The iOS stack is modern by design. We're SwiftUI-first, run The Composable Architecture TCA) across the app, use Swift Concurrency throughout, talk to our backend via Apollo GraphQL, and maintain a clean modular SPM codebase generated with Tuist. There's no legacy UIKit app hiding under the surface — you'll be working in a codebase you can be proud of.

AI tooling is part of how we work. We expect engineers to use it on the job, give it good context, and verify the output — not just accept it.

What you'll do

  • Design and ship production iOS features across the live-break experience: auctions, stream viewing, chat, marketplace, and collector tools
  • Own features end-to-end — API contracts, TCA reducers, SwiftUI views, testing, and release
  • Write genuine test coverage: unit tests with mock dependencies, TCA
  • TestStore assertions, async test patterns — not coverage theater
  • Review pull requests with judgment: surface real defects, prioritize what matters, coach on what to let go
  • Contribute to architectural decisions: modularization strategy, effect management, failure handling
  • Mentor engineers earlier in their career and raise the quality bar across the team

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years building consumer-facing iOS applications at scale
  • Hands-on with AI-assisted development tooling LLM optimization loops, Xcode CLI integration)
  • Swift Concurrency — async/await, structured concurrency, Sendable, Swift Macros
  • SwiftUI — stateless/stateful view patterns, NavigationStack, performanceaware composition
  • The Composable Architecture TCA — Reducer/Store/Action/State, effect management, parent-child delegation, testing with TestStore
  • Apollo GraphQL (iOS) — schema-driven development, Swift codegen, subscriptions
  • SPM multi-package architecture — modular feature separation, local packages, clean dependency graphs
  • Tuist or XcodeGen — project generation tooling; no committed .xcodeproj CI/CD — Bitrise, Fastlane, or equivalent automated build/test pipelines Static analysis — SwiftLint, Periphery or equivalent code quality gates
  • Structured commit/PR discipline tied to a project tracker Linear, Jira, or equivalent)

Bonus points

  • Experience with livestreaming, real-time auctions, or high-throughput WebSocket/subscription workloads
  • Exposure to marketplace or e-commerce iOS applications
  • Passion for sports cards, collectibles, or live commerce

The above list of job duties is not exclusive or exhaustive and the post holder will be required to undertake such tasks as may reasonably be expected within the scope and grading of the post.

title: Senior Engineering Manager - Agents and Context - Platform
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

The Chat team, part of Elastic’s Agents and Context group, builds the conversational and agentic platform that lets customers chat with and operate on their own data in Elasticsearch. We own the conversation experience, the agent harness and tools, retrieval and citations, streaming, memory, and the evaluation layer that keeps answers grounded and reliable. Everything we ship is production software that other Elastic solutions build on.

As Senior Engineering Manager you will lead a distributed team of approximately 12 engineers building this platform. Every engineering team at Elastic is led by a trio of Product Manager, Technical Lead and Engineering Manager. You will directly manage the engineers on the team, act as its primary project manager, and work with the PM and Tech Lead to define and deliver the roadmap. This is a people and delivery leadership role in a fast-moving space: the right person is energized by shaping structure where there is little, and keeps a calm, direct style while priorities shift.

Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. As a result, our team is diverse and distributed across continents. The ability to lead a distributed team is critical.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own delivery of the Chat roadmap: break it into milestones, see around corners on risk, and make sure the team ships predictably.
  • Run hiring end to end for the team: job descriptions, interview loops, sourcing with Recruiting, and onboarding.
  • Coach and develop engineers at every level, with regular 1:1s, clear expectations and honest feedback.
  • Run performance management with consistency: promotions, development plans, and managing underperformance through to resolution.
  • Partner with the Tech Lead and PM to shape roadmap and priorities, and with data science, UX, and the other Agents and Context teams on shared primitives and quality signals.
  • Build and improve team process (planning, async communication, release and on-call practice) through consensus and clear writing rather than top-down mandate.
  • Represent the team to leadership and stakeholders.

What You Bring

  • A proven track record as an established engineering manager of software engineering teams, including hiring, coaching, promotions and performance management.
  • A track record of delivering large, multi-team software initiatives in a distributed, async-first environment, including creating or improving team processes.
  • Previous hands-on software engineering experience as a senior contributor, with enough technical depth to understand a TypeScript/Node/React stack, an Elasticsearch-backed system, and how LLM-powered products are built and evaluated. You will not write production code, but you need to spot bottlenecks, risks and one-way-door decisions.
  • Familiarity with LLM applications, ideally including RAG, agents and tool use, evaluation, and prompt and context engineering.
  • Experience with Elasticsearch, Kibana, search and information retrieval, or open source communities is a plus.
  • Product acumen: comfortable with ambiguity, able to set and communicate priorities, and genuinely interested in what makes an agentic product good for users.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication. Clear, concise long-form writing is how this team works.
  • Direct, kind, calm and empathetic. You hold people accountable and navigate hard conversations without drama.

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

  • Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
  • Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
  • Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
  • Generous number of vacation days each year
  • Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
  • Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
  • Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. title: Senior Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰 £138,000 - £175,000 + Equity + Benefits 

About the Role 

This role is for a Senior Engineering Manager where you’ll be a manager of managers. You will be leading across multiple teams in an org of around 20-30 people. We’re expanding and your role as the Senior EM will be to grow and build new squads as needed. Your direct reports will include Tech Leads, Senior Engineers and 2-3 Engineering Managers.

Senior Engineering Managers at Monzo are part of cross-functional, autonomous teams and groups. Our teams are mission driven, and typically include Product Managers, backend, web and mobile engineers as well as data scientists, designers and subject matter experts relevant to that mission. Teams are organised into groups, and then collectives - we aim to keep our line management structure as shallow as possible, and for teams to directly own decision making relevant to their work.

Senior Engineering Managers are accountable for the technical and delivery outcomes for their area - that means supporting and developing best in class engineering talent, as well as creating an inclusive team environment for people to do their best work. You’ll be responsible for structuring, organising, supporting and challenging your team to deliver on their mission.

You can read more on the expectations of Senior Engineering Managers in our Progression Framework.

Is this role right for you?

While this is not a role which requires hands-on-coding, we are looking for an experienced manager who has a strong technical and delivery background and has worked as a software engineer in previous roles.

We recognise that Senior Engineering Managers lead in different ways, we’re looking for someone who is adept at: 

  • Delivery and Execution: Enjoys taking accountability for delivery across your squad(s), collaborating with the Technical Lead and Product Manager.
  • Engineering and Operational Excellence: Actively fosters a high bar for engineering excellence within your teams. You’re accountable for the technical outcomes your teams deliver alongside individual engineer performance and growth, so holding a high bar (and clearly articulating your expectations) is key.
  • People Leadership: Has experience directly managing at least 2-3 Engineering Managers and leading orgs of around ~20 engineers. You can support, coach and develop them through their career with regular 1:1s and continuous feedback.
  • Technical Influence: Partners with senior engineers to drive technical initiatives that raise the bar for our engineering practices.
  • Stakeholder Relationships: Builds strong stakeholder relationships with other teams, and creates a focus space for engineers to do their best work.
  • Organisational Wide Impact: Collaborates with the wider engineering organisation to contribute to company-wide best managerial and technical practices and standards.

We consider your application across all open EM roles at Monzo independent of which role you've applied for, so if you've recently applied to a similar role at Monzo and have been unsuccessful, please wait 6 months before applying again.

How we work 💻:

Locations & Flexible Working : 

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. 

We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. 

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨

Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼

The interview process:

After an initial informal recruiter call you go through two main stages

  1. Initial Call (1 hour) You'll meet with one of our Senior Engineering Managers or Engineering Directors. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular people leadership, product delivery and technical leadership. They’ll ask example based questions (‘Tell me about a time when…’)

  2. Loop Stage (3 hours 30 mins) The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability) and one 30 minute reverse interview (more details below).

The Loop is one stage and the interviews in this stage are:

- Team and Org Management (1 hour)An example based interview with 1-2 of our engineering leaders. They’re interested to hear examples from your previous experience on the teams you’ve led, how you’ve shaped and partnered with product, and the impact you had.

- System Design (1 hour)You'll partner with a Staff or Principal Engineer on a technical whiteboarding exercise.

- Behavioural (1 hour)Similar to Team and Org Management, this is an example based interview with 1-2 Engineering Leaders. This interview focuses on your people leadership style and core behaviours as an Engineering Manager.

- Chat with an Engineering Leader (30 mins)At Monzo, we believe interviews are a two-way street. This will be your opportunity to ask us any questions about Monzo, engineering leadership or our teams – whatever’s on your mind. 

All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀

Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You’ll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team throughout the process.

title: (Senior) Enterprise Engagement Manager (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Stackgini

How do you govern 20,000 applications when nobody in the building still knows which of them do the same thing? How do you get faster to market and leaner at the same time, when business units ship AI prototypes in days and the regulatory load grows every quarter?

Stackgini is the AI operating system for Autonomous Enterprise IT. Our system understands our customers' enterprise tech landscape from the ground up: from technical configuration to application documentation, from a single tech demand to the dependencies across the entire portfolio. With the depth of knowledge of a senior tech expert and the speed of a machine. Some of the largest organizations in the world work with us, including DAX-40 and Fortune-500 customers like Siemens Healthineers and REWE.

We're a small, talent-dense team, building what we believe will change how the world's largest companies operate. We are growing fast, and the people joining now are the ones who set the standard - for the product, the culture, and our category. Stackgini will be the place where you will do the most meaningful work of your career.

About the role

As an Enterprise Engagement Manager, you own what Stackgini actually becomes inside our customers. You take over once the deal closes and guide the organization from the first target-picture discussion to the point where tech demand management runs differently than it did before.

This is advisory work with a product behind it. You sit with CIOs, IT business partners, and enterprise architects, understand how their demand process works today and where it breaks, and design a target picture they can defend internally. You measure what it delivered and turn that into the basis for the next year.

Unlike consulting, you don't walk out after the final presentation. You stay with the accounts you own and see, over years, what became of your work.

Areas of ownership

  • Strategic advisory. You are the trusted advisor to tech leaders in DAX-40, Fortune-500, and ambitious mid-market organizations. You show them what best-practice AI-first demand management looks like and bring an outside view they can't get internally. Out of that you develop the target picture with them, from the end-to-end process concept to how Stackgini fits into the existing IT toolchain.

  • Value realization. You define the KPIs you will be measured against together with the customer, baseline them, and prove the effect. You guide them through portfolio optimization and build the business cases behind it. Realized value is not a story for the QBR here, it is the number the role hangs on.

  • Stakeholder engagement. You make the champions inside the customer's organization successful. You give them the arguments, the evidence, and the backing they need to carry Stackgini into business units, IT governance, architecture, procurement, and information security.

  • Adoption and enablement. You make power users and multipliers capable through trainings, best practices, and workshops, and you feed what you learn back into our methodology.

  • Account growth and expansion. Identify and drive expansion opportunities by developing growth plans across new use cases, teams, and units, and spot risk before it surfaces in a renewal.

  • Build our customer value engine. You work hands-on on daily operations, expand the Stackgini Academy into a best-in-class enablement hub, and develop thought leadership assets: playbooks, point-of-view content, best practice guides.

  • Partner cross-functionally. Bring structured customer insights into Product and Engineering, shape our roadmap with use-case-driven evidence, and support Sales on key strategic deals.

Who you are

  • 2+ years in enterprise tech or consulting. Strategy or management consulting, IT transformation, or an enterprise tech function such as IT governance, architecture, or tech demand management. What matters is that you owned an outcome at a customer, not a workstream.

  • You structure ambiguity. You break down complex problems, shape them into clear options, and build processes that work without you.

  • You hold your own up to C-level. Precise in writing, structured in speech, composed in front of executives. In German and English.

  • AI-native, not AI-curious. You can describe concretely how you use LLMs, agents, or custom workflows in your daily work. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to be credible in a room with one.

  • Ownership over scope. You move things forward without waiting to be assigned, and client-facing work energizes you rather than drains you.

What's a plus

  • A real understanding of how enterprise tech organizations work, ideally with exposure to enterprise architecture, IT governance, software asset management, or IT procurement

  • Experience designing onboarding paths, trainings, and certifications that drive adoption at scale

Your first 90 days

  • You own accounts and know their demand process well enough to challenge it.

  • You have built a target picture and the corresponding value KPIs with at least one customer.

  • You run workshops and trainings on your own, with business and tech in the same room.

  • You have improved one thing about our methodology, because you saw where it didn't hold up at a customer.

Process

Intro call, hiring manager interview, case study, meeting the team.

Compensation Package

The annual salary for this permanent, full-time position is EUR 80,000–110,000 per year and employee stock options.

Benefits

  • Gympass

  • Deutschlandticket subscription

This is a broad, high-ownership role. The ERP is the backbone that connects orders, materials, production and money. You will decide how that backbone is built, and you will be accountable for it working on day one of series production.

About us

We're a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications. We are building our first production facility in Steyerberg, Lower Saxony, and are applying our knowledge toward serial production of solid rocket motors.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you're excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you're ready to rise to the challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead the implementation of Dynamics 365 F&O across finance, procurement, inventory, production control, sales and project accounting.

  • Own the target process design (to-be) and run process workshops with finance, operations, engineering, quality and supply chain.

  • Define the integration architecture between Dynamics 365 F&O, the MES/PLC layer, and third-party systems (e.g., Power BI, CRM, banking, tax).

  • Lead data migration and master data design: items, bills of materials, routings, batches, suppliers and customers.

  • Define configuration, security role and authorization concepts, and the internal control requirements of the company.

  • Manage the ERP project team, implementation partners, budget and timeline.

  • Establish governance for change control, release management, testing and user training.

  • Ensure the ERP meets regulatory requirements for regulated energetic materials: batch and lot traceability, stock of hazardous materials, and the records required under German explosives law.

What we are looking for

  • Several years of experience leading ERP implementations or large process changes, ideally with Dynamics 365 F&O (or Dynamics AX).

  • Functional expertise in at least two of the following: production control, procurement, inventory and warehouse management, finance (GL, AP, AR), project accounting.

  • Strong understanding of end-to-end manufacturing processes (order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, plan-to-produce, record-to-report).

  • Experience with integration architectures (APIs, middleware, data management) and with shop-floor or manufacturing execution systems.

  • The ability to lead cross-functional teams and to communicate with executives and external partners.

  • A degree in business informatics, industrial engineering, business administration, computer science or a related discipline; equivalent experience may also be relevant.

Desirable experience

  • Dynamics 365 F&O certification or a Microsoft functional or solution architect certification.

  • X++ development, Data Management Framework, Azure Integration Services (Logic Apps, Service Bus) or Power Platform.

  • Experience in a regulated manufacturing environment (chemicals, pharmaceuticals, aerospace or defence).

  • Knowledge of German commercial and tax requirements (HGB, GoBD) and e-invoicing.

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up environment where processes are built from scratch.

  • Working proficiency in German.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

  • Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

title: Senior Executive Assistant
descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril’s Maritime Division seeks a Senior Executive Assistant to provide a wide variety of complex and professional-level executive support duties in support of 2-3 VPs. This person will be in a position of high trust and serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external clients. The Senior Executive Assistant is expected to help drive cross-functional projects and initiatives critical to the Maritime Executives, while also serving as a liaison to senior management teams. The ideal candidate must be detail-oriented, have the ability to exercise good judgment in a variety of situations, action items with limited oversight, think critically, and offer solutions to problems with a high-level of professionalism and discretion. Being able to anticipate needs of the Executives, maintaining balance among competing priorities, and working well under pressure are essential skills to succeed in this role.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Provide high-level administrative support to 2-3 VPs including managing calendars, preparing reports, drafting correspondence, coordinating complex travel plans, scheduling meetings, and compiling documents
  • Scope and coordinate critical projects and special assignments on behalf of the Executives by prioritizing tasks, gaining cooperation from relevant stakeholders, monitoring progress, problem-solving, and making necessary adjustments to ensure timely completion
  • Plan and execute day-to-day administrative tasks to ensure a smooth workflow for the Executives
  • Serve as a representative of the Executives with an array of internal and external clients
  • Maintain the Executives schedules and act as the primary point of contact for accessing their time
  • Identify opportunities to create new processes and systems to effectively support the needs of the Executives and their teams
  • Produce and prepare reports for the Executives on a variety of topics, liaising with members of senior leadership and other members of the business
  • Draft and revise memos, emails, agendas, notes, reports, presentations, and other communications to the highest-quality standards
  • Plan, execute, oversee, and facilitate all logistical aspects for on-site VIP meetings and events involving the Executives. This includes preparing agendas, presentation materials, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure seamless execution
  • Manage sensitive matters with a high-level of confidentiality and discretion, especially decisions with significant impact on operations of the company
  • Own and arrange travel, accommodations, itineraries, and all correspondence related to arrangements as needed for the Executives

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • A minimum of 5 years experience supporting VP to C-Suite level executives in a fast-paced corporate environment
  • Proven ability to balance multi-departmental projects from conception to execution with little to no supervision
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills. Approachable style and ability to effectively and professionally interface with high level executives, clients, employees, and business associates both internal and external
  • Strong organizational and time management skills. Proven experience in multitasking and working with multiple people and priorities, while delivering on high quality results and follow through
  • Demonstrates curiosity and a desire to understand the needs of the Executives
  • Highly trustworthy with ability to exercise sound discretion and function under highly ambiguous direction with constantly changing requirements
  • Proven ability to handle confidential and sensitive information in a professional manner
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
  • Strong Microsoft Office Suite skills
  • Proficient in scheduling meetings in multiple time zones
  • Experience as a project manager is highly preferred and desired

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an ----- address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to

    • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is ----- before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

    • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to 

 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/. 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

title: Senior Executive Assistant to the CEO (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

Building a fusion company across two continents takes focus, strong relationships and thoughtful coordination. Our CEO works closely with investors, governments, strategic partners and the leadership team. You create the structure that helps him use his time effectively and arrive prepared.

This is the most senior executive support role at Focused Energy. You will work directly with the CEO as part of a closely coordinated CEO Office, in partnership with and reporting to the Chief of Staff. You will take ownership of the operational infrastructure supporting the CEO, including diary and calendar management, travel coordination, executive administration and stakeholder logistics. The Chief of Staff leads strategic priorities, substantive briefings, executive alignment and follow-through on key decisions. You ensure the practical arrangements and information flow support those priorities effectively.

When a delegation trip with twelve meetings across three countries changes at short notice, you bring the overview and experience to rebuild the plan, coordinate the people involved and keep everyone informed. You enjoy solving complex logistics and creating clarity when plans change.

You will exercise sound judgment and make day-to-day decisions independently within agreed parameters, knowing when to escalate strategic conflicts or sensitive matters. You will help establish reliable, efficient ways of working as the CEO Office develops.

You represent the CEO Office to investors, ministries, partner companies and board members. As the most experienced EA in the company, you also help shape how executive support works across Focused Energy.

What You'll Do

  • Plan and coordinate the CEO’s domestic and international travel, including complex delegations, conferences and investor or government engagements.

  • Own itineraries, participants, visas, invitations, registrations, protocol requirements, ground logistics, contingency arrangements and live coordination during trips.

  • Be willing to accompany the CEO internationally when needed, independently or alongside the Chief of Staff, while providing effective remote support on trips you do not attend.

  • Maintain a clear overview of upcoming commitments and what each requires. Anticipate conflicts, preparation needs and logistical dependencies, and act early.

  • Coordinate the timely preparation, collation and distribution of briefing materials, working with the Chief of Staff and relevant content owners.

  • Maintain clear administrative follow-up and ensure decisions, commitments and emerging priorities are promptly communicated to the Chief of Staff for strategic follow-through.

  • Build trusted relationships with investors, ministries, agencies, partner companies, board members and their offices.

  • Keep the CEO Office running effectively, including expenses, approvals, signatures, tools, records and contact management.

  • Help develop shared standards for calendar management, travel, tools and confidentiality, supporting collaboration and teamwork across the EA team, both locally and internationally.

Who You Are

  • You bring ten or more years of experience in executive support, including several years supporting a CEO, founder or managing director in an international business with extensive travel and calendar management. Experience in a growing company or investor environment is a plus.

  • You have supported highly driven, fast-moving executives and can bring structure to changing or incomplete requests.

  • You have managed complex delegation trips involving multiple participants, countries and official meetings.

  • You combine strong organisation, judgment and emotional intelligence with a calm, adaptable style and are comfortable partnering with a Chief of Staff while maintaining a direct, trusted relationship with the CEO.

  • You understand competing priorities and can make confident decisions within your remit.

  • You protect an executive’s time with diplomacy and build constructive relationships with the people seeking it.

  • You are comfortable working with board members, investors, ministries and senior executives, as well as the teams supporting them.

  • You work proactively, identifying scheduling conflicts, travel requirements and preparation needs before they become urgent.

  • You stay composed when plans change, communicate clearly and know when to bring others into a decision.

  • You handle sensitive board, investor, M&A and personnel matters with discretion.

  • You use modern scheduling and collaboration tools confidently and are interested in using AI thoughtfully to reduce repetitive work.

  • You are fluent in English and German.

  • You are based in Berlin, or willing to relocate, and comfortable travelling with the CEO when needed.

A Word On Pace

This is a demanding role, with a strong emphasis on complex calendar management, exceptional attention to detail and the delivery of high-level, hands-on executive support to the CEO of a rapidly growing international company. Priorities can shift quickly and some trips or commitments require flexibility at short notice. It calls for someone who enjoys responsibility, stays calm under pressure and communicates clearly about priorities and capacity.

In return, you can expect meaningful ownership, a close working partnership with the CEO and Chief of Staff, and the opportunity to help shape how the CEO Office operates. You will be trusted to exercise judgment within agreed responsibilities and escalation parameters.

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs—whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

 


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

title: Senior Export Control Manager - Defense (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
TYTAN Technologies

The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We push boundaries, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in.

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty.

We are looking for an Senior Export Control Manager whose has understanding of defense product related export control and customs regulation to ensure full compliance with export control, customs, and trade regulations across our operations.

The role works closely with Logistics, Procurement, Production, and Engineering, while owning all export control and customs compliance topics within the Operations team, specifically related to the production and international movement of KWL-controlled goods.

You will act as the subject matter expert for both export control and customs, ensuring compliant classification, licensing, customs processes, and documentation across the entire operational value chain.

Your Roadmap to Make an Impact

Export Control & Trade Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with German, EU, and international export control regulations, including AWG, AWV, EU Dual-Use Regulation, and applicable international regimes.

  • Own export control topics for KWL-controlled goods, including classification, licensing, documentation, and audit readiness.

  • Classify products, components, software, and technology (e.g. KWL, ECCN, HS) in cooperation with Engineering and Product Management.

  • Determine licensing requirements, apply for and manage export licenses, and conduct embargo, sanctions, and restricted party screenings.

Customs & Import / Export Operations

  • Ensure compliance with customs regulations for imports and exports, including tariff classification (HS), customs valuation, origin determination, and preference management.

  • Coordinate customs processes with freight forwarders, customs brokers, and authorities.

  • Review and approve customs documentations and manage customs-related authorizations and procedures (e.g. simplified procedures, AEO where applicable).

Operations & Supply Chain Collaboration

  • Work closely with Logistics, Production Planning and Procurement to ensure compliant material flow.

  • Advise Operations on compliance implications for manufacturing, internal transfers, re-exports, and technology access.

  • Support onboarding of new suppliers and logistics partners and ensure export control and customs requirements are embedded into operational workflows and ERP systems.

  • Support item onboarding to ensure data quality across the product life-cycle.

Process Ownership & Governance

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve export control and customs processes, SOPs, and work instructions within Operations.

  • Maintain complete and audit-ready documentation, records, and prepare and support internal and external audits, and authority requests.

  • Act as the main point of contact for export control and customs authorities and external advisors.

Leadership & Advisory

  • Act as a lead for export control and customs department. Train and advise employees in Operations, Supply Chain, and Logistics on export control and customs requirements.

  • Monitor regulatory changes and assess their impact on different processes and act as escalation point and decision-maker for complex compliance cases.


  • 6+ years of experience in defense product export control, customs, or trade compliance in the defense area.

  • Strong knowledge of German export control regulations (AWG, AWV, KWL) and customs law; EU Dual-Use Regulation required, understanding of US EAR/ITAR is also important .

  • Understanding of export control and customs rules for defense product is a must have.

  • Experience with KWL-controlled goods and complex international supply chains.

  • Hands-on experience with customs classification, valuation, origin, and broker coordination.

  • High level of ownership, structured working style, and attention to detail.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

  • Fluency in German and English (written and spoken).

Why TYTAN?

  • Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defense systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security

  • Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defense technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

  • Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation

  • Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit

  • Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us

  • Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team

  • Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together

  • Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands

  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.

title: Senior Field Marketing & ABM Manager, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Serval is an AI-native automation platform transforming how enterprises operate. We build intelligent agents that understand real-world workflows and execute them end-to-end — replacing manual processes and rigid legacy systems with adaptive, learning software. Founded in early 2024, Serval is already trusted by companies like Fox, Notion, Perplexity, Vercel, and Brex to automate high-volume, high-friction operational work across their organizations.

At the core of Serval is an agentic AI platform that turns natural language into production-grade workflows. Our agents don’t just respond to requests — they reason, take action across systems, and continuously improve with usage. What began with operational use cases has quickly evolved into a horizontal AI automation layer used across IT, HR, Finance, Security, Legal, and Engineering.

Our mission is to eliminate repetitive, manual work across the enterprise and give teams leverage through intelligent automation. Long term, we’re building the universal AI operations layer — a system of agents that sits across business functions and runs the workflows that keep modern companies moving.

We’re backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Meritech, First Round, General Catalyst, Elad Gil, and others.

Role Overview

The opportunities that matter most are often the hardest to get in front of. As our first Field Marketing & ABM hire in EMEA, you'll partner directly with Sales to build our field motion in the region from zero: high-impact programs across segments and 1:1 ABM plays for our most strategic accounts. You'll challenge the status quo in field marketing to create unique experiences and moments that open doors, build trust, and move deals forward.

This is a build role, not a run role. There is no EMEA playbook to inherit: you'll write it. Expect increasing scope, budget, and responsibility as our European presence grows, and expect to hire behind you.

Who You Are

  • Creative and opportunistic. You see an opening where others see a closed door. You know that breaking through to hard-to-reach accounts isn't about budget, it's about timing, creativity, and understanding what matters.

  • Allergic to "best practices" that produce mediocre results. You'd rather test something bold than execute something safe.

  • A doer, not a delegator. You're equally comfortable building a Salesforce report, negotiating with a venue in Shoreditch, or sending a llama with an invite around its neck to a CIO's office in Canary Wharf.

  • Comfortable being first. You're energised by an empty calendar and a blank budget line, and you don't need a US playbook translated for you.

What You'll Do

  • Define the EMEA go-to-market strategy for field programs: what we do, where we show up, and how we win across UK&I, DACH, Benelux, and the Nordics.

  • Design 1:1, 1:few, and 1:many field marketing experiences [regional dinners, happy hours, hackathons, out of the box experiences, etc] that align to active opportunities and target accounts.

  • Orchestrate ABM programs with Strategic accounts across channels: direct mail, events, digital, gifting, and content, navigating the practical realities of multi-country execution [shipping, VAT, GDPR, local vendors, language].

  • Partner with sales to understand territory priorities, account dynamics, and pipeline gaps, then actively participate in deal strategy, not just event execution.

  • Adapt what works globally and kill what doesn't travel. Bring the best of our US programs to Europe, and feed EMEA-born ideas back the other way.

  • Track impact through account engagement, pilots started, velocity, and closed-won revenue.

  • Create tight feedback loops with Sales leadership on both sides of the Atlantic to continuously improve territory strategy and program effectiveness.

  • Test unconventional tactics. Push boundaries. Try things that make people's jaws drop.

What You'll Need

  • 5-7+ years experience in field, experiential, growth, or ABM marketing.

  • Experience running programs across multiple European markets, not just the UK.

  • Proficiency with Salesforce, Hubspot [or similar], and intent tools [6sense, Demandbase, or similar].

  • Proven track record of running regional field programs, account-based campaigns, or growth programs that drove measurable pipeline and revenue.

  • Strong data analysis skills. You can build reports, interpret metrics, and make data-driven decisions.

  • Deep experience partnering with Sales teams and marketing to Enterprise and Strategic companies.

  • Creative thinker who can turn a vague goal into a concrete, compelling plan and crush the execution.

  • Comfortable moving fast, experimenting, and adjusting in real time.

  • Strong collaborator who earns trust with Sales quickly, including with a US-based marketing team across time zones.

  • Comfortable with 25% travel across EMEA, up to 50% seasonally.

  • Based in London with the right to work in the UK.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience marketing to IT, Engineering, or Security leaders.

  • Experience as an early or first marketing hire in a new region.

  • Additional European languages.

What We Offer

  • Impact: Be a key player in shaping the success of our product and company.

  • Growth: Build a fundamentally new AI product offering with the support of our experienced team and investors. Grow rapidly with the company.

  • Culture: Join a culture that values innovation, ownership, accountability, and fun.

Compensation: £110K – £150K • Offers Equity

title: Senior Field Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Ping Identity: 

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. 

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. 

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. 

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. 

Ping Identity is looking for a proactive Senior Field Marketing Manager to join the UKI region. This team has gone through a restructure in 2025 and while has the largest customer base in EMEA ,the objective is to drive geo growth in 2H 2026 and beyond.  There is considerable effort needed to boost brand awareness and create net new logo demand to achieve the regions’ ambitious growth targets. 

This individual will be responsible for the UKI region, alongside a UKI Field Marketing Specialist. This innovative and forward-thinking marketing professional will partner closely with the UKI Sales leaders and Sales organisation and work with pan-EMEA Go To Market (GTM) teams to develop and implement a strategic integrated GTM plan, focusing on multi-touch campaigns that drive qualified pipeline.

Duty and Responsibilities:

  • Jointly work as part of the UKI leadership team and the Senior Manager Field Marketing for Northern Europe to develop the strategic approach required for success in region to drive exceptional growth
  • Work with internal parties and third-party vendors to develop and achieve our Go To Market vision in region
  • Execute the UKI plan with clear focus on delivering the metrics of success
  • Manage the day to day activity of the Field Marketing Specialist, ensuring growth and development
  • Review, refine and develop the GTM tactics on a regular basis to ensure continued engagement and penetration into the named strategic accounts
  • Work with the Pan-EMEA Programmes lead to create and execute vertical or use case led GTM plans for Account Executives to an enterprise audience (ABM 1:Few, 1:1, Deal acceleration programmes,)
  • Provide articulate feedback on the campaigns, analysis of success and next steps
  • Participate to the quarterly QBRs reporting on successes and outlining future strategies and tactics
  • Responsible for budget and procurement processes, auditing and accountability for budget spend and management

Desired Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or in a related field.
  • A minimum of 2-3 years’ experience in Senior Field Marketing role
  • Previous experience in the IT industry, ideally in a technology B2B SAAS environment
  • Knowledge of current digital marketing technologies and techniques.
  • Working knowledge of SFDC and Marketo.
  • Great relationship building and negotiation skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Positive attitude and work collaboratively. 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong initiative and ability to work independently and collaboratively.

Qualifications:

  • A marketing or related business degree or equivalent

Working Conditions:

  • Travel – approximately 30% travel, mostly within the UKI region but some within Europe or US
  • Remote working contract with occasional travel to our London and Bristol based offices to work alongside the regional Sales Development Reps

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day. 

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

  • A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.
  • Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.
  • Regular company and team bonding events.
  • Competitive benefits and perks.
  • Global volunteering and community initiatives

Our Benefits: 

  • Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule 
  • Parental Leave
  • Progressive Healthcare Options
  • Retirement Programs
  • Opportunity for Education Reimbursement 
  • Commuter Offset (Specific locations) 

Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone’s individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.

We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Senior Field Marketing Manager, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About Assembled

Assembled helps companies scale great customer support. As consumers, we’ve all been there. You need help, you’re stuck on hold or going in circles with an AI, and your problem still isn’t solved.

Behind great support is a complex operational problem: thousands of people and AI agents working across teams, time zones, and products as new problems emerge. Assembled gives support leaders the tools to manage that complexity, from AI agents that resolve customer issues to software that forecasts demand, builds schedules, and makes intraday adjustments.

More than 400 companies, including DoorDash, Salesforce, Stripe, and Sephora, trust Assembled. We've raised $71M from NEA, Emergence Capital, Stripe, and Basis Set Ventures and have offices in San Francisco, New York, and London.

The Role

We’re hiring our first marketer in London. Europe is our next growth market, and right now we’ve got a tight-knit, quota-focused sales team with big goals and not much regional marketing behind them—yet.

 

You’ll change that. Field events are the engine — dinners, roadshows, conferences, executive gatherings that put our team in front of the CX and Workforce Management leaders running Europe’s most complex operations. But this isn’t a role that stops at the event calendar. You’ll be the person who figures out what the European market needs from marketing and then goes and does it.

 

We’re starting in the UK with plans to expand across the region. You’ll work closely with our global events lead on moments where EMEA shows up inside the worldwide program, and with our growth team on campaigns that need European flair.

 

We work together in person five days a week from our London office in King’s Cross.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own the EMEA field calendar and the budget behind it — decide which events, dinners, and roadshows are worth doing, and which ones we skip

  • Run field as a pipeline channel: pre-event targeting through opportunity creation and deal acceleration, with named accounts attached to every program

  • Build account-based programs sized to the deal, whether that's one account, a handful, or a roomful, in lockstep with the London sales team

  • Build our EMEA partner and channel motion — joint events, co-marketing, and the relationships that get us in front of buyers we can't reach on our own

  • Be the voice of the European market inside Assembled: what needs localizing, which content doesn't land, where our story has to change by country, and what customer stories to bring to life

  • Foster community efforts. Get to know the European CX/WFM community by genuinely contributing and building relationships across a wide variety of stakeholders

  • Bring EU-specific campaign ideas to the team and make sure Europe is designed into campaigns rather than translated at the end

  • Build AI workflows that let one marketer cover multiple countries — invite list enrichment, event pages, personalized follow-up at volume, post-event analysis

 

What You Bring

  • 6–9 years in field, events, or regional marketing at B2B companies selling into enterprise, including time owning UK or EMEA programs rather than supporting someone else's

  • Startup, get sh*t done mindset. The region is new and our team there is small and scrappy. You know how to spot the highest-leverage opportunities and collaborate cross-functionally to make magic happen

  • You've been early somewhere — the first marketer in a region or on a small team, where no playbook existed and you wrote one

  • Event judgment with receipts. Tell us about an event you cut and why, not only the ones that worked

  • Nice to have: experience in European markets beyond the UK, with an understanding of how programs need to differ by market

  • A close working relationship with sales. You've sat in pipeline reviews, you know what an AE needs from a dinner, and you can hold your own on account strategy

  • AI systems you've built and use, with an example you can walk through. One marketer covering this much ground without AI is a headcount request, not a plan

  • A bias to go first. You'd rather run a twelve-person dinner next month than spend the quarter planning a conference booth for next year

 

Our UK benefits

  • Quarterly credits for professional development, wellness, and commuting

  • Budget for AI tools and experimentation, giving you room to test new ideas, build workflows, and rethink how you work

  • Paid parental leave

  • Onsite work model with catered lunches everyday (M-F)

 

The estimated base salary range for this role is £80,000 - £105,000 per year. The base pay offered may vary depending on location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Stock options are provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered.

 

We know great candidates don’t always meet every requirement listed in a job description. If the role excites you and you believe you can make an impact at Assembled, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels like they belong and has the opportunity to do their best work. We look forward to hearing from you!

For United States Applicants:
Assembled participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the United States.

For United Kingdom Applicants:
Assembled is required to verify your right to work in the UK and will conduct a Right to Work check prior to employment in accordance with applicable law.
