title: Senior Fullstack Entwickler Java / Angular (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wer wir sind

Rockstardevelopers, gegründet 2015 in Mannheim, weitere Büros in Stuttgart und München. Wir sind ein Software-Entwickler mit Erfahrung aus hunderten von individuellen Projekten für Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden.

Kurze Wege, ehrliches Feedback, keine politischen Spielchen. Keine Hierarchie-Ebenen zwischen dir und den Leuten, die Entscheidungen treffen.

Deine Aufgaben

Du arbeitest in Kundenprojekten bei großen Unternehmen und öffentlichen Auftraggebern, eingebettet in deren Teams, mit voller Verantwortung für deinen Bereich.

  • Fullstack-Entwicklung in Enterprise- und regulierten Umgebungen
  • Architektur mitgestalten, nicht nur umsetzen
  • Code generieren, reviewen und refactoren mit Claude Code, Copilot oder Cursor
  • Code Reviews und technisches Mentoring im Team
  • Abstimmung mit Product Ownern, UX und DevOps

Die meisten kommen ein bis zwei Tage die Woche in eins der Büros. Zwang ist das aber keiner. Beim Kunden vor Ort bist du nur für einzelne Termine alle paar Wochen, meist in Frankfurt am Main.

Wo du landest

Je nach Projekt und deiner Erfahrung:

  • Großkonzerne wie Deutsche Bahn / DB Systel (eisenbahnspezifische Domänen: Fahrplanmanagement, Vertrieb, Leit- und Sicherungstechnik)
  • Öffentlicher Sektor / Behörden (z. B. Bundesagentur für Arbeit, ITZBund, Bundesdruckerei) – regulierte Umgebungen, Barrierefreiheit, Security by Design
  • Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen

Unsere Kunden besetzen diese Projekte fast nur mit Festangestellten. Deshalb suchen wir dich in Festanstellung.

Erfahrung in einem dieser Umfelder ist ein starkes Plus – sag uns in den Fragen, wo du herkommst.

Was du mitbringst

Senior-Level. Unsere Kunden brauchen Leute, die ab Tag eins liefern und eigenständig arbeiten.

Backend-Kern (das erwarten wir):

  • Java (17+) und Spring Boot (Microservices, Domain Driven Design)
  • REST-Schnittstellen und relationale Datenbanken, vor allem PostgreSQL
  • Docker und Kubernetes
  • Testgetriebene Entwicklung (TDD) mit JUnit – Tests gehören bei uns zur Definition of Done, nicht in die Nacharbeit
  • Apache Kafka / asynchrone Kommunikation
  • CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), Git, agiles Arbeiten

Frontend (das erwarten wir):

  • Angular mit TypeScript

Von Vorteil (kein Muss):

  • LLM-Integration in Fachanwendungen (RAG, Tool-Calling/MCP, Agenten), gern mit einem Projektbeispiel
  • Kotlin, Camunda (BPMN-Prozessautomatisierung)
  • AWS oder Azure, JPA/Hibernate
  • Monitoring (Grafana, Prometheus), Tests im Frontend (Jest, Playwright, Cypress)
  • Barrierefreiheit (BITV 2.0 / WCAG AA), DevSecOps / Security by Design (öffentlicher Sektor)

Du musst nicht alles können. Wichtig ist, dass du auf beiden Seiten sicher bist und dich schnell in neue Stacks reinfindest.

AI-Tools sind Pflicht, kein Bonus

Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor: Damit musst du produktiv arbeiten können. Nicht weil wir hip sein wollen, sondern weil unsere Kunden das erwarten und wir auch so arbeiten. Wenn du AI-Tools für einen Hype hältst und lieber alles selbst tippst: falsche Firma. Intern investieren wir in deine AI-Skills.

Was wir bieten

  • MacBook (außer der Kunde stellt eigene Hardware)
  • Verschiedene Kunden, verschiedene Projekte
  • Die Gründer sind deine direkten Ansprechpartner
  • Internes Upskilling in AI-Entwicklung

Bewerbung

Lebenslauf reicht. Kein Anschreiben nötig. Nach einer kurzen Video-Frage-Runde (2×90 Sekunden) melden wir uns innerhalb weniger Tage.

title: Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) – PHP/Symfony & React
descriptionHtml:
Der Plan steht, jetzt fehlst du: Bring für unseren Kunden die Software von Legacy-PHP auf Symfony und React.

Auf einen Blick

  • Stack: PHP 8.1 (Legacy) → Symfony · jQuery/Vanilla-JS → React · MySQL/MariaDB, SingleStore · Git, CI/CD

  • Gehalt: 52.000–62.000 € brutto/Jahr, für außergewöhnliche Profile auch mehr · unbefristet, Vollzeit

  • Arbeitsmodell: hybrid, 3 Tage Büro / 2 Tage remote

  • Standort: Berlin

  • Produkt: Eine Software für Termin- und Vorgangsmanagement in der öffentlichen Verwaltung

  • Start: so bald wie möglich oder nach Vereinbarung

Die Rolle

Das Kernprodukt unserer Kunden ist über viele Jahre gewachsen, und das sieht man dem Code an. Das Backend läuft auf PHP 8.1 ohne Framework. Im Frontend stehen jQuery und Vanilla-JS neben React, und automatisierte Tests gibt es bisher wenige.

Wohin es gehen soll, ist klar: Das Backend wird schrittweise auf Symfony umgestellt, das Frontend auf React vereinheitlicht. Bis Ende 2027 soll die Migration abgeschlossen sein. Was dafür fehlt, ist kein Plan, sondern Kapazität.

Du triffst eigenständig technische Entscheidungen, bringst dich in Architektur- und Modernisierungsfragen ein und sorgst dafür, dass die Codequalität mit jedem Release besser wird. Dabei bleibt das Produkt im Einsatz: Wartung, Support und neue Features laufen parallel zur Modernisierung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Legacy-Module bei laufendem Betrieb schrittweise durch Symfony-Services und React-Oberflächen ersetzen

  • Fullstack-Features von der Datenbank bis zum Frontend entwickeln, teils auch als kundenspezifische Erweiterungen

  • Bestehenden Legacy-Code pflegen, debuggen und weiterentwickeln

  • Code-Reviews durchführen und die Testabdeckung ausbauen

  • Mit Entwicklungsleitung und Geschäftsführung abstimmen, welche Bereiche als Nächstes modernisiert werden

  • Zwei Auszubildende im letzten Ausbildungsabschnitt fachlich begleiten (ohne disziplinarische Führung)

  • Gelegentlich an Kundenterminen teilnehmen, etwa alle 3–4 Wochen

Nach 6 Monaten …

… setzt du Features eigenständig um, hast spürbar zur Modernisierung beigetragen, die Codequalität verbessert und bist für die Auszubildenden eine feste Ansprechperson.

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: etwa 4–5 Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung (ein Richtwert, keine harte Grenze)

  • PHP: fundierte Kenntnisse in modernem PHP 8.x mit objektorientierter Architektur, etwa Dependency Injection, Interfaces und SOLID

  • Symfony: nachweisbare Praxiserfahrung mit dem Framework

  • Legacy-Code: Du gehst sicher mit gewachsenen Codebasen um. Du refaktorierst, debuggst und entwickelst weiter, ohne alles neu zu schreiben.

  • JavaScript/React: solide Erfahrung im Frontend, jQuery schreckt dich nicht ab

  • Datenbanken: relationale Datenbanken wie MySQL/MariaDB oder SingleStore und sicherer Umgang mit SQL

  • Tooling: Git und Arbeit mit CI/CD

  • Sprache: Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, Englisch mindestens B1

  • Arbeitsweise: eigenständig, strukturiert, proaktiv und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch

  • Persönlich: Du kommunizierst verlässlich, arbeitest gern im Team, übernimmst Verantwortung, hast keine Angst vor schwierigen Codestellen und gibst dein Wissen gern weiter.

  • Abschluss: Ausbildung oder FH-Abschluss zählen genauso viel wie ein Uni-Studium. Entscheidend ist deine Praxiserfahrung.

Pluspunkte: REST/API-Design und Schnittstellenentwicklung, automatisiertes Testing (PHPUnit, Jest), Docker, Deployment-Pipelines und Cloud, Software-Architektur und Design-Patterns, produktiver Einsatz von KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder Codex. Erfahrung mit Software für den öffentlichen Sektor ist nicht nötig.

Dein Team

Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen: ein Developer Lead, ein Geschäftsführer und Projektmanager, der selbst aktiv mitentwickelt, ein externer Entwickler und zwei Auszubildende. Ihr stimmt euch täglich ab. Die Entwicklungsleitung und die Geschäftsführung übernehmen dein Onboarding persönlich.

Was wir bieten

  • Ein sinnstiftendes Produkt, das täglich in Bürgerämtern genutzt wird, in einem krisensicheren Markt

  • Echter Einfluss auf technische Entscheidungen und eine Modernisierung mit klarem Ziel

  • 30 Urlaubstage

  • Gleitzeit mit Kernzeit ab 10 Uhr, 2 Remote-Tage pro Woche

  • Weiterbildung während der Arbeitszeit, Udemy-Kurse; eigene Vorschläge sind willkommen

  • Claude-Lizenz, offen für weitere Tools

  • Hardware: Lenovo ThinkPad, offen für Vorschläge

  • UrbanSportsClub und JobRad

  • Gute Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr

So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess

  • Kennenlerngespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team

  • Technisches Interview mit Live-Projektarbeit mit dem Developer Lead und der Geschäftsführung

  • Teamgespräch vor Ort

  • Angebot

Über das Unternehmen

Unser Kunde entwickelt seit über 25 Jahren Software für die öffentliche Verwaltung. Städte wie Berlin, München, Bonn und Dessau setzen seit Jahrzehnten auf die Lösungen des Unternehmens.

Du willst ein bewährtes Produkt fit für die Zukunft machen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Senior Functional Safety Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

Join a motivating team of experts developing Electric Vehicle technology through innovative zonal architecture development.

This position is based in our Berlin office and operates on a hybrid model, requiring at least three days per week on-site.

Responsibilities

  • Establish and continuously improve the processes and technical pipelines that collect, organize, and present all traceable evidences required for Functional Safety release or sign-off reports (production and SW releases) across all FuSa domains (Dynamics, Body, Thermal, Energy, ADAS, Core).

  • Define quantitative, evidence-based release criteria for FuSa sign-off — including thresholds for requirement verification coverage, safety mechanism test pass rates, diagnostic coverage metrics, ASIL-graded open-issue limits, and residual risk acceptance.

  • Work closely with PMT to align FuSa maturity criteria to program milestones and gate reviews, providing per-domain risk profiles that surface gaps in evidence completeness and drive early visibility of domains at risk of missing gate criteria.

  • Coordinate with FuSa domain leads, test automation, SW FuSa, HW FuSa, and PMT to align evidence deliverables against release schedules, driving pipeline efficiency so that sign-off can be given with confidence and minimal overhead on technical teams.

  • Develop and maintain automated dashboarding that consolidates release readiness, requirement coverage, open safety issues, and post-release fleet safety performance — enabling data-driven release decisions and continuous calibration of release criteria over successive programs.

  • Establish and track post-release safety performance indicators — including field failure rates against safety mechanism assumptions and safety-relevant DTC rates — to close the loop between pre-release evidence confidence and real-world outcomes.

  • Coordinate with external suppliers and Brand partners to collect, validate, and integrate supplier-generated safety work products and SEooC arguments into the vehicle-level safety case.

  • Work closely with the FuSa Process team and VWG Central FuSi process team to ensure release processes align with ISO 26262 compliance expectations across Rivian and VW programs.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Degree in Electrical/Electronic, Mechanical, Software, Systems, or Computer Engineering (or similar).

  • Over 5 years of experience in the automotive industry (or equivalent), ideally at an OEM or Tier 1, with at least 2 years in functional safety, systems engineering, or release/program engineering roles.

  • Proven knowledge of ISO 26262, particularly around work product management, confirmation reviews, safety case argumentation, and evidence-based release assessment.

  • Strong experience with requirements management and traceability tools (e.g. JAMA, DOORS) and issue tracking tools (e.g. Jira, Confluence).

  • Experience defining quantitative release criteria and safety performance metrics, and building reporting pipelines or dashboards to track them.

  • Experience with data visualization tools (e.g. Databricks, Tableau, Power BI); ability to present risk and safety performance metrics to technical and leadership audiences.

  • Good understanding of vehicle system functionality across multiple domains.

  • Excellent organizational and coordination skills; ability to drive cross-functional alignment under tight release schedules.

  • Good interpersonal and communication skills; ability to report clearly and concisely to senior management.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with supplier safety artifact management — SEooC arguments and supplier-provided safety cases integrated into a vehicle-level safety argument.

  • Exposure to fleet monitoring, field quality data, or post-release safety performance tracking.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and data pipeline tooling; scripting ability (e.g. Python) a plus.

Total Rewards

We build the exceptional — and we believe the people doing that work should be rewarded accordingly. In addition to a competitive base salary, full-time positions may be is eligible to participate in our annual company performance bonus program.

Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. This role is also eligible for equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), subject to board approval and the terms of our equity incentive plans, including applicable vesting requirements.

In addition to our compensation programs, we invest in our people with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial future for full-time employees — including health coverage, retirement savings, time off, and family planning programs. Offerings vary by country. Learn more about our global benefit programs.

External candidates can apply for this role through the Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies careers site (https://rivianvw.tech/#careers). If you are a current employee, please apply through our internal job board.

title: Senior General Ledger Accountant / Bilanzbuchhalter (m/w/f)
descriptionHtml:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:  

The International Accounting team at Planet is seeking a versatile Senior GL Accountant to maintain our books and become a key part of our global Finance team. In this pivotal position, you will serve as a core financial anchor, managing critical workflows that directly support our expanding international footprint and global operational success. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, curious, collaborative, and analytical, bringing a strong work ethic to solve complex financial challenges. By driving rigorous accounting standards and cross-functional alignment, you will help power Planet's mission with a robust operational finance foundation. Ideal candidates are proactive problem-solvers who thrive in dynamic, cross-border team environments.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin manufacturing office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Manage day-to-day closing and reporting activities including journal entries and reconciliations for Fixed Assets and Inventory in our Berlin Manufacturing site to ensure books are maintained in accordance with U.S. GAAP and HGB.
  • Maintain the Fixed Asset Register (FAR), tracking capital expenditures, asset additions, disposals, transfers, monthly depreciation runs, and Construction in Progress (CIP) balances with operational stakeholders.
  • Review and clear consolidated transfer orders between international subsidiaries, managing asset movements between locations for both PBC and GmbH entities.
  • Maintain costs, prepayments, and accrued payables associated with satellite materials, launch, and build processes across inventory, WIP, and internal fixed asset materials.
  • Support physical count / cycle count programs and analyze inventory adjustments.
  • Partner with Berlin Operations to establish scalable cost accounting workflows, standard costing methodologies, and manufacturing time-tracking for our local production line.
  • Serve as the dedicated backup for US cost accountants during time-off and high-volume periods.

What You Bring:

title: Senior German Tax Operations Specialist (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role:

  • 1. Investment Tax Mechanics & Fund Processing

    • Daily KEST: Own the daily KEST activities, run controls, solve incidents and support the Product team.

    • Vorabpauschale (Advance Lump-Sum Tax): Support Product in the complete execution lifecycle of the annual Vorabpauschale calculation under the German Investment Tax Act (InvStG).

    2. Digital Dividend & Regulatory Reporting Transformation

    • MiKaDiv Execution: Support Product in the technical implementation and operational governance of MiKaDiv (Mitteilungsverfahren Kapitalertragsteuer auf Dividenden). Lead continuous data gathering throughout the custody chain, validate beneficial ownership timelines, and secure the electronic transmission paths required to fetch the mandatory unique tax reference numbers (UUIDs) from the BZSt.

    • NEK (Nichtentrichtete Kapitalertragsteuer): Manage reporting and exception workflows surrounding non-withheld or uncollectible capital gains tax (e.g., when an account lacks sufficient cash liquidity during a tax event like the Vorabpauschale), ensuring seamless reporting logs to the local tax offices via CPB.

    3. Customer Tax Exemptions & Account Adjustments

    • FSAk (Freistellungsauftrag / Kontrollverfahren): Support CPB with the submission and by running controls.

    • NV-Bescheinigungen: Validate, track, and audit Non-Assessment Certificates (Nichtveranlagungs-Bescheinigungen), ensuring proper single vs. joint application rules.

    • Loss Pot Management (Verlusttöpfe): Oversee the automated real-time logic of the Share Loss Pot (Aktienverlusttopf) and General Loss Pot (Allgemeiner Verlusttopf), cross-pot optimization offsets, and cross-border or marital Verlusttopf-Überträge (loss pot transfers) during account migrations or closures.

    • Deceased Account Backward Correction (Erbfall): Blueprint and implement the technical logic for backward tax corrections (rückwirkende Korrektur) in the event of an end-user's death, ensuring the immediate freeze and retro-active dissolution of exemption orders (FSA) and the automated cross-year recalculation/neutralization of loss pots (Verlusttöpfe) up to the exact date of death.

    • Church Tax Automation: Control the query process (KiStAM) to the BZSt, including ensuring the application of the correct split-tax formulas (Halbteilungsgrundsatz) to joint accounts with mixed religious denominations.

    4. Tax Documentation & Core IT Collaboration

    • Jahressteuerbescheinigung: Support CPB and Product in the flawless generation of the annual German tax certificate (Jahressteuerbescheinigung e.g., Erträgnisaufstellung), including complex edge cases for joint account primary address routing.

    • Product Tax Engine Architecture: Act as the primary business analyst for Product and Tech Engineering teams, writing technical tax specifications to translate German tax updates into automated core banking system logic.

How we Upvest in you:

  • Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

  • Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.

  • Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.

  • Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior Global Marketing Manager: Managed Service Providers
descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a strategic, results-driven Senior Marketing Manager to lead our marketing efforts across the Managed Service Provider (MSP) ecosystem. In this role, you will design and execute global "to-partner" and "through-partner" marketing programs that drive awareness, enablement, and demand generation. As a key bridge between Product Marketing, Global Campaign teams, and Channel Sales, you will own the marketing strategy that empowers MSPs to successfully scale their business using the Everpure platform.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Global Strategy & Campaign Execution

  • Develop and execute the comprehensive global MSP marketing strategy and roadmap aligned with corporate revenue and channel growth objectives.
  • Lead MSP-exclusive initiatives such as nurture campaigns, webinars, events, and value-driven programs in collaboration with Product Marketing and Content Marketing.
  • Design, execute, and measure comprehensive demand generation strategies to drive engagement and acquisition across the MSP partner lifecycle.
  • Create and manage end-to-end "through-partner" demand generation campaigns (e.g., webinars, digital kits, event templates) that MSPs can easily white-label to acquire end-customers.

Partner Enablement & Content Creation

  • Build, launch, and maintain a world-class MSP enablement toolkit, including pitch decks, battlecards, data sheets, and value-proposition messaging frameworks.
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing to translate complex technical features into business outcomes that align with an MSP’s business model (e.g., recurring revenue, operational efficiency).
  • Own the marketing content strategy for the Partner Portal, ensuring assets are localized, up-to-date, and intuitive.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Field Alignment

  • Partner closely with Channel Sales and MSP Sales Team Members to align marketing initiatives with pipeline goals.
  • Work alongside regional field marketing teams to localize global programs for specific geographic nuances (NAM, EMEA, APJ).
  • Collaborate with Marketing Ops to track Market Development Funds (MDF) allocations, ensuring high ROI on partner-spend initiatives.

Metrics, Analytics & Optimization

  • Establish, track, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) such as partner In quarter created pipeline contribution (IQC), marketing-generated leads (MQLs), Marketing Influenced Pipeline (MIP), partner portal engagement, and program ROI.
  • Continually optimize campaign performance based on data insights, partner feedback, and regional sales inputs.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Domain Expertise: At least 6+ years of dedicated MSP Marketing experience. A deep understanding of how MSPs or MSSPs operate, package, and price services is essential.
  • Experience: 6+ years of B2B MSP marketing experience within the  high-tech or software industry (SaaS, Cybersecurity, or Cloud infrastructure preferred).
  • Global Scale: Proven track record of creating centralized marketing programs that successfully scale across multiple global regions.
  • Content & Messaging: Exceptional writing and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex technical platforms into a clear "Why [Company Name] for MSPs" value proposition.
  • MarTech Proficiency: Hands-on experience with CRM and Marketing Automation tools (e.g., Salesforce, Marketo, AppSheet) and Partner Relationship Management (PRM) platforms.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • The "Channel First" Mindset: An inherent understanding that your success is completely tied to the success and ease of use for your partners.
  • Agility & Autonomy: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, matrixed tech environment with minimal day-to-day oversight.
  • Influence Without Authority: Strong interpersonal skills to drive alignment across Product, Sales, and Corporate Marketing teams.

descriptionHtml:

We take pride in our long-standing, market-leading partnership with Google, our deep technical capabilities across their Google ecosystem, and innovative proprietary solutions like Share of Model, setting us apart in the industry.

You'll contribute to accelerating commercial growth across UK and Ireland corporate clients by converting inbound leads, scaling reseller adoption across the Google stack, and championing proprietary tools. A distinct and unique aspect of this role includes collaborating on-site at Google’s London headquarters, cultivating senior stakeholder relationships across their product lines to unlock joint funding and commercial initiatives.

WHAT TO EXPECT:

We're seeking a seasoned Senior ASO Consultant to take on a pivotal role at Phiture, reporting directly to the Growth Lead and working closely with our key clients. As a key figure in our multidisciplinary marketing team, your responsibilities extend beyond client management. As a key figure in our multidisciplinary marketing team, you’ll lead client projects, mentor team members, and deliver strategies rooted in user behavior, experimentation, and impactful growth solutions. 

This is a fixed-term engagement (approx. 10-12 months) starting as soon as possible.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Lead ASO and CRO-driven strategies for global clients, ensuring scalable impact across markets and languages.
  • Support key ASO clients globally by providing guidance on strategic planning and roadmaps across multiple markets and languages.
  • Apply experimentation methodologies to optimize app campaigns' performance, combining ASO expertise with CRO principles to drive conversion improvements.
  • Lead keyword optimization (KWO) projects to improve app discoverability across global markets, tailoring strategies to multiple languages and audiences.
  • Apply creative testing methodologies to optimize app store assets, helping clients stand out in competitive app marketplaces.
  • Guide Growth Managers to build robust analytical and strategic skills, encouraging curiosity and data-driven decision-making.
  • Develop and refine client strategies using a deep understanding of user behavior, app store dynamics, and growth experimentation.
  • Grow Phiture’s influence on the mobile marketing industry (especially in ASO).
  • Ensure consistent delivery of high-quality services and solutions. 
  • Stay updated with industry trends and best practices, incorporating them into pod strategies.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • 3+ years of experience in ASO or related fields (e.g., CRO, performance marketing, experiment-driven mobile growth)
  • Solid knowledge of ASO & mobile marketing, especially performance marketing 
  • A strategic mindset with demonstrated expertise in experimentation, hypothesis testing, and user behavior analysis.
  • Strong research skills and critical thinking with a data-driven mindset.
  • Curiosity and adaptability, with a willingness to learn the technical aspects of ASO if not already familiar. 
  • Excellent client management skills in an agency setting.
  • Excellent English skills (spoken and written)

Nice to have:

  • Apple ads experience or any CAC:LTV based performance marketing
  • Familiarity with complementary growth disciplines such as lifecycle marketing or funnel optimization
  • Familiarity with A/B testing tools or experimentation platforms (Optimizely, Google Optimize, Hotjar, VWO)

We encourage all qualified individuals to apply, regardless of their age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. We celebrate diversity and are excited about building teams that represent a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

title: Senior Growth Director (Commercial Lead)
descriptionHtml:
About Moloco:

Moloco is an AI-native performance advertising company, bringing the power of AI advertising to the open internet. Founded in 2013 by machine learning engineers who had built AI advertising systems inside the world's largest technology companies, Moloco began from a shared mission: to build that same engine for the open internet.

Today, Moloco is one company with two businesses, built on the same compound AI system. Moloco Ads is our AI-native performance advertising platform, helping mobile app marketers acquire, retain, and re-engage high-value users across the open internet. Moloco Commerce Media is our AI-native retail media platform, enabling retailers and marketplaces to turn their platforms into thriving ad businesses. Both are powered by CARA (Compound Ad Recommendation Architecture), the AI system behind every Moloco product.

At Moloco, we bring together those who've already solved hard problems and those with the drive to. Here, we work on some of the complex problems in AI advertising, at a scale and level of sophistication very few companies can offer. Come build what's next.

The Impact You’ll Be Contributing to Moloco:

Join Moloco as a Senior Growth Director and lead the strategic growth of some of our most important partners across EMEA. As a senior individual contributor, you will own a dedicated portfolio of top accounts, building executive partnerships and developing commercial strategies that create lasting value for customers and Moloco.

You will bring a deep understanding of each customer’s business, connect their priorities to Moloco’s capabilities, and lead our most complex commercial conversations. Your impact will extend beyond your own portfolio through selective support on high-stakes opportunities, coaching, and influencing Moloco’s product and commercial direction.

The Opportunity:

Based in London, you’ll operate as a Commercial Lead within the EMEA Growth team, accountable for substantial revenue outcomes and long-term customer growth. This is an individual contributor role combining hands-on account ownership with commercial leadership across the wider team.

Strategic Growth & Commercial Ownership

  • Own and deliver revenue targets across a dedicated portfolio of top EMEA accounts, with accountability for forecast accuracy, risk management, and long-term growth.
  • Set and drive the multi-year growth agenda for your customers, leading joint business planning with executive stakeholders to secure investment commitments, establish shared accountability, and drive delivery against ambitious commercial goals.
  • Unlock incremental revenue through expansion into new geographies, business units, use cases, and product adoption.
  • Own the most complex and ambiguous commercial negotiations across your portfolio, structuring non-standard agreements in partnership with Sales, Finance, Legal, and leadership to balance customer value, commercial risk, and sustainable growth.

Consultative Selling & Executive Partnership

  • Act as a trusted commercial advisor and industry expert to your customers, combining deep knowledge of their business models and company goals with insight into market dynamics and competitive trends to challenge assumptions, shape growth strategies, and identify where Moloco can create lasting business value.
  • Develop tailored proposals grounded in customer business outcomes, including lifetime value, payback period, and return on ad spend at scale.
  • Build long-term strategic partnerships with customers, independently owning C-suite and senior commercial relationships and aligning Moloco’s role in their growth with shared objectives, investment priorities, and measures of success.
  • Use trusted executive relationships to shape customer priorities, influence investment decisions, and unlock growth opportunities beyond existing campaigns—including opening doors to new decision-makers, business units, and markets.
  • Lead executive business reviews and strategic planning conversations, translating performance data into clear recommendations for long-term growth.

Product Expertise & Cross-Functional Influence

  • Apply deep knowledge of Moloco’s products, machine learning capabilities, and the mobile advertising ecosystem to shape credible solutions for customers.
  • Work hands-on with data to test growth hypotheses, diagnose challenges, and build commercially sound recommendations.
  • Act as the voice of the market, partnering with Product, Data Science, and Engineering to translate customer needs, industry trends, and competitive insights into recommendations that shape product priorities and unlock growth.
  • Lead the commercial development of new and ambiguous growth opportunities, setting direction, mobilising cross-functional teams, and driving customer validation to turn successful approaches into repeatable revenue opportunities across EMEA.
  • Influence senior cross-functional stakeholders to prioritise strategic account opportunities, secure resources, and resolve competing priorities to deliver commercial outcomes.

Coaching & Commercial Leadership

  • Set the standard for consultative selling, deal strategy, negotiation, and executive engagement across EMEA, leading by example in your own accounts and coaching Growth Managers and Growth Directors to strengthen their commercial capabilities.
  • Bring senior commercial expertise to accounts beyond your own portfolio, working alongside account owners to lead high-stakes customer conversations, navigate complex negotiations, and resolve escalations.
  • Turn successful approaches into practical frameworks and playbooks that raise commercial standards across EMEA.
  • Build a reputation as a recognised industry expert in adtech and mobile growth, actively speaking at industry events and sharing insights that strengthen Moloco’s credibility with customers and the wider market.
  • Adapt your leadership and communication style to the audience and situation, using expertise and sound judgment to build trust, navigate disagreement, and secure commitment to action without formal management authority.

How Do I Know if the Role Is Right for Me?

Experience & Expertise

  • 10+ years of experience in mobile advertising, account management, consultative sales, or commercial leadership.
  • A proven track record of owning and growing some of an organisation’s largest and most strategically important accounts, navigating complex customer relationships and delivering substantial, sustained revenue growth.
  • Experience leading complex commercial negotiations and structuring agreements around customer business objectives.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted executive relationships and influence strategic investment decisions.
  • Deep understanding of the mobile advertising ecosystem, mobile measurement partners (MMPs), attribution, and programmatic performance marketing.
  • Evidence of improving commercial outcomes beyond your own accounts through coaching, co-selling, or cross-functional leadership.
  • Fluency in English (Turkish a strong plus).

Skills & Mindset

  • Exceptional commercial judgment and the ability to understand how customers make money, assess opportunities, and make disciplined trade-offs.
  • Strong product and analytical fluency, with the ability to connect technical capabilities and performance data to business value.
  • Executive presence and clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to simplify complex issues for senior audiences.
  • High ownership and resilience, with the ability to sustain momentum through long commercial cycles and changing priorities.
  • Comfort operating autonomously in ambiguous situations, creating clarity and mobilizing others around a shared outcome.
  • A collaborative, low-ego approach, with a commitment to learning, sharing credit, and developing others.

Supporting Your Best Work and Your Best Life:

Our benefits are designed to support our people in doing their best work and living well, at work and beyond. Benefits vary by country, employment type, and eligibility. Connect with a recruiter to learn more about benefits in your region.

Moloco Values:

  • Uncapped Growth Mindset: We see all situations as opportunities to learn, grow, and improve as individuals and as an organization. We seek diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and promote experimentation to push the boundaries of what’s possible.

descriptionHtml:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

🚀 The Role

We’re hiring a GTM Senior Product Marketing Manager who wants to take our product from 1-100, not 0-1 scale.

You will join the fastest growing unit inside tem. This team is obsessed about growing our SMB customers and transforming their perception of energy beyond the bill, so we can hand more money and value back in their hands.

You will be a hands-on product marketer who can bring sharp judgment and voice of customer consistently back to the table. Your focus is to grow the trial, adoption and experience of our RED product and be ruthless in those goals. Expect to solve problems on your own and with product, content and engineers whilst running your own team of expert GTM agents.

You’ll be 20% in architecting, 80% in delivery.

title: Senior Hardware Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago is an AI and computer hardware company whose mission is to drive the course of history forward. We do so by accelerating breakthroughs at the intersection of AI and semiconductors.

Founded in 2024 by AI researchers and physicists with deep expertise in photonics, electronics, software, mathematics, and machine learning, Arago brings together a lean team of engineers and scientists from the world’s top companies and research labs.

Composed of nine nationalities and operating from hubs in France, North America, and Israel, we believe in great science and fast achievements. Our work is guided by these core principles:

  1. Do great things: we deliver work we’re proud to sign our name to.

  2. High velocity: speed matters. We move quickly, one step at a time.

  3. One unit: we’re all in this together, with relationships grounded in trust, respect, and camaraderie.

Arago is backed by executives from Apple, Arm, Nvidia, Microsoft, and Hugging Face, as well as prominent US and European deeptech venture firms and exited founders.

 

What you’ll do

Design and verify custom digital hardware components and architectures that enable high-performance, tightly integrated computation workloads and interface Arago’s custom tensor unit for advanced AI/ML applications.

 

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and verify RTL blocks for memory, control, and compute subsystems within Arago’s custom multiphysics computation unit.

  • Collaborate with Arago’s system software and architecture teams to define block-level specifications and ensure alignment with performance and integration goals.

  • Develop and maintain functional verification infrastructure to validate design correctness across simulation and hardware testbenches.

  • Support synthesis, timing analysis, and backend integration, working closely with Arago’s physical design and CAD engineers.

  • Contribute to architectural exploration and hardware-software co-design efforts to shape future iterations of Arago’s compute platform.

 

Required Skills and Experience

  • Extensive experience in RTL design (Verilog/SystemVerilog) for control logic, datapaths, memory subsystems, and specialized processing units.

  • Strong understanding of digital architecture, including pipelining, arbitration, memory hierarchy, and system-level integration.

  • Proficiency in functional verification, including testbench development, assertions, coverage metrics, and debugging (UVM experience is a plus).

  • Familiarity with ASIC and FPGA design flows, including synthesis, timing closure, and DFT.

  • Comfortable working across the full hardware stack — from architectural specification and microarchitecture to physical implementation support.

  • Language: English at a proficient level. French is a plus.

At Quantum Systems, we are building the next generation of autonomous aerial systems. The Drone Port enables our UAV platforms to launch, land, charge and return to mission readiness autonomously.

You will work closely with Mechanical Engineering, Embedded Software, Systems Engineering, Testing, Manufacturing, Procurement and external development partners and suppliers. Your work will help deliver reliable, available and manufacturable hardware for current and future Drone Port generations.

  • Develop and assess hardware concepts for future Drone Port generations, and support architecture and design decisions.

title: Senior High-Voltage Electrical Design Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

As Senior High-Voltage Electrical Design Engineer (all genders) you will lead the electrical design of the battery packs, power distribution units (PDUs), and junction box of the propulsion battery system for VÆRIDION's CS-23 all-electric aircraft. You will own everything electrical on and within these units, from cell interconnections and busbars to protection and safety devices, internal HV and LV wiring, and the HV power and LV communication connector interfaces. Through electrical modelling and analysis, you will close the design before it moves to test and provide the engineering evidence that the propulsion battery system is electrically safe, robust, and certifiable.

Within the Airborne Electronics team, you will collaborate with Electronic Hardware Design and Power Electronics, and work closely with the Electrical Systems Architect and the HV Electrical Systems, Mechanical Design & Integration, Thermal Systems, Cell Technology, Safety, and Certification teams to ensure that the design of each unit is fully aligned with the propulsion battery system and the aircraft electrical system. Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION's mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead the electrical/electrothermal design of HV equipment for an 800 V class propulsion battery system, covering topology, segregation, protection, isolation, precharge, and safe disconnection within each unit.

  • Align the electrical design of each unit with the propulsion battery system and the aircraft electrical system, working closely with the HV Electrical Systems team and the Electrical Systems Architect.

  • Design cell interconnections and busbars as well as develop the cell connection system together with the Mechanical Design & Integration team.

  • Specify and select protection and safety devices, including contactors, fuses, pyrofuses, precharge components, current sensors, manual service disconnects, and the HV interlock loop, working with Airborne Electronics colleagues where solid-state power controllers (SSPCs) are used.

  • Define the HV power and LV communication connector interfaces of each unit together with the HV Electrical Systems team.

  • Lead or support component specification, selection, and supplier engagement depending on the component, together with the responsible teams.

  • Develop or assist with electrical models of the full battery pack to close the design before testing, and support propulsion battery system modeling of performance and failure cases together with the HV Electrical Systems team.

  • Perform electrical/electrothermal analyses, including short-circuit and fault current, protection coordination, insulation coordination, creepage and clearance, partial discharge at altitude, voltage drop, and Joule losses as input to the Thermal Systems team.

  • Own the grounding, bonding, shielding, and EMC design within each unit.

  • Define the physical layout and routing of electrical components together with the Mechanical Design & Integration team.

  • Perform safety analyses such as FMEA for each unit or support the Safety team in system-level safety assessments.

  • Draft test requirements (TRQs) for electrical verification, independently or together with the respective teams as required.

  • Create and maintain schematics, wiring diagrams, requirements, and interface definitions under configuration control, and contribute to design reviews and certification evidence.

 

Your Profile:

title: Senior HR Advisor
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our People team are the architects of a great workplace where brilliant minds come together to do their best work. From discovering diverse talent and nurturing future leaders, to creating spaces that spark collaboration and crafting rewards that celebrate success—we’re passionate about building a culture where everyone can thrive.

We’re looking for a Senior HR Advisor to join our Manchester team. This is a hybrid role. You’ll help us deliver a fair, consistent and high-performing employee experience by leading complex employee relations, strengthening manager capability and using people insights to improve how we work across our Merchant organisation.

Get to know our People team—what drives us, how we work and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the UKI People team, primarily supporting our Merchant organisation. Employee relations sits at the heart of the role, alongside a broader focus on employee experience, operational excellence and continuous improvement.

Employee Relations and Case Management

  • Manage a varied and complex end-to-end caseload across performance, probation, absence, grievances and disciplinaries.
  • Provide clear, practical advice that balances employee experience, commercial needs, employment law and organisational risk.
  • Build trusted relationships with managers, helping them address concerns early and confidently challenging where needed to achieve fair and consistent outcomes.
  • Respond to sensitive employee and manager concerns with sound judgement, discretion and professionalism, ensuring issues are resolved or escalated appropriately.
  • Maintain accurate and timely case documentation, delivering a consistently high standard of support across competing priorities.

Employee Experience and Engagement

  • Partner with managers, leaders, and People colleagues to create an environment where employees feel heard, valued and supported.
  • Use employee feedback, case themes and engagement insights to identify emerging concerns and opportunities to improve the employee experience.
  • Support feedback channels and targeted engagement activity, ensuring themes are followed through and actions are clearly communicated.
  • Coach managers on the behaviours and everyday practices that influence engagement, performance and retention.

Root-Cause Analysis and Process Improvement

  • Use case data, employee feedback and people trends to identify hotspots and underlying factors, such as onboarding, management capability or gaps in existing processes.
  • Turn insights into practical interventions that reduce avoidable cases and improve employee and manager experiences.
  • Recommend continuous improvements to People policies, guidance and processes, helping us deliver support with greater consistency and efficiency.
  • Identify recurring employee or manager questions and improve the guidance, tools and self-service resources available to them.

Manager Capability and Coaching

  • Coach and upskill managers through sensitive people matters, helping them build the confidence and judgement to handle issues effectively.
  • Deliver practical sessions on employee relations policies, UK employment legislation and effective people management.
  • Guide managers towards the right People tools and resources, encouraging greater self-sufficiency while remaining available for complex or higher-risk situations.
  • Communicate complex processes and decisions clearly to a range of audiences, adapting your approach to the situation and the people involved.

People Partnering and Strategic Support

  • Partner with leaders across our Merchant organisation, building a strong understanding of their teams, priorities and people challenges.
  • Support core People processes, including performance calibrations, engagement activity and organisational change.
  • Use data and people insights to support leadership discussions and inform practical, evidence-based decisions.
  • Contribute to targeted UKI People projects and work collaboratively across the wider People team to deliver meaningful improvements.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Significant experience managing complex end-to-end employee relations cases within a fast-paced environment, backed by up-to-date knowledge of UK employment law.
  • Strong advisory and coaching capability, with a proven ability to constructively challenge managers and balance commercial risk with employee experience.
  • Sound judgement and the confidence to navigate sensitive or ambiguous situations with limited direction.
  • An analytical mindset, with experience using case data, employee feedback and people trends to identify root causes and deliver proactive HR solutions.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, including the ability to maintain accurate documentation, meet deadlines and deliver consistently across multiple priorities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex or sensitive information clearly to a range of audiences.
  • A high level of discretion and professionalism when handling confidential employee information.
  • A collaborative and adaptable approach, with experience building trusted partnerships across teams and influencing without direct authority.
  • Confidence using HR systems and digital tools to manage work, identify insights and improve the employee and manager experience.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting commercial, operational or technology-led business units.
  • Broader exposure to, or an interest in, HR Business Partnering and organisational design.
  • Experience supporting employee listening, engagement or retention initiatives.
  • Experience improving HR guidance, self-service tools or digital processes to increase adoption and make support easier to access.
  • Familiarity with people analytics or AI-enabled tools and an interest in how emerging technology can improve HR decision-making and operational efficiency.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here, you can expect to:

  • 🔧 Make a visible impact every day
    Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.
  • 🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment
    Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.
  • 🧠 Build a career, not just a role
    Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.
  • 🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture
    Join collaborative, values-driven teams that support you to do your best work.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine. Our interview process typically includes three to four stages. You can find out more about how we hire here.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

title: Senior HR advisor / Senior HR Adviseur
descriptionHtml:
Maak impact op HR, organisatie en medewerkers

Wil jij als Senior HR Advisor complexe HR-vraagstukken vertalen naar praktisch en toekomstgericht HR-beleid? En krijg je energie van adviseren, verbeteren én zelf de handen uit de mouwen steken?

Bij Priva werk je nauw samen met onze HR Business Partners, HR Director en HR Operations-collega's. Je bent een ervaren sparringpartner voor het HR-team en de business en draagt bij aan complexe HR-casuïstiek, organisatieontwikkeling en strategische HR-projecten.

Je combineert een brede HR-expertise met een praktische aanpak. Van arbeidsrecht en verzuim tot HR-processen, beleid, data en systemen: jij weet wat er nodig is om onze HR-dienstverlening continu te verbeteren.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior HR Advisor:

  • adviseer je over complexe HR-vraagstukken, arbeidsrecht, verzuim, arbeidsvoorwaarden en organisatieveranderingen;

  • ondersteun je HR Business Partners en management bij individuele en collectieve HR-casuïstiek;

  • draag je bij aan strategische HR-projecten rondom onder andere cultuur, organisatieontwikkeling, transformatie en HR-beleid;

  • vertaal je HR-strategie en wet- en regelgeving naar duidelijke en werkbare processen en oplossingen;

  • werk je samen met HR Operations aan een professionele en efficiënte HR-dienstverlening;

  • analyseer en verbeter je HR-processen en systemen;

  • zet je HR-data en technologie in om betere beslissingen en procesverbeteringen mogelijk te maken;

  • werk je actief met HR-systemen zoals AFAS en kijk je verder dan alleen de gebruikerskant om processen slimmer in te richten.


Wie ben jij?

Je bent een ervaren HR-professional die gemakkelijk schakelt tussen strategie, advies en uitvoering. Je hebt een stevige inhoudelijke HR-basis, maar kijkt tegelijkertijd verder: waar kunnen processen beter, welke impact heeft een verandering op de organisatie en wat hebben managers en medewerkers nodig?

Je bent kritisch wanneer dat nodig is, praktisch wanneer het kan en weet verschillende stakeholders mee te nemen in veranderingen.

Daarnaast breng je mee:

  • een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld HRM, Human Resource Management, Bedrijfskunde of Arbeidsrecht;

  • circa 3 tot 6 jaar relevante HR-ervaring, bijvoorbeeld als Senior HR Advisor, HR Adviseur of in een vergelijkbare brede HR-rol;

  • gedegen kennis van het Nederlandse arbeidsrecht en sociale wetgeving;

  • ervaring met complexe HR-casuïstiek, zoals verzuim, reorganisaties en arbeidsvoorwaarden;

  • ervaring met strategische HR-projecten, beleidsontwikkeling of organisatieverandering;

  • het vermogen om strategisch te adviseren én betrokken te blijven bij de operationele HR-praktijk;

  • affiniteit met HR-technologie, HR-data, AFAS en procesoptimalisatie;

  • uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal;

  • beschikbaarheid van 32 tot 40 uur per week.

Wat bieden wij?
In cijfers:

  • Een bruto salaris tussen €4.000,00 en €5.000,00 (op basis van je ervaring);

  • Een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé vinden wij belangrijk: 30 vakantiedagen per jaar en de mogelijkheid om meer bij te kopen;

  • 8% vakantiegeld;

Voor je eigen duurzaamheid:

  • Maak gratis en onbeperkt gebruik van onze eigen sportruimte "The Box" op de Priva Campus, met diverse lessen in bijvoorbeeld CrossFit, Pilates en Spinning;

  • Deelname aan de pensioenregeling van Priva;

  • Opleidingsmogelijkheden via onze eigen Priva Academy.

Klaar om jouw HR-expertise in te zetten én écht invloed te hebben op hoe we HR binnen Priva verder ontwikkelen? Breng je strategische blik, praktische aanpak en verbetermentaliteit mee en bouw samen met ons aan een HR-organisatie die klaar is voor de toekomst.

Solliciteer als Senior HR Advisor en maak het verschil vanaf dag één.

title: Senior HR Medewerker (m/v/x)
descriptionHtml:
Een ervaren HR-professional die graag complexe HR-vraagstukken oppakt, kennis deelt, overzicht houdt en bijdraagt aan een goede HR-dienstverlening.

Voor onze volop in beweging zijnde HR-afdeling en administratie/HR-support team zoeken we een ervaren HR-professional die goed thuis is in HR-processen, toepassing van arbeidsvoorwaarden en graag meedenkt over uiteenlopende HR-vraagstukken. Herken jij jezelf hierin en bouw je graag mee aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze afdeling? Solliciteer dan snel!

Wat ga je doen?

Jij zorgt er samen met je hr-collega’s voor dat de basis van onze HR-administratie op orde is, maar jouw meerwaarde zit vooral in het behandelen van complexere operationele HR-vraagstukken, het ondersteunen van HR collega’s en het samen met de teamleider verder ontwikkelen van onze dienstverlening. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor het HR-team en een vertrouwd aanspreekpunt voor NLR medewerkers en HR-adviseurs.

Als senior HR-medewerker heb je een veelzijdige rol waarin HR-administratie, dienstverlening, inhoudelijke expertise en procesverbetering samenkomen. Jouw HR collega’s houden zich bezig met de dagelijkse HR-processen, waarbij jij je richt op vooral vraagstukken die meer ervaring, inzicht en zelfstandigheid vragen. Daarnaast deel je actief je kennis met collega's, denk je mee over een slimme verdeling van het werk en draag je bij aan de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening.

Jouw werkzaamheden in het kort:

  • Vraagbaak voor het HR-team: je behandelt tweedelijns HR-vraagstukken over bijvoorbeeld arbeidsvoorwaarden, personeelsregelingen en HR processen, detachering, inleen en deelt je kennis en ondersteunt collega’s.

  • Ondersteunen van de HR Adviseurs en managers: je helpt bij operationele HR-vraagstukken en zorgt voor een goede aansluiting tussen HR-processen en de praktijk.

Wat breng je mee?

We zoeken iemand die senioriteit laat zien in zowel gedrag als HR-kennis. Je hoeft niet alles te weten, maar je hebt een stevige basis, durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en weet wanneer je zelfstandig kunt handelen en wanneer afstemming nodig is. First time right is het devies, kwalitatieve en zorgvuldige HR administratie en dienstverlening vinden wij belangrijk.

  • Afgeronde opleiding in HRM of een vergelijkbare richting met minimaal vijf jaar relevante ervaring binnen HR, bij voorkeur in een brede HR-administratieve functie en kennis van AFAS.

  • Je hebt gedegen kennis van HR-processen en ervaring met het zelfstandig behandelen van HR-vraagstukken over arbeidsvoorwaarden, personeelsregelingen en HR administratie.

  • Je bent communicatief sterk, toegankelijk en klantgericht. Je maakt gemakkelijk contact met medewerkers en collega’s op verschillende niveaus.

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig, hebt oog voor details en houdt overzicht en helpt collega’s om werkzaamheden goed en tijdig af te ronden.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij NLR krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken én jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je werkt in een innovatieve nationale en internationale hightechomgeving waar nieuwsgierigheid, samenwerking en vakmanschap centraal staan. We geloven dat mensen het beste presteren als ze de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, zich te blijven ontwikkelen en een gezonde balans te vinden tussen werk en privé.

Verder bieden we je onder andere:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4400,- en € 5000 (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek), afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring;

  • 45 verlofdagen (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek);

  • 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%;

  • De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer.

  • Een zorgtoelage van €145,- bruto (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten;

  • Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof;

  • Volop kansen om te blijven leren met opleidingen, trainingen, coaching en andere ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • De mogelijkheid om 32-40 uur per week te werken inclusief thuiswerken.

Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving

Je wordt onderdeel van een breed HR-team met verschillende expertises, van HR-advies en beleid tot recruitment en Learning & Development. We sparren graag met elkaar, houden elkaar scherp en inspireren elkaar om verder te komen. Er is volop ruimte voor jouw ideeën, kennis en initiatief, met oog voor elkaar en het gezamenlijke resultaat. Samen werken we aan HR-dienstverlening die aansluit bij de behoeften van de organisatie en bijdraagt aan onze strategische ambities.

Onze HR-afdeling is volop in ontwikkeling en werkt aan verdere professionalisering en verbetering van processen en samenwerking. Dat biedt kansen, maar vraagt ook iets van jou. Je komt terecht in een HR-afdeling waar we volop werken aan het verbeteren van onze dienstverlening. We brengen meer structuur aan, maken onze processen eenvoudiger en werken steeds nauwer samen. Dat betekent dat niet alles al vastligt en dat er ruimte is om mee te denken en dingen slimmer te organiseren. Je standplaats is Amsterdam of Marknesse, maar je bent ook regelmatig op onze andere locatie voor overleg en samenwerking met collega’s.

Wat betekent werken bij NLR?

Koninklijke NLR is al meer dan 100 jaar een toonaangevende kennisinstelling voor toegepast onderzoek in de lucht- en ruimtevaart. Samen met meer dan 1000 professionals werken we aan innovatieve oplossingen voor een duurzamere, veiligere en efficiëntere lucht- en ruimtevaart. We willen dat iedereen bij NLR de ruimte krijgt om zichzelf te zijn, talenten te ontwikkelen en ideeën in te brengen. Door verschillen te waarderen en van elkaar te leren, creëren we samen een inclusieve werkomgeving.

Wil jij meer weten?

Mail dan met Christel Bouwers (Recruiter) via Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal.

title: Senior HSFE Specialist
descriptionHtml:
About us

Our teams are putting the world's retailers online using cloud technology, robotics, AI and automation. Through the Ocado Smart Platform (OSP), we provide innovative technology and operational services to partners globally, supporting highly automated fulfilment centres and world-class online grocery operations.

As our global footprint expands, we are continuously investing in robust health, safety, fire and environmental management to ensure a safe, compliant and high-performing working environment. This is an exciting opportunity to play a pivotal role in embedding a strong safety culture across our international operational services.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior HSFE Specialist to join our Operational Services team based in Hatfield (with travel), reporting directly to the Operational Resilience Director.

In this role, you will play a key part in establishing and driving Health, Safety, Fire, and Environmental (HSFE) compliance across our sites globally, embedding a proactive safety culture and ensuring consistent adherence to first-line requirements. Working closely with the HSFE Lead and operational leadership teams, you will provide day-to-day practical guidance and take ownership of delivering key first-line activities to support continuous improvement in safety standards across our operations.

The role involves travel across our UK CFCs, with potential international travel to our global sites when operational needs arise.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design for Future:
    • Support the design and continuous improvement of the HSFE Management System.
    • Help build a proactive safety culture across sites through engaging communication, training initiatives, and site-level engagement.
    • Work with operational teams to identify emerging risks, compliance gaps, and design mitigation plans ahead of need.
    • Contribute to the design of the annual audit and inspection schedule.
    • Support the development of H&S KPIs, operational metrics, and emergency preparedness activities.
  • Deliver for Today:
    • Support site inspections, audits, and risk assessments through the timely management and resolution of identified actions.
    • Support investigations into accidents, incidents, and near-misses, identifying root causes and driving corrective actions.
    • Provide daily advice, troubleshooting, and practical guidance to managers and operational teams on all H&S matters.
    • Coordinate responses to operational H&S queries and escalate complex issues when necessary.
  • Execute with Quality:
    • Maintain H&S documentation and reporting to ensure it meets required Group-defined and regulatory standards.
    • Establish clear reporting cadences to keep stakeholders and operational leadership updated on compliance and performance.
    • Implement sustainable, effective processes that maintain a safe and compliant operational environment.

About You

You are an organized, proactive, and solutions-focused safety professional who can build instant credibility and influence at all levels of an operation. You possess meticulous attention to detail, stay calm under pressure, and take a practical approach to resolving safety issues through sound, risk-based judgements.

You'll have:

  • Solid understanding of UK health and safety legislation and its practical application within an operational environment (knowledge of international H&S legislation is a strong plus).
  • Proven experience conducting risk assessments, site audits, inspections, and incident investigations.
  • Experience delivering practical H&S advice, training, and guidance to managers and operational staff across a multi-site network.
  • Experience developing or maintaining H&S policies, procedures, and training programmes.
  • Strong knowledge of incident reporting requirements (e.g., RIDDOR) and relevant regulatory body standards.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence positive safety behaviours across diverse teams.
  • Strong ability to produce clear, high-quality technical reports and data analysis, including incident trend analysis.
  • Qualifications: NEBOSH General Certificate (or equivalent) is desirable; NEBOSH Diploma (or working towards it) is an advantage.

What You'll Get in Return

Our employee benefits are designed with our people in mind because we know they are at the heart of everything we do.

Alongside challenging work and clear opportunities for professional development, we offer:

  • Hybrid and flexible working
  • Private healthcare
  • Car Salary Sacrifice and Cycle to Work schemes
  • Free Shares and Life Assurance
  • 15% discount on Ocado.com shopping
  • Company Shop offering discounts of up to 70% on leading brands
  • Exclusive travel, retail and leisure discounts
  • Modern Head Office campus with café and restaurant facilities
  • Free shuttle bus to and from Hatfield Station
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity leave
  • Enhanced pension scheme with company contributions up to 7%
  • Employee Assistance Programme

If you're looking for an opportunity to influence safety standards across a high-tech global operation, we'd love to hear from you.
