title: Senior Hub Developer
descriptionHtml:
We're looking for a developer to grow Ember's network of charging hubs. You'll find the sites, take them through legals and planning, manage the build and energise them. How you work and think matters more to us than which industry you've worked in. You think clearly, can run several projects at once and are as at home on a site as behind a desk.

About Ember

We're building the future of public transport — convenient, affordable, connected and zero-emission. Our goal is to make it easier and more enjoyable to get from A to B with Ember than it is with your own car.

Ember is a tech company, not a traditional bus operator. We've built a platform that coordinates our entire operation — everything from monitoring vehicles and controlling chargers to selling tickets and calculating ETAs. This allows us to use electric buses more intensively than anyone else in the world, leading to a massive reduction in emissions. It also helps us provide a much better passenger experience, with innovative features like demand-responsive stops.

We’re still tiny, with a handful of routes and ~100 buses. The challenge is to scale this 50x whilst staying lean, increasing efficiency and delivering an even better product experience. We’ve recently raised a Series A from some of Europe’s leading climate VCs and are looking for mission-driven individuals who want to get on board and help take us to the next level.

The role

Charging hubs are Ember's key growth enabler. They give us the ultra-fast charge points we need to run our network, and they act as a base for our fleet — parking, washing, driver lounges and more. We have hubs across Scotland today, with additional sites across the UK under construction or in the pipeline.

You'll join a small team of four, taking end-to-end responsibility for your own sites and helping out on others. We're typically running a handful of projects at any one time.

Step one is finding a site. You’ll need to think about where we need charging capacity to support future routes, scout industrial estates and brownfield plots and reach out to commercial agents, local authorities and landlords. Some great sites are advertised but many are not, so landing one usually means being patient and creative.

Once you've got a site, we move on to lease negotiations, design, the planning application and the power connection. You'll work with network operators to land the grid connection, and with our suppliers to procure, install and commission the charging equipment. Solicitors, architects and engineers are there to help, but the project is yours to drive — you set the direction, you ask the difficult questions and you make the trade-offs.

It’s important to be hands-on. We don't go to tender and leave the rest to an outsourced project manager — we want you on site, asking why a kerb is in the wrong place. Even after a site is live, our involvement doesn't stop. The team keeps refining and improving every site, and you'll be part of that work across the network, not just on the sites you've built yourself.

Diversity and equality

At Ember, we support diversity across our team and customers. We work to ensure every employee feels respected and able to give their best, whether temporary, part-time or full-time. We’re happy to offer flexible working patterns where they make sense, are compassionate when it comes to time off and offer enhanced maternity and paternity leave.

Read more about our approach in our Equal Opportunities Policy.

What's on offer

You'll receive a salary of £50,000–£75,000 per annum, depending on your experience and skills, plus share options. You'll be expected to work from our lovely office in central Edinburgh most days — we value in-person communication — but there's flexibility around the odd day from home, with an expectation that you'll spend some time travelling to different sites.

How do I apply?

Send your CV and a short note on why this interests you.

Applications close Friday 27 November at 5pm.


Who we're looking for

You should have a desire to get involved in the growth of a quickly scaling business, with a real opportunity to make your mark. How you work and think matters more to us than specific industry experience. The following should sound a lot like you:

  • Curious and quick to learn. You're comfortable in unfamiliar territory — new technical specs, new legal terms, new planning processes — and you treat each one as an opportunity to learn. You don't expect to know everything on day one.

  • Engineering mindset. You're the sort of person who'll happily watch YouTube videos explaining concrete reinforcement, three-phase distribution or substation transformers. You'll be excited to dive into the same level of detail on our projects.

  • A first-principles thinker. You take problems back to fundamentals rather than reaching for jargon or the way things are usually done. When you work with experts — solicitors, architects, engineers — you treat them as people you can learn from, not people you can outsource your thinking to.

  • Commercially astute. You can tell when something is worth fighting for and when it's better to redesign around a constraint, whether that's a lease, a planning condition or a contractor's quote.

  • Highly organised. Managing a pipeline of projects is complex, with many timelines, people to chase, details to look into and things that can (and will) go wrong. We want you at Inbox Zero, not in inbox hell.

  • Comfortable using AI. At a minimum you use it as part of how you work — to learn faster, draft documents and get to the bottom of unfamiliar topics. But maybe you’ll go further and build software to help the team work faster and more precisely.

  • Hands-on. Hubs are built in the real world, not behind a screen. You'll meet landlords, talk to electricians and look at drains, but you'll also need to read contracts and chase agents who've gone quiet.

  • A strong sense of what good looks like. Whatever the topic, problem or issue. You need to know how to hold yourself and others to a high standard.

title: Senior Imaging Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We’re hiring a Senior Imaging Engineer to join our optics and imaging team. You’ll own key parts of the image quality across our multi-camera systems, ensuring our cameras automatically capture high-performance footage that powers computer vision, tracking and insights for teams around the world.

As a Senior Imaging Engineer, you’ll:

  • Evaluate and improve camera systems. You’ll measure, analyze and improve how optics, sensors and image signal processing (ISP) perform across our computer vision applications.
  • Test and qualify hardware. You’ll evaluate lenses and camera modules against optical and environmental specifications, run qualification tests and partner closely with external suppliers on technical follow-up, and refine optical test methods for both lab environments and production lines
  • Support ISP tuning. You’ll tune exposure, white balance, tone mapping and dynamic range, while contributing to camera control and 3A algorithms to enhance downstream computer vision.
  • Collaborate and lead. You’ll contribute to imaging requirements and trade-offs alongside product managers and our optics lead, own projects end-to-end and share knowledge to mentor fellow engineers.

Location

Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We’re currently considering applicants within commuting distance of Den Bosch. You’ll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.

Must-Haves

  • Proven imaging experience. You have deep experience in imaging, camera systems or optical engineering, ideally working on shipped hardware products, bringing a strong understanding of optics, image sensors and ISP pipelines.
  • Hands-on lab expertise. You bring practical experience measuring image quality - including MTF/SFR, noise, color and distortion - using lab equipment like collimators, test charts and climate chambers.
  • Proficient programmer. You’re comfortable using Python for analysis and tooling, as well as C/C++ on embedded Linux.
  • A clear communicator. You explain technical trade-offs to non-specialists with ease and make sound decisions even when working with incomplete data

Nice-to-Haves

  • Control algorithm development. Experience developing camera control algorithms such as auto exposure and auto white balance.
  • Calibration knowledge. Experience with camera calibration (intrinsics, extrinsics and distortion models) and multi-camera or stitched systems.
  • Supplier collaboration. Experience partnering with suppliers and manufacturing partners on specifications, sample evaluations and issue resolution.
  • Embedded platform experience. Familiarity with embedded camera platforms and ISP tuning tools.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.  Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.  
  • Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you’ll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
  • Encourage career growth. We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
  • Provide an environment to help you succeed. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you’re at the office or working remotely, we’ll provide you the tech you need to do your best work.
  • Support your wellbeing. Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you’re located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is displayed below—starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices. 

This role will also be eligible for a long-term incentive (LTI) award. Any bonuses awarded are based on individual and company performance paid at Hudl's discretion. 

Base Salary Range€60.000—€101.000 EUR

descriptionHtml:
Wil jij als Senior Implementatie Consultant meer end to end verantwoordelijkheden krijgen? Bij Whitevision geven we je meer autonomie en ruimte om processen bij de klant en binnen het team te verbeteren. Kortom, wil je meer strategisch adviseren, collega’s coachen en écht impact maken binnen een snelgroeiende internationale SaaS-organisatie? Dan maken wij graag kennis met je.

Jouw rol
Als Senior Implementatie Consultant word je verantwoordelijk voor meerdere implementaties bij verschillende organisaties, met een diversiteit aan Whitevision producten. Jij bent het aanspreekpunt en de trusted advisor voor jouw klanten. Je bepaalt grotendeels zelf, in overleg met de klant, waar je je werkzaamheden uitvoert. Je analyseert klantprocessen, denkt strategisch mee over de beste inrichting en begeleidt organisaties servicegericht naar een succesvolle livegang.

Je werkt zelfstandig, deelt je kennis met het team en coacht startende consultants. Je signaleert commerciële kansen bij bestaande klanten en draagt bij aan standaardisatie en verbetering van onze consultancyprocessen, die het team als geheel beter maken bijvoorbeeld door het inzetten van AI gedreven functionaliteit. Tegelijk blijf je jezelf ontwikkelen: je vergroot je productkennis, houdt je vakkennis bij en krijgt de ruimte om door te groeien richting een leidinggevende, coachende of expertrol binnen onze consultancyorganisatie. Je taken en verantwoordelijkheden zijn:
+ Je leidt end to end de implementatietrajecten.
+ Je analyseert documentprocessen en vertaalt deze naar slimme, schaalbare oplossingen.
+ Je adviseert klanten op operationeel én managementniveau.
+ Je traint eindgebruikers en zorgt voor maximale adoptie van onze software.
+ Je bewaakt planning, kwaliteit en klanttevredenheid binnen je projecten.
+ Je coacht junior en medior consultants en deelt actief je kennis.


Wat breng je mee?
+ Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde Hbo, bijvoorbeeld richting BIM, Bedrijfskunde of bedrijfseconomie.
+ Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het uitvoeren van software-implementaties.
+ Je hebt al ervaring met projectleiding en stakeholdermanagement.
+ Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden (Nederlands én Engels).
+ Analytisch, resultaatgericht en commercieel bewust.
+ Ervaring met SaaS-oplossingen, SQL, ERP en affiniteit met documentverwerking is een pré.
+ Een coachende instelling: je vindt het leuk om collega’s verder te helpen.
+ Je bent minimaal 32 uur per week beschikbaar (onze voorkeur gaat uit naar 40 uur).

Jij bent de consultant waar klanten om vragen en waar collega’s van leren.
Bij Whitevision krijg je de ruimte, het vertrouwen en de schaal van een groeiende Europese groep om écht impact te maken.

Wat bieden wij?
Naast het werken binnen een gezellig, gemotiveerd en betrokken team bieden wij jou:
+ Een salaris tussen €4.250 en €6.000 (o.b.v. 40 uur), afhankelijk van je opleiding en ervaring.
+ Een auto van de zaak, laptop, mobiele telefoon en pensioenregeling.
+ 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om 5 extra dagen te kopen (o.b.v. 40 uur).
+ Een inspirerende werkomgeving met flexibiliteit in locatie/werkplek (hybride) en werktijden.
+ Verantwoordelijkheid en zelfstandigheid in je rol, met invloed op onze diensten en strategie.
+ Een professioneel en hardwerkend team, waar samenwerken en ontspanning samen gaan.
+ Een informele organisatie waar we regelmatig uitjes organiseren met het team en bedrijf

Over Whitevision
Whitevision is een toonaangevende SaaS-speler in Intelligent Document Processing & Management, die meer dan 2300 organisaties helpt hun documentprocessen slimmer, sneller en betrouwbaarder te maken. Wij ontwikkelen slimme, schaalbare en betrouwbare tools voor factuurverwerking, procurement, spend en document management, die naadloos integreren met een breed scala aan ERP-systemen.

Vandaag de dag vertrouwen onze klanten op onze oplossingen. Vanuit kantoren in Breda, Rotterdam, Zoetermeer, De Goorn, Milton Keynes en Southampton werken ruim 140 medewerkers aan de doorontwikkeling en toepassing ervan, in een cultuur gebouwd op de kernwaarden betrokken, ambitieus, respectvol en daadkrachtig.

Als Senior Implementatie Consultant speel je een sleutelrol: jij zorgt ervoor dat onze klanten succesvol live gaan én tevreden blijven. Je werkt nauw samen met 45 gedreven collega’s in het Support & Consultancy team. In een omgeving waar je je productkennis verder verdiept en je expertise volop kunt inzetten en uitbouwen.

Doorgroeimogelijkheden

Binnen Whitevision krijg je de ruimte om door te groeien naar rollen met meer strategische, organisatorische en internationale impact. Afhankelijk van jouw ambities kun je je ontwikkelen richting meer inhoudelijke diepgang (solution expert) of juist breder leiderschap als Lead of Manager binnen onze snelgroeiende internationale organisatie.

Standplaats
Zoetermeer of Breda

title: Senior Implementatiemanager Sociaal Domein    |   Gemeente Den Haag
descriptionHtml:
De opdracht

Van veranderkundig advies naar daadwerkelijke verandering. Daar ligt jouw opdracht. Voor twee veranderopgaven binnen het sociaal domein van de gemeente Den Haag zoeken we een ervaren senior implementatiemanager die veranderkundige expertise combineert met implementatiekracht. Ben jij een ervaren implementatiemanager die beweging weet te creëren in complexe maatschappelijke opgaven? Kun jij veranderkundige inzichten verbinden aan concrete resultaten en beschik je over de kracht om veranderingen daadwerkelijk te laten landen in de praktijk? Breng jij structuur en voortgang, zie je patronen en heb je oog voor belangen, krijg je mensen in beweging en kun je tegelijkertijd het eigenaarschap van de lijn versterken? Dan ben jij de senior implementatiemanager die we zoeken voor de ondersteuning van de teams Wet Maatschappelijke Ondersteuning (Wmo) en Jeugdgezondheidszorg (JGZ) binnen het Sociaal Domein. Er liggen twee uitdagende opdrachten waarbij organisatieontwikkeling, cultuurverandering en implementatie hand in hand gaan, daarnaast ben jij ook in de lead voor een pilot passend bij de twee opdrachten.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior Implementatiemanager begeleid je complexe verandertrajecten van ontwerp naar uitvoering. Je brengt structuur, regie en voortgang aan in trajecten waarin al denkwerk is verricht, maar waar de daadwerkelijke implementatie en borging nog vorm moet krijgen.

Je werkt nauw samen met opdrachtgevers, managementteams, medewerkers en interne adviseurs. Daarbij zorg je ervoor dat plannen niet op papier blijven staan, maar worden vertaald naar concrete veranderingen in werkwijzen, processen, gedrag en samenwerking.

Je:

· brengt regie, structuur, tempo en doe-kracht in de verander- en implementatietrajecten;

· ontwikkelt en begeleidt implementatieaanpakken die bijdragen aan duurzame verandering;

· hebt sterke veranderkundige vaardigheden en het vermogen om gedrag, cultuur en leiderschap bespreekbaar te maken;

· hebt bewezen implementatiekracht: je weet veranderingen te vertalen naar concrete acties, resultaten en borging;

· hebt ervaring met transitievraagstukken en het begeleiden van organisaties in verandering;

· adviseert over risico's, aanpak en passende veranderinterventies;

· stimuleert bewustwording, dialoog, eigenaarschap en samenwerking;

· maakt verschillende perspectieven en patronen zichtbaar en bespreekbaar;

· ontwikkelt praktische tools en werkvormen die de verandering ondersteunen;

· bewaakt voortgang en resultaten en stuurt bij waar nodig.

Je weet daarbij effectief te schakelen tussen denken en doen, richting geven en ruimte bieden, tempo maken en reflecteren.

Naast de twee veranderopgaven ben je in de lead voor de pilot rondom implementatie- en transitiemanagement, waar deze opdracht de input voor levert voor de afdeling Opgaven & Ontwikkeling. Op basis van je ervaringen binnen de twee teams (WMO en JGZ) breng je in kaart welke expertise, rollen en capaciteit nodig zijn om dergelijke veranderopgaven in de toekomst goed te ondersteunen. Jouw formele opdrachtgever is één van de managers van het team Organisatieontwikkeling voor dit deel van jouw opdracht.


Wie zoeken wij?

Je bent een stevige, zelfstandige en resultaatgerichte professional die complexe veranderopgaven kan doorgronden én realiseren. Je beweegt gemakkelijk tussen management en medewerkers, creëert draagvlak en bent organisatiesensitief. Je beweegt je op het snijvlak van organisatieontwikkeling, verandermanagement en implementatiemanagement.

We zoeken iemand die veranderkundige scherpte combineert met implementatiekracht en management en teams helpt om de verandering zélf te realiseren. Iemand die begrijpt wat nodig is om mensen mee te nemen in verandering, maar die tegelijkertijd zorgt voor structuur, voortgang en realisatie. Een professional die helpt richting te geven aan een verandering én ervoor zorgt dat deze daadwerkelijk wordt geïmplementeerd en duurzaam wordt verankerd binnen de organisatie.

Je beschikt over:

· WO werk- en denkniveau;

· minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring met project-, implementatie- en/of verandermanagement;

· aantoonbare expertise in organisatie- en veranderkunde;

· ruime ervaring met het begeleiden van management en teams bij verandering;

· ervaring met het vertalen van adviezen naar concrete interventies en uitvoering;

· uitstekende advies-, begeleidings- en communicatievaardigheden;

· analytisch vermogen, overtuigingskracht en organisatiesensitiviteit;

· het vermogen om effectief te opereren binnen een complexe, politiek-bestuurlijke omgeving.

Ervaring binnen een gemeente, publieke organisatie, consultancy en/of het sociaal domein is een pré. Kennis van Wmo en/of JGZ is eveneens een pré.

Informatie

Start: december 2026

Aantal uur: 36 uur per week

Lengte opdracht: 6 maanden met optie tot verlening

Locatie: Den Haag

Vorm: Detachering (niet geschikt voor zzp)

Geïnteresseerd?

Graag ontvangen wij jouw CV voor woensdag 3 november 12:00 uur met contactgegevens en de beschikbaarheid. Wij geven je op korte termijn een inhoudelijke reactie op jouw interesse in de interim opdracht.

Contact

Voor meer informatie over deze opdracht kunt u contact opnemen met Edgar Groenendijk, Senior Adviseur Interim Management

title: Senior Indirect Procurement Category Manager - Marketing (All Genders)
descriptionHtml:
The role

The (Senior) Category Manager Marketing will be responsible for overseeing strategic sourcing and contracting at HelloFresh for Marketing across different marketing categories, which may include: Offline Media, Online Media, Influencer Marketing, Sponsorships, Retail Media, etc. The goal is to collaborate seamlessly with Global and regional stakeholders and major suppliers in all HelloFresh markets and help them to navigate the procurement landscape. In addition, the role will be supporting initiatives targeted to increase the maturity level of Indirect Procurement’s processes and systems landscape. As part of the Marketing  Procurement team the position will report to the respective lead based in Berlin.

We are looking for an entrepreneurial, confident, proactive and high-spirited Procurement professional with a strength for prioritisation, data handling and great stakeholder management. Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences!   • Own end-to-end Marketing sourcing: supplier market mapping, RFx execution, negotiation, and contract award for high-value projects
  • Develop category strategies for different marketing categories, in alignment with the business’ goals 
  • Create, align and execute a sourcing roadmap with key stakeholders in the HQ and the regional markets to deliver P&L savings and overall procurement value
  • Develop and optimize the supplier portfolio across Hello Fresh’s markets
  • Cultivate and manage close relationships with (senior) business partners within Marketing to support their objectives and the company growth agenda

  • Deep knowledge of strategic sourcing methodology, category management, and supplier management

  • Proven track record of taking ownership: identifying problems early and driving resolution independently, without waiting to be directed
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including preparing and delivering presentations and reports for senior audience
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with proven ability to build trust and credibility with business partners at different levels

What we offer

From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

title: Senior Industrialization & Supply Chain Manager (f/m/d).
descriptionHtml:
About TACTILIA

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible.

You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor?

The Role

As Senior Industrialization & Supply Chain Manager you will take ownership of the industrialization perspective throughout the product development process. Working closely with R&D, engineering and external manufacturing partners, you will ensure that manufacturing considerations are integrated into product design from the earliest development stages.

You will challenge existing design decisions where necessary, identify more suitable manufacturing technologies and processes, and drive the transition from engineering concepts and prototypes to manufacturable, scalable products.

This is a key role for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of engineering, product development and manufacturing – and who is equally comfortable discussing technical trade-offs with R&D engineers, negotiating with suppliers and engaging directly with people on the production floor.

What you will do:

  • Drive industrialization from early product development: Work closely with R&D engineers from the beginning of the development process, integrating manufacturing expertise into design decisions and challenging concepts where necessary to improve manufacturability, cost and scalability.

  • Define manufacturing strategies and technologies: Evaluate, select and implement appropriate manufacturing technologies, processes and production methods for complex mechanical and electromechanical components.

  • Optimize product design for manufacturing: Identify opportunities to simplify designs, reduce component complexity, improve production feasibility and find more cost-effective manufacturing solutions without compromising product performance.

  • Drive design for manufacturing of electronics and sensorics hardware: Work with R&D on the hardware design of electronics and sensor systems (PCBs, sensor modules, cabling and assembly) with manufacturing and supply chain requirements in mind. Ensure designs are producible, testable, cost-efficient and robust in series production.

  • Develop external manufacturing partnerships: Identify and establish relationships with suitable manufacturing partners, particularly specialised SMEs. Work directly with company owners, technical experts and production teams to identify solutions and build reliable partnerships.

  • Build up the supply chain and procurement strategy: Define and implement the supply chain and procurement strategy together with SCHUNK SE and external partners. Leverage SCHUNK's established supplier network and purchasing expertise where it makes sense, and build additional sourcing channels, including second sources, for critical components.

  • Drive manufacturing readiness: Take ownership of manufacturing bottlenecks, technical feasibility, supplier lead times and production challenges, ensuring a smooth transition from prototypes to repeatable and scalable production.

  • Build industrialization capabilities: Establish manufacturing processes, methods and standards that support TACTILIA's future growth and increasing production requirements.

What you bring:

  • Several years (5 years) of experience in industrialization, manufacturing engineering, production engineering or a comparable technical role.

  • Broad knowledge of manufacturing technologies and processes, ideally involving complex mechanical, precision or electromechanical products.

  • Proven experience translating engineering designs into practical, cost-efficient and manufacturable products.

  • Experience with design for manufacturing of electronics and sensor hardware (PCB assembly, component selection, test strategies), ideally in an electromechanical or mechatronic product.

  • Experience identifying, evaluating and working with external manufacturing partners and suppliers.

  • Experience building or managing supply chains and procurement strategies, including working with a parent or group company's purchasing organization.

  • Comfortable engaging with different stakeholders, from R&D engineers and senior management to supplier owners, technicians and blue-collar production teams.

  • Entrepreneurial, pragmatic and hands-on mindset, with the ability to take ownership and drive topics independently.

  • Strong communication skills and the confidence to challenge engineering decisions constructively.

  • Fluent in English; German is an advantage.

The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.

At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability and robustness to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.

The technology is taking shape, the team is being built, and the standards around robotic hands and their skills are still open. That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.

Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next.

If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that work reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

WPP Onefluence is seeking a dynamic and trend-savvy Senior Influencer Executive to join our team dedicated to L'Oréal. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving successful influencer marketing campaigns that align with L'Oréal's brand objectives.

As the Senior Influencer Executive, you will lead influencer strategy and campaign execution across social platforms to amplify brand awareness, drive engagement, and grow our community within the beauty space.

You’ll be responsible for managing influencer relationships, developing creative campaign concepts, and ensuring brand alignment with both macro and micro creators.

  • Performance & Reporting
    • Monitor and analyse influencer campaign performance using analytics tools.
    • Deliver insights and recommendations to optimize future campaigns.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Work closely with PR, social media, e-commerce, and creative teams to ensure consistent messaging and amplification.
    • Support integrated marketing initiatives that combine influencer, content, and brand storytelling.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of social media platforms and influencer ecosystems.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.

  • Existing network of beauty influencers or creators.

descriptionHtml:
Senior Influence Executive

Department: Influence 
Location: London
Contact type: 12-Month Fixed Term Contract 
Full Time/Part time: Full Time
Reporting into: Business Director 

About the Role

WPP Onefluence is seeking a dynamic and trend-savvy Senior Influencer Executive to join our team dedicated to L'Oréal. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving successful influencer marketing campaigns that align with L'Oréal's brand objectives.

As the Senior Influencer Executive, you will lead influencer strategy and campaign execution across social platforms to amplify brand awareness, drive engagement, and grow our community within the beauty space.

You’ll be responsible for managing influencer relationships, developing creative campaign concepts, and ensuring brand alignment with both macro and micro creators.


Key Responsibilities

  • Influencer Strategy & Campaign Management
    • Develop and execute influencer campaigns for new product launches, brand awareness, and seasonal initiatives.
    • Identify and onboard relevant beauty influencers (macro, micro, and nano) across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and emerging platforms.
    • Create and manage influencer briefs, contracts, timelines, and budgets.
    • Oversee influencer content production to ensure brand tone, aesthetic, and compliance with marketing guidelines.
  • Relationship Management
    • Build and maintain strong relationships with top-tier beauty influencers, talent managers, and agencies.
    • Act as the main point of contact for influencer collaborations and ongoing partnerships.
  • Performance & Reporting
    • Monitor and analyse influencer campaign performance using analytics tools.
    • Deliver insights and recommendations to optimize future campaigns.
    • Report on ROI, engagement metrics, and audience growth.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Work closely with PR, social media, e-commerce, and creative teams to ensure consistent messaging and amplification.
    • Support integrated marketing initiatives that combine influencer, content, and brand storytelling.

Skills & Qualifications

  • 2-3 years of experience in influencer marketing, preferably within the beauty, cosmetics, or lifestyle industry.
  • Strong understanding of social media platforms and influencer ecosystems.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
  • Analytical mindset with experience using tools like Traackr, or similar.
  • Creative eye for beauty trends, social storytelling, and content aesthetics.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment
  • Existing network of beauty influencers or creators.
  • Experience with paid and seeding influencer amplification or affiliate programs.
  • Understanding of emerging platforms (e.g., TikTok Shop, Threads, YouTube Shorts).

Benefits 

  • 25 days annual leave + 1 Volunteer Day 
  • Bupa Healthcare
  • Enhanced Maternity, Adoption and Shared Parental Leave
  • We have a Flexible Working Model with core working hours: 10am – 4pm
  • A 1.5:1 Matching Pension Structure
  • Wellbeing and Health: Up to £25.00 per month towards physical or online exercise class membership, Unmind membership, LifeWorks tool and annual eye tests and development budgets and Wellbeing incentives and activities throughout the year 
  • Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work Scheme
  • Life Assurance

Our ambition is to attract the very best diverse talent to Ogilvy, and to be the employer of choice in the UK. We want everyone to feel welcome when they join us, and once they’re here, for them to want to stay with us, grow their career, and to feel they belong with us.

We are an equal opportunity employer and we’re committed to creating an inclusive, welcoming environment for everyone who wants to work at Ogilvy. For us, diversity, equity and inclusion is integrated into everything that we do. We believe that for creativity to flourish, everything about how we work must have diversity at its core. Your race, colour, ethnic, religion, gender, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, have no bearing on our hiring decisions, but we encourage everyone to feel free to express their true selves in an environment we are consistently striving to make as inclusive as possible.

We aim to facilitate an accessible and positive application experience for all candidates. If you require any adjustments from us to support you through the process or expect to require any adjustments to working conditions to be able to best perform in the role, please let us know. We are happy to consider all reasonable adjustments.

If you live with a disability and you would like to take advantage of our offer of a guaranteed interview under the Disability Confident Scheme, please ensure you fill out our voluntary Equal Opportunities Questionnaire when applying.

title: Senior Influencer Marketing Manager | US Market (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Yepoda

Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.

Our mission is to bring Clean K-Beauty Innovations,from Korea straight to Europe, UK, and the US – without ever compromising on our values, quality, and sustainability. Our clean, mindfully produced skincare products are made with love in Korea, vegan, cruelty-free, and packed with the best natural and active ingredients.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a fast-growing beauty start-up based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available across Europe and the US, since March 2025, in Sephora Europe & since August 2026 in Sephora US – online and in over 1200 stores. As a certified B Corp™, we are committed to building a business with purpose. With a team of over 120 brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda’s story every day.

We are looking for a Senior Influencer Marketing Manager to drive our creator partnerships in the US. In this role, you will build relationships with the creators and celebrities who shape American beauty culture, own campaigns from strategy to results, and personally drive a significant share of our US targets.

Your tasks

  • Manage a portfolio of influencers, key partners and multiple sub-projects within the assigned market.

  • Remain actively involved in campaign execution, contributing at least 30% to total country targets.

  • Develop and implement best practices to ensure high execution standards, efficiency, and continuous KPI optimization.

  • Take full ownership of influencer marketing projects, ensuring timely and effective delivery of all initiatives.

  • Supervise country-level campaign country planning, team targets, monitoring progress and ensuring alignment with overall company goals.

  • Track US beauty, social, and creator trends, and turn insights into local campaigns and partnerships that grow the brand in the US market.

Your profile

  • Proven track record in executing profitable and high-performing influencer marketing campaigns, delivering measurable business impact.

  • Over 4 years of experience in influencer marketing in the US, ideally within fast-paced or high-growth environments.

  • Strong understanding of the U.S. beauty market, including key trends, consumer behavior, and creator landscape.

  • Excellent project management and organizational skills, capable of handling multiple campaigns and stakeholders simultaneously.

  • Hands-on mindset with the ability to balance strategic thinking and day-to-day execution.

  • Data-driven and performance-oriented, with a focus on ROI, reach growth, and campaign optimization.

  • Collaborative team player with strong communication and leadership skills; team management experience is a must.

What We Offer:

  • Dynamic Environment: The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team.

  • Accelerate Your Career: Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand.

  • Inspiring Workspace: Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks.

  • Hybrid Working: We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery.

  • We Value Diversity: We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default.

  • Employee Discounts: You’ll get to enjoy the Yepoda products at a discount and share it with friends and family to keep your glow going!

  • Unique Add Ons: A monthly benefits budget that's yours to spend. Through the Probonio app you pick what actually fits your lifestyle.

Would you like to be part of the team? Then we'd love to hear from you! 🫰✨

Make sure to apply by clicking on the “Apply for this job” button below. Please upload your CV and Cover Letter in English language. Our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get back to you as soon as possible.

At Yepoda we are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals, regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, citizenship, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, parental status, disability, or any other status protected by applicable law.

title: Senior Information Security Consultant (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über HvS-Consulting GmbH

Wir - die HvS-Consulting GmbH – sind Spezialisten für Cyber Security und davon überzeugt, dass die Werte unserer Gesellschaft auch im Cyber-Raum geschützt werden müssen. Deshalb helfen wir Organisationen, sich mit dem richtigen Zusammenspiel aus Technologien, Prozessen und Menschen selbst zu schützen. Unser Motto lautet „People – Process – Technology"

Für unser Team in Garching bei München suchen wir ab sofort eine(n)

Senior Information Security Consultant (m/w/d)

Das erwartet Dich:

  • ISMS und BCMS: Du berätst unsere Kunden bei der Einführung, Weiterentwicklung und nachhaltigen Verankerung von Informationssicherheits- und Business-Continuity-Managementsystemen, beispielsweise nach ISO 27001, TISAX® oder BSI IT-Grundschutz

  • Praxisnahe Informationssicherheit: Du sorgst dafür, dass Informationssicherheit bei unseren Kunden nicht nur auf dem Papier existiert. Gemeinsam mit den verantwortlichen Ansprechpartnern entwickelst Du praxistaugliche Vorgaben und begleitest deren nachhaltige Umsetzung

  • Projektverantwortung: Du übernimmst die fachliche Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle und komplexe Kundenprojekte. Dabei steuerst Du die Projektbeteiligten, behältst Ziele, Qualität und Termine im Blick und sorgst für eine strukturierte Umsetzung

  • Portfolioentwicklung: Du übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle bei der Weiterentwicklung unseres ISMS- und BCMS-Beratungsportfolios und bringst Deine fachliche Erfahrung gezielt in neue Methoden, Leistungen und Beratungsansätze ein

  • Audit-Vorbereitung: Du bereitest unsere Kunden auf interne und externe Audits vor, coachst sie im Umgang mit Auditoren und vermittelst praxisnahe Tipps für eine erfolgreiche Zertifizierung

  • Dokumentation: Du erstellst und überarbeitest Auditunterlagen, Berichte, Sicherheitskonzepte und Maßnahmenpläne professionell und mit einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch

  • Methoden & Standards: Du entwickelst Best Practices, Methoden und interne Standards kontinuierlich weiter und bringst deine Erfahrung aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Teams ein

  • Mentoring: Du unterstützt weniger erfahrene Kollegen bei fachlichen Fragestellungen, teilst Dein Wissen und gibst konstruktives Feedback

Das bringst Du mit

  • Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in der ISMS- oder BCMS-Beratung mit und hast bereits anspruchsvolle Kundenprojekte eigenständig begleitet und fachlich gesteuert

  • Standards: Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse relevanter Standards und regulatorischer Anforderungen, insbesondere ISO 2700x, BSI IT-Grundschutz, VDA ISA / TISAX® und KRITIS

  • Verantwortungsbewusstsein: Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung, triffst fundierte Entscheidungen und behältst auch bei komplexen Projekten den Überblick

  • Kommunikation: Du trittst gegenüber Kunden und Stakeholdern sicher auf und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich vermitteln, vom Fachexperten bis zum Management

  • Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest strukturiert, analytisch und eigenverantwortlich und überzeugst durch einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch

  • Qualifikation: Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium, eine vergleichbare Ausbildung oder relevante Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen IT, Informationssicherheit oder Risikomanagement

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Reisebereitschaft: Du bist bereit, für Kundentermine innerhalb der DACH-Region zu reisen. Der Reiseanteil liegt bei etwa 30 %

  • Weitere Expertise: Idealerweise verfügst Du über Erfahrung in der BCM-Beratung, einschlägige Zertifizierungen sowie Kenntnisse der Anforderungen aus NIS2 oder KRITIS

Was erwartet Dich noch?

Ein abwechslungsreicher und vielseitiger Job in einem der (aus unserer Sicht) spannendsten Themengebiete überhaupt. Und das in einem Unternehmen, in dem wirklich jede Meinung gehört und geschätzt wird – vom Praktikanten bis zur Geschäftsführung. Uns gibt dieser Job nicht nur ein Gehalt, sondern auch persönliche Zufriedenheit, weil wir wirklich etwas bewirken und die Welt ein Stück sicherer machen.

Bei uns gibt es (natürlich) kostenlose Getränke, Kaffee und Snacks, aber das ist heutzutage Standard. Zusätzlich bieten wir auf Wunsch attraktive Benefits, von Jobticket bis hin zu Kindergartenzuschuss. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten helfen Dir, auch auf Unvorhergesehenes im Alltag gelassen zu reagieren. Schau dir unsere Benefits gerne auf unserer Karriereseite genauer an.

Was erwartet Dich noch? Wir pflegen eine offene, vertrauensvolle Unternehmenskultur (schau mal auf Kununu) und schätzen eigenständiges Arbeiten, natürlich auch, aber nicht nur im Home-Office. Schließlich haben wir ein modernes Büro in Garching mit sensationellem Alpenblick, in dem wir gerne gemeinsam Mittagsessen und uns mit unseren Security-Auditoren, Incident-Respondern, Awareness-Trainern und Multimedia-Designern austauschen.

title: Senior Information Security Infrastructure Engineer - Security Architecture - InfoSec
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role :

Join the InfoSec - Security Architecture team as a Senior Information Security Infrastructure Engineer, where you'll have the chance to play a key role in protecting our organization's data and systems. This position offers the opportunity to work on meaningful projects that directly impact our security posture and collaborate with a skilled team passionate about information security.   In more details: We ingest the security telemetry that the whole security org runs on. In this role you'll get that telemetry into Elasticsearch consistently and keep the underlying Elastic clusters healthy. You own the pipeline end to end: from a new security data source landing, through ingest pipelines, into the indices detection, IR, and consulting teams query, plus the clusters that store it all. 

What You Will Be Doing :

  • Security telemetry ingestion - build and maintain ingestion of security-relevant data into Elasticsearch (cloud provider audit logs, identity/SaaS activity, endpoint and asset data). This means integrating with third-party and cloud provider APIs to pull telemetry: auth, pagination, rate limits, and handling schema changes. Both Elastic integrations and one-off custom integrations.
  • Keep the Elastic Cloud on Kubernetes clusters healthy. Monitor and upgrade them regularly. This involves updating versions and builds. Manage capacity and shards. Handle index lifecycle management (ILM). Enable cross-cluster search (CCS).
  • Use Terraform to manage cloud infrastructure and Elasticsearch resources. This includes managing pipelines, index templates, and alerts. Utilize Kubernetes and Helm to deploy scheduled ingest jobs.
  • Use AI automation and tooling to reduce toil. This includes self-healing jobs and health checks. It also involves alerting, internal CLIs, and AI or agent-assisted workflows for investigation and operations.
  • Data quality & reliability - Own the "is the security data actually flowing correctly?" question. Monitor backfills. Ensure that schemas and fields are consistent. Keep an eye on costs.

What You Bring :

  • Ability to operate Elastic and Elasticsearch in production. This includes managing ingest pipelines, index templates, mappings, and queries, while ensuring that clusters are healthy and upgraded. Experience with ECK or Elasticsearch on Kubernetes is strongly preferred.
  • Proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and accelerate operations, while still owning the final outcomes.
  • Kubernetes - deploying and operating workloads (scheduled jobs, Helm charts, operators); troubleshooting pods/jobs in a cluster.
  • Terraform - managing cloud and Elasticsearch resources as code.
  • API integration - consuming REST APIs for data ingestion: authentication, pagination, rate limiting concurrency, and error handling.
  • Python scripting - able to read, write, and modify ingestion/automation scripts. Scripting-level, not full software-engineering depth.

Bonus Points :

  • Experience with cloud providers.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud providers, preferably GCP, and working with audit and logging data.
  • Knowledge of GitHub, PR-based workflows, GitHub Actions and Continuous Integration (CI).
  • Knowledge of SOC operations and incident response (IR) workflows, including the use of security telemetry during investigations.
  • Ability to develop and use dashboard/visualization tools.

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

  • Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
  • Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
  • Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
  • Generous number of vacation days each year
  • Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
  • Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
  • Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.

We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email . We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission.

title: Senior Infrastructure Manager
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Manager who is, first and foremost, a people leader.

In this role, your primary responsibility is the health, performance, and career growth of your engineering team. While you must possess a solid technical background to understand the challenges your team faces, your day-to-day focus will not be hands-on technical work. Instead, you will use your experience to remove blockers, guide decision-making, and ensure your engineers have the environment they need to succeed.

The Team You Will Lead

You will lead the Infrastructure Solutions team within the wider Technical Operations department. Your engineers are responsible for building the environment, delivering projects as requested by Engineering and Product, and ensuring we remain available, scalable, and secure. They are not responsible for the BAU function of the platforms that is managed by another team within Technical Operations. The Infrastructure Solutions team takes a concept or idea and makes that into a reality within the boundaries and constraints of our platforms.

You will be managing a team of engineers who individually possess experience in:

  • On-Premise Linux systems, Container solutions, Debian packaging, Ansible, data streaming and queuing technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
  • Advanced database management knowledge (MySQL, Postgres) in replicated environments.
  • Physical Network management, with an on-prem estate that is Juniper focused.
  • Cloud environments: GCP and AWS
  • Platform engineer focused on building, maintaining and supporting an Internal Developer Platform (CI/CD)

The Operational Reality

It is important to be transparent about the environment you are joining. We operate at high velocity with a broad and complex technology estate. However, we are a lean team, not a giant corporation with endless resources.

  • Context Switching is the Norm
    • You will rarely have the luxury of focusing on a single task for weeks at a time. You will be required to shift focus multiple times a week, and sometimes multiple times a day, as business priorities evolve.
  • Agility over Silos
    • Because we are a lean team, we wear many hats. You must be comfortable pivoting from a strategic discussion to an operational challenge without losing momentum.
  • Focus Management
    • Success in this role requires the ability to maintain high standards while navigating a workload that changes dynamically. This is not a role for those who prefer a slow, singular focus; it is for those who thrive on variety, pace, and solving complex problems in real-time.

As the Senior Infrastructure Manager, You Will:

title: Senior Infrastructure Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Lightning AI is the company behind PyTorch Lightning. Founded in 2019, we build an end-to-end platform for developing, training, and deploying AI systems—designed to take ideas from research to production with less friction.

Through our merger with Voltage Park, a neocloud and AI Factory, Lightning AI combines developer-first software with cost-efficient, large-scale compute. Teams get the tools they need for experimentation, training, and production inference, with security, observability, and control built in.

We serve solo researchers, startups, and large enterprises. Lightning AI operates globally with offices in New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, and London, and is backed by Coatue, Index Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, and Firstminute.

The Way We Work

The people who thrive here are builders who move fast, communicate openly, take ownership, and continuously improve themselves, their teams, and our company. Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • Move with Urgency: We move quickly, make thoughtful decisions, and keep momentum. We value action over perfection and learn by shipping.
  • Take Ownership: We own outcomes, not just our individual work. We make decisions that move the company forward and follow through.
  • Communicate Openly: We communicate directly, seek to understand, and create clarity for others. Honest conversations help us move faster together.
  • Build Great Teams: We lead by example, empower others, and create healthy teams where people can do their best work.
  • Raise the Bar: We're always improving ourselves. We learn from feedback, consistently challenge ourselves to grow, and focus on the work that matters most.
  • Think Long-Term: We design for what's next. We create scalable systems, simplify complexity, and use AI and automation to amplify our impact.
 

About the Role

Lightning AI is seeking a Senior Infrastructure Software Engineer to join our Infrastructure Engineering team.

Our Infrastructure Engineering team builds the software systems that operate and manage Lightning AI’s large-scale GPU and bare-metal infrastructure. We develop services, APIs, tooling, and automation that bridge the gap between our physical infrastructure and the systems our customers depend on for AI/ML training, inference, and HPC workloads.

In this role, you will build production software and automation that support infrastructure throughout its lifecycle, from provisioning and bring-up through monitoring, maintenance, and decommissioning. You will design systems that enable engineers and software to interact programmatically with thousands of servers, storage systems, and high-performance networks, reducing manual operations and making infrastructure management more reliable, repeatable, and scalable.

This is a software-first infrastructure role that combines strong software engineering with Linux systems and hardware-aware infrastructure automation. You will work closely with teams across Infrastructure, Networking, Data Center Operations, and Platform Engineering to bring new capacity online and continuously improve how we operate our infrastructure at scale.

This role may be fully remote within the U.S., or hybrid out of one of our office hubs (NYC, SF, Seattle, or London), with occasional team and company offsites. We are not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position at this time.

What You Will Do

Infrastructure Software & Automation

  • Design, build, and operate production services, APIs, tooling, and automation for managing large-scale bare-metal and GPU infrastructure
  • Build and extend software systems that support infrastructure provisioning, configuration, monitoring, and lifecycle management
  • Develop reliable automation that reduces manual operational work and improves the consistency and scalability of infrastructure management
  • Build tools and interfaces that enable engineers and other systems to interact programmatically with physical infrastructure

Provisioning & Lifecycle Management

  • Build and extend systems for server discovery, provisioning, configuration, validation, and lifecycle management
  • Automate infrastructure bring-up and capacity deployment across large fleets of compute systems
  • Integrate software and automation with hardware management and provisioning systems
  • Improve tooling and workflows for managing infrastructure throughout its production lifecycle

Reliability & Observability

  • Build telemetry, logging, and observability capabilities that provide visibility into the health of our infrastructure
  • Develop tools and automation to identify, diagnose, and respond to infrastructure and hardware issues
  • Translate recurring operational issues and hardware failure modes into improvements to software, tooling, and automation
  • Improve the reliability and scalability of infrastructure operations as the fleet grows

Architecture & Collaboration

  • Partner with Network, Infrastructure Operations, Data Center, Platform Engineering, and other teams to define requirements and build new infrastructure capabilities
  • Participate in architectural discussions and help define the technical direction of Lightning AI’s infrastructure software
  • Make pragmatic design decisions that balance reliability, scalability, simplicity, and speed of execution
  • Write clear design documents and technical documentation and contribute to engineering best practices

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering, infrastructure engineering, or related experience
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building production backend systems in Python or similar object-oriented programming languages
  • Strong experience with Linux in production environments
  • Experience building APIs, tooling, or automation for managing infrastructure at scale
  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration concepts
  • Understanding of HPC and bare-metal infrastructure fundamentals, including provisioning and out-of-band management
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and make pragmatic architecture decisions while building for long-term reliability and scale
  • Experience working in a startup or other fast-paced environment with a high degree of ownership and autonomy

Ideal Experience

  • Experience with bare-metal hardware troubleshooting and provisioning, including technologies such as PXE/iPXE, BMC, Redfish, or IPMI, particularly with Dell hardware
  • Experience with GPU servers, either in bare-metal environments or under virtualization
  • Experience with network switches, routers, and firewalls, particularly SONiC switches, Palo Alto firewalls, or Juniper Networks
  • Experience with high-performance storage systems, particularly VAST
  • Experience supporting AI/ML or HPC infrastructure at scale

 

Compensation

We are committed to offering competitive compensation that reflects the value each team member brings to our mission. Final offers are based on factors such as experience, skills, geographic location, and role expectations. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package for eligible roles includes a discretionary bonus, a meaningful equity component, and comprehensive benefits.

The anticipated annual base salary range for this role is:$180,000—$220,000 USD

Benefits and Perks

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support our employees’ health, well-being, and long-term success:

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents.

title: Senior Infrastructure Solutions Architect
descriptionHtml:
Diabolocom is a leading European sovereign cloud contact center (CCaaS) and customer experience platform, trusted by more than 400 companies across 60+ countries for business-critical customer operations.

Our technology combines proprietary AI, a private cloud and native telecom infrastructure. Unlike many SaaS platforms built primarily on public-cloud services, we operate our own production environments and manage the underlying infrastructure across networking, connectivity, virtualization, physical infrastructure, telecom and distributed systems.

The role

We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Solutions Architect with a strong infrastructure engineering background to design end-to-end technical solutions for our largest enterprise customers.

You will work at the intersection of our Infrastructure organization and complex customer environments, translating enterprise requirements into architectures that meet demanding security, performance and connectivity needs while remaining scalable and aligned with our platform.

You will work closely with our Infrastructure engineers and technical experts to develop and validate architecture options, assess trade-offs and then explain and defend the proposed solutions with customers.

The role covers both presales and implementation phases. You will own architecture and design, while our Infrastructure teams remain responsible for implementation.

What you will do

  • Lead technical discovery and design end-to-end infrastructure solutions for complex enterprise projects

  • Develop architecture options, assess trade-offs and validate designs with our Infrastructure experts

  • Work directly with enterprise customers to understand requirements, explain and defend technical decisions, and challenge requests when a simpler or more sustainable solution is appropriate

  • Support Presales on complex technical opportunities and RFPs

  • Stay involved during implementation to ensure delivery remains aligned with the agreed architecture

  • Create clear architecture documentation, procedures and reusable technical knowledge.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for a senior infrastructure engineer or architect with deep technical expertise across complex, on-premise environments and the ability to operate confidently with enterprise customers.

You can look beyond individual technologies to understand an infrastructure landscape as a whole, identify constraints and dependencies, and design coherent end-to-end solutions. You are equally comfortable discussing architecture with engineers and presenting, defending or challenging technical decisions with senior customer stakeholders.

What you bring

  • Strong background in infrastructure engineering and architecture, with deep hands-on understanding of on-premise environments

  • Solid expertise across networking, connectivity, virtualization and physical infrastructure, combined with a broad understanding of cloud, security, integrations and distributed systems

  • Proven ability to design end-to-end infrastructure architectures, evaluate trade-offs and turn complex requirements into technically sound solutions

  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers on technical discovery, architecture and solution design

  • Ability to communicate complex technical decisions with clarity and credibility, including challenging requirements when necessary

  • Strong technical documentation skills

  • Fluent French and strong professional English.

Nice to have

  • Experience with CCaaS, contact center or enterprise communications

  • Voice or telecom expertise

  • Security and compliance knowledge

  • Experience designing solutions for large French enterprises.

Your impact

You will take technical ownership of the architecture behind some of Diabolocom’s largest enterprise projects, including environments supporting thousands of contact center agents.

Your job is to make complex requirements technically workable: understand the customer environment, identify constraints, design the architecture, evaluate trade-offs with our engineers and defend the final solution with the customer.

As you build expertise in our platform, you will independently lead architecture work across enterprise opportunities and implementations, from technical discovery and RFPs through design validation and delivery.

Your impact will be visible in the projects we win, the architectures we deploy and our ability to scale enterprise delivery without compromising the technical foundations of the platform.

Why Diabolocom?

Work on infrastructure you can actually see

Around 95% of our production infrastructure runs on our own hardware across several European data centers. We operate our own private cloud and manage the layers underneath it, from physical infrastructure and virtualization to networking, connectivity and telecom.

For an infrastructure architect, this means working with the full stack rather than designing exclusively through public-cloud abstractions.

Design for real enterprise scale

You will work on business-critical communication platforms supporting thousands of users, with demanding requirements around availability, network connectivity, security, integrations and performance.

These are not theoretical architecture exercises. The solutions you design will be built, operated and used in production by major enterprise customers.

Stay at engineering depth

The role sits within Infrastructure, not Presales.

You will design alongside the engineers who operate our platform, challenge architecture choices with people who understand the systems in depth, and stay involved as your designs move into production.

Join at a point of global expansion

Diabolocom already supports more than 400 companies across 60+ countries. As we move further into the enterprise market and expand internationally, the scale and complexity of the infrastructure problems we need to solve are increasing.

You will help define how our platform supports the next generation of large enterprise deployments while keeping the architecture scalable, secure and operationally sustainable.

Logistics

📍 Paris, France

🏢 Hybrid model: minimum 3 days/week onsite

💻 Equipment: choose your preferred setup (Mac/Linux + monitors)

🍽 Lunch vouchers

🚇 Navigo: 50% of the monthly pass reimbursed

One more thing

You do not need to have held the exact title of Solutions Architect before.

Some of the strongest candidates for this role may come from infrastructure engineering or architecture backgrounds and have gradually taken on broader solution design, technical ownership or customer-facing responsibilities.

If you have deep infrastructure expertise, can think beyond a single technical domain and are ready to apply that experience to complex enterprise architecture, we would like to hear from you, even if your background does not match every requirement above.
