title: Senior Integrated Campaign Manager
descriptionHtml:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

 

Senior Integrated Campaign Manager

DeepL · Reporting to the Director of Performance Marketing and Campaigns

About the Role

DeepL's translation portfolio is trusted by well over 20,000 companies and hundreds of millions of professionals worldwide. Rather than organizing our go-to-market by product line, we run a single integrated campaign that speaks to the different people who drive adoption of that portfolio organized by persona, not by feature set. As Integrated Campaigns Manager, you will own the persona motion targeting Global Operators, the department heads in Marketing, HR, and Learning & Development who are responsible for how their organizations communicate globally. Other campaign owners run the parallel motions for personas like Product, Engineering, and Developers; your job is to build the strategy, narrative, and channel mix for the Global Operators audience specifically.

This role sits at the intersection of integrated marketing, demand generation, and account-based marketing. You will start from how Marketing, HR, and L&D leaders think, communicate, and buy, then shape DeepL's capabilities into narratives and programs that speak directly to their priorities. You will orchestrate multi-channel campaigns from concept to launch, and partner closely with Product Marketing, SDR, and Field Marketing to bring targeted, personalized programs to personas in our highest-value accounts.. You will report to the Director of Performance Marketing and Campaigns and work cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content, Creative, Regional Marketing, and RevOps..

What You'll Own

Campaign Strategy & Execution

  • Translate DeepL's translation capabilities into compelling, pipeline-driving campaigns tailored to how functional leaders operate and buy, educating the market on the value of AI-powered translation for global business communication.

  • Partner with Product Marketing, Field, Performance, and SDR teams to develop go-to-market programs and nurture streams aligned with persona priorities and regional needs.

  • Collaborate with Content, Creative, and Regional Marketing teams to produce and localize campaign assets.

  • Maintain a global campaign calendar and asset library, ensuring brand consistency, messaging alignment, and timely deployment across all touchpoints, and coordinate with owners of other persona tracks (e.g., Product/Eng/Dev) so the portfolio campaign reads as one coherent motion.

Account-Based Marketing (ABM)

  • Collaborate with the rest of the team to design and execute ABM programs, building tailored campaign strategies, messaging, and content for prioritized accounts and account tiers.

  • Partner with Performance Marketing and RevOps to feed account engagement, pipeline influence, and conversion data back into ABM targeting and strategy decisions.

  • Continuously refine account segmentation and messaging based on engagement signals, win/loss insights, and sales feedback.

.

Measurement & Optimization

  • Drive measurable impact on awareness, adoption, and pipeline; setting and tracking KPIs such as lead quality, conversion rates, account engagement, and ROI.

  • Collaborate with Performance Marketers to initiate data-driven optimization and A/B testing across campaign channels and ABM plays to continuously improve performance.

  • Leverage insights and competitive intelligence to inform campaign strategy, refine positioning, and identify new opportunities in the AI translation market.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Foster cross-functional collaboration and campaign excellence, sharing learnings, best practices, and post-mortem analyses to continually improve performance and scalability.

  • Serve as the campaigns subject matter expert, representing campaign and ABM performance in relevant leadership and planning forums.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS marketing, campaign management, demand generation, or ABM roles.

  • Proven track record of managing complex, multi-channel campaigns from strategy through execution.

  • Understanding account-based marketing programs, including account tiering, personalized content, and multi-touch orchestration alongside Sales.

  • Demonstrated success driving pipeline generation and revenue growth through integrated and account-based campaigns.

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously and meet deadlines.

  • Data-driven decision-making and proficiency in campaign analytics, attribution, and performance optimization.

  • Excellent communication skills for cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management, particularly with Sales and SDR teams.

  • AI literacy, including familiarity with GenAI tools for campaign planning, content creation, and execution.

  • Preferred: previous experience in high-growth SaaS companies (Series B–IPO stage).

  • Preferred: experience with ABM platforms (e.g., 6sense, Demandbase, RollWorks) in addition to core marketing tech.

Technical Requirements - nice to have

  • Marketing Automation: HubSpot

  • CRM: Salesforce (or equivalent)

  • ABM Platform: 6sense, Demandbase, RollWorks, or similar (preferred)

  • Project Management: Asana, Jira, or similar tools

  • Content Management: Contentful or comparable CMS/DAM platforms

About DeepL

DeepL is Germany's best-known AI company. People and their communication challenges are at the heart of everything we do. Founded by researchers in 2017, we have developed the world's most accurate AI translation and writing technology — serving well over 20,000 companies and hundreds of millions of professionals worldwide.

Accessible across the web, browser extensions, desktop and mobile apps, and an API, DeepL supports a best-in-class communication experience across 31+ languages.

  

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

 

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

While other companies talk about it, we do it!

Engineering is at the heart of Rocket Lab. Our engineering team has a proven track record of designing and developing world-class rockets and spacecraft that are changing the way we access and use space. You'll work alongside driven, talented engineers from varied backgrounds and experience levels, all committed to the same mission. Our engineering team members span design, analysis, prototyping, testing, manufacturing, assembly and integration, quality control, engineering documentation, and more.

About the Role

As a Senior Engineer – Test and Launch Operations, you will provide hands-on technical leadership and project ownership within Rocket Lab's Test and Launch Operations team. You'll drive operational improvements, fill key on-console operations roles, and facilitate cross-team problem-solving to ensure our missions launch on time and with low risk. This is your opportunity to make a direct impact on the future of space access.

What You'll Get to Do:

Integrated Operations

  • Identify and solve significant engineering challenges, independently or as part of a team
  • Perform operator duties during test and launch campaigns, including development, qualification, and flight acceptance testing
  • Facilitate inter-team problem solving to resolve issues impacting launch capability
  • Uphold and contribute to engineering best practices in Test and Launch Operations
  • Continuously improve and streamline testing and operational activities
  • Identify and implement quality, efficiency, and cost improvements
  • Optimize and automate checkout, processing, testing, and operations
  • Take ownership of process improvement initiatives and drive common processes and tools across Integrated Operations
  • Develop and implement solutions to support increasing operational cadence

Technical Leadership

  • Support development of resourcing plans and hiring strategies aligned with team objectives
  • Set the standard for professionalism and skill in operator duties
  • Use experience and sound judgment to make complex, risk-based decisions with limited information

Process & Projects

  • Lead and execute high-priority projects and systems for Test and Launch Operations
  • Move with urgency, translating strategic priorities into action
  • Take calculated risks to deliver solutions on time and within budget
  • Challenge the status quo and seek creative solutions to tough problems
  • Use metrics to drive accountability and continuous improvement

What You'll Bring:

Essential

  • Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronic Engineering, or equivalent
  • 5+ years' experience in engineering, test, and/or operations
  • Ability to read, understand, and follow detailed schematics, drawings, and instructions
  • Self-driven, motivated, and contagiously positive attitude
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to build strong working relationships
  • Meticulous work ethic with a keen eye for detail
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet strict deadlines
  • Comfortable working at heights and in confined spaces

Desirable

  • 8+ years' experience in engineering, test, and/or operations
  • 2+ years' experience leading time-critical, multi-disciplinary engineering operations
  • Experience with launch vehicles or spacecraft, including integration, testing, launch, and/or mission operations
  • Experience with CAD systems
  • Proficiency in Java, Python, or other object-oriented programming languages
  • Experience with LabVIEW and PLC development for data acquisition & real-time control

What Success Looks Like

  • You deliver results—on time and within budget—by rallying support, challenging the status quo, and driving accountability through metrics.
  • You're a role model for professionalism, positivity, and a "no job too tough" attitude.
  • You coach and mentor junior engineers, elevate team standards, and consistently contribute to a culture of excellence.
  • You communicate clearly and concisely, ensuring meetings and actions are purposeful and impactful.
  • You proactively identify and solve problems, always striving for the best outcome for the business.

Additional Information:

  • Domestic and international travel may be required
  • Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance
  • Adherence to health and safety policies and procedures is required

If the above sounds like you apply now!

WHAT TO EXPECT

We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other's backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Als eingespieltes Team aus Visionären, Tüftlern und talentierten Köpfen entwickeln wir kreative digitale Geschäftsmodelle und führen diese bis in die technische Umsetzung für unsere Kunden fort.

Als IT-Consultant & Business Architect bist Du der strategische Partner unserer Kunden bei der Neugestaltung ihrer Prozess- und IT-Landschaft. Du berätst Finanzdienstleister bei der Vorbereitung großer Transformationen. Das Besondere bei uns: Du denkst nicht nur strategisch, sondern nutzt modernste KI-Tools, um den Sprung von der Facharchitektur in die technische Delivery aktiv mitzugestalten und Konzepte schneller in greifbare Ergebnisse zu verwandeln.

Aufgaben

Was Dich erwartet: Beraten, Strukturieren, Umsetzen

  • Strategische Fachberatung: Du analysierst und definierst Geschäftsprozesse und Facharchitekturen als Fundament für komplexe Systemwechsel
  • Methodische Prozessgestaltung: Du optimierst End–to–End–Prozesse und leitest daraus belastbare Zielbilder für die IT–Architektur ab
  • AI–supported Delivery: Du nutzt KI–gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge, um bei der technischen Umsetzung zu unterstützen – sei es bei der Erstellung von API–Spezifikationen, Datenmappings oder dem Prototyping von Systemkomponenten
  • Architektur–Design: Du entwickelst Systemarchitekturen unter Berücksichtigung von API–isierung, Microservices und Security–Standards wie OAuth 2.0
  • Workshop–Leadership: Du moderierst Termine auf Augenhöhe mit Fachbereichen und den IT–Entscheidern, um Konsens über fachliche und technische Anforderungen zu erzielen
  • Dualer Mehrwert: Deine Beratung ist ein eigenständiges Geschäftsmodell, dient aber gleichzeitig dazu, unsere eigenen Lösungen im Markt optimal zu positionieren

Qualifikation

Dein Profil: Analytisch stark und technologiebegeistert

  • Erfahrung: Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in Beratung, Business Analyse oder Facharchitektur im Umfeld von Financial Services
  • Domänenwissen: Du verstehst die fachlichen und regulatorischen Herausforderungen (z. B. Funktionstrennung) der Finanzwelt
  • Tech–Affinität & KI: Du findest IT & Technik spannend und bist motiviert, KI–Tools (z. B. claude cowork/ code oder openai frontier) einzusetzen, um die Effizienz in der technischen Dokumentation oder im Delivery–Prozess zu steigern
  • Methodik: Sicherer Umgang mit Prozessmodellierung und der Ableitung von technischen Anforderungen aus fachlichen Needs
  • Persönlichkeit: Du bist ein souveräner Kommunikator mit „Hands–on“–Mentalität, der gerne innovative Wege in der Beratung geht
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse runden Dein Profil ab

Benefits

Warum wir?

  • Eigenständiges Consulting: Beratung ist bei uns ein echtes Produkt, kein reiner Pre–Sales
  • AI–First Culture: Wir geben Dir die Werkzeuge an die Hand, um die Grenzen zwischen Consulting und technischer Umsetzung durch KI–Unterstützung aufzuweichen
  • Best–in–Class Lösungen: Du hast ein starkes Produktportfolio im Rücken, das Du als optimalen Lösungsbaustein einbringen kannst

Werde ein Teil von crossbuilders und schreibe gemeinsam mit uns unsere Erfolgsgeschichte fort! Wenn Du interessiert bist, freuen wir uns auf Deinen Lebenslauf inkl. einer kurzen Erläuterung, wieso ausgerechnet Du Teil unseres Teams werden solltest. title: Senior IT-Consultant Microsoft 365 (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Everything as a Service. Egal ob es um Microsoft 365 geht oder Security-Lösungen wie Sophos und Hornetsecurity – dostani IT bietet seinen Kunden Lösungen für effizientes und sicheres Arbeiten. Durch die Expertise unserer Kolleginnen und Kollegen können sich unsere Kunden auf ihr Kerngeschäft konzentrieren. Hast du Lust, mit uns gemeinsam richtig gute IT Services zu liefern?

Für unser weiteres Wachstum suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als

Senior IT-Consultant Microsoft 365 (m/w/d)

am Standort Dortmund

in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit

Deine Rolle:

In deiner Rolle berätst du unsere Kunden strategisch und operativ rund um Microsoft 365 und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihnen passende Lösungen – von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung, etwa bei Rollouts, Migrationen oder Cloud-Projekten. Zusätzlich übernimmst du die Service-Management-Verantwortung für deine Kunden: Du sorgst für die stabile, SLA-konforme Erbringung der laufenden Services und treibst deren kontinuierliche Verbesserung voran.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Fachliche und strategische Beratung unserer Kunden rund um Microsoft 365 sowie Konzeption und Umsetzung passender Lösungsansätze für Kundenprojekte, inkl. Anforderungsanalyse und Entscheidungsvorlagen

  • Leitung und Umsetzung von Microsoft-365-Projekten wie Rollouts, Migrationen und Cloud-Projekten

  • Verantwortung für die vereinbarungsgemäße Erbringung der IT-Services (SLA/OLA), inkl. Monitoring, Reporting und Eskalationsmanagement

  • Durchführung regelmäßiger Service-Reviews und Steering-Termine, Ableitung und Nachverfolgung von Verbesserungsmaßnahmen

  • Koordination des internen Teams sowie externer Dienstleister

  • Pflege und Weiterentwicklung des Service-Katalogs sowie Mitwirkung an Vertrags- und Leistungsscheingestaltung

  • Fachliche Anleitung von und Wissenstransfer an Kolleginnen und Kollegen

Deine Qualifikationen

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung (Fachinformatik) oder Studium in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik

  • Fundiertes technisches Verständnis in Microsoft 365, Azure, Netzwerken und Security

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Beratung und Umsetzung von Microsoft-365-Lösungen, z. B. bei Rollouts, Migrationen oder Cloud-Projekten

  • Erfahrung in der Projektleitung bzw. -koordination von IT-Projekten

  • Kenntnisse im IT-Service-Management bzw. mit ITIL-Prozessen von Vorteil, z. B. im MSP- oder IT-Dienstleistungsumfeld; eine Zertifizierung ist ein Plus

  • verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch

Deine Benefits

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung – kurze Wege, echte Mitgestaltung

  • Verantwortung und Gestaltungsfreiheit von Tag 1 für Strukturen, Prozesse und neue Serviceangebote

  • Individuelle Weiterentwicklung: z.B. ITIL, Microsoft-Zertifizierungen, Trainings

  • Attraktive Vergütung mit erfolgsabhängiger Komponente

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten

  • Langfristige Perspektive in einem wachsenden MSP mit modernem Toolstack

Kein langes Anschreiben nötig – schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und 2–3 Sätze, warum du und dostani IT zusammenpassen.

Wir melden uns schnell zurück. Versprochen.

title: Senior IT Consultant Power Platform (m/w/d) - bundesweit
descriptionHtml:
Gestalte mit uns, wie Technologie Unternehmen verändert – und deine Karriere gleich mit.  

HSO gehört seit über 21 Jahren zum Microsoft Inner Circle – der exklusiven Top 1 % aller Partner weltweit – und wurde 26-mal als Microsoft Partner of the Year ausgezeichnet. Mit über 30 Jahren Erfahrung, 2.800 Mitarbeitenden aus 43 Nationen und 33 Standorten weltweit verbinden wir technologische Exzellenz mit tiefem Branchenverständnis.   

Wir gestalten die digitale Zukunft des internationalen Mittelstands und von Großunternehmen. Als treibende Kraft für digitale Transformation implementieren wir komplexe, globale Microsoft Dynamics 365 Multiworkload-Architekturen (Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, CE). Dabei gehen wir neue Wege: Wir verknüpfen klassische Projektmethodik mit den modernsten KI- und AI-Werkzeugen, um Projekte schneller, transparenter und effizienter zum Erfolg zu führen.

  • Architektur & Entwicklung
    In deiner täglichen Arbeit entwickelst du professionelle, unternehmenskritische Anwendungen auf Basis der Power Platform. Du setzt anspruchsvolle Model-Driven Apps um, modellierst hochwertige Dataverse-Strukturen, implementierst Geschäftslogiken und automatisierst Prozesse mit Power Automate. Dabei nutzt du Technologien wie Power Pages, AI Builder, Copilot Studio und Solution Layers, um robuste und gleichzeitig flexible Lösungen zu gestalten, die echten Mehrwert liefern.
  • Integration & Schnittstellenentwicklung – dein Schwerpunkt
    Ein wesentlicher Teil deiner Rolle besteht darin, Power-Platform-Lösungen tief in bestehende Systemlandschaften einzubinden. Du entwickelst Integrationen zwischen der Power Platform und Dynamics 365 (CRM/ERP) sowie anderen Backend-Systemen, arbeitest mit REST-APIs, OData, virtuellen Entities, Custom Connectors und Azure Web APIs und sorgst dafür, dass Daten sicher, performant und zuverlässig fließen. Du konzipierst Integrationsarchitekturen, entwirfst Datenflüsse und stellst sicher, dass Power Platform und Dynamics nahtlos zusammenarbeiten.
  • Governance, Landing Zones & ALM
    Du hilfst Kunden dabei, eine stabile und zukunftsfähige Power-Platform-Umgebung aufzubauen. Dazu gehört das Ausarbeiten von Governance-Konzepten, die Planung und Umsetzung von Landing Zones, die Strukturierung von Environments sowie die Definition von Sicherheits- und Compliance-Standards. Gleichzeitig treibst du strukturiertes Application Lifecycle Management voran, baust durchdachte Solution-Strukturen auf und nutzt DevOps-Pipelines, um Entwicklungs- und Deploymentprozesse zu professionalisieren.
  • Geschäftsprozessanalyse & Lösungsdesign
    Du analysierst Kundenprozesse, identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und entwickelst daraus skalierbare technische Designs. Im engen Austausch mit Stakeholdern übersetzt du fachliche Anforderungen in saubere Datenmodelle, Logiken, Automatisierungen und Integrationsarchitekturen. Dabei kombinierst du Low-Code- und Pro-Code-Ansätze so, dass Lösungen nachhaltig wartbar und technisch fundiert sind.
  • Datenmanagement, virtuelle Entities & Dataflows
    Du arbeitest mit relationalen Datenbanken, entwirfst Datenmodelle und entwickelst Datenarchitekturen, die optimal zu den Geschäftsanforderungen passen. Du bindest externe Systeme über virtuelle Entities an, nutzt Dataflows und Power Query für ETL-Prozesse und sorgst für konsistente und saubere Datenstrukturen innerhalb von Dataverse. Die Kombination aus Datenmodellierung, technischer Integration und Plattformwissen ermöglicht dir, komplexe Datenlandschaften ganzheitlich zu gestalten.
  • Workshops & Enablement
    Du führst Workshops durch, schulst Fachbereiche und ermöglichst Kundenteams, die Power Platform kompetent und sicher einzusetzen. Dabei vermittelst du Best Practices, erklärst Lösungsansätze verständlich und baust eine langfristige Kompetenz bei den Nutzern auf.

Qualifikationen

  • Power-Platform-Erfahrung (≥ 2 Jahre)
    Du entwickelst professionelle Model-Driven Apps, modellierst Dataverse-Strukturen, setzt Geschäftslogiken mit Power Automate um, arbeitest mit Power Pages und nutzt Custom Connectors, AI Builder und erste Funktionen aus Copilot Studio. ALM und Solution-Management sind dir vertraut.
  • Integrationserfahrung (Dynamics 365 & APIs)
    Du hast Power-Platform-Lösungen idealerweise an Dynamics 365 oder andere Enterprise-Systeme angebunden, arbeitest sicher mit REST-/OData-APIs, virtuellen Entities und Dataflows und entwickelst stabile Integrationen. Erfahrung mit Azure Web APIs, Functions oder Logic Apps ist ein Plus.
  • Starke Datenbank- & Datenmodellierungskenntnisse
    Du beherrschst SQL Server oder vergleichbare Systeme, entwirfst saubere ER-Modelle, arbeitest mit Normalformen und erstellst komplexe SQL-Abfragen. Datenstrukturen kannst du logisch planen, dokumentieren und konsistent in Dataverse übertragen.
  • Analytische & konzeptionelle Stärke
    Fähigkeit, Geschäftsprozesse zu verstehen, optimale Low-Code-/Pro-Code-Architekturen abzuleiten und technische Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar zu treffen.
  • Kommunikationsstärke & Leidenschaft für moderne Microsoft-Technologien
    Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie die Motivation, dich in Themen wie Dynamics 365, Power Platform, AI & Copilot weiterzuentwickeln.

Vorteile & über HSO

  • Result Orientation: Du arbeitest bei einem der global größten und erfolgreichsten Microsoft-Partner im Bereich Microsoft Dynamics 365 und treibst damit die digitale Transformation voran
  • Self Determination: Bei uns steht die Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe im Mittelpunkt - mit deinen Ideen und Erfahrungen kannst du dich bei uns einbringen, eigenständig agieren und damit den Unternehmenserfolg aktiv mitgestalten
  • Team Spirit: Da Menschen bei HSO den Unterschied machen, kannst du dich auf eine unterstützende, vertrauensvolle und wertschätzende Arbeitsatmosphäre freuen
  • Learning & Growth: Wir werden dich mit Trainingsangeboten durch unsere hauseigene HSO Academy und externe Schulungspartner in Kombination mit einem individuellen Karrierepfad fördern
  • Onboarding@HSO: Wir heißen dich in unserem Office in Böblingen willkommen - du startest deine ersten Onboarding-Tage bei uns vor Ort, um dich mit unserer Unternehmenskultur, unseren Prozessen und Tools vertraut zu machen
  • Hybrid Workforce:  Ohne festgeschriebene Kernarbeitszeit hast du die Möglichkeit flexibel bei Kunden vor Ort, aus deinem Homeoffice oder in unseren Offices in Böblingen, München, Nürnberg oder Chemnitz zu arbeiten
  • Appreciation: Ein attraktives Gehaltsmodell inklusive 20 % Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Mitarbeiterangebote, Bikeleasing, Gesundheitsförderung durch EGYM Wellpass, Geburtstagsgutscheine und außergewöhnliche Events runden dein HSO-Feel-Good-Paket ab
  • Workation:  Wir möchten unseren Mitarbeitenden mehr Flexibilität und Freiräume bieten, damit sie ihre Work-Life-Balance aktiv gestalten können. Daher hast du die Möglichkeit, bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr unter Einhaltung der rechtlichen Bedingungen aus der EU, dem EWR und der Schweiz zu arbeiten.



HSO setzt sich aktiv für Vielfalt und Inklusion ein. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen von allen qualifizierten Personen – unabhängig von ethnischer Herkunft, Hautfarbe, Religion, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität, nationaler Herkunft, Behinderung oder Alter. Unser Ziel ist ein diskriminierungsfreies Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Chancengleichheit gefördert und die Unterschiedlichkeit jedes Einzelnen respektiert und wertgeschätzt wird.

title: Senior IT Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.

About the role

At Typeform, we believe technology should make work simpler, smarter and more human.

We're looking for a Senior IT Engineer to help shape the future of IT at Typeform. Someone who combines strong technical expertise with a passion for automation, AI and building better ways of working.

This isn't just about keeping systems running. It's about rethinking how IT operates.

You'll play a key role in building an AI first, service led IT function, improving how we manage internal technology, support our people and automate everyday processes.

Working within a small, high impact team, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful projects, influence our technology roadmap and help us move from reactive support towards smarter, more proactive IT operations.

What you'll do

Own and improve our IT operations

  • Act as a senior escalation point for complex IT incidents, requests and technical challenges, taking ownership through to resolution.
  • Help maintain secure, reliable and scalable internal technology systems.
  • Apply ITIL best practices across incident, change, problem and service management.
  • Improve service performance, documentation, operational processes and the overall employee experience.
  • Work closely with the wider IT team to balance daily support with longer term engineering projects.

Build smarter systems through AI and automation

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve workflows across IT.
  • Design and implement AI powered solutions that improve service delivery, productivity and operational efficiency.
  • Improve employee onboarding, offboarding, access management and software lifecycle processes.
  • Use APIs, integrations, scripting and automation tools to connect systems and remove unnecessary manual work.
  • Explore emerging AI technologies and turn promising ideas into practical solutions, with appropriate security and governance.

Think like a product owner

  • Take ownership of specific IT services and capabilities, from identifying problems through to delivering improvements.
  • Work with stakeholders to understand their needs and prioritise improvements based on business impact.
  • Build and maintain clear roadmaps and project backlogs.
  • Measure the success of improvements through service quality, efficiency, reliability and employee experience.
  • Lead technical changes, migrations and improvements with clear communication, risk management and planning.

Collaborate across Typeform

  • Partner with Security, People, Finance, Procurement and Engineering to deliver secure and effective technology solutions.
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical colleagues.
  • Share knowledge, improve documentation and support the development of other IT team members.
  • Help create a culture of ownership, continuous improvement and experimentation.

What you'll bring

  • Strong experience in corporate IT engineering, systems engineering or IT service management within a modern SaaS or technology company.
  • ITIL certification and practical experience applying ITIL principles across incident, change, problem and service management.
  • Proven experience troubleshooting complex issues across corporate IT systems, identity, access, devices, applications and integrations.
  • Strong hands on experience with modern IT environments, particularly Apple devices, Okta, Google Workspace, Slack and Atlassian.
  • Experience building automation using APIs, scripting, integrations or workflow automation tools.
  • Practical experience using AI to improve IT operations, support processes or internal productivity.
  • Experience improving employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, provisioning and access management.
  • Strong problem solving skills and the ability to take ownership of technical challenges from investigation through to resolution.
  • A product mindset, with experience prioritising improvements, managing stakeholders and delivering measurable outcomes.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience designing AI driven IT workflows or introducing AI into internal service operations.
  • Familiarity with AI agents, intelligent workflow orchestration and knowledge management systems.
  • Experience integrating HR, identity, finance, asset management and IT service platforms.
  • Experience building internal tooling, dashboards or operational reporting.
  • Exposure to security, compliance, endpoint management and IT governance.
  • Experience leading technology migrations or large internal systems improvement projects.

*Typeform drives hundreds of millions of interactions each year, enabling conversational, human-centered experiences across the globe. We move as one team, empowering our collective efforts by valuing each individual’s unique perspective. This fosters strong bonds grounded in respect, transparency, and trust. We champion our diverse customer base by anticipating their needs and addressing their challenges with priority. Committed to excellence, we hold high expectations for ourselves and each other, continuously striving to deliver exceptional results.

We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and stand firmly against discrimination and harassment of any kind—whether based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. Everyone is welcome here.

title: Senior IT Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

About the role

You’ll run Morpho’s corporate IT: accounts and access, laptops, and the SaaS tools the company runs on, all set up securely. You’ll work closely with the security team: they set policy and lead on incidents, and you put that policy in place across our tools and devices. The scope is broad and the work is hands-on. We’d rather automate repetitive work than hire for it, so expect to write scripts and build your own tooling, using AI where it helps. We’ll go through our stack with you early in the process.

Responsibilities

  • Administer SSO, the directory and the password manager. Handle onboarding and offboarding, and run regular access reviews.

  • Manage the Mac fleet: setup, MDM policies, OS and app updates, and keeping the endpoint security agent installed and working.

  • Apply the security baselines and access policies the security team defines, and keep our tools configured to match.

  • Administer our SaaS tools: setup, admin access and licences. Handle the IT side of bringing on new vendors.

  • Support the security team during incidents by isolating devices, revoking access and pulling logs.

  • Provide evidence for IT controls during audits.

  • Automate repetitive work such as onboarding, offboarding, access reviews and evidence collection.

  • Write and maintain documentation for IT procedures.

  • Take part in IT on-call.

Definition of success

  • 1 month: handles onboarding, offboarding and day-to-day account and device work without help, and knows how our tools are set up.

  • End of probation: owns our identity, device and SaaS setup, has automated at least one process that used to be manual, and is the person the security team goes to for IT changes and incident support.

  • 12 months: runs corporate IT independently. Onboarding, offboarding, access reviews and audit evidence mostly run on tooling they built.

Experience

  • 5+ years in IT, systems engineering or IT security.

  • Hands-on admin experience with an enterprise identity provider, an MDM and endpoint security tools.

  • Strong macOS management: configuration profiles, privacy preference and system extension policies.

  • Writes Python or Bash to automate work. Infrastructure as code is a plus.

  • Has supported a SOC 2, ISO 27001 or similar audit.

  • Knows crypto companies are frequent targets of phishing and social engineering, and sets up systems with that in mind. Web3 or fintech experience is a plus.

  • Writes clear documentation.

  • Prefers simple setups people follow over perfect ones they work around.

  • Comfortable being part of an on-call rotation.

Perks & Benefits

We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning.

 

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment.

title: Senior Key Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Qui sommes-nous ?

N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers, qui développe deux solutions : N2F et Vertical Expense. Tu seras amené(e) à travailler plus particulièrement sur Vertical Expense, notre solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais qui accompagne les entreprises et les organisations publiques dans leur transformation digitale.

Notre mission : simplifier, automatiser et sécuriser la gestion des frais professionnels, tout en nous adaptant aux besoins et aux contextes parfois complexes de nos clients. Notre solution est très personnalisable, hautement interopérable, et déployée auprès de structures exigeantes, souvent multi-populations (collaborateurs nomades, agents, intérimaires, prestataires externes…).

Pour accompagner notre croissance, nous renforçons l'équipe Sales de Vertical Expense. Tu y prendras en charge le développement de grands comptes publics et privés, sur des ventes complexes à forts enjeux.

Tu auras pour mission de :

  • Piloter le cycle de vente de bout en bout : qualification des opportunités, proposition de valeur différenciante, accès aux décideurs, négociation et closing.

  • Développer de nouvelles opportunités par une prospection ciblée, en complément des leads apportés par le Marketing et par nos équipes Alliances & Channel.

  • Analyser les besoins de tes prospects et présenter la solution, avec l'appui de l'avant-vente sur les projets complexes.

  • Rédiger les réponses aux appels d'offres publics et privés (dont le mémoire technique), en t'appuyant sur les équipes internes.

  • Assurer une passation fluide vers les équipes projets et CSM, et suivre les projets en appui après la signature.

  • Participer aux réflexions stratégiques : veille concurrentielle, tendances du marché, différenciateurs produit.


Ce qu'on va attendre de toi :

  • Tu as une expérience significative et récente en vente complexe SaaS B2B auprès de grands comptes.

  • Tu as déjà mené des cycles de vente longs, dans des organisations multi-décideurs, en travaillant avec des partenaires et des influenceurs.

  • Tu as un vrai goût pour la chasse : aller chercher de nouveaux clients te motive.

  • Tu es à l'aise face à des interlocuteurs C-level et tu sais adapter ton discours à chacun (idéalement DAF, DRH, Travel Manager, DSI…).

  • Tu sais répondre à un appel d'offres avec rigueur, de la réponse au mémoire technique.

  • Tu comprends les solutions SaaS, web et mobiles.

  • Tu es autonome, organisé(e) et tenace, et tu sais rebondir face à un deal perdu.

  • Tu aimes travailler en équipe avec le Marketing, l’équipe Alliance/Channel, les équipes projets et le Produit.

  • Tu es à l'aise avec des déplacements réguliers chez les clients (environ une fois par semaine).

C'est un plus si :

  • Tu connais l'univers des notes de frais ou du voyage d'affaires.

  • Tu parles anglais.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Un poste stratégique, au cœur de notre développement sur les grands comptes publics et privés.

  • Pas que de la prospection à froid : une partie des leads vient du Marketing et de nos partenaires.

  • Une vision complète du cycle de vente, jusqu'au suivi du projet client.

  • Une équipe stable, fière de ses grands comptes, avec le sens du service et de l'excellence.

  • Une ambiance où l'on ne se prend pas au sérieux : team building réguliers…

Processus de recrutement :

  • Entretien téléphonique RH.

  • Entretien avec le manager.

  • Mise en situation : étude de cas sur un compte client fictif.

  • Entretien final avec la Direction.

Localisation : Montagnat (01), avec 2 jours par semaine sur site et des déplacements ponctuels à Aix-en-Provence.

Rémunération : fixe : 60K € - 80K€ + variable

title: Senior Key Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
Über BringLiesel

BringLiesel ist die Plattform für individuelle Bewohnerversorgung in der stationären Pflege. Über 1.200 Produkte des täglichen Bedarfs werden online bestellt, einzeln je Bewohner:in verpackt und revisionssicher abgerechnet. Unsere Prozesse sind dabei tief in den Alltag der Pflege und Betreuung integriert. Über 2.300 Einrichtungen und mehr als 80.000 Pflegebedürftige vertrauen uns bereits. Unser Anspruch: Selbstbestimmung für Bewohner:innen. Entlastung für Pflege und Verwaltung. Effizienz für den Träger.

Deine Rolle

Wir befinden uns in einer Wachstumsphase – und diese Rolle steht in ihrem Zentrum: Wir richten unseren Vertrieb strategisch auf die Träger-Ebene aus und stellen unser Geschäftsmodell auf ein SaaS-Lizenzmodell um. Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die mittleren bis großen Träger: von der Neuakquise über die Vertragsverhandlung bis zum Ausbau und der SaaS-Transformation im Bestand. Du brauchst dafür beides – strategischen Weitblick für die Accountplanung und eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität in der Umsetzung. Die größten Träger betreust du dabei gemeinsam mit dem Chief Commercial Officer.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Neuakquise auf Trägerebene: Du gewinnst neue mittlere bis große Träger und führst Gespräche und Verhandlungen auf Entscheider- und Geschäftsführungsebene.
  • Ausbau & SaaS-Transformation im Bestand: Du überführst bestehende Träger auf das neue Lizenzmodell und baust die Zusammenarbeit strategisch aus.
  • Vertrags- & Preisverhandlung: Du argumentierst das Preismodell überzeugend und führst Verhandlungen eigenverantwortlich bis zum Abschluss.
  • Strategische Accountplanung: Du entwickelst je Träger eine klare Wachstums- und Migrationsstrategie und priorisierst deine Pipeline eigenständig.
  • Operative Umsetzung: Du treibst Rollouts aktiv voran und packst hands-on mit an – von der ersten Ansprache bis zum unterschriebenen Vertrag.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit: Gestaltende Abstimmung mit Account Management, Customer Success, Vertriebsassistenz und Marketing entlang der gesamten Customer Journey.

Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Key Account Management – idealerweise im Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger Lösungen (SaaS oder Dienstleistung).
  • Branchenkenntnis in der Pflege bzw. im Gesundheitswesen ist ein deutliches Plus.
  • Ausgeprägte Verhandlungs- und Abschlussstärke auf Entscheider- und Geschäftsführungsebene.
  • Du denkst und handelst strategisch UND operativ – mit klarer Hands-on-Mentalität.
  • Erfahrung im Auf- und Ausbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen mit mittleren bis großen Organisationen.
  • Kommunikationsstark und empathisch – gerade im sensiblen Pflegeumfeld wichtig.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie bundesweite Reisebereitschaft.

Was wir bieten

  • Eine Schlüsselrolle in der SaaS-Transformation von BringLiesel – du gestaltest den Vertrieb auf Trägerebene maßgeblich mit.
  • Große Eigenverantwortung: Du steuerst deine Träger strategisch und operativ selbst.
  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum in einer Wachstumsphase: BringLiesel wächst, und diese Rolle wächst mit.
  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit: Du trägst direkt dazu bei, dass Pflegebedürftige selbstbestimmt einkaufen können.
  • Remote, deutschlandweit – flexibel organisiert, mit regelmäßigem Austausch im Team und bei Bedarf vor Ort.

The Difference You Will Make:

As a Senior Key Accounts Manager, you will be managing partner relationships with strategic Enterprises & API Connectivity partners. You will be responsible for recruitment, enablement and optimization of our strategic partnerships and become their trusted advisor with the aim to become their number one partner and accelerate growth and performance on both sides. You will be reporting to the Key Accounts Team Lead, EMEA.

This role is based in Paris (hybrid, 2-3 days a week in the office), and is not eligible for relocation support.

A typical day: 

  • Own a portfolio of Airbnb’s key partners and act as the key representative for these partners. 
  • Execute a global win-win strategy for your portfolio that drives value to all parties and positions Airbnb as a top strategic partner across all distribution channels. 
  • Develop strong and trusting relationships with executives and decision makers/key influencers within your API & Enterprise customers portfolio, ensure that the partnership is held to the highest industry standards and that commercial agreements as well as SLAs are met.
  • Analyze data and utilize data-driven recommendations to identify and action on strategic growth opportunities 
  • Work with quarterly goals, measure success against performance KPIs, feature adoption and supply acquisition growth.
  • Support partners through deep understanding of API and technical integrations 
  • Educate clients on our product roadmap and all significant product changes to accelerate feature adoption with the aim to excel our mutual guest experience 
  • Represent Airbnb in external meetings and industry events 

Your expertise: 

  • 8+ years of professional experience in Strategic Partnership, Key Account Management and/or Connectivity role at a global technology or tech hospitality company
  • Fluent verbal/written communication and presentation skills in both English and French
  • Exceptional stakeholder management across both internal and external audiences
  • Experience with API integrations a plus
  • World class account management experience with strong track record of successfully growing a book of business/geographic area and building enduring and successful client relationships
  • Experience in the hospitality technology space, knowledge of OTA specifications
  • Experience in analyzing, structuring and negotiating complex deals that align across multiple business unit needs
  • Extremely data driven in the decision-making process to ensure timely, impactful and accurate actions are taken.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with product, tech, legal, marketing, sales operations and enablement teams.
  • Ability to manage complex projects and multi-task with excellent organizational skills, in a fast-paced, dynamic and ever changing startup environment.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to effectively influence top leaders internally and within the industry. 
  • Passion for Airbnb, travel, and the sharing economy
  • Previous experience as product manager, working with product teams is a plus
  • Ability to travel at least 25% of the time 

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

France Annual Pay Range€74.000—€92.000 EUR

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Senior Key Corporate Sales Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. 

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

The Senior Key Corporate Sales Manager is responsible for developing and executing Lucid Motors’ European B2B sales strategy, driving sustainable growth across key accounts, enterprise customers, leasing companies, rental operators, and fleet and mobility partners.

This role identifies new business opportunities, develops strategic partnerships, negotiates commercial agreements, and delivers sales, revenue, and profitability targets. The role also leads and develops a team of Corporate Sales Managers and supports Lucid’s importer markets to ensure consistent execution across Europe.

Key Responsibilities

Corporate Business Development

  • Identify, develop, and secure new business opportunities with enterprise customers, corporate fleets, leasing companies, rental operators, and mobility providers.
  • Position Lucid as a preferred premium electric vehicle partner and develop strategic account plans that support sustainable growth.

Sales Strategy & Commercial Performance

  • Develop and execute the European corporate sales strategy in line with Lucid’s growth objectives.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to develop competitive vehicle, financing, and service propositions.
  • Deliver sales, revenue, profitability, and market share targets.

Strategic Account & Partnership Management

  • Build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers at major corporate accounts and strategic partners.
  • Understand customer fleet and mobility requirements and provide tailored commercial solutions.
  • Manage relationships with leasing, rental, fleet, mobility, and importer partners across Europe.

Commercial Negotiations

  • Lead complex negotiations and contract discussions with strategic customers and partners.
  • Structure commercial agreements that create long-term value for Lucid and its customers.

Market Intelligence & Reporting

  • Monitor industry trends, competitor activity, fleet market developments, and emerging mobility solutions.
  • Provide regular performance reporting, customer insights, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

Leadership & Customer Experience

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Corporate Sales Managers.
  • Promote accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and commercial excellence.
  • Ensure a consistent premium customer and partner experience throughout the sales lifecycle.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in automotive B2B sales, fleet sales, corporate sales, key account management, or mobility solutions.
  • Proven experience developing business and managing strategic accounts across multiple European markets.
  • Strong knowledge of fleet sales, leasing, financing, electric vehicles, total cost of ownership, and mobility trends.
  • Demonstrated success in delivering revenue growth, profitability, market share, and customer retention.
  • Proven experience leading and developing high-performing sales teams.
  • Experience negotiating complex commercial agreements and strategic partnerships.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, supported by a data-driven approach.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience with CRM and sales performance systems; Salesforce experience is preferred.
  • Results-oriented and entrepreneurial, with a strong interest in innovation and electric mobility.
  • Fluent in English; additional European languages are advantageous.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
 

Lucid Motors is committed to maintaining a safe and trustworthy environment. As such, a background check may be required during the hiring process. This will be performed in line with European data protection laws, and candidates will be informed and asked to provide consent before the check is conducted.

Compensation & Benefits: Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off.  Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

Lucid Motors is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing an inclusive workplace for all. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state or federal laws and regulations.

To be considered for employment, all applications must be submitted through the Lucid Motors Careers website.

Candidate Data Privacy: By submitting your application, you understand and agree that your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice.

title: Senior Konzepter Social Media (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Jobteaser

Social Media ist für dich kein Kanal, auf den man eine Kampagne am Ende noch irgendwie draufadaptiert. Sondern ein Ort, an dem Marken Teil von Kultur werden können.

Du weißt, was Menschen zum Stoppen, Teilen, Kommentieren oder Weiterschicken bringt. Du erkennst einen guten Insight oder einen Trend, bevor daraus eine Idee wird – und eine gute Idee, bevor daraus Content wird. Und du kannst beides: konzipieren und schreiben.

Wir suchen einen Senior Konzepter Social Media, der oder die Social Media versteht, Ideen entwickelt und Marken wie Oberbräu und der AOK Baden-Württemberg eine Stimme gibt, die man nach zwei Sekunden nicht wieder vergessen hat.

  • Du entwickelst Social-first-Ideen und kreative Konzepte für Marken, Kampagnen und Always-on-Kommunikation

  • Ein gutes Verständnis dafür, was eine starke Markenidee von einem kurzfristigen Trend unterscheidet

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Eine unabhängige, inhabergeführte Kreativagentur mit schnellen Entscheidungswegen

Vielfalt bringt neue Ideen und Impulse! Wir freuen uns schon auf deine Bewerbung - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion/Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.

title: Senior Launch / Onboarding Manager (f/m/x)
descriptionHtml:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

Your Mission

As our Launch Manager, you’ll own the end-to-end delivery of our partner onboarding, from kick-off through go-live and post-launch activities, turning complex, regulated brokerage integrations into predictable, high-quality launches.

Our partner universe is evolving: alongside our direct business with fintechs and neobanks, we’re building a combined offering with dwpbank, bringing a new wave of partners and increased cross-organization complexity. We’re therefore building a dedicated Launch Manager function to run these onboardings with clear ownership.

In this setup, you’ll provide the coordination we’re building, driving the launch plan, steering stakeholders, and ensuring a clean handover to Partner Management once the partner is live. You’ll sit at the center of cross-functional execution, aligning Partnerships, Product, Engineering, Operations, and second-line functions (and, where relevant, dwpbank) to keep delivery on time, within scope, and operationally sound.

In this role you will:

  • Lead end-to-end partner launches by owning the onboarding plan, milestones, and delivery rhythm across Partnerships, Product, Engineering, Operations, and second-line functions — so partners go live faster and with fewer surprises.

  • Drive alignment and decision-making between partnership leads, product counterparts, and executive sponsors — so scope, priorities, and trade-offs are clear and execution stays on track.

  • Run cross-functional workstreams (e.g., API integration readiness, ops/process setup, compliance & controls, partner enablement) to reduce delivery risk and ensure high-quality outcomes in a regulated environment.

  • Design and continuously improve an onboarding playbook (templates, checklists, risk log, status reporting, launch criteria) to standardize onboarding and scale partner delivery without scaling chaos.

  • Own stakeholder communication and reporting to leadership, internal steering committees, and partner counterparts — so progress, risks, and dependencies are transparent and manageable.

  • Manage complex/time-sensitive post-launch activities (feature expansions, new functionalities, operational changes) so existing partners can grow their offering without destabilizing day-to-day operations.

You’ll be successful in this role if:

  • You bring 5+ years of experience in launch management or project/program management within brokerage, fintech, or banking environments.

  • You have a deep understanding of B2B onboarding, including how to structure plans, manage dependencies, and steer stakeholders through complex delivery.

  • You bring strong financial services domain expertise (brokerage knowledge is a plus) and can translate regulatory/operational constraints into actionable delivery plans.

  • You have led complex cross-functional teams across business, product, engineering, and second-line functions, driving outcomes without formal authority.

  • You are comfortable mixing methods (waterfall, agile, hybrid) and pragmatically using tools like onboarding plans, risk logs, and reporting to get the job done.

  • You thrive in ambiguity and complexity, take ownership end-to-end, and can zoom out for the plan while still digging into the messy details needed to execute.

  • Communicate exceptionally well in English and German (C1+) building trust quickly, leading tough conversations calmly, and keeping momentum across senior internal and external stakeholders.

How we take care of you:

  • 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets.

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

  • 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributer lemoneers work 4 day or more per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners.

  • 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations as well as an annual learning budget.

  • 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day, Friday food market strolls at Maybachufer, and our monthly new-joiner breakfast. But also in the bigger things: celebrating the onboarding of new partners, growing our teams, and owning a strong discussion culture.

  • 💛 Perks & benefits: Wechoose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing.

  • 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total.

As an equal opportunity employer, lemon.markets is committed to building an inclusive workplace. The company welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply.

If you feel this role could be a great match for you even if you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you, please apply.

title: Senior/Lead Lifecycle Marketing Manager (Full Remote - France)
descriptionHtml:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

More than 50 million people already use EverAI’s products, and we’re growing toward 100 million.

The audience is already here. The opportunity is what happens next.

We’re hiring a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager to take CRM to an entirely new level. Your mission is clear: turn it into a major revenue channel by converting more users, increasing repeat purchases, and giving people compelling reasons to keep coming back.

You’ll own everything within CRM, from onboarding and first purchase to retention and reactivation, across email, push notifications, in-product messaging, and promotions.

You’ll report directly to Thomas Lacroix, our Co-founder and CMO, with the freedom to rethink journeys, test ambitious ideas, and build the CRM playbook that gets us there.

At our scale, even small improvements can influence millions of user journeys and create significant growth.

If you’re looking for more than a campaign-management role, this is your opportunity to drive measurable growth at exceptional scale.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own one of EverAI’s biggest growth opportunities: lead the strategy and execution across the full CRM lifecycle, from onboarding and conversion through repeat purchasing, retention, and reactivation

  • Find the growth hiding in our user base: use behavioral data to uncover where users lose interest, stop engaging, or miss an opportunity to purchase

  • Crack the first-purchase challenge: create onboarding, abandoned-payment, offer, and follow-up journeys that turn more registered users into paying customers

  • Keep users coming back: increase token purchases, repeat purchasing, retention, reactivation, and LTV through smarter segmentation, personalization, and timing

  • Test big ideas quickly: build experiments, measure what genuinely moved the numbers, scale the winners, and turn each result into the next opportunity

  • Make ambitious CRM ideas possible: work directly with Product, Data, Engineering, and Creative to improve the tooling, tracking, messages, offers, and reporting behind the channel

Your Qualifications

  • You’ve scaled CRM before: you can show significant improvements you personally drove in revenue, conversion, repeat purchases, retention, reactivation, or LTV, with real numbers

  • You understand consumer growth: you’ve worked in a high-volume B2C subscription business, where CRM had a direct effect on revenue

  • You think like a builder: you do not stop at recommendations; you can personally create segments, journeys, experiments, campaign logic, and performance analysis

  • You know how to find and prove what works: you can turn user behavior into ideas and use testing, control groups, attribution, and incrementality to validate the results

  • You move quickly and take ownership: you are comfortable building without a finished playbook, deciding what matters most, and creating momentum without waiting for perfect information

  • You communicate clearly and work across teams: you collaborate directly with technical, creative, and commercial stakeholders in English

  • You are comfortable with our product category: you can confidently work on products powered by uncensored AI models and content

Bonus points

  • You have worked in iGaming, free-to-play gaming, fintech, consumer subscriptions, or high-frequency e-commerce

  • You have experience with token, credit, virtual-currency, bonus, or repeat-deposit models

  • You have built or redesigned CRM in a fast-scaling company

  • You use AI to improve analysis, personalization, experimentation, or content development

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

Compensation: €85K – €105K • Offers Bonus

  • • Annual Compensation Range (Gross) €85K – €105K • Offers Bonus
