title: Senior Manager, Corporate Strategy & Development (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
The role

As a Senior Manager, Corporate Strategy & Development, you will work in a small, AI enabled team of highly driven and committed individuals, reporting to the Director Corporate Strategy & Development. This is a high-exposure role, acting as the strategic and analytical engine for our most important decisions in a team that reports directly to the Group CEO.

You will work across the team's full agenda: Group and business unit strategy, portfolio and capital allocation decisions, and M&A. You are hands-on: you build the financial models, analysis and executive-level outputs yourself. You work under the guidance of the team leadership, owning the quality of analysis and models within your workstreams as well as the respective internal stakeholder relationships.

What you’ll do

  • Corporate Strategy: Support the development of the Group's mid-term strategy by driving the process, own the underlying analysis, strategic synthesis, and preparation of strategic documents.
  • Business Unit Strategy: Act as an internal consultant, supporting our key business units across geographies on a project-by-project basis to develop their mid-term strategies and solve their most complex challenges.
  • M&A Strategy: Drive workstreams for M&A projects, building and owning financial models, analyzing targets, preparing negotiations and supporting the M&A processes the team owns.
  • Portfolio Optimization: Contribute to the strategic analysis for key portfolio decisions, including potential geo-expansions, new vertical or brand launches or divestments.
  • Capital Allocation: Develop and improve the analytical frameworks and models to support our strategic budget allocation and ROI analysis.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience: 4+ years of high-performance experience from a top-tier Management Consulting firm, Investment Banking, or a comparable in-house Strategy / Corporate Development team.
  • Toolkit: Exceptional qualitative and analytical problem-solving skills. You are hypothesis-driven and can own and structure complex analytical problems from end-to-end. You are utilizing AI tools to meaningfully improve your productivity. Ability to build applications with AI coding tools is a plus.
  • Financial Acumen: Strong financial modeling skills are required: you have built and defended models used for investment or strategic decisions. Valuation experience is a plus. You are just as comfortable building analysis and models from scratch as you are managing processes and presenting recommendations to leadership.
  • DTC economics: You are comfortable working with typical DTC KPIs like CAC, AOR, AOV, CLV, retention and understand how cohort economics build a P&L over time. DTC marketing analytics experience is a plus but not required.
  • Communication: Proactive 360° communication and excellent ability to synthesize complex analysis into clear, concise storylines, presentationsand memos for an executive audience. 
  • How you work: You take ownership of outcomes and pressure-test your own conclusions before presenting them. You go deep into the analysis to get to the right answer, and know when it is good enough to decide.

What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.

  • Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh - subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
  • Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
  • Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
  • Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

Are you up for the challenge?

Please submit your complete application below including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.

After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within 5 business days.

title: Senior Manager, Creator Partnerships & Social Commerce
descriptionHtml:
Build, Scale & Operate Leading DTC Brands alongside A-Players

Maneuver Marketing

Our Vision, Mission & Success are fuelled by our commitment to be a driving force of positive change to the health of everyday consumers, providing conscious, high-quality & innovative supplement products.

In just 5 years, we kicked off our own DTC Health & Wellness brand from scratch and scaled it to USD$100M+ in annual sales, serving more than 3,000,000 customers worldwide with an average of 4,000 daily orders across 9 SKUs.

These results caught the attention of The Financial Times, as they ranked us among APACs top High-Growth Companies. We have also been awarded 2nd place on the E50 Awards, jointly organised by The Business Times and KPMG in Singapore.

This is just the beginning of our journey, and you could be part of the next stage of our growth!

Your Next Role

We are looking for a strategic, commercially minded and highly organized Senior Manager, Creator Partnerships & Social Commerce to lead and scale our creator marketing capability.

You will own the end-to-end creator strategy and drive implementation for two women’s health brands. One brand offers supplements that help with symptoms and root causes, and the other offers supplements that support one’s lifestyle habits and addresses nutritional gaps.

Leading a team of two associates who execute the seeding program, you will upgrade and refine our current strategy to build a reliable community of high-quality creator partnerships that strengthen our organic presence, generate commercially valuable content and support our paid media performance.

This is a hands-on management role. You will set the strategy and performance targets, develop the team, improve our systems and processes, and remain directly involved in high-value partnerships and campaign decisions.

The ideal candidate combines strong creator marketing instincts with operational discipline, commercial judgment and a clear understanding of how creator content can be transformed into effective paid advertising.

What You’ll Do

1. Own the Creator Strategy Across Both Brands

  • Own creator strategy for two women's health brands across two distinct motions: an established seeding program producing content at volume, and a new TikTok Shop affiliate program built for direct sales.

  • Scope is deliberately asymmetric. Seeding covers 4 flagship SKUs today, expanding to all 6 once the team's agentic workflows free the capacity. TikTok Shop launches focused on 2 products under one brand.

  • Build creator-driven demand that shows up beyond the platform it originates on: branded search volume, Amazon and Shopify sales lift, and a content library that feeds paid media.

  • Identify the right mix of healthcare professionals and content creators for each campaign.

  • Establish measurable targets across outreach volume, response rates, partnership approvals, content delivery, cost efficiency and campaign performance.

  • Monitor competitor activity, creator pricing and emerging platform trends to keep our approach relevant and competitive.

  • Build and deploy AI workflows that increase the team's throughput - creator qualification, outreach personalization at volume, content tagging and rights tracking. We expect measurable capacity gains, not experimentation.

2. Lead and Develop the Creator Marketing Team

  • The Meta seeding program is built and running at scale. Your associates own the day-to-day operations; your job is to consult with creative leads, sharpen briefs, run creative tests, and hold quality while the majority of your own attention goes to TikTok and affiliates.

  • Oversee the team’s day-to-day outreach, follow-ups, creator communication, fulfilment coordination and administrative workflows.

  • Build clear processes and operating rhythms that allow the team to manage a high volume of influencer activity accurately and efficiently.

3. Build a Scalable Creator Acquisition Pipeline

  • Source creators across three routes: direct outreach, the TikTok Shop affiliate marketplace, and the established creator network available through our TikTok consultant. Convert the consultant's network into signed, producing partnerships rather than a list.

  • Sustain the current output of hundreds of pieces of creator content per month across the seeding program, while building a separate affiliate creator pipeline for TikTok Shop.

  • Assess potential partners based on audience fit, content quality, engagement, credibility, pricing and their ability to create or follow relevant trends.

  • Develop partnerships with a strong focus on micro- and mid-sized creators, while selectively pursuing larger influencers when commercially justified.

  • Create tailored outreach strategies for a competitive market in which larger brands may offer significantly higher creator fees.

4. Build the TikTok Shop Affiliate Program

  • Own the TikTok Shop affiliate program for 2 products under one brand, from creator recruitment through commission structure, sample logistics and GMV performance.

  • Set and manage commission tiers, open collaborations, targeted invites and any performance-based arrangements; decide where flat-fee and where commission-only makes sense.

  • Own affiliate GMV as a number you're accountable for, and the unit economics behind it: cost per acquired affiliate, sample cost per producing creator, blended commission rate.

  • Identify and develop the small number of affiliates who will drive the majority of GMV, and build repeat and exclusive arrangements with them.

  • Work with the TikTok Affiliate Creative Strategist on creative direction. They own research, concept and brief content; you own creator supply, terms, relationship and program performance.

5. Own Campaign Execution and Creator Relationships

  • Oversee partnerships from initial outreach and qualification through contracting, product delivery, content production, payment and performance review.

  • Ensure creators receive clear briefs, campaign expectations, timelines and feedback.

  • Build strong, professional relationships that encourage creators to become long-term brand advocates rather than one-off partners.

  • Maintain an active and engaged creator community through regular updates, challenges, educational content and brand communications.

  • Own claims compliance in creator content across both brands. Maintain the do-say/don't-say guidance creators work from, and make sure it holds at volume across seeding, affiliate and organic.

  • Ensure FTC material-connection disclosure and platform-specific policy compliance on every partnership. TikTok Shop enforces supplement claims differently from Meta; both need to be handled correctly.

6. Turn Creator Content into Growth Assets

  • Secure usage rights and TikTok ad authorization (Spark Ad codes) at the point of partnership, not retroactively.

  • Establish a clear process for reviewing, categorizing and distributing creator-generated content.

  • Evaluate content based on brand alignment, creative quality, audience relevance and potential commercial use.

  • Work with Paid Media, Creative and Marketplace to route creator content to its highest-value use: paid social, marketplace listings, email and brand channels.

  • Translate both organic and paid media learnings back into creator briefs so creators can produce stronger, more testable content.

  • Supply the brand social channels with a steady flow of approved, on-brand creator content. Publishing and community management on brand-owned accounts sit with a separate role.

7. Own Tools, Vendors and Operational Excellence

  • Manage our external partners - the TikTok consultant and content agencies - including scope, output quality, cost and the decision on when capability should move in-house.

  • Own the influencer marketing stack end to end. We currently run SARAL; assess whether it, Modash, Lefty or an alternative best serves discovery, outreach, relationship management and reporting at our volume.

  • Partner with Supply and Operations teams to ensure product kits are shipped accurately and on time.

  • Oversee creator invoicing and payment workflows, ensuring submissions are accurate, approved and processed promptly.

  • Identify bottlenecks and introduce scalable workflows, automation and documentation where appropriate.

7. Measure and Improve Performance

  • You'll be measured on four things: TikTok Shop affiliate GMV, cost per usable content asset, branded search and marketplace lift attributable to creator activity, and content throughput against quality standard. Everything else is diagnostic.

  • You'll manage a defined creator and sampling budget across both programs, with authority to reallocate between seeding and affiliate based on returns.

  • Define and monitor the KPIs required to evaluate the health and commercial impact of the influencer program.

  • Track outreach volume, open and response rates, approval rates, creator acquisition costs, content delivery, engagement, reach, conversions and return on investment.

  • Build clear weekly, monthly and quarterly reporting for the Growth team and company leadership.

  • Analyze performance by creator profile, product, platform, partnership structure, outreach message and content format.

  • Maintain a structured testing roadmap covering outreach messages, incentives, creator segments and content approaches.

How You’ll Succeed

  • You combine strategic thinking with a willingness to remain close to execution.

  • You create clarity for your team, hold people accountable and help them improve.

  • You build a predictable pipeline of relevant creators and commercially valuable content.

  • You use data and experimentation to improve response rates, partnership quality and return on investment.

  • You can recognize creators who offer strong value beyond follower count alone.

  • You build effective partnerships across Creator Marketing, Paid Media, Creative, Supply, Email Marketing and E-commerce.

  • You introduce structure without slowing down execution.

  • You communicate clearly, act quickly and resolve problems before they affect campaigns.

  • You remain resourceful in a competitive market where budgets and creator expectations may not always align.

  • You care equally about relationship quality, operational accuracy and commercial outcomes.

What You Bring

Required

  • 5+ years in influencer marketing, creator partnerships or creator affiliate marketing, including at least one program you owned end to end with commercial accountability.

  • Operator experience running a TikTok Shop or comparable creator affiliate program, with GMV or revenue you were personally accountable for.

  • DTC or e-commerce experience in health and wellness, beauty, or another regulated consumer category.

  • Experience managing or mentoring team members, with evidence you raised their output rather than just reviewed it.

  • Experience managing external agencies, consultants or vendors: setting scope, holding quality, deciding when to bring work in-house.

  • Experience structuring and negotiating both flat-fee and performance-based partnerships.

  • Strong analytical skills and a track record of using campaign data to change decisions, not just report them.

  • Evidence of an AI or automation workflow you built or deployed that measurably increased throughput. Be ready to walk through what it does and what it saved.

Strongly preferred

  • Ownership of brand-owned organic social channels, not only creator programs. You understand how owned content and creator content compound.

  • Working knowledge of FTC material-connection disclosure and platform claim policy in a regulated category. You know what a creator cannot say about a supplement, and why the answer differs on TikTok and Meta.

  • Experience collaborating with Paid Media or Creative to repurpose creator content into performance advertising, including securing ad authorization at partnership time.

  • Hands-on with an influencer marketing platform - SARAL, Modash, Lefty or equivalent.

  • Experience running influencer or creator programs across multiple brands or product categories.

  • Experience partnering with healthcare professionals or subject-matter experts as brand partners.

  • Genuine interest in health, wellness, consumer behavior and social media culture.

title: Senior Manager, Product Partnerships
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

Perk works best when it connects seamlessly with the tools and platforms our customers

already rely on. From ERP and accounting systems to workplace software, mobility providers,

technology platforms, and emerging AI ecosystems, these third-party relationships can directly

shape the value customers get from Perk.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Product Partnerships to own and build those relationships.

Unlike our Growth Partnerships and Supplier Partnerships teams, this role isn’t responsible for

generating sales pipeline or supplier commission revenue. Its goal is to make Perk’s product

and customer experience stronger through the third parties we depend on and integrate with.

You’ll determine where strategic relationships can unlock the most customer value, build and

manage those partnerships, secure the access and agreements our teams need, and work

closely with Product and Engineering to turn them into successful customer-facing experiences.

This is a new role at Perk with significant opportunity to define how Product Partnerships should

work as we scale.

What You’ll Do

  • Build our product partnership strategy: Translate Perk’s product and company priorities into a clear roadmap of third-party relationships across areas such as ERP and accounting, business software, mobility, integration platforms, and AI.

  • Own strategic partner relationships: Serve as Perk’s primary relationship owner for the external platforms and technology companies that enable or enhance customer-facing product experiences.

  • Unlock Product and Engineering: Secure the developer access, API licences, programme memberships, certifications, marketplace approvals, and other partner support our teams need to build and maintain integrations.

  • Structure and negotiate partnerships: Lead commercial and strategic discussions around API access, data, licensing, marketplace participation, co-marketing, and other partnership terms, working closely with Legal, Security, Finance, Product, and Engineering.

  • Partner with Product on priorities: Bring the partner and market perspective into roadmap discussions while Product Managers own product requirements and delivery. Help determine which external relationships and integration models create the greatest customer value.

  • Own the partner lifecycle: Manage relationships from initial engagement through integration, certification, launch, ongoing roadmap alignment, escalations, programme changes, and renewals.

  • Drive adoption and customer value: Work with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Sales, and Support to ensure partnerships aren’t simply launched—they are discoverable, useful, reliable, and adopted by customers.

  • Build the Product Partnerships playbook: Establish how Perk evaluates, prioritises, launches, measures, and manages product partnerships as this function grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience in strategic partnerships, ecosystem partnerships, business development, or a product-adjacent role within SaaS, fintech, or B2B technology.

  • Experience building and managing complex relationships with technology or platform companies, ideally including developer, API, certification, or marketplace programmes.

Design for Manufacturing & Design Release

Assembly Planning & Industrialisation

· Define work instructions, process documentation, and best practices

· Ensure processes are efficient, scalable, and aligned with future production needs

· Drive standardisation and continuous improvement across manufacturing activities

Cross-Functional Coordination

· Support integration activities by resolving manufacturability and assembly challenges

· Collaborate with engineering disciplines to ensure smooth transition from design to build

· Coordinate with suppliers and external partners as required

Health, Safety & Compliance

· Support risk assessments, safe operating procedures, and compliance activities

Education

Years of experience

· Proven experience in manufacturing engineering, ideally in aerospace or similarly complex industries

· Strong experience in DFM, industrialisation, and assembly planning

Hard Skills

· Strong understanding of aircraft structures, systems, and assembly processes

· Experience in design for manufacturing (DFM) and design release processes

· Experience in development of tooling, jigs, and fixtures for complex assemblies

title: Senior Market Manager
descriptionHtml:

  • Monitor performance dashboards and scaled campaign results, identify trends or gaps, and adjust team focus to improve outcomes.

  • 3-5+ years relevant experience managing teams, preferably scaled account management teams, with a strong interest in people management and team development.

  • Strong organisational and program execution skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities at once.

  • Clear and confident communicator who can translate strategy into actionable guidance for frontline teams.

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

United Kingdom Annual Pay Range£72,000—£85,000 GBP

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. title: Senior Marketing Manager - Customer Journey (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
eRecht24 ist als eine der bekanntesten digitalen Informationsplattformen rund um die Themen Internetrecht, Datenschutz und E-Commerce am Legal Tech Markt vertreten und hilft täglich tausenden Webseitenbetreibern und Agenturen dabei ihre Webseiten rechtssicher zu gestalten.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit im Bereich Marketing mit Fokus auf Customer Journey, die Verantwortung übernimmt, strategische Entscheidungen mitprägt und unsere Marketingmaßnahmen entlang der gesamten Customer Journey nachhaltig weiterentwickelt.

Aufgaben

Du verantwortest die Customer Journey bei eRecht24 End-to-End - vom ersten Markenkontakt über organische Kanäle bis zur langfristigen Kundenbindung. Du sorgst dafür, dass aus isolierten Kanal-Aktivitäten ein zusammenhängendes Kundenerlebnis wird.

  • Du entwickelst und pflegst eine kanalübergreifende Customer Journey Map, die alle relevanten Touchpoints, Phasen und Übergänge sichtbar macht

  • Du identifizierst die kritischen Momente in der Journey - wo verlieren wir potenzielle Kunden, wo liegen die größten Conversion-Hebel?

  • Du orchestrierst die Zusammenarbeit der Marketing-Teams entlang der Journey, damit Kanäle sich gegenseitig verstärken statt in Silos zu arbeiten

  • Du entwickelst Konzepte für Schlüsselmomente im Lifecycle: Onboarding, Activation, Upgrade, Retention und Win-back

  • Du schärfst Buyer Personas auf Basis von echten Nutzerdaten und sorgst dafür, dass unterschiedliche Zielgruppen die richtige Journey durchlaufen

  • Du bringst die Kundenperspektive in datengetriebene Marketing-Entscheidungen ein und verbindest quantitative Funnel-Analysen mit qualitativen Insights

Qualifikation

Must-haves

  • 5+ Jahre Erfahrung im digitalen Marketing mit Schwerpunkt Customer Journey, Lifecycle Marketing oder Growth Marketing

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Mapping und Optimieren von Customer Journeys über mehrere Kanäle und Funnel-Stufen hinweg

  • Starkes Verständnis des gesamten Funnels - von Awareness über Lead-Generierung und Nurturing bis Conversion und Retention

  • Cross-funktionale Arbeitserfahrung: Du kannst Brücken zwischen Spezialistenteams bauen und kanalübergreifend denken

  • Analytisch und konzeptionell stark: Du kombinierst Daten (Conversion Rates, Attribution, Kohorten) mit Nutzerverständnis

  • Erfahrung im SaaS- oder Subscription-Umfeld (Freemium-to-Premium, Churn-Prevention, LTV-Optimierung)

  • Fließend Deutsch mindestens (C2)

Nice-to-haves

  • Erfahrung mit Marketing-Automation und Journey-basierter Kommunikation

  • Kenntnisse in Attribution Modeling und Cross-Channel-Tracking

  • Legal-Tech- oder B2B-SaaS-Hintergrund

Benefits

  • Ein dynamisches Team mit Zusammenhalt und offener Kommunikation

  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege

  • Gründliches Onboarding und individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

  • Modernes Büro in Berlin-Charlottenburg (Nähe Ku’damm)

  • Kostenlose Snacks, Suppen, Kaffee, Limonaden und Wasser

  • Regelmäßige Team-Events und lockere Get-togethers

  • Leistungsgerechte Vergütung

Deine Rolle: Du arbeitest nicht in einem einzelnen Kanal, sondern cross-funktional über alle Marketing-Teams hinweg. Du bist die Person, die das große Bild hält und sicherstellt, dass die einzelnen Disziplinen gemeinsam eine kohärente Journey liefern. Du reportest direkt an die Marketing-Leitung.

Kontext: eRecht24 ist Deutschlands führende Legal-Tech-Plattform mit über 400.000 Nutzern. Unsere Customer Journey hat mehrere klar definierte Stufen - von organischem Erstkontakt über kostenlose Tools bis zum Premium-Abo. Die Journey ist in den einzelnen Kanälen teilweise gut verstanden, aber das kanalübergreifende Bild fehlt noch. Genau das ist dein Job.

Arbeitsweise: Remote-first, mit regelmäßiger Präsenz in Berlin für Workshops und Strategie-Sessions. Wir arbeiten datengetrieben und setzen KI-Tools aktiv im Arbeitsalltag ein.

Standort: Hybrid in Berlin, mindestens drei Präsenztage pro Woche vor Ort

title: (Senior) Marketplace Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Aufgaben

Als (Senior) Marketplace Manager verantwortest du unsere Präsenz auf den führenden Fashion- und Sport-Marktplätzen Europas, strategisch wie operativ. Du hast Ownership für Performance, Profitabilität und Markenauftritt deiner Kanäle und entscheidest aktiv mit, wie wir TEVEO auf den Plattformen positionieren.

Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Marke und Plattform. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit E-Commerce, Operations, Marketing, Finance und externen Partnern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass sich unser Community-Spirit auf jedem Marktplatz genauso anfühlt wie in unserem eigenen Shop.

Wichtig: Das ist keine reine Strategie-Rolle. Du bist hands-on unterwegs, packst im Tagesgeschäft selbst mit an und setzt deine Ideen eigenständig um, vom Produktfeed über die Kampagne bis zur SLA-Kennzahl.

Dein Bereich als (Senior) Marketplace Manager (m/w/d):
Strategie & Wachstum

  • Du entwickelst unsere Marketplace-Strategie für Europa und setzt sie um: Sortiment, Pricing, Promotions und die Erschließung neuer Marktplätze und Länder.
  • Du verantwortest die Umsatz- und Ergebnisziele deiner Kanäle (GMV, NMV, Deckungsbeitrag) und steuerst sie über klare KPIs wie Conversion, Retourenquote und Sichtbarkeit.
  • Du bewertest Marktpotenziale, erstellst Business Cases für neue Plattformen und leitest daraus Empfehlungen für das Management ab.
  • Du legst fest, welche Essentials wir dauerhaft listen und welche Drops exklusiv bleiben, und entwickelst Launchkonzepte je Marktplatz.

Account- und Plattformsteuerung

  • Du führst unsere Partnerschaften mit den führenden Fashion- und Sport-Marktplätzen eigenverantwortlich. Dazu gehören Jahresgespräche, Konditions- und Promotion-Verhandlungen und das Platzieren von Aktionen und Kampagnen.
  • Du verantwortest die CXM- und SLA-Kennzahlen (On-Time, Return Time, Valid Tracking), erkennst Risiken frühzeitig und setzt Maßnahmen konsequent um.
  • Du steuerst Feed- und Attributmanagement über unsere Middleware (Tradebyte, ChannelEngine o. ä.) und treibst die Weiterentwicklung der Schnittstellen und Prozesse voran.

Content, Visibility & Brand Experience

  • Du bist Marken-Wächter auf allen Plattformen und sorgst für einen einheitlichen Auftritt in Bildsprache, Texten, Pricing und Promotions.
  • Du planst Kampagnen, Launches und Retail-Media-Maßnahmen gemeinsam mit Marketing und steuerst die Budgets für Retail Media.
  • Du optimierst Produktdaten, Content-Qualität und Conversion und stellst sicher, dass unsere Produkte sauber und performant ausgespielt werden.

Operations & Data

  • Du verantwortest Forecasting, Bestandsplanung und Replenishment für die Marktplätze in enger Abstimmung mit Operations.
  • Du steuerst die Abläufe rund um Versand und Retouren, z. B. über Fulfillment- und Retourenprogramme der Plattformen oder eigene Carrier-Setups, und optimierst sie hinsichtlich Kosten und SLA-Erfüllung.
  • Du baust das Marketplace-Reporting auf und aus und übersetzt Zahlen in klare Entscheidungen für Management und Finance.

Partner & Dienstleister

  • Du steuerst externe Partner und Dienstleister wie Agenturen und Middleware-Anbieter.

Dein Profil

Deine Stärken die wir in unserem Team brauchen:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in Betriebswirtschaft, E-Commerce, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung im E-Commerce- oder Marketplace-Management, idealerweise im Fashion- oder Sportswear-Umfeld; für die Senior-Rolle nachweisliche Verantwortung für einen Marktplatz-Kanal inklusive Umsatzzielen
  • Fundiertes Know-how in Marktplatzprozessen, Fulfillment-Setups und Provisionsstrukturen; Erfahrung mit großen Fashion- und Sport-Marktplätzen ist ein großes Plus
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Tradebyte, ChannelEngine o. ä., Looker Studio und Excel/Sheets
  • Ausgeprägte analytische Stärke, unternehmerisches Denken und ein gutes Gespür für die Balance aus Performance und Brand-Ästhetik
  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Du arbeitest gern selbst im Tagesgeschäft mit, statt nur zu delegieren, und setzt Dinge schnell und pragmatisch um
  • Verhandlungsstärke und Souveränität im Umgang mit Plattformpartnern und internen Stakeholdern
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Warum wir?

Unsere Benefits:

    Profitiere von unserer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und baue dir entspannt deine finanzielle Absicherung auf – wir unterstützen dich dabei mit einem monatlichen Zuschuss.

title: Senior Mass Properties Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

We are looking for a Senior Mass Properties Engineer (all genders) to join our Central Engineering team and lead mass properties engineering activities for the Microliner aircraft. You will be responsible for establishing, maintaining, and communicating the aircraft mass properties baseline throughout the development lifecycle. Working closely with the Overall Aircraft Design, Airframe, Systems, Propulsion, Technology, Flight Physics, and Configuration Management teams, you will guide aircraft, system, and discipline owners in establishing reliable mass data and consolidate this information into a consistent, traceable, and configuration-controlled aircraft mass properties baseline.

As a senior member of Central Engineering, you will provide mass properties expertise across the organization, support technical and programme decision-making, and ensure that mass properties objectives are consistently considered throughout design, verification, certification, and production.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead mass properties engineering for the Microliner across aircraft, system, subsystem, and lower levels, ensuring reliable, traceable, and configuration-controlled mass data throughout design maturation, verification, certification, and transition into production.

  • Maintain, further develop, analyse, and communicate the consolidated aircraft mass properties baseline.

  • Manage and continuously refine mass targets, allocations, margins, and weight-saving objectives in collaboration with aircraft, system, and discipline owners.

  • Guide aircraft, system, and discipline owners in estimating, substantiating, and maintaining mass properties data for their respective scope, providing methods, quality assurance, and configuration-control guidance.

  • Perform aircraft weight and balance analyses, including operational loading conditions, centre-of-gravity envelopes, loading scenarios, and compliance with applicable airworthiness requirements.

  • Evaluate mass properties across aircraft configurations, managing applicability, effectivity, and consistency within the aircraft mass model.

  • Assess and communicate the mass-properties impact of design changes, technical trades, system integration decisions, and configuration changes.

  • Define mass properties verification and weighing requirements, and coordinate with suppliers and system owners to ensure that measured data is appropriately substantiated, reconciled, and incorporated into the configuration-controlled aircraft mass properties baseline.

  • Further develop and continuously improve mass properties processes, methods, tools, reporting, governance, and interfaces with configuration management and the wider engineering toolchain.

Your Profile:

  • Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable technical discipline.

  • Minimum 8 years of professional experience in aircraft mass properties engineering, preferably within the development and certification of civil aircraft under EASA CS-23 or FAA Part 23. Relevant experience from CS-25/Part 25, military or eVTOL development is also considered.

  • Experience with the mass properties of battery-electric aircraft, electric propulsion systems, high-voltage systems, or other electric aviation technologies is a strong plus.

  • Demonstrated experience managing aircraft mass properties throughout the product development lifecycle, including mass estimation, target setting, allocation, tracking, reporting, configuration control, and the incorporation of substantiated mass data into the aircraft baseline.

  • Strong expertise in aircraft weight and balance, centre-of-gravity envelope development, loading analysis, moments of inertia, mass margins, uncertainty management, and mass-properties substantiation.

  • Demonstrated experience working across the complete aircraft product hierarchy, from aircraft-level mass objectives and operational loading conditions through system, and lower-level hardware mass data, ensuring consistency and traceability between levels.

  • Good understanding of aircraft design, systems integration, configuration management, certification, and the interaction between mass properties, aircraft performance, structures, stability and control, and operational capability.

  • Proficiency with mass properties databases and analysis tools, as well as experience integrating mass data within product lifecycle management and configuration-controlled engineering environments; experience with Dassault Systèmes 3DEXPERIENCE is a strong plus.

  • Structured, analytical, and solution-oriented professional with strong ownership of aircraft-level outcomes, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate mass properties implications effectively across technical disciplines and programme stakeholders.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; additional European languages are an asset

  • Strong motivation for aviation and the advancement of electric aircraft technologies.

     

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

You’ll work closely with game designers, artists, developers and analysts to ensure the match-3 is satisfying, intuitive and rewarding, evolving its mechanics, pacing and feel so that the game’s creative vision and long-term engagement goals come through. You’ll use player feedback, analytics and playtesting to refine gameplay, experiment with new ideas and shape the ongoing evolution of the game’s core puzzle experience.

  • A consistent track record of delivering high-quality work that meets design requirements and project goals.

  • Sound judgement in balancing creative excellence with production efficiency.

Where You'll Be

This role is based in our London office. The team values in-person collaboration and typically works from the office three days a week: Mondays, Tuesdays and Fridays.

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read.

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

Relocation? Yes!

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

title: Senior Materials Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

As Senior Materials Engineer (all genders) you will lead material selection for the propulsion battery system of VÆRIDION's CS-23 all-electric aircraft. You will identify the best material for each application, from composites and metals to adhesives, gaskets, and insulation materials, and own the material requirements and evidence that support each choice. Through trade studies, characterization, and close supplier engagement, you will make sure that every material in the propulsion battery system performs safely in normal operation, under abuse, and during thermal runaway.

Within the Mechanical Design & Integration team, you will work closely with Mechanical Design and Materials & Processes, and support the Thermal Systems, HV Electrical Systems, Airborne Electronics, and Cell Technology teams wherever material choices matter, including thermal adhesives, electrical bonding, and insulation. As development matures, you will hand over qualification and process ownership to Materials & Processes while remaining the technical authority on material behaviour. Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION's mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead material selection for the propulsion battery system, including composites, metals, adhesives, gaskets, seals, potting compounds, and thermal and electrical insulation materials.

  • Lead structured material trade studies that balance mechanical, thermal, electrical, chemical, weight, cost, and supply chain considerations.

  • Own material requirements for normal operation, abuse, and failure cases, including thermal runaway, fire, venting, crash, vibration, humidity, and fluid exposure.

  • Evaluate high-temperature and fire protection materials, such as phenolic and high-char-yield composites, silicone systems, ceramics, and intumescent materials, for thermal runaway containment.

  • Provide material property data and guidance on material-driven design features to the Mechanical Design team.

  • Support material choices for thermal adhesives, gap fillers, electrical bonding, and insulation together with the Thermal Systems, HV Electrical Systems, and Airborne Electronics teams.

  • Draft test requests (TRQs) for material characterization and work with the test team and suppliers to execute them.

  • Analyse test data and derive design-relevant material properties and conclusions.

  • Own technical relationships with material suppliers, including requirements alignment, data requests, and the evaluation of new material candidates.

  • Define material specifications and approved-material definitions together with Materials & Processes.

  • Contribute to material qualification and certification substantiation, transferring ownership to Materials & Processes as development matures.

  • Assess material compatibility and durability over the service life, including chemical compatibility with coolants and electrolytes, galvanic corrosion between dissimilar materials, moisture uptake, outgassing, and property retention after thermal cycling and accelerated aging, as well as resistance to thermal runaway vent gases and ejecta, working with the Materials & Processes Engineer where processing such as cure state or surface preparation affects the result.

  • Lead failure investigations and root cause analyses where material behaviour is a contributor.

  • Consider regulatory constraints such as REACH and RoHS in material selection.

  • Act as the technical authority on materials in design reviews and technical discussions with suppliers and partners.

  • Mentor engineers and build materials expertise across the Technology division.

 

Your Profile:

  • Deep understanding of structure-property-processing relationships in polymers, composites, metals, and ceramics.

  • Proven ability to select the best material for a given application, based on data and first principles.

  • Experience with material characterization methods such as mechanical testing, DSC, TGA, DMA, cone calorimetry, and microscopy.

  • Experience planning tests, interpreting results, and correlating them with design requirements.

  • Strong knowledge of thermoset and thermoplastic composites, adhesives, and elastomers.

  • Knowledge of high-temperature material performance and fire, smoke, and toxicity behaviour is desirable.

  • Experience leading technical work with material suppliers.

  • Familiarity with CS-23, DO-160, DO-311A, and CMH-17 is beneficial.

  • Working proficiency with 3D CAD, such as CATIA, SolidWorks, or Siemens NX, is beneficial.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, technical curiosity, and attention to detail.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Introduction

We’re expanding and have a fantastic opportunity for a Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our mechanical and biomedical engineering department. We want to deepen and broaden the skills we already have in the group, and to add to its great culture. This role would suit someone in the early stages of their career, looking for a new challenge within an innovative company.

This team works predominantly across healthcare projects, and you will use your engineering skills at all stages of the development life-cycle, taking responsibility for design challenges and technical problems.

There is no deadline for this role, as we recruit on a rolling basis. Once the position is filled, we will close the advert. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

What you’ll be doing

The majority of your time will be spent delivering exceptional mechanical engineering for our multi-national medical technology clients, understanding their requirements and communicating clearly and effectively. You will be hands-on in solving complex mechanical challenges, often alongside other disciplines, within supportive project teams.

You will work on projects across a range of healthcare sectors, including medical devices, drug delivery, surgical systems and diagnostics instruments. The technical challenges we tackle are ground-breaking, innovative and make a real difference to the landscape of medical technology.

You will guide aspects of the mechanical development and define technical solutions, using your experience to design systems and parts for manufacture by applying real-world knowledge. Your work is likely to include:

  • First-principles engineering analysis
  • Concept generation and the development of engineering designs
  • Rapid prototyping
  • Hands-on testing and experimentation, including the design and execution of test programmes
  • Detailed design for manufacture and assembly, and liaising with suppliers
  • Presenting results, both internally and to clients
  • Preparing technical reports and producing high-quality documentation

Our culture encourages team members to take on the level of responsibility that suits them. You will have the opportunity to significantly develop your skills and career, learn from others and make a substantial impact on our projects.

We are keen to support the development of our employees, and as such offer an extensive in-house training program. As you advance within the organisation there will be plenty of opportunities for you to develop your technical skills and specialism, take on more leadership responsibilities and/or focus more on supporting the development of sales opportunities.

What you can bring

You’ll bring strong mechanical engineering ability and enthusiasm to the role. You will deliver high-quality work on client projects, to specification and to timelines. You will be responsible for delivering the tasks you’re assigned, and for defining tasks for yourself and often for others.

title: Senior Mechatronics Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Lightcast we are enabling scientists to gain a deeper understanding of human health and disease at the cellular level.

Our technology enables the direct, precise interrogation of single cell heterogeneity, interactions and functional behaviours with a level of flexibility and scale that was previously inaccessible. Across a broad range of disciplines from basic and translational research to drug discovery, we provide the freedom to accelerate discovery and apply novel biological insights. 

At Lightcast we are enabling scientists to gain a deeper understanding of human health and disease at the cellular level. Our technology enables the direct, precise interrogation of single cell heterogeneity, interactions and functional behaviours with a level of flexibility and scale that was previously inaccessible. Across a broad range of disciplines from basic and translational research to drug discovery, we provide the freedom to accelerate discovery and apply novel biological insights.  

The Lightcast platform is a benchtop laboratory instrument that uses microfluidics to allow precise and highly flexible control of thousands of aqueous microdroplets using software-generated light patterns. Control systems enable the integrated optical, mechanical, and fluidic sub-systems to perform complex workflows and assays used in the search for drug candidates. 

We are seeking a Senior Mechatronics Engineer to join our team and take a leading role in system design and engineering activities. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience delivering complex systems within a product business through a background in Electronics, Mechatronics or Mechanical Engineering, with an emphasis on designing and debugging systems at the intersection of hardware, firmware and control. You will have: 

  • A strong technical track record in designing complex mechatronic products for function, reliability, manufacture, serviceability and cost  
  • Hands-on and analytical approach to debugging complex systems, problem solving and resolution ownership 
  • Full end-to-end development experience in mechatronic and electronic systems, having worked with development and manufacturing teams to engineer and improve product designs 
  • Deep subject matter expertise and extensive experience in developing and delivering complex measurement systems and instrumentation  

Your responsibilities: 

  • Working with our development, manufacturing and support teams to design, develop, deliver and maintain our platform and microfluidic products 
  • A strong focus on delivering electro-mechanical system architecture designs  
  • Taking a key position in system engineering activities, devising and delivering system tests, functional characterisation and verification tests 
  • Technical review of projects, as a subject matter expert 
  • Technical documentation of design outputs and rationale 
  • Leadership in and advocacy for good product engineering practice, process development, definition and documentation 
  • Leading and participating in risk mitigation, design reviews, verification, change control 

It would be advantageous for you to have any of the following: 

  • Embedded programming experience 
  • Experience using Python or similar programming languages 
  • Experience developing Life science products 
  • Experience developing opto-mechanics, precision motion control and fluidics systems
  • A track record of working in a multidisciplinary environment 
  • Deep knowledge of operating with MCAD and ECAD 

Lightcast Discovery is committed to equal employment opportunity. Learn more about Lightcast Discovery

title: Senior Medical Content Manager (x/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Werde Teil unserer Mission, werde Teil von Doctolib!

Wir suchen Dich als Senior Medical Content Manager (x/f/m) als Unterstützung für das Patient Content Factory Team in Berlin.

Doctolib ist Europas führender Health Companion und begleitet Millionen von Patient:innen und Gesundheitsfachkräften auf dem gesamten Kontinent. Wir transformieren die Gesundheitsversorgung, indem wir unsere Plattform mit innovativen Lösungen rund um Prävention und Patient:innen-Empowerment bereichern.

Unser nächster Schritt: Doctolib zur vertrauenswürdigsten Gesundheitskontent-Destination in Europa zu machen. Dafür haben wir das Patient Content Factory Team ins Leben gerufen — ein dediziertes Team, das für alle Inhalte innerhalb der Doctolib-App verantwortlich ist. Dies umfasst Präventionskampagnen sowie personalisierte Gesundheitsinformationen (Artikel, Videos, interaktive Inhalte), die auf verifizierten medizinischen Kenntnissen basieren.

Du verantwortlich für das Verfassen und die Verwaltung von Inhalten für den Health Companion der App — und stellst dabei höchste Qualitätsstandards sicher. Du koordinierst funktionsübergreifende Stakeholder, sorgst für End-to-End-Qualität an allen Touchpoints und steuerst die gesamte Content-Produktion.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du hilfst beim Aufbau und der Pflege des Redaktionskalenders für alle deutschen Gesundheitsinhalte und identifizierst Content-Möglichkeiten basierend auf Patient:innen-Bedürfnissen und öffentlichen Gesundheitsprioritäten
  • Du schreibst und erstellst verständliche medizinische Inhalte für Patient:innen und übersetzt komplexe medizinische Informationen in klare, handlungsorientierte Artikel für das deutsche Publikum
  • Du managst den gesamten Content-Workflow von der Idee bis zur Veröffentlichung und koordinierst interne sowie externe Content-Writer:innen für eine termingerechte Umsetzung
  • Du verwaltest Inhalte und Redaktionskalender über ein CMS und treibst die Optimierung von Content-Prozessen durch Automatisierung und KI voran
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass alle Inhalte höchste Standards in Bezug auf Genauigkeit, Klarheit und Healthcare-Compliance erfüllen, und koordinierst strenge Review-Prozesse mit medizinischen Gutachter:innen und Expert:innen
  • Du trägst zum Aufbau eines Netzwerks aus glaubwürdigen Partner:innen (Institutionen, Expert:innen, medizinische Fachgesellschaften) bei, um die Autorität von Doctolibs Gesundheitsinhalten zu stärken

Dein Profil

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringst Du Folgendes mit:

  • Abschluss in Kommunikation, Journalismus oder Lebenswissenschaften (Biomedizin, Public Health o.ä.)
  • Mindestens 4 Jahre nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Bereich Medical Content Writing, Gesundheitskommunikation oder verwandten Feldern
  • Erfahrung im Management digitaler Kampagnen und in der Arbeit mit CMS-Systemen
  • Starker Projektmanagement-Hintergrund mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Stakeholder zu koordinieren
  • Herausragende schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Deutsch sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse

Besonders interessant sind für uns außerdem:

  • Neugier und Interesse an multiformat-Storytelling (Video, interaktive Inhalte) — praktische Erfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss
  • Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung mit Performance-Measurement-Tools
  • Starke zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, in einem dynamischen, funktionsübergreifenden Umfeld zu navigieren

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Ein von Doctolib gesponsertes Deutschlandticket, wenn Du aus dem Büro oder im Hybridmodus arbeitest
  • 28 Urlaubstage + 1 Tag zusätzlich für jedes volle Beschäftigungs-Kalenderjahr (max. 30 Tage)
  • Die Möglichkeit, 10 Tage im Jahr aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten
  • Eine betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung mit individuellen Zusatzleistungen (u.a. Zahnreinigung u.v.m.)
  • Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) mit einem Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 40 % (15 % während der Probezeit)
  • Teilnahme an Doctolibs langfristigem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth
  • Das Doctolib Parent Care Programm, das extra Elternzeit (1 Monat) u.v.m. enthält
  • Kostenlose Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über einen externen Partner
  • Zusätzlich zu gesunden Snacks und einem regelmäßigen Frühstücksbuffet, bieten wir Essensgutscheine
  • Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club
  • Für pflegende Betreuungspersonen und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen gibt es ein Angebot, das flexiblere Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung aus medizinischen Gründen und psychologische Unterstützung beinhaltet

Job Details

title: Senior Methods Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Methods Engineer to join our production plant in Wissous. In our context of fast growth, you will act as the connector between Production, Quality, Supply Chain, and our Industrialisation & Automation team.

We are not asking for you to maintain what someone else built, we are asking for you to build it yourself: every process, standard, lean system.

  

Responsibilities

An ideal day in this position starts on the shopfloor: quick walk, performance standup, catching issues early.

Mid-day splits between desk work (time studies, routing updates, ERP automation) and cross-functional sessions with Production, Quality, and the Automation team.

Afternoons are hands-on: kaizen walks, work instruction updates, problem-solving with supervisors.

You close the day feeding data back into the system.

Roughly 50% floor, 50% structured engineering work, every day. In a nutshell:

  • Continuous Improvement & Shopfloor Performance

  • Production Line Design & Internal Flow

  • Process Knowledge & Documentation

  • Automation Roadmap Contribution

 

Candidate Requirements

  • Diploma in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Production Engineering. A strong profile from a different engineering discipline associated with strong shopfloor experience is also valued.

  • Experience in building methods structure in a fast-moving manufacturing environment (written work instructions from scratch, run time studies, 5S,...). Has owned a lean improvement roadmap, not just contributed to one.

  • Ideally has navigated a ramp-up, a new plant launch, or a new product introduction where the structure did not exist yet.

  • Detail-oriented, rigorous, and comfortable working on the shop floor.

  • Team player with good communication skills.

  • Very good level of English and French

  • Full alignment with Harmattan AI's mission and willingness to go the extra mile to support our growth.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Senior ML Compiler Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

The Role

We are looking for Senior ML Compiler Engineers with experience in machine learning compilation to work on the compiler stack for our ground-breaking AI accelerators. You can be based in our Bristol office or London.

Fractile isn't another AI startup gluing together frameworks. We are designing a full-stack execution engine: hardware, compiler, runtime, to build the world's largest language models 100 x faster than today's systems. That ambition forces us to rethink everything from first principles.

For compiler engineers, this is a rare moment: the architecture is still being shaped. The IR, the lowering strategy, the optimisation passes, the execution model - you get to define its future.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop the machine learning compiler stack for Fractile’s innovative AI acceleration hardware

  • Enable industry-leading performance of the latest LLMs on Fractile’s accelerators

  • Work with hardware, driver runtime, and ML engineers in a highly collaborative hardware-software co-design methodology

It would be great if you have:

  • Proven experience of the development of machine learning compilers using industry standard technologies such as MLIR or TVM

  • Up-to-date knowledge of machine learning techniques and technologies

  • A good understanding of computer architecture and performance optimisation techniques

  • Excellent C/C++ skills and solid experience of industry standard development tools and technologies

  • An creative and innovative mindset, and a willingness to take ownership and drive results in a fast-paced environment

  • Computer Science, Electronic Engineering, Maths, Physics, or related degree and 4+ years of industry experience

You may also have:

  • Previous experience in a startup or small team environment

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

 

Export controls

Our work involves technologies subject to UK, US and other international export control regulations. Certain roles may require additional eligibility checks to ensure compliance with applicable law. We'll be transparent about this throughout the hiring process.

title: Senior ML Engineer
descriptionHtml:
For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands.

About SkinVision

Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped over 3 million people worldwide. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin cancer images and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. Where needed, cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need.

Senior Machine Learning Engineer at SkinVision

We're on the lookout for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer based in our Amsterdam office with the right skills and experience to ensure the Machine Learning team releases models with exceptional performance making use of state-of-the-art techniques. Not only are ML models vital to our product and hence for our end users, e.g., enabling early detection of skin cancer, they also enable our internal team to perform optimally. The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in training new and optimizing existing Machine Learning and computer vision models (Python), has hands-on experience in MLOps and deploying models to production (preferably in AWS) and is able to gather requirements and communicate results to the stakeholders directly involved in the model development and deployment. Moreover, in this senior role, it is vital that you can mentor other team members, own the technical processes and actively contribute to the ML roadmap. Knowledge of data orchestration tools (Apache Airflow), data modeling (dbt) and working in a regulated and/or medical environment are a plus!

What you will do

  • Drive the full ML model development lifecycle: from understanding and co-defining the problem to providing inputs on data collection, assessing the quality of data, model training, validation, deployment and monitoring.

  • Create requirements for data collection for both new and existing models. This includes data for model training and testing.

  • Develop and improve efficient ML training pipelines in the cloud (AWS or similar).

  • Involve stakeholders appropriately during the entire development, deployment and monitoring lifecycle.

  • Scale the ML environment and processes to multiple models being developed and deployed simultaneously.

  • Ensure ML development aligns with medical device standards if applicable, including ML best practices, experiment tracking, traceability, data lineage and documentation.

  • Support and mentor team members.

Your profile

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Econometrics, Statistics, Computer Science or a related field.

Skills

  • Ability to translate user needs and requirements into technical requirements and a development plan.

  • Hands-on expertise with modern deep learning architectures and other ML architectures, ideally but not restricted to image data.

  • Hands-on experience with MLOps practices for scalable training, deployment and monitoring.

  • Strong analytical mindset, problem-solving skills and the ability to extract actionable insights from intricate datasets.

You’ll leverage advanced analytics and AI to assess risk, optimise underwriting processes, and create tailored policies that meet the unique needs of our clients. If you’re passionate about making an impact, thrive in a dynamic startup environment, and are ready to lead the charge in redefining fleet insurance, we want you on our team!

title: Senior Network Administrator (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Sie haben schon einmal ein gewachsenes Netzwerk neu geordnet:
Segmente getrennt, Standorte sauber angebunden und alles so dokumentiert, dass auch andere damit arbeiten können? Und Sie möchten genau das jetzt über mehrere Standorte und mit voller Verantwortung umsetzen?

Über unseren Mandanten

Unser Mandant ist ein international tätiger Industriezulieferer der Mobilitätsbranche mit Hauptsitz im Großraum Kassel und Standorten in Europa und Nordamerika. Das Unternehmen wächst auf einer sehr soliden Auftragsbasis.

Warum diese Rolle

Das Netzwerk ist über Jahre gewachsen und wird jetzt neu strukturiert. Die Netze werden getrennt und segmentiert, die Produktionsnetze abgesichert, und es entstehen verbindliche Standards. Ziel ist eine performante, ausfallsichere und gegen Angriffe belastbare Netzwerklandschaft, auf der alle IT-Services aufsetzen.

• Weil Sie die Netzarchitektur über mehrere Standorte selbst prägen.

• Weil Ihre Arbeit sichtbar wird: in stabilen Verbindungen, sauberen Segmenten und einer Doku, mit der andere arbeiten können.

• Weil eine erfahrene IT-Leitung Ihnen Rückhalt gibt, auch wenn etwas nicht auf Anhieb klappt.

Das sind Ihre Aufgaben

• Planung, Aufbau und Betrieb von LAN, WAN und Backbone an allen Standorten

• Routing und Switching inklusive VLAN-Konzept und Redundanz

• Standortvernetzung per VPN und sichere Remote-Zugänge

• Betrieb der Firewalls (Fortinet) und Neuordnung gewachsener Regelwerke

• Segmentierung der Netze und Trennung von IT und OT, damit die Produktion geschützt läuft

• WLAN und Access Points

• Netzpläne, IP-Adressverwaltung und Standards, die das Netz für alle nachvollziehbar machen

Zur Einordnung: Security-Monitoring und SIEM betreibt ein externer Partner, mit dem Sie eng zusammenarbeiten. Clients, Server und Anwendungen betreuen Kolleginnen und Kollegen im IT-Team. Ihr Schwerpunkt ist das Netzwerk selbst, von der Verkabelung bis zum Routing.

Das bringen Sie mit

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Netzwerkadministrator oder Network Engineer, idealerweise inhouse in einem Industrie- oder Produktionsunternehmen

• Sie haben Netze konzipiert, strukturiert und dokumentiert, gern auch als Allrounder mit klarem Netzwerkschwerpunkt in einem kleineren Unternehmen.

• Fundiertes Know-how in Routing und Switching sowie Erfahrung mit der Vernetzung mehrerer Standorte, idealerweise international

• Praxis mit Fortinet oder vergleichbaren Enterprise-Lösungen, etwa Palo Alto, Check Point, Cisco oder Sophos

• Erfahrung mit Produktionsnetzen und der Trennung von IT und OT

• Sicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch für die Abstimmung mit den Standorten

• Von Vorteil: Zertifizierungen wie Fortinet FCP/FCSS, Cisco CCNA/CCNP oder vergleichbar

Das erwartet Sie

• Arbeitsplatz im Großraum Kassel: Die Rolle lebt vom direkten Austausch, deshalb arbeiten Sie überwiegend vor Ort. Dazu kommen projektbezogene Reisen zu den Standorten.

• Eine Fachrolle mit voller Verantwortung für Ihr Thema und kurze Entscheidungswege

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub

• Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket und Bikeleasing

• Weiterbildung, zum Beispiel für Hersteller-Zertifizierungen

Gehalt

60.000–70.000 € brutto im Jahr plus Tantieme, je nach Erfahrung

Interesse?

Senden Sie uns Ihren Lebenslauf mit Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestem Eintrittstermin. Stefan Schulz meldet sich bei Ihnen für ein vertrauliches Erstgespräch.
