title: Senior Product Manager – Tax and Recs (Europe)
descriptionHtml:
Hybrid role based in our London office (3 days a week)

 

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

 

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe, starting in Ireland.

 

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

 

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

 

If you want to help build the next chapter of Seccl in Ireland and shape the future of investing across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

 

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

 

The role

We’re looking for a Senior product manager to join the Tax and Recs squad in our European tribe. You’ll own how we reconcile client cash and assets, and how we help our clients report their customers’ tax correctly, as we grow across Europe.

Our European strategy has two parts. First, we’re going deep in Ireland, building a full proposition with the products, tax wrappers and pensions that Irish firms and their clients need. Second, we’re building the foundations to spread at speed into more European countries, with a focused offering for each market rather than a rebuild every time we enter a new one. The Tax and Recs squad makes both possible: we can only grow if our reconciliations hold up under regulatory scrutiny and our tax engine is something clients can trust.

You won’t be joining a finished roadmap. You’ll help define it, with real ownership over the problems that will decide how far and how fast we can grow in Europe. You’ll work closely with our Operations, Compliance and Customer teams, and with key European clients. A reliable tax engine is not just a regulatory necessity, it is a genuine advantage when we sell to new firms, so your work will be felt well beyond the squad.

What you’ll own

  • Scaling our cash and stock reconciliations to meet Client Asset Requirements (CAR) in Ireland, so we can grow volumes with confidence

  • Making sure our Operations team’s processes work in Europe and scale as we do

  • Building the tax reporting and tax engine for Ireland, so our clients can report tax correctly on behalf of their customers across the wrappers that matter to Irish firms

  • Localising that foundation to each wrapper and each country across Europe, rather than starting again every time

  • Connecting directly to tax authorities where a country requires us to pay tax on behalf of our clients’ customers

  • Making our tax engine reliable, transparent and easy to build on, so tax becomes a reason firms choose Seccl

  • Defining and prioritising the Tax and Recs squad’s roadmap, balancing what Ireland needs today with what the next European markets will need

  • Translating regulatory requirements, including CAR and Irish tax rules, into clear product requirements with Compliance

  • Breaking down complex problems like localising a tax engine into clear, actionable plans with engineers and other stakeholders

  • Using quantitative and qualitative data, such as break rates, exceptions and resolution times, to make evidence-based decisions

This role’s for you if...

  • You have a track record of owning a product area end to end, ideally in reconciliations, custody, investment operations or tax in a regulated environment (e.g. fintech, banking, investments, pensions, insurance)

  • You understand client money and money flow

  • You’re comfortable operating in 0→1 or highly ambiguous environments where structure doesn’t yet exist

  • You can bring clarity to complex, undefined problems and turn them into actionable plans

  • You’re highly proactive: you create momentum rather than wait for direction

  • You’re customer-obsessed, with a focus on improving workflows and outcomes

  • You thrive in cross-functional environments, working comfortably with Operations, Compliance, Customer and Engineering, and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences

What’s in it for you

We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

  • 💰 As salary between £75,000 and £90,000, reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance

  • 🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, with some flexibility around bank holidays, plus your birthday off

  • 💙 Two volunteering days each year

  • 🌎 The option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

  • 🌟 Secclbrate, our recognition programme offering flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

  • 🏅 One-month paid sabbatical after eight years

  • 🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

  • 👪 Enhanced parental leave

  • 💻 MacBook and up to £500 towards your home office set-up

  • 📖 Annual learning budget

  • 🌻 Health and wellbeing support, including free therapy through Wellness Cloud and mental health support through Headspace

  • 🌱 Financial wellbeing benefits, including Octopus Money, the Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing through Octopus Legacy

  • 🎁 Perkbox, with flexible points and a range of discounts and perks

  • 🚲 Access to Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

 

Our culture

We put people first and try hard to create an environment where people feel trusted, heard and able to do their best work.

 

We value openness, curiosity and different perspectives. You’ll have the freedom to challenge how things are done, experiment with better ways of working and take real ownership of your impact.

 

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

 

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way process. Our interviews are conversational, with plenty of time for you to get to know us and ask questions too.

 

  • First stage – 45 mins competencies-based interview with the hiring manager + team member

  • Second stage – one-hour technical focused interview, we will share a case study task in advance for you to present back to us on

  • Final stage – 45 mins bar-raiser culture-based interview

     

We review applications as they come in and may close the role once we have enough candidates to move forward. We’ll keep you updated throughout.

 

Everyone’s welcome

We want to build a diverse and inclusive company full of brilliant people with different skills, experiences and perspectives. All applicants will be considered without regard to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran status, neurodiversity or disability.

 

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior Product Manager - Trading
descriptionHtml:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

The Role:

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager, Rosso.

This is the second product manager on Rosso, reporting into the Rosso Product Lead. Rosso is deeply technical, built on ML-led models and complex engineering covering forecasting, pricing optimisation and portfolio balancing, so this is a role for a technically-minded PM who's happiest closest to the hardest problems. You'll work on complex, important problems as they arise across the Rosso product surface, alongside the other PM on the team, rather than owning one fixed patch. In the near term that means the portfolio area: fulfilling and balancing a growing two-sided portfolio, managing imbalance, and finding the revenue and margin in every position we hold. It's still forming, it carries live financial risk, and it needs someone who wants to win in it.

You will:

  • Take business and customer needs and turn them into feasible, shipped product, working closely enough to the ML and forecasting work to make good calls on it.

  • Own the technical-product detail, setting clear success criteria for how well a model or forecast needs to perform, and designing for the edge cases and operational reality of a system carrying live financial risk.

  • Drive open product decisions to a close - yours and the team's - so delivery keeps moving at pace, with a clear Now, Next and Future for the initiatives you own.

🚀 Responsibilities:

Turn needs into shipped product

  • Take business and customer needs and turn them into feasible product execution, balancing them against nascent ML and forecasting innovations that push the frontier of what's possible.

  • Take initiatives from discovery through to regularly released product, with a clear Now, Next and Future for a given area.

  • Drive open product decisions to a close, so work keeps moving.

  • Decide what to formalise, what stays a prototype and what to drop - be the editor and builder, not just the instigator.

Own the technical-product detail

  • Work embedded in full-stack teams that include ML/data science and software engineers, close enough to the models to make good calls.

  • Set clear success criteria for how well a model or forecast needs to perform for the product to work, and design for the edge cases and operational reality of a system that carries live financial risk.

  • Pull and interrogate your own and others' data to influence and inform decisions, and reason about model performance and error as business indicators.

  • Get close to the people who use what you build, from internal commercial teams to generators and businesses externally.

Win in the portfolio

  • Concentrate, in the near term, on the portfolio area while it's still forming, without that becoming a permanent boundary on where you work.

  • Treat hedging, imbalance and trading decisions as product decisions: when to hold a position, when to trade it out, when to reprice to close a gap in the portfolio.

  • Find the tangible and most pressing problems worth solving - such as whether to buy or build a new forecasting capability, or how to ensure Rosso reacts at scale to any event in the system.

  • Chase the commercial outcome, not just the shipped feature - the measure of this role is margin found and risk managed, at pace.

🎯 Requirements:

Must haves

  • A product manager with real product execution behind them: owned at least one complex product area end to end, with a track record of moving real business outcomes, not just shipping features.

  • Commercial drive. You set the pace for yourself and the people around you, push decisions to a close, and go after revenue and margin. You want to win, and it shows in how you work.

  • Experience in or around trading. Energy trading is the ideal, but financial trading, fintech, battery or EV trading all count - you understand positions, hedging and what it means for a system to carry live financial risk.

  • Uses data analysis throughout the product process, to validate ideas, progress work, and measure success.

  • ML-literate: has worked closely enough with ML and data science to make good calls on model-led products, and can reason about model performance and error as business indicators.

  • Built product in a startup, scaleup or other high-growth environment, with high personal ownership of an area.

  • A strong instinct for failure points, edge cases and the operational reality of a live system.

  • AI-native, AI-literate and AI-critical - you know where it helps and where it hurts.

  • A clear, structured communicator, especially in writing.

Bonus points

  • Hands-on energy trading experience - intraday, day-ahead, imbalance or battery optimisation.

  • Experience where forecasting or fulfilling a two-sided marketplace is central to the product.

  • Experience going through a third-party-access and/or international-expansion transition.

  • Experience with regulated industries and data-heavy products.

✨ Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive salary - our current band for this role is £85,000-£93,000 or equivalent in local currency.

  • Stock Options - everyone on the team has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday + public holidays - Swap public holidays for ones that matter most to you. Plus, get an extra day off for your birthday 🎉.

  • Remote & flexible working - We're fully remote with clear core hours, and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

  • Home working & wellbeing budgets:

    • Up to £1,200 / €1,200 annually to upgrade your remote setup (co-working passes, equipment, etc.).

    • Up to £150 / €150 monthly on anything that supports your wellbeing - from therapy to gym memberships to meditation apps.

 

🗣️ Interview Process:

Our processes normally take around 2-3 weeks from first call to offer - please let us know about any adjustments to timelines that may be required.

  1. First call with our Talent Team (30 Mins). This is to understand your experience, motivations, and discuss the role in more detail.

  2. Behaviour Interview with our Product Lead (45 Mins). This is your chance to really understand the role, the expectations, and ensure alignment on ways of working.

  3. Technical Interview with the Team (75 Mins). You’ll meet with potential peers to discuss how you drive product execution, work closely with ML and engineering teams, and think through real product scenarios - built around a real product decision shaped by a model or forecast, so we're testing on proof, not assertion.

  4. Bar Raiser Interview with Stakeholders (45 Mins). The final session will be with two cross-functional stakeholders, and will explore how your values align with ours, and is designed to be a genuine two-way conversation, your chance to understand what it’s really like to work at tem.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

title: Senior Product Manager, Vertical Search
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

Vertical search is where we combine public sources with premium vertical data and shape the result into a product for a specific use case. This role owns that layer end to end. You decide which industries and use cases we productize. With the data team, you find and evaluate the public and premium data providers behind each one. You shape the product surface that sits on top.

You will sit with customers in these industries, learn how they actually work, and turn their needs and pain points into clear specs. You will build with engineering, ship it, and make sure go-to-market knows how to sell it. You own the outcome, not just the handoff: from the first market call through to adoption and revenue.

The hard part is choosing. There are more verticals worth building than we can build, and the difference between a good year and a wasted one is knowing which ones to invest in and which to walk away from, even when a large customer is asking for another.

In your first year, we expect you to know our top use cases better than anyone here, ship a product built for one of them that customers will pay more for, and have a defensible view of what comes next.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership. You will work within a small PM team reporting to the Director of Product, alongside engineering, research, data, and go-to-market.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Own the vertical roadmap. You decide where we invest, what we ship for each, and when a vertical is not worth it.
  • Shape the product surface on top of the data, so a customer gets something built for their job.
  • Find and evaluate the data behind each vertical, across public sources and paid providers, and decide what is worth investing in.
  • Sit with customers in these industries until you understand their workflow, then turn that into specs engineering can build.
  • Set what a good answer looks like in each use case, working with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it.
  • Work with customer success to learn what customers ask us for and what makes them leave.
  • Partner with the search owner on how results should be ranked and shaped for each use case.

We expect you to have: 

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion in search, data, or industry-specific AI products.
  • Experience building products for a specific industry or use case, combined with enough technical depth to work directly on the data underneath: where it comes from, how good it is, and what it takes to make it usable.
  • A track record of real customer discovery: you have gone deep on how a particular kind of team works, and shipped something because of what you found.
  • Experience in API-first or developer-platform businesses.
  • Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, and how search and retrieval systems fit into agentic workflows.
  • A technical background, through a degree in computer science or engineering or equivalent hands-on experience, with the ability to engage deeply with technical architecture and tradeoffs.
  • The ability to influence and align cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority.

It will be an added bonus if you have: 

  • Domain experience in market intelligence, news, financial research, or another data-heavy industry.
  • Background at a data provider, enrichment vendor, market intelligence platform, or vertical search company, or experience building vertical data products in-house.
  • Experience evaluating and working with external data providers, including judging quality and negotiating what you actually need.
  • Leadership experience in a high-growth technology company, especially post-acquisition or startup-within-a-larger-org environments.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI 

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire. 

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

descriptionHtml:
About the Role

We are hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our team. You will own how DataSnipper’s products are understood and chosen in a crowded AI landscape. You will be the voice of competition, the buyer, and the message across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Product. You will join a small Product Marketing team where your work directly affects pipeline growth globally.

About DataSnipper

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. That frees professionals to focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

We're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. Today, more than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on our platform, and in 2025 alone DataSnipper delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to its customers.

What We Offer

The Product Growth team within Run My Business turns new product launches into measurable merchant growth by connecting product strategy with go to market execution across SumUp's portfolio. Booking has just launched as a premium offering and the beauty industry has become a top priority category.
With both merchant and end-consumer facing interaction points, this role will help lead the charge by building and executing on a go to market playbook. It's a chance to shape positioning, launch readiness and merchant adoption for a product area SumUp is investing in heavily, working closely with Product, Go-to-market and Growth teams to accelerate SumUp's hold into the appointment management industry.

  • Own positioning, narrative and messaging for Booking with a focus on the beauty industry, including the Local marketplace, across marketing and in product touchpoints
  • Lead go to market readiness for every Booking and Local release, including sales and support material, web updates, frequently asked questions, pricing and messaging ahead of launch
  • Train and support frontline sales and operations teams so they can confidently sell and support new features from day one
  • Feed merchant, sales and support feedback into product roadmap discussions and help the team prioritise what to build next
  • Track feature adoption and activation after launch and use the data to refine go to market and channel strategy by market

What we're looking for…

  • Fluency in English, written and spoken, with the confidence to work across global and local teams.
  • Track record of defining positioning, messaging frameworks and go to market plans in a product marketing or GTM role, ideally in SaaS, payments or marketplace businesses.
  • Experience feeding merchant, sales or support insight into product roadmap decisions, not only executing go to market plans.
  • Ability to coordinate launches across Product, Sales, Growth and Operations without a formal reporting line into those teams.
  • Comfort building a competitive view of positioning, pricing and segmentation across multiple markets, and using adoption and conversion data to prioritise effort.

Why you should join SumUp

  • 🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup
  • 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced
  • 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education
  • 💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions
  • 🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days
  • 🎁 Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 39 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 4,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

As the Senior Product Marketing Manager you will own the narrative for UFORCE products: what each platform is for, whom it serves, and the language that makes both immediately clear. The positioning, messaging frameworks and arguments produced in this role are what the rest of the company works from - sales, press, government relations, the website and the exhibition stand.

The role is the bridge between the engineers who build the systems and the people who sell them. It requires sustained time with both, and with the operators who use the products, until the technology can be explained effortlessly.

It also carries custody of that language. The standard is uncompromising: no document that overclaims, no adjective that would not survive a procurement review. The narrative is expected to iterate at the pace of the products.

What you will do

  • Own positioning and messaging for products, and maintain the frameworks that keep it consistent across markets, languages and audiences.

  • Produce the materials the company sells with: one-pagers, capability briefs, specification sheets, sales decks, demonstration narratives and launch content.

  • Maintain a current assessment of the competitive landscape - the neo-primes, the incumbent primes and the low-cost entrants - and convert it into positioning rather than description.

  • Brief designers, 3D artists and film-makers so that a complex system is legible visually.

  • Provide PR, communications and government relations with the product substance their work depends on, and ensure claims remain consistent wherever they appear.

  • Lead go-to-market for new products and capabilities, covering audience, message, materials, sequencing and timing.

  • Travel to events, facilities and customer engagements.

Required Skills

  • Substantial experience marketing hardware or software within a technology company, including ownership of at least one launch from positioning through to market.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives without loss of accuracy.

  • Exceptional writing and editing across registers. Copy for engineers, procurement, investors and press are four distinct disciplines.

  • The ability to brief a creative such that the resulting image or video explains a system rather than decorating it.

  • A record of cross-functional work with product and engineering teams, and a willingness to keep asking elementary questions until the answer is clear.

  • Ability to obtain UK national security clearance if required

Nice to have

  • Experience in defence, dual-use or uncrewed systems, whether in industry or in service

  • Experience working with engineering or operational teams remotely

  • Complementary skills in design or video

The nature of combat has changed.

Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability.

And UFORCE is ready.

Are You?

Our cloud-based accounting software transforms the finance function, making it easier for multi-entity businesses to capture, process, and report their financial data with ease and efficiency.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to take the foundations set out in our growth strategy, our product vision and our customer focus and drive a throughline across every team, every launch and every customer touchpoint. You'll report to our Product Director and work closely with marketing, sales, account management, implementation and customer success, so the whole business tells the same story to the right customers. 

It's a hands-on role that balances strategy, operations and execution. You’ll inform critical decisions, do the work yourself and build the systems that let it scale. You'll also be the voice of our product, inside the business and out. There's plenty of room for this role to grow as the function does. 

What you'll be doing:

Understand 

  • Know our best fit customers better than anyone. Deepen our understanding of who we serve best, our core segments and the people involved in buying and using our products. Feed that directly into product decisions, and make sure messaging and launches are built around it. 
  • Reset competitive intelligence. Build a clear view of the landscape that helps teams win against the systems customers are outgrowing and the alternatives they're weighing up. 

Shape 

  • Develop the complete value proposition. Work with product and service leads so today's product, what's coming and the service experience (onboarding, implementation and customer success) all deliver on our positioning. 
  • Shape how customers see what we offer. Help evolve how our products and services are structured, named and packaged, in step with the roadmap, so the offer is easy to understand, shows where it's heading and gives every launch an obvious place to fit. 
  • Connect product value to commercial results. Understand how each release adds value for customers, and help us capture it in new business, expansion and retention. Measure the impact of launches and enablement on pipeline, win rates and adoption. 

Deliver 

  • Lead the go-to-market rhythm. Run how product, marketing and customer-facing teams across our product family prepare for and deliver launches, so the right work happens at the right time and everyone knows where things stand. 
  • Be the voice of our product. Speak at customer roadshows, events and webinars, and give our point of view on market shifts, such as what AI means for finance leaders in the UK and Ireland. 
  • Strengthen our core, open up what's next. Make our proven go-to-market motion sharper while building new ones for the new segments our product roadmap opens up.  
  • Enable the whole business. Make sure every team, from sales and customer success to support and product, understands our customers, segments, competitors and positioning well enough to move their own work forward at pace. Clear enough to act on, deep enough to rely on. 
  • Turn positioning into pipeline. Work hand in hand with demand generation on campaign messaging, ABM plays, paid copy and outbound sequences. 
  • Build a go-to-market system that stays current. Use AI and automation to keep customer and market insight flowing in, and keep messaging, battle cards, proof and customer stories up to date and easy to find. 

What you'll need:

  • Typically six or more years in B2B SaaS product marketing, including launches for a product bought through a considered, sales-led process. 
  • Experience being part of building or scaling a product marketing function, ideally in a scale-up. 
  • Scale-up instincts. You know what breaks as a business outgrows its earlier stage habits, and how to fix it. 
  • Hands-on use of AI to run product marketing better: synthesising research, keeping content current, and building workflows that save the team time, with the judgement to know when the output is right. 
  • Ownership of positioning and messaging, seen through to how the business sells, onboards and supports customers. 
  • A track record of running go-to-market across product, sales and customer success, leading through influence rather than authority. 
  • Customer understanding you've built first-hand: interviews, win/loss, segmentation and personas, and evidence it changed what a product team built. 
  • Based in the UK or Ireland, with regular time in our London and Dublin offices. 

Desirable: 

  • Experience in finance, accounting or fintech software, especially selling to finance leaders 
  • Marketing a multi-product suite, or bringing products and teams together 
  • Working with an offer where experience (implementation, onboarding, customer success) is part of the value 

What's the hiring process?

  1. An initial call with our People Team to discuss your experience, career goals and interest in joining AccountsIQ.
  2. An interview with our Product Director and our Product Consultant to explore your product marketing experience, strategic approach and commercial impact.
  3. A short practical exercise presented to a panel from Product, Operations and Finance, focusing on your approach to positioning and bringing a product to market.

Why work with us?

AIQ Group brings together AccountsIQ and ExpenseIn, two ambitious SaaS businesses helping finance teams work smarter. In 2026, AccountsIQ was recognised as SaaS Provider of the Year at the International Accounting Awards and ranked #477 in the Financial Times FT1000 list of Europe's fastest-growing companies.

Following a €60M investment in 2024, we're continuing to grow our products, our people and our impact, making this an exciting time to join the business.

Our TEAM values aren't just words on a wall; they shape how we work every day:

  • Together - We work towards shared goals, support one another and celebrate success as one team.
  • Energy - We bring curiosity, positivity and urgency, focusing on what matters most for our customers and colleagues.
  • Action - We take ownership, make decisions and deliver with purpose.
  • Mindset - We embrace feedback, think big and continually raise the bar for ourselves and each other.

If you're looking for a business that's growing quickly, values collaboration and gives people the opportunity to make a genuine impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Some of our perks 

  • 28 days annual leave + bank holidays + your birthday off
  • Working from abroad - up to 6 weeks per calendar year 
  • Private Health Insurance 
  • 5% Pension contribution 
  • Life Assurance - 4 x Salary 
  • Income Benefit 
  • Wellbeing initiatives  

By submitting your application, you agree that AccountsIQ Group may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organisation planning, and related purposes. title: Senior Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
We are hiring a Senior Product Owner who gets energy from structure, flow and a perfectly organised backlog. Someone who wants to make sure great ideas actually reach healthcare professionals through product developments.

Our Mission
Attendi has already built a strong user base through speech-to-text integrations with electronic health record (EHR) vendors, used by over 300 care organisations in elderly and disability care. With the Attendi App, we are building a one-stop solution for AI-driven administration in healthcare: structured documentation, conversation summaries, voice-driven workflows and AI assistance, anytime, anywhere.

Our product and development team is growing fast. Our Product Lead, a former nurse, owns the what and the why: our users, the roadmap and experiments. To keep up with the pace, we’re looking for someone who owns the how and the when: turning that roadmap into well-structured, realistic and predictable delivery, together with our development team leads.

Your Role
As Senior Product Owner at Attendi, you will:

  • Translate roadmap items, experiments and MVPs into epics and user stories, with clear acceptance criteria and non-functional requirements (performance, security, privacy, platforms).

  • Own the development backlog in Jira: clear, up to date and one to two sprints ahead with work that’s ready to build.

  • Set up and guard our Definition of Ready and Definition of Done.

  • Prepare and lead refinement and sprint planning with our dev team leads.

  • Propose 6-week cycle goals and sprint goals, based on capacity, dependencies, risk and effort.

  • Propose the balance between features, bugs, tech debt and maintenance.

  • Be the first point of contact for developers on tickets, and handle small scope questions yourself.

  • Spot blockers, risks and delays early and solve them with the dev leads.

  • Help turn uncertain AI work into small, measurable experiments.

  • Accept delivered work, prepare phased rollouts and pilots, and write release notes for sales, implementation and support.

  • Make sure our requirements are traceable from requirement to story, test and release, as required for our medical device (MDR) certification.

  • Align technically with EHR vendors and partners on integrations, APIs and releases.

  • Make progress visible with Jira dashboards and delivery metrics.


You might be a good fit if you hit most or all of the following:

  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner in software product teams.

  • Strong command of Scrum and agile delivery, and you know when to adapt it.

  • Technical enough to discuss solutions with engineers, understand trade-offs and help make realistic estimates.

  • You keep the customer at the centre of the backlog, and link technical work to what users need.

  • You love structure: a clear backlog, a steady rhythm and predictable delivery give you energy.

  • Low ego, high ownership. You’re a builder who wants to ship a bit better every week.

  • You move fast, but carefully. You understand that in healthcare, getting it right matters.

  • Experience with Jira.

  • Fluent in English.

Strong candidates may also

  • Have a background in software engineering.

  • Have experience with AI products, and with an AI-native way of working.

  • Have worked in healthcare or another regulated environment, for example with MDR, IEC 62304 or similar.

  • Have worked with integrations and external partners.

  • Speak Dutch.

What we offer

  • Ideally 32 hours per week.

  • €6,000 - €7,000 per month (based on 40h)

  • Hybrid working: roughly half the week at home, half at our Amsterdam office.

  • Travel and lunch allowance.

  • Home office budget.

  • Lease bike.

  • Training budget of €1,500 per year.

  • Company MacBook.

  • ClassPass membership.

  • Pension contribution of 10% and roughly 7% paid by Attendi.

Our culture: People-oriented, curious, and proactive
At Attendi, you’ll work in a small, ambitious team that learns and builds together. We are empathetic, take initiative, dare to experiment, and stand by our work. Making mistakes is okay as long as you learn from them.

Application Process

  • Intro call with Roundr, our embedded recruitment partner

  • Interview with two people (product and engineering)

  • Case study: a take-home assignment you present at our office

  • Chat with our Product Lead

  • Offer, reference and pre-boarding

Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow.

We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy.

👥 About Our Team

We’re a team of around 30 curious minds working from our offices in Munich and Nuremberg – and remotely across Germany. We value ownership and a mindset driven by continuous learning. We take ideas seriously, see them through, and aren’t afraid to roll up our sleeves when challenges arise. title: Senior Projectmanager
descriptionHtml:
Jouw Missie bij CCS

Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam.

Voordelen voor de sollicitant

Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar).

Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks.

En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch?


Een voorbeeld van je werkdag

Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen.

Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan.

Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant.

Wie jij bent

De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten:

· Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten;

· Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope;

· Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat;

· Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig;

· Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift;

· Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch;

· Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties;

· Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij:

· Salaris: We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis;

· Middelen: Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon;

· Werkdagen: Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar, al heeft 5 dagen onze voorkeur;

· Vergoeding voor thuiswerken: Je kunt gedeeltelijk thuiswerken en krijgt een onkostenvergoeding van € 2,40 per thuiswerkdag. Ook krijg je een budget van € 750,- om thuis een ergonomische werkplek in te richten;

· Workation: Je kunt tot 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken;

· Leuke teamactiviteiten: Leer je collega’s beter kennen door deel te nemen aan maandelijkse evenementen georganiseerd door ons energieke Fun-team, zoals een pubquiz, Zomer BBQ, wine & beer tastings en movie night;

· Vakantiedagen: Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om maximaal 20 extra dagen bij te kopen;

· Groei en ontwikkeling: De mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden en verantwoordelijkheden te ontwikkelen binnen de functie, middels opleidingen en Linkedin learning, of door te stromen naar een van de andere functies binnen CCS;

· Vakantiegeld: Jaarlijks 8,33%;

· Voordelen: Je krijgt een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met een lage eigen bijdrage en kunt gebruikmaken van collectieve verzekeringen met korting. Ook is er een bedrijfsfitnessregeling voor een gezonde levensstijl en een fietsregeling voor duurzaam vervoer.

Waarom CCS?

Omdat wij geloven dat werk meer is dan een baan. Het is een plek waar je jezelf kunt zijn, impact kunt maken en kunt groeien. Het is een omgeving waar je wordt geïnspireerd om het beste uit jezelf te halen en samen te werken aan een duurzame toekomst. Kom bij ons en ontdek wat er mogelijk is als je een carrière bouwt vol passie, plezier en betekenis. Jij bent de ontbrekende schakel in ons team. Word onderdeel van ons verhaal. 🚀

title: Senior Projektleiter (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Rolle bei uns

Du übernimmst die übergreifende Steuerung großer Kundenaccounts mit mehreren parallelen IT- und Softwareentwicklungsprojekten. Dabei verantwortest du Termine, Budgets, Ressourcen, Qualität und Risiken und führst Projektmanager und Projektteams fachlich.
Dein Fokus liegt auf einer belastbaren, projektübergreifenden Steuerung. Du erkennst Risiken und Abhängigkeiten frühzeitig und greifst gezielt ein, wenn Projekte aus der Spur geraten. Als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, Projektteams und Delivery Management sorgst du dafür, dass komplexe Kundenaccounts erfolgreich gesteuert werden.

Aufgaben

  • Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Steuerung komplexer IT-Projekte, Programme oder größerer Kundenaccounts mit mehreren parallel laufenden Projekten.

  • Du bist erfahren in der Steuerung anspruchsvoller Kunden und im Umgang mit Management- und Entscheidungsebenen.
  • Du bist in der Lage, kritische Projektsituationen schnell zu erfassen, geeignete Maßnahmen einzuleiten und Projekte nachhaltig zu stabilisieren.
  • Du verfügst über ein solides Verständnis von Softwareentwicklungsprojekten, IT-Architekturen und modernen Entwicklungsprozessen.
  • Du denkst unternehmerisch und verstehst die wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhänge von IT-Projekten.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift auf mindestens C1-Niveau.

Womit du zusätzlich punktest

  • Du bringst Erfahrung aus dem IT-Beratungs-, Softwareentwicklungs- oder IT-Dienstleistungsumfeld mit.
  • Du hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Plane, Moco oder vergleichbaren Werkzeugen.
  • Du verfügst über Zertifizierungen wie IPMA, PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum oder vergleichbare Qualifikationen.
  • Du hast bereits kritische oder eskalierte IT-Projekte erfolgreich stabilisiert.
  • Du interessierst dich für aktuelle Entwicklungen im Bereich Künstliche Intelligenz und nutzt moderne KI-gestützte Werkzeuge, um Transparenz, Effizienz und Qualität im Projekt- und Programmmanagement weiter zu steigern.

Benefits

title: Senior Proposal Writer
descriptionHtml:
At OneStream, we're on a mission to empower every Finance organization and professional to exceed their potential. Our global teams span continents, cultures, and time zones, united by a shared purpose as we build the operating system for modern Finance and help organizations move with greater speed, clarity, and confidence.

That mission comes to life through our people. Behind every innovation, customer success, and milestone are talented people working together to make a difference. That's why we're looking for people who are bold enough to think big, authentic in how they lead and collaborate, curious about what's possible, and committed to delivering results.

Want a closer look before you apply? Explore our Careers site to learn more about our people, culture, and benefits.

Senior Proposal Writer- Open to UK, France and Netherlands

The Senior Proposal Writer leads the most complex, high-stakes and non-standard RFX responses from intake to submission, as a trusted partner to Sales. Alongside Solution Consulting and subject-matter experts, this role guides strategy shaping, pulls the contributions together and delivers proposals that are clear, accurate and give buyers confidence in the outcomes OneStream delivers. The role also coaches other writers and helps raise the standards, content and tools the whole team works with. 

Primary Duties and Responsibilities 

  • Lead complex, high-stakes and non-standard RFI, RFP and RFQ responses from intake to submission, maintaining the highest standards of execution and submission integrity. 
  • Work with Sales to understand the deal behind each response (the buyer’s priorities, the competition, the evidence that builds confidence) and shape the proposal around it. 
  • Coordinate concurrent contributions from Sales, Solution Consulting, Finance, Legal, Product and other specialist teams. 
  • Set and run the project cadence (including kick-off, RFP tool setup, check-ins, reviews, packaging and close-down), creating clarity, facilitating multiple contributors and consistently meeting deadlines and milestones. 
  • Take each response over the line, checking structure, formatting, accuracy and clarity before it goes. 

Knowledge & Continuous Improvement 

  • Keep knowledge of OneStream’s platform and competitive positioning current, and catch outdated or inaccurate product information before it goes out. 
  • Spot gaps and help close them, in how responses are crafted and positioned and in the standards, workflows, templates, tools and content library behind them. 
  • Turn lessons from completed proposals and their outcomes into guidance, content and examples the whole team can use. 
  • Use AI tools thoughtfully across the workflow, and share the prompts and practices that improve insight, quality, consistency and pace. 

Collaboration, Coaching & Influence 

  • Build strong relationships with the teams relied on, know their remit and boundaries, and route requests well so that colleagues’ time is used efficiently. 
  • Coach junior and mid-level writers with practical feedback on their work and the thinking behind strong proposal decisions, and help new joiners get up to speed. 
  • Shape how the team approaches content, quality and process, and model the standards expected of the team. 

Competencies 

  • Sound judgement on structure, messaging and emphasis when requirements are ambiguous, incomplete or non-standard, a willingness to adapt when the standard approach doesn’t fit, and ownership of the decisions made. 
  • Influence without direct authority, built on trust. 
  • The confidence to hold a reasoned position with Sales on quality and standards, with an open mind and a realistic view of what each deal needs. 
  • A commercial view of how proposals drive revenue, and the focus to put effort where it most influences the buyer’s decision. 
  • Self-motivation and accountability, working independently and delivering as part of a team. 
  • A habit of learning, spotting opportunities in their own skills and developing them. 

Required Education and Experience 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Communications, English, Marketing or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
  • Seven or more years writing and managing RFI, RFP and RFQ responses, working alongside sales teams on competitive, high-value deals. 
  • Professional experience using AI tools in a writing, editing or content workflow. 
  • Experience coaching or mentoring colleagues and contributing to team knowledge sharing. 

Preferred Education and Experience 

  • Experience in a cloud or SaaS environment, ideally in finance or a related domain. 
  • Experience with Ombud or a comparable proposal management platform. 
  • Experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM in opportunity and proposal workflows. 
  • APMP preferred but not required. 

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities 

  • Ability to analyse complex business processes, enterprise technology and buyer requirements, and work out what they mean for the response and where the gaps are. 
  • Exceptional writing, editing and verbal communication, turning complex technical, business and commercial information into accurate, persuasive content. 
  • Ability to prioritise competing projects, manage time effectively and stay accurate as deadlines shift. 
  • Solid grasp of sales frameworks, buyer enablement, and revenue operations. 

Supervisory Responsibilities 

n/a. 

Travel 

Regular travel is not expected for this position.

title: Senior Propulsion Engineer - Electric Engine (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

As a Senior Propulsion Engineer – Electric Engine, you will drive the development of the electric engine for the VÆRIDION Microliner. You will act as VÆRIDION’s internal technical expert for the complete electric engine, including the motor and controller. You will be responsible for decomposing aircraft-level requirements into engine requirements, guiding technical decisions, and ensuring compliance with applicable certification requirements.

Working closely with the engine supplier, you will critically review and challenge the engine architecture, detailed design, technical analyses, test results and certification evidence. You will maintain a holistic technical overview of the complete electric engine, including the electric machine, engine controllers, power electronics, thermal management, mechanical interfaces, control functions and supporting hardware and software.

As a senior member of the Propulsion team, you will play a key role in technical decision-making, supplier management, testing and certification activities, helping to bring one of the world's most advanced electric aircraft propulsion systems into service.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead the development and certification of the electric engine throughout its complete lifecycle, from requirements definition through testing and certification

  • Act as VÆRIDION’s electric engine subject-matter expert and primary technical counterpart to the external engine supplier.

  • Define, maintain and manage electric engine requirements, interfaces, operating limitations and verification strategies.

  • Review and challenge supplier architectures, designs, calculations, simulation models, and substantiation reports, identifying technical gaps and proposing solutions.

  • Evaluate the electric engine performance across its operating envelope, including efficiency, dynamic response, control stability, thermal limits and performance margins.

  • Contribute to system safety activities, including Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA), Failure Mode Effect Analyses (FMEA) and System Safety Assessments (SSA), in accordance with applicable airworthiness and safety standards.

  • Identify and assess applicable certification requirements, means of compliance and industry standards, including relevant aspects of EASA SC E-19, and ensure that certification considerations are addressed throughout the development cycle.

  • Coordinate the electric engine development and qualification test campaigns, in collaboration with the testing team, including the definition of test plans, objectives, and success criteria.

  • Review and assess test results, identify technical risks and deviations, and coordinate the resolution of issues encountered during testing.

  • Prepare and review technical documentation, including specifications, interface documents, design reviews, qualification reports, and compliance statements.

  • Support prototype build, aircraft integration and ground/flight testing activities throughout the maturation of the propulsion system

 

Your Profile:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related technical field.

  • At least 8 years of relevant professional experience in the development, integration or testing of electric motors, engine controllers/inverters or integrated electric-drive systems.

  • Strong knowledge of electric machines and power electronics, including motor topologies, inverter architectures, operating characteristics & limits, losses & thermal behaviour, motor control strategies & protection functions, and manufacturing processes.

  • Broad understanding of electric engine development, including thermal management, insulation systems, high-voltage systems, EMC, mechanical integrity, reliability & durability, and system integration.

  • Experience defining and managing technical requirements, specifications, interfaces and verification strategies for electric engines or electric-drive systems.

  • Experience collaborating with external development partners, engineering service providers or aerospace suppliers.

  • A high degree of self-motivation, resilience, reliability and precision, combined with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Strong analytical, technical-writing and written communication skills.

  • Excellent verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in another European language is an asset.

  • Passionate about aviation and the electrification of the aviation industry.

  • Previous experience as a Certification Verification Engineer or in a comparable compliance-related role is a plus.

  • Familiarity with EASA SC E-19 and its application to electric or hybrid propulsion systems would be an advantage.

  • Experience in verification, validation and qualification of electric engines, including performance, thermal, endurance and environmental testing, would be a plus.

  • Previous experience working within an EASA Part 21J Design Organisation or an international equivalent is a plus.

  • Knowledge of systems engineering and safety assessment methodologies, such as SAE ARP4754A and ARP4761, would be beneficial.

  • Specialized expertise in thermal management, high-voltage insulation systems, EMC, electric machine mechanics and vibration, or propulsion-system integration is an advantage.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

You will be responsible for decomposing aircraft-level requirements into engine requirements, guiding technical decisions, and ensuring compliance with applicable certification requirements.

Working closely with the engine supplier, you will critically review and challenge the engine architecture, detailed design, technical analyses, test results and certification evidence. You will maintain a holistic technical overview of the complete electric engine, including the electric machine, engine controllers, power electronics, thermal management, mechanical interfaces, control functions and supporting hardware and software.

title: Senior Prototype Machinist
descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:
About us

Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 100+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role

Thousands of rental companies run their business on Rentman, and many of them depend on it talking smoothly to the rest of their stack: accounting packages, webshops, calendars, and our public API. When an integration breaks, invoices don’t sync, bookings go missing, and customers notice fast.

As Senior QA Specialist for the Integrations team, you make sure every release reaches those customers without regressions. You own the team’s test strategy and lead the move from manual release-day testing to an automated, shift-left suite. This is a role with real ownership: you shape how the team thinks about quality, and you grow the practice as our integrations platform grows.

What you'll do

  • Join refinement with the Integrations team and write Gherkin (Given/When/Then) acceptance specs that developers turn into tests

  • Test new integrations and API changes end to end: our side, the partner’s side, and everything that can go wrong between them (auth, rate limits, partial syncs, retries, data mapping)

  • Explore beyond the acceptance criteria to find edge cases, and file clear, reproducible bug reports in Jira

  • Build and maintain automated tests in TypeScript, with API and contract tests alongside Playwright E2E tests, and review the tests developers write in pull requests

  • Own the daily automated regression run in GitHub Actions: triage failures the same day and fix flaky tests at the root cause, including ones caused by unreliable third-party sandboxes

  • Run release-day regression and the OWASP ZAP security scan, and give a clear go / no-go call

  • Migrate the remaining legacy tests and decide what’s worth automating and what stays manual

  • Coach developers so they own their tests, and organise QA days with the other product teams

     

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years in QA on web applications

  • Hands-on experience testing REST APIs and integrations with external systems (Postman, Playwright API testing or similar), including authentication flows like OAuth and webhooks

  • At least 2 years writing and maintaining test automation in code (Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, ideally TypeScript/JavaScript), not only record-and-play tools

  • Strong exploratory testing skills, with bug reports developers can act on without follow-up questions

  • You’ve defined a test strategy (what to automate, what to test manually, coverage), not only executed test cases

  • Experience running automated tests in CI (GitHub Actions or similar)

  • You get developers to adopt new habits through pairing, good examples and clear specs, not by policing

     

Nice to haves

  • Experience with complex B2B SaaS, ideally with a public API or integration marketplace

  • Contract testing (e.g. Pact) or mocking third-party services

  • Playwright specifically, and Gherkin / BDD

title: Senior Quality Engineer, Chassis and Powertrain
descriptionHtml:
Czinger Vehicles is redefining the future of automotive design and manufacturing. Founded in 2019, we're pioneering a new era of performance vehicles through revolutionary, proprietary technology that blends human-AI design with sustainable manufacturing. Our flagship 21C hypercar, celebrated as the world’s fastest production vehicle and for its record-setting runs at Goodwood Hill Climb, Circuit of the Americas, and Laguna Seca, showcases the innovation behind over 550 patents in AI-driven generative design, materials, and additive manufacturing. With our three core pillars of dominating performance, iconic design, and revolutionary technology, Czinger is at the intersection of deep technology, consumer products, and high-performance branding. We invite you to join our world-class talent in shaping the future of the automotive industry. Here, you'll be part of a groundbreaking journey that pushes the limits of performance, design, technology, and sustainability. 

Purpose

The Senior Quality Engineer is responsible for driving quality performance across the assigned products and supplier base throughout the full product lifecycle, from supplier development and production readiness through launch, current production and issue resolution.

The primary responsibility for this role is the Chassis vehicle system, with additional execution support for selected Powertrain suppliers and activities within the UK, including the Powertrain Controls interface. The role requires a high level of ownership, practical judgement and technical understanding.

Effective cross functional collaboration to identify quality risks early, develop effective solutions and ensure robust implementation. Working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and suppliers, the Senior Quality Engineer will take ownership of quality concerns, drive supplier performance and support the continuous improvement of Quality Engineering processes, standards and practices.

The Role

Supplier Development & Production Readiness

  • Support supplier selection by assessing manufacturing capability, process maturity and identify key quality risks and required actions before supplier nomination.
  • Apply the Supplier Qualification Framework and lead or coordinate the appropriate APQP, PPAP, audit and production-readiness activities.
  • Review key manufacturing controls, including FMEAs, Control Plans, inspection strategy, process capability and validation evidence, challenging gaps and driving actions where controls are not adequate.
  • Drive supplier-development actions and ensure significant supplier or manufacturing changes receive appropriate validation and requalification before implementation.

Supplier Execution & Current Quality

  • Own Quality Engineering follow-up for assigned suppliers and components  after launch, monitoring performance and emerging risks, proactively driving improvement.
  • Lead containment, root-cause analysis and corrective action for significant supplier-related concerns, verifying sustainable prevention of recurrence, including clear ownership, timing and evidence of effectiveness.
  • Determine when supplier visits, additional controls, escalation or supplier-development activities are required, using risk and data to determine the appropriate level of response.
  • Own and coordinate incoming inspection requirements for assigned parts when defined by the Supplier Qualification Framework or required as part of issue containment, including stock checks, increased inspection and verification of subsequent purchase orders until confidence in product quality is restored.
  • Provide local UK execution support for selected Powertrain suppliers while maintaining alignment with the Powertrain system owner and relevant Engineering teams.

Product Quality & Ticket Management

  • Own and coordinate the Product-quality ticket landscape for the assigned vehicle system, including Issues, Enhancements, FAR’s (Field Action Requests) and other applicable concerns.
  • Ensure concerns are clearly defined, prioritised and progressed with appropriate containment, technical ownership and corrective action.
  • Coordinate resolution across Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and suppliers, clearly escalating significant or ageing risks when progress is insufficient.
  • Maintain alignment between supplier-level actions and Product-level resolution, including support to Powertrain activities when assigned.

Quality Documentation & Standards

  • Support the development, implementation and continuous improvement of Quality Engineering standards and documentation, using lessons learned from practical supplier and product quality experience.
  • Ensure applicable requirements are understood and consistently deployed internally and within the supplier base.
  • Capture lessons learned from supplier and Product-quality concerns into standards covering areas such as qualification, APQP/PPAP, inspection, critical characteristics, supplier changes and structured problem solving.
  • Promote effective and proportionate quality controls without unnecessary complexity or bureaucracy.

Basic Qualifications

  • Strong ownership and a track record of taking complex issues through to effective closure, with the ability to work independently and make sound decisions in a fast-moving environment.
  • Practical experience in Quality Engineering, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Engineering or a related technical environment, ideally within a high-complexity manufacturing environment.
  • Hands-on experience working with suppliers and manufacturing processes, with sound structured problem-solving capability.
  • Working knowledge of APQP, PPAP, FMEA, Control Plans and production-process qualification, with the ability to apply these tools practically and proportionally.
  • Ability to understand engineering drawings, specifications and technical requirements, and translate them into practical quality controls. Previous GD&T experience is a plus.
  • Confidence working cross-functionally and constructively challenging suppliers or internal stakeholders when required, whilst maintaining effective working relationships.
  • Ability to prioritise in a fast-moving environment, combining a practical, data-driven approach with sound judgement, and focus effort on the highest quality risks.
  • Strong communication, curiosity and willingness to develop a detailed understanding of the product and manufacturing process, with the ability to communicate technical quality risks clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within automotive, motorsport, aerospace or other high-complexity manufacturing environments is essential.
  • Chassis or Powertrain experience is advantageous but not essential where strong transferable technical capability can be demonstrated.
  • Experience with low-volume, high value, high performance and technically complex products is particularly relevant to the role.

Work Environment

  • Onsite

  • Holistic Compensation Package: Enjoy a world-class compensation package that includes a competitive salary, equity plan, and discretionary results-based incentive bonus opportunities, ensuring you're truly valued for your contributions.
  • Wellness and Time Off: Embrace a healthy lifestyle with paid vacation, sick time, and company holidays, including a year-end shutdown to recharge. We support growing families with paid parental leave, recognizing the importance of bonding time.
  • Comprehensive Health and Wellness: Prioritize your well-being with our comprehensive health and wellness benefits, offering both HMO and Premium PPO options. Additionally, benefit from company-sponsored life insurance and short and long-term disability coverage for peace of mind.

Together, we're disrupting the traditional manufacturing industry, fostering innovation, and integrating people and technology to reduce our footprint.
