title: Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Signal AI, we use cutting-edge AI technology to offer clarity on decisions that shape businesses and society. We value restless curiosity, creative thinking, and diverse perspectives as we strive to become AI-native. We believe that AI is a collaborator, not just a tool, and we invite passionate individuals to join us on our journey as we continue to learn, experiment, and grow together.

About the role

Engineers at Signal AI are expected to bring a strong product mindset to their work. They’re comfortable with complex problems and proactively look for ambiguous ones rather than wait for others to resolve them, and work wherever the product needs them across the full stack. Engineers work closely with other disciplines, including applied research and design, as part of teams that own revenue-critical products from ideation through to production.

Owning a product end to end means much of an engineer’s time goes on understanding the problem: talking to colleagues in research, design and product, testing assumptions, and deciding what is worth building.

Our engineering teams are organised around the needs of the business. We value collaboration and teamwork, and we believe the best solutions to complex problems come from working together. You will work primarily within a small cross-functional team, contributing to its architecture and to engineering standards. You will provide clear, focused technical plans for current and future solutions, and you will keep the long-term technical vision in view.

AI-assisted development is part of everyday work across the organisation. We expect engineers to use tools like Claude Code to move quickly across the entire software development lifecycle, so more of their time is spent on the product questions that matter.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Building intuitive user interfaces and data visualisations that unlock valuable insights for our customers.

  • Building services that can cope with large volumes of data.

  • Implementing and maintaining the AWS infrastructure that supports the services owned by the team.

  • Build, maintain and evolve large-scale distributed systems, ensuring they remain resilient.

  • Building observability into everything you ship (logging, metrics, alerting).

  • Owning BAU in your primary domain and building enough operational familiarity with the other domains to support incidents, understand cross-domain interactions, and describe architectural boundaries.

  • Collaborating with Product and Design to define and scope the products we build.

  • Communicating with other teams and stakeholders when needed.

  • Working in a collaborative environment. Pairing for most of your time, giving and receiving reviews, and helping to uphold the team’s shared quality standard.

Working with AI

This is not specifically an AI Engineer role, but every senior engineer in this team is expected to be AI-literate, in two directions: using AI to build better, and building AI into the product responsibly.

  • Keep your practice current. Use current models, coding agents and agent tooling in your daily work, and re-test earlier assumptions as capabilities change; what was unreliable six months ago may be routine today.

  • Open mind, evidence-led. Give a new tool, pattern or model a fair chance and evaluate it against our own codebases and workflows before ruling it out. Push back when something is presented as a silver bullet and adopting it would bring more risk, or more change, than the team can absorb. Make both calls on evidence, not on instinct or hype.

  • Quality bar parity. Agent-generated code and content are held to the same standard as human work. Review it, test it and secure it the same way.

  • Build to learn. A working prototype in front of a Product owner or a customer beats a slide. Be as willing to report a disappointing result as an exciting one, and kill weak ideas early.

  • Design the human checkpoints and watch the cost. For agentic features, define what the system may decide alone, what needs approval and what escalates, and keep token and run costs visible alongside the value delivered.

  • Share what you learn. Contribute to how the team adopts AI across the whole lifecycle (planning, review, testing and release, not only coding) and share your findings with the team and the wider P&T group, so practice spreads beyond one person.

The Signal AI Way

We want you to apply for this position. We want people to enjoy a good experience at Signal AI and we appreciate your professional needs might be different to what we can offer.

  • Thriving in Dynamic Environments: If you thrive on stability and predictability, you might find our dynamic environment challenging. Our team frequently adapts to changing priorities, which can be incredibly exciting and rewarding for those who enjoy a fast-paced, ever-evolving workplace.

  • Versatile Skill Set: We value versatility and the ability to work on both back-end and front-end development, and across two product domains. If you are passionate about expanding your skills across different areas, you'll find this role enriching and fulfilling.

  • Collaborative Communication: Our culture emphasises building strong communication paths with various teams and stakeholders, including the Editorial team that depends on our tooling every day. If you enjoy collaborative problem-solving and sharing insights, you'll fit right in.

  • Team-Oriented Programming: We encourage pair programming and team collaboration over solo work. If you find joy in teamwork and learning from peers, you'll thrive here.

  • Flexible Coding Approaches: While we respect the discipline of TDD, we also appreciate flexible and innovative approaches to coding, and we prioritise observability over exhaustive test coverage. If you're open to experimenting with different methodologies, this role offers a great opportunity to broaden your horizons.

  • Leveraging AI: We're not just building AI products; we use AI to build better. We expect our engineers to actively explore and adopt AI tools that make them more productive, and to keep their critical thinking switched on while doing it.

  • Owning Our Systems: When something goes wrong in production, we don't point fingers. We fix it, learn from it, and improve our observability to catch it earlier next time.

If these aspects align with your professional values and aspirations, we believe you'll find a rewarding career with us at Signal AI.

About Signal

At Signal we want to help organisations identify risks and opportunities and see movements in the market before anyone else. We want to help leaders make bold decisions, safe that the data is on their side. We want to connect all those external data points together, uncover the unknown unknowns, and be at the very heart of the knowledge economy.

We’ve already built a world-class artificial intelligence platform for real-time information aggregation and analysis at a massive scale. We proved our value with monitoring and measurement products in the PR & Comms space, and are now joining the dots beyond.

We are friendly and informal people who are passionate about our brand as we all have a stake in our success. We have an inclusive environment, welcoming the skills and experience from many diverse backgrounds, and together we have created who we are and what we sell. We are proud of our achievements and continue to strive for the unknown.

Not sure you meet every requirement? Studies show that women and other underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they check every box. At Signal AI, diverse perspectives strengthen our teams, drive innovation, and lead to better performance. So even if your background doesn’t align perfectly with each qualification, we encourage you to apply if you’re passionate about this role.

We're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every Signaller feels welcomed, valued, and heard—a place where you can truly thrive as yourself.

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Product

In a rapidly evolving world, trust in AI depends on AI agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. Search is the foundation that makes this possible. We are building an agent-native search platform designed specifically for AI systems rather than human users. Our product provides programmatic, low-latency, and observable search APIs that AI agents use to retrieve, filter, and reason over real-world information at scale.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work on the rendering infrastructure of a novel search engine tailored for agentic AI consumption.

In this role, you will focus on loading modern web pages in a browser that we patch and build ourselves, so that content is rendered completely and reliably at a cost that works across billions of pages. You will work inside Chromium to remove what we do not need, make the rest faster and cheaper, and keep our build current as Chromium moves. Your work ensures that high-quality content is consistently available to the indexing and retrieval systems downstream.

In this position, your responsibility will be to

  • Change Chromium in its heavy core (Blink, the V8 integration, the compositor, the network service) to cut CPU, memory and startup cost per page
  • Strip Chromium down for agent workloads: skip what nobody needs, such as image and media decoding, web font downloads, and rasterization and GPU work where no one needs pixels, while keeping what page scripts depend on to run correctly (style, layout, animation frames, observers), and work out what breaks, or renders differently, when you do
  • Keep the browser compatible with the web: make sure that what we remove does not change how the sites we load behave or render
  • Profile and tune fleets of browsers: the process model, memory per renderer, startup, isolation and crash handling
  • Build the production system around it: how browsers are launched, pooled, recycled and monitored

You may be a good fit if you

Have 5+ years of experience building production systems, and are an expert in several of the following areas.

Inside the browser

  • Strong C++ in a large, performance-critical codebase, ideally Chromium, Blink or V8, or a comparable browser engine (Rust is a plus)
  • Chromium architecture: the process model, Mojo IPC, the rendering pipeline (DOM, style, layout, paint, compositing), and the network service
  • Building, debugging and shipping custom Chromium builds: the build system, tracing, crash analysis, and maintaining patches across releases

Performance and systems

  • Profiling CPU, memory and I/O for browser fleets, with tools such as perf, tracing and flame graphs
  • Linux process isolation and resource management, concurrency, and memory management
  • Have run browsers in production, or built the infrastructure that does, and can describe where the time and memory went

Strong candidates may also have experience with

  • Contributions to Chromium, Blink, V8, Firefox, WebKit or another browser engine
  • Building or maintaining a patched browser that you wrote the patches for
  • Browser instrumentation, including the Chrome DevTools Protocol
  • Working familiarity with how modern frontend frameworks render (SSR, CSR, streaming, hydration)
  • Distributed systems, Kubernetes, and Go or Python

The kind of problems you will work on

  • Cut the cost of loading a page in half. Where do CPU and memory go, and what would you change in the browser?
  • Turn off the GPU and image decoding for agent workloads. What breaks, and what changes in how pages load and render?
  • A page runs a script that never yields. How do we detect and stop it without help from the page?
  • Chromium ships a new version. How do we bring a large set of patches forward in days, not weeks?
  • Decide when a page is finished, for pages with analytics beacons, long polling and endless scrolling.

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Senior Software Engineer (AI/Data)
descriptionHtml:
About Codat

Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work.

Founded in 2017 and backed by JPMorgan, PayPal, Amex, Plaid, and Shopify, Codat has successfully powered over 350,000 connections to business customers’ financial systems — and is trusted by industry leaders to turn scattered information into actionable, strategic advantages in real time, every time.

The Role

We're building the Advisory Intelligence Platform: Codat's client intelligence delivered inside the assistant a banker already uses (Microsoft Copilot first). Ask it anything about a client and it answers from the client's real books. Don't ask, and it still tells you what's changed, why it matters and what to do about it. Under it we're building the semantic layer, so every answer uses the same definitions, the signal layer that spots what's changed for a client, and the reasoning layer, a Codat-side LLM that turns those signals into advice. The first bank goes live this year. You'll be building the data and reasoning behind all of it.

This is a hands-on job for software engineers who want to build the systems a model reasons over, not configure a warehouse. Codat is AI-first, not AI bolted onto SaaS. The product lives inside the AI assistant our clients already use, and we build it the same way: agents do the repetitive work, engineers do the hard parts. You'll build it and you'll run it. Nobody hands it over the wall once it's live. You'll also get a real say in where it goes next. That means making your case to engineers, product and the commercial team, and bringing them along with you.

What You'll Work On

  • The semantic layer. Measures, dimensions and definitions the model is allowed to use, so every answer it gives is the same answer. Yours to grow, persona by persona.

  • The signal layer. Detecting what's changed for a client and surfacing it before the banker asks. You'll be designing and building this.

  • The reasoning layer. A Codat-side LLM that turns signals into advice. Our calculations are the ground truth it reasons over. You own the calculations the model relies on, and the names, definitions and structure that let it pick the right one.

  • The agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers behind the assistant. What tools it has, how they're built, how they fail, and the evals that prove they work.

  • Everything from raw source data to the number the assistant quotes: the pipelines, services and data models, with the testing and observability to prove the number is right and the evals that catch the model quoting the wrong one.

You'll Probably Have

  • Built production systems from scratch, writing the code yourself rather than configuring managed services. You think about interfaces, failure modes and how the next person will change your code. If we ask about the hardest system you've built, you'll have a story ready.

  • Served data to an LLM and seen where it goes wrong: ambiguous definitions, poor retrieval, no evals. You know why "the model will work it out" isn't a data strategy.

  • Worked with data along the way, and liked it. You may never have been called a data engineer. You've built things that move, shape and serve data, and you know how they break, and how a model breaks on top of them.

  • Solid C#, Python or another backend language. Your code comes with tests, and you leave things tidier than you found them.

  • Depth in at least one of SQL, Spark, Databricks/Delta Lake, Dagster/Airflow/Temporal or dbt. Bonus if you've shaped any of them into something a model can query, through a metrics layer, metric views or an MCP server.

  • Time with CI/CD, Docker, cloud infrastructure (we're on Azure) and observability. Even better if you set them up for a team.

  • An interest in the business behind the data. If someone asks for a number the data can't support, you'll say so, and you'll build the guard-rail so the model says so too.

  • Treated your own workflow as something to engineer. AI has already taken over the repetitive parts of it, and you're the person others ask how to do the same.

How We Work

We're a small team with plenty to do. Things move fast: we'd rather ship something useful and improve it than polish it in private. What you build is yours from start to finish.

There’s no return-to-office mandate, and you can work hybrid or fully remote. We trust you to be around when the team needs you and to deliver what you said you would. What we don’t want is anyone staying online late to prove a point.

Compensation: £95K – £120K • Offers Equity

title: (Senior) Software Engineer – AI (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Worum es geht

MAIA ist eine KI-Plattform für Unternehmen. Mit MAIA durchsuchen Teams ihre internen Daten und verankern Agenten tief in ihren Prozessen. Wir begleiten Unternehmen dabei, KI nicht nur in einzelnen Abteilungen, sondern im ganzen Unternehmen einzusetzen.

Technisch heißt das: Wir bauen eine GenAI-Anwendung mit eigenen Agentensystemen, RAG-Pipelines und agentenbasierten Workflows, binden externe Systeme unserer Kunden an und analysieren ihre Daten. Wir nutzen die besten verfügbaren Modelle, betrieben in der EU, und machen sie verlässlich für anspruchsvolle Arbeit mit großen, komplexen Datenmengen.

Zahlreiche Industrieunternehmen arbeiten seit Jahren intensiv mit MAIA. Nach unserer erfolgreichen Finanzierungsrunde 2026 bringen wir MAIA jetzt in die Breite. Entwickelt wird MAIA seit 2021 in Leipzig.

Was du bei uns machst

Als Software Engineer entwickelst du MAIA weiter und bestimmst von Anfang an mit, wie wir Probleme lösen.

Woran du arbeiten kannst:

  • Vom Konzept zum Feature. Gemeinsam mit dem Produktmanagement schärfst du grobe Konzepte und verantwortest Features vom Prototyp bis zur Weiterentwicklung anhand von Feedback und Nutzungsdaten.

  • Chat und Agenten. Du gestaltest, wie Menschen mit MAIA arbeiten: Fragen stellen, Kontext mitgeben und Agenten mehrstufige Aufgaben erledigen lassen – mit nachvollziehbarem Fortschritt und prüfbaren Ergebnissen.

  • Unternehmenswissen erschließen. Du bindest externe Systeme an und machst Wissen aus unterschiedlichen Dateiformaten nutzbar. So findet MAIA die richtigen Stellen, liefert Antworten mit Quellen und hält dabei bestehende Zugriffsrechte ein.

  • Modelle und Qualität. Du integrierst neue Sprachmodelle und vergleichst Qualität, Kosten und Geschwindigkeit. Mit Evals erkennst du Fehler und verbesserst Antworten und Agenten systematisch.

  • Sicher, schnell und stabil. Du baust isolierte Umgebungen für die Ausführung von Code und Tools und verbesserst Antwortzeiten und Datenverarbeitung, damit MAIA auch bei großen Wissensbeständen zuverlässig läuft.

Was wir suchen

  • Solides Software Engineering. Du hast Backend-Systeme gebaut, ausgeliefert und über längere Zeit in Produktion betrieben. Architektur, API-Design, Datenmodellierung und asynchrone Verarbeitung sind dir vertraut. Schwache Architektur erkennst du auch dann, wenn ein Coding Agent sie geschrieben hat.

  • Sehr gut in mindestens einer unserer Sprachen. TypeScript, Python oder Go, am besten eine der statisch typisierten. Alle drei musst du nicht mitbringen. In die anderen arbeitest du dich ein.

  • Zu Hause im LLM-Ökosystem. Du hast echte Anwendungen mit LLMs gebaut, beruflich oder in komplexen eigenen Projekten. RAG, Embeddings, Vektorsuche und Tool Calling kennst du aus der Praxis, auch die Stellen, an denen sie scheitern. Neue Modelle und Frameworks probierst du aus eigenem Antrieb aus und trennst dabei Substanz von Hype. Produktionserfahrung mit LLM-Systemen ist ein großes Plus.

  • Messen statt vermuten. Du weißt, wie man Systeme testet und evaluiert, die auf dieselbe Frage nicht immer gleich antworten. Du baust die einfachste Lösung, die das Problem löst. Weitere Retrieval-Stufen, Prompt-Ketten oder Abstraktionen kommen erst dazu, wenn Messungen sie rechtfertigen.

  • Produktdenken. Du denkst an die Person, die mit MAIA unter Zeitdruck ein Angebot fertigstellen oder eine technische Frage klären muss. Du steigst gern früh in die Konzepte des Produktmanagements ein, stellst die richtigen Fragen und bringst eigene Lösungsideen ein, auch wenn noch nicht alles feststeht.

  • Agentisch arbeiten. Coding Agents gehören für dich zum Alltag. Du schreibst Pläne, die andere prüfen und auf denen Coding Agents aufbauen können, prüfst die Ergebnisse kritisch und weißt, wo sie helfen und wo nicht.

  • Sicherheit mitdenken. Unsere Kunden vertrauen uns ihr internes Wissen an. Mandantentrennung, Zugriffsrechte und sichere Entwicklung sind für dich selbstverständlich.

  • Klar kommunizieren. Du erklärst technische Zusammenhänge verständlich, auch gegenüber Produktmanagement, Customer Success und Vertrieb. Du sprichst sehr sicher Deutsch und ebenso Englisch.

Die Rolle umfasst keine Personalverantwortung. Ob du als Software Engineer oder Senior Software Engineer einsteigst, besprechen wir spätestens nach dem technischen Interview offen mit dir.

Arbeiten bei MAIA

Uns verbindet ein gemeinsames Ziel: ein richtig gutes Produkt zu bauen. Jede und jeder übernimmt Verantwortung für das eigene Thema. Wir haben Spaß an der Arbeit und sind stolz auf das, was unsere Kunden mit MAIA erreichen. Die Wege sind kurz, und Entscheidungen fallen schnell. Im Engineering-Team hinterfragen wir kritisch, wie wir entwickeln, und verbessern unsere Prozesse laufend, gerade in der agentischen Entwicklung.

Wir arbeiten gern zusammen in unserem Büro, zentral zwischen Innenstadt und Zoo, und kochen fast jeden Tag gemeinsam. An mindestens drei Tagen pro Woche sind wir vor Ort, an den übrigen arbeitest du, wo du möchtest. Wann dein Tag beginnt, legst du selbst fest.

  • Zugang zu aktuellen Frontier-Modellen und Coding Agents

  • Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungen, die zu deiner beruflichen Entwicklung passen

  • Zugang zu einer Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft

Vergütung

Das Jahresbruttogehalt liegt bei 75.000 bis 95.000 €. Wo du in dieser Spanne liegst, hängt von deinem Level ab. Darüber sprechen wir spätestens nach dem technischen Interview. Dazu kommt eine virtuelle Beteiligung über unser VSOP.

Bewerbung und nächste Schritte

Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte uns in ein paar eigenen Sätzen eine Frage: Warum willst du MAIA mitgestalten?

Wir arbeiten jeden Tag mit KI. Für diese Antwort zählt aber deine eigene Perspektive. Schreib sie deshalb bitte selbst, gern kurz und ohne Feinschliff.

Passt es, folgen ein 30-minütiges Kennenlernen, ein 90-minütiges technisches Interview und ein Abschlussgespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Nach jedem Schritt hörst du in der Regel innerhalb von zwei Werktagen von uns. Unser Ziel ist eine Entscheidung in rund drei Wochen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Job Overview 

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer specialising in Generative AI and Large Language Models, with a strong focus on agentic systems, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, and AI evaluations, to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will play a pivotal role in architecting and delivering production-grade AI solutions that meet complex business objectives effectively. This position requires a blend of expertise in modern AI technologies and software engineering, along with a passion for staying at the forefront of  advancements.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and operate multi-agent workflows and tool-enabled agents, implementing orchestration logic, state management, safety guardrails, and fallback strategies for resilient production pipelines.
  • Architect and maintain end-to-end RAG systems, covering document ingestion, chunking, embedding, vector retrieval, reranking, and answer synthesis with a focus on quality, attribution, and latency.
  • Evaluate and integrate LLMs and GenAI services across cost, performance, and privacy dimensions, selecting the right mix of managed and in-house models.
  • Develop, version, and optimise prompting strategies; implement automated prompt testing and regression tracking to maintain output quality and reliability.
  • Define and own evaluation frameworks for generative outputs, including automated metrics, LLM-as-judge approaches, human evaluation protocols, hallucination detection, and drift monitoring.
  • Apply classical NLP techniques where appropriate and maintain awareness of data distribution shifts that could impact model behaviour in production.
  • Build and operate scalable, secure AI infrastructure on AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, OpenSearch), following well architected principles and infrastructure-as-code practices.
  • Own the full deployment lifecycle: CI/CD for models and agents, testing strategies, observability, and rollback procedures.
  • Ensure data quality through rigorous validation and augmentation, and proactively source datasets for training, fine-tuning, and evaluation.

Requirements & Skills:

  • Agent Orchestration: Production experience designing multi-agent systems with tool use, memory/state management, and fault-tolerant routing. Familiarity with LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or custom orchestrators.
  • RAG & Retrieval: Hands-on experience building RAG pipelines end-to-end: chunking, embedding models, vector databases, retrieval tuning, and answer synthesis at production scale.
  • Evaluations: Strong experience defining and running evaluation pipelines for generative AI — automated scoring, human evaluation design, hallucination mitigation, and drift monitoring. LLM-as-judge patterns are a plus.
  • LLMs & GenAI: Demonstrated experience with foundation models and GenAI providers (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta). Comfortable with fine-tuning, instruction tuning, and prompt engineering at scale.
  • Traditional NLP: Solid grounding in classical NLP techniques (NER, text classification, intent detection, topic modelling) and good judgement on when to apply them alongside or instead of LLMs.
  • AWS Bedrock: Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock: foundation model APIs, Bedrock Agents, Knowledge Bases, and Guardrails. Experience with Bedrock Model Evaluation is a plus.
  • AWS Ecosystem: Proficiency with SageMaker, Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, OpenSearch, IAM, CloudWatch, and VPC networking.
  • MLOps & CI/CD: Familiarity with model registries, CI/CD for ML, feature stores, canary deployments, monitoring, and rollback.
  • IaC: Experience with Terraform or AWS CDK for reproducible infrastructure provisioning.
  • Python: Production-quality Python: packaging, testing (pytest), type hints, async programming, and clean ML pipeline abstractions.
  • ML Frameworks: Familiarity with traditional ML frameworks and fine-tuning workflows.
  • Experiment Tracking: Experience with Langfuse, Arize or Langsmith, or equivalent for tracking runs, metrics, and artefacts.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business goals into concrete technical solutions and communicate tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong collaborative instincts — comfortable working across engineering, product, and data teams.
  • A rigorous, evidence-driven mindset: you ship with confidence because you measure, test, and monitor thoroughly.

Education:                         

  • A Master’s degree in Machine Learning, Computer Science with a preference for specialization in the NLP domain.

title: Senior Software Engineer – Automation Runtime
descriptionHtml:
About Routine Labs
A lot of critical work in Germany still happens in legacy software. Routine Labs automates it: we record the process, AI writes the automation, and only deterministic, testable code runs in production. Our clients are in regulated industries, where "it usually works" isn't good enough.

The role
You own the layer where generated automations meet real legacy software: making them run, noticing when they break, and producing the diagnosis that gets them fixed at the source.

What you'll do

  • Build the engine that drives legacy desktop apps reliably, including apps that were never designed to be automated and give you very little to work with.

  • Make automations hold up in remote and virtualized environments like RDP and Citrix, where the usual automation hooks often aren't available.

  • Own the runtime side of the repair loop: when an automation fails, the runtime should know why and hand the generation pipeline a diagnosis it can act on, instead of waiting for someone to patch it by hand. The fix itself is regenerated and reviewed, never hot-patched in production.

  • Build and own the replay infrastructure: real client recordings, replayed on our Windows VMs, with execution success tracked for every runtime change. Generation quality metrics run on top of it.

What you bring

  • You've built and run production Python systems that other people depended on.

  • You've automated desktop apps or built test/automation infrastructure, and you know why it breaks.

  • You've worked against Windows UI automation APIs (UI Automation, MSAA, Win32) or their equivalents, and you know what they don't expose.

  • You measure whether something works before claiming it does.

  • Business-fluent German and good English.

Bonus: Citrix/RDP, OCR or vision-based fallbacks, durable workflow engines like Temporal.

How we work & what we offer

  • We're a small team of 8 in Berlin. You'll work directly with our founding engineer. Engineers join client onboardings, because the best product decisions come from seeing real processes up close. Our stack is Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL and background jobs on a fleet of Windows VMs.

Join the team shaping the technical foundation of a company redefining how legacy software gets automated.

Why we exist

Every decision a business makes, from the suppliers it trusts to the risks it accepts, eventually shows up as spend. This makes spend data the most honest record of how a company operates. Not the strategy deck or the org chart: spend describes what really happened.

This record exists, but it's scattered across dozens of systems and decades of legacy technology. Companies spending billions a year still can't easily answer: Who are our suppliers? Where are we exposed? What are we paying for twice?

We believe a business that can't see itself clearly can't make great decisions. Deducta exists to give the world's most complex organisations a true picture of how they operate, and the intelligence to act on it. Our ambition is to become the category-defining platform for enterprise data intelligence.

How we do it

Most tools start and stop with dashboards. We start with the hard part: turning fragmented, messy enterprise data into a consistent foundation people can trust. Then we use AI to make it conversational, so anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer they can act on.

We're well funded, growing fast, and have already processed more than £1 trillion of spend for some of the world's largest and most recognisable companies. Our partners use Deducta to deliver major business transformations orders of magnitude faster.

Why this role matters

None of this works without the data. Every enterprise brings its own tangle of ERPs and legacy systems, and the usual answer is yet another integration. We think a new era of enterprise data intelligence needs a new way of thinking about data, not a new layer of the same plumbing.

You'll find new ways to reach and make sense of enterprise data, pairing the very best of AI with your own creativity to crack hard problems. You'll have real autonomy over how you approach it, in a small, high-trust team with genuine influence over architecture, product and how engineering grows.

Who you are

You're a senior backend engineer who enjoys hard, loosely defined problems and takes them all the way to production. You don't need a background in enterprise data or procurement. We care about how you think and the quality of what you've built.

You might be the right fit if you have:

title: Senior Software Engineer, Billing & Monetization
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a skilled and passionate Senior Software Engineer, Billing & Monetization to join our Billing team in the Amsterdam office. Working in a high-growth scale-up, you’ll have the unique opportunity to drive innovation at scale while contributing to a company transforming the world of audit and finance.

About the role:

Every customer's path through DataSnipper, from first sign-up to first agent run to renewal, runs on the systems this team owns: how customers get in, what they are entitled to, and how AI usage turns into revenue. As we move from seats to usage and credits for our agentic products, these systems become as strategic as the product itself, and they have to be fast, accurate and trustworthy.

This is a hands-on role for an engineer who cares about correctness as much as speed, and wants to see the commercial impact of their code.

Why DataSnipper?

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

What You Will Do:

Metering & Billing

  • Build real-time usage metering and credit consumption for our agentic products, accurate down to the individual agent run

  • Design pricing and rating logic that supports seats, usage, credits and enterprise contract terms without a rewrite for every new plan

  • Integrate with billing, payment and finance systems (e.g. Stripe, CRM and ERP), and keep them reconciled

Licensing & Onboarding

  • Own the onboarding flow end-to-end: sign-up, trials, provisioning, SSO and SCIM, and the first-run experience

  • Instrument activation and conversion, and work with Product and Design to remove friction

Engineering & Collaboration

  • Build systems where correctness is non-negotiable: idempotent, auditable, observable and secure

  • Own it end-to-end, from design to production in our Python stack on Azure through to the web and add-in front ends. Anticipate issues, and shape the team's technical direction without waiting to be asked

  • Influence across functions: partner with Product, Finance, Sales and Customer Success, using data and empathy to turn pricing, packaging and licensing decisions into robust implementation

  • Raise the bar through code reviews, mentorship and clear, balanced feedback, and ask for the same in return

What You Bring:

Must-Have

  • 6+ years in software engineering, with strong, production-grade backend experience (ideally Python)

  • Experience building billing, metering, licensing or entitlement systems in production

  • Solid experience building data-driven web APIs and distributed systems on a major cloud platform

  • A strong grasp of financial correctness: idempotency, consistency, reconciliation and audit trails

  • Strong fundamentals in software architecture, system design and data modelling

  • Product mindset: you care about activation, conversion and revenue as much as uptime

  • Sound judgment under ambiguity: you balance speed and accuracy, stay calm when plans change, and reprioritise without being told

  • Proficient with AI-assisted engineering (we use Claude Code)

Nice-to-Have

title: Senior Software Engineer, Climate
descriptionHtml:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Why Climate Matters More Than Ever

Supply chain leaders are being asked to cut costs and carbon at the same time. Yet logistics and sustainability teams often work with different data, tools, and priorities. Meanwhile, regulations and industry standards are raising expectations for how companies measure and manage their emissions.

Most climate tools stop at reporting: a dashboard or a year-end PDF, produced long after a shipment has moved. They rarely reach the people deciding how to route goods, when to ship, or how much inventory to hold.

The Climate team at Flexport is building emissions intelligence directly into the platform where supply chain decisions are made. We help customers weigh cost, speed, and emissions together—and turn that understanding into action.

The Opportunity

Flexport already runs the shipments, holds the data, and provides the platform where customers manage their supply chains. That puts us in a strong position to connect climate insights with the operational decisions that drive emissions.

You will be the primary engineer for Climate, working independently of our existing engineering teams and partnering closely with the Climate Manager, your main day-to-day business stakeholder.

Think of it as a small startup within Flexport: direct access to the business, a broad scope, and substantial ownership. Together with the Climate Manager, you will identify the most valuable problems to solve, shape the product direction, and turn ideas into reliable software. This role calls for someone who enjoys both deciding what to build and building it.

Things We ❤️

  • Turning complex shipment and emissions data into clear, actionable choices.
  • Working directly with stakeholders and users to understand what would make their lives better.
  • Building simple, reliable products and learning from how people use them.
  • Finding opportunities where lower costs and lower emissions go together.
  • Taking an idea from an ambiguous problem to a useful product in production.

You Will

  • Work closely with Climate Programs Manager to understand customer needs, challenge assumptions, and translate business goals into a practical product roadmap.
  • Own delivery from problem discovery and technical design through implementation, launch, operation, and iteration.
  • Build emissions intelligence into everyday supply chain decisions, including routing, transport mode, shipment timing, and inventory planning.
  • Help customers identify opportunities to reduce emissions using Flexport’s shipment data.
  • Make lower-emission choices easier to understand and act on within existing workflows.
  • Develop products that help customers understand the wider environmental footprint of their supply chains, beyond freight.
  • Deliver useful improvements incrementally, balancing speed, scope, maintainability, and data accuracy.
  • Coordinate with other engineering teams when your work depends on shared systems, integrations, or expertise.
  • Measure whether what you ship solves the underlying problem, and use that evidence to decide what comes next.

You Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong engineering foundation and experience delivering production software.
  • A track record of working independently: you can bring structure to an unclear problem, set priorities, unblock yourself, and follow through without a detailed specification or constant direction.
  • Strong product judgment: you understand user needs, identify what is worth building, and make thoughtful tradeoffs between impact and effort.
  • Experience working closely with business stakeholders: you ask good questions, explain technical choices in plain language, and constructively challenge ideas when needed.
  • The ability to own features across the stack, including user interfaces, backend services, and data integrations.
  • A love of simple, well-tested code that is easy to extend and hard to break.
  • Comfort taking responsibility for the reliability and maintenance of what you build.
  • A bias for action, combined with the judgment to recognize when you need input or help.
  • An aptitude for learning quickly, including unfamiliar business domains and technologies.

Nice to Have

  • A personal motivation to work on climate and environmental challenges.
  • Experience in climate technology, emissions accounting, logistics, or supply chain software.
  • Experience building products in a startup or another small team with broad ownership.
  • Experience turning complex data into customer-facing insights and decision tools.

Prior climate experience is a plus; curiosity and the ability to learn the domain matter more.

How We Work

  • Your day-to-day work will center on a close partnership with the Climate Manager, with collaboration across engineering as needed.
  • You will have substantial autonomy and will be expected to keep stakeholders aligned on priorities, progress, and tradeoffs.
  • We build and launch incrementally, using feedback to guide the next step.
  • In Amsterdam, we come to the office two to three times a week to collaborate, whiteboard, and spend time together.
  • Flexport’s broader technology stack includes React, TypeScript, Ruby on Rails, Kotlin, Kubernetes, GraphQL, gRPC, Postgres, Kafka, and Snowflake. We welcome candidates from different technology backgrounds.

What’s in It for You?

  • Direct ownership of products that help customers make better supply chain and environmental decisions.
  • The opportunity to shape Climate technology with the autonomy of a small startup and the reach of Flexport.
  • Equity participation and a defined pension contribution scheme.
  • 25 vacation days based on full-time employment.
  • Fully paid premiums for Flexport’s collective health insurance plan.
  • Catered lunches, breakfast, snacks, and drinks in the office.
  • Covered home-to-office commuting costs for employees living outside Amsterdam.
  • Employee assistance and parental leave benefits.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at www.flexport.com/privacy for additional information.

title: Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Senior Engineer

Location: Bristol, London or Edinburgh (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Level: Senior Engineer I - Senior Engineer II

Team: Engineering

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: Software Engineering Manager

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

The role

You’ll join the Kaluza Technology community: a large team of product-focused and data-led Product and Platform Engineers working at serious scale. Our ecosystem is diverse depending on the team, spanning TypeScript on AWS, Go on GCP, and Scala, so we index on product-minded problem solving over language purity. As a Senior Engineer you’ll own a slice of the product end-to-end, from the first design conversation to running it in production, and you’ll build it with AI coding agents as your default. We’re looking for someone whose judgement is worth more than their typing speed.

Engineers at Kaluza build with AI, and we mean that practically. From your first day you’ll have paid access to Claude Code, with a budget we don’t ration, and MCP access to the systems you need. Our tooling and conventions are evolving quickly, and you’ll have a heavy hand in defining how we build moving forward.

What you’ll do

  • Own a slice of the product end to end: shape the problem with product and design, build the interface and the services behind it, ship it, and run it in production.

  • Work across the stack over time: depending on the team you’ll work across the interface people use, the services behind it, and the APIs between them, in whatever stack your team runs.

  • Build with AI coding agents as your default: break work down so agents can execute it, direct them, review what they produce as carefully as a colleague’s PR, and maintain the tests and guardrails that let agent-written code merge safely.

  • Stay close to the people who use what you build, directly or through our forward-deployed engineers: a supplier’s operations team, a customer plugging in a car at night. Instrument what you ship so you can see how it’s used, and turn what you learn into shipped changes.

  • Make good work the default: shape the codebase, conventions and automated checks so that agents and new teammates produce the right thing without anyone catching it in review.

  • Mentor, review, and share what you know.

What you’ll bring

These are the practices and behaviours we see most in our top engineers and value deeply, but we don't expect everyone to tick every single box. If you're excited by the role and can see yourself thriving here, we’d love to hear from you.

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Experience shipping production software: You bring real depth to either the front or back end of a modern stack, and potentially an openness to stretch across both as you navigate our diverse ecosystem.

  • A daily agentic development practice: You build with tools like Cursor or Claude Code, can walk us through work you’ve shipped this way, and review AI output as rigorously as a colleague’s PR.

  • Able to navigate a complex, high-stakes domain: You keep complex energy logic legible across microservices, knowing exactly when to use sync vs async to prevent cascading failures.

  • Cloud and operational ownership: You're comfortable deploying on major cloud platforms using shared tooling. You fully own your software in production, which includes participating in an out-of-hours on-call rota.

  • Strong product sense: You relentlessly ask "why" before building, and can point to times when direct user feedback or metrics materially changed what you ultimately shipped.

  • Clear written communication: You write specs, PR descriptions, and post-mortems with enough clarity and context that either a human teammate or an AI agent can immediately act on them.

  • A multiplier for your team: You mentor peers and proactively shape how the team works; introducing conventions, checks, or shared context that makes everyone else’s output consistently better.

Nice to have: you’ve built tooling around coding agents (MCP servers, skills, CI checks); experience in energy or another real-time, regulated domain.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Front End - Studio (Core)
descriptionHtml:
About Clear Street

Clear Street’s mission is to give every sophisticated investor access to every asset, in every market, through a unified platform built for speed, transparency and scale.

We give our clients the technology, tools, and service once reserved for the largest institutions, rebuilt with modern infrastructure. Our single, cloud-native, end-to-end capital markets platform powers investor growth today and is transforming how they can interact with markets tomorrow.

For more information, visit https://clearstreet.io.

The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer (Front-End), you will help build our flagship Clear Street Studio, a modern prime brokerage experience. You will tackle non-trivial problems that force you to balance trade-offs while implementing clean and efficient solutions. You will raise our bar on delivering solutions that delight and offer the best experience for our customers, and you will push our operational standards to ensure we can offer and maintain a high SLA.

This role is deeply involved in engineering the next generation of our state-of-the-art Studio (portal) for a varied client base including hedge funds, traders, and portfolio managers. As a senior member of the team, you will set technical direction, mentor other engineers, and own significant parts of the platform
end to end.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead the design and delivery of complex, user-facing features and shared foundations for Clear Street Studio.
  • Drive a system-design approach to building new front-end services, balancing trade-offs across scale, performance, and maintainability.
  • Set and evolve engineering standards across the Studio Core team, including architecture, testing, tooling, and code quality.
  • Mentor and grow other engineers through code review, pairing, and technical guidance.
  • Partner with product, design, and back-end leads to shape roadmaps and turn ambiguous problems into clear technical plans.
  • Own the operational excellence of your domains, ensuring reliability, observability, and a high SLA.
  • Clearly explain the nuances of system design and front-end paradigms to engineers and stakeholders alike.


The Team

You will join the Studio Core front-end team, a group of talented, passionate and highly collaborative engineers who own the foundations of the Clear Street Studio experience. Working together, we have built a platform that serves institutional clients and is at the forefront of technological innovation. Our engineers take pride not just in the value we provide our customers, but in the quality of our work. As a member of our team, you will work with cutting-edge technologies, collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds, and make a meaningful impact on the financial industry. We value creativity, innovation, and a strong work ethic, and we are committed to providing our team members with the support and resources they need to succeed.


Tech Stack

React, TypeScript, Next.js, Module Federation, Nx, Node.js, Kubernetes, and Cloud (AWS or Azure).


What We’re Looking For

  • At least six (6) years of professional experience implementing scalable web applications with React and TypeScript.
  • Experience contributing to systems that solve complex business problems and handle massive amounts of data; you are drawn towards scale, distributed systems, and associated technologies.
  • A strong command of design patterns, data structures, and algorithms.
  • The ability to clearly explain the nuances of system design and paradigms to engineers and stakeholders.
  • A track record of prioritizing end-user experience, reflected in your API design, functionality, and performance.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor team members, define engineering standards, and drive a system- design approach to building new services.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a consistent focus on delivering high-quality products.
  • Pride in the quality of your work and a high standard for what you ship.


Nice to Have

  • Experience leading front-end architecture for large-scale or data-intensive applications.
  • Deep experience with monorepo tooling (Nx, Turborepo) and micro-frontend architectures such as Module Federation.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms (AWS or Azure).
  • Experience in financial services, capital markets, or trading platforms.


What We Offer

At Clear Street, we offer competitive compensation packages, company equity, pension, gender-neutral parental leave, and full medical and dental insurance. Our belief has always been that we are better as a business when we are all together in person. As such, we require employees to be in the office a minimum of three days per week. Our top priority is our people. We’re continuously investing in a culture that promotes collaboration. We help each other through challenges and celebrate each other’s successes.

We believe that modern workplaces succeed by virtue of having high-performance workforces that are diverse in ideas, in cultures, and in experiences. We put in the effort to make such a workplace a daily reality and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Frontend)
descriptionHtml:
Op zoek naar een werkplek waar jouw ideeën het verschil maken en waar je op niveau kan sparren met een team van ambitieuze developers? Als Software Engineer bij IXON werk je aan een modern cloudplatform dat door duizenden machinebouwers wereldwijd wordt gebruikt. Geen remote eilandjes of kortlopende projecten, maar samen bouwen aan een product waar onze klanten fan van zijn. Klaar om impact te maken?

Hier krijg jij energie van

Binnen jouw rol als Software Engineer werk je niet aan een statische applicatie, maar aan een continu evoluerend cloudplatform met een diversiteit aan functionaliteiten. Samen met je team ben je verantwoordelijk voor het hart van de IXON Cloud: van complexe autorisatiestructuren tot een naadloze gebruikerservaring. Het doel? Onze klanten hun beheerprocessen zo efficiënt mogelijk laten uitvoeren.

Om dat voor elkaar te krijgen, werk je met een moderne tech stack die onder andere bestaat uit Angular en TypeScript. Je krijgt de vrijheid om actief mee te beslissen over technische keuzes die ervoor zorgen dat onze applicaties niet alleen vandaag snel en strak draaien, maar ook op de lange termijn schaalbaar en onderhoudbaar blijven.

Wat je concreet gaat doen:

  • Je pakt de verantwoordelijkheid, en draagt zorg voor jouw kwalitatief sterke code;

  • Je bent een sparringpartner voor je collega’s en om features technisch uit te diepen;

  • Je tilt graag ons front-end delivery proces naar een hoger niveau, op gebied van observability, testing en deployment

  • Je krijgt de ruimte voor PoC’s en research spikes om de nieuwste technologieën te valideren voor ons platform.

Dit maakt jou succesvol in deze rol

Jij bent een Software Engineer die gelooft dat een interface pas écht goed is wanneer de logica erachter vlekkeloos werkt. Frontend is jouw passie, maar je snapt ook wat er in de backend gebeurt. Dit maakt je een belangrijke schakel in ons multidisciplinaire Scrum team. Je werkt iteratief, leert van feedback en streeft voortdurend naar verbetering. Bovendien inspireer je jouw collega’s door best practices te delen en samen te groeien.

Daarnaast zou het fijn zijn als je jezelf herkent in het volgende rijtje:

  • Je beschikt over een WO werk en denk niveau

  • Minimaal 5+ jaar relevante werkervaring;

  • Sterke kennis van Typescript en Angular of een vergelijkbaar framework;

  • Je hebt sterke affiniteit met User Experience en begrijpt hoe een gebruiker door een applicatie beweegt;

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden zowel in het Nederlands als Engels.

  • Kennis en/of ervaring met Python en Docker.

Dit hebben wij jou te bieden

Streven naar topkwaliteit en een goede werksfeer gaan bij ons hand in hand. We streven naar ontwikkeling op hoog niveau, werken met een geavanceerde tech stack en dagen elkaar inhoudelijk uit. Tegelijkertijd is de sfeer open en informeel. Vragen stellen, kritisch meedenken of een nieuw concept pitchen? Dat hoort er bij ons gewoon bij. Daarnaast krijg je alle ruimte om nieuwe dingen uit te proberen. Leef je uit tijdens onze vrijdagmiddagprojecten, denk mee in de Frontend Guild en verbreed je horizon tijdens onze interne tech events.

Dit vullen we graag aan met:

  • Een goed salaris passend bij jouw niveau en ervaring;

  • Uitstekende secundaire voorwaarden: Een 13e maand, 8% vakantiegeld, Vitaliteitsbudget, WIA-hiaat verzekering en een pensioenregeling;

  • 30 vakantiedagen om op te laden en thuiswerkmogelijkheden;

  • Persoonlijke groei: Een uitgebreide onboarding, ruim persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget en coaching;

  • Een gezellige werkplek inclusief een volle kalender met teamactiviteiten, uitjes en spontane borrels.

Wat wij doen?

Bij IXON connecten wij machinebouwers met hun klanten. Naarmate machines complexer worden en de verwachtingen van klanten stijgen, moeten machinebouwers hun services continu professionaliseren om de concurrentie voor te blijven. En dat is precies waar wij in beeld komen.

Wij helpen machinebouwers wereldwijd om hun activiteiten te stroomlijnen en hun service naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Dit doen we met een pakket aan innovatieve oplossingen: van veilige remote access tot klantenportalen en geavanceerde data dashboarding. Onze oplossingen zijn ontworpen om zonder beperkingen mee te schalen en naadloos te integreren, zodat onze klanten hun services maximaal kunnen optimaliseren.

Klaar om impact te maken?

We houden van een laagdrempelige aanpak. Na een korte eerste kennismaking laten we je graag een live demo van ons platform zien. Zo ontdek je precies hoe en wat wij bouwen. Daarnaast maken we graag ruimte voor een kennismaking met het team, zodat je zelf kunt ervaren hoe de sfeer is en met wie je gaat samenwerken.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack) - Merchant EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Team

Merchant EMEA Engineering builds the technology that helps merchants join, grow, and operate successfully across our markets.

Our organization brings together the strengths of Wolt and Deliveroo and supports merchants across 37 countries. We work across the merchant journey, including onboarding, business growth and support, analytics and recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, and merchant applications.

Our teams sit close to the business. Rather than primarily building foundational platforms, we build products and features on top of our existing platforms to solve real merchant and market needs, including local business requirements, growth opportunities, and operational challenges.

📍This open role is based in our tech hubs in Helsinki or Berlin.

Please note: This role requires being based in Berlin/Helsinki on a hybrid basis. We are currently unable to offer fully remote work, visa sponsorship, or relocation support for this opportunity.

What You'll Do

As a Fullstack Engineer, you'll contribute to products and services used across the merchant experience. You'll:

  • Build and maintain production software across backend services and user-facing applications.
  • Work on areas such as merchant onboarding, analytics, recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, or merchant-facing tools.
  • Develop reliable APIs, data models, services, and user-facing features.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, operations, and other engineers to turn business needs into practical technical solutions.
  • Own features from implementation through production and ongoing maintenance.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions and improve the quality, scalability, observability, and maintainability of our systems.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools effectively as part of your engineering workflow, while critically evaluating their output and taking ownership of the final solution.
  • Be willing to work outside your primary area of expertise when needed to solve the problem end-to-end.

How We Work

  • Ownership: Engineers take responsibility for the features and services they work on, from development to production.
  • Collaboration: We work closely across engineering, product, design, data, and operations.
  • Pragmatism: We value simple and maintainable solutions that create business impact without unnecessary complexity.
  • Flexibility: We care more about solving the problem than strict frontend or backend boundaries.

Our Tech Stack

Our backend services primarily use Go and Kotlin, while our frontend applications use technologies such as TypeScript and React.

We also work with technologies including Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, and modern cloud infrastructure.

Our Humble Expectations

We're looking for engineers who have:

  • An AI-first mindset, with a deep experience in leveraging modern AI tools and solid engineering principles to solve problems end-to-end, independently of any specific technology stack.
  • Proven experience building production software in backend, frontend, or fullstack environments end-to-end and at scale.
  • Strong expertise in at least one area of the stack, with a willingness to contribute outside that area when needed.
  • Experience with a modern backend language such as Go, Kotlin, Java, or similar, and/or modern frontend technologies such as TypeScript and React.
  • Good understanding of APIs, databases, testing, and software design fundamentals.
  • The ability to work independently on well-scoped problems and collaborate effectively with others.
  • Good communication skills and a pragmatic, collaborative mindset.

You do not need to be equally strong in frontend and backend. We welcome different balances of experience. You might be primarily a backend engineer who is comfortable making frontend changes when needed, or a frontend-focused engineer who is happy to work with APIs and backend services.

What matters most is that you are comfortable working across boundaries to deliver the right solution.

Nice to Have

descriptionHtml:

Clear Street’s mission is to give every sophisticated investor access to every asset, in every market, through a unified platform built for speed, transparency and scale.

We give our clients the technology, tools, and service once reserved for the largest institutions, rebuilt with modern infrastructure. Our single, cloud-native, end-to-end capital markets platform powers investor growth today and is transforming how they can interact with markets tomorrow.

For more information, visit https://clearstreet.io.

The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer on Clear Street’s futures and options execution services team, you’ll play a key role in designing and building the next generation of our Clear Street futures and options EMS platform from the ground up.  You’ll develop a high-performance platform that brings together real-time market data, low latency exchange connectivity and execution, robust risk controls, and advanced trading capabilities within a fast, responsive web interface.  Working closely with cross-functional partners, you’ll contribute to large-scale, high impact initiatives that enhance our prime brokerage offering and help shape the future of the Clear Street trading experience.

What You’ll Do

  • You will be building a brand new EMS platform for Listed Futures and Options.
  • Translate product and design requirements into clean, maintainable and well-tested components.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, business, traders, designers and back-end engineers to deliver high-quality experiences.
  • Identify and resolve performance, accessibility, and usability issues across the application.
  • Participate in code reviews, contribute to shared component libraries, and help uphold our engineering standards.
  • Support the operational health of your features and help maintain a high SLA.

The Team

You will work with a team of talented, passionate and highly collaborative engineers. Working together, we have built a platform that serves institutional clients and is at the forefront of technological innovation. Our engineers take pride in not just the value we provide our customers but the quality of our work. You will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies, collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds, and make a meaningful impact on the financial industry. We value creativity, innovation, strong work ethics, and we are committed to providing our team members with the support and resources they need to succeed.

Tech Stack

Java and/or Rust, AWS, FIX protocol, Kafka ,  Kubernetes and Cloud (AWS or Azure).

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience using Java. 
  • At least 4 years of experience working with modern technologies, including a proven track record operating at Senior Engineer level.
  • Hands-on experience building and supporting low-latency, front-office trading systems.
  • Deep understanding of execution management systems (EMS), including their core functionality and workflows.
  • Strong knowledge of software design patterns, data structures, and algorithms.
  • A collaborative mindset and a preference for working in team-oriented environments.
  • A strong commitment to engineering quality, reliability, and high development standards.
  • Passion for delivering a best-in-class developer experience, with a focus on tooling, performance, and maintainability.

What We Offer

At Clear Street, we offer competitive compensation packages, company equity, pension, gender-neutral parental leave, and full medical and dental insurance. Our belief has always been that we are better as a business when we are all together in person. As such, we require employees to be in the office a minimum of three days per week.

Our top priority is our people. We’re continuously investing in a culture that promotes collaboration. We help each other through challenges and celebrate each other’s successes. We believe that modern workplaces succeed by virtue of having high-performance workforces that are diverse in ideas, in cultures, and in experiences. We put in the effort to make such a workplace a daily reality and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Java)
descriptionHtml:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebratingour wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

Anaplan is the leading enterprise decision-making platform, powering the world’s largest enterprises with our proprietary Hyperblock™ technology and cloud infrastructure. We are seeking an Engineer IV to join our team in Manchester, UK, or York, UK. 

Your Impact

  • Lead the design, delivery, and architecture of platform capabilities powering Anaplan’s enterprise-scale API gateways, edge routing, and developer acceleration.
  • Build and scale high-throughput backend engines that manage core request orchestration, seamless multi-tenant isolation, and API-first solutions serving thousands of tenants and tens of thousands of users.
  • Partner with architects and senior engineers across the Platform Experience domain to set technical direction, aligning implementation patterns for complex initiatives (like Vanity URLs, JWT auth flows, and cross-service proxying).
  • Drive the evolution of our deployment infrastructure, championing modern GitOps workflows (ArgoCD, Helm) and highly available containerized orchestration.
  • Own foundational features end-to-end—from design through to production—while continuously improving system observability, implementing intelligent rate-limiting, and solving complex concurrency challenges (e.g., database locks and connection starvation).
  • Deliver thought leadership and coding excellence across Java/Kotlin, ensuring seamless integration between backend microservices and UI components (including resolving complex CORS and distributed edge proxy requirements).
  • Mentor and elevate engineers across global teams through design reviews, pair programming, and hands-on leadership to foster a resilient engineering culture.

Your Qualifications

  • Experience in software engineering within enterprise-scale, high-throughput platform or data-centric environments.
  • Understand, leverage, and integrate modern AI tools and concepts—including agentic programming patterns and LLM-assisted workflows—to accelerate platform engineering and developer velocity.
  • Deep expertise in backend JVM languages (Java and/or Kotlin) with a strong understanding of distributed systems internals.
  • Proven track record of delivering API-first infrastructures, API Gateways (e.g., Traefik), and edge routing solutions that guarantee enterprise reliability under sustained traffic loads (2K+ requests per second).
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containerized deployments, and managing complex CI/CD pipelines (strong familiarity with GitOps, ArgoCD, and high-velocity release workflows).
  • Solid grounding in event-driven architecture, real-time data processing, and managing complex database transaction scopes at scale.
  • Experience balancing rapid prototyping and fast iteration with long-term sustainability and quality—you have a bias for action and prefer to try and iterate rather than wait for perfect information.
  • Exceptional technical communicator with a proven ability to align globally distributed teams. You are highly skilled at distilling complex concepts into clear, structured RFCs and architectural designs to build consensus.
  • Understand, leverage, and integrate modern AI tools and concepts—including agentic programming patterns and LLM-assisted workflows—to accelerate platform engineering and developer velocity.

Preferred Skills

  • You have shaped architecture and platform strategy at an enterprise scale, navigating the trade-offs of hybrid and cloud-agnostic infrastructures.
  • You bring a polyglot mindset, matching the right technology to the challenge rather than defaulting to a single stack (comfortable exploring React, Python, or Go when needed).
  • Genuine curiosity—you're energized by learning new technologies and approaches to solve edge routing and platform enablement challenges.
  • You enjoy mentoring others and raising the bar for engineering culture, without big egos.
  • You're highly comfortable operating in distributed teams, embracing asynchronous collaboration, and driving consensus across distinct domains.

#LI-SP1

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer  

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.  

Anaplan does not:  

  • Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.   
  • Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  

All emails from Anaplan would come from an ----- email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to ----- before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.   

Privacy & AI Notice

Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.
