title: Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Scope automates the data collection that's slowing down the physical world.

Standards are vital for the safety of our infrastructure. Spending hours manually documenting them is not.

Dave is an inspector. Today he’s climbing through one of Europe’s biggest chemical plants, looking for the corrosion that could shut the whole site down, with a notebook and pen in hand. Tomorrow, he’ll spend even longer on the part of the job he hates: turning those scribbles into a report.

We’re building the AI-native data collection layer for the 2 billion field workers like Dave. Scope radically simplifies how inspectors collect data in the field, make decisions, and produce reports. Along the way, we’re building the largest dataset on the condition of the built world and the decisions experts make about it.

It’s a $2T market and we’re just getting started. We're growing rapidly, and already work with 7 of the top 10 companies in the space. Our customers inspect facilities and products for companies including AstraZeneca and SpaceX.

We take pride in our talent density, and have assembled a best-in-class team: acquired and future founders, people from institutions like Imperial, Carnegie Mellon and Oxford, and from firms like Palantir, Goldman Sachs and Flexport .

Since launching from Entrepreneurs First in 2024, we've raised an oversubscribed $20m round led by Index Ventures, the firm behind Figma, Revolut and Wiz, with over 100 unicorns backed to date.

About the role

  • Real product ownership. You’ll go on site with inspectors, decide what matters, design it, ship it, and see whether it worked.

  • The hard, interesting problems in AI. Field data is messy: voice notes, photos, video, half-finished sentences recorded in a chemical plant with no signal. Turning that into a report an expert will sign is a context-engineering problem nobody has solved well yet.

  • A small team that ships fast. We ship to production every day and put changes in front of inspectors within days, not quarters. Ideas go from a site visit to a live feature in a single sprint. If something doesn’t land, we learn why and iterate quickly. There are no layers of sign-off between you and the user.

What you’ll do

  • Redesign the mobile app for how inspectors actually work: gloves on, no signal, one hand holding on

  • Build the systems that takes voice notes, photos, videos and proactively finishes reports without being annoying

  • Engineer how we feed context to AI models: how to store, fetch and select standards, reports, media, user intention

  • Evolve our workflow builder: something between Retool, Webflow and n8n for inspections

  • Design the architecture behind the product: how unstructured data flows through the system, how AI is integrated, how offline and online behaviour stay seamless, and how we keep the product simple as it becomes more powerful.

Who you are

  • You’re deeply technical. You’re a little bit sad that AI tooling creates more distance between you and the code, and you still like knowing how things work underneath.

  • You’re a manager of one. We believe great teams are made up of highly agentic people who care more about shipping results than collecting badges.

  • You’ve got the scar tissue. You have 5+ years of experience and know which technical decisions matter, and which ones don’t.

  • You’ve shipped real applications. Ideally mobile, ideally with Expo or React Native. You care about the details that break in the real world: offline, flaky networks, error states.

  • You’re curious about AI as an engineering problem. You’re interested in getting messy real-world inputs into a model and getting something reliable back out, not just in calling an API.

Interview process

  • An initial call with our talent team.

  • A collaborative technical exercise with an engineer, usually in Typescript or Python.

  • An Interview with a cofounder - Jonny (CEO) or Jakob (CTO).

  • Onsite Product Interview - Meeting more people on the team and getting a feel of what it would be like to work here.

  • Offer!

Compensation and benefits

We’re in the office five days a week, so we’ve made it a great place to be.

  • £120k–£150k base + significant equity, so you have a real stake in what you’re building

  • 33 days’ holiday (including bank holidays, which you can take at your discretion.)

  • Bupa private medical: £0 excess, pre-existing conditions covered, digital GP, plus Bupa dental

  • Fresh meal prep delivered every week, a stocked fridge, and team lunch out every Friday

  • Working late? Dinner’s on us, and so is your Uber home

  • Full visa sponsorship

  • New MacBook and whatever tools you need

  • Flexible parental leave, including adoption leave

  • Regular team events and off-sites

Compensation: £120K – £150K • Offers Equity

descriptionHtml:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

This role is for builders who thrive in 0→1. In Axon’s Global Artificial Intelligence pillar, you’ll build a stealth product with a small team and a big mission: deliver something the market hasn’t seen, and do it with pace.

As a Senior Software Engineer I, you’ll lead key areas of the product from concept through launch. You’ll make pragmatic architecture decisions, keep quality high while moving fast, and help the team turn prototypes into a scalable product. 

This is an AI-native delivery role: AI is a primary lever for how you ship, not an add-on and you have true Product acumen and ability to craft and build products end to end. 

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the build of major product surfaces and services; own features end-to-end from design to operations.
  • Drive product clarity in ambiguity: define the problem, shape MVP scope, set success metrics, and align stakeholders on what “done” means.
  • Build and ship software AI-natively across the SDLC (planning, implementation, testing, code review, debugging, and operations), with clear validation practices to maintain correctness and quality.
  • Measure and improve delivery outcomes using engineering metrics (lead time, PR throughput, defect rates, test coverage, incident load) and iterate on how the team ships.
  • Make architecture choices that balance speed and scalability—knowing when “temporary” becomes “permanent.”
  • Build and enforce engineering hygiene that doesn’t slow you down (testing strategy, CI/CD, observability, sensible release practices).
  • Partner tightly with Product and Design (and operate effectively when they’re not in the room) to prioritise, sequence, and ship the highest-value increments.
  • Mentor engineers and help establish a high-trust, high-ownership culture.

Work Location: This role is based out of our London office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.
Reports to: SVP, AI

What You Bring

Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of software development experience, including ownership of product capabilities in production.
  • Demonstrated, heavy AI-native delivery: consistent use of AI across the SDLC with concrete examples of faster delivery and maintained/improved quality.
  • Strong engineering judgement under uncertainty; ability to simplify and still build something great.
  • Experience building cloud-native services and/or modern user experiences that scale.
  • Comfort working across boundaries: product, design, customers, and platform dependencies.
  • Product judgement sufficient to ship: ability to frame problems, define MVP scope, make trade-offs, and drive to measurable customer outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Startup or internal incubation experience.
  • Experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities into product experiences responsibly.
  • Track record of accelerating teams through strong technical leadership.
  • Experience operating in PM-light environments where engineers help drive prioritisation and discovery alongside delivery.

Benefits that benefit you

  • Competitive base salary and RSUs
  • Comprehensive pension plan with matching contribution
  • Private health insurance & cash plans
  • 30 days paid holiday + UK public holidays
  • Enhanced maternity/paternity leave
  • GymPass subscription
  • Life assurance & income protection
  • Career growth support and wellness resources

Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Senior Software Engineer

Office Location: Temple, London - hybrid working environment (3 days in office per week)

Experience Level: +5 years commercial software engineering experience

About Investa

Investa is building the UK’s first zero-commission Options and Stocks trading platform. Legacy platforms typically feature high fees and complex interfaces that cut out the majority of retail investors. We are building a streamlined alternative to fix that. Investa is the first FCA-regulated platform to offer completely free US share trading with no FX, no commission, and no other fees.

Our Traction So Far:

  • £3.5M+ raised in funding with 1,000+ shareholders backing our vision

  • FCA-regulated and multi-award winning in 2026: Best Options Trading App (Good Money Guide) & Best App for Options Trading (ADVFN)

  • Available on iOS and Android, scaling rapidly toward our next milestones of 10,000 and 100,000 active users

  • 8,000+ trades processed, 2,500+ early supporters rewarded, and 150+ 5-star reviews

Our Mission: To democratise options trading for UK investors

Our Vision: Think Options, Think Investa

We are a lean, agile team where every employee directly shapes the business. We don't have a corporate way of working. Instead, we look for people who want high autonomy, care about making a visible impact, and align with our core values of being Collaborative, Curious, and Creative.

We are growing and looking for ambitious talent to help us democratise retail investing across the UK.

The Role

The Investa app was installed over 1,000 times within the first 24 hours of our priority access launch and we’re now looking for a high-impact Senior Software Engineer to join our founding engineering team as we scale.

You will have extensive commercial experience designing, building and maintaining systems used in critical services or those handling significant volumes of activity.

 

You will play a crucial role in building key parts of our platform and apps, ensuring the robustness, scalability, and security of our systems.

 

If you’re passionate about building best-in-class products to tackle complex challenges and you excel in a collaborative, fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you.

 

What the role involves

  • Founding Team Ownership: Designing, building, and maintaining robust, scalable services by joining our founding team of 4 engineers. Working directly with the founders with zero middle-management red tape, you won’t just pull tickets from a backlog - you will actually own your work end-to-end, see your code ship, and see its immediate impact on users.

  • Building the Engineering Culture: Joining our founding engineering team means you are actively building our engineering culture, not just stepping into one. You will have a direct voice in shaping how we collaborate day-to-day, how we learn from each other, and how we preserve a friendly, agile, and tight-knit environment as we grow.

  • Full-Stack Versatility & Growth: Hands-on Building: Writing high-quality, secure code for our FCA-regulated platform. You’ll navigate our stack to ship features that delight users. Driven by our fast-paced environment, you will have the opportunity to step outside your comfort zone and get hands-on with the wider technical stack, levelling up your skills significantly faster than in a traditional, highly specialised role.

  • System Design & Architectural Influence: Partnering directly with the CEO and Principal Engineers to tackle complex systems design and actively shape our evolving architecture. Your technical perspective will give you a strong voice in our high-level design choices. You will have true design ownership over the specific services and systems you build, ensuring they remain robust, secure, and performant as we scale.

  • Technical Excellence: Maintaining a high bar for code quality, testing, and documentation. You’ll participate in (and drive) meaningful code reviews.

  • System Integrity: Monitoring and improving system reliability, ensuring our trading platform is always "always-on."

  • Production Support: Root-causing real-time production issues; we all take pride in the stability of what we ship.

Your Background

  • Coding: You are a "doer." You love shipping code, crave the responsibility that comes with joining a founding team, and are comfortable driving tricky engineering problems forward with high autonomy and support from the team.

  • Adaptable & Impact-Driven: Technical Depth: You have +5 years experience in software engineering, specifically building and maintaining production-grade distributed systems. You are a flexible engineer who is excited to jump in wherever the business actually needs you most to solve interesting problems across the board. You are proficient in at least one or two modern languages (Python, TypeScript, Java, Go, etc.) and have experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • Pragmatic Mindset: You balance structural integrity with contextual relevance, ensuring we don't just build the "perfect" system, but the right system for our current needs.

  • Collaborative Spirit: You enjoy working in a tight-knit team, giving/receiving candid feedback, and contributing to a culture of shared learning.

  • First-Principles Thinker: You don’t just follow patterns; you understand why they exist. You can pick up new technologies or domains (like complex options Greeks) quickly, and you welcome a setup that actively forces you to grow into a much more versatile engineer.

On-call

  • All engineers at Investa are involved in providing support for our products. This involves responding to events outside of working hours and is a core part of the role of all engineers.

What we offer:

Career Ownership & Impact: While we provide clear levels to grow into, you also have autonomy over your execution and your career trajectory. Your work impacts the business immediately without corporate red tape. You can choose whether you want to pave a path as a high-level individual contributor or step into management as we scale - you shape your career.

Collaboration & Proximity: You’ll work directly alongside our Co-Founders, Alec and Ross, and our founding engineers to co-author both the product roadmap and our engineering architecture. Because of our size, our culture is extremely personal. Everyone has firsthand insight into top-level strategy, cross-departmental exposure, and a direct voice in how we solve deep technical issues as we scale.

Creativity & Speed: We prioritise innovation through speed, agility, thinking outside the box, and resource-efficient solutions.

Shared Success & Equity: We are in this together. To ensure everyone benefits from our growth, every employee receives meaningful company EMI equity. Our success is your success.

The Package and Perks: Competitive base salaries, private medical insurance, team socials chosen by you, milestone celebrations, and hybrid flexibility.

Compensation and Benefits

Financial Growth 💸

  • Base Salary: £85,000 – £105,000 per annum, commensurate with experience.

  • Equity: Initial grant of 0.1% - 0.25% in stock options. We reward impact with additional performance-based grants and milestone-linked top-ups.

  • Annual Review: Structured salary and performance reviews conducted every year to ensure your growth stays on track.

  • Annual Leave: 30 days (including bank holidays) + your birthday off.

  • Premium Coverage: Private medical and dental insurance via Bupa.

Office Environment & Lifestyle ☕

  • The Office: Work from a vibrant, spacious office featuring a private gym and a rooftop terrace for fresh-air breaks.

  • Fuel & Socials: Enjoy tea, coffee and snacks daily. Every last Wednesday of the month, we host a Team Lunch where the menu is chosen by you. We also run regular team socials, alongside company and individual milestone celebrations.

Tech 💻

  • Custom Setup: You’ll receive a high-spec MacBook Pro and £150 toward a mouse and keyboard of your choice.

  • Stage 3: Coding/Systems Design Interview

title: Senior Software Engineer, Mission Planning
descriptionHtml:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast. By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously. We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.
What you'll do
  • Work with our hardware engineering teams to translate the technical specifications and capabilities of our hardware into mission planning software, enabling operators to plan, simulate and deploy mission packages to our hardware.

  • Work with our UX team to build world class user experiences: planning that feels fast, visual and interactive. You build the real-time engine and services that make this possible.

  • Design and build the mission planning backend: plan generation, configuration, scenario planning and resource availability.

  • Build our software-in-the-loop (SITL) mission simulation environment: allowing scenarios to be realistically tested against battlefield environments before a missile has left the launcher.

  • Build the test harness and automation that run the product end to end against the simulation in CI, on every change.

  • Lead the design of the core data model and message schemas, working with our integration engineer to deploy authorized mission plans to real-world launch systems.


Who you are
  • A software engineer with 5+ years' experience building simulation, planning, decision support or real-time interactive software. You may come from an Aerospace, robotics, automotive, or gaming background.
  • Strong in modern C++ or Rust. A good grasp of numerical methods and floating-point behavior.
  • Experienced with simulation architecture: time-stepped or discrete-event simulation, software-in-the-loop, scenario management, deterministic replay.
  • Rigorous about testing: unit, property-based and scenario tests, and continuous integration.
  • Comfortable starting from a blank page. You can set up a codebase, choose tools, record decisions (for example in architecture decision records), and ship.
  • You use AI coding agents well and critically. You know when to trust their output, how to check it, and what not to hand over.

title: Senior Software Engineer — ML Inference & Numerics
descriptionHtml:
About Tensordyne 

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

The role

Help make the latest AI models run well on our silicon. You’ll work from model code to measured hardware performance: bring up new architectures, track down accuracy failures, and improve latency, throughput, and memory use.

The bigger challenge is making that work repeatable. You’ll build an agentic harness that can explore implementations, run experiments, check results, and guide the next change. Every investigation should leave behind better software, better tests, and a shorter path for the next model.

We’re looking for an excellent software engineer who understands LLM inference deeply and knows how to put coding agents to work. You’ll own substantial parts of our SDK and work closely with engineers across models, compilers, runtime, and hardware. Your particular focus will be numerical optimization: finding where precision matters, where computation can be cheaper, and how to preserve model quality.

What you’ll do

  • Build the agentic workflows. Give agents the tools to inspect models, change implementations and numerical settings, run emulation and hardware experiments, and diagnose failures. Build the feedback and evaluation that make the results trustworthy.
  • Bring up new models quickly; make them go brrrr. Work with engineers across the stack to take unfamiliar architectures from reference code to validated, performant execution on our accelerator. Turn what you learn into reusable model support and SDK improvements.
  • Optimize numerics. Explore precision, accumulation, and quantization choices across the model. Understand how they interact with kernels, KV caches, memory, and distributed execution, then measure the gains in latency, throughput, and memory use against model quality on silicon.
  • Make numerical quality measurable. Build conversion and emulation software that lets you test numerical choices quickly. Compare activations and outputs against reference models, trace accuracy regressions to their source, and validate changes with end-to-end model evaluations.
  • Ship software that lasts. Own design, implementation, testing, and delivery. Build clear APIs that are easy to use for agents. Make difficult bugs reproducible and keep them from returning. Know when to build fast, and when to build thoroughly.
  • Shape the next chip. Work with hardware architects to test how numerical formats and arithmetic choices affect real models. Turn those findings into better hardware and algorithm designs.

What we need from you

  • You understand LLM inference end to end. You can read a new model’s implementation and reason about prefill, decode, attention, KV caches, MoE, batching, and parallelism. You understand how these translate into compute, memory, and communication on an accelerator.
  • You build excellent software. You’ve owned substantial systems and delivered complex features from design through production. You’re strong in Python, thoughtful about interfaces, and rigorous about abstractions and testing.
  • You are fluent with agentic tooling. You’d rather build the agent that runs the optimization than doing it by hand; and running numerous agents in parallel excites you. You know what is required for agents to work effectively in a large software organization, and you have the judgement when an agentic loop still needs a human.
  • You take ownership and bring others along. You form clear hypotheses, test them, and drive problems to resolution across software boundaries. You communicate clearly through specs, design docs, and reviews that people and agents can act on. You explain complex trade-offs, give direct feedback, and make the people around you better.

If you tick a few of these boxes, we’d love to hear from you.

We’d be thrilled if you had

  • Expertise in improving inference systems like debugging and optimizing the runtime of complex models and reasoning about accuracy-performance trade-offs.
  • Experience with ML compilers, accelerator SDKs, or model compression libraries, particularly for non-NVIDIA accelerators such as TPU, Trainium/Inferentia, Tenstorrent, Groq, or Cerebras.
  • Experience with model quantization, sparsity, codebooks, low-rank factorization or other compression techniques.
  • Contributions to distributed inference or serving frameworks such as vLLM or SGLang.

Why join us

Your code will help determine how quickly we support new models, how efficiently they run, and what we build into our next chip. You’ll own meaningful software, work directly with the people designing the hardware, and see your decisions tested on real silicon.

If you want to build the tools, solve the hard failures, and help set the engineering direction of a new inference platform, we’d like to hear from you.

Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values

  • Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed.
  • Ethics and integrity always. Be open, honest, and respectful of everyone.
  • Think Big. Be ambitious and have audacious goals.
  • Aim for excellence. Quality and excellence count in everything we do.
  • Own it and get it done. Results matter!
  • Make each person better together than they would be as an individual.
  • Embrace each other’s differences, and embrace that there will be differences.

Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams are better equipped to solve complex problems and build exceptional technology. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

A note to recruitment agencies: Please do not contact Tensordyne employees or leaders regarding this role. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees associated with unsolicited submissions.

title: Senior software engineer (Node.js/TypeScript)
descriptionHtml:
Hybrid working based at one of our offices in London, Bath or Edinburgh. Your contract will be hybrid, although we don’t currently require a set number of office days. We support flexible working and trust teams to agree how and where they work best, taking a pragmatic approach based on the needs of the role and team.

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

Our culture:

Never settle – We think of ourselves as ‘embedded hero-makers’ for our customers. We put them first, and if we say we’ll do something, we’ll move heaven and earth to do it. We think boldly and embrace change.

Take ownership - We think rigorously and deeply about a problem, but then charge at it, acting with and urgency and speed that sets us apart. But we never lose sight of quality or long-term scalability.

Be generous & candid - We encourage our people – and our customers – to challenge us and never shy away from tough conversations. We have a flat and inclusive culture where everyone can be themselves – and speak up.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Our engineering ways of working:

  • Our Product and Engineering organisation is structured into four tribes: Custody, Accounts, Experience, and Cloud & Security. Each tribe contains multiple autonomous squads, with clear full ownership over specific product domains.

  • The squads are intentionally small and cross-functional, typically made up of an Engineering Manager, Product Manager, and 3–5 engineers with complementary skills aligned to the domain they own.

  • We operate in a build-and-run model, with teams responsible for the full software lifecycle, from architecture and delivery through to operational support and incident management.

  • Our core platform is built on AWS serverless technologies including Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway, S3, and ECS. We primarily develop in TypeScript and Node.js, with MongoDB as our primary document database. We also have a small number of C# services and are continuing to evolve our platform architecture, including expanding our use of ECS Fargate.

  • Infrastructure is managed through a combination of Terraform and Serverless Framework. We use GitHub Actions for CI/CD and incident.io to support our incident management processes and operational workflows.

  • We care deeply about engineering quality, pragmatic architecture, and continuous improvement. If you’d like to go deeper, we’re happy to share more about our engineering practices and technology radar during the interview process.

The role

As an engineer at Seccl you will design, build and operate reliable and scalable, testable and maintainable software solutions, building new functionalities and products using Typescript and Node.js. You play a key role in our software development and have a hands-on approach throughout the development process supporting resilient financial workflow systems and regulated investment operations. As a senior member of the team, you are the ‘go-to’ person for queries.

On a typical day you will…

  • Work collaboratively in a domain aligned cross-functional squad made up of engineers and product along with colleagues from customer-facing and operations teams

  • Design, implement and operate your services within your domain

  • Be accountable for the SLAs of your products and iterative improvements

  • Maintain and extend documentation for your services

  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement and technical excellence while understanding when “good enough for now” is appropriate

  • Provide guidance and mentorship for other engineers

  • Communicate with non-technical colleagues to answer queries about the Seccl system

What you need…

  • To own your services from design to operation. We operate a build-and-run model where engineers have autonomy but full accountability.

  • We care deeply about correctness, resilience and operational excellence because our systems underpin real customer investments.

  • Engineers are not passengers in their products but champions. Drive improvements and features while collaborating openly with product, operations and engineering colleagues, challenging ideas constructively and focusing on delivering the best outcomes for customers.

  • Have a strong ability to understand business and customer problems and turn them into efficient, scalable solutions. Be curious about how investment and custody products operate, and pragmatic in balancing customer value, operational correctness, engineering quality and long-term scalability.

  • Experience building financial systems with multi-region, multi-currency or trading-related complexity would be advantageous.

  • Experience in a strongly/statically typed language.

  • Have a strong understanding of designing, building, and running high-quality, standards-compliant workflow APIs, with a focus on testing, observability, and performance.

  • Have worked with a cloud provider (AWS/Azure/GCP). We use AWS.

  • Have worked with distributed systems and are comfortable debugging through tracing and observability.

  • Willing to be on-call for your services.

Core technical skills you must have:

  • Strong commercial experience with Node.js, specifically TypeScript

  • Experience with Amazon Web Services

  • Experience with Serverless products

  • Experience with document databases, ideally MongoDB

  • Experience mentoring engineers

  • Experience leading technical delivery in a build-and-run engineering model

  • Experience in a structured on-call process and incident management

  • Experience working in regulated industries, ideally financial services or FinTech.

This role isn’t for you if...

  • You rely on a lot of top-down direction. Here, you’ll have a lot of freedom and ownership of your role, and you’ll be expected to shape your own progression, bring forward ideas, and spot opportunities to improve

  • You’re not comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Our speed and scalability are what set us apart; you need to be able to act quickly and think on your feet

  • You struggle to follow through on ideas. We value people who do what they say they will. If you care about something, you have the freedom here to make it happen

  • You don’t like change. You’ll get on great here if you relish the ambiguity of rapid growth and are willing to embrace uncertainty

What’s in it for you…

We offer a generous mix of benefits for the things that really matter to our people, including:

Base salary based on experience and skills demonstrated during our assessment phase

🌴 27 days holiday + bank holidays (some can be flexible) + day off on your birthday + three days (full time) per year for Dependant leave

💙 Two volunteering days per year

🏅 Length of service award – one month paid sabbatical at eight years

✅ 6% employer pension contribution, and life assurance

🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

👪 Enhanced Parental leave

💻 MacBook and up to £500 home office set up budget

📖 £750 per person learning budget

🌎 Option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

🌻 Health and wellbeing initiatives including free therapy via Wellness Cloud, mental health support via Headspace

🌱 Strong financial wellbeing focus including access to Octopus Money, Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing offering via Octopus Legacy

🎁 Perkbox – Flexi-points giving you a range of discounts and perks including free weekly coffee, gym and retail discounts

🚲 Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way thing, and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you. Our interviews are conversational, so come with questions and be curious. In general, you can expect the interview process to look a bit like this:

  • Talent screen - 30 min intro call with our Talent partner or an Engineering manager

  • Bar raiser - 40 min with two Engineering leaders focused on Engineering culture alignment

  • Technical loop - 2h virtual technical assessment with 2 core components - system design, TypeScript code review with breaks between the stages. You will receive preparation materials for the round and more information on how to prepare.

⏳ We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out and you should expect to hear back from us within one to two weeks of applying.

🌈 Our aim is to build a diverse and inclusive company of awesome people, with unique skills, passions and experiences. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you!

title: Senior Software Engineer -  Ruby on Rails
descriptionHtml:
We're hiring a senior full-stack engineer to help us build the next version of FeedbackFruits.

  • Most of the work comes down to one thing: making the product better. We rethink each feature from the user's perspective and rebuild it on stronger foundations, together with our designers and product managers.

  • We modernise the stack as we go, moving from Rails + Ember.js to Rails + Hotwire. There's deeper technical work alongside it, on performance, stability, and the platform, all in service of a product that feels faster and more reliable.

  • Stabilisation and simplification are our top concerns, from both a product and an engineering standpoint. We'd rather fix root causes for the long term than patch symptoms, even when patching would be quicker.

  • Our long-term aim is to get closer to our users by shipping faster, moving from one monthly release with regular hotfixes toward continuous delivery.

  • We've also adopted agentic coding and integrations to sharpen how we work, and we value multipliers: engineers who raise the people around them and put the team before their own output.

What you'll do:

  • Join one of our engineering squads and own full-stack delivery on the roadmap, from backend logic and database design to the server-rendered UI it connects to

  • Lead the migration of Ember features to Rails + Hotwire, which means understanding the existing functionality, redesigning it thoughtfully together with PMs/designers, and shipping something better than what was there before

  • Handle support escalations and legacy bug-fixing as part of the mix alongside feature work. The balance will depend on which squad you join, but keeping the codebase healthy and customers unblocked is part of the job

  • Contribute to improving our CI/CD practices and deployment pipeline as we work toward more frequent, more reliable releases

  • Keep performance in mind across the stack

  • Build and maintain integrations with Learning Management Systems using LTI and partner APIs

  • Participate in code reviews and technical design discussions, bringing both quality standards and a pragmatist's sense of what's worth the effort

What you bring:

  • You have 5+ years of professional software engineering experience and Ruby on Rails is your home stack: you've shipped production code with it, you know its conventions, and you're comfortable in its edges

  • You write tests as a matter of course, not as an afterthought. RSpec and Capybara are part of your regular toolkit, and you write tests that actually catch things rather than just confirm the happy path

  • You are user-oriented: when you're deciding how a feature should work, your first instinct is to think about the person using it, not the implementation that's most convenient

  • You've worked in a legacy codebase before and come through it well. You know what to fix, what to leave, and how to leave things better than you found them without getting stuck in a refactoring spiral

  • You understand CI/CD well enough to work within good practices and to nudge a codebase toward them when they're missing

  • You communicate clearly, give honest feedback in code reviews, and take it just as well. You’re collaborative without needing everyone to agree with you

  • You are pragmatic and document your decisions; you'd rather make a thoughtful trade-off and write it down than chase the perfect solution indefinitely

  • Familiarity with Ember.js or migration scenarios from it to Hotwire is a genuine advantage here; experience with AI dev tooling, Azure, or observability practices would serve you well too

title: Senior Software Engineer — Software Platform & Middleware
descriptionHtml:
Build the Software Platform Powering Next-Generation Mobility

Apex.AI is developing the software foundation for autonomous systems, intelligent machines, and software-defined vehicles. We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer to help advance our core software platform technologies, including Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida.

In this role, you will work on high-performance middleware, runtime systems, developer tooling, and software platform infrastructure used in safety-critical and real-time environments. You will collaborate closely with world-class engineers to design and implement robust software components that enable scalable, reliable, and production-ready mobility systems.

This is an opportunity to work deeply in modern C++, distributed systems, middleware, operating systems, and developer platforms while contributing directly to products deployed in real-world applications across automotive, robotics, aerospace, and industrial automation.

We are looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex systems problems, writing clean and maintainable code, and building technology that other developers rely on every day.

This role is based in our Munich office.


What You’ll Do
  • Design, develop, and maintain core software components for Apex.AI products, particularly Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida
  • Build new software platform capabilities, middleware features, developer tooling, and runtime infrastructure
  • Improve performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability across the platform stack
  • Investigate, debug, and resolve complex system-level and distributed software issues
  • Develop and maintain automated tests, CI workflows, and development tooling
  • Collaborate closely with product, platform, and applications teams to deliver production-quality software
  • Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical design decisions
  • Contribute to engineering best practices, development workflows, and technical standards
  • Help shape product direction through direct collaboration with customers and internal stakeholders

What You Bring
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience
    • Strong software engineering fundamentals and system design skills
    • Excellent programming skills in modern C++ and solid experience with Python
    • Experience developing software on Linux-based systems
    • Hands-on experience with middleware or communication technologies such as DDS, shared memory IPC, SOME/IP, ROS, or similar systems
    • Experience working with application frameworks or SDKs for distributed or embedded systems
    • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across complex software stacks
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
    • Collaborative mindset with a desire to work in a high-performing engineering team
    • Curiosity, ownership mentality, and eagerness to learn new technologies

Nice to Have
  • Experience with multiple middleware technologies and distributed systems architectures
  • Familiarity with networking concepts, TCP/IP, sockets programming, and low-latency communication
  • Experience with ROS 2 and modern robotics software ecosystems
  • Knowledge of Interface Definition Languages (IDLs), code generation, or domain-specific languages
  • Familiarity with automotive software architectures and standards such as AUTOSAR
  • Experience with real-time operating systems such as QNX
  • Exposure to autonomous systems, robotics, or software-defined vehicle platforms
  • Experience developing safety-critical software following ISO 26262 or similar functional safety standards
  • Familiarity with cloud-native development tools and infrastructure

Why Apex.AI
  • Build foundational platform technology used in real-world autonomous and intelligent systems
  • Work with highly experienced engineers on technically challenging problems
  • Contribute to cutting-edge middleware, runtime systems, and developer infrastructure
  • Engineering-driven culture with meaningful ownership and impact
  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and professional growth opportunities
  • International team working at the forefront of mobility software innovation

About Apex.AI

Apex.AI is an international software company specializing in the development of safety-certified, developer-friendly, and scalable software for mobility systems, aiming to accelerate the transition to software-defined vehicles and mobility. Founded in 2017 by Jan Becker and Dejan Pangercic, the company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with additional offices in Munich, Stuttgart, Gothenburg, Tokyo, and Pangyo. To date, Apex.AI has raised over $75 million USD from world-class venture, financial and strategic investors including AGCO, Airbus Ventures, Canaan, Continental AG, Daimler Truck, HELLA Ventures, Jaguar Land Rover’s InMotion Ventures, LG Electronics, Lightspeed, Orillion, Toyota Ventures, Volvo Group Venture Capital and ZF.

The company’s flagship product, Apex.OS, consists of two core components: Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida.

  • Apex.Grace is an application runtime framework in the form of a software development kit (SDK). It provides a robust framework for developing real-time, reliable, and safe applications. Core APIs are based on ROS 2 APIs with numerous extensions enabling real-time execution, reliable performance, deployment into large fleets, system state management, safety, security, and much more. It is safety-certified to ISO 26262 ASIL D.
  • Apex.Ida is a communication middleware delivering optimal high-performance data transport across use cases. These use cases range from fully autonomous vehicles with dozens of high-resolution cameras to small signals with ultra-high frequencies in safety-critical domains. Its core is based on a shared memory data transport with connectors into DDS, SOME/IP, MQTT, CAN, and many more protocols, all abstracted into a single application facing API.

Additionally, Apex.AI offers:

  • Apex.Alan provides customers with a highly optimized and efficient software integration, development environment, build, test, and delivery process.
  • Apex.OS for V&V enables record and playback of very large and diverse data streams, both time- and data-deterministically, which is crucial for replay, analysis, and performance evaluation of complex autonomous systems.​

Apex.AI’s software solutions are utilized across a diverse range of industries, including automotive, agriculture, medical, and defense sectors. The products enable developers to efficiently create and deploy safe, reliable, and high-performance applications, thereby accelerating the adoption of software-defined mobility systems. Through its innovative software solutions and strategic partnerships, Apex.AI is at the forefront of transforming the mobility industry, facilitating the development of next-generation vehicles and systems.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you'll do

Kaluza runs the billing and payments engine behind some of the world's biggest energy retailers. Every bill sent and every payment collected across Kaluza's markets increasingly runs through one shared core platform, and GBPA exists to build and run that core, so foundational billing and payments capability gets built once and reused everywhere, rather than rebuilt separately for every new market or client relationship.

That matters because of where Kaluza is headed: as we grow into new markets and take on more of the world's largest energy retailers as clients, rebuilding core billing and payments capability separately for each one is slower, costlier, and more error-prone than building it once and configuring it at the edge. Getting this right directly shapes how fast Kaluza can bring new markets and clients onto the platform, and how reliable that platform is once they're on it.

We're also in the middle of reorganising how this part of the business works, moving from building billing and payments capability separately per area toward one shared global core that every area configures rather than rebuilds. Senior Engineering Managers across GBPA sit at the centre of that shift, each owning two domains rather than a single team.

  • Own technical and product strategy across both domains simultaneously, rather than handing strategy off to a single team.

  • Diagnose systemic and organisational issues using deep domain knowledge, not just resolve team-level technical problems.

What you'll bring

  • A proven track record leading engineering team(s) through complex, ambiguous, cross-squad initiatives — not single-team delivery.

  • Experience owning technical and product strategy across multiple domains or services simultaneously.

  • Track record of diagnosing systemic or organisational issues and resolving them with deep domain knowledge, not just fixing team-level technical problems.

  • Be a strong cross-functional stakeholder manager, working with Product, Delivery, and adjacent engineering teams to align roadmap and trade-offs.

  • Have full people-leader experience: goal-setting, performance and pay conversations, hiring and recruitment for the team(s) you lead.

  • Have a track record of successfully navigating complex stakeholder and leadership dynamics, influencing the wider organisation beyond your direct scope to improve product quality and team experience.

What will set you apart:

  • Experience operating a "global core, configurable edge" or multi-market platform model (one engine, configuration at the edge, no client-specific forks of core logic).

Our Values

title: Senior Solution Consultant
descriptionHtml:
About Rimes

Rimes provides the Intelligence Fabric for Capital Markets, a trusted data network and intelligence architecture that transforms fragmented data, operations and workflows into decision-grade intelligence. The world’s leading institutional investors, asset managers, and service providers rely on Rimes to help them make better investment decisions that power more than US$ 75 trillion in AUM annually.

A Senior Solution Consultant at Rimes is a recognized functional expert who leads workstreams and initiatives across client engagements. You have firm, working knowledge of your domain both from a business and technical perspective and you use that expertise to own outcomes, not just tasks. You are self-managing: you set your own priorities within agreed project objectives, manage your stakeholders without prompting, and lead the consultants working alongside you. You bring a strategic lens to your engagements, identifying what is not being asked as well as what is and you are trusted to represent Rimes' capabilities in complex client environments independently.

Rimes Professional Services is the change agent that enables clients to unlock value from Rimes' data management, benchmarking, and platform services. The Solution Consulting team sits at the heart of PS spanning the full client engagement lifecycle from initial scoping and requirements discovery through to solution design, delivery, validation, and adoption The Consulting function operates across three primary product tracks self-serviced Data Management and Investment Intelligence, Rimes-serviced Data Management, and Benchmarks & Indices (B&I) each with its own delivery model, which is reflected throughout this job description.

WHAT WILL YOU DO: 

Client Engagement & Requirements

  • Lead requirements discovery across complex, multi-workstream engagements, including facilitated workshops with senior client stakeholders
  • Interpret ambiguous or conflicting requirements, identifying the underlying need and guiding clients towards solutions that address it
  • Manage scope proactively — identifying scope creep, influencing clients towards pragmatic approaches, and ensuring changes are managed formally
  • Act as the primary Rimes consulting point of contact for your assigned client workstreams

Solution Design & Advisory

  • Design and own solution approaches for complex client use cases, covering multiple asset classes and data domains
  • Lead solution design sessions and client workshops, facilitating effective engagement and clear decision-making
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve client processes and expand the value Rimes delivers beyond the immediate project scope
  • Challenge non-standard client approaches confidently and constructively, backed by evidence and comparable engagement experience
  • Review and quality-assure solution designs and documentation produced by Solution Consultants on your team

Delivery & Team Leadership

  • Own delivery outcomes across your assigned workstreams, taking accountability for the quality and timeliness of your team's contribution
  • Anticipate and actively manage delivery risks; escalate promptly when senior involvement is required
  • Mentor and guide Solution Consultants working alongside you — reviewing outputs, providing constructive feedback, and helping them develop their capability
  • Collaborate cross-functionally across Professional Services, Product and Engineering teams as needed to drive delivery

Validation, Adoption & Practice Development

  • Lead UAT planning and execution, defining acceptance criteria and managing client engagement through the testing cycle
  • Guide clients through technology change, identifying adoption risks and addressing them proactively
  • Contribute to the development and improvement of PS best practices, delivery standards, and methodologies
  • Provide structured feedback to Product teams on client needs, product gaps, and field observations

General Delivery and Change

  • Support change beyond formal project delivery where required, including smaller client change, post-deployment enhancements, defects and transition activity, applying your expertise to understand the need, shape the appropriate solution and support it through to a successful outcome.
  • Support wider Professional Services and Rimes priorities as required, including internal projects, change initiatives and activities aligned to company and functional OKRs, contributing your expertise wherever it can add value.

AI & Innovation

  • Lead adoption of AI-enabled workflows within your engagements, identifying where new tooling can accelerate delivery or improve quality
  • Contribute to team capability-building by sharing effective AI workflow practices with less experienced colleagues
  • Stay actively current with evolving AI capabilities relevant to your product track

Qualifications and Desired Experience

  • Deep working knowledge of investment management, asset management, or financial data operations across multiple domains (e.g. equities, fixed income, alternatives, derivatives)
  • Strong understanding of data management workflows and technical considerations relevant to the product track
  • Demonstrated experience leading client-facing solutioning and delivery on complex, multi-workstream engagements
  • Experience mentoring or guiding more junior practitioners in a consulting or delivery environment
  • Familiarity with Rimes products or deep experience with comparable data management or benchmarking platforms

Skills

  • Ability to lead complex solution design and translate it into actionable, well-communicated delivery plans
  • Strong stakeholder management — able to influence at project and operational level without formal authority
  • Clear communication across operational, project, and senior client audiences — able to calibrate message to audience
  • Comfortable managing competing priorities across multiple workstreams independently
  • Constructive challenge — advocating for best practices diplomatically while maintaining client relationships

Key Attributes

  • Accountable for outcomes, not just tasks and takes ownership of what the team delivers
  • Self-managing: sets priorities, manages stakeholders, and escalates proactively without being prompted
  • A natural informal leader and mentor and invests time in developing the consultants around them
  • Brings a strategic perspective and sees what is not being asked as well as what is
  • Consistently models the professional standards in the PS Consulting Excellence Framework

Only selected candidates will be contacted for interviews. We appreciate your understanding. Thank you for considering a career with us.

title: Senior Solutions Architect
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Role:

Every Celonis outcome starts with data. As a Solutions Architect, you make sure our customers’ data gets into the Celonis Platform reliably, securely, and at scale, and that insights and actions flow back out into the systems and AI tools where work actually happens.

You’ll join our customer project teams as one of the first technical faces of Celonis. You’ll work hands-on across the full integration toolkit: deploying our out-of-the-box extractors, building custom API connectors in a low-code environment, writing code for push-based ingestion, connecting Celonis to customer lakehouses and LLMs, and configuring writebacks, SSO, and user provisioning. Part implementation consultant, part integration engineer, part trusted technical advisor, this role is ideal for someone early in their career who wants broad exposure to enterprise architecture and modern data and AI integration patterns.

The work you’ll do:

Data integration and ingestion:

  • Implement standard extractors. Install, configure, and troubleshoot Celonis out-of-the-box extractors in customer landscapes, including SAP (ECC and S/4HANA), JDBC-based databases, and cloud applications such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, and others.
  • Build custom API connectors. Design and build custom connectors with Celonis Extractor Builder for source systems that expose data through REST or SOAP APIs, handling authentication (OAuth 2.0, API keys, certificates), pagination, rate limits, and incremental (delta) loads.
  • Enable push-based ingestion. Help customers design and develop scripts and pipelines (typically in Python) that push data to Celonis via the Data Ingestion API, and advise on file formats, scheduling, and error handling.
  • Connect to the lakehouse. Set up zero-copy data sharing between Celonis and customer lakehouses such as Databricks and Microsoft Fabric, including Delta Sharing configuration, access controls, and data freshness.
  • Unblock infrastructure. Work through on-premise agent deployments, networking, proxies, firewall and IP allowlisting, certificates, and service-account permissions with customer IT and infrastructure teams.
  • Keep pipelines healthy. Tune extraction schedules and delta strategies, monitor pipeline health, and resolve data load failures so customers get timely, trustworthy data.

Actions, AI, and platform connectivity:

  • Close the loop with writebacks. Configure Action Flows and other integration patterns that write back to customer systems (for example, updating records in SAP, Salesforce, or ticketing tools) so Celonis insights turn into action.
  • Connect Celonis to AI. Help customers connect Celonis to their LLMs and AI agents through MCP (Model Context Protocol), covering authentication, permissions, and governance.

Identity, security, and governance:

  • Own authentication and provisioning. Configure SSO (SAML, OIDC) with identity providers such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, and Ping, and set up SCIM-based user and group provisioning.
  • Be the security translator. Support customer security, privacy, and compliance reviews, explain the Celonis architecture and data flows, and advise on topics like data minimization, pseudonymization, and least-privilege access.

Customer and team impact:

  • Scope with confidence. Run technical discovery, document integration architectures and requirements, and estimate effort so projects start on solid footing.
  • Partner across teams. Serve as a technical point of contact for customer IT, data, and security stakeholders, and work closely with Value Engineers, Data Engineers, Project Managers, Partners, Support, and Product & Engineering.
  • Be the voice of the field. Escalate product gaps and bugs with clear, reproducible detail, and share field feedback that shapes our integration roadmap.
  • Build reusable assets. Contribute reusable connector templates, scripts, runbooks, and best-practice documentation that scale across customers and partners.

The qualifications you need:

  • 5+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role such as solutions engineering, integration or implementation consulting, data engineering, or technical consulting.
  • Hands-on experience with REST APIs and common authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, API keys, tokens); comfort using tools like Postman to explore and test APIs.
  • Solid programming skills in Python (or a similar language) and strong SQL skills.
  • Working knowledge of data pipelines and ETL/ELT concepts, including incremental loads, scheduling, and handling large data volumes.
  • Familiarity with identity and access management concepts such as SSO (SAML/OIDC) and SCIM provisioning.
  • A basic understanding of networking and security fundamentals (TLS and certificates, proxies, firewalls, VPNs).
  • The ability to explain technical topics clearly to both engineers and business stakeholders, and to manage your own workstreams across multiple customer projects.
  • Curiosity, ownership, and a bias toward solving problems hands-on.
  • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Experience with SAP data structures, tables, or extraction (for example, RFC, ODP, or S/4HANA).
  • Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP) and/or lakehouse platforms such as Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, or Snowflake.
  • Exposure to iPaaS or low-code integration tools (for example, MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, or Power Automate).
  • Familiarity with LLMs, AI agents, or MCP.
  • Experience with Docker or Linux server administration.
  • Relevant certifications (for example, Celonis, cloud, or SAP certifications).

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Retire the ERP.

Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our AI-native financial platform gives modern, global companies automated accounting, real-time reporting and financial flows that move at the speed of the business. In a short time we've become the operating core for companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot.

Multinational companies don't stop at one market, and neither do we.

Come help us take Light into Benelux, Latin America, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific, and make it the global default for next-gen finance.

The role

TLDR: Own pre-sales from first discovery to signed contract across four growth regions, and build the local know-how that lets Light win there at scale.

Every new market brings its own GAAP, tax rules, e-invoicing mandates, banks and incumbent ERPs. Finance leaders there want proof that Light handles their reality, not just the UK or US version of it.

You'll work hand in hand with Account Executives in each region, pull in Product and Engineering when a requirement is new, and as a senior early hire you'll define how we sell technically in markets where we're starting from scratch.

What you'll do

  • Run the technical sales cycle. Lead discovery, solution design and tailored demos for CFOs, controllers and finance teams at multinational companies across Benelux, LATAM, the Middle East and APAC.

  • Own the hard questions. Handle objections on integrations, data migration, security, controls and audit trail, and run proofs of concept against each prospect's own data and success criteria.

  • Make Light local. Map country requirements such as local GAAP and IFRS, VAT and GST, e-invoicing (Peppol, CFDI, NF-e, ZATCA), multi-currency and statutory reporting to how Light handles them, and flag clearly where it doesn't yet.

  • Build the regional playbook. Create demo environments, localized scenarios, RFP answers and technical collateral for each market, so the next deal there moves faster.

  • Work with local partners. Support accounting firms, implementation partners and resellers in each region with technical enablement and joint deal work.

  • Feed the roadmap. Turn what you hear in each market into clear localization priorities for Product and Engineering, and use AI tooling to cut the time each evaluation takes.

What you'll bring

  • 3+ years as a Solutions Engineer, Solutions Consultant or Pre-Sales lead for ERP or finance software, ideally vendor side, with a record of closing complex multi-entity deals.

  • A strong accounting foundation: close, consolidation, intercompany, multi-currency, revenue recognition and controls, with hands-on knowledge of local requirements in at least one of our growth regions.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one major ERP (NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics or Workday) and real implementation work: data migration, integrations, APIs.

  • Experience selling across countries and cultures, and comfort working across time zones and travelling regularly to customers.

  • Executive presence and crisp writing. You make complex things simple, in a demo, a workshop or a one-page proposal.

  • Genuinely AI-native. You've changed how you work because of AI tooling, not just added it to your workflow.

Bonus points

  • Professional fluency in Dutch, French, Spanish, Portuguese or Arabic, in addition to English.

  • A qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CPA or a local equivalent), or a background at a Big 4 or regional accounting firm desirable

  • Experience being the first technical hire in a new region and building its playbook.

  • You've configured AI agents in production or built your own tools with them.

Probably not for you if: you've used ChatGPT once and weren't impressed, or you'd rather follow a proven playbook than write the first one.

Discover more at www.asteralabs.com.

About Astera Labs 

Astera Labs (NASDAQ: ALAB) is a pioneering fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Silicon Valley, driving the evolution of AI and cloud infrastructure through purpose-built connectivity solutions. As a leader in rack-scale architecture, Astera Labs is enabling the shift to AI Infrastructure 2.0, where compute is optimized at the rack level to support next-generation workloads. 

Our portfolio spans high-performance silicon, software, and system-level solutions that address critical bottlenecks in data movement across compute, memory, and networking domains. Role Overview 

Astera Labs is seeking a hands-on Senior Sourcing Specialist – Germany Operations & Manufacturing to support sourcing and procurement activities for our operations in Aachen, Germany. This role is responsible for supplier management, purchasing operations, commercial negotiations, and procurement support for manufacturing operations, engineering infrastructure, capital equipment, facilities, laboratories, and corporate services. The role will also provide support for materials management and logistics activities as needed to help ensure efficient operation of the Aachen site. 

The ideal candidate will serve as a key sourcing partner for the Aachen site, working closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations, Facilities, Finance, and Global Procurement teams to ensure the timely and cost-effective acquisition of equipment, materials, and services required to support manufacturing operations and site growth. 

The ideal candidate will bring experience supporting optical communications technologies, advanced manufacturing, engineering, laboratory, or other highly technical operating environments. Experience sourcing capital equipment, technical equipment, specialized services, or manufacturing-related products and services is highly desirable.

You will help ensure manufacturing and operational readiness by sourcing critical equipment, managing supplier relationships, obtaining quotations, supporting commercial discussions, and coordinating the procurement of materials and services needed to support day-to-day operations. 

Your responsibilities will range from sourcing production capital equipment and manufacturing consumables to supporting facility expansion projects, supplier performance initiatives, and logistics coordination. While the primary focus of this role is sourcing and procurement, you will also assist with materials planning, inventory tracking, and supplier delivery management to help support operational continuity as the Aachen operation continues to scale. 

This is a highly collaborative role requiring strong organization, responsiveness, customer service, and the ability to manage multiple sourcing activities across a diverse group of stakeholders.

  • Manage purchase requisitions, purchase orders, delivery tracking, and invoice resolution activities. 
  • Coordinate supplier onboarding, compliance documentation, and supplier performance reviews.

  • Identify opportunities for cost savings, supplier improvements, process efficiencies, and operational enhancements. 
  • Maintain procurement records and ensure compliance with company policies and applicable regulatory requirements. 

Basic Qualifications

  • 5–8+ years of experience in sourcing, procurement, purchasing operations, supply chain, manufacturing support, or related functions. 
  • Experience sourcing capital equipment, manufacturing consumables, production materials, MRO supplies, laboratory equipment, or technical products and services.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

descriptionHtml:

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

You will be the business advisor and main point of contact to some of our most important accounts. You will act as the voice of our product and ambassador of our brand, delivering expertise, education, and mentorship to our merchants. The key for success here will be the ability to use your business savvy knowledge and the required gravitas to effectively communicate and influence at all levels to achieve mutually beneficial scenarios and promote our value proposition.

 

The ideal candidate is an independent, high-achieving individual, able to stand out in an ambitious environment and excel through self-motivation and personal drive. If you are eager to join a thriving, fast-paced environment this is the role for you to make a difference.

 

How you’ll make an impact

- Building high touch, consultative, and nurturing relationships with our merchants through regular and open communications, both face-to-face and virtual.

- Delivering expertise, education, and guidance to merchants. Act as their payment consultant as they craft and complete a comprehensive, global payments strategy.

- Negotiate win-win pricing structures by growing a thorough overview of a merchant's revenue drivers to deliver the best, sustainable outcomes for both merchant and Checkout.

- Tracking merchant project deliverables and ensure merchant activities are updated within SalesForce, Clari, and other CRM tools.

- Understanding the intricacies of our products, services and partner networks thoroughly to leverage this against our merchants’ growing needs.

- Collaborating with various teams (e.g. Sales, Legal, Integration, Support) across the company to ensure an outstanding merchant experience and bring the voice of the customer to our internal stakeholders.

Qualifications

title: Senior Specialist, Information Security
descriptionHtml:
Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7.
