Your mission

As an Information Security Senior Specialist, you will lead and scale major elements of our security governance in a regulated fintech environment. You’ll own complex, cross-functional GRC domains (e.g., ISMS/ISO 27001 at scale, regulatory readiness, enterprise technology risk, third-party risk for critical vendors, compliance in key partnerships), drive measurable improvement in control effectiveness, and act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders.

What you’ll do 

  • Information Security Operating Model & GRC Ownership: Own and evolve one or more GRC domains end-to-end (e.g., ISMS operations, BCM, risk governance), including strategy, annual plan, cadences, and success metrics. Drive control rationalization and proportionality: tighten controls for critical/regulated assets and streamline low-risk areas to ensure an efficient, risk-aligned posture.

  • Risk Management & Strategic Decision Support: Facilitate and challenge high-impact risk assessments (new products, major architectural changes, critical vendors), ensuring consistency and defensible rationale. Drive risk treatment at scale: align owners, negotiate timelines, track commitments, and escalate where residual risk remains above appetite.

  • Audit, Assurance & Continuous Control Testing: Lead complex audits and assessments end-to-end (multi-entity, regulator-facing), including readiness, walkthroughs, and remediation. Design and run a risk-based control testing program to identify weaknesses and drive durable remediation (process fixes, automation, tooling) while translating regulatory requirements into structured internal work programs.

  • Third-Party Risk & Critical Supplier Oversight: Set due diligence depth and ongoing monitoring requirements for critical suppliers (e.g., cloud, payments, identity, SaaS); partner with Procurement/Legal on security contract requirements to ensure enforceable obligations and measurable oversight across the supply chain.

  • Enablement & Leadership through Others: Mentor Specialists, Associates, and Senior Associates; set quality standards for documentation, evidence, and stakeholder engagement. Act as a “GRC translator” for engineering and operations teams, helping them implement requirements efficiently and consistently across the organization.

title: Senior Specialist, Market Planning
descriptionHtml:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

At Wolt, keeping courier supply healthy across every city we operate in is core to a great experience for both customers and couriers. As we've scaled to dozens of countries and hundreds of cities, planning & managing supply has grown from a market-by-market exercise into a global challenge: we need a system that plans well everywhere at once, from our largest metros to our smallest cities.

That's where this role comes in. As Senior Specialist, Global Market Planning, you'll help refine the models and tools at the heart of how we plan courier supply globally. You'll make sure the right supply levers are pulled in the right markets, and you'll help us learn which levers actually work. It's a role at the crossroads of data, tooling, and operations. It's for someone who is as comfortable designing a test or building a model as they are working out why a specific market is off plan and what to do about it.

You'll be part of the Global Market Planning team and will partner closely with local operations and courier marketing so that our planning always reflects the reality on the ground.

What you'll be doing

  • Develop the global planning model: Help develop and refine our global supply planning model so it delivers robust coverage across both large and small cities, accounting for local context like holidays, special events, etc.
  • Allocate investments across markets: Help optimize supply lever allocation, translating region and country budgets into the right mix of levers for each market.
  • Test and learn in markets: Propose tests and actions within markets, in line with lever allocation, especially where we don't yet know the right answer or don't have enough data to rely on history. You'll work with local teams and analytics to shape the approach and turn what we learn into the next plan.
  • Build the tooling: Develop tools that ensure the correct supply levers are being used effectively across markets to hit our targets.
  • Deep dive & solve: Investigate problem areas, identify root causes, and turn your findings into corrective actions and better planning approaches.
  • Collaborate: Partner with regional supply leads, local operations teams, and central teams (finance, procurement, product, analytics) on plans, performance, and improvements.
  • Improve how we work: Test and prove new concepts in planning, acquisition, onboarding, and activation, and support the roll-out of global improvements across regions.

Our humble expectations

  • 3+ years of experience in consulting, operations, analytics, or strategic business development in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical and modelling skills, with a structured, pragmatic approach to solving complex problems.
  • Experience designing and interpreting tests or causal analyses, and good judgment about what you can and can't conclude from them in a marketplace setting.
  • A systems view of supply: you consider trade-offs between levers and their knock-on effects on cost, courier experience, and customer experience.
  • Comfort making and defending recommendations with incomplete data, and adapting your thinking when the facts change.
  • Proficiency in SQL, Looker, and Excel/Google Sheets modelling. Python, Cursor, and Claude Code are a plus.
  • An attitude for action and ownership beyond the obvious, always looking for opportunities to improve, with the determination to drive change.
  • The ability to work across cross-functional teams and manage relationships with stakeholders, both local and global.
  • A true culture champion who leads by example with collaboration, teamwork, and data-driven decision making, and who brings humility and respect to every interaction.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
  • Based in Berlin or Helsinki, with the ability to work in a hybrid model from our Wolt office.

Next steps

What to expect from our hiring process:

  1. Talent Acquisition screen — an introductory conversation with our recruiter to learn more about your background and answer any initial questions about the role.
  2. Hiring Manager interview — a deeper conversation with the team manager about your experience, the team, and what this role involves day to day.
  3. Assignment — a practical task related to the role, giving you a chance to show how you approach real problems in this space.
  4. Final interview — a conversation with a senior stakeholder to round out the process.

If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then click below to apply and get the conversation going!

We will be reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so if this sounds like an opportunity you want to pursue, apply today!

Please submit your up-to-date resume in English. 

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

That's where this role comes in. As Senior Specialist, Global Market Planning, you'll help refine the models and tools at the heart of how we plan courier supply globally. You'll make sure the right supply levers are pulled in the right markets, and you'll help us learn which levers actually work. It's a role at the crossroads of data, tooling, and operations. It's for someone who is as comfortable designing a test or building a model as they are working out why a specific market is off plan and what to do about it.

You'll be part of the Global Market Planning team and will partner closely with local operations and courier marketing so that our planning always reflects the reality on the ground.

What you'll be doing

  • Develop the global planning model: Help develop and refine our global supply planning model so it delivers robust coverage across both large and small cities, accounting for local context like holidays, special events, etc.
  • Allocate investments across markets: Help optimize supply lever allocation, translating region and country budgets into the right mix of levers for each market.
  • Test and learn in markets: Propose tests and actions within markets, in line with lever allocation, especially where we don't yet know the right answer or don't have enough data to rely on history. You'll work with local teams and analytics to shape the approach and turn what we learn into the next plan.
  • Build the tooling: Develop tools that ensure the correct supply levers are being used effectively across markets to hit our targets.
  • Deep dive & solve: Investigate problem areas, identify root causes, and turn your findings into corrective actions and better planning approaches.
  • Collaborate: Partner with regional supply leads, local operations teams, and central teams (finance, procurement, product, analytics) on plans, performance, and improvements.
  • Improve how we work: Test and prove new concepts in planning, acquisition, onboarding, and activation, and support the roll-out of global improvements across regions.

Our humble expectations

  • 3+ years of experience in consulting, operations, analytics, or strategic business development in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical and modelling skills, with a structured, pragmatic approach to solving complex problems.
  • Experience designing and interpreting tests or causal analyses, and good judgment about what you can and can't conclude from them in a marketplace setting.
  • A systems view of supply: you consider trade-offs between levers and their knock-on effects on cost, courier experience, and customer experience.
  • Comfort making and defending recommendations with incomplete data, and adapting your thinking when the facts change.
  • Proficiency in SQL, Looker, and Excel/Google Sheets modelling. Python, Cursor, and Claude Code are a plus.
  • An attitude for action and ownership beyond the obvious, always looking for opportunities to improve, with the determination to drive change.

title: Senior Stack Scientist
descriptionHtml:
Senior Stack Scientist

About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy.

As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks.

  • Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles.

  • Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance.

  • Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams.

  • Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies.

  • Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production.

  • Translate results into clear requirements for flow fields, bipolar plates, MEAs, sealing and compression.

  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers, and present results to internal stakeholders and partners.

Skills and Experience Required

  • PhD or MSc in electrochemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field.

  • 12+ years of experience in fuel cell stack development or testing (PEM preferred).

  • Strong grasp of stack physics: water and heat management, reactant distribution, contact resistance and compression.

  • Hands-on experience with stack test benches, cell voltage monitoring, EIS and durability/AST protocols.

  • Solid understanding of MEA, GDL and bipolar plate degradation mechanisms.

  • Experience with modelling and data analysis tools (e.g. Python, MATLAB, COMSOL or similar).

  • Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Team player who can also work autonomously in a fast-moving environment.

  • Management experience

  • English is mandatory; French or German is a plus.

Start date: Immediately

Your primary focus will be the pricing engine, which sets the fees added to every quote tem serves, carefully balancing growth and margin. You will also contribute to the systems which manage both short and long-term imbalance decisions to determine how tem deals with its exposure across its portfolio.

This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role. You own the technical direction of pricing by building it: most of your week is writing and shipping production code. It is not a people leadership role, and not an architecture role where others do the implementing.

The right person is energised by the greenfield environment: comfortable taking on ambiguity and able to make progress before the path is fully defined. They have built pricing, trading or optimisation systems that worked, ideally in energy or another market-driven domain, and have learned from the times they haven't. They'll bring that hard-won judgment to a system where the foundations are still being laid, and where early decisions compound. Success will be turning our current reactive system into a pricing engine which proactively drives growth by targeting the right customers to sign at the right time.

🚀 Responsibilities:

  • Own the technical direction for pricing ML: Define what to build and how within the pricing engine, setting the strategy and roadmap for pricing machine learning as a core piece of tem's IP.

  • Build ML systems for price optimisation: Design and implement models that dynamically set prices, balancing the trade-off between signing probability, portfolio balance and margin maximisation.

  • Solve imbalance problems: Develop probabilistic models to optimise risk management and short-term balancing decisions in a highly dynamic environment.

  • Bridge modelling and production: Own the modelling and data layer while working closely with software engineers and MLOps to ensure models are architected for production, contributing to system design decisions that affect performance and reliability.

  • Communicate pricing decisions clearly: Articulate model behaviour, assumptions, and trade-offs to other technical stakeholders so that pricing decisions are understood across the teams that depend on them.

🎯 Requirements:

Must-haves:

  • Deep experience building ML systems for pricing, revenue optimisation, or decision-making under uncertainty, with a track record of models that went from concept to production and delivered measurable commercial impact.

  • A quantitative background in a domain where prices, forecasts and risk interact: energy markets, power trading, batteries and flexibility, market making, or similar. Energy is strongly preferred and where our strongest fits have come from.

  • Strong foundation in stochastic optimisation and probabilistic modelling, with the judgement to formulate ambiguous business problems as the right mathematical approach rather than reaching for familiar tools.

  • Proven first-principles reasoning: you choose between stochastic programming, classical ML, reinforcement learning, or a simple heuristic based on the problem, not the technique you know best.

  • The engineering craft to match your modelling depth: production-grade Python, a high bar for code quality and system design, and the ability to work alongside software engineers as a technical peer across the full ML lifecycle.

  • Breadth across the full lifecycle: you carry the modelling and quant work and the productionising (deploying, monitoring, reasoning about the software systems around your models), and you would rather ship the whole thing to a good standard and iterate than perfect one component. You reason at the level of the outcome, the portfolio and its levers, not a single model.

Bonus points:

  • Experience with reinforcement learning or causal inference in applied, commercial settings.

  • PhD or equivalent research depth in a quantitative discipline (statistics, applied mathematics, physics, operations research, or similar).

  • Ability to reason about the trade-offs between optimisation solvers (Gurobi etc) and gradient-based ML methods (PyTorch etc), and the judgement to know when to reach for each.

  • Experience working with high data throughput systems in production.

✨ Benefits & Perks:

  • Salary: Competitive. We are looking to pay £127,000 or equivalent in local currency.

  • Stock Options: everyone on the team has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday + public holidays. Swap public holidays for ones that matter most to you. Plus, get an extra day off for your birthday 🎉.

  • Remote working: we're fully remote, distributed across Europe

  • Home working & wellbeing budgets:

    • Up to £1,200 / €1,200 annually to upgrade your remote setup (co-working passes, equipment, etc.).

    • Up to £150 / €150 monthly on anything that supports your wellbeing, from therapy to gym memberships to meditation apps.

🗣️ Interview Process:

Our processes normally take around 2-3 weeks from first call to offer. Please let us know about any adjustments to timelines that may be required.

  1. First call with our Talent Team (30 mins). This is to understand your experience, motivations, and discuss the role in more detail.

  2. Behavioural interview with our Rosso GM, hiring manager for this role (30 mins). This is your chance to really understand the role, the expectations, and ensure alignment on ways of working.

  3. Technical interview with the Team (90 mins). You'll meet with potential peers in this session and work through a live technical exercise.

  4. Bar Raiser interview with Stakeholders (45 mins). The final session will be with two cross-functional stakeholders.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

title: Senior/Staff Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.


We're looking for seasoned Product Designers who thrive in ambiguity and challenging problem spaces.

n8n is a powerful, flexible technical tool, which means the problems you tackle as a designer are complex. Your design decisions must account for diverse user workflows, technical constraints, and how changes impact the entire platform. To thrive here, you will need to love talking to users, understanding technology, and reducing complexity and scope.

You'll be embedded in a product squad alongside a product manager and around three to five engineers, owning the user experience for your area end to end. Our design team is small but growing, so you'll shape the craft bar and the culture, not inherit them.

We're hiring designers across the following teams:

  • Enterprise (two roles - Governance & Observability, and Licence & Billing): You've worked on technical B2B platforms. You've designed for scale, governance, and collaboration across teams, including permissions, environments, observability, and failure modes included and you're comfortable making deeply complex systems feel coherent and simple.

  • Adore - Adoption & Retention: You have exceptional product sense and can connect disparate elements into a coherent whole. You'll take something complex, with many moving parts, and make it make sense - shaping what the visual layer of n8n becomes next. Experience with data visualisation is welcome; deep technical expertise isn't required.

  • n8n Labs: As a Product Designer, you'll own discovery end-to-end, spotting the riskiest assumptions, running the research, and turning findings into decisions without waiting on a brief. You move fast, cut scope without losing what matters, and you're hands-on enough to build and ship your own prototypes, including using AI tools to get there quicker. You've got product and business judgment, not just craft; you can spot an opportunity and make the case for it. Founder or co-founder experience is a helpful signal but not a requirement.

Team assignment is confirmed at the offer stage and may be subject to change as the team structure evolves.

🎯 Regardless of the team, your main goal will be to lead end-to-end product design on complex workflows that elevate n8n's user experience, ship measurable outcomes, and raise the quality bar across our platform. To do so, here are your responsibilities:

End-to-end product design

  • Lead the full design process for your team, from discovery to polished delivery, collaborating closely with PMs and engineers.

  • Consistently ship high-quality, visually cohesive designs that improve the overall UX at every release.

  • Work effectively on complex features and understand the underlying technology.

  • Take ownership of complex, multi-faceted problems and drive them to completion with initiative and autonomy.

Research, feedback, and UX quality

  • Own the direction of research for your team, decide when it's needed, choose the right methodology, and take the initiative without waiting to be told.

  • Champion the user by running interviews, usability tests, and research to inform critical product and business decisions.

  • Master the feedback loop by gathering, synthesizing, and acting on input while giving actionable critique to elevate teammates' work.

  • Balance speed and quality in an MVP-driven environment, navigating ambiguity while maintaining a high bar.

Systems thinking and platform coherence

  • Design in systems, integrating solutions into the broader n8n platform and safeguarding the product's big picture.

  • Account for edge cases, constraints, and interaction details so users never end up in impossible states.

  • Collaborate across teams and designers to ensure consistency and quality across shared patterns and components.

Strategy, impact, and innovation

  • Shape team strategy by influencing planning, prioritization, and scope with a strong design perspective tied to KPIs.

  • Explore and adopt AI and automation tools to push the boundaries of design practice and AI-powered workflows.

Senior or Staff?

We're open at both levels, and we'll calibrate with you during the process. At Senior, you own your squad's design end-to-end and ship work that raises the bar for your area. At Staff, you do that, and your influence reaches beyond your own squad - you shape patterns other designers build on, and you take on the problems that span teams. Both are hands-on: this is not a step away from the craft.


REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🎨 Product design excellence: You're proficient across product design, UX, UI, and qualitative research, delivering polished, detail-oriented work.

  • 🧠 Technical mindset: You collaborate effectively with engineers and understand how software is built, including common web technologies. You don't need to write code, but you do need genuine curiosity about what's happening underneath - APIs, webhooks, data structures and how workflows actually execute.

  • 🧭 Ownership & delivery: You've shipped end-to-end features in smaller teams or startups and can drive complex problems to measurable outcomes.

  • ⚡ Fast, focused execution: You operate at high speed in an MVP-driven environment, balancing quality and velocity amid ambiguity.

  • 📈 Outcome orientation: You use research and metrics to inform decisions and consistently deliver solutions that enable team KPIs.

  • 🤝 Feedback & collaboration: You're open and non-defensive in critique and provide actionable feedback that raises the team's bar.

  • 🧪 Curiosity for AI: You're enthusiastic about AI and innovation, actively exploring new tools and approaches to advance the craft.

  • 📅 Experience level: You have 5+ years in product design with demonstrable impact on shipped products.


Nice-to-haves

  • 💻 Front-end fluency: You can prototype using HTML/CSS/JavaScript, with or without AI coding tools, and can collaborate effectively with engineers on the result.

  • 🧩 AI & automation domain: You've designed AI or automation products; familiarity with n8n is a plus.

  • 🔁 Process improvement: You proactively refine team rituals and workflows to increase effectiveness.

  • 📚 Continuous growth: You invest in your craft and are motivated by creating tangible product and company impact.

  • 🔎 Discovery frameworks: You know methodologies like Continuous Discovery or Shape Up.

  • 📊 Data-informed design: You're comfortable with metrics, A/B testing, or SQL to guide decisions.

  • 🚀 Entrepreneurial drive: You've built startups or side projects that show initiative and creative problem-solving.


Why join us?

At n8n, your work won't disappear into a slide deck. You'll lead high-impact design across core product surfaces, shaping AI-powered workflows, enterprise governance and billing, and how people discover and adopt n8n, from discovery to delivery. You'll join a fast-growing, Europe remote-first company where autonomy, experimentation, and craft matter, partnering closely with PMs and engineers to ship real outcomes to a passionate global community.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now and help us build the future of automation.

Benefits

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

title: Senior Staff Security Engineer, AI Security
descriptionHtml:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. 

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

As a Senior Staff Security Engineer focused on AI Security, you will be Ripple's deepest technical expert at the intersection of artificial intelligence and security. This is a purpose-built, high-impact individual contributor role that spans two critical mandates: securing AI systems that Ripple builds and operates, and harnessing AI to make Ripple's security function faster, smarter, and more scalable.

You will lead the technical strategy for AI security across the agentic SDLC, define and operationalize guardrails for LLM and agentic AI adoption, and build AI-powered security tooling in close partnership with the broader organization to embed AI security into how Ripple operates every day. You will also shape Ripple's external posture on AI security, contributing to industry standards, regulatory discussions, and Ripple's published security practices.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Drive the AI Security technical strategy and roadmap, defining how Ripple secures its AI systems, governs agentic workflows, and embeds security controls into the AI development lifecycle from day one.
  • Design and implement security controls for LLM-integrated and agentic AI systems, including sandboxing, identity and permission scoping, runtime monitoring, and containment of autonomous agent actions that exceed authorized scope.
  • Own AI security across the Controlled Agentic SDLC, establishing security guardrails, AI provenance standards, dual-review requirements, and audit trail controls for AI-assisted development across Ripple Engineering.
  • Lead the security review and risk assessment of all AI integrations entering production, including LLM APIs, SaaS copilots, AI code editors, agentic workflows, third-party MCP servers, and vendor-embedded AI.
  • Build and scale Ripple's Shadow AI detection capability, surfacing unsanctioned AI usage, driving adoption of the AI acceptable use policy, and ensuring all AI workflows operate within Ripple's auditable perimeter.
  • Serve as Ripple's go-to technical resource on agentic AI risks, including MCP server security, tool poisoning, prompt injection at the orchestration layer, and excessive agency in multi-agent systems, translating emerging threats into concrete mitigations with Engineering and Product.
  • Shape Ripple's external AI security posture, contributing to industry frameworks, engaging regulators, and publishing research that establishes Ripple as a credible voice in responsible AI security. 

WHAT YOU'LL BRING: 

  • 10+ years of Security Engineering experience with demonstrated depth in at least two domains, such as Product Security, Cloud Security, or Security Operations, and meaningful hands-on exposure to AI or ML security in practice.
  • Solid understanding of AI and LLM security concepts, including prompt injection, jailbreaks, data poisoning, model extraction, RAG manipulation, and agentic risks such as tool poisoning, excessive agency, and MCP server vulnerabilities.
  • Experience securing agentic AI systems, including sandboxing, permission scoping, human-in-the-loop design, or runtime monitoring for autonomous workflows.
  • Fluency with core Security Engineering domains including cloud security on AWS, GCP, or Azure, CI/CD pipeline security, container and Kubernetes security, IAM, and API security, with the ability to reason about how these apply in AI-specific contexts.
  • Strong threat modeling instincts, whether using STRIDE, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP LLM Top 10, or your own approach, and comfort applying frameworks to architectures where the playbook remains in development.
  • Experience in FinTech, crypto, or other highly regulated environments is a strong plus, ideally with exposure to frameworks like NYDFS, MAS, DORA, or SOC 2 as they relate to AI adoption.
  • Proven ability to work across teams, influence technical direction without direct authority, and bring structure to problems that span Engineering, Product, and Security.
  • A genuine builder's mentality. You are energized by problems without established playbooks, comfortable building in ambiguity, and motivated by raising the bar in an area that is still being defined.

Other common names for this role: AI Security Architect, LLM Security Engineer, Agentic AI Security Lead

WHO WE ARE:

Do Your Best Work

  • The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
  • A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact.  A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
  • Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
  • In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in.

  • We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!

Take Control of Your Finances

Take Care of Yourself

  • Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.

descriptionHtml:

VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore. 

VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. 

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on  LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

About VML Live

At VML Live, we believe brands don’t just belong in ad breaks—they belong in culture.

We exist to create moments that matter in the real world. By uniting brand ambition with genuine fan passion, we turn sponsorships and commercial rights into living, breathing cultural phenomena. Whether it’s global sports tournaments, music festivals, gaming universes, or grassroots movements, we ensure our clients show up where audiences are genuinely invested.

The Opportunity

A brand’s partnership rights are only as powerful as the way they are activated. Too many sponsorships end at logo placement; at VML Live, that’s where our work begins.

As a Senior Strategist (Sport & Entertainment), you will sit at the vital intersection of brand strategy, commercial rights, and multi-channel comms planning. Your mission is to take partnership assets—new or legacy—and translate them into culturally resonant, high-impact activation strategies that excite fans and move the commercial needle.

You will own strategic relationships across flagship accounts, guide creative teams with inspiring, actionable briefs, and spearhead pitches that showcase VML Live’s specialist edge to prospective clients across the globe.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect End-to-End Activation Plans: Translate brand ambitions, fan insights, and complex rights packages into integrated, channel-ready activation frameworks spanning experiential, digital, social, PR, content, and paid media.
  • Unlock Value Beyond Visibility: Ensure every asset, contractual right, and IP opportunity is leveraged creatively and commercially—moving clients from passive sponsor to active cultural participant.
  • Be the Strategic Catalyst for Creative: Partner closely with creative teams, providing sharp, fertile briefs and frameworks that empower them to develop bold work with speed, focus, and clarity.
  • Lead Pitches & Drive Growth: Play a pivotal role in new business and competitive pitches, crafting compelling narratives that demonstrate how partnership activation drives measurable business outcomes.
  • Collaborate Across the Network: Champion integrated thinking by seamlessly connecting with teams across VML Live, broader VML, and WPP sister agencies.
  • Prove What Works: Partner with data and effectiveness teams to build robust measurement frameworks, proving ROI and turning campaign learnings into future strategic advantage.

Who You Are

  • A Cultural & Fan native: You understand fandom, subcultures, and audience behaviors in sport, music, gaming, or entertainment, and know how brands can show up authentically without gatecrashing.
  • An Integrated Strategist: You have proven experience bridging brand strategy, partnership activation, and comms/channel planning within an agency, rights holder, or brand environment.
  • A Master Storyteller: You know how to structure an argument, articulate a vision, and deliver presentations that captivate senior clients and win high-stakes pitches.
  • Commercially & Operationally Astute: You understand rights contracts, sponsorship mechanics, and production realities—ensuring your strategic visions are both ambitious and executable.
  • A Collaborative Leader: You thrive in fast-paced, multi-disciplinary environments and enjoy mentoring junior team members while holding your own with senior stakeholders.

Why VML Live?

  • Unrivalled Scale & Access: Work with some of the world’s most recognizable brands, governing bodies, and entertainment properties.
  • Connected Culture: Join a collaborative, forward-thinking team backed by the global reach, tools, and intelligence of the VML and WPP network.
  • Real Cultural Impact: See your ideas come to life in stadiums, arenas, digital spaces, and on the streets—shaping how fans experience the things they love most.
  • Growth & Flexibility: We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, flexible hybrid working policies, and dedicated career development pathways.

Senior Strategist 

Company: VML
Working Model: Hybrid working
Location: Sea Containers office, London, SE1

At VML, we are a beacon of innovation and growth in an ever-evolving world. Our heritage is built upon a century of combined expertise, where creativity meets technology, and diverse perspectives ignite inspiration. With the merger of VMLY&R and Wunderman Thompson, we have forged a new path as a growth partner that is part creative agency, part consultancy, and part technology powerhouse.

Our global family now encompasses over 30,000 employees across 150+ offices in 64 markets, each contributing to a culture that values connection, belonging, and the power of differences. Our expertise spans the entire customer journey, building connected brands that drive growth for our clients. We do this by leveraging our three core practices: Brand Experience, Customer Experience and Commerce. Within these practices, we offer expertise across communications, commerce, consultancy, CRM, data, production and technology. We deliver end-to-end solutions that result in revolutionary work.

The Role

As a Senior Strategist, you'll be an important strategic voice within the team, working closely with Client Services, Creative, Data, Media and other specialist disciplines to turn business and customer challenges into clear, effective solutions.

You'll work on one of our major Pan-European automotive accounts, helping develop strategy across the customer journey — from brand consideration and lead generation through to lifecycle CRM, digital experiences and retail activations.

You'll be involved from brief through to delivery, using customer understanding, data, research and cultural insight to develop strong strategic thinking and give creative teams a clear direction. You'll also help ensure the work remains connected to the client's wider commercial objectives.

This is a hands-on role, with the opportunity to take ownership of projects and workstreams while working closely with senior members of the strategy team. You'll have regular exposure to clients and will be expected to build trusted relationships, present your thinking confidently and contribute to conversations with stakeholders at different levels.

There will also be opportunities to contribute to wider strategic projects, proactive thinking and new business, giving you the chance to bring your perspective to different challenges and develop your experience across the agency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop strategic thinking across projects and workstreams, from understanding the brief through to creative development, client sell-in and measuring effectiveness.
  • Turn business, customer, cultural and behavioural information into clear, actionable insights and strategic recommendations.
  • Develop compelling strategic and creative briefs that give creative teams a clear direction and space to do their best work across CRM, digital, social, search and dealership assets.
  • Support end-to-end CRM communications across Passenger and Commercial Vehicles, including automated and triggered reminders, such as maintenance, MOT and servicing, seasonal promotional campaigns and ad-hoc owner messaging.
  • Develop consideration and conversion activations for individual vehicle nameplates across UK and European markets, ensuring communications ladder seamlessly into wider global brand positioning.
  • Contribute to the development of digital servicing journeys, helping increase consideration for official servicing through effective content and customer experience.
  • Apply an understanding of modern search behaviour, including Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) and LLM-ready content, to relevant communications and digital experiences.
  • Work closely with Client Services, Creative, Data and Media partners to develop connected and effective solutions.
  • Build strong working relationships with clients and become a trusted and credible strategic partner.
  • Present strategic thinking and recommendations clearly and confidently to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Use data, research and customer understanding to inform recommendations and strengthen the work.
  • Challenge briefs and thinking constructively when there is an opportunity to make the work better.
  • Contribute to pitches, proactive strategic projects, quarterly thought leadership and opportunities to grow existing and new client relationships.
  • Support more junior members of the strategy team, sharing knowledge and helping raise the quality of strategic output.
  • Bring curiosity and new thinking into the team, keeping up with changes in culture, technology, customer behaviour and the wider industry.

Who You Are

  • Strategically strong: You can get to the heart of a problem, identify what really matters and turn it into a clear point of view.
  • Commercially minded: You understand how strategic thinking connects to client business objectives, customer acquisition, lead generation and long-term retention.
  • Confident but collaborative: You're comfortable presenting your thinking and contributing to senior conversations, while being open to challenge and different perspectives.
  • A strong communicator: You can make complex thinking feel simple, whether you're presenting to a client or briefing a creative team.
  • Customer curious: You genuinely want to understand what makes people tick and how behaviours, needs and motivations can influence the work.
  • Low ego: You care more about getting to the right answer than getting credit for having it. You enjoy working with different people and bringing the best out of those around you.
  • Adaptable: You can move comfortably between different types of briefs, from brand and communications strategy to CRM journeys, digital experiences and retail activation.
  • Culturally and technologically curious: You're interested in what's happening in the world and know how to turn those observations into useful strategic thinking. You're also interested in emerging technology, AI, LLMs and evolving search behaviours.
  • A team player: You enjoy working alongside Client Services, Creative and specialist teams and understand that the best work rarely comes from one person working alone.

What You'll Need

  • Proven experience working as a Strategist or Senior Strategist within an agency environment. Automotive, mobility or Pan-European client experience would be a strong advantage.
  • Experience developing strategic thinking from brief through to creative development and delivery.
  • Strong understanding of customer behaviour, customer journeys and how different communications and experiences work together.
  • Experience across some combination of brand, communications, CRM/lifecycle marketing, digital, social, search or customer experience.
  • Confidence presenting strategic thinking and recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • The ability to interpret data and research and turn it into meaningful insight.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex information clear and compelling.
  • Experience working collaboratively with Creative, Client Services, Data, Media or other specialist teams.
  • Experience contributing to pitches and/or proactive strategic projects would be beneficial.
  • Experience supporting or mentoring more junior team members would be advantageous.
  • An understanding of modern search trends, AI, LLMs and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) would be beneficial.

What Success Looks Like

  • Strategic thinking that is clear, compelling and rooted in genuine customer and business insight.
  • Work that gives creative teams a strong strategic foundation and a clear opportunity to respond to.
  • Clients who value your thinking and see you as a trusted strategic partner.
  • Strong collaboration across Strategy, Creative, Client Services and specialist teams.
  • Strategic recommendations that contribute to meaningful client and business outcomes.
  • The ability to take ownership of projects and move them forward with confidence.
  • A positive contribution to the development and quality of the wider strategy team.
  • Bringing clarity, curiosity and momentum to complex challenges.

What's in It for You?

  • The opportunity to work on high-profile clients and commercially meaningful challenges.
  • The chance to work alongside talented people across Strategy, Creative, Client Services and specialist disciplines.
  • A genuinely collaborative environment where different perspectives are encouraged.
  • The opportunity to work across a broad range of strategic challenges and develop your experience.
  • A culture that values good thinking, curiosity, collaboration and people who aren't afraid to challenge the status quo.
  • Strong learning, development and career progression opportunities.
  • A competitive package, hybrid working and access to the full suite of company and group benefits.

title: Senior Strategy & Operations - Success Department
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1300 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 300,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

 

Strategy & Operations chez Pennylane :

Chez Pennylane, faire partie de la fonction Strat & Ops, c’est parfaitement comprendre les problématiques opérationnelles. Ensuite, nous concevons et implémentons des solutions efficientes et scalables qui permettent à Pennylane d’atteindre et dépasser ses plans de croissance (de 110 000 à 1 200 000 clients entre 2024 et aujourd'hui). Pour déplacer ces montagnes, nos équipes Strategy & Operations travaillent au quotidien avec les équipes Tech (développeurs, Product Manager) et Data (Scientists, Analysts…).

 

L’objectif :

Améliorer de façon très significative la productivité des équipes par une meilleure utilisation des outils et une forte simplification.

 

Le quotidien :

Tu seras la/le responsable, l’interlocuteur.trice privilégié.e et la personne qui drive le changement au sein du département Customer Success (CS), aux côtés des managers opérationnels en charge des services professionnels, du support client et des chargés de comptes.

 

Ton rôle sera :

- D'être force de proposition et moteur de la transformation : tu observes, écoutes, questionnes, challenges le status quo et suggères constamment des points d’amélioration et des moyens de réduire le temps actuellement passé à des tâches administratives de saisie ou recherche d’information. Tu permettras l'anticipation de la croissance future et tu documenteras les changements.

- De mettre en oeuvre des points relevés via des nouveaux systèmes d’information, des modifications d’applicatifs existants et/ou des changements d’organisation. Tu devras conduire des projets au sein du CS tout en t’appuyant sur des compétences extérieures au service tels que la data, sales ou finance par exemple. Ta mission sera aussi de s'assurer de la satisfaction client, de veiller au respect des délais et de suivre les indicateurs de performance de mise en place.

- D'écouter et observer les autres services, de prendre du recul, de comparer, d'élaborer des benchmarks afin de nourrir ta propre réflexion.

- De mettre en place une communication forte et un accompagnement de proximité des équipes CS afin de les faire adhérer à de nouvelles méthodes de travail (configuration optimale, formation, amélioration continue…). Tu t'assureras de l’adoption et du support au quotidien des outils et process.

- De donner de la visibilité au niveau ops et data : aller comprendre au niveau corporate les challenges auxquels les équipes font face afin d’en anticiper et de comprendre les impacts sur le CS.

 

Profil recherché :

Nous recherchons un profil ambitieux, avec de précédentes expériences réussies sur des enjeux de transformation, d’amélioration de productivité et de gestion de projets.

 

Le candidat a les compétences et expériences suivantes :

- Expérience en transformation et amélioration de productivité par la mise en place de SI

- Une curiosité naturelle et l’envie de vraiment avoir de l’impact : capacité forte d’écoute et d’observation

- Expérience complète de la gestion de projet : tu sais cadrer un problème rapidement, livrer vite et itérer, sans attendre que tout soit parfait

- Capacité à, d’une part, descendre dans le détail et d’autre part, prendre du recul et analyser

- Mindset business

- Excellent(e) communicant(e) (à l’oral et à l’écrit), capacité à vulgariser un problème

- Appétences/connaissances sur l’IA, nocode, ou toute forme d’automatisation est souhaité

- Fortes capacités analytiques (une bonne maîtrise SQL est un plus)

- La connaissance d'un département Customer Support ainsi que des outils Intercom, Zendesk et Salesforce est un plus

 

Process de recrutement :

- Premier échange avec Florent - Recruteur - 45 min visio

- Second entretien avec Laetitia Bruneton (Manager) - 1h visio

- Étude de cas (sur site) : avec François Aubry (VP Success) et Laetitia

- Last round (sur site) : Eric Scaramozzino (VP Strategic Initiatives)

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

title: Senior Structures Design Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

As Senior Structures Design Engineer (all genders), you will be responsible for key structural design work for VÆRIDION’s CS-23 all-electric aircraft.

You will develop lightweight, manufacturable, safe and certifiable airframe structures from concept through detailed design, prototype build, test support, and production-ready release. Your work will cover primary and secondary structures, metallic and composite design and structural integration.

You will work closely with Material and Processes, Systems, Production, Configuration, Certification, Safety and external partners to turn our aircraft architecture into robust, buildable hardware while mentoring junior engineers within your area of expertise.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Independently execute regular structural design activities and assigned design work packages.

  • Develop concepts, layouts, and detailed designs for primary and secondary aircraft structures.

  • Apply hand calculations and first-principles engineering to support early sizing and design decisions.

  • Own structural design tasks from load-path definition, material and process selection, preliminary sizing, and trade studies through released CAD models and documentation.

  • Create and mature airframe integration concepts, including interfaces to systems like landing gear, propulsion battery installation, electrical routing, interiors, etc.

  • Work with analysis engineers to ensure designs are structurally sound, weight-efficient, inspectable, repairable, and suitable for certification.

  • Create high-quality 3D models, assemblies, installation layouts, model-based definitions (MBD), and configuration-controlled design data.

  • Drive design-for-manufacturing for metallic and composite structures.

  • Support prototype manufacturing, supplier reviews, structural testing, non-conformance resolution, and design improvements.

  • Coordinate product development activities with teams from engineering, production, certification, quality, and suppliers.

  • Contribute to technical discussions and lead design reviews within your assigned scope.

  • Solve local and multidisciplinary design issues, escalating highly specialized topics where needed.

  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to structural design standards, methods, and best practices.

 

Your Profile:

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • 10+ years of aerospace structural design experience, with deep proficiency in Catia V5 or 3DExperience.

  • Demonstrated performance on at least two aircraft development programs, such as clean-sheet aircraft, major modifications, prototype-to-certification programs, or production ramp-ups.

  • Strong experience designing primary and secondary aircraft structures in metallic and composite materials.

  • Solid understanding of structural load paths, joints, fittings, fasteners, grounding and bonding, GD&T manufacturability, inspectability, repairability, and installation constraints.

  • Strong hand-calculation skills and the ability to make sound design decisions before detailed analysis is available.

  • Ability to independently develop, compare, and mature airframe and integration concepts within an agreed technical scope.

  • Good understanding of airworthiness and certification principles related to aircraft structures, ideally including EASA CS-23, compliance documentation, test substantiation, and configuration control.

  • Strong understanding of cross-functional dependencies between design, stress, systems, production, certification, quality, and suppliers.

  • Ability to solve local and multidisciplinary issues while recognizing when specialist input or supervision is required.

  • Excellent communication skills, strong team orientation, and the ability to work effectively across functions.

  • Structured working style, and strong technical judgement.

  • Experience managing suppliers and supporting internal or external design reviews.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

title: Senior Structures Integration Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

As Senior Structures Integration Engineer, (all genders), you will be responsible for key structural design and integration work for VÆRIDION’s CS-23 all-electric aircraft.

You will develop lightweight, manufacturable, safe and certifiable airframe structures from concept through detailed design, prototype build, test support, and production-ready release. Your work will cover primary and secondary structures, metallic and composite design and structural integration.

You will work closely with Flight Physics, Material and Processes, Systems, Production, Configuration, Certification, Safety and external partners to turn our aircraft architecture into robust, buildable hardware while mentoring junior engineers within your area of expertise.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Independently execute structural integration activities and assigned integration work packages.

  • Coordinate, develop and mature physical interfaces across major airframe assemblies, flight controls, systems, equipment, batteries, landing gear, interiors, and electrical installations.

  • Identify, manage and track the maturity of structural, mechanical, geometric, and equipment installation interfaces.

  • Translate aircraft-level architecture and system requirements into integration constraints, space allocations, interface requirements, and installation design solutions.

  • Be responsible for integration work packages from initial architecture and space allocation through interface definition, design maturity, and released configuration.

  • Prepare and maintain Interface Control Documents, Frontier Package models, space allocation envelopes, keep-out zones, and other integration data.

  • Maintain and mature the aircraft Digital Mock-Up (DMU) and Product Structure, as well as perform clash detection, clearance checks, accessibility assessments, and support zonal analyses.

  • Liaise with internal and external engineering teams to define routing paths, structural provisions, penetrations, cut-outs, and attachment concepts.

  • Consider safety, certification, load, weight, interchangeability, manufacturability, inspectability, and maintainability requirements.

  • Work closely with Design and Analysis engineers to develop technically robust and weight-efficient integration solutions.

  • Coordinate interfaces across major airframe assemblies including fuselage, wing, empennage, doors, movable surfaces, landing gear, and propulsion or battery installations.

  • Lead integration reviews, track multidisciplinary issues and risks, and drive the stakeholders towards resolution.

  • Support prototype manufacturing, aircraft assembly, structural and system testing, non-conformance resolution, and design improvements.

  • Coordinate integration activities with internal engineering teams and external Design & Build partners.

  • Prepare and lead interface reviews, DMU reviews, integration reviews, and installation maturity reviews.

  • Track integration issues, dependencies, assumptions, risks, and technical decisions through closure.

  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to integration standards, methods, and engineering best practices.

 

Your Profile:

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • 10+ years of aerospace engineering experience, with strong experience in aircraft structural integration, airframe design, or aircraft systems installation.

  • Strong proficiency in CATIA V5 and/or 3DEXPERIENCE 3D modelling, including design of large assemblies and installations, DMU reviews, clash and clearance checks, and work with configuration-controlled Product Structures.

  • Demonstrated performance on at least two aircraft development programs, such as clean-sheet aircraft, major modifications, prototype-to-certification programs, or production ramp-ups.

  • Strong understanding of primary and secondary aircraft structures in metallic and composite materials.

  • Strong experience integrating aircraft structures with systems, equipment, landing gear, propulsion, batteries, interiors, electrical installations, or flight-control systems.

  • Solid understanding of structural load paths, joints, fittings, fasteners, equipment attachments, penetrations, grounding and bonding, corrosion protection, tolerancing, and installation constraints.

  • Strong understanding of aircraft space allocation, accessibility, maintainability, assembly sequence, inspectability, and removal requirements.

  • Experience developing and managing ICDs, IADs, geometric envelopes, installation requirements, and interface-related engineering data.

  • Experience working with Digital Mock-Ups, large aircraft assemblies, clash detection, clearance analysis, and multidisciplinary design reviews.

  • Ability to independently develop and mature integration concepts using first-principles and engineering judgement when detailed analysis is not available, resolve multidisciplinary issues, and recognize when specialist input or escalation is required.

  • Ability to apply first-principles engineering and sound technical judgement before detailed analysis is available.

  • Good understanding of airworthiness and certification principles related to aircraft structures and installations, ideally for EASA CS-23 aircraft.

  • Strong understanding of cross-functional dependencies between Design, Stress, Systems, Production, Certification, Safety, Quality, Configuration Management, and suppliers.

  • Ability to solve local and multidisciplinary integration issues while recognizing when specialist input or technical escalation is required.

  • Excellent communication skills, strong team orientation, structured working style, and strong technical judgement.

  • Experience managing suppliers and supporting or leading interface, integration, and design reviews.

title: (Senior) Supply Chain Consultant (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the role

Every RELEX implementation is a solution built from scratch for one customer: their processes, their data, their targets. (Senior) Supply Chain Consultants shape both sides of that build — the business processes and KPIs the customer will run on, and the configuration that makes them work in the system. Depending on your background you will lean more towards one side than the other. This is a heavily customer-facing role.

What you'll be doing

  • Understand how the customer really plans. Prepare, facilitate and document workshops to gather and specify business requirements, and run the data analysis that shows where the strengths and the gaps actually are.
  • Design the target picture — planning processes, roles and the KPIs the project is measured on — and guide customers towards RELEX best practice, including where their current way of working needs to change.
  • Build it. Configuration, business rules, workflows and reporting that deliver the design you just agreed, and that hold up in operation: nightly run performance, scalability and maintainability, not just functional correctness.
  • Make the value case tangible for customer leadership: define how forecast accuracy, availability, inventory and cost will be measured, and report honestly on where we stand.
  • Take it live. Coordinate User Acceptance Testing, resolve what testing surfaces, and upskill super users so the customer is proficient and self-sustaining after go-live.
  • Own adoption, not just delivery. A technically correct solution that nobody uses is not a successful project.
  • Document what you built — requirements, scope and configuration — so the project team, the customer and our Continuous Services colleagues can work with it after handover.
  • Work across disciplines: with Technical Consultants on the data model, interfaces and the customer's ERP landscape, and with Project Managers on scope, effort and timelines.

Within RELEX

  • Challenge and develop implementation best practice across industries (grocery, DIY, home goods, pharma, wholesale and more)
  • Share knowledge with the team as both a trainer and a participant, and support colleagues who are earlier in their journey
  • Work with our global teams on international projects and bring practices between regions
  • Use AI tooling actively in your daily work — we expect curiosity here and give you room to experiment

What we're looking for

  • Around 2+ years of relevant experience in supply chain or retail planning, demand and inventory planning, or in implementing / consulting on planning software. A degree in supply chain management, business, engineering, mathematics or computer science is a good foundation — but we care more about what you have actually done.
  • Structured thinking and comfort with ambiguity. Many customer requirements arrive without a ready-made answer. You break them down, work with data, and arrive at a defensible recommendation.
  • Communication that works across levels — from super users in a training room to senior stakeholders in a steering committee, including the conversations where the message is not what the customer hoped to hear.
  • Business-fluent German and English. Both are used daily.
  • Willingness to travel depending on the project phase.
  • Technical affinity: SQL, scripting, or an interest to pick these up

Additionally, for the Senior level:

  • Several years of consulting or implementation experience, including demonstrable ownership of a workstream or a smaller project end-to-end — scope, risk, timeline and completion, not just your own tasks
  • Reliable effort estimation for standard and custom requirements, supporting scoping and SOW discussions
  • Experience coaching and mentoring less experienced colleagues
  • Confidence in front of senior customer stakeholders, including steering committees
  • Hands-on experience with a supply chain planning system, either as a user or as an implementer
  • Experience defining and tracking KPIs or building a value case

Who we are

We’re bold thinkers and kind teammates, growing fast but staying grounded. Our Nordic roots and global outlook shape a culture of friendliness, creativity, and collaboration, all powered by openness and shared wins. We care deeply about doing the right thing - and doing it together. 

  • Flexibility in how and where you work
  • Room to thrivein a fast-growing global company with a good market position
  • Practical benefits that support work, family, wellness, and everyday life
  • Annual leave
  • Diverse, inclusive, and supportive work culture
  • Work that meaningfully reduces waste and improves sustainability
  • Ownership, autonomy and flat hierarchies
  • Two paid volunteering days each year

We are a global community of different cultures, voices, and experiences. We celebrate what makes us unique and connect through what we share, in an authentic and safe environment. Together we shape the future, and each other. 

If you feel this is the opportunity you don’t want to miss, you can apply by sending your resume through the application form as soon as possible. Please note that we cannot process any applications through email.     

Apply today and be part of the future. Be RELEX!

title: Senior Supply Specialist - UK
descriptionHtml:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The UK Operations Team is responsible for delivering Waymo service across UK cities. This role works closely with Product, Operations Partnerships, Engineering, Global Operations, Ops Planning, Finance, Safety, Policy and business partners.

We are seeking a confident, decisive, and results-oriented leader to join our team as a Supply Operations Manager. This role demands an individual who thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments, excels at managing cross-functional teams, and is committed to driving operational success and market excellence for our autonomous ride-hailing service. You'll foster strong partnerships, champion continuous improvement, and leverage data analytics to monitor market health, identify trends, and implement proactive strategies to balance demand and supply, ultimately driving innovation and long-term success.

In this hybrid role, you will report to the Country Lead within the European Market Operations Team.

You will:

  • Strategic Leadership (Partner Support/Management): Strategic and decisive leadership to manage and optimize daily partner operations, fostering a high-performance culture emphasizing collaboration and accountability, escalating product issues while supporting partner multi-facility operations (partner results) to ensure strict adherence to all safety, compliance, and regulatory protocols.
  • Commercialization: Primary liaison to support internal stakeholders in expanding the market by providing guidance and expertise, communicating with all stakeholders to ensure alignment, monitoring progress, identifying potential issues, and developing contingency plans to ensure the success and sustainability of the market scale.
  • Supply & Demand Planning: Manage Supply & Demand Planning by ensuring that staffing levels align with operational needs and in-service supply.
  • Continuous Improvement: Must be continuously monitoring and improving processes, systems, and performance metrics to drive efficiency and productivity, and reduce costs.
  • Co-Lead Market Expansion: Strategically expand the market by executing innovative initiatives with partners, leveraging data insights, and applying critical thinking to identify opportunities and resolve challenges effectively.
  • Build Collaborative Partnerships: Build and maintain strong partnerships across the company and with partners, ensuring alignment with organizational standards, goals, and a shared commitment to success.
  • Drive Sustainable Outcomes: Serve as a trusted leader with a continuous improvement mindset, consistently monitoring and enhancing processes, systems, and performance metrics to drive operational excellence, strengthen stakeholder alignment, and deliver measurable, sustainable results, all while boosting efficiency, productivity, and reducing costs.
  • Maximize Market Profitability: Manage departmental budgets, identifying and implementing cost-saving initiatives, and monitoring key performance indicators to effectively allocate resources and ensure all operational initiatives align with financial parameters and organizational goals.

You have:

  • 10+ years of experience in operations management, preferably managing daily operations in a fast-paced environment in fleet management, transportation, or logistics, with a deep understanding of safety.
  • Bachelor's degree, or in lieu of a degree, an additional 6+ years of work experience in a combination of program management, business operations, strategy consulting, planning, or equivalent fields.
  • Excellent leadership skills, including the ability to motivate & lead by influence partner teams, develop and execute strategies, and drive performance improvement.
  • Ability to deal with multiple conflicting priorities and stakeholder issues while driving towards pragmatic decisions/actions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify and address performance issues proactively, preferably using data analytics tools and reporting software to track key metrics and performance trends.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills showcasing an ability to influence people to contribute to continuous improvement of operations.

We prefer:

  • Experience in Ride-Hail & Transportation: Direct experience in the ride-hailing or broader transportation industry is a significant plus.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Proficiency in leveraging data analytics and reporting tools to monitor market health and inform strategic decisions is essential. Experience with SQL and data mining is highly preferred.
  • Operational Management Experience: A background in general operations management, vendor management in addition to the minimum requirements, would be beneficial.
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset: A demonstrated history of identifying and implementing process improvements to increase efficiency and reduce costs.
  • Strategic & Decisive Leadership: The ability to provide clear, strategic leadership and make quick decisions in a fast-paced environment.

The expected base salary range for this full-time position is listed below. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level.  Waymo employees are also eligible to participate in Waymo’s discretionary annual bonus program, equity incentive plan, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements.
