Jedes Teammitglied erfüllt eine wichtige Aufgabe, ohne die im Ganzen etwas fehlen würde. Wir sind uns sicher, dass diese Wertschätzung motiviert. Nicht ohne Grund sind wir alle mit Freude und Leidenschaft bei der Sache und erreichen dadurch Spitzenleistungen.

Individualität macht uns aus: Teamwork ist uns wichtig, trotzdem verschwindet hier niemand in der Masse.

Arbeiten mit Wohlfühl-Faktor

Den itesys-Spirit haben wir ja schon erwähnt. Teamausflüge, gemeinsame Grillabende oder Office Brunch – wir finden immer einen Anlass zusammenzukommen. Bei uns muss niemand zum Lachen in den Keller gehen: in den Pausen herrscht eine lockere ausgelassene Atmosphäre bei dem alle willkommen sind. Beim Arbeiten kannst du jederzeit auf die Hilfsbereitschaft deiner Kolleg*innen zählen und musst dich nicht davor scheuen, Fragen zu stellen.

Wir freuen uns darauf dich kennenzulernen!

Seit 2012 stehen wir als Schweizer Dienstleister für verlässliche SAP-Landschaften und fundierte Betriebserfahrung. In dieser Rolle verantworten Sie den Betrieb, den Unterhalt und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Rechenzentren, Netzwerke und Firewall-Infrastrukturen. Sie analysieren komplexe Netzwerkstrukturen, optimieren die Performance unserer Systeme und sorgen für eine reibungslose und sichere Datenkommunikation im hybriden Arbeitsumfeld an unserem Standort in Frauenfeld.

title: Senior Systems Engineer - Commissioning and Characterisation
descriptionHtml:
About the job

Explore how a next-generation AI architecture behaves from rack scale to data centre scale. 

As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will investigate a novel AI computing architecture under demanding real-world workloads. You will work on problems where answers aren't readily known, turning curiosity into measurable evidence.

You will design experiments, benchmark representative AI workloads and explore how hardware components and software interact at scale. When behaviour is unexpected, you will turn this into new measurements.

Your work will help infrastructure engineers, architects and application specialists understand system behaviour, performance, scalability and reliability across the stack. You will also help develop tooling and automation to collect, analyse and visualise system metrics.

You do not need to be an AI expert. You will need strong judgement, curiosity and a clear preference for evidence over opinion. You will love this role if you are someone who takes initiative, questions assumptions and enjoys working in areas where the answers are not yet known.

The team and culture

The System QA team is distributed across multiple locations. We work hard to stay connected and collaborate closely. Our daily team meetings feel more like a virtual coffee break than a formal status update with space to share ideas, ask questions, discuss discoveries and solve problems together.

We value trust, autonomy and openness, and we understand that great engineers don't all follow the same career path. What matters is the quality of your work, your curiosity, and your willingness to explore challenging problems.

You will have regular 1:1s with your people manager where you will have the opportunity to discuss things that matter to you. You will have dedicated time each week to focus on your CPD. The technical lead will provide direction and help set priorities, but everyone in the team is there to support each other.

One of our core principles is that we measure and report what we observe without trying to make results look better or worse than they are.

What we're looking for

  • Comfortable using Python to write tests, automate tasks, analyse data or develop practical engineering tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • A curiosity-driven approach to investigating complex systems.
  • Ability to explain technical findings clearly, using accurate and reproducible evidence.
  • Confidence to work independently, take responsibility and collaborate across engineering teams.
  • Experience in some of the following would be valuable: AI workloads and benchmarking, systems architecture, parallel and distributed computing, automation, containers or modern orchestration infrastructure

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences from different industries. We actively welcome applications from engineers to the profession through a returnship or after a career break.

Benefits

  • Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
  • Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
  • Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
  • Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success
  • Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day
  • Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones
  • Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover
  • Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.

Sponsorship

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.

Join the Team at Graphcore

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.

If you want to explore how complex AI systems really behave, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now to join the Systems Engineering team.

title: Senior Systems Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

We are looking to add a Senior Systems Engineer to our team in Munich Germany. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing leading-edge phased array antennas and radios for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in systems engineering, experience in space technology, and the ability to be the technical point of contact for our communication programs. In this position, you will lead the development of communication system architectures, operational concepts, requirements, and system-level performance analysis for advanced communication terminals and networks. You will coordinate activities across multidisciplinary engineering teams, raise issues at the program level, and drive complex programs to success.

The successful candidate will communicate effectively with team members and internal stakeholders, both verbally and through written content.


SUMMARY OF RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Evaluate customer and operational needs to define requirements, integrate technical parameters, and assure compatibility of all physical, functional, and program interfaces.
  • Represent CesiumAstro in customer meetings, design reviews, and technical discussions across Europe.
  • Define and validate space system requirements and interfaces, ensuring end-to-end feasibility.
  • Develop and direct technical concept development in support of proposals and demonstrations.
  • Participate in developing system engineering processes for requirements management, flow-down, and traceability.
  • Lead system-level trade studies, including antenna architecture design, modem design, performance analysis and system level integration
  • Coordinate with RF/Antenna, Electrical, and Software/FPGA engineers to ensure concept feasibility and compliance.
  • Support proposal development, design reviews, and technical documentation.

    • JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  • M.S. or higher in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in system engineering for communications payloads, RF systems, or space/defense platforms.
  • Very strong background in communication theory.
  • Practical experience working with antenna systems (design, integration, or performance evaluation).
  • Experience with and understanding of satellite-communications standards (e.g., NR NTN, DVB-S2x, CCSDS).
  • Proven ability to capture and manage requirements across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Excellent communication skills; comfortable presenting to customers and leading design reviews.
  • Fluent in English (German language skills a plus).
  • Deep understanding of RF concepts, impairments, and their impacts on system performance.

    • WHAT WE OFFER
  • The opportunity to help establish CesiumAstro’s first European office and grow our Munich team.
  • High-impact role with direct exposure to leading EU space programs.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • A collaborative, innovative environment shaping the future of space communications.
    • CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills.
    Please be aware that many roles will be subject to both security and export control restrictions. These restrictions mean that factors including new starter’s nationality, any previous or dual nationalities held, place of birth and country of residence may limit those roles that you can perform for the organization.
    Please note: CesiumAstro does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to CesiumAstro team members not through our approved vendor list or Talent Acquisition will be considered property of CesiumAstro, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees.

title: Senior Systems Software Engineer, GPU Compute
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Systems Engineer to join our team and play a key role in the development of our cutting-edge hyperscaler platform. The GPU & InfiniBand team is responsible for enhancing and optimizing the core components of our Cloud platform, with a specific focus on GPU computing, InfiniBand networks, and the KVM/QEMU stack. You’ll work closely with hardware virtualization and device emulation technologies, ensuring high performance and security in multi-GPU, HPC environments. The role involves analyzing, troubleshooting, and improving infrastructure to support new hardware, fine-tuning system performance, and automating fault detection and resolution in a complex system.

In this position, you will be responsible for:

  • Tuning the performance of GPU clusters and InfiniBand networks to ensure optimal operation in HPC and GPU-based environments. 
  • Analyzing and troubleshooting the root cause of issues related to GPUs and InfiniBand networks, and proposing corrective actions. 
  • Integrating new hardware into the existing infrastructure, including support for new GPU hardware through software stacks like Kubernetes, QEMU, and KVM. 
  • Enhancing automation systems for proactive monitoring, detecting, and resolving issues in GPU and InfiniBand environments. 
  • Configuring and managing GPU devices and InfiniBand fabrics, ensuring efficient and reliable operation.

We expect you to have:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in system-level software development (focused on performance optimization, low-level programming). 
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Linux systems (administration, troubleshooting, and performance tuning). 
  • In-depth understanding of server architecture, including PCIe devices, NICs, Linux OS/Kernel, and high-performance computing (HPC) systems. 
  • Strong proficiency in one or more performance-oriented programming languages (C/C++, Go, Python).

It would be a plus if you have:

  • Experience with GPU end-to-end testing in a cluster environment using InfiniBand networking. 
  • Proven track record of analyzing and optimizing the performance of HPC workloads (e.g., simulations, data analysis, AI/ML workloads). 
  • Familiarity with RDMA, RoCE, and InfiniBand protocols for high-performance communication. 
  • Background in Software-Defined Networking (SDN) and experience with HPC cluster networking. 
  • Understanding of QEMU/KVM virtualization and managing virtualized environments. 
  • Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow, and their integration with HPC systems. 
  • Familiarity with collective communication libraries like MPI and NCCL for distributed computing. 

We offer competitive salaries ranging from $170k-$300k + equity based on your experience.

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

#LI-LH2

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

The Role

We build the control chain that powers on, monitors, updates, and protects devices and racks across bare metal, RTOS, and embedded Linux. It’s production-critical software that keeps racks stable, updates safe, and hardware secure. It’s a critical layer in turning a tokens per second benchmark into a tokens per month system, turning great silicon into reliable output at rack scale.

You’ll be there for the first racks coming to life and rollout days where update safety matters. Your work makes the difference between a bad failure and a clean recovery path. This is the work that makes the system something operators can trust.

What you’ll do

  • Develop firmware and services for management controllers at every level: rack management, BMC, and board/device controllers (RTOS and bare metal)

  • Build systems software for board and rack management, from early bring-up through to production deployment

  • Implement the critical flows that keep fleets healthy: power-on and provisioning, monitoring/telemetry, updates, recovery, and security

  • Integrate with the wider host/device stack (drivers and runtime libraries) so the system works end-to-end

  • Work closely with hardware and device software teams to define reliable interfaces, validate behaviour, and debug boundary issues

What we’re looking for

  • Proven experience shipping production-critical, reliable embedded systems across two or more of: bare metal, RTOS, embedded Linux (or deep expertise in one with clear ability to ramp the others)

  • Strong C and/or Rust, and excellent engineering judgement around safety, testing, debugging, and failure modes

  • A reliability-first mindset: you design for observability, diagnosability, and recovery paths that are predictable and testable

  • Comfortable working close to the hardware/software boundary (bootloaders/BSP/kernel-adjacent work) and collaborating tightly with HW, driver, and runtime teams

  • Collaborative and high-ownership. You communicate clearly, move fast, and enjoy working through hard problems with others

  • Computer Science, Electronic Engineering, Maths, Physics, or related degree and 3+ years of industry experience

Nice to have

  • Embedded platform / systems firmware experience (board management, BMC-style stacks, rack controllers)

  • OpenBMC experience and/or embedded Linux image build/customisation experience

  • Zephyr (or similar RTOS) experience

  • Security-minded, with practical instincts around secure boot, signed updates, device identity, and designing systems that fail safe and recover cleanly (direct experience in some areas is a plus)

  • Kernel device work (drivers, device tree, bring-up, perf/trace)

  • Hardware bring-up experience, including lab tools (logic analysers, oscilloscopes, waveform viewers)

  • RISC-V familiarity

  • Experience with GPUs or ML accelerators

If you want to build the control software that keeps rack-scale systems stable, safe, and secure for next-gen AI, come build it together.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

 

Export controls

Our work involves technologies subject to UK, US and other international export control regulations. Certain roles may require additional eligibility checks to ensure compliance with applicable law. We'll be transparent about this throughout the hiring process.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Manager – Tech (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Cosuno

Construction is a €14 trillion industry that still runs on email, spreadsheets and scanned PDFs. Cosuno is replacing that with AI. General contractors tender their projects on our platform to more than 250,000 subcontractors, and our agentic AI matches the right firms, flags anomalies in bids and benchmarks every price against 6.5 million data points from over €136 billion in processed bid volume. Every tender makes the AI smarter. The results are measurable: general contractors cut costs by around 6 %, subcontractors win 22 % more volume, and every new general contractor customer this year has chosen our AI product. Founded in Berlin in 2019 and backed by Cherry Ventures and Spark Capital with over €40 million raised, we are now scaling our Engineering, AI and Product teams with that capital. That is where you come in.

Your mission

As our Senior Talent Acquisition Manager – Tech, you make sure every seat in Engineering and Product goes to someone exceptional. You report to Maximilian Seifert (CTO) and work closely with Carmen Pölking (Head of Product). Engineers trust you to tell them honestly what a role at Cosuno looks like, and our tech leads trust you to bring them people who raise the bar.

What you will achieve in your first year

  • You hire 25 people across Software Engineering, Product Management and Product Design, owning every process from intake to signed contract.

  • You build warm pipelines of senior engineers before roles open, so we hire through sourcing and referrals instead of agencies.

  • Together with our tech leads, you design structured, scorecard-based interview loops, from technical screening to final interview.

  • You put Cosuno on the map in the Berlin and European tech community, through referrals, meetups and content with our engineers.

  • You advise on levelling, compensation and market trends, so our offers win.

  • You make hiring measurable with a monthly dashboard on time-to-hire, conversion and source of hire.

What the job really looks like

  • The best engineers rarely apply. Most of your hires come from your own outreach, so a large part of your week is sourcing and candidate conversations.

  • You compete with big tech and AI companies for the same people, and you need a compelling story to win them.

  • You talk shop with engineers. You do not need to code, but you understand what a TypeScript full-stack role or an ML engineering role really involves.

  • There is no large TA team and no finished playbook. You build the processes while you hire.

  • You push back when a profile, a process or a decision is not right. We want you to.

What you bring

  • At least 4 years of recruiting experience, of which at least 2 years in-house at a high-growth tech company, hiring software engineers.

  • A track record you can prove in numbers: hires made, time-to-hire and offer acceptance rate. You steer your pipeline by data, not gut feeling.

  • Technical fluency: you understand modern tech stacks and roles (full-stack, backend, AI/ML, platform) well enough to assess candidates and challenge hiring managers.

  • Proven technical sourcing skills across LinkedIn, GitHub and tech communities, including Boolean and X-ray searches.

  • Structured assessment: you have built interview loops with engineering teams and keep them fair, fast and consistent.

  • Strong closing skills: you win engineers against competing offers, including from big tech and AI companies.

  • Fluent English, written and spoken.

Nice to have

  • German language skills.

  • Experience hiring AI/ML engineers.

  • Experience with cross-border hiring in Europe, including Employer of Record set-ups.

  • Hands-on experience with Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter, Clay or Lusha.

  • Curiosity about construction or other traditional industries.

What we offer

  • Salary: €70,000–90,000 gross base salary per year, depending on experience, plus a variable component of 25 % of your base salary at 100 % target achievement, tied to hires who successfully complete their probation period.

  • AI at the core: you work with Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter and you have a budget to test new tools.

  • Learning budget for your professional development.

  • Time off: 25 vacation days per year, rising by one day for each year with Cosuno up to a maximum of 28 days. On top of that, 24 and 31 December are always off.

  • Flexibility: fully remote within Germany or from our office in Berlin-Kreuzberg, with flexible hours.

  • Top equipment: a new MacBook Air.

  • A great team: open and international, with regular off-sites and team events.

  • Stability: permanent contract in a well-funded company.

Our hiring process (max. 4 weeks)

  1. Intro call with Vivien (People Lead), 30 minutes, video.

  2. Live Case Study with one of our Engineers, 60 minutes.

  3. Career deep-dive with Maximilian Seifert (CTO) and Carmen Pölking (Head of Product), followed by a conversation about our culture and values with Vivien Littmann (People Lead), 60 minutes in total.

  4. References: with your consent only, we speak with 1 or 2 hiring managers you have recruited for in previous roles.

  5. Offer.

From your first call to our decision, the process takes no longer than 4 weeks.


Your contact: Vivien Littmann, People Lead


We welcome applications from everyone who brings the skills for this role, regardless of background or circumstances. If you need any adjustments during the process, just let us know.

Compensation: €70K – €90K • Plus a variable component of 25 % of your base salary at 100 % target achievement, tied to hires who successfully complete their probation period.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Bei Superchat gestalten wir neu, wie Unternehmen mit ihren Kund:innen kommunizieren. KI wird dabei immer mehr zum Motor dieser Kommunikation. Integrationen sind das, was diesem Motor echte Power gibt: die Daten, Tools und Systeme, die aus einem cleveren AI-Agenten einen machen, der Prozesse wirklich automatisiert und Probleme löst.

Gegründet im Jahr 2020, ist Superchat heute die Plattform für über 10.000 Unternehmen weltweit - von bekannten Marken wie Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone und GASAG bis hin zu kleinen Unternehmen, Zahnarztpraxen und Solo-Founder:innen, die professioneller auftreten möchten.

Inzwischen laufen täglich Millionen von Nachrichten über Superchat.

Gestartet sind wir als Unified Inbox – ein zentraler Ort für alle Kommunikationskanäle wie WhatsApp, E-Mail, SMS oder Instagram. Mit dem Aufstieg von ChatGPT begann unser nächstes Kapitel: AI Agents, die über Chat, E-Mail und Voice in einer Qualität kommunizieren, die mit den besten menschlichen Teams mithalten kann.

Heute sind wir ein Team von rund 100 Mitarbeitenden, arbeiten profitabel und haben insgesamt 18 Millionen Euro Funding eingesammelt (unsere letzte Finanzierungsrunde liegt bereits 4,5 Jahre zurück – seitdem wachsen wir aus eigener Kraft weiter).

Unser Hauptsitz ist in Berlin.

In dieser Rolle gestaltest du aktiv, wie Superchat wächst. Du verantwortest den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess für zentrale Rollen, arbeitest eng mit Hiring Managern und dem Leadership-Team zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass wir die richtigen Menschen für unser nächstes Wachstumskapitel gewinnen. Wenn du Lust hast, Recruiting strategisch mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig hands-on zu arbeiten, könnte das perfekt zu dir passen.

Who We Want

Experienced and growth-oriented.

Du bringst 3+ Jahre Erfahrung im Recruiting mit und hast gleichzeitig die Motivation, weiter zu lernen, Prozesse aktiv mitzugestalten und gemeinsam mit dem Team zu wachsen.

Startup-minded and fast-paced.

Du fühlst dich in dynamischen Umfeldern wohl, priorisierst smart und behältst auch bei vielen offenen Rollen und wechselnden Anforderungen den Überblick. Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung aus dem SaaS- oder Tech-Umfeld mit.

Recruiting-first mindset.

Du denkst Recruiting nicht nur operativ, sondern strategisch mit. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse und hilfst dabei, unser Talent Acquisition Setup auf das nächste Level zu bringen.

Strong communicator.

Du kommunizierst sicher und professionell auf Deutsch und Englisch – egal ob im Austausch mit Kandidat:innen, Hiring Managern oder im Stakeholder-Management. Klar, empathisch und überzeugend.

Owns processes, not just tasks.

Du übernimmst Verantwortung für den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess – von der ersten Ansprache bis zum Offer – und sorgst dafür, dass Kandidat:innen eine starke Experience haben.

Flexible and calm under pressure.

Du bleibst hands-on, lösungsorientiert und organisiert, auch wenn es schnell geht oder Prioritäten sich kurzfristig ändern.

Who We Don’t Want

  • Menschen mit einer “Das ist nicht mein Job”-Mentalität. Ob kurzfristiges Active Sourcing, ein spontaner Hiring Sync oder Unterstützung bei Employer Branding
  • Kandidat:innen-Erfahrung ist für uns kein “Bonus”. Wir suchen keine Recruiter:innen, die unstrukturierte Prozesse, langsame Kommunikation oder Ghosting als normal ansehen
  • Personen, die bei vielen offenen Rollen oder wechselnden Prioritäten schnell den Überblick verlieren. Startup bedeutet Dynamik und wir brauchen Menschen die darin aufblühen
  • Recruiter:innen, die Recruiting nur als “Rollen besetzen” sehen. Für uns geht es darum, langfristig starke Teams aufzubauen und das Wachstum der Company aktiv mitzugestalten
  • Menschen, die sich ausschließlich auf eingehende Bewerbungen verlassen. aktives Sourcing und starke Pipelines aufzubauen gehört bei uns zum Daily Business.

Your Day To Day

Talent Acquisition & Pipeline Aufbau (ca. 60%)

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Hiring Managern und unserem Leadership-Team zusammen, um Top-Talente in Bereichen wie Product, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance und Engineering zu gewinnen
  • Du entwickelst kreative Sourcing-Strategien und baust dir über LinkedIn & Co. starke Talent-Pipelines für unsere zukünftigen Teams auf
  • Du identifizierst spannende Kandidat:innen proaktiv und begeisterst sie für unsere Vision, unser Wachstum und die Möglichkeiten bei uns
  • Du führst Rollenbriefings mit den Fachbereichen durch, stellst die richtigen Fragen und sorgst dafür, dass alle ein gemeinsames Verständnis des perfekten Kandidatenprofils haben

Process Improvement & Recruiting Operations (ca. 40%)

  • Du denkst Recruiting-Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter, erkennst Reibungspunkte in der Candidate Journey und setzt neue Ideen sowie Experimente zur Optimierung um
  • Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, challengst bestehende Prozesse und hilfst dabei, unsere Recruiting-Strukturen skalierbar und zukunftsfähig aufzubauen

Stakeholders

Kandidat:innen: täglich, wichtigste Ansprechperson während des gesamten Recruiting-Prozesses
People Team: täglich für Check-ins, Prozessoptimierung, Knowledge Sharing und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Recruiting-Strukturen
Hiring Manager: regelmäßig für Rollenbriefings, Profilabstimmungen, Interview-Debriefs und Hiring-Entscheidungen
C-Level & Leadership Team: für strategische Hiring-Themen, Teamstrukturen, Priorisierung und finale Entscheidungen

Why People Choose Us

  • Wir glauben an Zusammenarbeit vor Ort: Du arbeitest mindestens drei Tage pro Woche mit dem Team aus unserem Berliner Office. Viele der besten Ideen entstehen gemeinsam im selben Raum - Entscheidungen werden schneller getroffen, wir lernen voneinander und wachsen als Team enger zusammen
  • Wir sind ein internationales Team mit unterschiedlichsten kulturellen Hintergründen und Sprachen - Offenheit, gegenseitiger Respekt und der Austausch verschiedener Perspektiven prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit
  • Wir schätzen Ambition und Motivation - wir suchen Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Initiative zeigen und Lust haben, sich schnell weiterzuentwickeln
  • Wir arbeiten mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und einer starken Lernmentalität - Fragen stellen, neugierig bleiben und sich kontinuierlich verbessern gehört bei uns dazu
  • Wir legen Wert auf Humbleness und Teamgeist - no Ego, offenes Feedback und die Bereitschaft voneinander zu lernen sind uns wichtiger als Titel

Benefits & culture

  • Du hast die Wahl zwischen einer Urban Sports Club/John Reed Mitgliedschaft oder Fahrkarten/Dance-Abo
  • Regelmäßige Firmen- und Teamevents
  • Jährliches Budget für persönliche Weiterbildung in Höhe von 500 € für zum Beispiel Konferenzen, Kurse, Bücher, Karrierecoach usw.
  • Eine integrative und aufregende Start-up-Kultur, die schnelles berufliches und persönliches Wachstum ermöglicht
  • Schönes Büro im Herzen von Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) mit kostenlosen Snacks, Getränken und bester Ausstattung

We want to build a community, not just a company.

Uns ist wichtig, ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem Menschen wirklich gerne Zeit miteinander verbringen - egal ob beim HYROX-Training, Golfen, Beer-Pong-Turnieren, Running Clubs, Warhammer, gemeinsamen Wochenendaktivitäten oder welcher Community auch immer du hier aufbauen möchtest!

We firmly believe that diversity makes companies better. We welcome all applicants - regardless of gender, background, nationality, or religion. Feel free to send us your application!

By submitting your application, you agree to our privacy policy. 

We look forward to your application! 🙂

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, Engineering
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The Role

Legora has grown from 40 to more than 900 people in 18 months. During that time, we reached $100M ARR, tripled our valuation in five months, and continued expanding into new markets around the world.

Our Talent Acquisition function is now entering its next chapter. The processes, standards, and hiring approach that support our next phase of growth are being built today, which you’ll play a significant part in. You'll work closely with senior leaders from day one and play a key role in shaping how Legora hires and scales.

 

What you’ll do

Product velocity depends on having the right engineering and technical talent in place, fast, and at a high bar. As a Talent Partner, you will own that directly. You are not a support function for the Engineering team. You bring genuine craft to how technical hiring gets done, and you're accountable for the quality and pace of the people who build Legora's product.

You will own end-to-end hiring across engineering in UK&I, working closely with senior leaders who are genuinely invested in recruiting, trusted to make high-impact decisions on hiring and team composition. Specifically, you will:

  • Own full-cycle recruitment across UK&I, partnering closely with hiring managers to define role scope, success profiles, and hiring strategies aligned to business priorities.

  • Help shape how Talent operates at Legora, contributing beyond hiring to process design, programs, tooling, and broader People initiatives.

  • Build and nurture proactive talent pipelines for critical and future hiring needs, ensuring we stay ahead of demand rather than reacting to it.

  • Run structured, data-informed hiring processes that balance quality, pace, and consistency while maintaining a high bar for talent.

  • Deliver an exceptional candidate experience from first conversation through to offer, acting as a trusted and credible ambassador for Legora throughout.

 

What you bring

You understand that hiring decisions are business decisions, and you hold yourself accountable to the same outcomes as the teams you hire for. You're hands-on, sharp, and trusted by senior leaders to shape teams that win. We're looking for:

 

  • 5+ years in talent acquisition in a high-growth environment, startup, scaleup, or VC-backed company, with meaningful depth hiring engineering talent.

  • A proven track record hiring high-performing engineering talent across the seniority levels that matter most at this stage of growth.

  • The ability to hold a credible conversation with an engineering leader about what strong looks like. You understand the difference between a good CV and a good hire in technical roles, and you don't lower the bar when searches get hard.

  • Experience partnering with senior stakeholders on hiring strategy and team build-out, not just executing briefs, but shaping them.

  • The ability to run multiple complex searches without losing quality or pace.

  • Comfortable in ambiguity with a bias toward action. You build a structure where none exists and move without waiting for perfect conditions.

  • Collaborative but direct. You influence and challenge senior stakeholders when needed, and you drive decisions rather than defer them.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist (12 months FTC)
descriptionHtml:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As we grow the organisation, hiring the best people becomes one of our main priorities. To be able to successfully do that, we need to keep evolving: adjusting and improving our hiring processes, ensuring quality in everything that we do and creating new ways of working. This is why the successful performance of our Talent Acquisition (TA) team is highly important.

As a Senior TA Specialist, you will contribute to reaching the team’s main goal: attracting and employing the right talent for Vinted, while ensuring a great candidate experience. You will do this by applying your strong hiring competencies, effectively partnering with your Hiring Managers, leveraging innovative approaches, implementing best hiring practices, and collaborating with other teams on various projects.

You’ll support either our Group & Marketplace business units, covering Community Support, Marketing, Finance, Legal and People, or our Vinted Pay & VintedGo business units, covering AML/Compliance, Business & Commercial and Logistics, with your focus shifting based on business needs.

If you're excited to contribute to our team's efforts in supporting our organisation's growth, we would love to meet you.

Note. This role is offered as a 12-months fixed-term contract initially. There may be an opportunity for the position to be made permanent in the future, depending on business needs. 

In this position, you’ll 

  • Partner with hiring managers to define hiring strategies, prioritise critical hiring needs, and shape recruitment processes for best results
  • Lead the end-to-end recruitment process, including job posting, proactive candidate sourcing, conducting interviews, and extending offers; including senior-level as well as highly specialised roles
  • At times you may work in close partnership with the Talent Acquisition Support Specialists to maintain hiring alignment, ensure efficient assessment and selection processes, deliver hiring objectives, and provide ongoing mentoring support
  • Act as a strategic advisor to stakeholders, providing expertise on recruitment best practices, assessment methods, sharing market insights, and upskilling Hiring Manager competencies 
  • Drive initiatives to improve diversity and inclusion within the hiring process
  • Identify opportunities to drive innovation in talent acquisition, including new strategies, tools, and processes to enhance hiring and team performance
  • Use data-driven insights to track, analyse, and report on hiring metrics, creating strategies to improve time-to-hire, quality of hire, candidate experience and wider TA goals
  • Conduct proactive market mapping to build talent pipelines, understand competitor landscape, and support future hiring delivery
  • Analyse inefficiencies in the hiring process, identify opportunities for enhancement, and lead process improvements in the recruitment workflow to align with and support the goals of a growing organisation
  • Lead talent acquisition-related projects, including process improvement, recruitment marketing campaigns, and technology implementation
  • Stay updated on recruitment trends and innovative candidate evaluation tools to maintain a competitive edge in talent acquisition

About you 

  • You will have proven experience as a Talent Acquisition Specialist or Recruiter 
  • You are proficient in proactive sourcing candidates and creating talent pipelines using LinkedIn and other recruitment tools
  • You have proven experience partnering with senior stakeholders and hiring Managers at all levels, with the ability to coach and influence toward better hiring outcomes
  • You have strong interviewing and candidate assessment skills
  • You have the ability to mentor and coach members of the team, supporting their professional development and growth
  • You have the ability to analyse and interpret data, identify trends and communicate hiring recommendations to Hiring Managers for data-driven hiring decisions
  • Strong skills in candidate engagement and relationship building
  • Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate across teams and level

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • Company bike leasing scheme
  • Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
  • Work from Home allowance 
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work 

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:€59.800—€81.000 EUR

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Unser Auftraggeber ist ein international führendes Dienstleistungsunternehmen im Bereich operativer Geschäftsprozesse und Service-Management. Mit einer globalen Präsenz und einer großen Anzahl von Mitarbeitern an zahlreichen Standorten weltweit gehört das Unternehmen zu den bedeutendsten Anbietern in seiner Branche. Das Unternehmen ist spezialisiert auf die Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen und unterstützt seine Kunden mit innovativen Service-Lösungen. Das Unternehmen durchlebt derzeit eine Phase der Professionalisierung und des Wachstums mit dem Ziel, die Recruiting-Prozesse zu optimieren und die Qualität der Personalakquisition zu erhöhen.

title: Senior Tech Recruiter 360° (m/w/d), remote
descriptionHtml:
Unser Manifesto:

Beende das Glücksspiel im Tech-Recruiting

Hand aufs Herz: Die Branche ist kaputt. Die meisten Recruiter agieren als Bittsteller. Sie spammen hunderte Kandidaten an, hoffen auf eine Antwort und beten, dass der Kunde den Lebenslauf akzeptiert. Das Ergebnis? Frustrierte Kunden, genervte Talente und eine Platzierungsquote des Grauens.

Wir bei Recruitment Circle lehnen dieses Modell ab.

Wir sind keine Postboten.

Wir sind 360-Grad-Recruiter.

Was 360 Grad bei uns heißt

Du führst einen eigenen Desk. Vom ersten Anruf beim Kunden bis zur Unterschrift des Kandidaten liegt alles in einer Hand. In deiner.

  • Kunden gewinnen: Du sprichst CTOs, Practice Leads und Gründer selbst an, pitchst, machst das Angebot und verhandelst die Konditionen.
  • Kunden entwickeln: Du startest mit Bestandskunden und machst aus einer besetzten Rolle die nächste. Dein Buch gehört dir.
  • Kandidaten finden: Briefing, Boolean, Telefon und Active Sourcing bleiben bei dir.
  • Abschließen: Du führst beide Seiten durch Interviews, Angebot und Verhandlung, bis der Vertrag unterschrieben ist.

Wer nur Lebensläufe schieben will, wird hier nicht glücklich. Wer gerne verkauft, verdient hier doppelt.

Warum wir einzigartig sind

  • Einladungsquote von 60 bis 70 %: Der Markt liegt bei 10 bis 20 %. Bei uns werden rund zwei von drei eingereichten Kandidaten von Kunden wie SVA, Adesso oder FormlyAI zum Interview eingeladen. Warum? Weil wir tiefer graben. Auf deinem Desk führst du das Briefing selbst und weißt deshalb genau, wen der Kunde braucht.
  • Die RC-E-Learning Masterclass: Du hast Zugriff auf unser proprietäres Wissen. Wir bilden dich zum High-Performance Recruiter aus, der auf Augenhöhe mit CTOs und Practice Leads verhandelt.
  • Qualität als Identität: Wir identifizieren uns mit unserer Arbeit. Wenn wir eine Stelle besetzen, dann bleibt dieser Mensch dort und performt. Das ist unser Stolz. Und der Grund, warum Kunden mit der nächsten Rolle wieder zu dir kommen.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission: Die 12-Monats-Outcomes

Wir messen Erfolg nicht an der Zeit am Schreibtisch. Wir messen ihn am Umsatz deines Desks, an der Time-to-Fill und an den Kunden, die du gewinnst und hältst.

  • Monat 1: Du hast die ersten 3 Accounts übernommen, steuerst die Prozesse autark und hast deine Zielkundenliste für die Akquise stehen.
  • Monat 2 bis 3: Deine erste eigenständige Vermittlung ist unter Dach und Fach. Parallel führst du jede Woche Gespräche mit möglichen Neukunden.
  • Monat 6 (Probezeit-Finale): Du hast 120.000 € Revenue generiert, durch exzellentes Account Management 2 neue Projekte aus deinem Bestand heraus entwickelt und deinen ersten eigenen Kunden gewonnen.
  • Monat 12: Du stehst bei mindestens 250.000 € Jahresumsatz. Ein Teil davon kommt von Kunden, die du selbst geholt hast.

Dein Alltag auf dem 360-Grad-Desk

  • Akquise: Du rufst Zielkunden an, nutzt Job-Signale und Empfehlungen als Anlass und holst das Mandat.
  • Briefing und Angebot: Du führst das Rollenbriefing, machst das Angebot und verhandelst die Konditionen.
  • Suche: Du arbeitest im eigenen Bestand, mit Boolean auf LinkedIn und XING und am Telefon.
  • Kandidatenführung: Du bereitest Interviews vor, holst Feedback ein und verhandelst das Angebot bis zur Unterschrift.
  • Account Management: Du legst dem Kunden Zahlen, Daten und Fakten vor, steuerst nach und fragst nach der nächsten Rolle und nach Empfehlungen.

Du führst deinen Desk wie dein eigenes Geschäft.

Qualifikation

Wer du bist (The A-Player Profile)

Wir suchen keine „Sachbearbeiter“ und keine reinen Sourcer. Wir suchen High-Performance Headhunter, die beide Seiten können.

  • 360-Grad-Erfahrung: Du hast mindestens 3 Jahre in einer Personalberatung oder Agentur gearbeitet und dort Kunden und Kandidaten verantwortet.
  • Sales: Du greifst gern zum Telefon, gewinnst Kunden kalt und über Empfehlungen und kannst ein Honorar verteidigen.
  • Sourcing: Du beherrschst Boolean und nutzt LinkedIn Automation, Clay, GitHub oder Stack Overflow als Hebel, um passive Talente zu finden, die niemand sonst erreicht.
  • Status-Autorität: Du sprichst mit Practice Leads und C-Level auf Augenhöhe, im Pitch genauso wie im Briefing. Du bist kein Bittsteller, du bist der Experte.
  • Extreme Ownership: Ein schweres Profil oder ein Nein vom Kunden ist für dich kein Grund aufzugeben, sondern eine Challenge, die du gewinnst.

Wenn du reine Delivery suchst und Kundengewinnung als Aufgabe von anderen siehst, passt diese Stelle nicht zu dir.

Benefits

Deine Perks

  • Aggressives Provisionsmodell: Du partizipierst direkt am Erfolg deines Desks. 5 bis 20 % Provision vom ersten Euro an, ungedeckelt. Auf Umsatz mit Kunden, die du selbst gewinnst, kommen nochmal 10 % oben drauf.
  • Dein Buch gehört dir: Du übernimmst Bestandskunden und gewinnst eigene dazu. Dein Desk wächst durch deine Kunden.
  • Warme Anlässe statt Blindflug: Job-Signale von Zielkunden und aus Wettbewerber-Boards kommen als Digest. Lead-Listen und Erstansprache laufen als Sequenz. Den Aufhänger liefert das System. Den Anruf machst du.
  • High-End Tech-Stack: Du nutzt Recruit CRM, Clay, Juicebox und unsere eigenen Automatisierungs-Workflows, in der Suche wie in der Akquise. Die Werkzeuge nehmen dir Routine ab. Das Handwerk bleibt bei dir.
  • Radical Candor und Teamship: Wir kämpfen füreinander. Wenn ein Prozess stockt, sprechen wir es sofort an. Brutal ehrlich, aber immer mit dem Ziel, das Team besser zu machen. Keine Politik. Nur Ergebnisse.

„Wir bauen keine Datenbanken. Wir bauen Karrieren und die Marktführer von morgen.“

Und du baust dir bei uns deinen eigenen Desk mit eigenen Kunden.

title: Senior Technical Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Okta: The World’s Identity Company™

About Okta & The TAM Team

Okta is the leader in Identity management and The World’s Identity Company™. Our mission is to build a more secure world by providing a neutral, powerful, and extensible platform that puts identity at the heart of the modern tech stack—securing customers, employees, partners, and AI agents. Two-thirds of the Fortune 100 trust Okta to power their identity journeys.

The Technical Account Management (TAM) team is a global group of Okta product experts dedicated to driving long-term customer success. As a Senior TAM within our Strategic Workforce Identity segment, you will serve as the premier technical advisor and advocate for some of our largest enterprise customers (across Financial Services, Healthcare, Public Sector, and more), helping them elevate their technical maturity and maximize their Okta investment.

What You’ll Be Doing

1. Strategic Customer Partnership & Influence

  • Trusted Advisor: Build deep, executive-level relationships, serving as the primary technical point of contact for customer identity owners and IT leadership (up to CxO).
  • Strategic Roadmapping: Architect tailored technical success plans aligned with customer business objectives to drive platform adoption and secure Okta against competitive displacement.
  • Adoption & Expansion: Guide customers in expanding their Okta footprint across critical Workforce solutions, continuously improving their overall security posture.

2. Complex Problem Resolution & Advocacy

  • Technical Escalation Lead: Independently manage and resolve highly complex customer technical escalations, collaborating with Customer Success Managers (CSMs) as needed.
  • Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify technical roadblocks, design robust mitigation plans, and drive them to resolution.
  • Cross-Functional Advocacy: Champion customer needs internally by collaborating with Okta Engineering, Product, and Support teams to influence product direction.

3. Thought Leadership & Team Enablement

  • Knowledge Sharing: Deliver workshops, best practice sessions, and vertical-specific insights to enhance customer security.
  • Asset Creation: Author repeatable technical strategies and assets to level up the global TAM organization.
  • Mentorship: Actively mentor and develop peer TAMs to upskill technical capabilities across the team.

Workforce Identity Solutions You Will Support

You will provide deep technical guidance across Okta's comprehensive Workforce Identity lifecycle:

  • IAM: SSO, Adaptive MFA, Device Access, API Access Management, Secure Partner Access, Access Gateway, and Universal Directory.
  • IGA: Lifecycle Management and Okta Identity Governance (OIG).
  • PAM: Privileged Access Management.
  • ITDR: Identity Security Posture Management and Identity Threat Protection.

 

What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience & Education

  • 8+ years of related professional IT experience (or 6+ years with a Master’s degree).
  • 3+ years of experience as a TAM, Technical Consultant, Solution Architect, or Product Manager.
  • 3+ years of experience working with Identity & Access Management (IAM) solutions or related security technologies is preferred.
  • Education: BA/BS/MS in Computer Science, IT, or a related discipline (or equivalent experience).
  • Certifications: Okta Certified, CISSP, or equivalent certifications are highly preferred.

Technical Mastery (Workforce Identity Focus)

  • Okta Architecture: Extensive hands-on proficiency mapping Okta feature sets to complex enterprise architectures.
  • Federation Protocols: Strong understanding of modern identity protocols (SAML 2.0, OAuth, OpenID Connect, WS-Fed).
  • Hybrid Environments: Experience integrating legacy/non-standard applications that do not support modern federation protocols.
  • Lifecycle & Provisioning: Deep knowledge of lifecycle management, automated provisioning, and integrations (e.g., SCIM, Okta Workflows, HR-driven provisioning, Active Directory).
  • SaaS Ecosystems: Familiarity deploying and securing key SaaS platforms (O365, Salesforce, Workday, Box).
  • Code Proficiency: Ability to read and modify existing quickstarts, code samples, or scripts to match customer requirements.

Communication & Leadership

  • Executive Presence: Exceptional communication skills with a proven ability to translate highly technical concepts into clear business outcomes for CxO-level audiences.
  • Boundary Setting: Skilled at managing expectations, tracking portfolio health metrics, and setting healthy boundaries with internal and external stakeholders.

Location & Language Requirements: This is a hybrid role, open to candidates based in London, Munich, Paris, or Warsaw. Fluency in both German and English is mandatory.

title: Senior Technical Architect & Developer – Marketing Automation
descriptionHtml:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence.


Position Description

We are seeking a deeply technical Marketing Technology Architect / Developer to lead the data architecture, custom code development, system integrations, and infrastructure scalability of our marketing engine.

Our day-to-day stack currently relies on Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) as our primary engine, and we are actively considering next-generation architecture like Marketing Cloud Next. However, for us, specific tool proficiency takes a backseat to a genuine passion for marketing technology, AI-driven marketing innovations, robust data architecture, and technical problem-solving.

We value your ability to analyze complex data models, integrate APIs, write clean code, and optimize high-throughput automation pipelines over specific certifications. If you are a platform-agnostic technologist passionate about marketing tech stack mechanics and AI marketing tools, this role provides the scope and autonomy to build world-class system infrastructure.


What you will do

Data Architecture & Engineering

  • Operations Enablement: Prepare, clean, structure, and model marketing data for Marketing Operations teams to run campaigns, segment audiences, and manage daily operations friction-free.

  • Data Modeling: Build and optimize scalable relational database structures, data extensions, custom models, and subscriber key lifecycles for operational needs.

  • ETL & Data Pipelines: Partner with the Data Team to create automated SQL queries and ETL pipelines ingesting and transforming data warehouse datasets (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery) into production-ready data extensions.

  • Governance & Hygiene: Maintain data hygiene, identity resolution, deduplication, and real-time ecosystem syncs to ensure efficiency.

    • Technical Customization & Custom Development

  • Write maintainable custom platform code (e.g., AMPscript, SSJS, WSProxy) for personalization engines.

  • Develop dynamic rendering logic, interactive web forms, and secure landing pages.

  • Troubleshoot automation failures, script exceptions, and data bottlenecks.

    • API & Ecosystem Integrations

  • Architect and maintain API integrations (REST, SOAP, Webhooks) connecting product apps, mobile backends, and third-party systems to the marketing platform.

  • Configure native CRM and database connectors for low-latency, real-time bidirectional sync.

  • Manage rate limits, payload efficiency, OAuth, and retry handlers.

    • Platform Operations & System Health

  • Monitor runtimes, script performance, and query execution to ensure 99.9% uptime.

  • Lead security governance, permissions, business unit structuring, and privacy compliance (GDPR, CCPA, CAN-SPAM).

  • Partner with DevOps and IT Security on domain authentication and deliverability infrastructure.


    • Experience and qualifications

    Core Technical Competencies

  • Advanced SQL & Database Design: Extensive experience with relational data modeling, complex joins, aggregation, and query tuning.

  • Integrations & Protocols: Strong knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs, JSON/XML, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, and Postman.

  • Scripting & Code: Skilled in AMPscript, SSJS, or general languages (JavaScript, Node.js, Python) applied to MarTech.

  • MarTech & AI Curiosity: Passionate about marketing architecture, event triggers, relational mapping, agentic AI, CDPs, and automated personalization.

    • Experience

  • 3+ years in technical architecture, administration, or development in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) (Automation Studio, Journey Builder, Contact Builder, CloudPages, APIs, or Data Cloud/AI frameworks).

  • Practical understanding of how Predictive, Generative, and Agentic AI transform technical marketing.

title: Senior Technical Architect (Privacy)
descriptionHtml:

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. 

The Challenge

We are looking for a Senior Technical Architect (Privacy) to join our Technical Advisory team (part of Customer Success). This is a customer-facing role for someone who combines a strong technical foundation with attention to details, and the ability to build trust with customers.

You will work with privacy, legal, compliance, and technology stakeholders to understand business objectives and challenges, assess maturity and platform adoption, and provide clear recommendations across privacy processes, operating models, workflows, data, and integrations. You will act as a trusted advisor and product expert without owning hands-on implementation or configuration.

Previous privacy or OneTrust expertise is valuable, but it is not the defining requirement for this role. We are looking for someone with the attitude, consultancy skills, and technical capability to learn the privacy domain quickly and become a trusted advisor.

Your Mission

  • Lead outcome-focused discovery, advisory engagements, workshops, and expert sessions with customers.
  • Clarify customer objectives, constraints, stakeholders, and desired outcomes before recommending a path forward.
  • Translate business and regulatory needs into practical recommendations for privacy processes, workflows, data, integrations, and OneTrust capabilities.
  • Explain solution options, dependencies, trade-offs, and implications for scale at the appropriate level of detail.
  • Assess customer readiness, adoption barriers, process maturity, and solution direction; recommend pragmatic next steps.
  • Create clear, decision-ready deliverables such as current-state assessments, future-state recommendations, reference architectures, process guidance, and reusable patterns.
  • Build trusted relationships and communicate confidently with both technical and executive audiences.
  • Partner closely with Customer Success, Product, Sales, Support, Professional Services, and other specialist teams to deliver consistent customer outcomes.
  • Capture recurring customer needs and translate them into feedback, enablement content, playbooks, and product opportunities.
  • Maintain clear advisory boundaries: provide strategic framing, product expertise, and guidance while enabling customers or delivery partners to execute implementation.

You Are 

Your Experience Includes:

  • A consultative approach: you listen carefully, ask effective questions, structure ambiguity, and turn complex problems into clear recommendations.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Keet (100% Remote)
descriptionHtml:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own the vision for Keet and lead it to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. This is not a maintenance role. You will define where Keet goes, convince the board and the team that it is the right direction, and then drive the execution that gets it there.

You are a rare combination of three things. You are a product visionary who has shipped consumer chat or calling apps at scale. You are a technologist who can go deep on P2P architecture and the Pear / Holepunch stack (docs.pears.com). And you are a hands-on builder who uses AI tools to prototype and prove concepts in days, not months. You set the bar high, move at incredible speed, and lead from the front.

You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them.


If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Vision & Strategy

  • Own and articulate the long-term product vision for Keet as the world's leading private, peer-to-peer communication app, with a clear path to 1 billion users.

  • Analyze WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, LINE, WeChat and emerging competitors to identify where P2P gives Keet an unfair advantage, and build the roadmap around it.

  • Present product vision, strategy, metrics and progress to the board and executive leadership with clarity and conviction.

Define a growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention and virality, with measurable targets at every stage.

Technical Product Leadership

  • Develop a deep working understanding of the Holepunch P2P stack (Pear runtime, Bare, Hypercore, Hyperswarm, HyperDHT, Autobase, Hyperbee) and translate its capabilities and constraints into product decisions.

  • Partner with core engineering on hard P2P problems at scale, including NAT traversal, offline sync, multi-device support, large groups, push notifications, and battery and data efficiency on mobile.

  • Own the real-time calling experience (1:1 and group voice and video, plus screen sharing) to a quality bar that matches or beats Google Meet and Zoom.

  • Define clear feature tiers with explicit labels for stable versus experimental functionality.

Rapid Prototyping with AI

  • Use AI coding and design tools to build working prototypes and demos that prove concepts before committing engineering resources.

  • Turn ideas into something the team, users and the board can see and touch within days.

Execution & Team Leadership

  • Lead the product team and run the sprint cadence end to end, covering planning, prioritization, standups, reviews and retrospectives.

  • Own deliverables from conception through release, testing and post-launch iteration, ensuring core functionality works reliably every time.

  • Maintain issue trackers and roadmaps that accurately reflect priorities and sprint commitments.

  • Coordinate across engineering, QA, design, marketing and business stakeholders, and manage cross-team dependencies across the Holepunch and Tether ecosystem.

  • Provide transparent updates on status, risks and timeline changes, and hold direct conversations about accountability when needed.

Mobile & Distribution

  • Own the mobile release process across iOS and Android. This includes App Store and Google Play submissions, review guidelines, compliance, store listings, ratings and release management.

  • Oversee desktop distribution and installers across macOS, Windows and Linux.

  • Build crash reporting, debugging and analytics systems, privacy-preserving by design, that turn user reports into actionable engineering data.


Mandatory:

  • 8+ years of product management experience, including significant time in a senior or lead role owning a consumer product end to end.

  • Strong product sense, with a proven track record of setting product vision and driving it to measurable outcomes at scale (tens of millions of users or more).

  • Experience leading engineers who ship products, including running sprint cadences with predictable delivery across cross-functional teams.

  • Deep JavaScript and React skills. You can read and write production code, review pull requests, and build working prototypes yourself.

  • Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. You don't need P2P expertise, because our core abstracts it away, but you should be able to reason about sync, offline behavior and consistency trade-offs.

  • Hands-on experience shipping and scaling mobile apps on iOS and Android, with deep familiarity with App Store and Google Play logistics, review processes and release management.

  • Experience with real-time voice and video calling products (such as Google Meet, Zoom, FaceTime or WhatsApp calls) and the quality, latency and reliability trade-offs involved.

  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to rapidly prototype and demonstrate product concepts.

  • Exceptional communication skills, with experience presenting vision and strategy to boards, executives and investors.

  • A strong understanding of urgency versus importance, and the judgment to make fast, high-quality decisions with incomplete information.

  • You thrive in a high-intensity, fast-moving environment, set an exceptionally high bar, and are willing to go above and beyond, including extended hours, when the mission demands it.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to have:

  • Product leadership experience at a major messaging app such as WhatsApp, Telegram, LINE, WeChat, Signal, Viber or KakaoTalk.

  • Experience with peer-to-peer technologies, distributed systems or decentralized protocols. Prior exposure to Holepunch, Pear or Hypercore is a strong plus.

  • Experience growing a product in emerging markets or across multiple regions and languages.

  • A background in privacy, encryption or security-focused products.

  • Familiarity with Electron, React Native or similar cross-platform frameworks, as well as installer systems, boot performance and Linux packaging (Snap, AppImage, Flatpak).

  • A solid understanding of testing approaches (unit, integration, end-to-end), test automation and performance testing.

  • An engineering background or computer science degree.

  • Experience with Git, issue trackers and modern collaboration tools.

Why this role:

The next billion-user communication app will not run on someone else's servers. If you want to be the person who defines it, presents it to the board, prototypes it yourself, and then leads the team that ships it, we want to hear from you.

In your application, include a link to a product you have shipped or a prototype you have built, along with a few sentences on how you would take Keet to 1 billion users.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: Senior TechOps Engineer Contract
descriptionHtml:

We work alongside organisations such as PayPal, adidas, NatWest, FanDuel and Money Saving Expert, building digital products and services that make a difference  while always putting people first.

We’re a team of creators. We write code, shape delivery, build go-to-market strategies, develop AI solutions and create the practices that support our people.
