CreateFuture is a Great Place to Work-Certified™ company and has won Best Workplaces UK multiple years in a row.

Join us on our journey. Let’s create tomorrow, together, today.

About the role and team:

We are looking for TechOps Engineers to operate, stabilise and modernise our Azure-hosted platforms (Java/Spring Boot microservices on RHEL). The role covers 24/7 operations, incident management, hands-on troubleshooting and security remediation, and helps build out a codified platform: Terraform, GitHub Actions + Ansible, and centralised ELK.

Key responsibilities

  • Build and support environments on Azure; hands-on RHEL administration (hardening, patching, tuning)
  • Act as escalation for L2/L3 incidents, driving RCA and permanent fixes
  • Debug issues hands-on across the stack (OS, network, middleware, JVM, database) using logs, metrics, thread/heap dumps and packet captures
  • Support Java/Spring Boot microservices and the middleware they run on; diagnose JVM issues (memory, GC, threads, latency)
  • Drive security vulnerability remediation across OS, middleware and cloud platform
  • Collaborate with Security/SOC/NOC on incident response and post-incident reviews
  • Deliver changes as code: infrastructure in Terraform, deployments via GitHub Actions running Ansible
  • Own backup, restore testing and DR failover readiness
  • Participate in regular 24/7 on-call rotation
  • Manage incidents/problems/changes via Jira Service Management
  • Maintain runbooks, dashboards and documentation
  • Work with development and Platform team to take ownership of an inherited Azure estate, stabilise it, then modernise it with AI-assisted & reviewed tooling

Technical skills

  • Cloud/Network: Azure VMs, VNet, NSG, Load Balancer, App Gateway/WAF, Firewall, Virtual WAN, Key Vault, private endpoints, VPN; Azure Front Door, Cloudflare, Nginx, TLS
  • Data: Azure MySQL Flexible Server (HA, replicas, point-in-time restore), Redis, Blob Storage; Canal (MySQL CDC), MongoDB
  • OS: RHEL (enterprise production), Azure Update Manager; Docker engine on hosts
  • Java/Middleware: Spring Boot, Dubbo, Nacos, ZooKeeper, XXL-Job, Kafka, RabbitMQ
  • Observability: Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch cluster ops, ILM, Logstash, Kibana); Prometheus, Alertmanager, Grafana, Azure Monitor; Micrometer/JVM observability; PagerDuty
  • Access/Security: Entra ID, RBAC, PIM; Azure Bastion, JumpServer (PAM), Zscaler ZPA
  • Backup/DR: Azure Backup, DR region failover
  • IaC/CI/CD: Terraform, GitHub Actions, Ansible, GitHub Packages, GitOps; Python, Bash
  • Tooling: Jira Service Management, Confluenc

Requirements

  • 8+ years in TechOps/Infrastructure/SRE/Production Operations
  • Strong hands-on Azure and RHEL experience in production
  • Proven support of Java microservices/middleware in production
  • Strong hands-on debugging and analytical skills; comfortable working an unfamiliar problem from symptoms to root cause
  • Advanced Elasticsearch and JVM observability skills
  • Hands-on Terraform, GitHub Actions and Ansible; Python/Bash scripting
  • Strong incident management/RCA capability; ITIL familiarity
  • Comfortable with 24/7 operations; strong communication
  • Experience in gaming or another regulated, high-availability digital sector
  • Systems administration experience desired

What we’ll offer you:

We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.

We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.

We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.

Our hiring process

We try to keep our hiring process clear, fair and respectful of your time. We aim to get back to everyone who applies and we will be upfront about where you are in the process.

It usually looks like this:

  • Call with our Talent Acquisition Team 
  • Role specific capability interview 

Depending on the role, we might also ask you to do a short presentation, a practical or technical task or have a values focused conversation. We will explain what is involved before anything happens.

Inclusion at CreateFuture 

We believe diverse teams build better workplaces and better products. We want CreateFuture to be a place where people feel able to be themselves and do their best work.

title: Senior UX Designer - Map Visualisation
descriptionHtml:
TomTom's map is seen by millions of people every day - in dashboards, on phones, and across partner products worldwide. As a Senior UX Designer on the Map Visualisation team, you will shape how our 2D and 3D geospatial data is designed, styled and delivered across TomTom's product portfolio.

You'll spend your days crafting multi-zoom map experiences, working with spatial data and collaborating closely with engineers and product managers to turn cartographic intent into production-ready map styles. You'll need to be as comfortable discussing label collision and style-layer specifications with engineers as you are refining colour palettes and visual hierarchy.

This is a product role first. You'll be embedded in a cross-functional team that ships map rendering, map styles and SDKs used by other TomTom products and by the customers who build on our platform. You'll take part in the whole development lifecycle, from discovery and solution design through pull requests to release. Your product judgement, and your ability to bring people with competing priorities to a clear decision, matter here as much as your cartographic craft.

AI is part of how we work. We expect you to use it to explore, prototype and ship faster, to know where it falls short, and to help shape map experiences in products where AI is part of the experience itself.


What You'll Do

  • Design Compelling Map Experiences Create and refine 2D and 3D map visualisations from concept through production delivery. Own the end-to-end cartographic design process - from data exploration and sketching through to style implementation, QA and iteration across zoom levels, regions and use cases.

  • Maintain and Evolve Core Map Styles Enhance TomTom's core map styles, ensuring consistency, readability and visual quality across platforms, screen densities and global markets. Balance aesthetic ambition with rendering performance and data constraints.

  • Work as Part of the Product Team Work day-to-day alongside software engineers and product managers building TomTom's map data structures, renderers and SDKs. Take part in planning, refinement and reviews, provide design specifications engineers can act on, and review visual output during development and before release.

  • Make and Own Trade-offs Help decide what ships, when and at what quality. Weigh visual fidelity against render budget, memory and frame rate on automotive and mobile hardware, customer requests against platform consistency, and scope against release dates. Reach a decision with the people who own the product, record it and see it through.

  • Contribute to Renderer and Tooling Requirements Provide detailed input on the data and rendering capabilities needed to achieve design goals. Define requirements for internal cartographic authoring tools and identify workflow improvements that raise the team's output quality and speed.

  • Bring AI into the Design Workflow Use AI to shorten the loop from idea to rendered map: generating and editing style-spec JSON, scripting data exploration, and building interactive prototypes on real data instead of static frames. Turn what works into shared workflows the team can reuse, and help define how we check AI-generated output for cartographic quality.

  • Design for AI-Driven Map Experiences Contribute to how the map responds when the request comes from an AI system rather than a tap, for example in GeoAI answers, conversational search or agent-generated routes. Work out how the map shows what the AI found, how confident it is and when it is wrong.

  • Inform Decisions with Research and Data Participate in user research, customer conversations and competitive benchmarking. Use insights to ground design decisions and advocate for improvements that address real user needs.

  • Support the Design System and Standards Contribute to the Map Visualisation design system - documenting patterns, conventions and cartographic guidelines that enable consistency and scale across the product portfolio.


What You'll Need

Leadership & Product Team Experience

  • A track record of shaping product direction from the design seat. You set out the options, make the case for one and bring engineering, product and business stakeholders with you.

  • A track record of shipping software as a designer embedded in a product team, ideally on map, location or developer-platform products: SDKs, APIs, map styles or tooling that other teams and companies build on.

  • A clear understanding of how products move from discovery to release and beyond, including planning, roadmaps and measuring results after launch. You know how versioned releases, deprecations and backwards compatibility shape design choices on a platform with external customers.

  • Hands-on familiarity with how software gets built: backlogs, refinement, estimation, definition of done, Git, pull requests, code reviews, CI/CD, feature flags and release trains. You don't need to write production code, but you need to understand how your designs move through a rendering pipeline and into a release.

  • Sound judgement under constraint. You can point to decisions where you gave something up to ship, and explain why it was right for the product and its users.

  • Clarity with senior audiences. You can turn a complex design problem into a short, well-argued recommendation and own the result.

  • Comfort with disagreement. You challenge a decision with evidence, accept the outcome when it goes the other way and keep the work moving.

  • Experience contributing to solution design documents, technical specifications and cross-functional planning.

Cartography & Digital Map Making

  • A solid foundation in digital cartography, GIS or geographic information design. If your map-making depth is still growing, show us how fast you are closing the gap, including how you use AI to learn.

  • Experience designing multi-zoom digital maps with attention to cartographic conventions, label placement, generalisation and cultural adaptation.

  • Working proficiency with key mapping technologies and ecosystems: MapLibre, Mapbox GL JS, OpenStreetMap data and tooling, QGIS, ArcGIS, Leaflet, OpenLayers or comparable platforms.

  • Experience working with diverse spatial datasets - vector tiles, raster tiles, GeoJSON, shapefiles, point clouds or terrain data.

  • Awareness of cartographic standards across regions and cultures, including sensitive topics such as disputed borders and local place names.

Map Visualisation & Rendering

  • Demonstrated ability to build visually compelling 2D and 3D map experiences - from thematic styling and terrain visualisation to street-level detail.

  • Hands-on experience designing 3D map content such as buildings, terrain, landmarks and lane-level road geometry, in stylised or realistic form. You understand how LOD, lighting, materials and camera pitch affect legibility and performance.

  • Experience with 3D data formats and pipelines such as glTF and 3D Tiles, and how 3D assets are prepared and optimised for real-time map rendering.

  • Good understanding of real-time rendering concepts as they apply to maps: style layers, zoom interpolation, data-driven styling, symbol rendering and performance considerations.

AI in Your Practice

  • Evidence that AI has changed how you work. Be ready to show a real example, such as a map style, data visualisation or coded prototype built with AI, and tell us where it let you down.

  • Sharp judgement of AI output. You can spot errors in generated work and know which decisions still need a designer's eye.

  • Experience turning personal AI use into workflows the team shares, within the limits of confidential data and licensing.

Senior-Level Craft & Collaboration

  • 5+ years of professional experience in UX, product or cartographic design, with most of that time spent inside software product teams.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cartography, Geography, GIS, UX Design, Computer Science or a related field - or equivalent professional experience.

  • Ability to build clear, concise prototypes and specification documentation that bridge design and engineering.

  • Strong visual and graphic design fundamentals - typography, colour theory, hierarchy and layout.

  • User-centric mindset with a collaborative, low-ego approach to problem-solving.

  • High attention to detail and a real passion for the craft of map making.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with game engines or 3D content pipelines (Unity, Unreal Engine, Blender) and their application to geospatial visualisation.

  • Familiarity with front-end languages and graphics APIs (JavaScript/TypeScript, WebGL, WebGPU, GLSL) or scripting for cartographic automation (Python, PostGIS, Overpass API). With AI, even basic coding skills go a long way.

  • Experience with map data processing tools and pipelines: Tippecanoe, Tilemaker, osm2pgsql, Mapnik or similar.

  • Understanding of the automotive, fleet management or logistics industries and their mapping requirements.

  • Familiarity with emerging trends in spatial computing, AR navigation or digital twins.

  • Experience contributing to design systems at scale.

What we offer
A competitive compensation package, of course.
Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning.
Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities.
Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. It’s all about getting the best out of both worlds – we ask TomTom’ers to come to the office two days a week, and the remaining three are free to be worked in either location.
Improve your home office with a setup budget and get extra support with a monthly allowance.
Enjoy options to work from your home country and abroad for a set number of days each year, to visit family and friends, or to simply explore the world we’re mapping.
Take the holidays you want with a competitive holiday plan, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday.
Join annual events like our Hackathon and DevDays to bring your ideas to life with talented teammates from around the world.
Become a part of our inclusive global culture and have the chance to collaborate with a diverse community – we have over 80 nationalities at TomTom!
Find out more about our global benefits and enjoy additional local benefits tailored to your location.
Meet your team
We’re the User Experience Design team. Fueled by user insights and data analytics, our mission is to create powerful, easy-to-use products that delight our customers, from millions of drivers to automotive customers who embed our technologies in their vehicles. We deliver the design specifications for all TomTom’s products. Joining us, you'll be part of a team that brings together design disciplines from user research to interaction, concept and visual design. Together, we'll continue to develop a map that people trust all around the world.

At TomTom...
You’ll help people find their way in the world. In 2004, TomTom revolutionized how the world moves with the introduction of the first portable navigation device. Now, we intend to do it again by engineering the first-ever real-time map, the smartest and most useful map on the planet.
Work with a team of 3,600+ unique, curious and passionate problem-solvers. Together, we’ll open up a world of possibilities for car manufacturers, enterprises and developers to help people understand and get closer to the world around them.

After you apply
Our recruitment team will work hard to give you a meaningful experience throughout your journey with us, no matter the outcome. Your application will be screened closely and you can rest assured that all follow-up actions will be thorough, from assessments and interviews all the way through onboarding. To find out more about our application process, check out our hiring FAQs.

TomTom is where you can find your place in the world. Every day we welcome, nurture and celebrate differences. Why? Because your uniqueness is what makes you, you. title: Senior UX Designer
descriptionHtml:
Design trifft Code, Code trifft Impact: Wir bauen digitale Produkte, die die Zukunft gestalten.

Wir sind ein IT-Dienstleister aus München, der sich auf individuelle Softwarelösungen für Unternehmen mit komplexen Strukturen und Prozessen spezialisiert hat. Wir setzen auf agile Methoden und schlanke Teams, um innovative und zukunftssichere digitale Lösungen zu schaffen. Unsere Expertise umfasst diverse regulierte und komplexe Branchen wie Versicherungen, Logistik und digitale Gesundheit. Von der strategischen Planung bis zur Entwicklung sind unsere Lösungen auf einer soliden technischen Basis aufgebaut.

Flache Hierarchien sind bei uns nicht nur ein Buzzword, sondern gelebte Realität. Wir kommunizieren offen, direkt und auf Augenhöhe, denn wir glauben, dass die besten Ideen in einer lockeren Atmosphäre entstehen

Wir investieren in deine Weiterentwicklung, denn wir wachsen, wenn du wächst.

Also, bereit für dein nächstes Abenteuer?

Aufgaben

  • Eigenverantwortliche Führung von UX-Projekten im Kontext von Geschäftsanwendungen – von der Anforderungsanalyse über Konzeption und Design bis zur finalen Umsetzung
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen unserer Kunden zur Erhebung und Konkretisierung von Anforderungen durch Workshops, Interviews und iterative Prototypen
  • Weiterentwicklung und Pflege von Design Systemen, die über Component Libraries hinausgehen und durchgängige Prozesse, Patterns und Standards etablieren
  • Tiefes Eintauchen in die fachlichen Kontexte der Kundenprojekte, um als kompetenter Sparringspartner auftreten zu können
  • Projektverantwortung auch außerhalb des reinen UX-Scopes – ganzheitliches Denken in Produkten und Business-Zielen

Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im UX Design komplexer Business- und Enterprise-Software im B2B-Umfeld
  • Echte Leidenschaft für komplexe Software und starkes Interesse an den fachlichen Domänen deiner Projekte
  • Ausgeprägtes analytisches Denken, hoher Gestaltungswille und strukturiertes Vorgehen, verbunden mit einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch
  • Erfahrung im Aufbau oder der Weiterentwicklung von Design Systemen, die Prozesse vereinheitlichen und Interaktionskonzepte skalierbar machen
  • Verständnis für technische und organisatorische Rahmenbedingungen
  • Proaktive, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise mit dem Blick fürs große Ganze – auch über die reine UX-Brille hinaus
  • Idealerweise Branchenerfahrung in der Versicherungswirtschaft oder im Bereich Großhandel/Logistik

Benefits

  • Arbeite an Projekten mit strategischer Bedeutung für Kunden aus den Branchen Versicherung, Großhandel, Agrar und der Startup-Welt.
  • Keine Standard-Mentor-Mentee-Dynamik: Lerne durch aktive Beteiligung und individuell abgestimmtes Coaching von Branchenexperten, die wirklich wissen, wie der Hase läuft.
  • Bei uns gibt's keine starren 9-to-5-Schichten. Deine Uhr, dein Zeitplan – Jeder hat seine eigene Arbeitsweise und das fördern wir gerne.
  • Unsere Büros sind mehr als nur vier Wände. Erwarte Top-Ausstattung, zwei Terrassen, eine Küche voller kostenloser Snacks, die weit über den obligatorischen Bürokaffee hinausgehen.
  • Lebe besser mit unseren VIP-Vorteilen. Von exklusiven Shopping-Rabatten bis zu ermäßigten Fitnessmitgliedschaften – wir sorgen dafür, dass sich Arbeit mehr als nur auszahlt.
  • Wir sind Teamplayer ohne Ego-Trips. Bei uns gibt's keine Titel und keine Hierarchien, die im Weg stehen.
  • Langeweile ist bei uns ein Fremdwort. Unsere Team-Events sind mehr als nur obligatorisches Networking. Erwarte Spaß, der die Batterien wirklich wieder auflädt.
  • Überdurchschnittliche Bezahlung ist für uns Standard. Wir schätzen Deine Skills und lassen das auch auf dem Gehaltszettel spüren.

title: Senior UX & Interaction Designer (m/w/d) | Industrial Software | Teilzeit
descriptionHtml:
HappyOps entwickelt moderne Softwarelösungen für die produzierende Industrie. Unsere Anwendungen unterstützen Maschinenbediener, Schichtleiter, Instandhalter und Produktionsmanager bei ihrer täglichen Arbeit, von der Produktionsüberwachung über Qualitätsmanagement bis hin zu digitalen Arbeitsabläufen und KI gestützten Assistenzsystemen.

Wir verfügen über ein erfahrenes Engineering Team, das unsere Kunden von der Anforderungsanalyse über die technische Konzeption bis zur produktiven Umsetzung begleitet. Gleichzeitig entwickeln wir uns zunehmend vom individuellen Lösungsgeschäft hin zu einer skalierbaren Softwareplattform.

Was uns dabei noch fehlt, ist eine konsequente Spezialisierung auf User Experience, Interaktionskonzepte und intuitive Nutzerführung.

Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Wir suchen eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die komplexe Prozesse versteht, sich in unterschiedliche Nutzergruppen hineinversetzen kann und daraus einfache, effiziente und konsistente Bedienkonzepte entwickelt.

Dabei geht es ausdrücklich nicht primär um visuelles UI Design. Unser Team kann moderne Oberflächen mit bestehenden Designsystemen und KI gestützten Entwicklungswerkzeugen bereits sehr gut umsetzen.

Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Frage, wie unsere Software funktioniert und wie Menschen mit ihr interagieren.

Welche Informationen benötigt ein Nutzer in welcher Situation? Wie navigiert er durch komplexe Anwendungen? Welche Aktionen müssen unmittelbar verfügbar sein? Wie lassen sich mehrstufige Arbeitsabläufe vereinfachen? Wie vermeiden wir unnötige Klicks, Medienbrüche und kognitive Belastung?

Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Gründerteam und unseren Software Engineers zusammen und prägst die User Experience unserer wachsenden Softwareplattform.

Wir suchen ausdrücklich eine erfahrene Person, die eigenständig UX Konzepte entwickeln und fundierte Produktentscheidungen treffen kann.

Die Position ist auf eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit in Teilzeit mit etwa 20 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche ausgelegt. Über das konkrete Arbeitsmodell sprechen wir gerne individuell.

Aufgaben

  • Interaction & Workflow Design: Du entwickelst intuitive Interaktionskonzepte für komplexe industrielle Softwareanwendungen und optimierst die Abläufe zwischen Informationen, Entscheidungen und Aktionen.

  • User Journey & Task Flow Design: Du analysierst, wie unterschiedliche Nutzergruppen ihre täglichen Aufgaben erledigen, und entwickelst daraus effiziente, verständliche und möglichst reibungslose Bedienabläufe.

  • Information Architecture & Navigation: Du konzipierst die Informationsstruktur und Navigation unserer Anwendungen. Nutzer sollen relevante Informationen und Funktionen schnell, intuitiv und ohne unnötige Schritte erreichen.

  • User Research & Prozessanalyse: Du verstehst die Arbeitsrealität von Maschinenbedienern, Schichtleitern, Instandhaltern und Produktionsmanagern und übersetzt deren Anforderungen in konkrete UX Konzepte.

  • Komplexität reduzieren: Du hinterfragst bestehende Workflows, identifizierst unnötige Interaktionen und entwickelst Lösungen, die auch unter Zeitdruck und in anspruchsvollen Produktionsumgebungen funktionieren.

  • Produktübergreifende UX: Du entwickelst konsistente Navigations- und Interaktionsmuster für unsere wachsende Softwareplattform und sorgst für ein einheitliches Nutzererlebnis über verschiedene Anwendungen hinweg.

  • Konzeption & Validierung: Du visualisierst Konzepte durch User Flows, einfache Wireframes oder interaktive Prototypen und validierst sie gemeinsam mit Entwicklern und tatsächlichen Anwendern.

  • Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem erfahrenen Entwicklerteam zusammen, diskutierst technische Möglichkeiten und stellst sicher, dass Nutzerfreundlichkeit von Anfang an in die Produktentwicklung einfließt.

Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich User Experience, Interaction Design, UX Architecture oder Product Design, idealerweise mindestens fünf Jahre.

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Konzeption komplexer B2B Software, Enterprise Applications oder datenintensiver Anwendungen.

  • Ausgeprägte Kompetenz in Information Architecture, Navigation Design, User Journeys, Task Flows und Workflow Optimierung.

  • Fähigkeit, komplexe fachliche Prozesse zu analysieren, zu strukturieren und in einfache, intuitive Interaktionskonzepte zu übersetzen.

  • Erfahrung mit nutzerzentrierten Methoden wie User Research, Usability Testing, Journey Mapping und Prototyping.

  • Verständnis für unterschiedliche Nutzergruppen, ihre Aufgaben, Entscheidungsprozesse und Arbeitsumgebungen.

  • Fähigkeit, UX Entscheidungen fundiert zu begründen und eigenständig mit Produktverantwortlichen und Softwareentwicklern zu diskutieren.

  • Pragmatische, analytische und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise mit einem klaren Fokus auf funktionierende Lösungen statt aufwendiger Designprozesse.

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Erfahrung mit industrieller Software, MES, ERP oder vergleichbaren komplexen Fachanwendungen ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Wichtig: Wir suchen keinen klassischen UI Designer, dessen Schwerpunkt auf visueller Gestaltung, Branding oder der Erstellung schöner Screens liegt. Entscheidend ist deine Fähigkeit, komplexe Software durch bessere Interaktionen, Navigation und Workflows einfacher nutzbar zu machen.

Benefits

  • Direkter Einfluss auf das Produkt: Du definierst, wie Nutzer mit unserer Software arbeiten, und prägst grundlegende Interaktions- und Navigationskonzepte.

  • Erfahrenes Engineering Team: Du konzentrierst dich auf UX Konzeption und Nutzerführung, während unser Entwicklerteam die technische Umsetzung übernimmt.

  • Schnelle Umsetzung: Deine Konzepte können mit modernen Entwicklungswerkzeugen und KI Unterstützung schnell prototypisiert, getestet und produktiv umgesetzt werden.

  • Direkter Zugang zu Anwendern: Du erhältst Einblicke in reale Produktionsumgebungen und kannst deine Ideen mit den Menschen validieren, die unsere Software täglich nutzen.

  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung: Du entwickelst eigenständig Konzepte und arbeitest direkt mit unserem Gründerteam zusammen.

  • Flexible Teilzeit: Etwa 20 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche mit flexibler Arbeitszeitgestaltung und der Möglichkeit zu hybridem Arbeiten.

  • Langfristige Perspektive: Du gestaltest die User Experience einer wachsenden industriellen Softwareplattform mit.

title: Senior UX Strategist & Researcher (f/m/x)
descriptionHtml:
The role

HelloFresh is going AI-first. Join us in leading the shift and shaping the global customer experience. As a Senior UX Strategist & Researcher on our UX team, you'll own work from ambiguous brief to strategic outcome and implementation — defining project needs, using innovative research approaches, prototyping direction instead of presenting findings, and walking into executive meetings with a decision artifact, not a summary. The most valued teammates today aren't the ones who run the most studies. They shape which questions get asked, challenge business assumptions before money is spent, and stay in the room to drive the decision. 

You'll use AI fluently as a genuine creative and strategic partner throughout the product design lifecycle. Strategy and research are your deepest strengths, but you’ll also work across the wider UX practice. We’re looking for people who go deep in one area and can take interface design, service design, and content to a solid minimum quality standard on their own, using AI to move fast, and who know when a problem needs a specialist’s depth.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

  • Lead strategic research for insights to action: Own the end-to-end research and strategy work streams, from scoping through execution to insight delivery and application, balancing primary, secondary, qualitative and quantitative methods.
  • Shape experiences across the ecosystem: Partner with product, design, marketing, operations, and business teams to understand and shape experiences across the full customer and service ecosystem.
  • Shape the agenda, not just respond to it: Proactively identify which bets need de-risking before anyone has asked. Challenge briefs before executing them. Connect findings to business decisions, market context, and KPIs.
  • Influence at strategic altitude: influence decision-makers— often VP/SVP — presenting in formats that force a decision in the room, not a follow-up meeting. Build visual directions, opportunity frameworks, and concept artifacts that make choices tangible.
  • Design and lead workshops: Own co-creation and alignment sessions end-to-end — the room, the agenda, and the output. Move teams from findings to direction.
  • Make insight visible: Build prototypes, concept visualizations, and service scenarios — using AI where needed to close the gap between insight and expression. 
  • Apply the right method for the moment: Select methods based on what the problem demands, not what's most familiar. Apply foundational, generative, or evaluative methodologies, rightsized to the context and the level of speed and rigor required.
  • Work AI-native across strategy and research: Apply AI from framing the problem and scoping studies through analysis, synthesis, and strategic recommendations. Use it to prototype directions and create decision-informed content, turning findings into executive-ready narratives and visual frameworks that compress the insight-to-action cycle. Experiment with novel methods, bring what works into live projects, and apply critical judgment throughout, knowing when to override the model.
  • Break down barriers across UX: Use AI to flex into interface design, service design, and content, producing work that meets a clear minimum quality bar on your own, and knowing when a problem needs a specialist’s depth. Help the team do the same by sharing what works, so AI removes execution barriers between disciplines and scales across the UX organization.

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years in UX research, UX strategy, Service Design or a closely related field within a product or tech environment
  • Mixed-methods toolkit with strong judgment for when to apply which approach
  • Experience influencing VP/SVP-level stakeholders — changing decisions, not just informing them
  • Ability to design and lead workshops and co-creation sessions with cross-functional teams
  • Ability to prototype and visualize strategic direction independently — through concept sketches, lo-fi prototypes, service blueprints, or AI-assisted artifacts
  • Strong strategic storytelling and visual communication; deliverables built to move people, not just inform them
  • Genuine AI native workflows and outputs in a research or strategy context — demonstrated point of view on how AI should change our workflows and where its limits are, as well as practical experience applying AI in real project contexts
  • Business acumen: able to connect research to trade-offs, market context, and commercial implications
  • Depth plus breadth: Deep strategy and research skills, plus working knowledge of interface design, service design, and content craft. You can produce work that meets a defined quality bar with AI support, and you’re comfortable handing off when the depth required goes beyond that.

What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.

  • Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
  • Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
  • Invest in your growth with a German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
  • Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

title: Senior Value Engineer Automotive & Manufacturing
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

Senior Value Engineer 

The Team: Value Engineering is responsible for our largest Fortune 500 customers and owns their transformation journey by working on the very frontier of what’s possible with data and AI on the Celons Platform. Partnering closely with the Sales team, Value Engineering is responsible for ensuring that the Celonis Platform is deployed to tackle the most strategic business challenges, fits into the right place in our customers’ technology stack and most importantly generates strong ROI through deep and broad deployments.

The Role: As a Senior Value Engineer, you will spearhead AI and data-driven business transformation within the Automotive & Manufacturing sector by contributing to your customer’s end-to-end value journey using the Celonis Context Model. Working alongside Lead and Principal VEs, you will combine technical execution with consulting and project management. As an AI-fluent operator, your core mandate is to orchestrate complex roadmaps and execute targeted transformation initiatives that improve how these businesses operate across their ecosystems.

The work you’ll do:

  • Value Selling & Realization: Uncover the real issues by peeling back layers of organizational complexity. Own the Outcome from first discovery through realized ROI for your process areas. Tell the Value Story by crafting powerful executive narratives and leading business value workshops.
  • Stakeholder Management: Cultivate powerful executive sponsorship across core business units to champion transformation programs. Co-own change management with customer leaders and design CoE roadmaps that build self-sufficiency.
  • Program Management: Steer Global Transformations across complex workstreams. Own and implement AI-driven account planning and AI-assisted project management. Automate executive governance (QBRs, SteerCos) with minimal manual friction.
  • Platform & AI Fluency: Act as an AI-fluent operator, utilizing AI tools for rapid technical outputs while partnering with Applied Value Engineers for deep-dive solution builds. Champion platform adoption.
  • Scale Value & Innovation: Build a strategic expansion roadmap embedding Celonis as a strategic platform to drive adoption. Provide feedback to R&D based on evolving customer use cases.

The qualifications you need:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience taking ownership of complex workstreams, process areas, and customer relationships in Value Engineering, Consulting, or Pre-Sales.
  • AI & Technical & Fluency: Solid background in enterprise IT and business software (e.g., SAP, Workday, Salesforce, Oracle). You operate primarily as an AI-fluent operator, utilizing AI copilots to generate outputs and automations, avoiding heavy manual coding.
  • Builder Mentality: Comfortable setting your own direction within an account team. Driven to live for customer value, proactively hunting and ideating for highest-impact solutions.
  • Process Improvement & Value Realization: Proven expertise in executing process improvements. 
  • Strategic Program & Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated expertise orchestrating multi-region or business unit transformation programs. Expert at mobilizing VP/Director-level sponsorship. Flawless English and French communication with commanding executive presence.
  • Domain & Industry: Deep understanding of the Finance/Supply Chain domains and Automotive/Manufacturing trends. You stay continuously updated on business-critical use cases.
  • Degree: Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Business Analytics,  comparable technical degree or a Business/Economics degree paired with a technical minor

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

title: Senior Vascular Sonographer
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

We are growing our vascular team and building out the follow-up pathway that sits behind the Neko Body Scan. When a scan raises a vascular flag, such as a low ankle-brachial index, a difference in blood pressure between the arms, or asymmetry on our Spectrum Gen 2 imaging, a member is referred for a follow-up examination. You will carry out those examinations.

This is a senior role within a small, close team. You will scan and report your findings, work closely with our Vascular Specialist, who makes the clinical decisions and referrals, and help shape how the pathway runs as it scales. You will also be a vascular reference point for the doctors and operators who perform first-line measurements in our clinics.

What you will do

  • Perform and report arterial duplex ultrasound of the lower and upper limbs for members referred through the vascular follow-up pathway.

  • Carry out repeat ankle-brachial pressure index (ABPI) with Doppler, and toe pressures or toe-brachial index where the pathway calls for them.

  • Carry out the examination requested through the pathway, record your findings clearly and consistently, and report them to the Vascular Specialist, who decides the outcome and any onward referral.

  • Recognise findings that need urgent action, such as suspected critical or acute limb ischaemia, and escalate the same day through our agreed emergency pathway.

  • Flag it to the Vascular Specialist when a request does not fit what you find, explaining your reasoning, so they can decide the next step.

  • Support quality and pathway improvement: contribute to protocols and SOPs, take part in audit, and help us understand how well our thresholds and referral criteria perform in practice.

  • Maintain equipment, probe cleaning and infection control standards, and report faults promptly.

  • Where needed, cross-cover follow-up lists at our clinics in other cities, with notice and travel costs covered, so the pathway keeps running during leave and peaks in demand.

  • Uphold safeguarding, consent, confidentiality and information governance standards in all member contact.

What we are looking for

Essential

• Registered with the HCPC, or accredited as a vascular sonographer through a recognised route such as a CASE-accredited programme or the Register of Clinical Technologists [HR to confirm accepted routes].

• A recognised qualification in vascular ultrasound or vascular science (for example a postgraduate vascular ultrasound qualification or a clinical physiology degree with vascular specialism).

• Strong hands-on vascular ultrasound experience, with the ability to scan and report your findings accurately, or to reach that standard quickly with support from our team.

• Excellent communication. You explain what you are doing and finding clearly and kindly to members who may be anxious, and you pass on findings precisely to colleagues across clinical and non-clinical teams.

• Sound clinical awareness and the confidence to escalate. You recognise when a finding may be urgent and make sure the right person knows straight away. • Willingness to travel occasionally to cover our clinics in other cities. • Right to work in the UK

Desirable

  • Five or more years of experience, or experience supervising or training other clinicians in vascular technique.

  • Experience in a preventive, screening or private healthcare setting.

  • An interest in learning new vascular technologies.

  • Experience contributing to audit, service development or protocol writing.

  • Comfort working with digital clinical systems and structured reporting.

Working pattern

You will be based at our clinic in your city. We are hiring one vascular sonographer each in London, Manchester and Birmingham, and as a team you may occasionally be asked to cross cover another city. Cover is arranged in advance, and travel costs are covered.

title: Senior Verification Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

Our ideal candidate could have 6+ years’ experience. This is a unique opportunity to accelerate your development, working with an experienced and collaborative team and gaining exposure to a broad range of disciplines. At Fractile, we value ideas from everyone, regardless of title or tenure, and we believe the best engineering happens when people share, question, and learn together. You’ll be joining a culture where your curiosity is encouraged, your input matters, and there’s real room to grow.

As a Silicon Verification Engineer, you will be based in either our Bristol or London office in the UK. We are looking for you to take an active role in building world-class ML/AI IC products for scale-out to data centre applications. You will be ambitious and have a proven track record in working in high-performance delivery organisations in the discipline of pre-silicon RTL verification.

We are looking for someone who is passionate about verification – not someone content to go through the motions, but rather looking to push the field further forwards. If you get excited about bringing software concepts to hardware workflows, and enjoy improving established practices to increase tape-out quality and bring down costs, then this is the role for you.

Our preferred candidate will be comfortable working alongside colleagues across the organisation from disciplines such as modelling, system architecture and RTL design. You’ll be frequently collaborating to ensure our RTL releases are of the highest functional quality, and that the entire company shares the same definition of a functionally correct product. This means contributing to discussions around specification, architecture and the workflows surrounding them. You’ll be a key contributor to our highly disruptive and ambitious product.

We look for engineers with the following mindset:

  • Software mindset for solving hardware problems

  • The desire to be in a high impact role in a small team

  • A disrupter of the “status quo” of hardware development

  • Eagerness to contribute to and improve working practices and help build connections between hardware and software teams

  • Detail-focused, with rigour as the baseline for all work

  • Humility, desire to learn

  • Happy to be part of a fast-paced, open and collaborative environment

Required skills and experience:

  • Strong software skills

    • Python (or another object oriented language e.g C++)

  • Understanding of digital hardware concepts

    • Ability to read and debug RTL in SystemVerilog

    • Familiarity with debugging waveforms

Candidates with a UVM or a strong software background are encouraged to apply even without an RTL background

Desirable skills and experience:

  • Pre-silicon RTL verification

    • Verification planning and execution from specification

    • Building testbenches

    • Stimulus creation

    • Functional modelling of hardware blocks

    • Checker creation

    • Coverage definition/closure

  • Transaction-Level Modelling

    • Whether in UVM, SystemC or another methodology

  • SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA)

  • Software fluency in multiple languages

  • Open source tools for silicon development

    • Cocotb (used for all our testbench collateral), Verilator, Icarus Verilog

  • Commercial EDA tools

  • Formal verification

  • Working in a monorepo environment alongside software

    • Bazel is our chosen tool, familiarity is not expected

  • Contributing to architecture discussions

How we work

  • Ownership and execution: you will have full agency to drive your work forward

  • Rapid iteration: we all work directly with top leadership to move from idea to hardware on ambitious timelines

  • Full-stack engagement: hardware, software, silicon, and modelling teams all work closely together to create a product with generational impact

  • Optimistic and pragmatic: we possess the will to win, and to do the hard work to get us there

  • Team player mentality: the mission is bigger than any of us, and we have the curiosity and technical focus to see the best idea shipped

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

 

Export controls

Our work involves technologies subject to UK, US and other international export control regulations. Certain roles may require additional eligibility checks to ensure compliance with applicable law. We'll be transparent about this throughout the hiring process.

descriptionHtml:

title: Server & Infrastructure Engineer - Unannounced Project
descriptionHtml:
Level Up Your Career with Zynga!

At Zynga, we bring people together through the power of play. As a global leader in interactive entertainment and a proud label of Take-Two Interactive, our games have been downloaded over 6 billion times—connecting players in 175+ countries through fun, strategy, and a little friendly competition.

From thrilling casino spins to epic strategy battles, mind-bending puzzles, and social word challenges, our diverse game portfolio has something for everyone. Fan-favorites and latest hits include FarmVille™, Words With Friends™, Zynga Poker™, Game of Thrones Slots Casino™, Wizard of Oz Slots™, Hit it Rich! Slots™, Wonka Slots™, Top Eleven™, Toon Blast™, Empires & Puzzles™, Merge Dragons!™, CSR Racing™, Harry Potter: Puzzles & Spells™, Match Factory™, and Color Block Jam™—plus many more!

Founded in 2007 and headquartered in California, our teams span North America, Europe, and Asia, working together to craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.

Join us and be part of the play!

Who We Are:

At NaturalMotion, we make games that wow people. We innovate to create previously impossible experiences that would not exist without us. We take pride in making titles that reach a large audience and creating communities that last. Our commitment to excellence has earned us recognition as one of the UK's Best Places to Work in games for eight consecutive years by gamesindustry.biz, and we're proud to be part of the Zynga and Take-Two Interactive family.

Position Overview:

We are seeking a Server & Infrastructure Engineer to join our server engineering team. In this role, you will work on core backend systems and backend services, contributing directly to live services and build systems with minimal supervision. You will help manage and expand our infrastructure, automated CI/CD pipelines, and development tools while collaborating closely with technical leads to build reliable, high-performing server environments. You will have a passion for large-scale high-availability systems, a devotion to software craftsmanship, an unwavering commitment to quality, and the desire to have their work seen by tens of millions of people worldwide.

We embrace a hybrid work environment. Within this role, you would work 2 days per week in our London office and the remaining days at home.

What You'll Do:

  • Server & Infrastructure Execution: Complete multi-day backend engineering tasks with minimal guidance. Design, deploy, and support scalable server architectures and cloud infrastructure.
  • DevOps & Pipeline Automation: Build, maintain, and optimise robust CI/CD workflows and automated deployment pipelines across cloud environments and build platforms.
  • Architecture & Planning: Participate in technical planning, architectural brainstorming, and technical cost/complexity estimation for multi-week efforts.
  • Team Efficiency & Quality: Proactively identify workflow bottlenecks and drive initiatives to improve overall engineering team productivity, tooling, and code quality.
  • Technical Communication: Participate in internal tech talks, share best practices, and maintain collaborative peer relationships across engineering squads.

What You Bring:

  • Programming Languages: Demonstrated proficiency in Python, Go and C# for backend services, automation scripts, and custom tooling.
  • Cloud Infrastructure & IaC: Hands-on experience provisioning and managing AWS infrastructure using Terraform (Infrastructure as Code).
  • Build & Platform Systems: Experience configuring and managing automated orchestration/build platforms (e.g., Unreal Horde, Jenkins, or TeamCity), preferably with Game Engines (Unreal Engine, Unity, etc.).
  • Source Control Management: Strong working knowledge of version control systems and workflow strategies (GitHub, Perforce/Helix Core, Git-flow, branch management).
  • Work Execution: Proven ability to manage moderate-to-complex technical tasks independently, break down project deliverables, and communicate status accurately.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience writing server-side logic and managing database dependencies for live applications or multiplayer services.
  • Have worked in, or has a strong interest in the gaming industry
  • Interest in infrastructure deployment and monitoring
  • Interest in mentoring junior team members or interns, framing task deconstruction, and conducting technical interviews.
  • Familiarity with containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure security best practices.

What We Offer You: 

  • Competitive salary and discretionary annual bonus scheme
  • 26 days holiday, plus bank holidays & 2 paid personal days
  • 6 months fully paid maternity/adoption leave and 16 weeks fully paid paternity leave (eligibility criteria applies)
  • Pension plan, with a double matching employer contribution 
  • Private medical & dental insurance and healthcare cash plan
  • Life insurance, personal accident insurance and income protection
  • Mental health and neurodiversity support programs
  • Company Employee Stock Purchase Plan (eligibility criteria applies)
  • Fitness reimbursement plan, worth £600 per annum
  • Flexible working hours
  • Weekly happy hours, seasonal parties and monthly social events
  • Annual rail season ticket advance and cycle to work scheme

title: Service Desk Technician
descriptionHtml:
Build with us

Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.

We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

Your impact

You will be the heartbeat of our internal operations. Mollie is one of the fastest-growing companies in Europe, welcoming around 15 new colleagues every month. As Service Desk Technician, you are the first point of contact for all IT-related questions and the face of IT for our Amsterdam office. Your work makes sure 1000+ Mollies can build the future of payments without technical friction.

You help new colleagues get started and you handle incidents, problems and requests, with a focus on Apple. You keep teams from Engineering to Sales connected, productive and secure.

With a customer-obsessed mindset, you will give hands-on support at the office and remote assistance across Europe. When a tech headache shows up, you turn it into a seamless experience.

What you'll ship

  • Troubleshoot, resolve and document IT issues across networking, hardware, software and related services

  • Support 1000+ colleagues, mostly on Apple devices

  • Act as the first line of support and escalate to the wider team when needed

  • Facilitate employee onboarding and help new colleagues get up and running

  • Contribute to projects and ongoing service improvements

What you'll bring

  • 2 to 4 years of service desk experience

  • A customer-first mindset

  • Strong troubleshooting skills, including on systems you haven't seen before

  • Experience administering Google Workspace and Slack

  • Experience with Jira or a similar service management tool

  • The ability to work independently, stay organised and prioritise a busy workload

  • The ability to work well with a wide range of teams and colleagues

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

title: Services Architect 3 - Paris/London
descriptionHtml:
Datadog’s Implementation Services team helps customers implement and deploy Datadog quickly. Our team of architects leads the discovery, design, build, and launch of the Datadog platform to help customers accelerate time to value and get the most out of their investment. As a member of our team, you will be responsible for developing the technical roadmap for a customer’s implementation, and leading them through it every step of the way.   

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Design and guide execution of Datadog implementations, including gathering requirements, building technical architecture, and supporting deployment and launch
  • Guide customer onboarding through co-development working sessions and assist when they run into roadblocks
  • Write automation and design architecture for deployment templates 
  • Manage the operation of implementation projects 
  • Collaborate with other teams, including Customer Success, Technical Account Management, and Sales to deliver an exceptional onboarding experience

Who You Are:

  • Experience designing and delivering technical solutions for DevOps Monitoring or architecture systems
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and compute technologies (EC2, serverless, VMware, VMs, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with Config Management, IAC and CI/CD tools, including Ansible, Puppet, Terraform, Chef, Jenkins, Circle CI, GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines, etc…
  • Experience programming/scripting with any of the following: Java, Python, Ruby, Go, Node.JS, PHP, and .NET etc
  • Successful track record with 5+ years experience as an Architect or Consultant in a professional services team
  • Able to sit up to 4 hours, traveling to and from client sites 
  • Able to travel via auto, train or air up to 30% of the time
  • Growth mindset by embracing change and AI tools

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Growth:

  • Best-in-breed onboarding
  • Generous global benefits
  • Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking
  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
  • Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing
  • An inclusive company culture, able to join our Community Guilds and Inclusion Talks

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. title: Shift Supervisor | DSL-01
descriptionHtml:
Shift Supervisor | DSL-01

Voor DSL-01 in Delfzijl zoeken wij een ervaren Shift Supervisor die vanaf de voorbereidingsfase meebouwt aan de operatie. Iemand die meedenkt over procedures, voorbereiding van de commissioning en startup en helpt om operators klaar te stomen voor het moment waarop de installatie daadwerkelijk gaat draaien. DSL-01 wordt een grootschalige productiefaciliteit voor Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) en bijproducten.

 

Over de functie

Als Shift Supervisor speel je een sleutelrol in de veilige, stabiele en efficiënte operatie van DSL-01. In deze functie krijg je een unieke combinatie van projectwerk en operationele verantwoordelijkheid. Tijdens de huidige projectfase draag je in dagdienst actief bij aan de voorbereiding van de fabrieksoperatie, commissioning en startup. Zodra DSL-01 operationeel is, gepland vanaf voorjaar 2028, geef je (in ploegendienst) leiding aan een ploeg operators en ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing van een complexe chemische productie-installatie.

Je zorgt ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits-, veiligheids- en milieudoelstellingen worden behaald en neemt de leiding wanneer zich afwijkingen, storingen of noodsituaties voordoen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's van Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain en HSES.

Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is dat je niet instapt in een bestaande organisatie, maar vanaf het begin meebouwt aan de operatie, productie en manier van werken.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

Tijdens de project- en opstartfase (~1,5 jaar):

  • Werk je in dagdienst

  • Draag je bij aan de commissioning en inbedrijfstelling van DSL-01

  • Ontwikkel je procedures en werkinstructies

  • Speel je een belangrijke rol in het uitvoeren van trainingsprogramma's en het trainen van operators

  • Ondersteun je bij de opbouw van de operationele organisatie

  • Zorg je voor een succesvolle voorbereiding op de start van de fabriek.

In de operationele fase (vanaf medio 2028):

  • Geef je leiding aan een team van ongeveer 8 operators in een 5-ploegendienst binnen een volcontinu productieproces.

  • Bewaak je de veilige en efficiënte productie van SAF, propaan, butaan en nafta.

  • Monitor je procesprestaties via DCS- en MES-systemen, stuur je bij waar nodig en zorg je ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits- en rendementsdoelstellingen worden gerealiseerd.

Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het naleven van veiligheids-, milieu- en kwaliteitsstandaarden, neem je de leiding bij incidenten en calamiteiten en coördineer je werkzaamheden tussen Operations, Maintenance en andere betrokken disciplines. Ook speel je een actieve rol in het continu verbeteren van processen en het verder versterken van de veiligheidscultuur binnen de fabriek.

Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is het ontwikkelen van het operationele team. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de groei van operators, zowel op technisch vlak als in competenties zoals samenwerking, eigenaarschap en veiligheidsbewustzijn. Door coaching, begeleiding en duidelijke verwachtingen zorg je voor een sterk team dat veilig, effectief en met vertrouwen kan opereren.

 

Jouw profiel

SkyNRG is een groeiende organisatie in een snel ontwikkelende markt. Daarom zoeken we mensen die zich prettig voelen in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt en die actief willen bijdragen aan de verdere opbouw van de organisatie.

Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, denkt vooruit en voelt je op je plek in een omgeving die continu in beweging is.

Je herkent jezelf in het volgende:

  • Ervaring en affiniteit met Procestechniek, Chemische Technologie of een vergelijkbare richting

  • Minimaal een afgeronde VAPRO C of AOT niveau 4-opleiding

  • Minimaal 10 jaar ervaring binnen de chemische, petrochemische, raffinage- of vergelijkbare procesindustrie

  • Aantoonbare operationele leidinggevende ervaring en bewezen people development skills

  • Ervaring met procesautomatisering en het werken met DCS- en MES-systemen

  • Kennis van procesveiligheid, werkvergunningensystemen en relevante wet- en regelgeving

  • Ervaring met het nemen van operationele beslissingen in situaties waar veiligheid, kwaliteit en continuïteit samenkomen

Welkome extra kennis en ervaring:

  • Ervaring binnen greenfield-projecten of grootschalige industriële bouw- en opstartprojecten

  • Ervaring met commissioning, startup en operational readiness

  • Kennis van raffinage-, hydroprocessing- of duurzame brandstofprocessen

  • Ervaring met continue verbeterprogramma's en performance management

Over DSL-01

In Delfzijl bouwen wij aan DSL-01, een fabriek van SkyNRG voor hernieuwbare brandstoffen. Hier produceren we Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) uit reststromen zoals gebruikte vetten en oliën, met HEFA-technologie. Daarnaast maken we bijproducten zoals butaan, propaan en nafta.

DSL-01 wordt de eerste fabriek in Europa die volledig gericht is op SAF en bijbehorende duurzame bijproducten. Als de fabriek in bedrijf is, produceren we jaarlijks 100.000 ton SAF en 35.000 ton bijproducten. Daarmee verminderen we de uitstoot van broeikasgassen met circa 80% ten opzichte van fossiele kerosine, gemeten over de hele keten.

De bouw is gestart in 2026 en de eerste productie staat gepland voor 2028. Het project omvat de fabriek zelf, bijbehorende leidingen en tijdelijke werkterreinen. Je draagt direct bij aan de realisatie van een nieuwe industriële fabriek en de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart.

We werken volgens internationale standaarden en Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving om de impact op mens, natuur en omgeving zorgvuldig te beheersen. Veiligheid, duurzaamheid en samenwerking staan daarbij centraal.

Waarom deze rol?

Deze functie biedt een kans die maar weinig operators en shift supervisors krijgen. Je bent vanaf een vroeg stadium betrokken bij de realisatie van een compleet nieuwe fabriek en kunt jouw operationele expertise inzetten om invloed uit te oefenen op commissioning, procedures, opleidingen en de uiteindelijke manier van werken.

Na de opstart maak je de stap naar een operationele omgeving waarin je leiding geeft aan een moderne productie-installatie en een belangrijke rol speelt in het neerzetten van de standaarden, cultuur en prestaties van de fabriek.

Tegelijkertijd draag je direct bij aan de realisatie van een van Europa's eerste grootschalige SAF-fabrieken. Een unieke kans om mee te bouwen aan een nieuwe productieorganisatie én een tastbare bijdrage te leveren aan de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart.

NB: Voor de opbouw van de operationele organisatie zoeken we uiteindelijk vijf Shift Supervisors. De eerste twee Supervisors starten tijdens de project- en opstartfase van DSL-01. De overige drie posities worden naar verwachting in het voorjaar ingevuld, zodat het volledige team gereed is voor de operationele fase. ‌

 

Solliciteer

Wil jij meewerken aan de succesvolle realisatie van een nieuwe fabriek en het resultaat van je werk terugzien in de praktijk? Dan is dit je kans om bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van duurzame luchtvaart.

NB: Een medische keuring maakt vanwege veiligheids- en gezondheidsredenen onderdeel uit van de selectieprocedure voor deze functie. ‌

 

Meer weten over DSL-01 en SkyNRG? Kijk op www.skynrg.com.

📌 Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

SkyNRG is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. We zetten ons in voor een inclusieve werkomgeving en beoordelen alle sollicitanten op basis van hun kwaliteiten, ongeacht afkomst, huidskleur, religie, nationaliteit, geslacht, seksuele oriëntatie, genderidentiteit of -expressie, leeftijd, beperking of andere wettelijk beschermde kenmerken.

Compensation: €4,583 – €6,000 per month

title: Signal Processing Engineer (Radio)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role
As Signal Processing Engineer, you own the algorithmic core of our drone-to-ground radio link — the system that keeps drones connected, controllable, and streaming in contested environments. You design the waveform, the anti-jam logic, and the signal intelligence that turn radio waves into a reliable link under hostile conditions, working hand-in-hand with RF hardware, FPGA, and software engineers to bring your algorithms from theory to flight.

Responsibilities

  • Waveform Design: Design modulation, coding, and equalization schemes for a robust, low-latency radio link.

  • Anti-Jamming (ECCM): Build algorithms that keep the radio link alive under active jamming.

  • Signal Intelligence (SIGINT): Detect and characterize other radio emitters in the operating environment.

  • Mesh Networking: Optimize protocols so multiple radio units share the airwaves without collision.

  • AI-Assisted Processing: Apply machine learning to jamming detection and channel prediction where it improves field robustness.

  • Field Validation: Take algorithms from simulation to lab bench to real flight test.

  • Radio System Integration: Work daily with RF hardware and FPGA engineers to bring designs into a fielded radio.

Candidate Requirements

  • Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Signal Processing, or Applied Mathematics.

  • 8-12 years designing radio or communication systems, from algorithms to deployed products.

  • Hands-on experience with modem or waveform design: modulation, coding, synchronization, equalization.

  • Solid grounding in probability, DSP, and information theory; comfortable deriving solutions from first principles.

  • Practical awareness of RF hardware and FPGA constraints (latency, precision, real-time processing).

  • Exposure to ECCM, SIGINT, or mesh networking is a strong plus.

  • Clear communicator across RF, FPGA, and software disciplines.

  • Fluency in English required; French is a plus.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Signal Processing Engineer (RF Processing & Analytics)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

As Signal Processing Engineer within RF Processing & Analytics, you own the algorithms that turn raw electromagnetic intercepts into an actionable picture of the RF environment — detecting, characterizing, and identifying the emitters around our platforms in contested environments. You work across the signals captured by our Radar, Radio, and Electronic Warfare modules, building the classification and analytics layer that turns isolated detections into a real-time electronic order of battle for operators and downstream autonomy.

  • Emitter Classification & Identification: Develop classification pipelines — combining feature-based methods and machine learning — to identify emitter types and match them against threat libraries.

  • Electronic Order of Battle: Design the analytics that turn individual detections into a coherent, real-time picture of emitters, tracks, and threat posture.

  • AI-Assisted Analytics: Apply machine learning to modulation recognition, anomaly detection, and emitter fingerprinting where it improves classification confidence in dense, contested spectrum.

  • Cross-Module Data Fusion: Work with signals captured by Radar, Radio, and Electronic Warfare to build a unified processing pipeline rather than siloed, single-sensor analysis.

  • Real-Time Pipeline Engineering: Take algorithms from offline prototyping (MATLAB/Python) to real-time or near-real-time implementation, alongside software and embedded/FPGA engineers.

  • Field Validation: Validate detection and classification performance against simulated and real-world RF datasets, in lab and field-test conditions.

title: Silicon Infrastructure Engineer

About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.
