title: Software Engineer I
descriptionHtml:
At OneStream, we're on a mission to empower every Finance organization and professional to exceed their potential. Our global teams span continents, cultures, and time zones, united by a shared purpose as we build the operating system for modern Finance and help organizations move with greater speed, clarity, and confidence.

That mission comes to life through our people. Behind every innovation, customer success, and milestone are talented people working together to make a difference. That's why we're looking for people who are bold enough to think big, authentic in how they lead and collaborate, curious about what's possible, and committed to delivering results.

Want a closer look before you apply? Explore our Careers site to learn more about our people, culture, and benefits.

SUMMARY 

OneStream Software delivers a unified Corporate Performance Management (CPM) platform designed to meet the complex financial, operational, and analytical needs of large enterprises. OneStream operates at enterprise scale, supporting mission-critical workloads for the Office of the CFO across highly regulated industries. 

The OneStream platform is built on a sophisticated technology stack that includes distributed, multi-threaded services, OLAP and multidimensional data models, modern web frameworks, SQL-based persistence, and increasingly cloud-native, SaaS-oriented architecture on Microsoft Azure. 

The Software Engineer designs, develops, tests, and maintains software components within OneStream, building high-quality features using established design patterns and best practices. This role owns assigned features through the full software development lifecycle, collaborates with senior engineers, Product, and Quality Assurance, and develops user interfaces, APIs, and data access logic. The Software Engineer participates in code reviews and assists in diagnosing and resolving defects and production issues to ensure reliable, high-performing solutions and positive customer experience. Success in this role is measured by code quality, reliability, learning velocity, and the ability to deliver well‑scoped features safely and predictably. 

PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality software components within OneStream solutions. 
  • Implement features using established design patterns and best practices under guidance from senior engineers. 
  • Contribute to UI development using modern UI frameworks including Angular, React, and Blazor. 
  • Develop and integrate APIs and services following RESTful standards and practices. 
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code with appropriate unit test coverage. 
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate development, refactoring, test creation, and documentation, while validating AI-generated output for correctness, security, and architectural alignment. 
  • Participate in peer code reviews to improve code quality and consistency. 
  • Assist in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving software defects across development and test environments. 
  • Collaborate with Product, QA, and other engineering team members to deliver features that meet functional and quality expectations. 
  • Follow established SDLC, security, and compliance protocols

REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
  • 2–4 years of professional software development experience. 
  • Experience with object-oriented programming and the Microsoft technology stack, including C#, .NET, and ASP.NET. 
  • Basic experience with modern UI frameworks such as Angular, React, Blazor, and WPF. 
  • Familiarity with data formats and markup languages such as JSON and XML. 
  • Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL fundamentals. 
  • Experience using source control systems (Git) and participating in CI/CD workflows. 
  • Ability to write and review unit tests to validate functionality. 

PREFERRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE 

  • Experience building enterprise or platform-oriented applications. 
  • Familiarity with cloud‑hosted or SaaS‑based systems. 
  • Introductory experience with automated testing practices. 
  • Azure Fundamentals or entry-level Azure certification. 
  • Familiarity with Cursor, Claude Code, etc. 

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES 

  • Solid understanding of software development fundamentals and object-oriented design. 
  • Ability to learn new technologies and frameworks quickly. 
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills. 
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills. 
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment. 
  • Attention to detail and commitment to code quality. 

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES 

There are no supervisory responsibilities required for this role. 

TRAVEL 

Travel Requirement: Regular travel is not expected for this position

REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

PREFERRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Are you a recent or upcoming graduate ready to launch your career at the forefront of industrial IoT? Join us and help shape the future of connected operations. You will immediately dive into challenging, real-world projects with the freedom and responsibility of a full-time engineer. We believe in providing a greenfield opportunity for growth and a high degree of ownership from day one. You will build and innovate, making a tangible impact on our global customers. You'll also have access to the latest AI tools, with generous token allotments, giving you the leverage to ship more and learn faster.

At Samsara, New Grads can work on a wide range of high-impact engineering challenges across our connected operations platform. Depending on the team, a New Grad may help build the backend infrastructure that powers our IoT platform, scaling data ingestion and storage systems that support over 15,000 hardware assets and tens of thousands of customers around the world. They may also work across the full stack, creating intuitive user experiences that turn data from millions of devices into actionable insights, while partnering closely with product and design to rapidly iterate on features that deliver real customer value.

On the mobile side, a New Grad could help strengthen the infrastructure behind our React Native app, enabling feature teams to move quickly and build performant, maintainable products. For those focused on embedded software, projects may include building and maintaining software that runs directly on Samsara hardware, spanning areas like edge AI, multimedia frameworks, power management, and real-time data processing in demanding real-world environments.

Throughout the interview process, we will dig into your past experience, what you are most interested in learning next, and where you would be the best fit across our engineering teams.

Our engineering teams use Golang for backend development, TypeScript and React for the web client, GraphQL for data access, and React Native for mobile development. Direct experience with this exact stack is not required, but experience with similar technologies is strongly encouraged.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will help keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and - most importantly - ensure workers return home safely.

They visit customers in person to understand not just how Samsara helps them today, but where our products need to go next.   • You're curious and self-driven. You challenge yourself outside of class - hackathons, side projects, tearing apart how something works just because you want to understand it. You move fast, embrace new technology, and treat learning as constant.

  • You're AI-forward. You've woven AI into how you work, whether that's accelerating debugging, drafting code, or exploring unfamiliar problem spaces faster. You're quick to experiment and always looking for smarter ways to build.
  • You're a collaborator. You work well independently and across cross-functional teams, and you're motivated by winning together, not just individually.

That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We’re looking for an Engineer II to join our Platform squad working on one of Hudl’s most innovative products: next-generation, fully automated sports cameras. These autonomous cameras use edge AI to automatically track the action and upload to the cloud, giving our customers seamless access to vital, real-time video and insights.

The Platform squad builds the foundation our hardware teams rely on - the build systems, tooling, update pipeline and security processes that take our cameras from development through manufacturing and into the field. As we bring up our next-generation hardware platform, you’ll help shape how it’s built, tested, shipped and kept secure.

As an Engineer II, you’ll:

  • Support our hardware squads. You’ll help hardware squads integrate their work into our CI/CD pipelines, so every change is built, tested and delivered reliably.
  • Build development tools. You’ll create and improve the tools our engineers use every day to build, flash, debug and test devices.
  • Keep our infrastructure running. You’ll maintain our CI/CD infrastructure, including the regression testing that runs in manufacturing.
  • Ship updates to the field. You’ll roll out software updates to our customers’ cameras safely and predictably.
  • Enable manufacturing. You’ll provide the tooling our contract manufacturers use to flash, provision and test devices on the production line.
  • Own the problem. You’ll work in an autonomous squad that has the freedom and expertise to deliver the best solution.

Location

Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We’re currently considering applicants within commuting distance of Den Bosch. You’ll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.

Must-Haves

  • Yocto experience. You’ve worked with Yocto and are comfortable building and customizing images.
  • CI/CD know-how. You’ve built or maintained CI/CD pipelines (for example, GitHub Actions, GitLab or Jenkins), including build automation and automated testing.
  • Scripting and tooling skills. You write clean, maintainable tools and automation in Bash and Python, and you’re comfortable with Docker and Linux system administration.
  • Comfortable withAI-assisted development. You work fluently with AI coding tools and can evaluate their output critically.

Nice-to-Haves

  • OTA update experience. You’ve worked with over-the-air update frameworks.
  • Manufacturing experience. You’ve built flashing, provisioning or end-of-line test tooling for production environments.
  • Embedded platform experience. You’ve worked with SoC vendor BSPs, flashing tools or secure boot on platforms.
  • Low-level development. You’re comfortable reading and debugging C/C++ code, from user space down to kernel drivers.
  • Security vulnerability management. You have experience identifying, triaging and resolving security vulnerabilities in embedded Linux systems.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.  Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.  
  • Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you’ll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
  • Encourage career growth. We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.

About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.  Data Engineer III

About the Role
We're looking for a Data Engineer III to join our Data Engineering team, which builds and governs the data foundation that powers the business. You'll work within our stack — Python ingestion pipelines, Airflow orchestration, and Snowflake/Databricks — helping move data reliably and securely from source to decision-ready output.
You'll implement features and fixes against a given design, handle known classes of pipeline issues on your own, and escalate genuinely novel problems with clear context rather than working them in isolation. You're also expected to start contributing meaningfully in code review — catching real bugs, not just style nits.

What You'll Do
  • Implement new ingestion sources end-to-end against a senior engineer's design — connector code, DAG, schema, monitoring, and catalog registration — extending the team's existing framework where a new source needs a pattern it doesn't yet support
  • Investigate pipeline failures independently, recognize known classes of issues, and ship the documented fix without needing to escalate
  • Before shipping a new pipeline, identify downstream consumers and what would break if data were late or wrong, and flag gaps like this during spec review — before writing code
  • Write clear handovers when escalating a genuinely unresolved issue — what you tried, what you ruled out, and where things diverge — so a senior can pick up without re-discovery
  • Review peers' pipeline PRs and catch non-obvious issues (e.g., missing idempotency checks, race conditions) that could cause incorrect downstream data
  • Turn ambiguous "why is this data wrong?" questions into structured investigations — tracing data lineage from source to warehouse and communicating back what you found
  • Surface concerns in spec review as specific, well-reasoned questions rather than staying silent or blocking progress
  • Support data security and governance work (e.g., PII masking, access controls) and contribute to data delivery work, including reverse ETL integrations
  • Build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders and help scope and clarify requirements for new work
  • Mentor DE2s on their first significant projects — pairing on tricky decisions and helping them apply team conventions


What We're Looking For
  • 3–5 years of professional software or data engineering experience
  • Strong SQL and Python skills, with solid experience building and operating production data pipelines
  • Comfort investigating and root-causing pipeline issues independently before escalating
  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools (Airflow or similar) and a cloud data warehouse/lakehouse (Snowflake, Databricks, or similar)
  • Solid understanding of data pipeline concepts: idempotency, schema evolution, backfills, and data quality/testing
  • Experience giving substantive code review feedback, not just style or formatting comments
  • Strong communication skills — can write a clear technical handover, ask sharp questions in spec review, and explain a data lineage investigation to a non-technical stakeholder
  • A track record of taking ownership of known-class problems end-to-end rather than needing step-by-step direction

Nice to Have
  • Experience extending or building reusable pipeline frameworks/templates
  • Exposure to reverse ETL tools or patterns, PII masking, or data access governance (RBAC)
  • Exposure to observability/monitoring tooling (e.g., Datadog) for pipeline health and alerting
  • Some experience mentoring or informally supporting more junior engineers
  • Background in gaming, betting, e-commerce, or another regulated/high-compliance industry

Why Join Us
  • Real ownership over known-class problems, with senior/staff support available for the genuinely novel ones
  • Work on high-visibility, high-trust systems that the business depends on
  • A culture built around clear tenets: standardize before you scale, own the outcome (not just the ticket), and clarity over complexity
  • Clear growth path into Senior Data Engineer, with room to start mentoring and shaping team practices along the way

title: Software Engineer Intern - Ads
descriptionHtml:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll join one of the Mirakl Labs Ads teams for a six-month internship starting in January or February 2027, based in Paris or Bordeaux. You'll be part of a cross-functional Squad made up of a Senior Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, Software Engineers, and a QA Engineer.

2. Your Impact

  • Contribute to the development and enhancement of an AI agent that autonomously generates and executes test scenarios, covering new feature validation, regression testing, and exploratory testing.
  • Help design, write, and run test cases to evaluate the agent's performance.
  • Explore different technical approaches and contribute to benchmarking their results.
  • Work under the guidance of experienced engineers and QA team members
  • Contribute to the project using existing programming skills


3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:

  • Currently pursuing a degree in software engineering, computer science, or a related field (engineering school, university, or career change), and looking for a 6-month internship
  • First hands-on development experience through an internship, academic project, apprenticeship, or personal project
  • Good understanding of a programming language
  • Proficient in working with LLMs and developing skills and/or agents
  • Appreciation for software quality best practices: testing, clean code, design patterns
  • Strong team player with a genuine enthusiasm for knowledge sharing and problem-solving

4. Tech Stack

  • Back-end: Java 21, Spring Boot
  • Front-end: ReactJS
  • Data & Messaging: Kafka, ElasticSearch, PostgreSQL
  • Tooling & Practices: CI/CD, Git, Docker, Monitoring

5. Languages

  • French: Fluent
  • English: Professional proficiency (written and spoken)

Compensation, Perks & Benefits

  • Pay Range: €1,200 – €1,400 per month

Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.

Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

  1. Manual screening of your CV by a recruiter, then an AI-powered screening conversation (10 min) with Emma, Mirakl's AI Talent Ambassador, to explore your background and motivation for the role. You will need to complete this step within 3 days, otherwise we won't be able to move forward with your application.
  2. Recruiter interview (30 min) — conversation about your background, motivations, and an introduction to Mirakl
  3. Hiring Manager interview (45 min) — technical discussion
  4. STAR interview (1h) — exchange with one or two team members exploring Mirakl's values and culture

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French.

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

title: Software Engineer Intern - (AI x Greentech) (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Most internships ask you to watch, learn, and maybe fix a few bugs.
This one asks you to help build the interface of an entire industry.

At Reonic, we’re building the AI operating system for renewable installers, with a strong culture based on ambition, impact, and ownership.
And we’re doing it fast.

What makes this internship different

  • Your work directly impacts how renewable energy gets deployed

  • You’ll own features end-to-end, not just tickets

  • You’ll feel the speed: idea → code → live → feedback

  • No endless planning cycles. No hiding behind process. No side projects nobody uses.

Just building, shipping, improving, with real responsibility from week one.

Please note: This is a fully onsite internship in Augsburg for 4–6 months.

You will:

  • Build high-impact features used daily by real businesses

  • Ship fast using TypeScript throughout the whole stack

  • Dive into Node.js backends and handle data with PostgreSQL and Prisma

  • Turn complex workflows into clean, intuitive interfaces with React and Tailwind

  • Work closely with product and design, with no layers and no handoffs

  • See your code in production within days, not months

And if you want more:
Work with Rust to extend our simulation that predicts the future of our customers’ projects.

This is not a narrow internship. It’s a playground for builders.


You’ll thrive here if you…

  • Love turning complexity into simplicity

  • Care about UX as much as clean code

  • Prefer ownership over instructions

  • Move fast, learn fast, and fix things instead of debating them

  • Actually want to build, not just talk about building

  • Have already built things, whether through side projects, hackathons, open source, working student jobs, or previous internships. Experience with TypeScript and React is a plus.

  • Are currently enrolled at a university and available full-time for 4–6 months.

If you need perfect specs and slow timelines, this isn’t it.
If you want to learn fast and ship real product, you’ll love it.


Why join now

  • A competitive internship salary

  • High ownership from day one: you’ll work on real features, not a sandbox

  • Learn from a strong engineering team that gives you direct feedback

  • Gym membership or transportation ticket: pick between Urban Sports Club or D-Ticket

  • Uber Eats and Uber rides on us when you finish late

  • We’re still early. Be at the forefront of the energy transition.


About Reonic
At Reonic, we’re building the AI-native operating system for renewable installers.
We’re replacing fragmented tools (CRM, design, proposals, project management, invoicing) with a single integrated platform that supports installers across the full project lifecycle. Today, more than 3,000 companies across 13 countries use Reonic, and it’s just the beginning.
We’re a well-funded, VC-backed startup reshaping how the world uses energy, with top-tier people, great investors, and massive goals ahead. We work hard and move fast to build a company that lasts and that brings lasting change.


Location & duration
This is a full-time, on-site internship based in Augsburg for 4–6 months.


Ready to shape the future of renewable energy? Apply now!

  • Designing and implementing REST APIs
  • Working with databases and data access layers

  • Collaboration in an Agile engineering environment

Learning Opportunities:

  • Hands-on experience with real production systems

  • Contribution to products used by students and educators globally

What We Offer For Interns:

We’re still early in our journey, which means every person who joins shapes the future of our product, culture, and growth. title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine – Query Engine
descriptionHtml:
Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness.

In this role, you'll own the query engine that searches hundreds of billions of claims across a variety of retrieval backends, from a distributed graph database to vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial indexes.

This is greenfield work with a massive scope. No off-the-shelf system answers precise questions over hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims at agent speed, so you'll make foundational decisions, from storage layout and indexing across engines to the query language and the planner that routes work between them, that every query depends on.

What you'll do

  • Own storage and indexing across backends: data layout, partitioning and indexes for graph, vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval, with bulk snapshot builds and live ingest that never take the system down.

  • Decide how best to search: cost-based planning from cardinality estimates that chooses, for each question, which backends to use, in what order and how to join their results, executed as traversals, retrievals, filters and aggregations in one plan.

  • Make it fast at scale: serve thousands of queries per second, profiling and cutting p50/p99 latency, memory and cost per query under high concurrent load, from on-disk layout to network fan-out.

  • Keep answers consistent while the data converges: the graph is fed by live updates and bulk snapshots at once and is eventually consistent by design, so you'll own what a query may see while it converges: consistent snapshot promotion, ordered application of live updates and stable pagination across versions.

  • Measure precision and completeness: end-to-end checks every deployment must pass, plus evals and metrics that show when a plan returns wrong results or misses ones it should have found.

What we're looking for

  • You've worked deep inside a distributed database, query engine, search engine or storage system.

  • Strong grasp of indexing, query planning and optimization, and storage formats.

  • Solid grasp of distributed systems fundamentals: consensus, replication, sharding and fault tolerance.

  • Strong in a systems language (Go, Rust or C++).

  • You profile before you optimize, and you've shipped measured latency wins in production.

  • You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale.

Bonus

  • Graph databases, or combining vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval

  • Compilers, query language design or cost-based optimizers

Example projects

  • Build a system that retrieves and reasons over everything known about any company or person in the world, answering any factual question precisely and completely.

  • Answer precise multi-hop questions over hundreds of billions of claims at thousands of QPS with interactive latency.

  • Build a planner that picks the right mix of graph, vector, full-text and geospatial retrieval for any question, and proves it chose well.

  • Make new knowledge queryable seconds after it's synthesized, without ever serving an inconsistent result.

Logistics

  • Location: This is an in-person opportunity in Zurich.

  • Visas: We're happy to sponsor international candidates (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H1B, O1, E3). While we cannot guarantee your visa, we have historically been successful in sponsoring candidates from all over the world. If you receive an offer, our team will work hard to get you a visa.

  • Benefits: We offer premium healthcare benefits (medical, dental, vision), fertility benefits, 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, and a monthly wellness stipend to all of our employees.

descriptionHtml:
L'histoire du groupe et de son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Tu rejoins Theodo Extend, la nouvelle entité du groupe Theodo, pensée pour répondre à une réalité terrain : de plus en plus de clients souhaitent garder la main sur la gestion produit tout en intégrant des développeurs de haut niveau dans leurs équipes. En 2024, nous avons collaboré avec plus de 100 clients, dont Carrefour, Dior ou Yves Saint Laurent, 63 experts mobilisés sur ces missions
Ta mission : En tant que Software Engineer chez Theodo Extend, tu es intégré à 100 % dans une équipe client, mais tu n’es jamais seul. Tu restes pleinement connecté à notre communauté d’ingénieurs passionnés, tu es formé aux meilleures pratiques, et tu bénéficies d’un accompagnement continu. Tu travailleras par exemple sur : - La reprise d’une base de code existante pour en assurer la fiabilité, la maintenabilité et la scalabilité via une migration complète vers une stack moderne - La mise en production d’une V1 en quelques semaines, dans des contextes de forte contrainte, en maîtrisant l'ensemble du cycle : conception, dev, QA, mise en prod. - Le développement d’interfaces complexes en React / Next.js, tout en intégrant les contraintes UX/UI issues d’une refonte de marque ou d’objectifs business - Le fait de pouvoir travailler en autonomie partielle ou complète, en interaction directe avec les équipes produit/métier du client, notamment quand aucune expertise technique interne n’est disponible. Exemples de missions misent en place : Refonte e-commerce pour Decathlon en vue des JO 2024 - Dans le cadre de sa nouvelle stratégie de marque, Decathlon a confié à Theodo la refonte de son site e-commerce, avec un objectif de lancement en moins de 6 mois au UK, avant les Jeux Olympiques de Paris 2024. - Notre équipe a développé un nouveau site basé sur Next.js, ReactJS et Strapi, avec une architecture pensée pour absorber une forte montée en charge. - Les livrables clés : migration du CMS, création d’une application de paiement, et mise en place d’un routage intelligent via Cloudflare Workers. - Résultat : un déploiement à temps, étendu à 6 pays, +10% de trafic pendant les JO, sans aucun incident majeur en production. Refonte d’une application critique pour IRIS Capital - Pour IRIS, fonds de capital-risque, nous avons réécrit une application stratégique de Ruby vers Python, afin de fiabiliser la détection de startups à fort potentiel. - Au programme : nettoyage d’une base de données divisée par 150, création d’une extension Chrome en Vue 3, et mise en place d’une nouvelle API pour fluidifier la communication avec les investisseurs. - Objectif : rendre l’outil plus rapide, plus fiable et automatisé, avec un impact direct sur les décisions d’investissement. A propos de Theodo Extend Theodo Extend, c’est une entité jeune, agile, et sélective, qui te permet de : - Travailler sur des produits réels, dans des contextes exigeants - Faire partie d’un collectif d’ingénieurs reconnus, qui échangent, se challengent et progressent ensemble - Être formé en continu via nos formats internes : Brown Bag Lunchs, Dojos, coaching individuel, communautés techniques (Node.js, ReactJS, DevOps, IA…) - Rester immergé dans notre culture d’excellence (1 jour par semaine minimum dans nos bureaux) - Construire avec nous une offre en plein développement : tu peux avoir un vrai rôle dans l’évolution de l’entité Bref, tu ne rejoins pas une simple mission : tu rejoins une équipe, une vision, et une trajectoire en construction. Le profil que nous recherchons : - Tu as minimum 3 ans d’expérience en développement Node.js/ReactJS - Tu es curieux, autonome, structuré et tu prends du recul sur ton travail - Tu as envie d’évoluer dans un environnement où tech = levier de valeur, pas une usine à tickets - Tu aimes partager, apprendre, t’améliorer et faire progresser les autres. - Tu veux t’investir dans une aventure qui démarre, où ton impact compte vraiment Déroulement des entretiens L’entretien se déroule en 5 étapes sous 2 semaines : - Un call de qualification (20 min), avec Thomas, notre Responsable recrutement - Un Entretien Recruteur plus approfondie avec Thomas (1H) - Un entretien de refacto (1 heure) - Un entretien technique (1 heure) - Un entretien final avec Alexandre, notre CEOPourquoi rejoindre Theodo Extend ? L'accompagnement : 📚 Formation et développement : Tu pourras assister à distance ou lors de tes jours de présence aux formations (dojos) sur des sujets variés : la tech, le produit, la gestion de projet, le management… 👾 Communauté : Être au coeur d’une communauté reconnue techniquement pour son expertise sur Node.js/ReactJS et pouvoir échanger sur les “bests practices”, les nouvelles features… 🤝Développement de carrière : chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. title: Software Engineer - Ruby on Rails

title: Software Engineer — Software Platform & Middleware (Early Career)
descriptionHtml:
Build the Software Platform Powering Next-Generation Mobility

Apex.AI is developing the software foundation for autonomous systems, intelligent machines, and software-defined vehicles. We are looking for an early-career Software Engineer to help advance our core software platform technologies, including Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida.

This role is ideal for recent university graduates or engineers with 1–2 years of experience who are passionate about modern C++, distributed systems, middleware, developer platforms, and systems software engineering.

You will work alongside experienced engineers on high-performance middleware, runtime systems, developer tooling, and software infrastructure used in safety-critical and real-time environments. This is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience building production-quality software for automotive, robotics, aerospace, and industrial automation applications.

We are looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex technical problems, learning deeply about software systems, and building tools and platforms that other developers rely on every day.

This role is based in our Munich office.


What You’ll Do
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of core software components for Apex.AI products, particularly Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida
  • Help build software platform capabilities, middleware features, developer tooling, and runtime infrastructure
  • Support improvements in performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability across the platform stack
  • Assist in debugging and resolving complex software and system-level issues
  • Develop automated tests, CI workflows, and engineering tooling
  • Collaborate closely with platform, product, and applications teams to deliver production-quality software
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and software design activities
  • Learn and apply engineering best practices for modern C++ and systems software development
  • Contribute ideas and improvements to developer workflows and platform usability

What You Bring
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Robotics, or a related technical field
  • Strong foundation in software engineering and computer science fundamentals
  • Experience with modern C++ through coursework, internships, personal projects, or early professional work
  • Familiarity with Python or scripting languages
  • Experience developing software on Linux-based systems
  • Interest in distributed systems, middleware, runtime systems, or embedded software
  • Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Familiarity with Git and modern software development workflows
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Curiosity, ownership mentality, and eagerness to learn new technologies

Nice to Have
  • Exposure to middleware or communication technologies such as ROS/ROS 2, DDS, shared memory IPC, or networking APIs
  • Familiarity with TCP/IP, sockets programming, or Linux system programming
  • Experience with CI/CD workflows and automated testing
  • Exposure to robotics, autonomous systems, or embedded software projects
  • Familiarity with build systems such as CMake or Bazel
  • Understanding of distributed systems concepts or real-time systems
  • Interest in automotive software, intelligent machines, or software-defined vehicles
  • Internship or academic experience involving systems programming or developer platforms

Why Apex.AI
  • Build foundational platform technology used in real-world autonomous and intelligent systems
  • Learn from highly experienced engineers working on technically challenging problems
  • Gain hands-on experience with middleware, runtime systems, and developer infrastructure
  • Engineering-driven culture with meaningful ownership, mentorship, and growth opportunities
  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and professional development opportunities
  • International team working at the forefront of mobility software innovation

About Apex.AI

Apex.AI is an international software company specializing in the development of safety-certified, developer-friendly, and scalable software for mobility systems, aiming to accelerate the transition to software-defined vehicles and mobility. Founded in 2017 by Jan Becker and Dejan Pangercic, the company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with additional offices in Munich, Stuttgart, Gothenburg, Tokyo, and Pangyo. To date, Apex.AI has raised over $75 million USD from world-class venture, financial and strategic investors including AGCO, Airbus Ventures, Canaan, Continental AG, Daimler Truck, HELLA Ventures, Jaguar Land Rover’s InMotion Ventures, LG Electronics, Lightspeed, Orillion, Toyota Ventures, Volvo Group Venture Capital and ZF.

The company’s flagship product, Apex.OS, consists of two core components: Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida.

  • Apex.Grace is an application runtime framework in the form of a software development kit (SDK). It provides a robust framework for developing real-time, reliable, and safe applications. Core APIs are based on ROS 2 APIs with numerous extensions enabling real-time execution, reliable performance, deployment into large fleets, system state management, safety, security, and much more. It is safety-certified to ISO 26262 ASIL D.
  • Apex.Ida is a communication middleware delivering optimal high-performance data transport across use cases. These use cases range from fully autonomous vehicles with dozens of high-resolution cameras to small signals with ultra-high frequencies in safety-critical domains. Its core is based on a shared memory data transport with connectors into DDS, SOME/IP, MQTT, CAN, and many more protocols, all abstracted into a single application-facing API.

Additionally, Apex.AI offers:

  • Apex.Alan provides customers with a highly optimized and efficient software integration, development environment, build, test, and delivery process.
  • Apex.OS for V&V enables record and playback of very large and diverse data streams, both time- and data-deterministically, which is crucial for replay, analysis, and performance evaluation of complex autonomous systems.

Apex.AI’s software solutions are utilized across a diverse range of industries, including automotive, agriculture, medical, and defense sectors. The products enable developers to efficiently create and deploy safe, reliable, and high-performance applications, thereby accelerating the adoption of software-defined mobility systems. Through its innovative software solutions and strategic partnerships, Apex.AI is at the forefront of transforming the mobility industry, facilitating the development of next-generation vehicles and systems.

title: Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Software Engineer

The Role

We’re hiring a Software Engineer to maintain and grow the platform that clinicians rely on every day. You’ll take features from idea to production, keep the platform fast, reliable and cost-effective, and work closely with our Product Engineer and engineering leadership to turn the roadmap into shippable work. You’ll also help set the engineering standard for the team through thoughtful code review and sound technical judgement.

This role suits a broad, highly capable engineer who enjoys owning problems end to end rather than staying in one layer. You’ll be comfortable moving from a Svelte component to a FastAPI service to a database migration in a single afternoon, and you’ll enjoy the detective work of tracing a slow request or getting to the root cause of a production incident. You’ll lead in some areas and learn from teammates in others, and you’ll care as much about quality, safety and maintainability as you do about shipping.

About Us

Lyrebird Health is transforming the quality and accessibility of healthcare by automating clinicians’ most time-consuming tasks.

Thousands of clinicians across multiple disciplines use Lyrebird every day in environments where accuracy, safety, and time matter deeply. Everything we build is grounded in earning trust, reducing cognitive load, and delivering meaningful impact at scale.

What you’ll do

  • Deliver features end to end, from Postgres, to API services, through UI optimisations, and user experiences.

  • Build new clinical document types, from writing and evaluating the prompt to building the editor view and releasing it safely behind a feature flag

  • Improve the speed and cost of document generation by tracing requests, finding bottlenecks, and tuning models, prompts and retry policies without compromising quality

  • Build integrations with practice management systems such as Best Practice and EMIS, and with healthcare standards like FHIR and HL7

  • Investigate production incidents using Sentry, CloudWatch, and Langfuse, and then identify and fix the root cause rather than just the symptoms

  • Independently break down feature work into clear, shippable steps

  • Review your teammates’ code and help keep our engineering standard high

What you’ll bring

  • Strong, production-level TypeScript and modern front-end framework experience, ideally Svelte and SvelteKit

  • Strong Python skills, including data structures, async programming, and building APIs with FastAPI and Pydantic

  • Hands-on experience integrating large language models into products, including prompt engineering, structured output, streaming, and managing latency and cost

  • Solid Postgres and SQL skills, including schema design, indexing and query performance

  • Experience shipping and operating software on AWS, a history with Docker, and good observability and testing practices

  • The breadth and confidence to work across the full stack, and the judgement to know when to lead and when to learn

Nice to have

  • Experience with healthcare integrations such as FHIR, HL7, EMIS or Best Practice

  • Familiarity with Supabase, including row level security and generated types, or with Temporal for durable workflows

  • Experience protecting personal data in text using tools like Presidio, llm-guard or spaCy

  • Experience with rich text editors such as ProseMirror or TinyMCE, or with browser audio capture and real-time streaming

  • A working knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA) and front-end performance optimisation

Every hour a clinician spends on paperwork is an hour taken away from patients. The code you write here goes straight into the hands of doctors, nurses and allied health professionals, giving them time back and helping them deliver better, safer care. If you want your engineering to have a real, visible impact on people’s health, this is the place to do it.

We’re building a team that reflects the diversity of the people who benefit from our work. We want Lyrebird to be a place where everyone feels safe, supported, and able to thrive. If you’re from an underrepresented background in tech, we strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

On the mobile side, an intern could help strengthen the infrastructure behind our React Native app, enabling feature teams to move quickly and build performant, maintainable products. For those focused on embedded software, projects may include building and maintaining software that runs directly on Samsara hardware, spanning areas like edge AI, multimedia frameworks, power management, and real-time data processing in demanding real-world environments.

Throughout the interview process, we will dig into your past experience, what you are most interested in learning next, and where you would be the best fit across our engineering teams.

Our engineering teams use Golang for backend development, TypeScript and React for the web client, GraphQL for data access, and React Native for mobile development. Direct experience with this exact stack is not required, but experience with similar technologies is strongly encouraged.

You should apply if…

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will help keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and - most importantly - ensure workers return home safely.
  • You want to build for scale. You'll work on technology that powers physical operations at a scale most engineers never experience.
  • You believe customers are more than a number. Our engineers are deeply invested in our customers and the daily problems they face. They visit customers in person to understand not just how Samsara helps them today, but where our products need to go next. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with success and product teams, and use metrics to ensure your work translates into real outcomes.
  • You're curious and self-driven. You challenge yourself outside of class - hackathons, side projects, tearing apart how something works just because you want to understand it. You move fast, embrace new technology, and treat learning as constant.
  • You're drawn to hard problems and own them end to end. You dig into complexity, research it thoroughly, and find the simplest solution that works - then see it through, holding yourself to a high standard along the way.
  • You're AI-forward. You've woven AI into how you work, whether that's accelerating debugging, drafting code, or exploring unfamiliar problem spaces faster. You're quick to experiment and always looking for smarter ways to build.
  • You're a collaborator. You work well independently and across cross-functional teams, and you're motivated by winning together, not just individually.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Currently in your penultimate year of study (or second-to-last year of an integrated Master's / MEng), on track to complete a Bachelor's or integrated Master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, or Data Science, with expected graduation no earlier than Summer 2028.
  • This internship is hybrid: 3 days per week in our London office.
  • This internship is a full-time, paid experience — interns are expected not to be enrolled in school or university full-time while working at Samsara.

In your application

  • Include your CV / résumé.
  • Answer all of the application questions.
  • We're reviewing applications on a rolling basis, and we expect to finalize our cohort by late November/early December. Applications will close October 30th at 6:00pm (UK). Please do not email us to inquire about the status of your application.

We know that applying for internships can be time-consuming, and we truly appreciate your effort. We're looking forward to learning more about you through your application.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

title: Software Engineering Manager (Hands-On, Frontend)
descriptionHtml:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team - from Finance to HR - to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time. Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake or Siemens, use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario. With a team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software. At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

We're hiring an Engineering Manager who wants to spend 80% of their time writing code, not attending management meetings.

About the role

Are you an experienced Software Engineer who loves writing code, solving complex technical problems and helping other engineers become better at what they do?

At Pigment, our Engineering Managers are engineers first.

Unlike traditional Engineering Manager positions, this role is designed for someone who wants to remain deeply involved in building software while taking on meaningful people-management responsibilities.

You'll spend approximately 80% of your time designing, coding and shipping production features, with the remaining 20% dedicated to coaching engineers, running regular 1:1s, providing feedback and supporting their development.

We're particularly interested in Senior Software Engineers who have naturally taken on coaching, mentoring or technical leadership responsibilities and are ready to develop further as people managers.

You don't necessarily need to have held an Engineering Manager title before. What matters most is your technical ability, your experience helping others grow and your motivation to combine engineering with people leadership.

You'll join Pigment's Reporting & Collaboration community, building sophisticated frontend experiences that help customers interact with complex data, configure workflows and make better business decisions.


What you'll do

🧑‍💻 Software Engineering (80%)

You'll remain an active contributor to our production codebase, working alongside other engineers on challenging frontend projects.

  • Write, review, refactor and ship production code regularly using React, TypeScript and JavaScript.

  • Design and build sophisticated user interfaces for interacting with large datasets, including filtering, visualisation and complex configuration.

  • Take ownership of engineering tasks and features from technical design through implementation, testing and deployment.

  • Solve challenging problems involving frontend performance, scalability, state management and user experience.

  • Participate in technical discussions, code reviews, debugging and architectural decisions.

  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Tech Leads and Software Engineers to deliver high-quality features.

  • Contribute to AI-powered product experiences and use modern development tools where appropriate.

  • Maintain the same technical expectations and engineering standards as our Senior Software Engineers.

    • You'll continue to write production code, not simply oversee the engineers who do.


    📚 Coaching & People Management (20%)

    Alongside your engineering responsibilities, you'll help other engineers develop their skills, confidence and careers.

    • Coach and mentor engineers, sharing technical knowledge and helping them improve their problem-solving abilities.

    • Hold regular 1:1 meetings with your direct reports to discuss progress, challenges and career development.

    • Provide constructive feedback, recognise achievements and support individual development plans.

    • Help engineers establish clear goals and understand the skills required to progress.

    • Support performance reviews and development discussions, including more challenging conversations when necessary.

    • Work alongside Tech Leads to understand engineers' technical contributions and development needs.

    • Help foster a collaborative engineering culture where people continuously learn from one another.

      • At Pigment, technical leadership and people management are intentionally separated. Tech Leads own the technical direction of teams, while Engineering Managers focus on coaching and developing engineers alongside their own coding responsibilities.

      You'll initially focus on contributing as a Senior Engineer before gradually taking on direct reports.


Who we're looking for

You're an engineer first, with a genuine interest in developing people.

  • You have substantial professional software-engineering experience and are technically operating at a strong Senior Engineer level.

  • You're currently hands-on with production code and want coding to remain the majority of your working week.

  • You have strong frontend development experience with React, TypeScript and JavaScript.

  • You've built complex, scalable applications, ideally within B2B SaaS, enterprise software, analytics or data-intensive environments.

  • You have experience coaching, mentoring or supporting other engineers through code reviews, pairing, technical discussions or structured feedback.

  • You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping other engineers improve.

  • You're interested in taking ownership of 1:1s, career development and people-management responsibilities, or already have experience doing so.

  • You're comfortable solving complex technical challenges independently while collaborating with others.

  • You care about product quality, engineering standards and delivering meaningful value to customers.

  • You're fluent in English. French is not required.

    • Previous formal people-management experience is a plus, but not a requirement. We're equally interested in strong Senior Engineers who have demonstrated the ability to coach others and are ready to take the next step.


Our interview process

Because Engineering Managers at Pigment spend approximately 80% of their time coding, they go through the same core technical assessments as our Software Engineers.

We want you to understand these expectations from the beginning.

1️⃣ Technical Screen

A technical discussion including a 15-minute code refactoring exercise.

AI assistance is not permitted during the refactoring exercise.

2️⃣ Live Coding

A hands-on algorithmic coding interview focused on problem-solving, code quality and technical reasoning.

AI assistance is not permitted.

3️⃣ System Design

A discussion exploring your approach to designing software systems, evaluating technical trade-offs and solving complex engineering problems.

4️⃣ Final Interview with the EML (Engineering Manager Lead)

A conversation exploring your motivation, engineering mindset, approach to coaching and alignment with Pigment's culture and expectations.

Important: Our Engineering Managers are assessed against the same senior technical engineering standards as our Software Engineers. This is a role for people who genuinely enjoy coding and want to keep doing it.


Is this role right for you?

You'll probably love this role if:

  • You enjoy writing code more than spending your day in management meetings.

  • You're a strong Senior Engineer who wants to help others grow.

  • You want to develop people-management skills without moving away from engineering.

  • You enjoy the challenge of balancing meaningful individual contributions with coaching responsibilities.

    • This probably isn't the right role if:

    • You're looking to move away from hands-on software development.

    • You prefer managing delivery, budgets and team strategy over building software.

    • You haven't written production code regularly for some time.

    • You're looking for a traditional Engineering Manager position where engineering work is mainly delegated to others.

      • At Pigment, you don't have to choose between being an excellent engineer and helping other engineers grow.


What you will get
  • Competitive salary
  • Equity
  • The best health insurance with Alan Blue is entirely free for you and your family 💙
  • Trust and flexible working hours
  • Brand new offices in the heart of Paris, London, New York, and, Toronto
  • Remote-friendly environment

This may include verification of employment history, education, and, where legally permitted, criminal records. Any checks will be conducted lawfully prior to formal employment contracts being signed, with candidate consent, and information will be treated confidentially. Pigment is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity is a strength and fosters innovation. We are committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, social origin, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We may process your personal data in accordance with our HR Data Protection Notice.

title: Software Platform Engineer, EU Traffic
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Company

Help us build the world's most reliable, on-demand logistics engine for last-mile delivery! We're bringing on experienced engineers to help us create and maintain a 24x7, no downtime, global infrastructure system that powers the company's three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and riders.

About the Role

We are looking for experienced engineers to join the EU Traffic team, based at Deliveroo, part of DoorDash, and help build the next generation of DoorDash's Traffic platform. We are building a single, shared platform designed to serve DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt, so your work will shape reliability and security for all three marketplaces. Our team owns the infrastructure that carries every request into and through that platform: the edge, where we manage Cloudflare (CDN, DNS, rate limiting, bot mitigation) and the ingress systems for external traffic, and service-to-service (S2S) communication, where we run the service mesh and the authentication that secures calls between thousands of services across multiple regions.

You will work on core components of our traffic stack, including our Cloudflare edge configuration (managed as code), and service-to-service authentication and authorization (workload identity, token issuance and validation at the mesh layer). This role sits at the intersection of distributed systems, networking, and security. It includes designing, building, and maintaining systems that must operate reliably and efficiently across some of the most critical and latency-sensitive workloads at DoorDash, from the first byte at the edge to the last hop between services.

You will report to the Engineering Manager of the EU-Traffic Team within the Infrastructure organization. This role is hybrid working from London.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Design and build large-scale distributed systems that are high RPS and latency sensitive
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and fix issues that affect production and maintain our SLAs
  • Work collaboratively with other platform and product engineers to deliver on feature requests and solve their problems
  • Find ways to improve the team's productivity and operational capabilities through the use of automation, AI tools, and other avenues
  • Participate in a shared on-call rotation and help lead production investigations and incidents, with support from teammates
  • Mentor and learn from teammates through design reviews, pairing, and incident reviews

We're excited about you because…

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a software engineer in infrastructure, networking, or platform engineering/SRE
  • Experience operating edge technologies at scale, such as CDN, WAF, proxy layers, and DNS
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals like TCP/IP, HTTP, HTTP/2, gRPC, Load Balancing
  • Background working on and debugging high-QPS or latency-sensitive systems
  • You're curious, collaborative, and comfortable making progress in ambiguity
  • You work AI-first: you delegate to and orchestrate coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) across design, implementation, testing, incident response, and releases

If you don't meet every requirement but are excited about this work, we'd still love to hear from you.

Bonus points if you…

  • Experience with programming languages like Go, C++, Python or Rust
  • Experience with AWS, especially with networking primitives like LBs, Privatelink, etc. and Kubernetes or other container management tool
  • Experience with service mesh technologies such as Envoy, Istio or Linkerd
  • Familiarity with xDS or control plane architectures
  • Experience building RPC frameworks or client-side networking libraries
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tooling like Terraform
  • Experience with Gitops delivery tooling such as ArgoCD, Helm, Atlantis.
  • Track record of sharing prompts, tooling, and practices that make a whole team faster with AI

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Software QA Engineer II
descriptionHtml:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

Axon’s RF sensors detect and locate drones so public safety and critical infrastructure teams can protect airspace. You will own the test strategy and independent verification approach for RF sensor capabilities — spanning regression, integration, and real-world validation — so those systems are trustworthy in the lab and in the field. You will work closely with RF Engineering at the intersection of software, hardware, and real-world RF, helping turn technical evidence into confident product decisions.

Work Location: This role is based out of our Kassel, Germany office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the test strategy and independent verification approach for RF sensor software from design through release, adding rigor through regression, integration, and real-world validation.
  • Design and own test strategies spanning feature, regression, integration / interface, system, and field validation. Combine automated coverage with targeted manual validation based on risk and technical feasibility.
  • Develop in-depth functional tests for individual components of the RF sensor software, and keep those tests maintainable as the product evolves.
  • Reproduce, isolate, and characterize issues on real sensor hardware and in test environments; capture clear reproduction steps, logs, and environment details.
  • Build and maintain hardware-backed automated regression tests and supporting test tooling.
  • Monitor and improve development and test systems and test hardware so environments stay stable, observable, and ready for daily use.
  • Partner closely with RF Engineering and independently verify behavior in realistic environments and across system interfaces. Execute system, release, field, and acceptance testing with release stakeholders.
  • Document test results and defects clearly, and contribute to software design reviews and after-action reviews for the work you own.

title: Software Safety Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We pull medical technology from the future to solve human health.

 

Scarlet is authorised to assess and certify medical devices. We combine clinical, technical and regulatory expertise with AI agents and software so rigorous certification can keep pace with product development at the world’s most ambitious technology companies, without lowering the safety bar.

Our customers have cut a year or more from their certification timelines for new AI-enabled medical devices and shortened product-update cycles from months to weeks. You’ll join a team building the infrastructure that makes these outcomes repeatable at scale.

About the role

As a Software Safety Engineer, you’ll assess software lifecycle processes and technical documentation for medical device software. You’ll use AI-assisted workflows to navigate evidence, explore failure modes, develop questions and test hypotheses, and surface inconsistencies for deeper review. You’ll experiment with improvements to your workflows as model capabilities improve and work with our product, engineering and applied machine learning teams to improve the tools you use. Your work will identify software risks and evidence gaps so Scarlet can reach rigorous certification decisions about medical device software and help safe devices reach patients sooner.

Responsibilities

  • Assess software lifecycle processes and technical documentation submitted by our customers

  • Screen and action regulatory insights from the latest research, standards and guidance

  • Work with our product, engineering and applied machine learning teams to improve our systems

  • Work with our market access team to expand Scarlet's responsibility to new jurisdictions and certifications

  • Create content to explain complex regulatory topics to customers and prospects

  • Provide regulatory insights to prospects and customers

Required qualifications

  • A degree in computer science or a related discipline

  • Four or more years’ experience in medical device or other safety-critical product manufacturing, auditing or research, including two or more years’ experience developing safety-critical software

  • Practical experience with software development fundamentals, including software development lifecycle processes, software verification and validation testing, software configuration management and cybersecurity

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills

Preferred qualifications

  • Knowledge or training in the relevant standards and guidance for medical device software, such as IEC 62304 and IEC 81001-5-1

  • Practical experience with generative AI e.g. LLMs, embeddings, RAG, fine-tuning, evaluation/monitoring

Interview process

  1. Intro call with Hann — 30 mins

  2. Interview with one of our Software Safety Engineers — 30 mins

  3. Technical task and interview with Hann — 1 hour

  4. Culture and values interviews with Sandy, James and Jamie — 20 mins each

  5. Offer & referencing

Compensation: £75K – £85K • Offers Equity
