title: Softwarearchitekt – HMI / Automatisierungstechnik (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du willst nicht einfach irgendeine Code‑Rolle übernehmen. Du willst die technische Gesamtarchitektur von industriellen Bedienoberflächen bestimmen.

Hier geht es nicht um reine UI‑Entwicklung. Hier geht es um Security‑by‑Design nach IEC 62443, Skalierbarkeit und die Integration in komplexe Anlagen.

5 Jahre HMI‑Erfahrung, 2 Jahre in einer architekturverantwortlichen Position und gelegentliche Kundenreisen sind für dich Normalität.

Unser Kunde

Der Kunde ist ein mittelständisches Unternehmen im Bereich Automatisierungstechnik und Maschinenbau, das weltweit industrielle Anlagen und Steuerungssysteme liefert. Mit mehreren Standorten in der Schweiz und Europa entwickelt das Unternehmen integrierte Softwarelösungen, darunter eine einheitliche HMI‑Plattform für seine Produkte. Es positioniert sich als Innovationsführer im Bereich industrieller Bedienoberflächen.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

  • Technische Führungsrolle mit direktem Einfluss auf die Produktarchitektur
  • Arbeit mit Qt, QML, WinCC Unified und Web‑HMI‑Technologien
  • Verantwortung für Security nach IEC 62443 (Benutzerverwaltung, Verschlüsselung)
  • Vielfältige Industrieprojekte von Maschinen‑ bis Anlagenbau
  • Gelegentliche Kundenreisen zur Inbetriebnahme und Feldunterstützung
  • Gestaltung einer einheitlichen, wiederverwendbaren HMI‑Plattform

Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwurf, Dokumentation und Weiterentwicklung der HMI‑Softwarearchitektur (Schichten, Module, Schnittstellen)
  • Auswahl und Bewertung von HMI‑Frameworks und Tools (Qt/QML, WinCC Unified, TIA Portal, Web‑HMI)
  • Definition von Architekturprinzipien, Design‑Patterns (z. B. MVVM) und Coding‑Guidelines
  • Aufbau wiederverwendbarer Komponentenbibliotheken und Bedienbausteine
  • Konzeption der Anbindung an Steuerungen über OPC UA, Profinet, Modbus oder MQTT
  • Umsetzung von Security‑by‑Design, Rollen‑ und Rechtekonzepten nach IEC 62443
  • Fachliche Anleitung und Coaching des HMI‑Entwicklungsteams
  • Mitgestaltung von CI/CD‑Pipelines, Versionsverwaltung und Release‑Prozessen

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der HMI‑ oder Embedded‑Softwareentwicklung
  • Davon mindestens 2 Jahre in einer architekturverantwortlichen oder leitenden technischen Rolle
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit C++ (modern), Qt, QML, WinCC Unified und TypeScript/JavaScript
  • Sicherer Umgang mit OPC UA, MQTT, Profinet und feldbasierten Kommunikationsprotokollen
  • Kenntnisse in Security‑Standards IEC 62443 und Erfahrung in deren Umsetzung
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch‑ und Englischkenntnisse (C2)

Was hier nicht funktioniert

  • Job‑Hopper – häufige Wechsel sind ein Dealbreaker
  • Nur Front‑End‑Entwickler ohne Embedded‑Erfahrung – fehlt das Systemverständnis
  • Kein Interesse an Security – du vernachlässigst IEC 62443‑Anforderungen
  • Unflexibel – keine Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Kundenreisen
  • Mangelnde Kommunikationsfähigkeit – du kannst technische Konzepte nicht verständlich vermitteln

Deine Benefits

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

  • Du bestimmst die technische Zukunft der HMI‑Plattform eines Innovationsführers
  • Du kombinierst tiefes Fachwissen mit strategischer Gestaltungskraft
  • Du arbeitest in einem internationalen Umfeld mit Projekten von Bern bis in die ganze Schweiz

Viel Verantwortung, viel Gestaltung, wenig Ausreden. Für manche ein Albtraum. Für die Richtigen: genau das, was sie suchen.

Bereit?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt als Softwarearchitekt – HMI / Automatisierungstechnik (w/m/d).

Egal ob dein Titel Lead HMI Engineer, HMI Architect, Embedded UI Architect, Senior HMI Developer heißt: Entscheidend ist nicht der Titel. Entscheidend ist, ob du mindestens fünf Jahre HMI‑Erfahrung mitbringst und Sicherheit nach IEC 62443 in der Praxis umsetzen kannst.

title: Softwaretester / QA Engineer als Scrum Master (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Mach aus guten Ideen Software, die im Alltag überzeugt

Du probierst neue Funktionen aus und merkst schnell, wenn etwas nicht rundläuft? Du willst Fehler verstehen, Lösungen mitgestalten und gemeinsam mit einem kleinen Team ein Produkt besser machen? Dann könnte das deine Rolle bei AUGLETICS sein.

Wir entwickeln und produzieren smarte Rudergeräte in Königs Wusterhausen bei Berlin. Bei uns siehst du direkt, wie deine Arbeit das Training unserer Kunden verbessert: Du testest am echten Gerät, arbeitest eng mit der Entwicklung zusammen und begleitest neue Funktionen bis zum Release.

Du ergänzt unser Softwareteam mit vier bis fünf Personen und arbeitest direkt mit unserem CTO Christopher Klabunde. Dein Schwerpunkt ist Softwarequalität. Dazu übernimmst du technische Projektkoordination: Du bringst Ordnung in offene Aufgaben, klärst Anforderungen und hilfst dem Team, Ideen zuverlässig umzusetzen. In diese Verantwortung kannst du hineinwachsen.

Das machst du bei uns

  • App und Gerät gründlich testen: Du prüfst neue Funktionen, typische Trainingsabläufe und Grenzfälle und gibst konkretes Feedback zu Funktion und Bedienbarkeit.

  • Tests aufbauen und verbessern: Du entwickelst Testfälle, Checklisten und wiederholbare Regressionstests. Schritt für Schritt baust du Testautomatisierung auf – immer dort, wo sie dem Produkt und dem Team hilft.

  • Fehler bis zur Lösung verfolgen: Du beschreibst reproduzierbare Schritte, grenzt Ursachen gemeinsam mit der Entwicklung ein und prüfst, ob eine Korrektur auch im Zusammenspiel mit anderen Funktionen funktioniert.

  • Projekte ins Ziel bringen: Du strukturierst Aufgaben, formulierst klare Abnahmekriterien, koordinierst Abhängigkeiten und machst Fortschritt und offene Fragen sichtbar.

  • Zusammenarbeit erleichtern: Du moderierst agile Abstimmungen, etwa aus Scrum oder Kanban, und hilfst, Hindernisse zu beseitigen. Gemeinsam mit Chris und dem Team entwickelst du Abläufe weiter, die zu uns passen.

  • KI praktisch nutzen: Du setzt KI-gestützte Werkzeuge für Testideen, Fehleranalyse, kleine Hilfsprogramme und Automatisierung ein und überprüfst die Ergebnisse sorgfältig.

Deine Rolle als Scrum Master

Du verbindest deine technische Arbeit mit der Verantwortung dafür, dass unsere Projekte gemeinsam vorankommen. Als Scrum Master koordinierst du die Zusammenarbeit im Softwareteam und mit externen Entwicklungsagenturen. Du arbeitest eng mit CTO Christopher Klabunde zusammen; disziplinarische Personalführung gehört nicht zur Rolle.

  • Du bringst interne Entwicklung und externe Partner in eine gemeinsame Planung und sorgst für klare Zuständigkeiten, nächste Schritte und nachvollziehbare Abnahmekriterien.

  • Du bereitest agile Abstimmungen vor und moderierst sie, zum Beispiel Sprint Planning, kurze tägliche Abstimmungen, Reviews und Retrospektiven – passend zu unseren Projekten.

  • Du behältst Abhängigkeiten, Termine und offene Entscheidungen im Blick, sprichst Hindernisse früh an und hilfst dem Team, sie zu lösen.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Ergebnisse zusammengeführt, gemeinsam getestet und für einen verlässlichen Release vorbereitet werden.

Wenn du bereits Scrum-Master- oder Projektkoordinationserfahrung hast, kannst du sie direkt einbringen. Wenn du neu in der Rolle bist, wachsen wir mit dir hinein: Chris und das Team unterstützen dich dabei. Eine Scrum-Master-Zertifizierung ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Das bringst du mit

  • Interesse an Softwaretests, Qualitätssicherung und technischen Projekten. Erste Erfahrung ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung – auch ein eigener Lernweg oder die Motivation, dich neu in das Thema einzuarbeiten, interessieren uns.

  • Freude daran, genau hinzuschauen und Probleme systematisch zu lösen. Du kannst verständlich erklären, was nicht funktioniert und wie es sich nachstellen lässt.

  • Technisches Verständnis für das Zusammenspiel von App, Gerät und Backend sowie Lust, dich tiefer einzuarbeiten.

  • Eigeninitiative und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise. Du fragst nach, hältst offene Punkte nach und übernimmst Verantwortung für Ergebnisse.

  • Offenheit für KI-unterstützte Entwicklung und Tests. Wenn du damit schon selbst experimentiert hast, zeig uns gern ein Beispiel.

  • Gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift ist erforderlich, um technische Themen im Team sicher zu besprechen und zu dokumentieren. Deutschkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

  • Bereitschaft, regelmäßig vor Ort in Königs Wusterhausen zu arbeiten: Viele Tests finden direkt am Rudergerät statt.

Ein Studium der Informatik oder einer verwandten Fachrichtung, eine passende Ausbildung oder vergleichbare Kenntnisse sind eine gute Grundlage.

Mit Erfahrung oder am Anfang: Wir wollen dich kennenlernen

Du hast schon mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in diesem Bereich? Super – bring deine Ideen und deinen Blick von außen ein. Du stehst noch am Anfang oder hast bisher keine Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich? Auch das ist in Ordnung. Wenn du für unser Produkt brennst, technische Grundlagen mitbringst und dich schnell in neue Themen einarbeitest, möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

In beiden Fällen ist es unsere Aufgabe, dich gut ins Team zu integrieren und dir Wissen, Werkzeuge und Unterstützung für einen erfolgreichen Start bereitzustellen. Gemeinsam mit Chris und dem Team lernst du unser Produkt und unsere Abläufe kennen. Aufgaben und Verantwortung stimmen wir auf deinen Erfahrungsstand ab und entwickeln sie mit dir weiter.

Zusätzliche Pluspunkte

  • Erfahrung mit Android-Entwicklung, zum Beispiel mit Kotlin oder Java.

  • Erfahrung mit Firebase als Backend für Apps und dem Zusammenspiel von App, Benutzerkonten und gespeicherten Daten.

  • Erfahrung in der iOS-Entwicklung, idealerweise mit Swift oder SwiftUI.

  • Erste Kenntnisse in Testautomatisierung, Git, CI/CD oder agiler Projektarbeit. Eine Scrum-Master-Zertifizierung ist nicht erforderlich.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Ein eigenes Produkt, das du anfassen und ausprobieren kannst, und viele Ideen, die wir gemeinsam in hoher Qualität umsetzen wollen.

  • Ein Team von rund 25 Mitarbeitenden, kurze Entscheidungswege und direkte Zusammenarbeit mit CTO Christopher Klabunde.

  • Raum, fachlich zu wachsen und zunehmend Verantwortung für Qualität, Tests und Projektabläufe zu übernehmen.

  • Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle mit 40 Stunden pro Woche und 28 Urlaubstagen im Jahr.

  • 50.000 bis 65.000 € brutto pro Jahr, abhängig von deinen relevanten Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen.

  • Arbeitsplatz Zur Heide 10 in Königs Wusterhausen bei Berlin. Ein bis zwei Tage Homeoffice pro Woche sind nach Absprache möglich.

Dein Arbeitsplatz bei Berlin

Unser Standort ist Zur Heide 10 in Königs Wusterhausen. Der Bahnhof Königs Wusterhausen ist mit der S-Bahn S46 und Regionalzügen direkt an Berlin angebunden. Die Strecke vom Bahnhof zu uns lässt sich mit dem Fahrrad zurücklegen. Vor Ort entwickelst und testest du direkt am Produkt; ein bis zwei Tage Homeoffice pro Woche sind nach Absprache möglich.

Einfach bewerben

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf auf Deutsch oder Englisch. Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Ein Beispielprojekt oder ein Testkonzept ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Zum Einstieg lernen wir uns in einem kurzen Onlinegespräch kennen. Danach schauen wir gemeinsam auf deine bisherigen Erfahrungen, deinen Lernweg und die Aufgaben bei AUGLETICS.

English-speaking applicants are welcome. English is required; German is a strong plus. The role focuses on hands-on software testing and quality assurance, with growing responsibility for project coordination. Based in Königs Wusterhausen near Berlin, with one to two home-office days per week by agreement.

title: Solution Architect - 8295
descriptionHtml:
Solution Architect

Permanent | Hybrid | North West, Frimley, Yeovil or Filton | Cloud, Infrastructure & Enterprise Architecture | SC cleared

As a Solution Architect, you will be responsible for defining, governing and assuring end-to-end technology solutions that support both business and programme objectives. Working closely with programme teams, engineering functions, suppliers and senior stakeholders, you will ensure solutions are secure, scalable, supportable and aligned to architectural standards and strategic roadmaps.

This role requires a broad, multi-disciplinary architecture background, with the ability to work across multiple technology domains rather than specialising in a single area. You'll provide architectural leadership across cloud, infrastructure, workplace technologies, networking and security, helping to shape both current delivery and future technology direction.

Responsibilities:

  • Report to the System Design Authority and support architectural governance activities.
  • Define solution architectures and technical designs that meet business requirements within agreed cost, time and technical constraints.
  • Support the development and evolution of technology standards, strategies and roadmaps across workplace and enterprise technology portfolios.
  • Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to programme and engineering teams throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Work closely with internal and external technology suppliers, ensuring technical governance and delivery expectations are met.
  • Ensure security principles are embedded into solution designs and support ongoing security improvement and remediation activities.
  • Maintain knowledge of current technologies, industry trends and emerging architectural practices to inform future business strategy.
  • Collaborate with the wider architecture community to promote consistency, best practice and architectural integrity across programmes.

Skills & Experience:

  • Experience designing and delivering solutions within modern hybrid cloud environments.
  • Strong knowledge of hosting and workplace technologies, including Microsoft 365, Azure and AWS.
  • Experience delivering cyber-secure solutions and applying secure-by-design principles.
  • Proven experience in systems engineering, network design and technology delivery.
  • Strong understanding of recognised architecture frameworks such as TOGAF, MODAF or Zachman.
  • Experience operating across multiple technology domains, including cloud, infrastructure, networking, workplace technologies and security.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills, with the ability to engage audiences ranging from engineering teams to senior leadership.

Desirable Skills

  • TOGAF certification or willingness to work towards accreditation.
  • Understanding of Agile and Scrum delivery methodologies.
  • Awareness of industry standards such as ISO9001 and ISO20000.
  • Experience supporting accreditation and assurance activities within regulated environments.
  • Experience working across multiple government security classifications.
  • Defence, government or other highly regulated industry experience.
  • Security architecture, cyber security or security remediation experience would be particularly advantageous.

We're seeking a versatile architect who can comfortably operate across a broad technology landscape. The ideal candidate will combine strong technical expertise with excellent communication skills, enabling them to translate complex concepts into practical solutions and influence stakeholders at all levels.

Given the volume of security remediation and improvement activity within the portfolio, candidates with strong security-focused architecture experience will be particularly valuable. Equally important is the ability to balance strategic thinking with pragmatic delivery, ensuring solutions remain aligned to business objectives, architectural standards and operational needs.

About Peregrine

We build workforces that deliver tech and change programmes at leading UK organisations. By combining data science from Peregrine Intelligence, our industry-accredited Peregrine Academy, and market-leading attraction and diversity initiatives, we bridge capability gaps at all levels in public and private sector organisations. We work closely with our clients to understand their challenges and deliver flexible, long-term solutions that make a real difference. When you join Peregrine, you become part of a team that’s focused on growth, both yours, our clients’, and the sectors we support. You’ll also get access to a full range of benefits alongside your salary.

How Specialist Talent Works

As a permanent employee at Peregrine, you’ll be part of our Specialist Talent team. That means you’ll work on-site or remotely with our clients, supporting them on complex, high-impact projects in Data, Digital and Business Transformation. You’ll get the variety and challenge of consultancy work, with the stability and support of a permanent role. You’re not a contractor - you’re a valued member of our team, with access to all the same benefits, learning opportunities, and community.

Our Culture

We’re curious, open, and always learning. We believe in doing great work and doing it with integrity. We support each other, share ideas freely, and celebrate progress big and small. And we care about the impact we make, whether that’s helping clients solve tough problems or creating opportunities for people from all walks of life.

Diversity and Inclusion

We’re proud to be a diverse team, with 20+ nationalities represented across Peregrine. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences, and we’re committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. Through our partnerships and internal initiatives, we’re working to improve social mobility, reduce our environmental impact, and help our clients build more inclusive teams too.

title: Solution Architect AI-Modernisation - CDI Paris - Theodo
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Aujourd’hui, l’ambition du groupe est de se positionner comme le leader de l’IA appliquée au développement logiciel, c’est pourquoi nous avons lancé la practice AI Modernisation. Au sein de cette practice, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la modernisation de leurs systèmes legacy. Grâce à une IA maîtrisée et une méthode éprouvée, nous allons 3 fois plus vite sur le delivery de ces projets critiques.
La practice accompagne principalement des scale-ups comme Qonto ou Doctolib et des grands groupes comme Carrefour, Pernod Ricard, Les Mousquetaires, Urgo, Cdiscount ou Edenred. Si tu veux rejoindre le futur de la tech, tu es au bon endroit !

Ton équipe :

  • Ton manager : Quentin Pleplé, CTO de la practice AI Modernisation
  • Ton binôme au quotidien : les Business Developers AI Mod sur les cycles de vente
  • L'équipe AI Modernisation (50 personnes : sales, tech leads, software engineers, experts AI coding) et les autres équipes sales du groupe sur les ventes complexes, les offsites et les dojos
  • Tu es le premier Solution Architect dédié à la practice : tu participes activement à structurer le rôle, les frameworks d'estimation et les méthodes de prototypage

Si tu veux rejoindre le futur de la tech, tu es au bon endroit.

Tes futures missions

En tant que Solution Architect AI Modernisation, tu es le binôme technique des sales sur les cycles de vente complexes. Ta mission : concevoir des stratégies de migration ingénieuses qui rassurent autant la DSI que les métiers, et gagner les deals grâce à ta légitimité technique et ta posture de partenaire stratégique.

Qualification technique et relation avec les référents client

  • Qualifier techniquement les leads entrants : volume de code, dépendances, contraintes de conformité, maturité IA interne du client
  • Mener les échanges avec les DSI, RSSI, CTO et architectes en créant de la confiance par ta compétence et ton assertivité
  • Identifier les préférences client structurantes : sécurité, performance, stack cible, contraintes sur l'existant, LLM autorisés (Claude Code, modèles on-prem…)

Conception de la solution technique

  • Concevoir une stratégie de migration ingénieuse : trajectoire incrémentale (strangler pattern, isolation du risque), choix de la stack cible, intégration des outils d'AI coding pour accélérer la compréhension du code et la transpilation
  • Produire les livrables différenciants : schémas d'architecture, ADR, POC à montrer au prospect pour closer
  • Faire de la veille sur les patterns de modernisation, les LLM et les outils d'AI coding à l'état de l'art

Estimation et défense de la proposition

  • Estimer en fonction de la complexité technique et du budget client, en identifiant les zones de risque et de complexité
  • Soutenir la proposition face à un client métier et une DSI exigeante, en justifiant la valeur par le coût de l'inaction, le time-to-market et la sécurisation du CA

Passage en delivery

  • Aider l'équipe commerciale à prévoir le delivery en définissant les équipes à staffer
  • Assurer la passation aux équipes de delivery au démarrage des projets et le SAV technique

Quelques exemples de projets sur lesquels tu pourrais intervenir :

  • HealthHero : leader européen de la télémédecine, qui souhaite moderniser sa plateforme française Qare en vue d'une fusion avec la plateforme UK. Migration de Loopback2 vers Nest pour upgrade de Node 10 vers Node 20. Grâce à notre méthode accélérée par l'IA, nous passons d'une estimation à 70 semaines sans IA à une migration terminée en 21 semaines, et nous accélérons la vitesse de delivery par 3.
  • Pernod Ricard : modernisation d'une application interne de gestion de campagnes marketing avec des millions d'euros en jeu. En 23 semaines, migration complète de Vue/Express vers React/Nest avec une réécriture pragmatique, et connexion à leur nouvel ERP, auparavant impossible sans la migration.

Tes perspectives d'évolution

L'AI coding est en train de tout changer dans la façon de construire du logiciel. Le rôle de SA AI Mod est un bon tremplin pour y aller : un Partner te co-opte quand tu as prouvé que tu peux porter une offre et embarquer le Groupe avec toi.

Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu :

Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits.

Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients.

title: Solution Architect - CDI Paris - Theodo Data & IA
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Créée en 2016, Theodo Data & AI est l'entité Data et IA de Theodo. Notre ambition est d'accompagner nos clients dans la conception et le déploiement de leur stratégie data ainsi que la recherche et le développement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle à l’état de l’art. L'entreprise est en pleine croissance : chaque année, Theodo Data & AI enregistre une croissance de plus de 30 % de son chiffre d'affaires, ouvrant ainsi de nouvelles opportunités passionnantes pour les Theodoers !

Tes missions

Tu es l'architecte de la stratégie technique de nos deals Data & IA. Tu prends le lead technique des ventes de bout en bout, de la qualification du lead entrant jusqu'à la passation aux équipes de delivery. Concrètement, tu vas :

  • Qualifier techniquement les leads entrants : recueillir les exigences fonctionnelles et non fonctionnelles, identifier les préférences et contraintes du client (sécurité, performance, stack, existant) et orienter la stratégie du projet.
  • Auditer l'existant : analyser les architectures data/IA, les modèles de données, les sources et les usages en place, puis proposer une trajectoire technique crédible.
  • Concevoir la solution : définir une architecture ingénieuse et adaptée aux critères de performance du produit, en t'appuyant sur les technos classiques comme sur l'état de l'art, et en mobilisant les bons experts (dans le groupe ou à l'extérieur). Livrables : schémas d'architecture, ADR.
  • Chiffrer et construire la stratégie de réponse : estimer en fonction de la complexité technique et du budget client, construire le deck avec le Sales, et soutenir la proposition face à un métier, une DSI ou une direction data exigeante.
  • Anticiper les risques : sécuriser la faisabilité technique et la conformité des solutions vendues, et vendre de la qualité pour mettre les équipes dans les bonnes conditions.
  • Préparer le delivery : définir les équipes à staffer avec l'équipe commerciale, puis assurer la passation au kickoff pour aligner les équipes delivery sur la stratégie définie.
  • Faire de la veille et tirer l'amélioration continue : suivre les évolutions data/IA, évaluer leur pertinence pour nos offres, et capitaliser sur les deals gagnés comme sur les deals perdus.

Les sujets varient beaucoup d'un deal à l'autre : modernisation et migration de plateformes data, mise en production de modèles, plateformes GenAI, architectures agentiques, accélération du delivery par l'IA. C'est précisément cette diversité qui fait la richesse du rôle.

Tes premiers paliers

  • 3 mois : tu shadows un Solution Architect, tu mènes des qualifications en autonomie, tu as closé une première vente en binôme et participé à un cadrage.
  • 6 mois : tu es autonome sur 80 % du process, tu sais andonner au bon moment, et tu es pertinent sur les offres GenAI platform et data platform / data migration.
  • 12 mois : tu vends en autonomie un projet Data & IA, de la qualification à la négociation.

Tes perspectives d'évolution

  • Technique : Architecte senior / référent technique de la practice
  • Business / Influence : Thought Leader (animer une communauté tech) ou Intrapreneur (porter une nouvelle offre)
  • Managériale : Engineering Manager ou VP Tech

Tes moyens pour réussir

  • Accompagnement direct par le leader de la practice Data & IA et les dirigeants du groupe
  • Formations au Lean management par les plus grands coachs Lean
  • Écosystème de 500 expert·e·s tech & produit à mobiliser sur tes deals
  • Plusieurs dojos (sessions de mise en pratique) par semaine : "archi dojo", "projet dojo", etc.

Profil recherché

  • Au moins 5 ans d'expérience, dont un rôle au-delà du développement : Tech Lead, Architecte ou Staff Engineer.
  • Une expérience en société de services / conseil et une vraie aisance en interface client.
  • Basé·e en région parisienne, avec une présence majoritaire au bureau attendue pour ce rôle d'avant-vente.
  • Énorme envie de progresser, curiosité pour le Lean management, et attrait pour un environnement startup qui évolue vite.

Le process de recrutement

  • Call de qualification (30 min) avec un membre de l'équipe recrutement

  • Test d'architecture (1h)

title: Solution Architect Microsoft Dynamics
descriptionHtml:
Rol introductie

Jij hebt het! Dat waar wij niet zonder kunnen en onze klanten beter van worden. Jij bent in staat om in wisselende projectteams het beste uit elk team te halen en onmogelijke problemen om te zetten in mogelijkheden.


Als Solution Architect ben je functioneel verantwoordelijk voor een optimale implementatie van de integrale Dynamics 365 oplossing. Je bent het inhoudelijke geweten van de Project Manager en sparringpartner voor het management van onze klant. De best practices die wij en Microsoft hebben opgebouwd laat je hierbij leidend zijn. Op basis hiervan ben je voorstellend en adviserend naar je klanten. Daarnaast weet je de bedachte applicatie landschap ook overtuigend te presenteren aan de klant.

Wat ga je doen?

Je stelt de roadmap op om de integrale oplossing te implementeren. Je kunt denken vanuit integrale processen waarbij meerdere Microsoft oplossingen betrokken zijn:

  • Vaak ben je ook betrokken en ook verantwoordelijk voor de realisatie /implementatie van de oplossing;
  • Daarnaast geef je input voor de doorontwikkeling van branche oplossingen van HSO;
  • Je signaleert proactief optimalisatiemogelijkheden en adviseer je klanten over nieuwe functies en diensten binnen het Microsoft-ecosysteem die hun bedrijfsresultaten verbeteren;
  • Vaak ben je ook betrokken en ook verantwoordelijk voor de realisatie /implementatie van de oplossing;
  • Je bent de spin in het web tussen klant, je technische en functionele collega’s en de project managers.

Over het team

Je bent onderdeel van de Service Line Unified Operations, een onderdeel van HSO Nederland. Unified Operations is een geoliede projectservices organisatie met een uitstekende reputatie op het gebied van ERP. Samen met de andere Servicelines binnen HSO kunnen we de complete Microsoft Stack aanbieden (Modern Workplace, Analytics, CE, Azure Integrations,  e.d.). Het totale team van onze Service Line bestaat momenteel uit ruim 80 professionals, onder leiding van de Service Line Director Roy Daniels.

Kwalificaties

  • Je hebt een HBO of WO werk- en denkniveau (bij voorkeur afgestudeerd) in bedrijfskunde, informatica, engineering (Industrial of logistics), supply chain management of een vergelijkbare opleiding;
  • Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring met het ontwerpen van applicatie landschappen over verschillende functionele domeinen;
  • Je hebt liefst affiniteit en ervaring met het inhoudelijk aansturen van een team AX/D365 professionals;
  • Je hebt minimaal 6 jaar implementatie en consultancy ervaring met Microsoft Dynamics AX tot aan de laatste D365 versie;
  • Jarenlange ervaring opgedaan in 1 of 2 van de branches Retail, Distribution, Project/Services of Manufacturing. Mede op basis hiervan kun jij klanten overtuigen van onze adviezen en voorstellen. Methodologische affiniteit. Zowel op het gebied van het architectuur (TOGAF kennis) als project implementatie.

Wat bieden we jou?    

Werken bij HSO is uitdagend, we willen je daar graag een goede beloning voor teruggeven. Naast goede primaire voordelen bieden wij:  

  • Een competitief salaris, een jaarlijkse bonus op basis van bedrijfs-, team- en individuele prestaties;  
  • Mobiliteitsvergoeding waarbij je of een auto kunt leasen of het bedrag toe kunt voegen aan je salaris. Daar bovenop krijg 100% betaald van de ov-kosten; 
  • 25 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er 35 van te maken;  
  • Hybride werken, vanuit huis, op kantoor (Rotterdam, Veenendaal) of zelfs tijdens je Workation;  
  • EUR 65,- netto vitaliteitsbudget – we vinden het belangrijk dat we gezond blijven en een veilige werkplek hebben, zowel op kantoor als remote;  
  • Je kunt deelnemen aan het leasefietsplan;  
  • En vooral een leven lang leren. Op dag één start jouw onboardingprogramma, daarnaast krijg je een persoonlijk studiebudget dat je kunt inzetten voor jouw professionele ontwikkeling en ontvang je ook een GoodHabitz account, een online trainingstool voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling.   

Waarom HSO   

HSO is de eerste full-service Microsoft Partner in Nederland. Samen met ruim 2500 getalenteerde medewerkers in Europa, Azië en Noord-Amerika verlenen we ondersteuning op lokaal en internationaal niveau aan industriële bedrijven, retailers, financiële en zakelijke dienstverleners en overheidsinstellingen.  
  

HSO is voortdurend op zoek naar nieuw talent. We blijven onze wereldwijde community uitbreiden en scheppen er plezier in om samen te werken met prestatiegerichte mensen met een ondernemersgeest. Professionals die voortdurend willen leren en innoveren.  

Vrijheid, flexibiliteit en fun  

Je werkt in een internationale omgeving met professionals met verschillende nationaliteiten. Een flexibele werkweek van 40, 36 of 32 uur behoort tot de mogelijkheden omdat wij van mening zijn dat jouw manier van werken bij jouw levensstijl moet passen. HSO heeft professionals in dienst die plezier hebben in hun werk en klaar staan voor elkaar. Om het plezier in ons werk nog groter te maken, organiseren we uiteraard teamuitjes en bedrijfsfeesten, maar ook wekelijkse zomerborrels op ons dakterras, allerlei sportactiviteiten en is er de mogelijkheid bij te dragen aan onze Maatschappelijk Verantwoord Ondernemen-werkzaamheden.

title: Solution Engineer - Vehicle OS
descriptionHtml:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About the role

We are looking for a bright engineer to help our customers solve complex technical problems across Applied Intuition’s Vehicle OS portfolio. In this role you will work closely with vehicle software and tooling teams at OEMs and Tier 1s to ensure Applied’s solutions deliver maximum impact in advancing customers’ Software-Defined-Vehicle (SDV) strategies and in-cabin user experiences.

Vehicle OS is Applied Intuition’s software platform for SDV. It enables OEMs to modernize their E/E architecture through three interconnected areas:

  • Middleware & architecture Service-oriented, middleware-driven software stacks built on AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform, SOME/IP, and DDS. Helps OEMs migrate from distributed ECU architectures to zonal, centralized compute.

  • Developer toolchain A code-first toolchain that replaces GUI-bound configuration workflows. Engineers model vehicle behavior in Python, manage changes through pull requests, and validate in virtual ECU environments analogous to what cloud virtual engineering workbenches (e.g., AWS VEW) brought to cloud-native development, but purpose-built for automotive E/E systems.

  • IVI & in-vehicle infotainment Android Automotive OS (AAOS) based platform, HMI/cluster software, and intelligent in-cabin experiences including Cabin Intelligence (DMS, OMS, voice, occupant interaction).

This role sits at the intersection of all three areas, and the balance will depend on the customer mix.

At Applied Intuition, you will:

  • Act as the technical bridge between automotive customers and Applied Intuition’s engineering and product teams

  • Support OEMs in adopting Vehicle OS: middleware stack, developer SDK, and IVI/infotainment integration

  • Lead technical discussions, architecture reviews, demos, and early-stage deployments with OEM and Tier 1 engineering teams

  • Help customers adopt Applied’s code-first developer toolchain, onboarding engineering teams onto the SDK, setting up virtual ECU environments, and integrating with customers’ existing CI/CD pipelines

  • Guide OEMs through the design and implementation of service-oriented vehicle architectures and support system integration across ECUs, domain controllers and high-performance compute

  • Work with customers’ IVI and infotainment teams on AAOS integration, Linux-based IVI stack deployment, HMI/cluster software, and Cabin Intelligence features (driver monitoring, occupant monitoring, voice/AI interaction)

  • Collaborate with customers and internal product teams to triage and resolve technical issues

  • Manage project milestones and communicate progress across multiple customer and internal stakeholders

We're looking for someone who has:

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

We are looking for a Principal Solutions Architect to join us on a permanent basis. 

Our Commerce & Technology division helps leading global brands design, build and run the commerce platforms behind their growth. We are seeking a Principal Solutions Architect to lead solution in business pursuits and account growth, across enterprise commerce. 

You will be the person in the room who understands how the whole commerce estate fits together, from web storefront and mobile app through commerce platform, data and ERP.   You will turn that understanding into a clear case for business value, win the trust of senior client stakeholders, and when it helps, build a working demonstration to show them what good looks like.

Key Responsibilities 

  • Architect Enterprise Commerce: Design end to end commerce solutions across Adobe Commerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Shopify, HCL and composable (MACH) solutions, spanning web, mobile apps, data and back office systems.  
  • Lead with value: Frame every solution around commercial outcomes, cost and return, so clients can see clear cases for change rather than a technology shopping list.  
  • Serve as an outward-facing, energetic leader who runs workshops, participates in governance, and collaborates with commercial teams to identify and shape technical growth opportunities. 

What you’ll be doing 

  • Client Engagement and Discovery: Build trusted relationships with senior business and technology stakeholders. Run discovery workshops, ask the questions that uncover what really matters, and cut through complexity to the decisions that count. 
  • Solution Design and Architecture: Produce clear architecture diagrams and solution designs covering storefront, mobile apps, commerce platform, search, content, order management, product information, payments, data and other integrations. Recommend the right platform and approach for each client rather than defaulting to one. 
  • Platform Selection and Replatforming: Guide clients through platform choices and migrations, including the move from monolithic to composable, weighing total cost of ownership, speed to market, risk and operating model. 
  • Data, Integration and Back Office: Get into the detail of how commerce connects to ERP (such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or Oracle), order management, warehouse, customer data and analytics, and design integration patterns that hold up at enterprise scale. 
  • Mobile and Omnichannel: Shape mobile app strategy and architecture (native, cross platform and headless) alongside web, store and marketplace channels, so the customer experience is joined up. 
  • Business Case and Value: Build business cases, value models and roadmaps that link technology decisions to revenue, conversion, margin and cost to serve. 
  • Demonstrations and Proofs of Concept: Stand up demo storefronts and prototypes quickly, such as a Shopify store or a composable proof of concept, to show clients what is possible and take risk out of their decisions. 
  • Proposals and Pitches: Own the solution story, architecture, assumptions and effort estimates in proposals, and present them with confidence at pitch. 
  • Handover and Delivery Assurance: Make sure what is sold can be delivered, with a clean handover to delivery teams and continued involvement through mobilisation. 
  • Market and Partner Leadership: Stay across the commerce market, including cloud (AWS, GCP), AI in commerce and agentic commerce. Share that knowledge to strengthen our propositions and our partner relationships.

title: Solutions Architect - Post Sales
descriptionHtml:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the team

The Customer and Consulting team sits at the heart of how hx delivers lasting value to its clients. As hx continues to expand across global carriers, reinsurers, and specialist MGAs, this team ensures that customers don't just adopt the platform, they transform the way they price and underwrite risk. The post-sale Solution Architect is a critical part of that mission, responsible for making sure the hx platform is deeply embedded in customer ecosystems, from reporting pipelines to security infrastructure and third-party integrations.

This is a team that operates at the intersection of technical depth and customer partnership. The work is hands-on and high-stakes: translating complex customer environments into durable, scalable technical solutions, while building the kind of trusted relationships that drive adoption, margin, and long-term value. You will work closely with Customer Success and Delivery colleagues, acting as the technical anchor across multi-threaded customer engagements.

The team is growing, and there is real scope to shape how the Solution Architect function scales. Whether you are designing AI-first delivery artefacts, contributing reusable patterns to a shared toolkit, or presenting architecture decisions to a Chief Information Officer, your work will directly influence the outcomes customers achieve, and the reputation hx builds in the market.

Check out our Client Services Candidate Hub for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining!

What you'll be doing

  • Own the technical relationship with a portfolio of strategic customers, becoming the trusted advisor who anticipates challenges, aligns delivery to outcomes, and ensures the hx platform is embedded confidently within each customer's ecosystem.

  • Design and deliver bespoke integrations between hx and a range of customer technologies, including policy administration systems, data warehouses, BI tooling, and identity providers, applying sound architectural judgement throughout.

  • Drive customer adoption and platform usage by developing structured value realisation plans that translate technical delivery into measurable business outcomes, including faster quote turnarounds, reduced pricing errors, and stronger MI capability.

  • Build AI-first consulting and delivery artefacts that raise the bar for how the team works, creating reusable frameworks, templates, and innovation outputs that can be shared across the broader SA toolkit.

  • Support project margin outcomes by managing delivery scope, surfacing risks early, and coordinating effectively with Customer Success Managers, Delivery Leads, and customer-side technical teams.

  • Contribute to team capability by sharing patterns, leading internal show-and-tell sessions, and helping to codify best practices as the Solution Architect function grows and scales.

What you'll need to have done

  • Able to code to a high standard using Python.

  • Supported the technical delivery of SaaS platform integrations in a team setting. It’s beneficial if you also have experience with AWS architecture, SQL, and a foundational understanding from a computer science or software development background.

  • Built and maintained positive technical relationships with colleagues and stakeholders, including IT and data teams, by communicating effectively across different priorities and environments.

  • Helped communicate technical choices and delivery progress to non-technical stakeholders, using clear, outcome-driven explanations that link integration work to business value.

  • Gained experience in a post-sale or customer-facing technical role—such as Junior Solution Architect, Technical Support, or Implementation Analyst—where you supported the delivery process or customer needs.

  • Used AI or automation tools to enhance the quality, speed, or consistency of your work, with an understanding of where these technologies can add value.

  • Supported the management of delivery processes, such as helping to plan project phases, identify risks, or coordinate with internal or external teams to meet project timelines.

You're unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer to stay in a narrow technical lane and hand off customer communication to others; this role requires genuine ownership across both the technical design and the stakeholder relationship.

  • You need a fully defined brief before getting started; ambiguity is a constant here, and the best work comes from people who move confidently without waiting for perfect information.

  • You measure success by delivery completion rather than customer outcomes; at hx, adoption, margin, and measurable value are the real bar.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  1. Talent Screen - 30 minutes

  2. Hiring Manager interview - 60 minutes

  3. Skills Assessment - 60 minutes

  4. Values interview - 60 minutes

  5. Meet the CEO

  6. We offer!

Our commitment to Diversity

hxer's are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

title: Solutions Consultant, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About Firstwork

Labour markets are broken. Millions of people are ready to work and can't start. Screening, right-to-work checks, contracts, onboarding and scheduling still run across disconnected systems, with hundreds of manual decisions in between. Firstwork builds AI agents that run frontline workforce operations end to end. We activate hundreds of thousands of workers a month globally for some of the world's largest employers and staffing firms, working forward-deployed inside the customer's operation. Backed by Y Combinator and Gradient (Google’s AI fund), with offices in New York, with London and Dubai opening later this year.

Why this role

Our deals are won and lost in the technical room. By the time an enterprise customer is taking us seriously, the conversation has moved on to their document types, their screening vendors, their ATS, their audit requirements and the precise reason onboarding currently takes them eleven days. Someone has to sit in that room, understand how the operation really runs, and design something that survives procurement, security review and technical validation.

The product is configured to each customer's operational reality, so this is genuine solution design. What you produce goes to our forward-deployed engineers, and it has to be accurate enough for them to build against. You are the first Solutions Consultant in Europe, which means you set how we run discovery, demos, and implementation planning across the region.

What you'll do

  • Discovery with operations, compliance and IT stakeholders

  • Customer workshops on site, across Europe

  • Demonstrations built for the specific customer in the room

  • Solution design and technical qualification

  • Scoping, running and evaluating proofs of concept

  • Support through security and compliance review

  • Implementation planning, and the handover to delivery

  • Structured product feedback back into engineering

What we're looking for

  • Four or more years in solutions consulting, sales engineering, or a forward-deployed or implementation role

  • Time at Rippling, Deel, Workday, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Bullhorn, UKG, Fountain, or somewhere with comparable enterprise complexity

  • Enough understanding of HR, workforce or compliance operations to push back on a customer's assumptions

  • Technical credibility on APIs, integrations, data models and security questionnaires

  • Clear writing. Vague scoping documents turn into implementation problems six months later

  • A habit of prototyping during the workshop instead of after it, and turning notes into structured requirements the same day

  • Fluency in how agents behave. Where they work, where they need a human to review, and what our system does when it isn't sure

If you would rather design the solution than demo it, come and talk to us.

title: Solutions Engineer - Sr.
descriptionHtml:
About OpenTable: 

With millions of diners,70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion.

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About the Job

We are seeking an experienced Senior Solutions Engineer to lead complex API integrations and high-impact technical engagements across our partner and restaurant ecosystem. This role independently owns sophisticated implementations, partners cross-functionally to drive successful outcomes, and helps establish strong technical and operational standards across Solutions Engineering.

The ideal candidate brings deep experience with APIs and system integrations, thrives in ambiguous and technically complex environments, and can confidently drive initiatives from technical discovery through implementation and launch. They use strong technical judgment to navigate tradeoffs, proactively identify risks and dependencies, and influence scalable improvements across our integrations and developer experience.

Responsibilities

  • Lead complex API integrations and technical initiatives from discovery and solution design through implementation and launch.
  • Independently own complex, quarter-length technical projects and high-impact partner implementations, establishing clear milestones, dependencies, and delivery expectations.
  • Serve as the primary technical advisor for sophisticated partners, restaurant groups, and strategic initiatives.
  • Translate business and partner requirements into clear technical approaches, balancing implementation complexity, scalability, reliability, and partner needs.
  • Diagnose and resolve sophisticated API and integration challenges using logs, API requests and responses, authentication flows, and system behavior.
  • Navigate ambiguous technical problems by identifying assumptions, evaluating tradeoffs, and driving decisions toward resolution.
  • Proactively identify technical risks, dependencies, and implementation gaps and partner with stakeholders to develop mitigation plans.
  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to clarify scope, investigate technical challenges, and identify appropriate short and long-term solutions.
  • Communicate changes to delivery expectations, blockers, and technical risks early and clearly.
  • Act as an escalation point for complex technical issues and implementations.
  • Build and maintain deep expertise across our off-the-shelf APIs, integrations, and broader technical ecosystem.
  • Ensure Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and implementation commitments are met while balancing multiple high-priority initiatives.
  • Partner with Security teams to ensure integrations follow established security and compliance standards and proactively identify potential risks.
  • Work closely with Sales, Partnerships, Support, Product, and Engineering teams to connect technical decisions and tradeoffs to business outcomes.
  • Develop scalable troubleshooting approaches, implementation patterns, and technical guardrails that improve consistency and quality.
  • Partner with Engineering domain owners during complex incidents and technical investigations, using available logs and observability tools to drive resolution and identify opportunities to prevent recurring issues.
  • Develop scalable troubleshooting guides, implementation playbooks, and technical resources that improve partner self-service.
  • Identify and raise product improvement opportunities based on technical patterns, implementation challenges, and partner feedback.

Minimum Qualifications

  • You have significant experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Technical Consulting, Integration Engineering, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
  • You have deep experience working with REST APIs, JSON payloads, authentication methods, webhooks, and system integrations.
  • You are experienced in reviewing logs, debugging API requests and responses, and diagnosing complex integration issues.
  • You have successfully led complex technical implementations from discovery through production launch.
  • You are comfortable owning complex, quarter-length initiatives and driving work forward across multiple stakeholders.
  • You can navigate ambiguity, proactively identify risks and dependencies, and drive technical decisions toward resolution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • You have excellent communication skills and can translate complex technical concepts and tradeoffs for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • You have experience partnering with Engineering and Product teams to investigate technical challenges and deliver scalable solutions.
  • You can balance multiple complex projects and priorities in a fast-paced, global environment.
  • You demonstrate strong technical judgment and know when to independently drive a solution and when to engage additional expertise.
  • You contribute technical knowledge and expertise in ways that improve the effectiveness of those around you.
  • Experience in restaurant technology, hospitality technology, SaaS platforms, or system integrations is a plus.

Benefits and Perks

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
  • Generous paid parental leave, vacation & time off for your birthday
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Focus on mental health and well-being:
    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
    • Company-paid subscription to Headspace
    • Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
  • Paid volunteer time
  • Focus on your career growth:
    • Development Dollars
    • Leadership development
    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
  • Travel Discounts inc. Bike2Work, Season ticket loan
  • Employee Resource Groups
  • Income protection and life assurance
  • Employee Assistance Program - including 24/7 GP & free legal advice
  • Pension plan contributions
  • Discounted gym membership
  • Social events & Thursday happy hours
  • Free lunch 2 days per week

The best connections happen face-to-face, whether you’re sitting down to dinner or having coffee with a coworker. That’s why OpenTable has adopted a hybrid workplace model. This role aligns with that approach, with an expectation of coming into the office two days a week—giving employees the best of both worlds: in-person collaboration and flexibility.

Work Environment & Flexibility

At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. As a team member with us, you will benefit from a schedule tailored to accommodate a global workforce operating across multiple time zones. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. OpenTable will always abide by and consider local laws and regulations.

Inclusion

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. We know the best ideas come when we bring different voices to the table, so we're building a team as dynamic as the diners and restaurants we serve—and fostering a culture where everyone feels welcome to be themselves.

title: Southern Europe B2B Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes directly to our mission of responsible and widespread AI adoption.

The EMEA B2B Marketing team translates global priorities into regionally relevant programs that drive awareness, consideration, pipeline, adoption, and long-term customer trust. We partner closely with Sales and GTM, Product Marketing, Field and Executive Marketing, Content, Customer Marketing, Partner Marketing, Comms, Events, Marketing Operations, and regional leadership.

France will be the primary focus within the Southern Europe remit. Our opportunity spans major enterprises and digital natives, ambitious startups, developers, partners, and a highly influential business community navigating the adoption of AI.

About the Role

As Southern Europe B2B Marketing Manager, you will own the integrated B2B marketing strategy and execution for Southern Europe, with France as the primary focus.

You will be a close commercial partner to local Sales and GTM leadership, translating market insight, revenue priorities, target-account needs, and global launches into locally relevant programs that create pipeline, accelerate complex opportunities, deepen customer relationships, and grow adoption.

You will carry clear pipeline goals and be accountable for Marketing’s measurable contribution to commercial outcomes in Southern Europe. These goals will be established through the regional planning process and will evolve with the priorities and maturity of the market. You will be expected to understand the pipeline, make informed investment decisions, and demonstrate how marketing activity creates, influences, or accelerates revenue opportunities.

This is a generalist role spanning field and executive marketing, demand generation, account-based programs, content, customer marketing, partnerships, events, and product launches. You will bring these channels together into a focused Southern Europe B2B plan, drawing on specialist capabilities within the EMEA B2B Marketing team in London and global Marketing teams. A particularly important partnership will be with the local Consumer Marketing leads: together, you will align market strategy, narratives, launches, audience priorities, channels, and major moments so B2B and B2C activity is coordinated, complementary, and mutually reinforcing.

Close partnership with Marketing Operations will be crucial. Together, you will establish campaign infrastructure, audience and account segmentation, attribution, reporting, and operating rhythms that give Sales and Marketing a reliable view of performance and inform where the team should invest next.

The role requires someone who can move comfortably between strategy and execution: shaping the market plan, participating in pipeline reviews, developing a priority-account program, adapting a global campaign, briefing an agency, supporting an executive event, and personally unblocking delivery when needed.

Regular travel across Southern Europe, with France as the primary focus, and to London will be required.

In this role, you will:

  • Own and execute the integrated Southern Europe B2B marketing plan, aligned with regional priorities, local revenue goals, market opportunities, and customer needs. Partner closely with the local Consumer Marketing leads to ensure B2B and B2C strategies and activities are coordinated and complementary, while retaining clear accountability for B2B pipeline and revenue outcomes.

  • Carry pipeline goals for Southern Europe B2B marketing and be accountable for demonstrating measurable contribution to pipeline creation, influence, opportunity progression, and revenue outcomes.

  • Partner closely with Southern Europe Sales and GTM leadership on territory planning, target-account prioritisation, pipeline goals, strategic opportunities, and quarterly business reviews.

  • Build full-funnel programs across field and executive marketing, demand generation, account-based marketing, content, customer advocacy, partnerships, events, and digital channels.

  • Design programs around priority accounts and buying groups, tailoring narratives and engagement for senior decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—and connecting customer proof, partner participation, content, and seller follow-up to create or advance opportunities.

  • Work in close partnership with Marketing Operations to define target audiences, establish campaigns, maintain data and process quality, track performance, improve attribution, and turn results into clear recommendations.

  • Build a regular Sales, Marketing, and Marketing Operations pacing rhythm covering pipeline performance, account engagement, campaign conversion, opportunity follow-up, risks, and investment decisions.

  • Translate global campaigns, product launches, narratives, and assets into locally relevant programs that reflect Southern Europe market dynamics, language, industry priorities, and customer expectations.

  • Work with EMEA specialist teams in London to bring the strongest regional capabilities into the market, while serving as the voice of Southern Europe in regional planning and prioritisation.

  • Develop locally relevant customer stories and advocacy opportunities in partnership with Sales, Customer Success, Customer Marketing, Comms, and senior customer stakeholders.

  • Build joint programs with strategic technology, consulting, and implementation partners where they can extend reach, strengthen customer value, or contribute to pipeline.

  • Own the operating rhythm for Southern Europe B2B marketing, including planning, budget management, agency coordination, campaign pacing, performance reporting, and prioritisation.

  • Build repeatable playbooks and share market learning across EMEA, helping the wider organisation understand what resonates with Southern Europe customers and decision-makers.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 12+ years of experience in integrated B2B, regional, field, demand generation, or account-based marketing, ideally in enterprise technology, cloud, AI, or SaaS.

  • Have a proven track record of driving measurable pipeline and revenue impact through integrated B2B marketing programs, ideally within large, complex enterprise sales cycles.

  • Have supported high-value products with long sales cycles, multiple decision-makers, and significant commercial scrutiny, and are familiar with engaging senior decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—throughout complex buying journeys.

  • Have held pipeline goals or comparable commercial targets and can clearly demonstrate how your marketing decisions created, influenced, or accelerated revenue opportunities.

  • Have partnered closely with enterprise sellers and Sales leadership on account prioritisation, pipeline reviews, opportunity acceleration, executive engagement, and follow-up.

  • Have worked closely with Marketing Operations on campaign architecture, segmentation, lead and account processes, measurement, attribution, and performance reporting.

  • Are comfortable using pipeline and campaign data to diagnose performance, make trade-offs, and redirect investment—not simply report activity.

  • Are a marketing generalist with experience connecting multiple channels into one coherent market plan, rather than operating within a single specialist discipline, and have a strong track record of partnering with consumer marketing leaders to integrate B2B and B2C strategy and activity without blurring ownership.

  • Understand French enterprise buying dynamics and can translate local customer, industry, cultural, and regulatory context into stronger marketing decisions.

  • Can balance local market needs with regional and global priorities, influencing effectively within a matrixed international organisation.

  • Are both strategic and hands-on: able to establish direction and operating structure while personally driving high-priority work to completion.

  • Bring strong commercial judgement, operational discipline, and the ability to make clear prioritisation decisions when opportunities exceed available capacity.

  • Communicate credibly with senior customer decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—as well as Sales, Marketing, and partner stakeholders.

  • Are fluent in French and English.

  • Are energised by AI and motivated to help organisations across Southern Europe adopt transformative technology responsibly.

title: Spécialiste Support Comptable (Télétravail complet possible depuis Amiens)

En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière.

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.

- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.
