title: Stage Public Affairs Burson Nederland
descriptionHtml:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Stage Public Affairs bij Burson

Wil jij ervaring opdoen op het snijvlak van politiek, media, bestuur en bedrijfsleven?

Burson staat voor strategie en communicatie, met adviseurs die door opdrachtgevers worden ingeschakeld als het er echt om gaat. Met ons ervaren team van specialisten opereren we op hoog strategisch niveau en helpen we bedrijven en organisaties door de meest complexe situaties: van het versterken of beschermen van reputaties tot het inspelen op veranderende wetgeving, het agenderen van politieke thema’s, het begeleiden van fusies en overnames, productintroducties of crisiscommunicatie. We zijn onderdeel van Burson Group, een internationaal communicatiebureau bestaande uit een groot netwerk met meer dan 95 kantoren in ruim 40 landen. Samen maken wij onderdeel uit van WPP: het grootste marketing- en communicatiebedrijf ter wereld. Sinds 2019 zijn wij onder één dak gevestigd op onze Amsteldok-campus in Amsterdam. Daarnaast hebben wij in Nederland ook een kantoor in Den Haag.

Public Affairs bij Burson is veel meer dan lobbyen op het Binnenhof. In de huidige mediacratie wordt beleid steeds vaker beïnvloed door publieke opinie en politieke sentimenten. Hierdoor verschuift de macht: niet alleen overheid en markt bepalen de agenda, maar ook de samenleving zelf.  Onze adviseurs helpen organisaties om in te spelen op deze dynamiek: maatschappelijke trends signaleren, draagvlak creëren bij uiteenlopende stakeholders, en strategieën ontwikkelen die zowel politiek als publiek overtuigen.

Als geïntegreerd communicatieadviesbureau weten wij hoe we Public Affairs versterken met slimme PR en gerichte communicatie, zodat we de juiste doelgroep bereiken, op het juiste moment, via het juiste kanaal, met de juiste boodschap. Daardoor richten ons op het beïnvloeden van relevante stakeholders via een breed scala aan kanalen.

Burson stelt jaarlijks per 1 februari en 1 september een Public Affairs stage beschikbaar aan een talentvolle student.

Wat ga je doen?

Als stagiair Public Affairs werk je mee aan diverse projecten en ondersteun je onze adviseurs. Je maakt kennis met veel aspecten van het werk binnen een Public Affairs kantoor en krijgt een uniek kijkje achter de schermen van de politieke arena. Je leert hoe organisaties hun belangen behartigen richting politiek, overheid en media. Kortom: een veelzijdige stage op het raakvlak van politiek, bestuur, media en bedrijfsleven.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Monitoren van nieuws en politiek:dagelijks kranten, vakbladen en opinietijdschriften scannen op relevant nieuws voor onze klanten.
  • Volgen van parlementaire agenda’s:bijhouden van vergaderingen en debatten in de Tweede en Eerste Kamer, relevante Kamerstukken signaleren en samenvatten.
  • Verslaglegging: live en achteraf rapporteren over politieke debatten en griffieverslagen verzamelen.
  • Research en analyse: informatie verzamelen via databanken en analyses maken voor onze adviseurs.
  • Stakeholdermapping: relevante politieke en ambtelijke contacten in kaart brengen en up-to-date houden.
  • Ondersteuning bij diverse klantprojecten: bijdragen aan presentaties, pitches en strategische adviezen.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je volgt een HBO- of universitaire opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Politicologie, Bestuurskunde, Geschiedenis, Europese Studies of Internationale Betrekkingen (en staat ingeschreven tijdens de stageperiode).
  • Je hebt een grote interesse in en kennis van de Nederlandse politiek en maatschappelijke vraagstukken.
  • Je bent proactief, nieuwsgierig en analytisch sterk.
  • Je kunt complexe informatie helder analyseren en samenvatten en hebt een vlotte pen.
  • Je beheerst de Nederlands en Engels taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
  • Je kunt goed omgaan met deadlines en werkt nauwkeurig, ook onder druk.
  • Je bent minimaal vier dagen per week beschikbaar in de periode van 1 februari tot en met 30 juni.

Wat bieden wij

Tijdens je stage ontvang je een maandelijkse stagevergoeding van €650 (gebaseerd op een volledige werkweek) en word je begeleid door twee collega’s. Elke maand heb je een coachingsgesprek over je eigen ambities en wensen. Halverwege je stage is er een tussentijds feedbackgesprek waarin genoeg ruimte is om aan te geven wat je nog meer uit je stage wil halen. Daarnaast kun je altijd terecht bij andere Young Professionals, consultants en senior-adviseurs met vragen. Tenslotte worden je reiskosten vergoed en is het mogelijk om zo nu en dan eens vanuit huis te werken.

Solliciteren

You belong at Burson:

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. title: Stage Software Engineer - Paris - H/F/X
descriptionHtml:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Fondée en 2014, Artefact est une société internationale de services autour de l'IA et de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en IA, transformation data et en data & digital marketing. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 collaborateurs répartis dans 27 bureaux à travers le monde allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit de l’innovation business des entreprises. 

La mission des Artefactors ? Transformer la data de nos clients en impact business. Dans ce sens, nous collaborons avec plus de 1000 clients, leaders de leurs industries (Orange, Carrefour, Samsung, AccorHotels, L’Oréal, LVMH, Decathlon) et sommes partenaires privilégiés de Google (GMP/GCP), AWS ainsi que Microsoft Azure. 

En tant que stagiaire Software Engineer, tu seras ammener à: 

  • Participer activement à la conception et à l'implémentation de solutions techniques robustes et scalables.
  • Architecture logicielle : Contribuer à la réflexion sur l'architecture de nos applications, en veillant à la performance et à la maintenabilité du code
  • Déploiement et opérations (DevOps) :  automatisation des tests et des déploiements cloud avec des pipelines CI/CD et une infrastructure en tant que code (ex : Terraform), packaging d'applications dans des conteneurs (ex : Docker), implémentation d'outils d'observabilité des données (ex : DBT)
  • Déploiement de ton logiciel sur le cloud : GCP, AWS ou Azure 
  • Déploiement d’une ou plusieurs expertises techniques suivantes : développement logiciel, ingénierie analytique, ingénierie ML, architecture cloud ou ingénierie de sécurité et de fiabilité des sites
  • Veille technologique : Explorer de nouvelles technologies et outils pour optimiser nos méthodes de travail.

Profil recherché

  • Formation : Tu es étudiant(e) en dernière année de cycle ingénieur, Master 2, ou équivalent, avec une spécialisation en sotware engineering, génie logiciel, informatique, ou développement web et tu recherches ton stage de fin d’études à partir de Janvier 2027
  • Compétences techniques :
    • Maîtrise d'un ou plusieurs langages de programmation comme Python, Java, JavaScript (Node.js), Go ou Scala.
    • Connaissance des principes de la programmation orientée objet et/ou de la programmation fonctionnelle.
    • Expérience avec des bases de données SQL ou NoSQL.
    • Une familiarité avec le Cloud (GCP, AWS, Azure) et les conteneurs (Docker, Kubernetes) est un atout.
    • Connaissance des outils de versioning, en particulier Git.
  • Qualités personnelles :
    • Curiosité et proactivité : Tu as envie d'apprendre et de proposer de nouvelles idées.
    • Rigueur et souci du détail : Tu es soucieux(se) de produire un code propre et de qualité.
    • Esprit d'équipe : Tu es capable de travailler en collaboration et d'échanger avec des profils variés (Data Scientists, Consultants, etc.)
    • Français courant pour travailler en équipe et anglais professionnel obligatoire pour nos clients internationaux

Le processus de recrutement : pour rejoindre Artefact, nous te proposons un processus de recrutement en quatre étapes durant lequel tu auras l’occasion de parler de ton expérience et d'en apprendre davantage sur Artefact et le poste d'ingénieur logiciel.

  • Entretien RH
  • Entretien #1 – Test de codage avec un Senior Software Engineer 
  • Entretien #2 - Test d'architecture et de pipeline avec un Senior Software Engineer 
  • Entretien #3 - Entretien de motivation avec un Manager ou Directeur du pôle Data Engineering 

Processus d'onboarding : 

L'intégration comprend une formation sur des compétences transversales critiques telles que la gestion du temps, la communication orale et écrite. Un counsellor te sera également attribué qui te guidera dans ta familiarisation avec la culture et les méthodes de travail de l'entreprise. De plus, tu auras l'opportunité de travailler sur des projets internes pour acquérir une expérience pratique et perfectionner tes compétences. De plus, tu auras la possibilité d'obtenir des certifications sur les fournisseurs cloud avant de travailler sur des missions clients. Ce processus d'intégration est conçu pour te doter des connaissances et des compétences nécessaires pour devenir un ingénieur logiciel performant chez Artefact.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Un stage de 6 mois basé à Paris.
  • Un environnement de travail stimulant, où tu seras encouragé(e) à prendre des initiatives.
  • Un accompagnement par un mentor expérimenté pour te faire progresser rapidement.
  • L'opportunité de travailler sur des projets variés et complexes.
  • La possibilité d'être embauché(e) en CDI à la fin du stage.

Prêt à rejoindre l'aventure ?

Si tu te reconnais dans cette description et que tu souhaites mettre tes compétences au service de projets concrets et impactants, envoie-nous ta candidature !

Chez Artefact, nous recrutons nos collaborateurs uniquement en fonction de nos besoins et des qualités propres de chaque candidat. Nous assurons le développement de leurs compétences professionnelles et de leurs responsabilités sans discrimination d’aucune sorte. Le groupe s'engage à reconnaître et promouvoir tous les talents, quels que soient leurs croyances, âge, handicap, parentalité, origine ethnique, nationalité, identité de genre, orientation sexuelle, appartenance à une organisation politique, religieuse, syndicale ou à une minorité, ou toute autre caractéristique qui pourrait faire l'objet d'une discrimination.

title: Stage Spécialiste Environnement - Lyon
descriptionHtml:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Q ENERGY France est un acteur majeur du marché des énergies renouvelables en France. Autrefois affilié au groupe RES, l’entreprise œuvre depuis 27 ans dans le développement, la construction et l’exploitation de projets éoliens et photovoltaïques.

Aujourd'hui également positionnée sur le marché du stockage d'énergie, Q ENERGY poursuit son expansion vers de nouveaux domaines afin de proposer des solutions intelligentes et complètes pour la production et la fourniture d’énergie durable en France.

L'entreprise compte près de 300 collaborateur.rice.s et 6 agences sur le territoire ainsi qu'un siège social basé à Avignon. Q ENERGY France est une entreprise de la holding européenne Q ENERGY Solutions, créée en 2021 par Hanwha Solutions dans l'objectif de conduire à la prochaine génération de production d'énergie verte et flexible en Europe. Basée à Berlin, Q ENERGY Solutions est une société sœur de Q CELLS, fabricant de modules photovoltaïques reconnu à travers le monde. Les deux sociétés constituent la division Energie du groupe Hanwha Solutions, basé à Séoul.

Vos missions :

Rattaché.e au service développement éolien et sous la supervision de la Chargée d’Etudes Environnement, vous contribuerez à la bonne prise en compte des enjeux environnementaux tout au long des phases prospection, développement et construction des projets éolien terrestre.

  • Élaborer des notes d’analyse et des argumentaires techniques pour les volets environnementaux et paysagers.

  • Participer et suivre la mise en œuvre des mesures environnementales en phase de construction et durant les procédures de financement.
  • Assurer une veille, analyser les évolutions de la réglementation environnementale

Contribution à la culture Santé, Sécurité et Environnement de l’entreprise via :

  • Réalisation du travail dans le respect des mesures de prévention mises en place au sein de l’entreprise et reprises notamment dans le Document Unique, les Politiques Santé, Sécurité et Environnement, procédures, modes opératoires et guides
  • Déclaration de tout événement ou situation pouvant représenter un danger pour les personnes y compris collègues et prestataires et/ou l’environnement 
  • Participation aux événements de formations et de sensibilisations traitant de ces thématiques

Qualité :

  • Respect et mise en œuvre de la politique d’entreprise et des procédures qualité 
  • Participation à la mise à jour des documents du système de management de la qualité 
  • Déclaration des non-conformités et participation à la mise en place d’actions correctives
  • Participation aux actions et projets d’amélioration continue et de partage des savoirs

Requirements

Votre profil :

  • Vous préparez un bac + 5 dans une formation d’ingénieur.e en environnement, agriculture, agronomie ou un Master en Ecologie, Biodiversité, Développement Durable
  • Vous utilisez quotidienne le pack office et êtes à l’aise dans l’utilisation des outils informatiques d’une manière générale.
  • Vous maitrisez les outils cartographiques (Qgis)
  • Vous êtes rigoureux.se, curieux.se et force de propositions. Vous savez évoluer en autonomie dans vos recherches. Vous êtes doté.e d’un excellent relationnel.

Durée : 6 mois

Localisation : Lyon - déplacements ponctuels en Bourgogne-Franche-Comté, Auvergne-Rhône Alpes (frais pris en charge)

Benefits

Comment faisons-nous la différence ?

  • Des valeurs fortes et incarnées 
  • Un management de proximité 
  • Une dynamique d’organisation apprenante 
  • Une entreprise en constant développement 
  • Valorisation et développement des compétences 

Nos avantages sociaux

  • Flexibilité et bien-être : jusqu'à 1 jour de télétravail et flexibilité des horaires
  • Prise en charge à 100% des frais de transports collectifs
  • Forfait mobilité durable pour les déplacements en mobilité douce (vélo...) ou en covoiturage et aides à l’écomobilité 
  • Titres restaurants (10€ pris en charge à hauteur de 5,5€ par la société) 
  • Activités et évènements régulièrement proposés par le CSE 

Nous concourrons à créer un environnement professionnel fondé sur le respect, l'inclusion et la bienveillance, en réunissant des personnes d'horizons différents pour qu'elles nous apportent des idées novatrices et de nouvelles perspectives.

title: Stage: Technische bedrijfskunde/Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Over Nedlin

Nedlin is een industriële textielverzorger voor Healthcare, Hospitality en Industry, waar veiligheid, kwaliteit, continu verbeteren en verantwoord ondernemen centraal staan. Als groeiend B-Corp familiebedrijf investeren we graag in jong talent en versterken we de verbinding tussen onderwijs en arbeidsmarkt. Daarom bieden we studenten de kans om praktijkervaring op te doen, zich te ontwikkelen en Nedlin te leren kennen, met waar mogelijk mooie doorgroeikansen na het afstuderen.

De stageopdrachten

Bij de afdeling Engineering/Technische Bedrijfskunde hebben we twee uitdagende stageopdrachten openstaan. Je gaat aan de slag met één van onze nieuwe geautomatiseerde processen en onderzoekt hoe we deze verder kunnen optimaliseren. Daarbij combineer je techniek, data en procesverbetering en krijg je de kans om jouw verbeteringen ook daadwerkelijk in de praktijk te implementeren.

Mogelijke werkzaamheden en stageopdrachten zijn:

  • Je onderzoekt en optimaliseert het nieuwe geautomatiseerde badgoedvouwproces van Nedlin Hospitality. Met behulp van procesdata en de DMAIC-methodiek breng je prestaties en knelpunten in kaart, voer je verbeteringen door en borg je deze voor een hogere productiviteit, kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid.

  • Je onderzoekt het nieuwe geautomatiseerde sorteerproces voor vuil linnengoed bij Nedlin Healthcare. Je analyseert de prestaties en efficiëntie van de installatie, brengt knelpunten en verbetermogelijkheden in kaart en werkt passende optimalisaties uit. Vervolgens help je deze verbeteringen te implementeren en evalueer je het resultaat.

  • Je onderzoekt hoe Nedlin een digitale kennisbank kan opzetten om de Technische Dienst beter te ondersteunen. Je verzamelt en structureert bestaande technische kennis, zoals handleidingen, onderhoudsinstructies en logboeken, en richt de kennisbank zo in dat deze geschikt is voor zowel de werkvoorbereider als een toekomstige Copilot-agent. Vervolgens implementeer en test je de kennisbank in de praktijk.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Stagevergoeding:

    • € 400,- bruto per maand voor hbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week);

  • Een leerzame stage binnen één van de modernste en duurzaamste wasserijen van Europa;

  • Ruimte en begeleiding om te werken aan jouw (afstudeer)opdracht;

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding en korte lijnen;

  • Een familiaire en positieve sfeer: samen feestdagen vieren, een jaarlijkse familiedag en leuke uitjes;

  • Kans op een (bij)baan bij Nedlin na afronding van je stage, bij wederzijdse match.


Wie ben jij?

  • Je volgt een hbo-opleiding, bij voorkeur Technische Bedrijfskunde

  • Je werkt zelfstandig, nauwkeurig en proactief.

  • Je communiceert gemakkelijk met verschillende collega’s.

  • Je bent 32 tot 40 uur per week beschikbaar voor een meewerk- of afstudeerstage.

  • Je kunt zelfstandig naar onze locatie in Elsloo komen.

Pak het moment

Wil jij tijdens je stage niet alleen werken aan een interessante opdracht, maar vooral ook leren, ervaring opdoen en jezelf ontwikkelen? Bij Nedlin krijg je de ruimte om jouw kennis vanuit je opleiding toe te passen in de praktijk, mee te kijken binnen onze organisatie en samen te werken met ervaren collega’s. Maak van jouw stage een waardevolle stap richting je toekomst. Solliciteer eenvoudig via de solliciteerknop. Heb je eerst nog vragen over de stage of de opdracht? Bel of app gerust via +31 (0)6 14 88 60 22 of mail naar

title: Stagiair Office & Event Management (mbo/hbo)
descriptionHtml:
Een kerstviering organiseren waar collega's nog lang over napraten? Een externe bijeenkomst tot in de puntjes regelen? Of zorgen dat alles op kantoor lekker loopt?

Bij Zibber krijg je de kans om het allemaal te doen. We zoeken een enthousiaste stagiair die energie krijgt van organiseren, regelen en dingen voor elkaar krijgen.

Geen stage waarin je alleen maar meekijkt. Hier doe je écht mee!

Over Zibber

Met zo'n 240 collega's in Nederland, België en Duitsland zijn we marktleider in vastgoedmedia. Met fotografie, video en slimme technologie helpen we makelaars om woningen perfect te presenteren.

Op ons hoofdkantoor in Eindhoven werken zo'n 60 collega's samen. De sfeer? Informeel, energiek en altijd in beweging. We werken hard, lachen veel en houden van mensen die initiatief nemen.

De rol

Je werkt nauw samen met onze Executive Assistant en helpt bij alles wat ons kantoor en onze interne projecten nét wat beter maakt.

Denk aan:

  • Het organiseren van Zibber-events, borrels en teamactiviteiten.

  • Het regelen van offsites en externe bijeenkomsten, van locatie tot catering.

  • Zorgen dat alles op kantoor soepel verloopt.

  • Contact met leveranciers en het oppakken van praktische verzoeken.

  • Meewerken aan leuke interne projecten en verbeterideeën.

En zie jij iets dat slimmer, leuker of makkelijker kan? Laat van je horen!

Wat je van ons krijgt

  • Een afwisselende stage waarin je écht iets kunt bijdragen.

  • Ruimte om zelfstandig dingen op te pakken en eigen ideeën uit te voeren.

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding van onze Executive Assistant.

  • De kans om veel te leren over office management, events en projectmatig werken.

  • Een werkplek op ons gezellige hoofdkantoor in Eindhoven.

  • Korte lijnen, enthousiaste collega's en volop Zibber-events, lunches en gezelligheid.

  • Een stagevergoeding van €450,- bruto per maand bij een fulltime stage.

  • Bij een fulltime stage in principe vier dagen meewerken en één dag ruimte voor school.

  • Starten in januari of februari 2027!


Je volgt een mbo 4- of hbo-opleiding en zoekt een meewerkstage.

Verder vinden we vooral belangrijk dat je:

  • Positieve energie meebrengt en graag de handen uit de mouwen steekt.

  • Zelf initiatief neemt en niet afwacht.

  • Makkelijk communiceert en vragen durft te stellen.

  • Houdt van organiseren en overzicht bewaren.

  • Goed Nederlands spreekt en schrijft.

Ervaring? Mooi meegenomen. De juiste instelling? Veel belangrijker!

Klinkt dit als jouw stage?

Ben jij iemand die liever zegt 'Ik regel het!' dan 'Wie gaat dat doen?'?

Dan pas je waarschijnlijk perfect bij Zibber. Solliciteer en laat ons weten waarom jij graag dingen voor elkaar krijgt. We maken graag kennis met je!

title: Stagiaire assistant(e) ingénieur(e)
descriptionHtml:
Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Rejoindre Neolys Diagnostics, filiale d'ALARA Group, c’est participer à une aventure humaine et scientifique passionnante : innover dans le management des risques liés aux rayonnements et faire avancer la médecine personnalisée en oncologie !

Chez nous, rigueur scientifique rime avec bonne humeur ! Tu intégreras une équipe à taille humaine, dynamique, accessible et passionnée, où le travail d'équipe, l'esprit d'entraide et la bonne ambiance sont au centre du quotidien.

Ce que nous t'offrons :

  • L'immersion dans un projet scientifique à fort impact : Au sein de notre laboratoire Neolys Diagnostics, tu contribues directement au développement du test RadioProfile visant à adapter les traitements de radiothérapie pour les patients atteints de cancer.

  • Un accompagnement de proximité : Un encadrement de qualité (Dr. Sandrine Pereira) pour développer tes compétences scientifiques et t'accompagner vers l'autonomie.

  • Une ambiance unique reconnue par nos collaborateurs : Entraide, management horizontal, transparence, événements d’équipe… et bien d'autres éléments qui font la force du groupe !

Tes principales missions :

Sous la responsabilité de la Directrice du laboratoire, tu participeras au développement et à l'optimisation d'un test innovant par RT-qPCR pour mesurer la radiosensibilité tumorale et faciliter le parcours patient :

  • Mise au point expérimentale : Développement et validation du test de détection de la radiosensibilité par RT-qPCR, d'abord sur des lignées tumorales du commerce puis sur une cohorte d'échantillons patients.

  • Culture & analyse : Culture cellulaire, extraction/amplification d'acides nucléiques et analyse des mécanismes moléculaires impliqués dans la radiosensibilité tumorale.

  • Gestion & reporting : Consignation rigoureuse des résultats, analyse des données et participation à la rédaction des synthèses scientifiques.

Ta fierté si tu réussis avec nous ?

Tu contribues concrètement à lever des verrous technologiques majeurs pour accélérer le transfert de nos tests innovants vers la routine clinique, au bénéfice direct des patients !


Ton profil :

Tu prépares un diplôme de niveau Bac+5 (Master 2 ou École d'Ingénieur) en Biologie, Cancérologie, Biotechnologies ou domaine connexe, et tu recherches un stage.

Tu possèdes de solides bases théoriques et pratiques en biologie moléculaire (RT-qPCR, extraction) et en culture cellulaire.

Au-delà de ta rigueur scientifique et méthodique, c'est ton enthousiasme, ta curiosité, ton esprit d'équipe et ton autonomie qui feront la différence !

Prêt(e) à relever le défi et à faire avancer la recherche en oncologie ? Rejoins-nous vite !

Tous nos emplois sont ouverts aux personnes en situation d’handicap.

title: Stagiaire Chargé(e) de projet ERP
descriptionHtml:
Fondé à Paris en 1999, Advancy est un cabinet de conseil en stratégie de premier plan, comptant aujourd'hui plus de 300 consultants répartis dans nos bureaux mondiaux (Paris, New York, Boston, Shanghai, Francfort, Sydney, etc.). En forte croissance, nous modernisons actuellement nos propres outils internes et lançons un projet d'envergure : le déploiement mondial d’un nouvel ERP.

Pour nous accompagner dans cette phase clé, nous recherchons un(e) Stagiaire Chargé(e) de projet ERP pour une durée de 6 mois, à partir de début septembre 2026.

Vos Missions

Rattaché(e) directement au CFO, vous serez au cœur de la transformation digitale du cabinet. Vous participerez activement à l'implémentation de l’ERP sur les modules clés et accompagnerez la transition opérationnelle.

Votre quotidien s'articulera autour des axes suivants :

Assistange au pilotage Projet : coordination entre l’intégrateur et les équipes Advancy ; coordoniation entre les équipes Advancy (Finance, RH) : suivi des points bloquants ; participation aux comités projet

Aide au paramétrage et déploiement des modules :

  • Finance : Assistance au paramétrage, au nettoyage et à la migration des données

  • Core HCM : Assistance au paramétrage, au nettoyage et à la migration des données RH (profils collaborateurs, structures organisationnelles ; gestion des congés et absences).

  • Staffing : Aider à la modélisation des processus de staffing dans l'outil et à la sécurisation de la migration des données existantes.

  • Recette & Tests (UAT) : Élaborer les scénarios de test, identifier les anomalies ; faire le lien avec l'intégrateur et veiller à la conformité de l'outil avec nos processus métiers.

Accompagnement au changement : Participer à la rédaction des guides utilisateurs et aider au support des équipes (RH, Managers, Consultants) lors du lancement.


  • Formation : Étudiant(e) en Master (Bac+4/5) en École de Commerce, IEP ou Université, avec une spécialisation, Systèmes d'Information, ou Management de Projet.

  • Compétences techniques : Vous maîtrisez parfaitement Excel (TCD, formules avancées, analyse de données complexes). Une première approche d'un outil type ERP ou SIRH est un vrai plus, mais pas obligatoire.

  • Esprit Logique & Métier : Vous avez une excellente capacité à comprendre rapidement les processus métiers impliqués pour savoir les traduire de manière logique et fluide dans un outil informatique.

  • Qualités personnelles : Rigueur analytique, sens de l'organisation et esprit de synthèse. Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre aisance relationnelle et votre capacité à travailler en mode projet dans un environnement exigeant et dynamique.

  • Langues : Compte tenu du contexte international du cabinet et de l'outil, un bon niveau d'anglais est indispensable.

title: Stagiaire Talent & Operations (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
Apprendre, évoluer et accompagner le développement des talents. Contribuer à un impact positif.

  • Vous souhaitez acquérir une expérience concrète en gestion des talents et en Opérations au sein d’une entreprise internationale portée par une mission ?
  • Vous aspirez à évoluer dans un environnement dynamique, où la curiosité, l’apprentissage et l’esprit d’équipe occupent une place centrale ?

Le poste

Au cours de ce stage, vous découvrirez le fonctionnement opérationnel d’un cabinet de conseil : gestion des ressources, processus Talent, gestion de la performance et coordination de projets transverses. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Operations et Talent France, et développerez de solides compétences analytiques, organisationnelles et relationnelles, notamment en gestion des parties prenantes.

Vos missions

Talent management

  • Contribuer au déroulement du processus annuel d’évaluation de la performance : suivi des échéances, communication, collecte des feedbacks en lien avec les managers.
  • Participer à des projets RH transverses : formation, diversité et inclusion, autres projets transverses.
  • Apporter un soutien sur des sujets RH ponctuels, selon les besoins.

Excellence operationnelle

Staffing

  • Appuyer la coordination du staffing des consultants et des stagiaires.
  • Maintenir la planification de la charge de travail et les données de staffing.
  • Veiller à l’adéquation des demandes de staffing avec le pricing des projets.

Reporting

  • Maintenir la qualité des données dans les outils opérationnels (Napta, NetSuite).
  • Contribuer au reporting mensuel et aux tableaux de bord opérationnels.
  • Suivre l’exactitude des données projet et la complétion des feuilles de temps.

Coordination d’équipe

  • Préparer les réunions hebdomadaires de coordination de la branche France.
  • Participer à l’organisation des meetings internes mensuels des différentes populations de consultants (Juniors, Project Managers, Line Managers, etc.).
  • Contribuer à l’organisation et à la coordination du séminaire annuel.

Pourquoi rejoindre Quantis

Quantis, société du groupe BCG, est un cabinet de conseil de référence en développement durable, qui accompagne les organisations face à des enjeux environnementaux complexes. Depuis vingt ans, notre équipe d’experts collabore avec des organisations du monde entier afin d’intégrer le développement durable dans la stratégie, la prise de décision et l’action. Nous guidons les entreprises de l’ambition à l’action en associant les avancées scientifiques les plus récentes à une vision stratégique, pour les aider à appréhender la complexité, à progresser sur leurs priorités de durabilité et à créer une valeur durable.

Unis par un engagement commun en faveur de progrès concrets, nos plus de 250 professionnels incarnent une culture collaborative singulière, que nous appelons le Quantis Spirit. Nous sommes innovants. Nous sommes orientés vers l’impact. Nous sommes guidés par la science. Nous sommes Quantis.

Pour en savoir plus, découvrez Quantis et notre mission.

Votre profil

Vous réussirez dans cette mission si :

  • Vous souhaitez contribuer à l’action d’une entreprise engagée en faveur du développement durable ;
  • Vous faites preuve d’organisation, d’initiative et de rigueur ;
  • Vous appréciez l’analyse de données et l’amélioration des processus ;
  • Vous savez construire des relations de confiance et communiquer efficacement ;
  • Vous maîtrisez la suite Microsoft Office (en particulier Excel et PowerPoint) et portez un intérêt aux outils fondés sur l’intelligence artificielle ;
  • Vous maîtrisez couramment le français et justifiez d’un bon niveau professionnel en anglais.

Informations complémentaires

  • Lieu : Paris 2e (75002), organisation hybride alliant présence au bureau et télétravail
  • Conditions requises : être inscrit(e) dans une université, une école de commerce ou une école d’ingénieurs, et disposer d’une convention de stage valide. Une priorité sera accordée aux candidat(e)s recherchant un stage de fin d’études.
  • Date de démarrage : janvier 2027
  • Durée : 6 mois

Unlocking the Potential of All Quantisians

At Quantis, Unlocking Potential means empowering our employees to thrive, enabling them to drive our mission and manifesto forward—creating meaningful impact for people and the planet.

We aim to achieve this by nurturing a culture rooted in collective action, and shared purpose, where diversity is cherished, inclusion is lived, mental wellbeing is supported, and opportunities are open to all.

This extends to our clients, their clients, and their entire value chain as sustainable thinking and collective representation are integral components of our purpose to transform the way that businesses operate.

This is how we commit to our people, live our manifesto, and shape a sustainable future - together.

title: Storm Test Bench Principal Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

Here at The Exploration Company we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refuelled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.

We are seeking an experienced and talented Storm Test Bench Principal Engineer, to lead the development of one of the most powerful European cryogenic test bench for 2.5MN class engines.

This is a key leadership role that requires deep technical expertise in liquid-propellant propulsion systems, a proven track record managing complex engineering projects, and experience leading and mentoring technical teams. As Storm Test Bench Principal Engineer, you will ensure that test bench development is carried out safely, efficiently and with technical rigor, from design through commissioning and system-level testing. You will provide technical direction to the testing team, coordinate priorities and resources, resolve complex technical issues, and ensure the test bench meets its performance, quality, schedule and safety objectives.

The role combines technical leadership, people leadership and hands-on involvement in preparing and executing complex cryogenic propulsion test campaigns.

Key Responsibilities / Tasks:

  • Provide overall technical leadership for the test bench development

  • Define and maintain the development approach, philosophy, plans and technical execution strategy

  • Ensure that test bench capabilities are aligned with system requirements, design intent, verification objectives and programme milestones

  • Lead the technical assessment and resolution of complex test problems, including test anomalies, hardware issues, instrumentation problems and system performance deviations

  • Coordinate the investigation of anomalies and ensure that root-cause analysis, corrective actions and retest activities are properly managed

  • Ensure that the test bench design performed in accordance with applicable safety rules, operational constraints and approved procedures

  • Support the development of the teams through coaching, technical guidance and constructive feedback

  • Build a culture of ownership, disciplined execution, continuous improvement and learning from experience

  • Contribute to integrated project planning, including test schedules, resource requirements, facility usage and major test milestones

  • Identify technical, operational and schedule risks related to test activities and ensure that mitigation actions are defined and implemented

  • Ensure compliance with company processes and applicable regulatory requirements for cryogenic propulsion test activities

  • Promote a strong safety culture, particularly for activities involving cryogenic propellants, high pressure, hazardous energy and propulsion test operations

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, propulsion engineering or a related technical discipline

  • Proven professional experience (5+ years) in spacecraft, launch vehicle, aircraft, industrial gas, energy or another relevant high-technology environment

  • Experience in cryogenic propulsion systems testing

  • Proven experience leading engineering teams and coordinating multidisciplinary technical activities

  • Experience with cryogenic systems, liquid propulsion, pressurised systems, fluid systems or related test operations

  • Experience planning and executing complex test campaigns from test preparation through final reporting

  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical investigations and resolve test anomalies using structured problem-solving methods

  • Experience working with test facilities, ground support equipment, instrumentation and data acquisition systems

  • Capacity to travel to test sites and partner facilities as required

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Fluent professional English. French will be an advantage

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

title: Strategic Account Director
descriptionHtml:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

Role Summary

Location: London

Hybrid

Full-Time

The Strategic Account Director is a new-business, quota-carrying hunter responsible for landing the largest, most complex enterprise logos in the market. You own the full pursuit — from target identification and outbound generation through multi-threaded, committee-driven sales cycles to signed, revenue-producing contracts. Your prospects run cross-border volume at scale, they are today served by incumbent banks or specialist fintechs, and displacing that incumbent is the job.

This is a role for someone who is energized by the chase: building conviction where none exists, getting into the CFO's and Treasurer's office cold, orchestrating a pursuit team through a long and technical evaluation, and closing seven-figure relationships. You set the bar for how strategic new business gets won at Payoneer.

This is a strategic role. It is deliberately seated centrally under Global Sales so the strategic-accounts motion can be built, proven, and standardized before ownership is distributed to the regions. You will work hand in hand with regional heads of sales for in-market coordination and, over time, help shape how this function scales across the field.

What You'll Do 

  • Hunt and land net-new strategic accounts. Own a new-business quota. Identify, prioritize, and pursue the highest-value target accounts in your territory (typically $500K+/month cross-border volume, up to $10M+/month strategic targets) and convert them into signed, funded customers.
  • Generate your own pipeline. Build top-of-funnel through disciplined, research-led outbound — direct executive outreach, referrals, partner and ecosystem channels, and events. Do not wait for leads; create them.
  • Break into the buying committee cold. Get in front of and build conviction with CFOs, Treasurers, Finance Operations, and Compliance/Risk leaders at target accounts. Multi-thread deliberately so a deal never rests on a single contact.
  • Displace the incumbent. Position Payoneer's speed, global coverage, economics, and platform breadth to unseat incumbent banks and specialist competitors. Run competitive displacement plays and build the business case that moves an entrenched buyer.
  • Own complex, long-cycle deals end to end. Drive multi-stakeholder, technical, compliance-sensitive evaluations from first meeting to close. Own the mutual close plan, procurement, legal, and commercial negotiation.
  • Sell the platform. Lead with value, not features. Land the entry wedge and architect the deal to open cross-border payments plus high-value services (Capital, Treasury/FX, Embedded/Platform Payments, Workforce/EOR, and emerging rails) — maximizing initial contract value and expansion potential.
  • Qualify with discipline. Apply Payoneer's Sandler-based methodology — Up-Front Contracts, Pain Funnel, budget and decision qualification — to every pursuit so you invest team resources only in winnable, real deals.
  • Orchestrate the pursuit team. Direct Solutions/Pre-Sales, Product Specialists, Compliance, and RevOps as a coordinated deal team through the sales cycle, and quarterback executive sponsorship where needed.
  • Forecast honestly and close on time. Own a credible, hygienic pipeline and forecast in CRM. Drive deals to close dates and call your number straight.
  • Set up the win for the long term. Land with a clean handoff to Customer Success and a clear expansion thesis, so every logo you close becomes a growth account.

Who You Are 

  • 8+ years in enterprise B2B sales with a strong bias toward new business / new logo acquisition — not primarily account management or renewals.
  • Consistent, demonstrable record of hitting or exceeding a new-business quota on complex, high-value deals.
  • Proven ability to self-generate pipeline through outbound and to break into cold enterprise accounts at the executive level.
  • Experience closing long-cycle, multi-stakeholder deals with meaningful (six- to seven-figure) contract value.
  • Demonstrated success selling into and navigating executive buying committees — CFO, Treasury, Finance, Compliance/Risk.
  • Strong commercial and negotiation skills, including running procurement, legal, and margin-protective deal structuring to close.
  • Fluency operating in a matrix environment and orchestrating a cross-functional pursuit team.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred

  • Background in payments, fintech, banking, treasury, FX, or cross-border commerce.
  • Track record of competitive displacement against incumbent banks or specialist fintechs.
  • Experience selling a multi-product platform and structuring land-and-expand entry deals.
  • Familiarity with a structured sales methodology (Payoneer uses Sandler).
  • Exposure to compliance-sensitive, regulated sales environments (KYC/AML-aware selling).
  • Strong CRM discipline and data-driven pipeline management (e.g., Salesforce).

#LI-FD1

The Payoneer Ways of Working 

Act as our customer’s partner on the inside
Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further. 

Do it. Own it.
Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do. 

Continuously improve
Always striving for a higher standard than our last. 

Build each other up 
Helping each other grow, as professionals and people. 

If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.

Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.

title: Strategic Account Executive (Eastern Europe)
descriptionHtml:
About Ping Identity: 

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. 

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. 

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. 

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. 

Reporting to the Regional Sales Director, the Strategic Account Executive is a field-based position with ownership of an assigned territory (Eastern/Central Europe) focused on net new logo and upsell opportunities. You will have the ability to utilize a robust internal resource model, a broad tech stack, and a global partner directory to position yourself for future success. 

We will consider applicants based in the UK or Netherlands.

You will: 

  • Create, implement, measure and review a personal plan that drives achievement of performance goals aligned to the regional sales strategy. 
  • Position and articulate our value proposition to customers to maximize the business opportunity. 
  • Negotiate and close complex contracts with the support of global partners. 
  • Report on sales activity and forecasts to senior management. 
  • Prepare indicative subscription pricing and customer offers, including reviewing broader opportunities such as training and professional services modules, and guides request for proposal responses. 
  • Provides customer feedback to marketing, customer success, product management, and engineering teams. 
  • Work collaboratively to acquire additional/specialist resources as needed.  

You have: 

  • A demonstrable, successful track record of selling enterprise software solutions in the Eastern/Central European region
  • Proven ability to win net new business.
  • Results-oriented with multiple years meeting or exceeding quota within the market. 
  • Sustainable record of signing strategic and large projects, with long and complex sales cycles. 
  • A combination of experience in selling to both public and private sector accounts is preferred.
  • Established sector-related C level contacts. 
  • Successful record dealing with strategic buyers. 
  • Deep knowledge of the relevant key drivers of change in the industry. 
  • Background working with regional/national/global partners and system integrators.
  • Prior training and experience in value selling and account planning methodologies. 
  • Flexibility to travel to the assigned region as required

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day. 

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

  • A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.
  • Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.
  • Regular company and team bonding events.
  • Competitive benefits and perks.
  • Global volunteering and community initiatives

Our Benefits: 

  • Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule 
  • Parental Leave
  • Progressive Healthcare Options
  • Retirement Programs
  • Opportunity for Education Reimbursement 
  • Commuter Offset (Specific locations) 

Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone’s individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.

We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

At ClaimSorted, we’re building a more resilient world - one where people and businesses have the confidence to pursue bigger opportunities. We’re doing this by transforming how insurance delivers on its most important promise: helping people and businesses recover when things go wrong.

The world’s largest insurers and Fortune 500 companies work with us to handle claims and manage risk more efficiently, so they - and the people they protect - can move forward with confidence.

Backed by Y Combinator, Atomico and Eurazeo, we grew 10x in the past year - and we’re just getting started.


The Role

We’re looking for a Strategic Account Executive to join our founding GTM team and drive our next wave of growth, win new logos, and expand deals. You’ll own the full sales cycle, working with C-level executives at multibillion-dollar companies to transform how their businesses operate.

Success in this role goes well beyond closing deals. You’ll need to deeply understand each customer’s business, challenge their thinking, and work with them to build tailored solutions that fundamentally change how they work.

  • Create, drive, and close high-stakes deals with the largest insurance companies in the world - the kind of deals where a single signature changes how a multi-billion-dollar insurer handles every claim it processes

  • Act as a trusted advisor to prospects and customers - learning their needs and demonstrating how our products can solve real problems

  • Own your pipeline end-to-end, from first conversation to signed contract - running sharp, data-driven sales cycles that lead with insight and never lose urgency

We love working together in the office, so this is a full-time, in-office role in our London HQ. We're a high-intensity team and often put in significant time and effort, because we believe great outcomes come from doing the work well.

 

Who You Are

We care more about hunger and grit than years on a resumes. You might be a management consultant who's seen insurance's pain points firsthand, or a top-performing full-cycle sales rep ready for something bigger.

  • Full-cycle sales experience — you own everything from first conversation to signed contract, not just closing what someone else built

Our Values

  • Move Fast – Act decisively, iterate quickly, optimize for momentum.

  • Always Overdeliver – We exceed expectations in everything we do.

  • Think Customer-First, Always – The customer experience drives every decision.

  • Challenge the Status Quo – We innovate relentlessly and never settle for 'good enough.'

  • Say It How It Is – Transparency and direct communication build trust.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The Role

As Omnea's Strategic Account Manager, you won't own a fixed book of accounts. Instead, you'll work across a large, shared pool of customers, 50+ at a time, and your job is to make every single one of them successful.

Unlike a traditional account role built around a handful of strategic relationships, you'll operate at scale: building Omnea's presence and community across your customer base through events, webinars, roundtables, and digital engagement, turning individual customers into a connected, invested group of Omnea advocates.

You'll still carry a commercial edge, owning retention and a smaller share of expansion across your pool, but the bulk of the role is about driving real value realisation and adoption at volume rather than running a small number of deep, high-touch relationships.

You're someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, is energised by variety, and knows how to prioritise ruthlessly. You're as comfortable hosting a roundtable for 30 procurement leaders as you are running a tight renewal call with a CFO.

What You'll Do

  • Own a large, shared pool of accounts: Manage 50+ accounts at a time across SMB and mid-market, not a fixed book, building relationships from end users (Procurement, Finance, Ops) through to senior stakeholders (CFOs, COOs), and stepping in early wherever you spot a health risk.

  • Drive value realisation, with a lighter expansion motion: Own Net Revenue Retention across your pool. Lead renewal conversations, secure multi-year extensions, and pass qualified upsell signal to Sales rather than running full commercial cycles yourself.

  • Build community and drive engagement at scale: Design and run customer events, webinars, roundtables, and digital programmes that keep your accounts engaged, informed, and connected to each other. Co-host with Marketing and Sales, and turn your best customers into reference champions.

  • Be the voice of the customer internally: Translate patterns across your accounts into product feedback for the roadmap, and into scalable plays and campaigns for Marketing and Sales. Help define the playbooks, tools, and processes for managing accounts at this scale: you're building this function as much as running it.

What's Different About This Role

  • This isn't a book-of-business role. You work across a large, shared pool of accounts rather than owning a fixed set, so leverage through events, content, and digital touchpoints matters as much as one-to-one relationship-building.

  • The quota skews toward retention and value realisation, not expansion. Roughly 70% of what you own is keeping accounts healthy and renewed; the other 30% is expansion you spot and hand off or close.

  • Community is core to the role, not a nice-to-have. You're expected to build and run the events, webinars, and content that turn a shared pool of customers into a connected group of Omnea advocates.

  • There's no fixed playbook for managing accounts at this scale yet. You'll help define it as you go.

About You

TL;DR: you're commercially sharp, energised by building community, and have the operational discipline to manage a high-volume, shared pool of accounts without letting anything slip. You know how to create leverage through events, content, and digital touchpoints, and you balance that with the relationship skills to make customers feel genuinely looked after.

  • 2-7 years of experience in a B2B SaaS commercial or customer-facing role. You might come from account management, customer success, marketing, or events - what matters is a genuine commercial edge and a track record of excellence in whatever you've done

  • You're a natural community builder: you know how to design and run programmes that bring customers together, and you understand how those moments translate into retention, expansion, and advocacy

  • You have strong commercial intuition: you can spot an expansion opportunity in a conversation, navigate a renewal proactively, and hold your own in commercial discussions with senior stakeholders

  • You're a brilliant communicator in every format: warm, clear, and credible whether you're hosting a webinar for 50 people or writing a customer newsletter

  • You're operationally excellent. Managing 50+ accounts at a time means ruthless prioritisation, tight organisation, and building systems and processes that create leverage

  • You're outcomes-focused with a heavy bias to action, entrepreneurial, and want to help build a business. The scope of this role will be defined by the person who takes it on

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

About the role

We are looking for a Strategic Accounts Product Representative to strengthen the relationship between our Product organisation and our largest enterprise customers, as well as support major commercial opportunities across our products.

In this role, you will act as the primary Product interface for selected strategic accounts, helping customers understand our Product capabilities, direction and commitments while ensuring their needs are clearly understood and effectively translated into actionable Product insights.

You will work closely with Account Managers, Sales, Product Owners, Engineering and Delivery teams to connect customer expectations with our Product strategy, identify opportunities shared across multiple customers, and provide clear visibility on Product scope, dependencies and roadmap maturity.

This is a highly transversal, customer-facing role at the intersection of Product, business and technology. You will engage with stakeholders ranging from operational teams to senior executives, build a deep understanding of their business challenges, and help our Product organisation make better-informed decisions.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Building trusted Product relationships with strategic customers: Act as their main Product point of contact, in close coordination with Account and Project managers, clearly communicate product capabilities, strategic direction, constraints and trade-offs to stakeholders at every level.

  • Turning customer needs into Product insights: Qualify requests based on customer impact, business value, urgency, recurrence and strategic relevance. Identify common challenges across accounts and work with Product Owners and the Head of Product to surface broader Product opportunities.

  • Ensuring clear and reliable Product commitments: Maintain a consolidated view of Product commitments for strategic accounts, including scope, ownership, dependencies, status and confidence level. Ensure that customer-facing communications reflect internally validated product and delivery plans.

  • Bridging customers and internal teams: Coordinate Product Owners and relevant internal stakeholders to answer complex customer questions, clarify functional scope and address cross-product dependencies. Ensure changes to scope, timing or assumptions are communicated proactively.

  • Leading customer discovery and understanding business needs: Participate in or lead Product discovery workshops with strategic customers to understand their workflows, business challenges and expected outcomes. Challenge solution-driven requests where necessary to identify the underlying business problem.

  • Contributing to major commercial opportunities: Coordinate the Product contribution to strategic tenders, RFPs and major sales opportunities, ensuring that Product information, capabilities, limitations and proposed commitments are accurate and aligned internally.

  • Sharing customer and market intelligence: Develop an understanding of customers' industries, business models and relevant regulatory constraints. Bring these insights back to Product and help Sales, Customer Operations and other teams communicate Product decisions consistently.

    • What we're looking for

    We are looking for someone who combines strong customer-facing skills with a solid understanding of Product and technology. You can navigate complex enterprise environments, understand business challenges, communicate with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and bring structure to discussions involving multiple teams and competing priorities.

    Your experience and skills:

  • Significant experience in a customer-facing B2B technology environment, ideally within a SaaS company, enterprise software vendor or fast-growing technology business.

  • Experience working at the intersection of Product, customers and business, for example in Product Management, Enterprise Product Management, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management or a similar role.

  • The ability to understand complex customer environments, engage with senior stakeholders and build trusted relationships across operational, technical and executive levels.

title: Strategic Client Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

Our largest fleet clients are hugely important to Flock: they have more vehicles, more data and more opportunity to benefit from everything our connected proposition can offer, and we want to give them an even better experience as we grow. We’re looking for a Strategic Client Manager to become the primary face of Flock for our largest customers. From multi-national operations, to well known brands, and growing sector leaders, we want you to own these relationships, making sure they get the very best Flock service.

Nearly all of our business comes through brokers, and that remains central to how we work: you’ll sit at the heart of the client, broker and Flock relationship, working closely with our Broker Development Managers and teams across the business to deliver a brilliant joined-up service. You’ll report to our Head of Distribution, and use AI day to day to prepare for meetings, understand accounts, manage client queries and improve reporting, freeing up more time for relationships and problem-solving.

You’ll have the opportunity to build our corporate client management approach from the ground up: shaping account reviews and performance reporting, bringing together claims, safety, underwriting and finance for our biggest clients, and taking real ownership when something needs to get done. Success is simple: our clients stay with us, get more value from Flock and recommend us to others.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the relationship with a portfolio of Flock’s largest fleet clients, becoming their primary point of contact and developing a strong understanding of their business.

  • Build and run our corporate account management approach: client reviews, reporting, relationship cadence and account planning.

  • Work closely with brokers and our Broker Development Managers to deliver a coordinated experience for every large corporate client.

  • Bring together teams across Flock, including claims, safety, underwriting and finance, to resolve client questions and issues quickly, and build strong relationships with key stakeholders across client organisations.

  • Identify retention risks early and create clear plans to protect our most important accounts.

  • Help shape and improve Flock’s wider client service proposition, including account reviews, portal engagement, safety support, claims and reporting, feeding client feedback back into the business.

  • Use AI in your day-to-day work, from account research and meeting preparation to query management, meeting summaries and client reporting.

 

What you’ll need

  • Strong experience within the insurance industry, with a clear understanding of the broker–client–insurer dynamic and the judgement to know where you add value, without duplicating the broker’s role, creating confusion or adding unnecessary layers for the client.

  • Experience in a client-facing role such as insurer account or deal management, broker account management, claims relationship management or a similar position.

  • A proven track record of managing important client relationships and delivering strong retention or customer satisfaction, with the confidence to work with senior stakeholders across clients, brokers and internal teams.

  • Strong commercial judgement. You can identify when an account is at risk, understand what matters to the client and build a plan to retain them.

  • Energy and ownership. You’re comfortable picking up a problem, finding the right people and driving it through to a solution.

  • Confident using technology in your daily work, curious about how it can help you work faster and deliver a better client experience.

  • Preferable: experience with large, complex or multi-site corporate clients, Commercial Motor Fleet or fleet risk and safety experience, or exposure to the claims process or to building an account management or client service proposition.

 

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that’s a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

We are seeking a Strategic Partner Lead to build and manage trusted relationships on behalf of OpenAI in Europe.

You will identify and develop strategic partnerships that help people explore meaningful uses of AI and create value for OpenAI and the partners we work with. As the relationship owner, you will guide opportunities from initial engagement through development, execution, and ongoing growth, coordinating across product, technical, marketing, and other internal teams.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone with an established network, strong strategic judgment, product curiosity, and a track record of turning relationships into successful partnerships.

Domestic and occasional international travel should be expected.

In This Role, You Will

  • Originate, develop, and grow trusted external relationships.

  • Serve as the primary owner for a portfolio of strategic partners.

  • Coordinate closely with teams across Product, Marketing, Communications, Global Affairs, Research, Legal, and Safety.

  • Evaluate opportunities based on alignment, authenticity, feasibility, potential impact, and risk.

  • Manage multiple complex relationships and priorities while maintaining a high standard of execution.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You

  • Have 10+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, or a related field.

  • Bring an established external network and a record of building trusted relationships.

  • Have experience originating, negotiating, and growing complex partnerships.

  • Can identify valuable opportunities and clearly articulate why they matter.

  • Quickly understand a partner’s business, audience, incentives, and concerns.

  • Bring strong judgment around trust, rights, safety, reputation, and the sensitivities surrounding AI.

  • Communicate effectively with senior external partners and internal product and technical leaders.

  • Lead effectively across functions, including when priorities are not fully aligned.

  • Thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments and balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products.
