title: Strategic Partnership Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Andela:

At Andela, we know brilliance is evenly distributed around the world, but opportunity is not. For over 10 years, Andela has connected its customers with top global, remote technical talent from over 135 countries with the majority residing in emerging markets like Africa and Latin America.

As one of the world’s largest talent marketplaces, Andela gives companies greater flexibility to quickly deploy qualified technologists. With talent highly skilled in advanced technologies to support Application Development, Artificial Intelligence, Cloud & DevOps, Data Engineering, and much more, customers experience 33% faster project delivery. The company’s exclusive AI-powered platform, Andela Talent Cloud, is the industry’s only unified platform managing the complete global talent lifecycle and enables customers to fill individual roles or engage fully managed teams up to 66% faster.

Andela is on the precipice of two breakout industry transformations: one in staffing/hiring and the other in software development, both accelerated by generative AI.

Are you an exceptional, hungry leader seasoned in scaling businesses through transformation and growth? Join us and change the world.

Job Summary

Strategic Partnership Manager · London, UK

Andela is hiring a London-based Strategic Partnership Manager to own and grow our co-sell partnership with GitHub, one of our most strategic technology partners, across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. GitHub is one of our highest-priority partnerships, and EMEA is where our co-sell momentum with them is strongest.

You will own the partner relationship and be accountable for the partner-sourced and

partner-influenced revenue it produces. That means building trust with GitHub's field sellers and partner team, running deal registration and co-sell, mapping accounts, and keeping our program standing current so the partner sends us more opportunities and continues to invest in us.

GitHub is the anchor, but the role is built to flex. You will work across GitHub's wider cloud ecosystem, including co-sell, consumption credit and partner funding programs. As activity grows in region, you will extend the same motion to our AI lab partners. This is a revenue-generating role with a base-plus-variable compensation structure tied to partner-sourced and partner-influenced bookings.

Exceptional Leadership:

As an Andelan, you’ll serve as a role model for the rest of the company. Think about the feedback your peers typically give you – if it usually sounds like the below, we want to hear from you.

  • Low ego, low drama, servant leader: You share credit, take blame. You like being wrong because it means someone else had an even better idea.

  • One team mentality: You break silos across teams. You put the company and mission first above your team alone.

  • Great listener, hungry for feedback: You’re always seeking to improve – our product, our business, yourself. You solicit diverse opinions and deeply listen.

  • Owner, not renter: You see a problem, you fix it or find someone who will. The buck stops with you.

  • Player-coach: You fly high (create strategy) AND low (know the details that matter). You roll up your sleeves and get scrappy. You do this proactively collaborating with your team while actively engaging in important details.

  • Business problem solver: You’re not just a functional expert; you consistently get praise for approaching your function through the lens of solving business problems.

Key Responsibilities

Own the GitHub partnership in EMEA

  • Build and maintain relationships with GitHub's EMEA field sellers, partner managers, solution engineers and services leaders, so Andela is the partner they bring into accounts first.

  • Own the joint Partner Business Plan for the region, and run the QBR cadence and monthly deal reviews with GitHub.

  • Represent Andela in person at partner offices, sales kickoffs, field events and executive meetings across EMEA.

Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue

  • Source new opportunities from the partner's field organization and qualify them before bringing in Andela sales and Solutions Managers.

  • Run co-sell on live deals: connect partner sellers with Andela sellers, keep the partner informed through close, and remove blockers on both sides.

  • Map accounts with GitHub to agree on which customers we target together, then align Andela's EMEA sales team on how to pursue them.

  • Build and manage partner-sourced pipeline against a coverage target, with clean attribution in Salesforce.

Run deal registration, funding and program mechanics

  • Register every partner-involved opportunity so Andela receives credit for the consumption and seats we drive (for example, platform seats and cloud consumption).

  • Identify and secure deal-based partner funding, including co-investment and incentive programs, so sellers have more pricing flexibility on competitive deals.

  • Manage marketplace listings and partner program tiers: track designation and specialization requirements, certification counts, customer references and registered-deal thresholds, and file what is needed to maintain or move up a tier.

  • Maintain partner attribution tooling, such as partner portals and deal and consumption tagging.

Work across the Andela partner team

  • Bring Solutions Managers into qualified opportunities and partner enablement sessions, and relay what partner sellers need back into our offers.

  • Partner with the Partner Marketer on campaigns to partner sellers, joint customer campaigns and events, and own follow-up with partner sellers on the leads they produce.

  • Feed wins back into customer stories and references that strengthen our standing with each partner.

  • Report on partner pipeline, bookings, funding secured and program status to the Director of Partnerships and sales leadership.

Extend the motion to more partners

  • Apply the same co-sell playbook across GitHub's wider cloud ecosystem in EMEA.

  • As activity grows, support our AI lab partners in region: partner seller relationships, deal registration, program tiers and marketplace presence.

How success is measured

  • Partner-sourced bookings (primary), with partner-influenced bookings credited at a lower weight.

  • Deals registered and accepted by the partner, and co-sell opportunities with a partner seller engaged.

  • Partner-sourced pipeline against a coverage target, and co-sell wins.

  • Partner funding secured, and partner consumption driven (platform seats, cloud consumption, AI licenses).

  • Program status: designations achieved, tier requirements met, business plans current and QBRs held on schedule.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in partner, alliance or channel management at a technology services firm, consultancy, systems integrator or ISV.

  • Direct, hands-on experience with the GitHub partner program or a comparable cloud or developer-platform partner program: co-sell, deal registration, partner portals and partner funding claims.

  • A track record of carrying a partner-sourced or partner-influenced revenue target and growing pipeline through a partner's field sellers.

  • Experience running joint business plans, QBRs and account mapping with a large technology partner.

  • Enough technical fluency in software development, DevOps, platform migration or AI adoption to qualify an opportunity before bringing in a solutions specialist.

  • Comfortable working through others: you influence partner sellers and internal sales teams without direct authority.

  • Strong organization and follow-through on program mechanics, with clean CRM hygiene (Salesforce preferred).

  • Based in or able to work from London, and able to travel across EMEA for partner meetings and events.

Preferred

  • An existing network inside GitHub's EMEA partner and field organizations.

  • Experience managing partner tiers, designations, specializations and marketplace listings (for example, cloud marketplace listings and partner designations).

  • Exposure to AI lab partner programs, or interest in growing into them. We value candidates with a strong GitHub or cloud partner foundation who can carry that motion into newer programs.

  • Background selling or partnering on developer tooling, cloud modernization, engineering talent or technical training services.

  • Experience working across European and African markets.

  • Experience at a company building a partner function from an early stage.

title: Strategic Sales Manager (Paris)
descriptionHtml:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

The role

We’re hiring a Strategic Sales Leader to build Dust’s go-to-market presence with its most important French customers. This is a pivotal opportunity to shape how we win and grow strategic accounts, from developing senior relationships and navigating complex buying groups to building a repeatable approach for large, high-impact opportunities.

You’ll act as the business lead for the strategic segment, with accountability for revenue. You’ll lead and coach the sales team while staying close to customers, account plans, and active deals. You’ll build a focused pipeline and a sales motion suited to organizations with complex needs, multiple stakeholders, and ambitious transformation goals.

You’ll also orchestrate the cross-functional support needed to grow strategic accounts. Working closely with BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, Revenue Operations, Solutions Engineering, Deployment, and Customer Success, you’ll direct resources toward the accounts and opportunities where they can have the greatest impact.

What you’ll do

  • Lead, coach, and grow the Strategic sales team, including hiring, performance management, and day-to-day execution.

  • Own the segment’s ARR plan, forecast, and qualified pipeline. Set clear priorities with the CRO, review progress, and address gaps early.

  • Develop a focused strategy for target accounts, including account plans, senior stakeholder relationships, and a clear view of customer priorities and decision processes.

  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from first conversation through qualification, evaluation, negotiation, close, handoff, and expansion.

  • Coach sellers on executive engagement, value-based selling, multi-threading, commercial strategy, and navigating complex buying groups.

  • Build a consistent, evidence-based strategic sales motion, refining qualification, messaging, and execution based on customer conversations and deal patterns.

  • Bring customer and market learning to Product, making clear recommendations on strategic customer needs, use cases, and opportunities.

  • Set pipeline priorities with BDR and Growth leaders, including targeted outbound and other channels suited to strategic accounts.

  • Partner with Field Marketing to prioritize executive events, campaigns, customer advocacy, and community programs that support strategic pipeline and revenue goals. Work within the marketing leadership’s standards and methods, and ensure programs are well executed and measured.

  • Set direction for how Partnerships can support strategic priorities, working with the Partnerships lead on account access, co-selling, and delivery opportunities.

  • Coordinate with Solutions Engineering, Deployment, Professional Services, and Customer Success to deliver credible evaluations, successful implementations, adoption, and expansion.

  • Share strategic account and market insights with the CRO and other segment leads, helping shape a coherent France go-to-market approach.

What we’re looking for

  • A proven B2B software sales professional who has grown from individual contributor into people leadership, with 5+ years leading sales teams and a hands-on understanding of how to help sellers succeed.

  • Experience leading Strategic or Enterprise sales, including complex, multi-stakeholder deals and relationships with senior executives.

  • A track record of owning a segment or market revenue number end to end, and building pipeline through teams and functions you did not directly manage.

  • Experience making practical decisions about where to focus capacity and budget, including the roles of direct sales, marketing, and partners.

  • Strong judgment in developing account strategies, coaching complex deal execution, and building a reliable forecast.

  • The ability to create a repeatable sales approach without treating every strategic customer as the same.

  • Strong collaboration skills across BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, RevOps, and post-sales teams.

  • High EQ, clear communication, and a supportive but accountable leadership style.

  • Comfort building strategic sales practices in a scaling organization. French fluency and strong working English are important.

What success looks like

The Strategic segment has clear ownership, a focused pipeline, and measurable progress against its ARR goals. The team builds trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders and executes complex sales cycles with discipline. Cross-functional resources are aligned to the accounts and opportunities that matter most, and learning from customers and deals helps Dust sharpen its strategic sales approach in France.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

title: Strategic Supply Partnerships Lead (REMOTE)
descriptionHtml:
REPLUG is a Mobile Revenue Growth partner that helps companies turn mobile into a measurable driver of revenue, customer value, and long-term business growth.

Rather than treating acquisition, retention, measurement and app experience as separate disciplines, we help businesses connect them into a unified growth system that improves commercial performance.

From global app publishers to established brands looking to unlock more value from mobile, we partner with companies that want to grow more efficiently, reduce dependency on saturated acquisition channels and build sustainable growth.

Our work combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution across App Store Optimization, Paid User Acquisition, CRM, measurement and mobile growth consulting.

We're now looking for a Strategic Supply Partnership Lead to grow our performance ads business globally.

Tasks

We’re looking for a Strategic Partnerships Lead to own and develop REPLUG’s performance supply ecosystem.

This is not a traditional account management role, and we are not looking for someone whose experience is limited to managing an existing book of supply partners.

We want someone with a genuine hunter mentality.

You should have a proven track record of identifying, approaching, and onboarding new partners, opening doors through your own network, and creating new commercial opportunities from scratch.

Strong industry relationships matter in this role. We are looking for someone who already understands the key players across the mobile performance ecosystem, knows who is worth speaking to, and can use that network to accelerate REPLUG’s access to new supply.

Just as importantly, you should have strong market intelligence. You should know what is happening across the ecosystem, where new inventory is emerging, which partners are gaining traction, where quality is deteriorating, and where the next meaningful opportunities may come from.

You’ll be responsible for identifying the partners we should work with, building the commercial relationships behind them, negotiating the right conditions and ensuring that those partnerships translate into real growth opportunities for our clients and REPLUG.

You’ll operate at the intersection of partnerships, commercial strategy and performance operations.

Your ecosystem will span OEMs, DSPs, SDK networks, publishers, affiliate partners and other alternative acquisition channels.

You’ll work closely with our performance, operations and sales teams to ensure we have the right supply available to support client growth.

You will report directly to the Performance Ads Lead, while working alongside the founders.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

Build and Grow Our Supply Ecosystem

You’ll continuously develop the network of partners that powers REPLUG’s alternative acquisition offering.

You will:

  • Identify and evaluate new publishers, networks and inventory partners globally.
  • Develop relationships with OEMs, DSPs, SDK networks, affiliates and other performance partners.
  • Own partner onboarding from initial evaluation through activation.
  • Identify gaps in our current supply and proactively develop new opportunities.
  • Build a diversified ecosystem that allows us to scale without becoming overly dependent on individual partners.

Our goal is to build the right ecosystem to scale brands globally.

Own Commercial Partnerships

You’ll manage our supply relationships as commercial partnerships, not simply operational integrations.

This includes:

  • Managing and developing existing partner relationships.
  • Negotiating payouts, pricing models and commercial terms.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve margins and scalability.
  • Exploring exclusive opportunities, preferred access or new inventory.
  • Holding partners accountable for agreed performance, quality and delivery.
  • Understanding when a partnership should be scaled, renegotiated or stopped.

You should be comfortable protecting REPLUG’s commercial interests while maintaining strong long-term relationships.

Connect Supply With Performance

Supply has value only when it delivers results.

You’ll work closely with our internal teams to:

  • Match client campaigns with the most relevant inventory and partners.
  • Support campaign launches and supply activation.
  • Identify new scaling opportunities based on campaign performance.
  • Analyse partner performance across quality, delivery, scalability and economics.
  • Identify supply-side issues that may be limiting campaign performance.
  • Help teams diversify acquisition when existing channels begin to saturate.

You’ll need to understand both sides of the equation: what advertisers need and what partners can realistically deliver.

Protect Quality

Scaling poor-quality inventory isn’t growth.

You’ll help ensure that REPLUG’s supply ecosystem maintains a high standard of performance and transparency.

You’ll monitor and challenge partners around:

  • Traffic quality.
  • Fraud and suspicious activity.
  • Attribution anomalies.
  • Delivery consistency.
  • KPI performance.
  • Scalability.
  • Communication and operational reliability.

When something doesn’t make sense, we expect you to investigate it rather than accept the explanation you’re given.

Help Build REPLUG’s Own Performance Infrastructure

The role also extends beyond third-party partnerships.

You’ll contribute to the development of REPLUG’s own performance ecosystem, including:

  • Managing and optimizing supply operations for our in-house rewarded app ecosystem.
  • Supporting the development of our internal affiliate and network marketplace infrastructure.
  • Identifying opportunities to build more direct supply relationships.
  • Helping define processes, systems and commercial frameworks that make the ecosystem scalable.

This gives you the opportunity to help build infrastructure rather than simply manage existing relationships.

Requirements

We’re looking for someone who understands that successful partnerships sit somewhere between relationships, numbers and execution.

You should have:

  • At least 3-5 years of experience within mobile advertising, AdTech, performance marketing, or affiliate marketing.
  • A solid understanding of the mobile performance ecosystem.
  • Experience working with publishers, networks, DSPs, OEMs, affiliates, SDK traffic or comparable acquisition partners.
  • Strong commercial instincts and confidence negotiating deals.
  • The ability to evaluate a partnership based on performance and business potential, not just relationship quality.
  • Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with performance data and KPIs.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-management skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple partners and initiatives simultaneously.
  • A proactive approach to identifying problems and opportunities.
  • Excellent spoken and written English.

Nice to Have

  • Existing relationships across the mobile advertising ecosystem.
  • Experience managing international publisher or supply partnerships.
  • Experience with rewarded acquisition or offerwall ecosystems.
  • Understanding of attribution, MMPs and mobile measurement.
  • Experience working with performance campaigns on CPI, CPA, ROAS or revenue-based models.
  • Previous experience within a mobile agency, ad network, DSP, affiliate network or app growth company.
  • Additional languages.

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Thinks commercially.
  • Is comfortable negotiating.
  • Follows through.
  • Makes decisions based on evidence.
  • Can operate independently.
  • Understands when to push and when a partnership simply isn’t worth pursuing.
  • Wants to build systems and relationships rather than inherit a static portfolio.

Benefits

Joining REPLUG means you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Lead the supply partnership strategy for ambitious mobile brands.
  • Work alongside mobile growth specialists, driving growth across the whole mobile ecosystem
  • Help shape one of the industry's emerging Mobile Revenue Growth consultancies.
  • Own and influence how we scale our performance ads business
  • Become one of the public faces of REPLUG through conferences, webinars and industry content.
  • Work remotely with flexibility and a high level of ownership.
  • Continue developing through learning, experimentation and industry events.
  • Access monthly health and fitness benefits
  • Access yearly educational budget

descriptionHtml:

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

About the team

We’re building Strategy & Operations in the CEO Office to help Product and Engineering deliver the right work, at pace and with fewer surprises. Product sets what to build and why. Engineering builds it. S&O keeps the full picture in view, brings teams together and helps turn plans into results.

As S&O Lead, you’ll own that work across a product pillar and help raise the bar for how the wider S&O team operates. The impact is visible: what you improve in your pillar can shape how Checkout delivers elsewhere.

The role

This is a high-ownership role. You’ll be accountable alongside the product leader for delivery, but you won’t own the roadmap. You’ll need to earn alignment, challenge commitments and stay close to the work. When priorities collide, you’ll help decide what moves, what waits and what stops.

You will:

  • Keep the pillar’s major initiatives in view. Know what matters, what is slipping and where teams are blocked. Raise risks early and bring a clear point of view.

  • Be a trusted, independent partner to the product leader. Challenge dates and trade-offs, and help agree what to protect, move or stop. Product retains roadmap decisions.

  • Personally lead the pillar’s hardest cross-functional work, from getting teams aligned through to launch.

  • Build and lead the S&O team in your pillar. Hire, develop and manage performance, while setting practical standards that help S&O deliver better across Checkout.

What you'll do

  • Own execution across the pillar. Keep priorities, delivery tempo, progress, dependencies and risks visible. Spot when plans are off track and bring a clear recommendation.

  • Build deep expertise in the pillar’s products: how they work, who they serve and how they make money.

  • Challenge priorities and commitments with the product leader. Recommend what to protect, re-sequence, move or stop. The product leader owns roadmap and commit-date decisions.

  • Personally lead the pillar’s most important cross-functional initiatives, aligning Product, Engineering and partner teams and driving the work through launch to enable faster shipping

  • Lead and develop the S&O team supporting the pillar. People leadership is core to the role, including hiring, development and performance management. Alongside pillar delivery, help shape practical standards adopted across S&O.

What you'll bring

  • You have strong problem solving and analytical skills. You can frame an ambiguous business question, build the analysis yourself, test hypotheses, quantify trade-offs and turn findings into clear business decisions.

  • You move between strategy, hands-on delivery and building the organisation. You personally lead high-impact, cross-functional work and stay accountable through launch and results.

  • You make execution repeatable. You build practical operating mechanisms and use data, automation or AI where they remove recurring friction or help teams scale.

  • You influence without relying on authority. You challenge senior stakeholders constructively, communicate complex issues clearly and bring people to decisions.

  • You raise the performance of others. You set clear expectations, give direct feedback and help people grow. Prior formal line-management experience is helpful, but evidence of leadership matters more.

Strongly preferred:

  • Payments, fintech or regulated money-movement experience would be a real advantage, especially if you’ve worked with licences, regulators, schemes or banking partners. It can help you see risks sooner and get up to speed faster. It isn’t a requirement: strong operators from other sectors can be a great fit.

What this role is not:

  • Not support to the product leader. You own execution across the pillar and need to push back when commitments don’t add up.

  • Not a short-term consulting project. You stay with the work through delivery and build ways of working the team can keep using.

  • Not a product role. Product sets the roadmap. Engineering builds the product. You make sure the pillar executes well.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

title: Strategy & Operations Lead, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About Firstwork

Labour markets are broken. Millions of people are ready to work and can't start. Screening, right-to-work checks, contracts, onboarding and scheduling still run across disconnected systems, with hundreds of manual decisions in between. Firstwork builds AI agents that run frontline workforce operations end to end. We activate hundreds of thousands of workers a month globally for some of the world's largest employers and staffing firms, working forward-deployed inside the customer's operation. Backed by Y Combinator and Gradient (Google’s AI fund), with offices in New York, with London and Dubai opening later this year.

Why this role

A significant part of Firstwork’s growth over the next few years will be determined by how successfully we build the business in Europe. Which markets we enter and in what order, how we price against the incumbents, which partnerships and investors are worth the time, and how the company runs once it is spread across two continents. Those decisions sit with the CEO, and this role sits next to him and the Chief of Staff.

You work in the Office of the CEO alongside the Chief of Staff, and you own the European half of the agenda. That covers the market entry plan and the work of actually executing it, board and investor material, the relationships with private equity firms and their portfolio companies that drive our largest deals, and the strategic projects that have no owner yet. One week that looks like a pricing model. The next it looks like being in a major city getting an entity live and a first customer signed.

You will learn how a company really works, quickly, and then get handed a piece of it to run.

What you'll do

  • Own the European market entry plan, from sequencing and targets through to entity setup and first customers

  • Build board, investor and strategic partner material with the CEO and Chief of Staff

  • Support the private equity relationships and the pipeline running through their portfolio companies, including the preparation and the follow-through

  • Run pricing, packaging and competitive analysis for the region

  • Set the operating cadence for the European team, meaning planning, metrics and the weekly rhythm

  • Localise go-to-market with Sales, Marketing and Product, covering messaging, contracts and how we position on compliance

  • Pick up the projects the Office of the CEO needs done properly and nobody owns

What we're looking for

  • Four to eight years in tier one strategy consulting, investment banking, private equity, or a strategy role inside a company growing fast

  • The ability to take an ambiguous question, build the model behind it, and write the two pages the board will actually read

  • Enough range to be useful to a PE partner, a CFO and a Head of Operations in the same conversation

  • A bias to finishing. Getting the entity live counts. Writing the recommendation doesn't

  • Experience across more than one European market, and a European language beyond English

  • A habit of reaching for AI and automation before spreadsheets and headcount

If you want the closest available seat while a company goes from one continent to two, this is the job.

Firstwork is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

This summer, for the first time, Alan is bringing in a cohort of interns for a 3-month internship, from June to August. This program is for students whose curriculum includes a summer internship.

This is not a "watch and learn" internship. Past interns and Founders Associates have shipped work that teams still use after they left:

  • An AI tool searching the web for fake documents used in insurance fraud. The findings started a fraud-prevention pilot with a major French insurer.

  • An automated system approving simple medical claims in one of Alan's international markets, with no manual review.

  • An AI agent for sales reps. Cuts prep time before every prospect meeting with a personalized meeting brief and pitch.

  • A national health insurance bid. It led to a new local company and its first General Manager hire.

  • Launched a new insurance product, from the regulator application to in-app design and customer support. Took the product from idea to a regulator-ready launch.

  • A public AI healthcare hackathon co-hosted with Mistral. Brought together top AI builders, with €10K+ in prizes and credits for the winners.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

Compensation: €2.8K per month

descriptionHtml:
About Kuoni Tumlare

At Kuoni Tumlare, we deliver truly inspiring and innovative solutions and experiences that create value both for our Partners and Society at large. Our wide portfolio of products and solutions is built on 100+ years of destination management experience.

Our solutions include series tours, technical visits, educational tours, Japanspecialist travel consulting, as well as meetings, incentives, conferences, and exhibitions. Our product portfolio includes MyBus excursions at destinations as well as guaranteed departure tours devised and delivered by our Seat-in-Coach specialists, Europamundo (EMV) and MyBus Landcruise.

We cater to a wide range of customer needs in close collaboration with our trusted suppliers and powered by our team of destinations experts - enabling us to make a real difference to the world.

About the Business

Our Destination Management services form the core of our business. Together with our destination experts, our sales and account management teams generate business by partnering with our customers (Tour Operators, Travel Agencies) to shape exciting itineraries suited to their traveler’s needs. We take care of everything from ground support, hotel bookings, sightseeing, restaurants, and local guides; all while providing 24/7 customer support so that travelers from over 50 countries can enjoy memorable travel experiences worry free.

About the Role

Our Customer Service Supervisor is responsible for overseeing and leading the Customer Service (CS) team dedicated with delivering exceptional service to customers from Japan travelling into Switzerland. It is a crucial role in the operational management of the CS department, ensuring that quality standards and customer satisfaction goals are met, if not exceeded. The role involves being a leader capable of motivating, training, and guiding the team members to optimize their performance and maintain a high level of service.

Additionally, the role holder will be responsible for managing employee HR-related and operations tasks, organizing staff training and developing relationships with clients. Key Activities

The role holder intervenes in solving complex problems, providing support and solutions to delicate situations encountered by their team members. The role also involves close communication with other departments to ensure consistency in processes and information shared with customers. In summary, our Customer Service Supervisor embodies the essential link between the company and its customers, ensuring that each interaction is a positive and satisfying experience for both parties.

title: Supplier Quality Engineer - London
descriptionHtml:
About Isembard

Isembard is building a network of high-performance factories for critical industries. We combine advanced machine tools, robotics and our own software, MasonOS, to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and frontier technology companies, with factories across the UK, US, Germany and France. Our mission is to forge industrial acceleration.

The role

Our parts depend on materials, components and special processes from outside suppliers, and the network can only grow as fast as that supplier base can be trusted.

The Supplier Quality Engineer develops and maintains a capable, aerospace-ready supplier base across Isembard's network, from qualification and risk assessment to performance monitoring and corrective action. It is a central role working with procurement, supply chain, engineering and site quality teams, with the independence to raise concerns and escalate risk without compromising conformity.

What you'll do

  • Lead supplier qualification and approval: capability assessments, risk-based audits and approved-supplier recommendations.

  • Define supplier quality requirements, including material certification, conformity documentation, flow-down clauses and special-process approvals.

  • Monitor supplier performance and prioritise improvement by risk.

  • Own supplier nonconformance investigations, containment and corrective action, and check the fix worked.

  • Support receiving and source inspection and first article inspection (AS9102 where applicable).

What we're looking for

  • Four or more years in supplier quality, manufacturing quality or quality engineering in precision or regulated production.

  • Working knowledge of AS9100 / EN 9100 or ISO 9001 requirements for external providers, traceability and corrective action.

  • Experience running supplier assessments or audits.

  • Practical root cause analysis and corrective action.

  • Confidence with drawings, specifications, tolerances and certification requirements.

Nice to have

  • Aerospace, defence, CNC machining or high-mix precision manufacturing.

  • NADCAP special processes and raw-material traceability.

  • CMM inspection, GD&T, MSA or SPC.

  • Lead auditor or comparable quality credentials.

Why Isembard

  • Shape the quality and capability of a growing supplier network.

  • Build quality systems that work in practice, with a direct effect on delivery and customer confidence.

Location: On-site at our Southwark factory in London, with travel to suppliers and Isembard sites.

title: Supply Chain & Analytics Projects - Mid-Level (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Only about 1% of our applicants end up in the offer stage. To increase your chances, give yourself a competitive edge and come fully prepared!

In a nutshell

As we are building the best milkman on earth, we are looking for sharp minds that can help us further shape Picnic as we expand across Europe. We are looking for experienced hires with a background in top strategy consulting, private equity, investment banking, e-commerce or commercial roles, that can tackle challenges and growth opportunities at Picnic.

Tricks of the trade

  • Lead with ambition: Bring your relentless determination, creativity, and grit. Take the driver’s seat and redefine the grocery shopping experience for millions. You will be expected to think independently, move fast, and deliver results.
  • Steep learning curve: Your growth comes from owning real problems, testing your ideas, learning from your mistakes and starting again. You'll move at a pace that accelerates your growth like nowhere else.
  • Solve real-life puzzles: Spot opportunities, use tools at the forefront of technology, and own the outcome end to end. Not just making slides, but building the solution yourself.
  • Innovate across borders: You’ll collaborate with teams across the Netherlands, Germany, and France, tackling challenges that redefine how Picnic operates at a European scale.
  • High-performance environment: You’ll work alongside some of the best teams in analytics and tech, people who set a high bar and expect you to do the same.

Your superpowers

  • Master’s degree in Econometrics, Engineering, Finance, Math or an equivalent quantitative study
  • 2-5 years of work experience in top tier management consulting, PE, investment banking, retail topics and hands-on deal experience
  • Out-of-the-box thinking and initiative: hands-on, nothing-is-impossible mindset
  • Strong communication skills in German and English, allowing you to explain complex analytical concepts in a simple and practical way
  • Proficient with SQL and Python or excited to learn

Picnic Perks 

🏆 Rewarding Impact from Day One

You’ll receive an attractive compensation package, designed to reward your ambition, drive, and the direct impact you’ll make from your very first project.

🍎Learning & development 

You'll always have something to learn with us! You’ll benefit from opportunities like Lepaya training for polishing soft skills or Picnic Tech Academy training in case you want to learn new skills other than what you already know. We also offer free access to trained psychologists via our OpenUp partner, and German language classes if you’d like to get your experience in Germany to the next level. 

🗺️Relocation

If you’re moving from another country to join Picnic we make it as smooth as possible for you. We’ll cover your flight costs and a first month's accommodation. 

 🥗Fresh Lunch, coffee, and snacks 

Our offices are equipped with fully-fledged coffee bars and a kitchen. We get delicious fresh and warm lunches every day so you can keep your energy up.

⛳All the rest 

At Picnic you get 30 holidays, we cover your travel expenses and offer a pension plan. And your phone and laptop are on us, of course.

FAQ

Which team will I join?

At Picnic, we build almost everything in-house. This means that we have plenty of opportunities for you in terms of project topics. Your interest lies in consumer topics like pricing, assortment, customer life time value? Or rather in logistics, supply chain, automated warehousing areas? Or you'd love going adventurous into new areas as long as you're solving real world problems? Let's talk and figure it out where there's the best match.  

What are the long term opportunities for this role? What happens after I'm done with a project?

You get full accountability from the start: from shaping the strategy and driving step-change improvements, to collaborating with multiple teams to achieve tangible business results.

At Picnic, the long-term opportunity isn't just a role—it’s a platform to shape your own career trajectory with real ownership, business impact, and fast growth. Hence the career paths are as diverse as your ambitions. Depending on your interests and strengths, these are most common career paths we’ve seen so far:

  • Given our scale-up environment, many projects tend to grow in scope and complexity under your responsibility and you naturally grow a team around you in order to take your project to a next level.
  • As you grow, you’ll deepen your understanding of the business, build a strong internal network, and prove your ability to lead impactful projects. Once you feel you’ve learned everything in your scope and your projects have been successfully implemented, you can switch to complete different areas of Picnic. We have numerous colleagues that have switched from Commercial to Fulfillment, or from Distribution to Customer and many other examples.

In what language should I apply?

Please send your application in English.

title: Supply Chain Lead - London
descriptionHtml:
About Isembard

Isembard is building a network of high-performance factories for critical industries. We combine advanced machine tools, robotics and our own software, MasonOS, to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and frontier technology companies, with factories across the UK, US, Germany and France. Our mission is to forge industrial acceleration.

The role

We are looking for a hands-on Supply Chain Lead to own day-to-day supply chain execution in the UK and to develop the supplier base our network depends on.

You will connect purchasing, material planning, supplier delivery, outside processing and factory priorities so the team can deliver on customer commitments. It is a working leadership role: you solve urgent supply issues, set clear routines and keep aerospace-level discipline without unnecessary bureaucracy.

What you'll do

  • Lead daily procurement and material readiness: prioritise purchasing, resolve shortages and align supply with the production schedule.

  • Own supplier delivery: confirm orders, track milestones, expedite at-risk material and recover before customer delivery is affected.

  • Coordinate purchasing of aerospace-grade raw material, tooling, components and outside processes such as heat treatment, anodising, plating and coating.

  • Make sure purchase orders flow down drawings, revisions, specifications, quality clauses, certifications and traceability requirements.

  • Develop the supplier base, including subcontract manufacturing partners: find gaps in capability, capacity and coverage, reduce single-source dependencies and bring on qualified new sources with Supplier Quality.

What we're looking for

  • Five or more years in supply chain, purchasing or materials management in manufacturing.

  • Proven ability to manage suppliers, shortages and competing production demands.

  • Working knowledge of manufacturing drawings, material specifications, outside processing and technical purchase order requirements.

  • Familiarity with ISO 9001, AS9100 / EN 9100 or a comparable quality system, including traceability and certification requirements.

  • Experience with ERP/MRP systems and supplier performance tracking.

Nice to have

  • Aerospace, defence or precision CNC machining.

  • Aerospace materials, special processes and NADCAP.

  • Exposure to AS9120, DFARS, ITAR or EAR.

  • CIPS or a related qualification.

Why Isembard

  • Shape how supply chain execution works at a fast-growing precision manufacturer.

  • Visible impact on factory performance and customer delivery.

  • Competitive salary and equity.

title: Support Engineer (EMEA)
descriptionHtml:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Your main goal as a front line Support engineer will be to help n8n scale exceptional customer support by solving everyday customer challenges and automating repetitive requests, ensuring we deliver a great experience as our customer base grows.

You'll make this happen by combining hands-on customer support with smart automation and close collaboration across teams:

Deliver Outstanding Customer Support

  • Own and resolve helpdesk tickets for non-enterprise customers, representing approximately 65% of your time.

  • Initially focus on non-technical questions related to account management, account access, plans, subscriptions, and billing.

  • Provide clear, helpful, and timely responses that solve customer problems while gradually expanding your expertise into more technical topics.

Automate and Scale Support Operations

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive, non-technical ticket categories and reduce manual support work.

  • Build and improve automations that help Team Delta handle growing ticket volumes efficiently without compromising the customer experience.

  • Continuously spot opportunities to streamline support workflows and make it easier for customers to get the answers they need.

Strengthen Product Alignment and Knowledge Sharing

  • Collaborate with Product to share recurring customer questions, highlight friction points, and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Create and maintain documentation that enables customers to self-serve and helps the team resolve common issues more efficiently.

  • Participate in team meetings and cross-functional discussions to share insights, align on priorities, and improve the support experience.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • Technical Support Expertise: You have 3+ years in technical support, solutions engineering, or similar roles

  • n8n Experience: You have hands-on experience building and debugging n8n workflows in production environments

  • APIs & Integrations: You’re comfortable debugging APIs, webhooks, authentication, and data flows

  • Cloud & Infrastructure: You’re familiar with AWS, GCP, or Azure and have basic Linux fundamentals for troubleshooting

  • Networking & Databases: You understand networking basics (DNS, SSL/TLS, HTTP/HTTPS)

  • Communication: You explain technical issues clearly and document troubleshooting steps effectively

  • Containerization: You can work with Docker or Kubernetes to deploy and debug automation environments

  • Knowledge Sharing: You actively share knowledge and best practices with teammates, whether through team discussions, presentations, documentation, or contributions to internal playbooks and tools.

Nice-to-haves

  • Automation & AI Mindset: You have a basic understanding of AI concepts and a passion for automation, with some hands-on experience using tools like n8n, Zapier, Make, or Airflow to simplify tasks and improve workflows.

  • Observability: Familiarity with tools like Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, or Sentry

  • Authentication Protocols: Knowledge of OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, or JWT flows

  • JavaScript: You have a working knowledge of JavaScript, including reading and debugging code, working with JSON data, and making small code changes to troubleshoot workflows and integrations.

  • SQL & Databases: You have a foundational understanding of relational databases, such as PostgreSQL, including tables, relationships, and basic SQL queries to investigate and troubleshoot issues.

Why join us?

At n8n, you'll do more than answer support tickets. You'll play a key role in helping us scale our customer support operations, shaping how we use automation to resolve common issues and creating a better experience for our growing customer base. You'll have the opportunity to make a tangible impact on Team Delta's efficiency, collaborate closely with Product, and progressively deepen your technical expertise.

You'll join one of Europe's fastest-growing startups, working with a supportive, remote-first team that values autonomy, experimentation, and continuous improvement.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

  • Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

Als Support-Mitarbeiter:in bist du bei Anwendungsfragen die erste Ansprechperson

Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie gute

title: Support Operations Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Job title: Support Operations Analyst

Reporting to: Support Lead

Location: Remote (UK based)

Are you curious, analytical, and eager to grow in the world of SaaS and AI?

Aveni is an award-winning technology company. We use advanced AI to enable scalable efficiency for financial services companies, combining world-leading Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Large Language Model (LLM) expertise with deep financial services domain experience to drive enterprise-wide productivity. Aveni harnesses the power of voice to drive unprecedented efficiency and oversight. We’re using the latest in AI to automate and innovate, empowering businesses to achieve exceptional productivity and compliance outcomes.

We’re looking for a Support Operations Analyst to help us scale how customer support works through AI, automation, knowledge and strong operational processes. A core part of the role will be owning and improving our AI support experience: increasing the proportion of customer requests resolved through AI and self-service, continuously improving the content and workflows that power it, and using conversation data to identify new opportunities for automation. You’ll stay close to customers by providing second-line support when needed, while also improving our knowledge, incident and problem management practices.

About the Role

As a Support Operations Analyst, your primary focus will be making Support more scalable, proactive and effective. You’ll take day-to-day ownership of optimising our AI support agent, Intercom Fin, using performance data and conversation reviews to improve involvement, resolution and deflection. You’ll author and test AI content, tune workflows and routing, identify knowledge and automation gaps, and implement improvements that allow more customers to get the right answer without needing a human response. Alongside this, you’ll own key parts of our customer-facing knowledge and Support operations, help ensure we’re ready for product launches, coordinate customer-impacting incidents and recurring product issues, and provide second-line customer support where human investigation is required.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Second-line Customer Support – Provide hands-on support for customer requests that require human investigation or cannot be resolved through AI or self-service. Troubleshoot issues, communicate clearly with customers and use these conversations to identify opportunities to improve Fin, documentation or product experience.

  • Incident & Problem Management – Act as a Support point of contact during customer-impacting incidents: triage and escalate high-priority issues, coordinate with Engineering, maintain clear stakeholder and customer communications, and contribute recommendations that improve the process. For lower-impact bugs and recurring problems, work with Product and Engineering to maintain visibility and help ensure a healthy level of customer-impacting issues is picked up through sprint planning.

  • Technical Investigation – Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues, gather the right evidence and work confidently with Product and Engineering when deeper investigation is required.

  • Product Knowledge – Develop a strong understanding of Aveni’s products to support users effectively and confidently.

  • Launch & Cross-functional Collaboration – Work with Product, Marketing, Training & Enablement and Engineering to ensure Help Centre and Intercom content is accurate, and that customer documentation and Support readiness are in place for new features and product launches.

  • AI Support Optimisation – Take day-to-day ownership of optimising our AI customer support experience. At Aveni we use Intercom Fin, but experience with Zendesk AI or similar platforms is equally relevant. Author, test and continuously improve the content and instructions that power Fin; tune workflows, routing and hand-off paths; review customer conversations to identify new deflection and automation opportunities; and implement improvements that allow more requests to be resolved before reaching the Support team. Own regular reporting on AI involvement, resolution and deflection rates, using the data to identify trends, prioritise experiments and demonstrate the impact of changes.

  • Knowledge Management – Maintain and improve Help Centre content, FAQs and internal Support guidance, ensuring AI and human agents have accurate, useful knowledge to work from. Identify documentation gaps through conversation reviews, support trends and AI performance, and work with Product, Marketing and Training & Enablement to close them.

What We’re Looking For

  • A strong interest in technology, SaaS, and AI.

  • Solid problem-solving skills with a proactive, solutions-focused mindset.

  • Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts in simple terms.

  • Experience in a customer-facing or technical support role, ideally within B2B SaaS, with confidence owning customer issues from first contact through to resolution or escalation.

  • Hands-on experience optimising AI customer support platforms such as Intercom Fin, Zendesk AI or similar. We’re looking for evidence that you have actively improved how an AI agent performs — for example by authoring and testing content, tuning workflows or routing, reviewing conversations for deflection opportunities, and using involvement, resolution or deflection reporting to drive measurable improvements. Direct Fin experience isn't essential; the track record matters more than the platform.

  • Experience maintaining customer-facing knowledge bases or Help Centres and turning support trends into clear, useful documentation.

  • A collaborative team player who is comfortable working both remotely and independently.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in a B2B SaaS or fintech environment, particularly supporting complex or regulated customers.

  • Experience designing or running experiments to improve AI agents, automation or self-service journeys in a customer support environment.

  • Experience using support and AI metrics such as SLA, CSAT, involvement, resolution and escalation trends to identify and prioritise improvements.

  • Experience with incident and problem management practices, including escalation, stakeholder communication, root cause analysis and continuous improvement.

  • Experience working with Product and Engineering during high-priority incidents and managing lower-impact bugs through a backlog or sprint-based development process.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • A collaborative and innovative work environment with career growth opportunities

  • 34 days holiday plus your birthday off (inclusive of bank holidays)

  • Share options – we believe in shared success

  • Skills development – continuous learning is at our core, expect the development to be front and centre of everything you do

  • Remote and flexible working – remote, co-working spaces, or a mix of both

  • Life insurance, income protection and private health care

  • Freebies and discounts at a range of retailers

  • Emotional wellbeing (Employee assistance programme provides access to 24/7 employee counselling and emotional support)

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Pension scheme (employer contribution matched up to 5%)

Join Us in Making a Difference

At Aveni, we believe that diversity drives innovation. We're committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities we serve and creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best work. If you're passionate about leveraging technology to drive positive change and want to be part of a team that's shaping the future of financial services, we'd love to hear from you. We know that some people are likely to only apply where they meet 100% of requirements, but we’d like to hear from you anyway.

Apply now to join us on our mission to transform the financial services industry through AI.

title: Sustainability solutions consultant (french & german speaking)
descriptionHtml:
About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

We're looking for more early members to join our Sustainability solutions team! You may be a fit for this role if you’re excited to help Europe's largest companies deliver real decarbonisation, navigate an increasingly complex landscape of investor pressure, customer expectations and regulatory requirements. You’re willing to roll your sleeves up and go deep with prospective customers on their functional and technical needs, partnering with our sales, product and climate science teams along the way. You may be a carbon accounting aficionado or you may have never worked in climate before but have a passion for the subject; either way, you have a knack for quickly learning new, complex topics and distilling them for others.


You will:

  • Partner closely with 3-4 Account Executives, to analyse and understand customers’ businesses, climate ambitions and software needs

  • Become a trusted advisor to our prospective customers—educating them about corporate climate commitments, carbon accounting, regulation/policy and the Watershed offering

  • Build and share subject matter expertise on how the world’s largest companies can run successful climate programs

  • Demonstrate Watershed’s unique value to prospective customers, through product demonstrations, ROI analysis and customer stories

  • Creatively apply the Agentic AI capabilities of the Watershed platform to address innovative use cases

  • Scope complex customer engagements as Watershed expands to new industries

  • Interface with Customer Success and Sustainability Advisory teams to ensure smooth handovers from pre- to post-contract

  • Collaborate with Watershed’s Engineering, Product and Marketing teams to continuously improve Watershed’s products and positioning

  • It is a mandatory requirement to have business level French and German for this role

You might be a fit if you:

  • Have worked in a Solutions Consulting or Sales Engineering role for an Enterprise SaaS company

  • Have partnered with Account Executives to scope successful engagements with mid-sized to large companies

  • Master new concepts and technologies quickly

  • Have exceptional communication and presentation skills; can engage deeply with both technical and business executive audiences

  • Get energy from working across multiple projects concurrently and wearing many hats

  • Are passionate about decarbonising diverse industries, from aviation to manufacturing to cloud computing

  • Are excited to join a startup and are ready to take responsibility defining a new standard for climate and Sustainability AI programs around the world!

Considered a “very nice to have” if you:

  • Have a background in corporate climate programs or carbon accounting

  • Have policy experience, especially in climate/sustainability/corporate reporting

This role might include up to 25% travel.

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

title: SW Team Lead
descriptionHtml:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles.

The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance.

Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders.

Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work.

 

What you’ll do

As Software Team Lead, you'll coordinate the efforts of the software team across the stack, driving performance optimization, deploying pilot and prototype stacks to grow the developer base, and ensuring alignment between client specifications and deliverables. You'll build and mentor a growing team while staying hands-on with code, architecture, and performance yourself, working closely with chip architects and hardware teams during early silicon bring-up.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong background in systems software for AI/ML accelerators, GPUs, CPUs, or other high-performance compute platforms.

  • Solid understanding of computer architecture, memory systems, parallel computing, and hardware-software interaction.

  • Proven ability to lead small engineering teams while retaining significant individual contribution.

  • Strong C/C++ programming skills.

  • Experience with Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, ONNX, TensorRT, etc.) is highly desirable.

  • Strong communication and project ownership skills, including translating client requirements into technical scope, deliverables, and realistic timelines.

  • Strong background in testing and deployment infrastructure for large-scale software projects.

  • Language: English at a proficient level.

Responsibilities

  • Own and drive the software stack for AI accelerator products, balancing speed of execution with long-term technical foundations.

  • Work closely with chip architecture and hardware teams on hardware–software co-design and early silicon bring-up.

  • Lead development across kernel libraries, runtimes, drivers, firmware, and developer tooling as needed.

  • Optimize key AI workloads for performance, efficiency, memory usage, and reliability on emerging hardware.

  • Stay hands-on with architecture, coding, debugging, reviews, and performance analysis while mentoring a growing team.

  • Partner directly with clients to understand technical requirements, translate them into clear team deliverables, and align scope, priorities, and timelines.

title: System Engineer (ISOS Host)
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

Our Future Projects unit is dedicated to expanding and complementing these capabilities by conceptualizing and pre-developing new technologies, products and programs.

We want you as a talented systems engineer to help us in our mission by conceptualizing new technologies and products, characterizing stakeholders and use cases, translating these needs into system architectures, breaking them down into functional, specification and product trees, define and manage requirements and interfaces, and support technical trade-offs with a cross-functional engineering team. You will be part of the Future Projects Team working on the development of a robotic orbital station aiming at supporting the In Space Operations and Services eco-system, unlocking the resupply of servicers in satellites parts and propellant, and performing complexe robotic-assisted in-orbit experiments.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as a System Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include:

  • Perform the System Engineering tasks, including, but not limited to the tasks below:

    • Perform trade-offs and technical investigations at system level.

    • Define system-level requirements and ensure flow down and consistency of lower-level requirements.

    • Define the functional breakdown of the system.

    • Contribute to the development plan.

    • Contribute to the coordination of technical tasks of the different specialist engineers within a project, ensuring links between schedule and tasks.

    • Contribute to the co-engineering sessions between the engineering team and potential external partners (setup the agenda, coordinate priorities, take decisions, take the MoM, track the actions).

    • Create and maintain the technical budgets (mass, power, etc.).

    • Support the organization of technical reviews with the customer (in coordination with the team responsible), in terms of datapack definition and delivery, and RIDs management.

What we would love to see from you

In the role of Future projects System Engineer ideally, you will have the following:

  • Advanced degree (MSc) in aerospace engineering, systems engineering, or another related field.

  • 3+ years of experience in the aerospace industry, preferably in a launch system program

  • Experience in early development phase (Phase 0/A/B) project work and systems engineering

  • Good knowledge in programming (Python, Fortran, Matlab...).

  • Fluent in English. German, French and Italian is an asset.

Skills and Behaviors:

  • Strong oral and written communication skills.

  • Strong analysis and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong organizing and prioritization of tasks.

  • Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done.

  • Ability to communicate at all levels of the business.

  • Demonstrates behaviors consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Vision, Competence, Integrity and Passion.

  • Space enthusiast: ready to change the European space industry.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.

title: System Test Engineer
descriptionHtml:

This role sits at the centre of how Salience Labs takes our photonic switching technology from prototype to reliable deployment in AI networks. You will define, build and operate our system test capability, covering complex opto-electronic setups, automation and structured test execution.

We need someone with a clear, organised and outcome driven approach, able to design test strategies from first principles and communicate progress with data led clarity.

Success requires strong technical depth, solid operational discipline and the ability to work quickly and precisely in a lab environment. You will shape how we validate our switching hardware, ensure test readiness at each milestone and remove bottlenecks through smart automation and process improvement.

✎ What you'll be doing

  • Help design and implement the system level test strategy for Salience’s photonic switching platform, covering test planning, setup definition, execution and reporting.

  • Build and maintain complex optical and electronic measurement setups with strong attention to stability, repeatability and safety.

  • Automate test sequences and data capture pipelines to minimise manual overhead and accelerate learning cycles.

  • Develop and communicate a clear view of test readiness, critical paths and parallelisable work.

  • Create plans, timelines and prioritisation frameworks that reflect real engineering constraints.

  • Help shape and lead the function with competence, judgement and reliability, even before any formal line management is introduced.

  • Strong experience working hands on in lab environments involving complex optical, photonic or mixed signal electronic setups.

  • Ability to plan rigorously, track progress, think in parallel and flag risks early.

  • A background that may include photonics, optics, MEMS, mixed signal electronics, semiconductor test or high-speed transceiver validation.

  • Experience with automated test frameworks, scripting for test automation and data analysis tooling.
