title: Triage audicien - Drachten, Friesland
descriptionHtml:
Bouw mee aan hoogwaardige hoorzorg binnen een zelfstandige optiekwinkel

Ben jij audicien en wil je méér dan alleen hoortoestellen aanpassen? Zoek je een plek waar je de tijd krijgt voor je klant, kwaliteit vooropstaat en je tegelijkertijd de ruimte krijgt om mee te bouwen aan een succesvolle audiotak?

Dan is dit misschien wel jouw volgende stap.

Premium hoorzorg, zoals het bedoeld is

Binnen onze zelfstandige optiekwinkels staat persoonlijke aandacht centraal. Onze klanten kennen ons vanwege onze deskundigheid, kwaliteit en service. Diezelfde benadering willen we verder uitbouwen binnen horen.

Daarom zoeken we een audicien die samen met ons wil bouwen aan een sterke audiotak. Afhankelijk van de situatie gaat het om het verder ontwikkelen van een bestaande klantenkring of het opbouwen van een nieuwe activiteit binnen een winkel waar al een vertrouwde klantenbasis aanwezig is.

Je krijgt daarbij de ruimte om je vak uit te oefenen zoals jij vindt dat goede hoorzorg hoort te zijn: met tijd voor de klant, persoonlijke aandacht en premium hooroplossingen.

Wat maakt deze functie anders?

Je werkt in een professionele, persoonlijke omgeving waar niet de snelle verkoop, maar de beste oplossing voor de klant centraal staat.

Je kunt rekenen op:

· Premium hooroplossingen

· Ruim voldoende tijd en aandacht voor iedere klant

· Een bestaand klantenbestand vanuit de optiek

· Warme leads via onze partner Audibene

· Professionele ondersteuning en coaching vanuit de organisatie

· Ruimte voor jouw ideeën en vakmanschap

· De kans om daadwerkelijk mee te bouwen aan de audiotak

· Dagen en uren in overleg, met aandacht voor een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé

Voor wie is dit een mooie stap?

Misschien werk je nu bij een grotere keten en zoek je meer persoonlijke aandacht, vrijheid en betrokkenheid. Of je bent toe aan een omgeving waarin je niet alleen audicien bent, maar ook kunt meedenken over hoe we de beste hoorzorg voor onze klanten organiseren.

Ruime ervaring is voor ons niet het belangrijkste. Veel belangrijker is dat je passie hebt voor horen én voor mensen.

Je bent iemand die kwaliteit belangrijk vindt, graag persoonlijk contact heeft met klanten en energie krijgt van samen iets moois opbouwen. Je wilt onderdeel zijn van een professioneel en kundig team, maar vindt het tegelijkertijd leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor je eigen vakgebied.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Een zelfstandige functie met veel ruimte voor vakmanschap en persoonlijke aandacht, maar mét een professioneel team en organisatie achter je.

Geen omgeving waarin iedere minuut wordt gestuurd door targets en agenda’s, maar een plek waar we geloven dat tevreden klanten en goede hoorzorg de basis zijn voor duurzaam succes.

En minstens zo belangrijk: werk moet passen bij je leven. Daarom bespreken we graag samen welke dagen en uren het beste aansluiten. Of je nu een aantal dagen per week wilt werken of juist een volgende stap zoekt met meer verantwoordelijkheid: we kijken vooral naar wat bij elkaar past.

Zin om samen iets moois op te bouwen?

Ben jij audicien en spreekt de combinatie van kwaliteit, persoonlijke aandacht, vrijheid en bouwen je aan?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Ook als je nog niet jarenlang ervaring hebt, maar wel gepassioneerd bent over het vak, nodigen we je van harte uit om te reageren.

title: Trust Communications
descriptionHtml:
TL;DR

Millions of people build on Lovable, from software that runs new businesses to the tools that power existing ones. At the center of it all is trust. That’s why we’re looking for an exceptional storyteller to spearhead Lovable’s trust, safety, and security communications efforts.

Why Lovable

For decades, the ability to build software belonged to a tiny fraction of the population: the people with the credentials, the technical training, the access. Everyone else had to wait, or pay, or give up. Lovable is the counterargument: We exist for the people with ideas who were locked out of software creation until now.

Over 70 million projects have been built on the platform. Hundreds of thousands of people pay for it. The product handles real infrastructure, not only prototypes: authentication, databases, payments, and deployment. People run real businesses on Lovable, which means the stakes are real too.

The comms challenge: when anyone can build, the platform has to be safe for everyone who does, and they need to know it. That takes someone who can tell the story of how we think about topics like safety, security, and reliability before anyone asks, and who can be honest, precise, and fast when the questions come up anyway.

What you’ll do

Build and own Lovable’s trust narrative. You’ll own Lovable’s trust narrative in earned, new, and owned media, proactively telling the story of how we think about security, privacy, and safety. You’ll shape the stories that highlight our commitments and ensure we show up in the conversations where trust in AI platforms is being decided right now.

Be the comms partner to our security and trust leadership. You’ll develop and own the spokesperson platforms for our CISO and other senior leaders who speak on our trust efforts, identifying and preparing them for on-stage and media opportunities. You’ll help them become recognized voices on topics of trust in AI software creation.

Own incident communications, end to end. When something doesn’t go as planned, you’re the incident comms lead who ensures clear and swift communications for every audience that needs to hear from us, including media, customers, and employees. You’ll build and run the playbook that lets us move faster each time.

Build relationships with relevant media and creators. You’ll know the voices who matter most in telling our trust story, and you’ll make sure those relationships exist before we need them.

Who you are

You’ve done trust, safety, or security communications. You have proven comms experience across a variety of trust-related topics, from AI safety to security. You’ve worked on or alongside security, privacy, or trust and safety teams.

You have real incident experience. You’ve been the incident comms lead more than once, and you’ve probably written a playbook along the way. You bring the attention to detail, precision, speed, and judgment an incident requires.

You have strong media relationships in the tech and AI ecosystem. Security and trust reporters, analysts, policy-adjacent media, perhaps even researchers. You know who they are, what they care about, and how to earn their attention honestly.

You’re voraciously curious. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you need to be willing to understand how a platform like ours works well enough to describe an incident accurately and explain a safety decision without hand-waving.

You write clearly and have keen attention to detail. Your writing is precise, human, and accessible, even when the subject matter is complex or the situation is sensitive. You also catch things others may miss.

You’re calm, hands-on, and low-ego. You’ll draft the statements, build the media list, prep the spokesperson, and coordinate across teams yourself. You thrive in environments where the plan often changes and the pace is relentless.

You have 6+ years of experience in communications, with significant time spent on trust and safety, security, or incident communications at a technology company. We care more about the right years than the number of them: judgment under pressure matters more than tenure.

What you need to know

This is a strategic but hands-on role with both proactive and reactive components. That means you’ll need to be comfortable being the person who’s on call when something breaks, while simultaneously leading the charge on work that moves our trust narrative forward. The role itself lives at the intersection of several functions, and you’ll be the one finding the red thread among all that’s happening so we can tell a cohesive story externally.

Lovable is a European company with a global audience. The trust story has to resonate outside of Silicon Valley and our home turf in Stockholm. Wherever you sit, you’ll work across time zones and build relationships with the teams whose work you’re talking about.

Finally: joining Lovable Comms means you’re deeply curious, data-driven, and not extremely precious about role boundaries. You find ways to work smarter with AI, to measure what matters, and to step into work that isn’t technically “yours” when the moment calls for it.

title: UAV / Robotics Integration Field Engineer - Hardware
descriptionHtml:
🚀 Join SE3 Labs as (Senior) UAV / Robotics Integration Field Engineer - Hardware

Be the person who makes advanced autonomous systems work in the real world. Move across the full stack: drones, sensors, calibration, autonomy software, perception, networking, payloads, field operations, and partner environments. When the system is not mission-ready, you create clarity, find the root cause, and help make it robust.

 

About SE3

SE3 Labs is building Spatial AI by combining 3D computer vision with large language models. We believe the ability to reason about and act within physical space is foundational to unlocking the next generation of automation, from construction to smart infrastructure, and ultimately, defence.

Now, we’re bringing Spatial AI into the sky through high-performance UAVs that can perceive, localize, coordinate, and act in the real world. This requires more than strong algorithms and good hardware. It requires systems that can be configured, calibrated, tested, deployed, demonstrated, debugged, and improved under real field conditions.

We’re looking for a hands-on engineer who wants to work close to the product, close to the field, and close to the full autonomy stack. Someone who is not limited to one layer, but follows the problem wherever it leads.

 

About the Role

As (Senior) UAV / Robotics Integration Engineer, you will be the part of SE3’s engineering team to bring our technology into real-world use. You will bring together UAVs, payloads, sensors, onboard compute, autonomy software, operator tools, and partner environments into systems that are ready to fly, test, demonstrate, and deploy.

This is a highly hands-on, end-to-end prototyping and field engineering role. You will work directly with other startups, prime contractors, and military institutions, translating their requirements into practical mechanical and electrical designs building on our existing technology. When something is not working, you go where the evidence leads: recalibrate a sensor, debug a radio link, inspect a wiring harness, analyse a flight log, fix a configuration issue, improve a checklist, or bring the right evidence back to the software development team.

The problems you will work on are complex, dynamic, and multivariable. You will often have partial information, limited time, and a system where hardware, software, environment, and operator behavior interact in non-obvious ways. Your job is to create clarity, choose the right debugging path, and drive the system toward a robust long-term solution. You will not just operate systems. You will make them better.

 

What You’ll Work On

  • Own the integration project: Consult with partners, clarify requirements, agree interfaces and test criteria, and drive technical decisions and milestones to a working joint system.

  • Cross-Stack Engineering: Design integration concepts, CAD models, electrical circuits and system integration and bring together sensors, enclosures, calibration, compute, mechanisms, power electronics, controls, networking, autonomy software, and operator workflows.

  • Validation & Fieldability Ownership: Put your system through its paces: on test stands and in the field. Spot design flaws, integration gaps, recurring failure modes, and process bottlenecks. And establish confidence in mission-readiness as the maturity is realized.

  • Create clarity in complex situations: Separate symptoms from root causes, devise efficient debugging workflows, reproduce failures and drive lasting solutions that make the system more robust long term. When the root cause requires it, contribute directly to the layer that matters, drawing directly from the experts who develop core components of your system.

  • Acceptance & Testing Automation: Define and run acceptance tests for platforms, payloads, and deployment configurations. Own readiness checks across calibration, software flashing, networking, sensors, and pre-mission setup. Make readiness measurable and repeatable.

  • Field Deployment & End-User Interface: Install, configure, maintain, and support SE3 systems at test ranges, customer sites, partner demonstrations, exercises, and real-world deployments. Make sure our autonomous platforms perform reliably where it matters, enable end-users to succeed in their missions and represent SE3 with technical credibility outside the lab.

     
 

Your Profile

  • Most importantly, you’re structured, fast-moving, and mission-driven. You don’t wait for perfect information. You create clarity, iterate fast, and prefer finding and fixing root causes over applying patches.

  • You hold a B.Sc., M.Sc. or similar degree in Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, Mechatronics, or a related field.

  • You bring multiple years of hands-on experience integrating, testing, operating, and troubleshooting complex robotic, UAV, embedded, automotive, industrial automation, or defence systems.

  • You are proficient in using CAD software, creating wiring diagrams, building electromechanic prototypes and defining and executing test campaigns across hardware disciplines.

  • You are familiar with soldering, crimping, using multimeters, oscilloscopes, serial consoles, or other lab and field equipment, with at least basic experience in command line, data analysis tools and Linux usage.

  • You are proactive, hands-on and able to find effective solutions also under the constraints of field-campaigns and willing to travel and deploy across Europe.

  • You enjoy working directly with partners, operators, and end users. You can explain technical problems clearly, build trust in stressful situations, and represent SE3 professionally outside the lab.

  • You speak fluent English; German is a strong plus. A driving license is required. Given the nature of SE3’s work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to work on defence-related projects and, where required, obtain the relevant security clearance.

     
 

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • Specific knowledge in UAVs, PX4, ArduPilot, QGroundControl, Mission Planner, MAVLink, flight log analysis, mission planning, and airspace coordination.

  • Proficiency in PCBA and electronics circuit design and prototyping, especially targeting high-speed data interfaces and sensors

  • Experience with development on ROS2, Docker, Linux, edge compute devices, C++/Python, Bash, Git, or deployment automation.

  • Experience with networking and radio systems, including WiFi networks, LTE/5G modems, VPNs, telemetry links, antenna placement, RF interference, tactical communication links, and debugging connectivity issues in the field.

  • Experience with perception or measurement systems, camera/IMU calibration, sensor synchronization, image processing, or mission autonomy.

  • Skills interpreting sensor data, robot logs, flight logs, frequency-domain data, vibration issues, EMI issues, thermal issues, or intermittent hardware failures.

  • Experience with environmental testing such as vibration, thermal, ingress protection, EMI/EMC, or MIL-STD-style qualification workflows.

  • Experience creating acceptance tests, runbooks, troubleshooting- or training guides, fleet dashboards, release checklists, or field-support processes.

 

Perks & Benefits

  • Real Ownership: Get equity early, real stock options to participate directly in SE3’s growth

  • Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you. We are an AI-first company empowering every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge.

  • 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

  • Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

  • Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece

  • Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

 

Our Process

  1. Intro Call (20 min): Let’s get to know each other

  2. Technical Screen (30 min): First overview of your abilities in system integration, field testing and debugging

  3. Technical Interview (45 min): We dive deeper into your hardware design skills and ability to iterate based on first principle reasoning.

  4. Onsite Trial/Case (1.5-2 hrs): We’ll integrate, diagnose, debug, or test something together, just like on the job.

  5. Team Dinner/Lunch: See if it’s a culture fit on both sides

title: UI/UX Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Join SE3 Labs as a UI/UX Software Engineer

Design and build intuitive, high-performance interfaces for autonomous systems, turning complex operational capabilities into software that people can use confidently in the real world.

About SE3

SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.

We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our future, help us build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

Our founding team’s research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field

About the Role

As a UI/UX Software Engineer at SE3 Labs, you’ll take ownership of how our software looks, feels and performs. Your core challenge is to build one coherent interface system that works across many contexts: different devices, screen sizes, plugins and product features, from large command displays to small field devices with limited computing power. You’ll combine UX/UI design with hands-on front-end development, working closely with our software team. From integrating 3D visualisations to building interfaces for military personnel in the field, you’ll help shape a product from the ground up and see the direct impact of your work.

What You’ll Work On

  • Coherent UI System & Front-End Architecture: Design and build a modular, well-structured front-end and a consistent design language that spans our whole product range. Make it easy to add new plugins and features, and to run on different systems and devices, without losing consistency or maintainability.

  • UX/UI Design & Implementation: Work with the team to understand user needs, design and wireframe interfaces, and turn them into working software. Own both the user experience and the code that brings it to life.

  • Multi-Device & Performance: Build interfaces that adapt across small screens, tablets and large displays, and stay responsive on resource-constrained hardware. Identify bottlenecks, optimise rendering and deliver a smooth experience without relying on high-end devices.

  • 3D Visualisation Integration: Integrate 3D visualisations into the user interface so that they work smoothly alongside other features, including on devices with limited computing resources.

  • Plugin & Feature Interfaces: Build reusable UI components for different plugins and product features, so that third parties and internal teams can extend the platform in a consistent way.

  • Usability for Operational Environments: Help design interfaces for military personnel working in demanding conditions. Consider intuitive workflows, clear information hierarchy and established conventions such as NATO symbology. Learn from real user feedback and improve continuously.

  • Collaboration & Product Evolution: Work closely with the software team to understand customer needs and translate them into design and engineering decisions. Help shape how the interface evolves as the product grows, and look for ways to simplify workflows and make new capabilities easier to understand.

Your Profile

  • You enjoy building a coherent system rather than a single screen: one design language and one component structure that works across many plugins, systems and devices.

  • You bring hands-on experience designing and implementing user interfaces for software products, with a focus on intuitive, usable experiences across different devices and screen sizes.

  • You have built structured, responsive and maintainable front-end applications, not just static designs or isolated prototypes, and you know how to organise code into reusable components and modular structures.

  • You can move between UX/UI design and software development, turning wireframes and requirements into working interfaces and making informed decisions about both usability and implementation.

  • You care about performance as well as appearance, and you work methodically to improve the experience across different hardware.

  • You work well with engineers and other stakeholders, explore different approaches and turn ideas into practical solutions.

  • You take initiative, enjoy open-ended problems and want to help build and shape a product rather than maintain an established interface.

  • You’re interested in software for real-world use, where clarity, reliability and ease of use matter as much as visual design.

  • You’re happy to work on-site with the team in Munich.

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • 3D Visualisation: Experience integrating interactive 3D visualisations into software interfaces, particularly using Unreal Engine or similar technologies.

  • Performance on Constrained Hardware: Experience optimising front-end applications for low-compute devices, limited resources or demanding real-time requirements.

  • Complex Operational Interfaces: Experience designing interfaces for complex systems where users need to interpret spatial information, symbols or multiple sources of information quickly.

  • Gaming or Real-Time Visualisation: Experience in 3D gaming, motorsport, simulation or other fields where responsive interfaces and real-time visual feedback are important.

  • Building from Scratch: Experience establishing a front-end architecture, reusable component system or coherent design language for a new product or platform.

Perks & Benefits

  • Real Ownership: Participate in SE3’s growth through our employee participation programme

  • Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you

  • AI-boosted workplace: We empower every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge

  • 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

  • Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

  • Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece

  • Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

Our Process

  1. Intro Call (30 minutes): An initial conversation to discuss your experience, motivation and interest in SE3 Labs, alongside an introduction to the role and our working environment.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (45 minutes): Discuss your experience, approach to software development and UX/UI design, and how you would contribute to the team.

  3. Technical Deep Dive (90 minutes): Explore your technical capabilities in more detail, including front-end architecture, interface design and implementation, responsive development and problem-solving.

  4. Team Lunch or Dinner: Meet members of the team, get a feel for how we work together and learn more about life at SE3 Labs.

title: UK I Fractional Legal Counsel
descriptionHtml:
About Infinite Lambda

Infinite Lambda is a global data and AI consultancy on a mission to make innovation accessible. We help organisations build the data foundations and business context they need for enterprise AI to actually work: from modern data platforms to agentic enablement and our software solution, Flowline.

We are a Certified B Corporation, with 7 legal entities around the world, and are proud to nurture a workplace where decent human beings can do their best work. Curiosity is our default setting, autonomy is non-negotiable, and impact is the whole point.

The role

As our Fractional Legal Counsel, you will be the senior legal partner to our COO, Exec team, and Board. In a fractional capacity, you will be part of the team, close to the people who win and deliver the work, and trusted to make the calls that keep us keep moving.

We need someone who can start adding value from their first week. You will handle our most important contracts and legal questions across EMEA, the Americas, and APAC, and set up the templates, playbooks, and processes that let the business handle routine matters with confidence when you are not there.

Being qualified in both England & Wales and the US means you can cover our two largest legal systems directly and coordinate local counsel everywhere else.

You will report to the COO and work closely with our CFO and General Managers, as many of our legal questions (commercial terms, liability, entity structure and governance) sit at the intersection of legal, finance, and operations. As the business grows, you will also help us decide what our long-term legal function should look like.

What you will own

This role spans four pillars. As the role is fractional, focus matters a lot: you will prioritise what only a senior lawyer can do, bring in external support where it makes sense, and build the tools that let the business help itself.

1. Commercial contracting & client advice

  • Reviewing and negotiating our priority client agreements: MSAs, SOWs and framework agreements under English and US law

  • Drafting key partner, vendor, and supplier agreements

  • Advising clients and internal teams on cross-border matters across EMEA, the Americas, and APAC

  • Setting clear positions on liability, IP ownership, and data terms, so deals keep moving

2. Governance, risk & compliance

  • Flagging the legal risks that matter most and recommending priorities to the COO and Exec team;

  • Oversight of corporate governance and entity matters across our 7 legal entities, working with local advisers;

  • Supporting the Exec team and board matters when legal input is needed;

  • Keeping our compliance posture current, including anti-bribery, sanctions, and export controls.

3. Data, AI & intellectual property

  • Data protection and privacy across the UK, EU and US, including DPAs and international transfers;

  • Guidance on AI regulation, including the EU AI Act, as it applies to our services;

  • Protecting our intellectual property, including our flagship product, Flowline.

4. Building the legal foundations

  • Contract templates, negotiation playbooks and approval rules for routine matters;

  • A simple intake and tracking process so everyone knows what is in progress;

  • Selecting and managing external counsel for specialist or local-law work, within budget;

  • Helping shape the scope of a future full-time legal hire if and when we need one.

Who you are

We are not looking for a particular CV but for a particular kind of lawyer, namely senior, commercial, honest, and genuinely interested in the work our teams do.

Experience that matters

  • Qualified as a solicitor in England & Wales and the US (preferrably), with both qualifications current and in good standing;

  • 7+ years' PQE, with training at a leading law firm and in-house experience, ideally in technology, data, AI or professional services;

  • A track record of working fractionally, as an interim, or as a consultant lawyer, and of making an impact quickly;

  • Strong commercial contracting experience, especially services, technology and SaaS agreements;

  • Experience advising on cross-border matters across the UK, EU, and US, with exposure to APAC a plus;

  • Working knowledge of data protection, IP, and emerging AI regulation;

  • Experience setting up legal processes or being a company's first legal adviser;

  • Your own professional indemnity insurance, or cover through your platform or consultancy.

Your approach

  • You prioritise ruthlessly and are clear about what can wait;

  • You give clear answers and a recommendation, not a list of risks;

  • You build trust with clients, colleagues and leadership because you are straight with them;

  • You leave things better documented than you found them, so the business is never stuck waiting for you;

  • You bring rigour without bureaucracy. Life is too short for red tape;

  • You are aligned with our company values. This matters to us.

How the engagement works

  • 10 days a month with flexibility around specific working hours and with reasonable availability for urgent matters outside of those;

  • A shared request channel and a simple tracker so priorities are visible to everyone;

  • A regular check-in with the COO to review workload, priorities and whether the agreed working days still fit;

  • Additional days agreed in advance, at the same day rate.

Why work with us

  • Being your true self: show up as you are. We work with people for character, not conformity;

  • Practising innovation: front-row seat to the rapid evolution of data and AI, and the legal questions that come with it;

  • Living autonomously: remote-first, with flexibility on how you structure your days;

  • Real influence: a senior voice in a growing global business, working directly with the COO and Exec team.

We are a Certified B Corporation. That means we measure ourselves not just by what we deliver, but by how we deliver it because of our people, our clients, our communities, and the environment.

Our Legal Counsel will help make sure that commitment is reflected in how we contract and govern ourselves.

The practicalities

  • Engagement: Fractional, initial term of 12 months with the option to extend;

  • Contract: Consultancy agreement, directly, through your own company, or through a fractional legal platform; IR35 status assessed before contracting;

  • Location: Remote-first / UK / US;

  • Reports to: COO;

  • Key partnerships: CEO, CTO, CFO, and other Exec team members; General Managers, Sales and Partnership leads, Head of People / HR;

  • Compensation: competitive day rate.

Our hiring process

  1. Application review

  2. Screening conversation with our Talent Acquisition team

  3. Interview with the COO and CTO/CEO

  4. Technical interview with one of our legal advisors

▶ ▶ Submit your CV in English in PDF, with your day rate, availability, and preferred engagement route.

▶ ▶ Mind that as we are an international team, internal communication is in English.

▶ ▶ We will verify your qualifications on the SRA register and the relevant US state bar register before your first interview.

▶ ▶ To ensure legislative compliance, applicants may be asked to provide up-to-date proof of a clean criminal record, such as a Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check (UK) or a country-specific equivalent. This is the final step in the process and will only be requested once terms are agreed.

Infinite Lambda is an equal opportunity organisation. Our inclusive culture celebrates diversity and treats everyone with dignity and respect. Accordingly, our selection process will never discriminate against applicants on the grounds of any characteristics, such as disability, age, gender, sexual orientation, family status, race, faith or other.

title: UX Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
We are hiring a UX Designer who loves turning real user problems into clear, safe and well-tested designs, and who wants to shape how healthcare professionals work with AI every day.

Our Mission
Attendi has already built a strong user base through speech-to-text integrations with electronic health record (EHR) vendors, used by over 300 care organisations in elderly and disability care. With the Attendi App (web and mobile), we are building a one-stop solution for AI-driven administration in healthcare: structured documentation, conversation summaries, voice-driven workflows and AI assistance, anytime, anywhere.

Design is central to this vision. Our users are care professionals working with clients, not behind a desk. Every flow we build needs to be simple, fast and safe to use. And because the Attendi App is being certified as a medical device (MDR), we don’t just design what feels intuitive, we prove that users understand and use it as intended.

This isn’t about making it as easy as possible to order a pizza. It’s about how a care professional can receive AI-generated advice safely, and make sure they check what matters before they rely on it.

Your Role
As a UX Designer at Attendi, you will:

  • Translate user research into user flows, wireframes and high-fidelity designs for the Attendi App.

  • Work closely with our UX researcher, who uncovers user needs in the field, and turn those insights into the right solution.

  • Visit care organisations to test your designs with healthcare professionals: does this solution fit the problem we observed?

  • Design for safety in an AI product: identify where users could misuse or over-trust AI output, and design features that mitigate that risk.

  • Run usability studies as part of our MDR certification, through simulations, observation or A/B tests, and document what you tested and learned.

  • Work in two lanes: fast shipping of new features, and careful, well-documented work on our medical device track.

  • Work closely with the product owner, developers and our compliance team to get designs into production.

  • Help mature our design system in Figma.


You might be a good fit if you hit most or all of the following:

  • 2-4 years of experience as a UX or product designer in a product team, working in sprints.

  • Experience with B2B SaaS products.

  • You start with questions, not solutions: who is the user, what is their context, what problem are we really solving?

  • You balance a startup pace with taking a step back to research and test before going to production.

  • Strong Figma skills.

  • Native Dutch speaker. You’ll talk with healthcare professionals a lot, in their own language.

  • A portfolio that shows your thinking: the user, the problem, how you approached it and how you measured whether it worked.

Strong candidates may also

  • Have worked on AI products.

  • Have experience in healthcare, or another regulated environment such as legaltech, regtech or govtech.

  • Have worked on a CE-certified or medical device product, and know what that means for usability testing.

  • Have experience running usability studies or user interviews.

  • Enjoy working with a team for the long run and growing together with a scale-up.

What we offer

  • Salary between €4,000 and €4,500 per month, plus holiday allowance.

  • Ideally 40 hours per week.

  • Travel and lunch allowance.

  • Home office budget.

  • Lease bike.

  • Training budget of €1,500 per year.

  • Company MacBook.

  • ClassPass membership.

  • Pension contribution of 10% and roughly 7% paid by Attendi.

Our culture: People-oriented, curious, and proactive
At Attendi, you’ll work in a small, ambitious team that learns and builds together. We are empathetic, take initiative, dare to experiment, and stand by our work. Making mistakes is okay as long as you learn from them.

Application Process

  • Please include your portfolio with your application

  • Intro call with Roundr, our recruitment partner

  • Interview with a colleague from our design team

  • Case study: a short take-home assignment you present at our office

  • Offer and onboarding

title: UX Researcher
descriptionHtml:
UX Researcher 

  • Location: Bristol/London, UK (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

  • Team: UX

  • Salary: £58,000 - £70,000

  • Contract: Permanent

  • Reporting To: UX Lead

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you’ll do

Hands-on research

  • Run mixed-methods research in a B2B2C setting, combining qualitative studies with behavioural data in Mixpanel, that sets the standard for good research and shapes team roadmaps and client conversations

  • Research the whole chain, from client teams and subject matter experts to their end customers and the developers using our SDKs and APIs, and look for patterns that hold across clients so we build once and reuse

  • Make sure research has impact: track whether it changed a decision and what result followed, and use that to make the case for research investment

Research enablement and operations

  • Democratise research: coach and mentor colleagues in Product, Design and Engineering to run their own studies with rigour, through workshops, guidance and lightweight methods

  • Make insight easy to find and trust, through our insights agents, knowledge bases and journey management artefacts, backed by data you can rely on (quality, privacy, bias), so people can find and question evidence themselves

  • Help run research operations: improve how we recruit participants (frameworks, lead times, consent and data protection), and set clear guardrails so teams run ethical, compliant research

  • Assess and recommend research tools, deciding when to build and when to buy, trial them, and support procurement; use AI-assisted development such as Claude Code to build working tools where that is the right call

What you’ll bring

Ideally you’ll have/be

  • A track record of running research end to end that other teams used in product or roadmap decisions, with strong data literacy: you combine qualitative methods with behavioural data and know what the numbers can and can’t tell us

  • Experience researching in B2B or B2B2C or enterprise contexts, including technical users such as developers (eg SDKs, APIs or documentation), or a strong appetite to learn how

  • Experience coaching non-researchers in research fundamentals (interviewing, bias mitigation, ethical handling of user data) so they can self-serve

  • Experience on a platform or multi-client product, spotting patterns across customers, and familiarity with journey mapping or service design methods

  • Experience in research operations or enablement, such as participant recruitment, consent and data governance, repositories or tool selection, with judgement on when to build and when to buy

  • Confidence working with some autonomy across a distributed, international team

What will set you apart 

  • You’ve built a tool, repository or pipeline that measurably cut the time from research signal to team-wide insight

  • You’ve found a way to measure developer experience where there was no playbook (eg time to first successful call, or where developers drop off)

  • You’ve made the case for research with real numbers, and followed your research after the readout to see what happened

Where you'll work
We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Our Values

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

title: UX/UI Designer (m/w/d) – AI-powered
descriptionHtml:
Gestalte die digitale Welt von morgen als AI-powered UX/UI Designer!

Digitale Produkte, Apps und Web-Projekte sind die Welt, in der du arbeiten möchtest? Dich

faszinieren Technologie, Design und das Nutzererlebnis? Und du willst wissen, wie KI die

Arbeit von Designer:innen gerade verändert? Dann ist die Rolle als Product Designer

(UX/UI) genau das Richtige für dich. Du gestaltest digitale Produkte mit den neusten

AI-Tools und musst dafür nicht selbst tief in Code einsteigen.

Benefits:

● Wir bilden dich in 4 Monaten remote/online zum UX/UI Designer aus

(deutschsprachig)

● Du lernst die modernsten Tools wie Figma, Claude Design und Miro. Dazu kommen

AI-Tools für Ideation, Wireframing und Prototyping sowie Vibe Coding für interaktive

Prototypen

● Deine Trainer:innen sind Design-Leads aus Top-Tech-Unternehmen wie Delivery

Hero, Personio und SAP

● Wir unterstützen dich schon während der Weiterbildung dabei, ein Unternehmen zu

finden, das dir einen Jobeinstieg während oder nach dem Bootcamp bietet

● Die Weiterbildung ist in Vollzeit oder berufsbegleitend in Teilzeit möglich

● Du bekommst Mentor:innen, die dich durch das Programm führen, und simulierst die

Arbeit in Product Teams an realen Cases

● Bis zu 100 % förderfähig mit dem Bildungsgutschein der Agentur für Arbeit

(AZAV-zertifiziert)

● Nach vier Monaten steigst du mit Zertifikat und eigenem Portfolio-Case als Product

Designer / UX/UI Designer in digitale Produktteams ein

Deine Aufgaben:

Steuerung von Designprozessen

● Als UX/UI Designer arbeitest du eng mit Entwickler:innen, Stakeholder:innen und

anderen Beteiligten zusammen, um nutzerzentrierte Lösungen zu schaffen. Du

setzt AI-gestützte Workflows ein, damit ihr schneller von der Idee zur Lösung

kommt und besser entscheidet.

User Research mit KI als Thinking Partner

● Du führst qualitative und quantitative Forschung durch, um die Bedürfnisse der

Nutzer:innen zu verstehen. Mit Interviews, Umfragen und Datenanalysen erstellst

du Personas und Customer Journeys. KI hilft dir dabei, Erkenntnisse schneller

auszuwerten und Muster zu erkennen.

AI-gestütztes Prototyping & Wireframing

● Du entwickelst Ideen und visualisierst sie als Wireframes und interaktive

Prototypen. Mit AI-Tools erzeugst du Wireframes und Mockups schneller. Mit Vibe

Coding baust du klickbare Prototypen, die du direkt mit Nutzer:innen testen kannst.

Usability-Tests & Design-Optimierung

● Du planst und führst Usability-Tests durch, damit deine Designs intuitiv und

benutzerfreundlich sind. Die Testergebnisse wertest du aus, und das Feedback

fließt direkt in die Optimierung der Benutzeroberfläche ein.

Produkt- & User Experience Design

● Du gestaltest Erlebnis und Oberfläche des Produkts, damit es gut aussieht und

einfach zu bedienen ist. Dabei arbeitest du mit Design Systems und achtest auf

Barrierefreiheit nach EAA und WCAG.

Designing AI-Native Products

● Du gestaltest Produkte für eine Welt, in der KI selbst zum Interface wird, etwa für

Chat- und Assistenz-Erlebnisse. Dabei weißt du, wo KI echten Mehrwert für

Nutzer:innen liefert und wo nicht.

Tracking & Analyse

● Du beobachtest mit Tools wie Hotjar und Google Analytics, wie Nutzer:innen mit

dem Produkt umgehen. Über UX-KPIs misst du, ob dein Design funktioniert, und

verbesserst es gezielt weiter.

Qualifikation

● Du bist begeistert von Design und Technologie und liebst es, digitale Erlebnisse zu

gestalten

● Du bist neugierig auf KI und willst die neuen AI-Tools gezielt in deinem Design-Alltag

einsetzen

● Du arbeitest gern im Team und freust dich, gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern

● Du hast Spaß an agilen Arbeitsmethoden (z. B. Scrum, Kanban) und iterierst

Designs schnell

● Du kannst deine Designideen klar kommunizieren und Stakeholder von deinem

Konzept überzeugen

● Du zeigst Eigeninitiative, bringst kreative Lösungen ein und arbeitest pragmatisch

● Du hast ein starkes Gespür für Nutzerbedürfnisse und ein gutes Auge für Details

● Vorerfahrung in Design ist kein Muss, wichtig ist deine Bereitschaft, dich in Tools wie

title: UX/UI Designer (m/w/d) mit Projektverantwortung
descriptionHtml:
Über die Rolle

Du gestaltest digitale Produkte für Web und Mobile, die Menschen wirklich verstehen und gern benutzen?

Und du willst nicht nur Screens liefern, sondern Verantwortung für das Ergebnis übernehmen, vom ersten Nutzerinterview bis zum Release?

Wir entwickeln Software für die Diagnostik, unter anderem Apps, die Schnelltests per Smartphone-Kamera auswerten, und die dazugehörigen Webportale. Als UX/UI Designer (m/w/d) mit Projektverantwortung gestaltest du diese Produkte, führst deine Designprojekte selbst und bist Ansprechperson für unsere Partner, wenn es um Nutzererlebnis geht.

Deine Aufgaben

UI/UX Design:

  • Du gestaltest Web-Anwendungen (Portale, Dashboards) und Mobile Apps für Android und iOS

  • Du führst Nutzerforschung durch und entwickelst User Flows, Wireframes, Prototypen und finale Designs

  • Du pflegst und erweiterst unser Designsystem

  • Du arbeitest eng mit der Entwicklung von der Idee bis zum Release zusammen

Projektverantwortung und Kommunikation:

  • Du führst deine Projekte: Ziele, Zeitplan, Abstimmung und Ergebnis

  • Du stellst Konzepte und Designs bei Partnern vor und holst Feedback ein

  • Du schreibst User Stories mit klaren Akzeptanzkriterien und pflegst Roadmap und Prioritäten gemeinsam mit deinen Teamkollegen aus der Entwicklung und Geschäftsführung

Qualität:

  • Du testest neue Funktionen gegen das Design und die Akzeptanzkriterien und wirkst an Usability-Evaluationen mit

Was du mitbringst

Design:

  • Mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung im UX/UI Design

  • Ein Portfolio mit umgesetzten Web- und Mobile-Projekten

  • Sehr sicherer Umgang mit einem professionellen UI-Design-Tool, inklusive Komponenten und Prototyping

Verantwortung und Kommunikation:

  • Du hast mindestens ein Projekt selbst koordiniert, nicht nur daran mitgearbeitet

  • Du kannst Designentscheidungen gegenüber Partnern, Entwicklung und Geschäftsführung klar begründen

  • Du gehst offen mit Feedback um und bleibst trotzdem bei deiner Linie, wo sie für Nutzer:innen richtig ist

Ein Plus:

  • Erfahrung in regulierten Branchen (Medizintechnik, Pharma, Automotive o. ä.)

  • Kenntnisse in Barrierefreiheit (WCAG) und technisches Grundverständnis für Frontend und Mobile

  • Erfahrung mit agilen Methoden, Jira und Confluence

  • Erfahrung mit Nutzerforschung, Usability-Tests und Designsystemen

Sprachkenntnisse:

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch (C1+) für die Zusammenarbeit mit Team und Partnern

  • Gutes Englisch (B2+) in Wort und Schrift

Was wir dir bieten

  • Gestaltung mit Wirkung: Deine Designs werden in der medizinischen Diagnostik eingesetzt, und du hast spürbaren Einfluss auf ihre Richtung.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung: Vollzeit mit zwei Präsenztagen pro Woche in unserem Büro in Mannheim, der Rest flexibel und mobil.

  • Weiterentwicklung: Mindestens eine Konferenz oder ein Training pro Jahr; regulatorisches Know-how vermitteln wir dir im Onboarding.

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege: Ein Team aus knapp 20 Leuten, flache Hierarchien und direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung.

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Entwicklung: Du arbeitest täglich direkt mit unseren Web- und Mobile-Entwickler:innen zusammen, ohne lange Abstimmungsketten.

Unser Bewerbungsprozess

Wir legen Wert auf einen transparenten und respektvollen Prozess:

  1. Screening-Gespräch (ca. 30 Min., remote)
    Gegenseitiges Kennenlernen, Rahmenbedingungen, erste fachliche Einordnung

  2. Fachliches Interview (ca. 90 Min., remote oder vor Ort)
    Du stellst ein bis zwei Projekte aus deinem Portfolio vor und zeigst uns eine deiner Design-Dateien. Anschließend bearbeiten wir gemeinsam eine fiktive, praxisnahe Fallstudie zu Design, Projektsteuerung und Partnerkommunikation. Eine Vorbereitung außer der Portfolio-Auswahl ist nicht nötig.

  3. Team-Kennenlernen (ca. 45 Min., idealerweise vor Ort)
    Austausch mit den Entwickler:innen, mit denen du eng zusammenarbeitest; kann mit Phase 2 kombiniert werden

Zeitrahmen: Von der Bewerbung bis zur Entscheidung planen wir etwa 2–3 Wochen. Spätestens zwei Werktage nach Eingang deiner Bewerbung melden wir uns, nach jeder Phase erhältst du zeitnah Feedback.

Noch unsicher?

Du erfüllst nicht jede Anforderung, fühlst dich aber angesprochen? Dann bewirb dich gern. Ein Lebenslauf und ein Link zu deinem Portfolio reichen uns zum Einstieg.

Wir freuen uns auf dich!

title: VC AI & Automation Manager (Part-time / Freelance, with Full-time Opportunity) (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Ananda Impact Ventures, we’re not just investors; we’re pioneers and innovators in the impact investment landscape across Europe. We channel capital into startups tackling critical social and environmental challenges, focusing on areas like climate change, biodiversity, health and education. With Europe’s longest track record in Tech Impact VC, we are now investing from our freshly closed €100M Fund V. Learn more about our mission and team at Ananda.

We see considerable potential for artificial intelligence and automation to improve how venture capital firms operate, from identifying and evaluating investment opportunities to supporting portfolio companies and managing internal processes.

Our objective is to systematically integrate these technologies into our organisation, developing connected systems and applications that enhance the quality, efficiency and scalability of our work.

The Role:

We are looking for an AI & Automation Manager to develop and implement AI-driven solutions and automation across Ananda.

In this role, you will work closely with the whole team to identify opportunities for technological improvement, translate operational requirements into technical solutions and take responsibility for their implementation.

The position combines software development, AI engineering, systems integration and process optimisation. It requires a practical approach to technology, an understanding of business requirements and the ability to independently manage technical projects from concept to deployment.

You will have the opportunity to shape Ananda's internal technology infrastructure, establish scalable solutions and assume increasing responsibility as our AI and automation capabilities develop.

Responsibilities:

  • Investment processes: Develop and implement AI-enabled solutions that improve the identification, evaluation and execution of investment opportunities.

  • Portfolio management: Build systems and applications that support the collection, analysis and use of portfolio information.

  • Process automation: Identify and implement opportunities to streamline workflows across investment activities, fund operations and internal administration.

  • Data and systems integration: Develop and maintain the technical infrastructure connecting internal applications, external platforms and relevant data sources.

  • AI applications: Design, develop and maintain AI-powered tools, agents and automated workflows to support the organisation's activities.

  • Technology development and adoption: Evaluate emerging technologies, identify relevant applications and support their effective integration into existing processes.


Technical Skills:

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including practical experience with Python, APIs, databases and modern development tools.

  • Hands-on experience developing AI-powered applications using large language models, AI agents and related technologies.

  • Experience implementing workflow automation and integrating different software systems and data sources.

  • Understanding of software architecture, data processing, deployment and the development of reliable, maintainable applications.

  • Familiarity with information security, access management and the responsible handling of confidential data.

  • Experience with modern AI-assisted development tools and an interest in continuously expanding your technical expertise.

Professional and Personal Qualifications:

  • Practical experience: Demonstrated ability to independently develop and implement software applications or automation solutions.

  • Ownership: Ability to manage technical projects from requirements gathering through development, deployment and ongoing improvement.

  • Analytical and problem-solving skills: Strong ability to understand business processes, identify opportunities for improvement and develop appropriate technical solutions.

  • Pragmatic approach: Ability to evaluate technical alternatives and balance functionality, complexity, reliability and development effort.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset: Interest in emerging technologies, startups, venture capital and impact investing.

  • Communication and collaboration: Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and work effectively with colleagues from different professional backgrounds.

Previous experience in venture capital, private equity or the startup ecosystem is an advantage but not a requirement. We place particular value on relevant practical experience, technical competence and the ability to work independently.

What We Offer:

  • Technical ownership: Responsibility for developing and implementing AI and automation capabilities across the organisation.

  • Meaningful contribution: The opportunity to improve the systems and processes supporting our investment activities and portfolio management.

  • Collaborative environment: Direct collaboration with an experienced investment team and exposure to a broad range of technologies and business models.

  • Professional development: Opportunities to expand your responsibilities and contribute to the organisation's long-term technology strategy.

  • Flexible engagement: An initial part-time or freelance arrangement, with the potential to transition into a full-time position as the role develops.

Application:

We welcome applications from individuals with a strong technical background who are interested in applying AI and automation in a venture capital environment.

Please share your CV, together with examples of relevant software, automation or AI projects you have developed. We are particularly interested in understanding the problems you addressed, your technical approach and your individual contribution.

We look forward to learning more about your experience and your interest in joining Ananda Impact Ventures.

title: Velocity Account Executive - SMB (English)
descriptionHtml:
About Prelude

Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.

Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US.

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values

  • Care
    We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

  • Bias for Action
    We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory.

  • Ownership
    We take responsibility end to end, from identifying problems to delivering outcomes and learning from results.

This Account Executive role at Prelude is a hunting position, built for an outbound-first seller who thrives on prospecting and knows how to move fast. You’ll close SMB deals at volume across multiple industries and own the full cycle from A to Z, including your own prospecting, demos, and negotiation. Because you’ll handle technical stakeholders directly, you’ll also become a true expert in our product.

What will you be doing?

  • Running your own outbound motion through cold calls, emails and LinkedIn to build pipeline from the ground up, working closely with our high-performing BDRs

  • Owning the full sales cycle from first call to closed-won, typically within a short sales cycle

  • Qualifying SMB prospects across multiple industries

  • Running discovery that uncovers real pain and moves deals forward

  • Delivering demos tailored to each buyer, including technical stakeholders

  • Hitting and exceeding monthly and quarterly targets for pipeline generation, activities and closed revenue

  • Keeping HubSpot up to date for accurate forecasting

What are we looking for?

  • At least 2 to 3 years in a closing role running a full outbound sales cycle with a track record of closing high-volume SMB deals

  • A strong outbound background, ideally as a BDR or SDR - you’re comfortable picking up the phone 50+ times a day and know how to hook a prospect in the first 30 seconds

  • SaaS sales experience is a must - you know what an API is and can hold your own in a conversation with a technical buyer

  • Consistent quota attainment and overachievement

  • A hunter mindset and the ownership to build your own pipeline and drive your own metrics

  • Sharp, instinctive discovery skills - you can uncover pain efficiently

  • Curiosity and the drive to become a product expert, so every conversation is relevant and consultative

  • Fluency in English

  • Familiarity with HubSpot is a nice to have

  • Genuine excitement for what Prelude is building

What do we offer?

  • Competitive base salary with uncapped commission + BSPCEs

  • Hybrid working style: 4 days in-office in Paris, 1 day remote

  • High-end gear and ergonomic setup

  • 100% travel subsidised to our Paris office

  • Private health insurance

  • Swile meal vouchers

  • Gym pass

  • Annual offsites in great locations

  • The opportunity to be part of building something big, from the start!

Interview process

  • Meet a member of the Talent team

  • Interview with Hiring Manager

  • Role-play session with Sales

  • Final meeting with the CEO

We care about your potential and motivation. If you're excited about the role and this sounds like your next step, we’d love to hear from you

title: Venture Building Internship - New Venture (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One+, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.

Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du quantifizierst Marktpotenziale unseres aktuell strategisch wichtigsten New Venture und führst fundierte Feasability Analysen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Enpal Experten-Netzwerk durch.

  • Du übernimmst die volle End-to-End-Ownership für erste Projektpiloten im „Founder Mode“: von Kundenakquise über Projektplanung bis operativer Baustellenbegleitung.

  • Du bereitest strategische Unterlagen für C-Level Check-ins vor und unterstützt das Management direkt bei der Entscheidungsfindung.

  • Du konzipierst und implementierst skalierbare Vertriebs- und Operations-Prozesse, um unsere Produkte deutschlandweit erfolgreich auszurollen.

  • Du moderierst interne Workshops, um zusätzliche Wachstumspotenziale zu identifizieren und das Zusammenspiel innerhalb der Organisation zu heben.

Dein Profil

  • Du befindest dich in einem fortgeschrittenen oder hast ein sehr erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Bachelor/Masterstudium an einer Top-Tier Business School

  • Du verfügst über Arbeitserfahrungen oder Praktika in schnell wachsenden Unternehmen wie z.B. Startups oder in einer Unternehmensberatung/Consulting

title: Venture Partner
descriptionHtml:
We are hiring a Venture Partner to bring new opportunities into Pairs, and to grow the network of investors who see them first.

Pairs is a global network of family offices, institutional investors, VCs and angels. We screen deal flow very tightly, and the opportunities that clear our diligence go out to the network. We invest alongside them too.

THE ROLE
This role works across both sides of Pairs. You bring in companies worth our diligence, and you grow the network of investors who back them directly.

This role is for people who bring in deals on their own. You already have an active network of founders who are raising, and investors who write direct cheques. Here you open new relationships on both sides every month, using the same approach that built your existing ones.

We are not raising a fund. Our investors invest directly in companies, so the work is about family offices, high-net-worth individuals and angels, not fund LPs.

Our platform handles the pipeline, research and follow-up. Your time goes to founder and investor conversations, and to judging which opportunities deserve the network's attention.

You will work directly with the two co-founders and our investor team. The organisation is flat, so you will see first-hand how we screen opportunities, what we decline and why.

Your current title matters less than the quality of your relationships. We are looking for someone who has built those relationships personally and can explain exactly how.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

  • New opportunities. Companies raising Series A and later, brought to Pairs with the context our team needs to assess them.

  • Network growth. New relationships every month with family offices, high-net-worth individuals and angel investors who are new to Pairs.

  • Investor matching. A clear understanding of what each investor looks for, so the opportunities you share are relevant.

  • Your relationships. The founders and investors you bring, kept current and qualified. They remain yours.

YOU ARE A FIT IF YOU

  • Have an active network of founders you can bring to the table yourself, and direct investor relationships you built personally.

  • Have brought at least one company or investor into a private round, and can walk us through how it happened.

  • Understand what makes a company worth an investor's time: stage, traction, round structure, and the reasons investors pass.

  • Treat discretion as second nature. Please do not include any investor or company names in your application.

  • Use AI tools daily, with clear judgement about where they improve your work and where they would compromise its quality.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • A fully remote, asynchronous role

  • Direct access to the co-founders and our investor team

  • Close collaboration with our internal team

  • Live mandates from your first week, and access to the opportunities that clear our diligence

  • Insight into our internal processes, including how we screen deal flow

  • A base salary plus commission

Compensation: $120K – $180K

descriptionHtml:
Über Finton

Finton ist eine AI-Native Finance-Beratung, die AI-gestützte Lösungen für den CFO-Bereich konzipiert und implementiert. Unsere Services erbringen wir mit unserer eigenen Software, die den Berater von Projektmanagement über Datenverarbeitung bis zu Datenanalyse und Dashboard-Erstellung durchgängig mit AI unterstützt.

Konkret heißt das: Wir setzen auf dem bestehenden ERP, der Buchhaltung und den operativen Systemen des Kunden auf, bringen die Daten zusammen und liefern in kürzester Zeit ein produktives Ergebnis, etwa ein monatliches Management Reporting mit Kommentierung, einen rollierenden 13-Wochen-Cash-Forecast, eine Deckungsbeitrags- und Umsatzanalyse nach Kunden, Produkten oder Projekten oder einen Datenraum und ein Financial Fact Book für eine anstehende Transaktion.

Daneben arbeiten wir klassisch beratend: als Sparringspartner des CFO bei Budget, Forecast und Investorenkommunikation, als Interim-Kapazität in der Finanzabteilung und als Unterstützung bei M&A, Fundraising und Due-Diligence-Vorbereitung.

Unsere Kunden sind mittelständische und investorenfinanzierte Unternehmen mit typischerweise 10 bis 250 Mio. Euro Umsatz, bei denen das Finance-Team für die Anforderungen von Gesellschaftern und Banken zu klein oder zu manuell aufgestellt ist.

Finton wurde 2023 von Jan, Julian und Neil gegründet und betreut Kunden in der gesamten DACH-Region von Hamburg, Köln und München aus. Mehr als 150 abgeschlossene Projekte sprechen für sich.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Produktentwicklung: Mit Deinem Feedback unterstützt das Technologie-Team bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer AI-Platform.

  • Teamaufbau: Du führst und entwickelst jüngere Kolleginnen und Kollegen in deinen Projekten und prägst unsere Arbeitsweise mit.

Das bringst Du mit

Deine ersten Monate bei Finton

In den ersten Wochen lernst du unsere Plattform, unsere Projektmethodik und unsere laufenden Mandate kennen und arbeitest in bestehenden Projekten mit. title: Video Producer & Editor
descriptionHtml:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

As the Video Producer & Editor, you will be the point between raw footage and published work. The output goes onto company channels, into the hands of sales and government relations, and in front of closed-door audiences—including material that cannot leave the building.

Video is the clearest evidence of what UFORCE does to those outside the military. The systems are real, they are in use, and footage of them shows our customers what no render or animation can. In a market full of future-tense capability claims, that is the differentiator, and this role is what converts it into content people actually see.

This is not an assembly role. You are expected to shape and direct content as well as cut it: to decide what is worth capturing, what the film is, and what to leave out. The register is real and observed rather than advertised. The standard is publishable as it leaves the timeline.

It is a mid-level role with unusual freedom. There is no post-production team and no producer. The work is daily, the subject matter is serious, and there is room for someone who wants to build their craft on material most editors never get near.

 

What you will do

  • Cut and finish film for company channels, social platforms, sales and government relations, and internal and closed-door audiences.

  • Shape content from the outset: propose ideas, write shot lists and capture briefs, and direct or shoot capture where needed.

  • Deliver distinct cuts for distinct audiences rather than reformatting one film for all of them.

  • Finish to a publishable standard—grade, sound, captioning, titling and versioning.

  • Own the footage library: cataloguing, archive structure, backup and version control.

  • Hold the UFORCE film language and keep output consistent, including work delivered by external film-makers.

  • Travel to facilities, ranges, events and deployments, sometimes at short notice, and film in industrial and field conditions.

  • Utilise approved AI tools to optimize your workflow, strictly adhering to data security guidelines and ensuring no sensitive material leaves secure networks.

  • Apply the company's security and export-control requirements to footage, and route material showing platforms, facilities and personnel for clearance before release.

 

Required Skills

  • Around three to six years of professional editing experience, with a showreel of published work rather than showpieces.

  • Command of pacing, structure and sound, and the ability to explain the decisions behind a cut—particularly what was removed.

  • Experience in a factual, documentary, news or event register, not branded content alone.

  • Evidence of consistent output at pace, self-managed: media handling, versioning and deadlines without a producer.

  • A piece taken from idea and shot list through to final cut.

  • Fluency in a professional NLE—Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut—with working knowledge of After Effects or equivalent for basic motion work.

  • Sound judgement with confidential, embargoed or otherwise restricted material.

  • A point of view on what good looks like, and the willingness to argue for it.

  • Right to work in the UK and eligibility to obtain UK Security Clearance (SC level).

 

Nice to Have

  • Camera operation to a publishable standard, including commercial drone operation (with CAA certification).

  • Motion graphics and titling beyond basics.

  • Stills photography.

  • Experience cutting technical or engineering subject matter.

  • Experience in defence, dual-use or uncrewed systems, whether in industry or in service.

The nature of combat has changed.

Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability.

And UFORCE is ready.

Are You?
