title: Wirtschaftsinformatiker/in – Digitalisierung & Automatisierung - Vollzeit (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du denkst gerne in Systemen, erkennst ineffiziente Abläufe schnell und hast Freude daran, aus manuellen Prozessen saubere digitale Lösungen zu machen?

Als Wirtschaftsinformatiker/in bei ESH arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle zwischen Geschäftsprozessen, Software und Automatisierung.

Du analysierst bestehende Abläufe, entwickelst digitale Lösungen und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Systeme zuverlässig miteinander funktionieren.

Dabei geht es nicht darum, ständig jedem neuen Tool hinterherzulaufen. Wir suchen jemanden, der Prozesse wirklich versteht, sinnvolle Lösungen entwickelt und diese anschließend sauber, nachvollziehbar und dauerhaft implementiert.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du analysierst bestehende Geschäftsprozesse und identifizierst Möglichkeiten zur Digitalisierung und Automatisierung.

  • Du konzipierst und implementierst digitale Prozesse für unsere internen Abläufe.

  • Du entwickelst und optimierst Automationen für wiederkehrende Aufgaben.

  • Du verbindest unterschiedliche Anwendungen über APIs, Webhooks und Schnittstellen.

  • Du betreust und entwickelst unsere bestehenden SaaS-Anwendungen weiter.

  • Du führst neue Softwarelösungen ein und integrierst sie sinnvoll in unsere bestehenden Prozesse.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Daten zuverlässig zwischen unseren Systemen übertragen werden.

  • Du analysierst Fehler und entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungen statt kurzfristiger Workarounds.

  • Du dokumentierst Prozesse, Systeme und Automationen nachvollziehbar.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Vertrieb, Marketing, Kundenbetreuung und Geschäftsführung zusammen, um deren Anforderungen technisch sinnvoll umzusetzen.

  • Du schulst Mitarbeiter bei neuen Systemen und sorgst dafür, dass neue Prozesse im Alltag tatsächlich funktionieren.

  • Du überprüfst bestehende Lösungen regelmäßig auf Stabilität, Effizienz und mögliche Verbesserungen.


So sieht dein Arbeitsalltag aus

Ein großer Teil deiner Arbeit besteht darin, bestehende Abläufe zu verstehen und daraus funktionierende digitale Systeme zu entwickeln.

Du bekommst beispielsweise einen Prozess aus Vertrieb, Marketing, Kundenbetreuung oder interner Organisation und analysierst zunächst:

Was passiert aktuell? Wo entstehen Fehler oder unnötige manuelle Schritte? Welche Daten werden benötigt? Welche Systeme sind beteiligt? Und was lässt sich sinnvoll automatisieren?

Anschließend entwickelst du eine Lösung, setzt sie technisch um, testest sie und dokumentierst den neuen Ablauf.

Dabei arbeitest du überwiegend konzentriert und eigenständig an deinen Aufgaben und Projekten. Für fachliche Anforderungen stimmst du dich direkt mit den zuständigen Kollegen ab.

Wir legen Wert darauf, dass Lösungen nicht nur technisch funktionieren, sondern verständlich dokumentiert, stabil und langfristig wartbar sind.


Die Stelle passt besonders gut zu dir, wenn …

  • du gerne logisch und analytisch denkst,

  • du komplexe Abläufe schnell verstehen kannst,

  • du Spaß daran hast, Probleme systematisch zu lösen,

  • du sehr strukturiert und präzise arbeitest,

  • du lieber eine saubere langfristige Lösung entwickelst als mehrere kurzfristige Workarounds,

  • du dich längere Zeit konzentriert mit einem Problem beschäftigen kannst,

  • du bestehende Prozesse zunächst verstehen möchtest, bevor du sie veränderst,

  • du gerne eigenständig arbeitest, Anforderungen aber zuverlässig mit anderen abstimmst,

  • du Fehler nicht nur behebst, sondern ihre Ursache verstehen möchtest,

  • du Wert auf Dokumentation und nachvollziehbare Systeme legst,

  • du Verantwortung für die Funktionsfähigkeit deiner Lösungen übernimmst,

  • du gerne einen Bereich langfristig aufbaust und immer besser verstehst.


Das solltest du mitbringen

  • abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder einen vergleichbaren fachlichen Hintergrund

  • sehr gutes analytisches und strukturiertes Denkvermögen

  • schnelle Auffassungsgabe

  • gutes Verständnis für Geschäftsprozesse und deren Digitalisierung

  • Erfahrung mit digitalen Systemlandschaften und SaaS-Anwendungen

  • Verständnis von APIs, Webhooks und Schnittstellen

  • Erfahrung mit Automatisierungsplattformen oder die Fähigkeit, dich schnell in diese einzuarbeiten

  • hohe Lösungs- und Ergebnisorientierung

  • sorgfältige und nachvollziehbare Dokumentation

  • eigenständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

  • sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Erfahrung mit n8n, Make, Zapier oder vergleichbaren Automatisierungsplattformen ist von Vorteil.

Entscheidend ist für uns aber nicht, dass du bereits jedes von uns eingesetzte System kennst. Wichtiger ist, dass du technische Zusammenhänge verstehst und dich strukturiert in neue Lösungen einarbeiten kannst.


Deine Einarbeitung bei ESH

Zu Beginn lernst du unsere bestehenden Systeme, Geschäftsprozesse und Zuständigkeiten kennen.

Wir zeigen dir, wie Informationen zwischen den einzelnen Bereichen fließen, welche Abläufe bereits automatisiert sind und wo aktuell noch manuelle Schritte bestehen.

Danach übernimmst du schrittweise eigene Prozesse und Projekte.

Bestehende Dokumentationen, feste Ansprechpartner und unsere interne Schulungsplattform helfen dir dabei, schnell ein vollständiges Verständnis unserer Abläufe aufzubauen.

Unser Ziel ist, dass du unsere digitale Infrastruktur zunehmend eigenständig betreust, weiterentwickelst und optimierst.


Was gute IT-Arbeit für uns bedeutet

Wir führen keine neue Software ein, nur weil sie gerade neu oder interessant ist.

Technologie soll unsere Arbeit einfacher, zuverlässiger und effizienter machen.

Deshalb erwarten wir, dass du zunächst das Problem verstehst und anschließend die technisch sinnvollste Lösung entwickelst.

Eine gute Lösung ist für uns:

  • stabil,

  • nachvollziehbar,

  • möglichst einfach,

  • dokumentiert,

  • skalierbar

  • und für die Menschen nutzbar, die täglich damit arbeiten.


Das erwartet dich bei ESH

Eigener Verantwortungsbereich

Du bekommst nicht nur einzelne IT-Tickets, sondern übernimmst Verantwortung für digitale Prozesse, Automationen und Systeme.

Zeit für konzentriertes Arbeiten

Viele deiner Aufgaben erfordern Ruhe und analytisches Denken. Deshalb sollst du ausreichend Zeit haben, dich konzentriert in technische Fragestellungen einzuarbeiten.

Klare Anforderungen

Bei neuen Projekten klären wir zunächst gemeinsam das gewünschte Ergebnis und die fachlichen Anforderungen.

Innerhalb dieses Rahmens entwickelst du eigenständig die technische Lösung.

Moderne digitale Arbeitsweise

Wir arbeiten bereits stark digital und setzen verschiedene SaaS-Anwendungen, Automationen und Online-Systeme ein, die du weiterentwickeln und miteinander verbinden kannst.

Langfristige Perspektive

Unsere Prozesse und Systeme entwickeln sich mit dem Unternehmen weiter.

Wir suchen daher jemanden, der unsere technische Infrastruktur langfristig kennt, Verantwortung dafür übernimmt und sie kontinuierlich verbessert.

Attraktive Vergütung

Je nach Erfahrung und Qualifikation liegt dein Gehalt bei 4.800–5.300 € brutto pro Monat.

Moderne Arbeitsplätze

Dich erwarten moderne Büroräume in Hamburg-Altona, hochwertige Arbeitsgeräte und höhenverstellbare Schreibtische.

Mitarbeitervorteile

Über unser Mitarbeiter-Benefit-System bieten wir dir verschiedene Vergünstigungen und Zuschüsse, unter anderem über Probonio.


Rahmenbedingungen

Arbeitsort: Hamburg-Altona
Beschäftigung: Vollzeit
Arbeitsmodell: vor Ort
Gehalt: 4.800–5.300 € brutto/Monat

title: Wirtschaftsprüfer als M&A-Berater (a)
descriptionHtml:
Beraten Sie Mandate im Umfeld von erfolgreichen Familienunternehmen!

Als Teil eines interdisziplinären Teams aus Wirtschafts- und Finanzberatern, Rechtsanwälten und Steuerberatern beraten Sie insb. Familienunternehmen, Vermögensverwalter und Beteiligungsgesellschaften (Family Offices, Private Equity) zu notwendigen Transaktionen und wirtschaftlichen Opportunitäten. Sie sind daher nicht bloß als unparteiischer Amtsträger sondern insb. als Parteienvertreter tätig und übernehmen umfassende umfassende Mandatsverantwortung, von der konzeptionellen Vorbereitung bis zur praktischen Umsetzung. Apropos Umsetzung: Aufgrund des integrierten Beratungsansatzes sind Sie nicht "Zulieferer" für externe Auftraggeber, sondern bringen Ihre Kenntnisse allenfalls intern, an der Schnittstelle zur Finanz-, Rechts- und Steuerberatung ein.

Die Position eignet sich für Sie, wenn Sie gerne methodisch frei an wertschöpfenden Mandaten arbeiten möchten.

Aufgaben

  • Beraten von (oft inhabergeführten) Unternehmen bzw. deren Mehrheitsgesellschaftern (oft Familienunternehmern), Beteiligungsgesellschaften und Vermögensverwaltern (oft Family Offices) sowie involvierter Erben

  • Beraten zu Unternehmensübernahmen, Spaltungen („carve out“), Verschmelzungen, Beteiligungen und Ausschlüssen („squeeze-out“), oft im Rahmen von Unternehmensnachfolgen, Umstrukturierungen, strategischen Beteiligungen und Erbschaften

  • Bewerten von Unternehmen, Teilwerten, Anlagevermögen, Sacheinlagen, Barabfindungen und Besteuerungsgrundlagen

  • Durchführen von finanziellen und steuerlichen Risikoprüfungen (financial, tax due diligence)

  • Begleiten von durch Dritte erstellte Bewertungen

  • keine Buch- und Berichtsprüfung

Anforderungen

  • Bestellung zur Wirtschaftsprüfung

  • Sichere Kenntnisse relevanter Normen und Verfahren insb. HGB, AktG, BewG, IDW S, Multiplikatoren, IFRS

  • Interesse an direkter Zusammenarbeit mit Unternehmern, Rechts- und Steuerberatern

  • Kenntnisse von Datenanalysesoftware

  • Englischkenntnisse

  • idealerweise (keine Voraussetzung) erste Kenntnisse im Projektmanagement z. B. durch Tätigkeit im Bereich Corporate Finance/Transaktionsberatung/Transaction Advisory/Services

Angebot

  • abwechslungsreiche, unternehmerische Mandate

  • keine Buch- und Berichtsprüfung

  • kollegiale und vertrauensvolle Arbeitsatmosphäre

  • überschaubare Teamgröße

  • interdisziplinäres Team

  • strukturierte und individuelle Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten

title: wo/hbo-stage vertaalbureau
descriptionHtml:
wo/hbo-praktijkstage, vanaf februari 2027

Ben jij die perfectionist met passie voor de Engelse taal?
Volg je het laatste nieuws en wil je een bijdrage leveren aan een overheidsinstantie met grote maatschappelijke relevantie?
Heb je affiniteit met wetenschappelijke artikelen en statistiek?

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Bij het CBS vormt statistisch onderzoek de basis voor alle media-uitingen. Bij het vertaalbureau komen diverse verzoeken binnen vanuit de gehele organisatie. De Engelstalige website vervult een belangrijke rol in het verspreiden van informatie onder niet-Nederlandstaligen.

Je gaat aan de slag met het vertalen en reviseren van content voor de CBS-website.

Je maakt gebruik van vertaaltools (onder andere MemoQ).

Omdat je gelijktijdig aan meerdere publicaties werkt, leer je een goede planning te maken en ervaar je hoe het is om te werken met deadlines.

Je schakelt met opdrachtgevers, een extern vertaalbureau en raadpleegt referentiemateriaal.

Onze producties zijn te vinden op https://www.cbs.nl/en-gb

Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag

Je komt in een klein team en wordt intensief begeleid. Er wordt nauw samengewerkt met o.a. het redactieteam en collega's van logistiek en planning. Daarnaast is er contact met diverse afdelingen. Het vertaalbureau levert per maand zo'n 40 producten af, waaronder nieuwsberichten, webpagina's, corporate artikelen, brieven en presentaties.

Dit breng jij mee

Je volgt een opleiding tot vertaler met als studierichting Engels, of hebt een bachelor in Engels en bent bezig met een master Vertaalkunde.
Je hebt kennis van en enige ervaring met:

  • vertaaltools (liefst MemoQ);

  • vakontwikkelingen op het gebied van AI;

  • Microsoft Word, Excel en Adobe Acrobat;

  • Sociale media (LinkedIn).

Ook volg je het nieuws en de achtergronden in de media.

In deze stage krijg je de ruimte om je nauwkeurigheid, communicatieve vaardigheden en initiatief te laten zien. Je werkt graag samen, houdt overzicht en kunt goed omgaan met verschillende taken en veranderingen. Je bent flexibel, georganiseerd en zorgt ervoor dat afspraken en deadlines worden nagekomen. Samenwerken en resultaatgericht werken staan daarbij centraal.

Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk.

Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je:

  • leert om heldere vertalingen te maken die feitelijk en objectief zijn;

  • jouw Engelse (vertaal)vaardigheden verbetert en werkervaring met vertaaltools opdoet;

  • ervaart hoe het is om in teamverband te werken en om te gaan met deadlines.

Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week).

Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken.

Dit zijn onze voorwaarden

Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken.
Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking.

title: Workday Consultant - Automation & AI (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.

You will join Flix's People & Organization Digital Transformation team as a technically hands-on Business Analyst, bridging HR operations, Workday and emerging AI and automation technologies.

You will understand how HR processes work end to end, identify opportunities to simplify and automate them, and turn business challenges into practical technology solutions.

Beyond gathering requirements, you will help build and deploy workflows, integrations and AI-enabled tools, while supporting Workday tech operations and process optimization in close collaboration with our internal Workday technology team and FlixTech.

The role reports to the Head of Digital Transformation and collaborates with HR process owners, People Operations, Workday Tech team, FlixTech, IT Security and Data Privacy teams globally.

This role is based in Berlin (hybrid model).

About the Role

  • Analyze and optimize HR processes across the hire-to-retire lifecycle, working with People Operations and process owners to identify inefficiencies, conduct as-is/to-be gap analyses and translate requirements into practical Workday, automation and AI solutions
  • Support hands-on Workday operations and optimization, including approved HRIS transactions, organizational and position management, data maintenance, EIB uploads and functional testing, working within established security and governance frameworks
  • Design, build and maintain automation workflows using n8n, UiPath, Python and GenAI/LLM technologies, including MCPs, custom connectors, exception handling, monitoring and operational support.
  • Build and deploy AI-powered HR tools and internal applications, including Claude-based apps, with appropriate authentication, role-based access, data privacy and governance in collaboration with FlixTech and IT Security.
  • Drive business analysis and technical delivery from requirements and process design through prototyping, integration specifications, SIT/UAT, implementation and adoption, collaborating with Workday tech team on Workday configuration and technical integrations
  • Develop HR technology products and service-delivery solutions using Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence and Rovo Agents, improving employee and HR experiences through workflow automation, self-service and continuous product improvement

Most HR analyst roles stop at scoping requirements and handing them over. This one doesn't. You will keep Workday running for HR day to day, shape how our processes work in Workday, and build the automation and AI that removes manual work. You'll be the person the People function brings its problems to, and you'll help define how AI & Automation is adopted responsibly across HR at scale.

About You

  • 5+ years of experience in HR technology, HR business analysis, HRIS or automation, with strong operational HR domain knowledge across the hire-to-retire lifecycle
  • Strong understanding of Workday Core HCM, business processes, organizational structures, security concepts and HRIS governance, including practical experience with Workday optimization, operational transactions, reporting, data maintenance or EIBs. A Workday (e.g. Core HCM) certification is preferred
  • Strong business analysis skills: gap analysis between as-is Workday processes and feasible to-be processes, requirements engineering, BPMN, and the ability to explain clearly to both HR and technical colleagues what is possible and what is not
  • Strong hands-on programming and automation experience, particularly Python, n8n, UiPath or comparable tools, with proven experience building, troubleshooting and maintaining production workflows. N8n certification is a strong plus
  • A solid understanding of various integration approaches e.g. APIs, custom connectors and enterprise integrations, including REST APIs, SFTP, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, to specify integration requirements for tech teams to ensure secure data exchange between HRIS and other enterprise systems
  • Hands-on knowledge of the Atlassian ecosystem, including Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence and Rovo agents, together with experience building AI-enabled tools using Claude MCP, GenAI/LLMs or similar technologies and applying appropriate security controls
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work independently across HR and technology teams

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills.
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Workday Financial Systems Architect
descriptionHtml:
Hi! We are AMBOSS and we are looking for a Financial Systems Architect to join our team, and shape the future of medical education with us!

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering medical professionals globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.”

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique.


Why Systems at AMBOSS?

AMBOSS runs on a growing landscape of business systems: Workday as the ERP at the center, connected to Stripe, HubSpot, Pleo, Avalara, our banks, payroll and archiving. The Systems team, part of Data & Systems, makes this landscape develop as a whole: every problem solved in the system where it belongs, and processes that run smoothly from order to cash and from purchase to payment. Our expertise is platform-independent: accounting logic, process design, integration patterns and systems thinking. Working side by side with Finance, Accounting, Commercial, Data and IT, we support AMBOSS in pursuing its mission: empowering medical professionals worldwide to provide the best possible care.

Why can this position be exciting for you?

You are the technical owner of Workday Financials at AMBOSS: you take the tenant over from our implementation partner and run it. Some days that means a configuration fix before the close, other days the design of a new integration or the assessment of a new module.

You are the expert and advisor for everything Workday. Our Business Systems Manager owns the roadmap, stakeholder coordination and partner management and works with you day to day.

This is a senior individual contributor role: you build and own Workday the way a senior engineer owns a production system. It is not an administrator role with a ticket queue.

Where we are

Workday Financials goes live in November 2026 as our ERP for three entities in Germany, the US and Italy. Around twelve integrations connect it to the rest of the landscape, and they are the most demanding part of it. You join during hypercare and the first closes in Workday, with the first year-end close and statutory audit ahead.

You will:

  • Own the tenant technically. Configuration and business processes across record-to-report (General Ledger), procure-to-pay (Accounts Payable), order-to-cash (Accounts Receivable) and bank connectivity (Banking & Settlement), the security model and the financial data model.

  • Take over from the implementation partner. Review, document and harden what was delivered, close the gaps and bring run responsibility in-house as early as possible after go-live. Where we still use consultants, you set the technical standard and review their work.

  • Own the Workday side of every integration. Design and build the EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio integrations, web services and RaaS reports behind each interface and agree the interface contracts with our Data Platform engineers, who build and run the pipelines around the tenant.

  • Advise Accounting and Finance. Translate requirements into system design, say clearly what Workday can and cannot do and advise where in the landscape a problem is best solved.

  • Run it like a production system. Tier 2/3 support with root-cause fixes, testing discipline (unit, regression, UAT), the two Workday releases a year and a change log with configuration documentation. You enable the accounting stream leads who handle first-line questions.

  • Build the reports, dashboards and calculated fields that Finance and leadership rely on, and make them self-serve where possible.

  • Be the technical expert on expansions. HCM, treasury, automated VAT reporting and global payroll off DATEV: assess feasibility, design the solution and configure it.

You bring:

  • Workday Financials depth. 5+ years hands-on, including at least one full implementation and the post-go-live ownership of a tenant (hypercare, first closes, releases).

  • Configuration expertise. Core modules (GL, AP, AR, Banking & Settlement), the business process framework, configurable security and the financial data model (FDM, worktags).

  • Reporting. Custom and matrix reports, calculated fields and BIRT.

  • Systems thinking. Experience connecting SaaS business systems (APIs, integration patterns) and the habit of thinking in end-to-end processes across tools.

  • Accounting understanding. Chart of accounts, period close, reconciliations and audit requirements.

  • Engineering mindset. Structured troubleshooting to the root cause, disciplined testing and documentation that others can use.

  • Communication. Excellent English: precise with engineers, plain with finance colleagues.

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with Workday integration tooling: EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio, web services, RaaS and XSLT

  • Proficiency in German

  • Workday Pro certification in Financials or Integrations

  • Multi-entity, multi-currency or multi-GAAP experience (IFRS alongside local GAAP); experience with tax and e-invoicing platforms such as Avalara

  • Accounting Center, Prism Analytics, Extend or Orchestrate

  • A Workday consulting or CoE background

  • A formal accounting background (degree, CPA or equivalent) or experience with internal controls and SOX in a Workday context

You enjoy:

  • Owning a system end to end. Taking over a freshly built tenant and knowing it better than anyone else in the company within months.

  • Depth you can explain. You do the hard configuration and integration work yourself, and you explain the result to accountants and engineers in language each of them understands.

  • Getting the details right where they matter. Financial systems punish sloppiness: a misconfigured business process or a broken integration shows up in the books. You can tell a load-bearing detail (audit trail, data integrity, reconciliations) from polish that can wait.

  • Working like an engineer. You bring testing, documentation and versioned change into Workday and use modern tooling, including AI assistants, to move faster. When a release or a new module moves the ground, you question your own setup first.

What success looks like after your first year:

  • The tenant runs without the implementation partner.

  • The integrations run reliably through every month-end and year-end close: data lands in Workday without manual intervention, and monitoring catches failures before Accounting does.

  • The first year-end close and statutory audit in Workday are done with you answering the auditors' system questions, and two Workday releases are handled end to end.

  • Accounting and Finance treat you as the expert and advisor for everything Workday: requirements are shaped with you from the start, and your call on how a process should run in the system is the one they act on.

Benefits:

🌴 Rest & Time Off (30 paid vacation days, AMBOSS holiday, personal purpose day and more)

🥙Food & Office Comfort (Daily healthy breakfast & lunch by in-house chef in Berlin HQ, AMBOSS daycare, work remotely from other office spaces in Cologne, Sardinia, Cape Town)

🏃 Health, Fitness & Mobility (Urban Sports Club -M plan- , Fitbit Versa 3, Deutschland Ticket…)

title: Workforce & Business Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Build with us

Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

Your impact

The Planning & Analysis domain empowers the organisation with accurate, granular insights and drives proactive decision making that stays aligned with our growth plans and cost envelope.

This role is fundamental in connecting long term workforce strategy to daily execution. You will translate hiring, attrition and spend signals into clear guidance for the People & Places (P&P) team, talent acquisition and the business leaders they support.

You will be the trusted business partner and numbers person for P&P leadership, helping them prioritise where to focus and how to measure success.

What you'll ship

  • Own how Mollie tracks, measures and forecasts headcount, including the headcount model, hiring plan, attrition and open role view, and the link between headcount and budget.

  • Lead the analytical response to our most important workforce questions, such as sizing hiring needs, stress testing plan assumptions, and building the case for new teams and locations.

  • Build and own models that break headcount and people cost down into their key drivers (hiring pace, attrition, mix, seniority, location), giving P&P and senior leaders the visibility to prioritise and act with confidence.

  • Walk P&P through the trends in people data and the story behind them, including spend and other relevant metrics such as People OPEX, Places costs and vendor spend.

  • Own the people and headcount view end to end in our monthly business reviews and in the annual planning cycle.

What you'll bring

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in FP&A, workforce planning or people analytics, ideally within a high growth fintech, tech or payments company. Your academic background is in a quantitative or business field.

  • You are very comfortable using AI tooling in your daily work, and this is a must. You use it to accelerate your output, pressure test your thinking, automate recurring work and remove the grunt work that gets in the way of insight.

  • Strong modelling skills in Google Sheets or Excel, and familiarity with HRIS and data visualisation tools (HiBob, Workday, Omni or similar). You can reason about headcount, attrition, cost per head and hiring funnel metrics without the concepts needing to be explained.

  • Experience with Pigment, our planning tool, or with a comparable planning platform (Anaplan, Adaptive, or similar).

  • You are action oriented by nature. Your analysis does not stop at describing what happened. You formulate a recommendation and stand behind it.

  • You handle sensitive people data with discretion and good judgement.

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

title: Working Student Client Experience (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

 

About the role:

Germany's private pension system is being rebuilt from the ground up. From 1 January 2027, the Altersvorsorgedepot (AVD) replaces the Riester-Rente as the country's state-subsidised private pension and Upvest is building the operational infrastructure that lets fintechs and banks offer it to millions of savers.

Join us as a Working Student in Client Experience and you'll be there before Day 1: helping design the processes, then running them once they go live. This is a rare chance to see a regulated financial product being built from a blank page, rather than inheriting one that already works.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Support our clients: Our partners' support teams field questions from their end-users about subsidies, transfers and payouts. You'll help prepare clear, accurate answers and learn to translate dense regulation into language a customer can act on.

  • Support day-to-day AVD operations: Help run the core processes that keep the product working, e.g. contract registration with the ZfA (Zentrale Zulagenstelle für Altersvermögen), contribution management, the annual bonus application (AZ01), and payment reconciliation. You'll learn how a state-subsidised pension product actually functions behind the interface.

  • Help build the playbooks: As we prepare for launch, we're writing the processes from scratch. You'll help document workflows, build step-by-step guides and error catalogues, and keep them current as the rules and our systems evolve; the foundations the team will scale on.

  • Support error handling and reconciliation: Work through recurring error cases from the ZfA, check that payments and records match, and help spot the patterns behind repeat issues so they can be fixed at the root rather than one at a time.

  • Spot what should be better: You'll see every manual workaround first-hand. We want your view on what's slow, error-prone, or worth automating; and you'll have the room to say so.

 

What you bring:

  • Fluent German communication skills (B2/C1), along with comfortable working proficiency in English This one is a hard requirement rather than a nice-to-have: the regulation, the correspondence with the ZfA, and most of the documentation you'll work with day to day are all in German.

  • You're structured and genuinely precise. In this role, small details carry real consequences for someone's pension, and you're the kind of person who notices when a number doesn't add up.

  • You're curious about rules rather than put off by them. You're willing to read the actual regulation to understand why a process works the way it does.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. The product is brand new, so some answers don't exist yet; you'll ask good questions instead of waiting for perfect instructions.

  • You're confident with spreadsheets and AI tooling. Any prior exposure to financial services, operations or a regulated environment is a bonus, but not required.

  • You're available for a minimum of 6 months and based in Berlin.

 

How we Upvest in you:

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

 

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Working Student - Customer Care (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Instagrid, you are part of the clean-tech revolution by bringing pure energy into your region, helping professional workers transitioning away from combustion generators and making it possible for them to experience a safe, efficient, clean and silent energy solution.

Your Mission

Instagrid builds portable battery power systems for trades and pros. Our Pilot Fleet is how customers try them out before they buy. As a Working Student in Customer Care, you keep that fleet running. You handle demo requests, shipments, returns, check-ups, service and upgrades, and you support the team with everyday tickets and Salesforce-based Order-to-Cash processes.

You’ve done a great job when demo units are ready whenever Sales needs them, turnaround times stay short, the pool data in Salesforce and NetSuite is accurate, and our monthly fleet analytics give Customer Care and Sales leads a clear view of utilization and demo-to-order conversion.

Your Impact

  • Pilot requests: Receive, review and prioritize incoming demo requests, confirm unit availability and maintain an accurate Pilot Fleet inventory

  • Fulfillment: Prepare, pack and dispatch pilot units with the appropriate accessories, issue shipping and return documentation and track each unit from dispatch through to return

  • Communication: Maintain close contact with the Sales team and customers to ensure seamless delivery and pickup

  • Inspection and service: Coordinate inspections and functional tests of returned units with the Service team and schedule repairs and upgrades to bring units back into circulation quickly

  • Analytics: Maintain Pilot Fleet reporting (utilization, turnaround time, demo-to-order conversion, fleet condition) and prepare monthly insights for Customer Care and Sales leads

  • Process improvement: Identify friction points in the demo process, propose solutions and help document standard procedures in Confluence

  • Customer Care support: Support the team with day-to-day support tickets and Salesforce-based Order-to-Cash processing

  • Enablement: Support all stakeholders involved through structured documentation and process support

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Logistics, Supply Chain Management or a comparable field

  • Availability of 16–20 hours per week during the semester, with increased capacity during semester breaks, on-site in Ludwigsburg

  • A hands-on, structured approach to work and a strong sense of ownership for maintaining a physical fleet and the data that supports it

  • Proficiency in working with AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT)

  • Dependable and self-motivated, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent requests effectively

  • Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Nice to have: German language skills and initial exposure to enterprise software (Jira, Salesforce, NetSuite)

Your Benefits

  • Real ownership: from day one, the live Pilot Fleet is yours to run, with real responsibility instead of busywork

  • Flexibility for your studies: working hours coordinated around your lectures and exams

  • Broad experience: learn how a hardware company works end to end, from customer care and sales to service and operations

  • Hands-on tool skills: work with Salesforce, NetSuite, Jira and Confluence in a real business setting

  • Direct access to a lean, senior team: honest feedback, and room to push back and make your ideas count

  • Time to recharge: generous holiday entitlement plus additional special leave days, on a pro-rata basis

This is Instagrid

Pure instant power. Anywhere. We have created the world’s most advanced portable power supplies, bringing freedom to the way our customers work. With you we want to shape a world where advanced technology meets environmental responsibility and create lasting impact. Driven by our curiosity and the desire to leave tomorrow's world cleaner than we found it yesterday. Join us in transitioning away from combustion generators to a cleaner alternative for fast, measurable, and real outcomes. What we’ve achieved so far is just the beginning.

title: Working Student (m/w/d) - Cyber Security Engineering
descriptionHtml:
As a leading global software product company in Compliance & Automation, IMTF Group develops innovative RegTech solutions focusing on Anti-Money Laundering, Know Your Customer, and Anti-Fraud. Our technology helps financial institutions fight financial crime and meet demanding regulatory requirements.

At IMTF, we value innovation, technical excellence, and continuous learning. We encourage our teams to explore new technologies, challenge existing approaches, and continuously improve how we develop and deliver secure software.

As a Working Student in Cyber Security Engineering, you will join our Research & Development organization and help improve the security tools we develop and use internally. You will work on vulnerability scanners, security automation, and supporting software that helps us identify, assess, and address security risks across our products.

This is a hands-on software engineering role where you can apply your academic knowledge to real-world security challenges.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and enhance our internal security tools, including vulnerability scanners and automated security checks
  • Improve vulnerability detection, analysis, and reporting to deliver accurate and actionable security findings
  • Help automate security assessments of applications, dependencies, containers, and infrastructure
  • Contribute to tools and processes for software supply chain security, including SBOM and vulnerability management
  • Research emerging vulnerabilities, attack techniques, and security technologies and evaluate their relevance to our software
  • Integrate security tools and automated checks into our development and CI/CD workflows
  • Collaborate with software engineers to improve the effectiveness and reliability of our security tooling
  • Explore opportunities to leverage AI and automation to make security analysis more efficient

Requirements

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Cyber Security, IT Security, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
  • Basic programming skills, preferably in Python, and an interest in developing real-world software
  • Foundational understanding of IT security, networking, operating systems, and common software vulnerabilities
  • Interest in vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, and DevSecOps practices
  • Familiarity with Linux, Git, or container technologies is an advantage
  • Curiosity about security tools, automation, and emerging technologies
  • Analytical thinking, strong problem-solving skills, and a hands-on approach
  • Interest in using modern AI-assisted development tools
  • Ability to work independently while actively collaborating with a development team
  • Good communication skills in English; German language skills are an advantage

Previous professional experience in Cyber Security is not required. We value curiosity, practical problem-solving skills, and a willingness to learn.

Benefits

  • Make the World Safer: Help us strengthen the security of software used to combat financial crime
  • Be Part of an Established RegTech: Gain practical experience at an international Swiss software company
  • Hands-on Engineering: Work on real security software and contribute improvements that make a measurable difference
  • Ownership and Development: Take responsibility for your work, learn from experienced engineers, and develop your technical skills
  • Paid Further Education: Benefit from opportunities to expand your knowledge and professional capabilities
  • International Exposure: Collaborate with colleagues across different countries and engineering disciplines

The anticipated salary for this Working Student - Cyber Engineering position in Germany is EUR 18,000 gross per year, based on a 20-hour working week (50% employment level).

At IMTF, we are committed to treating all candidates with respect and equality, regardless of gender, religion, nationality, or any other characteristic. We embrace diversity and inclusion as integral parts of our organizational culture and welcome candidates from all backgrounds.

title: Working Student Data Engineer – Python, SQL & Cloud Platforms
descriptionHtml:
IMPORTANT Application note

Please apply only through this job portal. Kindly do not send applications or recruitment messages by email or LinkedIn. Only applications submitted through the portal will be considered. Thank you.

About AgentixLake

AgentixLake GmbH is a Data and AI engineering consultancy based in Hamburg, Germany. We design, build and operate production-grade data platforms and AI systems in our customers’ cloud accounts or on-premises environments. We are an AWS Services Partner and a Certified Services Partner in Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network. Our commercial focus is DACH and the Gulf region, alongside selected international opportunities.

Your role

Build the pipelines and data models that people can depend on. You will own defined components of our data engineering projects, from understanding a source system to delivering tested transformations and monitoring how they run.

Our data platform engineering work connects operational systems with analytics and AI applications. Depending on the project, you will work with cloud warehouses, lakehouse architectures and the data quality and reliability practices that support production use.

What you will do

Build Python and SQL pipelines to ingest and transform data from APIs, databases, files or event sources.

Develop data models and dbt transformations with clear definitions, tests and documentation.

Implement incremental processing, schema checks and reconciliation so changes and data issues are visible.

Configure orchestration and monitoring; investigate failed runs and improve recovery and troubleshooting.

Contribute to cloud data platform components, infrastructure configuration and deployment workflows.

Use Git, pull requests and code review to deliver maintainable changes and explain their impact on downstream users.

What you bring

Current university enrolment in computer science, data science, business informatics or a related technical discipline.

Strong SQL and practical Python, supported by pipelines or data models you have built and maintained for actual users or team workflows.

A sound understanding of data modelling, incremental loads, data quality and the operational behaviour of scheduled pipelines.

Experience with version control and testing, plus practical exposure to a cloud platform, warehouse or orchestration tool.

The ability to own a well-scoped deliverable, investigate problems systematically and communicate clearly in English.

Experience with dbt, Airflow, Dagster, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Apache Iceberg or Terraform is valuable. You do not need experience with every technology; show us where you have developed depth.

What you can expect

You will work on data systems with clear users and delivery requirements, collaborate directly with experienced engineers and the founders, and receive substantive code review. Your part-time responsibilities and schedule will be planned around your studies.

How to apply

Use the Apply button on this page to submit your CV, current study details, location and weekly availability. Describe one pipeline or data model you delivered, the decisions you owned and how you tested or improved its reliability. An anonymised example is welcome; please do not share confidential client material.

We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If the core responsibilities match your experience, we would like to hear from you.

Stay connected

Follow AgentixLake on LinkedIn for practical engineering insights, project updates and future opportunities. Following is optional and does not influence recruitment decisions.

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/agentixlakegmbh/

Website: https://agentixlake.com/

title: Working Student - LLM Inference Performance
descriptionHtml:
About Tensordyne 

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

About the Role

How fast should an LLM building block run on our hardware? How fast does it actually run, and what would make it faster?

As a Working Student, LLM Inference Performance, you'll help answer these questions by working directly with our hardware and software engineering teams.

You'll write and optimize low-level kernels, benchmark performance on real silicon, and develop profiling tools that help engineers understand and improve LLM inference performance.

You'll gain hands-on experience with our Rust programming stack and Python SDK, use AI coding agents as part of your development workflow, and collaborate closely with engineers working on compilers, runtimes, and kernel optimization.

This is an opportunity to apply your academic knowledge to real-world AI hardware challenges while taking ownership of meaningful technical projects.

What You'll Do

  • Understand our hardware: Learn how Tensordyne silicon processes data, manages memory, and synchronizes operations, and how key LLM components such as attention, MLP, and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routing map onto the architecture..

  • Develop and optimize kernels: Implement, test, and tune low-level kernels to improve the performance of LLM inference workloads..

  • Analyze performance: Build analytical and roofline performance models, compare predictions against simulator and real-silicon measurements, and investigate performance bottlenecks..

  • Build benchmarking and profiling tools: Develop benchmark harnesses, profiling scripts, and trace visualizations that make performance easier to measure, understand, and improve..

  • Work with AI coding agents: Explore workflows where AI agents assist with kernel development, optimization, and benchmarking, and identify the tools and context they need to work effectively..

  • Collaborate across engineering teams: Work closely with compiler, runtime, and kernel engineers to translate performance insights into practical improvements..

Example project: Develop a benchmarking and profiling harness for an LLM building block, such as decode attention, at two abstraction levels. Compare measured performance against theoretical estimates and make the tooling accessible to AI coding agents.

What We're Looking For

  • Currently enrolled in a Master's degree program in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field..

  • Strong programming skills in Python and at least one of C, C++, or Rust..

  • Understanding of computer architecture, memory systems, bandwidth, and parallel computing through academic coursework or personal projects..

  • Interest in low-level programming, hardware performance, and optimization..

  • Practical experience using AI coding agents in development workflows, with the ability to evaluate and improve their output..

  • An experimental mindset, with the ability to form hypotheses, analyze measurements, and communicate technical findings clearly..

  • Curiosity, initiative, and enthusiasm for learning new technologies..

Nice to Have

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be a plus:

  • GPU or AI accelerator programming..

  • Embedded systems or bare-metal programming..

  • Performance profiling, benchmarking, or optimization..

  • LLM inference fundamentals and architectures..

Why Join Tensordyne?

  • Work on cutting-edge AI technology: Contribute to the development of next-generation AI inference hardware and software..

  • Gain hands-on experience: Apply your university knowledge to real silicon and challenging engineering problems..

  • Own meaningful projects: Build tools and solutions that directly support our engineering teams..

  • Learn from experienced engineers: Work alongside specialists in hardware architecture, compilers, runtimes, and performance optimization..

  • Explore AI-assisted development: Gain practical experience building with AI coding agents and shaping how they interact with advanced hardware systems..

  • Make a lasting impact: Help develop performance tools and workflows that will support both current and future generations of Tensordyne technology..

Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values

  • Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed.
  • Ethics and integrity always. Be open, honest, and respectful of everyone.
  • Think Big. Be ambitious and have audacious goals.
  • Aim for excellence. Quality and excellence count in everything we do.
  • Own it and get it done. Results matter!
  • Make each person better together than they would be as an individual.
  • Embrace each other’s differences, and embrace that there will be differences.

Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams are better equipped to solve complex problems and build exceptional technology. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

A note to recruitment agencies: Please do not contact Tensordyne employees or leaders regarding this role. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees associated with unsolicited submissions.

About Tensordyne 

Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

The Opportunity

At Tensordyne, we are at the forefront of cutting-edge AI hardware and software solutions. To keep pace in this dynamic, interdisciplinary field, we are seeking a Working Student in ML Compiler Engineering to contribute to the development of compilers for our custom ASICs.

This role offers an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on experience in full-stack compiler engineering while working alongside a team of experts in a fast-paced, innovative environment. If you are passionate about machine learning compilers, numerical programming, and performance optimization, we’d love to hear from you!

As a working student, you’ll gain valuable experience in a dynamic and innovative environment that thrives on curiosity and collaboration. This part-time role (20 hours per week) is based on-site at our Munich office..

  • Solid understanding of graph theory and graph algorithms.

title: Quality & Data Intern (m/f/d) – Mandatory Internship / Prácticas
descriptionHtml:
About JawBuddy

JawBuddy helps people with jaw pain, teeth grinding and TMJ problems through a guided exercise app. Our app measures jaw movement through the phone camera using computer vision and AR, so users see their progress in real numbers.

We are a small, funded health-tech team with paying customers in Germany. Next up: a B2B platform release in early 2027.

How this internship works

We offer this role in exactly two ways:

  • Mandatory internship at an EU university: you are enrolled at a university in the EU and your study regulations require an internship. You send us a document from your university that confirms this. Start as soon as possible.

  • Prácticas at a Spanish university: you are enrolled at a university in Spain, and the internship runs through your university's internship agreement (prácticas extracurriculares with a convenio), full-time or alongside your studies. Start from December 2026.

We can't offer working-student contracts, voluntary internships or freelance work.

The role

You make sure our app and our numbers can be trusted, and you use AI to do it at a scale one person couldn't before. AI handles the repetitive checks; you handle what needs human judgment, like testing our camera features in the real world. You work directly with our CTO and founding engineer.

  • About 60 % app and computer vision quality: real-world testing, releases, accessibility, performance

  • About 25 % data quality: making sure analytics data is complete and correct

  • About 15 % automation with AI: building automated tests and checks, and reviewing what they find

What you'll do

Test our computer vision in the real world

  • Test camera-based jaw tracking across devices, lighting, faces, glasses and beards

  • Find the conditions where measurements break, and help the team fix them

Own app quality

  • Own the release checklist for every iOS and Android build

  • Test accessibility, German texts, performance, slow networks and offline use

  • Write clear bug reports in Linear, with steps to reproduce and evidence

  • Keep test evidence documented, as our product requires

Keep our data trustworthy

  • Review the daily data-quality checks across Amplitude, AppsFlyer, RevenueCat and BigQuery, and investigate what they flag

  • Find out why two tools disagree, and get it fixed

  • Keep our tracking plan in sync with what the app actually sends

Automate with AI

  • Use AI tools to write automated tests (Maestro), generate test cases and run checks

  • Review what AI produces: you are the person who decides whether it is right

What you bring

  • Enrolled at an EU university with a mandatory internship in your study regulations, or at a Spanish university that signs a convenio for prácticas

  • Available 20 to 40 hours a week, remote, as your university allows

  • Fluent in English (the app is in German; the team works in English)

  • Solid SQL

  • A structured, curious way of testing: you find the edge cases others miss

  • You already use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or similar) in your daily work

Nice to have

  • Test automation (Maestro, Detox, Appium)

  • Accessibility (WCAG, VoiceOver, TalkBack)

  • Product analytics (Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4) or attribution (AppsFlyer)

  • dbt or Dataform, Git, Python

  • Interest in computer vision, health tech or medical device quality

What we offer

  • Compensation: €300 per month

  • Real ownership: you own the release checklist, and when you say a build isn't ready, we listen

  • Work with AI from day one: you learn how to run quality at scale with AI, a skill few people have yet

  • Rare experience: computer vision, health data and quality in a health product, all in one role

  • Mentorship: a weekly 1:1 with our CTO

  • Hours that fit your studies: 20 to 40 hours a week, as your university requires

How we hire

  1. Send your CV and your university document (internship requirement, or confirmation that your university can sign a convenio).

  2. A 30-minute call with our team.

  3. A short trial task: we send you a test build of the app, and you spend about 2 hours finding and reporting what's wrong. Use any AI tools you like.

  4. A final conversation, and an offer within a week.

Details

  • Type: mandatory internship (EU university) or prácticas (Spanish university)

  • Hours: 20–40 per week, depending on your university

  • Location: remote within the EU

  • Compensation: €300 per month

  • Start: as soon as possible; prácticas in Spain from December 2026

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

The Space Operations team is crucial to Planet's success, responsible for maintaining and optimizing the health and productivity of the world's largest Earth Observation satellite constellation. descriptionHtml:
💬 Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS.

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book,which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

We don't just run people processes — we design, challenge, and rethink them.

Today, Joko is 100+ people across Paris, Barcelona, and New York, and we are set to grow to 200+ within 18 months. That kind of growth only holds up if the office, the rituals, and the daily fabric of the company scale with it — which is where the Workplace Manager comes in.

🎯 What you will do

As Workplace Manager, your mission is to make Joko a place people genuinely love coming to every day, and to hold our culture together as we double in size. You will report to the VP People and partner closely with the rest of the People team, Finance, and Legal.

You will manage service providers, supplies, and facilities, keep the space impeccable and organized, and be the first point of contact for anything office-related.   • Bring the team together through events: From All Hands to Joko Academies, Team Events, Joko Drinks, offsites, and our legendary Christmas Party, you will design and run each gathering so it is not just well-organized, but a genuine moment of connection. As we grow into an international company, you will make sure our rituals scale with us and keep bringing the team together across geographies.

You will run the process from employment contract to IT setup to team introductions to custom Joko goodies, so every new hire lands seamlessly and feels welcome from day one.

  • Hold the culture as we scale: Doubling in size is precisely when a company culture can slip. The office you run, the events you design, and the way new joiners are welcomed are where Joko's culture gets rebuilt every day. You will be one of the people who keeps Joko Joko as we grow.

  • Keep admin and compliance airtight: You will track expenses, make sure invoices are recorded correctly for our accounting team, and partner with Finance and Legal on our compliance routines so nothing falls through the cracks.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have 3+ years in Workplace, Office Management, People Operations, Event Management, or a similar role, ideally in a fast-growing tech company. You have already owned an office and a set of team rituals end-to-end — you know what it takes to make them impeccable, not just functional.

  • Ownership mindset: You take full ownership of your scope, from strategy down to the smallest detail, and run complex projects from start to finish with little supervision.

  • Attention to detail: You spot what others miss. A crooked frame, a missing supply, a rough onboarding email — none of it gets past you, because you know these details are what people actually feel.

  • Organized and efficient: You are structured, calm under pressure, and excellent at juggling many priorities without dropping any of them. You care about deadlines and you meet them.

  • Interpersonal skills: You build strong relationships across the team and foster a real sense of belonging. People feel comfortable coming to you, and you make them feel taken care of.

  • Confident communicator: You are comfortable engaging with the team every day and speaking in front of large groups when the moment calls for it.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset: You thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments. You welcome feedback, you go the extra mile by default, and you are not afraid of taking initiative on topics that were not in your job description.

  • Location: Based in Paris.

  • Languages: You are fluent in French and English (our working language).

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen mit gewichtsbedingten Erkrankungen. Für viele ist Gewichtsverlust ein Ziel, doch unser Ansatz geht weit darüber hinaus: Wir helfen, die Gesundheit zu verbessern, Selbstvertrauen aufzubauen und die Lebensqualität zu steigern.

Wir haben bereits über eine Million Menschen in der Schweiz, Deutschland, Polen und Grossbritannien unterstützt – und wir stehen erst am Anfang. Jedes Gespräch, jedes Coaching und jede Zeile Code bringt uns einer gesünderen Zukunft näher. Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte diese Zukunft aktiv mit.

Dein Verantwortungsbereich

Als Graduate / des. Ernährungsberater*in machst du dich Schritt für Schritt mit dem Arbeitsalltag einer Fachperson im ambulanten Beratungssetting vertraut und baust deine Handlungskompetenz kontinuierlich auf:

  • Ambulante Ernährungstherapie: Du führst Beratungen von Erwachsenen, Kindern und Jugendlichen durch – zunächst eng begleitet vor Ort in unseren Partnerpraxen und digital, später eigenständig mit Vor- und Nachbesprechungen (Praxisauslastung ca. 1–4 Beratungen pro Halbtag).

  • Zuweisermanagement & Vernetzung: Du arbeitest interprofessionell mit Ärzt*innen sowie medizinischem Praxispersonal zusammen, stärkst Beziehungen und unterstützt bei der Gewinnung und Entwicklung regionaler Partnerpraxen.

  • Wissensvermittlung: Du konzipierst und führst Fachwebinare (z. B. für MPA) durch und hältst praxisnahe Vorträge an Fachveranstaltungen sowie internen Weiterbildungen.

  • Qualität & Projekte: Du erstellst und überarbeitest hochwertige Beratungshilfsmittel, nimmst regelmässig an internen Fallbesprechungen teil und unterstützt bei regionalen Marketingprojekten.

  • Office-Präsenz: Jeden Mittwoch bist du vor Ort in unserem Büro in Zürich präsent, tauschst dich mit anderen Graduates aus und vertiefst dein Netzwerk.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ausbildung: Du stehst kurz vor dem Abschluss deines Bachelorstudiums (des. Ernährungsberater*in BSc) an einer Fachhochschule (z. B. BFH) in Ernährung und Diätetik.

  • Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest selbständig, flexibel und bist top organisiert.

  • Begeisterung: Du hast Freude an der persönlichen sowie digitalen Patient*innenbegleitung und bist offen für unterschiedliche Fach- und Indikationsgebiete.

  • Standort-Flexibilität: Du arbeitest flexibel im Homeoffice sowie digital, bist jedoch jeden Mittwoch verbindlich vor Ort in unserem Office in Zürich.

  • Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift setzen wir voraus; gute Englischkenntnisse sowie weitere Sprachen sind ein grosses Plus.
